Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Dip chicken in Italian dressing, then bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Add a layer of Mozzarella cheese the last few minutes (3 to 5) of cooking.
Cook jar of spaghetti sauce over low heat.
Add onion and garlic clove.
Remove when finished cooking.
Cook spaghetti noodles.
Prepare plate.

title: Simple Cherry-Pineapple Crisp
steps: Spread crushed pineapple in the bottom of baking dish. Spread cherry pie filling over the pineapple.
Spread yellow cake mix over pineapple and cherry filling.
Melt margarine and drizzle over the other ingredients.
Bake at 350° until golden brown on top.

title: Wacky Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cherry Torte
steps: Spread out on cookie sheet and make edges up side.
Cover with cherry pie filling.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add 6 tablespoons sugar.
Cover filling and sprinkle with ground nuts. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Red Raspberry Cordial
steps: In a 1-gallon jar fitted with a lid, combine the raspberries, sugar and the gin.
Stir the mixture well.
Secure the lid.
Let mixture stand, stirring it once a week, for 4 months.
Strain the mixture through a cheesecloth lined sieve into a pitcher, pressing hard on the solids.
Return it to the jar.
Makes about 4 cups.

title: Pavlova(Australia'S National Dessert)
steps: Line cookie sheet with wax paper; grease lightly.
Draw 8-inch circle in middle of sheet.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add salt and cream of tartar; beat until stiff, glossy peaks form.
Add sugar gradually; beat 2 minutes.

title: Lazy Day Chicken

ingredients.name: hunt s special chunky tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 can Hunt's Special chunky tomato sauce

ingredients.name: instant beef flavored broth mix
ingredients.raw: 1 packet instant beef flavored broth mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place chicken in baking pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray.
In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 30 minutes.
Remove cover; continue baking 30 minutes longer.

title: Frito Salad
steps: Drain beans.
Mix all ingredients together, except Fritos. Add Fritos just before serving.

title: Marinated Beef Slices

ingredients.name: sirloin
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. cooked sirloin or roast beef (rare)

ingredients.name: onion and separated in ring
ingredients.raw: 1 onion, thinly sliced and separated in rings

steps: Slice meat in julienne strips.
Add sliced onion, salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle lemon juice over mixture and mix in sour cream.
Chill well.
Serve in crystal bowl with crackers. Great appetizer!

title: Chicken And Stuffing Bake

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cut cooked chicken or turkey

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Place chicken in ungreased 2-quart casserole or 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Toss croutons, celery and onion with the 1/2 cup water and the margarine until croutons are moistened.
Reserve about 1 1/2 cups of this stuffing.
Spread remaining stuffing over chicken.
Mix soup with 1 1/2 cups water; pour over stuffing.
Top with reserved stuffing.
Cook, uncovered, in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Linguine Salad
steps: For option, try broccoli.
Mix all together.

title: Meltaways
steps: Mix in a bowl the cream cheese, margarine or butter and flour. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate overnight.
Divide in quarters and roll each into 8-inch circles.
Melt 1 stick of butter and brush on dough, then sprinkle filling.
Cut each circle into 8 triangles, rolling large end to pointed end and pinch ends.
Beat egg yolk with 2 tablespoons water and brush on top.

title: Sundown Cooler
steps: Chill ingredients; pour over ice and sliced fruit.
Makes 16 punch cups.

title: Oreo Dirt Cake
steps: Crush oreos and layer 1/2 on bottom of glass bowl or flower pot. Cream together margarine, powdered sugar and cream cheese. Add Cool Whip, dry pudding mix
and milk, mixing well.
Pour on top of oreos. Add remaining crushed oreos to top.

title: Spinach Squares

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, salt and baking powder.
Stir in beaten eggs, milk and butter.
Add remaining ingredients and stir until moistened.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cut into 1-inch squares.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sweet Baked Beans
steps: Mix altogether in a baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Spread bacon strips across (optional).

title: Butterscotch Torte
steps: Mix together egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, almond and baking powder.
Set aside.
Whip egg whites until very stiff and fold into yolk mixture.
Also fold in graham cracker crumbs and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
Whip the whipping cream and spread over cool cake.

title: Poppy Seed Bread

ingredients.name: betty crocker butter pecan cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix

steps: Mix boiling
water and poppy seed together.
Set aside. Mix remaining
ingredients.
Add seed and water mixture.
Pour into 2 greased
loaf
pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Freezes well.

title: Buttermilk Brownie Cake
steps: In a saucepan combine butter, cocoa and 1 cup water.
Bring to a boil and stir constantly.
Remove from heat.
In a large bowl sift together flour, sugar, soda and salt.
Stir in eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.
Add cocoa mixture; mix until blended. Pour into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Immediately pour frosting over brownies; spread evenly.

title: Seven Layer Salad
steps: Layer all ingredients in order listed.
Cover with Miracle Whip mayonnaise and sprinkle bacon bits on top.
Refrigerate.

title: Pizza Dippers

ingredients.name: pillsbury refrigerator pizza crust
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. can Pillsbury refrigerator pizza crust

steps: Grease 1 large cookie sheet and unroll pizza dough, cutting the rectangle in half crosswise, then cutting 8 (1-inch) strips. Place strips apart on cookie sheet and brush with margarine. Sprinkle evenly with seasoning and put into 350° oven for 11 to 17 minutes.
Bring out long enough to sprinkle cheese on top and return to melt.
Serve immediately with warm pizza sauce to dip. Makes 16 servings.

title: Madge'S Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Put sugar over yeast in lukewarm water and let foam.
Scald milk, sugar, oleo and salt.
When cool, add dissolved yeast.
Fold in egg whites, stir in flour.
Dough should be soft.
Do not add more flour.
Let stand covered until double in size.
Stir down and put covered in refrigerator.
Let set overnight.
Bake in muffin tins.
Two small balls dipped in melted oleo forms one roll.

title: Super Sundae Pie
steps: In a mixing bowl, stir slightly softened ice cream until smooth.
Spoon the ice cream into the pie crust and cover.
Place pie in freezer for several hours, until hard.
Remove pie from freezer and let stand for 10 minutes to soften.
Spoon strawberry topping onto serving plate.
Cut pie and place on top of strawberry topping.
Garnish with chocolate sundae syrup and other toppings, as desired.
Sprinkle with nuts and a cherry.
Return to freezer.

title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and butter until light and fluffy.
Add powdered sugar and salt.
Mix well.
Stir in flour.
Stir in water, vanilla and almonds.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheets.
Flatten slightly.
Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes or until done.
Dredge cookies in powdered sugar while they're still warm.
Yields about 8 dozen.

title: Garden Cabbage Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients except dressing.
Cover and chill. Toss with dressing just before serving.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Kentucky Pecan Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake 45 minutes in preheated oven at 350°. Decorate with whole pecan halves.

title: London Broil
steps: Place steak in shallow pan.
Combine oil, vinegar and garlic. Pour over steak.
Cover and let stand in refrigerator for 3 hours or better yet overnight, turning several times.
Preheat broiler. Broil steak 3-inches from heat, about 5 minutes.
Season.
Turn; broil 3 minutes.
Add more seasoning.
Remove to cutting board. Carve very thin slices diagonally across the grain.
Serves 4 to 5.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
steps: Melt oleo in a pan.
Add graham cracker.
Mix and spread in bottom of a 9 x 13 inch greased pan.
Layer chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, walnuts if desired and shredded coconut.
Pour condensed milk on top and bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Before baking, cover with crumbled cheese crackers and dot with butter.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
steps: Mix the cake mix, egg and margarine good and press into a 9 x 12-inch sheet cake pan.
Next, mix and cream together good the sugar, 2 eggs and sour cream.
Spread on top of cake mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Cut when cool.

title: Beef Barbecue
steps: Cook on top of stove several hours.
(Meat will eventually shred.)
Cook on low to medium heat.
If liquid disappears, add water and ketchup (if needed).
Cut beef in pieces and put into pot; add all ingredients to the beef.
Cook 3 to 4 hours.

title: Cream Pie And Pudding(Microwave)
steps: Microwave Directions:
Combine sugar, flour and salt in deep 2-quart glass mixing bowl.
Add eggs and milk.
Beat with whisk until smooth.
Microwave at Full power for 8 minutes, stirring 3 times.
Proceed as recipe directs.

title: Crispix Cookies
steps: Combine butterscotch and semi-sweet chocolate morsels in a large saucepan.
Stir constantly over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat and add peanuts and cereal.
Stir gently until well coated.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
Chill until firm.

title: Rum Balls
steps: Combine crushed wafers, nuts and 1/2 cup powdered sugar in large bowl; set aside.
Melt chocolate with corn syrup.
Stir in rum until smooth.
Pour chocolate mixture over crumb mixture; mix thoroughly.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Place on wax paper.
Roll each ball in remaining 1 cup powdered sugar.
Store in airtight container for at least 3 days before serving.

title: Millionaire Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple and juice
ingredients.raw: 20 oz. can crushed pineapple and juice

steps: Beat together.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Carrots

ingredients.name: and can pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (No. 2) can and 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Scrape and cut carrots into small pieces or chunks.
Cook and drain; salt.
Drain pineapple.
Use 1/2 cup pineapple juice, cornstarch, oleo and sugar and cook until thick.
Add carrots and pineapple to sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Better if made a day ahead.

title: Ginny'S Salad

ingredients.name: good season italian dressing mixed according direction
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing, mixed according to directions

steps: Wash, dry and break lettuce into bite size pieces.
Toss in cheese and walnuts.
Mix with dressing prior to serving.

title: Fish And Broccoli Roll-Ups(Serves 4)
steps: Cut fish into strips.
Cut broccoli into small pieces. Alternate broccoli pieces and rolled fish strips onto kabob spears adding lemon wedges to each end.
Baste with salad dressing. Broil 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Fat Free Pizza Treats
steps: Top English muffins with pizza sauce and toppings of your choice ending with cheese.
Toast in toaster oven until cheese melts.

title: Sesame Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

ingredients.name: chicken wing wing tip off
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. chicken wings, wing tips cut off

steps: In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, the garlic, the ginger, the honey and the pepper.
Add the wings; toss them to coat and let them marinate, covered and chilled, for 2 hours. Line a baking pan with foil and arrange the wings, drained (reserving the marinade) in one layer on the foil.
Brush the wings with the
oil; sprinkle them with the sesame seed and bake them in the middle of a preheated 400° oven, basting them occasionally with the reserved marinade, for 30 to 35 minutes or until they are browned.
Serves 4 as an hors d'oeuvre.

title: Macaroni And Cottage Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni until tender.
Drain.
Put into dish and mix in 1 small carton cottage cheese.
Brown butter in skillet and pour over mixture.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Serve.

title: Easters Hamburgers
steps: Brown hamburger patties.
Slice raw onions on top.
Pour mixture over hamburgers.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Coconut Macaroons
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir in beaten egg whites and almond extract; mix well.
Lightly grease cookie sheet.
Cut cherries in quarters.
Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet about 1-inch apart. Top with cherry.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Take out when edges are golden.

title: Lazy Day Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Mix all ingredients by hand.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Refrigerate all day or overnight.
Will keep for 7 to 10 days in fridge.

title: Chili Beef Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until done (10 to 12 minutes). Drain thoroughly.
Brown ground beef in skillet.
Add the soups and the macaroni.

Heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is bubbly. Slice cheese slices in half diagonally and put on top of hot mixture. Cover for a few minutes to allow cheese to melt slightly.
Serve at once. Serves 6.

title: Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add other ingredients, then add 1 to 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour.
Blend with electric mixer.
Add slowly bread flour (3 1/2 to 4 cups; total wheat and bread flour should be 5 cups).
After 3 cups flour are mixed with electric mixer, fold the balance of flour with a wooden spoon.
Put on a floured board or wax paper and knead.
Next, put in oiled bowl. Oil top of dough and press wax paper down over dough.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Divide dough and put in pans and let rise again.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes to 1 hour or until golden brown and pulled away from sides.
This will make 2 big loaves or 4 small loaves.

title: Salmon Casserole Baked In Sour Cream

ingredients.name: salmon and juice reserved
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) can salmon, drained and juice reserved

steps: Place salmon liquid in mixing bowl, add lemon juice, salt, pepper, sour cream and dill weed.
Mix to smooth sauce.
Break salmon in large chunks; place in greased 1-quart casserole.
Pour sour cream sauce over salmon.
Spread with onion; sprinkle with parsley.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Chicken And Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: egg noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: chicken breast and up in
ingredients.raw: 3 chicken breasts, cooked and cut up in small pieces

steps: Dressing:
Mix mayonnaise, Ranch dressing, creamy Italian dressing and a little sugar together and blend to taste.
Pour over and toss.

title: Ham Roll-Up
steps: Spread cream cheese on ham.
Place breadstick on cheese.
Roll up.

title: Penne Al'Arrabbiato

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. minced parsley (more if fresh parsley is used)

ingredients.name: tiny red pepper
ingredients.raw: whole tiny red peppers (to your taste)

steps: Put on water to boil (and when boiling put in penne). Meanwhile, saute garlic in the olive oil briefly then add tomatoes, parsley, whole peppers and salt.
(Always prepare this sauce in an open skillet.)
Simmer until pasta is cooked.
Mix the sauce with the drained pasta and top with sprigs of fresh parsley.

title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients and let set in refrigerator several hours or overnight.
It gets better with age and will keep well for 2 weeks.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.name: approximately c. chicken and bite size
ingredients.raw: approximately 2 c. chicken, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Line bottom of dish with chicken pieces.
Mix together Veg-All and 3 cans of soup in large bowl.
Spread this mixture on top of chicken.
In the same bowl, mix melted butter, milk and flour and pour this over soup.
Bake at 350° for approximately 30 to 40 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Grasshopper Pie
steps: Crush cookies and mix with margarine.
Press into pie plate and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Make sure it's cool before you fill.

title: Squash Souffle

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. butter or Land O Lakes sweet cream spread

ingredients.name: reduced fat cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. grated reduced fat Cheddar cheese

steps: Cut squash in cubes; cook in lightly salted water until tender, then drain. Add butter and mash until pulp. Add well beaten eggs, milk and cracker crumbs. Pour into Pam sprayed casserole dish; cover with cheese. Bake at 350° until firm in the center, approximately 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Kuchen
steps: Divide Basic Sweet Dough into 2 portions.
Press into 2 buttered 8 x 8-inch baking pans.
Press apples, rounded side up, into dough.
Sprinkle with mixture of sugar and cinnamon; drizzle with butter.
Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack.
Serves 16.

title: Eggplant-Tomato Casserole
steps: Peel and cut eggplant into 1/4-inch slices.
Peel tomatoes and slice.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, arrange a layer of eggplant; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Put a layer of tomatoes on top; sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano flakes you have crushed with your fingers and cheese.
Repeat layers until casserole is full, ending with cheese on top.
Cover; bake in a 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until eggplant is tender when tested with fork.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Casserole
steps: Simmer the cauliflower and broccoli.
Melt the butter in skillet and add cream of mushroom soup, milk and Velveeta cheese. Cook all ingredients until the cheese is melted totally.
Combine cauliflower and broccoli mixture with soup and cheese mixture with cooked rice.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Saute celery, pepper and onion in small amount of margarine. Add shredded cabbage and water.
Cover and steam for 5 to 6 minutes.
Remove from heat; add cream of celery soup and pimento for color.
Mix well.
Put in casserole dish.
Cover with Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing and butter mixed together.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Best Ever Salad

ingredients.name: fine spaghetti bit
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. fine spaghetti, broken into bits or 7 oz. Mexican angel hair pieces

steps: Cook spaghetti and let it cool off.
Add all vegetables and spices.
Stir in celery soup and if too stiff add small amount of mayonnaise.

title: Tuna Casserole

ingredients.name: kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 large box Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner

ingredients.name: or pea
ingredients.raw: 2 c. frozen or canned peas, drained

steps: Make macaroni and cheese according to package directions.
If peas are frozen, cook and drain.
Cook celery and onion and drain. Add all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in large baking dish.

title: Slinky(Apple Flavored, Low Calorie Quencher)

ingredients.name: apple and sprig of mint
ingredients.raw: a few apple slices and sprig of mint

steps: Pour water and apple juice into a glass.
Stir in lemon juice.
Garnish with apple slices and mint.

title: Raspberry Nut Perfection(Serves 8)

ingredients.name: red raspberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 6 oz.) can red raspberry or other favorite pie filling

steps: Spread pie filling in bottom of 8-inch square pan.
Combine cake mix, water and egg; beat well.
Pour over pie filling. Sprinkle coconut and pecans on top.
Drizzle melted butter over top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Boil chicken in water.
Cool and cut into pieces.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place on top of chicken in following order: chopped onion, grated cheese and crushed Doritos.

title: 10 Minute Peanut Brittle
steps: In 2-quart casserole (I use 2-quart measuring cup), mix the sugar, syrup and salt.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Stir in peanuts.
Microwave on High for 2 to 6 minutes or until syrup and peanuts are lightly browned, stirring after every 2 minutes of cooking time.
Stir in butter, vanilla and baking soda until light and foamy.
Spread to 1/4-inch thickness on a large well-buttered cookie sheet.
When cool, break into small pieces.

title: Onion Dressing
steps: In a covered jar, shake all ingredients together well.
Makes 2 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add
milk,
cocoa
and sugar. Stir well and boil for 1
minute.
Take	from heat and immediately add peanut butter.
Stir
well.
Add
vanilla,	oats and nuts;	stir well.
Drop from teaspoon quickly onto wax paper.

title: Pastry Crunch
steps: Place candy coating in microwave.
Melt according to directions. Stir melted coating in remaining ingredients.
Spread on wax paper to cool. Break into pieces and store in an airtight container.

title: Voodoo Chicken

ingredients.name: garlic and left
ingredients.raw: 4 cloves garlic, peeled and left whole

steps: Mix together vinegar, soy sauce, onions, garlic and pepper. Add chicken and marinate overnight.
Remove chicken.
Combine mustard and ketchup; coat chicken pieces well.
Bake chicken, skin side down, for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken pieces over.
Mix together remaining mustard and ketchup, coating mix, milk and remaining marinade.
Pour over chicken pieces and bake an additional 45 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Baking temperature is 350°.
Baking time is 1 hour and 15 minutes total.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add milk, nutmeg and vanilla.
Sift flour and baking powder together and combine with other mixture.
Add enough additional flour to roll out and cut.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in oven at 325° for 15 minutes.
Yield: approximately 4 dozen.
Happy eating!

title: Blue Muffins
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Pour into muffin pans and bake at 350°.

title: Devils Chicken(Pollo Alla Diavola)

ingredients.name: hot pepper sauce or
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. hot pepper sauce (Tabasco sauce) or to taste

steps: Using poultry shears, cut the bird open by cutting down the backbone.
Flatten a bit by pounding with your hand so that the chicken is "butterflied".
Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl; marinate the bird for 2 hours.

title: Heath Bar Pie
steps: Mix chopped Heath bars with whipped topping and pour into crust.
Top with chocolate curls or chopped nuts.
Refrigerate.

title: Victorian Baked French Toast
steps: Cook brown sugar, butter and corn syrup in small saucepan until butter melts.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer bread in pan, squeezing together to fit.
Mix eggs, milk and cinnamon. Pour over bread (you can cover and refrigerate overnight).
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until center is done and lightly browned.

title: Quick Swedish Meatballs
steps: Combine meat, bread crumbs, cheese, soup mix, seasonings and 1/4 cup milk; mix thoroughly (with hands).
Form into small balls. Brown lightly; remove to a baking dish.
Drain excess grease, leaving small amount in skillet.
Blend in sauce mix and remaining milk (add more or less milk for desired thickness).
Cook until thick and bubbly.
Pour over meat balls.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Irish Stew(Microwave)
steps: In 4-quart casserole, combine lamb, 1 1/4 cups water, soup mix and bay leaf.
Heat, covered, 7 to 8 minutes on High.
Continue cooking on power level 3 for 35 to 40 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Add carrots, heat on level 3 for 15 minutes until ingredients are done.
Stir once.
Peel and cube potatoes and add to stew.
Blend flour and remaining water.
Heat 5 minutes on High, or until thickened, stirring twice.
Serves 6.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix

steps: Combine salad dressing mix and oil.
Add dill weed, garlic powder and lemon pepper.
Pour over crackers; stir to coat.
Place in warm oven.
Use very low temperature for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Loaf

ingredients.name: loaf bread let thaw overnight
ingredients.raw: 1 frozen loaf bread, let thaw overnight

steps: Take thawed bread and roll out onto cookie sheet.
Set on door of oven preheated to 350° and let it rise for 15 to 20 minutes (until puffy).
Lay the slices of Provolone over entire loaf and then layer the pepperoni slices.
Roll bread in a jelly-like roll. Take egg white and baste bread.
Sprinkle sesame seed on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Animal Crackers
steps: Grind oatmeal in blender until fine.
Add honey, salt, flour and soda.
Stir. Cut in butter. Add buttermilk and stir.
Roll very thin.
Cut with animal cookie cutters.
Bake at 400° until brown (10 to 12 minutes).

title: Sauerkraut

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.raw: 3 strips bacon, chopped (need about 2 Tbsp. drippings)

steps: Cook kraut and water about 10 minutes.
Fry bacon.
Add onion to
drippings and cook until onion is glazed.
Add flour and stir well.
Pour
water from kraut into gravy mixture and add sugar. Add kraut.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Let mixture come to a boil, if too thick add more water.

title: Good Cabbage Slaw
steps: Place alternate layers of cabbage and onions in a large bowl. Cover with sugar and celery seed.
Boil together vinegar, salt and mustard.
Add oil; heat again to boiling.
Pour over cabbage and onions.
Do not mix.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Better after 24 hours.
Stir and serve.
Keeps well.

title: Roasted Potatoes With Arugula
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In large roasting pan, toss potatoes with the oil and seasoning until coated.
Bake 40 minutes, stirring once, until potatoes are tender.
Place arugula in large serving bowl.
Add potato mixture and toss until arugula is wilted.
Serve hot or at room temperature.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Pineapple Salad

ingredients.name: cream cheese room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. cream cheese, room temperature

steps: Mix all ingredients together by hand, squeezing to remove any cream cheese lumps.
Pour into a bowl or 9 x 13 pan and let stand in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Seafood And Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: tri colored rotini noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 bag tri-colored rotini noodles, cooked and drained

steps: Boil the noodles, then rinse and put in a bowl which you will be using for serving the salad.
Saute scallops in the olive oil. Add the scallops along with the rest of the seafood to the noodles.
Dice the green onions (exclude the chive part) and boiled eggs.
Add to the salad.
Add mayonnaise; use more or less for taste.
Mix ingredients together.
Ready to serve!

title: Easy Peanut Blossom Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In mixer bowl, beat condensed milk, peanut butter and vanilla until smooth.
Add Bisquick; mix well. Chill at least 1 hour.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.
Do not overbake.
Press Hershey kiss in center of each cookie immediately after baking.
Cool.
Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless chicken, cut up into cubes

steps: In greased casserole dish, mix chicken, broccoli, soup, sour cream, 1/2 cheese and 1 cup bread crumbs.
Spread evenly.
Top with remainder of cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Lebanese Carrots

ingredients.name: onion and separated
ingredients.raw: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated

steps: Combine sauce ingredients.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour over vegetables.
Allow to sit (refrigerated) for 24 hours. Serve on cold platter as salad or relish.
Serves 8.

title: Italian Style Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: hot italian sausage
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. hot Italian sausage or spicy bulk

steps: In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Place in 4 1/2 x 8-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour; drain.

title: Orange Roughy Fillets
steps: Fry onion in butter until golden.
Cover pan with foil.
Lay fish out.
Put butter, garlic and 1 teaspoon of orange juice on top of fish.
Broil for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Strawberry Smoothie
steps: Put ingredients in a blender and whip for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
Makes 2 large glasses.

title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Melt oleo; slice bread in finger size slices.
Dip in melted oleo and set aside.
Drain cooked asparagus and place in a long casserole dish.
Cut water chestnuts and place on top.
(I use the juice too.)
Put cheese on that, then cover with mushroom soup. Cover with bread slices.
Bake at 350° until bread is brown.

title: 7 Layer Dish
steps: Building from bottom of covered (tall) casserole dish (2 1/2-quarts), spread in layers, 2 cubed raw potatoes (1/4-inch cubes), 2 diced raw carrots, diced celery (enough to cover layer), small can peas, drained, 1 1/2 tablespoons Minute rice (cover peas), 1/2 pound raw ground chuck.
Pat down; add 1 cup tomato soup.
Final layer, another 1/2 pound ground chuck.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours covered.

title: Lo-Cal Baked Perch Fillets With Lemon Butter
steps: Grease a 9-inch square baking dish.
Place fillets in pan. Arrange onions down center of fish.
Dot each fillet with margarine.
Sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes or until fillets flake with fork.
Cut into portions.
Serve.
Makes 6 servings, 118 calories each.

title: Japanese Fried Rice

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef or round steak, cut into small cubes

steps: Wash rice in several cold water rinses until water is clear. Put into 3-quart saucepan with water to cover rice, about 1-inch from top of rice. Cook on high until this boils.
Turn on low heat with lid until all water is absorbed and rice is tender and flaky. Turn heat off and let steam with lid on.

title: No Peek Chicken
steps: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with foil.
Sprinkle the rice on the foil and place chicken pieces on rice.
Mix soup and water, then spread over chicken.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over all. Cover and seal.
Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours, without peeking.

title: Green Beans Marinated
steps: Fry bacon.
Remove from grease.
Pour off grease, leaving at least 4 tablespoons.
Add sugar, mustard, vinegar and water.
Heat until dissolved.
Add beans.
Cook about 5 minutes.
Serve at room temperature.
Crumble bacon over top of beans when ready to serve.

title: Polenta
steps: In pan mix corn meal with 1 cup cold water.
Add 3 cups hot water and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly for 7 to 8 minutes,
bringing
heat
down to low.
Place in two dishes, cover with gravy and sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: "Cholives" Puff Appetizers
steps: Soften butter.
Add cheese and blend well.
Blend in flour, a little at a time.
Form dough around each olive, approximately 3/4-inch in diameter.
Bake, on cookie sheet, for 10 to 15 minutes at 375°.

title: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Pie

ingredients.name: sugar instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 servings) box sugar-free instant pudding mix (vanilla or butterscotch)

ingredients.name: de fatted dry roasted peanut
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. chopped de-fatted dry roasted peanuts

steps: Sprinkle gelatin on cold water in blender or food processor, using steel blade.
Wait one minute, then add boiling water. Cover and process until gelatin granules dissolve.
Add peanut butter.
Process until blended.
Add milk, yogurt and pudding mix. Process until smooth.
Wait 5 minutes for mixture to thicken, then put into dessert cups or into pie shell.
Chill until set. Sprinkle with peanuts, if desired.

title: Custard Pie
steps: Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy, then add flour, vanilla, salt, milk and heavy cream.
Pour in unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake in oven at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce Meatballs
steps: Combine ingredients, except barbecue sauce.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place on broiler rack (or place in oven on a cookie sheet) at 400°.
Turn once.
Cook until done.
Combine meatballs with barbecue sauce.

title: Honey'S Hominy Soup
steps: Saute peppers and onion in butter until translucent.
Add 1 or 2 tablespoons of flour.
Stir to mix well.
Add chicken broth, stirring until mixture thickens.
Add hominy and tomato soup.
Mix thoroughly and continue heating to boiling point.
Simmer to blend flavors.
Serve hot.

title: Pizza Dip
steps: Saute ground beef with onion and garlic in skillet until brown; drain.
Add next 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add Parmesan cheese, mixing well.
Mix in cream cheese. Pour into chafing dish.
Serve warm with taco chips.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Angel Muffins
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop out on cookie sheet by tablespoon or pour into muffin cups.
Makes 12 muffins.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Beef And Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 4 c. frozen potato rounds (1/2 of a 30 oz. bag)

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed

ingredients.name: durkee french fried onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup

steps: Place potatoes on bottom and up sides of an 8 x 12-inch casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 10 minutes.
Brown beef; drain.
Place beef, broccoli and half of can of onions in potato shell.

title: Impossible Buttermilk Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch pie pan.
Place ingredients in blender.
Place on high for 30 seconds.
Pour in pie pan.
Bake 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
Serve warm with fruit.

title: Shrimp Wreck(Tastes Best When Made Earlier In The Day.)
steps: Chop shrimp and onion.
Place in bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well (do not use blender).
Chill.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Fat-Free Strawberry Dessert(My Personal Recipe)
steps: Prepare cake mix according to directions.
Wash and slice strawberries and add yogurt.
Mix well.
Place a slice of cake on plate; top with strawberry yogurt mix and add fat-free whipped cream if you desire.
Light and fresh!

title: New Year'S Casserole

ingredients.name: kolbassi each
ingredients.raw: 10 to 15 pieces kolbassi, cut each 4 to 6-inches long

steps: Mix all ingredients (except meat) in a large roaster or baking pan.

Place pork chops in mixture and cover them over completely. Add rest of meat, placing mixture over it and add 1 cup of water. Bake at 350° for several hours (checking to be sure you baste mixture over meat.)

title: Creamy Vinaigrette Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients in a screwtop jar and shake.
Chill.

title: Spinach Pie

ingredients.name: sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 small can sauce (pizza, tomato or spaghetti)

steps: Put 1/2 pizza dough on greased sheet.
Spread sauce to cover dough.
Saute onion and garlic in butter; mix in cheeses and spinach.
Spread on pizza dough.
Place second layer of dough on top.
Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Yum Yum Coffee Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, then add sour cream and dry ingredients that have been mixed together.
Put half of dough in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle half of topping on dough.
Add the rest of dough and put rest of topping on dough.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jean Booth'S Party Punch
steps: Mix Kool-Aid according to directions on package.
Add lemonade and orange juice, plus water called for one can.
Add pineapple juice and sugar; stir.
Makes 2 gallons or 64 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Caramel Layer Chocolate Squares
steps: Melt together caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk.
Mix together 1/3 cup evaporated milk, cake mix, butter and nuts. Press 1/2 cake mixture into greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for 6 minutes (probably longer).
Remove from oven.

title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs and bananas.
Sift flour and soda into mix.
Add milk, vanilla and nuts.
Bake in loaf pan at 350° until center is baked firm, about 30 minutes.

title: Christmas All Through The House Potpourri
steps: Put all ingredients in saucepan.
Cover with water and allow to steep.
Watch carefully.
Do not allow water to evaporate.
Good aroma throughout your house.
Do not drink!

title: Irish Potato Candy
steps: Boil potato until well done.
Take peeling off and mash well. Mix powdered sugar with potato until it is thick enough to roll out (takes about 1 pound box).
Sprinkle dough board with powdered sugar.
Roll out and spread with peanut butter.
Roll up.
Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until cool enough to slice and serve.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
steps: Mix oleo/butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Sift the remaining ingredients and add to the mixture.
Chill dough and roll into 1-inch balls.
Bake 10 minutes at 400°.
While still warm, roll in powdered sugar.

title: Creative Dough(Kids' Play Dough)
steps: Cook all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring vigorously, until mixture forms a ball.
Remove dough from saucepan and let stand on counter 5 minutes.
Knead dough about 30 seconds or until smooth and blended. Cool completely.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Broiled Herbed Tomatoes
steps: Wash tomatoes and remove stem ends.
Cut tomatoes in half crosswise.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Brush over cut surface of tomatoes with butter.
Combine bread crumbs, rosemary, basil, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle crumbs over tops of tomatoes.
Pour remaining butter over top of crumbs.
Broil under low heat with tops of tomatoes about 3-inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes until tomatoes are heated through and crumbs are well browned.

title: Pecan Pie
steps: Put all, except pecans, in mixing bowl; beat well with hand mixer.
Stir in nuts.
Place in unbaked pie shell.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can Crushed Pineapple with Juice

steps: Spread pie filling over bottom of 9x13x2 baking pan.
(Spray pan with vegetable spray).
Spread pineapple over blueberry filling.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple.
Pour margarine over all.
Sprinkle top with coconut and pecan pieces. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until done.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole(Serves 8)

ingredients.name: grain and wild rice
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. long grain and wild rice

steps: Brown meats and onion.
Drain fat.
Cook rice as directed. Combine all ingredients into a 3-quart glass casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Puffs
steps: Arrange marshmallows in 8-inch square pan.
Combine chocolate, peanut butter and butter in saucepan.
Melt over low heat, stirring constantly.
Pour mixture over marshmallows and smooth into the cracks.
Refrigerate.
Cut into small pieces about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Bertha'S Macaroni Delight

ingredients.name: bread made butter crumb
ingredients.raw: 2 slices bread made into buttered crumbs

steps: In saucepan, cook onions in margarine. Stir in soup, milk and 3 slices of cheese.
Heat until cheese melts.
Add macaroni.
Pour into 1-quart casserole.
Top with remaining cheese and crumbs. Bake at 350°
for 30 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
steps: Beat egg and stir in remainder of ingredients.
Drop in rings from spoon in 375° fat until brown.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Donah'S Coffee Milk
steps: Pour 1/2 cup coffee into a coffee mug.
Pour in the milk.
Add the sugar.
Stir.

title: Cucumber Relish
steps: Chop cucumbers, onions, garlic and peppers in blender.
Cover with 1/3 cup salt in ice and let stand for 3 hours.
Drain well. Mix vinegar, sugar and turmeric.
Pour over cucumber mixture. Bring to a boil and simmer about 15 minutes.
Makes about 8 pints. Good with soup beans.

title: Light And Dark
steps: Mix butter, flour and nuts together and pack in bottom of pan. Bake until brown and cool.
Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar with mixer and put in the Cool Whip.
Put on top of crust and put in refrigerator.
Mix pudding and milk.
Beat until thick and spread on top of 2nd layer.
Spread rest of Cool Whip on top and nuts if you want them.
If you want to make a big one, double everything except the crust.

title: Fried Whitefish(Modern)
steps: Beat eggs.
Salt fish and dip into eggs.
Mix flour, cornmeal and bread crumbs for breading.
Dip fish in breading.
Fry in hot lard for 4 to 5 minutes on each side.

title: Jicama Sun Delight(Appetizer)
steps: Cut outside skin off jicama.
Slice into 1/4-inch pieces. Slice smaller, if desired.
Peel skin off of cucumbers; slice small in 1/8-inch pieces.
Peel oranges into sections.
Squeeze 1/4 sections of lemon over vegetables and fruit.
Add more, if desired.
Keeps in fridge for about a week in sealed bowl.

title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Cook sausage well and drain.
Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Tear bread into small pieces and sprinkle over butter. Sprinkle drained sausage over bread crumbs.
Sprinkle cheese over sausage.
Beat eggs and other ingredients.
Pour over mixture. Chill 8 hours or overnight.
Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Strawberry Fluff
steps: Mix softened cream cheese and sugar thoroughly.
Add pineapple, strawberries, nuts and bananas.
Mix in cool whip thoroughly but gentle.
Pour into pans.
Freeze.
Cut in squares.

title: Old-Fashioned Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Layer sliced potatoes in greased baking dish.
Sprinkle each layer with salt, pepper, onion, parsley and flour.
Dot with butter and add milk to cover.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° until potatoes are tender.

title: Bee Sting Buns(Makes 16 Buns)

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. (1/2 stick) melted butter or margarine

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Unroll crescents and divide into scored triangles.
Cut cream cheese block into 16 cubes.
Place one cube at base of each triangle and roll up to enclose cheese.
Bring ends of crescent together forming balls.
Spray 16 muffin cups with nonstick coating.
Combine remaining ingredients and spoon into bottoms of muffin cups.
Place ball of dough in each cup. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly.
Let cool 1 minute, then immediately invert onto foil.

title: Pecan Fudge Pie
steps: Melt butter and mix all other ingredients, except pecans. Pour into pie shell.
Place pecans on top and bake at 350° until done.

title: Cheese Patties With Pecans
steps: Grate cheese and mix with softened butter.
Add flour and salt; work mixture with hands until it firms up.
Shape into long roll; wrap in waxed paper.
Refrigerate.
Cut as for icebox cookies.
Put pecan pieces on top.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Crab Spread(Appetizer)

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. cooked shrimp or crab flakes

steps: Mix all ingredients, except parsley, shrimp (or crab) and cocktail sauce.
Spread on glass plate.
Top with cocktail sauce and shrimp (or crab); sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Crispy Baked Onion Rings
steps: Cut onions into rings. Combine cereal, salt, sugar and paprika.
Divide in half. Beat egg at high speed with electric mixer until soft peaks form. Dip onion in egg.
Dredge in crumb mixture.
Place in single layer on baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes until crispy. Good and low-fat.

title: Peanut Butter Rice Krispie Bars
steps: Cream together peanut butter, sugar and corn syrup.
Add Rice Krispies and put in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Press down.
Top with chocolate chip pieces and place in heated oven until chocolate melts.
Spread with knife.
Cool and cut into serving pieces.

title: Christmas Cheer Punch
steps: Chill ginger ale and soda in bottles in refrigerator.
Pour part of ginger ale and lemon-lime in separate ice cube trays; place a green or red cherry or orange slice in each cube.
Freeze as quickly as possible.
When ready to serve, put cubes in chilled punch bowl and pour in chilled carbonated beverages.
Place bowl in bed of Christmas greens or other appropriate decoration. Yields 30 servings.

title: Fresh Cranberry-Orange Relish

ingredients.name: navel orange unpeeled and
ingredients.raw: 1 navel orange, unpeeled and cut into small chunks

steps: Process all ingredients in food processor using on/off turns until finely chopped. Cover and chill at least 1 hour.
Makes 3 cups; 12 servings.

title: May Muffins
steps: Mix lightly, bake in greased muffin pan for 15 to 20 minutes in a 425° preheated oven.
Yields 10 to 12 muffins.

title: Quick Salmon Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: liquid
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. liquid (liquid from canned salmon plus milk to volume)

steps: Drain and flake salmon and save liquid.
In a 1-quart, greased casserole, combine soup, liquid, peas and salmon.
Top with potato chips.
Place in a moderately hot oven (375°) and bake for 30 minutes or until bubbling hot.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
This is very delicious.

title: Cheese Cake
steps: Grease spring-form pan with butter; dust with graham cracker crumbs.
Beat cream cheese and Ricotta until creamy.
Blend in sugar and eggs.
Add cornstarch, lemon juice and vanilla until blended.
Add melted butter and sour cream and blend well.
Pour into a 10-inch spring-form pan up to top ring.
Bake in preheated 250° oven for about 1 1/2 hours until firm around edges.
Turn off heat and leave in oven for 2 hours.
Cool on rack, then put in refrigerator until morning.
Remove sides of pan.
Top with any topping you wish or eat plain.

title: M&M Cookies
steps: Blend shortening, brown and white sugar in bowl.
Beat in vanilla and eggs.
Sift remaining dry ingredients together, add to sugar, egg mixture blending well.
Stir in M&M's.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

title: Chickpea Spread On Baguette
steps: Crush chickpeas leaving some chunkiness to them.
Stir in sour cream, add rest of ingredients except cheese.
Slice baguette on an angle.
Spread with chickpea mixture.
Top with shredded cheese.
Place on baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Place under broiler for a couple minutes until cheese is bubbly and browning.

title: Quick One Dish Meal
steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed; add green pepper, onion and tuna.
Mix well and let set for 5 or 10 minutes with the lid on.

title: Instant Spiced Russian Tea

ingredients.name: presweetened lemon flavored instant tea
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. presweetened lemon flavored instant tea

steps: Mix together thoroughly.
Use about 1 teaspoon for each serving or 1/4 cup for a quart.
Good hot or cold.

title: Bean Dip
steps: Brown ground beef with onion.
Drain grease.
Add refried beans, seasoning mix and tomato sauce.
Mix well.
Spread in shallow dish.
Top with grated cheese.

title: Breakfast Bars

ingredients.name: orange flavored instant breakfast drink
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. orange flavored instant breakfast drink

steps: Butter 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
In a large saucepan, melt butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring constantly.
Stir in peanut butter until melted.
Stir in milk and breakfast drink. Remove from heat.
Fold in raisins and cereal stirring until evenly coated.
Turn into pan.
With buttered hands, pat evenly in pan.
Cool thoroughly.
Cut into bars.
Makes 1 dozen bars.

title: Salmon Patties For Two
steps: Drain salmon, reserving liquid.
Flake and clean salmon and blend it with the reserved liquid and the remaining ingredients. Add more crackers or another egg if the consistency will not make firm patties.
After you make the patties, fry them in a skillet. Fry with 2 or 3 tablespoons melted butter.
Brown on both sides. Serve with sliced lemon wedges.

title: Pickled Corn
steps: Cook corn until just tender; rinse until cold.
Leave on cob or cut off.
Put in jars.
Pour over a mixture of 1 gallon water, 1 cup salt and 2/3 cup vinegar.
Seal and let stand a few weeks.

title: Cheese Squash
steps: Cook squash in
small
amount
of
boiling salted water until tender.
Combine
all
ingredients
except 1/2 of cheese and paprika.
Pour into buttered casserole and place remaining cheese on top and
sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Sage is the surprise in this combination.

title: Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: envelope onion
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope onion or mushroom soup mix

steps: Thoroughly blend all ingredients.
Add potatoes and coat well. Bake, stirring often, until tender and golden brown.
Serves 8.

title: Spinach Balls

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained

steps: Mix and refrigerate to stiffen to shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Yields 40 to 50 balls.

title: Brown Gravy
steps: Add bacon grease, salt and flour.
Stir until brown.
Add milk slowly, stirring until thickens.
Serves 8.

title: Reuben Dip
steps: Mix together and heat in oven at 300°.
Serve warm on cocktail rye or pumpernickel bread.

title: V. Mc'S Chicken And Broccoli
steps: Over medium heat, heat margarine in small skillet.
Cook the chicken for 10 minutes, or until browned on both sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; simmer for 10 minutes, or until chicken and broccoli are tender to forking.
Stir occasionally.
Serves 4.

title: Onion Sandwich Spread
steps: Chop onion real fine.
Add cream cheese, salt and mayonnaise. Mix well.
Spread on bread of your choice.
Cut into finger size sandwiches.

title: Raisin Bread
steps: Combine all dry ingredients including raisins.
Beat eggs. Combine eggs, milk and flavoring.
Stir liquid into dry ingredients.
Fold in oil and mix thoroughly.
Spoon into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake in 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool on rack.

title: Florida Orange Chiffon Pie

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 to 5.8 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding

steps: Combine pudding, concentrate, water and rind.
Whip topping according to directions and add to above mixture.
Place in an 8-inch prebaked pie shell and refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potatoes For Two

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 sweet potatoes, cooked and cubed

ingredients.name: ground nutmeg
ingredients.raw: dash of ground nutmeg or ground mace

steps: Slice sweet potatoes into an 8-inch pie plate; set aside. In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, butter, water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Pour hot syrup over potatoes.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes, basting occasionally or until syrup thickens and potatoes are glazed.
Sprinkle with nutmeg or mace.
Yields 2 servings.

title: Yogurt Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour in pie shell.
Freeze 4 hours. Take out and let thaw until ready to serve.

title: Micro-Mushrooms

ingredients.name: mushroom and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, rinsed and dried

steps: Micromelt butter in a 2-quart glass dish on High for 1 minute. Saute onion, bouillon cube, garlic powder and pepper in butter. Cover and cook on High for 8 minutes.
Stir after half the time. Add mushrooms and wine; cover.
Cook on High for 5 minutes.

title: Turkey And Cornbread Casserole

ingredients.name: martha white buttermilk cornbread mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Martha White buttermilk cornbread mix

steps: Mix all ingredients except cornbread mixture.
Pour into 10-inch casserole dish and level.
Prepare cornbread mixture according to directions and pour over turkey mixture.
Bake until golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes, at 450°.

title: Peach Or Apricot Jello Salad

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. peach or apricot jello

steps: Heat pineapple, cream cheese and sugar until cheese melts. Add jello and stir well.
Add cold water.
Put in refrigerator to set.
When mixture is near set, fold in Cool Whip and nuts.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Syrup
steps: Combine cocoa, water and salt in saucepan.
Mix until smooth. Bring to a boil and simmer gently until smooth and thick.
Allow to cool 10 minutes.
Add vanilla and sweetener.
Store covered in refrigerator.
Stir well before using.
One tablespoon equals 9 calories.

title: Indoor S'Mores
steps: Melt 5 cups of marshmallows, the corn syrup, butter and chocolate chips in 3-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour over cereal in large bowl.
Mix melted ingredients with cereal quickly until completely coated with chocolate.
Stir in 1 cup marshmallows. Make squares by pressing mixture evenly in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan with the back of a buttered spoon.
Let stand at least one hour or refrigerate for a firmer bar.
Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake

ingredients.name: french vanilla instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. French vanilla instant pudding mix

steps: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Lay whole graham crackers on bottom of pan.
Mix pudding with milk and then blend with Cool Whip.
Spread 1/2 of pudding mixture over graham crackers.
Add another layer of graham crackers and remainder of the pudding mix. Top with third layer of graham crackers.
Cover with Chocolate Topping.

title: Eugene'S Chicken
steps: Sprinkle beef in bottom of casserole.
Place chicken breasts on top of beef.
Pour chopped mushrooms over chicken.
Mix cheese, sour cream and chicken soup in blender; pour over chicken.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove foil; add sherry and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour more.

title: Easy Chicken Gumbo

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, cooked, skinned, boned and chopped

steps: Mix all ingredients
in large crock-pot and cook on low for about 8 hours.
Serve over rice.

title: Baked Barbecue
steps: Bake
at
275° uncovered 2 hours in shallow pan.
Serve on warm buns.

title: Cherry Chiffon Dessert

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can sweetened condensed milk or 1 c. nonfat plain yogurt

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed or chunk pineapple, drained

steps: Combine ingredients in large bowl, folding together until blended.
Spoon into decorative bowl.
Chill.
Makes 12 to 14 servings.
Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: One Dish Chicken Dinner
steps: Mix soups, broth and rice.
Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; put chicken pieces on top of rice mixture.
Season with the pepper and Lawry's salt.
Cover and bake for 2 1/2 hours.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes more.
Bake at 350° for 3 hours.

title: Chicken Pronto
steps: Dip chicken in Italian dressing, then into bread crumbs. Place in baking dish.
Cover and bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Uncover; bake 10 minutes more.
Serves 4.
(I prefer skinless chicken.)

title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix together salad dressing, sugar and vinegar.
Toss with the rest of ingredients.
Chill before serving.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Thoroughly mix everything together.
Shape the dough into little balls, then enjoy.

title: Carrots A La Orange

ingredients.name: carrot diagonally
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, sliced diagonally or 1 lb. pkg. frozen carrot slices

steps: In a large skillet, bring salted water to a boil.
Add carrots to boiling water and cook over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain well.
Add butter, marmalade and nutmeg to carrots.
Saute over medium high heat until carrots are glazed. Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
steps: Flour and grease large Pyrex dish.
Mix all of the ingredients and pour into the dish.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Brownies
steps: Melt oleo and cocoa over low heat.
Add flour, sugar and baking powder; stir to blend.
Add eggs and vanilla; blend.
Add nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mounds
steps: Mix first five ingredients and press into 2 long Pyrex dishes. Chill overnight.
Melt paraffin and chocolate chips in top of double boiler over low heat, stirring frequently.
Cut coconut mixture into small squares and dip into chocolate (use toothpicks).
Let cool on waxed paper.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Pie Crust(I Can'T Believe It Works)
steps: Mix flour, salt and shortening.
Add egg, vinegar and water, mixing with a fork until flour is moistened.
This is a crust that you can play with.

title: Foolproof Hollandaise
steps: Put eggs, salt, mustard, lemon juice and Tabasco in blender and blend for 3 minutes.
Heat butter until melted and hot.
Do not burn.
Add butter, in a steady stream, to blender while blender running.

title: Eva'S Caramel Corn
steps: Melt margarine; add sugar, Karo syrup and salt.
Bring to rolling boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; add soda and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour over popped popcorn and mix well. Place pan in oven at 200° and bake for 1 hour; stir every 15 minutes.

title: Stuffed Hamburgers
steps: Prepare hamburg for patties with salt and a little pepper. Make individual patties.
Place a slice of dill pickle and a thin slice of onion.
Fold patty over and seal.
Brown in a little oleo or shortening.
Pour the tomato sauce over the patties. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Caesar Salad

ingredients.name: romaine lettuce cleaned and
ingredients.raw: 1 large bunch romaine lettuce, cleaned and torn into pieces

steps: Combine all ingredients together except lettuce in food processor and blend until smooth.
Pour over lettuce, tossing well.
Top with croutons, if desired.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Brazilian Cocoa
steps: In top of double boiler, combine chocolate, sugar and salt. Stir in boiling water.
Over simmering water, heat until chocolate is melted.
Add milk and coffee; stirring.
Mix in nutmeg.
Top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle with instant coffee, if desired.

title: Ruth'S Jello Salad

ingredients.name: wild strawberry gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) wild strawberry gelatin

steps: Prepare jello as directed. Chill until semi-jelled.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir and pour into 6-cup mold. Refrigerate until set, about 3 hours.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan.
Sift flour, cocoa and soda; set aside.
Cream Country Crock and sugar together in large mixing bowl.
Add eggs, mixing, one at a time.
Add sour cream, while continuing to mix.
Add flour, 1/2 to 1 cup at a time.
Add vanilla and lemon flavorings.
Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Use a toothpick to doneness of cake before removing.

title: Sheet Cake
steps: Mix sugar and flour.
In saucepan combine butter, cocoa and water.
Bring to a boil; pour over sugar and flour.
Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Doug Cooper'S Polynesian Black Bean Soup
steps: Boil beans in beef and chicken stocks until tender. Meanwhile, saute meat, onion and garlic.
Add diced tomatoes and juice after meat is cooked. Reduce this mixture to a paste. When beans are tender, remove 2/3 of beans and puree.
Combine pureed meat and bean puree. Put back into pot with beans.
Let simmer. Will thicken.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley.

title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix all dry ingredients.
Add water, egg, oil and pumpkin. Grease 2 loaf pans.
Fill with pumpkin mix.
Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 to 50 minutes.
Let cool on wire rack.

title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, soda and sugar.
Cut in shortening.
Blend in egg, milk and vanilla.
Roll on floured board.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Yields 3 dozen.

title: Cheese Squares
steps: Cut bread about 1 1/2 inches thick and remove crust and cut in quarters.
Whip butter and cheese together and ice the squares all
over, except the bottoms.
Place on baking sheet and
bake in
oven
for about 10 minutes at 350°.
Watch them closely.

title: Mother'S Pound Cake
steps: Sift flour and baking powder.
Mix shortening and sugar.
Then add eggs to shortening and sugar and mix well.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add flavoring.
Bake 1 hour or until done at 350°.

title: Beef Stew By Sylvia
steps: Chop and mix meat and vegetables.
Mix salt, sugar and tapioca and sprinkle over mixture.
Add V-8 juice.
Cover and bake at 275° for 5 hours.

title: Baked Pineapple
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and beat well.
Add pineapple; stir in bread and cinnamon.
Bake in greased casserole, uncovered, for 1 hour or lightly browned at 350°.

title: Oreo Pie
steps: Crumble enough Oreo cookies to line bottom and sides of pie plate (I make mine small chunks).
Fix the pudding according to directions on box.
Place cookies in pie pan.
Add pudding on top, then the cherry pie filling.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

title: Bacon-Flavored Chicken Breasts
steps: Sprinkle chipped beef in bottom of baking dish.
Wrap chicken breasts with bacon.
Mix sour cream and soup together and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Rice Salad(Great Switch From Potato Salad)
steps: Cook rice according to directions.
Chill.
Add mayo or salad dressing, celery, onion, mustard and salt; mix well.
Chill.
Stir in eggs, radishes and cucumber before serving.

title: Creamed Tacos
steps: Cook ground beef, onion and bell pepper together in a skillet; drain meat.
In double boiler, mix the Ro-Tel tomatoes, evaporated milk and Velveeta cheese; heat until cheese melts.
Layer ingredients from skillet on bottom of ungreased casserole dish, then spread cheese ingredients on top of meat, then layer flour tortillas.
Repeat layers until all ingredients are used.
Bake together in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Pie
steps: Brown almonds by spreading on pan and placing in a 350° oven until lightly browned.
Watch carefully.
Sprinkle cool almonds over pie shell.
Mix milk, salt, lemon juice, almond extract and vanilla together.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into pie shell and spread evenly.
Spoon cherry pie filling over top.
Refrigerate for 4 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Spinach Patties

ingredients.name: boned and skinned chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 boned and skinned chicken breast (into chunks)

steps: Put all ingredients except vegetable oil in a food processor and process until finely ground.
Form small patties and saute in oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat.
Flip until brown on both sides 1 minute.
Serve when cool.

title: Chicken-Mexican Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: firm tomato
ingredients.raw: 2 large firm, ripe tomatoes, sliced thinly

ingredients.name: corn chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 to 8 oz.) pkg. corn chips or tortilla chips

ingredients.name: boned chicken chunked
ingredients.raw: 2 (5 oz. each) cans boned chicken, chunked or 2 c. cooked and cubed chicken

steps: In a mixing bowl, place soup, chiles, onion and water.
Stir to blend well.
Lay 1/2 corn chips in 2-quart casserole.
Top with 1 can or 1 cup chunked chicken, then half of the tomato slices. Pour half of the soup mixture over chicken mixture. Sprinkle with half of the cheese.
Repeat layers in same order, ending with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, on High in microwave or reheat 8 to 10 minutes with cover on.
Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Pudding Or Pie Filling
steps: Sift sugar, flour and cocoa.
Add eggs and milk.
Cook until thick.
Add vanilla and butter.
Use more flour for pie filling.

title: Taco Salad(Easier For Kids To Eat Than Traditional Tacos)

ingredients.name: corn chip
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. pkg. corn chips or taco shells, broken up

ingredients.name: cheddar american cheese
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. shredded Cheddar, American cheese or soy cheese

steps: In a large skillet, rehydrate TVP granules and onion; drain. Stir in dry taco seasoning mix and water.
Simmer 10 minutes over low heat.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, cheese, tomatoes and corn chips.
Add TVP mixture just before serving.
Top with sour cream and/or taco sauce.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Fast Fudge Frosting
steps: Combine sugar, cocoa and salt, mixing well.
Add boiling water and butter; blend.
Add vanilla.
Beat until of spreading consistency.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato and in
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch slices

steps: Spray 2-quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray and set aside.
Cover potatoes with cold water in a pot and bring to a boil.
Cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain and set aside.
While potatoes are cooking, heat oil over medium heat in a large nonstick skillet.
Add onions and garlic; cook until onions are softened and beginning to brown (about 15 minutes). Spread thin layer of potatoes in baking dish, salt, pepper and onion mixture.
Repeat layers ending with onions.
Pour in milk. Sprinkle with parsley flakes on top.
Bake until potatoes are slightly brown.
Bake (preheated) at 400° for about 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Mix rice, soup mix, onion, mushroom soup and water in baking dish.
Sprinkle breasts with salt and pepper; put on top of rice mixture.
Bake uncovered 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325°.
Serves 6.

title: Burrito Bake

ingredients.name: ground beef and cooled
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef, cooked, drained and cooled

steps: Grease 10 1/2-inch pie plate.
Mix Bisquick, water and beans. Pat into pie plate.
Layer remaining ingredients.
Bake in 375° oven for 25 minutes.
Serve with sour cream, if desired.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
steps: Melt oleo in skillet and stir in flour.
Stir until smooth. Add cream and cook until smooth and thickened.
Drain corn in colander and mix with sauce.
Place in greased casserole and cook in 350° oven until bubbly (30 minutes).

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley

ingredients.name: broccoli carrot and cauliflower combination thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained

steps: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 can fried onions.
Pour into a 1-quart casserole.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings. Preparation time:
5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pistachio Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix

steps: Blend to moisten, then beat for 2 minutes.
(Optional: a few drops of green food dye for a richer green color.) Pour about 3/4 batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan.
With remaining batter, add 3/4 cup Hershey's chocolate syrup.
Pour into Bundt pan on top of the green batter.
(The chocolate batter will fall to the bottom.)
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool in pan on wire rack.
When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Boiled Cookies
steps: Bring the sugar, butter, milk and cocoa to a boil.
Panboil 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal, vanilla and nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and let set 1/2 hour.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together; put in a greased casserole dish. Make sure rice is moist and coated.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
steps: Combine jello and pineapple and microwave in bowl until jello melts.
Let cool.
Add Cool Whip to buttermilk; stir well.
Add jello mix when cooled.
Stir well and refrigerate.

title: Onion-Cheese Bread
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Saute onion in shortening until golden. Mix egg and milk.
Blend in Bisquick.
Add onion and half of the cheese.
Spread dough in greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round glass baking dish.
Sprinkle top with remaining cheese and poppy seed. Sprinkle melted butter over all.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Boxcar Barbecue

ingredients.name: tomato up
ingredients.raw: 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, cut up

steps: Place pork in shallow roasting pan.
Combine undrained tomatoes with rest of ingredients.
Pour over meat.
Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 4 to 5 hours, until meat is tender. Uncover.
Bake 1 hour more.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening and milk.
Divide dough and sausage into two parts.
Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness.
Spread with sausage and then mustard.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Wrap in wax paper and chill.
Slice 1/2-inch thick and bake on greased pan at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Cake

ingredients.name: sour milk
ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp. sour milk (sour cream is better)

steps: Mash bananas in a bowl and add sour milk or cream.
Sprinkle soda over this.
Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.
Alternate banana mixture with flour and blend thoroughly.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes for a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Grease and flour cake pans.
This makes 2 large layers or 1 good size loaf cake also.

title: Honey Baked Rabbit
steps: Arrange rabbit pieces in shallow baking pan.
Mix other ingredients and pour over rabbit.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently until browned.

title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cook eggplant until mushy; drain.
Add all ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup cheese, 1/2 cup crumbs and small amount of butter.
Mix well.
Pour into baking dish; sprinkle with reserved cheese, cracker crumbs and melted butter. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Cover chicken with
water.
Salt and pepper.
Boil over medium heat for 30 minutes.
Remove from broth.

title: Judy'S Pineapple Cake

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. walnuts (reserve some for the top)

steps: Mix all dry ingredients together and add to the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish at 350° for 35 minutes.
Let cool in the pan.

title: Evening Delight Hamburger Stew

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can small whole potatoes or 4 baked and cut potatoes

steps: Place package of vegetables on paper towel.
Microwave on High for 7 minutes.
Set aside.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
steps: Heat
about 10 minutes in microwave.
Stir during first four minutes and again after the next four minutes.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.raw: 1 medium cabbage, cut in large pieces

steps: Cook the beef until done; drain.
Then in a soup pot, mix all ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until vegetables are done.

title: Pink Salad
steps: Bring pineapple to boil.
Add jello; stir until completely dissolved.
Cool.
Add remaining ingredients.

title: Glazed Butternut Squash
steps: Cut squash into 3-inch pieces.
Pare and parboil until tender; drain.
Place in shallow baking pan.
Heat remaining ingredients, pour over squash.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, basting with syrup until glazed.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Bacon Corn Chowder

ingredients.name: bacon in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. bacon, cut in 1/2 inch pieces

ingredients.name: potato in
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes

steps: Cook potatoes and drain.
Fry bacon, then brown onion in fat. Add rest of ingredients.
Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Quick Freezer Fudge
steps: In 1 1/2-quart bowl stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla together until partially blended.
Put butter on top in center of dish.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir until smooth.
Blend in nuts (optional).
Pour into well buttered rectangular dish. Chill for 20 to 30 minutes in freezer.
Cut into squares.
Makes 36 squares.

title: Rye Rounds
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Spread on party rye bread.
Top with 1 slice onion.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes approximately 16 rounds.

title: Chocolate Mint Sugar Drops

ingredients.name: mint flavored chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. mint flavored chocolate morsels

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt and pepper.
Set aside.
Combine one cup sugar and oil; mix well.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in morsels.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Shape into balls.
Roll in remaining sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Carrot Bars
steps: Mix together.
Pour in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Sauce
steps: Combine cornstarch and sugar.
Stir in crushed pineapple and water.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil until clear; chill, then add lemon juice.
Serve on ice cream or pudding.

title: Sour Cream Frosting

ingredients.name: semi sweet
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet or milk chocolate pieces

steps: Melt chocolate and butter; cool slightly.
Blend in sour cream, vanilla and salt.
Slowly beat in sugar until spreading consistency.

title: Baklava
steps: Mix together nuts, cinnamon, cloves and sugar; set aside. Brush 9 x 13-inch pan with melted butter.

Line bottom of dish with 10 sheets of filo, brushing each sheet with melted butter. Spread 1/3 of nut mixture evenly on top and cover with another 5 sheets of filo, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Place 1/2 of the remaining mixture on top of filo.
Add 5 more sheets of filo.
Repeat this step once more, using remainder of filo, brushing each sheet with butter.

title: Butter Creams
steps: Mix ingredients until well blended.
Form into uniform balls. Melt chocolate in a double boiler on low heat.
Dip balls into chocolate to cover.
Let cool; store airtight in a cool dry place.

title: Cream Of Spinach Soup

ingredients.name: leaf spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. frozen leaf spinach, thawed and drained

steps: Blend spinach and 1/2 cup chicken broth in blender until pureed.
In saucepan, melt margarine.
Add onion and saute until tender.
Stir in flour and cook about 1 minute.
Add remaining chicken broth and cook until thickened.
Stir in pureed spinach mixture, whipping cream, pepper and nutmeg.
Heat thoroughly. Makes 2 or 3 servings.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli until slightly tender.
Drain.
Layer a casserole dish with broccoli cuts, chicken and cheese.
Mix cream of chicken soup with milk and pour over casserole.
Make sure it gets down through the mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Party Punch
steps: Mix all liquids together.
Top punch by adding scoops of sherbet to the bowl.
This also helps to keep it chilled.

title: Jan Clay'S Cucumber Sauce For Fish
steps: Grate cucumber.
Mix with seasonings.
Pack into covered container and refrigerate.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
steps: Mix ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Set aside. Dip chicken wings in sauce.
Lay on foil-lined cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.

title: Oven Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: lbs. meaty chicken breast thigh
ingredients.raw: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs. meaty chicken, breasts, thighs or drumsticks skinned

ingredients.name: worcestershire sauce
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. worcestershire sauce or white wine worcestershire sauce

steps: Rinse chicken, pat dry.
Place on a rack in a shallow baking pan and set aside.
In a small mixing bowl combine cornflake crumbs and parsley; set aside.
In another bowl combine yogurt, garlic, worcestershire sauce and pepper.
Brush chicken with yogurt mixture, then sprinkle with crumb mixture.
Bake uncovered in 375° oven for 45 to 55 minutes or till chicken is tender and no longer pink.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes with skin on.
When cool, peel off skins and cut potatoes into pieces.
Add eggs, pickles, onions and sweet relish to the potatoes.
Add mayonnaise and mustard to taste and to make the salad the way you like it. Sprinkle paprika over the salad.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Glazed Butterflies
steps: Twist each wonton skin in the center to resemble a butterfly. Heat peanut oil to 375° in saucepan or electric skillet.
Deep fry each skin in hot oil until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
steps: Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain and let cool.
Mix all other ingredients with macaroni.
You may need more or less Italian dressing according to taste.
Keep in refrigerator. Sprinkle with Parmesan when served.

title: Rice Cooker Shrimp

ingredients.name: uncooked unwashed rice
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. uncooked, unwashed rice (measuring cup, not rice cooker cup)

ingredients.name: salt and pepper and tony chachere
ingredients.raw: salt and pepper and Tony Chachere to taste

steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix well.
Put in rice cooker and cook as usual.

title: All-Purpose Sauce
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 4 cups.

title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Cream shortening.
Mix ingredients.
Beat and pour into prepared pans and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 325°.

title: Tamale Bake Casserole

ingredients.name: or oz. sharp cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. or 2 oz. shredded sharp cheese

steps: Drain tamales; reserve sauce.
Remove papers and slice tamales crosswise; set aside.
Combine tamale sauce, flour, chili powder and garlic salt.
Add eggs, corn, olives and tamales.
Turn into 10 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Bake in a 350° oven 40 minutes or until set. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
steps: Combine and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Chill for 2 hours.
Shape into cakes.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over a quick fire.
Brown the cakes on both sides. Yield: 6 cakes.

title: Broccoli Macaroni Casserole
steps: Melt butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk gradually, stirring constantly.
Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Add the mayonnaise.
Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender.
Drain, rinse and drain again.
Layer macaroni, broccoli and sauce in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, ending with sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes.

title: Potato, Pimento Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes in jackets until about done.
Avoid overcooking. Peel, dice and measure.
Arrange a layer of potatoes in bottom of large, buttered casserole.
Mix soup with remaining ingredients, except crumbs.
Cover layer of potatoes.
Continue alternate layers with potatoes completely covered.
Sprinkle top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spice Tea
steps: Mix all ingredients and store in airtight container.
Use 2 teaspoons per mug of water.

title: Pappy'S Spoon Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Sift flour into large bowl.
Take a spoon and make a hole in flour about the size of your fist.
Pour buttermilk and oil in the hole.
With a spoon begin stirring buttermilk and oil, pulling in flour gradually as you go.
After all flour has been stirred in, drop by large spoonfuls onto greased biscuit pan.
