(Dough will be sticky and have the consistency of a very thick batter.)
Bake in preheated 425° oven for about 15 to 20 minutes or until bottom of biscuit turns brown. Place under broiler for few seconds until tops turn light brown. Remove from oven.
Run a stick of butter across the top of the hot biscuits.
Good!
Easy!
No messy hands!

title: Lemon Fluff
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water and add sugar and lemon juice.
Chill until thick (like pudding).
Whip and add to whipped chilled Pet milk.
Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter.
Press in bottom of 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans.
Pour Jell-O mixture over crumbs and chill.
This recipe may be cut in half.

title: Chicken And Rice
steps: Mix all together.
Put in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish or deep round baking pan.
Place a cut up chicken on top and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until chicken is tender (or it can bake in a 250° oven for about 2 hours).

title: Lemon Strawberry Punch

ingredients.name: each can lemonade concentrate
ingredients.raw: 3 (6 oz.) each cans frozen lemonade concentrate

steps: In large bowl, prepare lemonade concentrate as directed on can.
Stir in strawberries with syrup.
Stir in ginger ale and, if you wish, add small scoops of strawberry ice cream or ice cubes.

title: Squash Dressing
steps: Mix well.
Place in baking pan and cook 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Four-Inch Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: onion garlic and celery salt
ingredients.raw: dash of onion, garlic and celery salts

steps: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients, except olives.
Mix well; stir in olives.
Cover and chill until firm.
Shape into a ball.
Roll cheese ball in chopped nuts.
Chill until firm.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken

ingredients.name: cracker
ingredients.raw: 1/4 box crackers (1 pack of 4 pack box)

steps: Cook chicken and cut in bite size pieces.
Add soups, sour cream and lemon juice; mix well.
Melt oleo, crumble crackers over chicken mixture which has been put in a baking pan.
Drizzle oleo over the crackers.
Sprinkle poppy seed over the mixture and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Nadiola'S Cinnamon Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine butter recipe golden cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines butter recipe golden cake mix

steps: Mix cake mix, 1/2 cup
sugar and Crisco oil together, beating well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg.
Then add sour cream.
Mix well, but do not beat hard after adding sour cream.
Spray or grease and flour Bundt pan.
Add 1/2 of the batter to the pan.
Mix together cinnamon and 1 tablespoon sugar.
Sprinkle over batter in pan, then add remaining batter.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Let cool in pan for 10 minutes before turning out.

title: Crazy Cake
steps: Put all ingredients in 9-inch cake pan in order.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot or use your favorite glaze.
Serve directly from pan.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben

ingredients.name: chicken breast and boned
ingredients.raw: 4 whole chicken breasts, halved and boned

steps: Place chicken in greased baking pan and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place Krrrrisp kraut over chicken; top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese.
Cover with foil and bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Pecan Cranberry Pie
steps: Beat eggs, sugar, margarine and corn syrup until blended. Stir in cranberries and pecans.
Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Cover edge with 2 inches foil.
Bake on lowest rack of oven at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.
Take foil off after 45 minutes of baking.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Mix together and put into covered container.
Shake well and it's ready.
Can be frozen.

title: Boiled Custard
steps: Mix sugar and flour.
Then add to milk and egg yolks.
Cook in top of double boiler until mixture coats the spoon.
Add vanilla and chill.
When cool, beat the egg whites and add to other mixture (just stir this in).

title: Squash Puffs
steps: Cook squash in water until done.
Drain and mash to make 1 cup.
Mix all ingredients and drop by tablespoon into hot oil. Cook until golden brown, turning once.
Drain well.

title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Ball
steps: Chop onion and ham.
Mix together with cream cheese.
Make sure cream cheese is left out to room temperature.
Makes 1 medium cheese ball.

title: Blackberry Jam Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients, except jam.
Cook until thick.
Add jam and place in unbaked pie shell.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole

ingredients.name: each fat cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can each: 97% fat free cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: green chile salsa
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 to 10 oz.) can green chile salsa

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fat free Cheddar cheese, grated

steps: Wrap chicken breasts in foil and bake 1 hour at 400°.
Cool and bone chicken.
Break into large pieces.
Cut tortillas into 1-inch strips or squares.
Mix soups, milk, onion and salsa.

title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix 1 cup boiling water, sugar and cornstarch.
Cook until thick.
Add Jell-O and mix well.
Let cool and pour over sliced strawberries in a baked pie shell.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. milk (more if needed to make paste)

steps: Melt butter; pour in bottom of dish.
Add peaches.
Mix flour and sugar together.
Add milk to make paste of flour and sugar. Pour over peaches and butter.
Stir in flavoring.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.
Serves 6.

title: Cheddar Chicken Surprise

ingredients.name: chicken breast boned skinned and split
ingredients.raw: 2 whole chicken breasts, boned, skinned and split into 2

ingredients.name: well aged white cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. grated well-aged white Cheddar cheese

ingredients.name: black forest ham
ingredients.raw: 4 large thin slices Black Forest ham

steps: Slice each piece of chicken breast open to form cavity.
Stuff with cheese and reshape meat with hands.
Wrap in slice of ham. Carefully dredge chicken in flour and then dip in beaten egg. Thoroughly coat with breadcrumbs.
Chicken must be well-coated or cheese may leak during cooking.

title: Apricot Oatmeal Bars
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, except for preserves and coconut.
Beat at low speed until crumbly.
Reserve 1 cup crumbs.
Press remaining crumbs in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Open House Salad

ingredients.name: mayo
ingredients.raw: 1 c. mayo or 1/2 c. mayo and 1/2 c. Miracle Whip

steps: Blend first 5 ingredients and refrigerate.
Layer ingredients and pour dressing over or toss.

title: Hamburger Casserole
steps: Mix hamburger, onion, potato, egg, salt and pepper.
Make meatballs and brown in oil.
Remove and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soup and milk.
Pour over meatballs and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and shortening with sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add lemon.
Mix.
Add flour and 7-Up alternately, beating after each addition.

title: Spicy Pot Roast

ingredients.name: beef chuck
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 to 4 lb.) beef chuck or rump roast

steps: Season roast with salt.
Brown well in Wesson oil in Dutch oven.
Add water and garlic, cover and simmer 2 hours or until almost tender.
Skim excess fat and add remaining ingredients. Cover, simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Thicken gravy.

title: Easy Apple Cake
steps: Pour sugar over apples and let stand 20 minutes, then stir well.
Add all other ingredients and beat until well mixed.
Add nuts and raisins, if desired.
Pour in greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Kate'S Angel Food Cake
steps: Sift together three times the flour and 1 cup of sugar and set aside.
Beat egg whites, water and vanilla until frothy, then add cream of tartar and continue beating until mixture stands in peaks but not dry.
Stir in 1 cup of sugar a little at a time.
Gradually add and fold in sifted flour and sugar mixture.
Bake in angel food cake pan at 325° for about 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Soy Vinaigrette(Nuoc Xi Dau Giam)
steps: In a jar, combine all the ingredients and shake well. Dressing will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Broccoli Dish
steps: Combine ingredients in lg. casserole dish or 9 x 13 baking dish.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes covered and 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Carrot Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; chill until thickened.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart mold or individual molds.
Chill until firm.

title: Grandma Mary'S Butter Cookies
steps: Cream butter.
Beat into sugar.
Add egg yolks and vanilla. Beat well after adding each yolk.
Add flour and beat after each 1/2 cup is added.
Chill about 1 hour.

title: Lorene'S Cornbread Salad
steps: Crumble the cornbread in a large dish. Add in layers, beans, peppers, onion, tomatoes and bacon.
Add a few sliced dill pickles on top of bacon.

title: Bailey'S Taste Alike Irish Cream
steps: Pour all ingredients in blender (or mixer and bowl) and blend. Done.
Pour into container and serve.

title: Beef Stroganoff Sandwich
steps: Brown hamburger; drain.
Add onion, pepper, tomatoes and seasonings.
Stir in sour cream.
When ready to serve, cut French bread in half.
Cover each half with the hamburger mixture.
Cover with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Beef And Broccoli Over Noodles

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's cream of broccoli soup

steps: Slice beef into thin strips. In skillet add oil and heat over medium heat.
After oil gets hot, cook beef and garlic until beef is brown.
Add onion.
Cook 5 minutes.
Keep stirred.

title: Chestnuts
steps: Fry some of the fat from bacon.
Roll chestnuts with bacon. Anchor with toothpick.
Cover with sugar, chili sauce and mayonnaise.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf

ingredients.name: bread crumb with milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. bread crumbs, softened with milk (1/4 c.)

steps: Combine ingredients.
Shape into loaf and bake in a greased baking dish at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Vegetables Tamale
steps: Mix corn, tomatoes, corn meal, cheese, onion and green pepper. Let stand 30 minutes.
Add eggs, milk and seasoning.
Pour into buttered baking dish at 325° for 1 1/4 hours or until firm in the center.
This may be served from the dish or may be baked in a loaf and unmolded onto a platter.
Buttered peas may be used as a garnish with sections of hard-cooked eggs on the platter.

title: Veggie Pizza

ingredients.name: onion broccoli cauliflower tomato and mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. onion, broccoli, cauliflower, tomatoes and mushrooms

steps: Mix together cottage cheese, cream cheese, Ranch dressing mix and mayo.
Spread crescent rolls on 8 x 10-inch sheet.
Put in oven as directed for 10 minutes.
Let cool.
Spread on first mixture.
Spread mixture of veggies over cold dough.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and oregano over all.
Heat and serve. Delightful.

title: Marshmallow Salad
steps: Mix egg
yolks,
water	and
vinegar
and cook in small heavy saucepan
until
thickened.
Cool.	Whip whipping cream and add to	cool
egg mixture.
Add all other ingredients and mix well. Put in large mixing bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Arrange potatoes and onions in layers in a greased, 3-quart baking dish, seasoning each layer with salt and pepper.
Trim fat from pork chops and save for later use.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin

ingredients.name: baking potato baked in oven with skin on
ingredients.raw: 6 to 8 baking potatoes, baked in oven with skins on

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in chunks

ingredients.name: bacon and sauteed until half
ingredients.raw: 6 strips bacon, chopped and sauteed until half cooked

steps: Remove skins from cooked potatoes and cut into large dice. Toss with next 4 ingredients.
Pour into greased casserole and sprinkle with bacon and olives.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Italian Pinwheels

ingredients.name: refrigerated quick crescent roll
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can refrigerated quick crescent rolls

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In small bowl combine cheese, pepperoni, oregano, pizza sauce and pepper; mix well.
Separate dough onto 4 rectangles.
Firmly press perforations to seal.
Spread each rectangle with about 3 tablespoons mixture.
Starting at shortest side, roll up each rectangle; pinch edges to seal.
Cut each roll into 6 slices.
Place cut side down, 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm.

title: Kraut Salad

ingredients.name: pimento
ingredients.raw: 1 small pimento, chopped or container of pimento

steps: Mix all together.
Let stand for 24 hours in refrigerator before serving.

title: Oriental Rice

ingredients.name: grain and wild rice
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice

steps: Place rice, seasoning packet, butter, water chestnuts, mushrooms, onion and soy sauce in a 3-quart casserole.
Microwave on High (100%) for 3 to 4 minutes or until onion is tender.
Stir halfway through cooking time.
Pour in chicken broth.
Cover with a tight fitting lid or plastic wrap.
Microwave on High for 5 to 7 minutes or until boiling.
Stir, then microwave on Medium (50%) for 40 to 45 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Yield:
6 to 8 servings.

title: Sausage Dressing
steps: Saute sausage, celery and onion.
In large bowl combine sausage mixture and remaining ingredients.
Blend well.
Bake mixture in greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 350°. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Foolproof Dark Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

steps: In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips, milk and salt. Remove from heat.
Stir in nuts and vanilla.
Spread evenly into wax paper lined 8 or 9-inch square pan.
Chill 2 hours or until firm.
Turn fudge onto cutting board.
Peel off paper and cut into squares.
Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Barbarakuchen(German Lemon Cake)
steps: Mix the butter until smooth; slowly add the sugar, eggs and the mixture of flour, cornstarch and baking powder.
Add the lemon extract.
Pour batter into greased loaf pan.
Bake 60 to 75 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Hot Dog Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Prepare potato puffs for 4 servings as directed on package.
Stir in pickle relish, mayonnaise, onion and mustard.
Spoon into a 1-quart casserole.
Cut each hot dog in half.
Insert hot dog pieces upright around edge of mashed potatoes.
Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Fruit Toddy
steps: In a large saucepan, mix the cider and sugar. Add cinnamon and cloves tied together in cheesecloth.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Remove cinnamon and cloves. Add juices and water.
Heat until piping hot.
Serve in mugs with lemon slices, if desired.

title: Mashed Potato Candy
steps: Mix until doughlike and can be rolled.
Roll 1/2-inch thick; roll it out using powdered sugar instead of flour.
Spread peanut butter on dough and slice.

title: Red Fox Tomato Pudding

ingredients.name: stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. whole stewed tomatoes (canned or fresh)

ingredients.name: dry white bread in
ingredients.raw: 1 c. dry white (wheat) bread, in 1-inch cubes

steps: Drain tomatoes; add sugar, butter, salt and dry bread.
Cook slowly on top of stove 2 1/2 hours.
Remove from stove, place in baking dish, sprinkle with bread crumbs and bake uncovered at 375° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Easy Bran Muffins
steps: Mix dry ingredients well; stir in raisins.
Add oil, milk and egg.
Mix lightly, not too much.
Drop by spoon into greased and floured muffin cups.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.
Makes 12 medium muffins.

title: Shrimp Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese with fork.
Add horseradish and Old Bay. Combine and add shrimp with a little of juice from each can.
Form into a ball in plastic wrap.
Put in refrigerator for a couple of hours.
Before serving, pour some cocktail sauce over ball and add as necessary.
Serves 10 to 15 people.

title: Mexican Nacho Dip

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in cubes

steps: Brown meat and drain.
Stir in cheese. Then add tomatoes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) small can crushed pineapple, drained

ingredients.name: dream whip
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Dream Whip or small Cool Whip

steps: Cream together cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Add and mix marshmallows, pineapple, fruit cocktail and Cool Whip.
Freeze.

title: Toasted Herb Bread
steps: Mix together garlic powder, parsley flakes, Parmesan cheese and oregano.
Cut bread in half lengthwise.
Spread oleo or butter mixture over both halves of bread.
Cut halves into 1-inch slices. Don't cut all the way through the crust.
Wrap each half in foil and bake in a preheated 350° oven for about 15 minutes.
Serve at once.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: Shrimp Rice
steps: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
Crumble and set aside.
Drain and reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings.
Add onion and celery.
Cook until tender, but not brown.
Stir in flour. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and shrimp.
Cook and stir about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.
Add margarine; stir until melted.
Combine shrimp mixture and hot rice.
Garnish with bacon. Serves 8.

title: Tuna Cheese Spread
steps: In a large bowl combine cottage and cream cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Add tuna, one can at a time, blending until smooth after each addition.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill and serve with crackers.
Yields 4 cups.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Stir sugar and syrup well in casserole dish; microwave 4 minutes.
Take out; stir in peanuts; microwave 4 minutes.
Take out; add vanilla and butter and stir well.
Microwave 1 1/2 minutes.
Take out; add baking soda and stir well until light and foamy.
Pour into greased cookie sheet; let harden in cool place, then break apart.
Makes 1 pound.

title: Easy Rolls
steps: Pour water over yeast and sugar.
Let stand about 5 minutes. Mix salt, oil and flour in milk.
Mix with yeast mixture and let rise 1 hour in a warm room.
Roll out.
Dip in melted margarine. Put in pan and let rise again for 1 hour.
Bake in middle of oven about 10 minutes or until done.
Brush top with margarine.

title: Hot Tomato Hamburger With Rice

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies, chopped and drained (reserve liquid and add enough water to make 2 c.)

steps: Brown ground beef in hot oil, separating with a fork as it cooks. Add green pepper and onion and continue to fry on medium heat for 5 minutes. Drain excess fat. Gently stir in seasonings, Ro-Tel and Ro-Tel liquid and rice.
Cover and reduce heat to simmer.
Cook for about 15 minutes. Do not uncover or stir during the last 15 minutes of cooking.

title: Double Chocolate Cookie Bars

ingredients.name: creme filled chocolate sandwich cooky
ingredients.raw: 2 c. finely crushed creme filled chocolate sandwich cookies (about 24)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine cookie crumbs and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
In medium saucepan over medium heat, melt 1 cup chocolate chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla.
Pour evenly over prepared crust.
Top with nuts and remaining chips.
Bake 20 minutes or until set; cool.
Chill if desired.
Cut into bars.
Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Hot Spiced Wassail

ingredients.name: allspice
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. whole allspice or 1 tsp. powdered

steps: Combine cider, cranberry juice, orange juice and sugar in a large cooking pan.
Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag.
Simmer all over low heat for about 1/2 hour; leave spices in until next morning.
This may be put into a crock-pot on low heat to keep warm while serving.

title: Aka Crispies
steps: Line cookie sheet with foil.
Place crackers as close as possible on sheet.
Boil butter, margarine and sugar two minutes. Brush/pour over graham crackers and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 12 minutes.
Cool and break into pieces.

title: Creamy Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta until tender.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Thaw vegetables, leave raw.

title: Zebra Cooler
steps: In blender container, place all ingredients except whipped cream.
Cover; blend until smooth.
Serve immediately over crushed ice.
Garnish with whipped cream.
Makes about 4 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Italian Cream Cake
steps: Thoroughly cream together Crisco, oleo and sugar.
Mix in eggs and vanilla.
Alternately add flour with soda and buttermilk until blended.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Makes 3 layers. Between cooled layers, spread cooled filling.

title: Cheddar Potatoes
steps: In a greased 2-quart baking dish, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows.
Sprinkle with cheese; spoon soup mixture over top.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Uncover. Bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.

title: Pocket Pizza
steps: Beat in a bowl until dough leaves sides.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface; gather into a ball.
Knead 10 times (I had fun doing this).
Cover with a bowl; let stand 15 minutes.

title: Apricot Cake

ingredients.name: junior jar apricot with tapioca baby food or
ingredients.raw: 2 junior jars apricot with tapioca baby food or 3 small jars

steps: Mix together sugar, eggs, oil and baby food.
Add flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nuts; bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Make sure cake is completely cooled before frosting it.

title: Grandma'S Buttermilk Pie
steps: Melt 1 stick margarine.
Add other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in an unbaked pie shell.

title: John Ben Getty Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef, onions and pepper in skillet.
When tender, mix all other ingredients in casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese over top and bake 30 minutes in oven at 350°.

title: "Cowbelle" Special
steps: Cook macaroni according to directions on label.
Saute ground beef until well done.
Add tomatoes, green peppers, steak sauce and ketchup.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Pour into baking dish.
Add cooked macaroni and mushroom soup.
Top with grated cheese.

title: Roman Holiday Casserole
steps: Drain cooked macaroni.
Melt margarine in pan and add onion. Cook until golden brown.
Remove from heat and add macaroni and remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into casserole dish and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Working Woman'S Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.
Quick and easy!

title: Chili Con Queso Dip

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes with juice

steps: Cook tomatoes, onion and peppers until most of liquid is gone. Add finely cut cheese.
Melt over low heat, stirring and observing as this burns easily.
Place dip in chafing dish to keep warm.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Casserole

ingredients.name: winter mix broccoli and cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Winter mix broccoli and cauliflower (16 oz) or use fresh vegetables

steps: Cook just to heat the broccoli and cauliflower then drain and put into casserole dish.
Spread over the vegetable the mushroom soup.

title: Chicken Divan Pot Pie

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained

steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Place cookie sheet in oven to preheat. In a medium saucepan, combine oleo, flour and pepper.
Cook over low heat until mixture becomes thick and bubbly.
Gradually stir in broth and milk and stir until mixture begins to thicken.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Stir in chicken and broccoli.
Pour mixture into pie shell.
Remove second crust (frozen); place on top of filled pie.
Let thaw 10 to 20 minutes.
Crimp edges together.
Cut slits in top crust.
Place pie on cookie sheet. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Jim'S Breakfast Delight

ingredients.name: carton yogurt cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) carton small curd cottage cheese

ingredients.name: green onion pimento and red pepper
ingredients.raw: green onion slices, pimentos and red pepper

steps: Stir together the dry ingredients.
Add the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until set.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Jello Cake
steps: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. When done, poke holes on top and pour a mixture of pineapple juice and powdered sugar over hot cake.

title: Breakfast On A Bagel
steps: Place bagel halves on baking sheet.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Broil until cheese melts.

title: Apple Cobbler
steps: Heat oven to 350° and melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a saucepan, heat sugar and water until sugar melts.
Cut shortening into flour until particles are fine crumbs.
Add milk and stir.
Turn onto floured board and knead until smooth.
Roll dough into large rectangle; spread apples and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Roll up and slice into 1 1/2-inches and lay apple, side up carefully in pan.
Pour sugar syrup carefully around rolls. Bake 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Goop - Cornstarch
steps: Mix food coloring in water and add to cornstarch.
Add less water for thicker solution.
Add more water for a thinner one.

title: Russian Refresher Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients and put in 1-quart airtight container. Label and store in cool dry place.
Use within 6 months.
Makes about 3 1/2 cups of mix.

title: Hello Dolly
steps: Mix butter and graham cracker crumbs together.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer other ingredients as listed.
Sprinkle a few nuts on top.
Bake in greased pan at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
steps: Soften yeast in warm water.
Combine rye flour, molasses, shortening, salt and boiling water; blending well.
Cool to lukewarm; add softened yeast.
Stir in white flour gradually. Transfer to floured board, let rest 10 minutes.
Knead until shiny (about 10 minutes).
Cover and put in greased bowl to rise for 2 hours.

title: Salmon Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 400° to 450°.
Wash and pat dry salmon steaks. Place on sheet of foil.
Cut apple into thick slices and place on top of salmon.
Sprinkle with nutmeg (to taste) and wrap foil over. Place in oven (can put cookie sheet under foil or in shallow baking dish).
Bake 15 to 25 minutes, covered, then unwrap and continue baking 5 to 10 minutes longer at lowered temperature of 350°, until salmon pulls into flakes with fork.

title: Skillet Baked Beans
steps: Brown bacon, pepper and onion in skillet.
Drain grease and break up bacon.
Add beans, catsup and syrup to skillet.
Let simmer 45 minutes.

title: Angel Delights
steps: Melt bark.
Mil all together in pan.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and let cool.

title: Mixed Vegetable Bake

ingredients.name: philadelphia brand cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese, cubed

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and drained

steps: Heat cream cheese and milk over low heat; stir until smooth. Add mixed vegetables and seasonings; mix well.
Pour into 1-quart casserole.
Cover with potatoes and top with tomato slices.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Jack'S Delight
steps: Break up pretzels with hands (enough to cover the bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish).
Put butter on top.
Put in 300° oven until butter melts and is absorbed by pretzels.

title: Chocolate Cream Log
steps: Sift flour and measure; add baking powder, cocoa and salt. Sift again.
Beat in half the sugar a little at a time.
Beat until smooth and glossy.
Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored; add remaining sugar and vanilla.
Continue beating until very thick; slowly add water, stirring constantly.
Gently fold in beaten whites; gradually fold in dry ingredients.
Turn into shallow oblong pan about 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Line with wax paper.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Turn out on clean towel and roll up.
Cool.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
steps: Melt butter and cocoa together; add sugar, flour, salt, eggs, vanilla and milk.
Mix all together.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can add walnuts or other nuts to mix if you like.

title: Mexican Biscuit Casserole
steps: Layer a 9 x 13-inch pan with one can of the crescent rolls. Brown the ground beef in a skillet.
Drain the beef and place it on top of the crescent rolls.
Spoon the taco sauce onto the beef. Sprinkle the Cheddar cheese over the beef and taco sauce.
Cover all of this with the remaining can of crescent rolls.
Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Finger Jello
steps: Using your favorite flavor of Jell-O, mix all ingredients until dissolved.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.

title: Fred'S Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
steps: Preheat oven and Pam spray two 9 x 13-inch casserole pans. Mix all ingredients together except oleo and corn flakes.
Pour into casserole pans and top with corn flake crumbs (rough crumbs) and drizzle melted oleo over the tops.
Bake about 45 minutes or until bubbly.
Yields two 9 x 13-inch pans.

title: Pretzel Candy
steps: Melt chocolate in microwave, stirring often to avoid scorching.

Add the pretzels and peanuts and stir to coat well. Cover a cookie sheet with foil and spread the mixture on foil. Let cool in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes or until hardened. Lift foil from cookie sheet and peel away from hardened candy. Break candy into bite-sized pieces. Store in air-tight container in a cool, dry place.

title: Salmon Party Ball

ingredients.name: salmon flaked remove bone and dark meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. can salmon, flaked, remove bone and dark meat

steps: Combine cheese, juice, onion and seasoning.
Then add salmon. Chill 2 hours.
Shape mixture into ball.
Roll in nuts and parsley.
Serve with crackers.

title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Boil sugar, Karo and water until it spins thread.
Add peanuts and stir continually after peanuts are added. Cook until mixture turns brownish gold. Take from the fire. Add butter, salt and soda.
Pour onto buttered pan to cool.
When hard, break into pieces.

title: Stacked Twinkie Cake
steps: Cut Twinkies in half lengthwise; line cake pan.
Bake a yellow cake (follow cake recipe), but add 2 packages of French vanilla (instant as directions says) pudding as a topping (for regular cake size) for cake instead of icing.
Pour over the cake.
Then drain one large can of crushed pineapple and spread all over top of pudding.
Then top pineapples with Cool Whip (1 tub).
Sprinkle with 2 cups of coconut and sprinkle chopped finely chopped pecans as decoration.
Can be frozen.

title: Jalapeno Cheese Squares

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 oz. can chopped jalapeno peppers or mild green chilies

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In greased 9 x 13-inch pan, place layer of cheeses and layer of peppers.
Pour eggs over top.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until eggs are set.
Cut into appetizer size squares.

title: Almond Roca
steps: Combine sugar and butter in heavy pot.
Bring to a boil and cook for 9 minutes or hard crack stage, stirring constantly.
Pour into 2 well buttered 8-inch pie tins.

title: Green Bean Cheesy
steps: Cook green beans and garlic powder together.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium and cook 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad

ingredients.name: macaroni and cooled
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cooked macaroni, rinsed and cooled

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Chill and serve.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Bake in casserole in a 375° oven for 1 hour, until potatoes are tender.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Wholesome Oatmeal Biscuits
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, brown sugar, nonfat dry milk and oats in medium bowl.
Mix thoroughly, breaking up brown sugar to distribute evenly.
Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly.
Combine eggs and water; add to flour mixture.
Stir just until blended.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Makes 2 dozen drop biscuits.

title: Dumplings With Chives
steps: Stir flour, baking powder, salt and chives together.
Combine milk, oil and add to dry ingredients.

title: Cornish Hens
steps: Salt and
pepper
insides
of birds.
Stuff with cooked brown rice.
Baste
with sauce every 15 minutes.	Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Cook first 5 ingredients 3 1/2 hours.
Add mushrooms halfway through and cooked ground beef.

title: Congo Square
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Heaven
steps: Tear cake into tiny pieces and line bottom of an oblong cake pan.
Mix Cool Whip and almond extract together and pour over cake. Pour pie filling over this and swirl around.
(Can use other pie filling if desired.)

title: Shortcut Rocky Road Candy
steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine butterscotch, chocolate chips and condensed milk.
Heat over medium-low heat, stirring until chips are melted.
Do not let chocolate burn.
Remove from heat. Stir nuts and marshmallows into mixture.
Spread into greased 9-inch square baking pan.
Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours. Cut into squares.
Makes 2 pounds.

title: *Chocolate Pie*
steps: Mix together in saucepan everything except egg yolks.
Beat egg yolks and add to mixture.
Cook over medium heat until thick. Pour in baked pie shells.
Two-pie recipe.

title: Easy Frozen Berry Jam

ingredients.name: concentrated white grape juice simmered down from c.
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. concentrated white grape juice, simmered down from 1 1/2 c.

steps: Place berries, juices, rind and salt in saucepan.
Mash berries to release juice.
Heat to boiling.
Sprinkle gelatin over hot mixture, stirring well to dissolve.
Remove from heat; skim and pack immediately into hot, sterile jars topped with sterile lids.
Set aside to cool to room temperature.
When cool, freeze in sharp freeze section of freezer.
Remove to main part for storage.
To use, thaw overnight.
One tablespoon has 6 calories.

title: Butterfinger Dessert

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding (you may substitute lemon or chocolate)

ingredients.name: butterfinger candy bar fine
ingredients.raw: 2 large Butterfinger candy bars, crushed fine

steps: Combine cracker crumbs and margarine.
Mix well.
Put 2/3 mixture in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix pudding and milk.
Blend in ice cream and pour over cracker mixture. Refrigerate until well set.
Spread Cool Whip over pudding.
Mix candy with remaining cracker crumbs and sprinkle over top. Refrigerate.

title: Pear Half Salad
steps: Mix together softened cream cheese, mayonnaise and nuts.
Add cream a little at a time to make a smooth texture.
Add sugar.
Put a heaping tablespoon on each pear half; serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Cranberry Cream Pie

ingredients.name: pie shell baked and cooled
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 or 9-inch) pie shells, baked and cooled

steps: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy.
Beat in confectioners sugar.
Stir in cranberry sauce; fold in whipped topping.
Divide filling between the 2 pie shells.
Freeze.

title: Meatballs For Spaghetti
steps: Combine all ingredients. Shape in little balls. Roll in flour-paprika mixture.
Fry in 3 tablespoons butter until brown. Add spaghetti and sauce.

title: Buffalo Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.name: fat ranch
ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp. fat-free Ranch or Blue cheese dressing

steps: *Note:
Butter can be substituted with fat-free margarine or Blue Bonnet light to cut more fat grams.

title: Ragout
steps: Drain beans and peas.
Add all other ingredients.
Mix well. Cover and chill.

title: Buttermilk Pie 1
steps: Cream butter, sugar, flour, vanilla and nutmeg.
Add eggs and buttermilk, stirring until mixed.
Put in dash of salt, if desired.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mock Pizza Snack
steps: Fry and crumble sausage.
Spread cream cheese onto pizza pan. Cover with salsa followed by sausage, onion, green pepper and cheese.
Scoop up onto tortilla chips to serve.

title: Cracker Snacks
steps: Put first 5 ingredients into a large brown sack and shake well.
Add oil and shake until well mixed and coated.
Put in airtight container for at least 1 hour

title: Tater Wedges With Cheese
steps: Cut potatoes in wedges; roll in flour, then pour in oil in fry skillet.
Place potatoes in oil and cook until brown.
Place on paper towel to drain excess oil.
Dice lettuce and tomatoes. Place on plate, then add potatoes on top.
Heat cheese in microwave oven, then pour over top of all your ingredients. Serves 4.

title: Lemon Bars
steps: Blend cake mix, butter and egg together.
Press into a 9 X 13 greased pan.
Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add eggs and mix until smooth.
Pour over crust.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool completely before cutting.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: sweet potato pared and up
ingredients.raw: 8 sweet potatoes, pared and cut up

steps: Boil sweet potatoes for 30 minutes or until tender.
Mash. Add remaining ingredients, except marshmallows and pecans.
Spoon mixture into greased casserole, cover with marshmallows and sprinkle with pecan halves.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Sauce
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch.
Add water gradually, stirring constantly.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from fire and add butter, lemon juice and nutmeg.
This is great over bread pudding.

title: Mike'S Fried Rice

ingredients.name: meat
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 c. leftover meat (barbecue chicken, pork chops, ham, etc.)

steps: Heat wok or large frying pan on high.
Add oil, then chopped green onions, including most of green parts.
Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add leftover meat that has been cubed; stir-fry another minute.
Add cooked mixed vegetables; season to taste with garlic powder and ginger.
Stir-fry 1 minute more, then add rice and mix well.
Add scrambled eggs which have been mashed well with a fork. Sprinkle with soy sauce to taste; stir-fry for 2 more minutes. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp Casserole

ingredients.name: uncle ben s wild rice mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's wild rice mix

steps: Cook mushrooms in butter about 4 minutes.
Cook rice according to directions on box.
Mix all ingredients in buttered 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Better Than Sex Cake

ingredients.name: bar german sweet chocolate shaved
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) bar German sweet chocolate, shaved

steps: Mix dry ingredients; whip eggs and oil together and add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Ball

ingredients.name: salmon
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (1 lb. can) drained, canned salmon

steps: In bowl, combine all ingredients, except parsley.
Mix well. Refrigerate about 4 hours or until firm enough to shape into a ball.
Shape in ball; roll in parsley (and chopped nuts, if desired).
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
Serve with crackers or small slices of rye bread.
Makes 5-inch ball.

title: Veal Parmesan

ingredients.name: seasoning match your
ingredients.raw: any seasoning to match your taste

steps: Cook patties until done; drain grease.
Simmer sauce, then mix cheeses, sauce, patties, garlic and herbs.
Cook for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Bake unpricked pastry shell in very hot oven (450°) for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from oven; reduce temperature to 325°.
Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Reserve 2 tablespoons.
Place remaining bacon in pie shell.
Add cheese.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cheese.
Trim with reserved bacon.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted just off-center comes out clean.
Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Green Fluff
steps: Stir together; pour into dessert dishes and cool.
Makes four servings.

title: Swiss Chicken

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 6 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

steps: Place chicken in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper.
Top each breast with cheese slice; set aside.
Combine soup and milk; stir until smooth.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with stuffing mix and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
steps: Mix together the Miracle Whip, Sweet 'N Low and vinegar.
Pour over chopped vegetables.
Add bacon bits and cheese.
Best if chilled a couple of hours before serving.

title: Pepper Steak And Rice
steps: Cube steak and brown; drain.
In large pot, boil about 4 cups water, bouillon, onion, pepper and mushrooms for 20 minutes.
Add meat.
Boil rice; add to mixture.
Add soy sauce.
Cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Virginia'S Christmas Salad
steps: Mix Jell-O and water regular way.
Add nuts, celery, cranberries, apple and sour cream.
Chill until ready.

title: Cherry Dessert
steps: Mix graham crackers and melted butter.
Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix all other ingredients, except the cherries.
Add on top of the pie crust.
When done pouring the mixture, smooth evenly and top with the cherries; refrigerate.

title: Split Pea Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients and cook on medium until it boils, then cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.
Add water if necessary to desired thickness.

title: Quesadilla Party Wedges
steps: Brush 6 tortillas with water and place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Spread 2/3 cup of cheese over each tortilla.
Sprinkle with some diced olives and chilies.
Top each with another tortilla.
Brush tortilla lightly with water.
Cover baking sheets with foil.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes or until hot and cheese is completely melted.
Remove from oven and cut each tortilla into 6 wedges.
Top each wedge with an avocado slice and brush with lemon juice.
Add hot sauce, if desired.
Yields 24.

title: Day Ahead Banana Pudding
steps: Mix vanilla pudding with milk until blended.
Add sour cream and sweetened condensed milk.
Fold in whipped topping.

title: Blue-Apple Pie
steps: Prepare pie crust as directed on box for 9-inch pie.
Line plate bottom with crust.
Mix sugar and flour.
Mix with apples. Fill apples in bottom of crust; add the blueberry filling on top of apples.
Cover with top crust.
Slit vent in top; flute edges high to prevent spill-over in oven.
Heat oven to 400°.
Bake 10 minutes.
Reduce to 350° and bake 25 minutes longer.
Makes one 9-inch pie.
Serves 8.

title: Old-Timey Frosting
steps: Add flour to water a little at a time.
Cook until real thick; let cool.
Mix sugar and shortening together until creamy.
Add flour mixture a little at a time.
Beat until smooth and creamy. Frosting will not get hard.

title: Pineapple Chicken

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple chunks, undrained

steps: Place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine Worcestershire sauce and next 3 ingredients; stir well.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Popcorn Balls
steps: Melt margarine, sugar and vanilla in microwave oven.
Add marshmallows and melt, stirring mixture once or twice during cooking.
Pour over popcorn.
Shape into balls.

title: Fried Salt Pork With Gravy
steps: Parboil slices in skillet; drain skillet well before using it for frying.
Heat oil in skillet until hot.
Dip salt pork in flour mixture; put in skillet and fry until golden brown.
To thicken gravy, use 2 tablespoons of flour used for dredging. Blend the flour and fat very well before adding milk.

title: Cows Milk For Kittens
steps: Mix all ingredients together and store in refrigerator.
To use, heat a small quantity to room temperature.
Feed kitten with an eye dropper.

title: Heavenly Onions
steps: Simmer onions in butter in heavy pan on low until tender and separated.
Stir constantly.
Place in a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with pepper; top with cheese.
Heat soup, milk and soy sauce until blended.
Pour soup mixture over all; stir gently. Butter bread slices on both sides and top casserole, overlapping the slices.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: "Surprises"
steps: Make a large patty for each person.
Place each patty separately in foil.
Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce over meat; dash with salt and pepper.
Place slice of onion on top of meat.
Place sliced potato on top of onion.
Place sliced carrot around meat.
Sprinkle with all-purpose flour, seasoning and a little more sauce over vegetables.
Wrap tight in foil. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 325°.
Serve hot.

title: Ham And Cheese Americana

ingredients.name: american cheese each lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 6 slices American cheese, each cut into 4 lengthwise strips

steps: Combine dairy sour cream, mayonnaise and mustard.
Lay ham slice flat.
Spread with some of the sour cream mixture.
Lay strip of American cheese on one end of ham slice.
Roll jelly roll fashion.
Fasten with toothpick topped with olive.
Makes 24 rolls.

title: Cranberry Relish
steps: Cook until the berries pop the cranberries, raisins, sugar, water and spices.
Add celery and apple and continue to cook until mixture thickens and apples are cooked.
Makes about one quart.

title: Corn Bread
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease small baking pan.
Blend all ingredients about 20 seconds.
Beat 1 minute.
Pour into pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook ziti with salt.
Cut ham into little squares.
Drain ziti.
Grease a casserole dish.
Then put one layer ziti and one layer of ham into casserole dish.

title: Mushroom-Alfredo Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in medium saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in flour until well blended.
Gradually stir in half and half, water and chicken bouillon cubes.
Cook, stirring constantly until sauce is slightly thickened.
Add sliced mushrooms (drained).
Stir in cheese and heat just until melted. Serve over fettuccine noodles or tortellini.

title: Margaret'S 7 Layer Cookies

ingredients.name: rice crispy
ingredients.raw: rice crispies or corn flakes (a hand full)

steps: Melt 1 stick of oleo in a 9 X 13 pan.
Add 2 cups crushed graham crackers on top of oleo.
Continue to layer the following: 1-6 oz package chocolate chips, 1 -6 oz package butterscotch chips, 1 cup shredded coconut, 3/4 cup chopped walnuts, 1 can condensed milk--pour over the top.
Top with rice crispies or crushed corn flakes (a hand full).
Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix all of the ingredients and put into a medium sized baking skillet.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Sparkle
steps: Mix thoroughly making sure sugar is dissolved.
Serve cold. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Double Fudge Brownie Bars

ingredients.name: fudge brown mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (19.8 or 21.5 oz.) pkg. fudge brownie mix

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare brownie mix as package directs. Stir in nuts.
Spread into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until center is set.
In heavy saucepan, over medium heat, melt chips and margarine with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla.
Spread evenly over brownie layer. Cool. Chill 2 hours or until topping is firm.
Cut into bars. Store covered at room temperature.
Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Jan Sherrill'S Shrimp Salad

ingredients.name: shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: Salt cucumbers; place in bowl for 2 hours.
Wring out moisture.
Mix other ingredients together in large bowl.
When cucumbers are ready, add to mixture.
Let it sit for an hour; adjust seasoning.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Baked Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Wash mushrooms and remove stems.
In a bowl, mix clams and wine.
Cut a few mushroom stems and add 1/3 to 1/2 cup Italian bread crumbs.
Spoon stuffing into mushroom caps.
Place in baking pan and pour 1/4 cup melted butter over them.
Cook in oven 20 minutes at 375°.

title: Cheese Sticks

ingredients.name: new york state strong cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. New York State strong cheese

ingredients.name: or dash of red pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/8 tsp. or dash of red pepper (1/4 tsp. if doubled)

steps: Grate cheese.
Let butter soften to room temperature.
Hand mix cheese and butter until smooth.
Mix dry ingredients together, then pour into cheese and butter mixture.
Mix with hands until well blended.
Press onto cookie sheet (ungreased).
Bake about 15 minutes or until set at 350°.
Makes 7 to 8 dozen.

title: Raisin Pie
steps: Boil raisins in 1 3/4 cups water for 5 minutes.
Combine brown sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and salt.
Moisten with remaining 1/4 cup water.
Add to raisins, stirring until mixture boils.
Remove from heat and add butter and vinegar.
Pour into pastry lined 9-inch pie pan.
Cover with top crust.
Bake 15 minutes at 425°, then reduce heat to 350° and bake until brown.

title: Fruit Scones

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

ingredients.name: dry cranberry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. dry cranberries or cherries, coarsely chopped

ingredients.name: chilled butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chilled butter, cut into pieces (1 stick)

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Butter 2 large cookie sheets.
Sift flour into bowl.
Mix in both sugars.
Add butter and rub in fingertips until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add 1/2 cup dried fruit.
Stir in enough cream to form soft, slightly sticky dough. Turn dough out onto slightly floured surface and knead until just combined.
Gather dough into ball; flatten into disc.
Roll out to thickness of 3/4-inch.
Cut out rounds using 2-inch round cookie cutter.
Gather scraps and re-roll on floured surface.
Cut out additional rounds.

title: Salsa Chicken
steps: Dip chicken in milk and then roll in bread crumbs.
Bake chicken at 375° for 30 minutes.
Pour salsa on top.
Bake for 30 more minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Catsup

ingredients.name: cornstarch mixed with a little vinegar
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with a little vinegar

steps: Combine tomatoes, salt, sugar, vinegar, cinnamon, mustard, red pepper and mixed spices in kettle.
Boil hard for 1 hour.
Strain. Return to stove and thicken with cornstarch, moistened with a little vinegar.
Boil for 10 minutes.
Very good. I prefer to use only 1 teaspoon red pepper.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease or line bottoms of 12 muffin cup tin.
Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir in remaining ingredients until dry ingredients are moistened.
(Batter will be lumpy.) Fill cups 2/3 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Serve warm.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling

steps: Pour half and half into large mixing bowl.
Add pie filling mix and instant coffee.
Beat with wire whisk 1 minute.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped topping.
Spoon into crust.
Freeze until firm (about 6 hours).
Remove from freezer.
Let stand 10 minutes to soften.
Top with fudge sauce.
Store in freezer.

title: Mozzarella Chicken
steps: Flatten chicken between sheets of wax paper.
Spread butter over each piece and season with salt and pepper.
Place 1 slice Mozzarella cheese over each piece.
Roll up and fasten with toothpicks. Roll each in flour, dip in egg and then roll in bread crumbs.
Place in a medium size casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Grilled Ham Sandwich

ingredients.name: philadelphia brand cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: velveeta pasteurized process cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Velveeta pasteurized process cheese spread, sliced

steps: Combine cream cheese, mustard and horseradish, mixing until well blended.
Spread approximately 1 tablespoon cream cheese mixture onto each bread slice.
For each sandwich, cover one bread slice with process cheese spread, ham and second bread slice. Spread sandwich with margarine.
Grill until lightly browned on both sides.
Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Easy Caramel Frosting
steps: Melt butter in heavy saucepan.
Add brown sugar and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.
Do not boil. Remove from heat.
Stir in whipping cream.
Add powdered sugar and vanilla; beat at high speed until smooth.
Frost 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Green Apple Punch
steps: Put juices and green coloring in punch bowl.
Gently add cold 7-Up. Serves 32 (4 ounces).

title: Golden Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Sift together corn meal, flour, sugar and baking powder into a bowl.
Add egg, milk and oil.
Beat with beaters until smooth.
Bake in a greased 8-inch square pan for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Fudge Brownies(Yield: 16 Servings)
steps: Combine the flour, cocoa, sugar and salt, if desired, and stir to mix well.
Stir in the applesauce, egg whites and vanilla extract.
Fold in the nuts, if desired.
Coat an 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan and bake at 325° for 23 minutes or just until the edges are firm and the center is almost set.
Cool to room temperature and cut into square and serve.
(Calories:
80, fat:

title: Flaky Pie Crust(Makes Two 9-Inch Crusts)
steps: Place flour and salt in large bowl.
Mix until blended well. Add Crisco with pastry blender.
Cut Crisco into flour until size of small peas.
Pour in 7-Up (1/2 cup); stir with fork. Dough should be kind of sticky.
Turn onto floured board. Smooth out to small circle with hands, making sure flour stays under at all times.
Roll, then roll to size of pie plate needed. Flute edges under.
For baked shell, bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden brown.
Be sure to prick all over with fork.

title: Cheese Ring

ingredients.name: onion or
ingredients.raw: 1 medium onion, grated or finely chopped

ingredients.name: tabasco
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp Tabasco or Lawry's ground red pepper seasoning

steps: Combine all ingredients except preserves and mix well.
Chill. Mold into ring.
(I coat a small jello ring mold with vegetable spray and press ingredients into that before chilling.)
When ready to serve, unmold onto serving plate, fill middle with preserves. Can be served as a complement to a main meal or as an hors d'oeuvre with crackers.

title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter together until all sugar is dissolved. Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time, and beat thoroughly.
Sift and measure flour.
Add salt and sift again.
Add flour to egg mixture; mix carefully.
Add vanilla.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes (grease pan).

title: No Fat-No Cholesterol-No Trouble Apple Pie

ingredients.name: apple pie spice
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. apple pie spice or cinnamon

steps: Mix all ingredients and place in pie plate sprayed with vegetable spray.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serve with low-fat whipped topping.

title: Hot Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: chicken breast boiled and
ingredients.raw: 4 c. chicken breasts, boiled and chopped

steps: Mix chicken, soup, celery, onions, water chestnuts and mayonnaise.
Add 1 cup of cornflakes and mix.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Mix the rest of cornflakes with butter and spread on top.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Country Ribs(Very Good)
steps: Cut pork ribs into serving pieces.
Arrange, meaty side up, in ungreased pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
Cover and bake in 325° oven until tender, about 2 hours; drain.
Heat remaining ingredients, stirring occasionally, until jelly is dissolved.
Pour over pork.

title: Cream Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: nut pecan
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chopped nuts, pecans or walnuts

steps: Mix cream cheese, onion, green peppers and pineapple together and shape into a ball.
Cover ball with nuts.
Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Buns
steps: Mix together yeast, 1 cup warm water and 1 tablespoon sugar. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Add yeast mixture to other ingredients. Add more flour until mixture is dough consistency.
Let rise for 3 hours (beating down every 1/2 hour).
Break into buns (roll), let rise until desired size.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Gelatin Mold
steps: Mix gelatin in boil.
Add boiling water and stir.
Add salt and pineapple; pour into greased, buttered mold.
Refrigerate.

title: Jello Mold
steps: Dissolve gelatin into liquid; add sherbet.
When melted, add oranges.
Pour into mold.

title: Hot Sauce
steps: Blend in blender just enough to mix.
Chill and serve with chips.

title: Dumbo'S Double-Thick Chocolate Malted

ingredients.name: scoop chocolate ice milk
ingredients.raw: 2 scoops chocolate ice milk or ice cream

steps: Pour the milk into a small mixing bowl.
Add 1 scoop ice cream.
Beat with an eggbeater until the ice cream is mixed in. Add the rest of the ice cream and the malted milk.
Beat again until mixture is foamy.
Pour into a glass to serve.
Serves 1.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
steps: Swirl oil in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Kraut Slaw
steps: Mix all the chopped vegetables and vinegar; put in shallow pan.
Sprinkle sugar over mixture.
Let stand overnight.

title: Lemon Graham Cracker Pie
steps: Combine jello and water.
Let cool but not set.
Whip evaporated milk until thick in a large bowl.
Add juice of 1 lemon. Beat in 3/4 cup of sugar.
Add cooled Jell-O mix.
Pour into 2 graham cracker shells.
Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs or "sprinkles."
Place in refrigerator until set.

title: Bacon Wraps
steps: Preheat oven to 225°.
Take each half slice of bacon and lay flat.
Lay one cracker on top in center of bacon so that bacon can wrap around cracker.
Pour Parmesan cheese in center on cracker. Wrap bacon around cheese and cracker carefully.
Lay cracker on ungreased cookie sheet, ends of bacon down.
Bake for 2 hours.

title: Pineapple Sheet Pie
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt, egg and oleo with mixer until well blended.
Pat in cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
steps: Tie allspice, cinnamon and cloves in cheesecloth bag.
Heat cider and sugar.
Add spice bag and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs with a dash of nutmeg.

title: Fat-Free Cajun French Fries

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 5 large potatoes (with skin or peeled, as desired)

steps: Slice washed potatoes.
Place in bowl.
Mix in 2 tablespoons Cajun seasoning.
Stir in unbeaten egg whites, coating the potatoes.
Place mixture in sprayed pan(s) and bake at 350°.
Turn potatoes with a spatula every 15 minutes until done.
This gives them a crunchy, browned exterior.
Cooking time is 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Fudge Surprise

ingredients.name: pasteurized processed cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pasteurized processed cheese cut into pieces

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 c. butter or margarine cut into pieces

steps: Sift confectioners sugar and cocoa into a very large bowl; stir in pecans.
Stirring frequently, melt cheese in the top of a large double boiler over simmering water.
Add butter to melted cheese, stirring until butter melts; stir in vanilla.
Add melted cheese mixture to sugar mixture.
Stir until well blended.
Press into a 10 1/2x15 1/2 jellyroll pan.
Cover and chill until firm.
Cut into 1 inch squares.
Store in an airtight container in a cool place. Yield:
about 12 1/2 dozen pieces.

title: Chicken Vegetable Casserole

ingredients.name: california blend vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. California Blend vegetables, cooked

steps: Spread Rice-A-Roni in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chicken on rice.
Put vegetables on chicken.
Heat soup, milk and margarine until margarine is melted.
Pour soup mixture over everything. Sprinkle cheese on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Remove foil.
Sprinkle cornflakes over top of dish and put back in oven, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Enjoy!

title: Salmon Noodle Romanoff
steps: Prepare noodles.
Add to salmon, mushrooms, cottage cheese, onions and dill weed.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole. Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in blueberries.
Add milk, eggs and butter; mix just until dry ingredients are moistened.
The batter will be lumpy.
Do not overbeat.
Spoon batter into 12 (2 1/2-inch) greased muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until tops spring back when lightly touched.
Serve warm.

title: Championship Chocolate Chip Bars

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In a medium bowl, combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Stir in 1/2 cup chips.
Press firmly on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 15 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.
Serve with crackers.

title: Corn-Cheese Delight
steps: Combine corn, 1 cup of water, salt and pepper in stove top casserole. Cook for 20 minutes.
Add sugar, margarine and milk. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Arrange cheese on top. Heat until cheese melts.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Fudgie Brownies
steps: Melt butter in medium saucepan. Combine sugar and cocoa.
Add to butter.
Blend in eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla.
Stir in flour and nuts.
Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Be careful not to overbake.
Cool and cut into 16 squares.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar for an extra touch.

title: Strawberry Cooler
steps: Heat 1 cup water.
Add sugar, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Transfer to blender and add rest of ingredients, blending until ice cubes are crushed.
Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Delight

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup plu can water heated until smooth
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom soup plus 1 can water, heated until smooth

steps: Place chicken in greased casserole.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place slice of cheese on each breast.
Toss stuffing with melted butter.
Pat on top of chicken.
Pour diluted soup over dressing.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Cinnamon Twists

ingredients.name: cake compressed yeast
ingredients.raw: 1 cake crumbled, compressed yeast or 1 pkg. dry yeast *

steps: Bring sour cream to a boil and remove from heat.
Stir in, until well blended, the shortening, sugar, soda and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add egg and yeast.
Stir until yeast is dissolved.
Mix in the flour with spoon.

title: Oatmeal Cookie Candy
steps: Boil together sugar, milk, butter and salt for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir until smooth.
Add oatmeal and mix together.
Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper.

title: Three Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: or pkg. green lima bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can or 1 pkg. frozen green lima beans

steps: Scramble the beef and onion together.
Add other ingredients and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
steps: Spread pecans and coconut on bottom of sheet cake pan.
Mix cake mix as directed on box.
Pour over coconut and pecans.
Mix cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar together.
Pour mixture over cake mix.
Don't spread all the way to the edge.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Stuffed Hot Dogs

ingredients.name: butter salt pepper and onion suit
ingredients.raw: butter, salt, pepper and diced onion to suit taste

steps: Mash 4 to 5 cooked potatoes with liquid from cooking.
Add butter or margarine, salt, pepper and diced onion to suit taste. Slit 10 hot dogs from end to end leaving each end uncut.
Stuff dogs with mashed potatoes and sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Put under broiler for about 5 minutes.
Watch closely.

title: Italian Style Zucchini
steps: Brown bacon.
Remove from pan, drain off grease and set aside. (Leave small amount of grease in pan.)
Put remaining ingredients into pan.
Cover and stir often over medium heat. Takes about 1 hour.
Add bacon last 15 minutes.

title: Cranapple Relish
steps: Quarter and seed orange and apples; drain.
Coarsely grind cranberries, oranges and apples in a food grinder or blender.
Add sugar, pineapple and pecans.
Mix well.
Refrigerate overnight. Yields 2 quarts.
Enjoy your turkey.

title: Chicken Supreme
steps: Wrap bacon around chicken breast.
Spread dried beef in bottom of casserole dish.
Place chicken on top of beef.	Mix mushroom soup
and
sour
cream.
Pour over chicken and beef. Bake 3 hours in a 275° oven.
Serve on rice.

title: New Classic Potato Salad

ingredients.name: refrigerated ready cook red potato
ingredients.raw: 1 bag (1 1/2 lb.) refrigerated, ready-to-cook red potatoes

ingredients.name: kernel corn partially thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 cup frozen whole-kernel corn, partially thawed

steps: Cook potatoes according to package directions. Drain in colander under cool running water, 30 seconds.
Set aside.

title: Mincemeat Cake

ingredients.name: applesauce spice
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. applesauce, spice or carrot cake mix

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes in a tube pan that has been greased and floured.

title: Easy Sausage Casserole

ingredients.name: hillshire farm
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Hillshire Farm or Eckrich smoked sausage

ingredients.name: great northern bean with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can Great Northern beans with juice

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. green or red bell pepper

steps: Brown sausage and cut into 1/2-inch slices.
Saute pepper and onions in 1 teaspoon margarine until soft.
Cook Minute rice.
Mix cut up sausage, onion and peppers, rice, Great Northern beans and salsa in casserole dish and heat on stove until bubbly.
Serve with cornbread for an easy meal that serves 6 to 8 easily.

title: Genoese Pesto
steps: Wash the basil leaves; make sure they are well dried.
Put basil in food processor and grind (may have to add it bit by bit). Next, add rest of the ingredients.
Process until it looks like creamed spinach (do not puree).
Serve over pasta.

title: Cabbage Slaw(Low Calorie)

ingredients.name: sugar substitute or
ingredients.raw: 4 packets sugar substitute or to taste

steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Makes 6 servings, 33 calories per 1 cup serving.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
steps: Bake cake in two layers according to directions on box.
Prick holes in layers.
Mix jello according to directions on box and spoon jello over cake layers until moist.
Layer Cool Whip between layers and ice entire cake with Cool Whip.

title: Cauliflower With Anchovy Sauce
steps: Trim the cauliflower, removing tough stems.
Cook it in boiling salted water until crisp-tender.
The water must barely touch the tips so that they do not break; drain.
Transfer to a serving dish and keep warm.

title: Rockefeller Coffee Cake
steps: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cake according to directions on box.
In separate bowl, put remaining ingredients and cut with a pastry cutter or fork.
Sprinkle over top of cake. Nuts are optional.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Corn Chowder
steps: Cook bacon.
Remove bacon from heat and add chopped onion. Brown and add cooked cubed potatoes.
Add milk and corn; season. Return to heat and cook until hot all the way through.

title: Grandma Mac'S Raisin Bran Muffins
steps: Mix oil, sugar, eggs
and
Raisin Bran cereal in a very large bowl.
Sift flour, salt and baking soda alternately with buttermilk.
Bake at 400°
for
25	minutes
in greased muffin tin.
Batter keeps 4 to 6 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Wings
steps: Mix soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, m.s.g. and pepper in large bowl with tight seal.
Add chicken wings; refrigerate for 12 to 16 hours.
Turn bowl upside-down after 6 hours.
After 12 hours, place chicken onto a sheet pan and place in oven at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Spareribs And Sauerkraut
steps: Brown ribs in shortening; add onion, salt, pepper and water. Cover and simmer for 1 hour over low heat.
Add sauerkraut; cover and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash Salad
steps: Drain well, reserving syrup from fruit cocktail and pineapple. Combine in saucepan the cornstarch and 1/4 cup sugar.
Mix well. Combine and add the egg yolks and 1 cup reserved syrup.
Blend well.
Cover over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Cool thoroughly.
Fold in Cool Whip, chopped nuts, marshmallows, pineapple, fruit cocktail and mandarin oranges. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Peachy Keen Nog

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. vanilla or peach ice cream

ingredients.name: peach and
ingredients.raw: 2 fresh peaches, peeled and pitted or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peach slices, thawed

steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender container.
Cover.
Blend at medium speed until smooth, about 15 seconds.
Serve immediately.
Makes 2 servings.

title: Johnnycake
steps: Mix ingredients.
Grease and flour pan.
Bake at 450 for 20 minutes.

title: Colonial Manor French Dressing
steps: Combine vinegar and onions in blender; add chili sauce and remaining ingredients and blend well.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine butter cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix (do not follow pkg directions)

ingredients.name: mandarin orange plu juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges plus juice

steps: Mix cake mix, oil, eggs, and juice slightly, then add orange pieces and stir.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Use 4 (8 inch) round layer pans.

title: Tomato Dip
steps: Combine cream cheese and sour cream until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill until served.

title: Golden Catfish Fillets
steps: In a shallow bowl, beat the egg white until foamy, add milk and mix well. In another bowl combine cornmeal, salt, garlic powder, cayenne pepper and pepper. Dip fillets in milk mixture, then coat
with cornmeal
mixture. Heat 1/4 in of oil in large skillet. Fry over medium high heat for 3 or 4 minutes per side until golden brown. Serve with french fries and lemon wedges.

title: Dilled Mushrooms
steps: Lightly saute mushrooms in butter.
Do not brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and drain.
Mix with remaining ingredients and marinate overnight or longer in refrigerator. Serve cold.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Frozen Cucumber
steps: Combine cucumbers, onion and salt and refrigerate 2 hours. Dissolve sugar and vinegar and set aside.
Drain cucumbers and rinse salt off.
Add sugar and vinegar mixture.
Stir, pack and freeze.
A bit of summer heaven in winter!

title: Pork Roast Stuffed With Sauerkraut
steps: Remove bone from pork shoulder.
Drain sauerkraut and stuff in the shoulder.
Roll shoulder in flour with various seasonings to taste.
Close opening with sewing or skewers.
Place roast in oven at 450°, uncovered, in a greased pan.
Reduce heat as it begins to brown to 325° and bake about 40 minutes per pound or until tender.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Souflettes
steps: Break the cauliflower and broccoli into small flowerets and steam until tender, 7 to 10 minutes.
Melt margarine; remove from heat.
Gradually add flour.
Stir to make a roux and add milk gradually, blending well until smooth.
Return pan to heat and stir until sauce thickens and comes to a boil.
Cool a little and add egg yolk and cheese.
Stir well and add nutmeg.
Whip the egg white until stiff and fold carefully into sauce.
Place vegetables into 6 small greased ramekin dishes and season.
Divide the sauce evenly between dishes and bake immediately in preheated 375° oven for 35 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve at once.

title: Baked Apples
steps: Scoop out the apple cores.
Mix cinnamon and sweetener and put in the apples.
Bake in small baking dish with 1/2 cup water in microwave for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes.
Add raisins and serve.
Has 96 calories each, 0 fat grams, 1 fruit exchange.

title: Pickled Beets And Eggs
steps: Boil all ingredients, except eggs and beets in a saucepan. Add the beets and simmer for several minutes.
Cool to just warm and add shelled, boiled eggs.
When cool, keep in refrigerator.

title: 30 Minute Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bring to boil in saucepan the margarine, cocoa and water.
Remove from heat and pour over flour and sugar.
Mix well.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes until set.
Pour topping on while still hot.

title: Salsa Fresca
steps: Mix all ingredients together and store in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend.
Yields 1 pint. Keeps for a couple of days in the refrigerator, but not much longer.

title: Pumpkin Pie Crunch(Even Those Who Don'T Like Pumpkin Pie Like This!)
steps: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Combine everything but cake mix, nuts and margarine.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle cake mix on top.
Add nuts and drizzle with melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve with whipped topping.
Serves 16 to 20.

title: Arkansas Cheese Ball
steps: Let cheese soften; work together.
Mix in garlic powder, mustard and horseradish.
Makes 4 balls/logs.
Roll in nuts, paprika and chili powder.
Refrigerate.
(Also freezes well.)

title: Apple Nut Ring

ingredients.name: refrigerated buttermilk biscuit
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz. each) pkg. refrigerated buttermilk biscuits

steps: Separate biscuits into 20 pieces.
Combine sugar and cinnamon. Dip biscuits into melted butter; then roll in sugar mixture. Arrange biscuits in a single layer in a deep dish baker.
Peel, core and slice apples using an apple peeler, corer or slicer.
Cut apple slices in half.
Place an apple slice between each biscuit and around outer edge of deep dish baker.
Mix nuts and raisins with remaining sugar mixture and sprinkle over top.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: chicken with scissor
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cooked chicken, cut into small pieces with scissors

ingredients.name: planter slivered almond toasted
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Planters slivered almonds, toasted (1/3 c.)

steps: Combine all ingredients except lettuce.
Mix thoroughly. Serve over lettuce, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Delicious Pea And Bean Soup

ingredients.name: split pea
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. split peas or Northern beans

steps: Combine all ingredients in a large soup kettle and bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer for approximately 3 hours.
Enjoy!!

title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: egg noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained

steps: Cook ground beef and onion until beef is brown.
Stir in flour, salt, garlic salt, pepper and mushrooms.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir soup into meat mixture.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve over noodles.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Mock Pecan Or Pinto Bean Pie

ingredients.name: pinto bean
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pinto beans (home cooked or canned)

steps: Mix eggs, sugar, margarine and vanilla with mixer.
Add coconut and set aside.
Put beans in blender (or mash with fork); you may want to add up to 1/4 cup of juice.
Add beans to first mixture; pour into pie shell.
Bake for 55 minutes at 350°.

title: Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: cold coffee
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. cold coffee (add 1 tsp. soda to the coffee)

steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs, one at a time, and blend.
Add coffee.
Then add dry ingredients.
Lastly add hot water.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: One Punch Pineapple Punch
steps: In a large punch bowl, combine the pineapple juice and apricot nectar.
Just before serving, add the club soda and sherbet. Makes 25 to 30 servings.

title: White Clam Sauce

ingredients.name: all the clam juice you can get
ingredients.raw: all the clam juice you can get

steps: Heat oil in pan; chop garlic and cook in olive oil until golden brown.
Add clam juice and pepper; let simmer very slowly. Add clams.
A few minutes before serving, add parsley.
Pour over linguine and serve.

title: Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of hot water.
Add strawberries and stir until thawed.
Add bananas, pineapple and nuts.
Pour 1/2 of the mixture into dish.
Let set.

title: Aunt Mamie'S Tomato Relish(Good To Put On Vegetables)

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.raw: 4 c. vinegar (red vinegar, White Oaks Brand best)

ingredients.name: sugar c.
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. sugar to 1/2 c. to taste (varies with vinegar)

ingredients.name: heaping tsp. each of mustard cinnamon and ginger
ingredients.raw: 2 heaping tsp. each of mustard, cinnamon and ginger

steps: In a cloth, put 2 heaping teaspoons of mustard (ground), cinnamon and ginger.
Tie up cloth.
Scald tomatoes and peel.
Cut up and mix all ingredients.
Cook until thick (use rubber gloves when cutting up hot peppers).
Cook about 3 hours until thick. Makes about 5 or 6 pints.

title: Microwave Caramels
steps: Combine butter, sugars and syrup in 3-quart glass casserole. Microwave 5 minutes or until butter is melted.
Stir to dissolve sugar.
Gradually blend in sweetened condensed milk.
Microwave, uncovered, 13 to 17 minutes (240°), stirring 4 to 5 times.
Check temperature during last few minutes (between soft and hard ball stage).
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Pour into foil-lined buttered (butter foil well) 8 x 8-inch or 7 x 10-inch pan.
Cool completely.
Turn out on board.
Cut squares; wrap in wax paper.

title: Cherry Fudge Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350° and grease a 12 x 10 x 1-inch cookie sheet.
In large bowl, mix ingredients with a spoon.
Pour onto the pan and cook 20 to 30 minutes.
(Don't overcook.
Use the clean toothpick test.)
Frost the cake when it is cooled with chocolate fudge frosting.
Cut into squares.

title: French-Style Beans
steps: Combine all ingredients and marinate all day in the refrigerator.
Cook several slices of onion; crumble and add to beans.
Cook in the oven at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
steps: Layer bottom of pan with vanilla wafers; put slice of banana on each wafer.
Mix Eagle Brand milk and water; add pudding and beat with fork until lumps are gone.
Add sour cream; mix until well blended.
Add Cool Whip.
Cover layer of wafers and bananas with 1/2 of pudding.
Add another layer of wafers and bananas; cover with other half of pudding.
Crumble remaining wafers on top.

title: Easy Oven-Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 frying chicken, cut in serving pieces or equivalent pieces of your choice

steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Melt shortening in 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan. Mix dry ingredients in paper or plastic bag.
Add chicken and shake to coat.
Place skin-side down in pan and bake 20 minutes. Turn and bake another 20 minutes or until tender.
