For barbecued oven chicken, omit the dry coating and baste with any barbecue sauce.
Continue basting every 15 or 20 minutes.
Can use little or no shortening.

title: Pumpkin Whirlies
steps: Mix and spread onto a sprayed cookie sheet (you can sprinkle with chopped walnuts if you want); bake for 15 minutes at 375°. When done, lay on a powdered sugar covered linen towel or newspaper; roll into a log and let cool about an hour.
When cool, spread with the following filling and roll into a log without the towel or newspaper.
Refrigerate and then slice.

title: T-Cakes White Barbecue Sauce
steps: Mix ingredients until smooth.
Great on chicken.

title: Grandma'S Cherry Salad
steps: Drain pineapple very well, then add the rest of the ingredients in order.
Mix very well and refrigerate until ready to use, at least 3 hours.
Delicious with poultry or serve as a dessert salad.

title: Shoo-Fly
steps: Mix flour, brown sugar and butter to crumbs.
Keep 1 cup crumbs aside.
Add boiling water, molasses, eggs, hot water and baking soda.
Mix all together with mixer.
Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Broccoli Cheese Bake

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Combine all except Parmesan cheese in a casserole dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

title: Mostaccioli
steps: Cook noodles.
Brown meat with pepper and garlic.
Stir everything together, except Mozzarella.
Put into a 9 x 13-inch dish and cover.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Then put on Mozzarella and bake, uncovered, for another 20 minutes.

title: Pink Punch

ingredients.name: each strawberry and cherry kool aid
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. each: strawberry and cherry Kool-Aid

steps: Mix frozen juices according to directions.
Add other ingredients and stir until dissolved.
Stir into 2 quarts of cold water.
Chill.
When ready to serve, add 1 bottle ginger ale. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Hot Apple Cider
steps: Pour apple cider into basket of a 30-cup coffee pot.
Add remaining ingredients, except cinnamon sticks and orange wedges. Perk.
Serve with cinnamon sticks and orange wedges.

title: Bean Soup
steps: Mix
all
together and store 2 cups of mixture in individual Ziploc bags.

title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Cookies
steps: Mix first four ingredients with a fork.
On floured surface, roll out dough to about 1/4-inch thick.
Using a cookie cutter, punch out 2-inch rounds of dough.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Top each round with approximately 1/4 teaspoon strawberry preserves.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Silk Pie
steps: Cream
butter;
gradually
add sugar, beating at medium speed until well blended.
Stir in chocolate and vanilla.
Add 1
egg and beat for 4 minutes.
Add remaining egg and beat for 5 minutes. Spoon mixture into graham cracker crust.
Chill at least 8 hours. Serve with whipped cream on top.

title: Old-Fashion Blackberry Cobbler
steps: Cream 1 cup sugar and margarine together.
Add flour and milk. Mix with mixer.
Spoon mixture gently into 12 x 10-inch greased baking dish.
Add berries on top of crust mixture.
Sprinkle remaining cup of sugar over berries.
Add the boiling water and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until well browned.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
steps: Cream butter; add sugar gradually, continuing to cream well. Combine flour and baking powder.
Sift together and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry.
Fold into creamed mixture.
Add flavoring.
Bake in 3 (9-inch) pans which have been greased and floured or lined with wax paper.
The oven should be 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 3 (9-inch) layers.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole

ingredients.name: size can green chili salsa
ingredients.raw: 1 medium size can green chili salsa

steps: Bake the chicken ahead of time so skin and bones can be removed.
Cut chicken into cubes.
Cut about 7 tortillas into strips.
Make gravy of the first 6 ingredients.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole

ingredients.name: stove top chicken flavored
ingredients.raw: 1 box Stove Top chicken flavored or cornbread

steps: Combine Stove Top seasoning packet, both soups, salt, pepper and melted oleo.
Stir in chicken.
Then add Stove Top bread crumbs; stir until well mixed, adding enough chicken broth to moisten Stove Top.
You want the mixture a little thin because it will dry out some as it bakes.
Pour into a casserole dish; bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
steps: Crush vanilla wafers.
Melt butter and add to cookie crumbs. Mix until
moist.
Then press mixture into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

title: Bessie'S Ritz Cracker Pie
steps: Combine whipped cream and powdered sugar.
Spread over crust when cooled.
Let set 3 to 4 hours.
When ready to serve, top with sweetened fresh fruit.

title: Apple Pastry
steps: Combine butter, margarine, cream cheese and flour.
Knead until well blended.
Form into ball, cover with plastic and place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.

title: Kugel
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions.
Mix the other ingredients in a large bowl.
Add cooked noodles.
Grease a rectangular baking dish; heat slightly.
Pour ingredients into baking dish.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake until golden at 375°.

title: Fruit Pie

ingredients.name: sugar and tbsp. flour mixed
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sugar and 1 Tbsp. flour, mixed

steps: Grease sides of 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Put in fruit.
Pour in water.
Mix sugar and flour; sprinkle evenly over fruit. Sprinkle dry cake mix over this.
Add margarine patties over cake mix.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over the top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed

ingredients.name: pared sweet potato lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 6 pared, cooked, large sweet potatoes, halved lengthwise or 1 (1 lb. 1 oz.) can vacuum-pack sweet potatoes

steps: In large, heavy saucepan or Dutch oven, combine sugar with corn syrup, butter and salt.
Bring to boiling over low heat, stirring until butter melts and sugar is dissolved.
Add pecans.
Reduce heat.
Add sweet potatoes, arranging in single layer; baste well with syrup.
Cook, covered, over very low heat, turning once, 15 minutes.
Remove cover.
Cook, basting occasionally, 15 minutes longer, or until potatoes are well glazed.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Bacon Roll-Ups
steps: Sprinkle bacon bits on top of bread; sprinkle cheese on top of bacon bits.
Put in microwave for 3 or 4 seconds or until butter is melted.
Roll them up and pinch ends together while hot.

title: Grapefruit Peel Candied

ingredients.name: grapefruit and in
ingredients.raw: 3 grapefruit, peeled and cut in strips

steps: Peel the grapefruit; cut in strips.
Cook in the water and sugar.
Keep adding water as it cooks.
When it looks transparent, you have to keep stirring, then use sugar to roll pieces in until it will absorb no more.
Lay on wax paper, then put in container. Eat as pieces of candy.

title: Delicious Punch
steps: Dissolve sugar and Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water, then add 2 cups cold water.
Add fruit juices and stir.
Chill.
Add 1 bottle ginger ale right before serving.
You may also float sherbet on top if desired.

title: Yogurt Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: 2 c. flour (whole wheat gives better flavor and texture)

steps: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add egg and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
Stir together flour, baking soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with yogurt.
Blend well.
Turn into a greased 9-inch square cake pan.
The top can be sprinkled with chopped nuts if desired.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Six Layer Dinner

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Layer potatoes, corn, onion, meat and carrots in 3-quart casserole, seasoning each layer with salt and pepper.
Pour tomatoes over top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 3/4 hours or until vegetables are done.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Pie

ingredients.name: hen
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 lb. hen or 6 chicken breasts

ingredients.name: flour dissolved in cold water with c. milk added
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. flour, dissolved in cold water with 1 c. milk added (add this to broth)

steps: Cook chicken until tender; remove all bones and skin.
In large pan, arrange layer or chicken and 1/2 cup margarine.
Roll dough and cut in strips.
Place over chicken.
Alternate this step until all chicken has been used, then pour chicken broth over this and roll top crust.
Place on pie and slit in center.
Brush top with butter.
Bake in a 350° to 375° oven until golden brown.

title: Buck Snort Slaw
steps: Early in day (6 to 8 hours) ahead, cut up cabbage and place in bowl.
Slice onion and place on top of cabbage.
Mix together and heat:
sugar, vinegar, celery seed, oil and salt.
Heat until sugar dissolves.
Pour over cabbage; do not stir.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve cold.

title: Crab Meat Stew

ingredients.name: imitation
ingredients.raw: 2 to 4 lb. imitation or real crab meat

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: milk (1 can to each can of soup)

steps: Chop onion and saute in butter until tender, then slowly add crab meat.
Stir on low heat so it won't stick.
Add white pepper, then slowly add 2 cans of soup, then 2 cans of milk, stirring slowly.
Do the same with the other 4 cans of soup.
Let cook on low heat until ready to serve.
Feeds 6 to 8 people.
This can also be frozen for quick meal with no bother.
Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Chip Vanilla Gems
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine flour, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
Set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix well the oil, milk, egg and vanilla.
Add the liquid ingredients to the dry and stir just until combined.
Don't overmix or the muffins will be tough. Gently fold in the chocolate chips.
Spoon batter into 24-cup mini muffin pan or 12-cup regular muffin pan that is sprayed lightly with cooking spray.
Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. You can use regular chips if you use regular muffin pans only. Enjoy!

title: Sin Pie
steps: Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pork Cutlets With Curried Cream Sauce

ingredients.name: curry powder
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tsp. curry powder or to taste

ingredients.name: cornstarch dissolved in tbsp. cold water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. cornstarch, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. cold water

steps: Pat the pork cutlets dry and sprinkle both sides with the curry powder and salt and pepper.
In a skillet, cook the onions in 1/2 stick of the butter over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.
In a large ovenproof skillet, brown the cutlets in the remaining 1/2 stick butter over moderately high heat for 3 minutes on each side and stir in the onions, the chutney and the cream.
Bake the mixture, covered, in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Bring the sauce to a boil; swirl in the cornstarch mixture and cook the sauce over moderate heat, stirring, until it has the desired consistency.
Serve the dish with rice.

title: Mushroom Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed.
Mix in butter and nutmeg.
Mix mushrooms with soup and salt to taste.
In casserole, alternate soup and rice, ending with soup.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
Add toasted pecans before taking from oven.
Serves 6.

title: Light Dessert
steps: Melt marshmallows in heated milk and put in refrigerator until thickens.
Add whipped cream and nuts to marshmallows and milk. Mix, stirring well.
Add whiskey.
Mix and cover with chocolate decorations.
Freeze, if desired.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
steps: Place hamburger in the bottom of a small roaster or casserole. Place onion, carrots and potatoes over the meat.
Mix soup and water together and pour over vegetables and hamburger.
Season with salt and pepper; bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

title: Instant Creamy Hot Chocolate

ingredients.name: nonfat dry milk powder
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 qt. size) box nonfat dry milk powder

ingredients.name: chocolate flavored drink mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) box chocolate flavored drink mix

steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight container.
Use 1/3 cup of the mixture in a cup of hot water.

title: Soda Cracker Bars
steps: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with soda crackers.
Mix brown sugar, cracker crumbs, milk and butter.
Bring to a slow boil and cook 7 minutes.

title: My Favorite Chocolate Cake
steps: Blend first 5 ingredients well.
Can use graham cracker crust in 9 x 12-inch pan or cheese cake pan.
Pour into prepared crust. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
Turn off oven and let sit 20 minutes. Cool completely and refrigerate.
Top with fresh fruit or canned pie filling before serving.

title: Coca Cola Salad
steps: Dissolve jellos and hot water together. When
mixture begins to thicken add nuts, cherries and pineapple. Refrigerate and allow to congeal.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Beat eggs. Add all other ingredients to the beaten eggs.
Pour excess butter into mixture and mix well.
Pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Super Quick Rolls
steps: Mix water, yeast and sugar until dissolved.
Add flour, milk and oil.
Stir until all flour is moist.
Batter will look lumpy. Bake at once in well buttered muffin pans at 475° for about 15 minutes, or until browned.

title: Judias Estofadas(Pinto Bean Soup)

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 3 large ripe tomatoes, peeled and halved

steps: In a 5-quart pan, add 3 quarts of water and all ingredients, except garlic, olive oil and paprika.
(Mash garlic; mix with paprika and olive oil and add to the beans after beans are tender.) Add water as needed.
Serves 6.

title: Fruit Delight

ingredients.name: jell o
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O (mixed fruit or strawberry-banana)

steps: Mix together cottage cheese, dry Jell-O and drained fruit. Fold in Cool Whip and all the pecans you can afford.
This can be made 1 or 2 days ahead and kept in the refrigerator.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Banana Slat Cake
steps: Cream oleo with sugar and blend well; add beaten eggs to mixture.
Add vanilla and bananas to creamed mixture.
Sift and measure flour with soda and sift again.
Add milk and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture.
Bake in 9x13-inch pan for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Crispy Chicken With Asparagus Sauce

ingredients.name: hot rice with parsley
ingredients.raw: hot cooked rice with chopped parsley

steps: In pie plate, dip chicken into egg; coat with bread crumbs. In skillet over medium low heat, cook chicken 15 minutes or until browned on both sides and no longer pink.
Remove; keep warm.
In same skillet over low heat, combine soup, milk and water.
Serve with rice.
Serves 4.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Combine sugar and cocoa in small saucepan; blend in evaporated milk and corn syrup.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils.
Boil and stir one minute.
Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla.
Serve warm.

title: Cowboy Coffee Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and shortening until crumbly; take out 1/4 cup.
To remaining crumbs, add baking powder, soda and spices; mix well.
Pour into one greased and floured 8 x 1 1/2-inch round pan; top with reserved crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve warm.
Makes one cake.

title: Bacon Spinach Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: spinach and well
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and well drained

steps: Melt butter in the water.
Remove from heat.
Stir in stuffing and add the rest of the ingredients, except bacon.
Chill at least one hour.

title: Pina Colada Cake
steps: Mix cake mix as directed on box except put the crushed pineapples instead of water.
Bake and cool.
After the cake has cooled.
Punch holes in cake with wooden spoon.
Mix the cream of coconut and eagle brand milk together and pour over cake and then top with cool whip and loose coconut.

title: Raspberry Pretzel Salad

ingredients.name: raspberry
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen raspberries (not the loose frozen raspberries)

steps: Mix crumbs, butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press in pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Cream the cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Spread on pretzel crust.
Dissolve jello in hot water; add frozen raspberries.
Let stand until thick and pour over top.
Let set.

title: Duchess Potatoes
steps: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover 15 minutes or until tender.
Drain and mash.
Stir in butter and next 3 ingredients. Let cool 10 minutes.
Stir in eggs.
Spoon mixture into a large decorating bag fitted with a large star tip.
Pipe 14 (2-inch) rosettes onto a lightly greased baking sheet.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges.

title: Easy Glazed Yams

ingredients.name: yam
ingredients.raw: 2 (17 or 23 oz.) cans yams or sweet potatoes, drained

ingredients.name: bama pineapple
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Bama pineapple or peach preserves

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange yams in ungreased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish.
Spoon preserves evenly over yams.
Top with nuts, marshmallows and butter.
Bake 25 minutes or until hot. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Peach And Orange Marmalade
steps: Crush peaches.
Put oranges through coarse blade of food chopper.
Add sugar and cook one hour.
Add syrup from cherries and chopped cherries just before marmalade is cooked.
Pour in hot jars and seal.

title: Golden Baked Chicken
steps: Place chicken on a rack in a shallow baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and brush on chicken.
Bake at 370° for 1 hour.
Brush chicken with mixture once or twice during baking.

title: Marinated Fresh Mushrooms

ingredients.name: mushroom wash trim off end and lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, wash, trim off ends and slice lengthwise

steps: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Marinate at least 3 hours or overnight.

title: Coconut Sheet Cake
steps: Mix and bake cake as directed.
Boil pineapple, juice and sugar for 5 minutes.
Prick holes in hot cake and pour boiled mixture over top of cake.
Prepare pudding and spread on cooled cake.
Top with Cool Whip and coconut.

title: Shrimp Sandwiches
steps: Soften cream cheese and add salad dressing.
Drain shrimp and add to cheese mixture and add a few parsley flakes.
Makes great party sandwiches.

title: Coconut Cake

ingredients.name: sifted swan down cake flour
ingredients.raw: 3 c. sifted Swans Down cake flour

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter; gradually add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt.
Add eggs one at a time to creamed mixture, beating well after each addition.
Add flour mixture alternately with milk and flavorings, beating after each addition until smooth.
Pour batter into three greased and floured 9 x 2-inch cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool in pans 10 minutes.
Remove from pans; finish cooling on racks.

title: Sweet Green Tomato Pickles
steps: In a large plastic container, soak tomatoes in water and lime mixture for 24 hours. Rinse well and soak in cold water 3 hours. Combine vinegar, sugar and salt in another container.
Place pickling spice, cloves and celery seed in cheesecloth bag. Add to vinegar mixture.
Set aside. Drain water from tomatoes; pour vinegar mixture over the tomatoes.
Soak overnight.
Next morning, simmer mixture until the tomatoes are transparent (about 50 minutes). Fill in hot sterilized jars and process in boiling water bath 5 minutes.

title: Bacon And Green Bean Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In bowl, combine beans, soup, milk, 1/2 can onions, 1/2 jar bacon bits and pepper; pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake 30 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bacon bits.
Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Guacamole Viva
steps: Peel and mash avocado with a fork in a medium glass bowl.
Add lemon juice and sour cream, mixing well.
Stir in garlic, onion and tomato.
Season with celery salt, oregano and cayenne pepper. Place avocado pit in the center; cover and chill until serving. Remove pit before serving.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
steps: Pop corn in air popper.
Place popcorn and peanuts in double brown grocery bag; set aside.
Combine sugar, butter, syrup and salt in glass bowl.
Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes, stirring after each minute, until mixture boils.
Microwave 2 minutes more. Stir in soda.
Pour syrup mixture over popcorn in bag.
Close bag; shake well.
Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High; shake. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High; shake.
Pour into roasting pan. Cool to separate.

title: Pasta Carbonara
steps: Take 1 pound of bacon and cut into cubes; brown.
Add 1 cup sliced mushrooms, garlic and green pepper; saute with bacon.
Set aside and save fat in pan.
In a spaghetti bowl, beat 2 eggs.
Add parsley and grated cheese.
Cook 1 pound of spaghetti.
Save 1/2 cup of water.
Fold spaghetti into egg mixture.
Let set 3 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup of boiling water; mix well.
Heat first mixture of bacon and vegetables; pour over spaghetti.

title: Dirt Dessert
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients in one bowl.
Mix the pudding, milk and Cool Whip in a large bowl, then blend and fold cream cheese mixture into Cool Whip mixture.
Layer cookie crumbs with the chocolate pudding combination in a clear glass container and decorate as you see fit.
Can be served with a little toy shovel. You can end with a crumb mix on top and put an artificial flower in center.

title: Grandma Liskawa'S Pork And Beans

ingredients.name: pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 5 (15 1/2 to 16 oz.) cans pork and beans

steps: Brown ground beef. Drain.
Add beans and remaining ingredients. Mix well.
Bake at 370° for about 1 hour or until nice and bubbly, stirring some.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Put in pan under broiler.
Turn frequently (every 3 or 4 minutes).
Cook 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 5 to 6.

title: Indian Tacos
steps: Mix together dry ingredients, add lard or shortening and mix until crumbly.
Begin adding water until a nice soft dough.
Roll on floured board to desired size.
Poke hole in the middle. Either fry in frying pan with 1 inch of oil or electric fryer. Brown to desired color, turn over and fry on the other side and drain.

title: Garden Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: hellmann s light
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Hellmann's light or reduced-fat mayonnaise dressing

ingredients.name: chicken breast grilled and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, grilled and sliced

steps: To make dressing, in a small bowl, combine first 6 ingredients. In a large bowl, toss vegetables with half of dressing.
Arrange on lettuce-lined platter.
Top with chicken.
Serve with remaining dressing.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Crepes(French)
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together in a bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Beat mixture until smooth.

title: Golden Corn Stuffing Bake

ingredients.name: campbell s golden corn soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's golden corn soup

ingredients.name: celery and onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. finely chopped celery and onions

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm herb seasoned mix
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned mix

steps: Combine soup, celery and onions in a 9-inch greased pie plate. Spoon stuffing mixture in.
Arrange chicken over stuffing mixture.
Press lightly into stuffing.
Combine sugar, margarine and mustard.
Spread evenly over chicken.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
Garnish with fresh sage, if desired.

title: Crunchy Cheese Ball
steps: Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in next 5 ingredients.
Cover; chill several hours.
Form into ball; roll in nuts to coat.
Serve with crackers.

title: Brown Sugar Sauce

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. sour cream or heavy sweet cream

steps: Add sugar to cream gradually, stirring constantly.
Add vanilla; beat thoroughly.
Serve over pound cake, ice cream or use as a fresh fruit dip.

title: Rocky Road Candy
steps: Cut the marshmallows in quarters and put into a very large bowl in double boiler.
Melt chocolate.
When melted, add milk and keep mixing until smooth. Add the vanilla and stir.
Let cool slightly. Add nuts.
Pour over marshmallows and mix.
Put in shallow loaf pan lined with waxed paper and let cool in refrigerator overnight.

title: Gram'S Irish Soda Bread
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Mix raisins with sifted flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Cut in butter with a pastry blender until consistency of corn meal.
Gradually add buttermilk and eggs.
Mix gently until just moistened.
Knead lightly until smooth on a floured board and shape into a round loaf.
Put dough in a greased round baking pan.
With a sharp knife cut a cross in top of dough.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°; reduce heat to 350° and bake 45 minutes.
Cool on wire rack.
Slice and dunk in a cup of hot tea.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients together and form into balls.
Bake.

title: Favorite Four Bean Salad
steps: Mix kidney beans, green beans, wax beans and garbanzo beans. Marinate overnight.
Add onion rings just before serving for crispness.

title: Kart-Wheels

ingredients.name: pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pie filling or jam (any flavor)

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix flour, margarine, powdered sugar, baking powder and just enough milk until dough forms.
If dough seems dry, mix in more milk one teaspoon at a time.
Divide dough into 6 equal parts.
Shape each part into a ball.
Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten slightly.
Make an indention 1 3/4 inches in diameter and about 3/4-inch deep in center of each. Fill each indention with about 2 tablespoons pie filling.

title: Melt Away Bars
steps: In large bowl, mix butter, sugar, egg yolk, vanilla, flour and 1/2 cup nuts.
Blend well.
Spread in ungreased jelly roll pan 15 x 10-inch.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
Spread over mix. Sprinkle with colored sugar and 1/2 cup nuts.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown.
Cool and cut into squares or bars.

title: Pecan Pralines I

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. brown sugar (1/2 light and 1/2 dark)

steps: Mix sugar, salt, milk and Karo syrup in heavy, 3-quart pan and cook to soft ball stage.
Add butter and vanilla.
Beat until cool.
Add pecans and drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
When firm, store in closed container.
Makes approximately 2 dozen pralines.

title: Recipe For Preserving Children
steps: Mix the children and dogs together.
Put them in a field, stirring constantly.
Pour the brook over the pebbles.
Sprinkle the field with some flowers.
Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in a hot sun.
When brown, remove and set to cool in a bathtub.
Now, go on with your cooking.

title: Cauliflower Salad
steps: Layer the first three ingredients in bowl.
Mix together mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar, then pour over first mixture. Cover top with cheese.
Let stand in refrigerator 24 hours, then mix and serve.

title: Linda'S Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook chicken and cut up.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix all ingredients and pour into greased casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Freezes well.

title: Death By Chocolate
steps: You may cut this recipe in half, it makes quite a bit.
Also, you can omit the Kahlua!

title: Pizzelle(Italian Cookies)
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop by teaspoon on waffle pizzelle maker.
Cook about 30 seconds.

title: Glazed Lamb Chops
steps: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper.
Brown both sides well under broiler.
Drain all fat.
Place in oiled baking dish. Combine curry powder, orange juice, lemon juice and honey.
Pour over chops and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes. Add oranges to sauce for last 5 minutes to warm them.

title: Tuna Spread
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Serve on crackers.
This is great for children's birthday parties.
Put some on a cracker; add a thin slice of ripe olive.

title: Perfect Gravy

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.raw: 1 can beef broth or chicken (8 oz.)

steps: Melt margarine.
Add flour; mix well.
Cook over medium heat until hot.
Add broth.
Cook until boiling.
Add other soup and water.
Cook 15 minutes longer.
Good over meat loaf or cream potatoes or anything that needs a little flavor.

title: Oatmeal Cake
steps: Boil water; remove from heat.
Add oatmeal and margarine.
Mix other ingredients; add to oatmeal mixture.
Bake in an oblong pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage And Cheese Biscuits

ingredients.name: reduced fat cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. (2 oz.) shredded reduced fat Cheddar cheese

steps: Place turkey in a nonstick skillet; cook over medium heat until browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain and pat dry with paper towel. Combine turkey and next 5 ingredients in a bowl; stir well.
Add buttermilk, stirring until just moistened.
Drop dough by heaping tablespoonful onto a baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray.
Bake at 450° for 11 minutes (68 calories each).
Makes 1 dozen.

title: Centennial Squares
steps: Mix graham wafer crumbs with butter and sugar to make crust. Spread on cookie sheet or shallow cake pan.
Put layer of chocolate chips first, then butterscotch chips, coconut and nuts. Top with Eagle Brand evenly.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool and cut into slices or squares.

title: Johnny Menyetta
steps: Brown ground beef, bell pepper, onions and celery.
Preboil noodles.
Mix noodles with meat sauce.
Add tomato soup, water and mushrooms.
Cover with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes; bake uncovered the last 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Baked Flounder
steps: In a well buttered, flat casserole dish, lay the fish, overlapping them.
Cover fish with very thin slices of Bermuda onion.
Put another layer of fish.
Cover fish with very thin slices of tomato.
Cover top of layers with a thick coat of sour cream.
Cook in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: French Fish Fillets
steps: Dip fillets in dressing; coat with crumbs.
Place fillets in grease in a 1 1/2-quart utility pan.
Sprinkle paprika, as desired.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Bake for 3 1/2 to 5 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Gumdrop Fruitcake

ingredients.name: colorful gumdrop in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. colorful gumdrops, cut in 4 pieces (do not use licorice flavored gumdrops)

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. cinnamon or apple pie spice

steps: Mix candy, raisins, nuts and dates with dry cake mix.
Beat together apple pie filling, eggs and cinnamon until well mixed. Pour this in cake and fruit mix and mix well.
Pack into two greased loaf pans or one greased tube pan and bake at 350° for 70 minutes.
May put icing on cake or eat plain.
This is very good and rather easy.

title: Broccoli Supreme
steps: Cook and drain broccoli.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and onion. Blend in cooked broccoli.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Melt margarine and add seasoned crumbs.
Mix well and sprinkle over top of cheese.
Bake in 350° oven 30 to 45 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tacos In Pasta Shells

ingredients.name: whipped cream cheese with chives
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. whipped cream cheese with chives

steps: Cook pasta shells, drain and toss with margarine, set aside. Brown ground beef and drain.
Stir cream cheese into ground beef, add taco seasoning (enough to taste) and salt, simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Crisp Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Mix the cucumbers and onions with the salt and 2 quarts cracked ice.
Then let them stand, covered with a weighted lid, for 3 hours.
Drain thoroughly and put the vegetables in a large kettle.
Add the sugar, spices and vinegar.
Bring almost to a boil, stirring often with a wooden spoon, but do not let boil. Pack the pickles into hot jars and seal.

title: Broccoli Dip

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese up
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. (16 oz.) Velveeta cheese, cut up

steps: Microwave broccoli in covered 2 qt. microwavable bowl on high 3 minutes or until thawed; drain.
Add Velveeta and garlic powder. Microwave 2 to 3 minutes or until
Velveeta is melted stirring, after 2 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers and cut up vegetables.

title: Broiled Zucchini Squash
steps: Wash zucchini; remove ends and slice lengthwise in 1/4-inch slices.
You should have about 5 slices.
Place on cookie sheet. Dot with small cubed butter (about 1/4-inch each).
Put thin slices of garlic in between butter cubes.
Heat under broiler until the zucchini begins to brown on edges.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
steps: Mix together the first 4 ingredients with your hands and shape into balls about the size of tennis balls.
Put into a pan and pour sauce over each ball until it is well covered.
Bake at 450° for about an hour.

title: Pumpkin Roll
steps: Stir altogether.
Pour into a greased cookie sheet.
Bake about 14 minutes at 350°.
Place on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar.

title: Six Cup Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Easy Chicken
steps: Combine chicken with mushroom soup for 15 minutes at medium heat.
Fold in sour cream, sherry (if used) and poultry seasoning. Cook in shalloww baking dish or pan in 325° oven.

title: Oatmeal Cake Topping
steps: Heat together oleo, sugar, evaporated milk and vanilla.
Add coconut and spread on hot cake.

title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Let cream cheese soften.
Mix mayonnaise and lemon juice with electric mixer.
Add other ingredients and mix well.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Combine cucumbers and onions.
Sprinkle with salt and set aside for one hour.
Drain off all liquid.
Put in saucepan with vinegar, sugar, celery seed, turmeric, cinnamon and peppers. Bring to a boil and cook 20 minutes.
Put in sterilized jars and seal.
Makes two quarts.

title: Corn Okra Casserole

ingredients.name: okra and tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 can okra and tomatoes or frozen okra or fresh smothered okra (much better)

steps: Put in buttered baking dish a layer of okra, layer of creamed corn, layer of onion, green pepper, bacon and layer of whole kernel corn.
Top with grated cheese.
Cover and bake for 1 hour at 375°. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Sift again. Cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Blend in vanilla. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately and beat until smooth after each addition.
Pour into greased and floured wax papered loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.
Remove from pan and cool. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Easy Frozen Salad
steps: Combine first 5, then fold in Cool Whip.
Put in 10-inch pie plate.
Cover and freeze 4 hours or overnight.
Serve on leaf lettuce.
Garnish with fruit.

title: Blonde Brownies
steps: Cream butter and sugar adding eggs one at a time, then beat well.
Add flour and blend well.
Stir in vanilla and pecans. Pour into greased 9x13 in. baking pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

title: Homemade Pot Pie
steps: Sift together dry ingredients.
Mix shortening in with fork. Add water; roll thin and cut into pieces.
Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Dip
steps: In a mixing bowl, blend all ingredients by heating until smooth.
Serve with sliced apples and chopped peanuts.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: or more deboned turkey
ingredients.raw: 2 c. or more cooked, deboned turkey or chicken, cut into bite size pieces

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or celery soup

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. sour cream (optional; increase milk if not used)

steps: Mix all ingredients, except stuffing mix and 1 stick butter, together.
Season and place into lightly greased, medium to large casserole dish.
In another bowl, mix stuffing mix with stick of butter.
Mix well and spread evenly on top of vegetable mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes; just long enough to heat mixture and lightly brown top.
Can be made ahead of time and frozen until ready to bake.
Serves 6.

title: Carrot Casserole
steps: Mix together well.
Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken and deboned
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cooked and deboned (save broth)

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In oblong baking dish, place the deboned chicken pieces on bottom.
Mix can of soup with 2 1/2 cups of the reserved broth.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken.
In bowl, mix melted margarine, flour and milk.
Pour over chicken.
Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Autumn Apple Salad
steps: In a saucepan, combine pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes.
Add gelatin; stir until dissolved.
Add cream cheese; stir until mixture is thoroughly combined.
Cool. Fold in apples, nuts, celery and whipped topping.
Pour into a 9-inch square baking pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaves.
Makes 9 to 12 servings.

title: Cathedral Window Candy
steps: Place butter and chocolate chips in medium heat resistant bowl.
Heat, uncovered, in microwave for 4 minutes, or until melted.
Combine egg and sugar; add slowly to chocolate mixture. Stir in marshmallows to coat well.
Pour onto waxed paper.
Shape into 18-inch log.
Refrigerate.
Slice before serving.

title: Blt Bites
steps: Cut a thin slice off of each tomato top.
Scoop out pulp. Invert the tomatoes on paper towel to drain.

title: Tostado Casserole
steps: In a skillet, brown ground beef.
Drain and add 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce and seasoning mix and mix well.
Line bottom of a 11 x 8 x 2 pan with 2 cups corn chips.
Crush remaining corn chips and set aside.
Spoon meat mixture over corn chips in baking dish. Combine remaining tomato sauce and refried beans.
Spread over ground beef mixture.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese and crushed corn chips.
Bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Jalapeno Pie

ingredients.name: green chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can whole green chili peppers or 2 (4 oz.) cans chopped green chilies

steps: Drain peppers (seed whole ones).
If using whole peppers, cut them lengthwise and line sides and bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Ginger Cookies
steps: Mix all dry ingredients together thoroughly; add applesauce. Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto a nonstick cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Bacon Nuts
steps: Soak water chestnuts in soy sauce for 4 hours.
Wrap each chestnut in a 1/2 strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Broil until brown.

title: Grasshopper Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple with the juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can crushed pineapple with the juice

steps: Mix pudding mix and Cool Whip together.
Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well.
Refrigerate.
May be used immediately.

title: Velveeta Cheese Fudge
steps: Melt cheese and oleo on low.
Mix confectioners sugar, cocoa and vanilla.
Pour cheese mixture into sugar mixture.
Mix well and add nuts.
Pat into buttered dish, 9 x 12-inch.
Can be cut immediately.
Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch or two 8 x 8-inch pans.
Sprinkle cake mix over mixture.
Press nuts into cake mix.
Drizzle melted margarine over cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Can be frozen.

title: Breakfast Burritos
steps: Beat eggs in separate container.
Mix other ingredients.
In large skillet, lightly buttered, put sausage mix.
Add eggs; stir until eggs are softly cooked.
Remove from heat.
Place eggs in spaghetti strainer (something to let the juice drain through). Soften flour tortillas.
Take 1 tortilla; place 1 slice of cheese in center, then 2 tablespoons of mixture.
Wrap in wax paper.
Can be frozen.
Yields 10 to 12 burritos.

title: Frothy Orange Slush

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate

steps: Mix all ingredients in a blender until ice cubes make a slush. Pour into glasses.
Drink immediately.
Store unused portion in freezer.

title: Clams And Cheese
steps: Melt cheese in a frypan.
In another frypan, saute onions and diced peppers in butter; add clams and their juice.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes; add remaining ingredients.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
steps: Mix pudding and milk until thick, then add Cool Whip and sour cream; mix well.
Put a thin layer of pudding in a bowl, then a layer of wafers, then bananas and continue until you get to the top and end with a layer of pudding.

title: Green Chile Casserole
steps: Grate the cheeses together.
Butter baking dish and put open, seedless chiles flat on the bottom of pan.
Then put cheeses over the top, then do another layer of chiles, etc.
Finish with cheese on top.
Mix together in bowl the flour, milk, eggs and salt.
Pour this mixture over chiles and cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°. This is for a 9 x 13-inch pan.
For a smaller serving, you may cut recipe in half.
You will be surprised how much this dish tastes like the true Mexican Chili Rellenos.

title: Hamburger Round-Up

ingredients.name: seasoning
ingredients.raw: seasoning to taste (can use seasoning salt)

steps: Place meat, seasoning, onion and water in skillet over low fire.
Slice potatoes thin and place on top.
Put lid on skillet and cook until potatoes are done.
Stir into meat and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Christmas Party Pinwheels

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg (8 oz. each) cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg (4 oz.) ranch salad dressing mix

steps: In mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and dressing mix until smooth.
Add red pepper, celery, onions and olives:
mix well. Spread about 3/4 cup on each tortilla.
Roll up tightly; wrap in plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Slice into 1/2 inch pieces.
Yield 15 - 20 servings.

title: Brown Rice Pilaf
steps: Bring broth to a boil in a heavy saucepan.
Stir in rice and rest of ingredients, except almonds.
Cover; reduce heat and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in almonds.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Ham Ring

ingredients.name: tube refrigerated crescent roll dough
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz. each) tubes refrigerated crescent roll dough

ingredients.name: fully ham
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. fully cooked ham, diced (about 1/2 c.)

steps: Unroll crescent roll dough and place triangles on a 12-inch pizza pan, forming a ring with pointed ends facing outer edge of pan and wide ends overlapping.
Lightly press wide ends together. Combine the remaining ingredients; spoon over wide ends of rolls. Fold points over filling and tuck under wide ends (filling will be visible).
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Swedish Pancakes
steps: Beat egg whites and fold in last.
Make small pancakes.

title: Cherry Cola Salad

ingredients.name: cold cola soft drink
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cold cola (Pepsi or Coke) soft drink

steps: Combine water and sugar; bring to a boil.
Add pie filling and return to a boil.
Pour over the Jell-O to dissolve.
Add rest of ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan or mold to set.

title: Rotel Casserole
steps: Brown meat and onion.
Chop tomatoes.
Mix with soup and meat. In baking dish, arrange layers of chips, meat mixture and grated cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with cheese.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350° or until cheese is melted.

title: Italian Zucchini Casserole
steps: Spray 9 x 13 inch pan.
Place layers of tomato, onion, zucchini and cheese.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and liberally with Italian seasoning.
Sprinkle about 1/2 cup crushed Ritz over all.
Make second layer same as first, beginning with tomato and ending with cheese, top with more seasoning and crushed Ritz. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove foil and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagne

ingredients.name: hunt s spaghetti sauce with parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 can Hunt's spaghetti sauce with Parmesan cheese

steps: Cook hamburger; drain and add spaghetti sauce.
Cook lasagne noodles for 10 minutes in boiling water; drain.

title: Stuffed French Toast
steps: Mix together and cover dish with plastic overnight.
Bake the next morning at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Double Crust Peach Cobbler

ingredients.name: peach and
ingredients.raw: 8 cups fresh peaches, peeled and sliced

ingredients.name: pastry double crust pie you can use refrigerated ready made crust
ingredients.raw: Pastry for double-crust pie, you can use refrigerated ready made crust

steps: Combine peaches, sugar, flour and spices.
Set aside until syrup forms.
Bring peaches to a boil.
Cook 10 minutes or until tender.
Remove from heat and blend in almond extract and butter.

title: Peanut Butter Logs
steps: Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler.
Melt margarine in separate pan.
Mix graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar, peanut butter and melted margarine.
Mix well.
Form into balls or logs with hands, then dip logs into chocolate chip mixture.
Lay logs on wax paper until dry.

title: Bread Stuffing

ingredients.name: day old bread
ingredients.raw: 8 slices day old bread or toast

steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cut bread into small cubes.
Put into large mixing bowl.
Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add onions and celery; cook until tender.
Add to bread crumbs.
Add sage, salt and pepper.
Moisten with broth, as desired.
Beat eggs lightly.
Stir into dressing.
Use as stuffing for poultry or other meats or bake, covered, in a one-quart casserole dish for 30 minutes.
Equals 1 bread, 1 fat and 1 vegetable.

title: Winter Fruit Bowl
steps: Drain juice from pineapple into 1-cup glass measure.
Stir in brown sugar and lemon juice.
Microwave on High, uncovered, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until mixture boils. Stir in flavoring. Cool. Quarter apples and cut into very thin slices.
Peel oranges. Cut into thin slices.
Cut slices in half.
In glass serving bowl, layer half the apples, oranges and grapes. Slice banana and arrange over grapes.
Top with pineapple chunks. Repeat with remaining apples, oranges and grapes.
Pour cooled syrup over all. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Makes about 12 servings, 70 calories each.

title: Hickory Stick
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Refrigerate 24 hours.
Mix well again.
Refrigerate another 24 hours.
Shape into small rolls, about 1 to 1 1/2-inches.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 150° for 8 hours.
Turn after 4 hours.
Can also use ground turkey.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: mayonnaise (just enough to make the cheese ball soft but not too soft)

steps: Mix all ingredients together, shape into a ball.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Angel Food Dessert

ingredients.name: buy
ingredients.raw: buy or make an angel food cake

steps: Slice top off cake to make 2 layers.
Make jello using 3 cups water for both.
After it sets, add sliced strawberries.
Mix in 1 cup Cool Whip.
Top bottom cake with mixture, fill in hole.
Put top layer cake over bottom layer.
Frost with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes

ingredients.name: salt pepper garlic salt and onion salt
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper, garlic salt and onion salt

steps: Wash the
potatoes well and dice.
In a large cake pan, pour the
Crisco
and
add potatoes. Coat potatoes in oil. Add salt, pepper,
garlic
salt and onion salt or season to taste. Slice the margarine over the potatoes.
Cook at 425°, stirring 2 to 3 times for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
steps: Mix milk with slightly beaten egg yolks.
Add lemon juice; mix.
Pour into shells.
Top with egg whites.
Add the sugar.
Put into oven and brown.
Chill.

title: Oriental Vegetables

ingredients.name: broccoli carrot water chestnut and red pepper
ingredients.raw: 16 oz. pkg. frozen broccoli, carrots, water chestnuts and red peppers

steps: In medium saucepan, cook vegetables as directed on package. Drain.
In small saucepan, stir together remaining ingredients. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for 2 minutes more.
Pour sauce over vegetables.
Toss to coat.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cocktail Sauce
steps: Mix ingredients and chill.
Serve with shrimp.

title: Black Russian Bundt Cake

ingredients.name: jell o instant chocolate pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Jell-O instant chocolate pudding

ingredients.name: betty crocker milk chocolate frosting
ingredients.raw: 1 can Betty Crocker milk chocolate frosting (to frost)

steps: In one bowl, combine all ingredients except frosting.
Beat with mixer at high speed for 2 minutes.
Grease and flour medium size (9 cup) Bundt pan and pour in batter.
(This will give a high cake; larger pans will give a flatter cake.)
Bake at 350°.
Test at 45 minutes and then every 5 minutes until done.
Cool in pan 10 minutes, then turn out on rack.
If frosted while warm, frosting will melt to sort of a glaze.
Equally good frosted when cool.

title: Sarah Coble'S Creamed Corn
steps: Combine corn, water and salt.
Cook for four minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add butter.
Combine milk and flour in shaker.
Shake until blended.
Stir into corn mixture.
Return to heat.
Cook four minutes, stirring often.

title: Fast Pie Crust
steps: Melt oleo.
Pour melted oleo over dry ingredients and mix. Press into pie plate.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
Good with all cream pies.

title: Million Dollar Pie(Yields Two 9-Inch Pies)
steps: Mix all ingredients, adding lemon juice.
This acts as a thickening agent.
Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts and chill.

title: Tartar Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients until well blended.
Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Chess Cheese Bars
steps: Mix by hand the cake mix, margarine and 1 egg until forms soft ball like cookie dough.
Press into large sheet-type pan.
(Pam greased).
Cream together the flavoring, cream cheese and 3 eggs (add one at a time).
Add powdered sugar.
Spread over top of dough.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Add butter.
Gradually add buttermilk. Spread on baking sheet, 8-inches in diameter.
Put deep cross in center with knife.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: King Ranch Chicken Enchiladas

ingredients.name: chicken breast and bite size
ingredients.raw: 3 chicken breasts (skinless, boneless), cooked and cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Cover a 9 x 13-inch buttered Pyrex dish with the Doritos chips. Cook chicken and cut into bite-size pieces; place over the Doritos. Mix together soups, milk and picante sauce.
Pour over chicken and Doritos.
Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Best made at least 6 hours before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Frosting
steps: Beat all but egg white 4 to 5 minutes.
Add egg white.
Beat 5 minutes longer.

title: Sauerkraut Salad

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/2 green pepper or 5 or 6 red sweet canned peppers or pimentos, cut up

steps: Bring sugar and vinegar to boil and let cool.
Drain well and cut up sauerkraut.
Add rest of ingredients.
Pour syrup over and let stand overnight.
Very important to stand overnight. Delicious.

title: Momma'S Forgotten Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Gradually beat sugar into stiff egg whites.
Fold in vanilla, salt and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Put cookies into the oven.
Turn the oven off and leave cookies in overnight.
Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
steps: Put cream cheese out to soften.
Scrub potatoes and dry. Grease them with butter and salt the skins.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove from oven and cool to handle.
Cut them in half lengthwise.
Remove cooked potato to bowl, being careful to reserve the skins whole.
Mash with cream cheese, hot milk, garlic salt and butter.
Pile mixture back into skins.
Sprinkle with parsley and paprika and bake 20 more minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg Custard Pie
steps: Mix beaten eggs and sugar.
Add hot milk and pour into a large pie shell. Bake at 350° about 30 to 45 minutes (until crust is brown).
You may put dots of butter on top and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Cheese Straws
steps: Sift salt and pepper with flour; fold in butter.
Let cheese be at room temperature and work until smooth.
Add to flour; mix until smooth.
Roll thin and cut into strips.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Wild Rice With Pecans

ingredients.name: green onion with top
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. sliced green onions with tops

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chicken stock or low sodium chicken broth

ingredients.name: uncooked grain white rice
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. uncooked long grain white rice

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. shredded fresh basil or chopped parsley

steps: In large saucepan, melt the butter over moderate heat.
Add onions and saute 5 minutes.
Stir in wild rice, coating with butter.
Pour in stock; bring to boil and stir.
Lower heat; cover tightly and simmer, stirring occasionally for 1 hour.
Add the water; stir in white rice.
Cover and steam 20 minutes longer or until both rices are tender.
Stir in the pecans and basil. Serves 4, easy to double.

title: Cherry Digest Cake

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can cherry pie filling or any fruit

steps: Spread in 13-inch loaf pan.
Sprinkle 1 cake mix on top.
Put oleo dribbles over top.
Put nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Top Of Stove Biscuits

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. buttermilk or milk or water

steps: Make hole in center of flour with knuckles.
Put shortening in the mix as in regular biscuits.
Then pinch off enough for size of biscuit.
Roll up in hand.
Place in slightly greased frying pan (on top of stove); continue with rest of dough.
Cook on low heat, covered with lid until lightly brown on bottom, then turn over to other side.
Let top side brown, uncover about 5 minutes before done.
Makes 6 to 8 biscuits.
Cooking time approximately 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Fruit Squares

ingredients.name: fruit mix
ingredients.raw: 1 can fruit topping mix (cherry, blueberry, apple or boysenberry)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix 3/4 cup sugar and butter.
Heat. Add crumbs.
Press into 13 x 9-inch pan and set aside.
Beat cream cheese.
Add eggs, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla.
Pour fruit mix over crust, then cream cheese mixture.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes.
Chill thoroughly before serving.
May garnish with whipped cream or small amounts of fruit.

title: Chicken Mushroom Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 6 to 8 pieces chicken or amount needed

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup

steps: Wash chicken thoroughly.
Dry with paper towel.
Lay chicken pieces in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine half the onions with the soup and milk.
Pour over chicken. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes or until chicken is done. Sprinkle remaining onions over top and return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Drunken Dogs

ingredients.name: smoky sausage
ingredients.raw: Little Smokies sausages (as many as will swim comfortably in sauce)

steps: Put everything in slow cooker.
Set on low heat until evening, stirring several times.

title: No Yeast Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Mix first three ingredients.
Add oil, molasses and honey. Mix well.
Add 2 eggs and boiling water.
May be hot!

title: Raw Vegetable Dip
steps: Slowly cook applesauce about 5 minutes to evaporate some of the liquid; chill.
Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Use for any fresh vegetable of your choice.

title: Oatmeal Bars
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk to creamed mixture.
Add oats, raisins and nuts.
Mix well.
Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool; cut into bars.

title: Chinese Pork Slices
steps: Cut meat lengthwise in half.
Mix remaining ingredients in medium bowl.
Add meat and turn to coat on all sides.
Cover and refrigerate, turning meat occasionally, at least 8 hours.

title: Potato Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: kraft mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. Kraft mayonnaise or Miracle Whip salad dressing

steps: Cook eggs, sugar, vinegar and salt over double boiler, stirring often, until it thickens.
Remove from heat.
Add mustard and mayonnaise.
Pour over salad.

title: Popcorn Crunch
steps: Boil oleo, brown sugar, white Karo and cream of tartar
for 5 minutes; take off heat and stir in soda and popcorn.
Pour into loaf pan and bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Company Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup undiluted

ingredients.name: turkey
ingredients.raw: 12 large slices Turkey or Chicken in bite size pieces

steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in skillet cook sausage until brown, break in bits and pour off fat. Stir in mushroom soups, mushrooms, worcestershire sauce and meat. Put all together in greased baking dish.
Cover with buttered crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Busy Day Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add milk, egg, vanilla and shortening.
Mix well.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Beer Stew(Pork)

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. pork shoulder, diced (fat to brown it)

steps: Brown pork.
Add beer, water and rosemary.
Simmer, covered, 30 minutes.
Add onions and cook 30 minutes more.
Meanwhile, cook potatoes and carrots (salted) together until done.
Add these and bouillon to stew pot.
Blend flour and water to make a paste and add to stew.

title: Chocolate Turtle Pie

ingredients.name: prepared oreo cookie pie crust.
ingredients.raw: 1 prepared Oreo cookie pie crust. (deep dish, if available)

steps: Bring butterscotch to a boil in saucepan, stirring constantly.
Pour 3/4 cup butterscotch into crust.
Then place a layer of pecans in the bottom.
Chill for about 5 minutes so sauce can harden.
Meanwhile, mix pudding with milk.
Pour into crust on top of pecans.
Chill.
Right before serving, drizzle a little butterscotch on top of pudding and top with Cool Whip and sprinkle chopped pecans on top.

title: Grandma Steve'S Cornmeal Dinner Rolls

ingredients.name: yeast in c. lukewarm water
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. yeast, softened in 1/4 c. lukewarm water

steps: Cook the first 5 ingredients until thick; cool until lukewarm. Add the eggs, 2 teaspoons sugar and the softened yeast.
Mix well, then add the flour.
Knead well; place in greased bowl.
Let rise for 1 hour or more.
Punch down; roll out.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Let rise until doubled in a greased pan.
Bake at 365° for 15 minutes.

title: Deer Jerky
steps: Cover bottom of pan with meat strips.
Liberally salt, pepper and garlic.
Sprinkle with soy sauce.
Cover with Worcestershire sauce.
Repeat layers if necessary.
Make sure meat is submerged. Cover and refrigerate 24 to 48 hours.
Place foil on oven racks; shape an edge.
Lay meat in single layer, edge to edge.
Brush with liquid smoke.
Dry in 150° to 175° oven until bends, but does not break, about 5 hours.

title: Creamy Corn Soup

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: In a sauce pan, heat soup, milk, mayonnaise and corn (with liquid), stirring occasionally.
Garnish with pimiento and parsley.
Makes 5 servings (1 cup each).

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs over margarine.
Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Top with chips; press down firmly.
Bake 25 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cool.
Cut into bars.
Makes 24 to 36.

title: No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Combine the sugar, milk, butter and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a boil, cooking 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add the remaining ingredients.
Stir and mix well.
Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper, letting them stand for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: tomato with liquid
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. canned chopped tomatoes with liquid

steps: Wash the chicken wings and pat dry.
In skillet, saute chicken wings in melted butter until lightly browned.
Arrange in oiled baking dish.
Add tomatoes with liquid and celery.
In separate bowl, mix together soy sauce, vinegar and salt.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes or until tender. Serves 4.
May be doubled to serve 8.

title: Scrumptious Pork Steak(Toms Favorite)
steps: Put vegetable oil in frying pan (black iron skillet is best). Add pork steaks, sprinkle generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder and brown on both sides.
When browned remove from pan and set aside.
Add 2-3 cups of water to drippings in pan, add salt to taste.
Bring to a slow boil and add cornstarch which has been diluted with water.
Stir until thickened, put pork steaks back in pan with gravy and cover.
Simmer about 1 1/2 -2 hours or until real tender.
Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Rhubarb Crisp

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. cinnamon or more to taste

steps: Pour mixed dry ingredients over rhubarb pieces in a bowl.
Add cold water and mix together.
Add food coloring.
Pour into a greased pan.
Cover with topping.

title: Chocolate Pecan Puffs
steps: Melt butter; add to flour.
Mix well.
Add powdered sugar, vanilla, pecan chips and chocolate chips; mix well.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll mixture into small balls.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
steps: Stir or whisk liquids; add dry ingredients.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
(Middle of pie should shake and not be too firm).
Do not overbake!

title: Thai Cucumber Salad
steps: Trim ends of cucumbers and scrape with fork to make a decorative pattern.
Quarter the cucumbers lengthwise and remove seeds.
Cut them crosswise into thin slices.
Put in bowl and add chili.
In small saucepan, combine sugar and vinegar; bring to boil.
Cook, stirring, until the sugar has dissolved.
Cool to room temperature and pour sauce over the cucumber mixture.
Chill and sprinkle with cilantro.
Serves 4.

title: Wild Blueberry Bread
steps: Melt the margarine.
Set aside.
Beat the eggs.
Gradually add sugar to eggs.
Add the melted margarine.
Add the cup of milk. Combine dry ingredients and add them.
Mix dough until flour is just blended.
Fold berries into dough.
Pour into well-greased loaf pan.
Sprinkle top with sugar to give a sparkle.
Bake for one hour in a 350° oven.

title: Pineapple Crush Cake

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix (4 serving size)

steps: Bake cake mix as directed in 3 pans. Combine pudding mix, milk and cream cheese.
Spread 1/3 of the pineapple on each cake layer, making sure layers are completely cool. Spread pudding mixture on top of pineapple on each layer.
Stack layers and cover with whipped topping.
A small amount of pudding mixture may be added to whipped topping to flavor.

title: Fruit Soup
steps: Cook tapioca, sugar and 1 cup of water until white is gone from tapioca.
Remove from heat.
Add fruit juice (use juice from peaches and oranges), orange juice, oranges, peaches and strawberries to tapioca.
Cool until time to serve.
Before serving slice and add bananas.

title: Skillet Macaroni And Beef
steps: Cook macaroni, onion and pepper until macaroni is yellow.
Add ground beef to skillet along with rest of ingredients and cover. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.

title: Crawfish Tortellini

ingredients.name: tortellini with parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. tortellini with Parmesan cheese

steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter.
Add crawfish (slightly rinsed) and continue cooking approximately 5 minutes.
Add Parmesan cheese, parsley and whipping cream.
Prepare tortellini as directed.
Fold in with sauce and season with salt and red pepper.
If sauce needs thickening, mix cornstarch with water and add to sauce.

title: Parmesan Perch

ingredients.name: ocean perch
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ocean perch or lean fish fillets

steps: Move oven rack to position slightly above middle of oven.
Heat oven to 500°.
Mix ingredients except margarine and parsley.
Brush one side of fish with margarine.
Dip into crumb mixture.
Place fish, uncoated side down, in rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Bake uncovered until fish flakes easily with fork, about 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley. Serve.

title: Quick Cheese Sauce In The Microwave
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in 2-cup glass measuring cup (about 30 seconds).
Whisk in 1 tablespoon flour and salt and pepper to taste.
Gradually add 1 tablespoon white wine and 1 cup milk. Whisk until smooth.
Cook on High for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring every minute, until sauce thickens.
Stir in 1/4 cup shredded cheese until melts.

title: Strawberry Pies
steps: Soften cream
cheese.
Whip
cream
cheese and lemonade with mixer.
Use a fork to whip in strawberries and Cool Whip. Pour in prebaked pie shells and chill.
Makes 4 pies.

title: Hungry Man'S Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger.
Drain.
Add tomato soup, onions and beans to hamburger.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, cook and prepare potatoes as you would for mashed potatoes.
Pour meat and bean mixture into oblong casserole dish.
Spread mashed potatoes on top.
Brown potatoes in oven.

title: Yeast Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water.
Combine butter, salt and sugar in separate bowl.
Add 1 cup hot water; beat in egg.
When this cools, add yeast mixture.
Add flour.
Place in greased glass bowl and cover with foil.
Leave in refrigerator 2 to 12 hours. Take out in time to rise again.
Press in pan.
Use floured knife or spatula to separate dough, creating pull apart rolls.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes at 425°.

title: Posh Squash

ingredients.name: squash
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. squash (mix varieties, zucchini, crookneck and patty pan)

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. minced onion (or 1 small onion chopped fine)

steps: Cut squash into chunks and steam until tender.
Drain well and set aside.
Beat eggs and blend in mayonnaise; add seasonings. Place squash in 2 1/2-quart casserole and pour mix over.
Put Parmesan cheese evenly on top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375°
for 25 minutes, or 35 minutes if cold.
Serves 8 to 10.
Can be made ahead and
reheated nicely.

title: Beef Roast
steps: Put beef shoulder in pan; heat oven to 400°.
Peel onion and cut up; cut up carrots.
Peel and cut up potatoes. Wash and cut up celery stick.
Put in large pan and cover with Reynolds wrap and cook for 3 1/2 hours.

title: Orange Spice Tea Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients and store in covered container (i.e., Tupperware).
To serve, dissolve 1 teaspoon mix in 1 cup boiling water.
One cup equals 3 calories.

title: Chinese Cole Slaw

ingredients.name: beef flavor ramen noodle
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. beef flavor Ramen noodles, broken into small pieces

steps: Brown noodles, almonds and sesame seeds in the butter and cool.
Add green onions and cole slaw.

title: Mango Chutney

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 12 c. green or half ripe mangoes, peeled and sliced

ingredients.name: hawaiian red pepper and
ingredients.raw: 4 Hawaiian red peppers, seeded and chopped

steps: Combine mango slices and salt.
Let stand overnight.
Rinse with cold water and drain.
Combine sugar and vinegar; simmer 30 minutes.
Add mango slices and remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour or until mangoes are tender and chutney is of desired consistency.
Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.
Makes 3 quarts.

title: New England Clam Chowder(Serves 6)

ingredients.name: salt pork
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. salt pork or bacon, chopped

ingredients.name: clam liquor
ingredients.raw: 1 c. clam liquor (add water to make 1 c.)

steps: Drain clams; save liquor and chop.
Fry salt pork or bacon until lightly brown.
Add onion and cook until tender.
Add liquor, potatoes and seasonings.
Cook 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Add milk and heat thoroughly.
Stir in chopped clams and warm gently 2 to 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
steps: Combine egg, sugar and oil.
Mix flour and cinnamon.
Stir into egg mixture.
This is very stiff.
Add vanilla, apples and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: White Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Combine flour, salt and soda.
Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in nuts and chips (dough is stiff). Make small balls and flatten either with fingers or fork.
Bake at 350° about 13 minutes or until golden in color. Do not overbake. They will start to flatten out a little.

title: Simple Turkey Casserole
steps: Mix together turkey, potatoes, and celery.
Mix 1 cup mushroom soup.
Pour over turkey and potatoes.
Sprinkle top with buttered cracker crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Pretzel Sparklers
steps: Place chocolate in microwave-safe bowl; heat until melted. Dip each pretzel rod about halfway into chocolate.
Sprinkle with candy stars.
Place on waxed paper.
Yield: 2 dozen.

title: Fiesta Potato Salad
steps: Combine ingredients, except lettuce.
Place in a lettuce-lined bowl.
Garnish with parsley and additional eggs and radishes.

title: Cornbread Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Ann'S Sweet Heart Salad
steps: Cream together cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Add pineapple, cherries, Cool Whip and nuts.
Save some cherries and nuts for top.
Chill and serve.

title: Irish Mistery Chicken

ingredients.name: baked ham in half
ingredients.raw: 4 slices baked ham, cut in half

steps: Use an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Arrange slices of ham in bottom.
Place chicken breast on each slice of ham.
Mix the soup, sour cream, whiskey and mushrooms together; spoon over chicken and ham, covering completely.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve with wild rice.
Serves 6 to 8.
Delicious!

title: Ice Cream Cake
steps: Crush chocolate bars so they are crumbly.
Soften both bricks of ice cream.
Leave on counter until soft enough to spread.

title: Fried Tomatoes

ingredients.name: hot fat
ingredients.raw: hot fat (half oleo and half cooking oil)

steps: Slice tomatoes 3/4-inch thick.
Dip into beaten eggs and then into fine bread crumbs.
Fry in hot fat (half oleo and half cooking oil) until brown on both sides.

title: Carol'S Coconut-Pecan Ice Cream Pie
steps: In a 9-inch pie pan, mix first 4 ingredients.
With back of spoon, press mixture to bottom and sides of pan.
Place in freezer until firm, about 10 minutes.
In large bowl, mix ice cream and pecans.
Smooth into crust.
Cover and freeze until firm for at least 4 hours.
Twenty minutes before serving, preheat oven to 500°.

title: Pumpkin Soup

ingredients.name: pumpkin
ingredients.raw: 3 c. pumpkin or butternut squash, peeled and cut

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. heavy cream or evaporated milk

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.raw: dash of nutmeg or allspice to season (optional)

steps: Steam pumpkin; set aside.
Saute onions in butter until translucent.
Add pumpkin and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chicken broth (salt, pepper and spices).
Cook mixture for 10 minutes. Remove from heat; put mixture in food processor or blender and puree until smooth.
Put cream or milk in small bowl; add a little of the hot pumpkin mix to milk, then add back into hot pumpkin mix and whisk.
Put pan back on low heat and continue to whisk until soup thickens enough to coat a spoon.
Serve with garnish of choice.

title: Memphis Spicy Baked Beans
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper.
Drain off fat. Combine beef mixture with remaining ingredients.
Place in casserole dish and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Fondant
steps: Combine sugar and cream of tartar.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Cover pan and boil 5 minutes, allowing steam to dissolve any grains of sugar on sides of pan.
Uncover and boil without stirring to soft ball stage.
Wipe all crystals from the sides of the pan with a damp cloth.
Pour into shallow pan, plate or onto a marble slab which has been rinsed with cold water.
Cool to room temperature.
Beat only until stiff enough to knead. Knead until smooth.
Place in bowl, covered with a damp cloth or with waxed paper and allow to stand for 24 hours before using.

title: Rosemary Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: red new potato scrubbed and
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. red new potatoes, scrubbed and quartered

ingredients.name: rosemary
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. chopped fresh rosemary or 1 tsp. dried

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Place potatoes in a large shallow baking dish that will hold all of them in a single layer.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir to coat well.

title: Boston Brown Bread

ingredients.name: rye meal
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. rye meal or all-purpose flour

steps: Mix the dry ingredients.
Stir in the liquids and mix well. Grease a mold*.
Fill not more than 2/3 full.
Put on the cover. Place on a rack in a deep kettle.
Add boiling water to come halfway up around the mold.
Cover.
Steam 3 to 3 1/2 hours, keeping water boiling.
Add more water as necessary.
Run a knife around the inside of the mold to loosen the loaf to remove it.

title: Cheesecake

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes and softened

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate. Place milk, vanilla, eggs, sugar and baking mix in blender container.
Cover and blend on high for 15 seconds.
Add cream cheese.
Cover and blend on high for 2 minutes.
Pour onto plate. Bake until center is firm, 40 to 45 minutes; cool.
Spread Cheesecake Topping carefully over top.
Garnish with fruit, if desired.

title: Spaetzle(German Dumpling)
steps: For soup or to butter them.
Mix all ingredients well.
Cook in salted water or chicken broth for 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Candy

ingredients.name: margarine
ingredients.raw: 3 sticks melted margarine or very soft margarine

steps: Mix together in mixer the margarine, sugar, vanilla and peanut butter.
Line an oblong pan with half the graham crackers.
Spread with mix over all and pat down with remaining crumbs. Refrigerate, then cut into squares.

title: Sweet Sour Tuna
steps: Blend cornstarch and vinegar in skillet.
Add sugar, catsup and shoyu. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add tuna. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add pineapple and green pepper. Continue cooking for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Lacking Salad
steps: Mix jello in hot water and then add cold water.
Add one can crushed drained pineapple.
Mash bananas and add to mixture.
Add marshmallows.
Place in refrigerator to jell.

title: Good Potatoes
steps: Cook the potatoes in their jackets; cool in refrigerator a day ahead of time.
Peel and grate the potatoes.
Melt the butter or margarine.
Add the salt and half and half.
Grate the Cheddar cheese; add a small amount of Parmesan cheese to the Cheddar cheese.
Layer potatoes, melted mixture and cheese in a baking dish; top with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans And Chutney
steps: In small bowl, dissolve the mustard in the bean liquid (1/2 C). Add finely chopped onion and minced chutney, salt and pepper.
Put beans in casserole.
Stir in mixture to beans and pour honey evenly over top.
Cover and bake at 325° for 1 hour or longer until browned.
Remove cover and bake.
Serve with yogurt.

title: Cracklin' Cornbread
steps: Combine all ingredients, adding cracklins last.
Pour in to a sizzling hot pan and bake for 30 minutes at 450°.

title: Lobster Sauce

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. cream or half and half

steps: Melt butter.
Add flour and seasonings.
Stir until smooth. Add milk and cream slowly; cook over low heat until thickened. Heat slowly.
Do not let boil.

title: Chili Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients and cook in heavy pan slowly (simmer) until thick.
Makes about 2 pints.

title: Barbecue Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops in hot shortening.
Drain.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops.
Bake in slow oven at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Turn chops once during baking.

title: Pasta Ala Renee
steps: Prepare pasta according to directions.
Saute garlic in margarine until soft.
Add onion and bell pepper until tender; add mushrooms, tomatoes and pepper to taste.
Combine sauce and pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Cheese Crunchies
steps: Mix margarine and cheese.
Add flour, Rice Krispies and pepper.
Roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork.
Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Oven Baked Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash and dry chicken pieces.
Combine Bisquick, Parmesan, paprika, celery salt, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in milk and roll in dry mixture.
Place chicken, skin side up, in large shallow baking pan.
Pour melted butter over chicken. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Put in a covered casserole dish and bake for 1 hour at 375°.
Remove cover last 10 minutes.

title: Ham Cups
steps: Combine first five ingredients and fill medium size muffin pans; round tops, meat loaf fashion.
Combine brown sugar and prepared mustard and spread over tops of cups.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Orange Roughy
steps: Dab fish with butter.
Cover with chopped vegetables.
Sprinkle with salt.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
A quick, easy, nutritious meal.

title: Impossible Pie
steps: Beat altogether for 2 minutes.
Pour into 9-inch (greased) pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
Do not open until done!

title: Myra'S Greens
steps: Wash greens thoroughly.
Braise meat in a 6-quart pot.
Add greens, wine and remaining ingredients.
Let come to a boil. Lower heat and cook for 1 hour or until greens are tender.

title: Baked Groundhog
steps: Clean groundhog good.
Put in pot and bring to a boil; cook for 10 minutes. Turn head down, cook for 20 minutes more.
Remove from pot.
Put in a baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or real tender.
Add 1 cup of water from the pot to bake in.
Add all ingredients 1/2 hour before groundhog is done.

title: Dirt
steps: Whip the first 3 ingredients with hand mixer until smooth and creamy.
Fold in the Cool Whip using a spatula and mix well. Refrigerate the mix plus the box of cookie crumbs for about 3 hours.

title: Light And Easy Alfredo Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender; process until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides.
Pour into a small saucepan.
Cook sauce over low heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated.
Yields 2 1/2 cups.
Contains 86 calories, 0.8 g fat and 0.5 g saturated fat per 3 1/2-ounce serving.

title: Avocado Orange Salad
