Heat pie filling with water, sugar and butter and spread over a layer of rolls which have been placed in a baking dish.

title: Raw Potato Pancakes
steps: Beat egg yolks; stir in grated potatoes and a mixture of flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix well.
Beat egg whites until rounded peaks form.
Fold into potato mixture.
Spoon about 2 tablespoons of batter for each pancake into skillet (hot grease). Brown on both sides.
Serve with applesauce.

title: Pineapple Pie - Nana'S Secret Recipe
steps: Combine pineapple and juice, egg, sugar and flour in a saucepan; stir over medium heat until thickened.
Pour into pie crust and cover with second crust.
Bake at 375° until top crust is browned (approximately 45 minutes).

title: Five Cup Salad
steps: Drain all fruit.
Mix with sour cream, marshmallows and sugar. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.
Add peanut butter, working into dry ingredients.
Add 1 egg, beaten with milk.
Mix gently; do not beat.
Bake 1 hour in small loaf pan at 350°.
Use toothpick to check doneness.
Top usually cracks.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.
Fold in flour.
Add flavorings and lemon juice.
Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in greased tube pan.

title: Fresh Lemonade

ingredients.name: lemon juice from squeezed lemon
ingredients.raw: 1 c. lemon juice from fresh squeezed lemons

steps: To make 2 quarts, dissolve sugar in hot water.
Add lemon juice and remaining water.
Add lemon peel if desired.
Serve over ice.

title: Eggnog
steps: Add egg to
milk;
beat
well.	Add
sugar and vanilla. Pour into tall glass and sprinkle nutmeg on top.

title: Souper Burgers
steps: Brown onion and ground beef.
Drain off fat.
Add soup, catsup and mustard.
Heat until thoroughly warm.
Season to taste.
Serve on buns or over rice.

title: Garden Stir-Fry
steps: Cut chicken breasts diagonally into thin strips.
Heat one tablespoon oil in large skillet or wok.
Stir-fry chicken strips and garlic until chicken loses its pink color.
Remove from pan and set aside.
Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil.
Stir-fry the onion, zucchini and green pepper for 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomatoes.
Continue to stir-fry an additional 3 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet.
Add spaghetti.
Stir-fry until heated through. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Easy Chicken Dinner
steps: Combine ingredients in saucepan and heat thoroughly on low heat.
Stir until heated.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.

title: Delicious Pecans
steps: In a 12-inch skillet, combine all ingredients.
Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until liquid disappears and nuts have a glazed appearance.
Pour onto a long pan covered with wax paper. Separate nuts quickly, using a fork.
Cool completely.
Store in covered container.
Refrigerate or freeze for longer preservation.

title: Flan(Spanish Custard)
steps: Beat eggs well; add sugar, milk and vanilla and mix well. Brown sugar in pan you are going to bake it in.
Pour everything in it and set in a pan of water.
Bake for 1 hour at 375°, then cool it and turn over to serve.

title: Baked Potatoes In Blankets
steps: Pound the round steak with edge of heavy saucer or meat pounder and cut into pieces the proper size to wrap around the potatoes. Rub a small amount of salt on the peeled raw potatoes and wrap the pieces of steak around them, fastening them with toothpicks.
Roll in the flour mixed with the salt and brown in hot fat.
Place in a greased covered casserole; cover and bake in a moderately slow oven (325°) for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until potatoes are done.
From time to time during the baking, pour on a small amount of hot water to prevent drying of the steak.
If desired, catsup may be put over the meat a few minutes before serving and if any liquid remains in the bottom of the casserole, it may be served as gravy.

title: K T'S Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: prepared instant potato
ingredients.raw: 6 to 8 servings prepared instant potatoes or use leftover potatoes

steps: Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole.
Sprinkle with chives and paprika (optional).
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Kahlua Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes in tube pan.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Balsamic Vinegar

ingredients.name: yellow onion and
ingredients.raw: 1 medium yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced

ingredients.name: salt and ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: Trim off the stems and remove any limp leaves from Brussels sprouts.
Blanch the sprouts in boiling water to cover for 5 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking. Heat a large frying pan and add the olive oil, garlic and onion. Saute a few minutes until the onion just becomes tender.
Add the blanched drained Brussels sprouts.
Saute a few minutes until the Brussels sprouts are cooked to your liking.
Add the vinegar and toss so that all the sprouts are coated with vinegar.
Add the butter and salt and pepper to taste and toss together again. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pineapple-Buttermilk Salad

ingredients.name: or pkg. orange flavored gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) or 2 (3 oz.) pkg. orange-flavored gelatin (I use sugar-free jello)

steps: Combine pineapple and sugar in a saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring until dissolved.
Cool.
Add buttermilk and stir until combined.
Fold in whipped topping and pecans.
Spoon into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex dish and chill until firm.
Cut salad into squares to serve.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, beat milk and butter until smooth.
Add biscuit mix and vanilla; mix well.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in sugar.
Place 2-inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet.
Do not flatten.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned (do not overbake).
Press Hershey's Kisses in center of each ball immediately after baking.
Cool.
Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Dandelion Wine

ingredients.name: tightly dandelion blossom picked in full bloom
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 qt. tightly packed dandelion blossoms, picked in full bloom (April)

steps: Wash blossoms well and drain.
In a large container with cover, pour boiling water over dandelion blossoms and let stand overnight.
The next morning, strain out blossoms and discard them.
Return liquid to container and add sugar.

title: French Chocolate Pie(Serves 6)
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Add one egg at a time, beating 3 minutes after each.
Prepare favorite graham cracker crust and bake.
Cool.
Add filling and refrigerate.
When ready to serve, cover pie with whipped cream and toasted almonds.

title: Cucumber Soup
steps: Pare 1 cucumber.
Cut both into slices (reserve 6 slices for garnish, refrigerate wrapped).
Pour 1/4 cup buttermilk and 1/2 cucumber slices into blender, beat until smooth, add remaining slices, salt, pepper and onion.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in remaining buttermilk.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or very cold.
Serves 6 to 8.
Add garnishes before serving.
(Cut up chives may also serves as garnishes.)

title: Rhubarb Jam
steps: Cook the rhubarb and sugar over low heat until sugar dissolves. Boil hard for 10 minutes. Add the Jell-O and boil 3 minutes. Skim and put in jars.
Seal.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
steps: In a jar that has a lid, sprinkle in herbs to the amount you choose and then the liquids.
Shake well and chill.

title: Rice And Beef Porcupines
steps: Mix all ingredients except tomato sauce and water.
Form mixture into 10 or 12 small balls.
Brown them lightly in uncovered saucepan; drain off excess fat.
Add tomato sauce and water.
Cover tightly; simmer 45 to 50 minutes or until rice is tender.
Serve with pan gravy.

title: Cranberry Pie
steps: Spread cranberries over bottom of greased 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and nuts.
Beat eggs well.
Add remaining 1 cup sugar gradually and beat until thoroughly mixed. Add flour and melted butter.
Beat well.
Pour batter over cranberries.

title: Tuna-Ripe Olive Loaf

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Combine crumbs, milk and heat to boiling.
Cook, stirring constantly about 1 minute.
Remove from heat; add small amount of eggs and mix well.
Stir into balance of hot mixture.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Place in shallow pan of hot water (approximately 1-inch deep).
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Serve hot with sliced ripe olives.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Butter Rolls
steps: Combine all ingredients and work dough until nice and smooth. Roll out; cut in squares. Fill with nut or prune filling.
Roll and shape into horns. Bake in moderate oven for 20 minutes. Apricot jam also works well for filling.

title: Erline'S Pineapple Pie(Icebox)
steps: Combine pineapple, flour, sugar, salt, lemon juice and sour cream.
Cook slowly until thick.
Cook an additional 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Beat 2 egg yolks and add small amount of mixture.
Transfer to pot of filling.
Cook additional 2 minutes. Bake in 9-inch pie shell with meringue until light brown.

title: Baked Ham
steps: Bake ham according to instructions on package; usually 350° for 20 minutes per pound.
Mix brown sugar, mustard and cloves and pour over top and sides of ham.
Return to oven and bake 20 minutes more.
Let sit 30 minutes before slicing.
Refrigerate leftovers for another meal or to make sandwiches.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
steps: Combine corn, sour
cream,
eggs,
sugar and oil.
Beat well. Add corn meal
and baking powder.
Mix well.
Pour in a greased 10-inch baking dish.
Bake	at
400° for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown.
Serve warm.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices

steps: Place potatoes in a 1-quart casserole, coated with cooking spray.
Combine cornstarch and brown sugar in a small bowl.
Add orange and lemon juices, stirring well.
Pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 425° for 40 minutes or just until potatoes are tender and glaze is thickened.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix at medium speed 5 minutes.
Pour in greased Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool 15 minutes; remove.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
steps: Mix together and freeze.
When ready to use, let thaw until mushy.
Add ginger ale.

title: Jigtime Mayonniase
steps: Blend first 6 ingredients 5 seconds.
While blending, pour in oil very slowly.

title: Mom'S Dream Cake

ingredients.name: yellow white
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (2 layer size) yellow, white or chocolate cake mix

steps: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl; blend until moist.
Beat on medium-speed for 4 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Cool in pan for a few minutes.

title: Grandma'S Sweet Noodle Pudding
steps: Boil and drain noodles according to box directions.
Add Crisco and beaten eggs.
Mix in rest of ingredients.
Put in 11 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle top with cinnamon (liberally).
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Sugar-Glazed Peanuts
steps: Mix all ingredients in 2-quart saucepan.
Cook until water is all gone and sugar has crystallized.
Then spread mixture on cookie sheet and bake for 30 minutes in 300° oven.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
steps: Layer ingredients in pan in order listed.
Bake at 350° until lightly brown (30 to 35 minutes).

title: Vegetable Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup

steps: Drain beans and corn; layer in bottom of oven-safe baking dish.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Mix onion, cheese, sour cream and soup in separate bowl.
Pour over vegetables and spread to edges of dish.
Mix crackers and butter.
Crumble over top of soup mixture.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until crackers brown and mixture is bubbly.

title: Apple Brown Betty
steps: Melt butter and stir in bread crumbs.
Set aside.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease baking dish, cover bottom with part of apples.
Sprinkle sugar mixture, then walnuts and then bread crumbs.
Repeat layers, ending with crumbs on top. Cover and bake 1 hour.
Remove cover last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Quick And Easy Breakfast Pizza

ingredients.name: sausage fried and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. sausage, fried, drained and crumbled

steps: Press crescent roll dough on pizza pan.
Top with sausage and cheese.
Beat eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and eggs are set.
Cut into slices and enjoy!

title: Pork Roast And Mustard Gravy
steps: Place pork roast in a Dutch oven.
Salt and pepper to taste and cover with water.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then turn heat down to medium.
Cook thoroughly, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Remove from heat and slice.
Place slices in an ovenproof casserole dish and sprinkle with a little more pepper.
Place in a 325° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
While roast is in oven, bring 1 1/2 cups of broth to a boil.
Dissolve 2 tablespoons of flour in 1/4 cup water. Stir into boiling broth.
Keep stirring to keep lumps from forming. Add mustard and cook until smooth.
Gravy may be poured over roast, or served separately.

title: Angel Salad
steps: Cream the cheese with sugar and vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip with mixer.
Drain pineapple and fruit cocktail.
Add bananas and nuts. Chill before serving.
Can be made the night before.

title: Taco Salad
steps: Cook beef with taco seasoning according to directions.
Shred head of lettuce into large bowl; add chopped onion and tomatoes. Add meat, when cool, and grated cheese.
Crush tortilla chips and add just before serving.
Add Catalina dressing to taste.

title: Strawberry Tunnel Cake
steps: Cut 1-inch slice crosswise from top of cake; set aside.
With sharp knife, cut around cake 1-inch from center hole and 1-inch from outer edge.
Remove cake from center, leaving 1-inch thick layer on bottom of cake.
This is your tunnel.
Reserve cake pieces.

title: Hamburger Cookies

ingredients.name: chocolate covered mint cooky
ingredients.raw: 6 chocolate covered round mint cookies or patties

steps: *Tip:
To tint coconut, place coconut and 1 to 2 drops of green food coloring in a jar or resealable plastic container. Seal container and shake until all colored.

title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt
steps: Place sugar and egg white in top of double boiler over simmering water.
With electric mixer at high speed, beat constantly until mixture thickens and forms soft peaks, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add yogurt, strawberry puree and vanilla to thickened mixture; stir until combined.
Pour mixture into container of ice cream freezer and process following manufacturer's directions.
Transfer to storage container, cover and freeze.

title: Mexican Corn Bread

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper and
ingredients.raw: 2 medium jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped

steps: Combine ingredients in a large bowl.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 400° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Crab And Olive Quesadillas(Makes 32)

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded (with or without jalapeno)

steps: Combine all ingredients, except tortillas.
Spread 2 tablespoons mixture onto each tortilla; fold in half.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes or until golden.
Cut each into 4 wedges.

title: Squash Pie(Sugarless)
steps: Heat and stir dates and water.
Cook until smooth.
Put dates, egg white, squash, spices and milk into blender and process until smooth.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie pastry and bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: semi sweet real chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (12 oz.) semi-sweet real chocolate chips

steps: Combine all dry ingredients and set aside.
Beat margarine, sugar, vanilla and eggs until light and fluffy.
Blend in flour mixture.
Stir in chips.
Drop from tablespoon, 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 375° for about 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Do not overbake.
Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: just a little bit of canned milk

steps: Mix everything together until well mixed.
Press into casserole dish and let sit in refrigerator until chilled.

title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cream cheese; stir until tiny flecks of white remain.
Add the mixed pineapple and blueberry juice.
Add the fruits and chill until almost set.
Fold in the Dream Whip which has been mixed following directions on package.

title: Liver And Onions
steps: In skillet, cook bacon until crisp; remove and crumble.
Dust liver with flour; brown lightly in bacon drippings.
Stir in soup. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until done.
Stir occasionally. Garnish with bacon.
Serve with cooked rice.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Chicken And Spaghetti
steps: Boil chicken in a pot of water.

Remove chicken when cooked, reserving broth. Cook green pepper and onion in a skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Add tomatoes with juice and cheese. Debone chicken and add to cheese mixture. Cook spaghetti in reserved chicken broth. Drain cooked spaghetti and mix with cheese and chicken.
Pour into a casserole dish.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Amish Cornmeal Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add milk, eggs and melted shortening.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Mix all ingredients and spread on cookie sheet.
Bake approximately 1 hour at 250°.
Stir often until seeds are no longer wet and are nicely browned.

title: Special Brownies

ingredients.name: duncan hine brown mix family size
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines brownie mix, family size

steps: Mix brownie mix as directed for chewy brownies and add nuts and chocolate chips.
Do not cook as directed.
Undercook.
Cook about 20 minutes, then let stand 3 or 4 minutes in turned-off oven with door open.
Then remove and let cool.

title: Bean Salad
steps: Mix together vinegar, sugar and salad oil.
Pour over beans, green pepper and onion.
Stir occasionally and chill several hours.
Drain before serving.

title: Black Bottom Squares
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix first 4 ingredients for 4 to 5 minutes or until well blended (I use food processor).
Add chips; blend, not using food processor.
Set aside.

title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Mix pretzel crumbs, 3 tablespoons sugar and melted butter. Press into a 9 x 13-inch dish and bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Cool. Whip the cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Spread over crust and refrigerate.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries.
When mixture has thickened, pour over cream cheese layer.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Even better if made a day ahead.

title: No Peek Oven Stew

ingredients.name: stew beef in
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. stew beef, cut in large cubes

steps: Combine all ingredients in roasting pan, mix well.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 275° for 3 1/2 hours.
Do not lift cover. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Forgotten Chicken
steps: Combine rice, mushroom soup, celery soup and milk in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Place chicken on the bed of rice and soups.
Sprinkle 1 package dry French onion soup over the chicken pieces.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°
for 2 hours.

title: Date Nut Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bake in a 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 325° to 350°.
Cut and roll in powdered sugar.

title: French Pound Cake

ingredients.name: sweet butter until fluffy
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. sweet butter, beaten until fluffy

steps: Beat the butter until fluffy.
Add the sugar.
Add the eggs, one at a time, and beat.
At slow mixing speed, alternate dry ingredients and milk.
Spoon into tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not open oven.
Cool in pan on rack for 15 minutes. Remove cake; place on rack to complete cooling.

title: King Ranch Casserole
steps: Stew chicken until very well done.
Tear into strips and mix with Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Mix soup, sour cream and and green chilies. Tear tortillas into bite size pieces.

title: Spicy Bean Dip
steps: Cook beef, onion and garlic until light brown and tender. Stir in tomato sauce, catsup, oregano and sugar.
Cover; simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon off fat.
Remove from heat and add cheeses.
Stir until melted and well mixed.

title: Delicious Dessert
steps: Mix and put into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 12 minutes.
Cool and break up with fork to make crumbs.

title: Squirrel Stew
steps: Boil squirrels.
Leave standing in water cooked in.
Cook onion, celery, carrots, salt and pepper.
Take squirrel off bone while vegetables are cooking.
When vegetables are cooked, put potatoes in squirrel water and cook.
Put potatoes and vegetables in bowl together with squirrel meat and add cornstarch to squirrel water and thicken to make gravy.
Then pour over meat and vegetables and serve.

title: Scalloped Sweet Potatoes
steps: Cook, peel and halve sweet potatoes.
Arrange sweet potatoes in shallow baking dish and sprinkle with salt.
Bring sugar and 1/4 cup water to boil, add margarine and pour over ingredients in baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven about 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Dump It Cake
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dump applesauce into pan and spread evenly.
Then dump pineapple on top of applesauce and then spread evenly again.
Spread the cake mix on top of mixture.
Pour the melted butter on top of the cake mix.
Now sprinkle the chopped nuts on top of butter.
(Note: Do not stir.)

title: Aunt Juana'S 20 Minute Rolls
steps: Mix ingredients
and
let sit only 15 minutes.
Mix and shape into rolls.
Let rise only 10 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.
Ready in 1 hour.

title: Benne Cookies

ingredients.name: baking soda in tsp. water
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. baking soda in 1 tsp. water

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Press down with a wet fork.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

title: Skillet Chicken Italiano
steps: In skillet, brown chicken in oil.
Pour off fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover; simmer for 45 minutes, or until done.
Stir occasionally.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
steps: Mix last 7 ingredients together.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 325° until set (about 30 to 40 minutes).

title: Chocolate Chip Dessert
steps: Soak cookies in milk.
Cover bottom of dish with Cool Whip. Add a layer of cookies and continue layering with Cool Whip and cookies.
Keep refrigerated.
Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Confetti Cookies

ingredients.name: cherry chip cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18 oz.) box cherry chip cake mix

steps: Cream the cream cheese, margarine, egg and vanilla.
Add cake mix, a third at a time.
Chill 30 minutes.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Classic Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans cut green beans, drained

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: durkee french fried onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions

steps: In medium bowl, combine beans, milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can of onions.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes, or until heated through.
Top with remaining onions.
Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes, or until onions are golden brown.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Milk Chocolate Bar Cake

ingredients.name: swiss chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. Swiss chocolate cake mix

ingredients.name: milk chocolate candy bar with almond divided
ingredients.raw: 10 (15 oz.) milk chocolate candy bars with almonds, divided

steps: Prepare cake batter according to directions on box.
Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch round cake pans.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool and divide to make 4 layers.

title: Low Calorie Tuna Salad

ingredients.name: no fat miracle whip salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp. no-fat Miracle Whip salad dressing

steps: Put drained tuna into bowl and shred with fork tines.
Add the no-fat Miracle Whip salad dressing.
Pour Equal sweetener onto the Miracle Whip and stir well. Salt and pepper to taste.
Great on toasted bread!
Serves 8.

title: Old Fashioned Waldorf Salad
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Toss gently to coat and chill 1 to 2 hours.
Spoon salad into a lettuce lined serving bowl. Garnish with apple wedges and pecan nuts.
Yields 10 servings.

title: Pickle Peach Slices
steps: Drain peaches in saucepan.
Set peaches aside.
To juice, add sugar, vinegar, cloves, allspice and cinnamon stick and bring to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour over peaches in heat-proof bowl. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Country-Style Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (26 oz.) pkg. frozen, shredded, hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cubed cooked chicken or ham

steps: In a large bowl, combine the first five ingredients.
Stir in hash browns, chicken and carrots, if desired.
Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Uncover; bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until bubbly.

title: Old Time Popcorn Balls
steps: Butter sides of saucepan.
In it, combine sugar, water, salt, syrup and vinegar.
Cook to hard ball stage.
Stir in vanilla. Slowly pour over popped corn, stirring just to mix well.
Butter hands and shape into balls.

title: Lettuce Salad
steps: Drain pineapple and oranges.
Stir over low heat until coated the almonds and sugar.
Cool and break apart.
Set aside.
Put remaining ingredients in a plastic bag.

title: Blond Brownies
steps: Melt margarine.
Add brown sugar.
Cool.
Add the remainder of the ingredients.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

title: Praline Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients together and drop into ungreased cookie sheet in a 350° oven for about 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from sheet and cool.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Mix together and press in buttered pan.
Melt 3 Hershey candy bars and pour over top.
Chill several hours and serve.

title: Twinkie Cake
steps: Layer Twinkies in 9 x 13-inch dish or pan.
Put large can pineapple with juice over Twinkies, then add bananas.
Mix pudding mix as directed on package.
Pour over bananas.
Then put Cool Whip and cherries and nuts on top.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Frosty Lime Float

ingredients.name: chilled lemon lime carbonated beverage
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bottle chilled lemon-lime carbonated beverage

steps: Put pineapple juice and sugar in pitcher.
Add 1/2 cup lime sherbet; stir mixture until smooth.
Pour 1/2 cup juice into each of 4 glasses; add 1 scoop sherbet to each glass.
Fill with lemon-lime beverages.

title: Chocolate Frosting
steps: In a small mixing bowl, cream the margarine.
Add cocoa and powdered sugar alternately with milk.
Beat to spreading consistency.
Additional milk may be needed.
Blend in vanilla.

title: New Orleans Orange Chicken
steps: Cut up chicken as desired.
Combine mayonnaise, ketchup and orange juice.
Pour over chicken in a shallow baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (uncovered).
Extra sauce may be used over rice.

title: Butter Brickle Cake
steps: Sift flour, sugar, powder and salt.
Add remaining ingredients, except egg whites.
Beat for 2 minutes, scraping bottom and sides frequently.
Add the unbeaten egg whites; beat for 2 more minutes.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Spinach Dip Or Spread
steps: Drain water chestnuts.
Mix all ingredients together.
Great on crackers!

title: Chess Pie(For 1 Pie)
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Dry Mix (Oriental Rice)
steps: Fry noodles in butter until golden.
Mix all ingredients except 1 can onion rings.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with remaining can of onion rings.

title: Sugar Drop Cookies
steps: In a large bowl, cream until light and fluffy the margarine, oil, sugar and powdered sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix well. By hand, add and mix the flour, soda and cream of tartar.
Place in covered bowl and chill at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350°. Place 1-inch balls of dough on a cookie sheet. Flatten and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes. This dough freezes well.
Cookies are very rich, 50 calories each.
(You may add chocolate or nuts to the dough or decorate with M&M's or chocolate stars.)

title: Pork Chops With Kraut
steps: Brown the pork chops quickly in heavy skillet. Arrange a layer of kraut in the bottom of a buttered casserole, then add 3 of the chops. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic.
Repeat again.
Pour over all the beer. Cover and bake at 325° for 2 hours.

title: Company Vegetable Casserole

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of celery soup

steps: In a bowl, combine beans, corn, soup, sour cream, cheese and onion.
Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.
Combine crumbs and almonds and sprinkle over vegetables.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Meringue
steps: Boil the sugar and water until thread stage.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour boiling mixture into egg whites and continue beating.
May brown in oven slightly.

title: Frozen Peanut Pie(Kent'S Favorite Pie)

ingredients.name: graham cracker crust
ingredients.raw: 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust or a regular pie crust, baked and cooled

steps: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy.
Beat in sugar and peanut butter.
Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly into mixture. Add whipped topping (made according to directions on package). Pour into baked pie shell.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
Freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Honey Wheat Bread

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.raw: 2 (1/4 oz. each) pkg. active dry yeast

steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole wheat flour and yeast.
In a saucepan, heat milk, water, honey, butter and salt to 120° to 130°; add to flour mixture.
Blend on low speed until moistened.
Beat on medium for 3 minutes.
Gradually stir in remaining whole wheat flour and enough of the remaining all-purpose flour to form a soft dough. Turn onto a floured board; knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.
Punch dough down.

title: Italian Beans (Fagioletti)
steps: Oil pan and add onion, garlic and beans.
Dissolve the tomato paste in water and add seasonings, herbs and a dash of sugar. Pour over the beans and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Dill Pickles

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: onion slices or clove of garlic

steps: Soak cucumbers in ice water 3 or 4 hours.
Drain.
Slice or cut into strips.
Place in sterilized jars, along with onion and a generous amount of dill.
Combine sugar, water, vinegar and salt and bring to a boil.
Pour over pickles and seal.
Store in 70° to 75° temperature until cucumbers look transparent, about 3 weeks. Makes 3 pints.

title: Lemon Congealed Salad
steps: Dissolve lemon jello in hot water.
Add cream cheese and eagle brand milk.
Then add mountain dew.
Add cool whip & crushed pineapple.
Add pecans to top.
Refrigerate.

title: Raisin Sauce(For Ham)

ingredients.name: broth from ham
ingredients.raw: 1 c. broth from ham or water

steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch in a pan and add broth or water gradually, stirring constantly.
Add remaining ingredients and cook, stirring occasionally, until raisins are plump and mixture is thick.
Serve hot with ham.
Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: French Dip Sandwiches
steps: Mix all together and pour over roast.
Bake until roast is tender.
Slice roast and serve on hard rolls.
Save juice and serve with sandwiches.

title: Farmer'S Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Melt butter in a frying pan.
Put salt and pepper on the meat. Brown chops and onions together.
Grease casserole.
Lay potato slices on bottom of casserole.
Remove the browned chops from the pan; place on top of the potatoes.
Add the soup and milk to the onions; stir until mixture is smooth.
Pour over chops.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Uncover; bake another 30 minutes.

title: Uncooked Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients except oats; boil for 1 minute.
Add mixture to uncooked oats and drop onto wax paper.

title: Fudge
steps: Stir sugar, margarine and milk consistently until it comes to a full boil.
Let boil 2 minutes, continue stirring.
Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallows until smooth.
Add chocolate chips and stir until smooth.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish lined with foil and well buttered.

title: Pineapple Pecan Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: pecan divided in half
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chopped pecans, divided in half

steps: In mixing bowl, whip cream cheese until smooth.
Gently stir in pineapple, green pepper, onion, seasonings and 1/2 cup nuts. Turn out onto a sheet of plastic wrap and shape into a ball. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Chicken In Foil

ingredients.name: carrot scraped and
ingredients.raw: 2 carrots, scraped and cut into 3/4-inch pieces

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

steps: Cut four 24 x 18-inch pieces of heavy-duty tinfoil.
Place a chicken quarter in center of each; sprinkle with garlic salt and paprika.
Top evenly with onion and next 4 ingredients.
Spoon soup evenly over each portion.
Seal bundles and place on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Easy Beef Stew
steps: Baking Temperature: 300°.
Baking Time: 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Using solid shortening or margarine (not oil), grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan.

title: Quick Rolls
steps: Mix yeast with water; add salt, sugar, shortening and flour. Let rise.
Make out into rolls and let rise again.
Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Chicken Gumbo
steps: Boil chicken until done and debone. Cut-up onion and bell pepper.
Dissolve Roux in chicken broth and add onions and bell pepper.
Put debone chicken into mixture and cook until onions and bell pepper is done.

title: Strawberry-Yogurt Drink

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 c. unsweetened fresh or frozen strawberries

steps: If frozen, thaw strawberries.
In blender, combine buttermilk, yogurt, banana, ice cubes and strawberries.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Makes 4 servings at 93 calories each.

title: Snowball Cookies
steps: Place sugar in bowl.
In another bowl, combine next 3 ingredients.
In saucepan, combine marshmallows and butter.
Stir until smooth.
Remove from heat.
Stir in extracts.
Pour over cereal mixture.
Stir until well coated.
Using greased hands, shape into 1 1/2-inch balls.
Coat with sugar.

title: Johnny Appleseed Cakes
steps: Grate apples (peeling, too).
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix and fry in a small amount of oil.

title: Civil War Cake Or Grandmama Pound Cake
steps: Beat egg yolks separately.
Add butter and sugar.
Add flour and nutmeg.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake at 350° until a knife comes out clean.

title: Hobo Pack
steps: Bake in oven in foil or on the grill.
If potatoes are not precooked, it will take longer.

title: Tracy'S Overnight Salad
steps: Prepare pudding mix as directed on package, use whole eggs. Mix in lemon juice with pudding.
Add whipped cream, fruit cocktail and marshmallows.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Easy Potato-Sausage Casserole
steps: In skillet crumble and brown sausage and onion; drain.
In a mixing bowl blend together milk, mushroom soup and pepper.
In 9 x 9-inch casserole dish layer one half of potatoes, one half of soup mixture, one half of grated cheese and one half of sausage. Repeat; cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Uncover; sprinkle a little more cheese over top.
Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Sirloin Steak Salad

ingredients.name: slivered almond brown under broiler
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. slivered almonds, browned under broiler or in frypan

ingredients.name: ramen soup noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Ramen soup noodles (beef or mushroom)

steps: Broil sirloin steak and cut into bite size pieces.
Crush Ramen noodles by hand while in package.
Open carefully and slide out flavor packet (to be used in dressing).
Mix all the ingredients, except noodles, almonds and dressing.

title: Lemon Glazed Carrots
steps: Wash carrots; pare.
Place in large saucepan with salt and enough boiling water to cover.
Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, or until tender.
Drain.
Melt butter in large skillet.
Stir in sugar.
Add lemon slices and carrots; cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until carrots are glazed.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Broccoli Orientale

ingredients.name: chicken thigh
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into strips

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 1 medium green or sweet red pepper, cut into 1-inch squares

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's cream of broccoli soup

steps: In skillet in hot oil, cook chicken, 1/2 at a time, until browned.
Add onion and pepper.
Cook until tender-crisp.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low. Cover.
Simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve chicken over rice.
Makes 4 servings.
Preparation time:
10 minutes; cooking time:
20 minutes.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour, chips and vanilla.
Stir until well mixed.
Add nuts.
Drop by half teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.
Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Coconut Cream Cake(Makes 12 Servings)

ingredients.name: pudding included yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18 3/4 oz.) pkg. pudding included yellow cake mix

steps: Prepare cake mix with eggs, water and oil, adding orange rind following label directions.
Divide batter into two greased and floured round 9 x 1 1/2-inch cake pans.
Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes or until centers spring back when lightly touched with fingertips.
Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes; turn out onto racks.
Cool completely.
Split each layer in half to make 4 thin layers.
Beat cream with 10x sugar in a small bowl until stiff.
Put layers together with Coconut Cream Filling. Frost side and top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle generously with flaked coconut.

title: Mississippi Corn Salad

ingredients.name: shoe peg white corn
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans Shoe Peg white corn

ingredients.name: plain yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. plain yogurt or substitute 1/2 c. mayonnaise

steps: Slice green onions and their tops.
Stir together with corn, tomato, mayonnaise, yogurt, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 24 hours.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cauliflower With Mustard Sauce
steps: Steam whole head of cauliflower.
Do not break head apart. After cauliflower is steamed, leave in pot.
Mix mayonnaise and mustard together and cover top of cauliflower.
Sprinkle sharp cheese on top of mustard sauce.
Cover and let cheese melt, then serve.

title: Texas Hash
steps: Heat oil in skillet.
Saute peppers and onions until tender. Add beef and cook until pink is gone, stirring to crumble meat. Add tomatoes, rice and seasonings.
Arrange in greased baking dish.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake until brown at 350°.

title: Reva'S Manicotti
steps: Add 1 c. water to large jar of Ragu.
Place small amount in 9 x 13 pan.
Fill uncooked noodles and place in pan.
Cover with remaining sauce.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for about 1 hr. If using glass pan, cook longer.

title: Quickie Broccoli Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 boxes broccoli (16 oz. each), chopped or spheres

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom soup (10 1/2 oz.)

steps: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes; set aside to drain.
Combine mayonnaise, soup and cheese, stirring in broccoli.
Pour mixture into a 2-quart buttered (or Pam) casserole dish.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Top crackers lightly with either melted or squeeze butter.
Cook for 30 to 45 minutes until crackers are browned good.

title: Red Lentil Soup With Garlic Croutons
steps: Fry chopped onion in hot oil until translucent.
Lower heat, add chopped garlic and continue frying while stirring until garlic just starts to change color.

title: Spinach Fettucine
steps: Clean spinach, removing stems.
Cook garlic, onion and 1/2 stick butter until golden.
Add spinach.
Cover until wilted. Cook fettucine.
Drain.
Mix with 1/2 stick butter, cream and cheese.
Add spinach mixture.

title: Graham Cracker Nut Torte
steps: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored.
Add sugar gradually and beat well, about 10 minutes.
Add vanilla.
Add crumbs and baking powder.
Blend in nuts.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in 2 (9-inch) round cake pans, greased and floured, for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
steps: In pan, layer refried beans, then guacamole.
Next, mix sour cream, salad dressing and taco seasoning together.
Spread on guacamole.
Layer the green onions, tomatoes, olives and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Grits And Sausage Casserole
steps: Cook grits - set aside.
Brown sausage, onion, and bell pepper.
Drain well.
Combine grits with meat mixture and 1 cup cheese.
Spoon into a greased casserole.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Salted Peanut Cookies
steps: Mix butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla thoroughly.
Blend rest of ingredients.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, on lightly greased sheet.
Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Lentil Loaf
steps: You may use a little cottage cheese and cereal in place of bread crumbs.
Add a little more lentils.
Add enough crumbs so it is not soupy.

title: Dieter'S Delight
steps: Boil chicken breasts about 30 minutes.
Add mushrooms, onion and celery.
Chop cabbage.
Simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve.

title: Green Beans With Meat Served Over Rice

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce or 3 medium-sized fresh tomatoes, cut small

steps: Clean and cut beans in about 2-inch lengths and set aside. Cut meat into 1-inch cubes and saute for 10 minutes.
Add onions, garlic and seasonings; saute for 5 minutes more.
Add water to cover meat and simmer until tender.
(If water evaporates before meat is almost done; add more water.)

title: Keebler Cherry Burst Pie
steps: Combine milk, lemon juice and vanilla.
Mix until well blended.
Fold in remaining ingredients, one at a time.
Mound mixture into crust.
Freeze until firm, 2 to 3 hours.
Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes before serving.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
steps: Crush wafers finely and blend all ingredients together. Freeze until firm and keep refrigerated.
(Use a loaf pan.)

title: Frozen Date Salad
steps: Soften and blend cream cheese and pineapple.
Add Cool Whip, then other ingredients.
Freeze.

title: Fruit Juice Punch
steps: Mix equal parts of 3 juices.
Chill to allow flavors to blend. Add ginger ale just before serving.
To make 25 (5 ounce) servings, use 46 ounce size pineapple juice and measure other juices with the can.
Use 1 liter (33 ounce) bottle of diet ginger ale.

title: Red Raspberry Ring

ingredients.name: red raspberry thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen red raspberries, thawed

steps: Drain raspberries, reserving syrup.
Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add ice cream by spoonfuls, stirring until melted.
Stir in lemonade and reserved syrup.
Chill until partially set.
Add raspberries and nuts.
Turn into a 6 cup ring mold or a flat Pyrex dish.
Chill until firm.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sandies
steps: Beat butter for 30 seconds; add granulated sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add vanilla and 2 teaspoons water, beat well.
Stir in flour and pecans.
Shape into 1-inch balls or 1 1/2 x 1/2-inch fingers.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 325° oven for 20 minutes.
Cool completely.
Gently shake a few cookies at a time in a bag with powdered sugar.
Yields 36.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
steps: Stir together sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.
Blend milk and egg yolks.
Gradually stir into sugar mixture.
Thicken and boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat, blend in butter and vanilla.
Immediately pour into baked pie shell.
Top with meringue.

title: Beef And Macaroni Skillet Dinner
steps: Brown ground beef in large skillet.
Add remaining ingredients; stir.
Bring to boil.
Reduce to simmer.
Cover. Cook until macaroni is tender, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Icebox Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, brown sugar and eggs; add cake flour and blend smoothly.
Roll in waxed paper in desired size.
Place in icebox overnight.
Slice as required.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Lemon Bread
steps: Mix all together.
Grease pans.
Bake at 350°.
Makes 5 small or 2 1/2 large.
Cook 40 minutes for large or 35 minutes for small.

title: Microwave Brownies
steps: Melt butter or margarine in bowl on HIGH for 1 minute or until melted.
Add sugar.
Cool.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Put flour, dry cocoa, instant drink mix and baking powder together and blend into sugar mixture.
Stir in nuts to suit your taste (1/2 cup or more). Pour in a 9-inch glass pie plate.
Cook on HIGH for 4 1/2 - 5 1/2 minutes, turning if needed.
Cool before cutting.
Makes 1 dozen.

title: Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: raisin suit soaked and
ingredients.raw: raisins to suit, soaked and drained

steps: Cook rice in microwave according to box directions.
Add rest of ingredients; sprinkle top with cinnamon and bake at 300° to 350° for 1 hour.

title: Oven Fry Orange Roughy
steps: Put bread crumbs in pan and toast at 375° for 8 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Put flour on a piece of wax paper, mixed with salt and pepper.
Beat egg white and place in shallow bowl.
Pat dry orange roughy and coat with flour, then egg white and then toasted bread crumbs.
Place fish on baking pan lined with foil and coat it with some vegetable oil.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Turn over and bake another 6 minutes.

title: California Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: corn flake
ingredients.raw: 1 c. corn flakes or crackers, crushed

steps: Combine all ingredients and top with crushed topping.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Good.

title: Pizza Sauce

ingredients.name: each basil salt and sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each: basil, salt and sugar

steps: Saute onion in olive oil until transparent.
Add garlic and saute for 1 minute.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer at a very low heat, uncovered, for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf.
Makes about 1 cup.

title: Chili Burgers
steps: Brown meat, onions, peppers, salt, sugar and vinegar.
Add other ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Serve on toasted buns.

title: Peppercorn Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: lg. chicken breast half skinned and boned
ingredients.raw: 4 lg. chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

ingredients.name: pink green
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. crushed whole pink, green or Szechwan peppercorns

ingredients.name: dry cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. dry sherry or orange juice

steps: Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap and pound with mallet.
Sprinkle with peppercorns.
Heat heavy nonstick skillet and add butter and chicken.
Cook, turning once, until done or about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken and keep warm.
Increase heat to high and add sherry or orange juice.
Whisk in the cream and tarragon.
Boil, stirring until sauce is glossy, thickened and reduced to about half the amount.
Spoon sauce over chicken.

title: Caramel Corn
steps: Combine caramels and milk in top of a double boiler.
Heat over boiling water until smooth and creamy.
Stir occasionally; remove from heat.
Drizzle over popcorn.

title: Apricot Nut Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch).
Mix the first 4 ingredients; beat hard for 30 seconds.
Stir in apricots and nuts.
Pour into pan; bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until cake tester stuck in middle comes out clean.
A crack in top is typical.
Cool before slicing.

title: 2 Baked Pie Shells(Fruit Pie)
steps: Boil the first 3 ingredients 5
minutes or until thick.
Stir in the Jell-O and boil 1 minute.
For strawberry pie, use the 4 cups uncooked strawberries and stir into the mixture.
Pour into shells and chill.
Use Cool Whip for topping.

title: El-Granda
steps: Brown meat, then drain.
Pour cheese soup, milk, chili seasoning and tomatoes and the juice into meat.
Simmer while the yellow rice is cooking.
Cook the rice as directed on the bag. When the rice has cooked, add to the meat mixture.

title: Kiss Cakes
steps: Beat egg whites very stiff; add sugar a little at a time. This is important.
Sprinkle in cornstarch and salt; add flavorings and pecans a few at a time.
Drop mixture by tablespoon onto a cookie sheet lined with brown paper.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.
They are done when you can lift them from the paper.

title: Pickles
steps: First Day:
Pour boiling water with salt over cucumbers; let stand 24 hours.

title: Red Lobster Cheese-Garlic Biscuits
steps: Combine butter or margarine and garlic powder.
Brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.
Serve warm. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Cherry Fluff

ingredients.name: or less nut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. or less to taste chopped nuts

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill until firm.

title: Cream Puffs
steps: Add shortening to boiling water and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add flour and salt all at once and stir vigorously until ball forms in center of pan.
Cool slightly.
Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each egg.
Mixture should be very stiff.
Shape on greased cookie sheet by dropping from spoon or pastry bag.
Bake.
Cook medium size (3-inch) for 10 minutes at 450° and 20 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Cut slice off top. Fill with cream, ice cream or pudding.
Yield: 18 medium-size.

title: Savory Pot Roast

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. beef round or chuck pot roast

ingredients.name: pouch dry onion soup and recipe mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pouch dry onion soup and recipe mix

steps: In a 6-quart Dutch oven, in hot oil, brown roast.
Spoon off fat.
Add mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water.
Cover; cook over low heat for 2 hours.
Add vegetables.
Cover and cook 45 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender, stirring occasionally.
Remove roast and vegetables.
Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth.
Gradually stir into soup mixture.
Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.

title: Hot Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix together and cook until thick.
Put in hot pint jars and seal.
Hot bath for 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
steps: Mix by hand.
Pat into a 9 x 12-inch pan and 1 smaller pan, 8 x 8-inch.
Bake at 275° for 25 minutes.

title: Bubblin' Party Punch
steps: In bowl, dissolve gelatin and sugar in water; set aside.
In large bowl, combine pineapple juice, lemon juice and gelatin mixture.
Chill.
Just before serving, pour juice mixture into punch bowl; add sherbet and club soda.
Makes 3 1/2 quarts.

title: Rainbow Twirls Alfredo
steps: Cook pasta according to directions; drain.
Meanwhile, in small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Gradually stir in cheese, then cream until well blended.
Continue heating sauce, stirring constantly, just to boiling point.
Remove from heat. Stir in parsley and toss with hot, cooked pasta.
Serve.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cinnamon Caramel Rolls
steps: Thaw bread slightly.
Cut in half and then in half again (lengthwise). Cut into cubes and roll in sugar and cinnamon.
Put in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
steps: Brown meat, onion and green pepper in skillet.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients except cheese.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole dish.
Bake for 20 minutes at 400°.
Top with cheese and return to oven until melted.

title: No Fail Biscuits
steps: Mix together flour and soda.
Add with fork until the consistency of corn meal the Crisco.
Mix in the buttermilk.
Roll or pat out dough.
Cut out biscuits and bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Willie Mae'S Cabbage With Tomato And Bacon
steps: Boil the cabbage until tender.
Drain, chop and add salt and pepper.
Simmer the mixture in tomato juice for about 20 minutes. Fry bacon over medium-high heat until crisp.
Crumble the bacon over the cabbage and sprinkle with the chopped parsley just before setting it on the table.

title: "Buckeyes"
steps: Melt oleo and peanut butter (slow).
Add sugar.
Shape into balls.
Melt chips and paraffin in double boiler.
Dip balls into chocolate mixture.
Put on wax paper.

title: Taffy
steps: Butter a large baking sheet.
In a black iron pot (about 2 quart size), combine the sugar, vinegar, corn syrup, cream of tartar and butter.
Bring to a boil and cook until it reaches 250 degrees on a candy thermometer.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in the vanilla extract.
Immediately pour into baking pan. Allow to cool slightly until the edges become firm enough to pull toward the center of the pan.
Continue pulling edges toward the center until mixture is firm enough to handle.
This mixture will be very hot, so be careful when handling it. Don't butter your hands because this makes it difficult to pull the taffy.
The taffy, when ready to be pulled, should not stick to your hands.
If it does, you can rub a little cornstarch onto the palms of your hands.

title: Lemon Herb Marinated Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves

steps: In a cup, mix the first 5 ingredients; pour over chicken. Cover; let stand at room temperature no longer than 30 minutes, turning once.
Broil 10 minutes, or until thoroughly cooked, turning once.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Baked Fish

ingredients.name: or bass
ingredients.raw: 3 or 4 servings bass or Walleye fillet

steps: Clean and dry fish.
Mix eggs and A.1. sauce.
Marinate fish in sauce 10 minutes.
Crush crackers fine and coat fish.
Place fish fillets on oiled heavy foil.
Bake 8 minutes at 400°.
Turn on broiler and broil fish 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned and fish are done.

title: Cathy'S Broccoli Salad
steps: Wash broccoli and cauliflower.
Break into small pieces.
Chop onion.
Add cheese.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar in small bowl until creamy.
Pour over salad ingredients.
Stir until coated.
Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Buffalo Wing Spaghetti

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 cooked chicken breasts, cut into strips

steps: Place all ingredients into saucepan, except spaghetti.
Heat and simmer about 10 minutes.
Stir thoroughly.
Boil spaghetti and drain.
Serve on top of spaghetti.

title: Chocolate Mousse Pie

ingredients.name: baker s german s sweet cooking and eating chocolate
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Baker's German's sweet cooking and eating chocolate

steps: Melt bar of chocolate with 3 tablespoons of water over low heat.
Stir constantly until chocolate is melted.
Add instant coffee and let cool.
Add vanilla.
Whip 1 1/2 cups heavy cream to medium consistency.
Fold chocolate mixture into cream.
Pour into pie shell and chill.
Garnish with bitter chocolate shavings.

title: Slavic Oven Stew
steps: Trim fat and bone from pork chops.
Layer first 7 ingredients in large baking dish in order given in recipe.
Arrange pork chops on top.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and pour 1 small can tomato sauce over chops.
Bake in 450° oven 1 hour (covered), then in 375° oven 1/2 hour (uncovered).
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Candy
steps: Scald milk and oleo.
Set aside.
Mix baking powder, salt, sugar and flour.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Beat together and put in a 15 x 10-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.
Take out of oven and spread peanut butter on top.
While cake is hot, refrigerate for 1 hour.
Melt Hershey bar and spread on top.
Let chocolate harden and cut in squares.

title: Baked Chicken Bundles
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to package.
Pound chicken breast halves into 1/4-inch thickness.
Put equal amounts of Rice-A-Roni on each breast half.
Roll chicken up to enclose filling.
Secure with a wooden pick.
Dip chicken into milk; roll in bread crumbs.
Put in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Best Banana Bread Ever
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Liberally grease loaf pan. Combine all ingredients until mixed thoroughly, but do not overmix.
Pour into pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Enjoy!

title: Chicky Licky
steps: Layer each ingredient.
Stuffing on bottom and top.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Whole Wheat Light Rolls
steps: Combine milk, sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm, then add eggs.
Add 1 cup of each of the flours and mix well. Soften yeast in warm water and add to first mixture.
Stir in remaining flour and put in greased bowl in refrigerator.
Cover with greased wax paper.
Two hours before baking remove from refrigerator and knead lightly.
Shape into rolls and let raise. Bake at 425° about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Summer Vegetable Bake
steps: Cut squash and onion into chunks about 1 x 1/2-inch.
Place all in a gallon bag.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil.
Shake to dampen veggies with oil.
Add onion soup mix.
Shake to cover veggies. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Cook uncovered for 20 minutes at 450°.
Stir once.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
steps: Melt butter.
Add veggies.
Turn on low heat.
Throw in shrimp; cover with tight lid.
Cook for 45 minutes.
Do not add water to this recipe.
Never freeze it.
Serve over cooked rice.

title: Sugared Peanuts
steps: Bring to a boil and continue boiling and stirring until all water is gone.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Bake in 200° oven until peanuts are crisp inside, not soggy.

title: Vanilla Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: jell o vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small box Jell-O vanilla pudding (not instant)

steps: Gradually stir milk and egg into dry pudding mix in saucepan, add rice and raisins.
Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to boil.
Remove from heat, cover for 5 minutes, then cool for 5 minutes, stirring twice.
Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate about 1 hour.
Serve with sprinkled cinnamon and nutmeg.
Makes 10 servings.
Can be doubled.

title: Jalapeno Dip
steps: Mix together softened Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise.
Stir in remaining ingredients; stir alot.
Can keep for two weeks or more in refrigerator.
Serve with Wheat Thins crackers, Fritos, etc. Hot, hot, hot!
But loved by all.

title: Chicken In Honey Mustard Sauce

ingredients.name: campbell s healthy request
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request (cream of chicken soup)

ingredients.name: each honey and dijon style mustard
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. each: honey and Dijon style mustard

ingredients.name: hot rice without salt
ingredients.raw: 4 c. hot cooked rice, cooked without salt

steps: In skillet over medium heat in hot oil, cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned.
Remove, pour off fat.
In same skillet, combine soup, orange juice, honey, mustard and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Return chicken to skillet.
Cover, cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring often. Serve with rice.
Makes 4 servings.
Contains 12 g fat and 520 calories.

title: Cranberry Jello(Given To Clo Fletcher By Clara Hollingsworth)
steps: Mix jello, hot water and cold water.
Add cranberry sauce; stir until dissolved.
Refrigerate and chill, then add sour cream and pecans.
Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes if skin is tough, otherwise leave skin on. Slice potatoes in thin slices, but not all the way through.
Put potatoes in a baking dish; spread out slightly.
Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter.
Sprinkle with herbs.
Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Banana Nut Bread(Diabetic)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or use a cooking spray.

title: Country Biscuits
steps: Cut shortening into dry mixture.
Add enough milk to make a fairly wet dough.
Place on floured board.
Cut into rounds about 1/2 inch high and place close together in pan (greased).
Bake in hot oven until brown.

title: Cheese Ball With Dried Beef

ingredients.name: beef up in
ingredients.raw: 1 jar dried beef, cut up in small pieces

steps: Mix together.
Roll in parsley flakes.
Makes one cheese ball. Wrap in waxed paper, then in foil.
Refrigerate.
Serve with snack crackers.

title: 100 Year Old Pie Crust

ingredients.name: milk with tbsp. white vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. milk with 1 Tbsp. white vinegar (soak together about 20 minutes)

steps: Fix milk and vinegar 10 minutes prior to mixing rest of ingredients.
Mix flour, Crisco or lard and salt with fork.
Mix well.
Make sure vinegar spoiled milk before mixing it with the other ingredients.
Makes 1 large double crust or 2 small double crusts.

title: German Pancake
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Blend it all together and put into a 10-inch skillet (cast-iron preferred).
Prepare skillet by smearing 4 tablespoons butter all around the inside.
Bake 25 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Peppermint Pie
steps: Beat egg whites, sugar and cream of tartar until peaks form. Spread thinly over pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes.
Cool. Fill crust with peppermint ice cream and place in freezer until ready to serve.
Yield:
6 servings.

title: Strawberry Tunnel Cream Cake

ingredients.name: light cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg light cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: low fat condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can low-fat sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: container reduced fat whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) container reduced-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: fresh strawberries or mint springs, for garnish

steps: Cut a 1-inch layer from top of cake; set aside.
Hollow out center of cake, leaving a 1-inch shell; tear remaining cake into bite-size pieces.
Place shell on serving platter, and set aside. Beat cream cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy.
Add condensed milk; beat until blended.
Stir in lemon juice and extract.
Fold in cake pieces and strawberries.
Spoon into cake shell; replace top layer.
Cover and chill 3 hours or until set.
Spread whipped topping on top and sides of cake; garnish, if desired.
Chill.

title: Dill Dip(For Vegetables)

ingredients.name: seasoned salt as
ingredients.raw: seasoned salt as needed to taste

ingredients.name: garlic salt as
ingredients.raw: garlic salt as needed to taste

steps: Mix mayo and sour cream together.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.

title: Strawberry Mousse

ingredients.name: sugar jell o brand strawberry flavor gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) sugar-free Jell-O brand strawberry flavor gelatin or any red flavor

ingredients.name: thawed cool whip whipped
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. thawed Cool Whip whipped topping

steps: Pour boiling water into blender.
Add gelatin and blend at low speed until completely dissolved, about 3 seconds.
Add ice cubes and stir until ice is partially melted.
Add strawberries, reserving 6 halves for garnish.
If desired, add the whipped topping.
Blend at high speed 30 seconds or until smooth.
Pour into individual glasses.
Chill until set, at least 30 minutes. Garnish with strawberries.

title: Drop Doughnuts
steps: Sift flour and measure in baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Combine shortening, egg, sugar and milk.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Use sufficient extra flour to make a stiff drop batter.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into 365 F fat.
Fry until golden brown.

title: Braised Cabbage With Caraway
steps: Core cabbage; slice head into 1 1/2-inch wedges.
In large skillet, melt margarine.
Add cabbage, parsley, sugar, pepper and broth.
Cover skillet and cook cabbage over medium heat for 12 minutes, basting several times with pan juices.
When cabbage is nearly done, sprinkle it with caraway seed.
Serve cabbage with a little of the pan juices.

title: Peanut Butter Cups

ingredients.name: graham cracker
ingredients.raw: 2 c. crushed graham crackers or 2 c. graham cracker crumbs

steps: Put all ingredients together and mix well.
Then press into buttered cookie sheet or 13 x 9-inch cake pan (I use cake pan). Then melt 1 (12 ounce) package chocolate chips and spread over top of mixture.
Cut while still warm.

title: Apple Butter
steps: Wash and core apples; cut in 8ths.
Put 1/3 cup cider or apple juice and 5 or 6 pieces of apple into blender.
Cover and process until smooth.
Increase speed to blender.
Remove cap and add apple pieces until container is full.
Empty into saucepan. Repeat with remaining cider and apples.
Add sugar and spices to apples.
Cook over low heat about 45 minutes, stirring slightly. Pour into jars.
Process 10 minutes in boiling water.

title: Eggnog Mix

ingredients.name: no bake mustard mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (4 1/2 oz.) pkg. no-bake custard mix (like Jell-O American egg custard)

steps: Mix well.
Mix 1/2 cup to 1 cup hot water.

title: Supremes Of Chicken With Herbes De Provence

ingredients.name: herbe de provence
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. herbes de Provence or a mixture of any or all of the following: dried marjoram, thyme, savory, sage, fennel, basil, rosemary, lavendar

steps: Melt butter in large, heavy skillet (preferably nonstick). Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt, pepper and the herbs de Provence, pressing herbs into the chicken.
Place chicken in the foaming butter and cook approximately 2 1/2 minutes on each side. Then remove from heat. Cover skillet and set aside for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mom'S Homemade Macaroni And Cheese

ingredients.name: macaroni
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked macaroni or 1 1/2 c. uncooked

steps: Mix
soup, milk, mustard and 1 1/2 cups cheese.
Add salt and cracked black pepper to taste.
Mix well and add macaroni.
Bake for 25 minutes in casserole dish.
Stir and top with remaining cheese and onion rings.
Bake 5 more minutes.

title: Blueberry Dessert
steps: Mix cracker crumbs, 1/2 cup sugar and butter.
Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Beat eggs, 1/2 cup sugar, vanilla and cream cheese together until smooth.
Pour over crust and bake 25 minutes at 375°.
Cool.
Pour blueberry filling over the top and garnish with whipped cream (rich whip).

title: Honey-Mustard Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless skinless Chicken Breast halves (1 lb.)

steps: Flatten Chicken to 1/4 inch thickness.
In a shallow bowl, combine Bread Crumbs and 1 teaspoon Mustard.
In another shallow bowl, combine Honey and remaining Mustard.
Dip Chicken in honey-mustard mixture, then coat with Crumbs.
In non-stick skillet, over medium heat, cook Chicken in Butter on both sides until juices run clear, about 8 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Mix all ingredients, knead until smooth.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Herb Roasted Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 375°. Sprinkle chicken cavities with the garlic salt and crushed rosemary. Truss chicken and place in an open roasting pan. Combine butter, wine, rosemary, basil, parsley, salt and pepper in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat a few minutes until thoroughly blended.
Baste chicken with wine sauce. Roast 20 minutes per pound until tender. Baste frequently. The last 20 minutes, turn to brown underside.

title: Rum Cake
steps: Grease tube pan.
Put chopped pecans in bottom of pan.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham

ingredients.name: ham in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. thinly sliced ham, cut in serving pieces

steps: Put half of the potatoes into a greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with half the onion, pepper and a little salt.
Use the salt sparingly.
Add ham.
Cover with rest of potatoes, seasonings and onion.
Add milk until it barely shows between the potato slices on top.
Save the rest of the milk to add during baking, if necessary.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
steps: Mix peaches, cinnamon and 1 cup sugar.
Put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sift flour, salt, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and vanilla in a bowl.
Pour over peaches.
Melt oleo and pour over all.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm dressing with tbsp. butter
ingredients.raw: Pepperidge Farm dressing with 3 Tbsp. butter, melted

steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk; add salt.
Place layer of broccoli in baking dish, then layer of white sauce and layer of cheese.
Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing.
Drizzle melted butter over dressing.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Calico Salad
steps: Wash radishes, spinach and lettuce; chill in refrigerator. Save 2 or 3 radishes for "roses;" crisp with ice cube.
Tear spinach leaves and lettuce into bite size pieces in salad bowl. Slice 5 or 6 radishes thinly.
Add to greens.
Peel oranges; cut into sections.
Cut avocado into bite size chunks or slices. Reserve 8 to 10 large onion rings.
Add remainder to salad.
Just before serving, add dressing and toss lightly.
Garnish with onion rings and radish "roses."
Serves 6.

title: Mom'S Easy Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 325° about 50 minutes.

title: Mini Pizza
steps: Brown
and
drain
ground chuck.
Spread pizza sauce on muffin.
Garnish
with
meat, mushrooms, pepperoni and cheese. Put in
microwave or regular oven at 350° until warm throughout.

title: Mexican Chocolate
steps: In large saucepan, heat all ingredients except milk and cream over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in milk; heat over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Beat with rotary beater until foamy.
Top serving with whipped cream. Makes 8 (2/3-cup) servings.

title: Mexican Salad

ingredients.name: corn
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. bag corn or tortilla chips

ingredients.name: kidney
ingredients.raw: 1 can kidney or Ranch Style beans

steps: Toss 1 cup grated cheese, 1/2 cup French or Thousand Island dressing and hot sauce to taste.
Crunch and add one (6 ounce) bag of chips.
Slice and add 1 avocado.

title: Blueberry Supreme
steps: In bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and sugar.
Melt margarine and add to mixture.
Press 2/3 crust mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Set aside.
In mixing bowl, beat Cool Whip and cream cheese together.
Add confectioners sugar and continue to beat until smooth.
Put cream cheese mixture on top of crust mixture.
Top with blueberry pie filling.
Sprinkle top with remaining crust mixture.
Refrigerate before serving.

title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cut ends off peppers and remove seeds.
Boil pepper 5 minutes.
Chop pepper ends and onions.
Saute with ground beef until brown, add other ingredients.
Bake in muffin pan for 20 minutes at 375 degrees.
Serves 6.

title: Susan'S Rolls
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pour 1/2 cup boiling water over this.
Mix until dissolved.

title: Carrot Delight

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. sugar (may add up to 1 c.)

ingredients.name: each salt pepper and dry mustard
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: salt, pepper and dry mustard

steps: Cook cleaned and sliced carrots in unsalted water until tender.
Drain and place in bowl with chopped pepper and onion. Make a sauce of remaining ingredients.
Bring sauce to boil and pour over carrots.

title: Strawberry Jello Dessert

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (13 or 15 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Make jello with boiling water.
Add 2 packages of strawberries and stir until thawed.
Add the fruit and nuts.
Mix well. Congeal 1/2 of mixture.
Spread sour cream over this and top with the other half of mixture.
Congeal.
Serves around 12.

title: Chicken Of The Year
steps: Combine corn flakes with salt, pepper and monosodium glutamate. Line shallow pan with aluminum foil.
Dip chicken legs in evaporated milk and then roll in corn flake mixture.
Place in pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Carrot Cookies
steps: Combine ingredients and mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Nutty Peach Crisp
steps: Layer in order given in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Asian Slaw

ingredients.name: beef seasoning from ramen noodle
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. beef seasoning from Ramen noodles

steps: Crush noodles in bottom of 13 x 9 casserole dish.
Layer slaw mix, onions, almonds and sunflower seeds, but do not mix.
Then mix together oil, vinegar, sugar and 2 packages of the Ramen noodle seasoning mix.
Pour over other mixture, but do not mix.
Let chill 24 hours.
Then mix before serving.

title: Mystery Squares
steps: Mix graham crackers and butter together.
Line 9 x 14-inch pan with this mixture.
Mix walnuts, chocolate chips and coconut; spread over crust.
Pour condensed milk over the top and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Mix first three ingredients.
Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
When biscuits are still warm, brush them with melted margarine/garlic mixture.

title: Assyrian Rice
steps: Combine rice and salt; soak overnight, covered well with water.
The next day, bring a large pan of water to a boil. Drain the soaked rice; put into boiling water and parboil (about 10 minutes).
Drain off water.

title: Mema Weimar'S Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Bring water to boil.
Add macaroni and cook for about 15 minutes.
Drain.
Place in pan and pour the can of tomatoes (mashed good) over top.
Add bacon grease and grated cheese.
Add salt and pepper to taste; stir all together.
Sprinkle some grated cheese on top and bacon bits.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi(Makes 4 Servings)

ingredients.name: salt and ground pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

steps: Preheat broiler to high.
Peel shrimp, rinse, drain well and pat dry.
Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add shrimp and mix to coat well.

title: Cinnamon Pecans
steps: Beat 2 egg whites until foamy.
Add pecan halves; mix until foamy.
Set aside.

title: Daffodilles
steps: Make 8 cuts in each biscuit.
Combine cream cheese, prepared mustard and dill weed together.
Indent center and add 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 13 minutes.

title: Vegetable Crunch

ingredients.name: sharp
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sharp or medium cheese, grated

steps: Mix all together.
Put in greased casserole dish.
Crumble Ritz crackers on top.
Drizzle 1/2 cup margarine on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Scallop Potatoes
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Mess
steps: Cut bacon strips into 1/2-inch pieces. Fry until done and drain off grease. Add tomatoes, tomato paste and 1 cup water. Cook to a thick sauce.
Boil noodles according to directions. Drain.
Pour sauce over noodles. Top individual servings with generous sprinkling of grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Lemon-Paprika Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken breast (for 2 people; skinless or skin on)

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: white or black pepper to taste

steps: Rinse chicken with cold water; pat dry with paper towels. Place skin side down on broiler pan.
Squeeze about 1 teaspoon lemon juice on each piece of chicken.
Sprinkle on lightly the pepper, garlic powder, salt and paprika.
Place broiler pan 6 to 8-inches below broiler element or gas flame.
Broil chicken until crispy.
Turn pieces of chicken over; apply lemon and spices on skin side and broil until done next to bone and surface is crispy.

title: Creamed Cabbage Deluxe
steps: Cook all ingredients together until tender.
Pour off liquid and thicken with cornstarch.
Add 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Pour over vegetables in casserole and serve.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: and tsp. reduced calorie oleo
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. and 2 tsp. reduced calorie oleo

ingredients.name: envelope low calorie lemon gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 (eight 1/2 c. serving size) envelope low calorie lemon gelatin

steps: Combine crumbs and oleo.
Spray 9-inch pie plate with Pam and press crumb mixture over back and sides of plate.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until crisp.
Cool.
Pour milk in medium size bowl, cover and freeze until partially frozen (15 to 20 minutes). Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Set aside.
With electric mixer beat milk until thick and foamy. Gradually beat in dissolved gelatin.
Add 1/2 cup Ricotta cheese to gelatin mix and beat.
Add remaining cheese, beating until smooth. Pour mix into cooled crust.
Cover and refrigerate until set (3 hours).

title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Beat egg.
Beat in remaining ingredients until smooth.
Serve with honey or currant jelly or dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Steak Butter
steps: Cook onion and wine in a small saucepan until the liquid is reduced to 1/4 cup.
Remove from heat and cool.
With beater, cream butter and parsley.
Gradually beat in the wine mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Makes 3/4 cup butter.

title: Tam'S Taco Dip
steps: Mix taco seasoning with beans in rectangular cake pan.
Spread evenly.
Spread sour cream over top.
Spread cheese, olives and onions.
Put as much lettuce as you like.
Top with tomato.
Dip chips and enjoy.
(Good with hot sauce, too!)
Preparation time: 15 minutes.

title: Crab Meat Dip

ingredients.name: mock crab meat in
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. mock crab meat, cut in small pieces

steps: Mix
ingredients together and heat in microwave on High until bubbly, 2 or 3 minutes.
Remove from microwave and stir vigorously until all ingredients are combined.
Sprinkle with Salad Supreme.

title: Make Ahead French Toast

ingredients.name: loaf pepperidge farm
ingredients.raw: 1 loaf Pepperidge Farm or Arnold bread

steps: Mix together eggs, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon.

Using a 13 x 9-inch pan, put some melted margarine in bottom of pan. Sprinkle a bit of the cinnamon and brown sugar mixture, then lay down six slices of bread (dunk in egg and milk mixture) and repeat the layers.
Do three layers of bread, six slices each.
Prepare the night before.
Cook, uncovered, at 350° for one hour.

title: Pear Relish

ingredients.name: bell pepper
