ingredients.raw: 6 large bell peppers (3 green and 3 red)

steps: Put
the pears, onions and peppers through food grinder and mix.
Add
the
remaining ingredients.
Mix well and cook for 1 hour before putting in sterilized jars.

title: Cabbage Soup
steps: Brown meat and drain well.
Add tomato juice and one juice can of water.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer several hours.

title: Chicken Burritos
steps: Boil or fry chicken and dice it up.
Dice onion.
Spread thin layer of chicken, onion, cheese, barbecue sauce and taco sauce on burrito wraps.
Add dash of chili powder.
Place burritos in baking pan and spread cream of chicken soup over burritos.
Sprinkle cheese and chili powder on top.
Bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted thoroughly.

title: Vegetable Rice Salad
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Cool.
Combine rice and vegetables, tossing lightly.
Combine mayo, mustard and garlic dressing.
Pour over rice-vegetable mixture.
Toss lightly. Chill overnight.

title: Hot Taco Dip
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch glass dish, spray with nonstick cooking spray.
Spread softened cream cheese onto dish.
Spoon chili on top of cream cheese.
Spread to cover dish.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese on top.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
Serve with nacho chips.

title: Italian Sausage Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: white kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can white kidney beans, drained

ingredients.name: kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained

ingredients.name: butter lima bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (15 oz.) cans butter lima beans, drained

steps: Cut sausage in bite size pieces and brown in frying pan.
Brown onion in sausage juice.
Add tomato paste and 1 or more cans of water, salt, pepper, a little oregano, 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard and 1 tablespoon brown sugar.
Simmer about 10 minutes.
Add drained beans and browned sausage.
Mix well.
Spoon into casserole or oblong baking dish.
Bake 45 to 60 minutes uncovered at 350°.
This recipe may be prepared the night before and baked the next day.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
steps: Mix together the margarine, peanut butter, sugar and vanilla in a large bowl with wooden spoon.
Refrigerate.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Refrigerate.

title: Zucchini Marmalade
steps: Place zucchini in small amount of water and cook for 6 minutes.
Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple with juice and cook 6 more minutes.
Remove from heat and add the jello.
Stir until jello is dissolved.
Place in jars and freeze.

title: Blueberry Crisp
steps: Put berries in dish.
Sprinkle with lemon rind (optional). Blend ingredients and sprinkle on berries.
Bake in preheated oven at 375° for about 25 minutes.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes. Place in baking dish.
Melt margarine and pour on top of potatoes. Add salt and pepper and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese; stir.
Place in oven and bake for 1 hour.
Halfway through cooking time, add 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and stir.
Add Mozzarella cheese, if desired, 5 minutes before removing from oven.
Great with grilled steaks. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Italian Vegetable Dip

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sour cream or fat-free sour cream

steps: Mix until well blended.
Serve with fresh, raw vegetables or chips.
Makes 2 1/4 cups.

title: Tasty Homestyle Noodles
steps: Mix eggs with water, add flour enough to it looks like pie crust, roll on floured counter, put flour on top of mixture, roll like jelly roll, cut 1 inch strips and let sit for 1/2 hour to dry a little, using a kettle boil your chicken extra with chicken bouillon and add noodles cook until they float to the top and then turn them to simmer and while they are simmering.
Fry up the remainder of the chicken.

title: Stuffed Shrimp(Scampi Ripieni)
steps: Peel and devein shrimp, leaving tail intact.
Butterfly and flatten
shrimp.
Mix
all remaining ingredients together and stuff shrimp.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Apricot-Almond Upside Down Cake

ingredients.name: layer size yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. 1 layer size yellow cake mix

steps: Drain apricots, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Place butter or margarine in a 9x1 1/2-inch round baking pan.
Melt butter in pan in oven while preheating.
Remove pan.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
steps: Spray a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with Pam.
Spread ingredients in layers according to way listed; pie filling first and crushed nuts last.
Do not stir.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Rhubarb Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry jello dissolved in hot water
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. strawberry jello, dissolved in hot water

steps: Cook rhubarb with sugar and water until tender.
While still hot, add strawberry jello and stir, then add pineapple and nuts. Cool and refrigerate.

title: Summer Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: plum tomato
ingredients.raw: 6 ripe plum tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch cubes

ingredients.name: coarsely black olive
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. coarsely chopped pitted black olives

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 3 scallions (with 2-inch of green onion), cut thinly

steps: Combine all ingredients except pasta.
In a large bowl, let rest covered for at least 2 hours to develop flavor.
Toss cooked pasta into sauce and serve at room temperature.

title: Quick Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in cake pan.
In bowl, mix the flour, sugar and milk. Add to melted butter.
Pour peaches into mixture.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
(Other fruits can be used.)

title: Citrus Slush Punch

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: In blender, combine bananas, lemonade concentrate and orange concentrate; blend for 1 minute or until smooth.
(If blender is unavailable, combine ingredients in large mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer.)
Pour into large container (1 gallon size); add pineapple juice and water.
Freeze overnight.
(May be frozen up to 6 months.)

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Dream
steps: Cook sugar, butter, milk, salt and vanilla to a soft ball stage; add marshmallow cream and peanut butter just before removing from stove.
Then beat by hand until thick and creamy. Pour in buttered pan; cool well before cutting into squares.

title: Milk Eggnog
steps: Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Add ice cream.

title: Chocolate Brandy Fondue
steps: Put chocolate chips, water and cream into a sauce warmer. Stir over moderate heat on stove until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in orange liqueur.
Keep warm over candle and dip in angel cake pieces, strawberries, oranges and the like.
Serves 8.

title: Muffin Biscuits
steps: Mix together in a bowl.
Fill greased muffin tins half full. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
Makes 6.

title: Rich Caramel Cake

ingredients.name: or oz pkg german chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 Box 18 1/4 or 18 1/2 oz pkg german chocolate cake mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt caramels and margarine.

Remove from heat, add milk, Mix well. Follow package directions for cake mix; pour 2 cups batter into a 9 x 13 inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake 15 minutes. Spread caramel mixture over cake; spread remaining batter over mixture. Top with pecans.
Return to oven and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
steps: Cut steak in strips.
Brown in small amount oil. Push to one side.
Add onion chunks.
Simmer until onions are done.
Add soy sauce, salt and garlic; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add green peppers.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Pepperoni Bread
steps: Roll dough out into an oblong shape.
Layer pepperoni, American and Provolone cheeses alternately.
Best if cheeses are layed out first, then pepperoni and then cheeses again.
Roll up and seal edges.
Brush with egg white.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Lazy Candied Yams
steps: Pour yams into casserole dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cover with marshmallows and bake until marshmallows melt to a golden brown. Make sure oven is preheated.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt.
Add shortening and sugar; beat at low speed.
Add eggs.
Batter should be dough-like; chill in refrigerator.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Never Fail Crust
steps: Cut Crisco into flour and salt.
Mix together vinegar, water and egg.
Add to flour mixture and mix.
May be stored in refrigerator for several days.
Makes 3 or 4 crusts.

title: Broccoli Bread

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed and but not
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed and drained, but not cooked

steps: Mix all ingredients except the cornbread mix.
Add last.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13 casserole dish.
Bake for 15 to 25 minutes at 400°.

title: Green Beans With Mint

ingredients.name: blue lake green bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans Blue Lake green beans

steps: In medium saucepan, heat green beans and mint flakes to boiling.
Drain; toss with butter, then salt and pepper to taste. Serves 6.

title: West Virginia Nog
steps: Combine sugar, milk, pudding, egg yolk, vanilla and nutmeg until well blended.
Beat egg whites until stiff with sugar.
Fold into egg nog mixtures.
Chill.

title: Nana'S Green Tomato Pie
steps: Slice
tomatoes
into unbaked pie shell.
Mix remaining ingredients;
pour over tomatoes.
Cover with top crust; flute edges and
make
several slits in the top.	Bake at 375° about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Ambrosia Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained (reserve juice)

steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour cooled dressing (amount according to personal preference) over all and stir well. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Simple Stir-Fry
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake chicken in foil.
Salt and pepper to taste, dot with margarine and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut chicken in bite size pieces.
Pour water into skillet.
Heat on medium high.
Add frozen vegetables and sliced chestnuts.
Add wine and soy sauce; gently stir in chicken.
Continue to stir until all food items are well coated.
Cover with lid; cook until all liquid has evaporated.
Stir occasionally.
Serve immediately.

title: Beefy Roni
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Rinse and set aside.
Brown ground beef in skillet.
Drain.
Add Miracle Whip and spaghetti sauce.
Stir in noodles.
Heat until desired temperature.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice

ingredients.name: uncle ben s wild and grain rice
ingredients.raw: 1 box Uncle Ben's wild and long grain rice (6 oz. pkg.)

steps: Melt margarine in dish.
Add rice and mushrooms.
Arrange chicken on top.
Add soup and water.
Sprinkle seasoning from rice on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour covered with foil.
Remove foil after 45 minutes if all liquid is not absorbed.

title: Honey-Glazed Carrots
steps: Cook carrots in boiling water about 10 minutes or until tender.
Drain.
In a skillet, melt margarine and add sugar and honey.
Simmer this for 2 minutes.
Add carrots and cook over low heat, turning until well glazed (about 5 minutes).

title: Caribbean Guacamole Crab Canapes

ingredients.name: avocado mashed and sprinkled with lemon juice
ingredients.raw: 3 ripe avocados, mashed and sprinkled with lemon juice

steps: Combine all ingredients (except spinach leaves).
Chill 2 hours.
Spoon onto spinach leaves.

title: One Pan Pork Chop And Cabbage
steps: Fry pork chops in large pan or electric skillet until browned. Take chops out.
Add finely shredded cabbage to pan and rosemary. Place chops on top of cabbage.
Cover and let cook on medium heat.
Stir cabbage occasionally.
Cook until cabbage is reduced down and fully cooked.
Chops will be tender.

title: Holiday Citrus Quencher
steps: Mix lemon juice, lime juice and sugar together, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Add Tropicana orange juice, chill.
When you are ready to serve add club soda and ice.
Stir.
Garnish glasses with lime slices.

title: Pizza Toast
steps: Spread about 1 tablespoon sauce on toasted bread.
Sprinkle a little garlic salt, then top with slice of cheese.
Ready to eat cold or heat in microwave for 20 seconds.

title: Red Hot Dogs
steps: Slice onions in a large saucepan.
Stir together vinegar, hot sauce, sugar, chili powder and salt.
Add franks and onions; bring to a boil.
Boil 3 minutes.
Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 days before serving.
Makes about 64.

title: Apricot Jello Dessert

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Combine jello powder, crushed pineapple and water in large saucepan.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Combine cream cheese with about 1 cup of mixture; slowly beat with electric beater.
Add to rest of cooked jello mixture.
Let stand in refrigerator until slightly jelled, 1 to 2 hours.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Refrigerate in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 2 hours.

title: Apricot Bars
steps: Beat brown sugar, butter, egg and vanilla until smooth.
Add in nuts and flour.
Pour half the batter in 9-inch square pan. Spread 1/2 the jam.
Pour in rest of batter.
Cover with remaining jam.
Bake at 325° about 45 to 50 minutes.
Let cool.
Cut into squares.

title: My Mom'S Old Fashioned Indian Bread
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Add shortening; mix well. Add water (enough to make a dough).
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Drain well.
Serve with butter.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Mix together cottage
cheese
and Jell-O (powder form), then mix fruit and Cool Whip in.
Refrigerate.

title: Bacon Bombs(Appetizer)
steps: Roll the Wonder Bread with a rolling pin until thin, then cut crust off of bread.
Spread Cheese Whiz on bread, then cut in 3 strips lengthwise.
Roll one water chestnut (possibly 1/2 depending on size) in strip of bread.
Cut bacon in half, then roll bacon strips around bread.
Stick a toothpick in to hold together.
Put cooling rack on top of cookie sheet, place bacon bombs on cooling rack.
Preheat Oven to 375.
Cook Bacon Bombs for approx 20 min. or until bacon looks crispy.

title: Old Fashion Butter Roll
steps: Use 1 package of ready made pie dough.
Let set until room temperature.
Spread both pieces with 1 1/2 sticks butter, using equal amounts of cinnamon, nutmeg and 1 cup sugar.
Roll up dough like a jelly roll.
Lay in oblong baking dish or pan.

title: Cheddar Spinach Quiche

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Drain spinach well on absorbent paper.
Toss cheese with flour. Add spinach, milk, eggs, bacon and seasonings.
Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Garnish with additional bacon if desired.
Yields 6 servings.

title: The Pottery Cornish Game Hen

ingredients.name: cornstarch mixed with water chicken sauce
ingredients.raw: cornstarch, mixed with water to thicken sauce

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. chicken base or 1 (No. 2) can chicken stock

steps: Season hens with salt and pepper.
In saucepan, boil wine until alcohol is vaporized.
Add other ingredients and thicken with cornstarch to desired thickness.
Bake hens 1/2 hour at 400°. Baste hens with sauce to prevent drying out.
Serve hens with sauce.
Serves 2.

title: Broccoli Topped Tuna Bake

ingredients.name: luxury elbow macaroni uncooked
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Luxury elbow macaroni, uncooked (2 cups)

ingredients.name: cheez whiz processed cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz processed cheese spread

ingredients.name: campbell s condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: white tuna in water flaked
ingredients.raw: 2 (6 1/2 oz.) cans white tuna in water, drained, flaked

steps: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.
Drain. Reserve 1/2 cup Cheez Whiz cheese spread.
In large bowl, combine Campbell's soup, milk and remaining process cheese spread.
Stir in macaroni, tuna and pepper.
Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Bake in 375° oven for 25 minutes.
Stir.
Arrange broccoli in spoke fashion on top of macaroni mixture.
Top with reserved process cheese spread.
Bake for 5 minutes or until hot.
Makes 8 servings.

title: 5 Gallons Of Ice Cream
steps: Combine sugar, flour and salt.
Then add condensed milk, beaten eggs and vanilla.
Add skimmed milk just before freezing. Use freezing directions for your freezer.

title: Special Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix German chocolate cake mix as directed on box and bake in 9-inch x 13-inch pan.
Cool completely.
Punch holes in top of cake.
Pour 1 can condensed milk over cake.
Pour 1 can cream of coconut over cake.
Ice with small Cool Whip.
Crush Butterfingers and sprinkle on top.
Refrigerate.

title: Pork Chops And Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.raw: 11 oz. chicken broth (3 cubes to 11 oz. water)

steps: Brown pork chops in hot skillet.
In casserole dish, add rice, pork chops, orange juice and broth.
Cover; bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes, or until the moisture is absorbed.
Uncover; bake 10 minutes more.

title: Ham Loaf Supreme
steps: Mix ham and beef well.
Add cracker crumbs, milk and eggs; mix well.
Make into a loaf.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Zucchini Cake
steps: In a mixing bowl, heat cake mix, eggs, oil, vanilla and cinnamon for 6 to 7 minutes.
Fold in zucchini, raisins and nuts. Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until done.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if you like.

title: Raspberry-Green Tomato Jam

ingredients.name: green tomato and ground
ingredients.raw: green tomatoes, peeled and ground (need 2 c. pulp)

steps: Boil tomato pulp and sugar for 5 minutes.
Add jello.
Put in jar and let set.

title: Georgia'S Tomato Soup
steps: Heat juice and mix in cornstarch, salt and sugar.
Cook chopped onions and pepper in butter 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour into juice.
Bring to a boil and can.
A little hot pepper may be added if desired.

title: Spinach Cream Cheese Sandwich Mix

ingredients.name: dry knorr vegetable soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry Knorr vegetable soup mix or Lipton or Knorr onion soup mix

ingredients.name: olive and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 can ripe olives, drained and chopped (optional)

steps: Squeeze spinach very dry.
Let cream cheese become very soft. Mix all ingredients and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. (Can use lite cream cheese and lite sour cream, but not lite mayonnaise.)
Spread on bread for either 1 or 2 slice sandwiches. Makes 12 to 15 sandwiches.

title: Surprise-Filled Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine flour and baking powder.
Mix well and set aside.
With an electric mixer, cream the butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Beat until smooth.
Add flour mixture and blend thoroughly at low speed.
Dough will be firm.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet, 1-inch apart.
With a small round object, make an indention in the center of each cookie.
Place 1/2 teaspoon of jam into center of ball. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a cool flat surface.

title: Anadama Bread
steps: Mix 2 1/2 cups flour, salt, cornmeal and undissolved yeast; add margarine.
Gradually add water and molasses beating 2 minutes at medium speed on electric mixer.
Add 1/2 cup flour or enough to make a thick batter.
Beat a high speed for 2 minutes.
Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.
Turn out and knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes).
Place in greased bowl; cover and let rise until doubled (1 hour).
Punch down; place in greased pans.
Cover and let rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: No Bake Cherry Cheesecake
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs, margarine and 1/2 cup of the powdered sugar.
Press mixture into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Combine and mix the cream cheese, the other half of the powdered sugar, vanilla, pineapple, marshmallows and Cool Whip.
Pour mixture over crust. Top with the pie filling.
Cool for
3 hours in refrigerator. Delicious!

title: Celery Crunch
steps: Cut up celery.
Cook and drain.
Put celery in buttered baking dish.
Add drained chestnuts.
Mix undiluted celery soup, 1/2 cup milk and juice from chestnuts.
Pour over celery.
Spread cracker crumbs on top and spread melted margarine on top of cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour, Crisco, sugar and salt with a pastry blender.
Mix water, egg and vinegar and pour over flour mixture. Mix together and make a ball.
Chill 30 minutes or up to 3 days in refrigerator.
Also can be frozen until ready to use.
Makes 5 (9-inch) pie crusts.

title: Oatmeal Fudge

ingredients.name: oatmeal
ingredients.raw: 2 c. oatmeal (3 minute oats) or 1 c. oatmeal and 1 c. nuts or coconut

steps: Mix first three ingredients.
Mix and boil for 1 minute. Remove from fire.
Add oleomargarine and peanut butter; dissolve. Add vanilla, oats and nuts; stir well.
Place on wax paper.
Should make 20 or 24 pieces.

title: Hodgepodge Pickles
steps: Put all in large pan with 5 cups sugar and 1 cup vinegar. Stir well and let it come to a boil.
Then thicken with 5 heaping tablespoonfuls flour and 1 cup vinegar.
Mix up before adding to pan.
Stir in; let it come to a boil.
Now put in jars and seal.

title: Rice Krispies Chicken
steps: Line cookie sheet with foil.
Dry chicken pieces and dip into seasoned oleo.
Roll in crumbs until well coated.
Place in pan, skin side up.
Do not crowd it.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not cover or turn pieces while cooking.

title: Cornish Hens With Wild Rice Casserole
steps: Split hens (salt, pepper and paprika).
Brown onion in butter and add hens.
Brown hens and add brandy and simmer until done. Remove hens.
Add cornstarch to thicken and sour cream.
Heat; do not boil.

title: Lime Pickles
steps: Let set overnight.
Boil together 35 minutes.
Add some green food coloring in juice.
Put into jars and seal.

title: Savory Sausage Casserole

ingredients.name: dehydrated chicken noodle soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (2 oz. each) pkg. dehydrated chicken noodle soup

ingredients.name: toasted
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. toasted halved or slivered blanched almonds

steps: Break apart the sausage; brown it in an ungreased skillet, pouring off any excess fat as it accumulates.
Remove from the burner.
Mix together the sausage, rice, soup, onion and celery; place in a 2-quart casserole.
Refrigerate.
When ready to bake, mix soy sauce with water and add this, with the almonds, to the casserole.
Mix all gently.
Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Glazed Carrots
steps: Peel carrots and cut into 3-inch strips.
Place in a large skillet.
Add water and butter.
Cover and cook until tender-crisp, about 5 to 10 minutes, adding more water if necessary.
When carrots are tender, liquid should be nearly gone. Gently stir in the cinnamon, honey and lemon juice.
Simmer for a few minutes.
Add walnuts, if desired and heat for 1 minute longer.

title: Pickled Fish
steps: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Cut fish into small pieces.
Put in very salty water; soak for 48 hours, then drain. Put fish in clear white vinegar.
Pour brine over fish.
Boil 5 minutes and cool.
Store in refrigerator in glass jars.

title: Chicken Easy

ingredients.name: herb seasoned dry bread stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (6-oz) herb seasoned dry bread stuffing mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare stuffing according to package directions.
Wash the chicken, pat dry and pound out to about a 1/2 inch thickness.
Place a slice of cheese on each breast, followed by a scoop of prepared stuffing.
Close each breast over the cheese and stuffing and hold with a toothpick.
Place stuffed breasts in a lightly greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear, then place a second slice of cheese over each stuffed chicken, and bake for 2 more minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Hot Curried Fruits

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine (at room temperature)

steps: Drain all fruits and turn out into 1 1/2-quart casserole and mix together lightly.
Blend together the soft butter, brown sugar, curry, cornstarch and lemon peel.
Sprinkle over fruit mixture.
Let mixture stand for several hours to draw out juices. Bake uncovered about 1 hour at 325°.
Spoon some of the juices over fruit several times during baking.
Serve while hot. Serves 6.

title: Olive Cheese Balls
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients
as for pie crust.
Wrap around olives to form a ball.
Bake 15 minutes at 400°.
Loosen immediately.
May be reheated.

title: Egg-Sausage Casserole
steps: Crumble, brown and drain sausage.
Combine eggs, milk, mustard, and salt and beat.
Stir in bread, cheese and sausage. Pour in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cappuccino Coffee Mix

ingredients.name: ground
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tsp. ground or zested orange peel

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Store in tightly sealed glass jar.

title: Peas Vinaigrette
steps: Put peas in colander.
Pour 2 kettles boiling water over them. Drain; combine with other ingredients.
Refrigerate.
Keeps 2 weeks.
Luncheon favorite!

title: Noodle-Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: angel hair spaghetti
ingredients.raw: 3/4 oz. angel hair spaghetti, broken into 1 1/2 inch pieces

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained

steps: Melt butter in large skillet.
Add spaghetti; cook until golden brown, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
steps: Arrange apple slices around plate. Combine cream cheese, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
Mix well.
Place in middle of plate.

title: 3 Hour Sunday Rolls
steps: Mix the above 6 ingredients together.
Add enough flour to make a thick dough batter.
Let set for 1 hour.
Make into rolls and let set for 1 or more hours to rise.
Grease top of rolls with oleo. Bake at 400° for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Slomgolian

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: small can sliced mushrooms (or use fresh)

steps: Brown ground beef.
Saute onion and bell pepper with meat (also mushrooms if fresh).
Drain excess grease.
Season with garlic salt and black pepper.
Add tomato sauce and mushrooms (drained if canned) to skillet.
Simmer, covered, about 10 minutes.
Add macaroni (slightly undercooked).
Cover and simmer about 5 more minutes.
Add a little water if it gets too dry during the simmering.
This is good leftover.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad

ingredients.name: hot water and orange juice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. hot water and orange juice

steps: Using juice from the mandarin oranges as part of liquid, dissolve gelatin in the hot water.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Chill.
Miniature marshmallows may be added to mixture.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: fryer
ingredients.raw: 1 fryer or pieces of chicken of your choice

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

steps: Place chicken in dish.
Cover with soup (do not dilute).
Pour melted butter over top.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until lightly brown and tender.

title: Gouda Cheese Spread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Return to the shell of baby Gouda.
Serve on bread.

title: Cheezy Broccoli
steps: Combine rice, soup, milk, cheese, salt and pepper.
Microwave on High 2 to 4 minutes until cheese melts and can be blended easily.
Add onion, celery and broccoli and stir.
Divide into 2 lightly greased dishes.
Microwave each 12 to 14 minutes on High.

title: Chocolate Filled Snowballs
steps: Beat butter, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add sifted flour and nuts; blend well.
Chill dough.
Shape dough around Hershey Kisses, being sure all is covered.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly brown.
Cool slightly.
While warm, roll in powdered sugar twice.
Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Spicy Orange Beef Kabobs(Makes 4 Servings)

ingredients.name: beef top sirloin steak
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut 1 inch thick

ingredients.name: red yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 medium red, yellow or green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Cut beef steak into 1-inch pieces.
Alternately thread pieces of beef, onion and bell pepper on each of four 12-inch skewers. Heat steak sauce, orange juice concentrate, brown sugar and crushed red pepper, stirring to blend.
Grill kabobs over medium heat for 9 to 11 minutes, brushing with sauce and turning occasionally.
Serve on rice.

title: Sundae Dessert

ingredients.name: cake baked and pound cake
ingredients.raw: 1 cake, baked and cut into pieces, pound cake or shortcake

ingredients.name: banana and mixed in pudding
ingredients.raw: 4 bananas, sliced and mixed in pudding

steps: In a large punch bowl, layer in this order: 1/2 of cake on bottom, pudding with bananas, cherry pie filling, pineapple and Cool Whip.
Repeat layers, then top with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate.
Enjoy!

title: Appleless Pie
steps: Mix water, sugar and cream of tartar and bring to rolling boil.
Drop in crackers and boil for 1 minute.
Do not stir. Remove from stove and add butter.
Cool and pour into pie shell. Sprinkle cinnamon and strip pie with dough.
Bake 15 minutes at 425°.

title: Christmas Hard Candy

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. red or green food coloring

steps: In a large heavy saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and water. Cook on medium heat until candy thermometer reads 300° (hard-crack stage), stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat.
Stir in oil and food coloring.
Pour onto a greased cookie sheet.
Cool.
Break into pieces.

title: Porcupine Meat Balls
steps: Mix hamburg, rice and egg together, then roll into meat balls. Put tomato soup, gravy and meatballs in kettle.
Cover and cook slowly about 45 minutes or until meatballs are done.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Cake
steps: Mix cream cheese and margarine good.
Add sugar slowly. Add eggs,
one	at a time.
Beat well after each.
Add flavoring. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Macaroni-Cabbage Salad
steps: Cook and drain macaroni.
Combine the next 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Mix remaining ingredients; blend well.
Pour over macaroni.
Mix; toss and chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Sweet And Sour Franks
steps: Mix mustard and jelly.
Place in double boiler.
Diagonally slice franks 1/2-inch thick.
Add to sauce and cook.
Refrigerate or freeze.
When ready to serve, place in chafing dish and heat. Serve with cocktail picks.

title: Pickled Beets
steps: Boil beets, leaving 4-inch tops.
When tender, place in hot jars (can also slice).
Boil water, vinegar and sugar.
Pour over beets.
Seal.

title: Barbecued Lima Beans
steps: Sort and wash beans; cook until tender.
Fry bacon until crispy; take bacon out of pan.
Cook onions and peppers in bacon grease until tender.
Crumble bacon.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour in baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Steak Diane
steps: Combine margarine and Worcestershire sauce in a large nonstick skillet; place over medium heat until hot.
Add mushrooms and onion; saute until tender.
Place steaks between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Spread 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard on one side of each steak.
Move mushroom mixture to one side of skillet. Add steaks, mustard side down.
Cook steaks 3 to 4 minutes over medium heat.
Stir mushroom mixture occasionally.
Spread 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard on top side of each steak; turn and cook 3 to 4 minutes on second side of steak or to desired degree of doneness.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
steps: Cream sugar, oleo and shortening.
Add eggs.
Sift flour and baking powder together and add alternately with milk.
Then add the coconut.
Bake in angel cake pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chocolate Fudge Easter Eggs

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips (fudge or semi-sweet)

steps: Melt butter.
Add marshmallows and chips.
Stir until all ingredients are melted.
Remove from heat and add rice cereal, dates and nuts.

title: Spider Christmas Cookies

ingredients.name: nestle semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) bag Nestle semi-sweet chocolate morsels

steps: Melt chocolate and butterscotch morsels in a double boiler until liquid. Gently fold in noodles and cashews.
Drop by the spoonful onto cookie sheet lined with waxed paper.
Refrigerate until solid.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli
steps: Cook broccoli and drain well.
Melt 1 stick of margarine and the Velveeta and mix with broccoli.
Put in casserole and top with the Ritz crackers (crumbled) and mixed with 1 stick of margarine. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Glazed Almonds
steps: Combine almonds, sugar and butter or margarine in heavy skillet.
Cook over medium heat stirring constantly, until almonds are toasted and sugar is golden brown, about 15 minutes.
Stir in vanilla.
Spread nuts on aluminum foil; sprinkle lightly with salt.
Cool; then break into 2 or 3 nut clusters with forks.

title: Peanut Cluster Candy

ingredients.name: or pkg. spanish peanut
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can or pkg. salted Spanish peanuts

steps: Combine morsels in a 2-quart microwave casserole dish.
Cook at a Medium level for 5 to 6 minutes, until melted.
Stir in peanuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto sheets of waxed paper.
Allow ample time to cool, usually overnight.

title: Tea Room Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Fold in Cool Whip.
Put 1/4 of the mixture in each of the pie shells.
Drizzle with caramel sauce.
Put remainder of mixture into pie shells.
Cover and freeze until ready to serve. Drizzle with caramel sauce and top with chopped nuts.
Makes 2 pies.

title: Garlic Cheese Roll

ingredients.name: kraft old english cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1 jar Kraft Old English cheese spread

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 oz. pkg. chopped pecans or pecan chips

steps: Soften cream cheese and mix all 3 cheeses together well. Shape into a ball or 2 logs.
Roll in crushed pecans.
Wrap in waxed paper to shape and refrigerate overnight.

title: 6-Cup Salad("Quik-N-Ez")
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well.
Chill as long as possible or overnight.
Serves 6.

title: Bread Machine Oatmeal Bread
steps: In bread machine pan, place ingredients in order given. Select "white bread" setting.
Bake according to bread machine directions.
Makes 1 large loaf (16 slices).

title: Speedy Chili
steps: Combine beef, onion and garlic in Dutch oven; cook until beef is browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain off drippings.
Add remaining ingredients; cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 minuets, stirring occasionally.
Yields about 4 cups.

title: Banana Pudding Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 layer size) pkg. yellow cake mix

ingredients.name: banana
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. banana or vanilla instant pudding

steps: Slice bananas into large mixing bowl.
Beat until well mashed.
Add remaining ingredients.
Blend.
Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into 10-inch well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.
Cool in pan at least 15 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Finish cooling on rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.
(May be baked in 9 x 13-inch pan for 50 to 55 minutes.)

title: Oven Baked Chicken Or Pork Chops
steps: Dip meat in 1 stick of melted butter and salt and pepper. Roll meat in dry onion soup mix.
Cover disk with foil.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Corned Beef Dip
steps: Blend all ingredients with mixer and refrigerate overnight. Hollow out bread and fill with mixture.
Use bread pieces for dippers.

title: Rita'S Refrigerated Rolls
steps: Place first 4 ingredients in mixing bowl; mix and let dissolve and cool.
Dissolve dry yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water and add to first mixture after it has cooled.
Stir in egg and flour.
(No kneading.)
Cover with a cloth or Saran Wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Instant Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside.
Cut in Crisco shortening to flour, soda and sugar.
Add buttermilk and yeast; mix well.
Place desired amount of dough on floured pastry sheet. Roll out and cut.
Let warm to room temperature before baking in a 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
Store dough in refrigerator and use as needed.
Keeps for several weeks.
May be taken from refrigerator and placed immediately in oven without being allowed to rise.

title: Hamburger And Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: mccormick brown gravy mix
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. McCormick brown gravy mix or substitute

steps: Fry 2 pounds of hamburger with chopped onions, salt and pepper to taste. Drain off grease. Mix 3 cups of cold water and 3 packages of gravy mix in a container, and stir well.
Add the water and gravy mix to the hamburger, cover, and bring to a low boil.
Turn down to simmer, and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring frequently.
If gravy is too thick, add water.
While this is cooking, make your mashed potatoes.

Dish the hamburger and gravy together, and the mashed potatoes separately. Let everyone serve themselves.	Place on table and let everyone serve themselves individual helpings of potatoes, and top with hamburger and gravy mix.

title: Cheese-Burger Casserole
steps: In skillet, brown ground beef with onions and green pepper. Drain fat.
Add tomato sauce, catsup and pepper; heat.
Alternate meat mixture and cheese in an ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Arrange biscuits around edge of casserole.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera Salad

ingredients.name: tricolor rotini and
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (5 1/2 oz.) tricolor rotini, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: parsley dill weed seasoned salt in dressing
ingredients.raw: parsley, dill weed, seasoned salt in dressing

steps: Mix pasta and vegetables in large bowl.
In separate bowl, mix dressing, parsley, dill and seasoned salt to taste.
Pour over vegetables and mix well.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.
Serves 8.

title: Peppermint Candy

ingredients.name: toll house white chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. Toll house white chocolate morsels

steps: Crush mint and melt white chocolate with oil.
Dip out with spoon on wax paper.
Refrigerate.
Melt almond bark and dip mints. Let cool.

title: Baked Pork Chops And Sour Cream
steps: Brown chops in flour, salt and pepper.
Then place chops in a shallow baking dish.
Mix water, soup, ginger, rosemary and onion rings.
Pour over chops; cover with foil and bake for 1 hour or more at 350° until done.
Remove chops and mix gravy with sour cream.

title: Herbed Pea Salad

ingredients.name: french dressing with herb and spice
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. French dressing with herbs and spices

steps: Cook peas; drain.
Combine French dressing with dill weed. Pour over peas and celery.
Chill several hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.
Serve in lettuce.
Top with hard egg slice.

title: Country Fried Corn
steps: Cut the corn from the cob and add the milk, salt and pepper. Melt the butter in a large skillet and add the corn mixture and thyme.
Cook, stirring, until tender.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Teatime Tassies
steps: Cream the cream cheese and butter together.
Add flour; blend to make a smooth dough.
Roll dough into 24 balls the size of walnuts; press each in a muffin cup.
Place in refrigerator; chill for 1 hour.

title: Traditional Pumpkin Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In large bowl, combine filling ingredients, mixing well.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake 15 minutes at 425°.
Reduce oven temperature to 350° and continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool pie before cutting.
Garnish with whipped topping and nuts, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Raspberry Angel Dessert
steps: Slice cake in 3 layers.
Prepare filling by mixing sugar, flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in saucepan.
Slowly add milk; mix well.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture is thick and bubbly.
Cook 2 minutes more.
Stir some of the hot mixture into egg yolks; return to hot mixture.
Bring just to boiling, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; add vanilla.
Cool.
Fold whipped cream into pudding.
Reassemble cake, spreading filling between layers and on top.
Garnish with raspberries and, if desired, fresh mint leaves.

title: Shower Punch
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; mix Kool-Aid with water and sugar.
Stir well.
Add pineapple juice and Jell-O.
Refrigerate until ready to serve, then mix in 7-Up and sherbet just before serving.
Yield: 35 servings.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole

ingredients.name: or yellow squash and
ingredients.raw: 4 or 5 medium yellow squash, peeled and sliced

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook squash and onion in water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Mix together soup and sour cream.
Fold in shredded carrot, squash and onion.
Melt margarine in medium saucepan.
Stir in stuffing mix. Spread half of stuffing in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour vegetable mixture over stuffing and top with other half of stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let stand about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Neiman-Marcus White Meat Of Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: white meat of chicken in bite size dice
ingredients.raw: 3 c. white meat of chicken, cut in bite size dice

steps: Mix mayonnaise and vinegar. Combine with remaining ingredients.
Spread on choice of bread or garnish with almonds if serving as a stand alone salad.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: One Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix together sugar, salt, flour and spice.
Stir in eggs and beat well.
Add pumpkin; stir in milk and vanilla.
Bake at 450° for 20 minutes, then 350° for 25 minutes more.

title: Cheese And Onion Potatoes
steps: In skillet, melt butter; add potatoes, which have been sliced 1/4-inch thick.
Add onion and pepper and toss to coat.
Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Uncover; cook until potatoes are browned, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Top with cheese; cover and remove from heat.
Let set for several minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley before serving. Serves 4.

title: Lorraine'S Stay Crisp Dills

ingredients.name: hot pepper
ingredients.raw: hot peppers to taste (yellow Hungarian work best)

steps: Pack cucumbers, dill, garlic and pepper in gallon jar.
Heat brine; pour over cucumbers.
Cover and place in refrigerator. Ready to eat in 1 week.
Will stay crisp indefinitely.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
steps: Crush cookies; mix with melted butter.
Blender works best. Spread evenly in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, reserving 1/3 cup crumbs.
Spread ice cream on crust.
Place in freezer until firm. Spread fudge topping over top of ice cream.
Sprinkle nuts on top, then sprinkle remaining cookie crumbs over topping.
Cover with foil; keep in freezer.
Cut into squares to serve.
Can be topped with caramel topping.

title: Lumpia

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef or other meat as desired

steps: Brown beef in skillet.
Drain excess fat.
Stir all veggies into skillet with drained meat.
Season with soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 3 minutes.

title: Pita Bread
steps: Sprinkle yeast and sugar in water; stir to dissolve.
Set aside to proof.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl; make a well and stir in yeast mixture.
Knead dough until it is smooth.
Dough will be sticky at first.
Use olive oil on hands to facilitate kneading.
A few drops at a time will surface.
Knead dough at least 10 minutes, until it is no longer sticky.
Grease top of dough; turn dough to coat surface.
Cover bowl; set aside 1 hour to rise.

title: Torn Enchiladas

ingredients.name: old el paso enchilada sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 can Old El Paso enchilada sauce (can should be slightly larger than the soup cans)

ingredients.name: old el paso taco seasoning mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Old El Paso taco seasoning mix

steps: Brown ground beef and add the taco seasoning.
At this point, do not add any water.
Mix in the cans of soup and the enchilada sauce.
You will now need to add enough water to make it soupy. Spoon sauce onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish (just enough to cover the bottom).

title: Snow Pie
steps: Cook the mixture in double boiler until thick and creamy. After it has slightly cooled, add stiff egg whites.
Beat vigorously.
Place in baked pie shell.
Top with whip cream.

title: Delicious Baked Beans

ingredients.name: bacon and fried
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bacon, cut into small pieces and fried

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and
ingredients.raw: 4 (4 oz.) cans mushroom stems and pieces

steps: Fry bacon.
Add peppers and onions; saute.
Add all ingredients to beans.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
This makes a large quantity.
Can be made in smaller amounts.

title: Christmas Cookies

ingredients.name: rolled oats in c. boiling water
ingredients.raw: 1 c. rolled oats in 2 c. boiling water

ingredients.name: yeast in c. lukewarm water
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. yeast in 1/3 c. lukewarm water

steps: Cook oats and add other ingredients.
Raise and put in pans as usual.
Bake at 325° in oven 4-inches from bottom for 50 minutes. Add raisins, dried fruits or herbs, if wanted.

title: Mom'S Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: old english and roka blue cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 jar old english and Roka Blue cheese

steps: Mix everything together and refrigerate till ready to serve. Serve with various crackers.
(My mom usually rolls it into a ball and rolls ground nuts around it. If you do this refrigerate it for a while first so it will be easier to work with)

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix all dry ingredients together and combine with the pumpkin mixture.
Add 1/2 cup coconut and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cherry Squares
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Gradually add flour.
Spread 3/4 of dough on a large cookie sheet.
Spread filling over dough.
Cover with remaining dough.
Marbleize top.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Coq Au Vin
steps: Place chicken in covered casserole.
Mix liquids and spices and pour over chicken. Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Serves 4.

title: Jello Jigglers
steps: Mix boiling water and Jell-O and let cool until room temperature.
Then add milk and pudding.
Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate.
Cut into squares.

title: Hamburger Soup
steps: Cook ground beef until brown.
Put ground beef, corn, kidney beans, carrots, tomato sauce and onion in baking dish.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° until potatoes are soft.

title: Round Salmon Loaf(Microwave)

ingredients.name: red salmon bone and skin removed if necessary
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (1 lb. each) red salmon, bone and skin removed, if necessary

steps: Beat egg slightly and mix with milk, butter, bread cubes, salt and salmon, blending well.
Pack firmly in greased 9-inch pie plate.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High for 9 to 11 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 5 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Serve with Dill Butter.

title: Potato Soup

ingredients.name: beef broth dissolved in c. water
ingredients.raw: 2 beef broth cubes, dissolved in 5 c. water

ingredients.name: pepper salt bay leaf allspice and nutmeg
ingredients.raw: pepper, salt, bay leaf, allspice and nutmeg

steps: Saute vegetables until transparent (not brown!).
Pour prepared beef broth over vegetables.
Add 1 bay leaf, 2 to 3 grains allspice and salt and pepper to taste.
Cook on medium heat until tender (about 0.5 hour).
Drain, setting liquid aside. (Remove bay leaf and allspice.)
Puree vegetables and combine with liquid until it has consistency of cream (do not need to use all; usually there is more liquid than needed).
If you want to freeze, do it now.

title: Italian Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: beef tip steak
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. beef round tip steaks, cut 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick

steps: Cut beef steaks crosswise into 1-inch wide strips.
Cut each strip crosswise in half.
Cook and stir garlic in oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat for 1 minute.
Add beef strips (1/2 at a time). Stir-fry 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Keep warm.
Add zucchini and stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Return beef to skillet with tomato halves and dressing.
Heat through.
Serve over hot pasta.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Ribs
steps: Broil ribs on both sides to remove excess fat.
Saute onion in butter.
Place ribs and onions in crock-pot.
Mix all other ingredients together and glaze ribs.
Cook at 200° for 8 hours.

title: Peach Delight
steps: Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar together. Spread over graham cracker crust.
Top with peaches and pour chilled glaze on top.

title: Flannel Cakes(Oatmeal Pancakes)
steps: Combine buttermilk and oats and let stand 15 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients to oat mixture.
Grill as for pancakes.

title: Glazed Ham Hors D'Oeuvres

ingredients.name: melba white bread toasted
ingredients.raw: 8 Melba thin sliced white bread, toasted

steps: Divide ham evenly among toast slices.
Put on cake rack with jelly-roll pan underneath.
Spoon about 2 tablespoons glaze over each sandwich (glaze that runs into pan can be spooned up, melted and reused).
Chill until glaze is set, then, with kitchen shears dipped in water, cut each sandwich in 8 triangles.
Make 64 triangles, about 12 calories each.

title: Barbecue Beef Sauce
steps: Mix well.
Pour over roast.
Cook all day in crock-pot until beef is tender.
Slice or pull apart with fork for sandwiches.

title: Onion Bake
steps: Place the following in tinfoil: whole onions, peeled and sliced and potatoes in wedges.
Cover with bacon slices; close tinfoil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Uncover foil and melt sliced cheese on top.

title: Boerenkool

ingredients.name: potato and up
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. (about 4 medium) potatoes, peeled and cut up

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped kale or 4 c. finely shredded cabbage

ingredients.name: polish sausage bite size
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Polish sausage, cut into bite size pieces

steps: In Dutch oven or large kettle, bring to boil the potatoes, cabbage, water and salt to taste.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until tender.
Drain off water.
Add milk, butter, sausage and pepper to taste.
Cover and simmer gently about 15 minutes or until sausage is heated through.
Spoon potatoes and cabbage in center of serving dish.
Serve with mustard.

title: Raw Eggs On Toast
steps: On a slice of pound cake, put a scoop of whipped cream.
In center of whipped cream, put peach half.

title: Garlic Herb Spread

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut into chunks

steps: In large food processor with chopping blade process parsley, thyme, basil, tarragon and garlic until finely chopped.
Add cream cheese, butter, Worcestershire and vinegar; process until well mixed and creamy.
Line a 1 1/4-quart plastic container or shallow bowl with plastic wrap. Spread herb cheese into container; refrigerate.
To serve, uncover container and invert cheese on to serving board or plate, remove container and plastic wrap. With small spatula or knife smooth surface. Garnish with fresh herbs.

title: Fish Fry Batter
steps: Mix well.
Let stand in refrigerator 45 minutes.
Dip and fry fish.

title: Chili Rellenos

ingredients.name: jack cheese x
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Jack cheese, cut into 1/2 x 1/2-inch strips

steps: Drain canned chilies.
Stuff with cheese.
Roll each chili in flour to completely coat.
Shake off excess.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
steps: Top each pork chop with 1 pat of butter, Worcestershire sauce and barbecue sauce.
Wrap individually in foil and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Cocoa Mix

ingredients.name: cremora
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. Cremora (if desired for richer mix)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Store in covered container. Place 4 tablespoons of mix in cup and fill with boiling water. Add whipped cream or marshmallows for extra treat.

title: Dump Cake
steps: Spray 9 X 13 inch pan.
Mix pineapple, and cherry pie filling in the bottom of a 9 X 13 inch pan.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit.
Then slice sticks of butter (place over cake mix).
Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until golden brown.
Prep time - 3 minutes. Cool time - 20 minutes.
Serves 16 to 20.
Good and so easy.
Top with whipped cream if desired when serving.

title: Sweet Chocolate Sensation

ingredients.name: chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chocolate cake mix (with pudding in the mix)

steps: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Using mixer, blend all ingredients 30 seconds on low speed; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into prepared pan; bake at 350° for approximately 35 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan and springs back when touched lightly in center.
Cool cake on wire rack and frost as desired; store in refrigerator.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
steps: Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail, 1 cup of coconut and eggs in a large bowl.
Blend; then beat on medium for 2 minutes.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Savory Peas And Rice(For Microwave)

ingredients.name: regular rice
ingredients.raw: 1 c. regular rice (Uncle Ben's does best)

steps: Place butter in a 2-quart casserole.
Cover and microwave on High for 1 minute.
Add onion; cover and microwave on High for 3 minutes.
Add rice, chicken broth, salt and pepper.
Cover and microwave on High for 30 minutes.
Stir in peas and mushrooms; cover and microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Chili

ingredients.name: pinto bean
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pinto beans or 3 cans red beans

steps: Brown hamburger and onions; drain.
Add tomatoes, chili powder, garlic and salt to hamburger.
Add beans and simmer.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: nut divided in half
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped nuts (pecans), divided in half

steps: Mix together to form a ball.
Save half of pecans to roll finished ball in. (This tastes better if made a day ahead.)

title: Low-Fat Bran Muffins
steps: Heat to 350°.
Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Mix cereal, milk and sugar in another bowl; let stand 5 minutes.
Stir in egg and applesauce.
Add to flour mixture; stir just until moistened.
(Batter will be lumpy.) Spoon batter into muffin pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, filling each cup 2/3 full.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm.
Makes 12.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits
steps: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese.
Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cooked sheet.
Bake at 475° for 10 minutes.
Mix melted margarine and garlic powder and brush over warm biscuits.

title: No Cook Pickles
steps: Pack first 3 ingredients into glass jars.
Mix together sugar, vinegar, salt and celery seed.
Pour over vegetables.
Cover tightly.
Store in refrigerator. Ready to eat after 24 hours.

title: Rhubarb-Orange Slice Jam

ingredients.name: candy orange up
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. candy orange slices, cut up

steps: Cover rhubarb with sugar and let stand 1 hour.
Cook until thick and tender.
Add candy pieces.
Cook until thick.
Pour into sterilized jars.
Adjust rings and lids according to manufacturer's directions and process in water bath 15 minutes.

title: Biscuit Muffins
steps: Mix all together and spoon into muffin pans which have been sprayed.
Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

title: Chicken Squares

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken (3 1/2 to 4 c., cooked and diced)

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken soup (save some for gravy if you like)

steps: Cook chicken (save broth) and rice.
Soak bread in broth.
Add chicken, rice, celery, salt, pimento and soup.
Mix well.
Stir in eggs.
Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until firm.
Cut in squares and serve with chicken or mushroom soup on top.
(The mixture will seem runny but it firms up when baked.)
Easy recipe and delicious!

title: Cinnamon Snaps
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat butter and 3/4 cup sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg and extract.
Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Gradually add to butter mixture, mixing well.
Combine cinnamon and remaining 3 tablespoons sugar in small bowl.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar/cinnamon mixture.
Place 2 inches apart on lightly buttered cookie sheet. Bake 11 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown.
Let stand on cookie sheet.
Transfer to wire cooling racks.
Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Spice Tea Mix
steps: Mix well and seal in jar.
Use 2 heaping teaspoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Special K Cookies
steps: Stir sugar and syrup together. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter and mix well.
Add vanilla to cereal. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Makes 6 dozen.

title: Strawberry Meringues
steps: Beat the egg whites until frothy.
Add the sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating until very stiff.
Divide mixture into 6 equal portions; shape into nests on heavy paper or cookie sheet.
Bake for about 1 hour at 250°.
When done, place sheet on damp cloth and lift off nest.
Let cool.
Fill with ice cream and strawberries.

title: Recipe For Happiness
steps: Mix those thoroughly and add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy for others.
Flavor with little gifts of love and kindly service. Fold in four cups of prayer and faith to lighten all other ingredients and raise the texture to great heights of character and Christian living.
After pouring all this into your daily life, bake well with the heat of human kindness.
Serve with a smile at any time and it will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

title: Play Dough

ingredients.name: food coloring
ingredients.raw: food coloring or 1 pkg. Kool Aid

steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Cook over medium heat until it forms a ball.
Pour out and knead a few minutes to increase smoothness.
Keep in plastic bag or tightly covered container.

title: Surprise Sandwich Loaf

ingredients.name: mild cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 slices mild cheese (Jarlsberg or Monterey Jack)

steps: Slice bread into 6 even slices, but not all the way through. Butter bread slices, if desired.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Spread ham slices with mustard, cut in half.
Rinse and slice tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cut cheese slices in half.
Place 1/2 slice ham, 1 tomato slice and 1 cheese slice between every slice of bread.
Sprinkle with little Parmesan cheese.
Press loaf together lightly.
Wrap in foil.
Place on oven rack.
Cook about 10 minutes or until cheese starts melting and bread is hot.
Bread should be crispy on the outside.

title: Chicken-Rice Bake

ingredients.name: pea and carrot thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) bag frozen peas and carrots, thawed

steps: In a bowl, stir together mushroom soup, milk, dry onion soup and undrained can of mushrooms.
Reserve 1/2 cup of soup mixture and set aside. Stir uncooked rice and vegetables into remaining soup mixture.
Place rice mixture into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange chicken pieces atop.
Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken.
Sprinkle paprika on top. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375° until rice is tender, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Rice Pilaf
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add rice.
Braise well until butter starts to bubble.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in 4 cups water. Mix together with rice in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken or cream of celery (if desired)

steps: Debone and cut up chicken into chunks.
Cook spaghetti.
Add soup and cheese. Cut into chunks. Season with garlic salt, salt and pepper to taste.
Heat in a 350° oven until cheese is melted and heated well.

title: Curried Fruit Casserole

ingredients.name: each pear pineapple and apricot
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can each: pears, pineapple and apricots

steps: Drain fruit well.
Place in buttered casserole (6 1/2-cup or larger).
Dab with butter.
Sift over fruit 1 cup of sugar with 1 scant tablespoon of curry.
Let set 24 hours in refrigerator. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve at once.
Leftovers are good cold.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Bring cocoa, sugar, milk and butter to a boil on medium heat. When it begins to boil, cook exactly two minutes.
Then add the vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal.
Stir quickly and place on wax paper with large spoon.

title: Cranberry Sauce
steps: Cook cranberries, sugar and water until done.
While hot, add rest of ingredients, stirring now and then until cool.
Let set overnight.
Real good.

title: Super Cheese Soup
steps: Cook carrots and celery in boiling water until tender; do not drain.
Cook onion in margarine until just tender.
Stir in flour. Gradually add milk.
Cook and stir until thick.
Add broth, cheese and vegetables.
Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sausage Roll
steps: Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients. Roll into small balls. Place on baking sheet.
Bake for about 2 minutes.
Makes about 75 to 100 meat balls.

title: Lo-Cal Orange Salad

ingredients.name: water mandarin orange and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. water packed Mandarin oranges, chopped and drained

ingredients.name: plain yogurt whipped with tsp. vanilla and pkg. sweet n low
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. plain yogurt, whipped with 1 tsp. vanilla and 2 pkg. Sweet 'N Low

steps: Mix cottage cheese, pineapple and oranges.
Sprinkle diet Jell-O over this; stir well.
Stir in pecans, then stir in the whipped yogurt mixture.
Chill.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.name: green onion with top
ingredients.raw: 3 green onions, sliced thin with top

steps: In blender or food processor, whip cottage cheese with lemon juice.
In large skillet, melt margarine.
Add mushrooms and onion mixture.
Stir in cottage cheese and cook about 5 minutes.
Do not boil.
Stuff tomato shells and bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Camembert Affair

ingredients.name: wheel camembert cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 1/2 oz. wheel Camembert cheese (at room temperature)

steps: Preheat oven to 325°. Place almonds in the empty tin that the cheese was packaged in and bake for 5 minutes.
Add butter to tin, then add Camembert. Bake another 5 minutes (10 minutes for very spreadable cheese.)
Serve on crackers.

title: Fried Venison

ingredients.name: venison steak
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. venison steaks or tenderloin (1/2-inch thick)*

steps: Mix the eggs and milk together in a shallow dish.
When blended, add the steaks to the mixture.
Cover; place in the fridge for 2 to 3 hours, turning over steaks occasionally.
Add salt and pepper to the flour to taste.
Remove steaks from the milk and egg mixture.
Roll in the flour; cook in oil over medium-high heat.
Turn only once when the first side is brown. When done, dry meat on paper towels, while being careful not to knock off any of the breading.

title: Quick Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Mix well the hash browns, 1 cup flakes, sour cream, onion and mushroom soup.
Place in greased baking dish.
Top with 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes, then 1/2 cup melted butter poured over, then 1/2 to 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Icing For Brownies
steps: Mix together and boil 30 seconds to melt chocolate chips.
Add nuts.

title: Potato And Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Slice potatoes thin and onions also.
Layer potatoes, onions and cheese.
Pour celery soup over all three ingredients.
Salt and pepper according to taste.
Repeat.
Each time when half of soup is used, fill can with water, stir and use the same way until finished.

title: Pineapple-Marshmallow Puffs
steps: Fold marshmallows and pineapple together until well mixed. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Fold whipped cream and nuts into marshmallows.
Cover and chill several hours.

title: Caramel Chews
steps: Melt caramels in double boiler.
Add cream when melting.
Add remaining ingredients and form into small balls (boulder marble size).
Put on greased cookie sheet.
Freeze well.

title: Diet Lovers Frosting
steps: In large bowl, with electric mixer, beat all ingredients together until creamy, and all lumps are gone.
Frosting is now ready to spread over cake.
Will frost 9 x 13-inch cake or two 8-inch layer cakes.
Best on chocolate cake.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cream, garlic powder, and pepper and simmer for 10 - 12 minutes or until thick.
At the same time, bring 4 - 6 quarts of water to a boil and add the pasta.

title: Creamy Icing
steps: Whip all together until creamy.
Will ice:
1 (13 x 9-inch) cake, 2 round cakes or 24 cupcakes.

title: Homemade Pizza Dough
steps: Put yeast, warm water and sugar in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, add the flour, salt/yeast mixture and warm water.
Mix together, then on a floured surface, knead for a few minutes.
Put dough into a well-greased bowl.
Cover with wax paper.
Let rise for 1 hour, then spread dough onto a well-greased pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Let rise another 1/2 hour.
Bake at 350° or until crust is brown on bottom.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Boil chicken and strip off bone.
Saute onion in 2 tablespoons butter and mix with chicken.
Take 3/4 cup of chicken broth, put in a bowl and add cream of mushroom, cream of chicken soup and Ro-Tel and blend them together.
Take 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Put chicken in dish.
Sprinkle layer of chips, layer of cheese mixed together, layer of chips, then pour soup and Ro-Tel mixture on top and layer with rest of cheeses. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Squash And Apple Bake
steps: Cut apples into 1/2 inch slices.
Cut each squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds.
Peel squash and cut into 1/2 inch slices.
Arrange in a lightly greased 13 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish and top with apples.
Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well. Spoon over apple slices.
Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until squash is tender.

title: Creamy Pesto And Ravioli
steps: Put first 4 ingredients in blender.
Blend slowly to paste consistency.
Add cheese when smooth.
Add olive oil in steady stream with blender running.
Add cream and blend.
Pour over ravioli.
Garnish with parsley.
Also good on tortellini.
Serves 4.

title: Spiced Wassail
steps: Bring to a bubble.
Do not boil.
Strain and put in container to use later.
Keep in refrigerator.
Heat when ready to serve.

title: Chicken Tacos
steps: In a large Dutch oven, put chicken in water and boil until tender.
Cool.
While cooking chicken, cut lettuce and tomatoes up in small cubes and shred cheese.
When chicken is cooled, tear from bone and cut up into small pieces.
Oil a large skillet, put chicken in with one cup water.
Add taco sauce and seasoning into chicken.
Let simmer for 20 minutes.
Ready to serve.

title: Yummy Hot Cider

ingredients.name: apple cider
ingredients.raw: 1/2 gal. apple cider or apple juice

steps: Tie spices in cheesecloth or tea strainer and place in slow cooker.
Add apple cider (or juice) and sugar, stirring well. Cover.
Simmer on low 1 hour.
Remove spices and stir in orange juice and lemon juice.
Continue heating 1 more hour.
Serve cider from cooker set on low.
Yield: 10 to 11 (1 cup) servings.

title: Lime-Pineapple Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale.
Add 1 bottle ginger ale for each quart of punch.

title: Mrs. Lynn'S Fudge Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients in order given as quickly as possible.
Do not beat.
Bake in a well-greased 9 1/2 x 13 1/2-inch pan in 400° oven for 12 minutes.
Frost while warm with powdered sugar icing or chocolate frosting.
Cut into squares and enjoy.

title: Water Chestnuts-Bacon
steps: Marinate water chestnuts in soy sauce 1 hour.
Cut chestnuts in half.
Roll in white sugar.
Cut bacon in thirds, wrap chestnuts in bacon, anchor with toothpick.

title: Pina Colada Sherbet

ingredients.name: or oz. can cream of coconut
ingredients.raw: 15 or 16 oz. can cream of coconut

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 15 oz. can crushed pineapple, with juice

steps: In blender, mix coconut, undrained pineapple, orange juice and rum. Blend until nearly smooth. Pour in 9 x 5 x 3-inch dish or 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover and freeze until firm. Take out and break into pieces. Put half at a time in blender.
Process until fluffy. Put in container and freeze until firm. Makes 5 cups.

title: Corned Beef In Foil
steps: Soak corned beef in water to cover for 1/2 hour or longer if deeply corned.
Place a large sheet of heavy-duty foil on a shallow pan.
Remove corned beef from water and pat dry to remove any salt on surface.
Place in center of foil and pour over it 1/4 cup fresh water.
Sprinkle with the spice and arrange orange slices and vegetables over and around the meat.
Bring long ends of foil up over meat and seal with a tight double fold.
Seal other ends, turning them up so liquid can not run out.
Bake in a 300° oven for 4 hours.
Remember, always slice meat across the grain.

title: Simply Elegant Steak And Rice

ingredients.name: onion in and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 2 large onions, cut in 1/2-inch slices and separated into rings

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained (reserve liquid)

steps: Cut steak or venison into thin strips.
Brown meat in a large skillet in oil, using high heat.
Add onions and saute until tender and crisp.
Blend in soup and liquid from mushrooms.
Add garlic salt and pour over steak.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until steak is tender or cover and bake at 350° until tender.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Squares(Nut Goodies)

ingredients.name: regular cooking vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. regular cooking vanilla pudding mix

steps: Melt chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and peanut butter in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat.
Spread 1/2 of mixture in buttered 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan.
Refrigerate about 1 hour until firm. Stir peanuts into remaining chocolate and set aside.
When refrigerated chocolate is firm, combine butter, milk and pudding mix in 4-quart pan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 minute.
Stir in powdered sugar and maple flavoring.
Spread over firm chocolate.
Spread with remaining chocolate.
Refrigerate. Cut into small squares

title: Butter Dips
steps: Heat oven to 450°. In a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan, melt butter in oven. Remove when melted. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl. Add milk. Stir until dough forms, about 30 strokes. Turn dough onto floured cloth covered board.

Roll or pat out to 8 x 8-inch square. Cut in half with floured knife, then each half into ninths. Dip each strip in melted butter on both sides. Slide each piece into place. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 18.

title: Beans And Hungry Jacks
steps: Brown the ground beef; drain grease.
Saute the onion slightly and add the salt, pork and beans, barbecue sauce and brown sugar. Heat until bubbly.
Place in a 2-quart casserole.
Cut the biscuits in half (moon shape) and place cut side down over mixture.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Bake 25 minutes or until biscuits are browned at 375°.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mandarin Cake

ingredients.name: mandarin orange with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can (11 oz.) mandarin oranges with juice

steps: Mix cake mix, oranges, juice, eggs and oil by electric mixer until oranges are broken up and batter is fluffy (about 3 minutes). Divide among 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes and cool.

title: Stay Up All Night Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add sugar, vanilla and salt.
By hand mix in chocolate chips and black walnuts as desired.
Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.
Turn off oven and put cookies in for 6 hours or overnight.

title: Short'Nen Bread
steps: Cream eggs and butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Grease and flour a 9-inch loaf pan.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 350° approximately 1 hour.

title: Chili Con Cornbread

ingredients.name: chili
ingredients.raw: 2 (15 oz. each) cans chili or 4 c. homemade chili

ingredients.name: any variety martha white corn bread mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. any variety Martha White corn bread mix

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Pour chili into lightly greased, 8-inch square baking pan.
Prepare corn bread batter according to package directions.
Stir in cheese.
Pour over chili.
Bake 30 to 35 minute.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert

ingredients.name: and carton cool whip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) and 1 (8 oz.) carton Cool Whip

steps: Combine Oreo crumbs and oleo, reserving about 1/2 cup of crumbs for topping.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pat down to make a crust.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Mary'S Sweet Potatoes
steps: Peel, cook and slice sweet potatoes into 1-inch slices.
Bring sugar, nectar, butter, lemon peel, cinnamon and nutmeg to a boil. Boil gently for 2 minutes.
Arrange potatoes in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Pour sauce over potatoes.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until potatoes are heated through and sauce is bubbly.
They should be turned occasionally.

title: Blueberry Sauce

ingredients.name: arrowroot powder
ingredients.raw: 2 to 4 Tbsp. arrowroot powder or cornstarch

steps: Heat
juice and arrowroot powder until thickened.
Stir in blueberries and serve over toast or waffles.

title: Egg Bake

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. cubed ham or 1 lb. bacon (small pieces) or 1 lb. sausage (no fat)

steps: Cube bread and spread over 9 x 13-inch glass dish or pan. Blend milk, eggs and mustard and pour over bread.
Cube cheese and sprinkle over everything and add desired meat choice to top.
Can leave sit in refrigerator overnight.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: German Potato Salad(For Big Group)
steps: Brown bacon (cut small) with onion.
Add vinegar with salt, sugar, pepper and dill to browned bacon and onion (don't drain). Mix this with potatoes.

title: Chocolate Muffins
steps: Cream the margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, flour, chocolate, vanilla and pecans.
Pour into tiny muffin tins sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Candied Yams

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 1/3 cup light brown sugar, firmly packed

steps: Melt margarine in skillet over low heat.
Blend in sugar and salt.
Increase heat and bring to boiling.
Add potatoes and cook over medium heat, turning potatoes several times.
Cook for about 20 minutes or until potatoes are well glazed and thoroughly heated.

title: Stewed Chicken
steps: Remove any excess pieces of fat from chicken.
Place chicken, giblets and neck in kettle.
Add just enough water to cover.
Add remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer until thickest pieces are tender, 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours.
If not serving immediately, refrigerate chicken in broth until cool.

title: Chitterlings(Makes 4 To 5 Servings)
steps: Chitterlings can be purchased frozen and ready to go.
The only problem is the cleaning.
You must open each piece and scrape the fat.
Cut into 6-inch lengths and rinse in fresh water several times.
Soak overnight in the refrigerator in salt water.
Rinse and place in a heavy kettle with a tight-fitting lid.
Add other ingredients except green pepper.
Simmer for 2 to 3 hours until tender.
Add green pepper and cook another 15 minutes.

title: Hot Dogs With Fried Rice And Tomatoes
steps: Melt butter or bacon fat.
Add rice and saute until yellow. Add onion and cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, seasonings and herbs. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes until rice is tender.
Arrange hot grilled hot dogs on hot platter and pour rice and tomato mixture around them.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Divan

ingredients.name: broccoli but firm
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked but firm or 1 broccoli, cut up in small pieces; lightly steamed

ingredients.name: chicken breast half and boned in
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breast halves, cooked and boned in pieces

steps: Arrange cooked broccoli in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chicken on top.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour on top of chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread and margarine and sprinkle over all.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Lasagne
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine in large bowl Ricotta, Parmesan, Romano and 1/2 Mozzarella cheese.
Add eggs and parsley. Soak noodles in cold water for 10 minutes.
In pan, spread 1/2 cup sauce, then place 3 noodles on top.
Spread 1/3 Ricotta filling over noodles.
Pour 1 cup sauce over cheese filling. Repeat layers, ending with sauce.

title: Spinach Patties
steps: Combine spinach, eggs and flour; mix well until you have a batter.
Pour "pancake-like" patties in hot skillet with 2 tablespoons oil.
Fry until golden brown (approximately 4 to 5 minutes on each side).
Take fried patties; place in baking dish. Cover with desired amount of spaghetti sauce and cheese.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until cheese is brown.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 chicken breasts (I use the boneless chicken)

steps: Stew and bone chicken (save broth from chicken).
Mix melted margarine with cornbread mix.
Put a little less than half of the mix in bottom of casserole.
Put half of chicken on top.
Dilute celery soup with a can of broth and pour over chicken.
Repeat layers, using chicken soup diluted with 1 can chicken broth. Sprinkle top with crumb dressing mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Grilled Potatoes In A Package

ingredients.name: onion and pepper
ingredients.raw: sliced onions and peppers (any other veggies you prefer)

steps: Tear off a piece of non-stick foil about 10-12 inches long. Peel and cut the potatoes, add the sliced onions and peppers, along with the tablespoon of butter and salt and pepper into the center of the foil.
Fold the foil and close it tightly at the top and on the sides.
Cook it on the grill on low for approximately 30 minutes.
Once the potatoes are done, open the packet (be careful of the steam), put slices of the cheese on the potatoes and close the packet up so it can melt.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of celery soup

steps: Dip the chicken pieces in melted butter or brush with butter and season with salt and pepper.
Mix rice with soups and spread in a shallow, buttered casserole.
Top with chicken breasts and bake at 300° for 2 hours.

title: Butterscotch Pull-Apart

ingredients.name: loaf bread dough
