ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 loaves frozen bread dough or 1 pkg. frozen roll dough

ingredients.name: regular butterscotch pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 3/4 oz.) pkg. regular butterscotch pudding mix

steps: Let frozen dough thaw until pliable.
Grease a 12-cup Bundt (tube ) pan.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the brown sugar on bottom of pan.
Top with walnuts and set aside.
In small bowl, combine pudding mix, remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar and cinnamon.
Cut thawed dough into 24 pieces (rolls do not need to be cut).
Dip each piece in melted butter, then roll in butterscotch mixture. Arrange dough balls on top of nut mixture in pan.
The pan should be filled at least half-way with dough.

title: Chicken, Cheese And Broccoli Pie
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inches). Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw; drain.
Mix broccoli, 2 cups of the cheese, chicken and onion in plate.
Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth.
Pour into plate.
Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 35 minutes. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake just until cheese is melted. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: 6 Layer Casserole

ingredients.name: tomato soup mixed with equal part half and half
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can tomato soup, mixed with equal part half and half

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar cheese mixed with c. mozzarella
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese mixed with 1 c. Mozzarella

steps: Butter a large casserole.
Cook broccoli and green onion in a small amount of water with dash of salt for 5 to 6 minutes.
Drain well.
Mix soup and half and half in bowl.
In casserole, layer rice, broccoli, green onions and ham.
Pour soup mixture over; top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 375° for approximately 35 minutes or until cheese is melted and light brown.
Serve hot from oven with salad and rolls.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Orange Pineapple Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple (do not drain)

steps: Blend well the jello and boiling water.
Add the next three ingredients and let it gel.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Add, in the order listed, and mix well.
Pour into oblong baking pan or dish.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Cool and add fresh strawberries and milk, if so desired.

title: Lazy Daisy Cake
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients and beat well, then add dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Scald milk and add butter. Combine the 2 mixtures and beat well.
Pour into square, flat pan and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and add frosting, then return to hot oven for frosting to brown.

title: Blueberry Cake("Local Bake-Off Winner")
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Then add egg and milk.
Beat until smooth.

title: Pecan Ritz Pie
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients together in small bowl.
Set aside.
Put egg whites in a large mixing bowl and beat until it forms peaks.
Slowly add sugar, then vanilla.
Add first bowl of dry ingredients and fold together gently with large spoon.
Pour into 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Nut Clusters
steps: Melt chocolate in double boiler; add butter and stir.
Stir in nuts.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.
Refrigerate until hard.

title: My Own Self

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese macaroni and broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 box Velveeta cheese macaroni and broccoli

ingredients.name: albacore tuna in water
ingredients.raw: 1 can albacore tuna in water, drained

steps: Kids love this; with your help, they can prepare dinner.
Make macaroni and cheese according to directions.
Steam veggies and drain.
Fluff tuna with fork in small bowl or big bowl if children are doing it.
Mix first three ingredients together and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Pound Cake
steps: Cream together the butter and confectioners sugar.
Add the whole eggs, one at a time, beating each in well.
Gradually add the flour, beating continually.
Add lemon and vanilla extracts and mix thoroughly.
Put batter in greased Bundt pan and bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken-Dressing Casserole
steps: Cook and debone chicken.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, combine soups.
Lay chicken on top of soups.
Put in frozen peas. Mix stuffing by directions on box; spread over chicken mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Good to make ahead and freeze.

title: Magic Eggnog Sauce
steps: Beat eggs until foamy in top of a double boiler; stir in condensed milk.
Cook over hot, not boiling, water 10 minutes. Stir rum flavoring and nutmeg; fold in whipped cream.
Serve hot or cold over fruitcake or ice cream.
Yield:
about 2 cups.

title: Lemon Jell-O Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine lemon cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines lemon cake mix

steps: Mix together first four ingredients.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each egg.
Pour in Bundt pan that has been oiled and floured.

title: Possum Pie
steps: Cream together powdered sugar and cream cheese; set aside. Mix vanilla and chocolate pudding mixes with milk.
Spread cream cheese mixture on bottom of cooled pie shell.
Spread the pudding over this layer.
Top with whipped cream.
Arrange pecan halves on the whipped cream.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Corn Muffin Bread
steps: Chop
onions.

Cook broccoli; drain well. Combine onions, broccoli, eggs, margarine, salt, corn muffin mix and milk. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake for 35 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle cheese over top and return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Christmas Morning Pie

ingredients.name: pork sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pork sausage, cooked and crumbled

steps: Line pie pans with pie shells.	In bowl, combine sausage and cheeses.
Place half of mixture in each shell.
Combine eggs, milk, onion and peppers. Pour half over sausage in each shell. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cauliflower Delight
steps: Cut up lettuce.
Chop cauliflower and onion.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Crumble into bits.
Sprinkle over lettuce mixture.

title: Congo Cookies

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips or butterscotch

steps: Cream together sugar and margarine or butter.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.
Add to mixture.
Add chips.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Macaroon Pie

ingredients.name: saltine cracker
ingredients.raw: 24 (2 inch sq.) saltine crackers, finely crushed

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: vanilla ice cream or whipped cream for topping

steps: Generously butter and flour an 8-inch pie pan; set aside. Preheat oven to 300°.
Beat egg whites until foamy, then gradually add the sugar and beat until stiff.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Pour into the prepared pie pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Cool completely.
Serve topped with scoop of ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Apple Salad
steps: In saucepan, combine pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes; add gelatin and stir until dissolved.
Add cream cheese.
Stir; cool.
Fold in apples, nuts, celery and whipped topping.
Pour into 9-inch pan.
Chill until firm (2 hours or so).

title: Gingersnaps
steps: Heat to boiling point the molasses.
Pour it over shortening. Sift together and stir this into the flour, baking soda, ginger and salt.
Shape 1/4 the mixture at a time, keeping the rest of the dough in the refrigerator until you are ready to cut it out.
Roll as thin as possible; cut with small, round cutter.
Bake at 350° until crisp and dry (8 to 10 minutes).
Makes 100 or more.
Keeps well.

title: Pickled Peaches
steps: Put peach syrup in a saucepan, add spices and vinegar.
Bring to a boil then simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour over peaches, cover and refrigerate.

title: Oatmeal Bread For Bread Machine
steps: Place ingredients in bread machine.
Select "white bread" setting.
Yield:
1 large loaf.

title: Italian Vegetable Pizzas

ingredients.name: italian style vegetable in seasoned sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Italian style vegetables in seasoned sauce

steps: Prepare vegetables according to package directions, omitting water.
Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Spread pizza sauce on each muffin half.
Top with vegetable mixture and Mozzarella cheese. Broil to melt cheese or microwave on High (100%) for 2 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Camp Biscuits
steps: Cut in shortening.
Stir in milk quickly and knead lightly for a few seconds, using as little flour as possible on board.
Roll to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with floured cutter.
Cook in lightly greased hot skillet over very low heat until biscuits are brown on underside and raised to height of 1-inch.
Turn and brown on other side.

title: Oven Baked Chicken And Rice

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Turn oven to 350° to heat.
Put whole chicken in big baking dish along with onion, bell peppers, celery, salt and black pepper. Then add the four cups of water.
Then let chicken bake for 35 minutes.
Then add mushroom soup and long grain rice.
Bake for another 30 minutes.
Please cover rice and chicken while baking. Take out of oven.
Serves 10.

title: Sherried Chicken
steps: Put chicken in oblong dish or pan, skin side up.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for a few minutes.
Dissolve bouillon in water. Stir in soup and sherry.
Pour over chicken.
Cover with foil and cook at 250° for 4 hours.
Serve over rice.

title: Watergate Salad

ingredients.name: pistachio instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 small box pistachio instant pudding mix

steps: Mix pudding mix and pineapple.
Add nuts, marshmallows and Cool Whip.

title: Berried Treasure Pie

ingredients.name: jell o instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O (lemon or banana cream) instant pudding

steps: Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk in bowl until smooth.
Spread evenly in bottom of pie crust.
Arrange strawberries on cream cheese mixture.
Prepare whipped topping as directed on package.
Prepare pie filling mix with 1 cup of milk as directed on package for pie.
Fold in 1 cup whipped topping. Spoon into pie crust and chill until set, about 2 hours.
Garnish with remaining whipped topping and additional strawberries.

title: Mom'S Squash Pie

ingredients.name: squash real good and cooled
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cooked squash, drained real good and cooled

steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt; next mix egg and milk all together. Add squash and flavoring.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Green Bean And Potato Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients together in casserole dish except for the bread crumbs; mix well.
Top with bread crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Chipped Beef Dip Or Spread
steps: Mix all ingredients until smooth.
Place nuts on top (optional).

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
steps: Mix well and pour in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Grits Casserole

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Cook grits according to package directions.
Set aside. Crumble sausage in a large skillet.
Add onion and green pepper. Cook over medium heat until meat is browned and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Drain well.

title: Hawaiian Delight
steps: Let jello start to jell; mix in drained pineapple.
Then add banana slices.
Mix well.
Let jell, then top with Cool Whip.

title: Very Good Rolls
steps: Pour boiling water over shortening and stir until melted.
Add sugar and salt and mix well.
Add eggs.
Place yeast in lukewarm water with the sugar to activate it.
Combine the two mixtures. Sift flour into mixture.
Blend well and place in refrigerator. Roll out dough in circles and fold like an envelope.
Place on greased cookie sheet and let rise for 2 hours.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until brown.
Dough can be kept in refrigerator for up to 10 days.
Serves 20.

title: Chili Cheese Log

ingredients.name: philly cream cheese room temperature
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. Philly cream cheese, room temperature

steps: Grate Cheddar cheese into a 1-quart bowl.
Add cream cheese and other ingredients.
Mix until well blended.
Shape into small logs or balls.
Roll in chili powder on waxed paper.
Refrigerate until solid, then wrap in waxed paper and Reynolds Wrap.
Store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Medley
steps: Chop in large bowl the broccoli, cauliflower and onions.
Add remaining ingredients and toss well.
Put in covered bowl and refrigerate.

title: Diabetic Cookies
steps: Boil first 3 ingredients together for 10 minutes.
Let cool. Then add all other ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate to chill.

title: Dill Cucumber Sandwiches

ingredients.name: good season italian dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 packet Good Seasons Italian dressing mix

steps: Mix together cream cheese, the packet of dressing mix and 2 tablespoons milk (better prepared the day before).
Spread bread slice with cream cheese mixture.
Top with cucumber slice, then sprinkle with dill weed.

title: Real Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Make pudding as per directions; let stand until firm.
Add and mix in condensed milk and crushed strawberries.
Cut cake in 3/4-inch slices.
Layer cake, pudding mixture and sliced strawberries until all pudding and strawberries are used up.
All you need now is a spoon and a little time.

title: Ham Salad Spread(For Food Processor)
steps: Position knife blade in bowl.
Add ham.
Process until ground, about 10 seconds.
Transfer to mixing bowl.
Re-position knife blade in bowl.
Add onion, celery and pickle.
Process until ground, about 10 seconds.
Add to ham along with mayonnaise and pepper.
Mix together.

title: Breakfast Tortillas
steps: Fry tortillas in oil until browned.
Set on paper towel to drain.
Melt butter in frying pan.
In bowl, add all other ingredients except bacon and stir until well mixed.
Add mixture to frying pan, stirring constantly over medium heat until well mixed.
Add mixture to frying pan, stirring constantly over medium heat until cheese is melted.
Put on tortillas and top with bacon. Makes 2 servings.

title: Busy Day Lemon Cheese Cake
steps: Stir in cream cheese until very soft, blend in 1/2 cup milk. Add remaining milk and the pudding mix.
Beat slowly with egg beater, just until well mixed, about 1 minute (do not overbeat). Pour at once into graham cracker crust.
Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs lightly over top.
Chill about one hour.

title: Cut Glass Dessert

ingredients.name: each lemon lime orange and strawberry gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. each lemon, lime, orange and strawberry gelatin

steps: Prepare orange, lime and strawberry gelatin separately in 1 1/2 cups hot water and put in 3 separate shallow pans to gel. Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup hot pineapple juice and 1/2 cup sugar.
Let cool until slightly thickened. Whip the cream and add vanilla. Fold into lemon mixture. Cut 3 trays of jello into cubes and fold in gently to other mixture.
Line pie pans with vanilla wafers.
Pour in mixture and refrigerate.

title: Chicken Spectacular

ingredients.name: uncle ben s combination wild and white rice
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's combination wild and white rice, cooked

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into greased 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 15 servings.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Blend and cool.
Add eggs.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to mixture. Add flour and blend well.
Cover and place in refrigerator at least 4 hours.
About 3 hours before using, roll out and cut.
Brush with melted butter.
Place on greased pan and allow to rise 3 hours. Bake at 425° for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Doris' Corn Bread

ingredients.name: unbolted white corn meal sifted
ingredients.raw: 1 c. unbolted white corn meal, sifted

steps: Mix sifted flour and meal together.
Add other ingredients. Mix well.
Pour about 2 tablespoons of oil in bread pan (13 x 6-inch) and heat in oven.
Pour the corn bread mix into the heated pan.
Stir.
Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Potato Bites
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut potatoes in half, then quarters and dice.
Put in baking pan.
Pour oil over potatoes using hands to make sure each potato has oil on it.
Sprinkle with garlic salt. Put in oven and bake for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Combine sugar, milk, margarine, Marshmallow Creme and salt in a 4-quart saucepan.
Stir over low heat until blended.
Bring to a boil over moderate heat.
Do not mistake escaping air bubbles for boiling.
Boil slowly, stirring constantly for 5 minutes (to soft ball stage).
Remove from heat; stir in chocolate, vanilla and nuts.
Stir until chocolate is melted.
Pour into 2 buttered 9 x 9-inch pans and cool.
Yields 5 pounds.
Recipe can be halved.

title: Orange Slice Cookie Bars

ingredients.name: orange fine
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pkg. orange slices, cut fine

steps: Prepare sheet cake pan with Crisco and sprinkle with flour. Cut up orange slices finely (dredge in part of flour).
Dip out some of your measured flour into orange slices and cut and separate them with fingers.
Add mixed together the brown sugar, flour and salt, then orange slices and flour.
Next, add eggs one at a time.
Stir well and spread with spatula and floured fingers in prepared pan.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes (depends on oven) at 325°. They will be light brown on top and dry to fingertips also.
Move to wire rack to cool.
While still warm, cut small bars and take out and roll in powdered sugar.
When completely cool, place in sealed container to keep.

title: Pistachio Marble Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients except for the chocolate syrup in large mixer bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes.
Pour 1/3 of batter in a separate bowl and stir in chocolate syrup.
Spoon batters alternately into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Zig zag spatula through batter to marble.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until center springs back when lightly touched.
Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Easy Hot Bread
steps: Grease muffin pan or spray with cooking spray.
Mix all ingredients only until smooth (do not overmix).
Drop mixture by teaspoons into muffin pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 450°.

title: Maple Syrup
steps: Stir sugar and water until sugar is dissolved.
Add cream of tartar, stirring well.
Boil for 5 minutes and remove from heat. Stir in flavoring.
Let stand until cool.
Pour into jar.

title: Seafood Dip

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. fat-free cream cheese, softened

steps: Stir the softened cream cheese until slightly smooth. Add crabmeat, onion, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Spread the mixture in a 9-inch pie plate.
Top with walnuts and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 25 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Garden Macaroni Salad
steps: Stir together first 3 ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients; toss.
Cover and chill.
Makes 8 cups.

title: Microwave Sausage-Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Cook ground beef and sausage in skillet until brown and crumbly.
Drain
and set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients in 8-cup heatproof glass container.
Microwave on Medium-high until cheese
melts,
stirring
often.
Stir in meat mixture. Serve with chips or fresh vegetables.

title: Caramel Popcorn
steps: Boil until slightly brown around edges.
Add 1/4 teaspoon soda.
Boil, stirring constantly.
Pour over popcorn, mix until covered; lay out to dry.

title: Chicken Noodle Bake
steps: In a buttered medium-size casserole dish, blend soup and milk.
Stir in cooked noodles, chicken and pimento.
Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 3 to 4 servings.

title: Orange Carrots
steps: Peel and cut carrots into 3-inch pieces. Cook in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain.
Place in 9-inch baking dish.
Melt butter.
Add sugar and flour.
Mix well. Add orange zest and orange juice.
Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour over carrots.
Bake 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Lime Congealed Salad

ingredients.name: whipped cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whipped cream or chill canned milk and whip

steps: Dissolve Jell-O in the water. Cut cream cheese in small pieces.
Add all other ingredients. Put in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Deluxe Pizza Bagels

ingredients.name: black olive
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped black olives, drained

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook ground beef over medium heat until brown and crumbly.
Remove beef from skillet with slotted spoon; drain on paper towels.
Arrange bagels cut side up on ungreased baking sheet.
Spread pizza sauce over bagels; sprinkle with beef.
Divide onions, mushrooms and olives evenly among bagels.
Combine Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese in small bowl. Sprinkle over bagels.
Bake until cheese is bubbly, approximately 10 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Pizza
steps: Spread cookie dough on 2 (9-inch) round tins or 1 (13 x 14-inch) pizza pan for crust.
Bake and cool.
Whip together cream cheese, sour cream and powdered sugar; spread on crust.
Arrange strawberries, cut in half, on top of cream mixture.
Top with Glaze.
Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Cherry Salad

ingredients.name: thank you cherry let set
ingredients.raw: 1 can Thank You cherries, let set (put in 9 x 7-inch cake tin)

steps: Mix and put on top of jello.
Let set awhile.

title: Lemon Butter Or Curd
steps: Mix all together in a heavy saucepan and cook over low heat until thickened.
Can in small jelly jars or use the whole amount. Cool and refrigerate.
Spread on fruit breads, bagels or as a jam.

title: Hot Milk Cake
steps: Blend sugar and eggs together and beat until creamy.
Put milk and butter in small pan and heat until warm.
Add flour to sugar and egg mix and add milk and butter a little at a time until all used up.
Add baking powder and vanilla; mix a little more.
Put in two 9-inch pans and bake in 350° oven until brown, about 35 minutes.
Use any frosting.

title: Beans For Tacos

ingredients.name: dry pinto bean soaked overnight
ingredients.raw: 32 oz. jar dry pinto beans, soaked overnight

steps: Cook soaked beans several hours until tender.
Add ingredients and continue to simmer.
Make sure beans are always covered with enough water.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
steps: Cook macaroni noodles.
Mix all ingredients together well. Cook 4 hours on low.
Put slices of cheese on top if desired.

title: Arizona Baked Frijoles
steps: Cover beans with cold water; let stand overnight.
In the morning, drain and cook with fresh water to which salt and soda have been added.
Let the beans simmer until tender.
Place onions and honey in the bottom of a casserole and cover them with the drained beans.
Add seasonings.
Rub the lid of the casserole thoroughly with the halved clove of garlic.
Cover and bake at 450° until completely tender.

title: Pork With Wild Rice

ingredients.name: grain and wild rice
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) box long grain and wild rice

steps: Mix contents of box, soup and water in shallow 10-inch casserole.
Add mushrooms; arrange pork chops on top.
Sprinkle with salt and paprika.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Pork Barbecue Sandwiches

ingredients.name: or more c. broth
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 or more c. broth (from cooking meat)

steps: Cook pork and cut in cubes.
Mix all ingredients with meat. Simmer until consistency desired.
Serve on buns.

title: Baked Chicken Breast With Sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Place butter in 9 x 13-inch dish and melt.
In plastic bag combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Shake to blend.
Add chicken one piece at a time.
Shake to coat. Place in dish and bake in hot oven for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken pieces over and bake few more minutes while you make sauce.

title: Indian Fried Bread
steps: Make a soft dough, using the first 3 ingredients and a little shortening.
Add enough milk to mix; cut this together.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease; let fry until brown and crisp.
Serve hot.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Boil noodles until done, drain.
Add tuna, drained, soup and 1 1/2 cans of water.
Drain and add peas and mushrooms.
Mix thoroughly and simmer until warm.
Salt and pepper to taste. Quick and delicious.

title: Mrs. Barrett'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Grease cookie sheets or use parchment paper.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cookies are very light and will melt in your mouth.

title: Domenica'S Ciambellone
steps: Mix sugar, Crisco; add eggs and beat well.
Add anise, lemon rind, milk, baking powder and flour.
Last, add wine to batter and beat well.
Pour batter into tube pan.
If desired; sprinkle batter with sugar or confetti.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Place the first 5 ingredients
in a large salad bowl.
Layer them; do not mix them together.
Spread over 2 cups salad dressing to seal in the 5 ingredients.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar over salad dressing.
Fry 1/2 pound bacon until very crisp, then cool, crumble and sprinkle over the top.
Also sprinkle 1/2 pound grated Cheddar cheese.
Cover and chill for 8 hours.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
steps: In greased casserole, arrange onions.
Mix together other ingredients except cracker crumbs and pour over onions.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with cracker crumbs.

title: Squash Fritters
steps: Combine squash, sugar, salt, flour, onion and pepper.
Add beaten eggs and melted butter; mix.
Drop by tablespoons onto oiled griddle.
Cook on both sides until brown.
Serve immediately.

title: Cocktail Meatballs

ingredients.name: or clove garlic mashed
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 cloves garlic, mashed or 1/2 tsp. garlic powder

steps: Combine ground beef with eggs, garlic, salt and pepper to taste.
Form into walnut-size balls.
Brown in a skillet with a little margarine or oil, if necessary.

title: Sweet Chex-Mix
steps: Mix brown sugar, butter and syrup.
Boil for 3 to 4 minutes in microwave.
Add baking soda and vanilla; stir it up good.
Spray paper bag with Pam.
Pour box of cereal in bag, then add mixture. Stir up good.
Put in microwave and cook on Full power for 1 1/2 minutes.
Shake bag well.
Put back in 1 1/2 minutes.
Shake well again.
Put back in 1 minute more, then shake.
Pour onto wax paper.

title: Green Bean Bake

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked green beans (cut or French-style)

steps: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, blend soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in beans and 1/2 of onions.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Stir.
Top with remaining onions and continue baking for 5 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Steak Teriyaki

ingredients.name: ginger and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2-inch piece fresh ginger, peeled and grated

steps: Place steaks in shallow pan.
Mix together, blending well, brown sugar, soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Pour over steaks.
Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Turn steaks occasionally.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 cans cherry or favorite pie filling

steps: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Soften cream cheese and beat with vanilla and sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour over crackers.
Top with pie filling.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Bake
steps: Cook or steam vegetables until almost done.
Mix soup with milk and mayonnaise.
Beat for 2 minutes.
Melt butter.
Crumble crackers in fine pieces.
In pan, layer mixed vegetables, then soup mixture, then cheese.
Mix crackers in butter and sprinkle on top.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli pear thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, thawed

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 10 to 12 slices cooked chicken or turkey

steps: Cut broccoli spears into bite size pieces and place in bottom of greased crock-pot.
In saucepan, blend milk, cream cheese, salt, garlic salt and Parmesan cheese over low heat until melted and smooth.
Pour one cup over broccoli; top with sliced chicken. Pour remaining sauce over chicken.
Cover and cook on low 4 to 6 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Wet Chocolate Cake
steps: Sift together flour and sugar.
In saucepan add butter, cocoa and warm water.
Bring to boil and pour over dry ingredients.
Mix well, then add buttermilk, baking soda, eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour in large oblong pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Vanilla Cream Caramels

ingredients.name: cream half and half
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cream, half and half or evaporated milk

steps: Stir the sugar, Karo, butter and 1 cup cream over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to 240°.
Reduce heat.
Add slowly the second cup of cream. Increase heat to medium and bring to 245°.
Pour at once, without scraping, onto buttered 9 x 13-inch pan or marble slab (with sides).
(Scrape bottom and sides of pan onto a second buttered pan; this candy will be more brittle, but is still great for eating.)

title: Whitefish Poached In Wine

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: mushrooms, 1 c. or to taste, sauteed in butter

ingredients.name: lemon juice salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste

steps: In buttered pie pan put 1 tablespoon shallots on bottom, layer fish on top in single layer.
Cover with remaining shallots and the mushrooms, dot with butter, salt and pepper.
Pour wine and water over just barely to cover.
Bring to low simmer on stove; cover with wax paper coated with butter.
Put in bottom third of oven, preheated to 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Happiness Cake
steps: Mix thoroughly; add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy.
Flavor with love and kindly service.
Fold in 4 cups of prayers, faith and enthusiasm; spread all into your daily life.
Blend well with human kindness; serve with a smile at all times and it will satisfy the hunger of many people less fortunate than ourselves.

title: Apricot Meringue Bars(Makes 16 Servings)
steps: Set oven at moderate 350°.
Blend butter, 1/2 cup sugar and egg yolks.
Work in flour.
Lightly flour hands and pat into well-greased 7 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch baking dish.
Bake 15 minutes. Remove from oven and spread evenly with preserves.
Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar.
Continue beating until peaks form, then fold in nuts.
Spread carefully over preserves.
Return to oven and bake 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.
Makes about 16.

title: Oreo Cookie Torte
steps: Layer 1:
Mix and crush Oreos, saving a small amount for garnish, and melted margarine.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan for crust.

title: Georgia Pecan Pie
steps: Beat eggs until foamy.
Add sugar, syrup, melted butter and vanilla; beat until mixture thickens.
Add nuts and pour into a pie shell.
Bake for 10 minutes at 450°, then reduce heat to 325° and bake until filling is firm (approximately 35 to 40 minutes).

title: Mushroom Burgers
steps: Brown patties in skillet.
Pour off grease.
Dissolve bouillon in water and pour over patties along with soup mix and mushrooms. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve on bun with slice of Swiss cheese.

title: Meringues
steps: Beat egg whites at room temperature until stiff peaks form. Gradually add sugar, beating until well blended.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 250° for 30 minutes.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
steps: Boil brown sugar, butter, syrup and salt for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add soda and vanilla and stir over corn.
Mix well; spread on cookie sheet(s). Place in oven at 200° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring every 20 to 30 minutes.
Remove and let cool. Break apart.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover batter and store in refrigerator. Use as needed.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Remove from muffin tin at once.

title: Lasagna
steps: Cook noodles, then drain them.
Layer with all ingredients, starting with small amount of sauce.
Put cheese on top of each layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple and juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and pour mixture in.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Frost with favorite icing or top with whipped cream.

title: Spaghetti Bake

ingredients.name: or jar spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 cans or jars spaghetti sauce

steps: Cook spaghetti.
Start with 1 layer of spaghetti.
Cover with sauce, then layer of cheese.
Repeat.
When finished, place pepperoni on top.
Bake until cheese melts, approximately 45 minutes.

title: Deep Dish Cherry-Peach Pie

ingredients.name: peach in juice
ingredients.raw: 16 oz. can sliced peaches in juice, drained

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Combine flour, 1 cup of oats, sugar and baking powder.
Cut 1/2 cup butter in until crumbly.
Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with 1/4 cup oats.
Cut in 1/4 cup butter until crumbly; set aside.
Mix water and remaining oat mixture with fork, just until moistened.
Press in bottom of 9-inch deep-dish pie pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Cool slightly.

title: Jiffy Lime Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin and marshmallows in boiling water in bowl. Cool.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 1 1/2 quart mold. Chill until firm.
Unmold on serving plate.
Garnish with whipped cream and cherries.

title: Stuffed Pepper For 2
steps: Cut out stem and seeds from Peppers with a grapefruit knife. Rinse Peppers out.
Boil 5 minutes.
Drain.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Stuff Peppers with mixture and bake at 350 for about 1 hour.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
steps: Mix 1 egg with margarine, nuts and cake mix by hand; pat into Pam sprayed 3 or 4-quart baking dish.
Cream the cream cheese with 2 eggs; add sugar.
Mix well; spread over cake layer.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Christmas Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: mandarin orange in half
ingredients.raw: 1 can mandarin oranges, cut in half

steps: Follow directions on gelatin using 2 cups of boiling water and plain gelatin.
Add sugar.
Mix to dissolve.
Add the rest of the ingredients.
Mix well and chill.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
steps: Put chicken in pan.
Mix other ingredients together.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cooked sauce can be used over rice as a side dish.

title: World'S Greatest Cookie
steps: In a large bowl, cream together until smooth the butter and peanut butter. Add gradually the granulated sugar and brown sugar, creaming until blended. Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until smooth. Add flour and soda. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop from a teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet and flatten with back of teaspoon.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes or until golden. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Baked Pineapple Chicken
steps: Drain pineapple; reserve juice.
Combine reserved juice with garlic, cornstarch, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and rosemary. Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish on broiler-proof dish, skin side up.
Broil until browned.
Stir sauce; pour over chicken.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Penne Pasta With Kalamata Olives

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: about 5 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: garlic clove or
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 garlic cloves, chopped or sliced

ingredients.name: ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: Cut white meat chicken up into 1-inch pieces.
Pit the kalamata olives and cut each olive into 3 or 4 pieces.
Chop or slice garlic.
Cut the basil leaves into strips.
Begin heating a large pot of salted water to boiling.
When water begins to boil, add pasta.
Don't overcook!
When done, drain pasta and put in a large pasta bowl.
Drizzle liberally with olive oil, then salt and pepper to taste (I like plenty of pepper here) and stir.

title: Lu Lu Paste Dip(Great For Veggies)
steps: Mix cream cheese, onion and green pepper together and set aside.
In saucepan, put sugar, vinegar, salt and well beaten eggs.
Cook over medium heat until thickened.
Don't let eggs cook too fast.
Remove from heat.
Add butter.
Let hot mixture cool. Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Velvet Crumb Cake

ingredients.name: fruit and whipped cream
ingredients.raw: fresh fruit and whipped cream or Cool Whip

steps: Grease and flour an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan or a 9-inch round pan.
Beat all ingredients until well blended and pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool.
Serve with fresh fruit and whipped cream or with Cool Whip as desired.

title: Neapolitan Pork Chops

ingredients.name: pork rib
ingredients.raw: 6 pork rib or loin chops (cut about 3/4 to 1-inch thick)

steps: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet.
Add garlic and cook until lightly browned.
Season chops with salt and pepper.
Put chops in skillet and brown on both sides.
Add mushrooms, green pepper, sieved tomatoes and wine.
Cover and cook over low heat about 1 hour or until tender.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Baked Potatoes With Onions

ingredients.name: onion in half lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 1 medium onion, cut in half lengthwise

steps: Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/8 to 1/4-inch slices, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Slice halved onion into thin slices.
Wedge these slices into potato cuts.
Brush with melted butter and season.
Wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until done.
Serves 4.

title: Baked Cheese Garlic Grits
steps: Prepare grits in boiling salt water.
Stir in cheese, butter or margarine, milk, eggs and garlic.
Cook over low heat until cheese is melted.
Pour into a 2-quart greased casserole.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pretzels Delight
steps: Break pretzels in small pieces.
Mix all the ingredients together.
In double boiler pot melt almond bark until smooth. Pour over the ingredients and mix well.
Make in small cluster balls and place them on a cookie sheet like you would do cookies. Let stand for about 1 1/2 hours.
If the weather is cold there is no refrigeration needed.
If not, place in the refrigerator until chilled.

title: Jerk Chicken

ingredients.name: ginger plu tsp. ground ginger
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh ginger plus 1 1/2 tsp. ground ginger or 2 tsp. ground ginger

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a large bowl, combine teriyaki sauce, garlic, ginger, pepper and salt.
Add chicken; toss to mix well.
Lift chicken out of sauce and place in oiled baking dish, skin side down.
Bake for 45 minutes, turning once and basting frequently with remaining sauce until brown and crispy.
Can also be cooked on the grill.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Cream together and spread on cake.
Makes enough frosting for two 9 x 13-inch cakes.
This frosting can be frozen.

title: Clinton Clamdigger
steps: Combine in mixing glass, stirring well.
Add ice and strain into old-fashioned glass.
Rim glass with lemon peel and throw in peel.

title: Diet Fresh Green Salad

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 small jar sliced mushrooms or 1/2 c. fresh

ingredients.name: good season italian dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix

steps: Combine all
vegetables.
You
will
want more broccoli than cauliflower.
Cut onions in wheels and cut up some of the blades in
the
salad.
Follow
directions
on
salad dressing package and pour over salad when ready to serve.

title: Chicken Or (Pork) Fried Rice

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. chicken or pork, cut in small pieces

steps: Place cooking oil in skillet and heat.

Add cut up onion and meat. Cook completely. Beat eggs and mix with meat. Add cooked rice, salt and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often. Catsup or soy sauce may be added while cooking, if desired. Serves 5.

title: Cheese Crisps
steps: Grate cheese.
Beat well with margarine.
Add dry ingredients. Chill dough for 1 hour.
Mix in Rice Krispies.
Roll into small balls; press out with fork.
Bake on cookie sheet at 350° until slightly browned.

title: Cornpatch Spoon Bread

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. white or yellow corn meal

steps: Stir boiling water into corn meal, mixing thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir quickly until just mixed.
Place in very hot, generously buttered skillet or casserole.
Bake in moderate oven at 375° about 40 minutes or until nicely done. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Shrimply Delicious Cauliflower
steps: Cook cauliflower in salted water until tender.
Drain.
Heat soup; stir in sour cream.
Do not boil.
Season to taste.
Place flowerets in dish; pour on sauce.
Sprinkle with almonds and parsley.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Elegant Frosting

ingredients.name: evaporated milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. evaporated milk or heavy cream

steps: Combine sugar and milk in a heavy saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat, simmer 6 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat and add chocolate.
Stir to blend. Stir in butter and vanilla.
Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Beat until thick and creamy.
Makes enough to fill and frost an 8-inch or 9-inch layer cake.

title: Cranberry Pork Chops
steps: Brown pork chops in small amount of oleo or olive oil.
Pour cranberry sauce over chops.
Cover with soup.
Bake covered at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Soft Butter Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add unbeaten eggs and vanilla.
Beat well.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Blend into creamed mixture.
Chill.
Roll on floured board and cut.
Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Mix all ingredients.
Place in covered dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cream Puff Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.

In a saucepan, combine the water, shortening and salt until melted. Add flour and stir constantly until mixture leaves side of pan and forms a ball.	Remove from heat and cool a few minutes. Beat in eggs, one at a time, until smooth and velvety. Spread in a greased 9-inch glass pie pan. Be sure to grease the sides of the pan but do not spread batter on sides. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°, then reduce to 350°.	Bake until done, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool away from any draft.

title: Lithuanian Sweet Bread(Pyragas; A Simplified Version Of A Traditional Holiday Bread)
steps: In a large bowl thoroughly mix 3/4 cup flour, sugar and yeast. Combine milk and margarine in a saucepan and heat over low heat until liquid is warm.
Gradually add to first mixture and beat 2 minutes at medium speed on electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour and beat at high speed for 2 minutes.
Add remaining 3/4 cup flour; beat at high speed for 2 minutes.
Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let rise in warm, draft-free place until bubbly (1 to 1 1/2 hours).
Stir in raisins; turn into greased 2-quart pan and let rise, uncovered, in warm place for 30 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Zesty Tomato Casserole
steps: Peel tomatoes and cut into chunks.
Melt butter in frypan; drain mushrooms and add to butter along with sliced celery.
Cook until browned.
Stir in salt, Worcestershire and tomato chunks. Spoon into a
1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs and shredded cheese.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for about 45 minutes or until bubbling hot and cheese is melted.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Rye Bread
steps: Take all and mix together.
Stir until smooth.
Put into baking loaf pans.
Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

title: Million Dollar Pie
steps: Mix Cool Whip and milk.
Add pineapple, coconut and nuts; mix well.
Add lemon juice; beat until thick.
Pour into pie shells and chill.

title: Cajun Chicken Creole
steps: Brown chicken in 3 tablespoons oil in deep skillet.
Remove, add onion, peppers and garlic.
Saute until onion is translucent. Add tomatoes, soy sauce and cayenne pepper; bring to a boil, lower heat and add chicken.
Cover and simmer about 1 hour.
Turn chicken 1/2 way through.
Serve over rice.

title: Pineapple Pistachio Fluff
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Put in parfait glasses.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Ron'S "Spicy" Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.name: banana pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 banana pepper or your choice, diced

ingredients.name: up cajun style smoked sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. cut up Cajun style smoked sausage or your choice

steps: When stir-fry mixture is ready, stir in eggs (already beaten). Need to stir constantly.
When eggs are done, add Velveeta cheese.
Let cheese melt and then serve.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
steps: Beat sugar, shortening and eggs.
Sift together and stir in dry ingredients.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can milk (to clean out soup can)

ingredients.name: thickly ham
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 oz. thickly sliced ham, cubed (optional)

steps: Mix together soup, milk, sour cream and cheese.
Add the frozen potatoes.
Mix well.
Toss in the cubed ham.
Place in a greased shallow pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until brown.

title: Chocolate Milkshake

ingredients.name: vanilla yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. frozen vanilla yogurt or ice cream

steps: Butter your bread.
Place on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes or until the unbuttered side is browned.

title: It Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.

title: Homemade Fruit Jello

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 c. sliced fruit (peaches, pears, grapes, bananas, berries, etc.)

steps: Mix together 1/4 cup juice and gelatin.
Measure another 1/4 cup juice.
Boil it, then add the hot juice to the gelatin to dissolve.
Add the remaining juice and stir.
Put the jello in the refrigerator to set.
After the jello begins to set a little, add sliced fruit.
Return jello to refrigerator until firm.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Grandma Ammons' Cookies
steps: Combine butter and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Sift flour, salt and soda; add to first mixture.
Add nuts; mix well.
Shape into a large bowl and chill overnight.
Turn cookies on a floured board and shape into a roll.
Slice very thin for baking.
Bake on a cookie sheet in 350° oven until crisp and light brown.
Yield: 5 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Pie Or Custard(Diabetic)

ingredients.name: envelope d zerta vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope D-Zerta vanilla or butterscotch pudding

steps: Beat eggs until frothy.
Stir pudding mix and evaporated milk to smooth paste.
Add this and all other ingredients to eggs and stir until well blended.

title: Breakfast In A Hurry
steps: Cook and drain sausage.
Put in 8 x 11-inch casserole dish. Mix together thoroughly the remaining ingredients.
Pour egg mixture over sausage and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.

title: Golden Punch
steps: Mix
ingredients.
Add crushed ice to keep cold.
Makes 46 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Chicken Soup With Chinese Vegetables

ingredients.name: spinach and bite size about bunch
ingredients.raw: 12 c. fresh spinach, washed and torn into bite-size pieces about 2 bunches

steps: Heat chicken broth to boiling.
Add mushrooms, then spinach; cook 2 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and hot sauce.
Serve at once Makes 4 qt.
One c. serving:
33 calories, 1 g. fat, 2 mg. cholesterol.

title: Personal Pizza
steps: Cook ground beef in the frying pan.
Open biscuits and flatten with your hand.
Spread ground beef on biscuits and pour tomato sauce over it.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake until biscuits are brown.

title: Christmas Scent
steps: Put all ingredients in a tea kettle or saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer as long as desired.
Add water as needed.
This is not to eat or drink!

title: Low-Fat Hash Brown Casserole

ingredients.name: campbell s fat cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) Campbell's fat-free cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: potato o brien with green pepper and onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (24 oz.) pkg. frozen potatoes O'Brien with green peppers and onions

ingredients.name: weight watcher fat parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Weight Watchers fat-free Parmesan cheese

steps: Combine soup, chicken broth, sour cream, Molly McButter, salt and pepper in a large bowl; mix well.
Add hash browns and mix. Pour into a large casserole dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Sprinkle Parmesan on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Dip
steps: Peel and mash avocados.
Spread over platter.
Top with dip, taco seasoning, tomatoes, onions, olives, taco sauce, Cheddar cheese and Monterey Jack cheese.
Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Milkshake
steps: Combine ingredients into blender.
Blend on high until smooth.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
steps: Brown sausage in skillet.
Drain.
Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 11 x 7 x 2-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Baking Powder Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, salt, sugar and baking powder together well.
Add eggs to milk, then pour into dry ingredients.
Add oil and mix together.
Proceed as for making pancakes from packaged pancake mix.

title: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli
steps: Slice beef across grain in thin strips.
Brown garlic and beef. Add broccoli and onion.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve over noodles.
Garnish with tomatoes and tarragon sprigs, if desired.

title: Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Mix oleo with grated onion and mustard.
Stir until smooth and spread on both sides of onion buns.
Add 1 slice of cheese and lots of ham.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until warm.
Can be frozen. (Wrap each bun in foil.
Do not put in microwave.)

title: Hot Curried Fruit

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) can sliced peaches or halves

steps: Cut peaches and pears into bite size pieces.
Combine fruits in 2-quart casserole.
Blend margarine, brown sugar and curry powder.
Spoon over fruit.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Caramel Icing
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Mix in brown sugar.
Stir over low heat 2 minutes.
Add milk.
Heat until boiling.
Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm.
Stir in confectioners sugar.
Spread onto cake.

title: Microwave Maple Nut Divinity
steps: Combine sugars, corn syrup and water in buttered large glass mixing bowl.
Microwave for 15 to 17 minutes on roast or until candy forms a hard ball in cold water (250°).
Meanwhile, beat egg whites in large bowl until stiff peaks.
Pour candy syrup in thin stream into egg whites; beat constantly with mixer.
Add maple flavoring and salt; beat until mixture is stiff and dull.
Fold in nuts.
Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.
Cool.

title: Cereal Cookies
steps: Heat sugar and syrup until the sugar is melted.
Mix in peanut butter.
Pour over corn flakes and press into buttered pan.
Let cool and cut in pieces.

title: Chicken Stew
steps: Boil fryer in about 2 quarts of water with celery, onion, parsley, green onion and seasonings.
Do not overcook.
Remove chicken, debone and set aside.
Strain broth.
Place broth back in pot and add potatoes, carrots and corkscrew noodles.
Cook until vegetables and noodles are done.
Add deboned chicken, season to taste and serve.

title: Baked Italian Chicken
steps: Cut your chicken in pieces.
Wash them and skin them.
Place in a baking pan.
Pour in your water to cover bottom of pan about 1/2-inch.
Add your lemon juice (your discretion) to water.
Put small pats of butter on each piece of chicken.
Sprinkle garlic powder over chicken, also sprinkle oregano on chicken.

title: Kahlua Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine cake mix, eggs, sour cream, Kahlua and oil.
Beat 3 to 5 minutes on medium.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.
Cool for 30 minutes on rack while still in pan.

title: Mrs. Stovers Fudge
steps: Cook sugar, condensed milk and butter or margarine until it forms soft ball.
Add marshmallow cream and chocolate chips.
Beat well.
Add vanilla and nuts.

title: Marmalade Drumsticks
steps: Spread the drumsticks with marmalade.
Coat evenly with stuffing crumbs.
Place in a single layer in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Drizzle with butter or oleo.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until the chicken tests done.
Yield:
6 servings.

title: Pretty Ugly Dip
steps: Put in microwavable dish and microwave for 2 minutes.
Stir. Microwave 2 more minutes.
Serve with white corn tostitos.

title: Hot Dog Hors D'Oeuvres
steps: Melt jelly and mustard together in a saucepan over medium heat (looks awful).
Cut the hot dogs into bite size pieces and place in the mixture to heat.
Put in a chafing dish or dish with candle to keep warm.
Serve with toothpicks alongside.

title: Broccoli-N-Cheese Casserole
steps: Saute onion in skillet with butter.
Cook rice and broccoli. Mix all ingredients and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Let sit for 10 minutes before baking.

title: Oyster Stew
steps: Boil oysters in about 1 cup water for 10 minutes.
Add salt and pepper. Lower heat to medium-low.
Add milk and butter. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Do not boil.
If like, add pinch of cayenne pepper or dash of Tabasco sauce.

title: Buttermilk Cornbread
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°.
Lightly spray an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Parmesan Halibut
steps: Combine eggs and milk to produce a French toast batter. Combine flour and Parmesan cheese.
Rinse the halibut, dip into French toast batter, then dip into cheese mixture.
Saute with lid about 20 minutes, adding little amounts of water, if needed.

title: Chocolate Eclaire A La Highland Pointe
steps: Mix Cool Whip, pudding mix and milk together.
In a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish layer, put graham crackers on bottom, then 1/2 pudding mix, crackers again, remainder of pudding and another layer of crackers.

title: French Lace Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Measure flour; blend with nuts.
Bring corn syrup, shortening and sugar to boil in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; gradually stir in flour and nuts.
Drop batter by level teaspoonful, about 3 inches apart, on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake only 8 to 9 cookies at a time. Bake for 5 to 6 minutes; remove from oven and allow to stand 5 minutes before removing from baking sheet.
Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Oven Apple Butter
steps: Place ingredients in large roaster.
Bake 3 hours in 350° oven.
Stir every 20 minutes.
Yields:
5 quarts.

title: Finger Paint
steps: Mix cornstarch, sugar and water in saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat, about 5 minutes.
Divide the mixture into separate cups or containers.
Tint mixture in each container with a different food color.
Stir several times until cool.
Store in an airtight container.

title: Marshmallow Treats
steps: Melt marshmallows in microwave at High for 2 minutes.
Add Rice Krispies and mix well.
Add M&M's and peanuts.
Pour into sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan or Bundt pan, press down.
I use Pam.

title: Chocolate Cookies
steps: Melt margarine and chocolate.
Let cool.
Add sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients.
Let dough chill and roll into small balls. Roll ball in confectioners sugar.
Bake for 18 minutes at 300°.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chocolate Cake(With Chocolate Icing)

ingredients.name: instant
ingredients.raw: 1 box instant or regular chocolate pudding

steps: In large bowl, combine ingredients (preferably with electric mixer).
Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch metal or glass container. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Test for doneness with toothpick.

title: Green Chile Casserole Grits
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil.
Add grits; cook slowly until thick.
Add cheese, cut in pieces, green chiles and oleo; stir until cheese melts.
Beat in eggs.
Pour into buttered casserole and bake for 1 hour at 275°.

title: Grandmother'S Bread(Rolls)

ingredients.name: shortening in dish you use
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. shortening, melted in dish you use

steps: Dissolve yeast cake in a little warm milk.
Stir together all and let rise to top of bowl.
Roll out.
Cut with biscuit cutter; dip in shortening.
Put in pan.
Let rise again.
Bake 30 minutes in a 325° oven.

title: Black Bread
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients; add flour.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.

title: Tuna Cheese Balls

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.raw: 2 cans tuna, drained (one in vegetable oil)

steps: Combine tuna, cheese, onions and celery.
Combine milk and eggs.
Add the 2 1/4 cups Bisquick.
Beat all ingredients until well blended.
(Heat oven to 375°.)
Take 1 tablespoon of mixture and roll in sifted Bisquick.
Shape into balls and put on well greased cookie sheet for 22 to 25 minutes.
Take off sheet immediately and put on cooling rack.
Makes approximately 55 balls.

title: Texas Coleslaw
steps: Mix cabbage and onions.
Combine other ingredients.
Pour over cabbage and mix well.

title: Marinated Carrot Salad
steps: Clean carrots and cook until tender.
Cool and combine with remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: California Tarts
steps: Blend all ingredients together.
Divide dough in muffin tins (small size).
Use fingers to smooth out in pan.

title: Gary'S Favorite
steps: Brown beef, sausage and onion.
Add soups and water, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Cook noodles and add to meat mixture.
Place in large, buttered baking dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Tea Punch
steps: Mix ingredients and add water to equal 2 1/2 quarts.
Chill. Stir each time before serving a glass.
(I omit the sugar usually.) Nice to serve at a luncheon.

title: Holiday Hors D'Oeuvres
steps: Mix olives, cheese, onion and mayonnaise together.
Spread on small square of rye bread.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°. Serve warm.

title: Anise Candy
steps: Mix syrup, water and sugar in a heavy medium-sized saucepan. Stir over low heat until sugar is completely dissolved.
Boil, covered, about 3 minutes; uncover and continue boiling slowly to 310°.

title: Franks And Sauerkraut
steps: Combine sauerkraut, caraway seed, 1 teaspoon brown sugar, onion slices and margarine.
Place in shallow square baking dish.
Cut unpeeled apples into halves and remove cores.
Brush cut surfaces with margarine and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Arrange apple halves on the sauerkraut in a diagonal line across the center of the casserole.
Place 2 frankfurters on each side of the apple halves. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Celery Ring
steps: Cream the cheese, butter and tomato paste.
Stuff all celery with mixture.
Start with heart and remake a stalk into its original shape.
Wrap in wax paper and chill.
Cut into rings for serving.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Spread
steps: Mix well and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Serve on crackers, Melba toast, or very thin sandwich bread, such as rye or pumpernickel.

title: Harry Truman Salad
steps: Break lettuce into large bowl, add green onions.
Fry bacon, drain and crumble.
Pour off drippings from skillet.
Combine rest of ingredients, beat well.
Add bacon and pour all into skillet.
Cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Cool.
Pour over lettuce in bowl; toss.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bread Pudding For A Crowd(Abington Grange Supper)
steps: Heat the milk in double boiler (I use 2 mixing bowls set in large kettles) until bubbly around the edges.
The butter can be melted in the milk.
Beat eggs lightly, add sugar and flavorings. Put bread cubes in baking pan (10 x 18 x 2 1/2-inches).
Mix hot milk, eggs and flavorings.
Pour over bread.
Sprinkle raisins on top and try to submerge them somewhat with a rubber spatula.
This will prevent them from sinking to the bottom or clumping together. Put your large broiler pan filled with water on lower oven rack and set pudding pan on a rack above.
Bake about 1 hour or until a dinner knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.
Serves 36.

title: Crunchy Ice Cream Pie
steps: Blend butter and sugar; mix with corn flakes, nutmeats and coconut.
Line bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan with 2/3 of mixture.
Fill with ice cream.
Sprinkle with remaining mixture. Freeze.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: chicken breasts or use small cans chicken

steps: Boil chicken.
Cook spaghetti.
Combine soups with melted butter and sour cream.
Stir in chicken and mushrooms, then add spaghetti.
Combine all together.
Add salt and pepper and spread into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top, then sprinkle Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan; set sugar mixture aside.
Combine egg yolks and milk; stir into sugar mixture.
Add butter.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Spoon into pastry shell.
Spread meringue over hot filling.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 28 minutes.

title: Oyster Chowder

ingredients.name: old bay
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. Old Bay or seafood seasoning

steps: Drain oysters, reserving liquor and chop.
Arrange alternate layers of celery, rice and oysters in a kettle; season with salt, pepper and Old Bay.
Add water and oyster liquid; simmer 1/2 hour. Mix egg yolks and milk and add to chowder.
Heat below boiling point for only a few minutes and serve piping hot.
If allowed to cook too long after adding the eggs, it will curdle.
Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.raw: 18 (1/2-inch thick) slices bread (from French bread or Italian loaf bread, no larger than 3-inches in diameter)

steps: Fill a 13 x 9-inch baking pan half full of hot tap water and place on oven rack in center of oven.
Heat oven to 325°.
Have ready 6 (6 ounce) custard cups or souffle dish.
In a medium size bowl, whisk eggs to blend yolks and whites.
Whisk in milk, sugar and vanilla until well blended.
Place 1 slice bread in bottom of ungreased custard cups.
Sprinkle with 1/2 tablespoon chocolate chips.
Add 2 slices bread overlapping to fit and sprinkle with another 1/2 tablespoon of chips.
Pour on about 1/2 cup milk mixture.
Gently press down so slices begin to absorb milk mixture. Place cups in pan of hot water.
Bake 25 to 40 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Grape-Nut Pudding
steps: Mix cereal with butter. Blend into eggs.
Add cereal and remaining ingredients and blend.
Pour into 1-quart pan.
Put this pan in another filled with an inch of water.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Stir thoroughly.
Bake 30 minutes longer.
Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
steps: Cook bacon and onion rings until tender; drain.
Combine bacon, onion, baked beans and barbecue sauce in 2-quart casserole; cover.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Garnish with additional cooked bacon strips, if desired.

title: Pork Chop Casserole

ingredients.name: pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can pork and beans or baked beans

steps: Trim excess fat from pork chops.
Brown in frying pan thoroughly on both sides.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Place in a deep baking dish.
Mix baked beans, chili sauce, brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over pork chops and top with pepper rings.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Three Layer Pudding Cake
steps: Mix together.
Pat into dish and bake for 10 minutes at 350°. Cool.

title: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients; pour into pie shell and bake in 350° oven for about 50 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

title: Mini Cheesecakes

ingredients.name: filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can filling or topping (any flavor), chilled

steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press equal portions onto bottom of 24 lightly greased or paper cup lined muffin cups.

title: Hot Fruit

ingredients.name: apple ring
ingredients.raw: 1 jar apple rings, drained (reserve 6 Tbsp. juice)

steps: Layer the fruit in casserole dish.
Mix the flour and sugar and sprinkle over the fruit.
Next, add butter and crackers (mixed).
Sprinkle 6 tablespoons reserved liquid on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Golden Fruit Punch
steps: Combine juices and sugar in a punch bowl.
Stir until well mixed.
Add ginger ale and ice cubes.
Garnish with orange and lemon slices, if desired.
Yields 4 1/2 quarts of punch.

title: Peppers Relish
steps: Chop peppers and onions.
Cover with boiling water.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Add vinegar, sugar and salt; boil mixture 5 minutes.
Pour into clean hot jars and seal immediately.
Good with hot dogs and hamburgers or dried beans.

title: Apple Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: regular
ingredients.raw: 2 to 4 Tbsp. regular or light mayonnaise

steps: In a bowl, combine apples, chicken, mayonnaise, pepper, pimento, rosemary and lemon pepper.
Chill until ready to serve. Place lettuce leaf on a serving plate and top with the chilled chicken salad.
Garnish with alfalfa sprouts if desired.

title: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand condensed milk

steps: In a large bowl, stir together milk and syrup.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into aluminum foil lined 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; cover.
Freeze 6 hours or until firm.
Scoop ice cream from pan or remove from pan, peel off foil and slice.
Return leftovers to freezer.

title: Marion Barbecue
steps: Mix all together.
Cook until done at 350°.

title: Fish Souffle(Fiskegrateng)

ingredients.name: boned fish fillet
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. cooked, boned fish fillets (cod, Mahi-Mahi or red snapper)

steps: Make a white sauce by melting butter, then mixing in flour and gradually adding milk.
Mix the chopped onion into the sauce and bring to a boil.
Allow sauce to cool and then mix the egg yolks in.
Beat the egg whites until stiff, but not dry and fold them into the sauce very carefully.
Add the fish to this mixture.
Pour the mixture into a round baking dish (10-inch) and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Let bake for 1 hour at about 400°.
Serve with melted butter.

title: Ice Cream (Peach)
steps: Mix in freezer.
Fill up with milk to line.
This recipe has never failed.
Enjoy!

title: Supreme Potatoes
steps: Mix potatoes, soup, sour cream and onions together; place in a casserole dish.
Top with cheese and bake in a 350° oven for approximately 1 hour.

title: Impossible Vegetable Pie

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained (not cooked)

steps: Mix broccoli, onion and green pepper; place in a lightly greased pie plate, 10 x 1 1/2-inches.
Beat remaining ingredients 1 minute with hand beater.
Pour into pie plate; bake 40 minutes at 400° until knife comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Fresh Lemon Tonic
steps: Stir lemon juice and sugar together until sugar is dissolved. Add whole cloves.
Pour in chilled tonic water.
Serve over 1 or 2 ice cubes in each glass.
Garnish with a lemon slice and a mint leaf.

title: Italian Beef
steps: Cook beef until tender.
Take beef out of juice and tear up into small pieces.
Return to broth; add peppers, cheese and oregano.
Simmer until ingredients are thoroughly blended, approximately 1/2 to 3/4 hour.
Salt to taste.

title: California Chicken
steps: Cook first four ingredients together.
Brown four tablespoons butter in skillet; add flour to this and milk to make a gravy. Add mushroom soup and tuna.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put in a casserole.
Put cracker crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: white potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. white potatoes, cut into large chunks

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients.
Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are coated.
Empty potatoes into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan; discard bag.
Bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Makes about 8 servings.

title: Steamed Yellow Squash
steps: Put margarine in bottom of pan. Wash and slice squash.
Add onion and pepper and salt to choice.
Start to boil margarine with other ingredients in pan also, then cover and turn down to low temperature.
Cook until tender.
Serve.

title: Cottage Pudding
steps: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in mixing bowl.
Combine shortening, sugar, egg, milk and vanilla.
Add to flour mixture. Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured 9-inch square pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Cut into 3-inch squares and serve warm with hot vanilla sauce.

title: One Pot Ham-N-Potatoes

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 ounce) can cut green beans, drained

steps: Combine potatoes, seasoning mix, milk, butter, ham, beans, and water in 2 quart saucepan.
Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Gently stir in apple.
Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli according direction
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked according to directions

steps: Saute onion in butter.
Combine remaining ingredients and heat (mix all ingredients together).
Pour in casserole; bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Vanilla Fudge
steps: Stir sugar and canned milk until dissolved, heating slowly to a slow boil (will scorch easily).
Place cream of tartar on side of pan and dissolve before mixing thoroughly.
Cook slowly to soft ball stage.
Add Karo syrup.
Set aside to cool.
Add vanilla and butter.
Cool to thumbprint.
Beat until smooth.
Add nuts and pour into greased pan.

title: Two Minute Fudge
steps: In a 1 1/2 quart microwave safe dish, stir together the sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla.
Mixture will be stiff.
Top with the stick of butter.
Microwave at high for two minutes. Stir until smooth and blend in the nuts.
Pour into 8-inch square dish lined with wax paper and refrigerate until firm.
Cut into squares.

title: Wassail
steps: Heat all ingredients except oranges.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain punch and pour into punch bowl. Float oranges on top.
Makes 32 (1/2-cup) servings, 85 calories per cup.

title: Cheese Spread
steps: Mix well and refrigerate.
Spread on crackers.

title: Mock Apple Rings

ingredients.name: cucumber and in ring
ingredients.raw: 7 lb. large cucumbers, peeled, seeded and cut in rings

ingredients.name: cinnamon red hot
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 1/2 oz.) pkg. cinnamon red hots (1/3 c.)

steps: Soak cucumbers in lime water overnight.
Wash 3 times and soak for 3 hours in cold water.
Drain.

title: Oven Fried Sesame Chicken
steps: Combine sesame seed, flour and pepper.
Dip chicken parts in soy sauce and dredge in sesame seed mixture.
Arrange in baking dish; drizzle with melted margarine.
Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Chocolate Dip
steps: Break chocolate into a bowl, heat some water in the saucepan over a low heat, until it just begins to bubble.
Keeping the heat on low, place the bowl over the saucepan.
Stir the chocolate with a wooden spoon until it completely melts.
Turn off the heat. Very carefully move the saucepan and the bowl from the stove to a mat or dish towel.

title: Sweet Apple Bucket

ingredients.name: each cortland golden deliciou
ingredients.raw: 10 each: Cortland, Golden Delicious or McIntosh apples, peeled, cored and sliced (11 c.)

steps: Place sliced apples in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Cut in egg with pastry blender until crumbly.
Sprinkle mixture over apples.
Pour melted butter over top, then sprinkle lightly with cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Rabbit Divan
steps: Cook broccoli partially according to package directions; drain. Layer broccoli and rabbit in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine mushroom soup, mayonnaise, milk and lemon juice in bowl; mix well. Pour over layers.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Souffle

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained

steps: Melt margarine.
Blend in flour and salt.
Cook over low heat; stir until smooth and bubbly.
Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk.
Return to heat and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in spinach and onion. Beat Egg Beaters; fold in spinach mixture.
Put in greased casserole.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
steps: Combine soy sauce, honey, oil, garlic and Five Spice powder. Pour over chicken.
Marinate 4 hours.
Remove wings and place on a broiler rack.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes, turning and basting every 15 minutes.

title: Rice Salad
steps: Combine cream cheese, sugar and mayonnaise until smooth.
Add other ingredients, folding Cool Whip in last.
Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Drop Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening until coarse.
Make a well in center and pour all the milk.
Stir until barely damp.
Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Baked Oatmeal

ingredients.name: oatmeal quick not old fashioned
ingredients.raw: 3 Cup oatmeal- quick not old fashioned

steps: Mix egg with the milk then add the remaining ingredients. Spread in well greased loaf pan.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Serve with milk.
Keep remaining loaf in refrigerator.
Heat slices if desired in microwave.

title: Bleu Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: hidden valley dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 package Hidden Valley Dressing Mix (original DRESSING recipe or buttermilk recipe)

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1 cup Mayonnaise (Do not substitute salad dressing or Miracle Whip)

steps: Mix first ingredients with mixer.
Add bleu cheese and mix on slow to stir in.
Great with fries, wings, and terrific on baked potatoes.
ENJOY!

title: Southern Greens

ingredients.name: green stem
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. fresh greens (collards, mustard, kale), large stems trimmed

steps: Soak greens in several changes of cold water; drain.
Transfer to a large saucepot; cover and cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally until stems are just tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain and cool slightly; coarsely chop.
Add salt pork to large skillet and cook over medium heat until crisp, about 5 minutes.
Add pepper flakes and salt.
Stir in chopped greens; cover and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
Makes 5 cups.

title: Guacamole Dip
steps: Peel and mash avocados.
Add salt and lemon juice.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce, garlic, pepper and onion.
Add hot pepper, if desired, and onion seasoning to taste.
Serve with crackers. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Country-Style Baked Ham

ingredients.name: alaga syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Alaga syrup (heavy cane syrup, do not substitute)

ingredients.name: beef tenderloin
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. beef tenderloin or round steak, cut in bite size pieces

steps: Combine the red pepper, garlic powder and seasoned salt in a shallow bowl.
Add the beef and mix with hands to coat each piece. Preheat the broiler (in the bottom of the stove) or prepare the barbecue grill so that you have hot coals.
Thread the meat, alternating with onions, onto 12-inch skewers.
Broil in the oven for 4 to 5 minutes or until the meat is tender.
Cook on the grill, on all sides, until the meat is tender.

title: Pie Crust - Easy - Never Fail
steps: Crumble ingredients with pie blender. Beat 1 egg in cup and finish filling cup with ice water.
Mix all together.
Roll into crust.
Makes 2 (2-crust) pies or 4 single or 8 apple dumplings. Crust freezes well.

title: Nicole'S Nachos
steps: In saucepan combine soup and salsa.
Heat thoroughly over low heat, stirring often.
Serve over tortilla chips.
Top with tomato, green onions and pepper.

title: Holiday Jello Mold
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
When jello becomes syrupy, add sour cream, cherries, crushed pineapple with juice and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Refresh Scents
steps: Mix cinnamon stick, cloves, extract and dried flowers.
Add orange rind.
Place in container.
Can use sense pleasers in baskets, Mason jar, big brandy snifter or whatever fits your environment.

title: Rainbow Punch

ingredients.name: carton orange
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) carton orange or lime sherbet

steps: Boil sugar and water for 3 minutes.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
Mix water mixture, juices, extract and ginger ale. Stir until mixed.
Add sherbet.
Serves 25.

title: Champagne Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients together except the champagne.
Sweeten to taste if you want.
Just before serving add the champagne and ice.

title: Sand Tarts
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add other ingredients in given order. Roll into 48 to 50 balls and place onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
Roll in white or colored confectioners sugar.

title: Apple Mystery
steps: Mix and sift first 6 ingredients.
Stir in unbeaten eggs and vanilla. Fold in apples and walnuts.
Turn into well greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until brown and crusty.
Serve warm or cold with topping or ice cream.

title: Flannel Pancakes
steps: Measure and sift dry ingredients together.
Beat egg yolks and add milk.
Pour milk mixture slowly into dry ingredients; beat thoroughly.
Add melted butter, then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake on hot griddle.
Makes about 12 medium sized cakes.

title: Fudge Swirl Toffee Pie

ingredients.name: container whipped with real cream
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. container whipped topping with real cream

steps: Melt chips; mix in milk, cream cheese and brown sugar.
Spread in pie crust.
Spread Marshmallow Creme on top and swirl around with knife.
Top with whipped cream and almond.
Chill until set.

title: Baked Chicken In Rice

ingredients.name: skinned chicken
ingredients.raw: skinned chicken or 6 filet breasts, cut up

ingredients.name: cream of celery
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup

ingredients.name: salt pepper and paprika
ingredients.raw: dash of salt, pepper and paprika

steps: Mix chicken, soup and water.
Add salt, pepper and paprika. Bake at 375° to 400° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Last 10 minutes, add rice.
Make sure there's at least 1 cup of liquid left so the rice looks soupy.

title: Chocolate Layer Dessert
steps: Mix flour, nuts and margarine together and pat in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip together and pour over crust.
Mix puddings and milk and pour over cream cheese mixture.
Top with Cool Whip and nuts.
Refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa.
In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Alternate, adding dry ingredients, eggs and milk.
Add vanilla.
Bake at 350° in well-greased tube pan for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: German Shepherd Pie
steps: Saute onion in butter (soft not brown).
Add meat, spices and gravy.
Place in casserole; top with mashed potatoes and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

title: Nita'S Special Corn
