title: Moo Goo Gai Pan

ingredients.name: chicken and in
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken, cooked and cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: Use electric skillet set at 450°.
Cook chicken with oil for 10 minutes.
Add broccoli and cook for 5 minutes.
Add bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and mushrooms and heat thoroughly.
Add chicken broth; sprinkle top with garlic powder.
Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 1/2 cup water for thickening.
Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

title: Nacho Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together, except chips.
Simmer over low heat or in a slow cooker.
Serve when mixture is completely warmed.

title: Papaya Salsa & Brie With Tortilla Wedges

ingredients.name: papaya and
ingredients.raw: 3 c. Ripe Papaya, peeled and diced

ingredients.name: kiwi fruit and
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Kiwi Fruit, peeled and diced

ingredients.name: brie
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. Round Brie or 8 oz. En Croute

steps: Cut enough tortillas into wedges (like pie) and bake at 350° for 10 minutes, until crisp, then set aside.
Combine the papaya and the next 6 ingredients.
Set aside.
Place the Brie on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350° until thoroughly heated.
Dip the chips made from the tortillas in the fruity salsa and accompany it with a chunk of warmed cheese.
MMMMMM!!!!!! Serves 16.

title: Cherry Sweetheart Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cherry or other fruit flavor pie filling

steps: Roll thawed dough into a 16 x 8-inch rectangle.
Spread 1/2 cup filling over dough.
Sprinkle sugars over filling.
Drizzle oleo over this. Starting with long edge, roll up jelly roll fashion sealing edges.
Coil dough, seam side down, in greased heart shaped cake pan.
Let rise until doubled.

title: Salmon Cakes
steps: Crumble bread; mix with other ingredients.
Heat cooking oil in skillet until hot.
Drop salmon in spoonfuls into skillet. Cook until golden brown.

title: Quick And Easy Snack
steps: Mix cereals, marshmallows and nuts together.
Melt white chocolate and pour over mixture.
Spoon on wax paper.

title: Barb Taft'S Chocolate Bakeless Cookies

ingredients.name: nestle quik
ingredients.raw: 6 Tbsp. Nestle Quik or 3 Tbsp. cocoa

steps: Bring to boil in a large saucepan the oleo, milk, sugar and salt.
Boil for 1 minute.
Turn off and add oatmeal, vanilla, nuts, Nestle Quik and peanut butter.

title: Corned Beef Congealed Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O and bouillon cube in boiling water.
Let cool. Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and pour into oiled mold (butter or margarine).

title: Bacon-Cheese Cucumber Slices

ingredients.name: bacon crisply and
ingredients.raw: 6 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled

steps: In medium bowl, combine cream cheese, bacon, green onions and Italian seasoning; blend well.
Cut ends from cucumbers.
Using long, thin serrated knife, hollow out inside of each cucumber, removing all seeds.
Using small spoon, firmly fill each cucumber with cream cheese mixture.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Makes 64 slices.

title: Clarabell Hartman'S Banana Refrigerator Dessert
steps: Melt marshmallows in milk in saucepan over medium heat.
Cool, then add vanilla.
Next crush graham crackers and add melted butter.
Mix well.
Pat half of mixture into a square pan.
Put a layer of sliced bananas on top of crumbs.
Add whipped cream to marshmallow mixture.
Put a layer of this mixture over bananas, then a second layer of bananas and a second layer of cream mixture. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Chili Willi Soup
steps: Brown beef in heavy saucepan; drain fat.
Add tomatoes, seasoning mix, water, macaroni and bouillon cube; stir to mix. Simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Ladle into 6 serving bowls; top with toast and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Pickled Okra
steps: Pack okra in pint jars.
Add the next 5 ingredients to each jar.
Boil the remaining ingredients and pour over okra, then seal jars.

title: Cookies To Cut-Out And Frost
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add beaten eggs, milk and mix. Add dry ingredients.
Chill several hours.
Roll out and cut. Bake at 350°.
Makes a lot of cookies.

title: Water Chestnuts(Quick And Easy Appetizer.)
steps: Soak water chestnuts in Worcestershire sauce for several hours.
Wrap in bacon with a chunk of pineapple (use decorative, fireproof toothpick to secure); or roll in barbecue sauce.
Place under broiler until bacon is done.

title: Three Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 onion, sliced or fresh green onion

steps: Combine all veggies in a bowl.
Pour 1/2 bottle Italian dressing.
Chill.

title: Apple Butter Bread
steps: Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon in medium bowl.
Set aside.

title: Dip(Microwave)

ingredients.name: green chili pepper and
ingredients.raw: 1 small can green chili peppers, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: yellow/white cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 or 10 oz.) pkg. yellow/white shredded cheese

steps: Spread cream cheese on glass pie tin.
Pour chili over.
Add onion and peppers. Top with cheese.
Microwave until cheeses melt and chili is heated.

title: Mocha Cake
steps: Grease 2 (9-inch) round layer pans. Dust with cocoa.
Blend all ingredients at low speed.
Put mixer on high and beat 4 minutes.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool layers in pans for 10 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Chili

ingredients.name: tomato puree
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can diced tomatoes in puree

steps: In heavy skillet or saucepan, saute together beef and onions until beef has lost its pinkness.
Cook over low heat.
Add tomatoes, kidney beans and liquid, salt, chili powder and curry powder.
Simmer over moderate heat for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Acini De Pepe

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)

ingredients.name: mandarin orange
ingredients.raw: 2 small cans mandarin oranges, drained (save juice)

steps: In a pot, cook sugar, eggs, flour and salt; mix well.
Add fruit juices.
Bring to a boil.
Cool well.
Cook and strain acini de pepe.
Stir macaroni into cooked custard juices.
Chill overnight.

title: Hawaiian Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 3 whole chicken breasts or 6 breast filets

steps: Wash chicken.
Coat with flour; brown in oil.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: When You Can'T Decide ... Stuffing Or Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes.
Toss with remaining ingredients.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
(Bake in regular casserole dish or baking dish.)

title: Corn Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Refrigerate.
Flavor is best after several hours refrigeration.
If doubling recipe, use only 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise.

title: Microwave Italian Chicken
steps: Dip chicken breasts in egg, then roll in bread crumbs/Parmesan cheese mixture.
Place in microwave-safe baking dish with 1 tablespoon oil.
Cook on High for 2 minutes each side.

title: Crescent Cheese Cake
steps: Beat cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press 1 package crescent rolls on bottom and sides of pan; pour cream cheese mixture over rolls.
Put other package of crescent rolls on top of mixture.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
While still warm, frost with:

title: Orange Tapioca
steps: Cook the first 3 ingredients.
When cooked, add the jello, Kool-Aid and sugar.
When cold, add the cut up oranges and put in the sugar overnight.
Pineapple or fruit cocktail added also makes it good!

title: Peanut Clusters
steps: Melt chocolate chips. Take off heat.
Add milk and peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.
Let harden in cool place.

title: Party Potatoes
steps: Cook potatoes for mashing.
Drain and mash, using ingredients. (May need a little milk for mashed potato consistency.)
Place in casserole and garlic.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Pasta Salad(Use Fat-Free Honey Dijon, Ranch Or Italian Dressing)
steps: Boil pasta until tender.
Drain, cool and put into very large bowl with lid.
Add chopped up onion, frozen peas (do not cook), cucumbers (cut into cubes), green pepper (chopped), 1 head cauliflower, 1 cup celery, 2 cups broccoli and 2 cups carrots.
(I steam my carrots a little.)
Add all this together; mix well. Serve with fat-free crackers and dressing.
Very filling meal. Only fat is maybe a little in pasta.
Lasts all week.

title: Quick Frosting
steps: Melt butter.
Stir in brown sugar.
Cook 1 minute.
Add milk. Stir.
Add vanilla and confectioners sugar to desired thickness. If you get it too thick, add cream or milk.

title: Strawberry Shortbread Shortcake

ingredients.name: whipping cream whipped and
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whipping cream, whipped and sweetened

steps: In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Mix in flour and chocolate.
Form dough into two balls (one slightly larger than the other).
On a floured surface, roll balls into 7-inch circles (one thicker than the other).
Transfer to greased baking sheets. Prick all over with fork.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or just until golden.
Allow to cool 5 minutes; cut thinner circle into eight equal wedges.
Cool on racks.

title: Tuna-Mac Supper

ingredients.name: macaroni and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 1/4 oz.) pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 1/2 or 7 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese dinner
as	directed.
Stir in soup.
Fold
in
tuna.
Pour
into a 9-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with margarine.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Giblet Gravy
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Add flour and salt.
Stir until smooth. Add milk gradually and stir constantly until thickened.
(Makes one cup white sauce.)
Bring chicken broth to a boil, add chopped giblets and eggs.
Add white sauce and cook until thick.

title: Easiest Ever Peach Cobbler
steps: Empty peaches, juice and all in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle cake mix over top.
Dot butter on top of this.
Put nuts on top of this if desired.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Scalloped Chicken
steps: Melt butter; add onions, celery and mangoes.
Cook 5 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Can freeze before baked.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Microwave butter for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
Stir until blended and well melted.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well (I knead with my hands).
Microwave until soft, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan.
Refrigerate.

title: Great Nachos
steps: Layer Doritos, chili and cheese on large plate.
Microwave 7 minutes on High or bake in 350° oven 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
steps: Blend in a blender.
Makes 1 pint.
This is very good heated and used over a spinach salad.

title: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Mix meat, eggs, onion, salt and pepper; shape into small balls.
Drop raw balls into sauce made from remaining ingredients. Gently simmer about 20 minutes until done.
These may be frozen and reheated for later use.
Serve in a chafing dish for party appetizers.

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
steps: Combine all ingredients and simmer; serve hot.
Remove cloves and cinnamon sticks before serving.
Makes a wonderful holiday aroma.

title: Vegetable Sandwiches
steps: Grate
or
finely
chop vegetables.
Squeeze vegetables dry. Add cream cheese and lemon juice.
Spread on thin sliced bread. Cut for party sandwiches.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
steps: Layer green beans and corn.
Mix sour cream, cheese and soup. Pour over vegetables.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Bake at 325° until bubbly and crackers are brown.
Mix chopped onion, celery and green pepper with soup mixture before pouring over vegetables.

title: Sausage Pie(Breakfast)
steps: Cook sausage, salt, pepper and onion together (drain fat off). Add potatoes and mushrooms and cook.
Put into pie crust, add top crust and bake at 350° until crust browns.

title: Syrup Cookies
steps: In large mixing bowl, mix butter and eggs; add syrup.
Mix good.
Add dry ingredients.
Add raisins.
Put in very hot water and stir well. Drop from a spoon onto a well-greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° until done.

title: Lemon Dessert

ingredients.name: lemon pudding and cooled
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. lemon pudding, cooked and cooled

steps: Mix
together margarine, sugar and flour and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan to form a crust.
Bake crust at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Cool.
Spread
cooled
pudding on crust, then top with the
last
ingredients, mixed together.
Cut into squares to serve.

title: Betty'S Dessert
steps: Cream together first 4 ingredients.
Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; add vanilla.
If desired, add 1/2 cup nuts and 1/2 to 3/4 cup chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake Squares

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix without pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (18.5 oz.) box yellow cake mix without pudding

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with cooking spray. Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg until well blended. Pat into prepared pan.
Mix in blender the cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour over first mixture and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: "Sandra'S" Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together with mixer.
Pour in graham cracker crust.
Let chill.

title: Pollo Almendrado(Almond Chicken)

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. chicken pieces (cut up whole chicken or chicken breasts)

ingredients.name: canola oil
ingredients.raw: canola oil for frying (1/2 inch deep)

steps: Toast the almonds in a 300° oven for 25 minutes or until brown; do not burn.
Set aside to cool.
When cool, grind 1/2 cup of almonds in blender until fine.
Chop remaining 1/4 cup coarsely.
Brown chicken pieces in tho hot oil for 10 minutes on each side.
Place chicken in single layer in a shallow glass baking pan.
Combine all other ingredients, including almonds, and pour over chicken.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
Baste several times.
Increase temperature to 350° and bake an additional 10 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
steps: Bake cake according to directions on package in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.

title: Best Ever Kraut Salad
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well.
Heat water, vinegar, oil and sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over kraut mixture and mix well.
Chill.

title: "Mock" Hollandaise
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Let cool briefly; add remaining ingredients.
Heat and serve.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: pineapple in own juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple chunks in own juice

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and
ingredients.raw: 2 half boneless chicken breasts, skinned and cubed

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans, drained

steps: Drain pineapple; reserve 1/4 cup juice.
In a wok or skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Add chicken; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper, if desired.
Stir in reserved juice and red pepper.
Reduce heat uncovered 2 minutes. Add green beans, pineapple and sauce.
Cover and cook until heated through.
Serve over hot cooked rice.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Blender Pancakes
steps: Separate yolks from whites.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
In blender, put yolks, milk, 2 tablespoons oil and flour; beat.
Pour into whites; fold together.
Cook in buttered pan only the first time at 350°.
Pour 1, 1/2 cups of batter into pan.
When formed together, turn.
Serve with butter, powdered sugar and maple syrup.

title: Angel Strawberry Dessert
steps: Dissolve jello in water.
Add strawberries and stir until thawed.
Break cake into egg size pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spoon jello over cake and chill one hour.
Top with Cool Whip and garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Spanish Skillet Rice
steps: In a heavy skillet, cook beef, stirring with a fork, until meat is broken up and has lost its red color.
Stir in onion soup mix, water, rice and tomatoes.
Cover and simmer about 25 minutes or until rice is tender.
Top with grated cheese just before serving.

title: Country Weekend Chowder

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: sweet red
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. diced sweet red or green pepper

steps: In a saucepan, stir soup.
Gradually stir in broth and water. Heat to boiling and add potatoes. Boil 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are done.
Makes about 8 1/2 cups or 6 servings. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Microwave Chocolate Pie
steps: In bowl safe for microwave, mix all dry ingredients, then add 1/2 cup water.
Beat well, then add the other 2 cups water.
Beat again.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Beat again.
It takes about 8 minutes.
Beat after every 2 minutes.
Be sure to stir it good off the bottom.
Beat in oleo and vanilla.
Pour into 9-inch baked pie shell.

title: Taco Pizza

ingredients.name: pizza crust
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. pizza crust (Martha White or other)

steps: Prepare pizza crusts as directed on package and combine into one crust.
Brown hamburger, adding taco seasoning according to package directions; add 1/2 can chilies (to your taste).
Spread pizza sauce on crust.
Layer with hamburger mixture.
Bake until bottom of crust is golden brown.
Add 1/2 of cheese and bake until melted.
To serve, layer with shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes and remaining cheese and chilies.
Serve with taco sauce.

title: Easy Lasagna

ingredients.name: prego traditional spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 large jar Prego traditional spaghetti sauce

steps: Cook noodles.
Brown hamburger and sausage; drain.
Add spaghetti sauce.
Let simmer 1/2 hour.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
steps: Mix Jell-O and cottage cheese.
Add remaining ingredients, one at a time.
Mix well and chill.

title: Tortilla Spirals
steps: Mix the last 6 ingredients.
Spread 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture onto each tortilla.
Spread almost to edges, then roll tortilla tightly and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Chill.

title: Clam Fritters

ingredients.name: clam shucked and fine
ingredients.raw: 25 medium clams, shucked, drained and chopped fine

steps: Combine pancake mix, salt and pepper; set aside.
In another bowl beat egg and add onions.
Mix well.
Stir mixture into dry ingredients.
Add clams.
Stir until smooth.
Drop clam mixture into large cast-iron skillet with hot oil. Fry until golden brown.

title: Crisco Pastry For Double Crust
steps: Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl.
Cut Crisco with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture is fairly coarse. Sprinkle with water.
When it forms a firm ball, pull into 2 parts and roll out on a floured board.
Roll into a circle.
Makes 2 (9-inch) pie crusts.

title: Orange Twisters
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cut or rub in shortening. Add milk to form a soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead 1/2 minute.
Pat or roll out onto an 8-inch square about 1/4-inch thick.
Roll sugar into dough.
Cut into strips about 3/8-inch wide. Double each strip over and twist. Place on baking sheet which has been buttered slightly.
Bake in hot oven at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Orange-Carrot Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the shortening and sugar.
Add egg.
Mix well.
Add carrots and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients; mix well.
Bake for 8 to 12 minutes.
Cool, then frost.

title: Cuneo Rum Cake(1930'S And 1940'S)
steps: Beat eggs, margarine and sugar together until well mixed and fluffy.
Add milk, flour, salt, baking powder and rum extract. Beat well.
Pour in an angel cake pan and bake for 45 minutes at 375°, or 350°.
Cool and remove from pan while its warm.

title: Corn
steps: Cook corn and all ingredients except flour and 1/4 cup water until done on medium heat.
Thicken with flour and 1/4 cup water.

title: Pineapple Horseradish Salad
steps: Cream the cream cheese and salad dressing together until smooth.
Add horseradish and crushed pineapple.
Combine jello and hot water and add to cream cheese mixture.
Let set.
Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Apple Celery Salad

ingredients.name: tart apple pared cored and
ingredients.raw: 3 tart apples, pared, cored and diced

steps: Combine apples, celery and walnuts. Blend together mayonnaise, sugar and allspice, tossing lightly to mix.
Chill and serve.

title: Sweet And Sour Beets
steps: Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan; stir well. Gradually add water, stirring until smooth.
Stir in vinegar and oil; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add beets, salt and pepper and cook until thoroughly heated, about 10 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
steps: Place chicken in casserole.
Add remaining ingredients, except paprika.
Pour over salted chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Lady Bird'S Pecan Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°. In a large bowl, combine the butter and sugar. Gradually add corn syrup, salt and vanilla. Blend thoroughly. Add eggs and gently beat. Fold in pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Place the pecan halves on top of pie for decoration.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until set in middle.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Punch
steps: Put lemonade concentrate, pineapple, strawberries and grenadine in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Combine in punch bowl with ginger ale with crushed ice.

title: Glorified Brownies
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.
Add flour, cocoa and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven. Put small bag of marshmallows on top of brownies.
Let melt, then cool.

title: Onion Patties
steps: Mix together the first 6 ingredients.
Stir in enough cold water for a thick batter.
Mix in the onions and drop by teaspoonfuls in hot oil.
Flatten patties as you turn.
Fry to a golden brown.

title: Homemade Play Dough

ingredients.name: food coloring
ingredients.raw: food coloring (optional) or flavors for smell

steps: Mix all ingredients; cook on medium heat until it pulls away from side of pan (approximately 3 minutes).
Knead.
Store in airtight container.

title: Cottage Cheese Jello Salad
steps: Mix together.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Special Strawberry Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water.
Add pineapple and strawberries.
Chill.
Place 1/2 the mixture into a bowl.
Spread sour cream over mixture that has set.
Add remaining Jell-O mixture and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Drunken Pork Chops
steps: Fry chops until brown on both sides.
Mix beer, ketchup and brown sugar.
Pour over chops and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Watch carefully so burning does not occur or in 9 x 13-inch pan, covered with foil, for 60 minutes.
Last 15 minutes take foil off.

title: Lemony Dill Sauce
steps: In small saucepan, melt butter.
Blend in mayonnaise, egg, lemon juice, water, sugar, bouillon and dill.
Mix well over low heat.
Cook and stir until thickened.
(Do not boil.)
If desired, fold in hard-boiled egg or use to garnish.
Serve over fish. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Kahlua
steps: Mix together coffee, water and sugar and let cool.
Combine with vanilla bean and alcohol in a glass jar or bottle.
Let sit in a dark place at least 4 weeks, the longer it sits, the better it gets.
Shake now and then.
Remove the vanilla bean and store in sealed glass containers.
Enjoy over ice cream or in coffee.

title: Pecan Delight
steps: Beat egg whites until very stiff.
Add sugar.
Fold in Ritz crackers and pecans.
Bake until done.
Cover with Cool Whip and more pecans.

title: Sausage-Spinach Pie

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and drained (you can also use fresh)

steps: Cook sausage meat over medium-heat in skillet until browned, 10 minutes.
Stir often; spoon off fat.
Reserve 1 egg yolk.
In a large bowl, combine remaining eggs, sausage meat, spinach, Mozzarella cheese, Ricotta cheese, salt, pepper and garlic. Prepare pie crust in a 9 or 10-inch pie pan.
Spoon meat mixture into shell.
Roll out top crust and put over filling in pie shell. Make steam vent in top shell.
Brush top with egg yolk and 1 tablespoon water.
Bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours, until golden. Let stand 10 minutes.
Cut.
Great with a salad.

title: Angel Biscuits(Self-Rising Flour)

ingredients.name: yeast cake dissolved in c. warm water
ingredients.raw: 1 yeast cake, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water

steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in Crisco.
Add milk and yeast to make a stiff dough.
Make into biscuits and bake.
Store remainder of dough in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Quick Corn Relish
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to a boil over medium heat.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Remove to a bowl; cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours.
Yield: 2 cups.

title: Raspberry-Nut Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Fold in frozen berries; add pineapple and nuts.
Pour in bowl and refrigerate.

title: "Cobbler Pie"
steps: Melt margarine in an 11 x 13-inch deep baking pan.
Beat flour, sugar and milk.
Pour over margarine in pan.
Heat fresh peaches with water to bubbling.
Pour over mixture in pan.
Do not stir!
Bake in 350° oven until slightly browned on top, about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Almond Crust
steps: Press onto the bottom and 1/3 up sides of 10-inch fluted tube pan.
Chill.

title: Marty'S Buttercream Frosting
steps: Beat 5 minutes, scraping sides often.
If loose, add a little more Crisco and beat well.

title: Dressing For Fruit Salad
steps: Beat eggs in boiler.
Add sugar, salt, margarine, fruit juice and flour.
Cook until thick, stirring constantly; when ready to serve, whip the cream and stir into mixture.
Use over mixed fruit.
This makes a quart and will keep a week in the refrigerator.
Can also be used as a dip for fruit.

title: Ida Mccolly'S Orange Drop Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs, milk and orange juice and rind.
Mix baking soda and baking powder in with flour.
Add flour mixture to wet ingredients a third at a time.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Hearty Tuna Salad

ingredients.name: italian green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Italian green beans or regular

ingredients.name: tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 1/2 or 7 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Cook beans, drain and cool.
Combine beans, flaked tuna, sliced celery, mayo, lemon juice, soy sauce and garlic powder. Chill.
Before serving, add chow mein noodles to tuna mixture. Toss lightly.
Serve in lettuce cups.

title: Noodle Nests
steps: Heat chocolate frosting over low heat and stir until liquid. Remove from heat and stir in chow mein noodles.
Drop by 1/4 cupfuls onto wax paper.
Press the centers in with a spoon to form nests.
Add jelly bean eggs and let set until firm.

title: Candied Dill Pickles

ingredients.name: dill pickle
ingredients.raw: 1 (32 oz.) jar dill pickle slices or quarters

steps: Pour brine off dill pickles and use for another purpose. Leave pickles in the jar.
Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan.
Heat until sugar dissolves.
Pour mixture over pickles and seal jar.
Refrigerate 2 days before serving.

title: Eight Layer Taco Dip Appetizer

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small can jalapeno peppers, finely chopped (green chile peppers)

ingredients.name: black olive
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can pitted black olives, chopped

steps: In blender or food processor, process beans to a paste consistency.
In a shallow serving dish with a rim, layer the ingredients as follows:
beans, sour cream, avocado dip, cheese, peppers, olives, scallions and tomatoes.
Serve with taco chips.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
steps: Wash and remove stems from berries; drain well, set aside. Sift flour and sugar together.
Combine eggs, milk, and oil. Gradually add to dry ingredients.
Stir only until coated with batter.
Pour onto a hot lightly greased griddle.
Cook until surface is covered with bubbles.
Turn and cook until bottom is brown.

title: Sugar-Free - Applesauce Raisin Muffins
steps: Beat together egg, oil and applesauce.
Add flour, baking soda, baking powder and spices; beat well.
Stir in raisins.
Put batter in oiled, floured muffin pans.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 375° oven.
Good topped with cream cheese.

title: White Fruit Salad
steps: Mix fruit together in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat real whipping cream and sugar to sweeten until fluffy.
Fold into prepared fruit and serve.

title: Cheese Grits
steps: Slice or tear cheese into small pieces.
Bring salted water to boil; slowly add grits.
Bring to second boil, reduce heat and cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring.
Add cheese and butter to grits, stirring until cheese melts.
Pour into ungreased casserole.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Squash Cake
steps: Mix oil, sugar and eggs, one at a time, with a mixer.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and cinnamon.
Add zucchini.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: One-Dish Meal
steps: Saute onion in oleo.
Add meat and brown.
Add tomato sauce, corn and chili powder to taste.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti.
Cover with cheese and place in oven until cheese melts.

title: Country Fruit Bread

ingredients.name: each salt soda baking powder and cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon

steps: Beat eggs until thick. Add oil and sugar.
Stir in cottage cheese, fruit and sifted dry ingredients. Mix well.
Spoon into two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Fire Pickles
steps: Mix until sugar melts.
Spoon into containers.

title: Ribbon Fantasy Fudge
steps: In a heavy saucepan, combine sugar, butter and milk; bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Boil for 4 minutes over medium heat, stirring to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Divide marshmallow cream into two heat-resistant bowls. Add chocolate chips and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla to one bowl and peanut butter and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla to the other.
Pour half of sugar mixture into each bowl.
Stir chocolate mixture until smooth and pour into a greased 9-inch pan; stir peanut butter mixture and carefully pour over chocolate layer.
Refrigerate.
Cut into squares.

title: Marie Deal'S Buffalo Wings
steps: Arrange the chicken in a baking dish.
Heat marinade ingredients.
Cool slightly; pour over wings.
Bake at 325° for at least 1 1/2 hours, turning frequently.
The secret is in slow baking.

title: Caramel Nut Ring
steps: Grease pan with the butter.
Put marmalade in pan.
Sprinkle nuts around.
Dip biscuits in butter and then in sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes (no longer) and then invert on plate.
Let stand overnight to caramelize.

title: Wet Burrito
steps: Brown meat and drain.
Place made burritos in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
You can layer if you want.
Pour evaporated milk over them. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°, covered with foil.
Done when hot and bubbly.

title: Kookie Brittle
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine butter, vanilla and salt in bowl and blend well.
Gradually beat in brown sugar.
Add flour and chocolate chips; mix well.
Press evenly into ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle nuts over top.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Cool, then break in irregular pieces and drain on absorbent paper.
Yields 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie

ingredients.name: container cool whip
ingredients.raw: 1 small container Cool Whip or whipped topping of choice

steps: Beat egg whites until very stiff.
Combine all the ingredients together.
Put in 8-inch pie pan.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Mary Lee'S Pecan Pie
steps: Place nuts in empty pie shell.
Pour remaining ingredients, which have been mixed together, over nuts.
Bake at 350° for approximately 55 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies

ingredients.name: peanut butter
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 or 12 oz.) pkg. peanut butter chips

steps: Stir together flour, cocoa and baking soda.
In large mixing bowl, beat Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Gradually add flour mixture, beating well. Stir in peanut butter chips.
Cool completely.
(Works well to cool overnight in the fridge.)

title: Meatballs Lasagna Style
steps: Combine meat, egg, onion and pepper.
Make 1-inch balls. Place in greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Spoon cottage cheese around meatballs.
Pour sauce over all; sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, or until done.

title: Gram'S Sand Tarts
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and sugar.
Rub in butter with a pastry blender.
Mix in beaten eggs and mix with your hands until blended.
Roll into the size of cookies you desire.
Wrap in wax paper and put in refrigerator overnight.
Next morning, slice thin and bake 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Ritz Cracker Casserole

ingredients.name: veg all
ingredients.raw: 1 large can Veg-All or substitute veggies (we like stir-fry oriental veggies)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom, chicken or celery soup

steps: Crunch one roll of Ritz crackers and cover bottom of casserole dish.
Mix all other ingredients and spread on top of crackers. Crunch second roll of Ritz crackers and use for topping.
Place small amounts of butter on top if desired.
Vary quantities of ingredients to suit personal tastes.
Bake at 325° until cheese melts, approximately 25 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni; drain.
Combine macaroni, corned beef, cheese, soup and milk.
Turn into greased 2-quart casserole.
Toss cubed bread and butter.
Arrange on top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Set 10 minutes.

title: Crouton Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast half in
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (about 1 lb.), cut in small pieces (1-inch)

ingredients.name: any condensed cream soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can any condensed cream soup (chicken, broccoli, mushroom, celery, etc.)

steps: Put chicken pieces into baking dish with cream soup, milk, salt, pepper and sherry.
Cook for about 1/2 hour with foil in 375° oven.
Top with cheese and croutons.
Cook another 15 minutes.

title: Mom'S Butterscotch Refrigerator Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add baking powder to flour.
Stir, then slowly mix into other ingredients. Fold in pecans.
Make into a roll and wrap in waxed paper.
Chill in refrigerator overnight.
Slice thin and bake at 375° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Marinade For Beef
steps: For marinade, combine all ingredients.
Pour over beef and marinate overnight.
Cook beef on grill, using marinade as a basting sauce.

title: Country Oatmeal Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine sugar, butter and syrup.
Stir in eggs, vanilla and oats.
Mix well. Pour into pie shell.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
Cool. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Taco  Soup
steps: Brown and drain ground meat.
Mix in taco kit, and ranch dressing.
Add all canned ingredients and water.
Simmer about 1 hour.

title: Whippy Frosting
steps: Cook flour and milk until thick, stirring constantly. Let cool and add remaining ingredients.
Beat until smooth.

title: Corned Beef Egg Patties
steps: About 30 minutes before serving:
In medium bowl, mix well corned beef, celery, green onions, one egg and salt.
With hands, firmly shape mixture into 4 patties.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Divan

ingredients.name: broccoli pear
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into spears or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked

ingredients.name: campbell s condensed cream of broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's condensed cream of broccoli or cream of chicken soup

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In a 9-inch pie plate, arrange broccoli; top with chicken.
In a small bowl, combine soup and milk; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over cheese.
Bake 15 minutes or until hot and bubbling.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream(Very Smooth)
steps: In blender, mix Eagle Brand milk, condensed milk, whipping cream, half and half and egg yolks until smooth.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold egg whites with blender mixture.
Add fruit, slowly blending in.
Pour in ice cream mixer and process according to directions.
If mixture does not come to fill line in mixer, add half and half to fill line.

title: Garlic Cheese Grits

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper and salt
ingredients.raw: cayenne pepper and salt to taste

steps: Cook grits in water.
Salt to taste and add all other ingredients except sharp cheese and paprika.
Pour into greased baking dish and bake 45 minutes in 300° oven.
Remove from oven and sprinkle top with 1/4 to 1/2 cup grated sharp cheese and paprika.
Return to oven and bake 15 minutes.
Casserole can be prepared ahead and baked an hour before serving.
Also heats well.

title: Garbanzo Bean Dip

ingredients.name: chickpea bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 to 16 oz.) can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Combine ingredients in a blender or processor and process until smooth.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
Serve with tortilla chips or use as a sandwich spread.

title: Baked Beef And Chicken

ingredients.name: bacon in half
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 pieces bacon, cut in half

steps: Use 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Line with the dried beef.
Place chicken on top.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Wrap chicken in bacon. Pour soup and sour cream mixture over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Corned Beef Salad
steps: Mash corned beef; add enough mayonnaise to moisten, then add rest of ingredients and mix with fork.
You may add or take away to please your taste.

title: Yummy Creamed Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. chicken broth or bouillon and water to equal this

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 cans chunk chicken or 1 c. cut up chicken

steps: Melt butter; blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Cook over low heat until bubbly.
Remove from heat and stir in broth and milk. Bring to boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gently stir in chicken.
Serve over hot biscuits and/or mashed potatoes.

title: Chicken Stuffing Bake
steps: Pour butter and broth over croutons.
Toss and stir.
Press in bottom and sides of 8 x 8 or 9-inch baking dish.
Combine soup, chicken, milk and peas.
Pour into stuffing shell.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with crushed potato chips.
Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Crab And Shrimp Spread
steps: Cream the cheese until smooth.
Add milk, onion and spices. Stir in crabmeat and shrimp.
Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 25 minutes or microwave for 6 minutes on High (until hot and bubbly).
Serve with crackers or bagel chips. Serves approximately 20.

title: Special Pecan Pie
steps: Combine sugar and flour in a medium bowl.
Combine corn syrup, eggs and butter; add to sugar mixture.
Stir well.
Add vanilla and pecans; mix well.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes, or until set.

title: Railroad Pie

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; drain well.
Combine remaining filling ingredients with meat mixture and pour into a 2-quart greased casserole.

title: Congealed Apple-Nut Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Sprinkle lemon juice over apples.
Add cold water, celery, apples and pecans to the gelatin. Chill until firm.
Serves 6.

title: Uncle Tom'S French Toast
steps: Mix eggs, milk and vanilla.
Dip one piece of bread in mixture, one piece at a time until all the mixture is used up.
Put in a heated skillet with butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
When brown, turn over and sprinkle the other side with cinnamon.
Serve with maple syrup.

title: Old Fashion Pineapple Salad
steps: Beat egg, flour and sugar.
Add juice of pineapple and cook. Let cool and add pineapple and 15-20 marshmallows.

title: Polka Dot Slaw
steps: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.
Stir gently to mix. Chill 1 to 2 hours before serving.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients except orange slices.
Place in a greased baking dish.
Place orange slice on top of pudding.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until slightly brown around the edges.

title: Impossible Quiche
steps: Heat
oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onions evenly over pie pan.
Place remaining ingredients
in blender on high speed for 1 minute.
Pour over bacon,
cheese
and
onions; bake until golden brown, 50 to 55 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Scoby'S Creamed Corn
steps: Mix all ingredients except cream and butter; simmer 20 minutes.
Add cream and butter last.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 2 1/4 c. light brown sugar, packed firmly

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease large cookie sheet (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
In large saucepan, melt butter and stir in brown sugar; cool 10 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Stir in flour mixture and chocolate pieces.
Blend well and spread in pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
steps: Mix oil, chocolate and sugar.
Blend in eggs, one at a time, until well mixed.
Add vanilla.
Stir in salt, flour and baking powder.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Drop teaspoonful of dough into 10x sugar.
Shape into ball.
Place about 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°. Makes about 50.

title: Oatmeal Pie
steps: Mix together and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes or until set.

title: Banana Bran Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In small bowl, combine the flours, sugar and baking powder.
In large bowl, mix cereal, milk and bananas.
Let stand 1 to 2 minutes.
Add egg and oil to cereal mixture and beat well with a spoon.
Stir in flour mixture until just combined.
Spoon into greased muffin tins or use paper. Makes 12 to 20 muffins.
Bake about 12 minutes.

title: Quick Chili

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and chilies

steps: Brown beef and add onions.
When onions are sauteed, add the Ro-Tel and beans.
Cook 30 minutes or until ready to serve.

title: Macaroni, Spaghetti, Etc.(Microwave)
steps: In a 3-quart casserole mix water and salt.
Bring to boil (6 to 8 minutes).
Add pasta and stir.
On Full power heat 15 minutes or until completely cooked.
Drain in colander.

title: Mexican Salsa
steps: Cut pepper up with scissors (seeds and all).
Dice onion, dice tomato, chop fresh cilantro and squeeze lime into mixture; stir. Hot and good.
Serve fresh with any Mexican dish.

title: Deviled Rice-Meat
steps: In a pot, lightly brown onion in oil.
Add meat and sprinkle with paprika and salt.
Cover pot, stirring frequently.
Stew the meat until tender, then add rice and mix well.
Add hot water to cover.
Slowly boil in covered pot until soup boils away and rice becomes soft.

title: Pico De Gallo(Hot)
steps: Combine peppers, onions, tomatoes and cilantro.
Squeeze the juice of all 4 lemons on mixture.
Add water and mix well.
If you want it hotter, add 5 to 6 Serrano peppers, chopped real fine. Then drink plenty of water or eat ice cream to cool off.
Enjoy!

title: Tropical Dessert
steps: Boil sugar and water for 5 minutes; cool.
Cut up bananas; cover with juice of lemons.
Add oranges, crushed pineapple and fruit cocktail with juice.
Pour in 13 x 9-inch pan and freeze. Cut in cubes; put in a tall glass and cover with 7-Up or ginger ale, if desired.

title: Sugar Roasted Pecans
steps: Mix egg white and water with a fork or whisk.
Add sugar, salt and spices.
Mix.
Dip pecan halves.
Lay face down on a buttered sheet.
Bake at 250° for 50 minutes.

title: Jiffy Stroganoff

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Brown meat, vegetables and seasoning.
Make sauce of soup and sour cream.
Stir into meat mixture and heat through.
Serve over hot noodles.

title: Coconut Pecan Topping
steps: In medium saucepan, combine sugar, milk, egg yolks and margarine.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Stir in coconut, pecans and vanilla. Cool 15 minutes and spread on top layers of German chocolate cake.

title: Mini Morsel Pound Cake
steps: Beat cream mixture together and add 1 egg at a time, ending with flour mixture.
Fold in mini morsels, then pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 70 to 80 minutes.
When done, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Apple Spice Custard Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed on box.
Add apples; mix well. Bake in a greased pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Or Coconut Pies

ingredients.name: egg yolk
ingredients.raw: 5 egg yolks (save egg whites for meringue)

steps: Mix milk and egg yolks well.
Add margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Add dry ingredients.
Cook until thick.
Remove from stove.
Beat well.
Add vanilla and coconut or cocoa depending on kind of pie.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Bar
steps: Mix and spread in pan and sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into bars.
It's a favorite at the high school.

title: Sour-Cream Raisin Pie
steps: Cook sugar, sour cream, flour, cornstarch and eggs until thick.
Put vanilla and raisins into mixture.
Mix all together. Put in a baked pie crust.

title: Crock Pot Venison Roast
steps: Soak the roast in milk overnight.
This removes the blood which gives the venison a strong wild taste and also tenderizers the meat.
Wash well and pat dry.
Stuff with garlic and season with salt and pepper.
Brown in a pot on top of the stove in 1/3 cup of oil until the meat is reddish brown.
Remove the roast. Add 1 cup of water in the pot and bring to gentle boil.
Scrape the drippings from the bottom of the pot. Boil until drippings are dissolved.
In a small bowl, make a thin paste with 3 tablespoons flour and 1 cup of water.
Slowly add to liquid already in pot. When well blended together, transfer roast and liquids to a crock pot.
Cook on low setting for about 8 hours.

title: Water Chestnuts With Bacon
steps: Wrap 1/2 slice bacon around each water chestnut; fasten with toothpick.
Place water chestnuts in oven-proof dish; brush with mixture of soy sauce and sherry.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Yields about 20.

title: Spicy Beef Ball

ingredients.name: corned beef
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. thinly sliced corned beef or pastrami, finely chopped

steps: Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Stir in onions and mustard, horseradish and garlic salt.
Stir in meat.
Shape into a 4-inch ball.
Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours.
Serve with thinly sliced pumpernickel or party rye bread.
Yields 2 cups.

title: Fried Apples
steps: Melt butter.
Add apples.
Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples.
Cover and cook over medium heat.
Stir to prevent sticking.
Cool until soft.

title: Herbal Mustard
steps: Mix mustard, flour and spices.
Mix vinegar, warm water and honey.
Combine; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 2 minutes.
Pack into clean jars.
Press out any air pockets.
Store in cool place.
To keep fresh, add a slice of lemon on top.

title: Chicken With Zucchini

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.raw: 2 medium zucchini (1/2 lb.), cut into thin strips

ingredients.name: basil leaf
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. thinly sliced fresh basil leaves

steps: Sprinkle both sides of chicken with 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper.
In a large, nonstick pan, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat.
Cook 2 chicken cutlets 5 to 7 minutes or until cooked through, turning once.
Remove chicken to a large serving platter.
Keep warm.
Repeat with the rest of chicken.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
steps: Rinse chiles; remove seeds and place 1/2 of the chiles in a layer in a greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with half of both cheeses; add remaining chiles and top with remaining cheese.
Beat eggs, flour, milk and salt together until smooth.
Pour over chili-cheese layers.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Perfect Meringue
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Place egg whites in mixing bowl (don't use plastic).
Add cream of tartar.
Beat at low speed until foamy.
Add sugar, a little at a time, beating at medium high speed until soft peaks form.
Spoon mounds of meringue around outer edge of pie filling.
Spread carefully around edge, being certain that meringue touches inner edge of crust.
Spoon remaining meringue over center of filling; spread to border.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, or until peaks are golden brown.
Cool pie on wire rack.

title: Fudge Brownies
steps: Mix cocoa and butter.
Stir in sugar.
Blend in eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Stir in flour and nuts.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Pie Crust
steps: Mix dry ingredients until well blended.
Beat egg, vinegar and water in large bowl.
Add dry ingredients all at once.
Mix with large fork.
Divide and roll out on floured board.
Makes 2 (9-inch) single or 1 double crust.

title: Miniature Ham And Cheese Rolls
steps: Do not break rolls apart but slice lengthwise through center. Layer ham and cheese between layers of bread.
Replace rolls in foil tray.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over rolls.
Leave uncovered until butter sets; cover with foil.
Bake, covered, 15 minutes at 350°.
Rolls can be refrigerated 24 hours or frozen until ready for baking.
After baking, cut into pieces.
Makes 24 servings.

title: Lemon Cream Dessert
steps: Mix flour and oleo as making a pie crust.
Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese and sugar, then add Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Mix pudding mix, milk and lemon juice until thick.
Spread over cream cheese mixture.
Spread leftover Cool Whip over top and sprinkle with chopped nuts.
Chill.
Serves 16.

title: Quick Chocolate Dessert
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, water and oleo in pan.
Bring to boil and turn off heat.
Add vanilla.
Pinch off pieces of the biscuits one at a time and dip in mixture and put in Bundt pan.
Pour rest of mixture over biscuits and bake at 350° until done.

title: Rocky Roads Candy
steps: In top of a double boiler heat milk and chocolate morsels as well as butter.
Remove from heat.
In a large bowl, combine nuts and marshmallows.
Fold in chocolate mixture.
Drop from a teaspoon onto wax lined baking sheet.

title: Strawberry Dessert
steps: Melt margarine.
Combine 1 cup pecans and 1 cup of flour. Spread in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Angel Food Cake Dessert

ingredients.name: angel food cake layer
ingredients.raw: 1 angel food cake, cut into 3 layers

steps: Line deep bowl with wax paper.
Set in 1 layer of cake into bowl.
Set tall glass in center hole of cake.
Pour slightly jelled lime jello/pineapple mixture (prepared as directed) into bowl.
Let jell a few minutes.
Put second layer of cake in bowl. Pour slightly jelled strawberry/strawberries mixture (prepared as directed) over second layer.
Let set a few minutes again.
Set third layer of cake on top.
Cover with wax paper.

title: Texas Barbecue Beef
steps: Combine all ingredients (except roast) in a bowl and mix.
Put chuck roast in large roasting pan and cover roast with the mix. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Put in a 275° oven, roast up to 8 to 12 hours.
It is done when meat is very tender and shreds easily.

title: Passion Fruit Chiffon Pie
steps: Beat egg yolks until thick.
Add 1/2 cup of the sugar, salt and juice.
Cook until thick, beating constantly.
Soften gelatin in cold water; add to egg yolk mixture and stir until dissolved. Add rind and cool.
Beat egg whites until stiff, gradually beating in the remaining 1/2 cup sugar.
Fold egg yolk mixture into stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into baked pastry shell; chill until firm.
Serve with whipped cream.

title: Double Cheddar Sauce

ingredients.name: pouch campbell s cheddar cheese soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pouch Campbell's Cheddar cheese soup mix

steps: In 2-quart saucepan, whisk 1/2 cup of the water into soup mix until smooth.

Gradually add remaining 1 cup water, mixing well. Over medium-high heat, heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, 2 minutes, stirring often. Stir in cheese until melted.
Serve sauce over French fries or vegetables.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Williamsburg

ingredients.name: cream soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 2 cans creamed soup, undiluted (mushroom, chicken or celery)

steps: Mix all ingredients together and place in a casserole. Sprinkle top with crushed potato chips.
Heat in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Crouton Salad
steps: Make dressing of mayonnaise, lemon juice, cheese and garlic. Chill.
Toss croutons in butter over low heat until golden brown. Drain.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
steps: Wash rice and mix with milk, salt, sugar, lemon rind, nutmeg and raisins.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake in slow oven at 325° for 2 1/2 hours, stirring 3 times during the first hour of baking.
If desired, stir in eggs 30 minutes before pudding is removed from oven.

title: Las Palmas Turkey Enchiladas

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese divided sage
ingredients.raw: 3 c. (12 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided usage

ingredients.name: las palma green chile enchilada sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (19 oz.) can Las Palmas green chile enchilada sauce

steps: In small bowl, combine turkey, 2 cups of cheese, green chiles and onion.
In small skillet, bring enchilada sauce to a boil; remove from heat.
Dip each tortilla into heated sauce to soften. Spoon 1/3 cup of turkey mixture and 2 tablespoons of sour cream down center of each tortilla.
Roll.
Place tortillas seam side down in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Pour remaining heated enchilada sauce over top.
Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
steps: Combine pretzels,
margarine
and
2 tablespoons sugar. Pat into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 8 minutes at 400°. Combine Jell-O in water; add strawberries and stir well.
Cool until soft set.

title: Irish Cream
steps: In another bowl, blend 1/2 pint heavy cream or half and half with a dash of sugar.
Fold whipped cream into base liquid and blend just for a minute.
(Refrigerate 24 hours.)

title: No Fail Meringue For Pies
steps: Beat egg whites and cold water until stiff.
Add sugar, baking powder and salt. Beat again until stiff.
Cover pie filling, piling high in the center and sealing over filling to edge of pie crust.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, until delicately browned.

title: Fillet Of Chicken
steps: Flour the fillet of chicken with the cornstarch.
Add salt and pepper.
Heat oil with butter in a frying pan on medium-high heat. Brown each side of the fillets for 5 minutes.
Place them on a plate.
Empty the cream in the pan, scraping the bottom with a spatula to recover the juices.
Let it heat without boiling.
Add the parsley.
Taste for flavor.
Then pour over the fillets.
Serve hot.

title: Elephant Cookies
steps: Mix butter or margarine and brown sugar in a large bowl until smooth and creamy.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.
Mix well.
Add flour mixture, eggs and vanilla to sugar mixture.
Mix well.
Add peanut butter.
Place by teaspoonfuls several inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Old-Fashioned Shortcake
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Sift flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt into large bowl.
Cut butter into flour mixture until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal.
Make well in center of mixture.
Pour in milk all at once.
Mix quickly with fork (just to moisten flour).
Turn into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Greco
steps: Brown ground beef.
Add onion and green pepper. Add can of mushrooms.
Cook macaroni as directed, then drain and add to meat mixture.
Add tomato sauce and corn.
Mix well and place in a 2-quart casserole.
Cover with shredded cheese.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Serves 6 generously.

title: Shrimp (Stir-Fry) Sauce
steps: Combine mayonnaise and ketchup.
Add paprika and garlic salt to taste.
Add milk until reaches desired consistency.
May add a touch of sugar.

title: Apple-Carrot Casserole
steps: Cook carrots
until tender.
Combine with apples, sugar and lemon juice in buttered casserole.	Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Taco Bake

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided

ingredients.name: shell macaroni and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. shell macaroni, cooked and drained

steps: In a skillet, brown ground beef and onion over medium heat; drain.
Add water, taco seasoning and tomato sauce; mix.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in macaroni, chilies and 1 1/2 cups cheese.
Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Broccoli Soup
steps: Cook broccoli in chicken broth for about 5 minutes.
Saute onions in butter.
Mix flour in milk.
Mix all ingredients except cheese.
Stir over medium heat until smooth.
Add cheese; when melted, serve.

title: Parsley Tea(A Natural Dietary Diuretic And Good Too!)

ingredients.name: tea bag
ingredients.raw: 2 tea bags or 2 Tbsp. instant tea (decaffeinated if possible)

steps: Simmer parsley in water
10 minutes; strain into pitcher.

title: Pork And Bean Soup

ingredients.name: campbell s pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 large can Campbell's pork and beans

ingredients.name: and half cream
ingredients.raw: half and half cream or milk

steps: Peel and slice several potatoes into bite size pieces.
Place into a large saucepan.
Cover with cold water; add salt to taste. Cook until potatoes are done.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: In the given order, put ingredients in saucepan and stir over medium heat until it comes to a boil.
Put into a bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
(I mix my cinnamon and sugar together and then sprinkle it on top of rice pudding.)

title: K.C.'S Broccoli Salad

ingredients.name: bacon and drain off all grease
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled, drain off all grease

steps: Wash broccoli well; pick off leaves and peel outer skin.
Cut florets and chop well.
Cut and chop stem of broccoli and mix with florets.
Wash cauliflower well; pick off leaves.
Use only florets of cauliflower; chop florets and add to broccoli.
Mix in onion and bacon.
Add mayonnaise to broccoli and cauliflower.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and molasses.
Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon and ginger.
Add dry ingredients to first mixture.
Add boiling water.
This will be a very thin batter.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Good with whipped cream or lemon sauce.

title: Ruby Glazed Pork Roast(Serves 6 To 8)

ingredients.name: pork loin roast
ingredients.raw: 1 boneless pork loin roast (3 to 4 lb.)

steps: Place roast in shallow Pyrex baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Pour lemon juice over it and cover. Marinate for 2 to 3 hours or overnight (refrigerated).

Roast pork in 325° oven for 20 minutes per pound with marinade and uncovered. Heat cranberry sauce until melted, add brown sugar and orange juice; simmer until sugar dissolves and mixture thickens slightly. Brush glaze on roast 1/2 hour before it is ready.

title: One Pot Lasagna
steps: Brown ground meat and drain grease.
Add Ragu and water. Bring sauce and meat to a boil.
Add 1 pound noodles.
Let them get soft, then add the other pound.
Cook until noodles are tender.
Add Mozzarella cheese.
Stir until melted.

title: Tortilla Soup

ingredients.name: regular
ingredients.raw: 2 (14 oz.) cans regular or Mexican-style stewed tomatoes

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn (with sweet peppers)

ingredients.name: envelope taco
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (1 1/4 oz.) envelope taco or chili mix

ingredients.name: tostada shell
ingredients.raw: tostada shells, broken or corn chips

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine undrained tomatoes, corn, water and seasoning mix.
Cook over medium heat until boiling, stirring occasionally. Spoon into 4 soup bowls.
Sprinkle with tostada shells or chips and cheese over hot soup.
Let stand about 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
steps: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Triple Good Veggies
steps: Cook vegetables in boiling salted water until tender; drain and pour into greased casserole.
Melt Cheez Whiz with soup and pour over vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Almond Granola Bars

ingredients.name: lightly butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. lightly salted butter or margarine

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 8-inch square baking pan.
Melt butter in large saucepan.
Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar and honey until combined.
Stir in oats and almonds.
When well mixed, press into prepared pan using back of wooden spoon.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from oven and place on wire rack.
Press mixture down again and cut into bars.
When cool, remove bars and store in airtight container at room temperature or wrap and freeze.

title: Lo-Cal Tuna And Fruit Sandwich

ingredients.name: water tuna
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can water packed tuna, drained

ingredients.name: lo cal spicy sweet french dressing
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. lo-cal spicy sweet French dressing

ingredients.name: pineapple in natural juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced pineapple in natural juices

steps: In a small bowl, mix first 3 ingredients.
Place equal amounts on bun halves.
Top with cheese and pineapple slice.
Broil until cheese melts.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Contains 200 calories each.

title: Vanilla Drop Cookies
steps: Measure and sift dry ingredients.
Set aside.
Cream shortening.
Add sugar gradually, beating after each addition. Add beaten eggs.
Stir in dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk and vanilla.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Yield:
about 3 dozen.

title: Deer Chili Pie
steps: Brown deer and onion in frying pan. Drain. While this is cooking, in a large pot, mix all ingredients except cheese and chips.
Let this simmer for about 1/2 hour, then add meat and onion.
Let this simmer for 1/2 hour more. Take 8 to 10 bowls, depending on how many are to be served.
Put corn chips in bottom. Pour chili on top, then put a slice of cheese on. Serve. Leftover chili can be frozen, if desired.

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: white bread crust off all side and roll flat with pin
ingredients.raw: white bread, cut crusts off all sides and roll flat with rolling pin

steps: Spread each slice of bread with cream cheese.
Steam asparagus until bright green; drain and pat dry.
Lay 2 spears, each in opposite direction.
Roll and cut into 3 or 4 pieces.
Place on baking sheet.
Broil until golden.

title: Easy Corn Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender. Process until smooth.
Pour into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (or until set.)

title: Fruit Compote

ingredients.name: very lemon rind
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. very thin lemon rind strips

steps: Blend corn syrup, orange juice, lemon rind and juice in large bowl.
Add fruit; toss to coat well.
Refrigerate, covered, for several hours.

title: Pork Sausage

ingredients.name: pork meat in ready grinding
ingredients.raw: 12 lb. pork meat, cut in pieces, ready for grinding

steps: Sprinkle meat well with the remaining ingredients.
Grind all together and it will need no further mixing.

title: Fruit Smoothies
steps: Put all together in blender.
Mix until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink.

title: Perfect Chicken
steps: Salt and pepper chicken breasts to taste.
Put chicken in 9 x 12-inch dish; sprinkle salt and pepper; mix soups and pour over chicken.
Spread to cover.
Sprinkle onion soup over all; pour water over all.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 8.

title: Orange Breakfast Punch
steps: Combine all the ingredients.
It can be prepared the night before so it's ready to serve first thing in the morning.
It also makes a delicious punch for any occasion.
Makes approximately 2 quarts.

title: Crispy Chocolate Ring

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed

ingredients.name: crisp rice cereal
ingredients.raw: 3 c. crisp rice cereal or corn flakes

steps: Melt butter in medium saucepan.
Add sugar, stirring well. Add peanut butter and chocolate flavor; stir until well blended. Stir in cereal; mix until cereal is well coated.
Pack mixture into well-buttered 8-inch ring mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold by running spatula around inside of mold.
Serve with ice cream balls, if desired.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb mushrooms, thinly sliced or diced

steps: Blanch and peel skin from tomatoes.
Cut out stem and remove pulp.
Cook mushrooms in milk for 3 minutes.
(Use a teflon pan.) Add salt, rosemary, and savory to taste.
Stir into cheese and bread crumbs and fill each tomato with 1/4 of mixture.
Bake 8 minutes in 400 degree oven.
Serve cut side down so filling is a surprise when cut open.

title: No-Bake Pumpkin Pie
steps: In a heavy saucepan, combine gelatin, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Stir in milk and eggs. Mix well and let stand for 1 minute. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until gelatin dissolves and mixture thickens slightly (about 10 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in pumpkin and mix well.
Pour into prepared crust. Chill 3 hours or until set.
Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chicken On A Stick(Serving Size:  4)
steps: Slice boneless chicken breasts in 1/2-inch strips.
Take the wooden sticks and weave alternating chicken and bacon strips until each stick is full.
Mix wine, soy and Worcestershire and place in a container large enough for the filled sticks to lay flat. Season with your favorite mixed seasonings.
If necessary to pile chicken sticks on top of each other, make sure you turn the filled sticks into the marinade so they all get at least 1/2 hour of marination.
Cook over low to medium heated grill or oven at 350° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.
Dip or baste chicken with marinade frequently to prevent drying of meat.
Do not overcook!

title: Basic Mexican Bean Recipe(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)

ingredients.name: pink
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. dried pink or red beans

ingredients.name: very hot lard
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. very hot lard or bacon drippings (about)

steps: Wash beans and soak overnight in water to cover.
The next morning, if necessary, add more water to cover.
Add salt and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until the beans are very tender.

title: Tomato Rice Soup(Yields 1 Quart)
steps: Peel and cut up the tomatoes and cook until they are very soft.
Press through a strainer to get out the juice.
Cook the rice in a large amount of boiling water until it is tender.
Drain all the water off the rice except for about a cupful and add the rice and water to the tomatoes.
Put in the sugar, reheat and serve.

title: Chili-Chicken

ingredients.name: chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. chopped chili pepper (or other peppers)

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 c. cut up cooked chicken

steps: Cook noodles and drain.
Cook onion in margarine in skillet until soft, then stir in soup, pimento and chili pepper.
Grease 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Layer 1/2 noodles, 1/2 the chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Top with half the soup mixture and half the cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8 to 12.

title: German Upside-Down Chocolate Cake
steps: Spread a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Mix nuts and coconut together.
Spread in bottom of pan.
Mix cake mix according to directions.
Pour over coconut and nut mixture.
Mix butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
Spoon over batter and swirl around.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Turn upside-down onto a plate while hot.
Serves 12.

title: Fudge Sauce (Hot Or Cold)(1 Pint)
steps: Heat butter and chocolate over simmering water in double boiler until melted.
Stir in salt, then the sugar in four or five portions, being sure to blend thoroughly.
The mix becomes very thick.
Now stir in milk, very slowly.
Then cook 5 to 6 minutes longer, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Store in refrigerator in a container with tight fitting lid.
To use hot, set jar in warm water for 30 minutes.

title: Light Confetti Appetizer

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix

ingredients.name: assorted vegetable up bite size
ingredients.raw: assorted vegetables, chopped up into bite size chunks (such as broccoli, cauliflower, bell pepper, carrots, onions, etc.)

steps: On cookie sheet, press out flat crescent rolls.
Fill in holes and bake according to directions.
Combine cream cheese, sour cream and dressing mix and spread on cooled bread.
Mix up vegetables and press into mixture. Top with cheese, cut into squares and serve.

title: Shrimp Salad
steps: Mix macaroni, oregano and mayonnaise together.
Fold in shrimp and diced tomatoes.
Sprinkle with barbecue spice, salt and pepper to taste.
Best if allowed to set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: cucumber and
ingredients.raw: 2 large cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: Combine water, vinegar and sugar in a small bowl, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Combine vinegar mixture, cucumber and onion in a shallow 2-quart container.
Stir gently.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve salad with a slotted spoon.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cheese Soup
steps: Cut cheese up and add milk.
Add mushrooms and mixed vegetables (liquid too).
Cook in crock-pot.

title: Stir-Fried Rice

ingredients.name: chicken ground beef pork chop beef
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. chicken, ground beef, pork chop, beef or bacon strips

steps: Put oil in a heavy pan or wok; add meat and vegetables to oil and cook until tender.
Add spices and eggs, then add rice and stir slowly on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Pecan Pies
steps: Combine all but nuts together and set aside.
Place 1 cup nuts on bottom of each of 3 pie crusts.
Pour mixture over nuts divided equally among 3 pies.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
Check for doneness after 1 hour.

title: Hearty Meat Sauce
steps: About 45 minutes before serving, in a 4-quart saucepan or 12-inch skillet over high heat, cook ground beef, onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion is tender, about 10 minutes, stirring often.
Add tomatoes with their liquid and remaining ingredients, stirring to mix well and break up tomatoes over high heat.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.
Makes enough for 16 ounce package of spaghetti.

title: Pepper Sauce
steps: Cook onion in oil and add rest of ingredients.
Add 2 peppers, cut in pieces.
Cook until soft, about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Zucchini And Tomatoes
steps: In a wok fry out bacon; drain and set aside.
Use about 2 tablespoons bacon grease and saute onions until tender and translucent.
Add stewed tomatoes.
Add sugar to cut acid in tomatoes.
Add seasoning.
Slice zucchini in rings.
Add to tomato mixture.
Cover and simmer until tender and done.
Crumble bacon and add right before serving.

title: Never Fail Pie Crusts
steps: Combine flour and salt in bowl.
Cut in shortening until crumbly.
Stir egg mixed with vinegar and 5 tablespoons cold water into flour mixture.
Divide into 4 portions.
Store, tightly wrapped, in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli And Cheddar Soup
steps: Saute broccoli in butter over medium heat until tender. Sprinkle with flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Gradually stir in stock and milk.
Heat just to simmering.
Stir in cream and cheese.
Allow cheese to melt in soup.
Season to taste and serve with croutons.

title: Baked Chicken Viva

ingredients.name: doz. corn tortilla
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 doz. corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips

steps: Bake chicken breasts; bone and shred.
Add, in a large bowl, tortillas (cut in strips), soups, salsa, chiles and cheese to the chicken.
Mix well.
Pat into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Popcorn Balls(Berta'S Recipe)
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in a 4-quart pot.
Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add baking soda.
Pour over dishpan full of popped corn.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Daddy'S G I Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in a large bowl.
Set aside. Beat egg.
Add milk and oil.
Combine liquid and flour mixture until mixed.
For best results, use wire whisk, leaving batter lumpy.
Cook pancakes in heated, greased frypan until covered with bubbles.
Turn pancakes and brown on the other side. Makes 12 medium size pancakes.
Great for waffles, too.

title: No Sugar Syrup
steps: Mix jello into boiling water; add cold water and cornstarch. Bring to a slow boil.
Boil 1 minute and cool to warm.
Add fresh fruit, bananas and vanilla.
Top with fat free yogurt.
Serve over your favorite pancake or waffle.
See oatmeal pancake recipe.

title: Microwave Rice
steps: In 2-quart deep casserole, put 2 cups water, salt and butter. Add cover.
Microwave on High power for 5 minutes.
Remove from microwave and add rice.
Stir.
Cover and microwave on 50% power for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Aunt Lillian'S Kraut Salad

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped celery or 2 tsp. celery seed

steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Bring sugar and vinegar to boil and pour over mixture of kraut and vegetables.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Will keep in refrigerator for 4 to 5 weeks.

title: Honey Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients but chicken.
Place chicken in baking dish and pour mixture on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°, then turn and cook, uncovered, for 30 more minutes.

title: Brownies Cockaigne
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter and chocolate in a double boiler.
Cool mixture.
Beat eggs and salt, gradually add sugar and vanilla.
Combine cooled chocolate mixture into egg and sugar mixture.
Fold in all-purpose flour and nuts.
Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan for 25 minutes.
Cut when cool.

title: Krum Kaga(Norwegian Pastry)
steps: In a bowl, sift together dry ingredients.
In second bowl, cream together the sugar and butter.
Blend in eggs and whipping cream.
Stir in dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on hot krum kaga iron. When light brown, wrap around stick.

title: Green Rice
steps: Blend Cheez Whiz in soup over low heat.
Brown onion in oleo. Cook rice and broccoli separately.
Combine all ingredients and bake at 350°
for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pudding
steps: Heat strawberries, sugar and jello just enough to dissolve Jell-O, stirring constantly.
Mix pudding and milk.
Add sour cream.
Fold in 3/4 of Cool Whip.
Layer wafers, pudding mix and strawberries.
Repeat.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
Garnish with sliced strawberries.
Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Pate
steps: Dissolve gelatin in white wine over hot water. Combine with remaining ingredients.
Place in a lightly oiled loaf tin, pressing down well. Cover with foil and allow to set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Nanny'S Tea Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, cream the sugar, shortening, eggs and extracts.
Gradually add flour, kneading until mixture is stiff enough to roll.
On lightly floured surface, roll dough 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into desired shapes. Place on greased cookie sheets and bake for 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

title: Picnic Coconut Pie
steps: Mix ingredients as given.
Bake in unbaked pie shell in moderate oven until lightly browned.
This makes 2 pies and can be stacked on top of each other when cool.

title: Orange Pineapple Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine butter golden yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 Duncan Hines butter golden yellow cake mix

steps: Cake:
Beat the cake mix, oil, eggs and oranges together. Bake in three (9-inch) layer pans at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool.

title: New Orleans Style Red Beans And Rice

ingredients.name: new orlean style kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can New Orleans style kidney beans

steps: Saute onion.

Brown seasoned beef while cooking rice separately according to directions. Add tomato sauce, Tabasco sauce and beans; simmer until rice is fluffy. Drain rice and add to mixture, cooking over low heat approximately 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt.
Mix well.
Slowly add flour. Mix and chill. Roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheet.
Flatten and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Cool in pan 2 minutes then place on wire rack.
Can be decorated.

title: Yummy Potatoes

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Combine cream of chicken soup and 1 cup cheese in saucepan. Heat over medium-low heat, stirring to prevent scorching.
Add sour cream. Mix thoroughly.
Place potatoes in casserole, one layer at a time, and top with the mixture 1/3 each time over the three layers.
Cream mixture on top.

title: Jelly Jump-Ups
steps: Combine first four ingredients.
Wrap in waxed paper; chill and roll thin.
Cut into four-inch circles.
Place 1 tablespoon jelly or jam in each.
Fold in half. Place on baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes at 400°.
Sprinkle warm cookies with sugar.
Yields 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Patties
steps: Mix ingredients and shape into patties.
Brown in vegetable oil.
Place in baking dish and cover with diluted mushroom soup. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Jello Pudding Dirt Cups

ingredients.name: chocolate sandwich cooky
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. chocolate sandwich cookies, crushed

steps: Pour milk into large bowl; add Jell-O mix.
Beat until well blended.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in Cool Whip and 1/2 of crushed cookies.
Place 1 tablespoon cookies into the cups.
Fill cups with pudding mixture.
Top with remaining cookies. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: King Oscar Pancakes With Rum Sauce
steps: Sift flour once.
Measure.
Add baking powder, sugar and salt. Combine milk and egg yolks and add to flour gradually, beating to a smooth batter.
Add shortening.
Fold in beaten egg whites and vanilla.
Pour this in hot buttered frying pan.
Brown on both sides.
Alternate six of these pancakes with Rum Sauce.
Cut this stack in four portions and top with lots of Rum Sauce and when ready to serve, bake in hot oven for 3 minutes.
Serve one stack to person with whipped cream on side.

title: French Onion Soup In Crock-Pot

ingredients.name: beef bouillon
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. beef bouillon or brown stock

steps: Pour bouillon or stock in crock-pot.
Cook onions slowly in large skillet in butter.
