Cover and let cook about 15 minutes. Uncover and add salt, sugar and flour.
Stir well.
Add to stock in crock-pot.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours (high 3 hours). Before serving, top with grated cheese.
Recipe may be doubled for 5-quart pot.
If you have ovensafe bowls, place finished soup in individual bowls.
Place slice of Italian bread and slice of Mozzarella cheese on top and place bowl under broiler until cheese melts.

title: Pork Barbecue Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients and bring to a good boil.
Can also be used for chicken.

title: Mexican Corn
steps: Boil and drain corn.
Add mayonnaise, cheese, and butter. Stir and add salt & crushed red pepper to taste.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes

ingredients.name: half and half
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. half and half or milk

steps: Put hash browns in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 square pans. Put rest of ingredients in blender.
Pour over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Escalloped Pineapple

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large (20 oz.) can drained crushed pineapple

steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Put in 3 quart baking dish (oblong shape is best).
Bake 45 minutes at 350° until brown and crusty on top.

title: Herb Dressing(Great On Vegetables)
steps: Combine the ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Frozen Parfait
steps: Blend berries, sugar and lemon until almost smooth.
With blender running, pour in heavy cream.
Puree about one minute. Serve immediately.

title: Nacho Popcorn
steps: Put popped corn in a large bowl.
Add melted margarine. Sprinkle with taco seasoning.
Toss until combined.
Add tortilla chips.

title: Night Before Casserole

ingredients.name: american cheese soft and up
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. American cheese, soft and cut up

steps: Combine ingredients; refrigerate overnight.
Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

title: Chinese Salad
steps: Mix cabbage and onions.
Put in Ziploc bag and refrigerate. Saute butter, noodles, sunflower seeds, almonds and sesame seed. Pour on paper towels and cool.
Keep in Ziploc bag until ready to use.

title: Cornbread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 8 x 8-inch pan.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add shortening, half of buttermilk and 1 egg.
Beat 2 minutes.
Add remaining egg and buttermilk; beat 2 minutes more.
Pour all batter at once time into pan.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes.
Muffin tins, bake 25 minutes.

title: Cracker Pralines
steps: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with whole soda crackers.
Boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes.
Pour over crackers.
Bake in oven (400°) for 3 minutes until bubbly.
Remove and sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Smooth over with knife after melted.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Cut while still warm.

title: Chicken Dijon

ingredients.name: chicken breast split boned and skinned
ingredients.raw: 2 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned

steps: Saute chicken in butter over low heat about 20 minutes or until tender.
Remove chicken to a warm platter.
Blend flour into pan drippings; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly.
Gradually stir in broth and half and half; cook until smooth and thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir in mustard.
Add chicken; cover and simmer about 10 minutes.
Yield:
2 servings.

title: Chocolate Chex Mix
steps: Combine the chocolate chips and peanut butter; melt on low heat.
Pour over the Chex cereal; toss.
Put half of mixture in a plastic bag filled with the powdered sugar.
Repeat with other half.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Flash freeze for 5 minutes.
Store in airtight containers in freezer.

title: Grilled Lemon Pepper Shrimp

ingredients.name: or shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 lb. medium or large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: Note:
Will also need 6 to 7 skewers.

title: Raw Cauliflower Salad

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 1 head cauliflower, chopped or separated into florets

ingredients.name: each stuffed and olive
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. each chopped stuffed and ripe olives

ingredients.name: american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. diced American cheese (not pasteurized process cheese)

steps: Combine chopped cauliflower, bell pepper, olives, radishes and tomatoes.
Stir in cheese.
Marinate overnight in dressing.
Salad reaches its full flavor 1 to 3 days after preparation.

title: Minute Magic Walnut Bread
steps: Mix together sugar, egg, milk and walnuts.
Add biscuit mix. Beat hard for 30 seconds.
Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool thoroughly before cutting.

title: Fishy Onion Dip
steps: Blend 1/4 cup oil, egg yolk, and 2 Tbsp. lemon juice.
Add rest of oil gradually.
Combine capers, rind, anchovy, tuna, remaining lemon juice and onion.
Beat into egg mixture.
Garnish with parsley sprigs.
Chill.
Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Quick Chocolate Mousse

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: instant chocolate pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz. or 4 1/8 oz.) instant chocolate pudding

steps: In large mixer bowl, combine Eagle Brand condensed milk, pudding mix and water; beat until well blended.
Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream.

title: Brunch Pie

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli or chopped spinach or 8 oz. asparagus spears, cooked and drained

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch pie plate.
Spread broccoli or spinach or asparagus in plate.
Beat sour cream, cottage cheese, baking mix, margarine and eggs until smooth.
Pour into plate.
Top with tomatoes; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean, about 30 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandmother Esther'S Matzoh Balls
steps: Add water, oil, salt and pepper to beaten eggs.
Mix well. Add meal and stir thoroughly.
Refrigerate one hour.
Form into balls and drop into soup or 1 1/2 quarts of boiling water to which salt has been added.
Cook 20 minutes with lid on.

title: Sweet Potato Salad

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. cooked, peeled and cubed sweet potatoes

steps: Combine potatoes, onion and green pepper in a large bowl. Stir in mayonnaise and hot sauce; mix well.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
Serves 10.

title: Herb And Garlic Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed

ingredients.name: lipton recipe secret savory herb and garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Lipton recipe secrets, savory herb and garlic

ingredients.name: campbell s healthy request cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request cream of chicken soup

steps: Combine water, Recipe Secrets and chicken in a 2-quart saucepan.
Cook until chicken is done.
While chicken is cooking, cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain and set aside. Add soup to chicken.
Simmer about 2 minutes.
Serve over cooked pasta.

title: Red Punch Slush

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.raw: 6 lemons (juice) or 2 Tbsp. ReaLemon per lemon

steps: Boil water, sugar and cinnamon candies for 5 minutes.
Stir to dissolve cinnamon candies.
Cool.
Add the juice from the oranges and lemons.
Mix cranberry and pineapple juices.
Freeze in two 1/2 gallon cartons.

title: Donald'S Corned Beef And Cabbage Sandwiches
steps: Mix mayonnaise with grated cabbage.
On one slice of bread, smear corned beef hash and on other slice, smear cabbage and mayonnaise mixture.
Coat outside of slices of bread with mayonnaise.
Brown in heated heavy skillet, pressing down while cooking.
Eat with friends while hot.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
steps: Brown onion and meat.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Strawberry Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries (do not drain) or 2 1/2 c. (measure whole, then slice)

steps: Mix dry ingredients together.
Add remaining ingredients. Stir carefully.
Turn batter into loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool in pans 10 minutes, then put on cooling racks.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies

ingredients.name: nut raisin
ingredients.raw: nuts, raisins or chocolate chips (if desired)

steps: Cream or mix well the shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Mix well.
Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

title: Red Beans And Rice For 120
steps: Soak beans several hours and drain. Put in large pot leaving room for plenty of water. Chop onion and garlic; add to beans. Slice sausage thin and add to beans the last 45 minutes of cooking. Cook rice by package directions.
Serve beans over rice. This recipe will fill a 48-quart cooler.

title: Bread Pudding
steps: Beat the eggs and add sugar, milk and nutmeg.
Butter a baking dish.
Arrange the bread in dish and pour liquid over it.
Let stand until bread has been thoroughly soaked.
Add raisins.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Brie
steps: Press crescent roll dough together, making it like a pie crust.
Assemble this in a pie plate. Spread bottom with apricot jam, thinly.
Place Brie cheese in the middle and pull crust around and on top to cover.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serve with plain crackers.

title: Oven-Shy Cookies(Kids Corner)
steps: In a saucepan over low heat, cook and stir marshmallows, chips and butter until marshmallows are melted
and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat and stir in peanuts and cereal; mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto wax paper; cool.

title: Eve'S Pudding(Copyright 1908 - 1933)
steps: Peel, core and chop the apples finely; add the bread crumbs, sugar, salt and nutmeg.
Beat the eggs well and use them with the milk to moisten the pudding.
Turn into greased mold; cover closely and steam 2 hours.
Serve with a hot sweet sauce.

title: Chicken-N-Dressing Casserole
steps: Take a stick of oleo and melt in 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole dish.
Use 1/2 of dressing and spread evenly over oleo.
Sprinkle chicken over dressing.
Combine both soups and chicken broth.
Mix well.
Add chopped onion and sage to mixture and pour over chicken.
Take other half of dressing and sprinkle over top. Bake 35 or 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Beaten Biscuits
steps: Adjust oven rack to lowest position.
Preheat oven to 350°. In food processor with steel blade, combine flour, salt and Crisco; pulse about 6 seconds, until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add milk and process until dough forms a ball.
Continue processing 2 minutes.
On floured surface, roll dough into rectangle 1/4-inch thick.
Fold dough in half, pressing lightly. With a 1 1/2-inch biscuit cutter, cut out dough and place on cookie sheet.
Re-roll scraps and repeat, cutting more biscuits. Prick each biscuit with a fork.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until pale golden.
Turn off oven, leave biscuits in oven for 35 minutes. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.
Contains 100 calories each.

title: Homemade Bread
steps: Scald milk and pour over sugar, Crisco and salt.
Beat eggs and add to mixture.
Measure 2 1/2 cups of flour into another bowl (gallon crock) and add yeast.
Pour lukewarm mixture and mix.
Add rest of flour gradually.
Takes about 4 pounds.
Knead about 10 minutes.
Grease bowl.
Cover and let rise.
Punch down and let rise again.
Punch down and shape into loaves, rolls or cinnamon rolls.
Bake at 325° until lightly browned.

title: Beet Jelly
steps: Bring jelly and Sure-Jell to a hard boil.
Add sugar, Jell-O and lemon juice.
Boil 8 minutes.

title: Lemon Daffodil Dessert
steps: Combine juice, sugar and milk. Add whipped cream.
Tear cake into small pieces and line the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Pour mixture over the cake and mix together a little. Chill for 24 hours before serving.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ham Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients
and
mix
well.
Shape
into a loaf and place in loaf pan, greased.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: German Potato Salad(Kantoffie Salad)
steps: Peel potatoes and slice.
Simmer onion in bacon drippings and add flour, vinegar, sugar, water and seasoning.
Mix well all ingredients together and serve warm.

title: Sunshine Carrots

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans small whole carrots, drained

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add carrots.
Return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook 5 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Dirt Cups

ingredients.name: instant chocolate pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant chocolate pudding

steps: Pour 2 cups cold milk into bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Beat with wire whisk until well blended, about 2 minutes.
Let pudding stand 5 minutes.
Stir whipped topping and 1/2 the crushed cookies into pudding with the rubber scraper until mixture is all the same color.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the remaining crushed cookies into bottom of each paper or plastic cup.
Add gummy worms to pudding mixture.
Fill cups about 3/4 full with pudding mixture. Top each cup with the rest of the crushed cookies.
Chill about an hour.
Decorate the tops with plastic flowers!

title: Little Pecan Pies
steps: Mix together margarine and cream cheese; add flour.
Chill 2 hours, then press into miniature cupcake pan and fill with filling.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Mold

ingredients.name: pineapple in juice
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) cans crushed pineapple in juice

ingredients.name: or pkg. jell o brand orange gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 serving size) pkg. or 2 pkg. Jell-O brand orange gelatin

ingredients.name: philadelphia cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened

steps: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
Add water to juice to make 1 1/2 cups.
Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl 2 minutes or until dissolved.
Stir in measured liquid.
Pour 2 cups of the gelatin into medium bowl.
Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened (spoon drawn through leaves a definite impression).
Stir in pineapple.

title: Beef Tips In Mushroom Sauce

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained (save liquid)

ingredients.name: dry cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. dry sherry or red wine

steps: Brown meat in oil.
Slice the onions in rings and cook with the meat.
Combine soup, sherry, garlic salt and liquid from mushrooms.
Pour over beef and onions.
Pour in mushrooms.
Let boil and then simmer for at least one hour.

title: Pickled Cukes
steps: In a large bowl, combine 1/4 cup of water with all ingredients. Peel cucumbers and cut very thin slices.
Add to bowl and toss very well.
Refrigerate, covered, for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Out-A-Sight Chicken
steps: Cut chicken in chunks and brown lightly in butter.
Brown sliced onions and set aside.
Slice cabbage very thinly and brown in butter.
Add very thin, round slices of zucchini.
When slightly cooked, add chicken and onions.
Simmer, adding a little water, wine and soy sauce to taste.
If mushrooms are used, slice whole, brown and set aside as with the onions.
Add at the end also.
Serve over brown rice with soy sauce as a condiment. Remember to cook vegetables only until lightly cooked.
Crispy zucchini gives a lovely texture compliment to other vegetables and undercooking retains vitamins.

title: Carol'S Favorite Dessert

ingredients.name: fruit pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can fruit pie filling (blueberry is best)

steps: Line a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish with the whole graham crackers. Mix the pudding with the milk and Cool Whip.
Spread half on the crackers. Put another layer of crackers and rest of pudding mix. Put a third layer of crackers and top with the pie filling.
Chill well before serving.

title: Lemon Sauce Cake
steps: Cream oleo and sugar.
Add egg yolks.
Stir in lemon juice, milk and salt.
Beat egg whites (stiff).
Add 1/2 cup sugar.
Fold in first mixture.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
This cake makes its own sauce.

title: Mama Tina'S (Allison) Canned Green Beans
steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a large pan and cover with water.
Bring to a boil.
Cook for one hour.
Put in jars to seal.
When ready to cook for your meal, drain and rinse twice before cooking.

title: Pralines
steps: Boil all ingredients, including pecans to soft ball stage, stirring constantly.
Cool slightly and beat until mixture just begins to stiffen.
Drop rapidly from a spoon onto a buttered pan or waxed paper.
If candy becomes too stiff at the last, drop into patties and stir in a little hot water.

title: Wilda'S Super Delicious Punch
steps: Heat together 2 cups water and sugar (only to dissolve sugar, do not boil).
Add 4 cups water, orange juice, lemon juice and pineapple juice.
Add bananas (mix a small amount of the juice mixture with bananas to mix well).	After all ingredients are mixed freeze contents!

title: Never Fail Cake Frosting
steps: Cream until smooth, then spread on cake.
You can add more powdered sugar, if needed.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Pie
steps: Beat yolks and milk.
Add to dry ingredients.
Beat lumps out. Cook until thick.
Cool.
Put in already cooked/cooled pie shells. Beat egg whites and spread on top. Brown in oven.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Mix sugar and milk in 2-quart saucepan.
Bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Add salt, vanilla, marshmallow cream and peanut butter.
Stir until mixed (one color).
Pour into buttered 8 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut with wet knife.

title: Crock-Pot Ham And Bean Soup
steps: Soak 2 cups of beans (I use 5 or 6 different kinds) overnight. Drain water and place beans and fresh water in crock-pot with 2 quarts of water.
Add ham, onions, basil, bay leaves, pepper, Tabasco and Worcestershire sauce to taste.
Bring pot to high, then reduce to low and cook all day.
Serve with cornbread and salad or fresh vegetables.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad

ingredients.name: olive
ingredients.raw: 1 (No. 2) can ripe olives or green olives

steps: Wash and chop broccoli and cauliflower.
Slice onion, olives and water chestnuts.
Blend mayonnaise and sour cream.
Pour over vegetables and toss to mix.
Chill.
Best if allowed to marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving.
(Good.)

title: Chicken And Dressing

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm herb stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 bag Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm cornbread stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 bag Pepperidge Farm cornbread stuffing mix

steps: Pick chicken from bone.
Melt 2 sticks margarine; mix with some of the chicken broth.
Pour over chicken and stuffing, which have been combined in pan.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Coffee Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar and oleo together.
Take 1/2 cup for topping. Mix well.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold into batter.
Put in greased 8-inch square pan.
Sprinkle crumbs on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
steps: On day before, cut spareribs into 2-rib portions.
In large pot over high heat, heat to boiling ribs and enough water to cover.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 hour.
Drain and refrigerate.
Grill for 50 minutes until desired doneness.

title: Baked Spaghetti
steps: Bring one pot of water to a boil and add spaghetti.
Let cook until just tender.	Heat up jar of spaghetti sauce according to the directions.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease a 9 x 13 baking dish. Drain spaghetti and place in baking dish.
Spread out evenly.
Pour heated spaghetti sauce over spaghetti in the dish. Then place in oven and cook for 30 to 35 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Bread Casserole

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 whole chopped onion or 1 tsp. dehydrated onion

ingredients.name: tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes and green chilies, chopped

steps: Brown meat with onions in skillet.
Add tomatoes and chilies, beans and salt.
Put in 2-quart oblong casserole.
Make corn bread according to directions on package.
Pour corn bread mix over meat and beans mix.
Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.
Makes about 6 servings.
(This is better the next time it is warmed over.)

title: Butterfinger Delight
steps: Melt margarine; add sugar, Cool Whip and egg whites.
Beat until creamy.
Break cake into bite-size pieces.
Place 1/2 of cake bits in a bowl.
Put 1/2 the cream mixture on top and broken pieces of 3 candy bars on cream mixture.
Then repeat the layers. Refrigerate.

title: Finger Paints(I Used This Recipe When My Children Were Small.)
steps: Mix pulverized laundry starch with cold water.
Pour in boiling water and stir quickly.
Cook the mixture over low heat about 3 minutes until the surface becomes glossy.
Remove from heat and add soap flakes and glycerin as a preservative.
Place the mixture in small jars and color with a few drops of different vegetable dyes.

title: Rice Dish

ingredients.name: uncle ben s wild blend rice
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Uncle Ben's wild blend (specialty blend) rice

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 small can mushrooms or 1/2 c. fresh mushrooms

steps: Mix everything together.
Cover.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. (Double for 6 to 8 people.)

title: Pizza Dough And Breadsticks

ingredients.name: cake yeast in c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 cake (1 Tbsp.) yeast in 1 1/4 c. 85~ water

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil or olive oil

steps: Combine yeast, water, salt and sugar.
Add to flour and combine thoroughly.
Knead 8 to 10 minutes.
Cover and let rise 1 to 2 hours; covered with damp cloth.
Punch dough down; divide in two equal parts.
Grease two 15 x 9 x 1-inch pans with vegetable oil and lightly sprinkle cornmeal on pan.
Pat out dough in pan or roll out and place in pan.

title: Eggplant Spaghetti Sauce

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.raw: 1 eggplant, cut into cubes (you don't have to peel it)

steps: Saute eggplant in oil, about 7 minutes.
Add onion, garlic and pepper.
Saute 3 additional minutes or until tender.
Combine tomatoes, tomato juice and herbs.
Add to the eggplant mixture. Cover and simmer for 1/2 hour.
Serve over spaghetti.

title: Gonga'S Fudge
steps: Mix sugar, butter and milk.
Bring to boiling point and let boil gently for 9 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in chocolate chips, nuts, vanilla and marshmallow cream until melted over low heat.
Pour into 9 x 12-inch buttered dish.
Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Carrots Of The Ritz
steps: Cook carrots in water with bouillon cube until almost done. Drain and save liquid.
Coarsely mash carrots. Add crushed crackers, onion, butter and 2/3 cup reserved liquid.
Mix well. Place in a small buttered baking dish.
Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Jubilee
steps: Tear up angel food cake into small bite sizes.
Put into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Mix pudding according to directions on box and pour over cake pieces.
Chill for 2 hours.
Put Cool Whip on top of pudding and chill for 1 hour.
Add cherries on top of Cool Whip and chill for 2 hours.

title: Moist Low-Fat Brownies

ingredients.name: eagle brand fat condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand fat-free sweetened condensed milk

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan with cooking spray.

title: Strawberry Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients and beat.
Bake at 300° until cake springs back when touched.

title: Christmas Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients and fold into
Cool Whip. Let set and chill 4 to 5 hours or overnight.

title: Pork And Sauerkraut
steps: Arrange in layers in a casserole.
Bake at 350 degrees for 2 hours or until pork chops are done.

title: Army Pudding
steps: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.
Line with crackers.
Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers.
Add another line of crackers. Pour rest of pudding mixture over crackers.
Top with another line of crackers and squeeze chocolate syrup on top of crackers.

title: Quick Savory Popcorn

ingredients.name: envelope original party dip mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) envelope original party dip mix

steps: Pour popped corn into a large bowl; set aside.
Microwave on High the butter in uncovered 1-cup glass measure for 1 to 1 1/4 minutes or until melted.
Stir in dip mix.
Drizzle butter mixture over popped corn.
Toss lightly to coat evenly.
Makes about 16 cups.

title: Christmas Fudge
steps: Bring sugar, syrup, milk and salt to boiling point, stirring constantly.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Cool; beat until stiff.
Add vanilla, butter, fruit and nuts.
Pour into buttered dish.

title: Special Carrots

ingredients.name: carrot scraped and diagonally
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, scraped and diagonally sliced

ingredients.name: chabli
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Chablis or other dry wine

steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat, simmering for 10 to 12 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Yields about 6 servings.

title: Tuna Pie
steps: Mix tuna, cheese and onion.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Stir together eggs, mayonnaise and milk.
Mix lightly into pie shell. Bake at 375° for about 50 minutes.

title: Country Iced Tea
steps: After water comes to a boil add tea bags and let set for 15 minutes,
While this is setting add sugar to a gallon container. Pour tea over sugar and stir until it is dissolved.
Add cold water to finish the gallon of tea.

title: Dutch Slaw
steps: Combine cabbage, pepper and onion.
Pour sugar over and set aside.
Combine salt, dry mustard, celery seed and vinegar in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour over cabbage and stir.
Let refrigerate overnight.
Serves 12 and will keep a week.
Recipe can be cut down 1/2 or 1/4.

title: Blueberry Delight

ingredients.name: blueberry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can blueberry pie filling (may substitute with other pie fillings)

steps: Melt 1 stick of butter.
Pour melted butter over cake mix; mix thoroughly.
Spread pie filling on the bottom of an 8-inch round baking pan.
Pour cake mix over the top of pie filling.
Bake in oven at 350° for 20 minutes, or until light golden brown.

title: Peachy Chicken
steps: Place chicken in pan skin down.
Combine juice with soy sauce, and pour over chicken.
Put in oven at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken
over and bake 30 minutes.
Save peaches for a cobbler.

title: Strawberries In The Snow
steps: Cream together cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip, then fold in pinched up angel food cake.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Top with strawberry glaze and strawberries (mix and pour over cake).

title: Scalloped Broccoli

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Put broccoli in 11 x 7-inch baking dish.
Melt 1 stick of margarine in saucepan.
Add flour and milk.
Cook until thick.
Add bouillon cubes.
Stir until dissolved.
Pour over broccoli and work through with a fork.
Mix 6 tablespoons melted margarine, stuffing and water.
Spread over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Surprise Burgers
steps: Shape meat into 12 thin patties.
Cover 6 patties with cheese, onion and 6 remaining patties.
Pinch edges to seal cheese.
Place meat on rack of broiler pan.
Broil on both sides to desired doneness.
Spread bottom half of roll with sandwich spread or relish; cover with lettuce, tomato, patty, sandwich spread or relish and top half of roll.
Makes 6 good size sandwiches.

title: Homemade Pizzas

ingredients.name: whatever you like on a pizza
ingredients.raw: whatever you like on a pizza

steps: One can of biscuits makes 10 pizzas (small).
Roll out each biscuit flat.
Spoon sauce on dough.
Top with your favorite pizza toppings.
Bake like you would the biscuits.
Makes great pizzas.

title: Pumpkin Pie Dip
steps: Beat sugar and cream cheese together.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a small pumpkin that has been cleaned out.
Serve with gingersnaps.

title: Make Ahead Mashed Or Whipped Potatoes
steps: Pare and cook potatoes as usual, adding salt.
Drain and whip them.
Whip in cream cheese and sour cream.
Place in casserole, cover and place in refrigerator until ready to cook.
Spread with butter and paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Great for the holidays when time is limited.

title: Lemonade Pie
steps: Mix all together; pour into pie crusts.
Use graham cracker crumb crusts.

title: Chocolate Vanilla Wafer Dessert
steps: Beat 4 egg yolks.
Add chocolate, water and powdered sugar and cook.
Let cool.
Add nuts, egg whites and whipped cream.
After cooking and cooling, line mold with crushed wafers.
Add mixture and cover with wafers.
Chill 12 hours.

title: Turmeric Slaw

ingredients.name: mustard seed
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. mustard seed or 1/2 tsp. dry mustard

steps: Chop cabbage, pepper and onion together; set aside.
Bring vinegar, sugar, salt, turmeric and mustard to a boil.
Pour over the cabbage, pepper and onion and mix well.
Put in refrigerator and chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Frozen Punch
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add sugar, then remaining ingredients (except ginger ale).
Freeze.
Remove 2 hours before serving.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Serves 35.

title: Almond Milk
steps: Mill almonds dry in liquefier until powdered.
Add remaining ingredients and thoroughly liquefy.
Add ice water or ice and water to make a total of 1 quart and blend.
Yields 1 quart.

title: Easy Salmon Patties

ingredients.name: generou sprinkle of mrs. dash
ingredients.raw: generous sprinkle of Mrs. Dash or Lawry's seasoning with no salt

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Form into 4 patties.
Broil on each side until brown.
Less calories than frying.

title: Zucchini Pie
steps: Cut zucchini into inch slices; sprinkle with flour and fry in olive oil until light brown.
In greased casserole, place 1 layer of fried zucchini; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and add a little of the sauce.
Cover with thin layers of Mozzarella and repeat procedure until zucchini and other ingredients are all used, ending with Mozzarella.
Bake in moderate oven, 375°, for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Delight(4 Layered Dessert)
steps: First Layer:
Mix flour, 1/2 cup chopped pecans and butter and press in baking pan.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Cool.

title: Heavenly Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown thaw use
ingredients.raw: 1 (24 oz.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thaw to use

steps: Mix all together and place in a casserole dish.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 12.

title: Zucchini Florentine
steps: Prepare zucchini by scooping out pulp, leaving 1/4-inch shells; mince pulp.
Melt butter in skillet and saute pulp and onion until tender.
Squeeze water out of spinach.
Add to zucchini mixture.
Keep warm while making sauce.

title: Sauteed Okra
steps: Wash okra thoroughly and cut off the stems.
Blanch pods by submerging in a pot of rapidly boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes. Drain and pat dry.
Slice okra crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Heat the butter and garlic (if used) in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the okra.
Stir frequently for 5 minutes or until nice and brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.

title: Chicken Souffle
steps: Grease a 9 x 12-inch cake pan.
Cut off bread crusts.
Layer 1/2 of the bread (cover the entire bottom of pan), chicken, mayonnaise, cheese and then cover with the other half of the bread.
Beat together the eggs, milk and salt.
Pour over the layers.
Cover the pan tightly with foil.
Refrigerate all day or overnight.
Just before baking, spread with soup and mushrooms. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour at 300° to 325°.

title: Fat-Free Mint Chocolate Drops

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. wheat flour
ingredients.raw: 1 c. plus 1 Tbsp. whole wheat flour

steps: Combine flour, cocoa, sugar and baking soda.
Mix well.
Add prune puree, chocolate syrup and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in chips.
Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough on sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Black Bottom Pie

ingredients.name: oz refrigerated ready bake brown
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg 18 oz refrigerated ready to bake brownies

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Evenly cover the bottom and sides of a 9 inch deep dish pie plate with the ready to bake brownies, forming a crust.
Bake for 20-25 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar, peppermint extract and green food coloring with an electric mixer until smooth.
Fold in the whipped topping then spoon into the crust.
Cover the pie and chill for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cheesecake!
steps: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with mixer until well blended.
Add eggs and blend again.
Stir in 3/4 cup chips.
Pour into pie crust and sprinkle top of mixture with remaining 1/4 cup chips.
Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes or until center is almost firm.
Cool and refrigerate at least 4 hours, overnight is fine.
Garnish with additional chips and/or chocolate Cool Whip.

title: Ribbon Jello

ingredients.name: each jello cherry orange lemon and lime
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. each jello: cherry, orange, lemon and lime

steps: In separate small bowls, dissolve each of the fruit jellos in 1 1/2 cups of boiling water.
Set aside to get syrupy.
Combine sugar and milk.
Heat until sugar is dissolved.
Mix Knox gelatine and water and heat until dissolved.
Combine milk mixture with Knox gelatine mixture and add vanilla.
Gradually mix in sour cream.
In a 10-cup dish or mold, layer one jello, then 1/4 cup sour cream mixture, another jello, another 1/4 cup sour cream, until all are used.
Each layer should be nearly firm before adding the next layer.

title: Fried Shrimp
steps: Mix all ingredients until thin.
Place cleaned shrimp, split up back and deveined, in the mixture.
Remove 1 at a time, roll in flour and drop in hot cooking oil.
Cook to light brown.

title: Good Any Time Punch
steps: Do
not
dilute juices.
Put partially thawed juices in bowl; stir in chilled Sprite.
Serves 25.

title: Foam Salad
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together, dry.
Add boiling water and microwave 2 minutes.
Let cool and add 8 ounces Cool Whip, fold in 1 small can mandarin oranges and chill overnight.

title: Heath Bar Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix according to box directions.
Bake as directed. Cool for 5 minutes.
Poke holes with wooden spoon handle over top of cake, 1-inch apart.
Spoon Eagle Brand milk into holes.
Warm hot fudge sauce in microwave until soft.
Spoon into holes.
Wait 30 minutes.
Mix crushed Heath bars and Cool Whip and spread on top. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Pork Normandy
steps: In hot oil, brown pork chops and onion for about 10 minutes. Spoon off fat.
Stir in soup, apple juice, celery and thyme. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve over noodles. Serves 6.

title: Ribbon Salad

ingredients.name: red raspberry
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. red raspberry or red cherry jello

steps: Dissolve the red jello in 1 1/2 cups hot water.
Dissolve the lime jello in 1 1/2 cups hot water.
When cool, add the drained pineapple, 1/2 to each of the jello mixtures.
Bring the pineapple juice to a boil.
Dissolve the Knox gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water, add to the pineapple juice and stir until thoroughly dissolved.
When pineapple juice is cool, add the cream cheese and thoroughly blend.
Pour the raspberry gelatin into an 8-inch mold, chill until firm.
Add the pineapple-cream cheese mixture, chill until firm, add the final layer of lime gelatin and chill until firm.

title: Lemon Delight
steps: Mix all the ingredients and press down in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Special Hamburgers
steps: Combine ingredients.
Mix well.
Form into 4 to 6 patties. Broil, or place in greased shallow baking dish and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Onion Casserole
steps: Cook rice in 1 cup boiling water 5 minutes; drain.
Set aside. Cook onion in butter until limp.
Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chewy Oreo Cookies
steps: Mix eggs and shortening well.
Add dry cake mix and mix well. Scoop by tablespoonful on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mrs. Almonds Jalapeno Dip

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. chopped jalapeno peppers or 1 (7 1/2 oz.) can jalapeno relish

steps: Melt cheese with tomato sauce in crock-pot.
Add Worcestershire sauce and garlic.
Brown (and drain) hamburger and add to cheese.
Add peppers.
Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Homemade Granola

ingredients.name: sugar substitute equal c. sugar
ingredients.raw: sugar substitute to equal 1/4 c. sugar

steps: Spread the oatmeal on a cookie sheet and heat in a 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Combine all but the last two ingredients.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet or pan for 20 minutes, stirring once to brown evenly.
Allow mixture to cook in the oven.
Add wheat germ and raisins.
Refrigerate in glass jars or plastic containers.
(Granulated sugar substitute was more acceptable than liquid sugar substitute in this product.)

title: Instant Russian Tea
steps: Mix together.
Add about 1 tablespoon to 1 cup boiling water for individual servings.

title: Artichoke Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke
ingredients.raw: 2 jars marinated artichokes (drain and reserve juice)

ingredients.name: chicken and
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken, cooked and chopped or use 4 chicken breasts

steps: Cook rice.
Combine
artichoke,
onion,
pepper, olives and chicken in	a
large
bowl.
Add rice.
Combine mayonnaise and artichoke liquid.
Add
curry powder and mix well.	Add to salad mixture in bowl and refrigerate overnight.	Serves 15.

title: Vanilla Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, then add sugar, making sure to beat mixture well.
Add eggs, one at a time, then add vanilla, fold in flour and salt into mixture.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Spray tube pan with Pam prior to placing mixture in pan to be cooked.

title: Carob Pecan Squares

ingredients.name: arrowhead mill stone ground wheat flour
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Arrowhead Mills stone ground whole wheat flour

steps: Blend egg and add liquids. Add the flour and mix well.
Stir in the pecans and carob chips.
Pour mixture into an oiled 8-inch square pan. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until lightly brown and mixture pulls away form sides of pan. Cut into squares.
Cool in pan.

title: Bobbie'S Apple Pie Filling

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 qt. sliced fresh apples (Northern Spies, Ida Reds and Cortlands, mixed, are good)

steps: Use a deep pie plate.
("Only the Evil One advocates a shallow pie!")
Slice the apples thin.
Mix sugar and flour; sprinkle about 1/4 cup over bottom crust.
Fill plate with 1/3 of the apples; sprinkle more mixture.
Scatter pieces of cheese (Kraft Old English or medium Cheddar, grated).
Add more apples, sugar mixture and cheese as desired.
Add the rest of the apples and the rest of the sugar mixture.
Scatter the butter in chunks over apples.
Mix the cinnamon and nutmeg with sugar; spread over the whole.
Drizzle sorghum (if available) or molasses in middle of pie and lace it around the apples.

title: Vanilla Butternut Pound Cake

ingredients.name: evaporated milk enough water make c.
ingredients.raw: 1 small can evaporated milk + enough water to make 1 c.

steps: Cream shortening, oleo, sugar and salt.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour, alternating with milk, ending with flour.
Add drained cherries and chopped nuts.
Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 325° for 2 hours.
Start with a cold oven.
Do not open oven door while baking.

title: Grandma'S Fruit Salad
steps: Pour the cans of fruit into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Do not drain fruit!
Sprinkle pudding mix over the fruit.
Slice the banana on top and mix together carefully so as not to mash the banana or fruit.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Meringue - Pillsbury
steps: In a small pan, cook 2 tablespoons sugar, cornstarch and water until clear and thick; set aside and cool.
Beat the egg whites until stiff.
Combine the salt, vanilla and 6 tablespoons sugar; add gradually to egg whites.
Add cornstarch mixture; mix until thick and stands in a peak.
Be sure to cover dessert completely so that meringue mixture touches and seals edge of crust.
Cook at 250° until slightly brown.

title: Pumpkin Pies
steps: Follow recipe on Libby's can, then add melted butter, flour, spiked egg nog and 2 extra eggs.
Mix well.
Bake in 350° oven 45 to 60 minutes or until butter knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Chilled Tortellini Salad

ingredients.name: or can broiled mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 or 5 oz.) jar or can broiled mushrooms

steps: Cook tortellini according to package directions.
Drain and put into bowl.
Empty olives and mushrooms in a chopper and chop to desired coarseness; mix into bowl of pasta.
Add salad dressing and grated cheese and toss well (salad dressing and grated cheese as desired).
Refrigerate 1 hour or until cold.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Jello Punch
steps: Mix jello, sugar,
hot water and cold water; add pineapple juice and lemon;
stir
very well.	Put in gallon container and freeze.
When ready
to
serve,
add ginger ale.
Very good for parties and special occasions.

title: Cherry Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine deluxe ii cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 Duncan Hines Deluxe II cake mix (dark chocolate)

steps: Stir
by spoon, mixing all ingredients.
Spread in cake pan. Bake same as directions on cake box.

title: Pan De Elote
steps: In bowl, combine corn, biscuit mix, egg, butter, sugar and milk; mix well.
Turn half of batter into a well-greased 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish.
Cover with chilies, then cheese slices. Spread remaining batter over cheese.
Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes, or until brown.

title: Beginner'S Rolls
steps: Mix 1 cup flour, yeast, sugar and salt in mixer bowl.
Add butter and water; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add egg and 1/2 cup flour; beat for 1 minute.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.
Knead on floured surface for 5 minutes.
Let rest, covered with plastic wrap and towel, for 20 minutes.
Shape into rolls.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Brush with oil. Chill, covered, overnight.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Ring In The New Year Punch
steps: Combine orange juice and cherry syrup in large punch bowl; add lemon soda slowly.
Add block of ice or ice cubes just before serving.
Garnish with orange slices and cherries.

title: Strawberry Slush
steps: Mix together boiling water, sugar and Kool-Aid.
Cool.
Add rum or vodka, orange juice and strawberries.
Serve with 7-Up.

title: Angelina'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, shortening, eggs and sugar; set aside.
Add flour and baking powder; set aside.
Then add milk, lemon juice and vanilla together.
Add to butter mixture.
Alternate butter mixture with flour mixture.
Pour into greased tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Crisp

ingredients.name: thank you apple filling and
ingredients.raw: 1 can (20 oz.) Thank You apple filling and topping

ingredients.name: quick
ingredients.raw: 1 c. quick or old fashioned oats

steps: Place filling in shallow one quart baking dish.
In a bowl, combine flour, oats, sugar, salt and spices.
Cut in butter and mix well.
Spread topping evenly over apple filling.
Bake in 375° oven for about 30 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.
Serves 6.

title: Triple Layer Party Pie*

ingredients.name: sugar instant butterscotch pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. sugar-free instant butterscotch pudding mix

ingredients.name: sugar chocolate instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. sugar-free chocolate instant pudding mix

steps: Mix in medium bowl the butterscotch mix, 2/3 cup dry milk and 1 1/4 cups of water.
Mix well with wire whisk.
Pour into pie crust.
Mix in bowl the chocolate pudding mix, remaining 2/3 cup dry milk and 1 1/4 cups of water.
Mix well with wire whisk.
Pour over butterscotch layer.
Chill until set.
Spread whipped topping over chocolate layer.
Sprinkle pecans and mini chocolate chips. Ready to serve.

title: Nutty Peach Crunch

ingredients.name: peach with syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 large (29 oz.) can sliced peaches with syrup

ingredients.name: betty crocker butter pecan cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix

steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Layer ingredients in order listed in ungreased, oblong 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 55 or 60 minutes.
Let stand at least 15 minutes before serving.
Good with vanilla ice cream on top.

title: Cheese Bubble Loaf

ingredients.name: loaf white bread dough thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) loaf frozen white bread dough, thawed

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. Cheddar cheese, cut into 32 (1-inch) cubes

steps: Cover dough; let rise in warm, draft free place until doubled. Divide into 32 equal pieces.
Shape each into a ball around a cube of cheese; pinch to seal.
Dip balls in melted butter.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: baked pie shell
ingredients.raw: 1 baked pie shell or 1 graham cracker crust

steps: Cream butter and gradually add sugar, creaming well.
Melt chocolate and cool.
Blend in chocolate and vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition 5 minutes on medium speed with the mixer.
Turn into baked pie shell.
Chill 1 to 2 hours and serve with whipped cream.

title: Raisin Sauce For Ham
steps: Mix brown sugar, mustard and flour.
Add vinegar, lemon juice and lemon rind.
Stir in water and raisins.
Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Serve hot over ham, sliced. Makes 10 servings.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 can (20 oz.) pineapple chunks, well drained

ingredients.name: mandarin orange well
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (11 oz.) mandarin oranges, well drained

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh fruit (strawberries, peaches or blueberries)

steps: In mixing bowl combine marshmallows, sour cream, mayonnaise and salt.
Refrigerate overnight.
Add fruit shortly before serving.
Toss gently to mix.
Yields 12 servings and may be doubled.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
steps: Cake:
Bake butter cake as directed on box in two 8-inch cake pans.
Let cool completely.
Slice each layer making a 4-layer cake.

title: Potato Leek Soup
steps: Melt butter.
Add thinly sliced leeks and saute until soft (8 minutes).
Stir in chicken broth and potatoes, peeled and sliced au gratin style.
Partially cover; simmer for about 10 minutes. Using a wooden spoon, mash some potatoes against the side of the pan.
Stir in coarsely chopped watercress.
Simmer for 1 minute. Serve in bowl.
Season with salt, pepper and swirl 1 tablespoon heavy cream.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms(Microwave)
steps: Wash mushrooms; remove stems and chop fine.
Place mushroom caps on paper towel on carousel or dinner plate.
Microwave at Medium-high 1 minute.
Drain and set aside.

title: Newburg Sauce

ingredients.name: fish stock
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. fish stock (use liquid from cooking fish)

steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Remove from heat, stir in flour, salt and paprika until blended.
Stir in cream and fish stock slowly. Cook over medium heat and stir constantly until mixture thickens and comes to boil.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
In medium bowl, beat egg yolks well.
Stir in about 1/2 cup hot sauce.
Stir egg yolk mixture into sauce in saucepan.
Add sherry.
Cook over low heat stirring until heated through.
Do not boil.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Breakfast Custard(Weight Watchers)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Pour into a 10 ounce custard cup or individual loaf pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top is puffed and lightly brown. Serve hot.
Makes 1 serving.

title: Chicken In Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless chicken breasts (4 halves; cut each in half)

steps: Place chicken pieces in greased baking dish.
Place cheese slices on top.
Spread chicken soup over; sprinkle with bread crumbs mixed with margarine.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 45 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Surprise Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease pans.
Mix all ingredients together and bake 20 minutes.
Yield: 2 dozen.

title: River Rice Pudding
steps: Mix all together on stove.
When mixture begins to thicken, add 2 cups River rice (precooked) and cook until thick and creamy.

title: Ma Rene'S Tea Cakes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat sugar and margarine together until creamy.
Add eggs and beat thoroughly, one at a time.
Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing well.
Add extracts and beat thoroughly.

title: Apple Blossom Salad(Canadian Friend'S)
steps: Mix the jello and hot water until dissolved.
Set the mixture in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
After the hour is over, mix all the ingredients together.
Pour into a mold and chill.

title: Fresh Herbed Vermicelli
steps: Cook vermicelli according to directions.
Drain well.
Set aside.
In same saucepan, melt butter.
Stir in remaining ingredients and vermicelli.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through (3 to 5 minutes).
Serve with green salad.
Great summer lunch.
Serves 6.

title: Coconut Bonbons
steps: Mix coconut, milk, sugar and nuts together.
Form into balls. Heat paraffin wax and chocolate chips.
Dip candy in hot wax mixture.
Cool on wax paper.

title: Asparagus-Bacon Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: asparagus pear
ingredients.raw: 12 fresh asparagus spears or canned asparagus spears

steps: Cook the asparagus spears; drain and cool.
Use a rolling pin to flatten out the bread.
Cut off the crusts after you have rolled over the bread.

This given an uptown finish to the roll-ups. Spread the cream cheese over the bread slices, sprinkle bacon bits over this, add the asparagus spear and roll as for a jellyroll. Cut each slice in half, place on cookie sheet, brush each roll with butter and sprinkle the Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake in hot oven (400°) until the Parmesan has a golden glow (about 5 to 8 minutes), but watch closely so the rolls don't burn.
You could also broil 6 inches from broiler until lightly toasted.
Yields 24 appetizers.

title: Peanut Butter Chews
steps: Bring sugar and Karo to a full boil.
Remove from the heat. Add peanut butter and mix.
Add 15 cups cornflakes.
Put into a pan and press.
Cut while warm.

title: Apple Roll(With Best Biscuit Mix)
steps: Peel, core and fine dice the apples or "coarse grate" in processor.
Place sugar and water in deep pan over low fire. While syrup is cooking, make up one batch of Best Biscuit mix. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick in a rectangle.
Spread apples evenly over dough.
Then roll up and cut as for cinnamon rolls.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dot with oleo and sprinkle cinnamon on top.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
Cut tops from tomatoes and scoop out insides. Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in each tomato and garnish with parsley.

title: Quick Bean Dip
steps: Mix ingredients together.
It's quick and easy.

title: Zucchini-Carrot Casserole

ingredients.name: herb seasoned pepperidge farm dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. herb-seasoned Pepperidge Farm dressing mix

ingredients.name: or zucchini and
ingredients.raw: 3 c. sliced or diced zucchini, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom or chicken soup (undiluted)

steps: Melt oleo; toss with herb-seasoned dressing mix.
Stir half of dressing mixture with the squash, soup, sour cream, onion, carrots and black pepper.
Can add a little salt to taste.
Turn squash mixture into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle remaining half of dressing mixture over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
You can also add browned hamburger meat, drained, to this casserole to make a main dish.

title: Rice Cake(Indonesian)

ingredients.name: sweet coconut juice
ingredients.raw: 7 3/4 oz. can sweet coconut juice or about 1/2 (14 oz.) can coconut milk

steps: Beat margarine and powdered sugar until smooth.
Add slowly the eggs, coconut juice or milk, rice flour, water, salt and vanilla. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 40 minutes at 350° until barely light brown.
Cool.
Sift powdered sugar over, if desired.
Cut into squares.

title: Microwave Easy Peanut Brittle
steps: Cook first 3 ingredients for 4 minutes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, nothing plastic.
Remove and stir.
Replace and cook for 4 more minutes.
Remove and stir well; add butter and vanilla.
Stir well.
Cook 2 more minutes.
Remove from oven; add baking soda.
Stir until foamy.
Pour on a greased cookie sheet and let cool, then break into pieces.

title: Quick Cocoa Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients and then add remainder of ingredients, not stirring until everything is added.
Beat well.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 40 minutes.

title: Three Corn Casserole

ingredients.name: jiffy corn bread mix
ingredients.raw: 1 small box Jiffy corn bread mix

steps: Mix ingredients in a large prepared casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or golden brown.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Stroganoff

ingredients.name: uncooked wide egg noodle
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 c. uncooked wide egg noodles

steps: Cook noodles and drain.
In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion.
Drain grease.
Stir in flour, then add water and mushrooms.
Stir constantly until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and stir in sour cream.
Serve over noodles.
Serves 4.

title: Caramel Marshmallows
steps: Melt caramels, butter and Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk in double boiler or microwave.
Stir until melted.
Roll marshmallows in caramel mixture, then in Rice Krispies.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
steps: Melt margarine.
Add to honey and curry powder.
Cut chicken breasts in half.
Put in baking pan.
Pour mixture over chicken breasts.
Cover and bake. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake another 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients except food coloring.
Add food coloring last.
Makes 3 layers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Lime Jello

ingredients.name: family size pkg. lime jell o

steps: Cream Jell-O and cream cheese; add boiling water and juice. Let set until lightly gelled.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put in 9 x 12-inch pan.
Chill.

title: Refrigerator White Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in warm water.
Combine milk, shortening, sugar and salt and add.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add 1 cup flour; beat well. Beat in yeast mixture and egg.
Add remaining flour; beat well. Place in greased bowl; grease top and cover.
Keep in refrigerator 2 hours, or until needed.

title: Cheese Hamburger Delight
steps: Brown meat and drain.
Add soup (add water if you prefer a thinner dip) and picante sauce. Stir.
Add mushrooms, if desired. Serve hot or cold with chips.

title: Jelly Snowman Carrot Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Generously grease a snowman shaped pan with shortening and dust with flour or spray with cooking spray. In large mixing bowl, beat sugar and eggs until thickened.
Add oil and stir well.
Stir together flour, cinnamon, baking powder and soda.
Add to egg mixture and mix well.
Fold in carrots and nuts. Pour batter into pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Decorate as desired.
(I take two 8-inch cake pans, use one for the body. Make head and arms out of other.
Easy to cut out with sharp knife. I use candy drops for eyes and mouth.)
Fun and easy to make, as you can also use spice cake mix.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls

ingredients.name: uncooked jimmy dean sausage
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. uncooked Jimmy Dean Fresh sausage

ingredients.name: all purpose baking biscuit mix
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. all purpose baking biscuit mix

steps: Preheat oven to 375°. Shred cheese and mix all ingredients. Form into one inch balls. Bake 15 minutes on ungreased baking sheet until golden brown. Makes 6 dozen. Sausage cheese balls can be frozen uncooked.
For a firmer texture add an extra 3 cups of baking biscuit mix and an extra 2 cups of shredded cheese to the ingredients listed above.

title: Hush Puppy (For A Crowd)
steps: Mix dry ingredients (meal, flour, sugar and baking powder). Add eggs (1/2 of them).
Add 1/2 buttermilk.
Add chopped up onions (1/2 of them).
Mix well and then add remainder of onions and milk.
Mix.
Form balls of about a teaspoon size.
Deep fry in oil until done (oil temperature 350°).

title: Low-Fat Lasagne
steps: Layer all items, beginning and ending with sauce.
Cover tightly with foil to allow the noodles to steam cook.
Bake at 350° for 75 minutes or until noodles are soft.
Fast and easy!

title: Kentucky Pound Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients except egg whites.
Beat egg whites until stiff and pour into batter.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Frozen Chocolate Pie
steps: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Add cocoa alternately with milk.
Mix well.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into shell.
Freeze for 8 hours or overnight.
Serve directly from the freezer.
(Pie does not need to be thawed to cut.)

title: Halibut Cheese Bake
steps: Clean and rinse halibut.
Arrange pieces in single layer in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour basting with butter frequently.
While halibut is baking, mix together grated cheese and mayonnaise.
(Mixture will stick to spoon in clumps.)
When halibut is almost done, top with cheese and mayonnaise mixture.
Continue to bake until cheese has melted and is lightly browned.

title: Cocktail Wieners
steps: Mix mustard and jelly in boiler.
Heat and stir until dissolved.
Cut wieners into bite size pieces.
Place in sauce and simmer.
Serve hot.
(You can simmer for several hours and stir occasionally.)

title: Chicken And Pork Adobo

ingredients.name: k. pork
ingredients.raw: 1/2 k. pork, cut into 1 to 2-inch pieces

steps: In a saucepan, combine vinegar, garlic, pepper, bay leaf, rock salt and soy sauce.
Put in chicken and pork.
Let soak 20 to 30 minutes.
Add water and simmer uncovered until tender.
Strain sauce.
Set aside.
Brown garlic, chicken and pork in cooking oil. Return everything to saucepan, cover and simmer until sauce thickens.

title: Homemade Dumplings

ingredients.name: stock pot full chicken broth boiling
ingredients.raw: 1 stock pot full chicken broth, boiling

steps: In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt, milk and chicken broth.
Drop by spoonfuls on boiling liquid.
Cook, uncovered, 20 minutes, then cook another 20 minutes.

title: One-Step White Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients in 1-quart saucepan.
Heat to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Makes 1 cup sauce.

title: Parmesan Oven-Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 6 chicken breasts or 8 to 9 skinned chicken thighs

steps: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.
Dip chicken in salad dressing, then dredge in bread crumb mixture.
Place chicken, bone side down, in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish, coated with cooking spray.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes (breasts), less for thighs, or until tender, at 350°.
Low calorie and tasty!
Easy to prepare.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Shake chicken in bag of flour and seasonings. Line 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish with foil; add margarine and place dish in oven until margarine sizzles.
Place chicken in dish, skin down.
Bake for 30 minutes; turn and bake another 30 minutes.
Do not cover.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Roast
steps: Any cut of beef roast can be used.
Flour and season roast. Brown both sides in frying pan.
After browning, place roast in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Add vegetable as preferred.
Add water to almost cover meat.
Cover baking dish with foil and bake at 200° for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Chicago Lasagna
steps: Saute onion with ground meat until meat is browned.
Drain any grease.

title: Possum Pate
steps: Try to get a possum that has been dead no longer than 3 days and doesn't have any tire marks on his back.
Add that rascal to a pot of boiling water, along with the pepper pods, salt and butter. Cook him 3 to 6 hours.
If he ain't tender, you'll know you got an old possum.
Combine the milk and flour.
Add small quantities of the mixture to the possum and broth.
Remember to stir constantly, so he won't cling to the pot.
If he sticks to the pot, pry him off.
Pull his tail; that usually works best.
Bon appetit!

title: Pasta With Spinach, Garlic And Oil
steps: Stem, wash, drain and coarsely chop spinach leaves.
Set aside.
Cook pasta as package label directs until al dente; drain. In pan, combine oil and garlic.
Saute over medium heat about 2 minutes, or until garlic is golden.
Add spinach, pepper flakes and salt; saute until spinach wilts.
Remove from heat.
Add pasta; toss to coat well and mix.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Creamy Shrimp Appetizer

ingredients.name: boiled and sized shrimp
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. boiled and peeled medium sized shrimp

steps: Mix cheese, mayonnaise and dressing.
Add to all other ingredients, stirring in shrimp last.
Chill at least 3 hours before serving.
Real good for parties!!!

title: Cucumber Appetizers

ingredients.name: good season dry blue cheese mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons dry Blue cheese mix

steps: Soften cream cheese; add sour cream and dry mix.
Spread on party rye bread.
Top with thin sliced cucumber!!

title: Grandma Cheney'S Pecan Pie

ingredients.name: alaga syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Alaga syrup or Delta Cane syrup

steps: Beat eggs; add sugar, syrup, melted butter and vanilla, then stir in
nuts.
Pour
in pie crust and bake at 325° until brown and puffy.
Turn
off
oven
and
let
set
for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Taco Seasoning Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper.
Add taco seasoning. Pour into casserole dish, sprayed with Pam.
Mix corn bread according to directions on package, with 1/2 can onion rings. Pour on top.
Grate cheese and add rest of onion rings on top. Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes.

title: Mrs. Jeffer'S Refrigerator Cookies
steps: Mix butter, salt and sugar.
Add eggs, then flour.
Make into rolls. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate.
Slice thin and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until edges are slightly brown.

title: Chicken Salad With Honey Dressing

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 can (8 oz.) sliced water chestnuts, drained

ingredients.name: lettuce bite size
ingredients.raw: 1/4 head lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces (about 3 c.)

steps: Prepare Honey Dressing.
Toss chicken, grapes, onions, bell pepper, water chestnuts and dressing in large bowl.
Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours or until chilled.
Toss chicken mixture, oranges and lettuce.
Serve on lettuce leaves if desired. Sprinkle with almonds.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Party Mushrooms
steps: Mix mayonnaise, bacon, onion and salt.
Take bread and soak up bacon drippings and add to mixture.
Stuff mushrooms and place in baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and cover with foil.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Pizza
steps: Place ingredients in order listed in greased baking dish. Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes.
Serve warm with corn chips.

title: Barbecue Pork And Mostaccioli
steps: Boil ribs until tender.
Mix barbecue sauce, catsup and water. Dip ribs in sauce, then put them in a Dutch oven.
Pour rest of sauce over ribs.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
Remove ribs from pan.
Put mostaccioli in sauce and mix well.
Put ribs back in pan on top of mostaccioli and bake 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Surprise Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Beat cream cheese, egg yolk, 1/8 cup sugar and vanilla together until smooth.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together to roll bread in. Trim crust from bread.
Flatten each slice with a rolling pin. Spread with cream cheese mixture and roll each tightly.
When all are rolled, dip each roll in butter, then roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut each roll in half.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
May be made ahead and frozen.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
steps: Put in large well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: No Name Cake
steps: Mix in large bowl (dry ingredients); dump in rest.
Stir with spoon.
Bake in tube pan at 350° for 80 minutes.

title: Microwave Toasted Seasoned Pecans
steps: Place pecans in 1 1/2-quart microwavable casserole dish. Sprinkle with seasoned salt.
Cut butter in 8 pieces and space evenly on top of pecans.
Cook, uncovered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking to distribute butter.

title: Canadian Vegetable Soup
steps: Melt butter in heavy saucepan.
Add onion.
Cook and stir until yellow.
Add celery, mixed vegetables and beef stock. Cover and simmer gently until vegetables are tender (15 to 20 minutes).
Combine flour and 1 cup of milk.
Add to vegetables, stirring until thick and smooth.
Add cheese and stir over low heat until smooth.
Gradually add remaining milk, stirring briskly.
Top with minced parsley.

title: Country Muffins
steps: Sift flour and baking powder.
Add remaining ingredients; mix until lumps disappear.
Pour into greased muffin pan or into cupcake papers in muffin pan.
Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Waldorf Grape Salad
steps: Toss grapes, apples, celery, walnuts and cheese.
Add mayo, lemon juice and sugar.
Mix well.
Fold in whipped cream.
May be served as is or served in lettuce cups.

title: Meat Flavoring Vinegar

ingredients.name: pure apple cider vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. pure apple cider vinegar (found in health food stores)

steps: Stir all ingredients together.
Let age 3 weeks.
Two tablespoonfuls of this will flavor and color a stew or gravy.

title: Peanut Butter Chewies
steps: In saucepan, over low heat, melt butter.
Add peanut butter; stir.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spread evenly in lightly oiled square pan.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
steps: Bring sliced apples and apple juice to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 5 minutes.
Dissolve cornstarch in small amount of water and stir into apples.
Cover and bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes, until softened.
Stir in cinnamon.
Pour into pie crust and dot with margarine.
Top with crust.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Beverage
steps: Follow the directions on all the packages except for 1 lemonade package.
Add the contents of this one package (lemonade) dry to the other mixture.
Using less water (since one package will be included "dry") will make the whole drink more zestful and delicious.

title: Cream Of Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tsp. salt or to suit taste

steps: Melt butter in saucepan and stir in vegetables and celery leaves.
Add water.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Navaho Fry Bread
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Add flour, if necessary, to make a stiff dough.
Roll out on a floured board until it is very thin. Cut into strips, about 2 or 3-inches long and 1-inch wide.
Drop into hot oil.
Brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with butter or sprinkle with sugar.

title: Caramel Filling
steps: Melt butter.
Add sugar and canned milk.
Stir until all lumps are gone.
Bring to a rolling boil (that can't be stirred down). Cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Let set a few minutes and heat until the right consistency to spread.
Covers a 3 layer cake.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients in bowl.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Press with fork.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.
Cool on wire rack.
Yields 5 dozen.

title: Oyster Crackers

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch buttermilk dry mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk dry mix

steps: Combine Hidden Valley Ranch mix and oil; add dill weed, lemon pepper and garlic powder.
Pour over crackers; stir to coat. Place in warm oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pepper Relish
steps: Put peppers and onions through grinder and add rest of ingredients.
Mix together.
Cook 30 minutes.
Makes 7 quarts.

title: Easy Pecan Pie
steps: Stir all ingredients together.
Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 1 hour at 300°.
Chill before cutting.

title: Heavenly Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: fruit cocktail well
ingredients.raw: 1 large can fruit cocktail, drained well

steps: Combine fruit and marshmallows.
Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon sugar.
Fold in 1 pint Cool Whip.
Chill.
Serve.

title: Chicken Rotel
steps: Cook chicken.
Remove from bone.
Cut in bite size pieces. Add tomatoes, soup and chicken broth and heat until bubbly.
In 9 x 13-inch baking dish, make a layer of Doritos, then chicken, soup mixture, then cheese.
Repeat and finish with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Russian Sauerkraut Soup

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. diced pork (1 chop should do it)

steps: Cook onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons butter until onion is tender.
Add pork and 1 cup of either broth.
Cook over low heat for 20 minutes.
Add balance of both broths and the sauerkraut. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Blend flour and the 2 tablespoons butter.
Add to soup.
Cook and stir until thickened.
If you wish, add rice before the last 20 minutes of cooking.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Baked Cheesy Green Beans

ingredients.name: bacon and cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jar bacon and cheese spread

steps: Cook beans according to package directions; drain.
Combine soup and cheese spread.
Toss beans with soup mixture; place in 6 cup casserole.
Top with onions and bacon.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine cake mix, 2 eggs and margarine; spread into a well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Next, mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs well; spread on top of first mixture.
Bake for 35 minutes.

title: Quick 3 Bean Salad
steps: Drain canned beans.
Mix together; add dressing and onion. Mix, cover and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Joy'S Divinity
steps: Cook from 248° to 250° to 260°, depends on weather.
If humid, turn oven on to help dry out room.
Pour syrup into dry egg whites; mix until pulls from bottom of bowl and does not shine so much.
Add coloring and pecans.
Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Dimple'S Icebox Fruit Cake
steps: If desired, chop pecans.
Pinch marshmallows.
Crush crackers. Pinch cherries.
Using hands to mix and squeeze, combine all ingredients in a large bowl and add just enough evaporated milk to mix to stiff consistency.

title: Potatoes The Way Men Love Them
steps: Cut
potatoes into thin slices to measure about 4 cups. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in large heavy skillet.
Arrange potato slices in 3 layers, each 1 slice thick, sprinkling each layer with 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Dot top layer with
2 tablespoons
margarine.
Cover; cook over medium heat for
20 minutes.
Uncover
and cook until potatoes are brown, turning once.
Yield:
4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Chowder
steps: In large pot, cook broccoli in 1 can chicken broth for 7 minutes.
Remove broccoli and chop coarsely.
Add remaining broth, milk, ham and pepper to broth in pot.
Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Stir in remaining ingredients and chopped broccoli.
Heat just to serving temperature (do not boil). Yield: 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Good Homemade Frosting
steps: Beat margarine, shortening and sugar.
Add vanilla and gradually add warm milk.

title: Haddock With Almonds
steps: Preheat broiler.
Arrange fish in a single layer in greased shallow baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and olive oil. Broil 5 inches from heat about 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Drain liquids from pan (important!).

title: Escalloped Pineapple(Serve With Ham)
steps: Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, pineapple and milk to moisten.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Nice when served with ham.

title: Easy Tasty Green Beans
steps: Put green beans in covered bowl using 1/2 cup of juice from beans.
(Add the tomatoes if you want.)
Microwave for 16 to 18 minutes on High.
After removing from microwave stir in the remaining ingredients.

title: Dipped Chocolate Candy

ingredients.name: or pkg. chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 4 small (6 oz.) or 2 large (12 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips

steps: Mix first 7 ingredients in large bowl and freeze.
Roll into balls or small thin logs.
Stick toothpicks into balls and freeze.

title: Hash Brown Scallop

ingredients.name: hash brown potato thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed

steps: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, cheese and onion.
Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/2 cup of boiling water.
Pour over potato mixture.
Dot with 1 tablespoon margarine.
Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until potatoes are done, stirring gently once or twice.
If desired, top with triangles of cheese and bake until cheese melts.
Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie Bars

ingredients.name: karo light
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. Karo light or dark corn syrup

ingredients.name: sq. semi sweet chocolate
ingredients.raw: 6 sq. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate or 1 1/2 (6 oz.) pkg. sweet chocolate

steps: Crust:
Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
(Be certain sides of baking pan are 1-inch high.)
In large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat flour, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and salt until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; press firmly and evenly into pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Oven Baked Pork Chops
steps: Combine crumbs, salt and pepper. In another bowl, blend egg and milk.
Coat chops with crumbs.
Dip in egg mixture and again in crumbs.
Place butter in pan.
Melt.
Place chops in a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Turn chops and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Yummy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Mash potatoes and add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Can be made up and stored in refrigerator up to one week.
When refrigerated, bake 45 minutes.
Can freeze before baking.

title: Vivian'S Cornbread With Pepper
steps: Mix all ingredients except oil.
Reserve one half of cheese for topping.
Put oil in skillet and heat until hot.
Pour over cornbread mixture, stir fast to melt cheese.
Pour mixture into hot skillet.
Top with reserved cheese.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Frosted Banana Cookies(Great For Using Those Last Two Bananas)
steps: Cream shortening.
Add sugar and blend.
Add egg, vanilla and bananas.
Sift flour, salt and soda.
Add to banana mixture and mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.
These cookies brown only on the edges.

title: Never Fail "Boiled Icing"
steps: Boil together sugar, water and vinegar to 238°, or until syrup spins a long thread when dropped from spoon.
Beat egg whites stiff.
Gradually add syrup beating constantly until frosting holds shape.
Add vanilla.
Makes enough for 2 layers.

title: Cheesy Asparagus Spears

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.raw: 3/4 lb. fresh asparagus or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen asparagus spears

ingredients.name: bottled hot pepper sauce
ingredients.raw: several dash bottled hot pepper sauce

steps: Wash fresh asparagus and break off tough ends.
In a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish, arrange fresh or frozen spears with tips toward center.
Add water, cover with vented clear plastic wrap.
Cook on 100% power for 7 to 9 minutes or until tender; rearrange asparagus once by switching center spears with those on the edges.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
steps: Mix together sugar and eggs.
Mix flour and soda together. Add to sugar mixture.
Stir in pineapple, nuts and vanilla.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch greased and floured pan.

title: Cherry Fruit Salad
steps: Drain juices from cherries and pineapple.
Heat juices to boiling and pour over Jell-O, stirring until dissolved.
Let cool until starting to gel.
Beat cheese with mixer until very soft. Stir in pineapple, cherries and nuts.
Add to Jell-O mixture and blend well.
Then stir in Coca-Cola and blend again.
Pour into oiled molds to congeal.
Makes 1 large mold or 2 medium size molds.

title: Best Beer Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Mix all ingredients well, adjusting the sugar according to how sweet a biscuit you prefer. Pour into well greased muffin tins.
Bake 15-20 min.
Serve with honey butter.

title: Apple Pound Cake

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. buttermilk or plain nonfat yogurt

ingredients.name: apple and
ingredients.raw: 2 medium apples, peeled and diced (2 c.)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Spray a 10-inch tube pan with Pam.
Mix flour, baking powder and soda until blended.
In a large bowl, beat sugar, margarine and buttermilk about 4 minutes.
With a mixer on medium speed, alternately add flour mixture and egg substitute.
Beat until well blended and fluffy.
Stir in apples and vanilla.
Spread in pan.
Bake 1 hour or until golden brown and a pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack 10 minutes.
Turn out onto rack and cool completely. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Ground Bologna
steps: Grind bologna.
Grind sweet pickles to taste.
Add Miracle whip to taste.

title: Easy Oatmeal Pecan Cookies

ingredients.name: instant oatmeal
ingredients.raw: 4 pkg. instant oatmeal (2 flavored and 2 regular)

steps: Mix together by hand.
Roll in small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 12 minutes.
Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.

title: Old Fashioned Lemon Pie
steps: Combine sugar and cornstarch thoroughly in heavy boiler.
Add water, grated rind and lemon juice to mixture.
Cook over low heat until the mixture begins to thicken.
Beat egg yolks slightly.
Add hot mixture, a little at a time, to the beaten egg yolks.
Return mixture to boiler and continue to cook over low heat until mixture thickens to consistency desired.
Pour cool mixture into a 9-inch pastry shell.
Top with meringue.
Brown meringue in oven preheated at 350°.

title: Irene'S Cobbler

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 4 c. fruit or berries (fresh or if frozen, drain liquid out)

steps: Combine fruit with 1 cup sugar and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Melt butter in 12 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
Mix flour and baking powder and add the second cup of sugar with milk and blend well.
Pour batter over melted butter (oleo) in baking dish and ladle hot fruit mix and juice over top of dish.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Cordon Bleu
steps: Spread as many cutlets as needed with slices of boiled ham and cheese.
Roll up.
Dip into mixture of grated cheese and egg. Saute in hot butter or fat until done.

title: Aunt Rachel'S Custard Pie

ingredients.name: sugar or
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. sugar or to taste

ingredients.name: sweet milk at room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sweet milk, at room temperature

steps: Beat eggs slightly.
Mix sugar and flour and add to eggs; mix well.
Stir in lemon juice, milk and butter and stir well.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.

title: Flan
steps: To prepare caramel:
In round
metal mold, cook 2/3 cup sugar on medium heat until golden brown (watch it doesn't burn).
Stir constantly until smooth.
Remove from heat and move it around until bottom and all sides are covered with caramel.
Let it cool.
