steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; put milk, butter, sugar and salt in a saucepan and bring to a scald (do not boil), letting butter melt.
Stir.
Put milk mixture in a large bowl; add yeast mixture and stir together.
Sift in the 5 cups of flour gradually until dough is formed.
Cover and place in warm place to rise. Let rise 15 minutes.
Knead dough down and roll out on a floured surface to cut into rolls.
Place rolls on a greased pan, touching each other.
Cover with wax paper and let rise about 15 minutes. Bake in 450° to 475° oven for about 12 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
steps: Mix ingredients in the order written.
Refrigerate.

title: Ketchup Swiss Steak
steps: Brown round steak.
Quarter onions and add water.
Add seasoning.
Simmer approximately 3 hours.
Add ketchup to taste, approximately 8 to 12 ounces.
Simmer 1 hour more.

title: Peach-Glazed Chicken With Stuffing

ingredients.name: stove top stuffing chicken flavor
ingredients.raw: 3 c. Stove Top stuffing chicken flavor

steps: Drain peaches, reserving syrup.
Add water to make 1 cup.
Set aside.
Brown chicken in hot oil in skillet.
Add water-syrup mixture, margarine, sugar, vinegar and allspice.
Bring to boil; cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in stuffing mix and peaches; remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks.
Beat thoroughly. Combine with graham cracker crumbs, rolled fine, and baking powder. Add flavoring, milk and nuts.
Mix thoroughly.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into well-oiled, shallow pans.
Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream.

title: Hearty Potatoes
steps: Mix ingredients together in a large bowl by hand.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
steps: Melt margarine in bottom of baking dish.
Layer the vanilla wafer crumbs, chocolate pieces, nuts and coconut.
Dribble the Eagle Brand milk over the top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Cool and cut in desired size squares.

title: Country Brunch Casserole

ingredients.name: white bean
ingredients.raw: 10 slices white bread, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
In dish, layer bread, bacon and cheese.
Beat together eggs, milk and salt; pour over bread, bacon and cheese layers.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut in squares.

title: Unbelievable Pork Chops
steps: Rub chops on both sides with salt, pepper and sage.
Brown chops in a large skillet.
Place onion slices on top of chops. Add consomme. Cover and simmer 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Apples

ingredients.name: or apple and
ingredients.raw: 5 or 6 large apples, peeled and quartered

steps: Mix brown sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt until crumbly. Place apples and mixture alternately in greased baking dish.
Add 2 teaspoons of lemon juice to 1/2 cup water and pour over all. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Sour Cream Self-Rising Cornbread
steps: Mix well and pour into an 8-inch lightly greased pan.
Bake.

title: Savory Skillet Meal
steps: Cut meat into serving pieces; salt and dip in flour.
Brown in skillet in hot oil.
Place vegetables on top of meat.
Add mushroom soup.
Cover skillet; turn heat to simmer (when steam escapes freely).
Simmer 50 minutes.

title: Amish Bubble Up Pizza
steps: Layer in baking dish, saving some cheese for the top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mom'S Lemon Sauce
steps: Dissolve cornstarch in water.
Melt butter.
Add sugar and dissolve.
Pour water with cornstarch into butter and brown sugar mixture and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and squeeze juice from lemon (to taste).

title: Cape Cod Cranberry-Pear Relish

ingredients.name: pear cored and
ingredients.raw: 1 medium pear, peeled, cored, and diced

steps: In 3-quart saucepan, heat cranberries, sugar, vinegar, and water to boiling over high heat, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, until most of cranberries pop, about 10 minutes.

Add diced pear, cover and cook about 10 minutes longer. Cover and refrigerate relish until well chilled, about 4 hours. Can be transferred to an airtight container and kept in refrigerator for up to 2 days.
Makes about 3 cups.

title: Chicken Barbecue
steps: Heat and let come to boil.
Salt and arrange chicken in Pyrex, greased well.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Sprinkle heavily with flour and dot with butter and pepper.
Cook at 400° until bubbly. Then turn to 300° to 325° for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours, according to size of chicken pieces.
Turn good side up first and turn over about halfway through.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie

ingredients.name: each ginger cinnamon and nutmeg
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each: ginger, cinnamon and nutmeg

ingredients.name: cold water and tbsp. gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. cold water and 1 Tbsp. gelatin

steps: To slightly beaten egg yolks, add 1/2 cup sugar, pumpkin, milk, salt and spices.
Cook until thick in a double boiler. Pour water into a bowl and sprinkle gelatin on top of water.
Add to hot pumpkin mixture.
Mix thoroughly and cool.

title: Viva La Chicken Casserole
steps: Salt chicken; wrap in foil and bake 1 hour at 400°.
Cool and cut into bite size pieces.
Break 6 tortillas in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Spread half of the cut up chicken over the tortillas.
Mix the rest of the ingredients (except the cheese) together and pour half the mixture over the chicken and tortillas. Repeat layers and cover with shredded cheese.
Refrigerate overnight.
Remove from fridge and let it come to room temperature.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Grandma'S Swedish Blueberry Pudding
steps: Boil sugar and water until it thickens as syrup.
Add blueberries and boil 3 to 4 minutes.
Butter a casserole dish. Place a slice of bread, a layer of berries, alternating and ending with berries on top.
Chill in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours.
Serve with whipped cream.

title: Anna Beth'S Corn Bread
steps: Mix all dry ingredients first.
Add milk, mayo and egg, gradually, stirring well.
Preheat oven to 475 degrees.
Bake about 25 minutes or until browned.
I recommend using a small iron skillet-reserving it for cornbread only.

title: Cholesterol-Free Lemon Chiffon Cake

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. vegetable oil or corn oil

steps: In a large bowl using electric mixer, whip egg whites with powdered sugar until fluffy, but not dry.
Set whites aside.
In another bowl, sift flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt.
Scoop out a well in the center of the flour and add oil, lemon rind and juice.
With medium speed on mixer, beat until well blended and smooth.
Fold the batter into the whites.
Spread solid shortening on bottom and sides of 9-inch tube pan and dust with flour.
Pour batter into pan and bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned on top.
(Should spring back to touch.)
Cool cake right side up in pan for 5 minutes. Invert onto wire rack and lift off the pan.
Cool completely and ice, if desired.

title: Chicken Fingers

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips

ingredients.name: pancake mix
ingredients.raw: 2 c. pancake mix (to roll fingers in)

steps: Let chicken soak in milk for 1 hour.
Drain and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Roll in pancake mix until well coated.
Fry in deep fat until done and floats, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Basic Plain Cake
steps: Cream shortening; add sugar and continue creaming until fluffy.
Add eggs.
Beat until light.
Sift flour; measure.
Add salt and baking powder and sift twice more.
Add vanilla to milk. Add dry and liquid ingredients alternately to creamed mixture. Beat until thoroughly blended.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°. Makes 2 (8-inch) layers.

title: Quick Yeast Rolls
steps: Combine yeast and 1/2 cup warm milk in 2-cup liquid measuring cup; let stand 5 minutes.
Combine yeast mixture and remaining milk and next 4 ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Gradually add 1 cup flour, stirring until smooth.
Gradually stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.
Place in well-greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover and let stand in warm place free from drafts for 15 minutes.
Punch dough down; cover and let stand in warm place free from drafts for 15 minutes.
Turn dough out onto floured surface; knead 3 or 4 times.
Divide dough into 24 pieces; shape into balls.
Place in 2 greased 9-inch square pans. Cover and let stand in warm place free from drafts for 15 minutes. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Camp Fire Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes in slices with skin on.
Place potatoes on bottom of tin foil that was sprayed with Pam.
Cut peppers and onions in slices and place on top of potatoes.
Pour oil all around and close up the tin foil and place on a grate over the open fire.

title: Unbaked Butterscotch Cookies
steps: In a large saucepan, combine sugar, butter or margarine and canned milk.
Bring mixture to a boil, stirring frequently. Remove from stove and add pudding, rolled oats, coconut and nuts. Mix together thoroughly.
Cool.
Drop dough by teaspoon on wax paper.
Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Ham-Cheese Quiche
steps: Combine oil and shredded raw potatoes.
Press evenly into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake 15 minutes at 425° until crust starts to brown.
Remove from oven.
Layer ham and shredded cheese.
Mix together half and half, eggs and salt and pepper to taste.
Pour mixture over ham and cheese.
Preheat oven at 425°.
Bake 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. In a large bowl combine first 4 ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Ala Parmigiana

ingredients.name: salt and ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Split and bone chicken breasts.
Remove and discard the skin. Season the flour with salt and pepper to taste; add nutmeg. Dredge the breasts lightly in the flour mixture.
Dip the breasts into the eggs and then in a mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese, coating thoroughly.
Brown on all sides in the melted butter.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
Serves 4.

title: Cheese Drop Biscuits
steps: Mix all ingredients together until dough is soft.
(Food processor works well.)
Drop by tablespoonful on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.

title: Honey Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Peach Dessert
steps: Fix 1 box jello by directions; add 3/4 can of peaches (no juice).
Let set up.
Mix other box jello with 1/2 cup boiling water; stir until dissolved.
Add 1/2 Cool Whip.
Beat until mixed well.
Chill.
Add remaining Cool Whip.
Top with remaining peaches.

title: Cinnamon Applesauce Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin and candies in 3 cups boiling water.
Stir in applesauce, lemon juice and salt.
Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan or gelatin mold.
Chill until set.

title: Brownies (Fudge Type)
steps: In a mixing bowl, mix very lightly, sugar and butter (just enough to mix) then add one egg at a time.	Add the rest of ingredients as listed. Pour in a large, greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Homemade Peanut Brittle
steps: Mix peanuts, Karo syrup, water and sugar together.
Cook on medium high, stirring constantly until syrup turns a caramel color, 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add soda and stir vigorously for a few seconds.
Then pour on a greased cookie sheet.
When cool, break in desired pieces.

title: Caramel Pudding Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamy mixture with milk.
Stir until smooth.
Stir in raisins and spread in a greased 8-inch square pan.
Combine brown sugar and cold water.
Pour over batter.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm.
Makes 9 servings.

title: Mini-Pizza Snacks
steps: Spread 3 tablespoons pizza sauce on an English muffin half. Top with meat and mushrooms, then add cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted and slightly brown, or boil for 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Beef Tips With Peppers
steps: Cut sirloin into thin strips.
In a large skillet, quickly brown steak, adding A. 1. sauce and Worcestershire sauce to taste. Add peppers and onions.
Cook until tender, about 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve alone or over rice.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
steps: Saute hamburg until blood disappears.
Add rest of ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

title: Pepperoni Casserole

ingredients.name: uncooked macaroni seashell
ingredients.raw: 3 c. uncooked macaroni seashells or others

steps: Cook macaroni until tender, but firm.
Drain.
Heat sauce and mix with macaroni. Add mushrooms and half the pepperoni. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and 3/4 of the Mozzarella.
Mix together and place in a buttered casserole. Top with remaining Mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese has melted.
Serves 6.

title: Buljol
steps: Break fish in pieces and place in saucepan with cold water. Gradually heat to boiling and pour off water.
Repeat until fish is no longer salty.
Remove skin and bones and slice fish in very small pieces.
Blend fish with first five ingredients.
Serve on platter and garnish with lettuce, hard-cooked eggs and avocado pear slices.

title: Cobbler Pie
steps: Melt margarine in baking dish.
Add sugar, milk and flour. Mix well with spoon.
Pour fruit or berries on top of this mixture, but do not stir.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Peppermint Patties
steps: In bowl, combine 10x sugar, butter, peppermint extract and vanilla.
Add milk and mix well.
Roll into one-inch balls and place on a waxed paper lined cookie sheet.
Chill for 20 minutes. Flatten with the palm of hand to 1/4-inch thickness.
Chill for an hour.
Dip into coating chocolate; place on waxed paper until chocolate is set.
Yield: Approximately 5 dozen.

title: Minutes To My Marvelous Meat Loaf
steps: Place mixture on cookie sheet.
Let cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Simple!!
Enjoy!!

title: Cranberry-Apple Mold
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water and let cool.
Stir in next 7 ingredients and spoon into lightly oiled 4-cup mold.
Cover and chill until firm.
Unmold on lettuce leaves and garnish with fresh cranberries and orange rind strips, if desired.

title: Orange Jello Sherbet
steps: Allow sherbet to soften to a mushy consistency.
Dissolve marshmallows in hot Jell-O mixture.
Add pineapple and oranges, then sherbet.
Add Cool Whip last.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or 1 can cream of chicken soup

steps: Melt margarine in frying pan; saute onion.
Add rice and stir. Pour in soup, milk, water and cheese; mix until cheese melts. Grease bottom and sides of baking dish.
Chop broccoli and cauliflower; place in baking dish.
Pour cheese and rice mixture on top; bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Bar Cookies
steps: Mix cake mix, peanut butter, margarine and eggs and pat 1/2 the mixture in an ungreased loaf pan.
Keep other half in bowl until the last.
Combine rest of ingredients and pour over top of the half in loaf pan, then crumble the half remaining in bowl over what is in the loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Grits Souffle
steps: Combine grits, milk, onion and salt in a medium size bowl. Beat yolks until thick and lemon color.
Stir yolk and cheese into mix.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Set casserole in a baking pan and pour boiling water in pan to a depth of 1 inch. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.

title: Party Baked Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast and boned
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, halved and boned (8 pieces)

steps: Tear beef slices into bits and cover bottom of greased casserole dish.
Wrap each chicken breast with slice of bacon, ends of bacon on bottom of dish.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Vicki'S Chicken

ingredients.name: good season s italian salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Good Season's Italian salad dressing mix

steps: Mix sauce.
Coat chicken.
Place in pan and cover with foil. Cook approximately 1 1/2 hours at 325°, turning chicken after 45 minutes.
Serve with Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt, paprika and pepper.
Saute rice and onion in butter.
Spread rice mixture in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Add broth and celery salt.

title: Butterscotch Cornflake Cookies
steps: Melt chips and peanut butter in a double boiler.
Pour over flakes.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
Refrigerate for 1/2 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix ingredients and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.

title: Lentil Garlic Soup
steps: Saute garlic, onion, carrots and celery in olive oil in medium soup pot.
Add lentils, broth, red wine, vinegar and pepper. Simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 6 or 7 people.

title: Company Potatoes

ingredients.name: dry onion mix
ingredients.raw: dry onion mix or chopped fresh onion

steps: Cook potatoes until done; drain and add soup.
Blend with mixer.
Add cheese and onion and blend.
Melt margarine in microwave oven.
Pour 1/2 melted margarine in large glass baking dish.
Pour potato mixture over margarine.
Sprinkle potatoes with crushed corn flakes.
Pour remaining margarine over top of corn flakes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until mixture bubbles.

title: Butterscotch Meringues
steps: Here is the butterscotch version of the meringue recipe you call Forgotten Cookies.
They are also called Simple Simons.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.raw: 10 slices bread, broken into small pieces

steps: Mix all together, except butter and cracker crumbs.
Place in a greased 8 x 10-inch casserole.
Mix melted butter and cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle over the top of casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Broccoli
steps: Clean and cut broccoli into small pieces.
Combine all ingredients and pour over broccoli, which is in a sealed container (i.e.
Tupperware).
Marinate overnight.
Shake occasionally, turning upside down, if container is leakproof.
Great at picnics served cold.

title: Doris' Mints
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill until firm.
Make small balls and roll in white sugar.
Press in mint mold and pop out. Makes about 150.

title: Cannoli
steps: In a large bowl with electric mixer at low, beat Ricotta, sugar, orange peel and vanilla just until smooth.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Cover.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Spoon mixture into ice cream cones.
Serves 10.

title: Italian Toast
steps: In mixing bowl, cream margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add 2 eggs and flavoring.
Stir in flour mixture and mix well.
Add nuts to batter.
Chill well (about 2 hours).
Shape into 3 loaves.
Brush top with egg white from third egg.
Bake on slightly greased cookie sheet at 300° for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Slice into 1/2-inch diagonal slices.
Return to oven and brown 30 minutes or until dry.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast split skinned and
ingredients.raw: 2 whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boneless

steps: Place ham and cheese slices on each breast half.
Roll up chicken from narrow end.
Secure with toothpicks.
In skillet, heat oil and cook chicken for 10 minutes or until brown on all sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Heat until boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars in mixing bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg.
Add salt, soda, flour and water; mix well. Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 11 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool on cookie sheet.

title: Impossible French Apple Pie
steps: Mix apples, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Turn in a greased 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate.
Beat milk, butter, eggs and sugar until smooth (about 1 minute).
Pour over apple mixture.
Sprinkle Bisquick Streusel on top.
Bake at 325° until a knife inserted in center comes out clean (about 55 to 65 minutes).

title: Four Layer Dessert
steps: This dessert is in layers.
They are as follows:

title: Pecan Tarts
steps: Mix like pie crust; chill for a short time.
Roll into balls the size of walnuts.
Press into small tart pans.

title: Impossible Quiche Lorraine

ingredients.name: bacon and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. bacon, cooked and crumbled or chopped ham

steps: Place all ingredients in blender except meat and cheese. Place in a 9-inch deep pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon or ham.
Press down.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Texas Pecan Pie
steps: Cream butter and
sugar.
Add
eggs, molasses and lemon juice. Beat with rotary egg beater and add pecans.
Pour into unbaked pastry shell
and
garnish with pecan halves.
Bake in hot oven, 450°,
minutes;
then reduce temperature to 350° and continue baking 30 minutes.

title: Green Bean And Mozzarella Salad

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh green beans, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Bacon And Swiss Quiche
steps: Fry bacon.
Spread frozen pie crust with 1 tablespoon melted butter.
Crumble bacon into bottom of pie and add Swiss strips. Mix 2 cups heavy cream with 4 eggs and 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper.
Pour over bacon and Swiss.
Bake at 425° for first 15 minutes.
Drop temperature to 350° and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Corn Meal Mush(A High-Protein Alternative To Pancakes.)

ingredients.name: corn meal
ingredients.raw: 1 c. corn meal or coarse corn flour

steps: The night before:
Bring water and salt to boil in a large pot; remove from heat.
Slowly add corn flours while stirring. Return to heat; cook over low heat until very stiff.
Let cool to touch.
Shape into a block about 4 inches high.
Wrap in foil or plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Shaker Lemon Pie
steps: Slice lemons as thin as paper, rind and all. Combine with sugar.
Mix well.
Let stand 2 hours or longer, preferably blending occasionally.
Add beaten mixture to lemon mixture.
Mix well. Turn into pie shell, arranging lemon slices evenly.
Cover with top crust.
Cut several slits near center.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375° and bake 20 minutes or until knife inserted near edge of pie comes out clean.

title: Ritz Cracker Dessert
steps: Mix sugar into beaten egg whites.
Add sugar, baking powder, vanilla and nuts.
Put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes; cool.
Prepare whipped topping.
Add cream cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Add crushed pineapple; pour into chilled crust and garnish with crumbs on top.

title: Colorado Marble
steps: Melt German sweet chocolate in 6 tablespoons hot water.
Add egg yolks to hot mixture, one at a time, stirring quickly so they don't curdle.
Add powdered sugar.
Set aside in pan of cool water to cool.
Beat egg whites; whip whipping cream.
Fold together. Combine with chocolate mixture.

title: Destroy Your Diet Dessert

ingredients.name: premium vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 gal. premium vanilla ice cream (Haagan-dazs, Trauth, etc.)

steps: Prepare brownies according to directions on package.
Add pecans to the mix.
To serve, place a brownie on dessert dish. Top with generous scoop of ice cream and pour caramel which has been heated in microwave over the ice cream.

title: German Meat Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: french fried onion ring
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) can French fried onion rings

steps: Parboil carrots and potatoes for 20 minutes.
Saut onion in butter; add beef and cook until turns grey.
Butter a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Alternate layers, beef-onion mixture and vegetables. Mix catsup with soup and pour over casserole.
Saut mushrooms in 3 tablespoons butter and place on top of casserole.
Sprinkle onion rings over top.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes or until onion rings are brown and crisp.
Yield:
6 large servings.

title: Apple Bundles
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Unroll dough.
Separate into 8 triangles.
Cut each in half to make 16 triangles.
Slice apples. At the wide end of each strip of dough, place 4 to 5 slices of apple and roll.
Place on cookie sheet.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
With pastry brush, brush each one with melted butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake 11 to 13 minutes.

title: Delicious Dirt

ingredients.name: oreo cooky grind in blender
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. Oreo cookies, grind in blender

steps: Mix cream cheese, butter and sugar together until blended. Add pudding and milk and beat on low speed until thickened.
Stir in Cool Whip by hand.

title: Chicken And Noodles
steps: Boil chicken until done.
Pull it off the bone.
Use broth to cook the egg noodles.
Add chicken, both cans of soup and chicken cubes in with the noodles.
Cook until juice starts to thicken.

title: Pimiento Spread

ingredients.name: american cream cheese fine
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. American cream cheese, chopped fine

steps: Mix flour, milk and egg.
Cook until thick.
Add vinegar, sugar, salt and cheese.
Cook until smooth.
Take from heat.
Add eggs and pimientos.

title: Butterscotch Bubble Loaf
steps: Generously butter a 12-cup Bundt pan.
Sprinkle with nuts. Cut partially thawed bread into 24 cubes and place in pan. Sprinkle pudding, sugar and cinnamon on bread.
Cover and let rise to double, 3 to 4 hours.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Turn out on plate lined with waxed paper.

title: Beef & Rice With Mushroom Gravy

ingredients.name: pkg. mushroom gravy
ingredients.raw: 1 - 2 pkg. mushroom gravy or 1 can of cream of mushroom soup

steps: Simmer beef stew meat in crock pot or skillet.
Add mushroom gravy mix or soup.
Add mushrooms, heat until soup and mushrooms are hot.
Cook rice.
Pour gravy over rice.

title: Honey(Without Bees)
steps: Boil sugar, water and alum about 12 minutes (rolling boil). Turn off heat.
Press clover blooms in hot syrup.
Let stand 20 to 30 minutes.
Strain in cheesecloth after removing clover blooms. Pour in jars.

title: Steak Marinade

ingredients.name: thyme leaf stripped of twiggy part
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh thyme leaves, stripped of twiggy part

steps: Puree all ingredients in blender until creamy.
Marinade is best if made 24 hours ahead to marry flavors.

title: Aunt Mildred'S Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Boil chicken until tender; cool.
Debone and set aside.
In mixing bowl, blend flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add enough chicken broth to form dough.
Roll out on floured surface (thin).
Cut into strips and drop into boiling chicken broth.
Add deboned chicken; reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook 20 to 25 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poverele (Chilled Squash Salad With Fresh Mint)
steps: Peel squash and cut into circles.
Cook squash until tender (do not overcook).
Combine squash, mint leaves (fresh only) and white vinegar.
Chill for 3 hours.
Serve with crusty Italian bread for dipping.

title: Less Fat Banana Nut Bread
steps: Cream applesauce and sugar and then add eggs.
Continue to beat.
In a separate bowl, crush bananas.
Add nuts and bananas to mixture.
Mix flour, soda and salt in a separate bowl.
Add to mixture and beat well.
Turn into loaf pan and bake just until knife comes out clean, about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chocolate Mint Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: paste mint candy
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. pastel mint candies (Guirard puts some out)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl combine all ingredients; blend well.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until set. Cool one minute; remove from cookie sheets.
Makes approximately 4 dozen.

title: Serendipitous Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 8-inch square baking pan; set aside.
Melt chocolate and butter over low heat, stirring occasionally; set aside.
In large mixer bowl beat eggs until foamy.
Gradually add sugar; beat until light and fluffy, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
Beat in chocolate until just combined. Stir in flour, salt and vanilla just until blended.
Spread in prepared pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out barely clean.
Do not overbake.
Cool completely in pan on wire rack.
Makes 16 squares, about 165 calories each.

title: Divinity Candy
steps: Boil first 5 ingredients until forms soft ball, just like fudge.
Add Marshmallow Creme; then pour into greased dish and cut into squares.
Garnish with nuts, if desired.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
steps: In double boiler, melt chocolate chips (over boiling water). Stir in sweetened condensed milk.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop teaspoon sized amounts onto a waxed paper cookie sheet.
Chill 2 hours.
Store at room temperature, covered loosely.

title: Baked No Peek Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients except chicken.
Pour into 13 x 9 pan. Put chicken in.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add salad oil and milk.
Spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425° for 18 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Ralphie'S Beef Stroganoff
steps: Chop onion and saute with mushrooms until slightly brown. Remove from pan.
Slice meat into thin strips and fry with a small amount of oil until cooked.
Sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper while frying.
A little browning in the bottom of the skillet is desirable.
Return onions and mushrooms to frying pan.
Add sour cream and enough milk to make a gravy.

title: Fruit Cookies
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs; stir in buttermilk.
Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture.
Fold in pecans, cherries and dates.
Drop small amounts onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Yields 6 dozen cookies.

title: Patty'S Taste "N" Stuff(Ground Beef And Macaroni Combo)
steps: Saute onion and pepper in oil until tender. Add ground beef and cook until brown.
In a saucepan, combine ground beef mixture, tomato paste, tomato sauce, water and spaghetti sauce mix.
Cook on medium heat about 20 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking. Add macaroni. Simmer on low heat 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken

ingredients.name: wyler s chicken flavor instant bouillon
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. Wyler's chicken flavor instant bouillon

steps: In plastic bag, combine all ingredients, except chicken.
Add chicken.
Cover.
Marinate in refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight.
Remove chicken from marinade.
Heat marinade thoroughly.
Grill or broil chicken, basting frequently with marinade.

title: Ham And Egg Casserole
steps: In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan layer half of the bread, chopped ham and cheese; repeat.
Combine eggs, milk, onion salt, salt and pepper.
Pour over layered mixture.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake in 375° oven for 40 minutes or until bubbly.
A good Sunday morning brunch.

title: Venison Chili
steps: Brown venison and onion in skillet.
In pan put rest of ingredients.
Bring to boil and then add meat.
Cook until done. Add 2 tablespoons brown sugar.

title: Barbecued Meatballs And Baked Beans

ingredients.name: each brown sugar vinegar and worcestershire sauce
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. each: brown sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce

steps: Mix together the beef, salt, pepper, bread crumbs and 3/4 cup water.
Shape into balls, brown and pour off the fat.
Add all but beans.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add beans and bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Guacamole
steps: Mash meat of 1 very, very, large avocado with a fork.
Add juice of lemon, salt and pepper.
Add grated onion, dash of garlic salt and Tabasco sauce.
Beat with hand mixer until smooth.
Serve with corn chips.

title: Quick Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix sugars, oil, vanilla and egg in a bowl with a spoon until smooth.
Stir in flour, salt and baking soda.
Spread dough into a greased square or round (8 or 9-inch) cake pan.
Sprinkle with chips.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool. Cut into squares or wedges.

title: Western Baked Chicken
steps: Combine 1/2 teaspoon chili powder with bread crumbs.
Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken breasts which lay in buttered casserole.
Cover with bread crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Cauliflower And Lettuce Salad

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 onion (sweet Bermuda or Noon Day), chopped

ingredients.name: hellmann s
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Hellmann's (I prefer salad dressing; your choice)

steps: Cut up cauliflower.
Tear up lettuce (I prefer to use hands instead of knife).
Crumble up bacon.
Mix all ingredients together with dressing.
Sprinkle cheese over top.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
steps: Mix cereal with butter.
Blend sugar into eggs.
Add cereal mixture and remaining ingredients.
Mix well.

title: Double Decker Fudge

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

steps: In a 2-cup glass measure with handle, combine peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk.
Cook on 100% power (High) in microwave for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute, until chips are melted and mixture is smooth.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla; spread evenly into foil lined 8-inch square pan.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Pot Pie

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: flour (enough to make stiff biscuit like dough)

steps: Knead briefly and roll out on floured surface as thin as you can.
Cut into squares.
Drop into boiling broth and cook 15 minutes or until done.
Add parsley before serving.

title: Surprise Meat Loaf
steps: Combine applesauce, salt, nutmeg and pepper.
Add ground beef, bread crumbs, chopped onion and egg; mix thoroughly.
Fold cheese into meat mixture.
Mold into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake at 350° for 75 minutes.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Beer Batter For Chicken
steps: Stir together the first 3 ingredients, then beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold into the first mixture.
This is a great batter for chicken!

title: Sawdust Salad
steps: Mix
jello
together
by
directions on box in a mixing bowl and
chill	until it's soft, then add bananas, pineapple and marshmallows.
Pour
into
a
large Pyrex baking dish and chill until firm.

title: Curry Chicken
steps: Mix milk, butter, mustard, honey, curry and salt in bowl until blended.
Roll chicken in mixture, making sure it is well coated. Place chicken in roasting pan and place in 350° oven.

title: Robert Redford Dessert

ingredients.name: instant chocolate pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 3/4 oz. size) pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix

steps: In medium pan, mix flour and butter with pastry blender.
Stir in walnuts and press mixture into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 325° or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Popovers(Portuguese)
steps: Beat together ingredients with rotary beater just until smooth.
Pour into well-greased deep muffin cup (3/4 full) or oven glass cups (1/2 full). Bake at 425° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Meringue For Pies
steps: Dissolve cornstarch in cold water and add boiling water. Slowly bring to boil, stirring constantly.
This goes fast as there is little liquid involved.
Put aside to cool.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
On high speed, gradually add sugar and salt until peaks form.
Add vanilla.
Switch to low speed.
Gradually add cooled cornstarch mixture.
Turn to high speed.
Beat well until peaks stand when beater is withdrawn.
Pile on pie filling. Bake at 375° until lightly browned.

title: Tortilla Casserole
steps: Brown meat; drain, then add chili.
Warm thoroughly.

title: Sister Mary'S Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients and spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust.
Crimp edges to seal.
Slit top crust and brush with egg, if desired.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Honey Citrus Chicken
steps: Place chicken skin side down in pan.
Mix other ingredients and pour/brush over chicken.
Cut orange in pieces and tuck around chicken.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 375°.
Turn and cook another 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Ala King

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Put salted turkey in roaster.
Pour over turkey 1 cup boiling water with 1 stick of melted margarine.
Cover airtight with lid or tent made of heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.
Place in a 450° preheated oven.
Bake for 1 hour.
Do not open oven door.
Leave in oven overnight, or until oven is cold.
(I cook mine last thing before going to bed.)
This time is for a 12-pound turkey.
Add about 5 minutes per pound for larger turkey.

title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour and salt, then add to creamed mixture along with milk.
Add vanilla and coloring.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325° or until well done.
Use favorite frosting.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Mix together water and yeast.
Add other ingredients.
Knead for 10 minutes.
Shape, cover and let rise 1 hour in a warm place in a well-greased bowl.
Punch down; place in greased loaf pan. Let rise 1 hour and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 375°.

title: Fresh Corn And Tomato Casserole

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. salt or to suit taste

steps: Cut corn from cob, about 4 to 5 cups of corn.
Melt butter or drippings in skillet; add corn and saute quickly for about 5 minutes.
Add bacon and salt; arrange in buttered casserole in alternate layers with the sliced tomato.
Place in oven at 350° for about 30 minutes or until corn is tender.
Serve hot.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Homemade Buns
steps: In a large bowl or pan, put flour.
After placing the flour in the bowl, make a hole in the center of the flour.
Put lukewarm water, sugar, Crisco, egg, yeast and salt in.
Mix all ingredients together gradually (you may need to add more flour), until it becomes a large ball.
Cover with a cloth and let rise until double in size.
Form buns and place in long baking pans.
Cover with a cloth and let rise again.
Set oven temperature to 350° and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Nice Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice.
Place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl and layer on top of rice.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes until hot and bubbly.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Creamy Dreamy Fudge
steps: Melt cheese and margarine together over low heat.
Sift cocoa and powdered sugar; stir in cheese mixture, blending until smooth. Add vanilla and nuts.
Spread into 8-inch square pan.
Chill. Cut into squares.
Freezes well.

title: Campanealle Noodle Salad
steps: Cook noodles according to package direction, rinse.
In a large bowl combine noodles, onion, tomato, cucumber, yellow pepper and salt and pepper to taste.
In a small mixing bowl mix mayonnaise, milk and sugar or equal to taste.
Mix with noodles and vegetables and chill.

title: Forgiveness Pie
steps: Take one large field, half dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a
pinch
of
brook
and some pebbles.
Mix children and dogs well together, put them on the field, stirring constantly.
Pour the brook over the pebbles.
Sprinkle the field with flowers. Spread over
all
a
deep	blue
sky and bake in sun. When brown, set away to cool in bathtub.

title: Dirt Pudding

ingredients.name: instant french vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small boxes instant French vanilla pudding

steps: Mix pudding and milk.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and butter. Then combine all together with Cool Whip.

title: Butterscotch Pie
steps: In heavy skillet, brown the brown sugar, white sugar and butter.
Mix together and brown.
In separate bowl, mix egg yolks, milk and flour.
Add milk gradually until smooth.
Add mixture to sugar and butter in skillet.
Stir until smooth and thick.
Add vanilla.
Pour in baked pie shell.
Use egg whites for meringue.

title: Oriental Chicken
steps: Spread jam over chicken in a casserole pan.
Add Catalina salad dressing.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Great with tossed salad and baked potato.

title: Rotel Dip

ingredients.name: ro tel green chily and tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel green chilies and tomatoes

steps: Melt about half of the Velveeta cheese and a little over 1/2 can Ro-Tel green chilies and tomatoes.
Serve with chips.

title: Amish Sugar Cookies
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients and beat well.
Add eggs and beat again.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Chill in refrigerator.
Drop small balls of dough on ungreased cookie sheet (can be flattened slightly).
Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until barely brown.

title: Pink Glory Rice Salad

ingredients.name: minute rice in qt. water drain and cool
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Minute rice, cooked in 1 qt. water, drain and cool

steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups hot water, stirring until dissolved.
Add sugar and juice.
Let set until slightly jelled. Add remaining ingredients and fold in Cool Whip.
Refrigerate until firm.

title: Summer Sausage

ingredients.name: morton tender quick cure salt
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. Morton Tender Quick cure salt

steps: Mix all ingredients together well with hands, then leave in bowl and refrigerate 24 hours.
Make into 2-inch rolls and about 6 to 8 inches long.
Wrap in foil, shiny side turned toward the meat. Slit bottom of foil in two places.
Put on rack or cookie sheet and bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Chill in refrigerator.
Slice when ready to use.
Nice for snacks.

title: Eggplant Oysters
steps: Peel eggplant and cover with water; boil until tender.
Drain and cool.
Add egg and pepper and mix well.
Add Bisquick mix. Drop mixture into deep hot fat (oil) until brown.

title: Crusty Curried Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Wash chicken and pat dry.
In oven, melt butter and shortening in baking pan.
Mix Bisquick and seasonings in plastic bag.
Shake 2 or 3 pieces at a time in bag to coat thoroughly.
Place chicken skin side down in single layer in pan. Bake 40 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 375°.
Turn chicken; bake 20 minutes longer.
Serves 6.

title: Oil French Dressing

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1/3 to 1/2 c. vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Combine all ingredients in a bottle.
Cover tightly and shake well.
Chill and remove the garlic.
Shake thoroughly before serving.
Makes 1 1/3 to 1 1/2 cups.

title: Mussels In White Wine Sauce

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 1 small tomato, peeled, seeded and diced

steps: Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in large pot (big enough to hold mussels).
Add onion and parsley.
Cook over medium heat until fragrant.
Add garlic and wine.
Cook about 1 minute.
Add mussels and tomatoes.
Cover and cook until mussels have opened (3 to 5 minutes).

title: Pineapple Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and beat.
Sift the four dry ingredients.
Add vanilla.
Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart.
Bake 12 minutes in 375° oven or until brown.

title: Bible Cookies
steps: Mix as for your favorite cookie.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Use your favorite topping.

title: Best Ever Cornbread
steps: Combine all ingredients, mixing well and pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Morgan'S Pecan Pie
steps: Combine corn syrup and sugar.
Mix in salt, butter and vanilla.
Add eggs and pecans.
Place in an unbaked pie shell and then sprinkle more whole pecans over the top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Green Goddess Dressing
steps: Place mayonnaise in blender container.
Add next six ingredients and blend on high speed until smooth.
Add sour cream and blend on low speed until mixed.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Spinach Quiche

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chopped frozen spinach, cooked and drained

steps: Blend eggs and cream until foamy.
Combine with all other ingredients and pour into prebaked 9-inch pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
A knife should come out clean when testing.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Mix milk, Eagle Brand, vanilla and salt in small mixing bowl. In large mixing bowl, beat eggs until light; add sugar gradually beating constantly.
Beat in mixture from small bowl.
Pour into freezer and freeze according to freezer directions.

title: Chicken-N-Stuffing
steps: Prepare stuffing according to instructions on the package. Spread in glass baking dish, 7 1/2 x 11-inch.
Save 1/4 cup of stuffing.
Place chicken on stuffing and pour the chicken soup and broth over ingredients in dish.
Bake in 350° oven for about 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Creamed Cabbage
steps: Chop cabbage; boil in salted water until tender.
Drain.
Melt 6 tablespoons butter.
Add flour; stir and add milk.
Cook until sauce thickens.
Layer cabbage in baking dish with sauce.
Repeat layers.
Cover with bread crumbs which have been mixed with 4 tablespoons butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: "24 Hour Layered Salad"
steps: Break up lettuce in bottom of container.
Layer the 2 ribs of diced celery, chopped green pepper and diced red onion.
Drain can of LeSueur peas and place on top of onion.	Next, the mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese.
Crumble bacon on top and seal well in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Sausage Rolls
steps: Mix all ingredients until moistened.
Roll into small balls and bake on lightly greased baking pan at 450° for 10 minutes. Serve hot.
These freeze well.
If baking while frozen, allow longer baking time.

title: Mints
steps: Cream the sugar and cheese.
Add flavoring and coloring.
Mix until pie dough texture.
Roll into small balls, then roll each ball in granulated sugar.
Press into molds.
Put on wax paper to set.

title: Hawaiian Salad
steps: Cook macaroni and rinse.
Cool.
Add sugar, flour, eggs, fruit juices and salt in saucepan over medium heat until thickened.
Stir in macaroni and refrigerate. Later, fold in fruit and Cool Whip.

title: Burger Florentine
steps: About 40 minutes before serving prepare spinach as label directs; drain well.
Toast English muffins; keep warm.
Preheat broiler if manufacturer directs.
Into bowl tear bread into small pieces; add spinach, ground beef, egg, salt and onion.
Mix well. Shape mixture into four 1-inch thick round patties.
Place patties on rack in broiling pan.
Broil patties about 5 minutes on each side for medium or until of desired doneness.
Just before patties are done, cut Mozzarella cheese into 4 slices.
Top each meat patty with a cheese slice; broil 1 minute longer or until cheese melts.
Serves 4.

title: Easy Banana Bread

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix without pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix without pudding

ingredients.name: banana instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 oz. pkg. banana instant pudding mix

steps: Beat eggs at medium speed with an electric mixer until thick and pale.
Add cake mix and next three ingredients mixing well. Stir in bananas and walnuts.
Pour batter into 2 greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pans on wire rack 10 minutes.
Remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks.

title: Hot Dog Relish
steps: Grind tomatoes, add salt and let stand overnight.
Drain, add finely chopped or ground peppers, onions and cabbage.
Combine sugar, vinegar and spice that have been tied in a bag.
Add liquid to vegetables and simmer 30 minutes.
Pack in hot jars and seal.

title: Ham Loaf(Microwave)
steps: Mix ground ham and
pork
with crumbs, water, onion and pepper.
Mold into flat
loaf
in 9-inch pie plate.
Microwave at Medium.
Set temperature to 170° for 11 to 14 minutes.

title: Rookie'S Quiche

ingredients.name: spinach in coriander
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen spinach, drained in colander

steps: Mix together.
Pour in 2 pie crusts.
Bake 45 minutes in a 400° oven.
Cool a few minutes and serve.

title: Herbed Chicken
steps: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper.
Brown slowly in margarine in skillet.
Place in shallow baking dish.

title: Norma Hill'S Far East Celery

ingredients.name: water chestnut and
ingredients.raw: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Precook celery slices in salted water until crisp-done; drain. Combine all ingredients in 1-quart casserole.
Toss the soft bread crumbs with the toasted slivered almonds and melted butter; sprinkle over casserole.
Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes, or until hot.
Excellent!

title: Black Forest Pie

ingredients.name: chocolate pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chocolate pudding and pie filling

steps: In bowl, mix at medium speed with electric mixer.
Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually blend in milk.
Add pudding mix; beat at low speed for 1 minute, scraping bowl often.
Beat at medium speed for 30 seconds.
Spread into pie crust.
Chill about 2 hours or until firm.
Spoon on cherry pie filling and garnish with whipped topping and grated chocolate.
Serve immediately.

title: Ham Salad
steps: Boil the eggs while putting the other ingredients through a food grinder.
Chop eggs and mix with other ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
steps: Prepare Dream Whip as directed.
Soften cream cheese; beat with 1/2 cup sugar until smooth.
Blend prepared Dream Whip into cheese mixture.
Spoon into unbaked 9-inch graham cracker crumb crust.
Chill 3 hours or more.
Top with 1 cup of canned cherry pie filling.

title: Aunt Lee'S Punch
steps: Pour milk in bowl.
Pour thawed orange juice into milk and beat.
Gradually add sugar.
Freeze.
When you thaw punch, add 2 quarts ginger ale.

title: Beef A La King

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Mix, heat and serve on pastry shells or toast points.
Serves 4.

title: Hawaiian Cake

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: Combine cake mix, oranges, 1 package pudding mix, 1 cup pineapple and 4 eggs in a large mixing bowl.
Beat for 4 minutes. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.
Combine remaining 1 cup pineapple, 1 package pudding mix and Cool Whip in bowl, mixing well. Spread over cooled cake.
Chill in refrigerator until serving time.

title: Any Fruit Cobbler
steps: Melt oleo in baking dish.
Mix dry ingredients.
Add milk. Pour 1 can fruit over oleo.
Pour the rest over the fruit.
Bake until brown at 350°.

title: Eggplant Provencale

ingredients.name: eggplant and
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 to 4 c. eggplant, peeled and diced

ingredients.name: garlic pressed
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic, pressed or garlic salt

steps: Macerate eggplant with salt for about 30 minutes to remove liquid and soften.
Drain.
Saute in a film of olive oil, green pepper and onion; don't brown.
Set aside.
Dry eggplant on paper towels and saute in film of olive oil, 2 to 4 minutes, to brown. Add onion, pepper and remaining ingredients to eggplant.
Cook down to thicken.
Serve as a vegetable or over cooked pasta.

title: Honey Mustard Steaks With Grilled Onions

ingredients.name: beef top loin steak
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless beef top loin steaks, cut 1 inch thick

ingredients.name: each cider vinegar and water
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. each cider vinegar and water

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.raw: 1 large red onion, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices

steps: Combine mustard, parsley, honey, vinegar, water, pepper sauce and pepper.
Place beef steaks and onion on grid over medium coals; brush both with glaze.
Grill 9 to 12 minutes for rare (140°) to medium (160°), turning once and brushing with glaze.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Grilled Chicken And Fresh Vegetables
steps: In shallow dish combine chicken and 2 bottles of the salad dressing.
Cover and marinate 4 hours in refrigerator.
Cut vegetables into bite size pieces and place in another shallow dish.
Add remaining 2 bottles of salad dressing; chill.
Remove chicken from marinade, reserving marinade.
Grill 5 to 6 minutes on each side, basting with marinade.
Remove vegetables from marinade.
Grill vegetables on wire rack or steamed or sauteed on top of stove.
Yields 12 servings.

title: War Cake
steps: Place sugar, water, molasses, salt and shortening in a saucepan.
Bring to a rapid boil.
Cool and then add flour, baking powder and spices sifted together.
Add the candied peel.
Beat thoroughly and turn into a greased pan; bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually add milk, then lemon juice, and vanilla.
Mix well.
Turn into crust.
Chill at least two hours. Put cherry pie filling on top just before serving.

title: Cornflake Crunch
steps: On medium-high, cook syrup and sugar until comes to a boil and is clear.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter until well melted. Gradually add cornflakes.
Coat well.
Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Orange Jello Mold
steps: Place Jell-O in large bowl; add 3 cups boiling water.
Add 2 cups cold water or orange juice (I use the orange juice).
Stir in the orange sherbet.
Stir in Cool Whip.
Add drained orange segment and crushed pineapple.
Stir well.
Place in container and chill.
This recipe fills a Bundt pan and more.

title: Lemon Pepper Steak And Vegetables

ingredients.name: green giant broccoli cauliflower pea pod and yellow pepper mixture
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. Green Giant frozen broccoli, cauliflower, pea pods and yellow peppers mixture

steps: Rub both sides of steak with lemon pepper seasoning.
Place steaks on rack of broiler pan.
Broil 2 to 3 inches from heat for 8 to 12 minutes for medium doneness, turning once.
Cook vegetables according to package directions until crisp-tender; drain.

title: Banana Pound Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box yellow cake mix (without pudding in mix)

steps: Mix all together.
Pour into greased Bundt or tube pan and bake 1 hour or until done at 350°.

title: Potato Supreme

ingredients.name: hash brown potato thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with 1 stick sliced oleo and 2 cups bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
May be made ahead and frozen.
Bon appetit.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Bake in large casserole dish for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Southern Lassies
steps: Mix and roll into a ball.
Put small amount in each cup and press around to make a shell.
In the bottom of each, put chopped walnuts.

title: 7 Layer Mexican Pie

ingredients.name: brick new york sharp cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 brick New York sharp Cheddar cheese or Monterey Jack

ingredients.name: or black olive
ingredients.raw: sliced or chopped large black pitted olives

steps: In deep dish pie or quiche pan, smear refried beans on bottom. Cover with salsa.
Plop guacamole mixture over this and smooth. Add sour cream on top, then cover generously with New York sharp Cheddar cheese.
Decorate the top with the black olives and chopped scallions.
Serve with a basket of restaurant-style corn tortilla chips for dunking into.

title: Mrs. Truman'S Ozark Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serve with cream, whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Pinto Bean Pot Stew
steps: Put pinto beans in
water
and
cook.
Fry hamburg with onion. Add to beans with remaining ingredients and cook until done.

title: Tomato, Zucchini Salad
steps: Slice vegetables in glass bowl.
Add olives.
Pour Italian dressing over vegetables as much as needed.
Cover, refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Lela'S Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef.
Cook the spaghetti.
Place cooked spaghetti in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan.
Add hamburger and diced Colby cheese.
Sprinkle with minced onion, oregano leaves (crushed) and Italian seasoning.
Pour can of tomato sauce over mixture with the bacon bits.
Place bacon strips over the top and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Country Ham Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Heat process cheese spread, milk and mayo over low heat; stir until sauce is smooth.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cheesy Wild Rice And Ham Bake

ingredients.name: white and wild rice mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (6 oz.) pkg. white and wild rice mix

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Prepare rice as package label directs, removing any seasonings with sieve.
Over medium heat melt butter; remove from heat.
Add flour, mustard and pepper until smooth.
Add milk returning to heat until thickened.
Reduce heat; add cheese until melted.
Set aside.

title: Pineapple Delight
steps: Bake cake in an oblong pan.
Mix the cream cheese, pudding mix and milk. Chill in refrigerator while cake is cooling, then spread this mixture over the cake.
Next, spread the pineapple over the pudding, then cover the pineapple with Cool Whip. Add nuts on top, if desired.

title: Coca-Cola Chicken
steps: Arrange chicken parts in a pan.
Mix ketchup and Coke.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and cook on top of stove for 45 minutes.

title: Barbecue Brisket
steps: Poke holes all over brisket.
Line a 9 x 12-inch pan with foil.
Lay brisket in pan.
Mix all ingredients and pour over brisket.
Leave a little air space and set in refrigerator overnight.
Cook at 275° for 6 hours.
Open foil and pour 1 1/2 cup Hunt's natural barbecue sauce over meat.
Re-wrap and cook 1 1/2 hours more.
Shred meat before serving or freezing.

title: Baby Food Salad

ingredients.name: orange jell o
ingredients.raw: 1 small box orange Jell-O (add no water)

steps: Heat orange Jell-O and pineapple until dissolved.
Add sugar. Mix in cream cheese (mash with fork until mixed well; do not beat). Add baby food. Chill until slightly jelled.
Fold in Cool Whip. Add nuts on top.

title: Inside Out Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 chocolate cake mix (no pudding in mix)

steps: Mix all ingredients together by hand in a bowl for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Sprinkle cooled cake with powdered sugar and serve with ice cream.

title: Sausage And Onion Squares
steps: Mix and brown in skillet; drain and spread over dough.
Mix Cheddar cheese and sour cream.
Spread over sausage.
Sprinkle with paprika and cook in a 325° oven for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Fried Potatoes

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. diced, cooked ham or other leftover meat

steps: Slice unpeeled potatoes.
Peel and chop onions.
Put oil in cold skillet and heat to about 300°.
Scatter potato slices over bottom of skillet.
Cover and cook about 5 minutes.
Turn potatoes over and brown other side in covered frypan about 2 or 3 minutes. Uncover, add chopped onions and water.
Replace cover and cook 3 minutes longer.
Uncover and add eggs and meat.
Stir until eggs are cooked.
Serve warm.

title: Muffins
steps: Beat egg; add milk and oil.
Stir in flour and sugar.
Mix just enough to blend.
Fill greased muffin tin 2/3 full.
Bake 20 minutes at 425°.

title: Cool Whip Treat

ingredients.name: chocolate wafer cookie crumb divided
ingredients.raw: 2 1/4 c. chocolate wafer cookie crumbs, divided

steps: Mix 2 cups cookie crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and margarine in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Press firmly onto bottom of pan.
Refrigerate.

title: Pecan Praline Pie
steps: Heat brown sugar, butter or oleo and chopped pecans until bubbly in a small pan; pour into a baked pie shell.
Heat in a 350° oven until bubbly.
Cool completely.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken

ingredients.name: fryer and skinned
ingredients.raw: 1 fryer, cut into pieces and skinned (remove excess fat)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients, except chicken, in saucepan; simmer 10 minutes.
Place chicken in glass baking dish and bake for 45 to 60 minutes.
Baste with remaining sauce every 15 minutes.
Good!!!

title: Merry Salad
steps: Prepare lime gelatin as directed on package.
Chill until slightly thickened; fold in pineapple.
Pour into 8-inch square pan; chill until firm.
Gradually add mayonnaise to softened cream cheese, mixing well until blended.
Add nuts; spread over molded gelatin layer.
Chill until firm.
Prepare strawberry gelatin as directed on package;
pour over cheese mixture.
Chill until firm. Cut in squares.
Serve on lettuce; Top with small amount of mayonnaise, if desired.

title: Bacon And Egg Pie
steps: Line pie plate with pastry.
Fry bacon until cooked; chop coarsely.
Put half of bacon into pastry shell.
Break eggs into pastry shell on top of bacon (eggs may be beaten).
Chop onion; put on top of eggs, along with remaining chopped bacon.
Cover with another pie pastry; glaze with a beaten egg.
Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

title: Crabmeat Wedges

ingredients.name: old english cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jar Old English cheese spread

steps: Mix cheese spread, margarine, mayonnaise and salt until smooth.
Mix in crab.
Cut English muffins in half.
Spread mixture on English muffin halves.
Chill in refrigerator.

title: Joyce'S Salad
steps: Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water and add the cold water. Cool slightly. Add the remaining ingredients.
Mix well and chill in mold. Serve.

title: Kismet Chicken

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 6 1/2 oz. can water chestnuts, sliced, drained

steps: Combine chicken,
grapes,
water
chestnuts, almonds and celery. Combine soy sauce, curry powder and mayonnaise.
Add mayonnaise mixture to chicken mixture.
Chill and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Ham Rolls
steps: Cut rolls to make a top and bottom.
Butter inside of top rolls and spread mustard on bottom half.
Sprinkle ham and cheese all over.
Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over ham and cheese (lightly).
Put top half on and cover with tinfoil.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Fanny Mae Fudge

ingredients.name: real milk chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) bag real milk chocolate chips (Nestle)

ingredients.name: baker s all natural chocolate
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. Baker's all natural unsweetened chocolate squares

steps: Cook all of the first 4 ingredients and boil for 3 minutes. Add marshmallows (cut into squares), chocolate stars, chocolate chips and unsweetened chocolate.
Stir together until all melted; pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add nuts, if desired.
Cut while warm.

title: Tuna Supreme Salad

ingredients.name: water tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 c. water-packed tuna, rinsed, drained and flaked

steps: In a mixing bowl, whisk the parsley, onion, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Stir in the tuna.
In a salad bowl, combine celery, cabbage and carrots.
Add the tuna mixture.
Toss.
Cover and chill until serving time.

title: Cornflake Macaroons
steps: Beat egg white until stiff but not dry.
Gradually add sugar. Add flavoring.
Fold in coconut and cornflakes.
Drop by teaspoonful onto well-greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
Remove from cookie sheet as soon as removed from oven.

title: Fudge Icing
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl except the 10x sugar and vanilla.
Add a couple tablespoons evaporated milk to make a stirring mixture.
Put over heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and add 10x sugar 1/3 at a time using electric mixer.
Add vanilla and continue beating until the icing is smooth and will spread easily.

title: Potatoes And Mushrooms

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. green onions or chives, chopped

steps: Cook potatoes in jackets until tender.
Drain and dry.
Place in a casserole, adding butter and chopped onion.
Beat egg yolks and add lemon juice, mushrooms and meat stock.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour over potatoes in casserole.
Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Dreamy Italian Dressing
steps: Blend all ingredients together.
Yields 1-1/2 cups of dressing.

title: Beef And Macaroni
steps: Heat on medium, stirring occasionally.
Top with cheese. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Shells
steps: Cook ground beef and drain.
Cook shells, drain and cool.
Mix together cheese and parsley flakes.
Fill with about 2 tablespoons of cheese mix.
Put in baking dish (9 x 12-inch) and pour over the meat and sauce plus any leftover cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Eggplant And Tomato Casserole

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 ripe tomatoes, peeled and sliced

steps: Soak eggplant slices in cold water for several hours.
Drain and arrange layers of eggplant and tomatoes in a buttered baking dish.
Sprinkle each layer with grated cheese, salt and pepper. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs, more cheese and sweet basil.
Dot with butter, Bake 300° for 1 hour.

title: Jane'S Coleslaw

ingredients.name: sesame seed plu tbsp. almond
ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp. sesame seed plus 4 Tbsp. almonds (all toasted)

steps: Toast sesame seed and almonds in 2 tablespoons of butter until light brown.
Cool.
Break up noodles.
Add onions, sesame seed and almonds.
Toss with dressing.

title: Layered Dessert

ingredients.name: each lime strawberry and orange jello
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. each: lime, strawberry and orange jello

steps: Tear up cake in 3 bowls.
Sprinkle in dry jello.

title: Creamy Carrot Casserole

ingredients.name: carrot and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced, or 20 oz. frozen sliced and thawed

steps: In saucepan, cook carrots just until crisp-tender.
Drain, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.
Place carrots in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and reserved cooking liquid.
Spread evenly over carrots.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Freezer Cucumber Pickles
steps: Sprinkle cucumbers and onions with salt.
Let set for 2 hours. Combine vinegar, sugar and pepper.
Pack cucumbers in plastic containers.
Cover with vinegar mixture; seal.
Freeze.
Thaw as needed.
These are real crispy and good!

title: Rice Krispies Crust For Ice Cream Pie
steps: Melt chocolate and butter in double boiler; add cereal and stir until coated.
Press into pie pan.

title: Banana Milk Shake
steps: Put all in blender.
Process until smooth.

title: Pig Picking Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, oil, oranges and eggs and bake for 25 minutes at 350 degrees.
Cool completely.
Mix cool whip, pineapple, and pudding.
Spread over top of cake with a spoon.
Refrigerate overnight and serve.

title: Creamed Corn Casserole
steps: In 1-quart glass casserole, heat butter 30 seconds.
Add egg, cracker crumbs, corn, salt and pepper; blend evenly.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking time.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oreo Delight
steps: Crust:
Crush Oreos with rolling pin on waxed paper; mix with melted butter and press into pan, 9 x 13-inch or smaller if you want thicker pieces.
Put in refrigerator to cool while you make pudding.
Save some to sprinkle on top.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Chicken Breasts
steps: Pound chicken breast halves until 1/4-inch thick.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top each piece of chicken with 1 slice ham and 1 slice cheese.
Fold chicken over ham and cheese.
Wrap each bundle with two slices bacon.
Place bundles side by side in a shallow baking pan.
Bake in a preheated (350°) oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked and bacon is brown.
Serves 6.

title: Jiffy Goober Haystacks
steps: Melt peanut butter and morsels in double boiler or heavy saucepan over low heat.
Mix in noodles and peanuts until all ingredients are moistened.
Form little clusters on waxed paper; allow to harden.

title: Baked Zucchini Casserole
steps: Dice zucchini and tomato into 1-inch pieces.
Arrange in 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with tomato paste; pour over 1/2 can water.
Add salt and celery seed; cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove cover; top with cheese slices and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes more.
Serves 6.

title: One Big Beautiful Loaf Of Bread

ingredients.name: active yeast
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. active yeast or small cake

steps: Dissolve active dry yeast in warm water, 105° to 115°.
Scald milk, sugar, shortening and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast mixture.
Add flour gradually, mixing with spoon, then by hand until well blended.
Place on lightly floured board.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl.
Rub top with shortening.

title: Zucchini Cutlets
steps: Combine together and add 2 eggs; mix well.
Heat 1/4 cup oil in frying pan; drop by large spoonful into oil.
You can also shape into patties first, then fry, turning once.

title: Brunswick Stew

ingredients.name: or butter bean
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 quart fresh or frozen butter beans

steps: Boil chicken and onions until tender meat can be removed from bones.
While chicken cools, add beans, potatoes and okra to broth and cook for 45 minutes.
Remove chicken from bones; remove skin and chop chicken into small pieces.
Add to beans along with corn and tomato juice.
(Amount of juice depends upon the amount of chicken broth you have.)
Season and simmer for at least another hour.
Freezes well.

title: Easy Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ground beef, soup and egg.
Place in a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Top with catsup and bake for 1 hour.

title: Creamy Onion Dressing
steps: Add egg to other ingredients to thicken.
Blend in blender.

title: Orange Sweet Potatoes
steps: Cook sweet potatoes in jackets in 1/2 inch of boiling, salted water until tender, about 30 minutes.
Remove skins.

title: Sweet And Sour Polish Sausage
steps: In large saucepan, cut Polish sausage into 1/2-inch slices. Then add remaining ingredients.
Cook on medium for about 30 minutes, then simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Lo-Fat Lemon Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts or thighs

steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Dip each piece of chicken in a mixture of yogurt, ginger and garlic powder.
Then coat lightly with bread crumbs.
Place in a single layer in a non-stick baking pan.
Bate at 350 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender and coating is crisp.

title: Blackberry Cake
steps: Cook berries; strain.
Reserve 1/4 cup juice for icing.
Add water for right measure.
Combine all ingredients except eggs. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Cool.

title: Homemade Soap
steps: Combine all ingredients and cook in a large black kettle until lye eats up grease and cracklings.
Let set in pot overnight or until cold and set.
Next day, cut into pieces.

title: Breakfast Pizza

ingredients.name: bulk pork sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bulk pork sausage, cooked, drained, and crumbled

ingredients.name: loose hash brown thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 cup frozen loose packed hash browns, thawed

steps: Separate rolls into 8 triangles and place on an ungreased pizza pan, points toward center.
Press dough over bottom and sides to form a crust.
Layer sausage and potatoes on crust.
Top with cheddar cheese.
Beat eggs; add milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over cheese.
Top with parmesan cheese..
Bake at 375 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pot Pie

ingredients.name: boiling chicken
ingredients.raw: Boiling chicken or beef broth (good with small pieces of meat in broth)

steps: Sift first 3 ingredients together; cut in shortening.
Stir water and egg together and add to flour mixture.
Roll very thin. Cut into squares and let rest 20 - 30 minutes.
Drop into boiling broth.
Cover & cook 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Pecan Cakes
steps: Blend and beat all ingredients.
Spoon filling into unbaked shells, filling each 3/4 full.
Sprinkle on chopped pecans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Freezes well.

title: Tandoori Chicken

ingredients.name: dry tandoori mix
ingredients.raw: dry tandoori mix (available at Indian grocery stores)

steps: Remove skin from chicken and place in casserole dish.
Place 1 teaspoon tandoori mix on each piece of chicken.
Pour yogurt into dish and mix chicken, spice and yogurt until there is a uniform orange color.
Place in refrigerator 2 hours up to 12 hours.
Bake in oven at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
steps: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl, stir and freeze.
Take out of freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Makes 2)

ingredients.name: prebaked graham cracker
ingredients.raw: 2 prebaked graham cracker or pastry crusts

ingredients.name: dream whip
ingredients.raw: 2 large Dream Whip or 4 c. Cool Whip

steps: Blend 1 1/2 cups confectioners sugar and 1/2 cup peanut butter; divide into thirds.
Put 1/3 mixture in bottom of shells.
Mix 1 package Dream Whip according to directions or use 2 cups Cool Whip. Mix whip with 1 large instant vanilla pudding made with 2 1/2 cups cold milk and with 1/3 peanut butter/sugar mixture.
Put in shells. Mix another package of Dream Whip or 2 cups Cool Whip.
Smooth on top.
Sprinkle remaining 1/3 peanut butter/sugar mixture on top. Refrigerate.

title: Lear'S "Hot" Chili

ingredients.name: vlasic hot chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Vlasic hot chili peppers, sliced

steps: Brown hamburg with onion and drain off grease.
Add tomatoes, peppers, onions, tomato juice and seasonings.
Bring to a boil, then simmer about 45 minutes.
Serve with crackers and ice water.

title: Lake Ozette Whole Wheat Quick Bread
steps: Stir together the dry ingredients.
Mix together the liquid ingredients well and blend into the dry ingredients.
Grease a tube pan or 1-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle sesame seed in the pan and shake to distribute.
Pour batter into the pan and let stand for 20 minutes before baking.
Bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick test shows done.

title: Cheesy Beef Enchiladas

ingredients.name: n chunky salsa
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) jar thick 'n chunky salsa (mild, medium or hot)

steps: Brown ground beef; pour off excess fat.
Add taco seasoning mix and water.
Put 3 to 4 tablespoons taco meat in each flour tortilla.
Roll and place seam down in a glass casserole.
Top with thick 'n chunky salsa, Cheez Whiz and Colby cheese. Microwave 6 to 8 minutes, until cheese has completely melted. Serve with cucumbers and sliced tomatoes.

title: Garlic Pretzels

ingredients.name: envelope hidden valley ranch original party mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Hidden Valley Ranch original party mix

steps: Break up pretzels on large cookie sheet.
Mix oil, salt, garlic powder and party dip mix and pour on top of pretzels.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.
Stir and bake 5 more minutes.
Drain on brown bag.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
steps: Position rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°.
Have ready an ungreased 1-quart baking dish for the pudding cake and a slightly larger, shallow pan filled with 1 to 2 inches of hot water.
In a medium bowl, whisk or stir together flour, the 1 cup sugar and salt; set aside.

title: Potato Kugel (Pudding)

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 3 Grated potatoes (by hand, in blender or with grinder)

steps: Grate potatoes, draining excess water.	Grate onion (and carrot), add to potatoes.
Mix in remaining ingredients and pour into an 8 inch or 9 inch square greased pan.
Sprinkle with paprika to aid in browning.
Bake at 375 for 1 hour or until golden brown on top.
Serves 2 to 3 - Can be doubled for a 9 x 13 pan.

title: Hi Ho Cheerios
steps: Place Cheerios in soup bowl.
Add milk and sugar; stir and eat.
Makes 1 serving.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans

ingredients.name: and bacon
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. cooked and crumbled bacon strips

steps: Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350° until hot and bubbly.
Serves 4.

title: K&W Egg Custard Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Beat until well blended.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Broiled Spicy Mustard Chicken(Light And Easy)
steps: Preheat the broiler.
Coat a broiling pan with low calorie cooking spray.

title: 4 Layered Dessert
steps: Mix well (will be crumbly) and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Let cool completely.

title: Mile High Barbecue Beef

ingredients.name: chuck roast
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. chuck roast or round steak

steps: Brown meat in small amount of oil along with celery and onion. Add meat mixture to beef broth and bring to boil.
Simmer 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries (do not thaw)

steps: Mix crushed pretzels, sugar and soft margarine and press in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 8 minutes at 350°; let cool.
Mix softened cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar.
Mix together and pour over crust (be sure to seal edges).
Mix strawberry jello with boiling water and frozen strawberries (do not thaw; add frozen).
Pour over cheese mixture.

title: Bunk House Beans
steps: Brown and drain sausage and hamburger.
Mix meats with remaining ingredients.
Pour in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Squash Patty
steps: Grate squash and onion.
Add cheese.
Add egg.
Add enough flour to make mixture pastey.
Fry in patties.

title: Deluxe Lemon Bars

ingredients.name: lemon juice plu a little
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. lemon juice plus a little extra (about 2 lemons)

steps: Cook the first 3 ingredients until the mixture clings together.
Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Beat together the eggs, sugar and lemon juice and add flour and baking powder.
Pour over crust.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle confectioners sugar on top.
Cool and cut in bars.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. butter or margarine, room temperature

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix flour and baking soda in a small bowl. In a large bowl, beat peanut butter, butter, sugars and vanilla with electric mixer until fluffy.
Beat in eggs.
Then add flour mixture gradually.
Mix. Stir in chips.
Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool.
Then enjoy. Serves 100 cookies.

title: Lemon Pound Cake

ingredients.name: lemon instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz. size) pkg. lemon instant pudding mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Blend all ingredients at low speed of mixer until moistened.
Beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Pour into pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Cool 25 minutes in pan.
Turn upside down and place on plate.

title: Hash Potato Casserole
steps: Mix potatoes, 1/2 cup butter, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese.
Put in greased casserole.
Crush cereal and stir in 1/4 cup butter, melted.
Sprinkle over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf Dip
steps: With mixer, combine the salmon, cream cheese and salts. Form into
a ball;
roll in parsley flakes.
