ingredients.raw: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel golden sweet corn

ingredients.name: ortega green chile
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can Ortega diced green chiles

steps: Drain corn, reserving 2 tablespoons liquid.
Combine reserved liquid and cream cheese in saucepan.
Heat and blend until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sauerkraut Soup

ingredients.name: smoked sausage in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. smoked sausage, cut in 1/2 inch pieces

ingredients.name: sauerkraut and with scissor
ingredients.raw: 1 can (32 oz.) sauerkraut, rinsed, drained and cut with scissors

steps: In large soup pan, combine sausage, potatoes, onion, carrots and chicken broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add sauerkraut and tomatoes. Return to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes longer.
If thinner soup is desired add more broth.

title: Roy'S Roast
steps: Sprinkle roast with lemon salt, black pepper, chives and any other spices you like.
Cover with foil and cook at 150° for 8 hours.
Just before roast is done, uncover and let brown.

title: Chocolate Fudge Candy
steps: Combine butter, milk, sugar and salt in medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallows, morsels, nuts and vanilla.
Stir for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted.
Pour into foil lined 8-inch square baking pan.
Sprinkle with additional pecans, if desired.
Chill until firm.

title: Cry Baby Cucumbers
steps: Layer several together, then cover with dressing.
Will keep in refrigerator 2 to 3 weeks.
Good with vegetables.

title: Vanilla Brownies
steps: Sift flour.
Stir margarine into sugar in a large bowl.
Add egg and vanilla.
Beat well.
Add flour mixture.
Blend well. Stir in nuts.
Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars or squares.

title: Chocolate Coconut Drops
steps: Melt chocolate and add milk.
Stir in coconut and walnuts.

title: Hearty Beef Stew

ingredients.name: stew beef in
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. stew beef, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: Trim all fat from meat.
Put all ingredients in crock-pot and mix. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. High 4 to 5 hours.

title: Chocolate Dessert
steps: Mix flour, oleo and nuts like pastry and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 15 minutes, until set.

title: Cranberry Frost

ingredients.name: jellied cranberry with fork
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jellied cranberries, crushed with fork

steps: Spread mixture over cranberries.
Refrigerate in freezer.

title: Dijon Pork Chops(Low-Fat Recipe)
steps: In a shallow bowl, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley, oil and pepper.
Mix well and set aside.
Spread both sides of each pork chop with mustard, then press each chop into bread crumb mixture, coating both sides and using all of the mixture.
Spray rack in broiling pan with cooking spray.
Arrange chops on rack and broil 5 to 6-inches from heat source, turning once, until thoroughly and lightly browned, 5 to 6 minutes on each side.

title: Brandy Slush
steps: Add tea bags to water and steep 20 minutes.
Bring lemonade and sugar to boil and dissolve sugar.
Add orange juice and brandy.
Mix, freeze and scoop into glass.
Add small amount of 7-Up, Sprite or ginger ale; add straw.
Lock the door, sit back and enjoy.

title: English Muffin Loaves
steps: In large bowl, combine 3 cups flour, yeast, sugar, salt and baking soda; set aside.
In medium saucepan, combine milk and water and heat until very warm (115° to 120°).
Add to flour mixture gradually, beating until batter is smooth.
Gradually add the remaining flour.

title: Caramel Pecan Balls
steps: Heat caramels and cream over hot water until the caramels are melted.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Wet hands in cold water and roll in balls.
Let set at room temperature until cool.

title: Low-Fat Cheesecake

ingredients.name: reduced calorie pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can reduced calorie pie filling (any flavor)

steps: Sprinkle cracker crumbs on greased spring-form pan (save some).
Mix jello with 1 cup hot water.
Add cream cheese, cottage cheese and Cool Whip.
Mix until smooth.
Pour into pan.

title: Camp Rolls(Makes About 18 To 20 Rolls)
steps: In a large bowl mix flour and sugar.
In separate bowls or containers melt dry yeast in lukewarm water; melt shortening and a little water to make the shortening lukewarm.
Beat egg; add all ingredients to flour mixture and mix thoroughly.
Add more lukewarm water to mixture if needed.
Cover bowl with cloth and let rise until dough has doubled in size, about 2 hours.
Roll out dough and cut out rolls.
Melt butter and pour in baking pan. Flip rolls over in butter to completely cover both sides.
Cover pan of rolls with a towel and let rise again in pan about 2 hours or until they look ready.
Bake in a 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetables

ingredients.name: vegetable of your choice or
ingredients.raw: vegetables of your choice (onions, carrots, broccoli, squash, cauliflower, mushrooms, etc.), chopped or sliced

steps: Mix all ingredients except vegetables.
Pour over vegetables. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.
Crunchy and good!

title: Chicken Paprika

ingredients.name: cooking muscatel dry wine
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. cooking Muscatel dry wine

steps: Soak chicken in salt water.
Brown chicken in oil or butter. Chop onion and garlic in a little oil.
Place in bottom of Dutch oven.
Place chicken on top.
Add flour, paprika and wine.
Simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

title: Momma'S Coke Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water, stirring until completely dissolved.
Add Coke and blend until smooth.
Refrigerate until jello starts to set.
Stir in celery and nuts.
Mix well. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Mom'S Biscuits
steps: Mix dry ingredients with shortening until shortening is thoroughly mixed.
Add enough milk to make a stiff, but stirable dough.
Put on floured table or board and knead until not sticky. Roll out to 1/2 inch thick; cut biscuits and turn in melted fat in baking pan.
Makes about 12 or 15 biscuits.

title: Salal Berry Jelly
steps: Wash berries.
Boil in about 1 1/2-inches water for 5 minutes. Strain.
Measure and combine with apple juice.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Add sugar and boil for 5 minutes more or until jelly sheets from the spoon.
Pour into prepared jars.
Seal.

title: Pizza Muffins

ingredients.name: spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. spaghetti sauce or pizza sauce

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Put spaghetti sauce, then other toppings on muffin halves.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Serves 2.
Easy for kids!

title: Mushroom Individuals
steps: Wash and dry mushrooms.
Melt butter and add the garlic.
Add the mushrooms to the butter, at the same time adding dill weed, salt, pepper, lemon juice and sherry.
Cook for 20 minutes or until mushrooms are cooked through. Pour small amount of mushroom liquid into sour cream and blend.
Then pour sour cream over mushrooms and mix to thoroughly coat mushrooms.
Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
When ready to serve, place in chafing dish and heat.
Use toothpicks for serving as appetizers.

title: Green Tomato Mince
steps: In a pan, mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a brisk boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour into clean jars.
Water bath for 10 minutes (optional).

title: Copper Pennies(Carrots)
steps: Steam carrots until a fork pricks them easily.
Boil the sugar, oil and vinegar together for 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour carrots, onions and pepper into boiled mixture, stirring to coat them well.

title: "Puttin' On The Ritz"
steps: Mix dates, milk and vanilla.
Cook over low heat until melted and thick.
Cool a little and spread on ritz crackers.
Bake for 8 minutes in 350° oven.
Cool and spread on cream cheese icing.

title: Spicy Nachos
steps: Mix together the first 5 ingredients; let sit for 15 minutes. Pour the Doritos in long pan.
Pour sauce over Doritos.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over all.
Put under broiler for 3 minutes, until cheese melts.

title: Reuben Pie
steps: Press bread into greased pie pan.
Spread mustard over bread. Place cheese, corned beef and sauerkraut on top.
Pour egg mixture over pie.
Bake in preheated 325° oven for 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Chocolate Sauce
steps: Heat sugar, cornstarch, water, cocoa and salt in microwave 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir and add butter and vanilla.
Put back in microwave until thickened.

title: Diabetic Apple Pie
steps: Fill pie shell with sliced apples.
Heat apple juice to boiling.
Dissolve cornstarch in water.
Stir into hot juice. Cook until thick.
Add spices to juice mixture and pour over apples.
Dot with butter.
Cover with top crust.
Bake at 425° for 45 minutes.

title: Jeweled Lime Salad

ingredients.name: lemon lime flavored soft drink mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) pkg. unsweetened lemon-lime flavored soft drink mix

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

steps: In large bowl, sprinkle gelatin over cold water; let stand 1 minute.
Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add soft drink mix; mix well.
Stir in sweetened condensed milk, lime juice and yogurt; mix well.
Fold in fruit cocktail.
Pour into 8-cup mold.
Chill 4 hours or until set.
Unmold into lettuce leaves.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Homemade Pretzels
steps: Mix yeast and sugar with 1/4 cup water.
Set aside until bubbly.
Place flour and yeast mixture into a mixing bowl and blend to form a dough.
Knead on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place in a greased bowl. Cover and let rise 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Punch down and shape the pretzels as follows:
divide dough into 12 pieces and shape into sticks 6 inches long or divide dough into 10 pieces and shape into knots.
Place on greased cookie sheets.
Cover and let rise 45 minutes.

title: Dreamy Cherry Pretzel Torte
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add sugar and blend.
Remove from heat.
Add pretzels; blend lightly.
Reserve 1 cup for topping. Press remaining mixture into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Candy
steps: Boil margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa for 2 minutes.
Add 3 cups quick cooking oats and vanilla.
Drop onto wax paper and cool.

title: Beef Jerky
steps: Slice flank steak lengthwise with the grain into 1/4-inch strips.
Combine soy sauce, garlic, salt and pepper; mix with steak strips and let stand about 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain. Arrange in single layer on a rack set in shallow baking pan.
Bake in very slow oven (150°) overnight or 12 hours, until dried.
Cut into 1-inch pieces.
Store in airtight container.

title: Lemonade Cake
steps: Soften ice cream and stir in frozen lemonade.
Split cake into 3 layers and use "lemon" ice cream as filling in between layers. Freeze.
Beat whipping cream with sugar until thick.
Frost cake with whipping cream.
Keep frozen.

title: Poor Man'S Caviar Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Scoop out insides of tomatoes.
Mix mashed avocados with garlic, mayonnaise and/or sour cream to taste.
Spoon mix into tomato shells and top with finely minced black olives.
Salt optional.

title: Chocolate Chip Butter Cookies
steps: In medium bowl, beat together butter, sugar, vanilla and salt until light and fluffy.
Add flour, beating until well blended. Mix. Will be stiff.
Stir in chocolate pieces.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with fork.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until edges begin to brown.
Remove cookies from baking sheet.
Cool on rack. While warm, sift powdered sugar over top.

title: Zucchini Souffle(Does Not Puff)
steps: Stir together zucchini, Bisquick, cheese and onion in one bowl.
Beat eggs with oil and salt in separate bowl.
Mix all together with spoon until blended.
Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Okra-Bacon Casserole
steps: Select a large casserole dish. Put a layer of the okra at the bottom, then a layer of tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle some of the chopped onions and bell pepper over top. Make another layer, beginning with the okra, then tomatoes. Season again with salt and pepper and use up the remaining onion and bell pepper.
Cover top entirely with bacon, overlapping strips.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown and tender.

title: Banana Tea Bread
steps: Cream shortening with sugar; then with eggs, until very light and fluffy.
Stir in bananas.
Sift together flour, soda and salt. Blend into banana mixture.
Add nuts.
Turn into a greased 9 x -5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.
Cool before slicing.

title: Pecan Tassies
steps: Mix ingredients and refrigerate 1 hour.
Make into small balls and put into a mini-muffin tin.
Use the pad of your thumb to indent into the center of each ball.

title: Spinach-Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 12 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) American cheese slices, cut into pieces

steps: Note:
Save two slices of cheese for topping.

title: Cheesy Wiener Crescents
steps: Slit hot dogs lengthwise almost to the end.
Place a strip of cheese in each one.
Separate crescent rolls.
Place hot dog at the shortest end and roll up.
Bake on greased pan at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Elegant Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Rinse mushrooms, pat dry and remove stems.
Place caps on greased baking sheet.
Combine ingredients except 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
Mix well.
Spoon mixture into mushroom caps. Sprinkle each with reserved cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: plu bunch green onion
ingredients.raw: 2 plus bunches green onions, finely chopped

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: jalapeno peppers to taste (about 4 to 5 Tbsp. chopped)

steps: Mix all ingredients, except the tortillas.
Soften tortillas in microwave.
Spread mixture on tortillas and roll up tightly. They should be 1 1/2-inches in diameter when rolled.
Refrigerate (or freeze) until firm.
Cut into about 1/2-inch long pieces and serve with picante sauce.

title: Sourdough Bread With Cheddar Cheese
steps: Slice Cheddar cheese, about 1/8-inch thick.
Place cheese slices over slices of bread and sprinkle with garlic powder. Place slices in oven under broiler until cheese melts.
Makes a delicious snack.

title: Scrambled Hamburger
steps: Melt margarine and saute onion and celery.
Add hamburg and cook over medium heat until brown.
Add soup, green beans and seasonings.
Finish cooking.
Serve over and type of noodles.

title: 3 Bean Salad

ingredients.name: kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can (16 oz.) red kidney beans, drained

ingredients.name: campbell s pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can (18 oz.) Campbell's pork and beans

ingredients.name: regular
ingredients.raw: 1 can regular or small baby lima beans, drained

steps: Brown hamburg and onion; mix everything together in 2-quart casserole.
Salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered, last few minutes, uncover.

title: Pie Dough
steps: Combine flour and salt. Cut in Crisco with a pastry blender or 2 knives. Add water, a little at a time, just until dough is moist enough to hold together, that it does not feel wet when pressed between fingers. Roll out 1/2 at a time approximately 1/8-inch thick.
Place dough loosely in pan. Trim edges.
When placing top crust on filling, moisten edges with water. Press to seal, trim and flute.
Handle pastry as little as possible after adding water.
Makes 2 crusts.

title: Shoe Peg Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup

steps: Mix all and top with 1/2 box crumbled Ritz crackers and 1 stick melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Mock Lemon Meringue Cake

ingredients.name: prepared lemon pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 2 c. prepared lemon pudding and pie filling

steps: Bake cake as directed on package in a 10-inch tube pan.
Cool. Cut cake in 3 layers.
Stir pudding and pie filling until smooth. Spread 1/3 of filling between each layer and on top of cake. Frost sides and center with whipped topping.
Refrigerate.

title: Hash Browns Au Gratin
steps: Pour over hash browns in greased casserole dish.
Let set 1 hour and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: "Bumsteads"

ingredients.name: each pepper onion stuffed olive and sweet pickle
ingredients.raw: 1 1/3 Tbsp. each: chopped pepper, onion, stuffed olives and sweet pickles

steps: Mix all ingredients except buns.
Fill buns and wrap buns together with foil.
Bake at 250° for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Cream Cheese Caviar Spread(Serve With Red Wine Biscotti)

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 scallions, finely sliced (include some green leaves)

steps: Allow cream cheese to soften to room temperature.
Add scallions and caviar and mix well.
Refrigerate if not served immediately.
Caviar will discolor spread if not served within a day or two.

title: Easy Black Bean Soup

ingredients.name: condensed black bean soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can condensed black bean soup

steps: Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and cook until tender, but not brown.
Add soup and water; bring to boiling point.
Add lime juice.
Slice frankfurters into 1/4-inch rounds; add to soup and heat thoroughly.
Makes 4 generous servings.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add whipping cream and flour alternately.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.
Do not open oven for the first hour.

title: Corn Flake Goodies
steps: Cook sugar and syrup in a pot until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat; add peanut butter.
Stir until well blended. Add cornflakes and stir until well coated.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Prize-Winning Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: chipped beef turkey
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. thin sliced chipped beef, turkey or ham

steps: Soften cream cheese.
Dice 2 packages of meat and 3 to 5 onions.
Mix well.
Add Worcestershire sauce and Accent.
Mix well and form into ball.
Set aside.
Dice remaining meat and onions (more or less to taste).
Roll cheese ball in meat and then onions, covering all the cheese ball.
Wrap in plastic wrap and chill overnight.
Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Hot Sausage Dip

ingredients.name: tomato with green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 10 oz. can tomatoes with green chilies

steps: Cook and drain sausage.
Drain tomatoes reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid.
Stir all ingredients together except for the cheddar cheese.
Spoon into lightly greased 1 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with corn chips.

title: Schaum Torte

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. vinegar or cream of tartar

steps: Beat egg whites until very stiff.
Gradually add sugar, vanilla and vinegar.
Keep beating until no longer grainy.
Pour into ungreased pan of choice (spring-form, Bundt).
Bake at 275° to 300° for about 40 minutes.
Cool and serve with whipped cream and fresh fruit.

title: Ham And Potato Bake
steps: Start grill or fire.
Cut ham into large pieces.
Cut aluminum foil in 4 pieces.
Place pineapple, sweet potatoes and ham on each piece of foil.
Pour a small amount of pineapple and juice over top.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Wrap up and place on top of grill.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Wieners (Microwave)

ingredients.name: wiener in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. wieners, cut in 1-inch slices or 1 pkg. cocktail wieners

steps: Stir together mustard and jelly.
Stir in wieners.
Cook on High for 7 to 8 minutes or until serving temperature.

title: Scrambled Egg Casserole
steps: Scramble eggs in butter until fluffy.
Place in 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Add bacon, pepper, onion, mushrooms and soup. Top with grated cheese.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Serves 12.

title: Old Fashioned Butter Cookies
steps: Cream butter, sugar and egg until light and fluffy.
Beat in flour, baking powder, orange juice and vanilla until smooth. Chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm enough to roll.
Roll out half at a time on floured surface.
Cut into your favorite shapes and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 6 to 10 minutes.
Decorate as desired.

title: Spanish Lima Beans

ingredients.name: corned beef in
ingredients.raw: 1 can corned beef, cut in pieces

steps: Cook pepper and onion in margarine, about 5 minutes.
Mix with other ingredients and bake in casserole dish for about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Melting Moments
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Blend in butter until a soft dough forms.
If dough is too soft, cover it and chill for 20 to 30 minutes.
Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll balls in coconut.
Place balls 1 1/2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
Makes 3 dozen.

title: German Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Let chill overnight.
Shape in balls size of walnuts.
Press with fork to make cross.
Bake in moderate oven 10 to 12 minutes.
They are best if not cooked too done.
Take them out so that they will fall when taken out of the oven.
The dough will keep in refrigerator for days.

title: Quick Avocado Soup(Serves 4)

ingredients.name: each salt pepper and dill weed
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. each salt, pepper and dill weed

steps: In a blender or food processor, combine all ingredients. Blend to combine. Process until smooth.
Chill 1 hour or longer covered.
Serve sprinkled with chives.

title: Summer Corn Salad
steps: Chop onions (tops and all).
Drain corn.
Mix all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Arabian Stew
steps: Sear pork chops on both sides and place in a casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ham And Scallion Soup
steps: In a large pot, pour chicken soup and enough water to make broth, 3/4 pan full.
Add rest of ingredients and simmer until potatoes are done.

title: Sausage Appetizers
steps: Combine Bisquick, crumbled sausage and cheese; mix well.
Roll into balls about size of walnut.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.
May be frozen and baked later. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Zucchini Pickles
steps: In bowl, combine zucchini, salt and water.
Cover and let stand for 2 hours.
Drain and rinse well.
Combine all ingredients in large pan.
Bring to boil, stirring.
Boil 5 minutes, stirring. Fill hot jars, leaving 1/2-inch space.
Pour hot vinegar mixture over zucchini.
Adjust lids.
Process in boiling water bath 15 minutes.
Yields 4 to 5 pints.

title: Chicken Woodruff
steps: Line baking dish with beef.
Wrap each breast with slice of bacon and place on top of beef.
Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.
Bake uncovered at 225° for 3 hours.

title: Crabbies

ingredients.name: sharp cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. sharp cheese (Old English spread)

steps: Combine all ingredients except muffins.
Spread mixture on English muffins.
Cook at 450° for 10 minutes.
Cut each into 6 or 8 pieces for hors d'oeuvres.
May freeze.

title: Instant Yeast Rolls

ingredients.name: self raisin flour
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. self-rising flour or enough for a nice dough

ingredients.name: dry yeast dissolved in c. warm water
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water

steps: Note:
Rolls will rise better if set in a warm place.

title: Chocolate Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients except vanilla in saucepan.
Heat, stirring often until sugar dissolves.
Add vanilla and mix. Store in covered jar in refrigerator.
Makes 1 1/2 pints.
Better than you can buy.

title: Fat Free Strawberry Pretzels
steps: Mix melted margarine with sugar, then combine with the pretzels; coat pretzels well.
Place pretzels in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° for 5 minutes.
Cool well.
In a large bowl, combine Cool Whip, 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese together.
Mix until smooth and spread over cooled pretzels.
Now combine Jell-O with hot water and mix until Jell-O is dissolved.
Add the strawberries and chill until Jell-O starts to thicken, then pour over cream cheese mixture and chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Homemade Tartar Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Chill before serving. Yields about 2/3 cup.

title: Fruit Slush

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple (in its own juice)

steps: Mash the bananas.
Add the pineapple and orange juice.
Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking pan (or ice cube trays) and freeze.
Take it out of the freezer 15 minutes before serving so it can thaw to a slushy stage.
Great as a breakfast dish or as an after school snack.

title: Baked Fruit Delight

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. cans cherry or peach pie filling

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 1 box white or yellow cake mix

steps: Preheat oven at 400 degrees.
Pour cans of pie filling in pan evenly.
Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling.
Melt butter and pour over cake mix. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Chili-Burger Supper

ingredients.name: chili beef soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can chili-beef soup or 1 (15 oz.) can mild chili

steps: Cook and drain macaroni.
Brown hamburger and drain off fat. Add soups and cooked macaroni to the meat.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
Halve the cheese slices into triangles and put on top.
Let melt.
Serve right in the frying pan.

title: Mama'S Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Cook sweet potatoes.
While hot, mash, and mix sugar, nutmeg, lemon flavoring, butter, eggs and milk with the sweet potatoes. Pour in deep dish, unbaked pie crust.
Bake for 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Tortilla Crunch Chicken Fingers

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret fiesta herb with red pepper soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Fiesta Herb with Red Pepper soup mix

ingredients.name: plain tortilla chip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. finely crushed plain tortilla chips (about 3 oz.)

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a medium bowl, combine Fiesta Herb with Red Pepper soup mix and tortilla chips.
In a large plastic bag or bowl, combine chicken and egg, beaten with water, coating well.
Dip chicken in tortilla mixture, coating well.
In a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan sprayed with no-stick cooking spray, arrange chicken and drizzle with margarine.
Bake, uncovered, for 12 minutes or until chicken is done.
Makes about 24 chicken strips.
Can be served with salsa.

title: Bow Ties(Serves About 18 To 22)
steps: Beat eggs and egg yolks together until very light.
Beat in sugar, cream, salt and liquor.
Stir in flour.
This dough should be soft.
Knead dough on a floured board until smooth.
Cover dough and let it stand for 10 minutes.
Roll the dough out until it is very thin, about 1/8 inch.

title: Applesauce Pie

ingredients.name: pie shell
ingredients.raw: 2 small pie shells or 1 deep one

steps: Beat all ingredients well and pour into pie shells.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425°, then turn to 350°.
Bake until center is done.

title: Fudge Sauce
steps: Heat milk and sugar to a rolling boil for 1 minute.
Add chocolate squares; stir until dissolved, then beat with mixer (on stove) until smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add 1/4 cup oleo and add 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Caramel Pull-Apart Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Generously grease fluted tube pan. Combine the brown sugar, nuts, margarine and water.
Heat until the butter melts.
Separate the biscuits; cut each biscuit into quarters.
Place in mixing bowl.
Pour brown sugar mixture lightly over the biscuits.
Toss lightly to coat evenly.
Spoon into pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Let stand 3 minutes. Invert onto serving plate.
Pull apart; serve warm.

title: Sausage Appetizer Roll
steps: Brown sausage; drain thoroughly, blotting extra grease with paper towels.
Mix sausage with cheeses, eggs and oregano; save a couple tablespoons of egg to brush on top of roll.

title: Fish Chowder(5 Servings)

ingredients.name: butter margarine
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. butter, margarine or bacon drippings

ingredients.name: fish fillet defrosted and in
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. frozen fish fillets, defrosted and cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: Melt butter, margarine or bacon drippings in large saucepan. Add onion slices and cook until light yellow.
Add water, diced potatoes, salt and pepper; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are slightly soft when tested with a fork. Add fish and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add milk and heat, stirring occasionally.
Serve in hot soup bowls accompanied with large, round crackers.

title: Spaghetti Pasta Salad
steps: Toss together all ingredients.
Chill and serve.

title: Hobo Bread
steps: Pour 1 cup boiling water over the raisins and soda.
Let stand until cool.
Add the rest of the ingredients and stir.
Bake in a large soup or juice can or small soup cans (they should be half to 2/3 full, well greased and dusted with flour).
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Marinated Tomatoes(6 Servings)
steps: Slice or wedge tomatoes and arrange in shallow dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour over tomatoes.
Chill, covered, one hour.

title: Heath Coffee Cake
steps: Blend flour, sugars and margarine.
Take out 1/2 cup of crumb mixture.
To rest of mixture, add buttermilk, soda, egg and vanilla.
Blend well.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 14 x 2-inch pan.

title: Raisin Crisscross Cookies

ingredients.name: coarsely ground
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. coarsely ground or chopped raisins or nuts

steps: Mix together first 3 ingredients.
Stir in next 2 ingredients. Stir in last 2 ingredients.
Roll into balls the size of a small walnut.
Place balls, about 3 inches apart, on greased baking sheet.
Flatten with a fork, dipped in flour, making a crisscross pattern.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a moderate oven (350° to 375°), no more.
Makes about 50 cookies.

title: Potatoes, Cheese And Onions On The Grill
steps: First, spray piece of heavy duty foil with Pam.
Then arrange individual packages by alternating layers of potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, pepper and dots of butter.
Make 2 or 3 layers, according to size portion desired.
Wrap and seal tinfoil tightly. Place on grill for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour, turning approximately every 15 minutes.

title: Light And Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
steps: Beat sour cream, cottage cheese, Bisquick, margarine and eggs. Spread broccoli in an 8 x 8-inch dish.
Pour over broccoli. Arrange tomato on top; sprinkle cheese over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown and knife comes out clean.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pudding

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: In a large bowl, layer vanilla wafers and sliced strawberries until bowl is full.
In a small mixing bowl, mix vanilla pudding according to directions on box.
Mix the rest of the ingredients in another bowl until well blended.
Add pudding; mix well.
Pour over wafers and strawberries.
Refrigerate.
Best if it sets overnight.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
steps: Brown hamburger, green peppers and onions in frypan.
Mix in pizza sauce and mushrooms.
Set aside.

title: Grandma Robena'S Collards

ingredients.name: salt pork ham hock
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. salt pork, ham hock or ham bone

steps: Wash salt pork and place in a big pot with about 6 to 8 cups of water.
Boil gently, covered, for about 1/2 hour.
Pick and prepare collards for cooking.
Discard tough outer leaves and stems. Tear washed collard leaves and put in pot with pork. Cook collards for about 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add salt and pepper near end of cooking time.
At serving time, drain the greens and chop coarsely.
Put the chunks of pork on the platter or in the dish with them. Be sure to serve with pepper sauce. Also serve with cornbread.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Sauce
steps: Heat over simmering water.
Stir until chocolate and marshmallows are melted.
Remove double boiler top from heat and blend in 1 tablespoon butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Serve hot.

title: Spanish Rice With Meat
steps: Place meat and rice in pan; brown.
Put in casserole.
Add remaining ingredients, which have been coarsely chopped, in layers.
Do not stir.
Salt to taste.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Jeanette'S Fast Cherry Crumb Cake
steps: Add the following to a greased rectangular pan:
the whole can of pineapple (juice, too!) and the whole can of cherries. Sprinkle the dry cake mix over the fruit.
Cut the margarine in slices and place on top. Bake at 350° for 48 to 50 minutes.

title: Chatty Cathys
steps: Cream together the margarine, sugar and egg.
Sift together and add the flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder.
Add rolled oats and coconut.
Drop by teaspoon; press flat.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Raspberry Cooler
steps: Combine 1 package of raspberries with sugar in a 2-cup measure.
Microwave on Medium for 4 minutes.
Crush berries. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add crushed berries.
Add ginger ale (before serving) and 1 package uncrushed, thawed raspberries.
Serves 6.

title: Mallow-Apple Dip
steps: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature.
Empty entire jar marshmallow cream into a bowl and add strawberry cream cheese. Beat until completely blended.

title: Romantic Raspberry Chocolate Meringues

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. pecans or walnuts, finely chopped

steps: Beat egg whites until they begin to get stiff.
Add gelatin gradually blending thoroughly.
Add sugar a little at a time, beating until stiff peaks form.
Beat in salt and vinegar.
Fold in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by half full teaspoons on foil-lined baking sheets.
Bake 20 minutes at 250°; turn off heat and leave in oven 3 hours without opening the door.

title: Peppered Steak
steps: Cut steaks into strips; brown in cooking oil.
Add onion and pepper, chopped in strips.
Cover for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and soy sauce, cook until thickened.
Serve over rice.

title: Baked Potato Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients in bowl and put in well greased baking dish.
Cover and bake for one hour and fifteen minutes.
Remove foil and bake 15 minutes more.
Bake at 375°.
Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Beef Chow Mein
steps: Saute first 3 ingredients.
Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake 1/2 hour at 325°.

title: Easy Punch

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sugar (only if you use unsweetened Kool-Aid)

steps: In 2-quart container, mix Kool-Aid, pineapple juice and sugar. Finish filling the container with water, 7-Up or ginger ale.
Stir and serve.

title: Fried Burritos

ingredients.name: roast beef chicken
ingredients.raw: leftover roast beef, chicken or pork

steps: In a saucepan, dip each tortilla in cooking oil. Add some of each remaining ingredient to each flour tortilla.
Roll up as a burrito.
Heat oil and fry each burrito until flour tortilla is brown on both sides.

title: Tuna Biscuit Casserole

ingredients.name: refrigerator biscuit
ingredients.raw: 1 can refrigerator biscuits (Pillsbury Big Country biscuits)

steps: Arrange biscuits in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine ingredients.
Pour over top of biscuits.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 400°.
Biscuits will come up to top through the tuna mix, browned and puffy.

title: Carrots And Apples

ingredients.name: plu tsp. reduced calorie tub margarine
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. reduced-calorie tub margarine

ingredients.name: onion and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. firmly packed light brown sugar

ingredients.name: granny smith apple cored and
ingredients.raw: 2 small Granny Smith apples, cored and cut into 16 wedges

steps: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook carrots for 8 to 10 minutes, until just tender; drain.
In a large nonstick skillet, melt margarine.
Add onion; cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden.
Add carrots, sugar and syrup; stir to coat.
Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, until glazed. Stir apples, cinnamon and nutmeg into skillet.
Cover and cook 5 minutes longer, until apples and carrots are tender.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Oven French Toast(Easy And Excellent)
steps: Heat margarine in jelly roll pan.
Beat orange juice, honey and eggs until foamy.
Dip bread in mixture and place in jelly roll pan.
Bake in 450° oven until bottoms of bread are brown, about 10 minutes.
Turn and bake on other side for 6 to 8 minutes longer.

title: Banana Strawberry Cobbler(Microwave)
steps: Slice bananas in bottom of 10 x 7 x 2-inch glass dish.
Mix lemon juice and vanilla with pie filling.
Pour over bananas. Microcook on High 6 minutes.
Sprinkle nuts and cookie crumbs over top.
Microcook 1 1/2 minutes on High.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Hamburger Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Drain grease from meat and onions.
Put in casserole and add soup and grated Velveeta cheese.
Mix together and put Tater Tots all over the top.
Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Walnut Custard Pie
steps: Mix ingredients together as you would be pumpkin pie.
Beat egg whites stiff and put in last.
Add a pinch of salt.
This makes 1 pie.

title: Marciel Jello
steps: Jell Jell-Os.
Add cream cheese. Whip before adding fruit and pecans.

title: Easy Baked Potatoes
steps: Mix in Ziploc bag flour, Parmesan cheese, pepper and salt. Melt margarine in a casserole dish.
Place potatoes in flour mixture.
Shake until coated.
Place potatoes in single layer in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Turn over and finish baking until fork-tender.

title: Fish Balls
steps: Boil or bake fish; remove all bones, then mash.
Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.
Beat egg yolks until creamy; add flour, salt, pepper, a little garlic and onion salt and parsley. Mix together, then add fish and mix well.
Add egg whites; fold in.
Drop into hot grease until golden brown.

title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
steps: Brown chops; place half of potatoes and onion in greased 9 x 12-inch cake pan.
Heat soup and milk to make sauce; pour about half over potatoes and onion; place remaining potatoes and onion in dish.
Place pork chops on top; pour remaining sauce over chops.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove cover and bake 30 more minutes.

title: Tortilla Torte(Dessert)

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. sour cream (low-fat is OK too)

steps: Gently melt chocolate chips.
Stir in sour cream until fully blended.
Spread mixture over tortillas in layers. Chill. (Once it has set up, I prefer to serve it at room temperature, but refrigerate any leftover.)

title: Light Brown Brownies
steps: Add sugar to the eggs; mix well.
Sift dry ingredients and add to sugar and eggs.
Also add balance of ingredients except the nuts.
Mix just enough to blend thoroughly.
Add the nuts.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350° (325° for glass pan) in greased pan.
Cut when slightly cool.

title: Lite Ranch Dressing Mix(Lo-Fat Salad Dressing)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small jar.
Store in dry place.

title: Leche Flan(Dessert)
steps: Dissolve brown sugar in 1/4 cup water and cook over moderate heat until the sugar browns.
Line a suitable mold with the mixture evenly and set aside.
Scald milk in double boiler for 15 minutes.
Blend the egg yolks with the sugar, milk and flavoring. Pour into the mold lined with caramelized sugar.
Place this in a bigger pan half filled with water and bake until mixture becomes firm.
Cool before removing from mold.

title: Freezer Biscuits
steps: Mix dry ingredients and cut in shortening.
Add milk.
Mix. Roll out dough and cut out biscuits.
Place on baking sheet for 30 minutes to freeze.
When frozen, put in a freezer bag.
When ready to bake, place on baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes at 450°. Yields 2 dozen biscuits.

title: Five Star Lentil Soup

ingredients.name: ham bone with a little meat left on
ingredients.raw: 1 ham bone with a little meat left on

steps: Put all ingredients in soup pot and fill with water.
Cook 3 to 4 hours if 3 quarts water used.
Cool.
Pick out bone and grizzle.
Reheat with a few fat hot dogs sliced in, if desired. Serve with French bread.
This is the only way I could persuade my family to eat ham - promise this soup!

title: Quick Cookies

ingredients.name: any flavor cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box any flavor cake mix (except white)

steps: Mix together all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake in 350 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
The flavor of cookies can be changed by using a different cake mix.

title: No Cook Cranberry Relish
steps: Remove the seeds from the apples, oranges and lemon but do not peel. Combine fruit.
Put through coarse blade of food chopper. Stir in 2 1/2 cups sugar.
Toss and chill.
Let set 24 hours before serving.

title: Date Nut Balls
steps: Melt butter; add sugar and beaten eggs.
Heat these and add dates.
Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Take off heat and add vanilla, Rice Krispies and chopped nuts. Shape into balls and roll in coconut.

title: Coffee-Date Skillet Balls
steps: Melt butter in large, heavy skillet.
Stir in sugar, dates and instant coffee.
Remove from heat; blend in egg.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil.
Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; stir in cereal, 1 1/3 cups of the coconut and the nuts.
Let stand 10 minutes. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in remaining coconut.
Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pineapple Filling
steps: Beat pineapple, eggs, sugar and flour with a fork.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Cut bread into cubes and brown in butter. Place cubes on top of pineapple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool for 15 minutes before serving.
Serve with main course in place of potatoes.
Serves 6.

title: Hearty Hamburger Casserole

ingredients.name: ready chunky vegetable soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can (19 oz.) ready to serve chunky vegetable soup

steps: In a skillet, cook beef until no longer pink, drain.
Stir in soup and set aside.
Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions, spoon half into a greased 2 quart
baking dish.
Top with beef mixture, cheese and remaining stuffing.
Bake uncovered at
350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Maple Onions
steps: Peel and cut onions in half.
Place in a greased baking dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over onions.
Bake at 350° for about an hour or until onions are soft.
Serves 16.

title: Honey Orange Squash
steps: Microwave:
Combine honey, butter, salt and orange peel in 2 cup glass measure.
Cover tightly with Saran Wrap, turning back edge to vent.
Microcook at 100% power for 4 to 5 minutes or until butter melts.
Set aside.

title: Pear Pickles
steps: Boil pears 20 to 30 minutes in clear water.
Boil the sugar, water, vinegar and spices in bag.
Drain pears and put in vinegar mixture.
Cook until pears are tender.
Pack in hot jars.
Process in hot water bath 5 minutes.
Seal.
Take jars out and place in dark place.

title: Oyster Crackers(Appetizer)

ingredients.name: cream italian style salad mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. creamy Italian style salad mix

steps: Mix the oil and the creamy Italian style salad mix.
Pour over the crackers and stir several times.
If you put the crackers and mixture in a Tupperware bowl with lid, you can just turn the bowl upside down every so often to mix.

title: Georgia Blueberry Muffins
steps: Beat egg.
Stir in milk.
Add blueberries and oil.
Pour in flour mixture that has been sifted together (flour, salt and baking powder) all at once and stir until flour is moistened. Fill paper lined muffin tins about 3/4 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

title: Lillie'S Tikoy

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 cans water (use coconut milk can to measure)

steps: Mix ingredients together until smooth.
Pour in a greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° until toothpick or fork comes out clean.

title: Katjang Sauce(Peanut Sauce - Indonesian)
steps: Mix together all ingredients except peanut butter.
Bring to a boil.
Turn heat to medium and add peanut butter.
Stir until smooth.
Take off stove and serve over Sate.

title: Stir-Fried Vegetables
steps: Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and cook 20 seconds.
Add beans, carrots and onions; cook, stirring, 2 minutes.
Add water, soy sauce and sugar. Reduce heat to medium; cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Pork Butt Roast
steps: Trim excess fat.
Place meat and onions in a 3 to 4-quart casserole.
Mix all ingredients and pour over top. Bake 3 hours at 300°.
Serve with rice and veggies.

title: Ellen'S Brownies

ingredients.name: sq. chocolate
ingredients.raw: 2 sq. unsweetened chocolate or 6 Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa

steps: Melt butter
and chocolate or add powdered cocoa in saucepan. Remove from heat.
Add sugar and eggs; mix.
Add flour; mix.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes in 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan.

title: Corn Meal Pancakes
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Cook in skillet in hot oil.

title: Olive Nut Spread
steps: Put all ingredients in a small bowl and blend well.
This will stay fresh in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.
Serve with crackers or may be used as a sandwich spread.

title: Aunt Bill'S Devil'S Food Cake
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, oleo and eggs together.
Alternately add and mix in flour, milk and vanilla.
Add boiling water.
Mix to a light creamy batter.
Pour into 2 (9-inch) pans or a loaf pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Use your favorite icing.

title: Zippy Taco Salad
steps: Brown meat; drain. Stir in beans and sauce.
Cover.
Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add Velveeta; stir until melted. For each serving, top chips with lettuce, tomato and meat mixture.

title: Apple-Pecan Cake
steps: Beat the first 4 ingredients together.
In another bowl, mix the remaining ingredients.
Combine the two mixtures and bake for about an hour at 350°.
(This is a very old recipe.)

title: Chicken Tetrazzini(Low-Fat)
steps: Cook chicken and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Cook pasta according to package directions.
Saute garlic and mushrooms using cooking spray and a little water.
Stir in soup, milk, cheese and chicken pieces.
Heat through.
Drain pasta and toss into mixture until well blended.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crispy Coated Chicken

ingredients.name: pouch dry onion soup mix with chicken broth
ingredients.raw: 1 pouch dry onion soup mix with chicken broth

steps: Crush soup mix in pouch.
Combine soup mix, bread crumbs and pepper.
Beat together egg and water.
Dip chicken into egg and then crumb mixture.
Arrange breasts on baking sheet.
Drizzle with margarine.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Osgood Pie
steps: Beat egg yolks until light and thick.
Sift spices with sugar; add to yolks.
Add pecans, raisins, butter and vinegar.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 400°.
Reduce to 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Ruth'S Carrot Cake

ingredients.name: junior baby food carrot
ingredients.raw: 2 (7 oz.) jars junior baby food carrots

steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into two 8-inch round cake pans.
(Pans should be prepared with Crisco and flour.) Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake springs back to touch.

title: Crawfish Maquechow
steps: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter.
Add Ro-Tel; cook down. Add corn and cook approximately 20 minutes.
Be careful not to scorch.
Add well seasoned tails and cook another 20 to 30 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Butter Pecan Chess Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, 1 egg, and 1 stick butter well and spread in a greased 9 x 13 cake pan.
Then, mix 1 stick butter, 8 oz. cream cheese, 1 box powdered sugar, 2 eggs, and 1 tsp. vanilla well and pour over bottom layer.
Top with 1-2 c. chopped pecan pieces. Bake at 300 degrees for 45-50 minutes.

title: Garden Club Dessert
steps: Combine ingredients; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 375°.
Cool.

title: Delores' Double Crust Pastry
steps: Cut shortening into flour and salt until crumbly.
Gently stir in cold water until pastry holds together.
Divide into 2 parts. Roll out on floured surface.

title: Tuna Salad With A Twist

ingredients.name: and flaked white tuna
ingredients.raw: 2 cans drained and flaked white tuna

steps: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill.
Makes about 4 cups.

title: Mini Spinach Quiches

ingredients.name: spinach and well
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and well drained

steps: Separate each biscuit into 3 layers.
Fit layers into 30 (1 3/4 x 1-inch) mini muffin pan cups.
In a 2-quart saucepan stir together cornstarch, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in milk until smooth.
Stirring constantly, bring to a boil. Gradually stir about 1/4 cup of the hot cornstarch mixture into the beaten egg until blended.
Stir egg mixture into the remaining hot mixture in pan.
Cool.
Stir in cheese and spinach.
Spoon about 2 teaspoons spinach mixture into each tart (should be full). Bake in 400° oven 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from pans and serve.
Quiches may be frozen in tightly covered container for 1 month.
Bake frozen quiches 15 minutes at 400°.

title: String Pie

ingredients.name: spaghetti
ingredients.raw: cooked spaghetti (2 Tbsp. butter on noodles)

steps: In a baking dish, place cooked spaghetti in bottom of dish.
In a separate bowl, mix eggs and Parmesan cheese with cottage cheese. Add onto noodles, then mix meat, spaghetti sauce, onion and green pepper and put over cheese mixture.
Over the top, add shredded Mozzarella and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Round Steak And Gravy
steps: Put cream of mushroom soup and water in a 5-quart Dutch oven. In large skillet, put 1/4 cup oil.
Roll steak pieces in flour; brown quickly.
Drop in Dutch oven with soup and water.
Leave oil in frying pan.
Add 1/4 cup flour to pan and brown.
Add salt and pepper.
Add enough to make thin gravy.
Add this to Dutch oven; cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Primavera

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can (10-3/4 oz) condensed cream of chicken or mushroom soup, undiluted

steps: In a large saucepan, combine the first seven ingredients. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until vegetables are tender, about 12 minutes.
Stir in spaghetti; heat through.

title: Fruity Tea
steps: Brew tea bags and water until very strong tasting.
Use a gallon jar, put tea, sugar, juice and lemonade in jar; mix well. Fill rest of jar with cold water.

title: Chocolate Fondue

ingredients.name: mixture of different kind of fruit or
ingredients.raw: mixture of different kinds of fruit, cubed or sliced (best if chilled)

steps: Mix all except fruit.
Heat in fondue pot until chips are melted and mixture is hot.

title: Great Punch

ingredients.name: tray ice
ingredients.raw: 4 trays ice cubes or 3 juice cans water

ingredients.name: ginger ale
ingredients.raw: 7 qt. ginger ale (2 at a time)

steps: Mix pineapple juice, orange juice, ice cubes, fruit cocktail and cherries.
You can refrigerate overnight before needed or freeze.
When ready to use, pour into punch bowl.
Add 2 quarts of the ginger ale.
Mix.
Top with sherbet.
As needed, add more ginger ale.

title: Amaretto Dip
steps: Mix pudding with 1/2 cup milk (use mixer).
Blend in Cool Whip. Add Amaretto liqueur.
Let stand for awhile.
Serve with fresh fruit.
Will keep for several days.

title: Aunt Betty'S Sherried Chicken And Cheese

ingredients.name: size chicken in half
ingredients.raw: 16 serving size pieces chicken, cut in half

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: cherry wine or
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. sherry wine or to taste

steps: Arrange chicken in single layer in shallow baking pan. Scatter green onions over top; cover with sprinkling of cheese and paprika.
Blend soups with sherry; pour over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for about 2 hours, or until fork-tender.
(Do not cover; do not salt.)
Excellent with pilaf-type rice.

title: Cherry Pie Cobbler
steps: Sweeten cherries to taste with sugar.
Dump fruit in cobbler dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Sprinkle cake mix over all. Chip oleo on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: No-Bake Fudge Clusters
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan; then add milk and syrup, stir.
Cook to soft ball stage and remove from heat.
Add margarine, vanilla, oats and coconut or walnuts.
Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
steps: Break up chicken and line bottom of dish.
Pour cream of chicken soup over chicken.
Sprinkle stuffing over top as desired. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Caramel Bars

ingredients.name: german chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. German chocolate cake mix

steps: In a pan, combine caramels and milk.
Heat until all caramels are melted and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cake mix, oleo, 1/3 cup milk and nuts.
Press 1/2 of the dough into a greased 9 x 11-inch pan or dish.
Save the rest of the dough for topping.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over the mix.
Spread the caramel mixture over the chocolate chips.
Then, crumble the rest of the cake mixture over the caramels.
Bake for 18 minutes at 350°.
Cool before cutting.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Waffles
steps: Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In a mixing bowl, beat eggs until light.
Add buttermilk; mix well.
Add dry ingredients and beat until batter is smooth. Stir in butter.
Pour about 3/4 cup batter onto a lightly greased preheated waffle iron.
Sprinkle with a few pecans.
Bake according to manufacturer's directions until golden brown.
Repeat until batter and pecans are gone.
Yields 7 waffles (about 8 inches each).

title: Boston Baked Beans
steps: Simmer beans in 6 cups of water for 1 hour.
Allow to stand, covered, for 2 hours or until softened.
Drain.
Put all ingredients in a crock-pot.
Add 1 cup of water.
Stir to blend. Cover pot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours.
Stir occasionally.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Saucy Pork Chops
steps: In a skillet, brown pork chops on both sides in small amount of oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with onion slices. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl.
Pour over pork chops.
Cover, simmer 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Hamburger And Cheese Pizzas(Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: lean ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. lean ground beef or turkey

ingredients.name: low moisture part skim mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 oz. (1/4 c.) shredded low-moisture part-skim Mozzarella cheese

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In small skillet, brown ground beef; drain.
Place pocket breads on ungreased cookie sheet. Top each with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce and 3 tablespoons ground beef. Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Makes 4 pizzas.
Serving:
1 pizza.
Calories:
Fat grams: 6.

title: Quick Sheath Cake
steps: Mix together and beat.
Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350° for thirty minutes.

title: Raymond'S Pecan Pie
steps: Mix sugars and flour.
Beat in eggs, milk and flavoring.
Add melted margarine and pecans.
Bake in unbaked pie shell 40 to 50 minutes at

title: Old-Fashioned Doughnuts
steps: In mixing bowl, measure 1 1/2 cups flour and remaining ingredients.
In mixer beat 1 minute, then stir in remaining flour to make soft dough.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick and then fry in deep fat fryer with oil at 370°.
Makes 24.

title: Jingle Bell Fudge
steps: Combine butterscotch chips and peanut butter in top of double boiler.
Place over hot, not boiling water, until butterscotch melts; remove from water.
Stir until blended; add milk and stir until blended.
Spread in foil-lined 8 inch square pan.
Press chopped nuts into surface, if desired, and chill until firm.
Cut into 1-inch squares.
Yield:
64 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Bring vinegar, sugar, salt and spices to a boil.
Pour over freshly sliced vegetables and let sit for 1 hour.
Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes.
Pack in hot sterilized jars.
Seal. Process 10 minutes.
Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups.
Beat egg; stir in milk and oil.
Stir in remaining ingredients all at once just until flour is moistened.
Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Immediately remove from pan. Makes about 1 dozen muffins.

title: Pat'S Corned Beef
steps: In medium saucepan, combine the corned beef, tomatoes, diced onion and baby limas.
Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
Serve with creamed potatoes, salad and rolls for a quick and easy meal the kids will love.

title: Impossible Coconut Custard Pie
steps: Place all ingredients, except coconut, into blender or food processor (with chopping blade).
Blend for 2 minutes.
Pour into lightly greased pie plate, preferably glass.
Sprinkle coconut on top and pat down with back of large spoon. Let stand 5 minutes. Bake at 350° for 4 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
Serves warm or cold.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
steps: Add sugar, margarine, cocoa, salt and milk to saucepan.
Boil 1 minute hard.
Take off stove; add peanut butter, oats and vanilla.
Mix well.
Drop on wax paper and cool.
(Good without cocoa, too.)

title: Glazed Acorn Rings
steps: Cut off ends of squash.
Slice crosswise into 1-inch rings and remove seeds.
Place in a single layer in large, shallow baking dish and add orange juice.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Combine brown sugar and remaining ingredients; simmer 5 minutes. Pour over squash rings and bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer, basting occasionally.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
steps: Combine ingredients.
Pour into 2 prepared pie crusts.
Bake at 300° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Minced Lobster
steps: Pour a small amount of oil and 1 can of tomato paste in pan. Cook slowly for 2 minutes.
Pour celery, onions and bell pepper in pan and let cook for 5 minutes.
Pour diced lobster meat in mixture and simmer for 10 minutes or until fully cooked.

title: Pepper Cabbage

ingredients.name: or head of cabbage
ingredients.raw: 1 small or medium head of cabbage

steps: Quarter cabbage and remove core.
Remove inside seeds from pepper.
Grind on course blades of grinder.
Make a mixture of water and vinegar (proportion 1/3 cup vinegar to 2/3 cup water). Make enough to thoroughly moisten cabbage and pepper.
Some seasoning will be needed (salt, pepper, a little sugar to taste). Store in refrigerator in covered bowl.

title: Loaded Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil corn and cut off cob.
Put in hot sterilized quart canning jars.
Add 2 tablespoons of canning or pickling salt to each jar.
Fill to neck of jar with boiling water.
Seal.

title: Kentucky Corn Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients except cheese.
Pour half of mixture into greased iron skillet.
Sprinkle with half (1/4 cup) Cheddar cheese. Pour in remaining half of corn bread mixture.
Top with remainder 1/4 cup cheese.
Bake at 475° for 30 minutes.

title: Skillet Spaghetti
steps: Brown the first 4 ingredients in skillet.
Drain well.
Add the next 3 ingredients to meat mixture and simmer well.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Add spaghetti and cook until tender. Place in baking pan, top with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Cool And Easy Pie
steps: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in bowl at least 2 minutes. Add enough ice to cold water to make 1 ; cup.
Add Jell-O and stir until ice is melted.
Add Cool Whip; stir with whisk until well blended.
Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is very thick and will mound.
Spoon into crust.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Hot Dog Appetizers
steps: Cut hot dogs and bacon pieces into thirds.
Wrap each hot dog piece with 1 piece of bacon and secure with toothpick.
Arrange in single layer on cookie sheets or shallow baking pans; bake at 250° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Pour barbecue sauce evenly over hot dogs; then drizzle molasses lightly over barbecue sauce. Sprinkle brown sugar over all.
Return to oven and bake an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot or keep warm in a crock-pot. This will make a crock-pot full of appetizers.
Makes 72 to 90 appetizers.

title: Leek And Potato Soup

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced to 2 1/2-inch pieces

steps: Trim dark green leaves from leeks; slit leeks and clean carefully.
Chop fine.
Cook the leeks with the onion in butter. Add potatoes and stock.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Add cream and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, sprinkled with chives or scallions.
Also good served cold.

title: Apple-Pineapple Dump Cake
steps: Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in this order:
apple pie filling, pineapple and dry cake mix.
Melt oleo and drizzle over top.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
steps: Wash and cut squash in half lengthwise.
Scrape out seeds. Brush cut surfaces and cavity with melted butter.
Place close together, cut side down, on baking sheet.
Bake at 350° until almost tender, about 30 to 40 minutes.
Turn cut side up and brush again with butter.
Sprinkle cavity with sugar and salt.
Add a few drops of sherry.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes more, until surface is glazed.

title: Cheese Dip Or Spread
steps: Mix 1 tablespoon cream with softened cream cheese.
Add 5 tablespoons
oyster hot tomato ketchup and French dressing. Add
1 small
finely chopped onion.
Season with celery salt. Serve with crackers or potato chips.

title: Lobster Bisque
steps: This soup is not suitable for freezing.
In large pot, combine lobster meat and cold water.
Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
In large saucepan, melt butter and blend in the flour.
Gradually add the milk and cook until thickened, stirring frequently.
Add the milk mixture to the lobster mixture.
Stir well and reheat.
Add salt and pepper and cayenne pepper to taste and serve.
Yields 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Perfect White Bread
steps: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; set aside until remaining hot water, shortening, salt and sugar cool to lukewarm.
Stir in 2 cups flour; beat well.
Add remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough.
Turn on floured surface and knead until satiny, 8 to 10 minutes.
Let sit 10 minutes and knead again a few minutes. Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease surface.
Let raise in warm place until double in bulk.
Punch down; raise again 1 hour until double.
Cut dough in two portions.
Place in small ball; set 10 minutes.
Place in loaves; let raise until double about 1 hour. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: 9 Minute Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: In a glass pan with handles, stir together the peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt.
Cook 8 minutes on High, stirring after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla.
Cook one minute longer on High.
Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and fluffy (foamy). Immediately pour on lightly buttered baking sheet.
Spread out thin.
When cool, break into pieces.
Store in airtight container.

title: Grandma Jackson'S Sorghum Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together except flour.
Add flour gradually, enough to make a stiff batter.
Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° until done.
Top will fall.

title: Plain Cake

ingredients.name: soda dissolved in tbsp. hot water
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. hot water

steps: Cream oleo and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add soda and buttermilk.
Add flour gradually.
Add vanilla.
Bake in Bundt pan 1 hour at 300°.

title: Chipped Beef Dip

ingredients.name: smoked chipped beef
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. jar smoked chipped beef, finely chopped

steps: Blend cheese and milk.
Add beef, onion and pepper to cheese mixture.
Blend in sour cream.
Put in ovenproof dish.
Cover top with crushed pecans.
Serve hot with crackers.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ricotta Snowflake Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients; form into a ball and chill for 1 hour. Roll out the dough to a 1/8-inch thickness.
Use a round cookie cutter or a fluted cookie cutter and cut out shapes.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Do not let them get too brown.

title: Muddy Buddies
steps: Pour cereal into large bowl; set aside.
In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine chips, peanut butter and margarine. Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour chocolate mixture over cereal, stirring until all pieces are evenly coated, then pour cereal mixture into large, resealable plastic bag. Add powdered sugar.
Seal securely.
Shake until all pieces are well coated.
Spread on waxed paper to cool.
Serve. Store leftovers in airtight containers.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Own Crust)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use shortening and heavily grease and flour deep dish pan.
Mix ingredients together.
Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Drop Biscuits
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine milk, oil and egg; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 400° for 12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool on a wire rack. Yields 1 dozen biscuits.

title: Strawberry Kielbasa
steps: Cut uncooked kielbasa in slices.
Sprinkle jello over kielbasa.
Spread jam over mixture.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
Mix and serve.

title: Broccoli-Bacon Salad
steps: Mix together broccoli, onion, raisins and bacon.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over salad, adding enough to moisten. Stir gently to mix.
Chill.

title: Creamed Salmon
steps: Melt butter. Add flour and blend.
Add milk, salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat until slightly thick, stirring often. Add dill weed, grated cheese and salmon.
We like this over toast or mashed potatoes.

title: Squash Pickle
steps: Sprinkle salt over squash and onions and let stand 1 hour. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Add squash and onions. Again bring to a boil.
Pack in hot sterile jars and seal. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Combine ingredients in a 2-cup measuring cup.
Microwave on High 3 minutes.
Equals 1 can.

title: Baked Potato Mice

ingredients.name: herb
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 Tbsp. chopped herbs (such as parsley, chives, sage, thyme)

steps: Peel potatoes.
Cut into thin slices (but not all the way through; use handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way).
Put potatoes in a baking dish, fanning them slightly. Sprinkle salt and spread butter.
Sprinkle herbs.
Bake at 450° for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle on cheese.
Bake for 7 to 10 minutes more.
Add parsley ears and tail from parsley stem.

title: Dilly Shrimp Dip
steps: Drain and rinse shrimp.
Mix all ingredients together.
Serve with crackers, fresh vegetables or potato chips.

title: Sweet Potato Stuff

ingredients.name: sweet potato and mashed
ingredients.raw: 3 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed

steps: Mix all ingredients and spread in a 13 x 9 inch casserole dish.
Top with topping and cook in 350 degree oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Bacon Tomato Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Chop bacon, tomato, onion and grated cheese.
Mix all ingredients except biscuits.
Separate each biscuit into 3 thinner biscuits.
Lay each biscuit over a mini muffin pan cup.
Press biscuit into cup. Fill cups with bacon mixture and bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown.
Yields 30.

title: Florence'S Old-Fashioned Chocolate Icing
steps: Cook this a little longer than	previously
and pour on cake.

title: Crab Bites
steps: Mix all ingredients together well. Spread on bread (without crust) or English muffin halves. Cut into fourths.
Heat until cheese melts in a 350° oven.

title: Sesame Chicken(4 Grams Of Fat)

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: chicken breasts or pieces, skinned (all visible fat removed)

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour over chicken and marinate. Barbecue or bake 40 minutes or until well done.

title: Ma-Mae'S Homemade Rolls

ingredients.name: fleischmann s dry yeast
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Fleischmann's dry yeast (regular or quick-rise) *

steps: Preparation: About 1 hour, plus rising time.
Cooking Time: 10 to 15 minutes.
Temperature: 350°.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream

ingredients.name: butter pecan instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 3 small boxes butter pecan instant pudding

steps: Prepare the instant pudding.
Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Mix the beaten eggs, sugar, pudding and cream.
Put these in freezer can after they are mixed.
Add enough milk to have can 3/4 full.
Freeze.
Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Party Fruit Salad
steps: Heat pineapple to boiling; add gelatin and stir until dissolved.
Chill until partially set.
Soften cream cheese; stir in pimiento.
Add to gelatin mixture and blend.
Fold in whipped cream, celery and nuts.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until firm.

title: Benedictine Spread

ingredients.name: onion juice
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. onion juice or onions, grated very finely

steps: Combine all ingredients with 1 to 2 drops of food coloring in blender or food processor.
Add more color if needed.
Blend until smooth.
Makes filling for 6 to 8 full size sandwiches.

title: Easy Hershey Fudge
steps: Cook the first 3 ingredients until boiling; boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; let cool for 10 seconds.
Add the chocolate bars.
Stir until mixed.
Pour into a 10 x 13-inch greased glass container.

title: Mom'S Chicken Fricassee
steps: Take 2 tablespoons oil in large frying pan.
Cut up large onions small.
Put in large frying pan on medium heat until onions are a bit soft.
Take parts of chicken and put salt and paprika on each piece.
Put skin side down on onions.
Lower to simmer and cook until tender.

title: Broiled Tomatoes
steps: Slice tomatoes in half carefully; do not puncture bottom. Squeeze out some seeds and the juice.
Add mixture of bread crumbs, cheese, oregano, salt and pepper and a few drops of oil to each tomato half.
Put under broiler for 3 to 6 minutes.

title: Sky High Strawberry Pie
steps: In a large bowl, mash enough berries to equal 3 cups.
In a saucepan, combine the sugar and cornstarch.
Stir in the mashed berries and water; mix well.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
Remove from the heat; add food coloring if desired.
Pour into a large bowl. Chill for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture is just slightly warm.
Fold in the remaining berries.
Pile into pie shell.
Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Decorator Icing
steps: Mix together.
Yields enough icing to do flowers and leaves for 350+ cake squares.

title: Pumpkin Delight
steps: Mix and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

title: Fruited Cabbage Salad
steps: Combine first five ingredients and set aside.
In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the mayonnaise, milk, sugar, lemon juice; shake well.
Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat.

title: Swiss Fondue

ingredients.name: garlic in half
ingredients.raw: 1 large clove garlic, cut in half

ingredients.name: natural swiss cheese or
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. natural Swiss cheese, cubed or shredded

steps: Rub inside of fondue pot or saucepan with cut edge of garlic, then discard.
In fondue pot, simmer apple juice.
Blend in soup. Combine cheese and cornstarch; stir into soup mixture.
Heat until cheese melts; stir now and then.
Spear bread with fondue fork and dip into fondue.
Makes about 4 cups.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole

ingredients.name: egg noodle and
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In medium saucepan, melt margarine; blend in flour.
Stir in milk, salt and chicken broth.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix chicken and noodles with sauce.
Pour in pan.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until top is lightly browned.

title: One Dish Ham Bake(Chicken, Turkey Or Beef Can Be Used.)

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli cuts, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: meat in
ingredients.raw: 3 c. meat, cut in small pieces

ingredients.name: onion powder
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. onion powder (1/4 c. cut up onions can be used)

steps: Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, meat and onion.
Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix Bisquick and 1 1/2 cups milk and pour evenly over soup mixture.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 450° oven.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with tossed salad and French bread for complete meal.

title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Add eggs and beat well. Add baking powder to flour.
Add alternately with milk to batter. Add vanilla and mix well.
Makes 3 or 4 layers.
Bake in 350° oven about 30 minutes.
Use favorite filling and icing.

title: Jewel Cookies

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. finely chopped walnuts or pecans

steps: In medium bowl with wooden spoon, beat butter, sugar, egg yolk and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in flour just until combined. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°.
Using hands, roll dough into balls 1-inch in diameter; dip in egg white, then roll in walnuts.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
With thimble or thumb, press center of each cookie.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until a delicate golden brown.
Remove to wire rack; cool.
Place 1/4 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie.

title: Curried Pears
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Use a small baking dish.
Peel, half and core pears.
Combine butter, brown sugar, curry powder and salt; mix with a spoon.
Cook 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Jake Kalberer'S Spinach Dip
steps: Put all ingredients together (except rye bread) in food processor or blender.
Hollow out bread; save extra bread for dipping.
Pour dip into hollowed out rye bread.

title: Cherry Pie Bars
steps: Mix margarine, sugar, vanilla and eggs.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Makes soft dough (sticky).
Spread 3/4 (plus) of dough on greased sheet cake pan, will seem thin (don't have bare spots).
Spread on pie cherries (get red everywhere).
Take a little at a time part of the 1/4 dough left; add flour and pat out real thin between hands.
Place patchy over cherries.
Looks real messy, cherries and red can show.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (when it starts to brown and is firm, just barely brown).

title: Apple-Pecan Caramel Salad

ingredients.name: dannon creme caramel light yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Dannon creme caramel light yogurt

steps: Combine apples and pecans in bowl.
Mix yogurt, light mayonnaise, sugar substitute and cinnamon together and pour mixture over apples.
Toss gently to coat.
Chill until ready to serve.
Serves 6.

title: Mrs. Lynch'S Old Country Cake

ingredients.name: raisin soaked in boiling water minute then
ingredients.raw: 1 c. raisins, soaked in boiling water for 1/2 minute, then drained

steps: Mix and sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening with 2 knives.
Add beaten eggs.
Stir in raisins and seed.
Add milk; stir.
Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan (or use cooking oil spray).
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 375°.
Can also use 3 small 6-inch round pans and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Olive Balls
steps: Blend cheese and margarine (room temperature).
Add flour and other ingredients.
Pinch off dough and form into balls around olives.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Quick And Hearty Soup
steps: In large saucepan, brown ground beef; drain off excess fat. Cut up tomatoes slightly.
Add beef, along with mixed vegetables, water, onion soup mix, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in macaroni, then lower heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Wiener Schnitzel
steps: Sprinkle veal with lemon juice, salt, pepper and grated cheese.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Then roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry on one side in hot butter.
Turn.
Reduce heat. Place cheese slice on each cutlet.
Slowly fry other side.
Serve with crisp salad.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: or chicken breast until tender
ingredients.raw: 3 or 4 chicken breasts, cooked until tender

ingredients.name: lettuce bite size
ingredients.raw: 2 heads lettuce, broken into bite size pieces

steps: When chicken is cool, break into small pieces.
Store each of the first 3 ingredients in a Ziploc bag until ready to use.
In a skillet, brown the sesame seed, almonds and ginger.
Store in Ziploc bag until ready to use.

title: Salisbury Steak
steps: In bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion.
Shape firmly into 6 oval patties.
In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot oil, cook patties until browned. Spoon off fat.
Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms.
Return patties to skillet.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning patties occasionally.

title: Gr. Aunt Frances' Celery Sauce
steps: Peel tomatoes and squeeze seeds out of them.
Mix all ingredients together and boil.
Seal while hot.

title: Corn Dog Twists
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Melt margarine in small saucepan over low heat or in microwave on High for 15 to 20 seconds.
Unroll dough into 1 long sheet.
Seal the short center perforation.
Separate into 8 long strips.
Wrap each strip around 1 hot dog.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Brush each corn dog twist with melted margarine.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 16 minutes or until dough is light brown.

title: Fudge Fruit And Cream Salad
steps: Mix
pudding and buttermilk.
Fold in
whipping
cream. Break up cookies and fold into salad.
Add oranges and pineapple. Chill.

title: Beer Nuts
steps: Boil on medium heat 25 to 30 minutes.
Stir once or more to keep from burning.
Boil until dry.
Heat oven 300°, grease jelly roll pan and spread nuts in pan.
Sprinkle coarse salt on nuts. Bake 20 minutes.
Stir and salt again.
Bake 20 minutes more.
Stir so won't stick.
Cool and store in container.

title: Cherry Charlies
steps: Boil cocoa, sugar, salt, milk and corn syrup on medium heat for 2 minutes.
Stir in other ingredients.
Shape into small balls and drop onto wax paper.
Ready to eat when cool.

title: Gloop(Gloop Can Be Pulled To And Fro For A Snap-And-Crackly Tug-Of-War!)

ingredients.name: borax powder
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. Borax powder (located in the detergent aisle in grocery stores)

steps: Pour the white glue into a clean, empty peanut butter jar. Add 1/2 cup of water and 10 drops of food coloring and stir. Combine the Borax and a cup of water in a medium size plastic bowl.
Slowly pour the glue mixture into the Borax solution and stir until well mixed.
The Borax causes the mixture to congeal. Scoop the gloop out of the water and knead it in your hands until it becomes dry enough to play with.
If stored in a sealed container or plastic bag, it should keep for several weeks.
Gloop dries out after a lot of handling.
