title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
steps: Mix altogether.
Bake 45 minutes at 350° in 8 to 9-inch greased square pan for very thick pieces or larger pan for more servings!

title: Cheerio Bars
steps: Put the first 3 ingredients in saucepan; cook over low heat until it comes to a full boil.
Stir in the peanut butter; stir until melted in.
Add rest of ingredients; stir until well coated. Press into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: Chocolate Creams

ingredients.name: light cream
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. light cream or half and half

steps: Melt chocolate with butter in saucepan over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth.
Blend in sugar, cream and vanilla.
Chill about 30 minutes.
Shape into 1/2-inch balls and roll in nuts.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Double Cheese Meat Loaf
steps: Combine hamburger, crumbs, onion, pepper, egg, Italian seasoning and 1/4 cup tomato sauce.
On a sheet of tinfoil, spread mixture into a 10 x 12-inch rectangle.
Sprinkle with cheeses and roll into a log.
Seal ends and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
At the end of the hour, pour remaining tomato sauce over meat loaf and bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
steps: For Cake:
Cream sugar and butter.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add soda to buttermilk.
Then stir into first mixture, alternately with flour and salt.
Add peaches and nuts.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool.

title: Good Rice
steps: Mix all together in casserole.
Place margarine on top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Lamb Chop Casserole
steps: Brown chops on both sides.
Place in greased casserole.
Pour drippings over meat.
Saute onion in butter until golden brown. Mix onion, potatoes, cucumbers, salt and pepper.
Spread over chops.
Add tomatoes.
Cover.
Bake at 400° for 2 hours.

title: Cool Vegetable Salad
steps: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces.
Put in large bowl.
Mix together and add dressing.
Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.
Stir and ready to serve.
Serves approximately 10 people.

title: Buttermilk Meat Loaf Ring
steps: Combine buttermilk, bread, onion, egg, salt and pepper.
Mix lightly, just until blended.
Pack firmly into buttered ring mold. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Allow to stand
for 5 minutes.
Drain off fat.
Turn out onto serving dish and drizzle catsup over meat loaf.

title: Sweet Potato Slaw
steps: Combine vegetables in a bowl. Toss gently. Combine remaining ingredients and stir well. Add to cabbage mixture. Toss well. Cover and chill.
Yields 6 servings.
Serving Size:
1/2 cup. Exchanges:
1 bread/starch.

title: Refrigerated Cheese Torte
steps: Save 1/2 cup of this mixture for top.
Blend ingredients as for pie crust.
Grease 9 x 3-inch loose bottom torte pan and line sides and bottom with graham cracker crust.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool before freezing.

title: Seasoned Black-Eyed Peas

ingredients.name: black eyed pea soaked overnight
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. dried black-eyed peas, soaked overnight

ingredients.name: hot pepper pod
ingredients.raw: 2 hot pepper pods or 1 tsp. crushed red pepper

steps: Drain peas (if desired, instead of soaking, cover peas with water and bring to boil then let stand 1 hour).
Combine peas, water, bouillon, onion, pepper, garlic, thyme, vegetable oil and salt in Dutch oven or large saucepan.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and cover.
Simmer gently for 1 hour or until tender.
Add additional water if pea mixture becomes too thick.
Serves 8.

title: French Dressing
steps: Mix well.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
steps: Combine sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and milk in saucepan.
Heat until smooth and very warm.
Stir in margarine, vanilla and egg yolks.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 425°, turn heat to 350° and bake 10 more minutes.
Prepare Never Fail Meringue while pie bakes.

title: Brunch Souffle
steps: In a large casserole greased with margarine, break up bread. Grate Cheddar cheese and mix with bread.
In a blender, mix quickly eggs and milk.
Pour over bread and cheese mixture.
Cover with foil and let sit in fridge overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour; 35 to 40 minutes covered, 20 to 25 minutes uncovered.

title: Crisp Marshmallow Bars

ingredients.name: malt o meal crispy rice cereal

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, melt butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring occasionally until marshmallows are melted.
Remove from heat; blend in vanilla.
In a large bowl, add mixture to cereal.
Stir to coat.
Spread into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely.
Cut into bars.

title: Beefy Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Combine cornmeal mix, eggs, buttermilk and corn. Saute ground beef; add onion and cook until onion is transparent, then drain. Pour 1/2 of the cornbread mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased liberally. Crumble ground beef over cornbread mix and sprinkle cheese over this. Top with peppers, then rest of the cornbread mix.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Pickle And Onion Salad
steps: Cut into chunks the onions and pickles.
Mix with mayonnaise to make sauce.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with fried fish.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmesiana

ingredients.name: size eggplant and very
ingredients.raw: 5 medium size eggplants, washed and sliced into very thin pieces

steps: Dip each slice of eggplant into well beaten egg and into seasoned bread crumbs.
Fry breaded eggplant slices in medium to hot oil in frying pan, 2 minutes on each side.
Drain cooked eggplant slices on paper towels.
Layer in glass baking dish some of your favorite tomato sauce, then all of the cooked eggplant. Top with more sauce and finish by topping with some grated Mozzarella cheese and dried oregano.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. potatoes, cut into large chunks

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In a large plastic food bag or bowl, combine all ingredients.
Toss until potatoes are coated evenly. Place into shallow baking or roasting pan.
Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Per serving:
174 calories, 9 grams fat.

title: Chocolate Boiled Cookies
steps: Cook sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa over medium heat until it comes to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add nuts, oats, peanut butter and vanilla.
Beat until well blended.
Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Rye Snacks

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained

steps: In a bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients.
Spread on bread slices and place on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until bubbly.
Yields 4 dozen.

title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: sirloin steak in bite size
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. sirloin steak, cut in bite size pieces

steps: In a small bowl, mix beef broth with cornstarch and teriyaki sauce; set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat; add mushrooms, green pepper and onions.
Stir-fry until tender.
Remove to bowl.
Add remaining oil and beef; stir-fry until cooked.
Add beef broth mixture and cook, stirring constantly until thickened.
Add vegetables.
Serve in warm pastry shells.

title: Meringue Cake
steps: Sift flour and baking powder.
Mix in order given.
Pour into 2 layer cake pans.

title: Biscotti
steps: Mix all ingredients together and knead.
Bake at 350° until firm.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Slice and rebake on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
steps: Boil syrup and sugar together for two minutes.
Pour slowly over eggs and stir well.
Add margarine, vanilla and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375 degrees for 50 minutes.

title: Burrito Casserole
steps: Brown meat in skillet.
Drain.
Add can of beans and taco seasoning.
Stuff tortillas and place in casserole dish.
Mix chili and picante sauce in separate bowl.
Pour over tortillas. Top with cheese and bake at 375° until bubbly.

title: Yum Yum Salad

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. lemon or lime Jell-O

steps: Boil pineapple and sugar together.
Add Jell-O; when dissolved, add cup water.
Refrigerate until almost jelled; add cheese, Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Cocoa Fudge Icing
steps: Combine all except vanilla in pot.
Slowly bring to a boil. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring constantly.
Take from heat; add vanilla and beat until spreading consistency.
Ready to frost 2 or 3 layer cake.
(I usually use Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix for layers.)

title: Italian Supper Casserole
steps: Cook the lasagna noodles according to directions.
Drain rinse and separate.
brown the beef and sprinkle the mix over the meat.
Add tomatoes and blend well.
Whip the cream cheese. In a buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole.
Make 2 layers each of noodles, meat & dollops of cream cheese. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chinese Goulash

ingredients.name: celery in diagonal
ingredients.raw: 1 c. celery, cut in thick diagonal slices

ingredients.name: bean sprouts and
ingredients.raw: 1 can bean sprouts, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: mushroom soup and/or can cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can mushroom soup and/or 1 can cream of chicken soup (no water)

steps: Brown beef; drain fat.
Add onion and celery and continue cooking until tender, but not soft.
Add bean sprouts and soup. Heat thoroughly.
Add canned mushrooms if desired.
Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Satsuma Salad

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded fresh coconut (frozen or packaged is okay)

steps: Peel the satsumas and cut crosswise into slices.
Sprinkle powdered sugar over satsuma slices.
Drain pineapple.
Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator overnight (or at least 3 to 4 hours).
To serve, spoon mixture onto lettuce leaves.

title: Rigatoni Casserole
steps: Cook noodles.
Cook spaghetti sauce.
Add mix and water.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Layer all ingredients in a casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cookie Sheet Cake
steps: Remove from heat.
Add 1 box powdered sugar.
Beat.
Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts and 2 teaspoons vanilla.
Spread on cake as soon as it is taken from the oven.

title: James Earl Jones' Chilean Sea Bass

ingredients.name: chilean sea bass wide
ingredients.raw: 12 pieces Chilean sea bass, 2-inches wide, 2 1/2-inches long

ingredients.name: roma tomato
ingredients.raw: 12 seeded, chopped Roma tomatoes or the canned, drained or canned equivalent

steps: Slice and cook onions in a skillet on low heat until caramelized (between 1 and 2 hours).

Puree all ingredients except olive oil and chicken broth. Heat olive oil. Add ingredients and cook on low for 30 minutes. Add chicken broth as necessary. Season bass with salt and white pepper to taste.
Cover bass with onions and bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Each of 6 servings should include one piece of bass over about 1/6 of the sauce.

title: Smoky Salmon Appetizer Ball

ingredients.name: salmon
ingredients.raw: 2 (6 1/2 oz.) cans skinless, boneless salmon, drained

steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl.
Place mixture on plastic wrap and form into a ball.
Cover and chill overnight.
Several hours before serving, roll in chopped nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
steps: Bake at 300° for 55 minutes.
Do not bake crust before pouring in the ingredients.

title: Best Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: oatmeal
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. oatmeal or crumbled soda crackers

steps: Mix all together by hand until all ingredients are combined. Put in dish and put in oven at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with ketchup. Cook uncovered.

title: Orange Molded Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add sherbet and place in refrigerator until partly set (watch carefully).
Add other ingredients and fold in Cool Whip last.
Chill and enjoy.

title: Aunt Beta'S Beer Bread
steps: Blend beer, egg and sugar, then add flour.
Put it in a bread pan and cover with towel.
It rises in an hour or so.
Bake at 350° for an hour.
Cool and slice bread.
Spread real butter on top.
Mmmm!
Good!

title: Broccoli Au Gratin

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Combine ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Onion Pie

ingredients.name: each salt pepper and sugar
ingredients.raw: dash of each: salt, pepper and sugar

steps: Saute onions until clear.
Pour onions into a prepared pie shell.
Add grated cheese.
Beat eggs; add milk and pour over cheese.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Artichoke And Spinach Casserole

ingredients.name: artichoke heart and up
ingredients.raw: 1 can artichoke hearts (not marinated), drained and cut up

steps: Cook spinach.
Saute onion in butter.
Mix spinach, onion, artichoke hearts, sour cream and 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese in a casserole dish.
Add pepper and toss well.
Put remaining 1/4 cup cheese on top.
Bake, covered, at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Cabbage
steps: Brown onions.
Remove from pan.
Place 1/3 cabbage in pan followed by 1/2 of bell pepper, one tomato and half the browned onion.
Layer with another 1/3 of cabbage and remaining bell pepper, tomato and onions.
Sprinkle remaining cabbage on top and add salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce

ingredients.name: tomato pulp
ingredients.raw: 4 c. tomato pulp or 1 (28 oz.) can crushed tomatoes

steps: Saute onion in oil until limp.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes.
Add cooked meat, if desired.

title: Meatballs With Gravy
steps: Mix well the first 6 ingredients; shape into balls.
Brown in the shortening.
Mix the soup with water; pour over meatballs. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Coleslaw

ingredients.name: liquid red pepper seasoning
ingredients.raw: liquid red pepper seasoning to taste

steps: Combine vinegar and sugar in small saucepan.
Cook over low heat just until sugar dissolves.
Stir in barbecue sauce, water, mayonnaise, mustard powder and red pepper seasoning.
Combine cabbage and carrots in large bowl.
Pour dressing over; toss to combine.

title: Papa Nick'S Dill Pickles
steps: Bring water, vinegar and salt to boil; let stand 20 minutes. When cool, pour over cukes and green tomatoes, prepared according to preference.
Small tomatoes and cucumbers can be left whole, if desired, and larger vegetables can be cut into chunks.
Cucumbers may be sliced open lengthwise and cut into quarters or eighths. Put vegetables in quart jars; to each jar, add 2 sprigs dill and 2 large garlic cloves, depending on taste.

title: Easy Pecan Rolls
steps: Butter pan.
Cover pan with frozen bread dough, then add pudding mix, brown sugar, cinnamon, pecans and butter.
Cover; let sit out on counter overnight.
Cook at 350° for 15 minutes uncovered, then 15 minutes covered.

title: Apple Snack
steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
Place apples in a single layer in a large, flat baking pan. Bake 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, and stir in popcorn and pecans. Mix remaining ingredients in a cup and drizzle over apples, popcorn, and pecans. Return to oven, and bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Choc' Gravy
steps: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick.
Serve over buttered toast or biscuits.

title: Joe'S Cheesecake
steps: Combine ingredients, except sour cream.
Beat until smooth, blending in sour cream.
Pour into graham or nut crust, trim with reserved crumbs.
Bake in moderate (375°) oven for 35 minutes or until just set.
Let cool with oven door open.
Do not overheat or cool too rapidly.
Chill well.

title: Peach Cobbler Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix (not pudding type)

steps: Pour undrained peaches in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle Jell-O over peaches.
Sprinkle cake mix on top.
Poke holes in cake mix and pour 1 1/2 cups water over all.
Dot with 1 1/4 sticks butter and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Linda'S Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix jell-O with hot water.
Add pineapple with the juice and the pie filling; mix well.
Place in a 13 x 9 casserole dish.
Let congeal in refrigerator.
In a small bowl mix cream cheese, sour cream and sugar.
Pour this mixture over congealed salad.

title: Pina Colada Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients and freeze in a covered container.
When ready to serve, let defrost to a slushy consistency.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sugar (half white and half brown)

steps: Brown ground beef with onions; drain grease.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cup Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Press flat.
Bake at 325° for approximately eight minutes. Watch carefully for these goodies burn easily.

title: Pa'S Fruit Bread
steps: Mix sugar, cooking oil and eggs.
Add fruit and nuts; mix well.
Stir in flour; mix well.
Pour in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Dessert Pizza

ingredients.name: and bake sugar cookie dough
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) slice and bake sugar cookie dough (frozen)

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 4 c. thinly sliced fruit (strawberries, kiwi, raspberries)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Arrange cut cookie dough (1/8 to 1/4-inch) rounds in slightly overlapping pattern on pizza pan. Press dough together to seal.
Bake until puffed and golden, about 10 minutes.
Cool completely.

title: Sugar Pie
steps: Mix the flour with the sugar.
Add the milk.
Mix and pour into 1 pie crust and cover with the second crust.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Lower the heat to 300 degrees, and bake for approximately 15 minutes longer.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into small pieces

steps: Cook cauliflower in saltwater 10 to 15 minutes; drain.
In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender.
Blend in flour.
Add chicken broth, milk and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook until slightly thickened.
Add cauliflower.
Bring to boil; add cheese.
Sprinkle chives over each serving.

title: Billy Faye'S Chip Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Heat on low until melted and fairly smooth.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Scott'S Sour Cream Biscuits
steps: Mix all
ingredients and spoon in miniature muffin pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Burgundy Ice Cream

ingredients.name: dark sweet cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 large can dark sweet pitted cherries, drained (save juice)

steps: In saucepan, dissolve jello in 1/2 cup boiling water and juice from the cherries.
Cool slightly.
In mixing bowl, beat eggs well.
Add sugar; beat well.
Blend in the half and half.
Cut cherries into fourths and add to mixture; stir in vanilla and jello mixture last.
Pour into freezer canister.
Add milk until about 3/4 full.
An electric freezer takes about 15 minutes to freeze.

title: Whipped Cream Supreme
steps: Melt butter.
Stir in flour and nuts.
Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool.

title: Strawberry Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour melted butter into a shallow, 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
In a large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar and milk.
Pour mixture evenly over butter.
Combine strawberries, remaining 1/2 cup sugar and water in a separate bowl, then spoon evenly over the flour/milk layer.
Do not stir. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tarheel Pie

ingredients.name: dish pie shell unbaked
ingredients.raw: Large deep dish pie shell, unbaked

steps: Melt margarine; pour over chocolate chips until dissolved. Combine eggs, sugar, vanilla, and nuts.
Mix with chocolate mixture.
Place in deep dish pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Sparkling Punch
steps: Dissolve gelatin in water.
Stir in lemonade.
Add ginger ale and ice.
Serve.
Makes 1 gallon.

title: Mushroom-Cheese Souffle("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 or 4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained

steps: Start heating oven to 300°.
With hand beater, beat egg yolks until light and foamy.
Stir milk gradually into flour.
Add to egg yolks and beat well.
Add salt, pepper and cheese and beat until blended.
Gently fold in onion, mushrooms and egg whites, stiffly beaten.
Turn into greased 1-quart casserole.
Bake about 50 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Makes 2 servings.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
steps: Melt the butter in saucepan. Stir in the brown sugar. Cook 2 minutes on low heat, stirring constantly. Add the milk, stirring until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from stove.
Stir in the confectioners sugar gradually. Add the vanilla and mix well. Spread immediately on cake.
Frost 1 pound cake or 2 layers.

title: Sin Cake
steps: Mix flour, melted oleo and nuts.
Spread in pan; bake approximately 20 minutes at 350° or until light brown.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and 1/2 cup Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Mix pudding and milk until thick; spread over 2nd layer.
Spread cherry pie filling over all.
Cover with the balance of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Tuna Dip
steps: Drain tuna.
Mix with cream cheese until smooth.
Add seasoning.
Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Mexican Bites
steps: Blend all ingredients, except muffins.
Toast muffins until half dark.
Top with mixture and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cut into 4 pieces.

title: Helen'S Sugar Cookies

ingredients.name: lemon flavoring
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. lemon flavoring or 1 tsp. vanilla

steps: Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and flavorings thoroughly.
Measure flour and sift.
Stir flour, baking powder and salt together. Blend well and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat oven to 400°.
Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a lightly floured board.
Cut with a 3-inch cookie cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Parslied Ham And Swiss Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Blend the first 4 ingredients and spread on sandwich buns. Fill with ham and cheese slices.
Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Quick Veggie Soup

ingredients.name: italian style stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 2 (14 1/2 oz.) cans Italian style stewed tomatoes

ingredients.name: or c. uncooked egg noodle
ingredients.raw: 1/2 or 1 c. uncooked medium egg noodles

steps: In large pot, brown meat and onion.
Cook until onion is tender.
Drain; salt and pepper to taste.
Put in remaining ingredients; stir.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, or until noodles are tender.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Three Cheese Cheese Ball
steps: Let cheese soften at room temperature.
Combine all ingredients with hands and form a ball.

title: Chicken And Corn Soup
steps: Bone chicken and discard skin.
Mince the chicken and combine with 1 teaspoon cornstarch and the egg whites, beaten until frothy.
Bring chicken broth to a boil.
Dissolve remaining cornstarch in water and add gradually to broth.
Add chicken mixture, corn, sherry and soy sauce and simmer a few minutes. Serve garnished with ham (boiled, baked or most flavorful and closest to the Chinese, Smithfield ham).
Serves 4.

title: No-Bake Holiday Cookies
steps: Finely grind the first 3 ingredients.
Add sugar and whiskey and form into small balls. Roll in colored sugar.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Special Scalloped Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato slightly thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, slightly thawed

steps: Put first 5 ingredients in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle casserole with paprika and parsley flakes.
Bake in a preheated oven at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Berry Rich Shake

ingredients.name: liquid nondairy cream
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. liquid nondairy creamer (i.e. Coffee Rich)

steps: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend.
Pour into a glass.

title: Picante Sauce

ingredients.name: salt pepper and garlic salt
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste

steps: Mix well.
Can be mixed in blender, but don't process too much or it will be too runny.
Makes 5 cups.

title: Delicious Peach Pie

ingredients.name: chilled margarine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chilled margarine, cut into 6 pieces

steps: Beat egg white until foamy.
Brush over the bottom and sides of pastry.
In a small bowl combine flour and sugars.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Sprinkle 2/3 into bottom of pastry.
Top with peaches.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.

title: Brownies From Scratch
steps: Mix with electric mixer, margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla, cocoa and flour.
Blend all together.

title: Sweet French Dressing
steps: Mix sugar and oil in the blender until well blended.
Add the next 3 ingredients and blend.
Add catsup; blend.
You may use more catsup for the taste you desire.
Refrigerate.

title: Milkless Potato Soup

ingredients.name: celery parsley onion juice and thyme
ingredients.raw: celery, parsley, onion juice and thyme

steps: Boil the potatoes and process them through a colander, then mash them thoroughly.
Add 6 cups of water.
Brown the flour in the butter and add the potatoes and water with the chopped celery, parsley, thyme, salt and white pepper.
Beat in two egg yolks just before serving.
You will never miss the cow.

title: Toad-In-A-Hole
steps: Melt a bit of butter in skillet.
Using the rim of a glass, press the center out of the slice of bread.
Reserve center circle. Put slice of bread in pan.
Crack egg into center hole of bread. Turn when egg is set.
Cook over low heat until egg is done. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with bread hole covering egg center (Toad)!

title: Easy Day Lasagne

ingredients.name: spaghetti sauce with mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 large jar spaghetti sauce with mushrooms

steps: Cook noodles; drain.
Brown hamburger and Italian sausage together; drain.
Put together cottage cheese and Ricotta cheese in bowl.
Put spaghetti sauce in bowl and add meat mixture after browning.
Stir both cheese and meat mixtures good.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Kiss Cookies
steps: Cream the butter, sugars, peanut butter, egg and vanilla. Sift flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture.
Form into balls.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Place in oven for 8 minutes. Put chocolate kisses on top.
Push them down on the cookie.
Put back in oven for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Marshmallow Marble-Top Fudge

ingredients.name: hershey s semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 3 c. (1 1/2 pkg.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

steps: Line an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil and set aside.
In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter with sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Remove from heat and stir in nuts.
Spread evenly into prepared pan.

title: Green Tomato Relish

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 6 red or green peppers, finely diced

steps: Mix vegetables.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Cook in kettle for 30 minutes vegetables and vinegar mixture.
Pour in jars and seal.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake

ingredients.name: roll refrigerator chocolate chip cookie dough
ingredients.raw: 2 rolls refrigerator chocolate chip cookie dough

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, beat together the cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla until well blended; set aside.
Slice cookie dough rolls into 1/3-inch slices.
Arrange slices from 1 roll over bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Press together so no holes are left in dough.
Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly over dough; top with remaining roll of dough, sliced.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown and center is slightly firm.
Cool, then refrigerate.
Cut into bars. May serve with chocolate sauce, fudge or Cool Whip.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Pie
steps: In a heavy pot, bring milk almost to a boil.
Remove from heat and sprinkle in nutmeg to taste.
Beat eggs and to them add sugar, vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Add hot milk to egg mixture.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust.
Bake in slow oven at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Dessert
steps: Combine all until crumbly.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Remove from oven and cool!

title: Magic Peach Cobbler

ingredients.name: or more peach
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. or more sliced peaches (either fresh or canned)

steps: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and milk together and pour on butter.
Do not stir.
Add peaches on top of this in layers.
Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons sugar.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Gingerbread
steps: Mix soda with sour milk and add to molasses.
Sift together flour, ginger and salt; combine 2 mixtures and add butter.
Bake in greased pan in moderate oven, 350°, for 25 minutes.

title: Koulourakia(Greek Butter Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream butter gradually beating in sugar. Beat eggs until light; add to butter mixture and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla extract.
Add lemon rinds.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
Carefully blend into butter-egg mixture to make soft dough.

title: Baked Chicken N' Noodles
steps: Blend soup and milk.
Add chicken, noodles, pimento and parsley.
Spoon into 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake in 350° oven 25 minutes.

title: Chicken With Bell Pepper
steps: Brown chicken (unfloured) in shortening until golden brown. Remove chicken from skillet and make gravy in small amount of shortening.
In same skillet return chicken and lay peppers and onions over gravy covered chicken.	Simmer for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Artichoke Nibbles

ingredients.name: salt pepper and oregano
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and oregano to taste

steps: Drain liquid from one jar of artichokes into pan.
Chop artichokes and set aside.
Add onion to liquid in pan and saute. (Add a little garlic salt.)
Beat eggs; add bread crumbs and seasonings.
Stir in cheese, parsley, artichokes and onion.
Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cut into 1-inch squares and serve hot or cold.

title: Delicious Zucchini And Yellow Squash
steps: Fry bacon; when almost crisp, add onion, squash, salt and pepper.
Cook until tender (about 10 minutes).
Remove from stove; add sour cream and serve.
Serves 6.

title: Red Rice

ingredients.name: shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, cooked and deveined

steps: Fry bacon until brown.
Remove from pan.
Chop onion and green pepper.
Saute onion and green pepper in grease.
Add tomato sauce.
Add one can of water.
Mash stewed tomatoes and add to mixture.
Break bacon into bits and add to mixture.
Add Tabasco sauce and salt to taste.
When mixture starts boiling, add shrimp and turn fire down low.
Stir constantly to keep from sticking. Cook until rice dries out.

title: Spanish Cream

ingredients.name: fruit put on after it is put on plate
ingredients.raw: fruit to put on after it is put on plate to serve (optional)

steps: In top of a double boiler, scald milk.
Slowly add gelatin and honey.
Pour a few tablespoonfuls over egg yolks, then add egg mixture to milk mixture in boiler.
Place over hot water and cook until thick and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add salt and vanilla, then fold in egg whites.
Pour into a large mold and chill.
The mixture will form 2 layers as it sets.

title: Dutch Pot Roast
steps: Dredge beef in flour and brown in Dutch oven.
Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly on low heat for about 3 hours. Thicken gravy if necessary.

title: Garlic-Mayonnaise Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until fork goes through, but not mashes.
Let cool.
Cut up into 1-inch squares.
Whip up mayonnaise, chopped onion, cilantro (use less if using fresh), garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Stir in potatoes and mix well to coat.
Maybe eaten cold or warm.

title: Fiesta Nacho Platter

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Combine beans, picante sauce and 1 cup cheese; stir over low heat until cheese is melted.
On serving platter, layer chips, bean mixture, lettuce, sour cream and tomatoes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
steps: Brown beef.
Add salt, pepper, onion, chili powder, rice, soup and water.
Cook gently for 2 or 3 minutes.
Put cabbage in casserole.
Pour meat mixture over cabbage.
Do not stir.
Bake, covered, for 2 hours at 350° or longer, if desired.

title: Rancher'S Sunday Chicken

ingredients.name: prepared hidden valley ranch original salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch Original salad dressing

steps: Wash and dry chicken pieces.
Dip into prepared salad dressing.
Spoon crumbs over the dressing to cover.
Place in foil lined pan.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika to taste. Bake uncovered at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Fresh Corn-On-The-Cob
steps: Remove husks from ears of corn; brush off silks.
Drop in kettle of boiling water to cover, adding 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon lemon juice to each quart of water.
Cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes, or until milk is set and corn is tender.
Cooking time depends on maturity of corn.
Remove from water and serve with butter, salt and ground black pepper.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Treats
steps: Melt chips and peanut butter.
Add chow mein noodles and marshmallows.
Mix together and spoon out on waxed paper.

title: Cream Of Cheese Soup
steps: Cook carrots and celery in boiling water until tender.
Cook onion in margarine until tender, but not brown.
Stir in flour. Add milk and chicken broth.
Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Makes 6 cups.

title: Nanna'S Chocolate Frosting
steps: Soften cheese (I use microwave) on Low.
Add chips and oleo until melted.
Let cool for a few minutes and then add sugar. This recipe can be cut in half, if you don't want as much frosting.
Mix until smooth.

title: Laurene'S Shortbread Cookies
steps: Mix margarine with sugar.
Add vanilla, salt and flour; mix well.
Add chips, nuts and shape into balls and press flat.
Bake at 325° until light brown (approximately 13 minutes).

title: Hash And Corn Bread
steps: Mix hash, onion and egg together.
Prepare muffin mix as directed on package.
Add salt and cheese.
Spread half the batter in greased 8-inch square or round baking dish.
Spread on hash mixture.
Top with remaining batter.
Bake at 400° for about 25 minutes until corn bread is golden brown.

title: Potato Candy
steps: First, mash potato, then add flour.
Next, add powdered sugar and mix until it makes a ball of dough.
Next, take a sheet of wax paper and spread with dough.
Then spread the peanut butter out on the dough.
Roll up like a burrito.
Chill for a couple of hours, then cut in little strips.

title: Chicken Vegetable Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: corkscrew pasta and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. corkscrew pasta, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: chicken that has been
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. cooked chicken, that has been cubed

ingredients.name: assorted
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 c. assorted cooked or raw vegetables (such as zucchini, bell peppers, green onions, cherry tomatoes, broccoli, etc.)

steps: Toss all ingredients in a bowl.
Chill until ready to serve.

title: Blueberry Yum Yum
steps: Mix crumbs and melted butter and press 3/4 of mixture into Pyrex dish.
Cream sugar and cream cheese together.
Mix milk, Dream Whip and vanilla until stiff and add to cheese mixture. Layer on top of crumbs the blueberry filling, then cheese mixture and sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs.

title: Bernie'S Meatballs
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Form meatballs and brown.

title: Pistachio Torte
steps: Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato partially thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, partially thawed

ingredients.name: montergomery jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Montergomery Jack cheese

steps: In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except 1/2 cup Colby cheese.
Mix well and turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Top with remaining cheese and bake 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apricot Mousse(Serves 8)
steps: Puree the apricots after they have been soaked and cooked according to the package directions; add the sugar and extract. Soak the gelatin in the cold water, add the hot milk and stir over hot water until gelatin is dissolved.
Add this to the puree. Whip the cream and fold it into the puree.
Spoon it into a wet 8-cup mold and chill it in the freezer for about 3 hours. This may be unmolded or served directly from the mold.

title: Baked Cranberry Dessert
steps: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl.
Add shortening and milk.
Blend other ingredients except cranberries.
Beat 2 minutes.
Stir in cranberries.
Bake in greased 9-inch square pan at 350° for 40 minutes or until tested done.
Serve with hot butter sauce.

title: Pear Honey
steps: Cook the pears and sugar until real thick, then add coconut and pineapple about 1/2 hour before you take it up.
Process in jars for long period of keeping.

title: Raspberry Cream Dip
steps: In small bowl, combine cream cheese, brown sugar, ginger and vinegar; blend until smooth.
Stir in raspberries.
Serve as a dip or dressing for fresh fruit.
Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Peach Pudding Dessert

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 2 c. peaches, drained (use two 16 oz. cans sliced cling peaches; reserve syrup)

steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water.
Add 2 cups reserved peach syrup (if not enough, add water until there is).
Put mixture in fridge to set a bit (about 1 1/2 hours).
Beat peaches with mixer until very mushy.
Beat the whipping cream, adding the powdered sugar.
Fold in the Jell-O mixture.
Stir very well.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and keep in fridge until set.

title: Apple Rings
steps: Peel and core apples, leaving them whole then slice into 1/2-inch slices.
Set aside.
Mix together the water, sugar, candies and food coloring in a saucepan.
Bring mixture to a boil. Drop in apple rings. Simmer until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from syrup.
Serve as an accompaniment to any type wild meat.

title: Dinner Party Chicken

ingredients.name: envelope good season italian salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add salad dressing mix.
Add chicken and brown slowly until golden.
Place contents of skillet in baking dish.
Blend soup (undiluted), cream cheese and wine until smooth.
Spread over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, 1 hour at 325°.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Krispies
steps: Mix all ingredients well with hands.
Roll into balls the size of a walnut.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork in a criss-cross pattern.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on a cake rack. Serve at room temperature.
They freeze very well.

title: Chicken Bologna
steps: Wipe off bologna and
leave
skins
on.
Cut
into 4 or 5-inch lengths.
Pack in jars lengthwise and add 1/2 cup water to each quart.
Cook 1 hour in hot water bath or 30 minutes at 10 pound pressure.

title: Pimento Cheese Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Cool until syrupy and beat in cheese spread and pineapple.
Let congeal to syrupy stage and fold in prepared dessert topping mix.
Refrigerate until set.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
steps: Put can of milk in icebox over night.
Add sugar and lemon juice to strawberries.
Beat until berries are a fine pulp.

title: Cappuccino Pie
steps: Mix liquids and coffee together with pudding mix and beat with hand.
Mix in Cool Whip and put in crust.
Freeze.
Remove and dollop extra Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with toasted almonds.
Serve semi-frozen.
Take out of freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spice Candied Nuts

ingredients.name: pet milk
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Pet milk (dilute with 2 Tbsp. water)

steps: Place first 3 ingredients in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture forms soft-ball stage; add vanilla, then coat nuts.
Turn out onto wax paper.
Allow to cool and then separate into pieces.
Place in candy dish.

title: Salmon Roll

ingredients.name: baked salmon flaked no bone
ingredients.raw: 2 c. baked salmon, flaked, no bones

ingredients.name: cream cheese regular
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. cream cheese, regular or lite

steps: Use king, silver or red salmon.
Stir all ingredients together.
Shape into roll, ball, log, or leave in bowl.
Chill for 3 hours.
Serve with crackers.

title: Butterscotch Delight
steps: Make crust from first 3 ingredients.
Mix and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Cool well.
Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
Spread on crust.
Mix pudding and milk, cook until thick.
Let cool; pour over cream cheese mixture.
Toast coconut, sprinkle over top and let chill.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
steps: Brown roast.
Put into crock-pot.
Add Lipton onion soup mix and mushroom soup with water and pour over roast.
Cook overnight on low.
Melts in your mouth!

title: Spooned Halva
steps: Melt butter in deep pan; add farina and cook until golden color, stirring constantly.
Stir in chopped nuts.
Reduce heat. Meanwhile, bring water and sugar to a slow boil.
Cook 3 minutes. Pour syrup slowly over farina, stirring with wooden spoon until halva is slightly thickened.
Remove from heat.
Cover; let stand 10 minutes.
Shape with individual molds or with spoon.
Place on large platters and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Beef Rounds
steps: Cut round steak into thin strips.
Cut onions into chunks. Wrap round steak around onion chunk, then wrap with a piece of bacon.
Secure with a toothpick.
Brown on all sides.
Make broth with bouillon cube and simmer for 1 hour.
Use tongs to pick up.

title: Rye Loaf Dip
steps: Shred beef and mix all ingredients.
Make the night before. Cut top out of loaf bread.
Dig bread out, leaving a 1-inch rim. Pour mixture in bowl.
Cut bread in dip sizes.
When all bread cubes are gone, then cut loaf in bite sizes.

title: Baked Spanish Rice(6 Servings)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 12-inch skillet, over medium heat, fry bacon crisp; drain on paper towels.
Crumble and set aside.

title: Company Carrots
steps: Place carrots in an ungreased 9 inch square baking dish. Add water and dot with butter.
Sprinkle with oregano and salt. Cover and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Welsh Rabbit

ingredients.name: american
ingredients.raw: 1 c. grated American or nippy spreading cheese

steps: Melt butter, add flour and blend.
Add milk and cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Add cheese and stir over low heat until melted.
Add seasonings.
Serve over hot toast or crackers.
Serves 6.

title: Bohemian Pot Roast

ingredients.name: beef chuck pot roast
ingredients.raw: 1 boneless beef chuck pot roast (2 to 3 lb.)

ingredients.name: tomato with liquid
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can tomatoes with liquid, chopped

steps: Combine flour and pepper; dredge pot roast.
In a Dutch oven, brown roast in oil.
Drain.
Add water, tomatoes, caraway seed, onion soup mix and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover tightly and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until roast is tender.
Remove to a warm platter.
Discard bay leaves.

title: Soup For Freezer
steps: Cook butter beans until tender.
Cook all for about 35 minutes. Cool.
Put in containers and freeze.

title: Pickled Eggs
steps: Bring beet juice, white vinegar and sugar to a boil.
Cool before adding beets and eggs.
Start eggs with cold water.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Turn stove off and let eggs set in water for 20 minutes.
Run cold water over eggs and peel.
Eggs will pickle overnight.

title: Hot Clam Dip

ingredients.name: french
ingredients.raw: 2 rounds French or pumpernickel bread, unsliced

steps: Cut top off one loaf of bread and scoop out soft bread.
Mix all remaining ingredients (except the other loaf of bread) and fill scooped out bread shell.
Replace top.
Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 3 hours.
Cut up second loaf of bread to use for dipping.

title: Audra'S Squash
steps: Top with bread crumbs over cheese.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Baked Carrots
steps: Cut up carrots and cook until almost done.
Melt butter with cheese.
Put carrots in baking dish (approximately 8 x 11-inch). Pour melted cheese and butter over carrots.
Crush the crackers and sprinkle over carrots.
Bake at 350°, approximately 15 to 20 minutes, until cheese bubbles.
Serve hot.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
steps: Melt butter.
Stir in graham cracker crumbs and sugar.
Pack in a pie shell and let cool for 10 minutes, then put in freezer for 30 minutes.
Now it is ready to fill.

title: Good Friday Rice
steps: Saute onions in butter until golden and limp.
Add rice and saute until golden.
Pour in cans of broth and mix well.
Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 350° for approximately 40 to 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed (microwave approximately 15 minutes).

title: No-Knead Dinner Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in 1 cup warm water.
Cream sugar and shortening together.
Add boiling water, mixing well, with mixer at medium speed.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Mix salt and flour together and add to the batter alternately with the yeast.
Cover and let rise in a warm place 1 hour.
Turn out on a floured surface and pat into a large rectangle.
Cut into rounds with a biscuit cutter or floured glass; dip both sides in melted butter and place in baking pans.
Cover and let rise an additional hour.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until nicely browned.
Makes about 48 rolls.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour, salt and sugar in a large bowl.
Add shortening and mix until crumbly.
In small bowl, beat together water, vinegar and egg.
Combine the 2 mixtures until all ingredients are moistened.
Divide dough into 5 portions and shape into flat, round patties ready for rolling.
Wrap each patty in plastic wrap and chill at least 1/2 hour.
When ready to roll, lightly flour both sides of patty and roll on lightly floured surface.
For shells, bake at 450°.
Will keep 3 days in refrigerator.
Makes 2 double and 1 single crust or 20 tart shells.

title: Hot Pepper Relish

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.raw: boiling water (just to cover peppers and onions)

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.raw: cold water (to cover peppers and onions)

steps: Chop peppers and onions.
Pour boiling water over peppers and onions, then drain.
Cover with cold water.
Bring to boiling point, then drain again.
Put vinegar, salt, sugar and mustard seed in another pan and bring to boil.
Add to peppers and onions and boil 1 minute.
Fill jars and seal.

title: One Step Lasagna

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. water or 1 c. water and 1/2 c. wine

steps: Combine 1 1/2 cups water with spaghetti sauce in bowl.
Cover bottom of sprayed 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of sauce.

title: Hamburger-Meat-Rice-Tomato Sauce Pie
steps: Combine ingredients; mix well.
Put into greased 9-inch pie plate.

title: Chocolate Chip Coffee Cake
steps: Beat egg.
Add 1/2 cup sugar gradually.
Stir margarine in lightly.
Alternately add pancake mix and milk-vanilla mixture. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan.
Sprinkle with mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and chips.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Zesty Sauerkraut
steps: Saute onion and pepper in butter.
Broil bacon and crumble. Rinse sauerkraut and place in baking dish.
Add the beer, molasses and mustard to onions, peppers and bacon.
Cook and stir for 3 minutes.
Pour over sauerkraut and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: California Blend Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients and top with onions.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Lucky Cake 1-2-3

ingredients.name: butter pecan instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. butter pecan instant pudding mix

steps: First Layer:
Mix first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
steps: Place lettuce in a 3-quart glass dish. Top lettuce with tomatoes (make layers). Next green pepper, red cabbage, water chestnuts, broccoli, red onion, cauliflower.
Just arrange it colorfully.
Use your favorite salad dressing.
Creamy Italian is great.

title: Tina'S Hot Crab Meat Dip

ingredients.name: or can crab meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. or 3 cans crab meat, drained

steps: Melt cream cheese in double boiler.
Add all ingredients except for crab. When smooth, fold in crab.
Serve hot (over sterno) with Pepperidge Farm pumpernickel and cheese cracker sticks.

title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms And Onions
steps: In a 3-quart lidded saucepan, bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add salt and the wild rice.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.
Add the converted rice, mushrooms and onion to the pot without stirring.
Cover and continue cooking another 5 minutes. Do not remove the lid.
Let the rice sit for 5 minutes after finishing the cooking.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Bourch
steps: Cook meat; cool and drain off fat.
Combine all other ingredients; add meat back to mixture and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Split Seconds
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and egg.
Blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Mix well. Divide dough int 4 equal parts.
On lightly floured surface, shape each part into 12 x 3/4-inch roll.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.

Using handle of wooden spoon or finger, make a depression about 1/2-inch wide and 1/4-inch deep lengthwise down center of each roll. Fill each roll with 2 tablespoons of jelly. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool slightly. Cut diagonally into bars.
Makes 4 dozen.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad Ring
steps: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Chill until partially set. Blend in mayonnaise.
Fold in celery, green pepper and cottage cheese.
Pour into a 4-cup ring mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold on lettuce.

title: Crevettes Scampi
steps: Shell and devein shrimp, leaving tail intact; arrange in single layer on bottom of broiler pan.
Preheat broiler.
In small saucepan, heat olive oil, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt and red pepper.
Pour over shrimp; toss to coat.
Broil 4 inches from source of heat for about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with lemon juice. Serves 6.

title: Hot Cheese And Crab Dip

ingredients.name: crab meat flaked and cartilage removed
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 1/2 oz.) can crab meat, flaked and cartilage removed

steps: Melt cheese and milk in medium saucepan or microwave, stirring to smooth consistency.
Stir in crabmeat and wine.
Heat through. Serve hot with crackers or party rye.

title: Surprise Sherbet
steps: Mix and put in ice cube tray.
Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Piccalilli
steps: Slice tomatoes and onions thin.
Mix with all other ingredients.
Boil until tender, about 20 minutes.
Pack into hot sterilized jars.
Seal.

title: Charlotte Russe
steps: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup milk.
Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and lemon colored; stir in gelatin and scalded milk.
Cook in top of a double boiler, stirring constantly, until thickened; cool. Stir in sherry and fold in whipped cream.
Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into custard.
Line a 3-quart bowl with ladyfingers; pour in filling and chill until set.
Yields about 12 servings.

title: Supreme Chicken

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

ingredients.name: mushroom and stem
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can mushroom pieces and stems (undrained)

steps: Bone and skin chicken.
Stir rice, chicken soup, broth and mushrooms together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with boned chicken and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400°.

title: Orange Cherry Cobbler
steps: Combine pie filling, water, sugar, lemon juice and butter in saucepan and heat until boiling.

Pour into an 8 1/4 x 1 3/4-inch round ovenware cake dish. Top hot cherry mixture with rolls, cut side up. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until rolls are done. Spread tops with the icing that comes in the Danish orange roll package. Good served warm.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Chop Suey
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and add next 4 ingredients.
Using a 9 x 9-inch pan, bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip.
Serves 9.

title: Blueberry Lush
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let cool about 15 minutes. Add blueberries with syrup and pineapple.
Let gel completely.

title: Mom'S Egg Noodles

ingredients.name: baking powder
ingredients.raw: 1/16 tsp. baking powder (I just take a pinch in my fingers)

steps: Beat eggs, salt and baking powder together good.
Then add flour to make a stiff dough.
Flour linen table cloth and sprinkle with flour.
Put dough on floured table cloth and knead until smooth.
Roll out on cloth and let dry.
When dry, fold in half, then in half again until a narrow roll.
Then slice to desired thickness.
Cook in roast or chicken broth.

title: Fresh Lemon Pie

ingredients.name: egg yolk
ingredients.raw: 2 egg yolks (save whites in bowl for later)

steps: Cook the sugar, cornstarch and the water until thickened. Beat the egg yolks, adding 1/4 cup sugar, then pour some of the hot mixture into egg mixture and back into cooking pan to thicken more.
Add the lemon juice.
When thick enough for pie crust, add 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla.

title: Butter-Nut Crunch

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces (1 c.)

steps: Butter a 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, salt, butter or margarine and water.
Cook until mixture reaches soft crack stage or 270° on a candy thermometer.
Stir in chopped walnuts.
Pour onto prepared cookie sheet.

title: Tea Sparkler
steps: In a large pitcher combine all ingredients except soda.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, add a splash of soda. Pour into ice filled glasses and garnish, if desired, with orange, lemon and lime slices.
Makes 5 servings.

title: Texas Barbecue Brisket(6 Pound Brisket)
steps: Sprinkle lean side of brisket with 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke. Rub in 1/2 teaspoon each of the salts.
Place lean side down in large pan.
Score fatty side.
Rub in rest of liquid smoke and salts.
Cover tightly.
Refrigerate overnight.
Before cooking, sprinkle each side with Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Place fatty side up in roasting pan.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 225° for 1 1/2 hours for each pound (9 hours for 6 pounds).
Last hour of cooking, uncover and pour over barbecue sauce.
Leave uncovered.

title: French Roll Pizzas(Snack Or Meal)

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) block Cheddar cheese or preferred cheese

ingredients.name: sourdough bread roll in half the longway
ingredients.raw: sourdough bread rolls, cut in half the longway

steps: Mix all ingredients together and let sit to blend.
Spread on sourdough bread halves.
Bake in oven at 325° until cheese is melted and bread is crispy.

title: Fancy Franks
steps: In a small skillet or saucepan, combine first 4 ingredients. Add cocktail franks and pineapple chunks.
Simmer together for 15 minutes.
Serve warm with cocktail picks.

title: Grilled Corn
steps: Strip husks down to the end of the cob, but do not tear off. Remove silk.
If desired, soak in salted ice water to which 1/2 cup milk has been added for about 20 minutes; drain well.
Brush with softened butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bring husks up around the corn.
Wrap each ear securely in a double thickness of aluminum foil.
Twist the ends well.
Barbecue on briquets 10 minutes, turning once.

title: Praline Cookies(Servings:  48)
steps: Put 1 layer whole graham crackers in jelly roll pan (approximately 24).
Boil and stir sugar and margarine for 2 minutes.
Stir in pecans.
Pour over crackers.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool in pan for 2 minutes.
Finish cooling on rack and break into halves.

title: El Paso Burgers
steps: Place meat in a large bowl.
Add onion, green pepper and taco mix.
Combine thoroughly.
Shape into 8 burgers.
Place onto a well-greased oven broiling pan.
Spread salsa on top.
Bake at 400° until done.
Place 1 slice of cheese on each burger and return to oven just long enough for it to melt.
Serve on bun.

title: Jello Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Drain pineapple and reserve juice.
Add pineapple juice, lemon juice and sugar to jello. Stir.
Chill until thick, but not firm.
Fold in crushed pineapple and cottage cheese.
Pour into bowl and chill until set.
Unmold onto lettuce.
Dot with mayonnaise.

title: Souped Up Chicken Soup

ingredients.name: chicken breast boiled and boned
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, boiled and boned

steps: Save broth from boiled chicken.
Add carrots, potatoes, macaroni and onions to broth; cook until tender.
You may need to add more water if too thick.
Add chicken, tomatoes and spices. Cook 15 to 20 minutes and serve.

title: Real Key Lime Pie
steps: Cut off the ends of the lime.
Grind up fine and squeeze juice from pulp and use.

title: Holiday Pecans
steps: Melt oleo in large pan.
Mix next 3 ingredients. Stir in pecans, then spread in glass dish.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Turn onto paper towel and sprinkle with salt. Let season at least 1 day before serving.

title: Congealed Blueberry Salad

ingredients.name: concord grape jello
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. Concord grape jello (black raspberry may be used)

steps: Mix
jello in boiling water;
add blueberry pie filling and pineapple.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Creamed Tuna On Patty Shells

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 small can mushrooms, drained or fresh ones

steps: Melt margarine; add flour and pour in milk slowly until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and whisk in cream and egg yolk.
Add tuna, mushrooms and peas and serve over patty shells. Garnish top with parsley.

title: Onion Cornbread
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Saute onion in margarine.
Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and pour into greased pie plate.
Spread onion over top.
Mix sour cream and cheese together; spread over top.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Scott'S Potato Salad
steps: Peel and slice boiled potatoes.
Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and allow to sit 1 hour.
Pour off excess dressing and add eggs, onion and spices.
Add mayonnaise until desired consistency is obtained.
Serve immediately or chilled.

title: Potatoes Baked In Cheese Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add flour and stir until smooth. Add catsup, paprika and salt.
Add milk gradually; then add grated cheese.
Cut raw or cooked potatoes in thin slices.
Place alternate layer of potatoes and pepper in a baking dish.
Cover with sauce and repeat until all is used.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Holiday Apple Cider
steps: Bring the apple cider, cloves, allspice, cinnamon and sugar to a boil.
Lower heat.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Strain punch and pour into heatproof bowl. Add orange slices.
Makes 16 cups.

title: Bonnie'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream
butter
and
sugar.
Add
flour alternately with eggs. Bake in loaf pans at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Stromboli

ingredients.name: loaf bread dough
ingredients.raw: 2 loaves frozen bread dough (thaw the night before)

ingredients.name: mushroom onion and green pepper sauteed
ingredients.raw: mushrooms, onions and green peppers, sauteed

steps: Roll dough into an oblong shape.
Brush with olive oil and oregano.
Place filling in the center.
Fold long sides over and pinch to close.
Close ends by rolling once and pinching.
Grease pan with Pam. (Or for best results, eliminate Pam and bake on stoneware.)
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Pineapple Carrot Salad
steps: Heat the pineapple juice and water to boiling.
Stir in the lemon Jell-O until dissolved.
Cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, mix the cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Heat milk and add to cheese.
Mix until well blended.
Then add carrots, pineapple and vinegar; put the Jell-O mixture into the cheese and mix well.
Pour into container and chill.

title: Bread Dip
steps: Chop peppers, onion and ham.
Mix everything together.
Hollow out a round loaf of bread and put dip in loaf.
Use the insides to dip with.

title: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: skinned boned chicken breast half
ingredients.raw: 6 (4 oz.) skinned, boned chicken breast halves

steps: Combine breadcrumbs and rind, stirring well.
Combine lemon juice, mustard and lime juice; brush mixture over both sides of chicken.
Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture.
Place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray; sprinkle with any remaining breadcrumb mixture.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 15 minutes.
Turn chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes or until done.
Garnish with lemon slices, if desired.
Yield:
6 servings (167 calories and 12 percent fat per serving).

title: Spinach Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and well
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and well drained

steps: Mix together.
Heat tortillas as directed.
Spread evenly on tortillas and roll up.
Chill 3 hours before serving.
Slice into 1-inch pieces.

title: Maple Nut Bars
steps: Cream oleo until soft; add powdered sugar gradually and beat until creamy.
Add egg, maple syrup and soda.
Mix in flour.
Add nuts.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan.
(I had to use a pan much smaller than this size.)
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar.
I put maple icing and walnuts on mine on top.

title: Cocoa Mayo Cake
steps: Melt mayonnaise and sugar.
Add part of sifted flour and dry ingredients, then the water.
Mix well.
Add remaining flour and vanilla.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pop Cake
steps: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add soda.
While cake is still hot, poke holes in top with toothpicks.
Slowly allow gelatin mixture to seep through holes.
Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
steps: Slightly beat eggs with sugar, salt and vanilla.
Gradually add hot milk, to eggs; stir in rice.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and set dish in pan of hot water.
Bake in 325° oven until set, about 40 minutes.
Do not overbake.

title: Grape Pie
steps: Pop middle out of grape skins; save skins.
Put pulp (middles) in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Put hot pulp through colander or food mill to remove seeds.
Combine strained pulp with skins.
Add sugar, flour and salt.
Pour into unbaked crust.
Dot with margarine.
Add top crust with slits, lattice or circular cut outs on top of pie.
Bake at 425° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
steps: Have eggs, butter and milk at room temperature.
Combine sugar, a cup at a time, to the softened butter until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift flour four times and add to creamed mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, beating well after each.
Stir in milk and flavorings.
Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Ceilia'S Potato Salad
steps: Cook, peel and dice potatoes.
Add diced celery, onion, parsley and dill.
Add mayonnaise; mix.
Then add lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Tomato Juice
steps: Wash tomatoes.
Remove cores and chop.
Combine tomatoes, onions and celery and bring to a boil.
Continue cooking and stirring for 20 minutes.
Press through a food mill.
Heat almost until boiling.
Stir in other ingredients.
Adjust seasonings to taste.
Process in pints or quarts for 35 minutes.
Makes 6 quarts.

title: Play Dough Recipe
steps: Do not double or halve this recipe.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl.
Add only 1 cup of water to the dry ingredients.
Mix thoroughly with your fingers, adding more water if necessary to make the dough the consistency of pie crust. Remove the dough from the bowl and knead for 4 or 5 minutes on wax paper.
Store in tight container until used.

title: Hot Cheese Puffs
steps: Combine all ingredients, except bread; blend well.
Cut bread into 1 1/2-inch rounds; spread with cheese mixture.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Yield:
25 servings.

title: Rockport Red Sauce
steps: Mix well and chill.
May use more pepper sauce to taste.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake

ingredients.name: cream whipped
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pt. cream, whipped or medium size Cool Whip

steps: Roll wafers into crumbs; put 1/2 in Pyrex dish.
Cream butter and sugar; add 2 eggs.
Put on top of crumbs. Whip cream and fold in pineapple and nuts.
Pour over other.
Top with other half of vanilla wafer crumbs.
Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Cucumbers In The Cold
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients with water to cover.
Let stand overnight or 12 hours.
Rinse and drain.
Put into jars (glass) the rinsed and drained cucumber mixture.

title: French Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all together.
Pour into shell and bake for 35 minutes at 250°.

title: Shrimp Boats(Appetizer)
steps: Combine shrimp, eggs, celery salt, salt and pepper.
Combine mayonnaise with cream.
Fold into shrimp mixture.
Spread shrimp mixture between bread slices.
Cut into halves, diagonally. Fasten corners with wooden picks.
Place on cookie sheet; broil 4-inches from source of heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until bread is toasted.
Yield: 8 servings.

title: Celery Sauce
steps: Put tomatoes, onions and peppers through food chopper. Combine with other ingredients; cook over low heat until thick. This takes about all day.
Put in jars.

title: Ham And Onion Wrap-Ups
steps: Spread about 2 tablespoons of cream cheese onto each slice of ham.
Place trimmed green onion (approximately 4 inches long) on cream cheese.
Roll tightly.
This is a great party snack!

title: Ha'Penny Snacks
steps: Let butter and cheese come to room temperature and mix thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients and blend.
Shape into about 3 rolls, 1-inch in diameter.
Wrap in wax paper and chill. Slice rolls into slices 1/4-inch thick.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly browned on edges.
Keeps well in airtight container.
Yields 6 dozen.

title: Irish Creme

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: Blend all ingredients together in large container.
Put into bottles and store in refrigerator.
Gets stronger as it ages.
To serve, mix with half and half over ice.

title: Roasted Garlic Potatoes

ingredients.name: mazola no stick corn oil cooking spray
ingredients.raw: Mazola no stick corn oil cooking spray

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes (unpeeled), sliced 1/8 inch thick (about 1 lb.)

steps: Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray.
In small bowl combine corn oil and garlic.
Arrange potato slices on baking sheet.
Brush with corn oil mixture.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and pepper.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Cool Fruit Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix baking mix and 2 tablespoons sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly.
Press in bottom and up side of ungreased glass pie plate (10 x 1/2-inch).
Bake about 15 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and vanilla.
Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff.
Fold whipped cream and marshmallows into cream cheese mixture.
Spread over crust.
Refrigerate any remaining pie.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Corned Beef In Rolls
steps: Mix ingredients together and toss.
Fill 8 hot dog rolls with mixture.
Wrap each in foil and heat on cookie sheet for 20 minutes at 250°.
These are simple to make and may be wrapped in foil and frozen for later use.

title: Banana Energy Bars
steps: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg, salt and bananas.
Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuit
steps: Heat oven
to
Mix
Bisquick, milk and cheese to soft dough.
Drop
by spoonful onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Mix melted margarine and garlic powder and brush over biscuits while warm.

title: Pesto Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast with sugar in 1/4 cup water.
Let set for 5 minutes to proof.
In large bowl, mix 2 cups flour with yeast mixture together; add remaining water and flour as needed.
Mix by hand or electric mixer with dough hook.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Put in greased bowl to rise.
When doubled in size, punch down and divide into 2 balls.
Roll dough into rectangle (12 x 8).
Spread with pesto mixture, roll up and place on baking sheet that has been spread with corn meal.
Let rise again.
Bake at 375° until lightly browned and hollow sounding to touch.
Let cool and feast.

title: Bacon Cheddar Muffins
steps: Spray muffin pan with Pam.
In a large bowl, mix flour, cheese, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix egg, milk and oil.
Add to flour mixture.
Stir until moist.
Batter will be lumpy.
Fold in the crumbled bacon.
Fill the muffin cups even with the top.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden.
Serve warm.

title: Favorite Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease bottoms and sides of 12 medium muffin tins.
Beat egg; stir in milk and oil.
Mix in remaining ingredients just until flour is moistened.
Batter should be lumpy.
Fill muffin cups
2/3 full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
If using self-rising flour, omit baking powder and salt.

title: Apple Crisps
steps: Arrange apples in a buttered 8-inch square pan.
Combine oats, sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Cut butter into mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over apple slices.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
Yummy.

title: Batter For Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. cayenne pepper (only if you like spicy)

steps: Shake all ingredients in Ziploc bag.
Batter chicken and fry. Refrigerate leftover batter in Ziploc bag for future use.
This may remind you of the Colonel's chicken (just a little).

title: Glazed Raisin-Cinnamon Biscuits
steps: Mix all ingredients until dough forms, about 20 strokes.
Turn into a floured board. Shape into a ball and knead 10 times.
Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2 1/2-inch cutter.
Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Spread with Vanilla Glaze while warm (see Miscellaneous for Vanilla Glaze).

title: Best Ever Coleslaw
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
In saucepan, bring vinegar, sugar and seasonings to a boil.
Pour over cabbage mixture. Place in airtight bowl.
Will keep in refrigerator 3 weeks.

title: 7-Up Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple drain and save juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (13 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drain and save juice

steps: Drain pineapple and save juice.
Add water to make 1 cup liquid.
Heat to boiling and add jello to dissolve.
Cool.
Stir in 7-Up.
Refrigerate to partially set.
Mix in pineapple and cranberries.
Pour into dish to congeal.
Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread on top.
Sprinkle with pecan pieces.

title: Pecan Pie Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box yellow cake mix (set aside 2/3 c.)

steps: Mix together 1 egg, melted butter and yellow cake mix (except 2/3 cup).
Pat into a greased 13 x 9-inch oblong pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350° until brown.
Mix rest of ingredients.
Pour over baked crust.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Take out before completely firm.

title: Best Ever Soup

ingredients.name: lipton onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Lipton onion soup mix

steps: Brown meat and onion.
Add other ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring about every 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients, except cheese slices (batter will be thin).
Pour half of batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer cheese slices on batter, then pour remaining batter on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Herbed Cream Cheese For Bagels
steps: Combine cream cheese, whipping cream and garlic in work bowl of food processor or blender.
Process until smooth.
Stir in chives, thyme and pepper.
Refrigerate to blend flavors.
Allow to stand at room temperature about 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Sparkling Red Punch
steps: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups hot water.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water.
Combine all ingredients and freeze.
Thaw to slush stage.
Pour in ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Bootsie'S Spaghetti Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or celery soup

steps: Saute chopped onion in small amount of oil.
Add meat and cook until done.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add tomato soup, catsup and Worcestershire sauce.
Stir and simmer.
Boil spaghetti.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Boil chicken and pull off bone.
Chop chicken and layer in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour chicken broth over chicken.
Spread chicken soup (undiluted) over chicken and broth.
Melt margarine and combine with flour and milk.
Spread mixture on top of other layers and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Butter Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 12 (3-inch) muffin pan cups. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar together.
Beat in the eggs, salt and nutmeg.
Stir in the flour alternately with the milk until the mixture is just combined.
Fill the muffin cups full.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mama'S Pound Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients by hand until moist.
Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes.
Scrape sides of bowl and beat 5 more minutes.
Put in cold oven.
Do not preheat!
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms

ingredients.name: or larger jumbo shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1.5 lb. or larger jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each.
Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms.
Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out).
Add garlic, salt and pepper.
Stir and add shrimp.
Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes, until shrimp are done.
Stir occasionally.
Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
steps: Cook chicken 1/2 hour; skin and bone it.
Cook broccoli as directed.
Arrange broccoli in buttered 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch dish. Tear chicken in strips and place over broccoli. Mix soups with mayonnaise and spread over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese and then bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Dream Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat until fluffy.
Add vanilla and then stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nuts.
Mix until smooth.
Form small balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with a fork.
Bake in slow oven at 300° for 20 minutes or until light brown.
Makes about 75.

title: Old Fashioned Cheese Potatoes

ingredients.name: processed american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded processed American cheese

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: In saucepan melt butter.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Cook and stir until a thick paste forms.
Gradually add milk.
Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken.
Add cheese.
Cook and stir until melted.
Place potatoes in a greased 13 x 9-inch dish.
Pour sauce over and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Strudel
steps: In large bowl of electric mixer (or by hand), beat cheese and butter until smooth.
Gradually add flour mixed with salt and herbs.
When dough holds together, form into a ball, wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.

title: Carrot And Vegetable Stew

ingredients.name: carrot scraped and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, scraped and cut 1/2 thick

ingredients.name: tomato with liquid tomato up
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes with liquid, cut tomatoes up

steps: Put all ingredients in a large pot and start cooking at high heat, then reduce heat to medium-high heat when it begins to boil. Cook, covered, until carrots are tender, but not too soft.
Then serve over rice or plain.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
steps: Combine in crock-pot and cook for 5 to 6 hours.
As mixture thickens, add catsup, as needed.

title: Bride'S Pink Punch
steps: Mix jello with hot water.
Add Kool-Aid, sugar, water and juices.
Chill.
Just before serving, add chilled Sprite.
In punch bowl, pour punch over sherbet.

title: Bearnaise Sauce
steps: Put egg yolks with 1/3 of the butter in top of double boiler. Keep water in the bottom hot but not boiling.
Stir eggs and butter constantly until butter melts adding more butter a little at a time and stirring each time until it melts.
As soon as the mixture is thick remove from heat and stir in rest of ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Fried Cheese Balls
steps: Combine the cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper.
Using your hands, gently stir in egg whites.
Pat the mixture into small balls and roll them in cracker crumbs.
Heat oil in skillet.
When hot, put the balls in the pan without crowding them.
Cover over medium-high heat, turning so all sides become golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.

title: Easy Chicken In Wine

ingredients.name: or chicken breast in half
ingredients.raw: 3 or 4 whole chicken breasts, cut in halves

steps: Place chicken breasts in one layer in a shallow baking pan. Mix together all other ingredients.
Pour sauce over chicken. Cover with foil. Refrigerate. Spoon sauce over chicken a couple of times.

title: Easy Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° until done.

title: Grandma Leones' Caramel Frosting
steps: Put brown sugar, milk and butter in saucepan and simmer slowly for about 3 minutes and cool.
Add powdered sugar and stir until creamy.

title: Chocolate Animal Crackers
steps: Melt the chocolate bits and shortening in a saucepan over low heat.
Stir until smooth.
Dip animal crackers into chocolate and lift with a fork.
Place on waxed paper to harden.

title: Stu'S Fine Chili

ingredients.name: minimum good grade of ground beef
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. minimum good grade of ground beef

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 2 medium onions (more if more meat is used)

ingredients.name: per pound of chili mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. per pound of chili mix

ingredients.name: tomato per pound of meat
ingredients.raw: 1 can whole tomatoes per pound of meat

ingredients.name: kidney bean per pound of meat
ingredients.raw: 1 can kidney beans per pound of meat

steps: Fry ground beef with sliced onions; pour off excess oil (do not overcook).
Stir in chili mix.
Stir in tomatoes, chop or cut tomatoes before adding.
Add tomato paste (about 2/3 can).
Add jalapeno peppers (split into halves or quarters).
