Add kidney beans juice and all.
Add water to thin out (your choice as to density). Let simmer about 1 hour.

title: Bill'S Favorite Banana Pudding
steps: Mix pudding mix and milk.
Add Cool Whip.
Layer cookies, bananas, pudding and repeat.

title: White Bread(Quick Method)
steps: Scald milk.
Add sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and add to milk.
Add half of flour and beat until smooth.
Add melted shortening and remaining flour or enough to make easy handled dough.
Knead quickly and lightly until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in greased bowl, cover and set in a warm place.
Let rise until double in bulk, divide into 4 equal portions and shape into loaves.
Place in greased loaf pans. Bake in 425° oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes longer.

title: Walnut Broccoli
steps: Cook broccoli until barely tender.
Drain and put in casserole dish.
Melt the 1/2 cup butter and add the flour.
Remove from heat and add bouillon.
Gradually add milk.
Return to heat and cook until smooth and boiling.
Pour over broccoli.
Heat the 3/4 cup water and 6 tablespoons butter.
Add the stuffing and walnuts. Sprinkle over broccoli and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Italiano'S Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Simmer onion in oil.
Add tomatoes, paste, sauce and water; simmer.
Do not burn on bottom.
Simmer 1 hour or more.
Parboil sausages slowly to get some fat out, about 20 minutes.
Drain and add sausages to spaghetti sauce.
Heat for 30 minutes at a slow simmer.
Serve with spaghetti.

title: No-Mix Blackberry Cobbler
steps: Stir together berries and 1/2 cup sugar.
Melt margarine in casserole dish.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and rest of sugar. Add milk and mix well.
Pour batter into dish with margarine.
Do not mix.
Put berries and sugar over batter; do not mix.
Bake 50 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

title: Fried Scallops
steps: Combine half and half with Worcestershire powder.
Dip scallops in milk mixture and roll in bread crumbs.
Fry in hot oil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Mother'S Brownies
steps: Melt together the bitter chocolate with the stick of butter. Mix the eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and coffee.
Blend the mixture with the chocolate and butter.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts or marshmallow bits, M&M's or other small edible bits.
Bake about 20 minutes in a 350° oven in an 8 x 14-inch pan.
Test with toothpick for slight moistness.
Refrigerate immediately.
(This keeps them moist.)
Can be frozen.

title: Best Ever Brownies
steps: Cream 1 stick of butter and 1 cup of sugar.
Add eggs, flour, chocolate syrup and nuts; mix well.
Pour into greased and floured pan and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes.
Top with frosting when cool.

title: Budget Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple slightly
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained slightly

steps: Combine all ingredients in mixer and beat until mixed well, approximately 2 minutes.
Pour into two 9-inch cake pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Cool before icing with cream cheese frosting.

title: Strawberry Butter

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. unsalted butter or margarine (at room temperature)

steps: Cream butter until light and fluffy, then gradually add oil, beating continuously.
Beat in honey, strawberries and orange rind (if desired).
Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to one week.
Serve on toast, muffins, biscuits or other warm homemade breads.

title: Crab-Filled Buns

ingredients.name: or green olive
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped ripe or green olives

steps: Combine crab meat, olives, cheese and onion.
Add mixture of mayonnaise and lemon juice; add seasonings.
Fill buttered buns with mixture; wrap each in foil.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Jumblet Cookies

ingredients.name: soda in c. boiling water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. soda in 1/2 c. boiling water

steps: Grind dates with a little flour to keep from sticking; walnuts help, too.
Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten, last.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Snow Ice Cream
steps: Whip cream to soft peaks; add sugar.
Fold in half and half and vanilla.
Add snow and beat.
Cover and place in freezer.

title: Greek Roasted Chicken
steps: Place chicken on a rack in roasting pan.
Season with salt and pepper and 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano.
Arrange potatoes around chicken; sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano.
Pour butter and lemon juice over chicken and potatoes.
Add chicken broth to pan bottom.
Bake at 350° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Baste with juices while baking.

title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine sugar, cinnamon, allspice and ginger.
Add scalded milk slowly to eggs; mix well.
Add sugar-spice mixture and butter or margarine; stir until sugar dissolves.
Combine bread cubes and raisins in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Pour custard mixture over bread cubes. Place casserole in pan of water.
Bake 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Mocha Punch
steps: Heat 1 cup of the water to boiling; dissolve instant coffee in water.
Stir in remaining water, dry milk, sugar and salt. Refrigerate until chilled 3 to 4 hours.
Place softened ice cream in punch bowl.
Pour chilled coffee mixture on ice cream.
Swirl ice cream throughout coffee mixture.
Beat whipping cream in chilled mixing bowl until very soft peaks from.
Top chocolate mocha punch with mounds of whipped cream.
Sprinkle nutmeg over the mounds of whipped cream.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad No. 1
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Cover and freeze.
Serve frozen.
Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Heloise'S Fudge
steps: Mix sugar and milk in a large, heavy saucepan.
Slowly bring to rolling boil and boil for 8 minutes.
Then move the saucepan off the heat and add the butter, chocolate chips and marshmallows. Mix only until the chips and the marshmallows are melted.
Add the vanilla and nuts and blend.
Spread the mixture in a large ungreased pan and let it cool.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese
steps: Heat pineapple juice and lime jello.
Put pineapple, cottage cheese and marshmallows in big bowl.
Cool lime jello and pour over pineapple mixture.
Add whipped cream.
Sets quickly.

title: Nana'S Bean Soup
steps: Cook beans until mushy.
Dice potatoes, carrots and onions. Add salt, pepper and tomato soup.
Add small amount evaporated milk to thicken and cook until vegetables are cooked.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Apple Punch
steps: Combine juices and coriander in large pitcher or punch bowl. Just before serving add club soda and stir.
Garnish with orange slices and cranberries.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 2 large cans chunk pineapple, drained well

steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with finely crushed crackers and melted oleo.
Bake at 375° until cheese melts and mixture is bubbly.
Serve warm.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
steps: Lightly oil a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Stir together sugar, oil, margarine and eggs.
Mix in nuts and vanilla.
Stir together flour, baking soda and salt; add to sugar mixture.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake in 350° oven about 25 to 35 minutes (until browned and knife comes out clean).
Cut into 32 pieces.

title: German Chocolate Icing
steps: Cook on medium heat in saucepan until thick.
Pour on cake while hot, then place in oven broiler until brown, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Potato And Cabbage Slaw
steps: Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch cubes.
Cover with water; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Drain and cool.
Slice cabbage.
Toss potatoes, cabbage and remaining ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing(Great Christmas Gift!)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender.
Blend until creamy.
Refrigerate, covered.
Will keep for weeks. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Mother'S Lemon Pie
steps: Beat eggs well, but not to the creamy stage.
Add sugar; mix well.
Add grated rind and juice of lemons.
Mix well and last, add real cream; mix.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake until golden brown at 350°.

title: Praline Brownies

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: Prepare brownie mix according to directions, using 1 egg method.
Put in pan.
Mix other ingredients and sprinkle over top of brownie mix.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
steps: Brown onion and pepper in margarine.
Cook limas until tender; drain.
Add peppers, onions and celery soup.
Place in a greased casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Grandma Bella'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the butter, cheese and sugar until fluffy.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating 3 minutes for each egg.
Combine dry ingredients and beat in alternately with the milk and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan lined with waxed paper.
Bake for 1 hour.

title: Weight Watchers Apple Cake
steps: Beat eggs until fluffy; put bread in blender, then add apples. Fold in eggs.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Elephant Ears
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.
Add salt, sugar, water, shortening and egg.
Mix well.
Stir in flour, 1/2 cup at a time until smooth. Break off pieces the size of an egg.
Roll out 1/4 inch thick on floured surface.
Deep-fry in shortening.
When brown and crisp, remove and dust with sugar and cinnamon.
Recipe makes 20.

title: Stuffed Sea Shells

ingredients.name: stuffing macaroni sea shell
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. large stuffing macaroni sea shells

ingredients.name: spinach and well
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. spinach, cooked and drained well

steps: Cook macaroni shells until done.
Stuff with mixture of cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan, eggs, spinach, salt and pepper.
Cover with Prego sauce.
Cook at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cornflake Chewies
steps: Mix corn syrup and sugar in saucepan.
Bring to a full boil and then add peanut butter.
Remove from heat then add vanilla and cornflakes.
Stir well and drop by tablespoonful onto greased wax paper.

title: Miracle Pie Crust
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
In a cup, mix egg, vinegar and water.
Add to flour mixture.
Makes 5 to 7 crusts.
Can be frozen.

title: Chinese Beef And Peppers

ingredients.name: chuck in
ingredients.raw: 3/4 lb. boneless chuck, cut in thin slices

ingredients.name: green and/or red pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 c. green and/or red pepper strips

steps: Saute beef, onion and garlic in oil until meat browns.
Add rest of ingredients except rice; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice. Cover; let stand 5 minutes.

title: Butter Cookies

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. shortening (half butter and half margarine)

steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Mix dry ingredients; add to egg and sugar mixture.
Roll in balls and press with a fork.
Bake at 375° to 400° until lightly browned.

title: Cucumber And Green Onion Dip
steps: Wash and dry cucumber and onions.
Chop very fine.
For each package of cream cheese you use, add cucumber and green onions.

title: Sun-Drop Cake
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
Add flour and eggs; beat well.
Add flavorings; mix well.
Stir in Sun-Drop.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.
Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate.
Spread frosting over cake.
Yield:
16 servings.

title: Watergate Jello Salad
steps: In a large bowl, add pineapple (with juice) and pudding; mix well.
Add fruit cocktail and marshmallows.
Fold in Cool Whip. Put in a pretty glass bowl and top with coconut, chopped nuts and cherries.

title: Russian Pea Salad
steps: Thaw peas; add all other ingredients.
Chill overnight. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Bean Soup
steps: Sort and soak beans with a pinch of baking soda over night. Next day bring to a boil. Rinse and cover with water and add ham or bacon, onion, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer
1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Add water as needed during cooking time.

title: Squash Supreme

ingredients.name: yellow squash well then mashed
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cooked yellow squash, well drained, then mashed

steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients together.
Spray a loaf pan or dish with Pam.
Sprinkle a layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing on the bottom of the pan.
Add squash mixture, then cover with another layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing.
Dot the top of the casserole generously with butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Delight
steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes.
Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil.
Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce(This Is A "Mom" Original)
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt.
Add butter and milk.
Bring to a boil over medium to low heat; stir constantly.
When sauce thickens, remove from heat.
Cool 3 to 5 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.
Use over ice cream, cream puffs or eclairs.

title: Artichoke Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke heart in half
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) jar marinated artichoke hearts, cut in half

steps: Cook pasta as directed on the box.
Drain; rinse with cold water and put in a large bowl.
Add olives, artichoke hearts, celery, dressing and cheese.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss together.
Cover and let marinate in refrigerator overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cookie Kisses
steps: Beat the margarine, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix well.
Chill the dough.
Shape about 1 tablespoon of dough around each chocolate kiss.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 12 minutes.
The cookie should be set but not brown.
Cool slightly, then roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Beef And Biscuit Skillet

ingredients.name: sharp natural cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese

steps: In a 10-inch skillet, brown meat with onion; drain off fat. Stir in gravy and 1/2 cup water.
Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and frozen vegetables, breaking apart with fork.
Bring to boiling.
Cover; reduce heat.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Top with biscuits; simmer, covered, 15 minutes.
Sprinkle biscuits with cheese; heat until cheese melts.
Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.
Serves 4.

title: Gooey Cake

ingredients.name: cake mix dry
ingredients.raw: 1 cake mix dry (double butter or butter brickle, etc.)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease oblong pan.
Mix egg, butter and cake mix together.
Pat into pan.
Pat flat; do not leave raised edges.

title: Whipping Cream Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and stir until mixed well.
Add flour and stir until well blended.
Add flavoring.
Stir in whipping cream.
Bake in a Bundt pan at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Star Cookies
steps: Mix all together and put in icebox overnight.
When chilled, roll them and cut in star shape.
Bake at 350°.

title: Goblin Cookies

ingredients.name: drop of red and yellow food coloring
ingredients.raw: a few drops of red and yellow food coloring

steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together; stir in 1 cup of any dry cereal.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a piece of waxed paper.
Put a jelly bean in center of each and refrigerate until firm.
Makes 12 cookies.

title: Mushroom Soup

ingredients.name: family size can cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 family size can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Mix well.
Use more water if needed for thinning.
Serve over Swedish meatballs.

title: Cheese Fish Bake
steps: Arrange fish in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
Pour soup over fish.
Sprinkle with pepper, cheese and paprika.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until lightly browned.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake

ingredients.name: chocolate wafer
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. chocolate wafers or cracker crumbs (18)

steps: Press evenly into ungreased pan first 3 ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Beat cream cheese in 3-quart bowl.
Add sugar and cocoa gradually.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Pour in vanilla.
Pour into spring-form pan.
Bake at 300° until center is firm, about 1 hour.
Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.
Prepare topping.
Spread over cake; loosen sides and remove.

title: Potato Cheese Puffs

ingredients.name: american
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. shredded American or Cheddar cheese

steps: Combine all ingredients except for oil; mix well.
Pour about 2 inches of oil into frying pan; get oil hot but not smoking, or use Fry Daddy.
Drop batter by tablespoons, 4 to 5 at a time, into hot oil.
Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve immediately.
Makes about 24 puffs.

title: Salad Dressing For Green Vegetables
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Use as a dressing for vegetables.

title: Blueberry Trifle With Lemon Curd
steps: Combine the yolks, lemon juice and sugar in the top of a double boiler.
Cook over simmering water until sugar is dissolved.
Add butter; continue to simmer until mixture thickens. Pour in a clean bowl.
Chill.

title: Mimaw'S Butterscotch Squares
steps: In large saucepan, melt butter.
Remove from heat.
Add brown sugar and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Salad Dressing
steps: Cook all ingredients on low heat.
Stir constantly to prevent sticking until thickened.
Remove from stove.
Add lump of butter. Cool; ready for use.

title: Dean'S Perfect Divinity
steps: Bring to a boil and boil, covered, 2 minutes.
Uncover and cook to a soft ball stage.
While cooking, beat 2 egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
Pour the syrup over the beaten egg whites slowly.
Beat with electric mixer until thick, almost stands in peaks.
Quickly add 2 cups pecans and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla. Drop on wax paper.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

ingredients.name: seasoning salt and pepper garlic powder parsley
ingredients.raw: seasonings to taste: salt and pepper, garlic powder, parsley

steps: Mix ground beef, egg, seasonings and bread crumbs with 1/3 can of tomato sauce.
Add more sauce and/or breadcrumbs until mixture is moist and well mixed.
Place remaining tomato sauce in medium saucepan with sugar and lemon juice.
Mix and place over medium-high heat.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Burgers
steps: Brown hamburger; drain off fat.
Add pepperoni and pizza sauce.
Mix well and simmer 5 minutes.
Add cheese just before serving.
Spoon onto bun and enjoy.

title: Shrimp Pie

ingredients.name: egg blended with enough milk
ingredients.raw: 3 large eggs, blended with enough milk or cream to make 1 1/2 c. in all

steps: Saute the shrimp with the butter and seasonings for 1 minute. Add the vermouth and boil for 1/2 minute.
Strew shrimp in pie shell.
Make custard with eggs and milk or cream.
Pour in custard to within 1/8-inch of rim; sprinkle on cheese.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375° or until puffed and browned.

title: Lemon Pie(Old Family Recipe)
steps: Mix flour and sugar together.
Beat egg yolks.
Mix all together and cook over boiling water until thick.
Put in baked pie shell.

title: Blanche'S Peach (Cake) Cobbler

ingredients.name: duncan hine deluxe ii yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines Deluxe II yellow cake mix

steps: Pour peaches and juice into
an 11 x 14-inch pan, which has been greased.
Pour
dry
cake
mix
over
peaches.
Melt margarine and pour over mixture.
Bake
in 325° oven 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Banana Split Pudding

ingredients.name: pineapple reserve liquid
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 1/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained, reserve liquid

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: instant banana cream pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant banana cream pudding

ingredients.name: banana and dipped in lemon juice
ingredients.raw: 4 medium bananas, sliced and dipped in lemon juice

steps: To reserved pineapple liquid add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups.
In large bowl combine Eagle Brand milk.
Add pudding mix and beat well.
Add pineapple.
Chill 10 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon 1 1/2 cups pudding into 3 to 4-quart glass serving bowl.
Top with 1/3 each of chocolate wafers, banana and pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding.
Chill thoroughly.

title: Cream Cheese Pastry

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (can use low-fat)

steps: Cream first 4 ingredients together.
Butter or Pam spray 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer 1 package rolls, filling, 1 package rolls and cinnamon-sugar topping.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Granddad Bill'S T Cakes
steps: Mix all ingredients well and drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 300°.

title: Grammy'S Brownies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Beat well. Add melted chocolate.
Then add flour.
Pour into four 8-inch pans.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: One Bowl Holiday Fudge(Microwave)
steps: Microwave chocolate and milk in 1 1/2-quart microwavable bowl on High 2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute.
Stir until chocolate is completely melted and smooth.
Stir in vanilla, salt and nuts. Spread in greased 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.
Makes about 2 dozen pieces.

title: Old Fashioned Stickies
steps: Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Mix well.
Add milk.
Mix well.
Roll out thin. Spread softened margarine over dough.
Sprinkle sugar over margarine.
Roll up jelly roll fashion.
Slice into 1-inch pieces. Place in pan and cook at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage(Rodkaal)
steps: Melt fat in pan.
Add remaining ingredients in layers and cook until very tender.
If too dry, add water.
Garnish with apple slices.

title: Red Beans And Rice
steps: Saute onion, bell pepper and sausage in a large skillet.
Add beans and tomato sauce.
Cook on low, until it thickens, for about 45 minutes.
Serve with your favorite rice and cornbread, cooked according to package directions.

title: Banana Split Ice Cream
steps: Mix all ingredients except chocolate milk.
Add milk.
Pour into 4-quart ice cream freezer bucket and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.
Let harden 1 hour before serving. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Chuck Wagon Western Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: spaghetti in tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. can spaghetti in tomato sauce

steps: Combine meat, onion and pepper in skillet and brown; drain off grease.
Add other ingredients.
Put in a covered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
This is a delicious meal with bread and a salad!
So easy!

title: Brittany'S Favorite Pickles
steps: Peel and thinly slice cucumbers.
Slice onion into thin rings. Mix all ingredients.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Stir occasionally.

title: Seafood Etouffee
steps: Saute butter, onion and celery until wilted.
Add tomato sauce, soup and water.
Cook 20 minutes.
Add shrimp, crab meat and/or scallops.
Cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Yam Bake

ingredients.name: pineapple and juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice

steps: Take 1 large ball field, half a dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles.

Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field, stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles, sprinkle the field with flowers, spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun.
When brown, set away to cool in the bath tub.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruit
steps: Beat all above together at medium speed.
Constantly continue beating while gradually adding 1/4 cup salad oil.
Cover and chill.
If it becomes too thick, let stand at room temperature. Use over fresh fruit and walnuts.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler(Mrs. W. A. Broadway)
steps: Melt margarine in bottom of casserole dish.
Mix flour, sugar and milk.
Pour this mixture over margarine in dish and top with peaches.
Bake at 350° until brown.
You may substitute any fruit you wish to use and also add cinnamon or other spices.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip
steps: In a large bowl, mix garlic salt, green onion dip mix, Miracle Whip, seasoned salt, salt, pepper and milk.
Add cottage cheese. Stir.
Let set at least 12 hours.
Serve with chips of your choice.

title: Grandmother'S Cherry Cobbler

ingredients.name: cherry and save juice
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cherries (canned cherries), drained and save juice

steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and beating until smooth.
Pour batter into greased baking dish and put fruit on top.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top.
Pour on juice over all.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Bleu Cheese Dressing
steps: Combine sour cream, dry mustard, black pepper, salt, garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix at low speed for 2 minutes. Add mayonnaise and blend 1/2 minute at low speed, then 2 minutes at medium speed.
Add crumbled Bleu cheese and beat at low speed for 3 minutes.
Store in refrigerator for 24 hours before using.

title: Persimmon Pudding
steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan.
Mix pulp, eggs and sugar together; alternate milk and dry ingredients.
Pour melted margarine from pan into mixture.
Mix well.
Pour mixture into pan.
Bake 1 hour at 300° to 325°.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Three Fruit Punch
steps: Blend 3 fruits in blender.
Add ginger ale right before serving.

title: Fresh Peach Chiffon Pie

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. lemon juice (fresh, frozen and canned)

ingredients.name: heavy whipped cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. heavy whipped cream (can substitute skim evaporated, chilled until ice crystals form, then whip)

steps: Add sugar to peaches; let stand 30 minutes.
Soften gelatin in cold water, dissolve in hot water and cool.
Add peach mixture, lemon juice and salt.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into pie shell (graham cracker); chill thoroughly.

title: Beriox

ingredients.name: hot roll mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box hot roll mix (or make your own)

steps: Brown meat in a large skillet or Dutch oven.
Chop onion and brown.
Add salt, pepper and spice. Then add chopped cabbage and flour. Stir about 2 minutes

title: Apricot Casserole

ingredients.name: apricot half
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 13 oz.) can apricot halves, drained

steps: Place apricots in baking dish, cut sides up.
Crumble crackers over top.
Sprinkle with sugars and drizzle butter over all.
Heat at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Oven Roast

ingredients.name: golden mushroom soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can golden mushroom soup, undiluted

steps: Place roast on heavy-duty aluminum foil; brush with steak sauce and sprinkle with onion soup mix.
Spoon mushroom soup on top.
Wrap loosely with foil.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Quick Pinwheel Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: red jelly
ingredients.raw: red jelly or cherry preserves or cranberry orange relish

steps: Separate rolls and spread each with butter.
Sprinkle mixture of sugar and cinnamon on rolls.
Roll up as directed on can. Arrange in a circle on a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Arrange remaining rolls on top.
Bake 15 minutes at 375°.
(Cover tips with foil so as to brown evenly.)
Spoon jelly, preserves or relish in center of rolls, letting some run between rolls. Combine confectioners sugar and milk; drizzle mixture over the rolls.
Serve warm.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
steps: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in a large mixing bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes.
Stir in coconut and nuts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Boiled Shrimp
steps: Wash shrimp; place in boiling salt water.
Cover and return to a boil.
Simmer 3 minutes and drain.
Peel shrimp, removing veins. Refrigerate and serve with cocktail sauce as an appetizer, or use in any recipe that calls for cooked shrimp.
Yields 1 1/2 pounds or about 4 cups, cooked.

title: Diabetic Salad Dressing(Diabetic Recipe)
steps: Mix low-fat yogurt and lemon juice or relish together.
Add Equal to taste; mix well.

title: Grilled Garlic Toast Bruschetta

ingredients.name: tabasco or
ingredients.raw: dash of Tabasco or to taste

steps: Slice baguette in 1/4-inch slices.
Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Using a flat knife, spread mixture thickly on slice baguette.
Arrange on waxed paper covered tray (no spacing necessary; close together is fine).
Place in a 400° preheated oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
Allow to cool on the tray, then transfer to a plate.
These are great the day before needed or the day you intent to serve them.
If made the day before a double batch may be necessary.
Family and friends may want to sample them before you make it to the table! Check after 5 minutes.
Cooking times may vary depending upon your oven.

title: Sausage Corn Casserole
steps: Cook sausage; drain off fat.
Combine sausage with remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Place in pan of hot water.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until set.

title: Sour Cream Dip
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Chill overnight.
Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Aunt Sylvia'S Mustard Sauce
steps: Whisk all ingredients together except butter.
Heat butter and add mixture to pan.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until thick.
You can not substitute margarine as it will separate later.
This sauce is great for any meats.
If you want a good mustard barbecue sauce, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of Matouk's hot sauce after it cools down and mix in.

title: Frosties(Rum Balls)
steps: Melt the chocolate chips.
Combine the melted chips, corn syrup, coffee and rum flavoring.
Add the wafers, nuts and 6 cups of powdered sugar to the chocolate mixture.
Form into balls. Roll into remaining powdered sugar.
Refrigerate.

title: Hungarian Pork Chops
steps: Sprinkle chops lightly with salt and pepper; flour on both sides.
Brown in a heavy skillet; then arrange a layer of kraut, then a layer of potatoes with a layer of kraut on top.
Sprinkle with paprika and brown sugar.
Pour tomatoes over top.
Cover and cook slowly on top of stove for 40 to 45 minutes or until chops are very tender.

title: Marinated Shrimp Kabobs

ingredients.name: size green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 medium-size green pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Peel and devein shrimp; set aside.
Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1/4 cup juice.
Set pineapple aside.

title: Raisin Tarts
steps: Cover raisins with water. Bring to a boil; drain.
Stir in egg, brown sugar and salt.
Mixture is ready to put into unbaked tart shells.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes (small tarts bake 10 minutes).

title: Pecan Puffs
steps: Whip together pecans, cheese, steak sauce, bacon and mayonnaise until thoroughly blended.
Spread on crackers.
Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until lightly puffed.
Serve hot.

title: Pea-Peanut Salad
steps: Cook peas according to directions.
Cool.
Measure and add equal amount of peanuts.
Mix thoroughly with sour cream and salad dressing.
Chill before serving.

title: Shrimp Rangoon
steps: Combine shrimp, cream cheese, garlic powder and steak sauce. Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in center of each wrapper.
Roll as directed on package.
Deep fry until delicately browned.
Serve with sweet-sour sauce.

title: Appetizer Oyster Crackers

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1.0 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix

steps: Combine Ranch salad dressing mix with dill weed and oil.
Pour over crackers; stir to coat.
Place in warm oven (250°) for 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir gently halfway through baking.
Serves 6.

title: Easy Broccoli Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook broccoli according to package and drain.
Add cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine.
Stir until melted.
Add remaining margarine.
Pour into casserole.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Top with cracker crumbs and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Sugar-Free No-Fat Poppy Seed Dressing
steps: Combine and mix well all ingredients.
Store in a covered container in the refrigerator.
Will keep 2 weeks.

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
steps: Cream margarine.
Blend in part of sugar.
Add peanut butter. Cream well.
Alternate remaining sugar and milk.
Beat until of spreading consistency.
Makes about 1 cup.

title: Olive Cheese Ball(Makes 3 Cups)

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped walnuts or toasted, diced almonds

steps: Blend cheese and butter or oleo.
Stir in olives and chives. Chill slightly for easier shaping.
Form into ball on serving dish, after rolling in or patting on chopped nuts.
May be trimmed with parsley.
Serve with crackers.

title: Granny'S Homemade Fruit Cake
steps: Mix nuts, cracker crumbs and raisins together in a bowl.
Heat milk with marshmallows until melted, stirring constantly.
Pour mix over crumbs.
Pour in square pan and cover with foil.
Freeze 4 to 6 hours.

title: Icebox Cookies
steps: Sift the sugar and cream it and butter together; beat eggs and add to creamed mixture.
Sift all other ingredients together and add to first mixture.
Knead with hands when mixture becomes too stiff for a spoon.
Chill well and slice.
Bake in moderate oven.

title: Sunday Glazed Carrots
steps: Steam carrots.
Combine brown sugar and butter.
Heat.
Mix water and cornstarch until smooth.
Heat until thickened.
Stir into carrot mixture.
Stir nuts into carrot mixture.

title: Fluff 'N Chip Treats

ingredients.name: nestle toll house semi sweet chocolate mini morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (half of 12 oz. pkg.) Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels

steps: In small bowl, stir marshmallow cream and peanut butter just until mixture is striped.
Spread 1 tablespoon onto each cracker. Dip tops into mini morsels.
Makes 20 treats.

title: Savory Potatoes

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. butter or 3 Tbsp. Butter Buds

steps: Cover all ingredients in saucepan with barely enough water to cover top of vegetables.
Cook 15 minutes until tender.
Do not add more water, but watch to prevent scorching.
When tender, mash with fork only.
Add milk to make consistency that you like.

title: Oven Chicken

ingredients.name: italian good season dressing mix powder
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Italian Good Seasons dressing mix powder

steps: Put together in bag and mix.
Shake.
Chicken should be coated. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Homemade Chili
steps: Put in kettle browned hamburger meat (drained).
Add onion, beans and chili powder.
Bring to boil.
Add tomato juice.
Add more if you need to.
Add salt to taste and dash of pepper.
Serve.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat egg yolks well.
Add sugar and Eagle Brand milk, Milnot condensed milk and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add egg yolks and egg whites and mix well.
Don't use chocolate syrup in mixture!
It won't freeze.

title: Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Then pour over 1-quart chicken broth.
Bake at 350°.

title: Kidney Bean Soup
steps: Cook bacon until crisp and crumble.
Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, put bacon drippings, diced onion and crushed garlic.
Cook in a microwave oven, covered, for about 3 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water and rest of ingredients, including liquid from beans.
Mix until well blended.
Cook, covered, for 10 to 12 minutes.
Place 1/2 soup in a blender for 10 seconds and return to casserole dish.
Repeat with other half of soup.
If soup is too thick, add water to make it the desired consistency.
Cook for another 3 minutes in microwave.
Just before serving, stir in reserved bacon.

title: Marinated Roast Cookout
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour over roast in glass dish.
Let marinate for 6 to 8 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator plus two hours at room temperature.
Cook to desired doneness on outdoor grill, 1-1/2 hours for rare, 2 hours for medium or 2 -1/2 hours for well done.
Serves 8-12.

title: Marsha'S Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken, cut up, or 3 breasts, boiled or baked and deboned

ingredients.name: broccoli pear
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked

ingredients.name: stove top stuffing prepared
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. Stove Top stuffing, prepared

steps: Layer chicken and broccoli in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Slice cheese; spread over chicken and broccoli.
Spread dressing over cheese; top with soup.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cornish Hen Delight
steps: Preheat oven to 500° (to sear juices).
Meanwhile, lay hens in pan.
Salt and pepper each hen; rub in good.
After oven is hot, put hens in oven for 30 minutes or until crispy golden brown. Meanwhile on stovetop, saute onions and celery in butter.
Put can of cream of chicken and 1 can of water; heat until creamy and set aside until 30 minutes are up, then pour mixture over hens and cook for about another 20 minutes or until hens are done.
Serve over rice (can substitute chicken if you don't have Cornish hens).

title: Braised Chuck Beef Pot Roast

ingredients.name: chuck beef pot roast
ingredients.raw: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. fresh chuck beef pot roast

ingredients.name: envelope dehydrated onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 1/4 oz.) envelope dehydrated onion soup mix (Lipton)

steps: Sprinkle both sides of meat with garlic salt.
Place in 3-quart (13 x 9-inch) glass baking dish.
Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on Simmer for 45 minutes.
Turn meat over; re-cover and continue cooking on Simmer for 40 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender.
Remove meat and slice meat approximately 1/4-inch thick.
Dissolve onion soup mix in hot meat juices; place sliced meat in seasoned meat juice (add sliced onions on top of beef, if desired).
Cover with plastic wrap or glass cover.
Microwave on Reheat for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.
Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.
Serves about 8.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: chipped beef very
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. chipped beef, cut very small

ingredients.name: green onion very
ingredients.raw: 6 green onions (tops included), cut very thin

steps: Combine 2/3 chipped beef with cream cheese, green onions, Worcestershire and milk.
Mix well and roll into a ball and then in remaining beef.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spicy Salt Substitute
steps: Mix the ingredients together very well and put in an airtight container.
Store in a cool, dry place, away from the stove.

title: Creamed Asparagus
steps: Cook asparagus until tender (steam).
Add milk, flour and water; cook until thick.
Add asparagus and diced hard-boiled eggs.

title: Tortellini Alla Checca
steps: Cook tortellini according to package.
In large saute pan, heat olive oil.
Add tomatoes, garlic, lemon juice and basil. Saute gently for 5 minutes.
Add cooked tortellini, butter, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.
Gently toss.
Serve.

title: Island Salsa

ingredients.name: yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 c. yellow or red bell pepper, chopped

ingredients.name: kiwi fruit and
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Serve on Hawaiian Lavash crackers or serve over grilled chicken.
Can be made 3 hours ahead.

title: Coconut Caramel Pie

ingredients.name: container whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

ingredients.name: hot fudge ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) hot fudge ice cream topping

steps: Melt butter in large skillet; add coconut and chopped pecans. Cook until golden brown, stirring frequently.
Set the mixture aside.
Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk; beat until smooth.
Fold in whipped topping.
Layer 1/2 of cream cheese mixture in each shell.
Drizzle 1/4 of chocolate fudge topping on each pie.
Sprinkle 1/4 of coconut mixture evenly over each pie, repeat layers with remaining ingredients.
Cover and freeze until firm.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
steps: Cut chicken wings in half.
Discard the tip.
In a bowl, mix orange juice, soy sauce and minced garlic.
Add the chicken wings to the mixture and marinate at least one hour.
It is better to do this the day before and marinate overnight.
Place chicken wings on a cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 30 to 45 minutes or until very brown.
Let cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Oven French Fries(Dietetic)
steps: Slice potatoes in half and then slice each half into 8 thick crescent-shaped pieces.
Chill sliced potatoes 10 minutes (or longer) in ice cold water to crisp them.
Preheat oven to 475°. Drain potatoes well.
Toss lightly with oil.
Spray a baking pan with Pam.
Arrange the slices in a single layer.
Bake 25 minutes turning occasionally.
Season and serve.
Makes 4 (75 calorie) servings.

title: Quick Lime Pie
steps: Blend first 3 ingredients together in blender or food processor.
Pour into large bowl and fold in Cool Whip.
Add food coloring at this time.
Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Meat Pie - Good For Holidays
steps: Simmer first 7 ingredients together until done.
Place in crusts.
Cover with lattice work crust or rolled top crust and be creative with designs on top.
Bake 1 hour at 450°.
Makes 4 pies.

title: Southern Spoonbread
steps: Pour boiling water over meal.
Let stand until cool.
Add sugar, salt and beaten egg.
Dissolve soda into buttermilk and add to batter; mix well.
Add melted shortening; pour in greased deep dish or skillet.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hop'N John And Rice
steps: Boil beans and thyme in 2 quarts of water until peas are tender.
Dry onions and bacon until brown.
Add to peas; add rice. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover tightly over low heat about 3/4 hour.

title: Lynn'S Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and brown sugar.
Add beaten eggs.
Mix together flour, soda and baking powder.
Add with coconut flakes and oatmeal to mixture.
Add nuts (optional).

title: Toasted Mixed Nuts
steps: Place pecans, cashews and almonds in 1 1/2-quart micro-proof casserole.
Sprinkle with seasoned salt.
Cut butter into 8 pieces and arrange evenly on top of nuts.
Cook, uncovered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
steps: Mix jello according to directions. Add pineapple and oranges (drain both).
Chill until set.
Top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Cheezy Garlic Biscuits
steps: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously for 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls on ungreased sheet.
Bake in a 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Mix butter and garlic powder together.
Brush over warm biscuits before serving.
Makes 10 to 12.

title: Teriyaki Burgers
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Shape into burgers and fry or grill.

title: Special K Candy
steps: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan.
Cook until sugar is dissolved.
Add peanut butter; continue cooking until it melts. Add this to cereal.
Mix in large bowl until cereal is coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let set until firm.

title: Cream Puffs(Yield:  6 Medium Puffs)
steps: In saucepan, melt butter in boiling water.
Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously.
Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate.
Remove from heat; cool slightly and add eggs, one at a time, beating with a spoon after each addition until smooth.
Drop
by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325° and bake 10 minutes.
Remove from oven; cut off tops.
Turn oven off; return cream puffs to oven to dry 20 minutes.
Cool on rack.

title: Hot (Soup)
steps: Slice a large onion and boil until tender in chicken broth; strain and throw away onion.
Return to heat.
Add one (more if needed) can of pureed tomatoes.
Stir.
To add a little color and taste, season with some black pepper and ground cayenne.
Simmer. Pour into cup over a slice of lemon.
Strips of corn tortillas dropped in are good.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream (1923)(Over 50 Years Old)
steps: Scald the fresh milk in a double boiler.
Mix the 1/2 cup sugar, flour and salt.
Sift.
Moisten with the 3 tablespoons cold milk.
Add 1 cup of the scalded milk and mix, then add to remaining hot milk.
Cook 30 minutes.

title: Pasta With Primavera Sauce

ingredients.name: red sweet pepper in
ingredients.raw: 1 small red sweet pepper, cut in strips

ingredients.name: spaghetti
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. spaghetti or other pasta, cooked and drained

steps: In a large skillet, saute broccoli, zucchini, red pepper and snow peas in butter until crisp-tender. Add half and half and black pepper.
Cook briefly until slightly reduced. Serve over pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Microwave Zucchini Bake
steps: Slice squash in half.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and oleo. Cook in microwave until tender.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Return to microwave and cook until cheese is hot.

title: Chocolate Nut Caramel Bars(Snicker Bars)

ingredients.name: nestle milk chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 1/2 oz.) pkg. Nestle milk chocolate morsels

steps: In microwave on High, melt chocolate morsels and shortening together.
Stir until mixture is smooth.
Pour 1/2 of the melted chocolate into an 8-inch foil lined square pan.
Spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (about 15 minutes).

title: Veal Paprika
steps: Mix salt, pepper and flour.
Roll individual servings of veal cutlets in seasoned flour.
Brown in hot oil in skillet rubbed with garlic.
Add 1 cup hot water; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Arrange meat on hot platter.
Into gravy left in pan, stir 1 cup cream.
Heat and pour over noodles.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Frosted Toffee Bars
steps: In medium bowl, combine oats, sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 13 minutes or until light golden brown; cool.
In small, heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips.
Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts.
Refrigerate until chocolate is set.
Cut into bars and store in tightly covered container in refrigerator.
Makes 2 dozen bars.

title: Banana Yellow Cake

ingredients.name: nut if desired
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. finely chopped nuts, if desired

steps: Make batter as directed, except stir 1/8 teaspoon soda into mix before adding liquid.
Use only 3/4 cup water and add 1 cup mashed bananas (2 to 3 medium).
If desired, fold 1/3 cup finely chopped nuts into batter.
Pour into prepared oblong or layer pans.
Bake.
If desired, fill and frost with sweetened whipped cream and sliced bananas.

title: Mint Cordial
steps: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator.
Shake well before serving.
Serve chilled.
Makes about 4 cups liqueur.

title: Beef And Beans Barbecue
steps: Brown ground chuck in skillet with chopped onions and drain. Then add other ingredients.
Either simmer on top of stove or place in oven at 375° until all ingredients are bubbly.
This will take 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Kids Favorite Morning Spiced Tea
steps: Mix all ingredients in an airtight container.
Use 1/3 cup (more or less to taste) per cup of hot water.

title: Prepare Ahead Mashed Potatoes
steps: For "Mashies" that stay smooth, mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and an egg yolk.
Whip an egg white and fold it into the potatoes.
Place in a buttered casserole and dot with more butter.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Pecan Thins
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour.
Add egg yolk and vanilla. Batter will be stiff.
Spread as thin as possible on 2 cookie sheets.
Lightly beat egg white.
Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts.
Press in with hand.
Bake 1 hour at 275° or lower.
Remove from oven and cut into squares immediately.
Freeze well.

title: Kool-Aid Fizzy

ingredients.name: mountain dew soda pop
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can Mountain Dew soda pop

steps: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pitcher.
Mix well.

title: Quickie Brownies
steps: Stir all ingredients together;	spread into shallow 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Nutty Yam Bake
steps: Drain yams.
Melt butter in bottom of baking dish.
Put yams in bottom of baking dish.
You can mash or cut up in small pieces. Sprinkle brown sugar on top along with cinnamon.
Add pecans and marshmallows.
Bake about 20 minutes.
Don't let marshmallows burn.

title: Onion Pizza Bread

ingredients.name: bread dough thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. frozen bread dough, thawed or 1 lb. pizza dough

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine onion and garlic with an equal amount of water; set aside 10 minutes to soften.
Fit dough into a greased 12-inch round pizza pan.
Brush dough with 2 tablespoons of oil.
Sprinkle dough with salt and reserved onion and garlic. Dribble remaining 2 tablespoons oil over top of dough.
Bake until dough and onion is browned, 15 to 20 minutes.
Cut into wedges.

title: Chinese Spice Cookies

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. vanilla or 1/2 tsp. almond flavoring

steps: Combine shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Add powdered ingredients.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Dip or sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Frosted Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: dream whip make per instruction on box
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 oz.) pkg. Dream Whip, make per instructions on box

ingredients.name: cream cheese room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, room temperature

steps: Drain pineapple.
Reserve juice and make up to one cup with water.
Heat to boiling; dissolve jello in hot liquid.
Gently stir in ginger ale; chill until partially set.
Mix pineapple and the cranberry sauce; fold into jello.
Turn into 9 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm.
Mix cream cheese and whipped topping; spread over jello and sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Punch Bowl Strawberry Cake
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
Crumble cake and put in large bowl.
Stir half of mix in with cake.
Mix strawberries and glaze together and put on top of cake.
Put rest of Cool Whip mixture on top.
Add whole strawberries on top and side of cake.

title: Christmas Jewels
steps: Mix all ingredients, except coconut and food coloring.
Shape in about 3 dozen small ovals.
In two separate pint jars, put a few drops each of red and green food coloring.
Add 1/2 teaspoon coconut to each jar.
Cover and shake until coconut is tinted. Roll ovals in coconut.
Chill.

title: Creamed Celery

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can water chestnuts, sliced thin

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook celery in lightly salted water until tender; drain.
Add water chestnuts, soup and pimento.
Top with bread crumbs, almonds and melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: "Hands-Off" Chicken

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery soup (do not dilute)

steps: Mix rice and soups together.
Spray dish (long, flat 2-quart dish) with Pam and put soup and rice in the casserole dish.
Place raw chicken on top of rice mixture.
Then sprinkle onion soup mix over everything.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°.

title: Velveeta Fudge
steps: In saucepan over simmering water, beat cheese, butter and cocoa.
Slowly add in sugar.
Add vanilla.
Cook 10 minutes over medium heat until thick.
Put in buttered 9-inch pan for thick slices or put in 10 x 13-inch pan for thinner slices.

title: Cherry Tart
steps: Beat until stiff the egg whites and baking powder.
Add sugar, crackers and nuts.
Let set overnight. Butter 2 pie dishes or 9 x 13-inch oblong dish.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Old Timey Potato Salad
steps: Take Irish potatoes.
Peel and wash and chop small.
Put a small amount of salt in the water you boil them in.
Cook until real tender.
Drain water off and break eggs in the hot potatoes. Mash real good, the hot potatoes will cook the eggs.
Add onion (chopped fine), mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, salt and black pepper. Stir all this up real good and taste to see if it's flavored to suit your taste.

title: Creamy Pot Roast
steps: Boil roast in a large pot on top of stove until extremely tender.
Pour the cream of mushroom soup over cut up roast. Salt, pepper and enjoy.

title: Hash Browns
steps: Heat butter, cream and salt.
Put 1/2 hash browns in bottom of baking dish.
Sprinkle with half of cheese.
Top with remaining hash browns.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Pour cream mixture over.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Rolls
steps: Combine dry ingredients in large mixer bowl.
Heat milk and oil in saucepan over low heat until warm.
Add 1 egg and warm liquid to flour mixture; beat 1/2 minute at low speed and 3 minutes at medium speed.
By hand, gradually stir 2 cups flour, Cheddar cheese and 2 to 3 cups more flour until soft dough.
Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise until doubled in size.
Punch down dough.
Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan.
Cover; let rise 15 to 20 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Superb Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

ingredients.name: scalded milk
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 c. scalded milk (depending on type of sweet potatoes used)

steps: Wash the unpeeled sweet potatoes.
Cook in a large saucepan in the water with 1 teaspoon salt for about 20 minutes, until tender, but not mushy.
Drain, peel and mash to a puree.
This may be done in a food processor, blender or electric mixer.
Add the remaining salt, butter, pepper and milk.

title: Boursin
steps: Combine cream cheese, sour cream and butter thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill.
Serve with crackers.

title: 10 Day Slaw
steps: Chop or shred cabbage.
Add sliced onions and chopped green peppers.
Pour white sugar over cabbage mixture and let stand while mixing dressing.
Heat oil, vinegar, celery seed and salt to a rolling boil.
Pour immediately over cabbage.
Store in refrigerator.
Keeps 10 days.

title: Squaw Corn

ingredients.name: kernel corn drain and save juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drain and save juice

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.raw: 8 slices bacon, sliced into small pieces

steps: Cut bacon across strip into 1/4-inch pieces. Chop onion and pepper about the same size. Fry bacon; drain. Discard half of the bacon fat.
Add liquid from corn and chopped vegetables.

Cook over medium-high heat until thick syrup forms on bottom of pan, stirring frequently. Add corn, bacon, pimento, salt, pepper and chiles. Stir to mix and continue cooking until corn is heated through.
("Great for company.")

title: Four Fruit Float
steps: Use fresh or frozen berries.
Put all ingredients into blender container.
Blend until smooth.
Serves 4.

title: Triple Layer Mud Pie

ingredients.name: chocolate ready crust pie shell
ingredients.raw: 1 chocolate ready crust pie shell (6 oz.)

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: chocolate flavored instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. (4 serving size) chocolate flavored instant pudding

ingredients.name: tub non dairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) tub frozen non dairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: Pour chocolate and sweetened condensed milk into bowl; stir until smooth and pour into crust.
Press nuts evenly onto chocolate in the crust and refrigerate 10 minutes.
Pour milk into large bowl and add pudding mixes.
Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes or until smooth.
Mixture will be thick.
Spread 1 1/2 cups of the pudding over nuts and chocolate layer in crust. Immediately stir half of the whipped topping into remaining pudding.
Spread over pudding in crust.
Top with remaining whipped topping.
Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Old-Timey Biscuits
steps: Sift flour and cut lard into mixture.
Add sugar and buttermilk; mix well with hands.
Roll out and place apart on baking sheet that has been greased with margarine.
Bake at 450° for about 18 minutes, or until brown on the bottom, then broil tops until golden brown.
Brush margarine over the tops while hot.

title: Microwave Toasted Butter Pecans
steps: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole place pecan halves.
Sprinkle with seasoned salt.
Cut butter into 4 pieces and arrange evenly over top.
Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes. Mix to evenly distribute butter.
Serve warm or cold.

title: Pineapple Roast
steps: In electric skillet, brown roast on all sides in butter.
Pour enough water to cover roast; simmer 2 to 3 hours.
Add more water during simmering if necessary.
Drain water (if any) and place potatoes in skillet with roast.
Pour in pineapple juice.
Cook until juice becomes thick-like sauce and potatoes are tender.

title: Cheesy Mostaccioli
steps: Mix Ragu sauce and Cheddar cheese soup with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese in baking dish.
Drain grease off ground beef. Mix ground beef in sauce.
Add cooked noodles; mix well.
Top with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Vanilla Wafers
steps: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or up to 1 week ahead: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium bowl with mixer at low speed, beat all ingredients until blended, occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula.
Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake cookies 10 to 12 minutes until edges of cookies are browned.
With pancake turner, remove cookies.

title: Caramel, Coconut, Pecan Pie
steps: Bake and cool pie crusts.
Toast chopped pecans and coconut. Mix Cool Whip, condensed milk and cream cheese.
Put a layer of this mixture in bottom of crusts, then sprinkle in pecans and coconut.
Next, drizzle caramel topping over all.
Layer again, starting with cream cheese mixture and ending with caramel topping. Freeze.
Take out about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake

ingredients.name: condensed cheddar cheese soup
ingredients.raw: 1 Can (11 ounces) condensed Cheddar Cheese Soup

ingredients.name: pea and carrot if desired
ingredients.raw: 1 Cup Frozen Peas and Carrots, if Desired

steps: Heat oven to 400.
Grease rectangular baking dish, 13x9x2 inches.
Cook beef and onion in 10 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until beef is brown.
Drain.
Stir in soup, vegetables and milk.
Remove from heat.

title: Polka Dot Pudding
steps: Combine water, fruit juice, Minute tapioca, sugar and salt in saucepan and mix well.
Bring mixture quickly to a boil over direct heat.
Stir all the time and remove from heat after boiling.
Do not overcook.
Will be thin.
Put in pineapple and nuts.
Stir occasionally until cool.

title: Cabbage Slaw
steps: Mix well and serve chilled.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.

title: Buttercream Frosting
steps: Put all in mixer bowl.
Stir on slow to combine.
Beat well.

title: Peanut Butter Round Up
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine shortening and sugar in mixing bowl.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and beat until well blended in peanut butter.
Sift together flour, salt and soda. Combine with peanut butter.
Stir in oats.
Roll dough to form small balls.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.
With fork, press cookie balls.
If dough sticks to fork, dip in flour. Bake for about 12 minutes.

title: Marinated Artichokes

ingredients.name: anchovy filet
ingredients.raw: 3 cans anchovy filets, chopped (not the oil)

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. olive oil or enough to cover ingredients

steps: Mix all ingredients and allow to marinate for at least 2 hours.
Serve with crackers.
(Better if made 1 or 2 days ahead.)

title: Company Goodies
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over mixture.
Mix cream cheese and box confectioners sugar and spread over nuts.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
When cool, cut in squares.

title: Salmon Pie

ingredients.name: biscuit mix pastry double crust pie
ingredients.raw: biscuit mix pastry for 2 double crust 9-inch pies

steps: Combine salmon, onions and butter; mix thoroughly.
Add potatoes and mash.
Stir in milk; whip until smooth.
Spread mixture in prepared pastry shells; top with crust and crimp edges to seal.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Pie may be frozen.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Angel Food Candy
steps: Boil until syrup reaches 300° on candy thermometer.
Take from heat.
Add 1 tablespoon soda.
Pour on a buttered cookie sheet. When hard, break in pieces and dip.

title: Chipped Beef Appetizer
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. Serve with crackers.

title: Bacon, Cheese And Macaroni Bake
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Cool and crumble.
Cook macaroni according to directions.
Combine macaroni, crumbled bacon and tomato sauce.
Cut cheese up in pieces and mix in with other ingredients.
Put in a 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, until cheese is melted.

title: Surprise Sandwiches

ingredients.name: the following ground ham tuna salmon chicken
ingredients.raw: any of the following: ground ham, tuna, salmon, diced chicken or turkey

ingredients.name: mushroom sauce
ingredients.raw: mushroom sauce (cream of mushroom soup diluted with cream or whole milk)

steps: Prepare the night before.
Grease an 8 x 10-inch pan with butter or oleo.
Place 6 slices of bread (crusts removed) in bottom of pan.
Cover each slice with a slice of American cheese. Then spread each with prepared mustard and cover with any of the listed meats.
Butter 6 more slices of bread and place on top, buttered side up.

title: Crab Bisque Soup

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: cream of asparagus soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of asparagus soup

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. dry white wine or sherry

steps: Blend soups.
Stir in milk and cream.
Heat just to boiling. Add crab.
Heat.
Stir in wine just before serving.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Veal Parmigiana

ingredients.name: veal cutlet
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. veal cutlets (2 x 2-inch slices; 1/4-inch thick)

steps: Pound cutlets until they reach 3 x 3-inch size.
Dip meat into egg and milk mixture, then dip into 3/4 cup dry seasoned bread crumbs.
Sprinkle freely with Parmesan cheese; allow to stand 15 minutes.
Saute in butter or oil until crisp (2 to 4 minutes, each side).
Place in baking sheet, top with your favorite spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese.
Place in preheated oven until cheese melts.
Serves 4 to 5.

title: Jim'S Mother'S Beet Pickles
steps: Cook beets.
Peel and cut.
Pour liquid over and bring to boil, then put in jars and seal.

title: Liver Pat
steps: Saut chicken livers and onions until done, but not browned. Cool slightly.
Puree 1 cup at a time in blender.
Stir in salt, dry mustard, pepper and butter.
Refrigerate.

title: Half Moon Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Frost 1/2 chocolate and 1/2 white frosting.

title: Stew

ingredients.name: hamburger meat brown and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. hamburger meat, browned and drained

steps: Put 2 to 3 cups hot water in large stew pan.
Add potatoes, carrots and onions (all peeled and diced).
When halfway tender, add tomato sauce, corn, beef stew mix and hamburger meat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Cook on low heat until ready.

title: White Buttermilk Sheet Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add vanilla and then salt.
Add egg whites one at a time, beating after each one.
Beat in 2 tablespoons flour.
Add 3/4 cup buttermilk with baking soda added. Add remaining flour and buttermilk alternately.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch sheet cake pan that has been greased and floured.
Cool and frost with buttercream frosting.

title: Oven Barbecue Hamburgers
steps: Mix all ingredients and make medium size patties.
Brown in small amount of cooking oil and set aside.
Make the sauce.

title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
steps: Cook and cube chicken.
Mix together all ingredients, except cheese and tortillas.
Put a little of the mixture in the bottom of pan (so they don't stick).
Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in tortilla and some of the cheese, roll and place in pan.
After all are rolled up, spread rest of sauce and cheese on top.
Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Pistachio Microwave Cake
steps: Grease 9 x 9 x 2-inch or tube microwavable cake pan with solid shortening and line with waxed paper.
Blend water, egg whites and oil.
Stir in cake mix and pudding until well blended.
Microwave on turntable 9 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Remove from microwave and cool until warm to touch.
Turn out on cake plate and remove waxed paper.
Frost with cream cheese frosting, if desired.

title: Texas Beans
steps: Brown ground beef; drain well.
Combine everything together. Bake in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add milk and margarine.
Bring to a boil for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes.
Add vanilla and oatmeal.
Remove from heat.
Spoon out on wax paper.
Let cool.
Cookies will harden while cooling.
Yield: 2
dozen.

title: Oatmeal Pecan Cookies

ingredients.name: oatmeal
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 cup raw oatmeal (can substitute 1/2 c. pecans for 1/2 c. oatmeal)

steps: Bring to a boil first 4 items.
Boil 1 minute and remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat until well mixed.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.
Let stand for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Jubilee
steps: Whip the Dream Whip. Add sugar and cream cheese.
Mix well. In deep dish, put 1 layer of ladyfingers.
Spread with mixture. Cover with pie filling.
Repeat in layers.
Chill at least 3 hours. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mexi-Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients except cheese.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: or bunch broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen or 1 bunch fresh broccoli

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook and drain broccoli.
Place in bottom of greased, glass baking dish (13 x 9-inch).
Arrange cooked chicken on top.
Mix together soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice.
Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with shredded cheese, bread crumbs and paprika.
Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: No Fail Yeast Rolls
steps: Stir yeast, salt and sugar into flour.
Heat milk until hot to touch.
Add milk and oil to dry ingredients, beating until well blended, for about 5 minutes.
Then with a spoon, add as much flour as needed.
Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Place into a greased or oiled bowl and cover with a towel.
Let rise until double.
Punch down and turn out onto a floured surface. Roll out; cut with a biscuit cutter.
Put into oiled pan and let rise until double.
Cook at 400° until brown.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
steps: In a 9-inch pan place Bisquick and soft butter.
Pour boiling water over this and stir with fork until soft-ball.
Pat dough in pan over the edge.	Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 450° oven.

title: Sweet Potato Chips
steps: Peel and wash yams.
Slice as thin as possible, the thinner, the better.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan; let oil get very hot. Place chips in oil until golden brown.
Place cooked chips on a paper towel.
Salt to taste and serve.

title: Appetizer Pie
steps: Blend cheese and milk.
Stir in dried beef, onion and pepper. Mix well.
Add sour cream.
Spoon into 8-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle walnuts over top and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serve with crackers as a dip.

title: Cheezy Chicken
steps: Dip boneless chicken breasts in butter, then roll in cracker crumbs.
Place in baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Very Best Burrito
steps: Combine milk and pudding mix and blend 1 minute.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fold in 2 cups of Cool Whip.
Add about 1 1/2 cups of strawberries.
In bowl combine sugar and cinnamon.
Butter both sides of tortillas.
Sprinkle one side with the sugar/cinnamon mixture.
Put in 350° oven, sugar/cinnamon side up, only about 2 minutes until bubbly.
Take out of oven and let stand 3 to 4 minutes.
Fill shells with sugar side out.
Top each with Cool Whip and add sliced strawberries.

title: Old-Fashioned Custard Pie
steps: Beat lightly; pour into 9-inch unbaked crust.
Bake for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted into side of filling comes out clean.
Center is soft, but will set later.
Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes, then at 350° to finish.

title: Small Apple Crisp
steps: Lightly spray 8 x 8 pan; place apple in pan and sprinkle with lemon juice and water.
Combine remaining ingredients and cover apples.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are done and brown.

title: Barbecued Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 6 medium to large sweet potatoes or yams

steps: Wash and scrub potatoes.
Cut slits in tops.
Place each potato in a piece of aluminum foil, wrapping securely.
Cook 6-inches from heat, tops down, for 20 minutes.
Turn and pierce foil tops with a fork.
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or longer, until done.
Cut foil open.
Combine cloves and butter.
Frizzle over tops.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Blintz Souffle
steps: Place blintzes (partially defrost) in baking dish.
Blend remaining ingredients and pour over blintzes.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes (mixture should be set).
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Red Cabbage - German Style(Sweet And Sour)
steps: Cut cabbage in half and slice thin.
Place in a large kettle of boiling water for 10 minutes.
Drain.
Put cabbage back in pot and add all other ingredients.
Pour the boiling water on last. Bring all to a boil and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.
Be sure to use a close-fitting lid.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Cream the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add drained pineapple, then add cherries and nuts; mix well.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mixed Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: mandarin orange and
ingredients.raw: 1 c. mandarin oranges, canned and drained

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
steps: Prepare potatoes according to package directions.
Heat sour cream but do not boil.
Add mustard, salt and sugar.
Stir to blend and add to hot potatoes.
Stir in onion.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Banberry Surprise

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 1 box white or yellow cake mix

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add strawberry soda pop and cool completely.
Mix cake according to package directions (do not use cake mix with pudding in it).
Bake in 13 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 2 inch greased and floured pan.
Let cool completely.
After cake is cooled, using potato peeler, poke lots of holes all the way to the bottom.
Pour gelatin and soda pop mixture over cake.
Cover entire top of cake with thick sliced bananas.

title: Mother'S Cheese Cake
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Let cool 15 minutes.
Mix sour cream, 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla; pour over cake. Bake 3 to 5 minutes more at 475°.

title: Nacho Cheese Chowder
steps: In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole, crumble meat.
Add the green pepper.
Cook in microwave, covered, on High for 2 to 3 minutes until no pink remains in meat, stirring once or twice. Drain off the fat.
Stir in nacho cheese soup, milk, corn, chopped tomato and minced onion.
Cook, covered, on High for 7 to 10 minutes or until chowder is heated through, stirring once.
Makes 3 main dish servings.
Serve with corn chips.

title: Pineapple Fluff Pie
steps: Soak gelatine in cold water 5 minutes.
Beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup sugar.
Add pineapple, lemon juice and salt.
Cook on low heat until consistency of custard.
Add softened gelatine, stir and cool.
Beat egg whites until white and foamy.
Add remaining sugar gradually and continue beating until glossy and holds soft peaks. When mixture begins to thicken, fold in egg whites.
Beat whipping cream and fold in.
Pour into baked pie crust and refrigerate.

title: Willie'S Homemade Boiled Chicken And Rice
steps: Boil chicken thighs for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups rice.
Cook, covered, for 20 minutes longer.
Ready to serve.

title: R C'S Fudge

ingredients.name: chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chips (semi-sweet chocolate, butterscotch or milk chocolate)

steps: Cook in 2-quart pan, stirring constantly, over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil.
Boil and stir 5 minutes. Take off heat; stir in 6 ounces chips, vanilla and nuts.
Pour in greased pan.

title: Cream Cheese Cut-Out Cookies
steps: Blend well with spoon the oleo, cream cheese and sour cream. Gradually add sugar, continuing to beat until light.
Add egg yolks (slightly beaten with vanilla).
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt and mix

title: Almond Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix flour, baking soda and salt.
In a blender, grind 1/2 cup blanched almonds to a fine powder, add to flour mixture.
Cream the sugar, shortening, almond extract, egg and water and add to dry mixture.
Mix thoroughly.
Form into 1-inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press one of the remaining almonds into the center of each ball while flattening it slightly with fingers.
Brush cookie with beaten egg.
Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: 3-Day Brown-N-Bag Coconut Cake

ingredients.name: coconut thawed and fluffed
ingredients.raw: 18 oz. frozen coconut, thawed and fluffed

ingredients.name: duncan hine butter recipe yellow cake mix baked direction
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines butter recipe yellow cake mix, baked to directions

steps: Mix sour cream, sugar and coconut together and keep in refrigerator 24 hours before making cake.
Make cake according to directions on box.
Make in 3 layers.
Let cake layers get completely cool.
Spread coconut mixture over layers.
Slide cake into turkey-sized brown-n-bag, satin refrigerator bag and let stay for 3 days before serving.

title: Caramel Apple Pie
steps: Combine 10 caramel candies; cut each into 4 pieces.
Add 1/3 cup flour.
Add 3 cups (cut into 1/2-inch cubes) Jonathan or Rome apples, 2/3 cup caramel ice cream topping and 2 teaspoons lemon juice.
Mix well.
Bake at 375° on a preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes.
Store at room temperature.

title: Diced Mcintosh Apple Cake
steps: Add sugar to diced apples and let stand for 10 minutes.
Sift flour and spices.
Blend oil and egg into apple mixture.
Add flour mixture all at once.
Beat with large spoon until well blended.
Pour into a 9-inch well greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Homestyle Chicken And Biscuits

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots or any type frozen vegetables)

steps: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine gravy and poultry seasoning.
Stir in chicken and frozen vegetables.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, or until mixture begins to bubble.

title: Carla'S Five Can Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Barbecued Ribs
steps: Cook rack of ribs in Dutch oven or regular 350° oven for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done.
In a bowl, mix together remaining ingredients.
Pour sauce over ribs and bake, uncovered, until brown, about 20 minutes.
Keep basting ribs with sauce.

title: Cranberry And Apple Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water.
Break up cranberry sauce with fork.
Add the gelatin mixture; chill until thickened. Fold in apples and nuts.

title: Miracle Whip-Up

ingredients.name: your favorite spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 30 oz. jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce

steps: Brown and cook the ground beef.
Add the salad dressing, spaghetti sauce, and cooked macaroni.
Heat on medium heat.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese-Pineapple Casserole
steps: Put pineapple in 2-quart casserole dish.
Mix flour, sugar and cheese and cover pineapple.
Cover this with cracker crumbs. Drizzle margarine over crumbs.
Bake at 350° until bubbly, approximately 20 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lemon Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake mix according to directions on package and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan.
Let cool thoroughly.
Spread with pie filling, then frost with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated until you serve it.

title: Crumb Crust

ingredients.name: fine graham cracker chocolate wafer
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. fine graham cracker, chocolate wafer or gingersnap crumbs

steps: Combine crumbs and sugar.
Mix in butter.
Press firmly on bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan. For unbaked crumb crust, chill 1 hour before filling. For baked crumb crust, bake at 375° for 8 minutes. Cool thoroughly before filling.
For ease in serving, dip pie pan in warm water for a few seconds, then cut and serve.

title: Aloha Slush

ingredients.name: banana
ingredients.raw: 3 ripe bananas (mashed or blend in blender with a little water)

steps: Mix all of the ingredients and divide into 4 separate containers and freeze.
When serving, add 1 quart of 7-up to each container.

title: Tiger Butter(Candy)
steps: Melt vanilla and chocolate almond bark in separate bowls in microwave.
Add peanut butter to almond bark and stir in good. Pour vanilla almond bark mixture in deep cookie sheet (pan must be completely dry).
Swirl in chocolate almond bark.
Let set on counter.
Do not refrigerate!
Cut and serve.

title: Teenage Scramble
steps: Saute ground beef with onion in oil in skillet until ground beef is browned, stirring frequently.
Add mushrooms and spinach, mixing well.
Stir in eggs gradually.
Cook until eggs are set, stirring constantly.
Season with salt and pepper.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Quick Fruit Crisp
steps: Pour pie filling into 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan.
Mix remaining ingredients with a fork.
Sprinkle over fruit.
Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chicken Soup Mother Didn'T Make

ingredients.name: vegetable seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. frozen vegetables for seasoning (in freezer case close to onions and peppers)

steps: Boil chicken, including heart, gizzard and liver for about 45 minutes.
Use enough water to just float the chicken.
Remove pan from heat.
Take chicken out and let it cool.
Save the pot of water.
When chicken is cool, pick the meat off the bones (don't start too early or you will invent words the dog won't stay around to hear).
Put chicken meat back into the pot of water.
Add the complete soup starter, the vegetables for seasoning and the sliced carrots.
Add any leftover veggies found in the fridge.
Cover pot and simmer at least 2 hours.
Serve with cornbread.
It will fix what ails you!

title: My Favorite Fried Potatoes

ingredients.name: each bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 each diced bell peppers (green and red)

steps: Fry onions, bacon and mushrooms together, turning frequently until bacon is sufficiently cooked (not crispy).
In a separate frypan, heat vegetable oil on medium-high temperature for 2 to 3 minutes.
Season sliced potatoes with paprika, pepper and salt as listed in large bowl.
