Reduce temperature to low-medium; add sliced potatoes slowly to hot oil; turn potatoes frequently.
Fry until light brown color is achieved.
Combine all ingredients in one frypan and cook an extra 10 to 15 minutes and serve.

title: Twice-Baked Italian Cookies

ingredients.name: anisette
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. anisette or other anise liqueur

ingredients.name: bourbon
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. bourbon or 2 tsp. vanilla and 2 Tbsp. water

ingredients.name: coarsely almond
ingredients.raw: 2 c. coarsely chopped almonds or walnuts

steps: In a bowl, mix sugar, butter, anise seed, liqueur, bourbon, almonds and eggs.
Beat to blend. Stir together flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate dough until firm, 2 to 3 hours.

title: No-Peek Chicken
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle rice on bottom.
Layer chicken, skin side up on rice.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken.
Mix water with both cans of soup and heat, then pour over chicken.
Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 325° to 350°.

title: Wilted Lettuce
steps: Fry bacon until crispy.
Remove from skillet and set aside. Into bacon drippings stir, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, onion and egg.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Add lettuce to skillet and toss with hot dressing quickly.
Remove to bowl.
Crumble bacon on top.

title: Nutty Crispies(Easy Cookies)

ingredients.name: nut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. nuts, chopped (your choice, almonds, pecans or walnuts)

steps: Line cookie sheet with sides with foil.
Arrange separated crackers on foil, side by side.
Sprinkle nuts over top of graham crackers.
Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil in small saucepan and pour over crackers evenly.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350° oven until bubbly.
Remove from oven and let set a couple of minutes.
Cut apart with knife while still warm and cool on wax paper.
Makes about 3 dozen 1 1/2 x 3-inch cookies.

title: Bohemian Turkey Soup
steps: Make and brown small meatballs and drain well.
In large stock pot put chicken broth, soup bone and cleaned giblets on medium flame approximately 1 hour.
Remove soup one, skim off and add vegetables.
After another hour, reduce flame.
Add parsley, meatballs and noodles after 10 to 15 minutes, should be ready.

title: Cranapple Sherbet Punch
steps: Mix sugar and water until sugar is dissolved.
Mix remainder and stir well.
Chill.
Just before serving, add 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet.
Makes 60 (1/2 cup) servings.
Good for wedding and other receptions.

title: Low-Fat Vegetable Soup
steps: Stir onion, cabbage and celery in water.
Simmer until tender. Add rest of the ingredients and simmer.
Serve the next day. (One pound of ground turkey may be added.)

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
steps: Use wooden spoon to stir up ingredients which are placed into a pot.
Cook until tender.

title: Snow Salad
steps: Drop marshmallows in boiling water, dissolve well.
Add jello and cool.
Add pineapple to cheese and mix well, then add to cooled gelatin mixture.
Add whipped cream and nuts, pour into large pan, 8 x 14-inch, chill well and serve.
May use a large jello mold.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Millionaires
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Add quick cooking oatmeal to desired consistency.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Place in freezer to harden.
(This can be rolled into waxed paper and sliced after hardening.)

title: White Bean Soup
steps: Soak beans overnight.
Cook in chicken broth until soft.
Chop onion, celery, cabbage and garlic.
Cook in small amount of oil until soft.
Add to beans.
Add ham, salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low for 30 minutes.

title: Polly Smith'S Pistachio Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large (1 lb.) can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Mix the pudding and pineapple.
Add remaining ingredients and blend everything together.
Refrigerate until cold.

title: Taco Burgers

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. cream cheese, cut into 1/8-inch strips (thick)

steps: Crush enough corn chips to make 1/3 cup.
Mix ground beef, chips and seasoning mix.
Shape into 6 patties.
Set oven to broil. Broil patties 5 minutes; turn and broil for 3 minutes more. Crisscross cheese strips on each patty and sprinkle with paprika. Broil until cheese is puffed and golden.

title: Tostado Dip
steps: Layer refried beans mixed with taco mix.
Layer sour cream with carton of avocado dip.
Layer grated Cheddar cheese.
Layer green onions and black olives.
Refrigerate until chilled.
Serve with taco chips.

title: Pork Chops And Rice

ingredients.name: mushroom soup plu c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 can mushroom soup plus 1/2 c. water

steps: Spread rice on bottom of oblong dish.
Dissolve bouillon in water and pour over rice.
Place pork chops on rice.
Pour mushroom soup and water over chops.
Sprinkle onion soup over all. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Chicken can be substituted for chops.

title: Hedge Hogs
steps: Cook first 6 ingredients for 5 minutes.
Stir in Rice Krispies. Roll in balls.
Then roll balls in mixture of coconut and confectioners sugar.
Makes about 24 balls.

title: Golden Potato Squares
steps: Saute onion in butter, add milk and bring to boil.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Save 1/2 cup cheese to sprinkle on top and bake 30 minutes more.
Cut in squares to serve.
Good with ham and cole slaw.
May be refrigerated overnight before baking.

title: Frozen Pineapple Torte

ingredients.name: pineapple and saved
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained and saved

ingredients.name: salerno vanilla wafer crumb
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Salerno vanilla wafer crumbs or more

steps: Beat egg yolks, salt and 1/2 cup sugar.
Add pineapple syrup and lemon juice.
Cook in double boiler, stirring constantly, until thick.
Add pineapple.
Cool.

title: Chopstick Tuna
steps: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 375°.
Inexpensive and very good for tuna.

title: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Sift baking powder and flour together.
Add to sugar mixture with milk.
Fold in egg whites, vanilla and lemon flavoring.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Date Balls
steps: Cook over low heat first 4 ingredients for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups Rice Crispies.
Add rest of Rice Crispies if needed.
Prepare aluminum foil with part of coconut; spread over to put mixture on adding more coconut as needed.

title: Artichoke, Potato And Bacon Salad With Fennel Flowers

ingredients.name: or fennel flower with stalk
ingredients.raw: 3 or 4 fennel flowers with stalks 6 to 8-inches long

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.raw: juice of 1/2 lemon or 1/2 c. cider vinegar

ingredients.name: each red yellow and green bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/2 each: large red, yellow and green bell peppers

steps: Wash and cook potatoes just until tender.
Cut onion lengthways into quarters and cut thinly crosswise.
Soak in cold water.
Cut peppers into strips, 1/4 x 1-inch long.
Cut artichokes in half.
Slice artichokes crosswise in 1/4-inch slices.

title: Hot Chicken, Shrimp Or Crab Salad

ingredients.name: chicken boned and up
ingredients.raw: 1 cooked chicken, boned and cut up or 1 pound raw shrimp, cooked and peeled, or 1 pound crabmeat

steps: Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips; put in casserole.
Combine cheese and potato chips and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350 degrees until hot, 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Squash Casserole 1
steps: Mix all ingredients.
If bacon drippings are cold, melt them first.
Pour into ungreased dish.
Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Rich Lemon Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Press into bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Meanwhile in a large bowl combine eggs, granulated sugar, baking powder, ReaLemon and remaining 3 tablespoons flour.
Mix well.
Pour over baked crust for 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cool.
Cut into bars.
Sprinkle with additional confectioners sugar.
Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (2 lbs.)

ingredients.name: paprika salt and black pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. paprika, salt, and black pepper

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray.
Dip chicken in margarine and coat with combined remaining ingredients.
Place in prepared pan.
Bake 20-25 minutes or until tender.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Orange-Pineapple Sherbet
steps: Mix well.
Pour into ice cream freezer can.
Freeze until firm.

title: Sage-Onion Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato scrubbed and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. potatoes (small), scrubbed (but unpared) and cut into 1/4-inch slices

ingredients.name: sage leaf
ingredients.raw: 6 sage leaves or 1/2 tsp. dried sage

steps: Heat butter and oil in a large heavy skillet.
Add the sliced potatoes; turn them to coat thoroughly in the butter and oil, then cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Turn potatoes often so they cook evenly.
Carefully add 1 cup boiling water to the potatoes in the pan.
Add the scallions, sage, parsley and season with salt and pepper.
Boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes, until water evaporates.
If potatoes aren't done, add 1/3 cup boiling water and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve at once.
Serves 4; 315 calories per serving.

title: Deer Stew
steps: Cut deer up into small pieces; boil for about 1 hour and a half on medium-high.
Dice onion, potatoes and carrots; add to boiled meat after half hour cooking.
Add all other ingredients and continue cooking for the other hour.
Serves 3 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Cookie Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt butter in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs over butter, then pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Top with remaining ingredients; press down firmly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
Cut into bars.
Store loosely.

title: Frozen Orange Dessert

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate thawed and undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted

steps: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup.
Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Set aside.
Combine condensed milk and orange juice concentrate. Fold in whipped topping and oranges.
Spoon mixture over crust and sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze until firm. Makes 12 servings.

title: Fireside Coffee
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Store in tightly sealed container. Use 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

title: Stuffed Ham

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 onion, finely chopped or 2 Tbsp. onion flakes

steps: Split rolls in half and brush with mixture of butter, poppy seed, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Layer ham and cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Great for parties.

title: Tuna Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients, except pecans.
Chill, then roll into ball.
Roll ball in chopped pecans.

title: Rice-Con-Queso
steps: Spray a 1 1/2-quart casserole with cooking spray.
Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Black Forest Cheesecake
steps: Combine crumbs and margarine.
Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Our Favorite Chocolate No-Bake Cookies(Kids' Stuff)
steps: Form cake in a dragon cake mold with your favorite cake mix and bake.
Get dry ice; place in small container at mouth of dragon.
Decorate with green icing.

title: Lemon Pepper Catfish
steps: Wash fish and place in pan.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning.
Cover.
Broil for 10 minutes, then turn catfish and repeat process, cooking for another 10 minutes or until fish flakes apart.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients and heat.
Serve with egg rolls.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
steps: In a
large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain, reserving liquid, and setting vegetables aside.
In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until soft.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper; gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Gently stir in cooked vegetables.
Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.

title: Marsha'S Dessert
steps: Heat oleo, nuts and flour in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
Press down and let cool.
Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip on top of cool crust.
Mix puddings with milk and let thicken. Pour over cream cheese topping.
Top with Cool Whip and a few pecans.

title: Chicken Veronique
steps: Skin and bone chicken breasts lengthwise.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; set aside.

title: Low-Fat Herbal Hash Brown Potatoes

ingredients.name: or potato
ingredients.raw: 2 small (1 1/2) or 4 large potatoes, sliced thin (about 1/8-inch and about 3/4 inch)

ingredients.name: garlic clove more
ingredients.raw: 5 garlic cloves more or less, sliced as thin as possible

ingredients.name: sage leaf more
ingredients.raw: 8 sage leaves more or less, cut in 1/8 inch to 1/16 inch strips or use dry sage or your favorite herb

steps: Steam potatoes over steamer until sticky and not quite done, still hard.
Include garlic, onion and herbs in steamer.
Turn frequently.
For serving 4, you may want to steam a batch of potatoes, set aside and steam the other half with herbs.

title: Quick Lime Icebox Pie

ingredients.name: graham cracker crust
ingredients.raw: 1 graham cracker crust or baked pie shell

ingredients.name: cool whip
ingredients.raw: 1 large Cool Whip or 1 pt. whipping cream (beat stiff)

steps: Place Cool Whip in bowl and add lemon juice; mix.
Stir in jello and sugar.
Mix well.
May add more sugar, if needed, for personal taste.

title: Date Bread
steps: Mix dates, butter, sugar and boiling water and add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Magic Apple Pie
steps: Combine sugar and egg.
Sift together baking powder and flour, then add to sugar mixture.
Toss together nuts and apple, then add to batter.

title: Easy Rocky Road Candy

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 3 (6 oz.) pkg. (3 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: Melt chocolate chips over hot, not boiling, water, stirring until smooth.
Spread about 1/3 of the melted chocolate in buttered 8-inch square pan.
Cover with marshmallows mixed with walnuts.
Pour over remaining chocolate, mixing slightly until marshmallows and walnuts are coated.
Let set until firm.
Cut in squares.
Makes 1 2/3 pounds of candy.

title: Short Ribs

ingredients.name: short rib
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 lb. boneless short ribs (fat trimmed)

steps: Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of short ribs and put into Dutch oven or a 3-quart covered casserole dish.
In a small saucepan, combine the tomato soup with the molasses, vinegar, liquid smoke and minced onion; bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour over short ribs; cover and bake in a 275° oven for 3 to 4 hours, or until very tender.
Just before serving, spoon off any excess fat.
(If you prepare this dish ahead, refrigerate it and then lift off the solidified fat before you reheat it.)
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cumber Kimshi(Variation Of Traditional Korean Cabbage Kimshi)
steps: Slice cucumbers very thinly and wilt with salt.
Squeeze out water.
Add spices.
This keeps in the refrigerator for weeks.
It gets hotter the longer it sets.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots
steps: In a small saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and ginger.
Add orange juice.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Stir in butter and pour over hot carrots.
Stir to coat.

title: French Cherry Delight
steps: Beat eggs until stiff.
Add vanilla.
Fold in sugar, crackers, baking powder and nuts.
Spread in loaf pan (grease well).
Bake 325 degrees for 20 minutes (let completely cool).

title: Auntie'S Green Bean Salad

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 sliced onion (sliced as you would for onion rings)

steps: Mix sugar, vinegar and oil.
Pour over vegetables.
Cover and place in refrigerator.
This salad will keep for weeks and improves with age.

title: Angel Cookies
steps: Soak bread crumbs in condensed milk to which the extract and coloring have been added.
Add nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Top each with a nut half; bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Cousin Susie'S Perfect Fudge

ingredients.name: butterscotch chip
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. pkg. butterscotch chips (I substitute one 12 oz. pkg. milk chocolate chips)

steps: Combine chips and milk and microwave for 2 1/2 minutes.
Stir and microwave 2 1/2 minutes more.
Add vanilla and pecans.
Pour into greased glass pan and refrigerate.

title: 5 Day Sour Cream Cake

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.raw: 24 oz. fresh frozen coconut (or regular coconut)

ingredients.name: butter yellow cake mix with pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 butter yellow cake mix with pudding

steps: Mix sugar, cream and coconut; refrigerate overnight.
Bake cake as directed on package, except use 3 round pans.
Remove from pans; freeze, then slice each layer in half.
Remove filling from refrigerator to soften while slicing cakes.
Spread filling on top of each layer, stacking them.
Refrigerate for 5 days.

title: Coconut-Orange Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Fold in whipped cream.
Chill several hours.
Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Dorito Dip

ingredients.name: green chile pepper
ingredients.raw: 3 (4 oz.) cans green chile peppers, diced

steps: Brown chopped onions, garlic and salt.
Add drained tomatoes (puncture tomato in strainer to get out most of juice).
Add drained chile peppers.
Cook until all moisture is absorbed, approximately 45 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add cheese.
Stir constantly until melted.
Serve warm with Dorito chips.
Can be cut in half for small gathering.

title: Flaky Yellow Pastry

ingredients.name: egg yolk with enough cold water fill scant
ingredients.raw: 2 egg yolks, beaten with enough cold water to fill scant c.

steps: Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Very gradually add egg/water mixture while gently mixing with fork.
Don't overwork dough.

title: Cornflake Cookies
steps: Beat egg whites, sugar and vanilla together until stiff.
Add coconut and cornflakes.
Mix until blended.
Drop onto buttered cookie sheet by teaspoons.
Bake at 250° until lightly brown.

title: Veggie Burger
steps: Process vegetables in food processor until well chopped.
Mix all with turkey.
Form into burger and bake.

title: Coconut Cream Dessert
steps: Set out 1/2 gallon ice cream to soften.
Roll crackers fine. Melt oleo and combine with crumbs, except a handful saved out for on top.
Pat mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat together pudding and milk.
Fold into the ice cream.
Pour over crumb crust.
Top with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with crumbs. Set in refrigerator for 8 hours.
Cut in squares.
Fast and easy.

title: Joan'S Dip

ingredients.name: buddig beef
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Buddig beef or corned beef

steps: Chop meat and onions (greens only) and mix with cream cheese, soup and sour cream.
Serve with Ritz or Club crackers or with party rye bread.

title: Iris' Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken thigh skin removed
ingredients.raw: 12 chicken thighs, skin removed (thighs are tastier than breasts)

ingredients.name: stove top stuffing chicken
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. box Stove Top stuffing for chicken

steps: Place chicken thighs in shallow casserole.
Mix soup with 1/4 cup of water and pour over chicken.
Cover with thin cheese slices, then place Stove Top stuffing on top.
Bake at 325° to 350° for
1 hour.
Freezes beautifully.
Nice served with asparagus or Chinese pea pods.
Serves 8 to 12.

title: Turtle Cookies

ingredients.name: german chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18.5 oz.) box German chocolate cake mix

steps: Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk.
Melt, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, melted butter and nuts.
Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips.
Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels.
Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Nacho Pizza
steps: Cut tortillas in quarters, making 16 wedges.
Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets.
Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: Hamburg Casserole With Cheesy Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Fry hamburg, onion and peppers.
Let cool.
Cook potatoes and celery and add milk and flour; cook until creamy.
Place layer of potatoes, then layer of hamburg, ending with potatoes on top.
Mix biscuit mix (buttermilk kind).
Roll biscuit dough out flat and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Roll up like jelly roll and cut; place on top of potatoes.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tamale Casserole
steps: Remove tamales from can, reserving liquid.
Remove husks from tamales, cut tamales in half crosswise and place in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Spoon reserved liquid over tamales.
Spread chili over tamales, and sprinkle with cheese. Top with corn chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Serves 4.

title: Greek Potatoes

ingredients.name: envelope dry lipton onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope dry Lipton onion soup mix

steps: Place all ingredients in plastic Ziploc bag and shake to coat evenly.
Place in shallow baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, stirring several times during baking.
Cover with foil if it browns too fast.

title: Mama'S Pineapple Salad
steps: Cook beaten egg yolks, pineapple juice, sugar and butter in double boiler until done.
Thicken with flour.
Pour this cooked custard over pineapple, apples and nuts and chill.

title: Camper'S Cocoa
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container.
Stir in 1/2 to 3/4 cup dry mix into a mug of hot water.

title: Chicken Tarragon

ingredients.name: broiler
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 lb.) broiler or fryer, cut up

steps: Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt, pepper and paprika.
In skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot butter or margarine, cook chicken pieces until well browned.
Sprinkle tarragon over chicken.
Add onion and mushrooms to skillet.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 25 minutes or until tender.
Skim fat from liquid.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown steak and saute with onions and mushrooms.
Add rest of the ingredients and then add sour cream.
Serve over buttered noodles with poppy seed.

title: One Pot Pork Chop Supper

ingredients.name: carrot split lengthwise and in
ingredients.raw: 4 small carrots, split lengthwise and cut in 2-inch pieces

steps: In skillet, brown pork chops.
Pour off fat.
Add rest of ingredients.
Cover; simmer 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Reuben Spread

ingredients.name: sauerkraut and
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. sauerkraut, drained and finely chopped

steps: Mix well all ingredients together.
Serve with rye crackers or rye cocktail bread.

title: No Crust Cheesecake
steps: Beat eggs well in glass bowl.
Fold in sugar and softened cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Grease a 9-inch pie pan (glass) well with oleo.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, filling will sink slightly to form its own crust.
Let cool, then cover with your favorite topping (cherry pie filling, berry, etc.).

title: Nippy Carrots

ingredients.name: onion top celery leaf
ingredients.raw: onion tops, celery leaves or parsley

steps: Use pancake mix and in the place of water in the recipe, use light colored pop (like 7-Up or ginger ale).
It will make the pancakes very light.

title: Tiny Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into 4 rectangles, pinch edges to seal.
Stir together sugar, powdered sugar, and cinnamon.
Sprinkle evenly over rectangles.
Roll up, jelly roll fashion, starting with long side.
Press edges to seal.
Cut each log into 5 slices and place in lightly greased 8 in. round cake pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes.
Combine powdered sugar, milk and vanilla.
Stirring until smooth.
Drizzle over warm cinnamon rolls.

title: Arlene'S Appetizer
steps: Cut off top of bread and take out insides.
Mix all other ingredients in large bowl.
Pour mixture inside bread shell. Replace top of bread and wrap in foil.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
steps: Mix syrup and sugar; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter and then stir in the Rice Krispies.
Pour into a greased pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: Knox Gelatin Squares
steps: Mix unflavored gelatin into cold water.
Mix Jell-O into hot water.
Then mix both together.
Pour into Pam sprayed glass 9 x 12-inch pan.
Set until firm.

title: Potato Stuffing

ingredients.name: pork in
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. salted pork, cut in small pieces

steps: Mix together very good.
May use in any recipe calling for stuffing.

title: Pasta Con Presto

ingredients.name: tightly italian parsley
ingredients.raw: 2 c. tightly packed stemmed Italian parsley

steps: Chop
cloves
of
garlic
in
food processor.
While processor
is still running add fresh Parmesan cheese, Italian parsley, pine nuts, fresh basil, salt and vegetable oil.
When mixture is soft and pasty, spoon sauce over freshly cooked hot spaghetti and mix thoroughly.
Add grated Parmesan as topping.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie(Makes 8 Or 9-Inch Pie)

ingredients.name: rind and juice of lemon
ingredients.raw: grated rind and juice of 1 lemon

steps: Cook in double boiler the egg yolks, sugar, grated rind and juice of lemon and dash of salt, stirring frequently until consistency of thick custard.
Dissolve gelatin in water and add to hot custard.
Mix well.
Cool.

title: Strawberry Angel Squares

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained (reserve 1/2 c. juice)

steps: Cut half of the angel food cake into 1-inch cubes.
Pour boiling water on gelatin in a large bowl; stir until the gelatin is dissolved.
Stir in reserved pineapple juice.
Place cottage cheese in blender container.
Cover and blend on medium speed, stopping blender frequently to scrape sides (about 15 seconds). Return mixture to large bowl.
Stir in pineapple, strawberries and cake cubes.
Pour into square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches). Refrigerate until firm, at least 6 hours.
Garnish with fresh strawberries, if desired.

title: Tea Cookies
steps: Mix softened butter with 1/2 cup sugar, vanilla, flour and baking soda.
Mix in pecans and form balls, about the size of a round tablespoon.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cool and roll in more powdered sugar.

title: Apricot Chicken

ingredients.name: apricot jam
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. jar apricot jam or apricot/pineapple preserves

steps: Place chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Tetrazzina

ingredients.name: red pimento
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chopped red pimento or red pepper (optional)

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. fresh parsley or 2 tsp. dried flakes

steps: Combine and heat soup, water and cheese.
Heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally.
Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley.
Heat through, stirring, or pour into baking dish and heat in microwave or oven until hot.
Serves 4.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add strawberries, pineapple, bananas and nuts.
Pour half into 2-quart mold.
Chill until firm.
Spread sour cream over.

title: Queen Victoria'S Soup(Serves 8)

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken (3 to 5 lb.) or 2 small chickens, cut up

steps: Put the chicken in a large saucepan.
Cover with the stock and parsley.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Golden Pork Chops
steps: Brown pork chops in deep fat quickly.
Pour off grease.
Add soup, water, diced celery, pepper and onion.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for 30 minutes with lid on pan.
Cook on medium heat on top of stove.

title: Barbecue Burgers
steps: Mix together.
Make patties and brown.
Place patties in baking dish.

title: Whiskey Slush
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Freeze.
Spoon 1/2 cup in glass and fill glass with Fresca, Squirt or Wink.

title: Glazed Onions
steps: Peel onions; cut into even slices.
Heat butter in large skillet.
Add onions and toss for a few minutes until coated with butter.
Do not brown.
Add vinegar, brown sugar and curry powder. Stir to blend.
Add parsley.
Cook onions for about 5 minutes, covered, until almost tender-crisp.
Remove cover and cook onions for 2 to 3 minutes, until glazed.
Season with salt, black pepper and paprika.
Add chili.

title: Homemade Salsa

ingredients.name: salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: lots of salt and pepper to taste

steps: Finely chop the first 3 ingredients.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Better to make ahead and let marinate.
May need to drain off some of the liquid that forms.
Serve with Doritos chips.
Delicious!

title: Marinated Sliced Pickles

ingredients.name: dill pickle well
ingredients.raw: 1 (32 oz.) jar dill sliced pickles (Vlasic or other brand can be used), drained well

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. sugar (2 2/3 if you prefer sweeter pickles)

ingredients.name: pickling spice put in cheesecloth is best
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. pickling spice, put in cheesecloth is best (can be used loose also)

steps: In a large bowl, marinate at room temperature for 24 to 30 hours.
Mix occasionally during marinating.
Then you can store in jars (whatever size you want).
If spices are in cheesecloth, throw them away.
Refrigerate.
Keeps for weeks.

title: Picklelets
steps: Beat the egg and sugar until thick and add with the milk to the sifted flour, salt and baking powder.
Lastly, add the melted butter.
Mix until smooth and cook in spoonfuls on a hot grease griddle or frying pan.
Serve with butter, jam or sliced strawberries.

title: Aunt Sandy'S No-Bake Cookies
steps: Cook first 4 ingredients together until they boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from stove and add the other ingredients all at once.
Mix together quickly.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let harden.
The secret to this recipe is to work quickly and time carefully.

title: 7-Up Sauce
steps: Put all ingredients into Ziploc bag; shake to mix.
Add 4 to 6 turkey tenderloins, cut into 2-inch strips.
Marinate for at least 2 hours in refrigerator.
Great on the grill.

title: Carrots And Walnuts

ingredients.name: carrot in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, cut in 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices

ingredients.name: tsp. olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. + 2 tsp. extra virgin olive oil

steps: Cook carrots with water until tender (5 minutes in microwave or 10 to 15 minutes in covered pan over medium heat).
Combine olive oil, nuts, lemon peel and seasoning salt in a bowl.
Add carrots.
Toss.
Serve warm.
Serves 4.

title: Bacon And Egg Bake
steps: Fry bacon until crisp.
Drain fat, reserving 2 tablespoons. Saute onions in bacon fat.
Stir in soup, milk, eggs, cheese and seasonings.
Bake in an 8 x 8-inch dish for 20 minutes at 350°. Top with crumbled bacon and serve over muffin halves.

title: Drop Dumplings
steps: Combine until just moistened.
Drop by spoonfuls onto bubbling stew, chicken and gravy, etc.
Cover and simmer 12 minutes.

title: Japanese Fried Chicken
steps: Blend all ingredients (except chicken).
Add chicken, soak for 20 minutes and deep fry.

title: Texas Rice

ingredients.name: single size envelope instant cream chicken soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 single serving size envelope instant creamy chicken soup mix

steps: In 3-quart casserole, combine the water, uncooked rice, soup mix and onion.
Cover, cook on 100% power (High) for 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling.
Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
Stir before serving.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
steps: Brown the Sizzlean on both sides and drain on paper towels. Stir together the dry ingredients.
Stir in the egg, vinegar and water.
Add the bacon.
Cook slowly, stirring until thickened.

title: Monster Mash Potatoes
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes.
Cook in boiling water until tender. Drain and mash.
Add next 4 ingredients and beat at medium speed until smooth.
Put in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peas And Peanut Salad
steps: Cook peas.
Drain and cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, sugar, dill seed, mustard, vinegar and salt until creamy smooth. (I add garlic powder, too.)
Add peas; blend.
Add peanuts.
Best served that same day.

title: Hot Italian Submarine Sandwiches

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: ham (3 to 4 thin slices per sandwich)

steps: Fill sandwich roll with ingredients.
Add salt, pepper and about two tablespoons Italian salad dressing.
Roll in aluminum foil and bake about 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Oven-Baked Apple-Pecan Pancake
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Mix pancake mix, eggs, water and 1 teaspoon sugar; mix well.
In ovenproof skillet, saute apples in butter until tender.
Remove skillet from heat and sprinkle with nuts. Pour batter evenly over apples.
Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter.
Cover skillet with lid or foil and bake 12 to 14 minutes or until pancake is puffed and sugar is melted.

title: One Dish Supper
steps: Fry turkey burger in large skillet.
Bring tomatoes to boil in turkey (cooked).
Add dry rotini to boiling mixture.
Cook about 7 or 8 minutes or until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Serve with green peas, tossed salad and garlic toast.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
steps: In large bowl, mix all ingredients.
Toss with the Italian dressing which has been made according to package directions.

title: Tuna Or Salmon Dinner
steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed.
Mix all other ingredients and serve.

title: Chocolate Chipper Champs

ingredients.name: m m s plain chocolate candy

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix brown sugar, margarine, vanilla and eggs in a large bowl until well blended.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3-inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Press 3 or 4
additional candies in each cookie, if desired. Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove to wire rack.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: "Buch'Ta"
steps: Warm milk, add yeast and sugar; let melt.
Add the eggs, salt, margarine (melted) and oil.
Add flour and knead dough approximately 20 minutes.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken With Spicy Fruit Sauce

ingredients.name: skinned boned chicken breast half
ingredients.raw: 4 (4 oz.) skinned, boned chicken breast halves

steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in large non-aluminum skillet, bring to a boil.
Add chicken and cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is done.
Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm.
Bring cooking liquid to a boil; cook 7 minutes or until reduced to 3/4 cup, stirring occasionally.
Combine strawberry spread and cornstarch; stir into cooking liquid and cook 1 minute or until syrupy.
Spoon 3 tablespoons sauce over each chicken breast, garnish with green onion strips.
Yields 4 servings, 215 calories and 1.5 fat.

title: Delicious Potatoes
steps: Melt cheese and oleo; mix in half and half, all in pan.
Pour over potatoes and let stand for an hour.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Ranch House Casserole
steps: Melt shortening in skillet over medium heat.
Place meat in skillet and scramble it.
Let it cook until done but not brown. Add all other ingredients and turn heat to low; heat and let it simmer until hot.

title: Sausage Treats
steps: Mix all together well. Make into very small biscuits.
Cook on cookie sheet.
Bake about 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Overnight Tuna Casserole
steps: Reserve 1/4 cup Cheddar cheese.
Whisk soup and milk in 2-quart microwave-safe bowl until well blended.
Stir in remaining ingredients, except reserved cheese.
Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Beef
steps: Fry hamburger and onion until red disappears.
Add garlic, onion salt, chicken gumbo and catsup.
Simmer for 2 hours.
The longer it simmers, the tastier it gets.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.raw: 2 c. boiling water or 1 c. water and 1 c. fruit juice

steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Mix other ingredients together.
Add to cooled jello and chill.

title: Cherry Christmas Cake

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. (2 sticks) butter, softened (can use margarine)

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pecans or walnuts (leave in large chunks)

steps: Beat butter until softened and light.
Add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat after each addition. Stir in almond flavor.
Mix flour and salt together.
Add to butter mixture alternately with milk (about 1/3 each time).
Fold in nuts and cherries.
Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Delicious And Healthy Pancakes

ingredients.name: egg white soft peak
ingredients.raw: 1 egg white, beaten to soft peaks

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. olive oil or salad oil

steps: Preheat frypan or griddle.
In medium bowl, combine dry ingredients.
Add buttermilk and skim milk; stir just until combined.
Fold in egg white gently; add olive or salad oil.
Cook on hot griddle which has been sprayed with nonstick spray.
These pancakes contain no cholesterol.

title: Spinach Dip For Fresh Vegetables
steps: Combine all ingredients and stir well.
Stir before serving. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Sausage Roll-Ups Snacks
steps: Cut smokey links lengthwise halfway through.
Insert long thin wedge of dill pickle (drained) in each cut.
Spread triangle of dough of crescent roll as label directs.
Lightly spread each triangle with cheese.
Place smokey link, pickle side down, on wide end of triangle and roll up toward point.
Repeat with each roll and link.
Arrange rolls on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with melted butter or margarine and bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until puffy and golden brown.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Fudge Topping For Ice Cream
steps: Boil chocolate and milk until thick, about 3 minutes.
Add sugar, butter and marshmallows.
Add vanilla.

title: Japanese Fruitcake Pie(Makes 2)
steps: Mix
butter,
sugar and eggs together (after butter has cooled to
room temperature).
Mix thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients
and pour evenly into unbaked pie shells.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Black Bean Dip

ingredients.name: black bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can (15 oz.) black beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. salad dressing (fat free works good)

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies, drained

steps: Mash beans with fork.
Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended, refrigerate.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Gingersnap Crust
steps: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan.
Remove from heat.
Stir in gingersnaps and sugar.
Press evenly into the bottom of an oiled, 9-inch spring-form pan and freeze until needed.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
steps: Cook pudding as directed on box.
Let cool.
Add cake mix. Mix well.
Pour into greased 9 X 13 pan.
Add butterscotch morsels on top of cake.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Lemon-Butter Broiled Chicken
steps: Sprinkle chicken quarters on both sides with salt and pepper. Melt butter in small saucepan; add lemon juice, tarragon, chervil and vermouth; brush part over chicken.
Place chicken, skin side down, on rack of broiler.
Broil 6 inches from heat for 20 minutes, basting frequently.
Turn; broil 15 to 20 minutes longer or until nicely browned, brushing with remaining lemon-butter.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Roasted Salted Pecans
steps: Toss pecans in bowl with oil until well coated.
Spread on cookie sheet; salt to taste.
Cook at 400° for about 10 minutes. Check; should be a little brown.
Remove from oven and cool.
Pack into containers.

title: Andes Candies Cookies
steps: In small saucepan, combine margarine, sugar and water until sugar has dissolved.
Add chocolate chips till partially melted. Remove from heat and stir until chips are totally dissolved and mixture is smooth.
Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Rice Medley

ingredients.name: pea and tiny onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (17 oz.) can peas and tiny onions, drained (save juice)

steps: Add enough water to reserved vegetable liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups.
Pour into 2-quart saucepan.
Heat to boiling.
Stir in peas, rice, butter, salt and carrot.
Heat to boiling. Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Pan Fried Liver
steps: You will need an iron frying
pan.

title: Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookie Dessert
steps: Mix pudding and 2 cups of milk until smooth.
Add chocolate Cool Whip; set aside.
Crumble 1 box of thin mints in bottom of an 8 x 8-inch dish.
Pour in half of the pudding mixture.
Top with vanilla Cool Whip.
Continue to layer, saving 1/4 cup of cookie crumbs for top.
I use a Tupperware container so I have the cover to store in the refrigerator overnight.

title: Cheese And Chicken Enchiladas

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded extra sharp Cheddar cheese, divided

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cook and stir onion in margarine in large skillet until tender.
Stir in chicken, 1/4 cup picante sauce and cream cheese; cook until thoroughly heated.
Stir in 1 cup cheese.

title: Glaze For Fresh Fruit Pie
steps: Mix and boil one minute.
Pour over fresh strawberries or peaches in baked pie shell.

title: Sausage Swirls
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Blend in vegetable oil.
Add enough milk to make a stiff dough.
Thinly roll out dough (1/4-inch thick) on a lightly floured board into two 10 x 18-inch rectangles.
Spread on sausage; roll up lengthwise.
Chill well and slice 1/4-inch thick.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Better Than Anything Cake
steps: Bake yellow cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine crushed pineapple and its juice and 1 cup sugar.
Bring to boil for 5 minutes.
Punch holes in cake and pour pineapple mixture over cake.
Let cool.
Prepare vanilla instant pudding.
Pour over cool cake.
Slice 3 bananas and layer over pudding.
Spread with 8 once carton Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with nuts and coconut.
Keep in refrigerator.

title: Conga Bar
steps: Melt margarine and add sugar.
Stir and let cool.
Add eggs (one by one), flour and vanilla.
Stir.
Add peanuts and chocolate chips.
Stir again.
Pour mix in greased rectangular pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Apple Pie

ingredients.name: apple cored and
ingredients.raw: 7 to 8 apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps: Fill a 9 x 9-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan full of apple slices. (Spray pan with vegetable spray first).
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon and sugar.

title: Ms. Carly'S Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
steps: Spread cooked broccoli in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Add chicken, salt and pepper lightly.
Mix soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice and pour over chicken.
Top with corn flakes and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Golden Glow Salad
steps: Prepare jello using pineapple juice for cold water.
After thickened, add other ingredients.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad #2
steps: Mix together and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 8 minutes in 400° oven.
Set aside to cool.

title: Fruit Ice
steps: Mix above ingredients in blender.
Serve in glasses and enjoy; it tastes like ice cream without the fat!

title: Anise Cookies
steps: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick; add sugar gradually. Continue beating until sugar is dissolved.
Add anise and beat until thoroughly blended.
Beat in flour to make a moderately stiff dough.
Chill dough for several hours or overnight; roll into a rectangular sheet 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick on floured board.
Cut cookies in 1 1/2-inch squares; place on greased baking sheet and chill, uncovered, for about 1 hour.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cool and store in covered container.
These can keep for weeks. Makes 60 cookies.

title: Simple Shortbread Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll out on floured board (1/4 to 1/2-inch thick).
Cut into desired shapes and arrange on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes.
When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: None Such Mincemeat Prize Cookies
steps: Cream together until fluffy the shortening and sugar.
Add eggs; beat
until smooth.
Stir together the flour, soda and salt. Add to first mixture.
Stir crumbled mincemeat into dough.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375° until lightly browned.
Makes about 6 1/2 dozen.
A tasty, mild, fruity cookie.

title: Cheesecake Factory Key Lime Cheesecake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Stir to coat well the ingredients. Keep it crumbly.
Press crumbs on bottom and half way up sides of 8-inch spring-form pan.
Bake 5 minutes.

title: Ruth'S Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Shake well.
Serve over spinach salad.

title: Mexican Dip
steps: Put in small cake pan in layers:
Bean dip, guacamole (avocados mixed with the mayonnaise), sour cream mixed with taco seasoning, shredded cheese, tomatoes, olives, onions and shredded cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Irish Kisses
steps: Beat up the butter and all the other ingredients.
Sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough.
Drop a teaspoonful at a time on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle with 4x sugar.
Bake in hot oven.

title: Cheese Whiz
steps: Melt cheese and milk.
Add mustard and vinegar.
Put in container and refrigerate.

title: Crock-Pot Mushroom Barley Soup

ingredients.name: mushroom in processor
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. fresh mushrooms, diced in processor

steps: Microwave meat first, or else put in crock-pot and cook until half done.
Add barley and mushrooms, fill pot to within 1 inch of top with stock or water.
Cook 3 to 4 hours until barley is done. Season to taste.

title: Short'Nin Bread
steps: Combine sugar and flour.
Add butter.
Place on floured board; pat to thickness of 1/2-inch.
Cut into shapes desired.
Bake in a moderate oven (325° to 350°) for 25 minutes.

title: Very Berry Surprise

ingredients.name: blackberry
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. blackberry or black cherry Jell-O

steps: Drain blueberries and pineapple (save juice).
Mix Jell-O with package directions (hot water only).
Add juice from berries and pineapple.
Let jell.
Add pineapple and blueberries to Jell-O. Mix remaining ingredients together.
Top chilled Jell-O mixture and chill.

title: Corn Bread Mix
steps: Mix dry ingredients together and cut in shortening. Store in an airtight container.
Take the amount that you think you need and add egg and water.
Bake until golden brown.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
steps: Heat liquid to boil.
Dissolve Jello and let cool slightly. By spoonful, add ice cream until all is in and melted.
Chill for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes and fold in fruit.
Mix well.
Chill till set.

title: Sausage Rings
steps: Mix Bisquick and water well.
Roll the dough mixture thin. Spread the sausage in a thin layer over the dough.
Roll from each end toward the middle for 2 rolls.
Cut down the middle and wrap in Handi-Wrap.
Refrigerate overnight for easier slicing or freeze for several weeks.
Slice 1/2 inch rings.
Bake in 400° oven until slightly brown, around 20 minutes.

title: Angel Food Delight
steps: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler; add beaten egg yolk and cool.
Add beaten egg whites, sugar and nuts.
Fold in whipped cream.
Put broken pieces of cake in bottom of pan.
Pour cool mixture over the pieces of cake.
Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Microwave Garlicy Potatoes

ingredients.name: new potato scrubbed and patted dry
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. small new potatoes, scrubbed and patted dry

ingredients.name: garlic and
ingredients.raw: 2 large cloves garlic, peeled and crushed

steps: Place potatoes in a 1 1/2-quart dish.
Add remaining ingredients and stir to coat potatoes.
Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap.
Cook on High for 10 minutes in a 600 to 700 watt oven or 15 minutes in a 400 to 500 watt oven, shaking dish to redistribute potatoes.
Potatoes are done when the tip of a small knife easily pierces the potato in the center.
Serves 4 as a side dish.

title: Dorothy'S Candy

ingredients.name: white chocolate
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. white chocolate or Eagle Brand candy maker coating

ingredients.name: pretzel stick in
ingredients.raw: 2 c. pretzel sticks, broken in pieces

steps: Melt chocolate very slowly in double boiler; add rest of ingredients.
Spread on wax paper; chill.
Break into pieces.

title: Crunchy Broccoli Salad
steps: Combine mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar to make dressing.
Set aside.

title: Chicken Acapulco

ingredients.name: chicken breast up and
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, cut up and cooked

steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer chicken.
Melt margarine and add flour until smooth, add sour cream until it just bubbles.
Add soup, chilies and onion salt.
Blend well, pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Add cheese and bake until melted.
Serve over rice.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
steps: Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs.
Mix sour cream and soda in separate bowl and let stand until foamy.
Add sour cream mixture to egg and sugar mixture and mix well.
Pour into four greased and floured loaf pans (or 10 mini loaf pans 2/3 of the way full).
Bake 50 minutes at 350° or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cheeseburger Rice

ingredients.name: kraft natural cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. Kraft natural Cheddar cheese, sliced

steps: Brown meat and onion in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Drain.
Stir in water, catsup and mustard; season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice; cover.
Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with fork.
Top with cheese; cover. Let stand until cheese melts.
Makes 4.

title: Favorite Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix squash, nutmeg, cinnamon and sugar.
Mix thoroughly.
Add eggs and milk.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.
(May need to cover edges of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning.)

title: Bulls Eye Breakfast
steps: Cut hole in bread with biscuit cutter.
Spray cooking spray in frying pan.
Place bread with hole in pan; cook on medium heat. Break egg into bowl, then pour into hole in bread.
Cook until almost set; turn.
Put circle cut from bread into pan while egg finishes cooking.
Remove from pan and serve hot.
Makes 1 serving.

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
steps: Blend sour cream and dry mustard; set aside.
Slice cucumber and place in shallow dish.
Pour sour cream mix over all.
Chill. Serve cold.

title: Spam And Macaroni
steps: Cook macaroni as directed.
Drain and set aside.
Cut Spam into small cubes.
Set aside.
In a pot big enough for all ingredients, melt margarine.
Add Spam and cook it for a few minutes.
Add macaroni and all-purpose seasoning and pepper. Serves 3 to 4 people.

title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Steak

ingredients.name: chuck beef roast in partially
ingredients.raw: chuck beef roast, cut in thin strips, partially frozen (easier to cut)

steps: Mix together soy sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic powder.
Add meat strips and marinate overnight in refrigerator.
Cook on barbecue grill on bamboo sticks after draining.

title: Cheese And Chile Dip

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded mild Cheddar cheese

steps: Combine the first five ingredients in a bowl and beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth.
If you use a food processor, use the knife blade.
Drain the can of chiles.
Gently stir in the last three ingredients.
Chill well.
If you wish, garnish with chile strip.
Set out at room temperature before serving, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Rock Candy

ingredients.name: desired flavoring
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. desired flavoring or cinnamon oil

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Cook over medium heat until mixture is dissolved.
Cook over high heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and add desired flavoring or cinnamon oil.
Add food coloring if desired.
Pour into cookie sheet; allow to cool completely.
Crack candy and roll into powdered sugar.
Store in airtight container.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into a glass pie plate.
Needs no crust.
Bake at 325° until browns on top.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until fork easily pierces potatoes.
Cool slightly. Remove skins. Place cooked and peeled potatoes into a large mixing bowl.
Mix with electric mixer until smooth. There should be 3 1/2 cups of mashed sweet potatoes. Stir in butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Mix in spices, salt and evaporated milk.
Pour into unbaked pie crusts.
Bake in a 425° oven for 20 minutes.
Lower heat to 325° and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool before serving.

title: Bread Pudding With Lemon Sauce
steps: Butter square Corning baking dish. Put bread in dish.
Mix scalding milk, butter, salt and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg, stir over bread.
Set baking dish in some water in Pyrex pie plate.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Super Simple Supper Soup

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.raw: 10 to 14 c. chicken broth or bouillon

ingredients.name: each basil marjoram rosemary oregano and spice island fine herbe
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: basil, marjoram, rosemary, oregano and Spice Islands fines herbes (no tarragon!)

ingredients.name: green giant mexican style bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can Green Giant Mexican style beans

steps: Bring all ingredients, except macaroni, to a boil.
Add macaroni and simmer until tender.
Serves lots.

title: Lemon Pudding

ingredients.name: slightly egg yolk
ingredients.raw: 2 slightly beaten egg yolks or 1 well beaten egg

steps: In saucepan, blend sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat.
Stir small amount of hot mixture into yolks or beaten egg.
Return to hot mixture; cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat; blend in butter, vanilla, lemon juice and lemon peel.
Pour into sherbet dishes; chill.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Frosty Cranberry Salad
steps: Combine cranberries and pineapple.
Mix powdered sugar and sour cream together.
Stir into fruit.
Pour into shallow dish and freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer and let sit a few minutes before serving.

title: Heavenly Lemon Dessert

ingredients.name: walnut plu more
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. chopped walnuts, plus more for topping

steps: Mix flour and margarine like pie crust, add nuts and press into bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes; cool.
Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in 1 c. Cool Whip then spread over crust.
Mix the pudding mix using only 3 c. milk, and beat until stiff; spread over the cream cheese mixture.
Top with the remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Chill well before serving.

title: Sweet-Sour Carrots(Serves 8 To 10)
steps: Peel carrots and cut into strips.
Cook until just tender; drain.
Add butter, sugar, vinegar and mint or dill.
Cook until transparent.
Serve hot or as a cold relish.

title: Poteau French Dressing
steps: This should be made just before serving.
Rub the bottom of a small bowl with onion or garlic.
Put in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, a dash of Tabasco sauce and a tablespoon of cold water (to dissolve salt).
Stir until salt is completely dissolved.
Now gradually add, stirring constantly, 6 tablespoons of oil and 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice.
Beat quickly until well mixed.

title: Date Nut Bars
steps: Sift flour; add baking soda and salt. Sift again. Combine with brown sugar. Add melted shortening to beaten eggs and combine with dry ingredients. Add nuts and dates. Pour into greased 7 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut in bars while hot. Sprinkle or roll in powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
steps: 1. Have all ingredients measured and ready.
Line a baking sheet with waxed paper or foil; set aside.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: german chocolate cake mix mixed as directed on box
ingredients.raw: 1 box German chocolate cake mix, mixed as directed on box

steps: Grease and flour long cake pan.
Sprinkle on bottom the pecans and coconut.
Mix cake mix and pour in pan.
Mix butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar and spoon on top of cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Oats 'N Pumpkin Pinwheels

ingredients.name: quaker oats uncooked
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Quaker oats (Quick or old-fashioned), uncooked

steps: Beat 1 cup sugar and margarine until fluffy.
Mix in egg whites.
Stir in combined flour, oats and baking soda.
On wax paper, press into 16 x 12-inch rectangle.
Spread combined pumpkin, 1/2 cup sugar and spice over dough to 1/2 inch from edge. From narrow end, roll up dough.
Sprinkle sesame seed around roll, pressing gently.
Wrap in wax paper; freeze overnight or until firm.

title: Mexican Green Peppers
steps: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seed.
Cook peppers 5 minutes in boiling water to cover (salt added).
Drain and set aside.
Combine next 7 ingredients.
Mix well.
Fill peppers with meat mixture.
Place in a 2-quart shallow casserole.
Pour tomato sauce over and around the peppers.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Punch
steps: Mix Jell-O and boiling water in large container.
Add cold water and stir.
Add sugar and stir.
Add lemonade and stir.
Add pineapple juice and stir thoroughly.
Freeze in appropriate containers (large mouth plastic gallon jugs are good).
Let thaw until slushy before serving and add ginger ale.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
steps: Cream the cream cheese and nuts; set aside.
Drain juice from cherries and pineapple; bring juice to a boil.
Pour over jello to dissolve.
Let cool; add Coke.
Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Party Ham Biscuits
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Cut rolls in half.
Spread sauce over bottom half of roll.
Sprinkle with ham and cheese.
Cover with top half of roll.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
May be frozen and reheated.

title: B L T Salad Toss
steps: Combine tomatoes, celery, salad dressing, green pepper and onion; toss lightly.
Chill.
Add bacon; toss lightly.
Spoon vegetable mixture over shredded lettuce.
Garnish with additional cherry tomato halves and bacon curls.

title: Greek Pizza

ingredients.name: pepper and oregano
ingredients.raw: pepper and oregano or basil to taste

steps: Fry chopped meat and drain. Add tomatoes. Saute eggplant in olive oil, then add to meat mixture. Grate cheese. Set aside. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls. Spread meat mixture on dough. Top with cheese and season to taste.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until crust is golden.

title: Fresh Pickle Slices

ingredients.name: cucumber unpeeled and
ingredients.raw: 2 large cucumbers, unpeeled and sliced thin

steps: Combine cucumbers and onions.
Mix remaining ingredients and then pour over cucumbers and onions.
Stir gently to mix. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease pie plate (10 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).
Beat remaining ingredients after you sprinkle turkey, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Refrigerate any remaining pie.

title: Chicken Rice Dish

ingredients.name: french style green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can French-style green beans, drained (medium size can)

ingredients.name: salt and pepper season
ingredients.raw: salt and pepper to season (if desired)

steps: Cook chicken; save broth.
Remove chicken from bone and cut in chunks.
Saute chicken and mushrooms in butter or oleo. Add the chicken broth
and	green
beans
and
bring this to a boil.
Stir in Minute
rice, then remove from heat.
Cover for a few minutes before serving.

title: Quick Apple Crisp
steps: Pour pie filling into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar; put dry cake mix on top.
Put pats of margarine on top.
Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until top is brown and bubbly.
(Any flavor pie filling may be used.)

title: Grilled Salmon Fillets(Easy; See Marinade Variations)

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil (plus extra for grill grate)

ingredients.name: center salmon fillet pin bone removed
ingredients.raw: 4 center-cut salmon fillets (each about 6 oz. and 1 1/2-inches thick), pin bones removed

steps: Make a marinade by mixing 2 tablespoons oil, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt and cayenne together in large shallow bowl. Add fish and marinate in the refrigerator for no more than 30 minutes. Meanwhile, build a single-level fire. Set grill rack in place. Cover grill with lid and
let rack heat up, about 5 minutes. Rub cooking grate with oil-dipped wad of paper towels.

title: Irish Whiskey Cake
steps: Make yellow cake according to directions, except substitute double strength coffee for water called for.
Bake in two round layers.
When layers are cool, split them in half.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon whiskey on each cut, except for rounded top.
Spread Cool Whip on each cut surface and top.
Stack layers.
Refrigerate 8 hours (24 is better).

title: Nantucket Cranberry Pie
steps: Sprinkle 2 cups cranberries into buttered 10-inch pie plate. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and walnuts.
Sprinkle over berries.

title: Tapioca Jello Salad

ingredients.name: envelope dream whip made according pkg. direction
ingredients.raw: 2 envelopes Dream Whip, made according to pkg. directions

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple or pineapple tidbits, drained

steps: Cook the first 3 ingredients together until thick; let cool. Mix Dream Whip; add to cooled jello-pudding mixture, along with drained pineapple and oranges.
Refrigerate.

title: Cheeseburger Logs
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine tomatoes and bread crumbs in a large bowl; let stand until liquid is absorbed.
Lightly mix in ground beef, egg, mustard, salt and pepper.
Divide mixture into quarters, then shape into a 5-inch loaf; make a ridge down middle of each with your finger.
Place loaves on a rack in a shallow baking pan.
Bake 30 minutes.
Spoon cheese into hollows.
Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts and loaves are crusty brown. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chippers
steps: Cream together butter, sugars, egg and vanilla.
Add flour, chocolate chips and pecans.
Bake at 375° about 10 minutes. (Dough does better if chilled.)

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup

ingredients.name: chicken flavor ramen noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chicken flavor Ramen noodles (3 oz. pkg.)

steps: Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan.
Break block of noodles; reserve seasoning packet.
Stir noodles, chicken, bok choy and carrot into water.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in seasoning packet.

title: Mixed Nut Crunch
steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
In large roasting pan, spread the popped corn and the dry roasted nuts.
In heavy saucepan, combine the sugar, butter and dark corn syrup.
Cook until mixture boils. Boil for 5 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat.
Stir in the vanilla and baking soda.
Pour mixture over corn and nuts; stir to coat.
Bake, uncovered, at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir occasionally.
Cool; break apart.
Store in covered container.

title: Roasted Red Peppers
steps: Place the peppers on a roasting tray and put in a 350° oven. Turn the peppers until cooked on all sides (about 1 hour).
When done, place the peppers in a paper bag.
Wait a few minutes and then peel and slice the peppers into strips.
Place in a bowl with fresh garlic and olive oil and let marinate.

title: Chicken Broccoli

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Velveeta cheese or Cheez Whiz

steps: Cook chicken (cut into pieces) in water with 1 teaspoon salt. Strain and debone.
Use 2 cups broth to cook rice.
Saute onion and broccoli in oleo.
Mix all together and put in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Okra Casserole
steps: Cook and crumble meat.
Arrange in layers in casserole dish. Bake at 350° until vegetables are tender.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
steps: Combine oat bran, brown sugar, walnuts and baking powder in bowl; mix well.
Combine milk, bananas, egg whites and oil in small bowl; mix well.
Stir into oat bran mixture just until moistened.
Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake at 425° for 17 minutes or until brown.
Yield: 12 servings.

title: Potatoes And Sausage Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Peel the potatoes (enough to fill a 13 x 9-inch casserole bowl) and slice as thin as possible.
Grate the cheese.
Brown the sausage.
Alternate the layers of each, beginning with a layer of potato slices, then sausage and then cheese.
Add the milk, salt and pepper.
Bake in preheated 350° oven.
You may have to cover with foil.
For softer potatoes you may want to boil them for a few minutes before putting them in the casserole bowl.

title: Ron'S Biscuits
steps: Dump all in big bowl and mix really good.
Sprinkle pastry cloth well with flour and roll dough out like a cross.
Take left side; fold to center.
Take right side; fold to center.
Take bottom; fold up.
Take top and fold down.
Roll over slightly with rolling pin, then cut biscuits out with top of drinking glass.

title: Carrot-Raisin Salad(Makes 4 Servings)
steps: Mix shredded carrots with combined ingredients.
Refrigerate before serving.

title: Chocolate Rum Souffle
steps: Soak macaroons in the rum.
In a double boiler, melt chocolate with water and 6 tablespoons of sugar.
Mix well.
Remove the chocolate from heat and add the egg yolks one at a time.
Let mixture cool.
Beat egg whites, adding 1 tablespoon sugar to make them more dense.
Fold into chocolate mixture gently.
Line bottom and sides of an oiled 7 1/2 or 8-inch spring-form pan with split ladyfingers.
Add half of the chocolate and then the layer of soaked macaroons.
Add the remaining chocolate mixture.
Top with remaining ladyfingers and cool for at least 6 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Grated Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: sharp process american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cubed sharp process American cheese

ingredients.name: potato pared and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium potatoes, pared and cubed (about 3 c.)

steps: Place milk, eggs, salt, pepper, cheese, butter or margarine, onion and cubed potatoes in blender container.
Blend on high speed, just until potatoes are grated.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake in 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: My Favorite Tuna Fish Sandwich

ingredients.name: tuna fish
ingredients.raw: 1 can tuna fish, drained (your choice of brand)

steps: Put tuna in a medium mixing bowl.
Add enough Miracle Whip to make it look creamy or to your taste.
Cut up pickles and put them in (I like lots of pickles).
Stir it all up and put it on the bread or eat with crackers.

title: Pie Crust(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
steps: Sift into a bowl flour and salt.
Mix oil and milk.
Add all at once to the flour and stir until mixed,
Using the hands, form the mixture into a smooth ball.
Roll the dough between 2 sheets of wax paper until it is a circle about 11-inches in diameter. Remove one sheet of wax paper.
Turn the crust into a 9-inch pan. Remove wax paper.
Bake in 400° oven for 12 minutes or until browned.
If the crust is to be baked with a filling, follow the cooking directions for the filling.
Double the recipe for a double crusted pie.

title: Vegetables Tossed In Olive Butter

ingredients.name: red potato unpeeled and
ingredients.raw: 4 small red potatoes, unpeeled and sliced

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: sweet red pepper julienne
ingredients.raw: 1 small sweet red pepper, cut into 2-inch julienne strips

steps: Mix vegetables and steam until tender.
Transfer to a bowl. Toss with Olive Butter.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Light Strawberry Pie

ingredients.name: vanilla wafer
ingredients.raw: Vanilla wafer or graham cracker crust

steps: Mix sugar, eggs and strawberries.
Bring to hard boil. Remove from stove and add Jello.
Cool.
Whip milk and add to mixture.
Pour into crust.
Chill.
Add a few drops of red food coloring if desired.

title: Individual Pizzas
steps: Cut one pita bread in half.
Spread on ingredients (sauce, cheese, etc.).
Spray a cooking sheet with Pam.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Spray And Wash
steps: Mix together and put into a spray bottle.
Use for removing stains before washing clothes.
Apply just before placing in wash. Be sure to always check for colorfastness on colored garments.

title: Kayla'S Secret Muffins
steps: Cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time.
Add yogurt, mix at medium speed.
Mix in flour, salt, soda and poppy seed.
Put in muffin tins.
Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 14 muffins.

title: Baked Chicken In Sour Cream

ingredients.name: boned chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked, boned chicken (preferably chicken breasts)

steps: Place chicken in greased flat 2-quart casserole dish.
Mix soup, sour cream, broth, water chestnuts and almonds.
Heat and pour over chicken.
Top with cracker crumbs which have been tossed in oleo.
Bake at 375° until crackers are browned.

title: Red Punch
steps: Mix together; add water.
Makes 2 gallons.

title: Frosty Pineapple Punch

ingredients.name: pineapple orange juice concentrate thawed and undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen pineapple-orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted

ingredients.name: lemonade concentrate thawed and undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed and undiluted

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1/2 gal. pineapple or lemon sherbet, softened

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a punch bowl.
Just before serving, spoon sherbet into punch bowl by heaping tablespoonfuls; stir gently.
Serve immediately.
Yields 3 quarts.

title: Easy Refrigerator Roll Dough
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.
Stir in sugar, shortening, beaten egg, salt and 3 cups of the flour.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in enough flour to make dough easy to handle.
Place dough in greased bowl, then turn greased side up.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until ready to use.
Dough can be kept up to 4 days in refrigerator at 45° or below; keep covered.

title: Nuts Over Turkey
steps: Combine first seven ingredients.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with almonds. Bake at
350° for 20 minutes or until heated through.
Makes 3 cups.
Has 300 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Country Butter
steps: Note:
Have oleo and cream cheese at room temperature (soft).

title: Continental Round Steaks

ingredients.name: green pepper crosswise ring
ingredients.raw: 1 medium green pepper, cut crosswise into 6 rings

steps: About 1 1/2 hours before serving:
In large skillet over medium-high heat, cook bacon until light brown.
Push bacon to one side of skillet.

title: Potatoes Deluxe I

ingredients.name: hash brown potato thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

steps: Melt 1/2 cup margarine in baking dish in slow oven.
Mix potatoes, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup and place in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Mix corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine.
Put on top and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Apple Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: dutch baked apple
ingredients.raw: 2 jars Dutch baked apples (not pie filling)

steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add cheese and flour.
Place apples in a 2-quart dish.
Spread batter over apples.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Monastery Lentil Soup
steps: Saute oil, onions and carrots for 5 minutes.
Add all ingredients to one pot and cook for 45 minutes.
Add sherry at end.
Serve with Swiss cheese.

title: Saucy Asparagus

ingredients.name: campbell s new cream of asparagus soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's new cream of asparagus soup

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen asparagus cuts or 1 1/2 lb. fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces (about 24 to 30)

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring often.
Add asparagus.
Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 8 servings.
Preparation time: 10 minutes.
Cook time:
15 minutes.

title: Zombie
steps: Build in bucket glass with crushed ice.
Float rum.
Garnish with red cherry and orange slice.

title: Beef Stew
steps: Mix all ingredients in large casserole dish.
Cover.
Bake at 250° for 5 to 6 hours.
Serve with cornbread.

title: Cheese Quiche

ingredients.name: pie crust mix
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (10 to 11 oz.) pkg. pie crust mix

ingredients.name: jarlsberg
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. Jarlsberg or Swiss cheese, shredded (1 c.)

steps: About 1 1/4 hours before serving, prepare pie crust mix as label directs for 1 crust pie; use to line 9-inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 425°.
In medium bowl, with wire whisk or fork, mix eggs, half and half, salt and pepper until well blended. Sprinkle shredded cheese in pie crust.
Pour egg mixture over cheese.
Bake quiche 15 minutes, turn oven control to 325° and bake for 35 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center of quiche comes out clean.
Makes 6 main dish servings.

title: Favorite Baked Beans

ingredients.name: onion and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 1 small onion, sliced and separated into rings

ingredients.name: baked bean in tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can baked beans in tomato sauce

steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble, reserving drippings.
Set bacon aside.
Saute onion, catsup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce and mustard in a greased 1-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yield: 4 servings.

title: Baked Chicken Coating
steps: Brush chicken with oil and coat with this coating.
Bake until done.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
steps: Cream together sugar and shortening, beating in eggs, one at a time.
Sift flours together; add milk and vanilla.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tostada Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown beef and drain fat.
Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and the taco seasoning.
Mix well.
Line bottom of 2-quart flat casserole with 2 cups corn chips.
Crush the remaining chips and set aside.
Spoon meat mixture over corn chips in dish.
Combine remaining tomato sauce and the refried beans. Spread over meat.
Bake, covered, for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed corn chips.
Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes more.
Serves 5.

title: Broccoli Nut Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli.
Drain. Add soup, mayonnaise and nuts.
Mix well. Add eggs and onion.
Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and top with crumbs. Repeat.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Broccoli & Cauliflower Cheese Soup
steps: Dehead broccoli and cauliflower.
Put in a 3-quart pot with enough water to cover vegetables.
Cover and steam until done. Drain.
Add 1 to 1-1/2 quarts of milk and 1/2 loaf of Velveeta cheese.
Cover.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Hot Spiced Tea

ingredients.name: concentrated orange juice
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. can frozen concentrated orange juice

steps: Bring to a boil.
Turn heat down and simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Polish Mistakes
steps: Fry sausage and hamburger together; drain grease off.
Put in a bowl while warm; mix Cheez Whiz.
Put on party rye bread (rye bread) and broil until bread is lightly brown and crisp.
Watch close.

title: Spiced Apple Loaf

ingredients.name: tart apple
ingredients.raw: 2 c. finely chopped tart apples (such as Granny Smith or Cortland)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
In a medium bowl, mix together flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a large bowl, using a wooden spoon or an electric mixer set on medium speed, beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Stir in the apples.
Stir flour mixture into the apple mixture until the dry ingredients are just moistened.
Spoon batter into the prepared pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about 1 hour. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes.
Turn the cake out onto the rack to cool completely.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole

ingredients.name: mild italian sausage link
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. mild Italian sausage, cut into 1 inch links

ingredients.name: sauerkraut
ingredients.raw: 1 can sauerkraut, undrained (I use Del Monte)

steps: In a skillet, cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender, drain.
Stir in apples, sauerkraut, water, brown sugar and caraway seeds.
Transfer to a 2 1/2 qt. baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for one hour.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.
Make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Ri'S Easy Salisbury Steak
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix all ingredients, except peas and gravy, and shape into 2 loaves.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Place loaves in dish, lightly spray top with Pam to help brown nicely and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour.
Add gravy and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Then add peas to gravy and steak.
Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Custard Pie(My Mother'S Recipe)
steps: Beat egg yolks, butter and sugar.
Add flour and buttermilk. Cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Add extract. Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with meringue and brown.

title: Bbq Rice

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and
ingredients.raw: 1 large can mushroom stems and pieces

steps: Pour rice
in
a large baking dish.
Add soup and mushrooms and
stir
to mix.	Place 1 stick of margarine in center of dish. Bake
in
preheated oven at 400° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Shells Florentine

ingredients.name: jumbo shell
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. jumbo shells (1 c., Ronzini)

steps: Cook shells according to package directions.
Pour marinara sauce into saucepan and heat.
Spoon 1 cup of sauce into bottom of a large roasting pan or 1/2 cup sauce into each of two 2-quart baking pans.
Reserve remaining sauce; keep warm.

title: French Pea Soup

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. green or yellow split peas

steps: Wash peas and put in 6-quart pot.
Add 6 cups water and 2 onions.
Cook on low heat for 45 minutes.
Add carrots and celery. Cook for an additional 30 minutes on low heat, continuing to be sure it remains boiling.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Casserole Sauce Mix
