steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Store in an airtight container and keep in refrigerator.
This recipe makes 3 cups mix (equivalent of nine 10 1/2 ounce cans of condensed cream soup).

title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
steps: Break eggs into mixing bowl.
Add margarine, molasses, sugar, nutmeg and baking soda.
Cream thoroughly.
Work in flour. Transfer dough to a well floured board and knead until it is pliable.
Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 400° until light brown.
Yields 3 dozen tea cakes.

title: Party Casserole

ingredients.name: noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. medium noodles, cooked, drained and rinsed

steps: Brown beef and onion; add Ragu sauce and heat to boiling point. Beat cream cheese; add cottage cheese, sour cream and olives and mix.
In a 3-quart casserole, layer 1/2 beef mixture, 1/2 noodles, cheese mixture, remaining noodles and top with remaining beef mixture.
Bake.

title: Instant Lemon Pie
steps: Mix and pour into 2 graham cracker pie shells.
Chill and serve.

title: Venison Roast

ingredients.name: venison shoulder
ingredients.raw: 6 to 8 lb. venison shoulder or neck roast

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put roast in roasting pan.
Add water, tenderizer and cover.
Cook for 1 hour.
Peel potatoes and cut in half.
Cut celery in half.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and return to oven for 1 more hour.
At end of baking time, remove from oven.
Place roast on platter and surround with veggies.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
steps: Combine five ingredients in food processor; process until blended and cheese is fine as you want it.
Add pimiento; process just to blend.
Store in covered container in refrigerator.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Irish Coffee
steps: Fill a stemmed glass with hot water, then empty glass.
Refill with boiling water and empty again.
Fill the glass more than half full with the coffee and sugar to taste.
Stir and add whiskey. Spoon on whipped cream and drink hot coffee through cool cream.

title: Stuffed Mandarin Ham
steps: Prepare stuffing and let stand 2 minutes.
Add oranges to stuffing.
Place 1/4 stuffing in each ham slice.
Roll ham and place each one, seam down, in a baking dish.
Spoon remaining stuffing around ham slices.
Spoon marmalade over all.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Baked Potatoes And Onions
steps: Peel and cube potatoes.
Put into shallow baking pan and mix oil into potatoes.
Pour dry soup mix over potatoes and mix well. Bake in oven at 350° or until done.

title: Fruit Soup(Servings:  8)
steps: In food processor, blend strawberries until smooth; pour into saucepan.
Add water, sugar, tapioca and salt; let stand 5 minutes.
Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat and add lemon juice.
Chill; add orange sections just before serving.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

title: Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
steps: Combine biscuit mix, milk and cheese in a large bowl.
Mix until a soft dough forms.
Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Mix the butter and garlic powder in a small bowl.
Brush the butter mixture over the warm biscuits.

title: Fast Rolls
steps: Beat well; cover and let rise 30 minutes.
Stir and spoon into muffin cups.
Let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

title: Passion-Orange Pudding Jello
steps: Dissolve orange
jello	in boiling water.
Add passion-orange juice,
then add evaporated milk.
Whip all ingredients together. Let stand for 1 hour in refrigerator.

title: Special K Bars
steps: Bring to boil the white sugar and white syrup; add peanut butter and Special K cereal.
Spread on buttered 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet.
Melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Spread on top of mixture on sheet.

title: Chocolate Drops
steps: Mix sugar, butter and milk in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add oatmeal, cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla.
Blend together; drop from teaspoon onto wax paper. Let set for 1 hour.

title: Linley'S Jello Salad
steps: Mix jello and water.
Let cool and add cream cheese.
Mash with a fork and stir together.
Then add pineapple and Cool Whip. Last, add 7-Up slowly.
Put into square Pyrex or plastic container.
Refrigerate.

title: Buttercream Easter Eggs
steps: Note:
Use 1/4 cup peanut butter in place of 1/4 cup margarine.

title: Mom'S Favorite Hot Artichoke Dip

ingredients.name: artichoke in water
ingredients.raw: 1 large can artichokes, packed in water

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: dash of garlic powder or salt

steps: Chop artichokes to small pieces. Mix artichokes with rest of the ingredients.
Place in decorative baking dish in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Sirloin Roast
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour over roast.
Turn roast over in sauce and cover all sides.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Bake in slow oven at 325°.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in shortening.
Make a well in dry ingredients. Add milk.
Roll out or pat down on a floured board and cut.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.

title: Ron'S Baked Corn Casserole
steps: In a small bowl, beat the eggs with melted margarine.
In a larger bowl, combine the corn and sour cream.
Stir in the butter and egg mixture.
Add the corn muffin mix and mix well.
Pour into a well-greased casserole or Pyrex baking dish (9 x 13-inch or smaller).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (will be lightly browned on top).
Do not overbake.

title: Stroganoff

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can of cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 2 cans of beef or mushroom gravy

steps: Fry steak in pan until tender.
Mix soup, gravy and 1/2 of the sour cream in a pan; heat on low.
Cook noodles in boiling water until done.
When steak is cooked, add to the soup mixture.
When noodles are done add to the rest of the ingredients.
Mix well and let stand for a minute or two.
The extra sour cream is for adding before storing leftovers or if it is not moist enough.

title: Codfish Cakes
steps: Soak codfish overnight.
Drain off water.
Run through meat grinder or chop in food processor with onion and garlic.
When done mix together with eggs, flour and other ingredients.
Drop by spoon into shortening or any cooking oil.
Fry until golden brown.

title: French Fried Onions
steps: Peel onions. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Separate into rings.
Dip into milk, then into combined flour and salt. Fry until light brown, a few rings at a time, in shallow frying pan.
Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with salt.
Serve hot.
Great with steak.

title: Thousand Island Salad Dressing
steps: Put mayonnaise, catsup and sugar into blender; blend 10 to 15 seconds.
Add relish and blend for 2 to 3 seconds.
Pour into jar or container and keep refrigerated.

title: Peanut Pie(From:  "Southern Living" Magazine)

ingredients.name: container whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar, peanut butter and milk in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended.
Fold in whipped topping; spoon into crust and sprinkle with peanuts.
Chill 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars

ingredients.name: milk chocolate
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (about 12 oz.) milk chocolate or semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted

steps: Have ready a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Mix confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter in medium-size bowl until blended.
Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer.
Spread melted chocolate over top.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm.
Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars.
Makes 36 bars at 173 calories per bar.

title: Scottish Timesavers
steps: Measure all ingredients into large bowl.
Mix at low speed of mixer until a dough forms.
Using well floured rolling pin or well floured fingers, roll or pat out dough, half at a time on ungreased cookie sheet to a 12 x 8-inch rectangle.
Cut into 2-inch squares. Do not separate.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Immediately cut into squares along lines.
Cool 2 minutes; remove from cookie sheets.

title: Hot Artichoke Appetizer

ingredients.name: water artichoke heart
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can water packed artichoke hearts, drained

steps: Mix mayo, cheese, parsley and hot pepper sauce in medium size bowl until well blended.
Fold in artichokes.
Spoon into ungreased 2 cup ovenproof serving dish.
Sprinkle with garlic powder.
Bake 20 minutes or until spread is hot and bubbly.

title: Broccoli With Rice

ingredients.name: or broccoli pear
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch fresh or frozen broccoli spears

steps: Cool rice; spread in flat casserole dish.
Parboil broccoli; arrange on top of rice.
Combine mushrooms, mayonnaise and seasonings.
(For thinner sauce, add 1 cup milk.)
Top rice with sauce mixture.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until bubbly.
Serve immediately.

title: Fusilli And Chopped Meat

ingredients.name: fusilli pasta three s
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fusilli pasta, broken into three's

steps: Put small amount of oil in a large frypan.
Cook green pepper and onion until tender.
Remove from pan and put on the side.
Cook chopped meat, then drain all fat.
Return chopped meat, pepper and onion to frypan.
Mix the 2 cans of tomato soup together.
Pour into chopped meat and mix.
Cook pasta.
Drain.
Return to pot. Add soup mixture and mix well.

title: Grandma Arp'S Oatmeal Cookies

ingredients.name: soda dissolved in a little water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. soda dissolved in a little water

steps: Mix well.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Honey Cereal Nibble
steps: To prepare syrup, put honey, sugar and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Mix cereals and nuts in roasting pan; pour on syrup and toss.
Bake at 275° for 45 minutes; stir once 1/2 way through.
Remove from oven immediately and spread out on a cookie sheet or Reynolds Wrap in a thin layer to cool.
Don't leave in pan or it will stick together.
Store in airtight container.

title: Texas Brag Cake

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can cherry pie filling or 1 large can peach slices

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box yellow cake mix (sprinkle over top)

steps: Spray Pam in glass dish.
Layer pineapple, pie filling or peach slices, cake mix, coconut and oleo.
Bake 1 hour at 350°. Add pecans.
Bake 15 minutes more.
Cool before serving.

title: Stir-Fried Green Beans
steps: In skillet, brown bacon until crisp.
Break into small pieces. Add onion and stir until almost done.
Add fresh green beans with 1/3 cup water.
Turn to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Add more water, if needed.
Cover and turn heat to low.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve.

title: Jackie'S Broccoli Salad

ingredients.name: sunflower seed if possible
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. sunflower seeds, unsalted, if possible

steps: Wash and cut broccoli flowerets into bite-sized pieces.
Add raisins, sunflower seeds and onions.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Pour over broccoli mixture.
Mix lightly.
Top with bacon bits.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Fondant
steps: Microwave candy on Roast - a setting that allows sugar syrup to quickly boil and blend into a candy, yet needs little watching. Mix and cook ingredients in a buttered glass mixing bowl or 4-cup glass measure.
Bowl or dish must be 2 or 3 times as large as the volume of the candy ingredients so candy syrup will not boil over. Cover candy during cooking when called for in the recipe.

Use a glass plate or stretch plastic wrap tautly across the bowl or glass measure; pierce plastic wrap so steam escapes during cooking. There is no need to worry that candy will scorch because microwaves cook from all sides, not just the bottom.
Candy syrups are usually stirred once during cooking so heat is equalized and candy cooks smooth.
Do watch candy closely because a microwave oven cooks fast.
When candy is removed from oven, it should register 236° on a candy thermometer.
Do not put a candy thermometer into a microwave oven or it will be damaged.

title: Fast Fiesta Dip

ingredients.name: old el paso homestyle chunky salsa
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) jar Old El Paso homestyle chunky salsa, drained

ingredients.name: envelope old el paso taco seasoning mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 1/4 oz.) envelope Old El Paso taco seasoning mix

steps: In medium bowl, combine sour cream, salsa and taco seasoning. Mix well.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Chicken Rolls
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients and form into log.
Roll in chopped pecans and Parmesan cheese.

title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
steps: In a large bowl, mix well mayonnaise, chili sauce, relish, onion and salt.
Add cabbage and raisins; toss to mix well. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mixed Vegetables Casserole
steps: Mix all together.
Break 1/2 stick of Ritz crackers and melted margarine (1 stick) and put on top.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Potato Soup

ingredients.name: undiluted condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 2 cans undiluted condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: In large saucepan, cook onions in3
tablespoons oil until tender.
Add potatoes; cover with water.
Cook covered 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Blend in soup, milk and salt.
Heat but do not boil.
Serve garnished with bacon and parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Four-Cup Salad
steps: Drain fruit.
Add coconut and chill. Stir in sour cream just before serving.

title: Deep Dish Brownies

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chocolate chips or may use peanut butter chips

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a square 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Blend butter, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs; beat with a spoon.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add to egg mixture.
Stir in chips.
Spread in pan.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes (slightly less for chewy brownies) or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan.
Cool completely.
Cut into squares.
Yields 16 servings.

title: Helen'S Fried Rice
steps: Saute onions in oleo until brown.
Add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes.
Add rice and saute another 5 minutes.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; bring to a boil.
Pour over rice mixture. Cover and shut off heat.

title: Fried Do-Nut Holes
steps: Beats eggs; add shortening and sugar and beat well.
Add remaining ingredients and stir in.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease and fry until brown on all sides.
Coat hot do-nut holes in cinnamon/sugar mixture.
Dough can be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Cinnamon Lemon Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, lemon pudding, cooking oil, water and eggs all together.
Mix in a separate bowl the cinnamon and sugar. Set this aside.
Grease a tube pan and sprinkle about 1/2 of the cinnamon and sugar mixture around in pan.
Pour your cake mix in pan and then add the rest of the cinnamon and sugar mixture on top. Stir lightly and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Yellow Split-Pea Soup With Kielbasa(My Favorite Winter Soup - A Meal In Itself)

ingredients.name: onion lengthwise and crosswise
ingredients.raw: 1 onion, halved lengthwise and sliced thin crosswise

ingredients.name: yellow split pea picked over and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. dried yellow split-peas, picked over and rinsed

ingredients.name: kielbasa length
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths (may use turkey kielbasa)

steps: In a heavy kettle, cook the onion in the butter over moderately low heat, stirring until it is softened.
Add the split-peas, the sliced carrot, the celery, the kielbasa, the bay leaf and 2 1/2 quarts water.
Bring the liquid to a boil, skimming the froth and simmer the mixture, covered, stirring occasionally for 3 hours.
Discard the bay leaf and transfer the kielbasa with a slotted spoon to a plate.
In a blender, puree the mixture in batches.
Transfer the puree to the kettle and thin it with hot water to the desired consistency.
Cut the kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Quarter the slices and add them to the soup. Season the soup with salt and pepper.
Makes about 9 cups before thinning, serving 6.

title: Beaufort Stew
steps: Note:
May increase potatoes, corn or shrimp.

title: Sesame Milk
steps: Bring sesame seed and water to a boil; simmer 10 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients; blend until smooth.
Chill and serve.

title: Pancake Syrup
steps: Simmer sugars and water for 10 minutes.
Add extract.
Doesn't need to be refrigerated but may crystallize.
Reheat.

title: Cherry-Almond Balls

ingredients.name: vanilla wafer
ingredients.raw: 3 c. finely crushed vanilla wafers (12 oz.)

steps: Mix Karo light corn syrup, orange juice and almond extract. Add crushed vanilla wafers.
Mold 1 teaspoon around a candied cherry.
Roll in colored sprinkles. Store tightly covered.

title: Sonya'S Pretzel Dessert
steps: Blend the sugar and butter.
Add pretzels and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.

title: Cooked Onions With A Difference
steps: Peel onions.
Cut off stem area and hollow out an area about the size of a thimble.
Insert a beef bouillon cube in each onion and cover with about a 1/2 teaspoon of butter.
You may have to push the cube in firmly.
Wrap in aluminum foil and place on grill or in a low oven with mixture side up.
Cook for about 1 hour or until the onion is tender.
You won't believe how good this is! Serves 2.

title: One More Chicken Dish
steps: Cook chicken; cool and dice.
Reserve 1 cup broth.
Mix soup, milk and broth.
Cook until smooth.
Fill each roll with 1 tablespoon chicken.
Roll and seal edges.
Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Pour soup mix over.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Turkey can be used, also.

title: Gruyere Potatoes

ingredients.name: size baking potato unpeeled and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium size baking potatoes, unpeeled and thinly sliced

steps: Place potatoes in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine next 5 ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake an additional 5 minutes.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: No Sugar Cookies
steps: Combine first three ingredients.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet.
bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies

ingredients.name: vanilla pie filling
ingredients.raw: Vanilla Pie Filling OR 1 pkg. Jello

steps: Combine pudding mix and Bisquick| mix in a bowl.
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add egg and milk; blend well.
Stir in chips.

title: Buffalo Chips
steps: Brown ground beef and sausage.
Stir in spices and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted.
Put 1 Tbsp. meat mixture on thin slice of rye bread.
Cut slices into 4 pieces each.
Brown in oven for 15 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: mushroom onion red
ingredients.raw: mushrooms, onions, red or green peppers (optional)

steps: Fry sausage and drain.
Sprinkle into the bottom of a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Add Italian bread, torn into pieces.
Beat eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Add vegetables if desired.
Pour egg mixture over bread and sausage.
Refrigerate over night.
Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 40 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Pound Cake(The Best Recipe I Have Ever Tried)
steps: Cream butter.
Add confectioners sugar; add eggs and lemon extract.
Add 1 confectioners sugar box of flour, filled lightly, vanilla and milk.
Mix thoroughly by hand.
Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
steps: Boil raisins in water about 5 minutes.
Let cool slightly. Add sugar.
Add shortening to raisins.
Next, add dry ingredients and mix.
Bake in greased Bundt or tube pan at 400° for 35 or 40 minutes.
If necessary, bake longer and reduce heat to 350°.
Good luck.
Enjoy!

title: Tiger'S Butter

ingredients.name: light chocolate
ingredients.raw: 1 c. melted light chocolate (melt over hot water from faucet in double boiler)

ingredients.name: white summer
ingredients.raw: 1 c. melted white summer coating (melt over hot water from faucet in double boiler)

steps: Mix thoroughly by hand the melted white summer coating and peanut butter in a small bowl.
Add the melted light chocolate to that mixture and stir slightly.
Pour into a wax paper lined pan (approximately 10-inch square) and use a table knife to stir pretty swirls of the dark and light mixtures to give a marbelized effect.
Let set at room temperature until solid.
Cut into squares and serve as you would fudge or roll into balls and use as centers in a bonbon mold.

title: Quick Spanish Rice

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, chopped and undrained

steps: Brown the beef in a skillet; crumble.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients except rice, stir to mix well; bring to a boil.
Add the instant rice; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: One Dish Chicken & Rice Bake

ingredients.name: campbell s healthy request cream of mushroom with roasted garlic and herb recipe soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request Cream of Mushroom with Roasted Garlic and Herbs Recipe Soup

steps: In 2-quart shallow baking dish mix soup, water, rice and paprika.
Place chicken on rice mixture.
Sprinkle with additional paprika.
Cover.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Serves 4.
For creamier rice, increase water to 1 1/2 cups.

title: Angel Bavarian Cake

ingredients.name: vanilla jello pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. vanilla jello pudding mix (not instant)

steps: Mix pudding mix by directions on box.
Let completely cool. Slice cake in thin slices and lay flat in 9 x 13-inch dish.
Pour 1/2 pudding mix over cake.
Top with half of Cool Whip.
Add another layer of cake, then pudding, then rest of Cool Whip.
Top with package of coconut.
Chill before serving.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: In heavy pan put sugar, milk and oleo, stir.
Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes.
Turn off heat, stir and add rest of ingredients. When starts to set up pour on buttered platter.

title: Two Birds With One Stone
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes.
Add the next 5 ingredients and beat well.
Add the chives and dill.
Add the cooked, drained spinach and beat well again.
Put in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Supreme
steps: Cut meat in thin, narrow strips.
Season with salt and pepper. Brown in oil, using an ovenproof skillet.
Add celery, green onions and peppers.
Saute until tender.
Stir in rice, broth and seasonings.
Bring to a boil, cover and bake at 375° until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork.

title: Quick Buttermilk Rolls
steps: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.
Add milk, half the flour, sugar and shortening.
Beat with spoon until smooth and batter falls from spoon in sheets.
Using your hands, mix in enough of the remaining flour until dough cleans the bowl.
Turn out onto lightly floured board.
Cover and let rest 10 to 15 minutes.
Knead until smooth and blistered, about 10 minutes. Shape into crescents or any shape.
Let rise 1 1/2 hours or until double in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pull A Pound Soup
steps: Cut all vegetables fine.
Cover with water.
Bring to a boil and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Makes a big kettle.

title: Champagne Cake
steps: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, club soda, eggs and oil; beat with mixer, then stir in cherries, pineapple and nuts with spoon. Make 3 layers.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.
For added color, use 1/2 jar red and 1/2 jar green cherries.

title: Mozzarella In Carrozza(For 6 People)
steps: Cut bread in shape of a triangle.
Place 1 slice of Mozzarella between 2 slices of bread.
Cover them with flour, then dip in egg, then in bread crumbs.
Meanwhile get oil ready and hot so you can fry the bread.

title: Buttercream Cookies
steps: Cut in butter, shortening and sugar, creaming well.
Blend in almond extract and sifted flour, mixing well.
Roll dough into balls, using 1 level tablespoon of dough for each cookie.
Press and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Place on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in a 350° oven.
Cook for 8 minutes.

title: Festivities Poppy Seed Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and pulled
ingredients.raw: 6 chicken breasts, cooked, skinned and pulled into strips

steps: Arrange chicken in the bottom of a casserole dish.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Stir together soup and water in saucepan over medium heat to remove lumps.
Remove from heat and add sour cream.
Stir in cheese and 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seed. Pour over chicken strips.
Mix together remaining poppy seed, melted butter and cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle over chicken and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Irene Enright'S Bailey'S Pie
steps: Following directions on Knox package, thoroughly dissolve gelatine.
When slighlty cooled, combine with Irish cream and slowly add to heavy cream which has been whipped with sugar and extract until it is almost stiff.
Don't add the liquor too soon, or it might not stiffen.
When combined, pour into crumb crust. Garnish with sprinkles or nuts and extra whipped cream (so dietetic).
For quick setting, place in freezer for a few hours. Can be frozen a few weeks ahead of time and put into refrigerator a few hours before serving.

title: Lemon Custard Cake
steps: Tear the cake into bite-sized pieces.
Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In mixing bowl, combine the pudding mix, milk and sour cream. Beat until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Spread over the cake. Spoon pie filling on top.
Chill until serving time.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Cake

ingredients.name: dark chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dark chocolate cake mix (Duncan Hines)

steps: Mix gently by hand.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased and floured).
Bake at 350° for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost with dark chocolate frosting.

title: Vegetable Bundles
steps: Remove husks from ears of corn.
Spread corn generously with margarine and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Wrap each ear in heavy-duty foil, sealing and twisting foil around ends.
Place on grill for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Barry'S Deer Jerky
steps: Combine all ingredients together and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 to 10 hours.
When ready to dry, remove slices and drain on paper towels; may pat dry.
To dry, spread slices in single layer on oven racks.
Place a pan under racks to catch drippings.
Set temperature at 140° or lowest temperature on your stove.
Open door slightly to allow air to circulate and moisture to escape.
Drying will take 6 to 10 hours.
Turn over after 4 hours.
Jerky is done when meat is shriveled, dark, leathery and chewy.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
steps: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and melted oleo.
Spread in bottom of pan, then pour fruit over the top (the fruit needs to be cooked long enough to melt sugar and make syrup).
I use blackberries or rhubarb or peaches; use sugar to sweeten as needed.
Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: Macky'S Taco Dip
steps: Mix cream cheese and sour cream.
Add taco mix.
Put mixture in round dish.
Layer with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and olives. Pour salsa over all.
Serve with nachos.

title: Dottie'S Olive Spread
steps: Chop olives and pecans finely or in a food processor.
Mix in the mayo and softened cream cheese and pepper adding the olive juice to achieve spreading consistency.
Refrigerate.
Serve on crackers or as a sandwich filling.

title: Featherbed Rolls
steps: Add shortening to milk while milk is still hot.
When milk has cooled, dissolve yeast in water and add to milk.
Add sugar, salt, eggs and flour.
Mix well and let stand in bowl for 20 minutes. Knead for a minute or two.
Shape into rolls and let rise until doubled in size.
Bake in hot oven, 425°, until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Brush with butter after removing from oven. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lasagna Al Forno

ingredients.name: ronzoni curly edge lasagna
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) box Ronzoni curly edge lasagna

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (8 oz.) Mozzarella cheese, diced or shredded

steps: Brown beef or sausage, cut in small pieces, in oil in 3-quart saucepan; drain.
Add spaghetti sauce and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook lasagna; drain.
(Separate lasagna and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.) Spread about half cup meat sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Cover with layer of lasagna.
Add some Mozzarella and Ricotta cheeses and cover with sauce.
Repeat layers of lasagna, meat sauce and cheeses, ending with a layer of lasagna and sauce.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
Cover dish with aluminum foil.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Remove foil and bake 5 minutes longer.
Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling.

title: Dollie'S Soup

ingredients.name: enough turkey
ingredients.raw: enough turkey or chicken broth (nonfat) to make soup

steps: Simmer about 1 hour or longer.
If you use broth that you have prepared yourself from turkey, put it in the refrigerator until fat has risen to top.
Skim off fat and use only the broth.

title: Munching Peanut Brittle
steps: Microwave on High power.
Mix sugar and syrup and microwave for 4 minutes.
Add peanuts and microwave for 3 to 5 minutes until peanuts are light brown.
Stir in vanilla and butter and microwave 1 to 2 minutes.
Stir in baking soda until light and fluffy. Spread on greased cookie sheet to cool 1/2 to 1 hour.
When cool, break into small pieces.

title: Mary Ball Fudge
steps: Mix sugar and milk together.
Bring to a boil and boil exactly 9 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in chocolate bits, butter and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Yields about 5 pounds.

title: Wine Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 3 oz.) pkg. yellow cake mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Beat with mixer 5 to 7 minutes.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
steps: Layer in dish as given, starting with the lettuce.
Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours.
Do not stir.

title: Mousse(Chocolate Or Lemon)
steps: Mix flour, margarine and pecans together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Mix Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl.
Add last 5 ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Osie'S Plum Cake
steps: Mix together in a large bowl.
Pour in tube pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Barbecued Rice Entree
steps: Combine all ingredients except almonds.
Simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in almonds and serve. Serves 4.

title: Molasses Cookies

ingredients.name: each cinnamon clove and ginger
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves and ginger

steps: Mix shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, then molasses; blend well.
Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Combine thoroughly.
Roll balls size of walnuts in white sugar. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu

ingredients.name: boiled
ingredients.raw: 4 thin slices boiled or baked ham

steps: Pound chicken fillets until thin.
Lay out flat and sprinkle with parsley.
Top each fillet with a slice of cheese, then a slice of ham.
Roll up tightly.
Brush each fillet with mayonnaise and then roll in the bread crumbs.
Spray a baking pan or sheet with cooking spray.
Arrange the chicken rolls, seam side down, in a single layer.
Bake in a 400° oven about 30 minutes.

title: Dinner Pork Chops

ingredients.name: chicken and rice soup
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 cans chicken and rice soup

steps: Wash and drain pork chops.
Dip each chop in prepared mustard. Roll in flour, salt and pepper.
Fry to a golden brown.
Drain off fat.
Using the cans of soup, spoon the rice on top of pork chops and pour the soup around chops.
Cover and simmer until tender.
If more rice is desired, cook the cup of rice and spoon on the chops.
(Use an electric skillet.)

title: Butter Nut Cheerios
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with Crisco. Beat eggs until light. Beat in sugars, vanilla, butter and Crisco until creamy.
In large bowl, combine flour with baking powder and salt.
Add sugar mixture to flour.
Mix on low and fold in pecans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
steps: Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.
Pour in dry rice.
Lay raw chicken on top of rice.
Mix together mushroom soup, soup can of water and onion soup mix.
Pour this over rice and chicken. Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
Yield:
4 to 5 servings.

title: Layered Summer Salad

ingredients.name: lettuce
ingredients.raw: 3 c. shredded lettuce or fresh greens of choice

ingredients.name: farmer cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. cubed farmer cheese or other low-fat cheese

ingredients.name: turkey
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. turkey or chicken, cooked and cubed

steps: In a salad bowl, layer the ingredients as follows: lettuce, 1/4 cup dressing, bacon, tomatoes, cheese, turkey or chicken and remaining 1/4 cup of dressing.
Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

title: Warm Springs Apples
steps: Put apples in baking dish.
Sprinkle jello on top.
Mix sugar, flour and margarine well.
Put on top of apples.
Bake 30 minutes until apples are done.

title: Rice For A Crowd
steps: Bring to boil and boil 13 minutes.
Rinse in cold water.
Salt to taste.
Place in large pan.
Cover very tightly with foil. Place in low 150° to 200° oven until needed.

title: Meat Marinade(Chicken, Pork, Beef)

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. garlic powder or crushed cloves

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Marinate meat about 4 to 6 hours. Refrigerate for about 1 hour before grilling.

title: Fruit Jello Salad(Makes One Dish)

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple (in own syrup)

steps: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups of hot water.
Reserve 1/3 cup to mix with mayonnaise.
Add canned pineapple and juice.
Stir in cottage cheese.
Mix the mayonnaise with 1/3 cup hot jello and add to the rest of mixture.
Add nuts last.
Set in refrigerator.

title: Aunt Kay'S Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Steak Sauce
steps: Mix well.
Brush on uncooked meat and let stand for 1 hour. Barbecue and keep moist.

title: Old-Fashioned Cream Pie
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt; slowly add cream and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked shell and sprinkle cinnamon on top.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Broken Glass Cake
steps: Dissolve each Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups hot water.
Put in square pan.
Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water, then add hot pineapple juice and put in refrigerator and let cool.
Add whipped cream, sugar and vanilla, then fold in cubes of Jell-O.
Take half crust mixture and press in bottom of buttered pan.
Put in filling and sprinkle remaining crust over top.
Put in refrigerator to set for at least 6 hours.
Better if left overnight.
Allow Jell-O to set overnight, then cut into small squares.
Set pan into hot water for 1 or 2 seconds.
Jell-O will slide right out.

title: Grilled Marinated Beef(Korean)
steps: Cut meat into serving pieces; score on both sides.
Place meat in shallow pan.
Mix soy sauce, onions, garlic, sugar, oil, sherry and pepper.
Pour over beef and let stand 1 hour at room temperature.
Turn once; drain.
Place meat over medium coals. Grill until desired doneness (allow 15 minutes for medium). Garnish with additional green onion, if desired.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Grits
steps: Cook grits as directed on box.
Add ingredients as listed. Beat hard after each addition.
Bake in a moderate 400° oven until firm and slightly brown (about 1 hour).
Serve at once.
Good with barbecue.

title: Deerburger Pie

ingredients.name: ground deer meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground deer meat (can use other ground meat)

steps: Brown meat, onions, salt and pepper; drain.
Add beans and soup; mix well.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Peel potatoes and cook until tender; mash, using butter and milk.
Pour meat mixture into casserole pan; drop spoonfuls of potatoes on top. Make sure to leave openings in the middle for steam to escape. Bake at 350° until potatoes start to brown.

title: Cheese Potatoes In Foil
steps: Slice potatoes into a large piece of foil.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Crumble bacon over potatoes.
Add onion and cheese. Dot with butter.
Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold. Cook in 350° oven for about 1 hour or until done, turning occasionally.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesed Broccoli

ingredients.name: sharp process american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. shredded sharp process American cheese

steps: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain.
In saucepan, over low heat, combine mayonnaise, cheese and milk. Heat, stirring until cheese melts.
Serve over broccoli.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chewy Bars

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips (can mix with peanut butter chips)

steps: Mix the softened margarine and sugar well.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually add the flour and stir in well.
Add vanilla, chips and nuts.

title: Coupe De Luxe
steps: Combine fruit and juices with brandy.
Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
To serve, fill large stem glasses or goblets half full of fruit and marinade.
Pour the champagne over the fruit at the table.
Serves 6.

title: Million Dollar Cake
steps: Mix ingredients in order given.
Mix well after each.
Grease and flour angel food cake pan.
Spread in cake pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° or when cake springs up when touched.

title: Red Cinnamon Popcorn
steps: Melt butter in medium saucepan; stir in sugar, corn syrup and cinnamon candy.
Bring to boil; continue boiling, stirring constantly, until candy is dissolved completely.
Boil without stirring for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in soda. Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.
Allow to cool completely.
Break apart and store in tightly covered container. Makes about 4 quarts.
(Spray popped corn container with Pam.)

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Stir together all ingredients, using hands or spoon. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place in pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
Serve warm with sauce for dipping.
Makes 7 1/2 dozen.
I like barbecue sauce.

title: Lemon Ice Box Pie
steps: Mix Eagle Brand milk, egg yolks, and lemon.
Pour into crust. Whip egg whites and a tablespoonful of sugar until fluffy. Spread on top of pie.
Brown meringue.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
steps: Put the wafers in a casserole dish; cut the bananas up on top, then spoon on the pudding.
Repeat 2 or 3 times until you use it all up.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Kosher Dill Green Tomato Pickles

ingredients.name: mrs. wage kosher dill mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Mrs. Wages kosher dill mix

steps: Follow directions on package but substitute sliced green tomatoes for the cucumbers.
Process in hot water bath just long enough to seal and change color.
They will become soft if processed too long.

title: Crock-Pot Spareribs
steps: Brown ribs in a pan for 15 minutes.
Drain fat.
Place ribs in crock-pot.
Combine other ingredients and pour over ribs.
Cook on medium for 4 to 5 hours.

title: War Time Cake
steps: In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, water, shortening, raisins, cinnamon, salt and cloves.
Bring to a boil.
Cool.
Add flour and soda.
Pour into loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for one hour and 15 minutes.
For a flat cake, use a greased 8-inch pan.

title: Homemade Salsa Recipe

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: about 6 to 8 finely chopped tomatoes (Roma tomatoes work best)

ingredients.name: green and red onion
ingredients.raw: green and red onions (if you have them)

ingredients.name: jalapeno
ingredients.raw: 1 jalapeno, minced (1/2 jalapeno with seeds removed if you prefer it mild)

steps: Mix everything together and use with Tostitos chips or garnish on your favorite Mexican dish.
It's also very delicious on white chili.

title: Salmon Log
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients well.
Refrigerate for 3 hours.
Form into 2 logs; roll in finely chopped pecans and sprinkle parsley over top.
Serve with crackers.

title: Icing
steps: Beat well.
If adding jello, do not add any water.
Add any kind of jello for any color icing.

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
steps: Mix all ingredients in a pot.
Bring to a boil.
Boil until a few small drops form a little ball when dropped in a glass of cold water.
Remove from heat.
Ready for cake.

title: No Sugar Apple Syrup
steps: Mix first three ingredients in saucepan.
Heat and thicken with cornstarch until desired consistency.
Serve over pancakes, waffles, French toast, etc.

title: Marinated Cheese Squares

ingredients.name: wheat
ingredients.raw: Wheat Thins or other serving cracker

steps: Cut cheeses into 1 inch squares about 1/2 inch thick.
Cover with dressing and pimentos and marinate several hours or overnight. Serve in shallow serving dish with crackers.

title: Honey Date Nut Bread(1 Loaf)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend ingredients in mixing bowl. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tofu Casserole

ingredients.name: shiitake soaked and
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 shiitake (dried mushrooms), soaked and chopped

steps: Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes.
Drain and crumble.
Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Pear Cake
steps: Mix eggs and sugar.
Add oil.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Add pears.
Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Carp-A-La-Shingle
steps: Clean
and
scale
carp.
Melt	butter;
mix with wine. Place fish with butter/wine sauce into aluminum foil, wrapping tightly. (Salt
and	pepper	before	wrapping fish.) Place on redwood shingle
and
bake	at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Then remove fish from oven.
Throw away and eat shingle.	Serves all.

title: Rice Krispies Treats

ingredients.name: regular marshmallow
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. regular marshmallows or 4 c. miniature marshmallows

steps: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, if desired.
Add Rice Krispies cereal.
Stir until well coated.
Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: Creamy Pasta With Mushrooms

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. fat-free mayonnaise or salad dressing

steps: Prepare fettuccine as directed on package.
Drain and set aside. Gradually add skim milk to fat-free mayonnaise and garlic in small saucepan.
Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; blend in Egg Beaters.
Toss with fettuccine and mushrooms until well coated.
Add Parmesan cheese and mix well.

title: South Seas Pot Roast
steps: Place roast in deep pot or casserole.
Mix sugar, ginger, soy sauce and soup.
Pour over meat.
Cut onions in thick slices. Place slices over meat.
Cover tightly and bake at 300° for 4 hours and 30 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Friendship Tea
steps: Combine and store in sealed jar.
Use 1 heaping tablespoonful per cup of boiling water.

title: K.K.'S Monkey Bread
steps: Cut biscuits into fourths.
Fill a small baggie with sugar and 2 tsp. cinnamon.
Shake biscuits in baggies.
Place into bundt pan.
Melt 1 1/2 sticks of oleo and add brown sugar, pecans and 1 tsp. cinnamon.
Pour batter over biscuits.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes and then empty pan.

title: Chicken Tortillas(4 Servings)

ingredients.name: green chily and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 cans green chilies, seeded and diced

steps: Cut chicken into large pieces.
In bowl combine onion, soups, salsa and milk, blending well.
In a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole, layer half the tortillas, chicken, sauce and cheese. Sprinkle with green chilies.
Repeat layers once more ending with cheese on top.
Cover; refrigerate for 24 hours.
Remove cover. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Puff

ingredients.name: bread crumb with tbsp. butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. bread crumbs with 1 Tbsp. butter (topping)

steps: Place broccoli in baking dish.
Mix rest of ingredients and pour over broccoli.
Then place topping mixture on top of broccoli and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Martha'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Combine salt and flour.
Add to mixture.
Beat well and stir in vanilla.
Cook in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 300° until brown.

title: Sweet And Light Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch).
Measure all of the ingredients into large mixing bowl. Beat on medium speed for 30 seconds.
Pour into prepared pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted.
Allow to cool.

title: Moose Shoulder
steps: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes.
Chop garlic.
Brown meat in fat. Add garlic and cover with stock.
Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add cattails for the last 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Oven French Toast
steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking pan in hot oven.
Add brown sugar and cinnamon; mix well.
Arrange bread slices in double layer in prepared baking pan.
Beat eggs with milk.
Pour over bread slices.
Chill, tightly covered, in refrigerator overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve with warm syrup and sprinkle of confectioners sugar.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
steps: Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish and keep hot 1/4 cup roast beef drippings.
Beat until thick and piled softly 2 eggs.
Add to beaten eggs and beat with rotary beater until smooth milk, flour and salt.
Pour mixture over hot meat drippings and bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and browned. Cut into squares and serve immediately with standing rib roast of beef.

title: Batter
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Mix with water and egg.
Use for onions or vegetables.

title: Maple Pralines
steps: Cook sugars, syrup, cream and salt over high heat until mixture forms a soft ball (235°) when dropped in water.
Remove from heat. Add flavoring and pecans.
Beat until creamy.
Drop from spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Hot Dip
steps: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbled; drain excess grease.
In crock-pot, melt cheeses.
Add meat, soup, tomatoes, green chilies and onions; mix well.
Makes a large amount and can be frozen.
Serve with chips.
Serves many.

title: Frosting Mix
steps: Beat cream cheese and sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Spread over cool cake.

title: Flour Tortilla Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. can diced green chilies, drained

steps: Cream the cream cheese and add drained green chilies.
Blend well with mixer.
Spread out tortillas; divide and spread out cream cheese evenly over tortillas.
Roll each one like a jelly roll. Wrap and refrigerate.
When ready to serve, cut in thin slices.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken And Dumplings
steps: In large pot, boil chicken and keep stock.
Bone and skin chicken.
Place back in pot.
Add vegetables.
Salt and pepper. Boil until cooked.
Reduce heat to simmer.
Keep water level high. Add water to flour to make slightly sticky dough.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut 1 1/2-inch squares.
Drop squares into water and let cook until dough is done.
Drain water only as needed to keep from overflowing.

title: Pecan Praline Crunch

ingredients.name: quaker brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) box Quaker Squares Brown Sugar

steps: Heat oven to 250°.
Spray 13 by 9 inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray.
Combine cereal and pecans in pan.
In large bowl, microwavable, combine sugar, corn syrup and crisco. Microwave on high for 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Stir and microwave again for 30 seconds or until boiling.
Stir vanilla and baking soda into mixture.
Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat mixture evenly.
Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.
Spread on baking sheet and cool completely.
Break into pieces.
Store in air tight container.
Makes 9 cups.

title: Goolash
steps: Brown ground beef and onions together.
Add salt, tomato sauce, beans and water.
Let simmer 45 minutes.

title: Raspberry Jam Strips
steps: Mix margarine, sugars, egg and vanilla.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
(If dough is soft, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.)
Heat oven to 350°.

title: Meringue(Swiss)
steps: Beat egg whites.
While beating, heat water, cornstarch and sugar on stove until it boils, then pour into egg whites slowly and add vanilla.
Only needs browned, if desired.

title: New England Style Clam Chowder
steps: Cook potatoes, water and salt until tender.
Cut bacon into small pieces and fry until almost cooked.
Add onion and cook slowly until bacon is completely cooked.
Combine all cooked ingredients in one pot and add milk and clams.
Bring to a boil, however do not boil.

title: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm party roll
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Pepperidge Farm party rolls (20 rolls per pkg.)

steps: In medium bowl, combine mustard, onion, margarine and poppy seed.
Do not separate rolls first.
Split entire roll package horizontally and spread each side with mustard mixture.
Cut ham and cheese into squares to fit individual rolls.
Put one of each on each roll, then top with other half of roll package.
Separate rolls and return to original aluminum pan.
Cover with foil and heat at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Can be made ahead and frozen. Do not heat until ready to serve.
Serves 8 to 10 persons.

title: Puddles(Candy)
steps: Melt together the milk and Hershey bars. Take off stove and stir in pecans.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.
Let chill.

title: Peasant Rye

ingredients.name: onion flake
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. onion flakes or 1/2 real onion

ingredients.name: black olive
ingredients.raw: 1 small can ripe black olives, thinly sliced

steps: Mix all ingredients, except the bread.
Chill mixture for 2 to 3 hours.
Then cut top of bread off and pull bread out of inside of loaf to form a cavity.
Fill cavity of bread with dip mixture before serving.
Use bread cubes for dipping.

title: Low Calorie Apple Pie
steps: Combine brown Sugar Twin, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add apples and mix together.
Place in pie shell and dot with 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.
Makes 8 servings at 231 calories per serving.

title: Chicken Soup
steps: Go to the store and buy a can of chicken soup.
Put it in a small bowl, then microwave for 15 minutes.
You can eat it with a spoon.

title: Veal Veggie Loaf

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. chopped veal or combo of veal and turkey

steps: In the microwave:
Mix 1/2 of your spaghetti sauce with all your ingredients.
Using a quiche pan (micro-safe) form a loaf in a circle, leaving the center empty.
Pour the rest of spaghetti sauce over the top of the circular meat loaf.
Cook on High for 12 minutes.
Pour off drippings.
Cook on High approximately 5 minutes more (depending on your microwave).
Serve with peas or another green vegetable in the center.

title: The Best Potato Salad

ingredients.name: salt pepper and cayenne
ingredients.raw: dash of salt, pepper and cayenne

steps: Boil potatoes with their skins until tender (red potatoes are best).
Hard-boil 12 large eggs.

title: Joe C.'S Salad
steps: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip with dry jello.
Add drained fruit.
Quick, easy and a refreshing taste for any lunch or dinner.

title: Quick White Sauce
steps: Melt butter and flour; stir 3 to 4 minutes until blended. Slowly stir in milk.
Cook and stir until thick and smooth.

title: Magic Lemon Pie

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: lemon peel
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. grated lemon peel (fresh or dried)

steps: Blend together milk, lemon juice, lemon peel and yolks until thickened.
Turn into pie shell.

title: Spinach Salad(If You Like Spinach, You Will Love This Spinach Salad!)
steps: Wash spinach and break into small pieces in a large bowl.
Add bacon, eggs and bean sprouts and lightly toss.
Top with croutons and this dressing:

title: Lemon Custard
steps: Put sugar and rind into food processor.
Blend well.
Add egg yolks, juice and cooled butter; blend.
Warm on stove about 10 minutes.
Do not boil.
Put into puffed pastry.

title: Peach Fuzz

ingredients.name: pink lemonade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed

steps: In blender, combine peaches, orange juice, rum and lemonade concentrate.
Blend until smooth. Gradually add ice, blending at low speed, until slush consistency. Serve immediately.

title: Tuna Cakes
steps: Combine all ingredients, except margarine and shape into 6 equal patties.
In a 10-inch skillet, heat margarine until hot and bubbly.
Add patties and cook over medium heat, turning once, until brown on both sides.

title: Original Pecan Pralines

ingredients.name: mixed pecan and half
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. mixed pecan pieces and halves

steps: Combine sugar and water in a 2-quart saucepan.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Stir in pecans.
Cook until mixture reaches soft ball stage, 235°.
Remove from heat.
Stir in butter. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
Let stand until firm.
Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Crumble Blue cheese with a fork and mix with mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, chives and pepper.
Add sour cream and buttermilk.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.
Add additional buttermilk to achieve preferred consistency.
Will keep refrigerated 1 month.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients with mixer, except chocolate pie crust. Put mixed ingredients in the chocolate pie crust.
Freeze for 1 hour.

title: Emily'S Fudge Cake
steps: Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch cake pan; set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix ingredients together in large bowl until well blended.
Put in pan; bake for 25 minutes, until done.
When cool, frost with favorite chocolate frosting (butter frosting suggested).

title: Caramel Apple Dip
steps: Mix brown sugar and butter in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add vanilla.
Pour mixture over cream cheese and blend thoroughly.
Use as a dip for sliced apples.

title: Angel Puffs
steps: Beat egg whites until very stiff.
Add sugar gradually. Continue beating until very, very stiff.
Add salt and vanilla. Drop by large heaping tablespoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Using back of spoon, make indentation to hold whipped cream.
Bake in 250° (slow) oven about 1 hour.

title: Honey'S Cabbage Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage, celery, green pepper and onion.
Mix together sugar, celery seed, salt, vinegar and mustard seed.
Mix sauce before shredding cabbage and let stand after shredding all ingredients.
Pour sauce over ingredients.
Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Low-Fat Brownies

ingredients.name: family size duncan hine brown mix
ingredients.raw: 1 family size Duncan Hines brownie mix

ingredients.name: low fat vanilla yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. low-fat vanilla yogurt or 1/2 c. plain yogurt with 1 tsp. vanilla

steps: Combine box mix, yogurt and egg whites.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 22 to 24 minutes at 350°.

title: Crabmeat Spread
steps: Mix ingredients.
Put into small casserole dish and bake at 325° for about 15 to 20 minutes. Top with slivered almonds. Serve with crackers.

title: Caramel Bars

ingredients.name: chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 package chocolate cake mix (kind with pudding in mix)

steps: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Combine remaining milk with cake mix, melted margarine and mix well.
Press half of cake mix into bottom of 9x13 greased pan.
Bake at 350 for 6 minutes.
Sprinkle one cup nuts, coconut and chocolate pieces over crust, pour caramel mixture on and top with teaspoons of remaining cake mix, pressing gently into caramel mix.
Sprinkle with remaining nuts, pressing lightly into top.
Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.
Cool slightly, refrigerate (2 dozen).

title: Vivian'S Pumpkin Roll
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a well-greased sheet cake pan. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Remove cake from pan onto a tea towel covered with powdered sugar.
Roll up towel and cake together.
Put in freezer for 30 minutes.
While cake is cooling, make the filling.

title: Red Cabbage Relish

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 1 medium red or yellow onion, minced

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in mixing bowl.
Sprinkle with salt.
Let stand 1 hour.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill at least 1 hour.
Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Texas Dip

ingredients.name: picante sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 small jar picante sauce (as hot as you like it)

steps: Brown meats and drain.
Melt cheese in a microwave-proof dish. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and mix well.
Let crock-pot warm all ingredients and keep the crock-pot on low while serving. Stir occasionally to keep it from sticking to the bottom.
Serve with lightly salted tortilla chips.
Great for tailgating, parties or other social gathering.
May not look very appetizing, but it tastes delicious.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Serve on crackers.

title: Pineapple Muffins

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) cans crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Mix milk, 1 can pineapple with juice, egg whites and oil.
Combine with dry ingredients and mix.
Add second can of pineapple.
Bake after lining muffin pans with paper baking cups at 425° for 17 minutes.
Makes 12.

title: Cheesy Zucchini Casserole
steps: Put all ingredients into greased casserole in 2 layers with the cheese on top.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pineapple Au Gratin
steps: Mix together the pineapple chunks, Cheddar cheese, sugar and flour.
Put in baking dish.
Crumble Ritz crackers over this mixture.
Pour melted margarine on top of crackers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin And Streusel Muffins

ingredients.name: pillsbury nut quick bread mix
ingredients.raw: 16.6 oz. pkg. Pillsbury nut quick bread mix

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease bottoms only of 12 muffin cups.
In large bowl, combine all muffin ingredients; stir 50 to 75 strokes until dry particles are moistened, breaking up any lumps.
Divide batter evenly among prepared muffin cups.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine strawberry supreme cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines strawberry supreme cake mix

ingredients.name: container whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.
Prepare, bake and cool cake following package directions. Place cake layer on cooling racks in jelly-roll pan.
Freeze 2 hours or until cake layers are firm.
Place cake layer on serving plate.
Spread softened ice cream to edges.
Place second layer on top of ice cream.
Freeze assembled cake until ice cream is firm. Frost sides and top of cake with whipped topping.
Garnish with fresh strawberries.
Store in freezer until ready to serve.

title: Bourbon Franks

ingredients.name: mini cocktail frank
ingredients.raw: 4 (8 oz. each) pkg. mini cocktail franks or 2 (16 oz. each) pkg. franks, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: In large saucepan, mix all ingredients, except franks.
Cover and simmer at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
(Can be made ahead to this point.
Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Reheat sauce until hot.)
Add franks and simmer until heated through (about 5 to 10 minutes).

title: Lentil Soup
steps: Cook ham hock until meat pulls apart.
Remove meat from bone. Pour lentils into the ham stock.
Refrigerate overnight.
Dice onion and carrot; add to stock.
Cook until lentils are tender.

title: Slushy Punch
steps: Mix and freeze all ingredients.
Take out about 3 hours before serving and pour in ginger ale.

title: Cherry Crunch
steps: Pour cherry filling in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Pour cake mix on top.
Pour melted butter on top of those.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake pie crust 10 minutes and remove. Reduce oven to 325°.
Over low heat, melt chips with butter.
In a large mixing bowl, beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients, except nuts, until smooth.
Then add nuts.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set.
Cool. Serve with warm ice cream if desired.

title: Hot Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in small crock-pot until melted. Serve with crackers.

title: Get Well Chicken Meal Soup
steps: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt and pepper and garlic salt as needed.
Add celery.
Cover chicken and celery with water. Boil until tender.
Take off fire for 15 minutes.
Put back on fire.
Add 1/2 cup corn meal.
Boil 4 or 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Swedish Pot Roast
steps: Mix salt, pepper and cinnamon.
Rub spice mixture on both sides of roast.
Brown roast in some oil in a roaster.
Now mix the vinegar and brown sugar together and pour over the roast.
Add onions and bay leaves and pot in oven. Bake for 3 - 4 hours at 350 degrees.

title: Brownie Fudge Nut Pie
steps: In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir condensed milk, margarine and cocoa until margarine melts and mixture is warm. Remove from heat.
Stir in eggs, flour, vanilla and chopped nuts. Pour into prepared crust.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until center is firm.
Serve warm or cold, topped with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Impossible Egg Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Grease two 9-inch pans or baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Add one can coconut to make coconut pie.

title: Cajun Fried Turkey(For A Crowd)

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chopped peppers (your choice of green, jalapeno or banana or a combination of all three)

steps: Thaw turkey completely.
Season outside of turkey by personal preference.
Preheat oven to 500°.
Put turkey in aluminum pan. Add 10 cups boiling water.
Seal pan with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.
Cook 12 to 14 pounds for 1 hour, or 20 pounds for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Turn oven off.
Leave overnight.
This is the crucial key.
Do not open oven door at all!
(This actually steams turkey.)

title: Southern Maryland Stuffed Ham
steps: Cut/tear up cleaned greens.
Combine with cabbage, celery and red pepper.
Place ham on clean cheese cloth.
Make small slits all around the ham.
Stuff the green mixture into the slits.
Tie 1 package cheesecloth around the ham and place in a roaster that is half filled with water.
Boil for at least 1 hour or until ham is done.
Remove cheesecloth and serve.

title: Cauliflower Delight(Diet)

ingredients.name: cauliflower separated floweret
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cauliflower, separated into flowerets

steps: Cook cauliflower in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender-crisp.
Drain.
Mix pickle liquid, sweetener, garlic and onion in a small bowl.
Pour over cauliflower, pickles and radishes in bowl.
Toss to marinate.
Cover in refrigerator for 12 hours, stirring occasionally.
Drain before serving.

title: Blackberry Wine Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow cake mix sifted
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix, sifted

steps: Mix together all ingredients on low speed until moistened. Mix on medium for 2 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Ham Casserole(Great For Christmas Brunch!)
steps: Sprinkle cracker crumbs in buttered casserole.
On top of cracker crumbs, layer half of chopped eggs, 1/4 of sauces, half of ham and 1/4 of sauces.
Repeat layers, topping with crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Ladson'S Potato Pone
steps: Mix all ingredients
and
cook on top of stove in heavy iron skillet, stirring
frequently.
Must
cook	slowly on low heat. When almost done put in baking pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Beef Roast Of Beef

ingredients.name: potato pared and
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 potatoes, pared and thinly sliced

ingredients.name: carrot pared and
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 carrots, pared and thinly sliced

ingredients.name: brisket rump roast
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 lb. brisket, rump roast or pot roast

steps: Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Salt and pepper meat, then put in pot. Add liquid. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours).
Remove meat and vegetables with spatula and thicken for gravy, if desired.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
steps: Bring oil and water to a boil.
Stir in flour.
While mixture is still warm, put into 9-inch pie plate and proceed with filling; bake.

title: Jello Salad For Angels
steps: Tear cake and fill 13 x 9-inch pan with pieces.
Mix all other ingredients and pour over cake pieces.
Refrigerate until set, approximately 1 hour.

title: Bread Pot Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: firm loaf bread
ingredients.raw: 1 round firm loaf bread (8 to 10-inch diameter)

ingredients.name: mild
ingredients.raw: 3 oz. mild or hot green chilies, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: assorted veggy and cracker dipping
ingredients.raw: assorted raw veggies and crackers for dipping

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Slice off top of bread.
Reserve top. Hollow out to 1/2-inch shell.
Combine Cheddar, sour cream and cream cheese in bowl.
Add ham, onion, chilies and Worcestershire sauce.
Spoon cheese filling into bread shell; replace top of bread.
Tightly wrap loaf in several layers of foil.
Set on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Stir filling before serving.
Remaining bread can be made into croutons.

title: To Turn Cooper Green(Antique Look)
steps: Use 2 to 1 parts water with muratic acid.
Sprinkle salt evenly over copper dipped in acid solution.
Let dry.

title: Refrigerator Cukes
steps: Soak cukes in salt and ice for 2 hours.
Drain well.
Heat the remaining ingredients (except onions) for 5 minutes, then cool. Add onions and mix together.
Put into refrigerator in quart or gallon jars or Tupperware.

title: Broccoli Salad(Serves 16)

ingredients.name: broccoli flower and tender stem
ingredients.raw: 6 c. chopped raw broccoli, flower and tender stems

steps: Toss first four ingredients when ready to serve.
Add dressing last.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
Serves 16.

title: Salad Dressing Cake(Heritage Recipe)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Sift all dry ingredients together.
Then add others, I use Crisco Oil in pan sparingly. (No flour.)
Bake.

title: Canned Vinegar Beans

ingredients.name: besan
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bag dried beans (your choice of type)

steps: Boil all ingredients, except beans, for 25 minutes. Fill jars with beans and pour vinegar mixture over beans.
Scald.

title: Brandy Smash
steps: Bring to a boil for 1 minute, 9 cups of water and 2 cups of sugar.
Take off stove and add 1 (12 ounce) can frozen orange juice and lemonade.
Let cool.
Add brandy.
Stir and put in a gallon bucket; put in freezer.
Let sit for 24 hours.
Put 2/3 cup Smash in glass and add 7-Up to fill glass.
Serve with a straw.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni.
Melt butter in saucepan; take off heat and add flour.
Blend well; add milk slowly until blended with flour mixture (no lumps).
Return to heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
Heat oven to 250° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Grate cheese mix all together in baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Pork Lo Mein
steps: Slice pork thinly and shred into match-stick sized strips. Shred cabbage.
Cut scallions into 1-inch sections.
Heat oil until very hot in wok or heavy skillet.
Add salt; then scallions. Stir-fry 45 seconds.
Add pork.
Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes.
Add cabbage and mushrooms.
Stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add spaghetti and soy sauce.
Toss with rest of mixture.
Cover and cook 5 minutes over medium heat.
Serves 6 to 8. Contains 340 calories and 7 grams fat per serving.

title: Molly'S Seafood Crepes
steps: Use mixing method of your choice.
Cook 45 to 60 seconds, preferably in crepe iron.
Makes 14 to 16 crepes.
Prepare crepe filling as follows.

title: Yeast Hot Rolls
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Turn to 325°.
Place rolls in oven.
Mix yeast in water until dissolved.
Mix salt with flour, then mix all together well.
Make rolls on floured board.
Let rise for 3 hours. Bake in a 325° oven.
Heat oven to 400°; then turn down heat to 325° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Mix together cream cheese and sugar.
Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell and top with pie filling.
Chill for about 1 hour.

title: Dip For Fruit
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Add sugar and marshmallow cream.
Stir well.

title: Sweet Cucumber Relish
steps: Remove pulp from cukes (do not peel unless ripe).
Grind with meat grinder (fine) the cukes, onions and peppers.
Put in layers and sprinkle salt between each layer.
Let stand overnight.
Drain well in morning.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a full rolling boil and boil 10 minutes.
Pack in hot jars.

title: Butterscotch Cheese Crunchies
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine over hot (not boiling) water the butterscotch morsels and butter.
Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.
Transfer to large bowl.
Stir in graham cracker crumbs and walnuts with a fork until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Reserve 2 cups for topping.
Press remaining mixture into 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch ungreased baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts.
Mix flour and shortening until crumbly.
Add milk and stir with fork.
Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth.
Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Add fruit on top.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices, 1/2 inch thick.
Place in pan with melted butter.
Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid, but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Cake
steps: Roll
biscuit
in sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Put in a well greased tube or loaf pan.
Cream together 1/4 cup margarine and 1 cup brown sugar.
Pour over cake.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pat'S Cheese Cake
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 1/3 cups sugar, eggs and 1 tablespoon vanilla.
Pour into baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Set aside for 20 minutes; leave oven on.
Mix sour cream, 6 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons vanilla.
Pour on top of cake and spread.
Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Holiday Fruitcake

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: mixed candied fruit
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (1 lb. jar) mixed candied fruit

steps: Break mincemeat into pieces in medium size saucepan.
Add water; stir over medium heat until lumps are broken.
Boil 1 minute; stir occasionally.
Cool.

title: Old-Time Biscuit Pudding
steps: Soak biscuits in milk, making a thin batter.
Add remainder of ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Bake at 400° until done.

title: Corn Pudding(Kentucky Style)

ingredients.name: or kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 2 c. drained cooked or canned whole kernel corn

steps: Combine ingredients; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Set in a shallow pan filled to 1 inch with hot water.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Let stand for 10 minutes at room temperature before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pina Colada Dip
steps: Whisk all ingredients together, except the whipping cream. Cook in the top of a double boiler until boiling and thick, stirring constantly.
Cool in a refrigerator until serving time. Just before serving, whip 1 cup of whipping cream until fluffy. Fold whipped cream into mixture and serve.

title: No Crust Pizza
steps: Fry beef and sausage together until done; drain.
Cook and drain macaroni.
Divide meat and macaroni equally into 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans.
Add equal amounts of sauce; mix well.
Top with pepperoni and cheese.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
(Can also be frozen before baking.)

title: Golden Cheddar Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: sharp natural cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

ingredients.name: broccoli pear and
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained

steps: Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; stir in flour and salt.
Add milk gradually, mixing until smooth.
Cook until mixture boils, stirring constantly.
Add cheese, stirring until melted.
Mix in 1/4 cup corn flakes and corn.
Arrange broccoli in a 7 1/2 x 11 3/4-inch baking dish.
Pour cheese sauce over broccoli.
Toss remaining 1/2 cup crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted margarine.
Sprinkle crumb mixture over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. cubed hash brown potatoes

steps: Mix ingredients together and put in greased 9 x 13-inch.
Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes mixed with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Tremendous Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Peel and slice the potatoes and add chopped onion.
Simmer in a very small amount of water for 1 minute.
Grate the cheese and combine with mushroom soup.
Add no water.
Alternate layers of sliced potatoes and cheese and soup mixture in greased casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Joyce'S Dip

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato with green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies

steps: In crock-pot or double boiler; put tomatoes in and cut up cheese and put in.
Let cheese melt.
Brown ground chuck or beef and onions; drain.
Add to cheese and tomatoes mixture.

title: Chicken And Cabbage
steps: Cut the cabbage core off, then wash cabbage.
Peel cabbage leaves so you can make layers.

title: Cream Filled Torte
steps: Whip cream with powdered sugar and flavoring.
Arrange 9 graham crackers in a square on a plate.
Spread with a thin layer of whipped cream and top with thinly sliced bananas.
Repeat 4 times.
Top with another layer of crackers.
Frost sides and top with remaining cream.
Coat sides with chopped nuts and put remaining on top.
Chill about 3 hours and cut in squares.
Is better if left overnight.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown meat; drain.
Stir in next 5 ingredients.
Heat until bubbly.
Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles.
Place cut side down around edge of casserole pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are brown.
Take out; top with cheese and return to oven until melted.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Peach Jello Salad
steps: Cook until thick.
Be sure and let cool and mix with one package of Dream Whip, prepared as directed.
Fold into cool mixture and spread on jello.

title: Great Creamed Potatoes
steps: Pare potatoes.
Boil until tender; drain.
Beat softened cream cheese and sour cream until well blended.
Add hot potatoes, gradually beating until light and fluffy.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Put in 2-quart casserole.
Dot with butter. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Southwestern Shrimp

ingredients.name: jalapeno
ingredients.raw: 1 finely chopped jalapeno (remove seeds for milder dish)

steps: Peel and devein shrimp; cut in half.
Heat oil in nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Saute onion, cilantro and jalapeno for 5 minutes.	Stir in tomato sauce. Add shrimp and stir until shrimp turns pink. Serve over white rice. Serves 2.

title: Party Pizzas
steps: Brown
meat and drain.
Add seasoning.
Mix with cheese until melted.
Spread over rye bread.
Broil slices on cookie sheet until golden brown.

title: Golden Glazed Chicken
steps: In shallow baking dish, arrange chicken and brush with butter. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Baste once with pan drippings. Combine remaining ingredients; spoon over chicken.
Bake 15 minutes more, or until chicken is done.

title: Impossible Spinach Pie

ingredients.name: oz. spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. 10 oz. frozen spinach, thawed and drained

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease pie plate.
Mix spinach, cheese and onion in plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into pie plate.
Bake until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
About 30 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Put into a 9-inch pie pan and bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Set aside.
Cream together cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Pour into crust and bake 20 minutes.
Cool.

title: Mama'S Homecooking Fried Muskrat
steps: First, trap muskrat.
Then skin muskrat, then cut into 4 pieces.
Once this is completed, dip into egg and milk, then roll into flour, cracker meal, salt and pepper.

title: Fruit Yogurt Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 20 oz. can chunk pineapple, drained (reserve liquid)

ingredients.name: mandarin orange
ingredients.raw: 11 oz. can mandarin oranges, drained (reserve liquid)

steps: Cook liquids and cornstarch until thick, cool.
Combine yogurt, sugar and vanilla and mix with cooled mixture.
Stir in fruit and chill.
Be creative and add different kinds of fruits.

title: Bread Machine Bread
steps: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order listed, measuring carefully and using a knife to scrape off the excess. Bake as directed by the directions on the bread machine. Makes 1 1/2 lb. loaf.
(You may also use the dough setting on your machine and when the dough is ready, form it into dinner rolls. Let them rise until doubled in size, then bake at 375° until brown.)

title: Good Rich Yeast Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar in lukewarm water.
Sift flour with remaining sugar and salt; add eggs, milk, shortening and cooled yeast.
Mix. Turn dough onto floured board and knead.
Pinch off and roll into golf ball size balls; place in greased muffin pans.
Let rise (covered with light cloth).
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
Yields about 36 rolls.

title: Oat Bran Muffins
steps: Add all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Put in muffin pans.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

title: Bonnymill Baked Eggs

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 2 c. diced ham or cooked crumbled sausage

steps: Beat eggs in large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat well.
Pour into an oiled 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° until mixture is set and top is golden, about 45 minutes.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pecan Crispies
steps: Set oven to 375°.
Cream butter and sugars until light.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients; blend into creamed mixture.
