Stir in nuts and drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake about 10 minutes.
Cool slightly before removing from pan.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Hot Antipasto Casserole

ingredients.name: red roasted pepper
ingredients.raw: 2 (7 oz.) jars sliced red roasted peppers

steps: Boil artichoke hearts for 5 minutes.
Drain and quarter.
Mix all ingredients, except olives.
Slice olives.
Place on top. Bake, uncovered, 15 to 20 minutes at 450° in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Day Before Salad(Serves 10)

ingredients.name: english pea and chilled
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen English peas, cooked, drained and chilled

steps: Layer lettuce and chopped vegetables, saving enough lettuce for top layer.
Layer the peas and last layer of lettuce.
Cover with mayonnaise.
Add thick layer of Parmesan cheese and refrigerate a day or two. Crumble 1/2 pound of cooked crisp bacon and spread on top.
Looks pretty in deep glass bowl.

title: Hello Dollies(Makes 24 Squares)

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can sweetened condensed milk (I use Eagle Brand)

steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle the wafers over top evenly.
Sprinkle the chocolate chips, coconut and walnuts on top.
Pour the milk over all and bake at 350° for thirty minutes. Cut into squares while warm.
(I doubled the recipe.)

title: Rich Yeast Rolls
steps: Combine scalded milk, shortening, sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Soften yeast in lukewarm water; stir and combine with cooled milk mixture.
Add about half the flour; add the beaten eggs and beat well.
Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough; mix thoroughly.
Turn out on lightly floured board and knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and satiny.

title: * Butterscotch No Bake Cookies *
steps: Melt butterscotch and peanut butter together in top of double boiler.
Add cereal.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Damn Good Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour, eggs and butter and put in saucepan.
Cook on low heat until butter melts.
Add coconut and pineapple.
Stir all together and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until pie is golden brown.

title: Blue Devil Salad
steps: In a 2-quart dish, dissolve gelatin in water.
Add pie filling and pineapple.
Chill until firm.
Combine cream cheese, sour cream, nuts and sugar.
Spread over gelatin mixture.
Chill.

title: Crustless Cheesecake

ingredients.name: cream cheese at room temperature
ingredients.raw: 4 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature

steps: Mix until well blended.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: German Kuchen

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shortening (use 1/2 c. Crisco and 1/2 c. butter for flavor)

steps: Cream shortening; add sugar, beaten eggs, flour, salt and vanilla.
Spread into a 9 x 12-inch greased pan.
Reserve 1 cup batter for top.
After spreading the portion of batter in bottom of pan, spoon pie filling on batter.
Drop the rest of the batter on top of filling, not completely covering it.
When baked, fruit will ooze up through batter.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Bake at 325° if using glass dish.

title: Dried Fruit Pie
steps: Put fruit in bottom of pie shell. Beat egg yolks. Add milk. Mix cornstarch with sugar.
Add sugar mixture and butter to beaten egg
yolks, then add vanilla flavoring.
Pour over fruit. Bake at 325° until set.
Let cool.

title: Harvest Fruit Bars

ingredients.name: mixed fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. diced, dried mixed fruit

ingredients.name: apple pie spice
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. apple pie spice or ground cinnamon

steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl; set aside, stirring occasionally.
In large bowl beat together margarine and sugar until creamy.
Add flour, oats and 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice; mix until crumbly.
Save 3/4 cup mixture for topping. Press rest into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Crunchy Chicken "N" Rice Bake

ingredients.name: pea and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: durkee french fried onion
ingredients.raw: 1 small can Durkee French fried onions

steps: Combine rice and cheese.
Mix well. Add chicken, peas and half of the onions. Mix lightly. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Little Smokies In Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients, except Smokies.
Cook on stove top until thick.
Add Smokies.
Serve warm.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
Add 1 cup boiling water. Stir together.
Knead mixture until it forms a soft dough.

title: Chicken Crescents
steps: Cream cheese, softened.
Add butter, chicken, mushrooms and Lawry's seasoning.
Flatten rolls with a rolling pin; put 1/8 of chicken mixture on roll.
Roll to form from narrow end.
Dip in melted butter and roll into walnuts, then in bread crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, until done.
Thicken chicken broth and use as a side dish to pour over chicken.

title: Brown Rice Casserole
steps: Brown rice in butter in skillet.
Mix beef broth bouillon soup, French onion soup and browned rice in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Excellent with smothered quail.
I usually double this recipe.

title: Vegetable Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients, except oil, until thick.
Shape into balls.
Place into hot oil to fry.
Drain and serve warm.

title: Yummy Deviled Eggs
steps: Boil eggs for 15 minutes.
Cool off and peel.
Slice in half. Place yolks in a bowl.
Mash with a fork until smooth.
Add salad dressing, sweet relish, mustard and sugar.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon up and place in center of each egg half.
Sprinkle with paprika and refrigerate.

title: Easy Cherry Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease square brownie pan.
Dump cherry filling in pan; add cake mix and pour melted margarine over top. Spread pecans on top.
Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Luby'S Pan-Grilled Fish(Lo-Fat)
steps: Combine water, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. In a separate bowl, mix flour, paprika and seasoned salt. Preheat electric skillet to 325° of place a heavy skillet on the stove and preheat on medium-high. Dip fish fillets in liquid mixture and then place in flour mixture, covering completely. Shake off excess flour and place fillets, meat side down, in greased preheated pan. Cook 6 to 7 minutes, depending on the thickness, then turn over and cook until firm to touch (about 6 minutes more).
Garnish each with a sprig of parsley and a lemon twist.
Serves 6.

title: Jackie'S Gorditas(Jackie Clotfelter)
steps: Combine masa, flour, baking powder and salt.
Add water slowly and knead to a stiff dough.
Cover dough and let sit for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 6 portions and roll into balls.
Roll balls out to 1/4-inch thick.
Deep fry until puffed and browned. (They will be hollow.)
Cut off the end and stuff as you would a taco.

title: Lemon Baked Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange chicken in baking dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 40 minutes.
Uncover and cook an additional 20 minutes or until brown.
Contains 242 calories, 15 fat and 78 cholesterol.

title: Diet Orange Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello and hot water.
Add salad dressing; beat.
Stir in cottage cheese, oranges, pineapple and cherries.
Refrigerate until set.

title: Orange Creamsicle Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine orange supreme cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 Duncan Hines orange Supreme cake mix

steps: Mix Jell-O and 1 cup boiling water.
Set aside to cool.
Bake cake as directed on box in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Let cool slightly. Using a fork, poke holes 1-inch apart throughout.
Pour Jell-O over entire cake slowly.
Refrigerate until cool.

title: Glorious Macaroni

ingredients.name: macaroni
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. macaroni (shells or twists work best)

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded (8 oz.)

steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
Saute onion, pimento and mushrooms in butter.
Combine macaroni, onion mixture and remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Scones

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: milk or egg for shine (if desired)

steps: Scone dough must be handled minimally and quickly.
As soon as the soda makes contact with liquid the rising action has begun. The object is to get the scones into the oven quickly while the dough is still wobbling so the rising is not wasted.

title: Lillie Mae'S Cake
steps: Mix ingredients together adding only enough pineapple or applesauce to make cake.
Bake at 350° until done.

title: Tangy Salsa Shrimp And Rice

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 jar (4 oz.) chopped green chilies, drained

steps: In bowl, mix shrimp and salsa.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
Cook rice and add chilies, scallions, salt and pepper. Mix well. Skewer salsa-coated shrimp; broil or grill.
Place on rice.
Serves 4.

title: Spinach Lasagna

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and well
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and well drained

ingredients.name: lasagna noodle and
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. lasagna noodles, cooked and drained

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix together Ricotta cheese, spinach, Parmesan cheese and egg until well blended.
Layer 1 cup sauce, 3 noodles, 1 cup Ricotta cheese mixture and part of Mozzarella cheese in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Repeat layers twice.
Cover with foil.
Bake 20 minutes; remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Little Debbie Cookies
steps: Cream oleo, sugar, eggs and spices.
Add rest of ingredients and roll into small balls.
Flatten on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350°.
Fill with filling.

title: The Ten Minutes, No Fuss, Healthy Lunch
steps: In medium bowl, combine the chickpeas, tomatoes, onion and tuna.
Mix olive oil, vinegar and pepper until blended.
Pour over chickpeas-tuna mixture.
Toss.
Serve with bread.
Serves 3 to 4.

title: Butterscotch Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix into boiling milk.
Cook a few minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
In small saucepan, melt chocolate with milk over low heat; stir occasionally.
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
In large bowl, beat butter with peanut butter and sugar until blended.
Stir in flour and oats until combined.
Measure out 1 cup and set aside. Press remaining oat mixture into pan.
Spread chocolate over. Crumble reserved 1 cup of oat mixture over top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: "Bonnie'S" Sweet Potato Gook
steps: Drain yams.
Add pineapple, white sugar, cinnamon and 1/4 cup melted butter.
Mash until creamy; spread in glass pan.
Pour remaining butter over top of mixture.
Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Homestyle Boursin Cheese

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (may use light)

steps: Beat cream cheese and all other ingredients with electric beater until blended.
Line a margarine tub with foil and pack in mixture.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Turn out on serving plate and peel off foil.

title: Home Fries

ingredients.name: red potato
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 lb. red potatoes (2 to 4 potatoes)

steps: Place potatoes in a pot.
Cover with water.
Boil until tender (20 to 30 minutes).
Drain and place potatoes in a bowl. Refrigerate until cool.
Cut potatoes in 1/2 to 1-inch pieces.

title: Chicken With Rice
steps: Salt and pepper fryer.
Mix rice, water, oleo and soup.
Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Bake at 350° for 2 hours, without lifting cover.

title: Chocolate Toffee Candy
steps: Line a cookie sheet with well buttered foil.
Place saltines, side to side, to cover.
Boil together the butter and brown sugar; pour over crackers.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with the chocolate chips; spread with spatula while hot.
They will melt.
You can also add chopped nuts or coconut on top of the chocolate.
Refrigerate for 3 hours.
Break into chunks when chilled.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Stacy'S Marinated Potato Salad

ingredients.name: italian salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Italian salad dressing (the bottled type)

steps: Leave skin on potatoes when boiling.
Put in large bowl when boiled and after drained.
Make the following to pour over while potatoes are still warm:
Italian salad dressing, sliced green onions and chopped parsley.
Pour over the warm bite-size potatoes and let set for about 1 hour to marinate.
Toss several times. Then add the mayonnaise.
Toss until completely covered.
Put in fridge for at least 2 hours.
Better to chill overnight so flavors have plenty of time to blend.
Just before serving, garnish with sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Great!

title: Bits 'O Brickle Delight Pie
steps: In deep bowl, using mixer, combine cream cheese, sugar and milk.
Add 3/4 cup Bits 'O Brickle; fold in whipped topping.
Spoon into pie crust.
Sprinkle remaining Bits 'O Brickle over filling. Freeze about 4 hours before serving.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Black Forest Cake
steps: Blend first 4 ingredients in bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured 12 cup Bundt pan.
Bake in preheated 350° oven 45 minutes or until cake is done.
Cool in pan 25 minutes, then invert onto cooling rack to finish cooling.
Decorate and serve with 1 can cherry pie filling and Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Casserole (Mexican Style)
steps: Heat onion, soups and Ro-Tel in saucepan, then in casserole dish, put layer of chicken, layer of soup mixture, layer of Doritos and top with cheese.
Bake in slow oven until mixture bubbles.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Brownies

ingredients.name: chocolate and cooled
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: Heat margarine until melted and remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and eggs.
Beat slightly by hand just until combined; stir in flour.
Remove 3/4 c. of batter and set aside.
Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter.
Spread chocolate batter into a greased 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan; set aside.
Stir peanut butter into reserved batter.
Dollop on top of chocolate batter, then sprinkle with chocolate pieces.
Swirl batter with a knife.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Do not overbake.

title: Golden Cheese Grits

ingredients.name: roll garlic cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 roll garlic cheese or bacon-flavored cheese

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 2-quart casserole.
Cook grits in boiling water.
When almost done, crumble cheese and butter into grits.
Blend eggs and milk together.
Then mix egg/milk mixture with grits.
Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Turkey Meat Balls
steps: Mix together ground turkey, egg, Stove Top seasoning, onion and Stove Top dressing.
Make small meat balls.
Brown slowly in butter.
Drain.
Add flour to drippings.
Stir until smooth. Remove from heat and add milk and water.
Cook and stir slowly until gravy is smooth.
Add meatballs to gravy.
Simmer 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Country Bread Pudding With Custard Sauce
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Pour melted butter into approximately an 8-cup baking pan and refrigerate.
Place the bread sliced into a large bowl and pour the milk over them, tossing to let the bread absorb most of the milk.
Tear sliced bread into pieces.

title: Philly Three-Step Cheesecake
steps: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Cool.
Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Serves 8.

title: Poppy Chicken Casserole
steps: Simmer chicken until tender.
Cool and remove from bones.
Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Mix soup and sour cream.
Add chicken and chopped, boiled eggs.

title: Jogging In A Jar

ingredients.name: undiluted apple juice thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen undiluted apple juice, thawed

ingredients.name: undiluted welch s concord grape juice thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen undiluted Welch's Concord grape juice, thawed

steps: Mix all together and keep refrigerated.
Drink at least 2 ounces per day.
This will help to keep your cholesterol down as well as help those with arthritis.

title: Poppy Seed Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk.
Sift flour and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add vanilla and yeast mixture.
Add one egg at a time and beat well after each addition.
Place dough in refrigerator overnight.

title: Potato Special
steps: Put potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour 3 tablespoons melted butter over potatoes.
Mix soup, cheese, sour cream and onion. Pour over potatoes.
Mix corn flakes, 2 tablespoons butter and 1/2 cup grated cheese over top.
Bake 30 minutes at 300° to 325°.

title: Broccoli And Yellow Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. chopped frozen broccoli, cooked

steps: Simmer onion and celery in margarine.
Add mushroom soup, cheese and 1/2 cup water, heat until cheese melts.
Combine all ingredients in a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
steps: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions, adding a handful of brown rice to make more (optional).
While rice is cooking, skin and debone chicken and cut it in small pieces.
After rice is soft and dry, spread chicken over the top of rice along with the corn (drained); cover dish with no heat for 5 minutes.
Mix and serve.
Applesauce and biscuits go well with this dish.

title: Edith'S Gourmet Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops and arrange in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Combine soup, water and thyme.
Heat.
Then add parsley, sour cream and 1/2 can of onions.
Blend and spread over the chops. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove cover, put remaining onions on top and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Easy Cherry Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs in large bowl.
Stir in cake mix, cherry pie filling and oil until blended.
Spread in pan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.
Prepare pudding pie filling as directed on package.
Let stand for 5 minutes or until thickened.
Spread over cake. Garnish with Cool Whip and chopped nuts.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: parsley flake
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. parsley flakes or 1 Tbsp. finely chopped fresh parsley

steps: Peel and cut potatoes into chunks.
Boil until soft.
Drain. Add butter and sour cream.
Beat.
Slowly add milk*.
Continue beating.
Shake on cheese.
Add parsley and pepper.
Whip until creamy.

title: Children'S Snack
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Roll mixture into 1-inch balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Curried Chicken Pufflets

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

steps: Split each cream puff in half.
Combine undiluted soup, curry powder and chopped chicken and heat through over low heat.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Fill bottoms of puffs with the hot mixture and replace tops.
Serve at once sprinkled with paprika, if desired.
Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Two Cup Citrus Punch
steps: Dissolve sugar in water in large container.
Add lemon juice, orange juice and pineapple juice.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Serve over crushed ice.
Yield:
34 servings.

title: Favorite Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.
Add flour alternately with 3/4 cup sour cream.
Dissolve baking soda in 1/4 cup sour cream; add to batter and blend well.
Add extract and salt.
Stir.
Bake in pan for 1 hour and 5 minutes.
Cool 20 minutes in pan.
Remove and sift powdered sugar over warm cake.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Add yeast to warm water; let rest for 10 minutes.
Mix scalded milk, butter, sugar and salt.
Stir until dissolved.
Cool to 85°. Beat 1 egg and add to yeast mixture.
Add to milk mixture.
Beat in half of flour (sifted).
Beat 2 minutes.
Add remaining flour and mix the dough until it blisters.
Place in greased bowl; cover, place in refrigerator.
To bake, form into two loaves.
Let rise for 1 hour before baking.

title: Cranberry Muffins

ingredients.name: or cranberry coarsely
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh or frozen cranberries, coarsely chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
In a bowl, sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add with milk to the sugar and butter mixture.
Stir by hand just to moisten ingredients. Stir in cranberries.
Spoon into 18 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups, filling 3/4 full.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Hard Rock Candy
steps: Mix all ingredients except the flavoring and the food coloring in a saucepan.
Let heat until 300°.
Take off of heat.
Add coloring and flavoring.
Have cookie sheet lined with powdered sugar.
Pour in a sheet and allow to cool.

title: Honey Coconut Squares
steps: Bake oblong cake as directed.
As soon as cake is removed from oven, drizzle 1/2 cup honey over top.
Sprinkle with 1 cup coconut and slip under broiler a few minutes to toast coconut.
Best when served warm.

title: "Hide Ems" Cookies
steps: Mix sugar and syrup; bring to a rapid boil.
Add peanut butter and stir until well mixed.
Pour over corn flakes and mix well. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper and cool.
Then hide em.

title: Lemon Ice Cream
steps: Combine sugar, lemon juice and peel in large freezer container.
Slowly stir in cream and salt, blending well.
Cover and freeze until firm outside but still soft in center.
Stir several times.
Freeze until firm.

title: "Watermelon Rind" Pickle

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.raw: 8 qt. cucumber chunks (large ones, yellow okay)

steps: Day 1:	Peel and seed chunk cucumbers to make 8 quarts. Cut into chunks and soak 24 hours in
2 cups lime mixed with 8 quarts cool water.

title: Date Nut Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour loaf pan(s).
Measure all ingredients into a large mixer bowl; beat on medium speed 1/2 minute.
Pour into pan(s).
Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from pan(s).
Cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Ft. Henry Dip
steps: Put in blender and mix well.
Serve with assorted vegetables.

title: Quick Candy
steps: Melt almond bark.
Add dry ingredients.
Drop by the spoonful on wax paper.

title: Mexican Hominy
steps: Melt oleo.
Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo until tender. Empty the 2 cans of hominy, draining one and draining 1/2 of the other can.
Mix in with the onion and bell pepper mixture.
Stir in Cheez Whiz and pimento until melted and mixed well.
Pour into casserole dish.
Bake until bubbly.

title: Apple Bits Mold
steps: Soften gelatin in water.
Stir over hot water until dissolved. Add all remaining ingredients except apple.
Chill until mixture begins to thicken.
Fold in apples.
Spoon into individual molds or small ring mold and chill until firm.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups, 4 servings.

title: Chef'S Salad
steps: Shred lettuce and put into a large bowl.
Cut into strips the chicken, ham and cheese; arrange over lettuce.
Top with thinly sliced eggs and scatter over with onions.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
steps: Cut pickles in small pieces.
Grate onion.
Mix ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Beat until well blended (use electric mixer for best results).
Chill.

title: Date Nut Roll

ingredients.name: or can eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 cans Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs, pecans, marshmallows and dates together.
Add milk gradually until mixture is moist enough to stick together and roll in logs. Roll logs in graham cracker crumbs.
Place logs in aluminum foil and refrigerate.
Freezes well.

title: Ice Cream And Candy Pie

ingredients.name: hot fudge ice cream
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. hot fudge ice cream topping

ingredients.name: butter pecan ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. butter pecan ice cream, softened

steps: Spoon coffee ice cream into pie crust, spreading evenly. Freeze until firm.
Place candy in plastic bag.
Crush with rolling pin, mallet or hammer.
Spread fudge topping evenly over coffee ice cream.
Sprinkle with 1 cup of crushed candy.
Spoon butter pecan ice cream over, spreading evenly.
Freeze until firm, 2 hours.
Garnish with fresh whipped cream-rosettes around edge of pie.
Put remaining candy in middle.
Delicious!

title: Strawberry Daiquiri
steps: Mix together in blender.
Makes 5 (8 ounce) drinks.

title: Eggplant Dressing
steps: Peel and cube eggplant and boil until tender.
Soak bread in milk.
Drain eggplant, add bread and milk mixture.
Mix well. Stir in beaten eggs, onion, salt and pepper.
Place in well buttered casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese Sandwich Filling
steps: Cream the cheese with mayonnaise and add remaining ingredients; blend together.
Use whole wheat bread for a great tasting treat.

title: Peach Crunch
steps: Melt oleo in 8-inch square pan.
Stir in flour and pecans and beat in bottom of pan to form crust.
Bake at 350° until lightly brown.

title: Creamy Cheese Soup(Debbie Loves My Cheese Soup.)

ingredients.name: ham in tiny
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. ham, diced in tiny pieces

steps: Put milk in a double boiler and cook on medium heat.
Melt oleo (this can be done in microwave) and add flour to oleo.
Mix well, then stir into hot milk.
Add cheese, ham and carrots and cook for 20 minutes.
Do not let double boiler boil dry!
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato with green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies, diced

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. green onions, finely chopped

steps: Grease potatoes and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350° or until done.
Brown hamburger meat and mix with taco seasoning mix according to package directions.
(Be sure meat is drained.)
In a double boiler or microwave, melt Velveeta cheese mixed with Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Stir frequently.
To serve, slice hot potato and lightly fluff.
Layer taco meat, cheese mixture, sour cream, green onions and salt and pepper to taste.
Yield:
4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Quesadillas

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 large can white chicken breast chunks

steps: Mix ingredients in bowl.
Spread on tortillas.
Fold tortilla and dampen edges.
Cook in oven at 350 about 15 minutes in greased pan.

title: Peach Salad
steps: Mix and put in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
steps: Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat.
Add chicken, onion and pepper.
Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn, broth and salsa; bring to boil.
Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese.
Let stand 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Cake Donuts
steps: Cream butter, potatoes and sugar.
Add eggs, milk, nutmeg and vanilla.
Sift baking powder with flour.
Stir in mixture and add more flour to make a soft dough.
Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut and deep-fry.
Drain on paper towels.
Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Ranch Style Beans

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix

steps: Brown ground beef.
Combine with all other ingredients in a crock-pot.
Heat on low for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: California Breakfast

ingredients.name: cream yogurt cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. creamed small curd cottage cheese

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded (2 c.)

ingredients.name: mild green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can mild green chilies, drained

steps: Beat eggs until lemon colored.
Add flour, baking powder, salt, cottage cheese, shredded Jack cheese and melted butter.
Blend smoothly and stir in chilies.
Pour mix into well-greased 9-inch square dish.
Bake in 350° preheated oven 35 minutes or until top is lightly brown and center appears firm.
Cut in squares and serve hot.
Serve with coarsely chopped and sauteed red pepper and green onions.
Accompany with bran muffins.

title: Lemon Barbeque Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops in oil; drain.
Place chops in baking dish and top with lemon slices.
Mix catsup, vinegar, water and sugar.
Pour over chops.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or more. Serves 4 to 6.
Can prepare ahead of time and be baked when ready to serve.

title: Strawberry Bread Loaf
steps: Combine all dry ingredients, mixing with a fork.
Beat eggs, oil and berries until well blended, then add flour/ sugar mixture and mix well.
Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: No-Crust Coconut Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients, except coconut; mix well.
Stir in coconut.
Pour into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciatore

ingredients.name: ragu low fat tomato and herb spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 jar Ragu low-fat tomato and herb spaghetti sauce

steps: Arrange washed, dried chicken pieces in a large casserole dish.
Pour Ragu sauce over top, covering pieces well.
Sprinkle Parmesan on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is very well done.
Serve over hot, buttered spaghetti or fettucine.

title: Caramel Apple Salad

ingredients.name: dry roasted peanut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. dry roasted peanuts or 3 chopped up Snickers bars

steps: Mix dry pudding, Cool Whip and pineapple and juice until well blended. Stir in apples, marshmallows and peanuts or candy bars until thoroughly combined.
Refrigerate until served. Best if eaten within 24 hours. Tastes like a caramel apple.

title: Microwave Country Breakfast
steps: Microwave sausage and onion, uncovered, in a shallow, 2-quart casserole on High for 4 to 5 minutes, or until sausage is no longer pink.
Stir twice during cooking.
Remove sausage and onion from dish with slotted spoon and drain on paper towel.
Add potatoes to the casserole with the sausage drippings and microwave, covered, until potatoes are cooked, about 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir in 1/4 teaspoon salt and spread potatoes evenly in the dish.
Combine eggs, milk, remaining salt and pepper in a 2-cup measure.
Pour evenly over potatoes.
Mix sausage mixture with thyme and sage in a small bowl and sprinkle over potatoes. Microwave, uncovered on High for 3 minutes.
Lift eggs at edge with spatula to distribute uncooked portion of egg mixture evenly. Do not stir potatoes and sausage.
Microwave, uncovered, at 50% power (Medium) until eggs are almost set, about 8 to 10 minutes. Give dish a 1/4 turn twice during cooking.
Serves 4.

title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
steps: Saute minced onion and green pepper in butter to soften.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pea And Peanut Salad

ingredients.name: pea minute and
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. frozen peas, cooked 3 minutes and drained

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cool and chill.
At serving time, add:

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
steps: Mix cake mix according to directions on package.
Fill cupcake pans 2/3 full.
Cream the cheese with sugar, salt and egg; stir in chocolate pieces.
Drop one rounded teaspoon cheese mixture into each cupcake.
Bake as package directs.
When cool, frost with any white buttercream frosting.
Makes 30 cupcakes.
These cupcakes freeze well.

title: Tomato Aspic
steps: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Pour into individual molds.
Chill until firm.

title: Spanish Beef
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper.
Cook noodles according to directions on package.
Drain and mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Banana Slush Punch
steps: Boil water and sugar.
Chill.
Put bananas in blender.
Blend with juices.
Before freezing, divide in half and freeze.
Before serving, thaw 2 hours.
Place in punch bowl and add 3 quarts of Wink before serving.

title: Currant Wieners
steps: In a large pot or crock-pot, melt mustard and jelly together. Cut hot dogs into bite size pieces.
Add to mixture.
Bring all this to a boil.
Turn heat to low; cook for at least 1 hour.
If using a crock-pot, just let the mixture cook together for several hours.
A wonderful appetizer.
Kids love them.

title: Garlic Bread Sticks
steps: Trim crust from bread.
Cut loaf of bread in half lengthwise, then into 8 equal crosswise slices.
Combine butter and garlic; mix well.
Spread on all sides of each 8-inch slice.
Arrange on 15 x 12-inch cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with seed.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Molded Jello Salad
steps: Mix jello with 1 cup boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries and stir until separated.
Add drained crushed pineapple and nuts. Put 1/2 mixture in bowl and set in refrigerator 10 to 15 minutes (until slightly gelled).
Remove from refrigerator and spread with sour cream.
Pour remaining jello on top and return to refrigerator.
(Should remaining jello gel, place bowl in warm water and stir until slightly thin.)

title: Choco-Caramel Squares
steps: Combine cake mix, oleo, evaporated milk and chopped nuts. Press 1/2 of the mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Pour melted Caramel Sauce over top. Crumble remaining cake mixture over and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meatless Mexican Beans
steps: Cover beans with water plus 2 inches more.
Soak beans 10 to 12 hours.
Put in slow cooker.
Add water to cover beans plus 2 inches more and add chili mix, garlic and onion.
After 4 to 5 hours cooking, add liquid smoke and hot sauce.
When beans are done, add salt.
Do not heat beans in microwave as they get hard.

title: Lemon Dill Fish(Makes 4 Servings.)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Shake flour in oven bag; place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add water, lemon juice, garlic and dill to bag.
Squeeze bag to blend ingredients.
Add fish fillets to bag. Turn bag to coat fish with sauce.
Arrange fish in an even layer; dot with margarine.
Close bag with nylon tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top.
Bake until fish is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meringue Puffs
steps: In a mixing bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form.

Gradually add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time. After all sugar is added gradually add salt and vanilla. Beat until stiff peaks form and all the sugar is dissolved about 5 to 8 minutes. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on baking sheet. Once cooled, remove and store in airtight container. Yield: 4 dozen.

title: Linda'S Chicken Fingers

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch strips

ingredients.name: good season italian dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix

steps: Mix egg, milk and poultry seasoning in bowl and set aside. Mix flour, dressing mix, salt, pepper and Accent in large bowl with fitted cover (or gallon Ziploc bag).
Heat 2 cups oil on stove in large frying pan.
Dip chicken strips in egg mixture and then in flour mixture and fry until golden brown, turning once.

title: Western Casserole
steps: Brown beef, onion and bell pepper; drain.
Cook tomatoes, rice and Italian seasoning; let it go to boiling.
Turn down heat; cover and let it simmer until rice is tender.
Mix with beef. Pour into baking pan or dish.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and melt in a 350° oven.
Great.

title: Easy Potatoes
steps: Scrub potatoes; peel onion and melt 2 tablespoons butter in glass baking dish.
Slice potatoes and onion.
Alternate layers of each onto melted butter.
Top with 1 tablespoon butter.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave 10 minutes (or until potatoes are tender.)
This may also be fixed inside foil and placed on grill just prior to cooking hamburgers.

title: Tomatoes Vinaigrette
steps: Arrange tomatoes on serving plate; set aside.
Whisk together oil, vinegar, sugar and basil.
Stir in onions.
Season with salt and pepper.
When ready to serve, pour dressing over tomatoes.

title: Chinese Spareribs
steps: Mix sauce all together and pour over spareribs.
Roast ribs for 2 or 3 hours at 350°.
Baste them while baking.

title: Pork Chops Hungarian
steps: Trim fat off chops.
Brown chops in small amount of shortening in 8-inch pan.
Drain fat.
Combine onion, caraway, salt, paprika, dill weed, garlic powder and water.
Add to pan; cover and cook over medium heat for 1 hour until chops are tender.
Watch the juice!
It evaporates; add water every so often.
Transfer chops to warm platter.
Stir sour cream into juice in pan.
Heat through.
Do not boil!
Spoon over chops.

title: Jennifer'S Colored Sugar
steps: You can save money by making your own colored sugar!
Put sugar in Ziploc bag.
Add 3 or 4 drops of food coloring to bag and seal. Knead the bag until the sugar is uniformly colored.
If the sugar is too light, add more food coloring.
If the sugar is too dark, add more sugar.
To make unusual colors, mix the food coloring in a spoon and stir with a toothpick before adding to the sugar.
We use these sugars for decorating cookies, etc.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Cranberry Fruit Tarts
steps: Thicken cranberries with cornstarch.
Combine flour, shortening and milk.
Roll out on floured surface.
Cut with 4-inch cutter. Spoon 1 teaspoon of cranberries on each one.
Go around each with milk to seal edges.
Cover and seal with a fork to crimp.
Lightly grease sheet to bake.
Bake at 375° 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Party Tea

ingredients.name: lemon juiced
ingredients.raw: 4 lemons, juiced or 1 can frozen juice

steps: Simmer tea, cloves and cinnamon sticks in 1 quart of water for about 15 minutes.
Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of hot water, then add enough cold water to make 3/4 gallon.
Add sugar, pineapple juice and lemon juice.
Mix all together and serve hot or cold.

title: Magic Coconut Pie
steps: Put the ingredients in a blender; blend about 1 minute.
Pour into well-greased and floured pie plate.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Glass pie plate works well.

title: Cherry Cream Pie

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling

steps: Bake pie shell.
Beat pudding and pie filling, whipped topping mix, milk and almond extract in 2 1/2-quart bowl on low speed until blended.
Beat on high speed until soft peaks form, about 3 minutes.
Fold in cherries.
Pour into pie shell.
Refrigerate until firm, at least 2 hours.
Top each serving with 1/2 cup reserved syrup.
Makes 8 servings, 360 calories per serving.

title: Dried Beef Dip

ingredients.name: cream cheese in tbsp. milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened in 1 Tbsp. milk

steps: Mix all ingredients
except
butter
and nuts together. Pour in ovenproof baking
dish.	Saute 1 cup chopped pecans in 1/2 stick butter for 5	minutes.
Put
on top of dip.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot.
Serve with Ritz crackers or one of your choice.

title: Seafoam Frosting
steps: Cook sugar and water until it spins a thread.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar.
Pour syrup over egg whites; add vanilla and beat until it will stand in patties.

title: Western Fettuccini

ingredients.name: baby pea in pouch
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. baby peas frozen in pouch

steps: Cook peas as directed on package.
Prepare noodles as directed on package.
Drain well.
Toss lightly with sour cream, grated cheese and salt.
Add peas to noodle mixture and sprinkle more Parmesan cheese lightly on top.
Serve immediately.

title: Omaha Potatoes

ingredients.name: cornflake mixed with c. butter
ingredients.raw: 2 c. crushed cornflakes mixed with 1/4 c. melted butter

steps: Defrost potatoes.
Combine all ingredients except cornflakes. Put them on top.
Bake at 275° for 60 minutes, uncovered in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except sunflower seeds. Toss with dressing and store covered in refrigerator.
Toss in sunflower seeds before serving.

title: Good Layer Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter with Crisco and eggs, one at a time. Alternate flour and buttermilk; add vanilla.
Bake at 350° until done.

title: Chocolate No-Bakes
steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, stir in peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir in oatmeal. Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper.
Let cool.

title: Easy Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in a bowl.
Add oil, salt and sugar.
Mix and add 2 cups flour.
Stir well.
Add 3rd cup of flour.
Leave in bowl, cover and let rise until doubled.
Pour out on floured board.
Knead about 10 strokes.
Put in greased pans; let rise again.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Sensations

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. walnuts, chopped (and large pieces for top)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine flour, soda and salt; set aside.
In mixing bowl, beat brown sugar, butter and vanilla until creamy.
Beat in egg.
Gradually add flour.
Stir in 1 1/3 cups chocolate chips (save 2/3 cups chocolate chips for top).
Spread into 9-inch square pan.
Bake 23 to 25 minutes.

title: Gingered Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: chicken tender diagonally in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. chicken tenders (or breast), sliced diagonally in 1/4-inch slices

steps: Cut chicken.
Drain oranges, reserving 1/4 cup syrup.
Cook ginger in hot oil 30 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Add snow peas, reserved syrup and stir-fry sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover and cook 2 minutes.
Top with orange sections.
Serve over rice.
Makes 2 servings, about 300 calories.

title: Virginia Baked Beans

ingredients.name: baked bean
ingredients.raw: 1 large can baked beans (30 to 40 oz.)

steps: Fry bacon until crisp.
Chop onion and garlic.
Fry in 2 tablespoons of bacon fat until soft.
Add vinegar, sugar and mustard.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the drained kidney beans and butter beans in a large baking dish with the baked beans.
Crumble bacon and add, then mix in the onion and sugar mix.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Coffee Cake
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Pour 1/2 of batter into a 10 x 12-inch greased baking dish.
Mix sugar and cinnamon.
Spread 1/2 over batter and 1/2 of nuts.
Then add rest of batter, cinnamon and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
You can use any flavor cake mix and instant pudding you like.

title: Orange Punch
steps: In a gallon jug, dissolve acid in 1/4 can orange juice; add remaining juice and sugar.
When dissolved, finish filling jar with water.
Cover and let stand for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine soup mix with bread crumbs. Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture, coating well.
In lightly greased pan, put chicken, then drizzle with butter.
Bake, turning once, 10 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Championship Chicken Breasts
steps: Mix salad dressing, mustard and honey.
Place chicken on grill or rack of broiler pan.
Brush with half of the salad dressing mixture.
Grill or broil 8 minutes.
Turn; brush with remaining salad dressing mixture.
Continue broiling or grilling 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Puffy Fried Bread
steps: Sift flour, measure, and sift again with salt, baking powder, and sugar. Cut in shortening, and add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let dough stand for 30 to 60 min. Roll 1\4 inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into diamond shaped pieces.

Heat about 1 inch of oil in frying pan 370° to 380°. Add a few pieces at a time; turn at once, so they will puff evenly. Then turn back to brown on both sides. Drain on paper toweling. Serve with butter or honey. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Banana Pudding Supreme

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: Cream the cheese until smooth.
Stir in sweetened condensed milk and pudding mix; fold in half of the whipped topping.
Layer pudding, cookies and bananas in dish; top with remaining topping. Chill.

title: Hershey'S Syrup Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with syrup.
Bake 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Meat Loaf Layered

ingredients.name: herb flavored bread stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb flavored bread stuffing mix

steps: Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Combine beef, salt, pepper, onion and milk.
Mix thoroughly.
Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package.
Fill pan with three layers of meat and two layers of stuffing, beginning and ending with meat.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Makes six servings.

title: Rice Artichoke

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke heart and
ingredients.raw: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, chopped and drained

ingredients.name: dry mustard
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. dry mustard or curry powder

steps: Cook the Rice-A-Roni as directed in large skillet.
Add the green pepper, onions, celery and artichoke hearts to the skillet with the Rice-A-Roni.
Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice and dry mustard or curry powder.
Mix this into the skillet and serve.

title: Soft And Easy Cheese Ball
steps: Set cheeses out until softened to room temperature and mix together.
Add Worcestershire sauce.
Chill for several hours. Form into ball and roll in chopped nuts.
Cheese ball will be very soft.
Keep cool.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
steps: Cook ground beef until brown, stirring to crumble meat.
Drain well.
Combine beef and next 6 ingredients; stir well.
Spoon mixture into lightly greased baking dish.
Arrange bacon on top of beans.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

title: Baked Chop Suey

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup

steps: Brown ground beef and onions; add salt and pepper.
Add other ingredients and mix all together.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Upside-Down Cake
steps: Heavily grease bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter or margarine.
Sprinkle brown sugar over the bottom of the pan to cover the butter.
Cover this with drained peaches or pineapple. Mix cake mix according to directions.
Pour over fruit.
Bake as directed or until done.
Serve warm with sauce.
Turn the piece upside down and put sauce over it.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings And Drummies

ingredients.name: chicken wing and drummy
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 lb. chicken wings and drummies

steps: Separate chicken wings at the joints, cut off wing tips and discard.
Mix all ingredients well and pour over chicken wings and drummies in shallow dish.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight.
Place wings on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and put in slow cooker on low until tender.

title: Chicken L'Orange

ingredients.name: sugar from orange marmalade
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar sugar from orange marmalade

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.raw: dash of lemon juice or 1/4 c. orange juice

steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken in baking dish.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes; uncover and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Quickie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Press with a fork (sugar coated).
Bake for 10 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen.

title: Fried Rice And Cabbage
steps: Fry rice, onions and pepper in small amount of shortening until it is brown, then add cabbage; cover it with water and add beef and salt to taste.
Add tomato paste.
Let simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes, then serve.

title: Chicken Parisenne

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Place, uncooked, skinned thighs in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex baking dish.
Mix red wine vinegar, water, brown sugar and soup with wire whisk.
Pour over chicken.
Top with mushrooms.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
One half hour before serving,
mix in sour cream with a spoon.
Serve with rice.

title: Cheez Whiz Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. butter or margarine, melted and cooled

ingredients.name: well potato
ingredients.raw: 3 (1 lb.) cans well drained diced potatoes

steps: Bake 20 minutes at 375°.
Last 5 minutes, sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Best-Ever Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and beat for 1 minute by hand.
Bake in greased, but not floured, 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Let cool.
Chop 1 large jar maraschino cherries (drained) and put on top of cake.

title: Snow Punch
steps: Beat together bananas, lemon juice and sugar.
Pour into punch bowl.
Add cream, 7-Up and sherbet.
Sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Taco Meat Balls
steps: Mix and make into small balls.
Cook in microwave for 3 minutes on High.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
steps: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Store unused batter in airtight container.
Do not stir when ready to spoon into muffin cups to bake.
Can sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar or nuts before baking.

title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies

ingredients.name: quick cooking oats
ingredients.raw: 1 c. quick cooking oats (not instant or old fashioned)

ingredients.name: nut may be added if desired
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. nuts may be added if desired

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease baking sheets.

title: Mama'S Lap Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening together.
Add eggs and cream.
Sift flour and soda together.
Add alternately with milk. Form into small balls the size of walnuts; flatten with fork. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Party Chicken
steps: Grease one large 8 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Line with chipped beef.
Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon. Place on beef in casserole.
Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours.

title: Tomatoes With Basil
steps: Arrange tomatoes on a platter.
Sprinkle with minced garlic, salt, pepper, oregano, basil and cheese. Drizzle oil over all.

title: Fifty Dollar Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks and melted chocolate.
Sift in flour and baking powder.
Add milk and fold in egg whites. Add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in a 350° oven. When done, cool and cover with Fifty Dollar Cake Icing.

title: Weight Watchers Quick Dinner Rolls
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 muffins.
A 1 ounce serving equals 1 Bread.

title: Coconut Bars(Candy)
steps: Melt oleo; add milk, sugar and coconut.
Mix well.
Chill until easy to handle and then form into small balls.
Chill again until firm.
Melt chocolate chips over warm water.
Stir until smooth, then dip the bottom of each ball into the chocolate using a toothpick.
Harden on waxed paper.

title: Basic Meringue How-To
steps: Note:
A copper bowl is excellent for beating egg whites.
The chemical reaction which occurs between copper and egg whites helps to stabilize mixture.
Cream of tartar should be omitted when beating egg whites in copper bowl.

title: Quick Casserole
steps: Slice potatoes thin in a long baking dish.
Add sliced onions and then sprinkle rice over this.
Crumble beef over top of potatoes.
Pour tomato soup over all in pan.
Bake at 350° about one hour.

title: Western Sour Cream Dressing
steps: Blend together all ingredients and chill.
Makes 1 1/4 cups dressing.

title: Italian Cheese Pie
steps: Note:
Can top with any topping or sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Yummy Apple Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Cool before slicing.

title: Picnic Casserole
steps: Fry hamburger loosely in butter with onion; add remaining ingredients.
Put in greased casserole dish.
Bake slowly at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
(If uncovered a tasty crust forms.)

title: Traditional Chex Party Mix

ingredients.name: mixed nut and/or pretzel stick
ingredients.raw: 1 c. salted mixed nuts and/or pretzel sticks

steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
Heat margarine in large shallow roasting pan (about 15 x 10 x 2-inch) in oven until melted. Remove.
Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Add Chex cereal and nuts.
Mix until all pieces are coated.
Heat in oven for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

title: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
steps: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough, one part at a time, 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let cool; decorate.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Nothing Cake
steps: Beat eggs slightly.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing by hand.
Batter is stiff.
Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
When cold, cut into squares.
Don't get upset when the cake looks like it fell.

title: Corn Pie
steps: Whip eggs thoroughly in bowl.
Add sugar, flour, milk, margarine, salt and pepper.
Stir in corn.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Set dish in pan of water about 2 inches deep.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until knife blade comes out clean when tested.
You also may use fresh or frozen corn.

title: Granny'S Chocolate Dessert
steps: Layer #1:
Mix flour, nuts and butter and make crust.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Grandma Wood'S Butter Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick.
Serve warm over berry and fruit pies or dumplings.
Yields approximately 2 1/2 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and oil together.
Add shredded zucchini. Add flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts.
Pour all into greased loaf pans.
Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Peanut Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients in order given.
Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Test for doneness with toothpick.
Cool on rack.
Chill for easier slicing.

title: Chicken Liver Stroganoff
steps: Cook onions in butter until tender, not brown.
Add chicken livers.
Season with salt and pepper also paprika.
Brown livers. Cover; cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add sour cream; heat thoroughly.
Serve over rice.
Serve with Sue Tossed Salad in 1988 book, page 19.

title: Chicken Broccoli Crepes
steps: Beat eggs lightly in medium bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth.
Lightly grease crepe pan or 7 or 8-inch skillet and place over medium-high heat.
Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter into pan.
Tilt pan to spread batter evenly. When crepe is light brown and set, turn to brown other side. Remove and repeat to make 12 crepes.

title: Pink Lady Punch
steps: Mix cranberry and pineapple juice with sugar and chill.
When ready to serve, add chilled ginger ale.
Serves approximately 35.

title: Ham Potato Scallop

ingredients.name: fully ham
ingredients.raw: 1 fully cooked ham slice or 1 lb. ham

steps: Cut ham in bite-size pieces.
Put half the potatoes in greased 2-quart casserole.
Cover with ham pieces.
Place remaining potatoes on top.
Combine soup, milk, onion, green pepper and pepper; pour over potatoes.
Dot with margarine.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour; remove cover and bake 45 minutes longer or until potatoes are done.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherry Angel Cream Cake

ingredients.name: angel food
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 to 12 oz.) angel food or pound cake

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix

ingredients.name: cherry pr peach pie filling or
ingredients.raw: 2 (21 oz.) cans cherry pr peach pie filling or topping

steps: Cut cake into 1/4-inch slices.
Arrange half the slices on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
In a large mixing bowl, combine milk, water and extract.
Mix well. Add pudding mix and beat well.

Chill 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread half the cream mixture over cake slices. Top evenly with 1 can cherry filling. Top with remaining cake slices, cream mixture and cherry filling. Chill 4 hours until set. Cut into squares to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Honey Of A Chicken
steps: Place chicken in greased pan.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed on package.
Rinse and drain.
Brown sausage; add onion, pepper and celery.
Cook vegetables until tender.
Add rice, mushrooms and soups.
Pour in greased 3-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Sugar-Free Orange-Pineapple Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple in own juice
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple in own juice

steps: Boil water and add jello.
Mix thoroughly.
Add pineapple and mandarin oranges.
Refrigerate until congealed.

title: Golden Cornbread
steps: Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Makes a 9-inch square pan. Delicious with spaghetti or chili.

title: Banquet Potatoes
steps: Thaw frozen hash browns until they can be broken apart and stirred.
Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well.
Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, in 300° to 325° oven.
Serves 12.
May be made in advance and refrigerated until time to bake.

title: Millionaire Piesmakes 2 Pies
steps: Mix all ingredients well and pour into pie crusts.
Let stand overnight.

title: Cool Creamy Cucumber Salad
steps: Combine cucumbers, onion, pimento, chives and dill weed in medium size bowl.
Add the salad dressing and toss.

title: Hot Cinnamon Biscuits
steps: In an aluminum 9-inch or 10-inch pie pan melt butter, water, sugar and sprinkle of cinnamon over low heat.
Open tube of biscuits and dip in mixture.
Turn over and put on mixture.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cranberry Slush]
steps: Combine Jell-O and boiling water; let cool.
Add the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into freezer container and freeze.

title: Salt Rising Bread
steps: Peel and slice potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Let stand overnight in a warm place. In the morning, when it has foam on top, remove the potatoes and discard. Add 1/4 teaspoon of soda and thicken with flour. Let rise. Add 1/2
gallon (8 cups) flour to make a sponge.
Add risen mixture and let rise again. Make out into 4 loaves. Grease pans well. Bake in moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes or more.

title: Oven-Fried Pecan Corn Meal Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (20)

steps: Pound the chicken breast halves to an even thickness.
Pour 1/2 cup of oil into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat it in the hot oven for 10 minutes.
Combine the remaining oil with the mustard, salt, pepper and paprika in a shallow bowl.
Mix well.
Combine the pecans and corn meal on a sheet of wax paper.
Dip the chicken pieces in the seasoned oil and then in the nut mixture.
Remove the pan from the oven and place the chicken pieces in the pan.
Bake for 10 minutes, then turn with tongs and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dutch Potato Filling
steps: Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water.
Place mashed potatoes in large bowl.
Add slightly beaten eggs, bouillon cube mixture, onion, salt, pepper and parsley; blend well.
Place in a 1-quart greased casserole.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven with chicken, or until browned on top.

title: Greek Vinaigrette
steps: Combine ingredients in a jar with a screw-top lid.
Shake well to mix.
Store in refrigerator, covered, for up to two weeks.

title: Mexican Meat Filling
steps: In large skillet cook ground chuck, onion, garlic and cayenne over medium-high heat, stirring often until meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin and salt.
Cook 1 minute.
Add tomato sauce and cook, stirring often, until thickened, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy No Crust Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a blender or electric mixer and pour in a 10-inch, buttered Pyrex pie pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 325°.
This will bake to a delicious crust and a toasted coconut top.

title: Fruit Cheese Ball
steps: Roll in sliced almonds.
Serve with Escort crackers.

title: Fried Ice Cream

ingredients.name: scoop hard vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: 5 large scoops hard frozen vanilla ice cream

steps: Dip ice cream in
egg,
then
roll
in crushed cookies. Repeat. Freeze at least 24 hours before frying. Deep fry for 1 minute.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
steps: Pour sugar over berries; stir.
Let stand while you prepare the Sure-Jell.
Boil Sure-Jell and water for 1 minute at rolling boil.
Pour over berries and stir for 3 or 4 minutes.
Put in jars and freeze.

title: Stuffed Jumbo Shells And Tofu

ingredients.name: each parsley parmesan cheese wheat germ and onion
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. each chopped parsley, Parmesan cheese, wheat germ and diced onion

ingredients.name: each celery seed and basil
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each celery seed and basil

steps: Cook, drain and rinse shells.
Combine remaining ingredients except spaghetti sauce and the extra Parmesan cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of shallow baking dish.
Fill shells with tofu mix and place in single layer in baking dish.
Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 6 servings. Calories 277.

title: Microwave Sugar Glazed Nuts
steps: Mix sugar and sour cream in large microwave bowl.
Microwave on High a total of 7 minutes, 2 minutes and stir, 3 minutes and stir, 2 minutes and stir.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Mix well and spread onto waxed paper.
Separate as mixture cools.

title: Dinner Salad

ingredients.name: and ham turkey
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cooked and cubed ham, turkey or chicken

ingredients.name: miracle whip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Miracle Whip or your favorite dressing

steps: Chop broccoli, cauliflower, lettuce and tomatoes. Place the vegetables in a large mixing bowl.
Grate carrots and add to vegetable mixture.
Stir in cheese and meat.
If adding the hard-boiled eggs, slice them and mix into vegetables. Mix with Miracle Whip and refrigerate 1 hour.
Serve with crackers or toast.

title: Cutout Cookies
steps: Combine shortening and butter.
Add sugar, then beat in egg. Add salt, almond and vanilla extract.
Last, add flour 1 cup at a time.
Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 9 minutes or until edges brown.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara

ingredients.name: prosciutto
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Prosciutto (Italian ham or lean bacon)

ingredients.name: salt and white pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Finely chop Prosciutto and cook in 4 Tbsp. butter.
Cook until crisp (can do ahead and reheat).

title: Peach Crumble Pie
steps: Line pie shell with plain pastry.
Trim; let rest 10 minutes, then flute edge.
Do not prick.
Combine sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon.
Add butter and work with fingertips until crumbly.
Add 1/2 of this mixture to the peaches.
Mix lightly and turn into pie shell.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumbly mixture over top of peaches.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes or until peaches are cooked.
Cool 2 or 3 hours on rack before cutting.
Serves 5.

title: Teriyaki Steak Marinade
steps: Mix together.
Pour over meat.
Marinate several hours or overnight.
Barbecue or broil meat.

title: Libby Danti'S Sauce With Sausage

ingredients.name: oregano salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: oregano, salt and pepper to taste

steps: In a large pot, mix tomatoes, seasonings, wine and water. Stir and simmer 10 minutes.
In skillet, fry sausage and remove from pan.
Leave a small amount of oil in pan.
Saute onions and mushrooms. When cool, cut sausage in slices. Add to skillet.
Stir and simmer 5 minutes.
Add to large pot. Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and let simmer slowly, covered, 1 hour.
Uncover and continue cooking for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at low heat.
If sauce is too thick, add more water to your taste.
Stir occasionally during cooking.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Baked Squash
steps: Wash and cut up squash.
Boil until tender.
Drain thoroughly, then mash.
Add all ingredients, except 1/2 of the butter to squash.
Melt remaining butter.
Pour mixture into baking dish, then spread melted butter over top and sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake in a 375° oven for approximately 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Revival Goulash

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in pieces

ingredients.name: wide egg noodle as directed
ingredients.raw: 1 medium bag wide egg noodles, cooked as directed

steps: Saute onion and bell pepper in small amount of oil.
Add ground beef; cook until brown. Add soup and cheese.
Use 1/2 can of water to rinse can out.
Add to drained cooked noodles.
Pour into large baking dish.
Bake at 350° until hot.
Freezes well.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Rice Soup

ingredients.name: uncooked brown rice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. uncooked brown rice (cook rice separately)

steps: Put chicken broth in large pot with vegetable base.
Simmer on low.
Next, add all vegetables and cooked rice.
Stir occasionally and cook, covered, for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Wendy'S 3 Layer Quick Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese; spread in bottom of dish.
Add salsa. Sprinkle cheese on top of salsa.
Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Serve with tortilla chips.
Enjoy!!

title: One Pan Chicken And Gravy
steps: Mix all together the soups and pour over chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked. Any form or amount of chicken may be used.

title: Hot Dog Hash
steps: Combine potatoes and onion.
Sprinkle on flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk and hot dogs.
Put in shallow baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake for 30 minutes at 425°.
Top with cheese until melted.

title: Chocolate Heaven
steps: Combine flour, oleo and nuts and press in thin layer into 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° about 15 minutes.
Let cool, then let chill in refrigerator.
Combine softened cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread evenly over chilled crust and return to refrigerator.
Mix instant pudding with milk and vanilla.
Beat until thick and spread over cream cheese mixture.
Chill.
Top with remainder of Cool Whip.
Will keep 4 to 5 days in refrigerator.

title: Party Sandwiches
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Add ham and Swiss cheese. Split rolls and fill with mixture.
Wrap in foil and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.
Makes 48 sandwiches.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: baby food strained prune
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 oz. jar baby food strained prunes

steps: Boil cream, butter and sugar for 5 minutes (start time when bubbling).
Then add marshmallow cream and then add other ingredients.
The strained prunes make this very creamy.
Let set for 2 hours.

title: Green Rice Casserole
steps: Place all ingredients in greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add sugar, oil and room temperature buttermilk.
Stir together well (be sure oil is well blended when adding flour).
Add 4 cups flour and mix well.
Then add 5 cups flour (more if needed), salt, baking powder and soda; mix well.
Dough is ready to bake.
Seal mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate!

title: Chocolate Caramel Pecan Fudge
steps: In a saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips with milk and salt.
Remove from heat; stir in nuts, caramel topping and vanilla.
Spread evenly in a foil-lined 8 or 9 inch pan.
Chill 2 hours or until firm.
Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off foil and cut into squares.
Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Potato Onion Casserole
steps: In a 9X13 baking dish, layer onions, potatoes, Velveeta. Repeat onions and potatoes.
Salt and pepper.
Pour soup over all and top with grated cheese.
(soup may be diluted with 1/3 cup milk.) Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Test potatoes for doneness.

title: Hamburger And Beans
steps: Brown hamburger.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Put beans in casserole dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar, Worcestershire and ketchup.
Stir.
Add hamburger and mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chow Mein
steps: Brown beef.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour into casserole.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown ground beef; drain.
Cut up and add the cream cheese to the meat; stir until melted.
Add the mushroom soup and 1 can of water to the mixture.
(Use less water, if desired.)
Heat through until well blended and hot.
Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Oven Apple Pancakes

ingredients.name: tart apple cored and in
ingredients.raw: 3 tart medium apples, peeled, cored, and cut in 1/4 inch wedges

steps: With whisk or beater, beat eggs, milk, salt and flour until smooth.
Let the batter rest.
Combine the sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle over the apples; toss to mix.
Generously butter two 9 inch pie pans, using about 2 Tbsp. for each pan.
Divide apples evenly between the pans.
Stir the batter and pour it over the apples, using 1 c. per pan.
Bake at 375° 30-40 minutes, or until pancakes are fluffed, golden brown, and set.
Serve hot in wedges topped with whipped cream.

title: Macaroni Salad(For Large Gathering)
steps: Cook macaroni.
Drain and let cool. Cut cheese, tomatoes, cucumbers and bell peppers in little cubes.
Mix this with cooled macaroni, relish and Miracle Whip to taste.
(Original recipe did not list quantities or ingredients.)

title: Spritz Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
In large bowl, cream the powdered sugar, butter, vanilla and egg until light and fluffy.
Stir in flour and salt; blend well.
Fill cookie press; press dough into desired shapes onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until lightly browned on edges.
Immediately remove from cookie sheets.
Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.

title: Margaret'S Eclair Cake

ingredients.name: french vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. French vanilla instant pudding

steps: Mix pudding, Cool Whip and milk.
Layer 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers, then with pudding mixture; alternate twice, ending with crackers.
Pour chocolate sauce over all.
Refrigerate.

title: Cauliflower Patties
steps: Cook cauliflower; drain and mash.
Add other ingredients; mix well.
Let stand about 1 hour before cooking.
Drop by tablespoons into hot oil and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Can be frozen and then reheated as you need them.

title: Sausage Squares
steps: Combine the biscuit mix and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Brown sausage in skillet. Add onion and cook until tender; drain well.
Spread sausage mixture over first layer.
Combine egg, grated cheese and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise.
Spread over top of sausage mixture. Press lightly.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cook about 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: German Apple Pudding Cake
steps: Mix apples and sugar together.
Let stand until sugar is thoroughly dissolved.
Add eggs and mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Stir into apple mixture.
Add nuts, raisins, and vanilla.
Pour into 8 X 8 inch pan which is slightly oiled.
Bake at 375° for 40 - 45 minutes.
If preferred use unsweetened can sliced apples instead of fresh apples.

title: Good N Easy Crawfish Jambalaya
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Put in rice cooker.
After cooker chimes, let jambalaya set on warm for 30 minutes before serving. May use shrimp instead of crawfish.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
steps: Crush crackers and combine with butter and sugar.
Press in bottom and up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan.
Combine whipped topping, pudding and sour cream.
Pour half of filling over crust. Slice bananas and layer on top.
Pour remaining filling over bananas, then sprinkle chopped pecans over top.

title: Italian "S" Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat eggs.
Add sugar, vanilla, lemon rind and shortening.
Mix into bowl with flour to form a soft dough.

title: Ella Davis' Russian Tea Cakes
steps: Cream butter and 10x sugar.
Add next 3 ingredients.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 400° for 14 to 17 minutes.
Roll in 10x sugar while warm and again when cool.

title: Chicken Surprise

ingredients.name: boned chicken breast in half
ingredients.raw: 4 whole boned chicken breasts, cut in half

steps: Wrap each piece of chicken in a piece of bacon.
Put each piece of chicken on 2 slices of dried beef in a casserole dish. Use one so the chicken fits snug in the dish.
Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup sour cream together and spread over chicken.
Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours uncovered.

title: Cheezy Bacon Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes and cut in small pieces; add margarine and milk.
Mix until soupy.
Add onions, green onions and parsley; mix.
Add bacon, salt and pepper.
Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes until perfect consistency.
Melt cheese on top for last 5 to 10 minutes.
Serves 25.

title: Georgetown Red Rice
steps: Cook bacon, remove from pan and crumble.
Cook onions in bacon fat until tender, then add red tomatoes, rice, broth, catsup, seasonings and crumbled bacon.
Cook on low heat until rice is done.
Stir several times during cooking.

title: Tomato Soup

ingredients.name: hot sauce
ingredients.raw: 2 dashes hot sauce or 1 to 2 chopped small peppers

steps: Heat milk in one pan.
Heat tomatoes, tomato soup, butter, flour (mix first in some of the tomatoes) and salt in another pan. When hot, add pinch of soda.
When both milk and tomato mixture are hot, mix together.

title: Lazy Cobbler

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. fruit (whatever you desire; sweetened to taste)

steps: Melt margarine in baking dish or pan.
Mix flour, sugar and milk together.
Pour over melted margarine.
Add vanilla to sweetened fruit.
Pour over batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Wassail(Kids Love It!)
steps: Cut orange into eighths, and pierce with whole cloves.
Put all ingredients in a crock-pot.
Cover.
Cook one hour on high, then four hours on low.
Makes 12 servings.
Can be doubled for a six-quart crock-pot.

title: Cheese Fries
steps: Bake French fries as directed on package.
Fry bacon; pinch into small pieces.
When fries are baked, pour Ranch dressing on them, then add cheese and top with bacon pieces.
Place back in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Life'S Recipe
steps: Mix these thoroughly and add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy for others.
Flavor with little gifts and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith to lighten the other ingredients and raise the texture to a great height of Christian living.
After pouring all this into your daily life, bake well with the heat of human kindness.
Serve it with a smile.

title: Boiled Dressing
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add vinegar, lemon juice, water, butter or oleo.
Cook on low heat until thickened, stirring.
Add beaten yolks and cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Cool.
Refrigerate.

title: Creamy Cherry Dessert

ingredients.name: cream cheese and pkg. cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese and 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (21 oz. each) cherry pie filling

steps: Mix melted oleo and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl.
Then press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch bowl or pan.
Combine softened cream cheese (8 ounces and 3 ounces) milk and vanilla in a medium bowl. Beat until smooth.
Spread the following in order over crust: cream cheese mixture, whipped topping and cherry pie filling. Chill several hours.
Cut into squares to serve.

title: French Chicken
steps: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with rice; add broth plus water if needed.
Layer chicken over rice.
Mix soup, sour cream and poppy seed.
Pour over chicken.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Pour melted butter over top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Beach Party Punch
steps: Pour all ingredients into punch bowl with ice ring.
Garnish with orange slices and cherries.

title: Crab Nibbles
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and microwave until cheese is melted. Spread mixture on muffin halves.
Bake in 350° oven until slightly brown.

title: Great Grandma Lockerbie'S Scones
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in skillet on top of stove, slowly, until done.

title: Cinnamon Hard Candy
steps: Cook sugar, water, corn syrup and food coloring to very hard crack stage (300°).
Add oil of cinnamon; stir slightly to mix in oil.
Pour onto well-greased cookie sheet, cool.
Crack into pieces.
Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Butterscotch Cake
steps: Make pudding according to directions.
Cool slightly.
Pour into cake mix; add eggs and blend well.
Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle on butterscotch chips and nuts generously.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. This is a time saving recipe.

title: Re-Baked Stuffed Potatoes
steps: Scrub potatoes and grease with corn oil.
Bake for 5 minutes in microwave or 20 minutes in 400° oven.
Test with fork for tenderness.
Wrap in foil and set aside.

title: Fried Cheese Ball
steps: Mix Cheddar cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper.
Add egg whites.
Shape into small balls and roll in fine cracker crumbs. Fry in deep oil at 375° until golden.
Serve hot.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip

ingredients.name: pace picante sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar Pace picante sauce or salsa

steps: Stir Velveeta and salsa in saucepan over low heat until Velveeta is melted.
Stir in cilantro.
Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Scallops And Parsley Sauce

ingredients.name: firmly curled parsley leaf divided
ingredients.raw: 1 c. firmly packed chopped curled parsley leaves, divided

steps: Heat butter and oil in heavy, large skillet over medium-high heat until butter is melted.
Add scallions and 1/2 cup parsley; cook 5 minutes, or until scallions are softened but not burned. Add wine; cook 2 minutes.
Add scallops.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, for 4 to 5 minutes, or until scallops are opaque. Stir in remaining parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over spaghetti; toss gently to mix.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Meatballs(For Macaroni Sauce)

ingredients.name: approximately tbsp. parsley
ingredients.raw: approximately 5 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley (if you use dry use less)

steps: Mix
ingredients
well	and
roll into small meatballs. Let 1/2
wedge of lard or some Crisco melt in frying pan.
Put in meatballs, let brown on all sides and remove.

title: Easy Potato Soup
steps: In a large pot, put potatoes and water. Bring to rolling boil. Add salt, pepper, celery salt and onion flakes.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then add butter or margarine. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Rich Pecan Pie
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine syrup, margarine and sugar in saucepan.
Bring to boil; boil gently 5 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally.
Cool slightly.
Place pecans in pie shell. Mix eggs, vanilla and salt in bowl.
Gradually stir in cooled syrup mixture.
Pour over pecans in pie shell.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack.

title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
steps: In a saucepan melt margarine.
Stir in flour and salt.
Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for one minute more.
