Add cheese, stir until melted.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
steps: Boil margarine, sugar and milk for 1 1/2 minutes.
Pour over remaining ingredients in large bowl.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.
Let cool, then refrigerate.

title: Shrimp Cheese Turnovers

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut up

ingredients.name: tiny shrimp thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen cooked tiny shrimp, thawed

steps: Cut butter and cream cheese into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Work with hands to form ball.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
On floured surface, roll half into 11-inch circle.
Cut into rounds with 2-inch floured cutter.
Spread each round with about 1/2 teaspoon of cheese spread.
Top with a few shrimp.
Fold in half and seal.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Wieners
steps: Mix sauce and jelly in saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until blended.
Add wieners and heat thoroughly.

title: Dilled Macaroni And Cheese Salad(Cold)
steps: Cook macaroni, omitting salt.
Drain well; rinse in cold water.
Combine the next 4 ingredients and the cooked macaroni.

title: Creamy Italian Dressing

ingredients.name: dill basil oregano
ingredients.raw: a bit of dill, basil, oregano or any spice you like

steps: Mix all ingredients in a blender, except oil. After all is well blended, add oil very slowly. Blend until thick.
Delicious.

title: Mil'S Dressing

ingredients.name: juice from meat
ingredients.raw: juice from meat or 2 1/2 c. boiling water and 1 chicken bouillon cube

steps: Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Double recipe for 4 or more people.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
steps: Mix with hands, the first 5 ingredients.
Remove 2 cups of crumbs and set aside.
Mix remaining crumbs with boiling water, molasses and baking soda.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Bread
steps: Soak the Grape-nuts in the buttermilk for 10 minutes.
Combine other ingredients; beat well.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before putting in oven.
Bake 40 minutes at 375° in loaf pan.

title: Dolly Parton'S Soup
steps: Cook cabbage, celery, onion and carrots until tender in the least
amount
of
water
possible.
Then
add tomatoes or juice and bouillon cubes.
Simmer until well done.

title: Easy Refrigerator Dough
steps: Measure water and yeast into bowl; stir to dissolve.
Stir in sugar, salt, oil and eggs.
Mix until dough is soft.
Do not knead.
Cover with damp cloth; place in refrigerator.
Let set at least 2 hours.
About 1 to 1 1/2 hours before baking, shape into rolls.
Cover; let rise until doubled in size.
Bake at 400° until done.
This dough will keep in the fridge for about 5 days.
Just keep the cloth covering it damp.

title: Golden Glazed Ham With Cherry Sauce

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) jar apple or guava jelly

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 15 oz.) can cherry pie filling

steps: Place ham, fat side up, on a rack in shallow pan.
Heat in a 325° oven for time indicated on label.
One-half hour before end of time, remove ham from oven and score fat in diamonds.

title: Cherry Swish
steps: Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Pour 1/2 of mixture into each pie shell.
Pour 1/2 pie filling on top of each mixture and swish around until white shows through, making swirls.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Oven Fries
steps: Cut potato into quarters lengthwise and dry with a paper towel.
Coat all over with the oil.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Place in a nonstick pan or a Pam sprayed pan and bake at 450° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Peanut Butter No Bakes
steps: Mix oleo, sugar, milk and salt in saucepan.
Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Chocolate Bubble Biscuits
steps: In large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt.
Using pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in 1/3 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in chocolate chips. Add milk; stir until dough holds a shape.
On floured board, knead dough lightly.
Roll dough into 16 balls.

title: Creamy Chocolate Squares
steps: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in bowl until light and fluffy.
Blend in chocolate and vanilla.
Add walnuts; mix well.
Pour into buttered 8-inch dish.
Chill until firm.
Cut into squares.
Yield: 2 pounds.

title: Shrimp Provencale

ingredients.name: shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: About 45 minutes before serving in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat in 2 tablespoons of oil, cook shrimp, stirring often about 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink; set aside.
In same skillet, add 1 tablespoon of oil.
Add mushrooms; cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook 3 minutes more.
Return shrimp to skillet.
Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with rice.

title: Cheese Salsa Dip

ingredients.name: picante
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar picante or salsa sauce

steps: Microwave cheese and picante sauce in a 1 1/2 quart microwavable bowl on High for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted, stirring after 3 minutes.
Stir in cilantro.
Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers.
Yield: 3 cups.

title: Almond Potato Puffs

ingredients.name: mashed
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. cooked, mashed or riced potatoes

steps: Combine the water and butter in small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat.
Remove from heat; add flour, all at once, and beat until smooth.
Add egg, blending thoroughly.
Let cool. Add potatoes to flour-egg mixture and blend well.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Flour hands lightly, shape mixture into tablespoon-size balls.
Roll balls in chopped nuts.
Pour oil into a deep fryer or large saucepan and heat to 375°.
Fry balls in batches until golden, about 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.
Yield: 2 servings.

title: Cranberry Congealed Salad
steps: Heat pineapple juice and dissolve Jell-O.
Stir well.
Add cranberry sauce and mix well.
Add pineapple and oranges.
Mix well and pour into Jell-O mold.
Chill.

title: Pork Chops And Kraut
steps: In
casserole
dish,
arrange
pork
chops
in a single layer. Salt and pepper to taste.
Cover pork chops with layer of sauerkraut.
Cover
casserole with aluminum foil.
Bake in slow oven, 200°, for 3 to 4 hours or until chops are fork-tender.

title: Butterscotch Crunch Squares(Frozen Dessert)
steps: Combine flour, oats, and sugar.
Cut in butter until mix resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in nuts.
Pat mix into 13 x 9 inch pan and bake in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes.
Stir while warm to crumble and then cool.

title: Donna'S Dessert
steps: Break angel food into pieces and place in bottom of 15 x 12-inch pan.
Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth, then add Cool Whip.
Make 3 packages Jell-O with 2 1/2 cups boiling water, adding frozen berries after Jell-O is dissolved.

title: "Sean'S Favorite" Cranberry Pie
steps: Grease a 9-inch pie plate.
Layer with cranberries and apple. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts.
Beat egg until thick; slowly add 1/2 cup of sugar, flour and melted butter until blended well. Pour egg mixture over cranberry mixture.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix by package directions.
Pour 2 cups batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake 15 minutes.
In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt caramels and margarine.
Remove from heat.
Add sweetened condensed milk.
Mix well.
Spread caramel over cake.
Spread remaining batter over caramel mixture.
Top with nuts.
Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.
Cool.

title: Crumb-Coated Chicken
steps: In small bowl beat together eggs, butter and salt.
In shallow dish place crumbs.
Coat chicken with crumbs, then egg mixture and crumbs again.
In 2 qt. oblong glass baking dish arrange chicken with meatiest pieces to outside edges of dish.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave:
13 to 16 minutes.
Power level:
high (10)

title: Fruit-Cookie Pizza
steps: Roll out cookie dough and place on a baking pan.
Bake according to pkg directions.
Set aside.
Mix cream cheese and sugar together and spread over cookie, slice fruit and layer on top of cheese mixture.
Garnish with pecans and cool whip.

title: Quick Green Beans And Potatoes

ingredients.name: bush s green and shelly bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (29 oz.) can Bush's cut green and shelly beans

ingredients.name: bush s white potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can Bush's whole white potatoes, drained

steps: Empty beans into crock-pot.
Add drained potatoes, onion and bacon.
Cook on high for 30 minutes.

title: 7 Cup Salad

ingredients.name: mandarin orange segment
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange segments, drained

steps: Mix all together, except sour cream and sugar.
Now add sour cream and sugar.
Mix well and chill.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
steps: Combine eggs, sugar, corn syrup, pumpkin and vanilla.
Mix well.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool and serve.

title: Stripe-It-Rich-Cake

ingredients.name: jell o brand instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Jell-O brand instant pudding (4 oz. size any complimentary flavor)

steps: Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Remove from oven.
Poke holes once down through the cake to the pan with the round handle of a wooden spoon.
Holes should be 1-inch apart.
If you don't have wooden spoon, you may use a plastic drinking straw using a turning motion to make large holes.

title: Taco Dip Ambrosino

ingredients.name: taco sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 jar taco sauce (hot or mild, to taste)

steps: Cream together with a fork cream cheese and cottage cheese until blended.
Layer mixture in bottom of a glass pie plate or serving bowl/plate.
Add layer of taco sauce, vegetables and Cheddar.
Alternate layers until supplies are exhausted. Finish with Cheddar and garnish with parsley.
Serve with taco chips to scoop.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: hershey chocolate bar with almond
ingredients.raw: 1 large Hershey chocolate bar with almonds

steps: Melt the Hershey bar over low heat.
Blend into Cool Whip. Pour mixture into the pie crust.
Put in refrigerator and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Mackerel Potato Cakes
steps: Mix together all ingredients except fat.
Put fat in pan and drop cakes in hot pan.
Fry.

title: Ashley'S Pecan Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Stir in all other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in slow oven at 275° for about an hour.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Squares
steps: Mix cake mix (dry), melted butter, nuts and 1/3 cup Pet milk. Stir by hand.
Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan; bake for 6 minutes at 350° (ungreased).
Combine caramel and 1/3 cup milk. Melt in double boiler.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mix. Pour melted caramel over chocolate chips.
Pour remainder of cake dough over mix.
Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Supreme
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add water, vinegar and egg all at once to the dry ingredients.
Mix. Roll as usual.

title: S'More Gorp
steps: In a large bag, mix the ingredients.
Then shake well.
This recipe gives you the same S'more flavor without the trouble of roasting the marshmallows and other things.

title: Toasted Pecans
steps: Measure pecans in a small bowl.
Mix vinegar and sugar; pour over pecans and stir to coat thoroughly.
Let stand 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Place pecans in a shallow baking dish and bake in a 300° oven for 10 minutes.
Add melted butter to pecans, stir and allow to bake for another 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Balls
steps: Mix sugar, pecans, coconut.
Add milk, margarine.
Mix and roll into balls.
Refrigerate to harden.
Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler or on
very low heat.
Dip each ball and place on waxed paper to cool.

title: Strawberries(Using Dry Jello)

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. finely grated coconut (put in blender)

steps: Combine milk, coconut, one box of jello, almonds, sugar and vanilla.
Mix well, then hand-shape to form strawberries.
Roll berries in other box of jello to coat thoroughly.
Set to dry. Pipe green icing on berries to form leaf and stems.

title: Bea'S Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
steps: Blend cheese and oleo.
Add flour and paprika.
Take 1 teaspoon of the mixture and wrap around an olive.
Bake in 450° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
May be prepared early and frozen before baking.

title: No Bake Snow Drop Cookies
steps: Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add sugar very gradually; beat until stiff.
Fold in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoons in mounds on baking sheet.
Place in a 350° oven and turn oven off.
Leave 3 hours to overnight.

title: Chip Dip
steps: Cook hamburger and drain.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Cook until cheese melted.
Serve with Doritos or other chips.

title: Sweet Onion Pie
steps: Saute onion in butter until soft.
Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps.
Add eggs, salt, pepper and cheese.
Add onion and mix well.
Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown, bake at 350 degrees.

title: Zucchini Cheese Casserole
steps: Saute zucchini and chopped onion in oil.
Whip cottage cheese with basil and oregano in blender. Place alternating layers of zucchini, cottage cheese and tomatoes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Bake

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large skillet, brown chops.
Drain on absorbent paper.
In buttered, oblong baking dish, arrange chops, potatoes and mushrooms on top.
In a small bowl, combine water and soup mix.
Pour over other ingredients in baking dish.

title: Quick Taco Salad

ingredients.name: monterey jack
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese

steps: Step 1:
In a large skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain.
Remove from skillet.
Set aside.

title: Ham Sauce
steps: Blend cornstarch, mustard and salt into ham drippings.
Add water, sugar and raisins.
Cook and stir until clear and slightly thickened.
Blend into vinegar and lemon juice.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Glazed Waverly Crackers
steps: Line cookie sheet, 12 x 16-inch, with Waverly crackers and sprinkle about 1/2 cup pecans on top of crackers.
Boil sugar and oleo for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Pour over crackers.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Remove crackers from cookie sheet while still hot.

title: Best-Ever Egg Nog
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar in medium saucepan.
Slowly beat in two (2) cups of the milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until thermometer registers 150°F. or mixture coats the back of a metal spoon.
Remove from heat;
strain into pitcher.
Stir in remaining milk, Jim Beam Bourbon, vanilla and nutmeg.
Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight.
Sprinkle with additional nutmeg.

title: Crescent Roll Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and onion; drain.
Stir in seasoning and tomato sauce.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread 1 can of rolls onto bottom of pan.
Spread hamburger mixture on top of rolls. Sprinkle both kinds of cheese on top, then top with second can of rolls.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Gold Kist Pecan Pie
steps: Cream butter.
Add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy. Add slightly beaten eggs and other ingredients.
When all is blended, pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake on lower shelf of oven at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Italian String Beans
steps: Cook beans until partially tender; drain and saute in olive oil, 1 clove garlic and oregano.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook until tender.

title: Good Green Beans

ingredients.name: bacon bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bacon, cut into bite size pieces

steps: Drain green beans.
Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 20 to 30 minutes until bacon pieces are done.

title: Aunt Lettie'S Pound Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add 6 tablespoons of sugar gradually.
Put in refrigerator.
Cream butter and add remainder of sugar.
Beat at low speed.
Add 2 egg yolks at a time.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Add flavoring and fold in egg whites.
Pour into greased steeple pan.
Bake 1 3/4 hours in a 300° oven.

title: Garlic Rosemary Chicken
steps: Wash chicken. Push garlic and rosemary under skin and in cavity. Cook in Brown N Bag
1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours at 375°.

title: Microwave Pralines
steps: Stir whipping cream and sugar together well.
Cook 7 minutes. Stir well, then cook 7 more minutes.
Remove and add butter and pecans.
Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla (optional), then drop on wax paper.

title: Savory Chicken Breasts
steps: Place chicken breast in shallow baking dish.
Combine soup and milk.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle stuffing mix evenly over milk and soup mixture.
Drizzle melted oleo over stuffing.
Bake, covered, for 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove cover and continue baking for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Raisin-Filled Apples
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Peel off a strip around top of apples.
Place apples in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish; fill centers with nut mixture.
Microcook, covered, until tender, 5 to 6 minutes; give dish a half turn twice.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
Serves 4.

title: Butternut Squash

ingredients.name: red hot candy
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. red hots candy (2 oz. pkg.)

steps: Cut squash in half lengthwise and discard seeds.
Slice into 1/2-inch slices crosswise and remove peel. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Heat orange juice in microwave dish. Dissolve candy in the orange juice.
Pour over squash. Sprinkle with salt.
Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Place liquid from baking pan into small saucepan and boil until thick.
Pour over squash. Yields 4 servings.
Has 150 calories, fat free.

title: Champagne Salad(Frozen)

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple, with juice

steps: Fold in fruit and nuts with mixture.
Freeze in Pyrex dish. Cut into squares.
Fills a 7 x 11-inch dish.

title: Crisscross Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs and beat thoroughly.
Stir in peanut butter.
Sift dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture.
Form into tiny balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with back of fork to make crisscross.
Dough may also be rolled and cut, if desired.
Bake in moderated oven at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 8 dozen.

title: Mexican Lasagna

ingredients.name: ground meat
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. ground meat (beef, turkey, chicken, venison)

ingredients.name: salsa
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) jars salsa (1 mild and 1 medium)

steps: Cook meat and onion until brown; drain fat.
Add taco seasoning mix to meat mixture.
Add chilies.
Cut tortillas into thirds.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer salsa, meat, cheese and tortillas in that order.
End with layer of tortillas topped with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Mom'S Dandelion Wine
steps: Gather 1 peck dandelion heads.
Do not collect from an area sprayed with pesticides or herbicides.
Wash to remove bugs. Combine dandelion heads with boiling water in a large container. Let the flower heads steep for 24 hours.
Strain the juice.
To the juice, add sugar, yeast and fruit.
The amount of fruit can vary, depending on the flavor you want.
Set it in a warm, dark area to ferment.
Do not stir.
Keep mixture quiet for about 2 weeks.
When the mixture reaches the desired potency, siphon off and filter through cheesecloth.
Refrigerate.
It's ready!

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar.
Add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup, nutmeg, salt, butter and evaporated milk.
Beat well.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Smoked Salmon Rolls
steps: Blend softened cheese with capers.
Spread on salmon.
Roll, jelly-roll fashion.
Chill.
Cut in 1/2-inch slices.
Serve on cocktail picks.

title: Crock Pot Pepper Roast

ingredients.name: big
ingredients.raw: big or small jar of roasted pepperoni peppers, depending on size of roast

ingredients.name: chuck
ingredients.raw: chuck or pot roast (one with fat tastes better)

steps: Place about 5 or 6 peppers in bottom of pot.
Put roast on top.
Pour remaining peppers and the juice on top.	Cook on low all day while you are at work.
You could also put on before bed and allow to cook all night.
Refrigerate in the morning.

title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
steps: Dip into boiling water the peaches.
Plunge peaches into cold water.
Slip off skins. Cut in half.
Discard pits.
Press peaches through sieve or food mill into mixing bowl.
Stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice and the sugar.

Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. Combine the heavy cream, vanilla, almond extract and salt. Stir into peach mixture. Fill freezer container 2/3 full of mixture. Cover tightly. Set in freezer tub and freeze until firm.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool in pans 10 minutes.
Finish cooling before adding icing.

title: Sauce For Fresh Fruit

ingredients.name: dream whip
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Dream Whip or whipping cream

steps: Place beaten egg in top of double boiler and add sugar, flour and salt.
Mix well.
Add butter and pineapple juice.
Cook over water until smooth and thickened.
Cool, then add Dream Whip or whipping cream.

title: Eggplant Souffle
steps: Peel eggplant and cook in boiling water 7 to 10 minutes. Drain and season with dash of onion powder and dill.
Mix remaining ingredients with 1/3 cup cracker crumbs and combine with eggplant.
Put in 2-quart greased casserole.
Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter and dash of paprika. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Famous Lemon Pie
steps: Mix cornstarch and lemon juice in pan.
Separate 3 yolks from egg whites, set the whites aside.
Add egg yolks to lemon mixture and stir, then add boiling water and cook until thick.
Pour into pie shell.
Beat egg whites and sugar until stiff peaks form for topping.
Spread onto pie and bake at 325° for 15 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

title: Spatini Meatballs
steps: Mix together ground beef, Spatini, cold water and bread crumbs.
Shape into meatballs.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake in oven for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: North Rim Rolls(Grand Canyon)

ingredients.name: yeast dissolved in c. warm water and tsp. sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 packet yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water and 2 tsp. sugar

steps: Mix milk, sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add eggs and yeast mixture.
Stir in flour.
Refrigerate overnight. Roll out dough.
Cut or shape as desired.
Let rise at least an hour.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Imperial Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add soda and vinegar, then vanilla and flour.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Israeli Salad
steps: Dice each vegetable into extremely small pieces.
Add oil, then squeeze in the juice of 1 to 2 lemons depending on your taste.
Add the salt, then add lemon, oil and salt based on how much salad you need.
The salad should be tart and refreshing.

title: Chicken Enchilada(Microwave)

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: In 2-quart casserole, mix all the ingredients.
Microwave on High for 11 to 13 minutes.
Rotate dish 1/2 turn; cook 5 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Hot Dish
steps: Brown hamburger and drain grease.
Peel, cut and boil potatoes.
Mash potatoes.
Add butter and milk; set aside.
Drain green beans.
Combine tomato soup, green beans and browned hamburger in a greased baking dish.
Layer mashed potatoes on top of hamburger mixture.
Spread evenly.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Let set 5 minutes and serve.

title: Spiced Mocha Mix
steps: In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Store in airtight container.
Makes 2 1/2 cups mix (12 to 14 servings).

title: Swedish Pineapple Nut Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together with mixer.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cheese And Veggie Crescents

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach or broccoli, thawed and well drained

steps: Combine spinach or broccoli, cheese spread, bread crumbs and bacon in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted.
Unroll dough
and separate into 16 triangles.
Cut each triangle in half lengthwise so you'll have 32 triangles.
Spread each triangle with about 1 teaspoon of mixture.
Roll up, starting at wide end.
Place on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Ice Cream Cookies
steps: Whip Crisco, sugar, eggs and vanilla together.
Mix flour, soda, cream of tartar and pinch of salt.
Combine and drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie Casserole
steps: Butter casserole dish.
Spread ingredients in layers (Chili, cheese, Fritos, onion, tamales, cheese then repeat.)

title: Grits Casserole 2
steps: Cook grits in boiling water for 15 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Delicious with ham.

title: Christmas House Fragrance
steps: Mix and bring to boil.
Keep simmering.
(Crock-pot is great.)

title: Frozen Slush
steps: Mix in order given; put in Tupperware dish.
Put in freezer. Whenever you want a slush, scrape with ice cream scoop.

title: Easy Chili
steps: Brown ground beef in frypan or pot.
Remove from heat.
Drain excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Baking Dish Cobbler

ingredients.name: peach and
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 fresh ripe peaches, peeled thinly and sliced

steps: Butter a 9 or 10-inch pie dish at least 1 1/2 inches deep. Place peaches in dish.
Spread bread evenly over peaches.
Mix melted butter, sugar, flour and egg together until well blended. Pour evenly over bread, making sure all bread is covered.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Fried Apple Pies
steps: Add water to apples and cook until done.
Add sugar, salt and spices and simmer until jelled.
Refrigerate until used.

title: Almond Bark Candy
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Turn off and place pan in oven with peanut butter and Candi-Quick.
Mix the next 3 ingredients and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Braised Bratwurst With Spicy Mustard Sauce

ingredients.name: fully bratwurst
ingredients.raw: 8 fully cooked bratwurst (German style veal sausage)

steps: About 30 minutes before serving, with sharp knife, score sausages for even cooking.
In 12-inch skillet, over medium heat, cook sausages in apple cider until cider evaporates and sausages are browned and heated, turning sausages occasionally.

title: Grape Finger Jello

ingredients.name: grape juice concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen unsweetened grape juice concentrate, thawed

steps: Soften gelatin in juice and cold water.
Add the boiling water and stir until gelatin dissolves.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan coated with nonstick vegetable spray.
Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Cajun Cabbage

ingredients.name: salt pepper and cayenne pepper
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and cayenne pepper to taste

steps: Cook the bacon in iron skillet until crisp.
Add the onion and peppers.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Oriental Grilled Chicken
steps: Cut chicken breasts in half.
Mix remaining ingredients together in a shallow pan large enough to hold breasts in one layer.
Place breasts in marinade, turning to coat and rubbing marinade into breasts.
Marinate at least one hour and as long as overnight.
Grill chicken over hot coals or under broiler.
Strain marinade, bring it to a boil and serve it with chicken.
Yield:
4 servings.
Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 21 g, fat 5 g, calories 186.

title: Pork Chops Au Gratin
steps: Brown the pork chops.
Meanwhile, mix remaining ingredients and put into large casserole dish.
Place browned pork chops on top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Soft Sour Cream Cookies
steps: Cream together sugar and shortening, add eggs and sour cream. Mix well. Add vanilla.
Combine flour, baking powder and soda. Add to creamed mixture slowly. After well mixed, set overnight in refrigerator. Roll out on a floured surface.
Cut into shapes. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. Frost and decorate.

title: Mexican Fiesta Pie

ingredients.name: cheddar american
ingredients.raw: 2 c. shredded Cheddar, American or Monterey Jack cheese

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease a 9-inch square pan or 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish.
Layer half the corn chips, chili, onion and cheese in pan; repeat.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 15 minutes or until hot.
Garnish with lettuce, tomatoes and olives.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Mike'S Ice Cream
steps: Combine all.
Leave plain or add whatever fruit desired. Freeze in ice cream freezer.
Delicious!

title: Cole Slaw, Frozen
steps: Shred cabbage; add salt and set for 1 hour.
Mix sugar, vinegar, water, celery and mustard seed.
Boil for 1 minute.
Let cool.
Add pepper and carrot to cabbage.
Pour mixture over cabbage.
Mix well.
Put in containers and freeze.
Will keep in refrigerator a week or more.

title: Ground Beef Basic Mix
steps: Melt margarine in 8-quart pan over low flame.
Add ground beef; turn flame to medium and cook until red color disappears. Add onion, celery and green pepper; cook until beef is brown and vegetables are tender.
Add soup, tomato sauce, salt and pepper; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool and divide equally into 5 freezer containers.
May be thawed and used in a variety of recipes.

title: Anise Oil Cookies
steps: Mix together butter and sugar.
Add egg, wine, vanilla and anise oil.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and remaining ingredients and mix together.
Put in refrigerator overnight. Take out and roll out with cookie cutters.
Grease pan and bake at 350° for 3 minutes.

title: Valley Fresh Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: valley french chunky chicken and
ingredients.raw: 1 can Valley French chunky chicken, drained and cut into pieces

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and chill before serving.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
steps: Have butcher cut loin chops with a pocket for the stuffing. Brown onion in butter.
Combine with bread crumbs, raisins, salt and seasoning.
Stuff pockets with stuffing.
Place in an 8-inch square baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Grandma'S Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown
hamburger
meat
on
stove;
season as you wish. Layer the
hamburger,
potatoes and onions in casserole dish. Pour can of cream of mushroom soup over mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Hot Sponge Cake
steps: Beat eggs; beat in sugar.
Beat in flour.
Melt butter in milk and pour over dry ingredients.
Add vanilla.
Bake in 10-inch square pan at 350° for 25 minutes.
May frost or serve plain with fruit, such as strawberries.

title: Vanilla Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat until mixture is a light lemon color.
Add flour and mix well. Form dough in 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on lightly oiled cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly browned.

title: Cabbage Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Bake at 350° as you would for any meat loaf.
Time depends on thickness of loaf.
Drain juice off as it bakes.
Cabbage will produce extra liquid.

title: Lemon Snowdrops
steps: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar; add extract.
Sift together flour and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Roll level teaspoonfuls into balls.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets; flatten slightly.
Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes.

title: Delicious Bread Pudding #1

ingredients.name: milk scalded with c. butter
ingredients.raw: 2 c. milk, scalded with 1/4 c. butter

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Put bread crumbs in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Blend in remaining ingredients and stir.
Place baking dish in pan of hot water, about 1-inch deep, and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until knife inserted comes out clean.
Great for holidays!

title: Oriental Marinade
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour over uncooked fish or meat.
Marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours.
Grill, broil, saute, stir-fry or bake as you desire.
Grilling seems to bring out the best flavors.
Marinade may be heated and thickened with cornstarch and served as a sauce.

title: Cottage Cheese Spoon Bread
steps: Scald milk in saucepan.
Add cornmeal and cook, stirring constantly until thick.
Mix in sugar and salt.
Mix small amount of hot cornmeal mixture with egg yolks; return to saucepan and mix thoroughly.
Stir in butter and cottage cheese.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Gradually fold in cornmeal mixture.
Pour into baking dish and bake 35 minutes.
Serve with melted butter.

title: Apple Or Peach Crisp

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. Fruit Fresh or lemon juice (pour over fruit)

steps: Mix sugar, flour and egg.
Will be dry and crumbly.
Sprinkle over fruit.
Melt 1 stick margarine.
Pour over.
Bake 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Apple Jello
steps: Dissolve jello and candy in boiling water.
When cool, stir in lemon juice, applesauce and salt.
Pour into mold.

title: Chocolate Scotcheroos

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (6 oz. pkg.) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: Combine sugar and syrup in a 3-quart saucepan.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until mixture begins to bubble.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter; mix well.
Add Rice Krispies; stir until well blended.
Press mixture into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Trout Meuniere

ingredients.name: flour seasoned with salt pepper and spinach of thyme
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. flour, seasoned with salt, pepper and pinch of thyme

steps: Roll trout in seasoned flour.
Heat oil in frypan and add trout which should be gently cooked and browned on both sides. When thoroughly cooked, transfer trout to heated serving platter and keep hot.

title: White Bread
steps: Scald milk. Stir in sugar, salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.
Pour warm water into bowl. Sprinkle yeast and dissolve. Add milk mixture. Stir half the flour into mixture, then add rest of flour and combine.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead. Put into greased bowl.
Brush with melted shortening.
Cover and let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes. Punch down. Divide into 2 equal parts.
Knead.
Place in loaf pan.
Let rise 55 minutes.
Bake at 400° for 50 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

title: White Trash
steps: Mix cereal, raisins and peanuts in a large container.
Over low heat, melt margarine, peanut butter and chocolate morsels, stirring well.
Remove from stove and cool; pour over cereal mixture and mix well.
Place mixture in large paper bag; pour in confectioners sugar and shake until it is coated.
Store in an airtight container.
Enough for a crowd.

title: Stanley Surprise

ingredients.name: black olive and
ingredients.raw: 1 large can pitted black olives, drained and chopped

steps: Mix ingredients and spread on English muffins.
Bake at 400° until bubbles appear, about 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Brown in oil.
Remove chicken and saute onions and garlic until soft.
Add chicken and 20 cups of water.
Bring to a boil and add salt, pepper and Tabasco.
Add rice.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Stir twice while cooking.
Cook until water is absorbed and chicken is tender.
Yields 24 servings.

title: Uncooked, Fresh Peach Pie
steps: Combine peaches, sugar and lemon juice; let stand for 1 hour. Drain and measure 1 cup syrup.
Add cornstarch to syrup and blend. Cook over low heat until thick.
Add salt, butter and flavoring; cool.
Put peaches in shell.
Cover with sauce.
Serve with whipping cream or ice cream.

title: Apple Casserole
steps: Combine cheese, flour, margarine and sugar.
Mix until creamy. Drain apples and pour into baking dish.
Spread cheese mixture over top.
Pour canned milk over the top of this.
Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350° or until well browned.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
steps: Follow directions on cake box and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Beat cheese, sugar, vanilla and eggs.
Spread over cake batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and enjoy.

title: Aunt Lena'S Chocolate Topping
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt.
Add hot water first before cream; cook for 10 minutes at boil.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla; beat with mixer until cool.

title: Hot Choco-Mallow Mix
steps: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl.
Stir in marshmallows. Store in an airtight container with these serving instructions: Combine 1/4 cup mix and 6 ounces boiling water in a mug.
Stir and serve.

title: Bagna Cauda(Northern Italian Antipasto)

ingredients.name: anchovy fillet
ingredients.raw: 6 to 8 anchovy fillets, chopped or equivalent anchovy paste

ingredients.name: your favorite italian bread
ingredients.raw: your favorite Italian bread, sliced thick

steps: Heat butter or margarine and olive oil in saucepan.
Add anchovy and garlic.
Cook on low heat, stirring constantly (if using fillets, ensure they dissolve to a paste).
Transfer to a fondue pot over fondue burner.

title: Molded White Bean Pate

ingredients.name: white kidney bean and thoroughly
ingredients.raw: 2 (15 oz.) cans white kidney beans, rinsed and drained thoroughly

ingredients.name: ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: Place drained kidney beans in a medium bowl and mash thoroughly with a fork.
Saute garlic in olive oil until lightly golden, about 30 seconds.
Do not let it brown.
Mix the garlic and the beans and all other ingredients except 1 tablespoon parsley.

title: Aunt Mary'S Fruit Punch
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients real good.
Then, add the recommended amount of water for each can of orange juice and mix well.
After this, I usually put 1 quart of water and 1 cup of sugar and then stir and taste.
I continue putting 1 quart of water and then some sugar (doesn't have to be a cup each time, maybe 1/2 cup) and taste each time until I get it to taste like I want it.
Everyone has their own taste.

title: Pinwheel Date Cookies
steps: To prepare filling, cook brown sugar, water and dates for 5 minutes, then add nuts.
Allow to cool.
To prepare dough, cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, then salt and flour, mixing until dough like.
Roll out dough and spread on the filling as for jelly rolls.
Roll up, chill, slice and bake at 400° until done.

title: Fabulous Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 large box instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: All fruits must be fresh, not canned or frozen.
Prepare and slice all fruit into bite size pieces.
Mix instant pudding mix powder (not prepared) with fruit and refrigerate overnight in sealed bowl.
Before serving the next day, toss lightly, mixing thoroughly.
The juice and pudding mix make a nice fruit pudding.

title: Millionaire Candy
steps: Place caramels and water in double boiler and stir to dissolve.
Pur over pecans.
Make in flat round balls.
Put on buttered platter and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Cheesy Chicken Crescent Supper
steps: Combine chicken and 1/3 cheese soup.
Roll up in crescent rolls.
Heat remaining ingredients.
Pour 1/2 of soup mixture on jelly roll pan.
Arrange rolls on top of mixture and pour remaining soup mixture on triangles.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Pork Chop Scallop

ingredients.name: pork loin
ingredients.raw: 4 pork loin or rib chops, 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick

steps: Trim excess fat from chops.
Grease 10-inch skillet with fat. Brown chops on both sides; season with salt and pepper.
Remove chops from skillet.
Empty potatoes and seasoned sauce packet into skillet.
Stir in pimiento and amounts of milk and water called for on package.
Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat; place pork chops on top.
Cover and simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Sad Cake Squares
steps: Combine coconut, baking mix, brown sugar and nuts.
Add eggs. Mix with spoon.
Do not overmix!
Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan for 40 minutes at 325°.
Cool.
Cut into squares.

title: Tuna Cheese Wedges
steps: Drain and flake tuna.
Add a few drops of Worcestershire sauce.
Add all ingredients together and spread over 12 English muffins.

title: Blueberry-Lemon Muffins
steps: Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and 3/4 teaspoon salt.
Combine egg, milk and oil.
Add all at once to flour mixture.
Stir until moistened.
Fold in blueberries which have been mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar, the peel of 1 lemon and the juice of that lemon.

title: Best Yet Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients by hand. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (greased only).
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cherried Cranberries
steps: Put all ingredients and 1 cup water in heavy 4-quart pan. Bring to boil over medium heat.
Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Do not uncover during cooking or cooling.
Store in jars in refrigerator.

title: Crawfish Etouffee

ingredients.name: salt and cayenne pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and cayenne pepper to taste

steps: Saute onions and sweet peppers in butter or margarine for 5 minutes.
Add cream of mushroom soup.
Add few tablespoons of water, if necessary.
Add scallions, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika to taste.
Add crawfish tails; cook 5 minutes or until done.
Serve over white rice.

title: Sausage-Egg Bake
steps: Spread bread cubes in buttered 7 x 11-inch baking dish.
Layer sausage and cheese over bread.
Combine eggs and mustard with 1 generous cup of milk in a
bowl, beating well.
Pour over sausage and cheese.
Blend 1/4 cup of milk with soup until smooth.
Pour over all.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Yields 6 servings, about 350 calories each.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Pare and quarter potatoes.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag, coating potatoes well with cheese mixture.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Place potatoes in pan.
Bake at 375 ° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking when golden brown.

title: Yummy Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients, except soup; shape into balls and place on a greased baking dish.
Pour the soup, thinned with water over the Yummy Balls and bake for 1 hour at 375°.

title: Top Of The Stove Baked Beans
steps: Brown together ground beef with onion powder.
Drain off excess grease.
Mix together with all other ingredients.
Stir and simmer until thick.

title: Apple Candy Pie
steps: Put apples in baking dish (greased) and sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Add water.
Melt butter and add it to 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour.
Mix well and put on top of apple mixture, patting it down firmly.
Bake 3/4 hour to one hour in 350° oven.
Serve with cream.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except chocolate and nuts.
Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add chocolate and nuts and mix.
Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.

title: Chicken Taco Casserole
steps: Boil chicken breasts.
(Skin, debone and tear into small pieces.)
Mix chicken pieces, cream of chicken soup (not diluted), onions and peppers.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with corn oil. Layer chips, soup mixture and cheese until soup mixture is gone. Final layer of chips and sprinkle top with cheese.
Cover with foil.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil; cook for 5 more minutes.
Allow to cool for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Muffins
steps: Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly (do not sift). Add shortening, unbeaten egg and sour milk.
Beat only until smooth. Fill well oiled muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 425° about 25 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves.
Boil, without stirring, until temperature reaches 310° or until drops of syrup form hard, brittle threads in cold water.
Remove from heat.
After boiling has ceased, stir in flavoring and coloring.
Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Cool and break into pieces.
Store in airtight containers.

title: Peanut Buster Dessert
steps: Mix together butter and pat 3/4 of the cookie crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream that has been softened.
Put in freezer until firm.
Before serving, cover with fudge topping (not syrup); sprinkle with peanuts and cover with Cool Whip.
Use the 1/4 cup of Oreo cookies on top.

title: Blueberry Pie (Low-Fat)
steps: Place first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a good boil.
Heat oven to 350°.
Melt oleo in a Dutch oven.
Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and vanilla and pour mixture over oleo.
Using a cup, pour berries over the mixture. Bake at 350° until done, about 40 minutes.

title: Crescent Cheese Danish
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Lay out 1 package of rolls in bottom of pan.
Pinch seams together.
Mix cream cheese, 1 egg and 1 yolk, sugar and vanilla.
Mix well.
Spoon over rolls.
Take other package of rolls and spread on top.
(I lay rolls out on waxed paper first so I can push out to right size.)
Brush slightly whipped egg white on top.
Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of sugar. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Chill.
Great for breakfast or as dessert.

title: Allison'S Peach Crisp
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put peach slices in square casserole dish.
In separate bowl, work together the sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and margarine until crumbly.
Add the lemon rind and mix.
Sprinkle over top of fruit.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven until the peaches are tender and the top is browned.
This takes about 20 to 30 minutes.
Enjoy!
Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Belleville Gooey Bars
steps: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix cake mix and 1 egg until crumbly.
Press into bottom of pan.
Mix the cream cheese, eggs, lemon juice and sugar (except for 1 tablespoon of the sugar) and pour onto cake.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved sugar and cool. Cut into squares.

title: Cassie'S Pecan Pie
steps: Beat all ingredients together, except pecans, for approximately 2 minutes.
Add pecans.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in a 375° oven for 35 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.
Cool before cutting.

title: Hoppin' John
steps: In a large skillet, saute onion, celery and garlic in hot olive oil until onion is soft.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to a boil; reduce heat and cover tightly.
Simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Makes about 6 servings.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
steps: Mix all ingredients in proper sized buttered baking dish.
Dot generously with butter.
Bake, uncovered, slowly until bread browns a bit, at least 1 1/2 hours in 325° oven.

title: Snickers Pie Or Cake
steps: Cook cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
When cake gets done, take out of oven and poke holes all in the cake.
Take your Smucker's caramel and condensed milk, already mixed together, and pour over cake.
Take the Snickers bars, sliced thin (to melt) and put on top of cake.
Top with Cool Whip, if desired.
Very rich!

title: Peas And Rice

ingredients.name: salt pork fine fat from a baked ham
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. salt pork, chopped fine, fat from a baked ham or bacon drippings

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 c. canned tomatoes or 2 Tbsp. tomato paste

ingredients.name: pigeon pea
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pigeon peas or black-eyed peas

steps: Fry salt pork to get the fat.
Add onion, tomato, salt, pepper and thyme.
Stir all together and continue cooking.
Add peas and 3 cups water.
Let come to a boil and stir in rice.
Cover and cook until rice is tender and water absorbed.
Add another cup of water and cover to swell the rice.
Add more water, if needed. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Raspberry Crisscross Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening as for pie.
Add eggs and milk.
Keep 1/4 of dough out.
Spread rest on 10 x 15-inch cake tin.
Press dough well up along side of pan.
Spread with jam. Sprinkle with nuts.
Pinch off pieces of reserved dough with palms of hands and make 1/2-inch strips.
Place on top for crisscross at 1 1/2 inches apart.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes.
Let cool in pan.
Cut with sharp knife in center of each strip so that each piece has dough around.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple juice and reserved
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, juice drained and reserved

ingredients.name: sugar instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: In small bowl, combine reserved pineapple juice, pudding mix and Tang; set aside.
In large bowl, combine all the fruit.
Fold juice mixture into fruit.
Refrigerate before serving.

title: Pimento Cheese
steps: Heat in double boiler until melted, then mash up pimiento pepper real good.
Remove from boiler and stir for a few minutes longer.

title: Top Heavy Coconut Cake
steps: Make cake by box directions.
Bake as directed.
When has about 15 minutes left in oven, put sugar and pineapple in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
Boil until sugar is dissolved.
Poke holes in cake and pour mixture over entire cake.
Place in refrigerator. Cool completely.
Make pudding and pour over cake.
Use 1/2 coconut and Cool Whip.
Mix together.
Put over cake.
Then top with remainder of coconut.
Then take your hand and push coconut into Cool Whip so it doesn't fall off cake.

title: Perpetual Pot Of Fruit With Rum Or Brandy
steps: Bring water and sugar to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Cool.
Add lemon juice and rum or brandy (or some of both).
Pour into a large container with cover. Add fruit to the syrup, making sure that the fruit is submerged. Refrigerate, replenishing as needed.
Keeps beautifully.

title: Carrot Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Beat all ingredients until smooth and even color.
Sprinkle paprika or cut chives on top.
Serve with carrots.

title: Raspberry Mousse(Makes 8 To 10 Servings.)

ingredients.name: red raspberry in syrup thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen red raspberries in syrup, thawed

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

ingredients.name: realemon lemon juice from concentrate
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate

ingredients.name: whipping cream stiffly whipped
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (1 pt.) whipping cream, stiffly whipped

steps: In small saucepan, combine 1 package undrained raspberries and cornstarch; cook and stir until thickened and clear.
Chill thoroughly.
In blender, combine remaining 1 package drained raspberries, Eagle Brand and ReaLemon brand; blend until smooth. Place in large bowl; stir in food coloring if desired.
Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon half the mousse mixture into dessert dishes; top with equal portions of raspberry sauce, then remaining mousse mixture.
Chill thoroughly.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Triple Layer Party Pie

ingredients.name: sugar instant butterscotch pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) sugar-free instant butterscotch pudding mix

ingredients.name: nonfat dry milk powder divided
ingredients.raw: 1 1/3 c. nonfat dry milk powder, divided

ingredients.name: sugar instant chocolate pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) sugar-free instant chocolate pudding mix

steps: In medium bowl combine butterscotch pudding mix, 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder and 1 1/4 cups water.
Mix well using a wire whisk. Pour into pie crust.
In medium bowl combine chocolate pudding mix, remaining 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk and remaining 1 1/4 cups water. Mix well using wire whisk.
Pour over butterscotch layer.
Cover and chill in refrigerator until set, about one hour.

title: Kraut Soup
steps: Boil pork chops and potatoes until cooked.
Saute onion in pan and roll in flour.
Add 1 large can of tomatoes and string kraut.

title: Gingersnap Cookies
steps: In large bowl, beat together sugar and shortening; add molasses.
Mix well.
Add beaten egg.
Stir together all remaining ingredients.
Mix into molasses mixture until thoroughly combined. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or overnight.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls, then place balls into granulated
sugar.
Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Coca-Cola Ham Steak
steps: Cut each end of ham so ham steak won't curl.
Pour the Coke over the ham in skillet. Cook over medium heat.
Keep turning until Coke has vanished.
Ham will be done. Serve with a slice of pineapple on top.

title: Key Lime Cake With Frosting
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Pour into a greased and floured 9x13-inch pan.

title: Children'S Edible Play Dough
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
If it gets too sticky, put in a little flour.
Feeds six children.

title: Hot Chili Dip
steps: Mix together.
Microwave on High until bubbling or bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Mandarin Salad
steps: Mix the sour cream, marshmallows and coconut.
Use wooden spoon and stir in oranges and pineapple.
Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving, add bananas.
Serves 6.

title: Quesidillas(Kay-Sa-De-Ya)
steps: Soften cream cheese; then add olives and enough salsa to make mixture pink.
Place 1 tortilla on plate (or server) and spread cheese mixture; repeat process ending with tortilla on top.
Cut into small slices like pie.
For garnish, fasten stuffed olive on each slice with toothpick.

title: Red-Skinned Mashed Potatoes
steps: Add salt and soybean oil to 1 quart water.
Bring to a boil and add potatoes until fork-tender.
Remove potatoes and add butter, heavy cream, pepper and sour cream.
Mash.
Serves 4.

title: Salted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Boil dry seeds for 5 minutes.
Spray baking sheet with pam. spread seeds on baking sheet.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bake at 350 degrees until dry. Serve warm or cool.

title: "Company" Bread
steps: Trim
crust
off top and sides of loaf of French bread. Cut X's across top.
Place Swiss cheese, cut in small pieces, in
X's. In
pan
melt butter, mustard, onion, poppy seed and lemon juice until all is dissolved.
Spoon over bread and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Box Honey Graham Crackers
steps: Break graham crackers into sections and line bottom of pan. Bring butter to boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour over crackers and add pecans.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Let cool.

title: Corn Souffle
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven or until lightly browned.

title: Chocolate-Almond Frosting
steps: Mix butter with coffee, salt and chocolate.
Add rest of ingredients and beat thoroughly.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Beat until creamy and frost tops and sides of cakes.

title: Rice And Broccoli Dish
steps: Saute chopped onion in melted margarine until tender.
Add the mushroom soup.
Cut up 1/3 of a small box of Velveeta or American cheese.
Add to onion and soup mixture.
Melt cheese with mixture. Add 2 cups cooked rice and 10 ounces of frozen broccoli (thawed and drained).
Pour in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Drop on greased sheet.
Bake at 375°.

title: "Miss" Jean'S Squash Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup mixed with c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken soup mixed with 1/2 c. water

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm dressing mix cornbread kind
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing mix, cornbread kind

steps: Combine melted butter with dressing mix.
Sprinkle small amount in casserole dish.
Save
enough
to cover top of casserole and combine the rest of crumbs with the other ingredients. Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle the reserved crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
steps: Mix sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt together.
Beat egg whites and water until it's meringue consistency.
Add sugar mixture 1 tablespoon at a time.
Beat to a stiff peak.
Fold in pecan halves.

title: Baked Applesauce
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine first four ingredients in a buttered casserole dish.
Put butter on top of applesauce.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Dream Bars
steps: Mix until crumbly.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown and firm.

title: Seafood Casserole

ingredients.name: bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. bread crumbs (reserve 1/2 c. for top)

steps: Blend half and half and mayonnaise.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into greased casserole.
Cover with 1/2 cup bread crumbs.
Dot with butter, if desired.
Bake at 350° approximately 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Carrie

ingredients.name: plu c. chicken broth
ingredients.raw: 1/2 plus c. chicken broth (I use 1 can Campbell's chicken broth)

steps: Use a skillet or wok.
Saute onion, green pepper, salt and pepper in chicken fat.
Place potatoes on top of ingredients in skillet or wok, then chicken breasts on top of potatoes.
Pour in broth.
Cover and simmer gently, about 30 minutes.
Do not stir.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruits
steps: In small bowl, combine all ingredients until smooth.
Chill about 2 hours.
Serve over fresh fruit salads.
Yield: 1 1/4 cups.

title: Red Hot Salad
steps: Dissolve red hots in hot water and add Jell-O.	Blend thoroughly and cool.
Add applesauce.
Pour in loaf pan and jell.

title: Apple Bars
steps: Sift flour, salt and baking soda together.
Add brown sugar and rolled oats.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Spread half the mixture in a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish.

title: Eggplant Parmesan

ingredients.name: eggplant and
ingredients.raw: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided

steps: Whisk together eggs and 3 tablespoons water until well blended.
Combine bread

crumbs and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Dip the sliced eggplant into the egg mixture, then dredge in the bread crumb mixture. Cook the eggplant in 3 batches in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil (per batch) in a large skillet over medium heat 4 minutes on each side or until tender. Arrange 1/3 of eggplant in a single layer in a lightly greased 11 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers twice. Spoon 3 cups pasta sauce over top. Bake, covered, at 375° for 35 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake 10 more minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Popovers
steps: Put flour and salt in bowl.
Add milk and eggs.
Beat with a rotary beater for 3 minutes.
Add melted butter and stir.
Put in well-greased muffin tins (have tins hot).
Bake in hot oven at 350° for 40 minutes.
Yield will be 12 muffins.

title: Frozen Lemon Crumb Dessert
steps: Mix flour, brown sugar, margarine and nuts until crumbly. Spread on cookie sheet lined with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.
Bake in 350° oven for 13 to 15 minutes.
Cool; break apart into crumbs. Line an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil, leaving a 1 1/2-inch collar around top.
Spread 2/3 of crumb mixture in bottom.
Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon color; blend in condensed milk.
Add lemon juice and rind; stir until thickened.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold into lemon mixture.
Pour mixture into prepared pan; sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Freeze until firm.
When solid, cover with piece of foil the size of the top.
Lift from pan and return to freezer. Slice in bars to serve.

title: Pecan Pie(Easy)
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in uncooked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Pecans will rise to top.

title: Speedy Charlie Chile
steps: Drain the first three ingredients.
Mix all together and heat.

title: Best (And Easy!) Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and flour.
Beat for 10 minutes.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300° until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Great with strawberries and whipped cream or for wedding cakes.

title: Chopped Beef Spread

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chopped beef or corned beef

steps: Soften cream cheese; add finely chopped onions, beef, garlic and Worcestershire sauce.
Chill; serve on crackers.

title: No Cook Fudge
steps: Melt oleo and cheese together in a large pan.
Be very careful not to get too hot.
Add sugar, cocoa, vanilla and nutmeats.
Mix well, then spread in two 9 x 13-inch buttered pans.
Let cool 30 minutes before cutting in squares.
Makes about 7 pounds.

title: Boiled Tongue
steps: Scrub tongue well.
Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil.
Skim, cover and simmer until tender, 3 to 4 hours.
Add 1/2 teaspoon salt per pound when partially cooked.
Remove skin when tender.
To 2 cups strained water in which tongue has been boiled, add the rest of the ingredients.
Blend together to form sauce.
Place tongue in roasting pan; pour over sauce.
Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°, turning often.

title: Bubbling Cheese Bread

ingredients.name: loaf french bread lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) loaf French bread, halved lengthwise

steps: In medium bowl, combine the first 3 ingredients.
Spread cheese mixture on cut side of each bread half.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Time Out For Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: doz. chicken wing disjointed and tip removed
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 doz. chicken wings, disjointed and tips removed

ingredients.name: catalina french dressing from kraft
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) bottle Catalina French dressing from Kraft

steps: Combine dressing, soy sauce and ginger.
Pour over chicken. Marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight.
Place wings on broiler pan.
Broil 15 to 20 minutes, turning once.
Brush occasionally with marinade.
Makes 36 appetizers.

title: St. Patrick'S Trader Vic Salad
steps: Mix all but lettuce and croutons.
Toss with greens and top with croutons.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: berry cranberry sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can whole berry cranberry sauce

steps: Mix all ingredients together and spoon into paper lined muffin cup and freeze.
Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving. Makes 15 servings.

title: Party Pizza
steps: In a frying pan, brown ground beef.
Drain off fat.
Mix in Parmesan cheese, onion, oregano, tomato paste and Mozzarella cheese.
Cut French bread in half lengthwise.
Lay bread, cut side up, on a cookie sheet.
Spread meat mixture evenly over top of bread halves.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Old Fashioned Mince Pie
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix mincemeat and apple.
Pour into pastry lined pie pan.
Cover with top crust which has slits in it.
Seal and flute.
Cover edge with 1 1/2-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excess browning.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is nicely browned.
Serve slightly warm with whipped cream on top.

title: Quick Uncooked Cookies
steps: Mix together sugar, milk, cocoa and butter; bring to a boil. Boil for 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat; then add quick cooking oatmeal, vanilla and pecans.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Veal Cutlets

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. veal or pork, cut into 4 slices

steps: Pound meat.
Sprinkle with salt.
Dip first in flour, then in eggs and then in bread crumbs.
Fry in butter or oil until brown. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Seasoned Brussels Sprouts Parmesan
steps: In large saucepan, add brussels sprouts, salt and butter to 2 inches of water.
Bring to boil, cover and cook until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain.
Add salad crunches and parsley and sprinkle parmesan to cover sprouts.
Serve warm.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Edible Rocket
steps: Peel the banana.
Cut it in half crosswise.
Cut the pineapple ring into quarters. Place a banana half on a plate.
Place 2 pineapple quarters near the base of the banana.
Spoon 1/4 cup of the cottage cheese around the bottom and eat!

title: Easter Lily
steps: Mix all together.
Drop on greased cookie sheet (about 1 teaspoon), six on sheet.
Bake at 350°
for 7 minutes.
Pinch together while hot in the shape of a lily.
Fill open end with Cool Whip and cherry.

title: Marinated Steak

ingredients.name: flank steak
ingredients.raw: 1 thick flank steak or London broil (about 1 1/2 lb.)

steps: Mix together the wine, soy sauce and seasonings.
Place the steak in a long glass baking dish and pour the marinade over the meat.
Cover and chill at least 12 to 18 hours, turning the meat over once or twice.
Preheat the broiler.
Remove the steak from the marinade.
Pat dry and broil 4-inches from the heat for about 5 minutes on each side.
To serve, cut thin slices diagonally across the grain.
Serve with rice.

title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins

ingredients.name: raisin bran
ingredients.raw: 15 to 20 oz. box Raisin Bran (7 1/2 c.)

steps: Mix in very large bowl Raisin Bran, sugar, flour and salt. Add soda, cinnamon, beaten eggs, oil and 1 quart of buttermilk; mix well.
Stir all the way to the bottom; refrigerate.
Do not stir again.
Fill muffin tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Keep in refrigerator for 6 weeks.
Use just what you need each time.
Makes 5 dozen.

title: Johnny Cake
steps: Heat water to a boil.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, sugar and salt.
Add boiling water, stirring gradually into 3 ingredients.
Batter should not be too thin.
Add milk and butter.
Using a small ladle, pour batter onto hot greased griddle forming cakes about 3 inches in diameter.
Fry until browned on both sides.
Serve with maple syrup.
Serves 2 to 4.

title: Banana Cream Pie(No Bake)

ingredients.name: instant banana pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. instant banana pudding (regular or sugar-free)

steps: Mix pudding mix with cold milk at lowest speed of mixer for 3 minutes.
Remove mixer.
Fold in 1/2 cup whipped topping.
Slice banana into pie crust.
Pour in pudding.
Chill 3 hours.
Top with remaining whipped topping.

title: Pineapple Spoon Bread

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 lb. can (2 1/2 c.) crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Grease 2-quart casserole. Mix sugar, flour and salt. Beat in eggs. Add pineapple. Pour in pan. Tear bread or croissants into pieces and spread over mixture.
Pour melted butter over bread. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour or until it stops jiggling.

title: Day Ahead Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: mashed potato prepared as usual
ingredients.raw: 4 c. mashed potatoes, prepared as usual

steps: Mix all ingredients together while potatoes are warm.
Put in casserole a day ahead.
Warm in oven at 350° for 45 minutes. Especially good with ham.

title: Corn Puddings

ingredients.name: yellow kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 can yellow whole kernel corn (12 oz.)

steps: Mix flour and sugar together.
Stir in corn and all other ingredients.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake until thick, but not too dry (approximately 30 minutes at 350°).

title: Smoky Sausage Spread

ingredients.name: smoked sausage link fully
ingredients.raw: 3 large smoked sausage links, fully cooked

ingredients.name: cheese spread with jalapeno
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar cheese spread with jalapenos

ingredients.name: bread bagel
ingredients.raw: sliced bread, bagels or English muffins

steps: Cut up cooked sausage links in small, fine pieces; set aside. Combine cheese spread and Monterey Jack cheese; beat with mixer until well combined.
Stir in sausage.
Spread on bread, bagels or English muffins.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Pilau

ingredients.name: or can mushroom and brown
ingredients.raw: 3 small or 1 large can mushrooms, sliced and browned

steps: Cook hen with celery, bay leaves, salt, pepper and enough water to cover.
When the chicken is ready to fall from the bones, remove from broth; set aside.

title: Apple Pie Mix

ingredients.name: tart apple and
ingredients.raw: 6 tart apples, peeled and sliced thin

steps: Sprinkle apples with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add vanilla and lemon juice.
Cook slowly for about 25 minutes, stir occasionally.

title: Coconut Surprise
steps: Mix and bake cake (per directions) and let cool for about 15 minutes.
Poke holes in top of cake.
Mix together milk and cream of coconut.
Pour mixture on top of cake.
Put in refrigerator and let set.
Sprinkle coconut and/or nuts on top.

title: Lattice Jam Bars

ingredients.name: almond is best
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. chopped almonds, crushed is best

ingredients.name: each sugar butter and flour
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. each: sugar, butter and flour

steps: Mix together the almonds and sugar.
Blend in butter and flour.
Mix well.
Add egg yolks.
Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick. Save half for cross bars.
Spread on cookie sheet, then spread 1 pound apricot jam over dough.
Make cross bars by rolling out dough and cutting into strips.
Crisscross strips on top of jam to give lattice effect.
Bake in a 350°
oven about 30 minutes, or until light brown.
Great!

title: Dump Delight Cake

ingredients.name: cake mix yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 box cake mix yellow or white (dry)

steps: Spread pie filling and pineapple in a 13 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit (do not stir).
Top with nuts; add coconut.
Pour melted butter over all and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Great with ice cream.
Serves 12 to 15.

title: Broiled Salmon With Herbed Lemon Butter

ingredients.name: dill weed rosemary
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. dill weed, rosemary or marjoram, crushed

steps: Line broiler pan with foil and place salmon fillets on the well-greased rack.
Combine remaining ingredients; baste salmon with mixture.
Broil 4 inches from heat, allowing 10 minutes cooking time per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Do not turn salmon.
Baste several times during cooking.
Makes 8 servings.

title: New Uncooked White Mystery Fruitcake

ingredients.name: each candied pineapple lemon peel orange peel citron up
ingredients.raw: 1 c. each: candied pineapple, lemon peel, orange peel, citron, cut up

ingredients.name: red and green cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whole red and green cherries

ingredients.name: blanched almond and pecan up
ingredients.raw: 4 1/2 c. blanched almonds and pecans, cut up

ingredients.name: betty crocker fluffy white frosting mix
ingredients.raw: Betty Crocker fluffy white frosting mix

steps: Bake cake mix, following package directions.
Cool.
Crumble cake into very large bowl or pan.
Add fruit to crumbled cake. Make Betty Crocker frosting mix, following package directions. Mix with cake and fruit.
Pack tightly into foil-lined 10-inch tube pan or two 9 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Cover cake with foil and chill in refrigerator at least 24 hours.
Cake should be kept refrigerated.
Slice with sharp knife.

title: Coconut Flan
steps: Mix both milks, eggs and vanilla until well combined.
Stir in the flaked coconut and pour the mixture into 6 individual custard cups or a larger flan mold.

Place the cups or mold in a large baking pan and fill it with water to a depth of 1-inch. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. A flan mold will take longer than individual cups. Allow to cool, then refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Fried Fish
steps: Cut fillets in 4-inch portions.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix nuts and cayenne.
Dip fillets in egg and water mix; roll in flour.
Fry in butter in skillet or microwave 5 minutes with nut mix sprinkled over fillets.

title: Green Bean Casserole (Quick And Easy)
steps: Mix green beans and cream of mushroom soup and top with onion rings.
Place in microwave until steaming hot.

title: Chili-Cheese Rounds

ingredients.name: green chily and
ingredients.raw: 1 can (4 oz.) whole green chilies, drained, seeded and chopped

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (about 4 oz.)

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix beans, onion and pepper sauce; reserve.
Mix baking mix and sour cream until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth covered board.
Knead 20 times.
Roll dough 1/4 inch thick.
Cut with floured 2-inch cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press a deep indention about 1 1/2 inches in diameter in center of each round with floured hands.
Fill each with generous teaspoon of bean mixture; spread within indention. Top each with chilies and cheese.
Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Snicker Bar Salad
steps: Dice apples with peeling on.
Slice bananas and the refrigerated candy bars into bite size pieces.
Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Loaf
steps: Saute onion and celery in margarine.
Mix all ingredients well and bake in greased 8-inch casserole at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Honey Cornbread
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Beat eggs, add cream, oil and honey.
Stir into dry ingredients until just moistened.
Pour into 9 inch square pan.
Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Spiced Coffee
steps: In saucepan, combine all ingredients except coffee.
Heat to boiling.
Strain.
Pour liquid over coffee in heatproof container. Stir coffee until dissolved.

title: Meat And Potato Cakes
steps: Mix ground beef with sauce, onion and salt.
Shape into patties. Brown on each side.
Put hot potatoes on each patty. Sprinkle with cheese and brown or until cheese melts.

title: Cake
steps: Mix the yellow cake mix, one of the eggs and the margarine together and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat for 3 minutes the other 2 eggs, cream cheese and sugar.
Pour on top of the "crust."
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Frankie Rouse'S 7-Minute Icing
steps: Place all ingredients except marshmallows and vanilla in top of double boiler over boiling water and beat with a rotary beater 7 minutes or until mixture holds a peak.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and marshmallows.
Continue to beat until well blended and apply to cake.

title: Cheese Souffle

ingredients.name: salt and red pepper
ingredients.raw: dash of salt and red pepper

steps: Line sides and bottom of medium size casserole dish with bread dipped in melted butter or margarine.
Mix other ingredients together and pour into bread-lined dish.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Easy Clams And Linguini
steps: Fry garlic and onion in oil until lightly browned.
Add clams with only 1/2 juice, parsley and a little salt and pepper.
Add wine; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve over cooked linguini.

title: Microwave Party Mints

ingredients.name: red green
ingredients.raw: red, green or yellow food coloring

steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup, milk and cream of tartar in a 2-quart glass measure.
Cook on High for 6 minutes.
Let stand 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly cooled.
Beat vigorously until creamy. Add peppermint extract and food coloring.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto sheets of foil.
Let stand until cool and firm.
Store in airtight container.
Makes about 36 mints.

title: American Meat Loaf
steps: Thoroughly combine all ingredients and shape into a loaf pan (8 x 4 x 1 1/2-inches).
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
Allow meat loaf to stand 5 minutes before slicing.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Torn Salad Dressing
steps: Put all the ingredients into blender. Can add roquefort or bleu cheese.
Keeps well.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Appetizers

ingredients.name: each of rosemary thyme salt pepper garlic powder
ingredients.raw: small pinch each of: rosemary, thyme, salt, pepper, garlic powder

steps: Drain crabmeat; press to remove excess fluid.
Flake.
Mix crabmeat, onions, cheese, seasonings and mayonnaise.
Remove stems and scrape gills from mushrooms with a spoon to make deep cups. Heat oven to 325°.
Stuff mushrooms generously with crab mixture. Place in ungreased shallow baking dish.
Bake 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Turn oven to broil.
Broil until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Apple Punch
steps: Combine juices in freezer container.
Mix well.
Freeze for 2 days.
Place mixture in a punch bowl.
Add ginger ale 1 hour before serving.

title: Gnocchi
steps: Beat egg before you mix in rest of ingredients.
Flour hands and separate dough into 4 sections.
Roll each section into snakes on a floured surface.
Cut 1-inch pieces out of the snakes and, with thumb, press flat.
Fast freeze (about 10 minutes) on a cookie sheet.
When hard, cook in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes after they rise to the top of the pot.
Serve with spaghetti sauce.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Casserole

ingredients.name: ground meat beef
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. ground meat, beef or veal

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. tomato sauce or chopped tomatoes

steps: Cook macaroni until slightly tender.
Drain.
Set aside. Brown meat and onions in small skillet.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Oil a 1-quart casserole dish; spoon in 1/3 of meat mixture.
Add cooked macaroni and then add remaining meat. Spread cheese soup over all (may be frozen uncooked).
Cover the casserole tightly; bake at 400° until bubbly.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip S'More Cookie
steps: Microwave Directions:
Spread 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter on flat side of each cookie.
Place marshmallow between peanut butter spread sides of cookies, making a sandwich on microwave-safe paper towel.
Microwave on High for 6 to 8 seconds or until marshmallow is slightly softened.
Squeeze cookie together slightly.
Makes 1 cookie.

title: Venison Ala Desjardins

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: 2 c. water or more as needed

steps: In heavy skillet brown salt pork in olive oil.
Add vegetables and saute until slightly tender.
Remove pork and vegetables, leaving fat in skillet.
Add 1/4 cup pickle juice to skillet and brown meat.
Baste meat with juice while browning.
Sugar in juice will caramelize and glaze meat.
Turn meat and baste with additional 1/4 cup of juice.
Add more juice as needed.
Juice will cook off as meat browns.
Put all the remaining ingredients in a large covered roasting pan or kettle and cook in 325° oven for approximately 4 hours or cook, covered, on top of stove for 4 hours or until tender.
Pour gravy over sliced meat to serve.

title: Black Bean Salad

ingredients.name: shoe peg corn thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 small bag Shoe Peg corn, thawed

steps: Soak beans overnight. Drain soaking liquid. Cook 1 hour. Rinse and chill beans.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour over with Italian dressing. Will keep several days.

title: Apple Nut Pudding
