steps: Beat the egg until foamy.
Add sugar and beat again.
Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder and beat into the egg-sugar mixture.	Blend in the apples, nuts and vanilla.	Bake in a pie pan at 350° until the top is crisp, about 30 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Almond Butter Crunch
steps: Mix everything in a 10 inch skillet.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly until the mixture turns golden brown (about 5 or 6 minutes).
Spread in a greased 8 or 9 inch round pan.
Cool.
Remove from pan and break into pieces.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad Dressing
steps: Mix juices and sugar; stir in beaten egg.
Cook in double boiler for 5 minutes until spoon is coated.
Good on fruits and melons.

title: Stuffed Sweet Peppers
steps: Mix ground beef, onion, 2/3 cup chopped pepper and cooked rice.
Add crumbled bread and tomato juice; mix well.
Take seeds out of the 8 sweet peppers and drop peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain and fill with ground beef mixture.
Put in a large pot with lid and pour ketchup over top of peppers.
Add 1/2 cup of tomato juice to pot.
Cover and cook 2 hours in oven at 350°. Uncover and cook 30
minutes.

title: Stuffed Cornish Game Hens

ingredients.name: stove top grain and wild rice stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Stove Top long grain and wild rice stuffing mix

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. orange juice or white wine

steps: Prepare stuffing as directed on package.
Do not stuff hens until ready to roast.
Rinse hens with cold water.
Pat dry.
Rub neck and body cavities with salt and pepper.
Lightly stuff cavities with prepared stuffing.
Roast at 400° for 1 hour.
Place any remaining stuffing in a small baking dish; bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
(Meanwhile, heat orange juice and butter; baste hens frequently during the last 30 minutes of roasting.)

title: Baked Beans With Pineapple And Bacon

ingredients.name: pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (30 oz.) large can pork and beans, drained (remove pork)

steps: Mix all ingredients, except bacon in 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cook bacon crisp; blot on paper towel.
Crumble up and add to bean mixture before serving.
Very good.

title: Confetti Rice
steps: Melt butter in a skillet.
Add rice, toss to coat with butter. Heat on low for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place rice mixture in a 2-quart casserole bowl; add hot chicken broth.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Cook 5 additional minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Italian Torta

ingredients.name: loaf italian bread in
ingredients.raw: 3/4 loaf Italian sliced bread, broken in pieces

steps: Soak bread in hot milk.
Set aside.
Beat together eggs and sugar.
Add to soaked bread/milk mixture.
Add vanilla, raisins and grated apple.
Add brandy last.
Bake in well-greased pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Carrots
steps: Grate
carrots.
Place	in
8-inch Dutch oven.	Mix the rest of the ingredients and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Bake
steps: Cook meat, mix in refried beans, taco seasoning mix until hot and blended. Mix enchilada sauce and soup together, warm.
Put meat mixture in middle of tortilla, roll and place in greased baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over rolled tortillas, sprinkle with cheese and bake until bubbly.

title: Pickled Shrimp

ingredients.name: and deveined shrimp
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. raw, peeled and deveined shrimp (41 to 50 count or larger)

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 2 medium white or purple onions, sliced into rings

steps: Place shrimp in boiling salted water; reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.
Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender; drain and rinse with cold water, then chill.

title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream Pie

ingredients.name: dry roasted peanut
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. chopped dry roasted, unsalted peanuts

steps: Prepare crust.
Cool.
Press half of softened ice cream into crust.
In small bowl, stir corn syrup and peanut butter until blended.
Pour half of mixture over ice cream.
Sprinkle with half of peanuts, repeating layering.
Freeze until firm, about 5 hours. Let pie stand at room temperature for 5 minutes for easy cutting.

title: Mrs. Yoppi'S Nut Roll
steps: Mix oleo with flour, like pie dough.
Add egg yolks, sour cream and vanilla.
Mix together and make 8 balls of dough.
Put in refrigerator for 2 1/2 hours or overnight.
Roll like pies in powdered sugar.
Beat egg whites and 1/2 box powdered sugar together.
Spread egg white mixture over dough; sprinkle with ground nuts.
Cut with pizza cutter like pie in 8 pieces.
Roll outside to center and put on greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Meatza Pie

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm herb stuffing crumb
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing crumbs

steps: Place beef, garlic salt and stuffing in pie pan.
Add milk and mix together with fork.
Spread mixture evenly over bottom of pan with a rim around the edge.
Spread tomato paste over meat. Sprinkle oregano and mushrooms over paste.
Top with cheeses. Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Quick And Easy Lasagne
steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Mix with spaghetti sauce, drained mushrooms and water.
Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan: meat sauce, uncooked lasagne noodles, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, beginning and ending with meat sauce.
Sprinkle top with Parmesan.
Cover with heavy duty foil and seal tightly.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before removing foil.

title: Shirley'S Snack Crackers
steps: Put crackers in a large bowl.
Pour on oil.
In another bowl, mix together all dry ingredients.
Mix all ingredients together and store in a container with a lid.

title: Hummus

ingredients.name: chickpea
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can garbanzo beans, drained (reserve liquid)

steps: In small frying pan, toast sesame seed over low heat, shaking pan often, until golden brown (about 3 minutes).

Transfer seed to blender or food processor and add garbanzos, 2 tablespoons olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and 6 tablespoons reserved liquid. Whirl, adding more liquid if necessary, until hummus is smooth, but still thick.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place in shallow bowl.
Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
steps: In small saucepan on low heat, melt butter and chocolate. Take off burner.
Add sugar and mix.
Add one egg at a time, mixing after each.
Add all remaining ingredients and mix.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice In Green Vegetable Broth
steps: Remove and discard skin from chicken.
In a large sauce pan, combine chicken broth, water, rice, thyme and pepper.
Add chicken, cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Shred cabbage and spinach.
Remove chicken to a cutting board.
Remove meat from bones and cut into bite size pieces.
Return chicken to broth, add cabbage and spinach, bring to a boil over medium heat.
Boil broth just until cabbage and chicken are wilted and heated through, 1 minute.

title: Zesta Dessert
steps: Combine crackers with butter and press on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan, reserving 1/4 cup for topping.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gradually add sugar, salt and vanilla.
Spread egg white mixture over cracker crumbs.
Bake in a 325° oven 10 to 15 minutes.
Cool.
Spread pie filling over top. Beat whipping cream until stiff.
Add powdered sugar.
Spread pie filling and refrigerate.
Cut into squares to serve.

title: Fried Onion Rings
steps: Slice onions and separate into rings.
Make batter of the beaten eggs and milk.
Stir together flour and seasoning.
Dip onions into flour and then in batter.
Drop onion rings into oil and cook until golden.
Serve hot.

title: Brides Punch
steps: Chop ice cream and sherbet in punch bowl.
Add juice.
Stir. Add ginger ale last.
Serves 25 people.

title: Coconut Balls(No Bake)

ingredients.name: vanilla wafer
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) box vanilla wafers, crushed or 1 box graham cracker crumbs

ingredients.name: orange juice thawed but not diluted
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. frozen orange juice, thawed but not diluted

steps: Mix all ingredients together (except for powdered sugar). Blend well; roll into small balls.
Roll in powdered sugar. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Dog Chili
steps: Combine cold ground beef and remaining ingredients and mix well in a heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until boils, stirring often. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease pie plate.
Heat salted water; add broccoli.
Cover and heat to boiling.
Cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain.
Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand mixer.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife comes out clean at 350° for 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Apricot Roasted Pheasant
steps: Place pheasant on aluminum foil in roaster.
Rub interior with butter, then salt, pepper and garlic.
Cover bird with uncooked rice.
Pour apricot juice and apricots over all.
Wrap tightly in the foil.
Bake in 325° oven until pheasant can be easily pierced with a fork.
Serves 2 to 4.

title: Yams Hawaiian Style

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 2 (1 lb. 2 oz. each) cans sweet potatoes, drained

steps: Slice sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick pieces.
Combine with pineapple, butter, sugar and cinnamon in 2-quart casserole.
Place in microwave oven and cook on High 4 minutes.
Stir.
Sprinkle top with pecans and brown sugar.
Continue cooking 2 to 4 minutes.
If dish is not hot and topping melted after 2 minutes, give 1/4 turn before continuing to cook.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
steps: Cut cheese into cubes in a saucepan; add salsa to keep cheese from sticking.
Brown hamburger; drain.
Salt and pepper to taste. Add Tabasco sauce.
Combine hamburger and cheese.
Excellent dip for nachos or taco salad.

title: Holly Taters
steps: Wash potatoes (medium or large).
Cut into wedges.
Drop into salted cold water for 1 hour.
Drain, but do not dry.
Put a couple of wedges in Shake 'n Bake bag.
Repeat process until all potatoes are used.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Salt potatoes and drizzle margarine over the top of potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Soup With Rivels
steps: Peel pumpkin and cut into small squares.
Boil until soft. Do not drain water.
Add milk until pumpkin is covered.
Bring to a simmer.
Add salt and pepper.
Beat eggs with fork.
Add flour slowly and keep mixing until it gets a little thick (like dumplings).
Drop this mixture into pumpkin 1/2 teaspoon at a time; let simmer 20 minutes.
Serve.

title: Cinnamon Rolls

ingredients.name: cake yeast dissolved in c. warm water
ingredients.raw: 1 small cake yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Let stand until double in size, about 1 hour.
Knead down and let rise again.
Roll out on floured board until 1/4-inch thick.
Spread with oleo, cinnamon and brown sugar.
Roll up like a jelly roll.
Grease pan with oleo and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Let raise until double in size.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Basic White Sauce
steps: In small saucepan, whisk together broth, milk and flour. Insert clove into onion; add to broth mixture along with remaining ingredients.
Bring to just below boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Lower heat to simmer and cook, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes.
Remove onion and bay leaf with slotted spoon.
Makes 1 cup.

title: Bread Pudding And Brown Sugar Sauce
steps: Butter dish.
Layer brown sugar on the bottom, then layer the bread cubes over sugar.
Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla, milk and raisins; pour over bread, slowly.
Put in pan of hot water.
Bake at 375° until done, about 1 hour.

title: Sherbet Jello Salad

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.raw: 3 c. boiling water or ginger ale

steps: Dissolve Jello in water, add sherbet.
Stir until melted. Let set until jelly like.
Gently stir in Cool Whip.
Let set until firm.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
steps: Cream together shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and mix thoroughly.
Add flour, soda and baking powder with pineapple and vanilla.
Mix.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Homemade Pizza
steps: Follow directions on package for bread dough except use cookie sheet.
Spread dough on a greased sheet.
Cook hamburger meat, sausage, onions and green peppers.
Spread tomato sauce on bread dough; sprinkle with garlic salt, if desired.
When meat mixture is about cooked, drain and spread over dough.
Add mushrooms and pepperoni.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients except coconut in electric blender (can be mixed with electric mixer if you do not have blender) container. Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan.
Let stand about 5 minutes, then sprinkle coconut. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until a table knife comes out clean when inserted into middle of pie.
Serve warm or cool with whipped cream or not.
This pie makes its own crust.
A great pie when you have unexpected guests.

title: Veggie Pie

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chopped fresh broccoli or diced cauliflowerets

steps: Set oven to 400°.

In saucepan, cook broccoli or cauliflower about 5 minutes; drain. Grease one 10-inch pie plate. Mix cooked vegetables, onion, green pepper and cheese on the pie plate. Beat Bisquick, eggs, salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Coconut Yule Trees

ingredients.name: dark chocolate confectioner
ingredients.raw: 2 to 4 oz. dark chocolate confectioners coating

ingredients.name: green sugar and red hot candy
ingredients.raw: green sugar and red hot candies

steps: Combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well.
Drop by tablespoon onto a waxed paper-lined cookie sheet.
Chill for 1 hour.
Shape into trees.

title: Zucchini "Crab" Cakes
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together.
Shape into cakes and roll in crushed cracker crumbs.
Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Remp Eyek
steps: Grind coriander, garlic and nuts.
Mix all together into batter, adding 2 packages Spanish peanuts.
Scoop batter with a hostess spoon and fry until brown.

title: Chicken 'N Dumplings
steps: Boil fryer until tender. Remove from broth and set aside to cool. Mix dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Add beaten eggs and enough milk to make a stiff dough. Roll out really thin on heavily floured board.
Cut into pieces (pizza cutter works great!).
Drop into rapidly boiling broth.
Cover and simmer on very low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones from chicken and pull into bite size pieces.
Add chicken to pot and season to taste with black pepper.
I pour about a cup of sweet milk in pot just as it's finished cooking.

title: Strawberry Cream Squares
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries; stir occasionally until thawed.
Add pineapple and bananas and mix.
Pour half of mixture into an 8-inch square pan.
Chill until firm.
Spread evenly with sour cream.
Pour remaining jello mixture on top.
Chill until firm.
Cut into squares.

title: Barbecued Meat Patties
steps: Mix together all ingredients for patties.
When milk is absorbed, shape mixture into 12 patties.
Cook slowly for 10 minutes or until brown on both sides in a small amount of fat. Mix together all ingredients for Sauce.
Add to the meat in skillet and cook slowly, turning in Sauce.

title: Coleslaw And Salad Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients except mayonnaise. Beat well with mixer.
Cook until thick. Remove pan from stove and add mayonnaise. Beat well and cool.

title: Dry Beef Dip
steps: Cut beef with scissors.
Mix all together, then refrigerate.

title: Southern Blackberry Cobbler
steps: Place berries in 9 inch square baking dish.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt, mixing well.	Sprinkle mixture over berries. Dot with butter.
Roll out pastry to fit dish.
Place pastry over berries.
Brush with milk, and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Quick Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients in punch bowl.
Makes 25 to 30 punch cup servings.

title: Alita Darby Arthur'S Classic Pecan Pie

ingredients.name: corn oil
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. corn oil or margarine, melted

steps: Stir together eggs, sugar, corn syrup, margarine and vanilla. Add pecans; mix.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes in 350° oven.
Cool; serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Tropical Fruit Cake
steps: Cut dates into thirds, add coconut, nuts and cherries, sprinkled with flour.
Add milk and mix well.
Butter loaf pan and dust with flour.

title: Gene'S Hop-N-John
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add the remaining ingredients. Add water to cover 1 inch above ingredients.
Cook for 1 hour on low heat.
Serves 15 to 20.

title: Classic Lobster Seafood Salad(4 Servings)
steps: Mix lobster, mayonnaise, celery and onion.
Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: No Peek Brisket
steps: Lay slices of rye bread in bottom of Dutch oven.
Place brisket, with fat side down, on top of the bread in Dutch oven. Sprinkle garlic powder and pepper on brisket.
Throw onion slices into pan.
Pour beer over the meat.
Spread the chile sauce over the meat.
Cover Dutch oven.

title: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread
steps: Sift together all the dry ingredients.
Add egg, buttermilk, and oil.
Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake 15 minutes.
Flip in pan and brown.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; set aside.
With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce.
Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Valentine Punch

ingredients.name: or tbsp. peppermint
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. dried or 4 Tbsp. fresh peppermint

steps: Wrap cinnamon, cloves and mint in cheesecloth or place in a cloth spice bag.
Place bundled spices in cranberry-raspberry juice; simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove spices and pour juice into a punch bowl.
Cool.
Add ginger ale, orange slices and fresh mint leaves for garnish.

title: Cookies Quick
steps: Any additional ingredients you wish such as chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, peanut butter chips, etc., depending on your choice of cake mix.
(Yellow cake mix is excellent for adding other flavors to.)

title: Giant Burger
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix meat and salt; divide in half.
Pat one half evenly in ungreased 8-inch pie pan.
Mix cream cheese, mustard and horseradish; spread over meat.
Shape remaining meat into 8-inch circle.
Place on cheese mixture; pinch edges together to seal.
Bake 45 minutes.
Place onion rings around meat.
Cut into wedges.

title: Angel Kisses

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chocolate chips (milk chocolate chips are good)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat egg whites until thick and foamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Fold in salt, pecans, vanilla and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets covered with brown paper.
Place in oven, close door and turn oven off.
Leave in oven overnight.

title: Salmon Dip
steps: Blend the cream cheese, juice of salmon, mayonnaise, sour cream and onion salt well.
Add salmon; blend well.
Serve with vegetables, crackers or potato chips.

title: Savory Cheese Muffins

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease 24 mini muffin cups.
Stir together flour, cheese, mustard and chili powder in mixing bowl. Beat eggs in separate bowl; stir in milk and oil.
Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just until blended.
Batter will be slightly lumpy.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling each 2/3 full.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Yummy Fruit Dip

ingredients.name: powdered sugar
ingredients.raw: powdered sugar- add to taste (about 1 T.)

steps: Whip all ingredients with mixer.
Store brands don't work as well.

title: Banana Nut Cake
steps: Blend ingredients and beat 2 minutes.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350° in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar or glaze.
May be baked in loaf pans for banana bread.

title: Wash Day Cake
steps: Slice margarine sticks and distribute evenly over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour dry cake mix over margarine.
Pour peaches, including juice, over cake mix.
Top with coconut.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Onion Dip For Veggies Or Chips And Pretzels

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 large (8 oz.) pkg. softened cream cheese

steps: Boil bouillon cubes with water.
Using an electric mixer, add cream cheese and onion.
Should make a day ahead and refrigerate. Warm to almost room temperature before serving.
Stir well and thin with a little milk if needed.

title: Lime-Pineapple Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Chill.
Add remaining ingredients and let set.

title: Boozy Bourbon Balls

ingredients.name: vanilla wafer
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. vanilla wafers, finely crushed (about 5 doz.)

steps: Melt chocolate in double boiler over hot, not boiling, water. Remove pan from fire and stir in sugar and corn syrup.
Blend in bourbon.
Combine crushed vanilla wafers and walnuts in bowl.
Add chocolate mixture to it.
Form into one-inch balls and roll in sugar.
Let ripen in covered container for few days or longer. Then wrap and present to your friends.
Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Breakfast Cocoa
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt; add water and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in milk; heat to boiling, but do not boil.
Beat with rotary beater just before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Coconut Candy
steps: Melt butter, let cool.
Pour over sugar and grated orange peel.
Add 1 tablespoon orange juice.
Add milk, nuts and coconut; mix well.
Set in freezer to cool.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
steps: Shred cabbage and place in
a large pot with 3 tablespoons water and 1 can of stewed tomatoes.
Cook until almost tender.
In a separate pan, melt 1/4 stick margarine.
Mix with 1 teaspoon salt, 2 tablespoons white vinegar and 1 tablespoon flour.
Saute the diced onion in the mixture.
Add this to the cabbage when the cabbage is almost tender.
Heat until desired tenderness is reached.
Add a teaspoon of sugar if needed.

title: Baked Diet Chicken
steps: Line baking dish with foil.
Arrange chicken in pan.
Add rest of ingredients.
Cover pan with foil and bake at 350° until well done.

title: Squash And Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: onion in
ingredients.raw: 1 large onion, chopped in large pieces

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. milk (as much as needed)

steps: Mix all together.
Bake at 350° until squash and potatoes are tender.
Add cheese and melt.

title: Cinnamon Rings
steps: Combine 1 cup sugar and cinnamon to taste.
Melt 1 stick of butter.
Roll biscuits in butter, then in sugar mixture.
Bake at 400° until done.

title: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli cuts or spears

steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. In 10 x 6-inch baking dish, layer 1/2 of the broccoli, 1/2 the soup mixture and 1/2 can of the onions.
Top with the remaining broccoli and soup mixture.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions.
Bake 5 minutes.
May be microwaved, covered, 8 minutes.
Turn half through.
Top with onions.
Return to microwave, uncovered, 1 minute.

title: Miracle Soup

ingredients.name: tomato or
ingredients.raw: 1 whole tomato, canned or fresh (if canned, 8 oz. size)

ingredients.name: season with dry onion soup and other herb seasoning
ingredients.raw: season with dry onion soup (1 pkg.) and other herb seasonings

steps: Cut vegetables into medium pieces, cover with water; let come to a boil.
Your soup mix may be added at this time.
After soup has boiled at least 10 minutes, lower heat and simmer until vegetables are soft.
Can be eaten at any time that you feel hungry, as much as you wish, as often as you like, any time of the day.
This soup will not add calories.
The more you eat the more you will lose.

title: Microwave Ritz Pizza Snack
steps: Put sauce on cracker.
Put on pepperoni.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Place in microwave until cheese melts (about 10 seconds).

title: Oven Baked Bourguignonne

ingredients.name: chuck
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. boneless chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can whole tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserve liquid)

steps: In a 2-quart casserole dish, toss beef with flour.
Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 20 minutes.
Add carrots, tomatoes, beefy onion soup mix blended with reserved tomato liquid, wine and bay leaf.
Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Add mushrooms.
Bake, covered, an additional 10 minutes.

title: Steamed Fish
steps: Place fish and ginger in pot of boiling water (water should cover fish).
Turn flame off and cover with tight fitting lid. Let stand for 30 minutes or until done.
Place fish on platter. Sprinkle with finely chopped green onion.

title: Spaghetti Sauce Seasoning Mix

ingredients.name: thyme and basil
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. dried thyme and basil, crumbled

steps: Place all the ingredients in a 1-pint jar.
Cover tightly and shake well to mix.
Store in a cool, dark, dry place for up to 2 months.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Spectacular Casserole

ingredients.name: uncle ben s combination wild and white rice
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's combination wild and white rice, cooked

steps: Mix all ingredients, except bread crumbs.
Pour into 3-quart greased casserole.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
To freeze, do not cook before freezing.

title: Black Forest Parfait
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine milk, yogurt and pudding mix.
Stir until it is smooth and thick.
Next, spoon a layer of pudding mixture into 4 clear glasses. Do the same with a layer of whipped cream. Repeat layering so you will have 4 levels. Chill 1 hour. Top with nuts and drained cherries.

title: Company Beef Casserole
steps: Brown beef and onion together; add tomatoes, ketchup, steak sauce and parsley.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook macaroni.

title: Poor Man'S Soup

ingredients.name: in refrigerator
ingredients.raw: any leftovers in refrigerator (such as peas, beans, cabbage, etc.)

steps: Cook short ribs and stew meat together until done.
Add onion, celery and seasoning.
Cook until done.
Add all precooked leftover veggies.
Heat thoroughly.
Serve with cornbread.

title: Casserole Cheese Bread
steps: Scald milk; add sugar, salt and margarine.
Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water.
Add milk and cheese and flour.
Stir about 2 minutes until well blended.
Cover; let rise until more than double.
Stir down and beat vigorously for 1/2 minute.
Turn in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375° for 1 hour (no second rising).

title: Salmon Balls
steps: Let cream cheese set out for 1/2 hour.
Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl (with gloved hands) until well mixed.
Roll salmon mixture in a ball, then roll in the walnuts.
Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Quiche

ingredients.name: onion pepper and meat of choice
ingredients.raw: diced onions, peppers and meats of choice

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Glorified Chicken

ingredients.name: broiler/fryer chicken up
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. broiler/fryer chicken, cut up

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom or cream of broccoli

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.

Meanwhile in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side up. Drizzle with margarine. Bake 40 minutes. Spoon soup over chicken. Bake 20 minutes more or until chicken is tender and juices run clear.
Transfer chicken to platter. Stir sauce.
Spoon sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Biscuit Tortoni(My Version)
steps: Beat egg whites; slowly add sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip, macaroons and sherry.
Place cupcake papers in muffin tins.
Put in mixture and freeze.
Decorate.
Serve with cookie.

title: Mississippi Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 8 c. potatoes, cooked and diced or 1 pkg. frozen hash browns

ingredients.name: or green olive
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. ripe or green olives, sliced

steps: Toss together potatoes, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, cheese and onion.
Place mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with crumbled
bacon and sliced olives. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: 10 Minute Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
steps: Stir together the salt, sugar and syrup in one-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Stir in peanuts.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir.
Microwave 1 to 3 minutes longer, until it is light brown.
Remove from microwave.
Add butter, vanilla and soda.
Stir until butter is all melted.
Pour out on warm buttered cookie sheet to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cool and eat.

title: Katie Gooch Wilmot'S Seafoam Candy
steps: Boil sugar until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water.
Pour over stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until it cools and creams.
Then drop on wax paper by spoon.
Put halos of chopped nuts on top of the candy.

title: Creamed Chicken
steps: Cook celery, onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Blend flour into mixture.
Stir in chicken broth and milk; cook to a smooth sauce, stirring constantly.
Add chicken to sauce; season with salt.
Heat mixture thoroughly.
Serve on rice, toast or biscuits.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Pain Persille(Parsley Bread)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Split the loaf of bread in half lengthwise.
Melt the butter in saucepan and add the garlic, stirring.
Stir in the parsley and salt and pepper to taste and remove from the heat.
Spoon and brush one half of the bread with the mixture.
Cover with the second side, sandwich fashion.
Wrap the bread in a sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil and bake 10 minutes or until piping hot.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup
steps: Cook potatoes, water, cubed chicken, onion, celery and grated carrots until done.
Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese.

title: Praline Muffins
steps: Place paper liners in a muffin tin, if you use them; otherwise, butter the tin well.
Fill them to 3/4 full and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen 2-inch muffins.

title: Sparkling Orange Eggnog
steps: In a large bowl, measure 3 cups of the orange juice, the lemon juice, eggs, sugar, cinnamon, ginger and cloves.
Blend with beater.
Stir in remaining orange juice.
Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving pour eggnog mixture into punch bowl.
Spoon ice cream into bowl; add ginger ale.
Blend with beater.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Makes 30 servings.

title: Chicken Nuggets
steps: Roll chicken pieces in flour, then in eggs and finally in bread crumbs, patting it on well.
Using a frying pan, brown in olive oil until done.
It doesn't take long and they are good!

title: Greek Bread
steps: Blend mayonnaise and oleo.
Add other ingredients.
Slice French bread in half-horizontally.
Spread with mixture.
Bake on a cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.
Slice--serve hot.

title: Spicy Pickled Cabbage
steps: Trim cabbage.
Cut heads into small wedges.
Pack into jar, placing tomatoes and pepper about midway.
Pour salt over cabbage and add water.
Fill pint size freezer bag with water and weight mixture down.
Make sure water covers cabbage.
Cover jar with dish towel, held in place with a rubber band.
Store in warm place 10 to 14 days.
Can the same as kraut.

title: Italian Spaghetti
steps: Brown onions and garlic in small amount of olive oil.
Add ground beef and cook until tender and meat is brown.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until sauce is thick or the longer you cook, the better.

title: Puerto Rico Chicken
steps: Put chicken in cooking oil and cook until brown.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.
Serve over rice.

title: Best Ever Pineapple Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple do not drain
ingredients.raw: 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple, do not drain (20 oz.)

steps: Mix flour, sugar, eggs, baking soda, vanilla and nuts.
Add crushed pineapple.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.
"Happy eating".

title: Salsa Dip

ingredients.name: and chunky picante sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 c. thick and chunky picante sauce

steps: Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart microwave safe bowl. Microwave on High 5 minutes, stopping after 3 minutes.
Serve hot with tortilla chips or as a veggie dip.
Makes 3 cups.

title: Pork Chop Marinade
steps: Combine marinade and place pork chops in a glass dish; add marinade.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally. Grill or broil chops for 8 to 10 minutes; brush occasionally with reserved marinade.

title: Ceviche
steps: Cut uncooked fish into small pieces.
Add lime juice to cover fish; cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours, or until fish become opaque.
Stir occasionally.

title: Cecil B. De Mille'S Baked Beans
steps: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain off most of the fat.
Add onion to bacon and saute until onion is soft.
Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Combine all in large 3 quart casserole.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour uncovered.
Serves about 10.

title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
steps: Mix the sugars and shortening, peanut butter and margarine together.
Stir in flour.
Shape dough into balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° until edges are light brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
As soon as they are removed from the oven, press a chocolate Kiss in center of each cookie.

title: Avocado Salad

ingredients.name: up some celery green onion and big of avocado guess at the amount.
ingredients.raw: Cut up some celery, green onions, and big chunks of avocados, Guess at the amount.

steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add tomato sauce and vinegar. When partially set, add avocados, onion and celery.

title: All American Corn Bread
steps: Scald cream (half and half) with butter.
Add to thoroughly mixed dry ingredients.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Party Salad
steps: Mix milk and Cool Whip; refrigerate for one hour.
Add cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple.
Mix well; add pecans and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Air Buns
steps: Mix 1/2 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl. Add dry yeast and let stand 15 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix 3 1/2 cups warm water, 1/2 cup sugar, shortening, vinegar and salt.
Mix well and let cool to lukewarm.
Add flour.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Let rise, then punch down and form into rolls.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until done.
This is a large recipe and can be cut in half.
A full recipe will make 5 to 6 dozen rolls.
I usually make a large pan of rolls plus a pan of cinnamon rolls and some hamburger buns.
It is also a good recipe for hamburger buns for family gatherings.
The extra rolls freeze well.

title: Deli-Style Barbecued Beef

ingredients.name: deli roast beef or
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. thinly sliced deli roast beef, shredded or cut into strips

steps: In medium saucepan combine roast beef and barbecue sauce. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.
Serve in buns.
Yields 8 sandwiches.

title: Spiked Cabbage
steps: Cut cabbage in 4 quarters; then slice each quarter into 1/2-inch slices.
Cut up green pepper and onion.
Add about 3/4 cup water, cover and cook on medium burner for 15 minutes.
To be eaten alone, or along with a full meal, serving as a vegetable.

title: Apricot Pinwheels

ingredients.name: sugar substitute equal tbsp. sugar
ingredients.raw: sugar substitute (Sweet 'N Low) to equal 4 Tbsp. sugar

steps: Combine apricots and boiling water; allow to stand until most of the water is absorbed; drain.
Sift flour and baking powder into bowl.
Beat butter or margarine, brown sugar, sugar substitute and water until well blended.
Add the flour mixture; blend with a fork until the dough forms a ball.
Place the dough on wax paper; flatten slightly.
Wrap in the wax paper; chill in the freezer 20 minutes.

title: Turnip Salad
steps: Boil turnips and peel; cut in slices.
Add chopped onion, salt, oregano, vinegar and oil.
Toss gently and top with sliced eggs.

title: April'S Blueberry Salad
steps: Boil 1 cup water and add 2 packages of jello, then add 1 cup cold water.
Drain pineapple and mix with jello and add blueberry pie filling.
Chill until jelled.

title: Orange-Date Crescents
steps: Assemble blender.
Put water, orange juice and dates in blender container.
Cover and process at blend for 2 to 3 cycles. Cook mixture on low heat until thickened.
Blend chopped nuts. Add to date mixture.
Cool.

title: Beef Balls

ingredients.name: roast beef fine and
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped roast beef, cut fine and cooked

ingredients.name: mario salad olive with pimiento
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. chopped Mario salad olives with pimiento strips

steps: Combine all ingredients and chill overnight.
Roll into balls. Place on serving tray.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Creamy Peach Pudding

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced fresh peaches or drained canned peaches

steps: Arrange fruit in the bottom of a shallow 1-quart serving dish. Place remaining ingredients in an electric blender.
Cover and blend at medium speed, 10 seconds or until smooth and creamy.
Pour sauce over fruit and stir gently to mix.
Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Makes 4 servings.

title: People'S Puppy Chow
steps: Melt first 4 ingredients until smooth.
Add Rice Chex and mix gently until coated.
Now put 2 cups of powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag and shake until coated.
Leave in bag until cool.

title: Frosted Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.name: boned chicken or
ingredients.raw: cooked boned chicken or 2 to 3 (5 oz.) cans

ingredients.name: old english cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 2 (5 oz.) jars Old English cheese spread

steps: Combine chicken, eggs, olives and mayonnaise.
Fill sandwiches (3 slices to a sandwich).

title: Chinese Winter Soup

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. diced cooked chicken or turkey

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, thinly sliced

steps: Saute celery and mushrooms in butter until crisp-tender but not browned.
Add cabbage; saute for 3 minutes.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; add to vegetables.
Mix well.
Add soy sauce, water chestnuts and chicken to mixture.
Bring to a boil.
Cook gently, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
Wonderful!

title: Pecan Crunch Cookies
steps: Cream together the margarine, sugar and vanilla.
Add crushed potato chips and pecans.
Stir in flour.
Form small balls with 1 tablespoon of dough.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press balls with flat bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake in oven at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes, or until cookies are light brown.

title: Butterscotch Chews
steps: Beat eggs.
Add all ingredients to beaten eggs and blend well. Spread in a well-greased and floured jelly roll pan.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
They freeze well.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad

ingredients.name: carton whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: In a saucepan, bring pineapple to a boil.
Remove from heat; add gelatin and stir to dissolve.
Add buttermilk and mix well. Cool to room temperature.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into squares.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Jan'S Chicken Stock
steps: Place all ingredients, except the chicken liver, into a large pan.
Bring to a boil.
Turn heat to simmer for 2 hours.
Remove chicken, strain broth.
This broth may be used for soup, stew or just eaten like it is.
Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
steps: Sift dry
ingredients together.
Add soft margarine and vanilla.
Beat
on	medium	speed of mixer until well blended. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Artichokes Parmesan
steps: Mince artichokes very fine and blend with remaining ingredients.
In a small baking dish, bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until slightly golden and bubbly around edges.
Serve hot with assorted crackers.
Especially good with Melba rounds.

title: Posole(Yields 12 Servings)

ingredients.name: posole
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pkg. frozen Posole (comes in 32 oz. pkg.)

ingredients.name: pork in bite size
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. pork, cut in bite size chunks

ingredients.name: green chile roasted and
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 green chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped

ingredients.name: or can stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 (16 oz.) cans stewed tomatoes (depending on how hot the chile is and how hot one likes it)

steps: Boil Posole about 2 hours until it pops.
Add pork, onion and garlic.
Boil until meat is cooked, about 1 hour, on medium heat. Add chile and tomatoes and season with salt to taste.
The tomatoes cut the "hotness" of the chile (acid neutralizes the base) and gives a tangy flavor.
Chicken also makes good posole and is often used in place of pork.

title: Lemon Jello Cake

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.raw: 1 box lemon or yellow cake mix

steps: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix with electric mixer until well blended.
Pour into tube pan and bake for 1 hour at 325° (or bake until done).

title: Delicious Potato Rolls

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 2 medium potatoes (enough for 1 c. mashed potatoes; reserve potato water)

steps: Pour 1 1/3 cups hot potato water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Allow to stand until lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water.
Add to first mixture.
Then add eggs, mashed potatoes and flour.

title: Lemon-Honey Carrots
steps: Mix butter and mustard in saucepan.
Stir in honey, lemon peel and lemon juice.
Heat. Pour over carrots. Sprinkle with parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Cheesy Chicken Pie

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. chicken breasts, cubed and cooked

ingredients.name: up vegetable
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked, cut up vegetables (I use broccoli, cauliflower and sliced carrots)

ingredients.name: durkee french fried onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions

steps: In a large bowl, combine soup, milk, spices, Worcestershire sauce, vegetables, cubed chicken and 1/2 can of onions.
Place in a 10-inch pie pan that has been prepared with Pam.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, then stir ingredients.
Sprinkle with remaining onions and 1 cup of cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes more or until cheese melts.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Grandma'S Gingerbread
steps: Mix and pour in greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Use nonstick skillet, well coated with spray.
Heat skillet.
Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet.
Brown on both sides.

title: Raw Apple Cake

ingredients.name: each salt soda cinnamon and vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: salt, soda, cinnamon and vanilla

steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Bubble Rolls
steps: Mix butter and brown sugar.
Separate biscuits and dust with a cinnamon sugar mixture.
Place on edge around bottom of greased bundt pan (36 in all).
Pour melted butter and brown sugar mixture over rolls.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes.
Turn out on large plate when done, so caramel will run over rolls.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
steps: Mix together.
Pat out.
Place 2 to 3 slices of cheese.
Roll up.
Place in pan.
Baste with ketchup and brown sugar.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Crispy Cocoa Bars
steps: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter; stir in cocoa and marshmallows.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth and well blended.
Continue cooking and stirring for one minute.
Remove from heat; add cereal and stir until well coated. Press into buttered pan with a buttered spatula and let cool and then cut into 24 squares.

title: Classic Pecan Pie

ingredients.name: karo light
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Karo light or dark corn syrup

steps: In large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter and vanilla until well blended.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie crust. Bake in preheated oven at 350°.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Meatball Casserole
steps: Roll the hamburger and onion together.
Place in casserole dish, then sprinkle garlic salt all over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until done.
Boil potatoes until tender.
Turn burner on low and mash with a little milk until creamy.
Add Cheez Whiz and mix well.
Pour over top of the meatballs and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Zesty Grilled Ham

ingredients.name: fully ham steak
ingredients.raw: 1 fully cooked ham steak (1 to 1 1/2 lb.), 1-inch thick

steps: In small saucepan bring brown sugar, horseradish and lemon juice to a boil.
Brush over both sides of ham.
Grill over medium-hot coals, turning once until heated through and well glazed, about 20 to 25 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Skillet Corn
steps: Combine corn, salt, pepper, sugar, butter and water in a 10-inch skillet.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Combine flour and milk, blending until smooth.
Stir into corn.
Cook 5 minutes over low heat, stirring constantly.

title: Corned Beef Hash
steps: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Stir in all ingredients, mixing together.
Cook until browned and potatoes are tender.
A little water may be added from time to time, if it starts to stick.
Serves 4.

title: Cinnamon Rolls-Yeast Rolls
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast.
Heat milk, water and margarine.
Gradually add to dry ingredients.
Beat 2 minutes on medium speed.
Add 1 egg and 1/2 cup flour.
Beat on high speed for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 1/2 cups to 3 cups flour to make a soft dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl and grease top of dough.
Cover and let rise until double.
Punch down; turn onto floured board.
Divide into two parts, 1/2 for rolls.

title: Tuna Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill and serve.

title: Sour Cream Doughnuts
steps: Put enough shortening into deep frying kettle to fry doughnuts. Sift flour, add salt, baking powder, soda and nutmeg.
Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat.
Add sour cream.
Add to dry mixture.
Remove 1/2 of dough to pastry cloth.
Roll about 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with doughnut cutter.
Fry in hot shortening (370°).
Drain.
Roll in powdered sugar or dip in doughnut glaze.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
steps: Combine all ingredients except the pineapple juice.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add pineapple juice and return to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Makes 3 quarts.

title: Sandy'S Delight
steps: Wash and cut strawberries in fourths.
Mix in fruit cocktail, then add strawberry jel.
Mix well; chill.
Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Spice Pecans
steps: Beat egg and water until it foams.
Stir in pecans.
Mix sugar and spices.
Sprinkle over pecans.
Stir; cover all.
Pour in pan. Bake at 300° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool.

title: Lemon Icebox

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 14 oz. can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
In large bowl, beat egg yolks, condensed milk and lemon juice.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake 30 minutes.
Cool, then top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

title: Blt Dip
steps: Let chill about 1 hour.
Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.

title: Applesauce Cake(No Eggs)
steps: Cream oil and sugar.
Add applesauce and flour which has been mixed with spices.
Mix in raisins.
Mix soda with hot water and add last.
Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with granulated sugar, making a light coating.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
No frosting is needed.
Best served warm.

title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Eggs
steps: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Position knife blade in food processor bowl.
Add yolks, Blue cheese and remaining ingredients.
Process until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides.
Spoon or pipe into egg whites.

title: Kente Cloth Cake

ingredients.name: white cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. white cake mix (2 layer size)

ingredients.name: jell o gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Jell-O gelatin (your favorite flavor)

steps: Prepare cake according to directions on package and bake in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Cool cake 15 minutes in pan.
Remove from pan and let cool completely on a rack.
Wash and dry cake pan. Return cake back to pan, placing top up.
Pierce cake with a large fork at 1/2-inch intervals.

title: Honey Graham Cake

ingredients.name: candied cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. candied cherries, chopped (red or green)

steps: Crush crackers and mix with chopped cherries and pecans.
Melt Parkay margarine and marshmallows together and pour over cracker mixture.
Press well into a greased tube pan.

title: Peanut Butter Cookie
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon out on cookie sheet; mash with fork.
Bake at 350° until lightly brown.

title: P T A Cookies
steps: Mix together syrup and sugar in a saucepan. Boil mixture for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla until well blended. Add cereal. Mix until coated.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Creme Sherry Wine Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake mix, pudding, eggs, salad oil, sherry and walnuts or pecans.
Grease and lightly flour Bundt pan. Pour in pan and bake at least 45 minutes.

title: Susie'S Chocolate Fudge Icing
steps: Mix
first
ingredients
and
bring to boil, cooking until drops
from
spoon	and barely holds its shape.
Remove from heat and add butter and dash of salt.
Bake 3 thin layers of cake and ice with mixture, poking holes in bottom layers so the fudge will soak through.

title: Pecan Crescents
steps: Cream oleo, sugar and vanilla; add flour then nuts, mix well. Roll and shape into crescents.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Remove and cool slightly.
Put powdered sugar into a zip lock baggie.
When the cookies are cooled a little add a few at a time to the powdered sugar and shake gently.
Shake off any extra powdered sugar.
Set on paper towels to finish cooling.
This makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: A Berry Good Banana Smoothie
steps: Peel and slice bananas.
Wash and cut off tops of strawberries.
Put into blender with milk and yogurt and whirl away.
Pour into cups and enjoy!

title: Molasses Cookie
steps: Combine sugar, oil and egg; beat well. Add molasses and beat. Combine flour and other ingredients. Stir into sugar mixture. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Fudge Dessert

ingredients.name: hot fudge ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 can hot fudge ice cream topping

steps: Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Freeze.

title: Chicken And Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Roll chicken in mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add chicken pieces, skin side down.
Bake 40 minutes; then turn chicken.
Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken.
Place biscuits on top and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Bean And Bacon Soup

ingredients.name: each celery and red bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. each: diced celery and red bell pepper

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. olive oil or vegetable oil

ingredients.name: italian tomato with liquid puree
ingredients.raw: 1 c. canned Italian tomatoes with liquid, pureed

ingredients.name: and white kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. rinsed and drained canned white kidney beans (cannellini beans)

steps: In a 1-quart casserole, combine onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic and oil.
Cover; vent top and microwave on High 3 minutes until softened.
Stir halfway through cooking.
Add remaining ingredients and stir.
Cover and microwave on High 1 minute until thoroughly heated.
Serves two 1-cup servings.
Contains 164 calories, 6 gm fat and 496 mg sodium.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
steps: Mix together by hand.
Grease
and
flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Frost cake while warm.

title: Crunch Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Line 10 x 15 x 1-inch pan with foil. Arrange saltines in pan.
In saucepan melt butter and brown sugar. Heat to boiling; boil for 3 minutes.
Pour evenly over crackers. Bake about 7 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over top; spread evenly.
Cool.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Break into pieces.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Nicaraguan Fried Rice
steps: Wash and drain rice.
Set aside.
In skillet, heat oil and saute onion, green pepper and carrot.
Add 2 cups water and salt on medium heat until rice is done.
Three minutes before, spread chopped tomato on top.
When rice is done, top with lid.

title: Cranberry Cloud

ingredients.name: coarsely walnut
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. coarsely chopped walnuts or pecans, toasted

ingredients.name: whipping cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whipping cream or Cool Whip

steps: In processor, coarsely grind cranberries.
Combine berries, marshmallows and sugar in large bowl; stir gently.
Cover and chill at least 1 1/2 hours.
Add apples, grapes and nuts; stir gently.
Fold in cream or Cool Whip.
Cover and chill 1 hour. Serve on lettuce.

title: Crunchy Surprise Bars

ingredients.name: peanut butter
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. peanut butter (or use 1/3 c. crunchy peanut butter)

steps: Mix sugar, butter, molasses, egg yolk and vanilla with a spoon.
Stir in flour and 1 cup of chocolate bits.
Press dough in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes, at 350°.

title: Infallible Rice
steps: Saute onions in butter until transparent.
Combine onions, rice and hot broth.
Bring to boil; turn on low heat.
Cover and cook for 25 minutes.

title: Robbie'S Favorite Graham Cracker Fruit Cake

ingredients.name: unshelled walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. unshelled walnuts, chopped or shelled 2 1/4 c.

ingredients.name: unshelled pecan
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. unshelled pecans, chopped or shelled 2 1/4 c.

ingredients.name: green cherry
ingredients.raw: 14 oz. jar green cherries, chopped (save juice)

ingredients.name: red cherry
ingredients.raw: 14 oz. jar red cherries, chopped (save juice)

ingredients.name: or lb. pkg. marshmallow
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) or 1 lb. pkg. large marshmallows

ingredients.name: honey graham cracker
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. box honey graham crackers, crumbled

ingredients.name: each red and blonde raisin
ingredients.raw: 1/2 box each: red and blonde raisins

steps: Mix nuts, cherries and crackers together.
Pour juices into double boiler and melt marshmallows.
Pour over mixture and pack back into cracker box.

title: Poor Man'S Lobster

ingredients.name: fish fillet
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. fish fillets, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: Place water, salt, lemon juice, onion and celery in 4-quart pan.
Bring to boil.
Add fish.
Bring to boil again for 3 minutes.
Drain.
Place fish on cookie sheet.
Brush on melted margarine or butter and sprinkle paprika on top.
Broil 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Chocolate Sauce
steps: Combine cocoa and sugar in a small saucepan.
Stir in milk and water with wire whisk until smooth.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
Serve warm over ice milk. Yield:
1 cup (26 calories per tablespoon plus 100 calories per 1/2 cup ice milk).

title: No Cook Recipe
steps: Load family (husband included) into family vehicle (van preferably for separating kids).
Drive to nearest location (can't stand kids for any longer) and release kids on the establishment (hopefully there's a playground).
When food is gone (whether in stomachs or on floor) leave to the relief of others sitting around you.
Oh!
Don't forget your coupons!

title: Rice
steps: Fry bacon; add celery, onion, green pepper and tomato and saute.
Add rice.
Let brown with bacon and vegetables; add water or chicken broth.
Cover; let come to boil, turn heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Batter Bread
steps: In a mixer bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups of flour, yeast, oregano and garlic powder.
In a saucepan, heat water, oleo, sugar and salt just until warm, stirring to melt oleo.
Add to dry ingredients in bowl.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed.
By hand, stir in pepperoni and enough remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough.
Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, 45 to 60 minutes.
Stir dough down.
Spread evenly in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Let rise 30 more minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
steps: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in top of double boiler.
Beat one minute at high speed to blend; then place over boiling water and beat until mixture forms peaks when beater is raised, about 7 minutes.
Remove from boiling water; add vanilla. Continue beating until thick enough to spread.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
steps: Crush Oreo cookies.
Melt butter and mix with Oreos.
Put aside 1/4 cup of mixture.
Put the rest in 9 x 13-inch pan. Soften cream cheese.
Mix with pudding and 3 cups milk.
Put on top of Oreo mixture.
Let set 2 hours in refrigerator.
Put Cool Whip and 1/4 cup Oreo mixture on top.

title: New England Pumpkin Pie
steps: Thicken boiling milk with flour (mix flour with milk and cook until smooth).
Mix all other ingredients, except egg whites.
When thoroughly mixed, add slightly beaten egg whites.
Bake until brown on top; well done.
Bake in 425° oven first 15 minutes, then 325° for 30 plus minutes.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
steps: Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and confectioners sugar with electric mixer until well blended.
Cut angel food cake in half horizontally to make 2 layers.
Spread cream cheese mixture between layers, on sides and on top of the cake.
Let it drizzle down the side.
Top with cherry pie filling.
Place cake, covered, in refrigerator overnight or several hours before serving.

title: Saucy Smokies
steps: Place Smokies in medium saucepan; combine with jelly and 1/2 bottle chili sauce.
Simmer over low heat until jelly melts, stirring occasionally.
When sauce is thickened, remove from heat and place in serving bowl.

title: Cork And Cleaver Mud Pie
steps: Crush wafers into fine crumbs and mix thoroughly with melted margarine.
Press into a 9-inch pie tin about halfway up the sides.
Crust should be about 1/8-inch thick.
Firm in freezer for 15 minutes.
Whip softened ice cream until smooth.
Fill pie shell so that top is mounded to 3-inches in the center and less than 1-inch on the edges.
Place in freezer to harden.
When ice cream is firm, spread topping to 1/8-inch thickness all over top and return to freezer to harden.
Serve on a chilled plate.
(Suggest you also chill server.)
Top each slice with whipped cream and sliced, toasted almonds.

title: Chocolate Eclair

ingredients.name: container premade milk chocolate frosting
ingredients.raw: 1 container premade milk chocolate frosting (approximately 1 1/2 c.)

steps: Layer bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with graham crackers, then whip pudding as directed (less one cup milk).
Let stand for 1 minute, then add container of whipped cream to pudding.
Put thin layer on crackers, then another layer of crackers and so on until you end up with a layer of crackers on top.
Put frosting in microwave until runny and pour on top of mixture.
Refrigerate about 3 hours.

title: Chewy Pecan Squares
steps: Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan.
Stir together egg, brown sugar and vanilla. Quickly stir in flour, soda and salt. Add nuts.
Spread in pan and bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes. Should be soft in center when removed from oven.
Do not overbake. Leave in pan and cut into 2-inch squares.
Makes 16 squares.

title: Raisin Pie(From The Parsonage Kitchen)
steps: Combine raisins, sugar, flour, vinegar, butter and salt in boiling water.
Roll pie dough and spread bottom crust with margarine; add raisin mixture.
Wet edges of crust with water. Place top crust on top of filling and seal down good.
Bake in hot oven at 425° for 15 minutes, then lower heat and bake until brown.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)

ingredients.name: pet milk
ingredients.raw: 1 small can Pet milk or 1/2 c. milk

steps: Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole.
Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.

title: Mock Pink Champagne

ingredients.name: grapefruit juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen grapefruit juice concentrate

steps: Early in day, mix sugar with water in saucepan and boil 5 minutes.
Cool and add frozen juices.
Refrigerate.
At serving time, add ginger ale and grenadine syrup.
Stir lightly.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts or 10 servings.

title: Paul'S Favorite Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix margarine, powdered sugar, eggs, vanilla and almond extract until thoroughly mixed up.
Add flour, soda and cream of tartar. Cover and chill overnight.
Set oven to 375°.
Divide dough.
Roll each part of dough to about 3/16-inch thick on a floured cloth covered board.
Cut into desired shapes; sprinkle with sugar.
Put on baking sheet.
Bake about 7 minutes or until they are light brown.

title: Colleen'S Ultra Fudgy Brownies
steps: Microwave halved chocolate squares and butter in a large glass bowl for 1 minute and 45 seconds or until butter is melted.
Stir until chocolate is melted.
Let this mixture cool.

title: Edith'S Pineapple Salad
steps: Add first 4 ingredients and refrigerate.
Can also add a container of whipped cream.

title: Tuts Toffee
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange crackers, 7 across and 5 down.
Melt butter with brown sugar, mix and pour over saltines.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes (will bubble and harden when removed).
Sprinkle warm toffee with chocolate chips and spread with a spatula when melted.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Chill until firm.
Peel off foil and break into pieces.

title: Betty'S Pecan Pie
steps: Mix together eggs, syrup, salt, vanilla, sugar and butter. Stir in nuts and pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes.
Filling should appear slightly less set in the center.

title: Candy Cane Popcorn Balls
steps: Keep popped corn in 225° oven.
Butter sides of saucepan. Combine sugar, syrup, vinegar, 1 1/2 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Cook until hard-ball stage (250° on candy thermometer). Stir in vanilla.
Slowly pour over corn; stir just to mix well. Butter hands; shape mixture into balls around candy.
Makes 15 to 20.

title: Fruit Cocktail Frosting
steps: Add the oleo, sugar and evaporated milk and let this boil slowly for 10 minutes, stirring often, then add nuts, coconut and vanilla.
Cook for a couple minutes.
Let it sit for about 10 minutes, then put on a warm cake.

title: Camper'S Fare Skillet Spaghetti
steps: Brown hamburger.
Add salt and pepper.
Pour off fat.
Add all other ingredients to hamburger in a skillet.
Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Apple Crisp 2
steps: Slice peeled apples into
a 1-quart buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with spices and lemon juice.
Work together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.
Spread over the apples.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in a moderate oven (375°), or until apples are tender.
If mixture becomes dry while cooking, add a small amount of water.
Serve cold with whipped cream or hot with plain cream.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Eight Layer Salad
steps: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with shredded cheese.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix by directions on package in 2 pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Dribble melted butter over warm cake. Combine sugar, coffee and cinnamon and sprinkle over cake. Chopped nuts may be added if desired.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
steps: Mix together and refrigerate.
Reduce 1/3 to 1/4 for family.

title: Cherry Dream Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks; stir in Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice.
Pour into crust; bake 8 minutes.
Cool. Chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Copper Pennies
steps: Dice and cook carrots until tender.
Combine all the rest of the ingredients; heat to near boiling.
Drain the carrots and mix into the sauce; let cool.

title: Snowballs
steps: In large bowl combine all ingredients except confectioners sugar.
With hands, mix until thoroughly blended.
Refrigerate dough 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°.
Form dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet; bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set, but not brown.
Let stand 1 minute.
Remove to wire racks; cool partially.
Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm; roll again.
Makes about 20.

title: Cherry Crisp
steps: Mix dry ingredients until crumbly.
Pat half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Spread pie filling over mixture.
Cover with other half of crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll Ups
steps: Cook soup, milk and grated cheese until cheese is melted. Pour in casserole dish.
In each crescent roll, put a strip of chicken and a strip of cheese.
Roll up and place on top of soup mixture.
Cook in 350 degree oven until rolls are brown.

title: Mile High Strawberry Pie
steps: Use a large mixing bowl.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add sugar and cream of tartar very slowly to stiffly beaten egg whites.
Slowly add the nearly unfrozen berries and juice to the egg white peaks.
Beat on high with mixer for 15 minutes.
Put into pie shell of your choosing and freeze.
Add sliced berries and whipped cream for garnish before serving.

title: Broken Glass Dessert

ingredients.name: boiling water each pkg.
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. boiling water for each pkg.

steps: Make graham cracker crust.
(Save some crumbs to sprinkle on top.)
Combine ingredients for dessert.

title: Snacks
steps: Mix well the day before going to use.
Turn several times to mix good.
You can add 1/4 cup grated cheese or use cheese crackers.

title: Barbecue Bake
steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Stir in chilies and barbecue sauce.
Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.

title: Tang Pie
steps: Mix Tang with Eagle Brand milk.
Make sure Tang is dissolved and add sour cream and Cool Whip; mix well.
Put in graham cracker pie crust.	Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches

ingredients.name: nestle butterscotch flavored morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle butterscotch flavored morsels (1 c.)

ingredients.name: nestle semi sweet real chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle semi-sweet real chocolate morsels (1 c.)

steps: In a large saucepan, melt butterscotch flavored morsels and peanut butter over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth. Stir in cereal.
Press half of the mixture in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Chill.
Set remaining mixture aside.
Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels, sugar, margarine and water, stirring constantly until smooth.
Spread over chilled cereal mixture.
Spread remaining cereal mixture evenly over top. Press in gently.
Chill until firm (1 hour).
Yields 25 squares (1 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).

title: Lemon Krispies Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Stir together dry cake mix, butter and eggs in a mixing bowl.
Stir in cereal.
Roll dough into 1 1/2 inch balls.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
bake 8 to 10 minutes until edges are brown.
Cool on cookie sheet before moving to a cooling rack.

title: Vegetable Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of potato soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans Campbell's cream of potato soup

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable prepared according pkg.
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen mixed vegetables, prepared according to pkg.

steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients.
Spoon into prepared pie crust.
Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal.
Slit top crust and brush with egg, if desired.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Breakfast Souffle
steps: Brown and drain sausage.
Beat eggs with milk, mustard and salt.
Cube bread and layer with sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Pour egg mixture over layers; cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
Bake 45 minutes at 350° (20 minutes with foil on and 25 minutes with foil off).
Do not overbake.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Pie(Heritage Recipe)
steps: Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 c. cold water, add rest of ingredients.
Cook until thick and pour into baked crust.
Use egg whites for meringue.
Makes 2 pies.

title: Wild Rice Soup

ingredients.name: chicken broth made from chicken bouillon
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chicken broth made from chicken bouillon

ingredients.name: white chicken meat
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. cooked, diced white chicken meat

steps: Saute onions and celery in nonstick skillet sprayed with Pam. Combine flour with 1/2 cup of the broth in a small jar with a lid. Shake until there are no lumps.
Add to kettle and slowly add rest of broth and milk.
Stir over medium heat until thickened. Add cooked wild rice and chicken.
Heat to serving temperature. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Buffalo Potatoes

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret onion
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton recipe Secrets onion or savory herb with garlic soup mix

ingredients.name: green giant baking potato lengthwise
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. Green Giant fresh baking potatoes, sliced lengthwise into wedges

ingredients.name: wish bone chunky blue cheese dressing

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan, blend onion soup mix, butter and pepper sauce.
Add potatoes and turn to coat.
Bake, stirring occasionally 45 minutes or until potatoes are crisp.
Serve with dressing.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Spider Sandwiches
steps: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut a circle from each bread slice.
Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds.
Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for "eyes".
Using peanut butter as glue, push one raisin into each indentation.

title: Butterscotch Oaties
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine butterscotch morsels and butter; melt over boiling water.
Remove from heat.
Mix boiling water with baking soda and add to butterscotch mixture.
Gradually blend in the remaining ingredients.
Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Sweet Cucumber Pickles
steps: Mix the plain salt with enough water to cover cucumbers.
Put a weight on cucumbers to keep under water. Stir every day for 15 days. Remove, wash and slice. Soak overnight in alum water to cover. Rinse 3 times.
Cover with vinegar.
Let set overnight. Remove cucumbers and throw away the vinegar.
Layer cucumbers, sugar and spices in crock.
Cover. In a few days enough syrup will be made to cover pickles.
Put in jars. Do not have to be sealed.

title: Crazy Salsa Dip
steps: Melt Velveeta cheese in saucepan; add salsa.
Melt together, then add green onion (chopped up).
Pour over soft tortillas or chips.

title: Cucumber Dill Dip

ingredients.name: cucumber and
ingredients.raw: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped

steps: In medium bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Stir in mayonnaise, cucumbers, green onions, lemon juice, dill and hot pepper sauce.
Cover and chill.
Serve with fresh vegetables, crackers or chips.

title: Chicken-A-La-Can-Can

ingredients.name: or can boned chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 1/2 oz.) can or 2 small cans boned chicken or 1 1/3 c. chicken

steps: Combine soup, water and chicken.
Add dry rice and 1/2 can French fried onions.
Stir to mix.
Pour in buttered casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining onions on top; bake 15 minutes more.

title: Christmas Holly Wreaths
steps: Melt marshmallows and oleo over low heat, add coloring and cornflakes.
Using
tablespoon, put some mixture on it.
Drop onto waxed paper and dip hands into water and shape into wreaths. Decorate with red hots.
Makes about 24 wreaths.

title: My Mom'S Roast Beef
steps: Place meat in an 8 x 12-inch cake pan lined with foil paper (enough to be able to wrap meat after all ingredients have been put in).
Place on top of meat the onion, green pepper, bay leaves, garlic and mushrooms.
Add tomato soup straight from the can on top of ingredients, then add ketchup.
Wrap meat up with foil.
Bake in oven at 350° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Wonderful Banana Pudding
steps: Mix pudding as directed on box less 1/3 milk; set aside.
Line 9 x 13-inch dish with vanilla wafers, side and bottom.
Layer bananas, fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture.
Pour over vanilla wafers and bananas.
Crush about 1 c. wafers and sprinkle on top. Chill and serve.

title: Fireman Hash Casserole
steps: In a large skillet cook ground beef until crumbly.
Drain off fat.
Add onions and green pepper.
Cook until they are tender. Stir in tomatoes, rice, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Asparagus Salad
steps: Heat soup to boiling.
Remove from heat and add Jell-O.
Stir until dissolved.
Add cream cheese and mix until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Chill.

title: Elegant Chicken Breast

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, halved

steps: Slightly cook bacon.
Wrap one piece around each breast. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Mix butter and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over chicken; sprinkle mushrooms and scallions over top.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, basting once or twice.

title: Gold Coast Cape Cod
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
Put in vodka.
Add cranberry juice to top.
Squeeze in lime and stir.
Serves 1.

title: Frozen Fruit Medley

ingredients.name: liquid from apricot and pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 c. liquid from apricots and pineapple

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate

ingredients.name: strawberry partially thawed and up
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed and broken up

steps: Drain apricots and pineapple, reserving 1 cup of the combined liquid.
Combine the liquid with the apricots, pineapple and remaining ingredients.
Spoon into cupcake papers put in muffin tins.
Freeze until solid, then package cups in freezer bags. Remove from the freezer 20 minutes before serving to partially thaw.
Makes 30 servings.

title: Low-Fat Cucumber Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in water; let slightly thicken.
Add rest of ingredients.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pie
steps: Combine first six ingredients.
Spoon into prepared deep dish pie crust.
Place second crust on top.
Seal the edges of the crust.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Cutlets
steps: Remove bones and skin from salmon; mash with fork.
Add potatoes, salt, pepper and beaten egg.
Mix well.
Form into cutlets.
Roll in crumbs.
Heat oil and fry.
Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Baked Rabbit
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Add seasonings to flour.
Add rabbit. Heat oil.
Add rabbit; brown on both sides.
In casserole dish, add rabbit, mushrooms, milk, butter and onion.
Cover with foil; cook for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Drummettes
steps: Combine all ingredients and pour over chicken.
Soak for 5 to 6 hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Drain marinade and cook at 450° for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
steps: In large bowl combine all ingredients.
Saute onions in a skillet with a small amount of oil.
Add onions to the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan or large casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm at 350°.

title: Sesame Curry Sauce(Use To Brush Over Chicken, Meat Or Fish When Grilling.)
steps: Combine in a screw-top jar.
Shake well.
Brush over grilled items.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
steps: Mix in large mixing bowl the sugar, flour and baking soda. Mix the butter, Coca Cola, and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil.
Add the hot mixture to the dry ingredients and stir.
Add the buttermilk, eggs and marshmallows to the mixture. Mix all well.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan and bake for 30 - 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Poor Man Pie
steps: Brown hamburger meat.
Season to taste - onions optional to brown with hamburger.
Drain meat.
Place back in skillet.
Layer up with corn (either whole or cream) and green beans (drained). Top with mashed potatoes.
Garnish with cheese on top.
Bake approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Rollatini
steps: Rinse and pat dry cutlets.
Dip each cutlet in bread crumbs, shaking off excess.
Put breaded cutlets on flat surface and place slice of Mozzarella cheese and slice of ham on each cutlet.
Roll up cutlets and fasten each one with a toothpick.

title: Holiday Cauliflower
steps: Bread cauliflower into medium sized flowerets; cook in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain well; set aside.
In saucepan, saute mushrooms in butter.
Blend in flour gradually. Stir in milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until thick.
Stir in salt, cheese and pimento.
Place 1/2 of cauliflower in buttered 2-quart casserole.
Cover with 1/2 the sauce.
Add remaining cauliflower and top with remaining sauce. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Miracle Pie
steps: Put all ingredients in blender; mix, then pour into two 8-inch pie pans (greased and floured).
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
A crust will form on bottom, pie filling in center and coconut on top.

title: Corn Potato Bake
steps: Peel and cut potatoes for cooking.
Cook until almost done. Transfer to casserole; add corn and salt and pepper to taste. Cover top with grated cheese.
Bake until brown in a 350° oven.

title: Icing Or Fudge
steps: Cook first four ingredients over low heat until margarine melts.
Bring to a hard boil.
Boil for 1 minute.
Take off burner and add 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
Beat until almost thick.
Add nuts (if desired) for fudge.

title: Spicy Molasses Cookies

ingredients.name: cinnamon ginger clove and nutmeg
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. cinnamon, ginger, cloves and nutmeg

steps: Combine flour, soda and spices.
Beat butter, sugars, egg and molasses.
Then add dry ingredients.
Use a cookie press on cold ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mucho Nacho Salad
steps: Brown ground beef and cool.
Chop lettuce, tomatoes and onion. Mix, then add shredded Cheddar cheese and creamy Ranch dressing. Sprinkle more cheese on top.
Serve with nacho chips.
May be crushed and added to each individual salad or served on the side. Use salsa to suit your taste.
This makes a very large main salad.

title: Tea Cakes(Old Recipe)
