ingredients.name: flour make stiff dough
ingredients.raw: flour to make stiff dough (about 2 1/2 c.)

steps: Beat sugar, Crisco and egg together. Add soda and baking powder to buttermilk and stir until it foams. Add to other mixture. Add vanilla and flour.
Roll out and cut cookies.
Bake in a
400° oven.

title: Sausage Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato with green chile
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chiles

steps: Brown sausage and ground meat.
Drain and add melted cheese mixture.
Heat in crock-pot.

title: Suzy'S Key Lime Pie

ingredients.name: key west lime juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Key West lime juice, concentrate

steps: Mix milk until well blended with lime juice.
Mix in Cool Whip (may add a few drops of green food color) and pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set.

title: Dip For Fresh Vegetables

ingredients.name: vegetable in bite size
ingredients.raw: fresh vegetables, cut in bite size pieces

ingredients.name: container sour cream
ingredients.raw: 16 oz. container sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: Mix sour cream or yogurt with salad dressing.
Serve with veggies.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies

ingredients.name: old fashion oats
ingredients.raw: 6 c. old fashion oats (not quick cooking)

steps: Melt butter over low heat.
Blend in sugar, eggs and peanut butter; mix until smooth.
Add oats, soda, raisins and chocolate chips (mixture will be sticky).
Drop on greased baking sheet with large spoon.
Flatten slightly.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes for large cookies.
Remove to cooling rack.
Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
steps: Mix fruit in flour to coat.
Add salt, coconut and pecans. Add Eagle Brand; mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 275° for 25 minutes.
Cool completely.
Store in airtight container about 5 days before serving.
Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Green Enchiladas

ingredients.name: las palma green chili enchilada sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (28 oz.) can Las Palmas Green chili enchilada sauce

ingredients.name: black olive onion sour cream
ingredients.raw: chopped black olives, chopped onions, sour cream (optional topping)

steps: Mix shredded chicken and 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce in saucepan.
Fry tortillas in vegetable oil until medium fry.
Dip tortilla in green enchilada sauce.
Scoop chicken; sprinkle cheese inside and roll tortilla.
Repeat steps for each tortilla.
Put enchiladas in tray and spread leftover enchilada sauce on top. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Cocoa Cream Pie
steps: Mix cocoa, cornstarch, sugar and salt.
Slightly beat egg yolks.
Add to mixture and milk.
Cook until thick; stir constantly.
Add flavoring.
Pour into pie shell.
Cover with meringue.

title: Honey Bars(Uncooked)
steps: Grind raisins and nuts.
Mix with honey and press into sheet 1/2-inch thick.
Cover and place weight on top for 24 hours.
Cut into bars.
Roll in white or colored coconut.

title: Flag Salad

ingredients.name: jell o
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. (3 oz.) Jell-O (2 red raspberry and 1 black raspberry)

steps: Dissolve red raspberry Jell-O in 3 1/2 cups water.
Chill until firm.
Use 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pierogi Casserole

ingredients.name: dry onion
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. dry onion or 1 small onion, chopped

steps: Make mashed potatoes with potatoes and part of milk.
Save remaining milk for cheese sauce.
Cook noodles 10 minutes; rinse with warm water and set aside.
Cook margarine, milk, onion and cheese until melted.
In 9 x 13-inch greased pan, add 1/2 of noodles.
Spread in pan.
Add not quite 1/2 of cheese sauce. Spread evenly.
Add mashed potatoes on top of noodles and cheese. Add remaining noodles and cheese sauce.
Bake at 350° until golden brown or 30 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Potatoes Au Gratin
steps: Peel and cube potatoes.
Place in a well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with flour and pour milk to cover.
Stir potatoes with a fork so that all are well coated with flour and milk.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with the grated cheese and dot with butter.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Dream Salad
steps: Sprinkle Jell-O over Cool Whip; mix well.
Stir in remaining ingredients; chill.

title: Italian Lemon Chicken

ingredients.name: spearmint plant very fine
ingredients.raw: 1 spearmint plant, cut very fine (or 2 Tbsp. basil)

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine all ingredients except chicken. Lay chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
(Use 2 pans, if necessary.)
Pour ingredient mixture over chicken.
Add water, enough water to cover chicken.
Bake in oven for 15 minutes at 400°.
Turn oven down to 350° and bake for another 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Scampi
steps: Boil chicken quickly.
Separate into serving pieces or strips. Cover with spaghetti sauce mix (I use Giant's brand).
Add vegetables.
Simmer on stove or in oven.
Just before time to serve, add prepared shrimp (the amount and size you can afford that week)!
Cook 3 or 4 minutes.
Serve on rice.

title: Camel Droppings
steps: Mix together butter, cherries, nuts, coconut and powdered sugar.
Form balls; chill.
Melt paraffin and chocolate chips. Dip balls and chill.

title: Easy Egg Custard
steps: Mix well with whisk.
Pour in custard cups.
Bake at 325° until golden brown.

title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
steps: Cook carrots and onion in boiling water until tender.
Stir in soup, milk, cheese and Worcestershire sauce.
Stir over low heat until cheese melts.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lipton'S Party Puffs
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cut each biscuit into 4 sections.
In saucepan, melt butter.
Over very low heat, stir in Lipton Onion Soup Mix and biscuits; gently toss just until light golden.
On a cookie sheet lined with brown paper, place biscuits;
bake 5 minutes.
Serve hot.
Makes 40 puffs.
Variation:
Roll baked puffs in Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Coco-Lopez Coconut Cake

ingredients.name: cake mix with pudding in mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. cake mix (yellow) with pudding in mix

steps: Cook cake by directions on package; use 13 x 9-inch pan. While still warm punch holes in cake and pour a can of Eagle Brand milk over cake, then cool and pour 1 cup Coco Lopez over cake. Spread on a large container of Cool Whip.
Sprinkle coconut on top.
Refrigerate.

title: Cold Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix vinegar, salt, celery seed and sugar until dissolved. Pour over rest and put in covered dish.
Place in refrigerator. Wait 24 hours before eating.
Good for a summer cook out.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
steps: Blend well.
Place in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in oven. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Garlic And Cheese Biscuits
steps: Melt butter and mix into all ingredients.
Stir and drop onto baking sheet.
Bake at 400° until browned on top.
If desired, brush on butter and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Butter Bean Casserole
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Combine crackers and butter, sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes.

title: Orange Slush(Similar To Orange Julius)
steps: Blend the first 5 ingredients in blender.
Add ice cubes 2 at a time.
Beverage should be slushy.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Tomato French Dressing
steps: Mix in electric blender.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Rudolph Sandwiches
steps: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
Cut it diagonally. Place 2 raisins on the wide side of the bread for eyes, a cherry on the tip of the triangle for the nose and pretzels for the antlers.
(Use peanut butter to "glue" the trimmings.)

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
steps: In medium saucepot, saute bacon until lightly brown.
Remove bacon and drain.
Saute onion and red pepper.
Cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in flour.
Gradually stir in milk, corn, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Bring just to boiling point over low heat; simmer one minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle chowder with sauteed bacon pieces.

title: Okra Fritters
steps: Combine all ingredients and stir well.
Drop by tablespoon into hot oil.
Turn once.
Drain and serve at once.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
steps: Cook onion in oil until soft and golden.
Stir all ingredients together.
Pack tightly into a casserole, greased.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
Uncover the last 15 minutes. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving.
For a moister loaf, use less crumbs. You can also use more nuts.
Walnuts work well.

title: Margie'S Brown Rounds
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and egg.
Add remaining ingredients. Drop and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish.
Bake in a 325° oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until slightly golden brown.
Serve warm with Fritos, chips of choice, or crackers.

title: Butterballs
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add vanilla.
Blend in flour and nuts until like pie crust, crumbly.
Chill 1 hour.
Roll in balls. Bake 15 minutes or until light brown at 325°.
Roll in powdered sugar when cool.

title: Peach Cobbler No. 1
steps: Mix sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt together.
Melt stick of margarine in a pan.
Pour sugar and flour mixture in pan. Add peaches.
Bake at 375° until mixture forms a cake and browns, approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
steps: Shake Molly McButter on bread.
Add both cheeses and garlic powder.
Broil until brown.

title: Blueberry Griddle Cakes
steps: Beat egg well.
Add salt and milk.
Stir baking powder with flour and stir in other mixture. Beat until smooth.
Add blueberries. Drop from spoon and brown both sides.
Serves 4.

title: Mom'S Hot Cake

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. buttermilk or half and half

steps: Cream shortening and sugar together.
Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Stir in vanilla.
Bake at 350° until straw comes clean.
Serve with a hot caramel sauce.

title: Bread Sticks

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: milk (enough to make a good consistency)

steps: In mixing bowl, combine flour and butter, stirring butter into flour and then add milk to desired consistency.
Batter should not be thin but have a texture that will hold its shape when out on flour surface (wax paper).

title: Quick Peanut Butter Blossoms
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium size bowl, mix cake mix, water and peanut butter until blended.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls.
Put the sugar in a bowl and roll the dough balls in it until covered.
Place dough balls on a cookie sheet about 1-inch apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until cookie separates.
Then place chocolate candy on center and press down until cookie separates around edges.
Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Chill for 2 hours.
Roll out, cut and bake at 350° until golden brown.
Cool.

title: "A B C" Sandwich
steps: In a bowl, combine cheese, apple, salad dressing and walnuts. Spread on 6 slices of bread and place 2 slices of bacon on each. Cover with egg slices.
Top with tomatoes, if desired, and remaining slices of bread.

title: Strawberry-Lemonade Punch

ingredients.name: pink lemonade concentrate
ingredients.raw: 2 (6 oz.) cans frozen pink lemonade concentrate

steps: In punch bowl, combine lemonade, juice, strawberries and 3 cups cold water.
Refrigerate.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Add onions and mushrooms to ground beef.
Then brown and drain.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over noodles or split hamburger buns.

title: Clo'S Pound Cake
steps: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, alternately with flour until all are well mixed.
Add salt.
Pour into tube pan.
Begin baking in cold oven. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Self-Crust Coconut Custard Pie
steps: Put ingredients into blender and blend about 20 seconds.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.
Bake until golden brown in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
Crust forms at the bottom, custard in the middle and the coconut on top.

title: Peachy Angel Food Dessert

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 (21 oz.) can peach or cherry pie filling

steps: Tear cake into bite size pieces; set aside.
Prepare whipped topping according to package directions; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Fold in whipped topping.
Add cake pieces; stir gently to coat evenly. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Top with pie filling. Chill until ready to serve.
Yields 12 servings.

title: Coconut Bread
steps: Cut bread into oblong shape 2 x 1-inch.
Use a teaspoon and put the condensed milk on each side of the bread.
Mix the coloring and banana flavoring with the coconut.
Spread the coconut over the slices of bread.
Place slices on a greased baking sheet.
Bake at 250° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Pretzel Pieces

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch original party dip
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original party dip

steps: Break pretzels into bite size pieces.
Then place pretzels in a large mixing bowl minus any crumbs which will soak up the dressing. Mix ingredients in a separate bowl and pour over the pretzels.
Mix pretzels and ingredients well.
After mixing, put pretzels in a pan, approximately 11 x 9 1/2-inch.
Put in preheated oven at 350° for 5 minutes.
Then take out.
Pour back into mixing bowl and mix well again.
Then place pretzels back in oven 5 more minutes. Remove and drain on paper towel.

title: Pam'S Meat Loaf
steps: Soak bread crumbs in milk; add meat, eggs, onion and seasonings.
Mix well.
Form in individual loaves; place in greased muffin pans.
Cover with Piquant Sauce.
Bake in a moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.
Or form one loaf in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan.
Spread with sauce; bake 1 hour.

title: 24-Karat Cake Or Cupcakes

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1 stick (1/4 lb.) butter or margarine, at room temperature

ingredients.name: cream cheese at room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature

steps: To make icing, beat butter or margarine with cream cheese in bowl of an electric mixer until very light and fluffy.

Beat in powdered sugar, followed by vanilla, pecans and optional coconut. To frost the cake, spread a generous amount of filling between and over the top of the layers, leaving the sides of the cake unfrosted.
Or use the icing to generously frost the top of the cupcakes.

title: Sausage And Potato Stew

ingredients.name: potato and bite size
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size pieces

ingredients.name: polska kielbasa sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Polska kielbasa sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: italian stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 to 16 oz.) can Italian stewed tomatoes

steps: In a 3-quart saucepan, heat potatoes, salt and enough water to cover to boiling.
Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.
Drain.
While potatoes are boiling, in a 12-inch skillet, heat butter.
Cook onions until tender.
Add sausage, tomatoes with liquid, paprika, caraway seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in potatoes and serve.

title: Sweet And Easy Corn Pudding
steps: Blend all ingredients.
Conventional oven bake 45 minutes at 375°.
In microwave oven, microwave on High 4 minutes, stir; 4 minutes more, stir; 4 minutes more.
Should be like pudding.

title: Hawaiian Baked Chicken

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Skin and wash chicken breasts.
Pat dry.
Place in a shallow pan.
Mix pineapple juice, soy sauce, oil and ginger.
Cover chicken with marinade and cover.
Refrigerate for 8 hours; turn pieces over once.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour off marinade, reserving liquid.
Bake chicken for 20 minutes; baste every 10 minutes.
Turn chicken pieces over and bake for another 30 minutes.
Continue to baste every 10 minutes, until chicken is done.
Serves 4.

title: Nancy Luthy'S Festive Chowder
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Stir in celery and chopped onion; cook until tender.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper, if desired. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly.
Add potatoes.
Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Add bacon and Crab Delights.
Heat 3 to 5 minutes more.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Cafeteria Cookies
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla.
Stir.
Drop on wax paper. Refrigerate 1/2 hour.

title: Gay'S Pineapple Banana Slush Punch
steps: Dissolve sugar in water to make a light syrup.
Mix syrup with next three ingredients and pour into small containers to freeze solid.
Approximately 1 hour before serving, remove containers from freezer and place in punch bowl.
Pour ginger ale over frozen ingredients.
As mixture thaws, rake a fork over ice mixture to make slushy.

title: Instant Love
steps: Take friendship and love and mix them with tenderness.
Blend thoroughly with loyalty.
Add hope and faith.
Sprinkle with forgiveness.
Serve daily with abundant laughter.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.name: steak
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into thin strips

steps: Brown meat in a small amount of oil.
Add chopped onions, water and salt.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook 5 minutes.
Blend cornstarch with a little water and add to meat mixture.
Cook, stirring, until thick.
Just before serving, add tomatoes and soy sauce; heat. Serve over rice.

title: Chinese Hamburg Casserole

ingredients.name: dry rice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. dry rice or Minute rice

steps: Do not salt anything.
Brown hamburger in 2 to 3 tablespoons butter, add pepper.
Remove meat from frypan, put in vegetables and cook until tender.
Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to keep from burning.
Cook rice, when done add soy sauce and canned soups.
Add meat and rice mixture to vegetables.
Mix ingredients well and put into covered dish and bake 30 to 40 minutes.
A half cup water may be added, if needed.
Can be frozen before baking.

title: Wild Rice Rose(Serve With Lamb Or Chicken)
steps: Soak rice overnight; drain.
Wash and drain.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Place in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beer-Battered Bass
steps: Combine pancake mix, flour, baking powder and salt in bowl. Add egg and beer; mix until smooth.
Dip fish in batter, coating well.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain.
Yield:
6 servings.

title: Apple Jello Salad

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped apple (use a red one and leave skin on)

steps: In a saucepan, heat applesauce until it bubbles.
Stir in Jell-O and cook until dissolved.
Remove and cool, then stir in pop, orange juice and peel.
Chill until partially set, then stir in apples and nuts.
Chill until set firm.

title: Fruit Roll

ingredients.name: candied cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. candied cherries, chopped into small pieces

steps: Mix all together, then fix into a roll; freeze.
Slice when ready to serve.

title: Sausage Omelet

ingredients.name: brown and sausage link
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. brown and serve sausage links

steps: Heat sausage in heavy 8-inch ovenproof skillet according to package directions.
Remove sausage and keep warm.
Saute the onion and green pepper in sausage skillet over medium-high until tender.
Combine eggs and milk in bowl.
Add the onion, green pepper and tomato.
Melt the butter in the skillet over low heat. Add the egg and vegetable mixture and cook until eggs are almost set.
Arrange the sausage on top of eggs.
Place under the broiler and broil until center is firm and top is lightly browned.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Butterscotch Surprise(Candy)
steps: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter in the top of a double boiler. Stir in nuts and shoestring potatoes. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Cool for several hours in the refrigerator.
Yields 2 or 3 dozen.

title: Steaming Oyster Stew
steps: Heat milk and cream together until film shimmers over surface. Do not boil.
In separate pan, precook oysters and drain.
Add oysters (slice if you prefer) and butter to hot milk and cream mixture.
Heat but do not boil for 5 minutes more.
Add seasonings and serve at once.
Serves 5 to 6.

title: Grandmother Fowler'S Rolls
steps: Place warm water in a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Add shortening, salt, sugar, egg and 1/2 of flour. Mix well with electric mixer. Mix in remainder of flour well with a spoon or dough hooks.
Turn out into a well greased large mixing bowl. Grease top of dough (I spray it with Pam). Cover and let rise in a warm place until double.

title: Summer Ginger Ale Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add lemonade concentrate and stir to dissolve.
Add ginger ale.
Chill until thick, but not set.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 2 1/2-quart mold. Chill until firm.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Roast And Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Place roast in medium roaster pan and cover with water.
Add chopped onion, celery, salt and pepper. Cover and let cook 30 minutes. Turn oven down to 325°.
Let cook slowly, approximately 4 hours. Check roast to be sure it is covered with water. After 4 to 4 1/2 hours, add potatoes and carrots.
Cook about 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Fruit Whip
steps: Prepare Jell-O as directed.
Cut Jell-O into cubes and mix ingredients together.
Cool.

title: Baked Squash From "Black-Eyed Pea Restaurant"
steps: Cut off tips of squash and cut in pieces.
Boil until tender. Drain and mash.
Add eggs, bread crumbs and butter.
Then add sugar, salt, onion and pepper.
Bake in greased casserole at 350° until top is lightly browned, about 45 minutes.
Makes 10 servings.

title: Shortbread Salad
steps: Mix pudding and buttermilk.
Add oranges (I drain 1 can), Cool Whip (I use 16 ounces) and shortbread cookies.
Refrigerate.

title: Rolled Up Nut Cookies
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk.
Mix all ingredients together and roll up to 90 balls.
Cover and set it in the refrigerator overnight until next day.
The next day, roll the balls on powdered sugar, but don't roll too thin.
Put the filling in the center of the cookie; fold one side of the cookie and then overlap the other side on top.
Slightly greased a cookie sheet using two cookie pans. Place 6 or 7 cookies across and 6 rolls down.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Use apricot or nut filling.

title: Crock-Pot Dessert
steps: Spray crockery with nonstick spray.
Stir in peaches and pour into crock-pot.
Cook on low for four to six hours.

title: Dieter'S Ambrosia
steps: Sprinkle gelatine over ginger ale.
Heat until dissolved.
Do not boil.
Cool.
Mix in other ingredients.
Serves 10 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Veal Marsala

ingredients.name: salt pepper and flour as
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and flour as needed

steps: Season veal with salt and pepper, then dip in flour, vigorously shaking off the excess.
In a heavy skillet, melt 2 tablespoons margarine with olive oil over moderate heat.
When the foam subsides, add the veal, 3 or 4 at a time, and brown for about 3 minutes on each side.
When done, transfer them to plate.
Pour most of the fat out of the skillet, leaving only a thin film at the bottom.
Add the Marsala and 1/4 cup of broth and boil briskly over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes.
Scrape in any brown fragments clinging to pan.
Return veal to pan; cover and simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, basting with pan juices until tender. Transfer veal to a heated platter.
Add 1/4 cup broth to sauce in pan and boil briskly, scraping in brown bits.
When sauce has reduced and is syrupy, taste it for seasoning and season as necessary.
Remove the pan from the heat; stir in 2 tablespoons of softened margarine and pour the sauce over the veal.

title: Chicken Divon
steps: Cook broccoli and place in 9x13 baking dish.
Debone chicken; place on top of broccoli.
Mix mayonnaise, soup, lemon juice and spread on top of chicken.
Brown bread crumbs.
Sprinkle on top with cheese.
Bake 350 degrees 30 minutes.

title: Soy-Flavored Chicken
steps: Skin chicken breasts (optional for low-fat).
Place into a baking dish the breasts.
Add 1/3 cup water and place into a preheated oven at 325°.
After 30 minutes, add soy sauce.
Continue to cook for another 30 minutes, then add chopped pepper and sliced mushrooms.
Continue to cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes.
Turn breasts several times to allow the soy sauce to penetrate the meat. Brown lightly.
Serve with wild, brown or white rice.
A low-fat dish and low-salt.

title: Jodi'S Broccoli

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in pieces

steps: Cook broccoli according to box directions.
Drain.
Place broccoli in a casserole dish.
Add the butter and Velveeta cheese. Crush crackers and spread over top.
Dot extra butter on top of crackers.
Place in a 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Orange Pecans
steps: Combine sugar and milk in saucepan.
Add vinegar.
Boil until it forms a soft ball in cold water.
Pour mixture over pecan halves.
Add grated rind of 2 oranges and stir until pecans are coated.
Spread on foil to dry.

title: Chicken Baked In Soy Sauce

ingredients.name: fryer up and put in a roasting pan
ingredients.raw: 3 large fryers, cut up and put in a large roasting pan

steps: Mix the onions, soy sauce and water and put into roasting pan. Put fryer in roaster, skin side down.
Cook 40 minutes and turn; cook 40 minutes.
Serve with Uncle Ben's seasoned long grain and wild rice.
Serves 15.

title: Quick Kolacky
steps: Cream the margarine.
Add cream cheese and beat until fluffy. Add flour.
Chill 15 minutes.
Roll out and cut into 2-inch rounds. Make depressions in center of rounds.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hillbilly Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage.
Cut carrot, cucumber, bell pepper and radishes in rings.
Mix sugar, vinegar and oil and pour over vegetables. Toss and refrigerate several hours before serving.
Salt to taste before serving.

title: Cream Cheese Muffins
steps: Combine all ingredients except honey in a large bowl.
Beat at low speed of electric mixer.
Fill baking cup lined muffin tins 1/2 full.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Drizzle with honey. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Chicken And Vegetables Pot Pie

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed

steps: Combine chicken, mixed vegetables and soups in bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Spread topping evenly over chicken mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown.
Yield:
8 servings.

title: Caesar'S Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: or garlic clove
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small garlic cloves, crushed

steps: Mix all ingredients in a jar and shake well.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy As 1-2-3 Microwave Brownies
steps: In a medium bowl, beat together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes.
Beat in cocoa.
Add flour and beat until well blended.
By hand, stir in pecans.
Spread evenly in a wax paper-lined 8-inch square glass dish.
Cook in a microwave oven on High for 3 minutes. Turn dish a quarter turn and cook 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer.
Let cool.
Sift powdered sugar over top.
Cut into 16 or 25 squares.

title: Pineapple Rice Salad

ingredients.name: dream whip
ingredients.raw: 2 boxes Dream Whip or 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip

steps: Cooked cup of rice is added to all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Serve.

title: Patsy'S Pecan Pie
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add baking powder and sugar to egg whites.
Add nuts and crackers.
Mix together.
Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Set and let cool, then put Cool Whip or whipped cream on top.

title: Krum-Kaka

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. vanilla (almond flavoring may be used)

steps: Melt butter and cool.
Beat eggs; add sugar and mix.
Whip the cream.
Add melted butter to eggs and sugar; add whipped cream. Add vanilla and flour.
Use 1 scant teaspoon for each one on Krum-KaKa iron.
Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Heart-Smart Wacky Cake
steps: In ungreased 8-inch cake pan, mix together flour, sugar, soda and cocoa.
Make 3 wells in flour mixture.
Put vinegar in one, vanilla in one and corn oil in 3rd.
Pour water over all and mix with fork until entirely moist.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until just done.
Ice as desired.

title: Blueberry Banana Pie

ingredients.name: pie crust
ingredients.raw: 1 (9-inch) frozen pie crust or graham cracker crust

steps: Bake pie crust and let cool.
It is not necessary to bake graham cracker crust.
Cover bottom of pie shell with banana slices.
Whip cream cheese and combine with Cool Whip.
Spoon over bananas in pie crust.
Top with blueberries.
Chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Three Layer Coconut Cake
steps: Cream margarine and Crisco until fluffy.
Add sugar gradually. Cream for 10 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add vanilla; beat for 1 minute after last addition.
Bake at 325° until brown.
Cool; frost with White Cake Icing.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).
In medium saucepan, melt morsels and margarine.
Stir in crumbs and nuts.
Press 1/2 the mixture firmly into bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy, then beat in sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and egg; mix well.
Pour into prepared pan.
Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool to room temperature.
Chill before cutting into bars.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Frosted Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Combine 2 cups baking mix and milk in a bowl.
Mix well.
Beat vigorously for 30 seconds, adding enough remaining baking mix to make moderate dough. Knead 10 times on floured surface. Roll into 1/2-inch thick rectangle.
Spread with butter.
Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over butter.

Top with raisins and nuts. Roll as for jelly roll to enclose filling; cut into 1-inch slices. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Blend confectioners sugar with a small amount of water.
Drizzle over rolls. Cool for 5 minutes.
Yields 1 dozen.

title: Chicken Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm herb dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing

steps: Melt butter.
Add water and dressing.
Put 1/2 dressing in casserole (8 1/2 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch).
Cook and drain beans.
Layer on top of dressing.
Add a layer of almonds, followed with split up chicken breast pieces.
Cover with remaining dressing, then combine the soup and chicken broth; blend until smooth.
Pour soup mixture over entire casserole.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Milano, Italy)

ingredients.name: chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small chili pepper or 1 tsp. dried crushed chilies (hot red pepper flakes)

steps: Heat the oil and gently fry the chopped onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chili pepper and fry gently for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, sugar, salt and pepper to taste and cook on a high flame, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
When the sauce is reduced and thick, check the season.
If you like a smoother sauce, you can pass the sauce through the medium disk of a food mill.
I usually just chop up the tomatoes with a fork and leave the sauce a bit chunky.
Add the chopped parsley just before serving.
Cook the pasta following the directions on the packet very carefully to avoid overcooking.

title: Pam'S Barbecue Ribs
steps: Mix all dry ingredients together and roll ribs in this mixture until well coated.
Place ribs in greased roaster pan with lid. Blend together tomato soup, vinegar and onion.
Pour this over ribs.
Bake in oven very slowly at 250° to 300° for 3 or 3 1/2 hours.

title: Rolled Cheese Appetizers
steps: Mix filling together.
Spread onto tortillas.
Let refrigerate about 1 hour.
Slice into pinwheels and serve.
Great to make ahead and serve.

title: Diet Natural Food
steps: Mix together.
Bake at 300° until lightly browned, stirring often.

title: Mexican Sausage
steps: Mix ingredients by hand.
Let mixture set overnight in refrigerator.
Make into patties and cook on slightly greased grill or frying pan.

title: Macaroni Lunch

ingredients.name: elbow macaroni and
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: tomato sauce and can water
ingredients.raw: 1 small can (8 oz.) tomato sauce and 1 can water*

steps: Pan fry sausage into crumbled pieces and drain on paper towels.
In a large boiler, bring to boil tomatoes, tomato sauce, water (add more or less water according to your liking), salt and pepper, oil and celery seed.
Add sausage and macaroni.
Stir well, turn off, place on lid and leave covered 5 minutes.
Serve with crackers and salad or coleslaw.

title: Honey Bun Cake
steps: Mix and put half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.
Mix brown sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle 1/2 brown sugar mixture on batter and swirl in.
Pour rest of batter in and use rest of brown sugar mixture.
Bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

title: Crispy Baked Onion Rings(Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: corn flake cereal
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. corn flakes cereal, crushed

steps: Cut each onion into 4 thick slices; separate into rings (reserve small rings for another use).
Set aside.
Combine cereal and next 3 ingredients; divide in half and set aside.
Beat egg substitute at high speed with an electric mixer until soft peaks form.
Dip half of onion rings in egg substitute; dredge in half of crumb mixture.
Place in a single layer on baking sheets coated with cooking spray.
Repeat procedure with remaining onion rings, egg substitute and crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, or until crisp.
Serve warm.

title: Cousin Agnes' Bread Pudding
steps: Put sugar on bottom of double boiler insert.
Add bread.
Mix eggs, milk and vanilla.
Pour over bread.
Place insert over hot water.
Cook until set 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Remove insert and let cool.
When cool, place plate over top of pan and invert pudding. Serve warm or cold.

title: Meat Loaf With Tangy Sauce
steps: Mix all together well and spread into loaf pan.
Spread tangy sauce over meat loaf and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Bohemian Pickles
steps: Put cucumbers in quart jars.
Add garlic, dill weed and peppers.
Mix all other ingredients.
Fill jars with liquid. Store in cool dark place for 2 weeks.

title: Cool Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix

steps: Bake cake as directed for about 25 to 30 minutes in a rectangular pan.
Then remove from oven and punch holes all through the cake with a fork.
Then pour the condensed milk on the cake, covering it completely.
Let cool about 10 minutes.
Then mix the rest of the ingredients together and spread over the cake and store in refrigerator.

title: Spam Salad
steps: Cube Spam into 1/2 to 3/4-inch cubes.
Put into a pan.
Add cooled, cubed potatoes.
Add salt and pepper as desired.
Add chopped onion.
Mix well with sour cream.
Before serving, add croutons (do not refrigerate with croutons, they will get mushy). Serve directly on plate or on lettuce leaf as garnish.

title: Hominy Bake

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can of cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: butter bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1 cup Butter Bread crumbs or 1 can onion rings, crumbled

steps: Combine soup, peppers, celery seed, Worcestershire sauce and salt.
Place over medium heat until mixture is heated thoroughly. Place hominy in greased baking dish; pour soup mixture over hominy; top with crumbs and almonds.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes.
Yields: 12 servings.

title: Boursin Cheese
steps: Cream butter and cheese together.
Mix in all spices.
Serve at room temperature.
Can be frozen.

title: Italian Eggplant Casserole
steps: Cook eggplant and onions in water to cover 20 minutes.
Drain and add remaining ingredients.
Place in greased casserole and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown. Serves 6.

title: Hot Crabmeat Spread

ingredients.name: alaskan crab and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) can Alaskan crab, drained and flaked

steps: Combine crab, cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Add lemon juice, curry powder, Worcestershire sauce and onion to taste.
Put in 7 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish; top with cheese and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

title: Apple Crisp Pudding
steps: Butter casserole dish, add apples and pour water mixed with cinnamon over them.
Mix together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.
Spread mixture over apples and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Old Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix and pour into pastry.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Meringue(That Doesn'T Weep)
steps: Combine in a small saucepan, dry ingredients and water over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and clear.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form by gradually adding 4 tablespoons sugar, beating well.
Slowly add cooled cooked cornstarch mixture, beating until stiff glossy peaks form.
Spread meringue evenly to edge of pie crust to seal all around.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden.

title: Banana Brownie Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake pastry shell 10 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Reduce temperature to 325°.
In small saucepan over low heat, melt chips with butter.
In a large mixer bowl, beat chocolate mixture with milk, biscuit mix, eggs and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in walnuts.
Place bananas on bottom of pastry shell. Pour chocolate mixture over bananas.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until center is set.
Cool.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Wild Strawberry Preserves
steps: To a quart of strawberries, add sugar and water.
Boil slowly for 15 minutes.
Let stand overnight.
Next morning, bring to a boil and pour into jars while hot.

title: Banana Pepper Pie
steps: Line an 8 x 8-inch pan with sliced banana peppers. (May use other peppers.)
In a large bowl combine eggs, corn and cheese. Mix well.
Pour over peppers in pan.
Bake in a 300° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Larry'S Hot Sausage
steps: Cut sausage into bun sized pieces.
Cook for 15 minutes; drain.
Slice onions and peppers into 1/2-inch strips.
Mix whole tomatoes, Sweet 'N Low and tomato sauce with 1 1/2 cans of water. Cook for 15 minutes.
Add vegetables and cook another 15 minutes. Add sausage and cook another 15 minutes.
Serve with (soft) sausage buns.
Makes about 20 sandwiches.

title: Rotini Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain.
Prepare rotini noodles according to package directions; drain.
Mix all ingredients together except cheese.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover with cheese.
Bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted.

title: Trifle
steps: Mix pudding mix with milk.
Let set until thick.
Slice cake very thin.
In an attractive bowl, layer the following:

title: Potato And Cabbage Casserole

ingredients.name: american
ingredients.raw: 2 c. American or Cheddar cheese, shredded

steps: In large pan, heat butter and saute cabbage and onions until wilted.
Place half of the cabbage, onions and potatoes in a 3-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese.
Put remaining cabbage, potato and onion on top.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in same pan cabbage was cooked in.
Add 1/4 cup flour.
Cook 1 minute.
Add can of broth.
Cook until thickened.
Pour over top of cabbage.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Free Cake

ingredients.name: applesauce
ingredients.raw: 1 cup unsweetened applesauce (or other unsweetened fruit)

ingredients.name: each cinnamon nutmeg
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp each: cinnamon, nutmeg OR cloves, vanilla, baking soda

steps: Cook raisins in water until dry.
Let cool.
Then mix all ingredients well by hand.
Bake in lightly greased bundt pan or 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan for 55 - 60 minutes at 350.

title: Sausage Beef Casserole
steps: Cook sausage; drain.
Brown beef; drain.
Cook onion and celery in meat fat until tender.
Cook rice and drain.
Mix all ingredients together except cheese and bake at 350° for 1 hour, adding cheese to top during last 15 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Jam
steps: Mix the rhubarb and sugar together and let set overnight.
In the morning, boil the mixture for 5 minutes, then add the Jell-O. Stir well.
Put in jars to seal.
Very good if you like rhubarb strawberry on your toast.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 4 1/2 x 6 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Mix flour and sugar.
Stir in pecans.
Blend eggs, potatoes, milk and shortening.
Add liquid mixture to flour mixture.
Stir until blended.
Pour into pan.
Press pecan halves in top of batter. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Soppin Chocolate
steps: Mix and cook sugar, cocoa, flour and milk in saucepan until thick.
Add vanilla and butter.
Pour over hot biscuits.

title: Susan'S Salad
steps: Drain oranges and pineapple.
Mix all ingredients except gelatin.
Sprinkle dry gelatin over salad and toss lightly.

title: Granny Little'S Pound Cake(In Loving Memory)
steps: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour (presifted with baking powder) alternately with flavoring.
Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chicken or turkey, cooked and diced

steps: Toss together all ingredients except almonds and lettuce leaves.
Put almonds on top.
Serve 6.

title: Special Tea

ingredients.name: instant orange flavored breakfast drink mix
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. instant orange flavored breakfast drink mix

steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Store and pack in jars or tin cans.

title: Company Shrimp Boil

ingredients.name: crab and shrimp boil seasoning
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. crab and shrimp boil seasoning

steps: Fill a large pot with water to cover ingredients. Add shrimp and crab boil seasoning.
When water comes to a boil, add sausage and corn. Boil 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and boil 3 minutes.
Drain and serve with butter for the corn and cocktail sauce for the shrimp.
Cole slaw and favorite beverage completes the meal.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients except dressing, Fritos and cheese Add the French dressing. Allow a few hours to marinate in the dressing.
Add cheese and Fritos before serving.

title: Pigs In Blankets
steps: Take each frank.
Wrap 1/2 slice cheese around it.
Take 1 piece bacon and wrap over the frank and cheese.
Wrap 1 biscuit around frank.
Continue until ingredients are used up.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450° until golden brown.
Serve hot.

title: Friendship Tea Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Store in tightly closed jar. Combine 1 tablespoon of mix and 1 cup of hot water in a mug; add sugar.
Makes 2 1/2 cups of mix.

title: One Step Pie Crust
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
With hands, form dough to fit pie pan.

title: Pineapple Dessert Cake

ingredients.name: philadelphia cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened

steps: Follow directions on box for cake mix. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. With electric mixer, beat cream cheese, milk and pudding until thick. Spread over cooled cake.
Spread drained pineapple over creamed mixture. Top with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with some chopped nuts and coconut.
Keep in refrigerator until served.

title: Round Steak

ingredients.name: golden cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 4 cans golden cream of mushroom soup

steps: Melt shortening in a skillet.
Cut round steak in sections. Brown until done.
Empty cans of mushroom soup and stir together. Let simmer for about 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Ribs

ingredients.name: or more your favorite barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/2 bottle or more your favorite barbecue sauce

steps: Prepare ribs.
Remove excess fat, wash and pat dry with paper towel.
Place ribs in baking pan; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with chopped onions and chopped celery.
Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce.
Bake slowly in 325° oven until tender (approximately 1 1/2 hours).
Drain fat and pour 1/2 bottle or more barbecue sauce over ribs and return to oven for 1/2 hour, baste occasionally and remove from oven.

title: Ice Cream Party Punch
steps: Put pineapple juice, sherbet and ice cream in large mixing bowl and mix together.
When ready to serve, add ginger ale. Makes 24 servings.

title: Peach Frostee

ingredients.name: peach in juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can peach slices in juice

steps: In a blender, combine canned sliced peaches, dry milk powder, vanilla and cinnamon.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Add five ice cubes, one at a time with the motor running.
Blend until smooth. Makes 4 servings.
Calories per serving:
Diabetic exchanges per serving:
milk 1, vegetable 0, fruit 1/2, bread 0, meat 0 and fat 0.

title: Bartley'S Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: spaghetti
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. spaghetti or other thin pasta

steps: Cook pasta in boiling water until just done and rinse in cold water.
Add enough salad dressing to thoroughly coat the pasta. Add Parmesan cheese and vegetables.
You may use any other vegetable you choose.
Enjoy!
This makes enough for 10.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
steps: Beat eggs.
Cook sausage and onion.
Drain grease.
Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
When set in the middle it is ready to eat.
Can be prepared the night before and cooked in the morning.

title: Spaghetti Ala Carbonara*

ingredients.name: bacon crisp and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. bacon, cooked crisp, drained and diced

ingredients.name: spaghetti tender according pkg. direction
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. spaghetti, cooked tender according to pkg. directions

ingredients.name: cream light cream
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. cream, light cream or milk

steps: Mix cream, egg, Parmesan cheese and bacon together.
Toss with cooked spaghetti.
Sprinkle with salt, Parmesan cheese and plenty of freshly ground black pepper.
Serve immediately!

title: Tutti-Frutti
steps: Do not drain fruit.
Mix and chill first 6 ingredients.
Just before serving, add bananas.
Serve plain or with whipped topping.

title: Golden Cheesy Potatoes
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Moisten potatoes.
Drop in bag and shake well.
Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Arrange potatoes in one layer.
Bake at 425°.
Turn once.

title: Made-In-The-Shade Pork Chops
steps: In shaker jar, combine lemonade concentrate, soy sauce and seasonings.
Shake ingredients vigorously to blend.
Pour half of marinade into shallow pan and add chops in single layer.
Pour remaining marinade over steaks; cover pan and place in refrigerator approximately 24 hours.
Meat should be turned once or twice during refrigeration.
Remove from refrigerator three or four hours before grilling.
Grill over medium coals 40 to 45 minutes.
Baste steaks occasionally with remaining marinade.

title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
steps: Grease a 10-inch tube pan.
Set aside.
Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Combine flour, baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda, cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream, beating after each addition.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 75 minutes, or until done.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Take off wire rack; cool completely.

title: Creamy Squash Casserole
steps: Wash squash. Slice in rounds, fairly thin. Salt, pepper and roll in flour.
Have cooking oil medium-hot and fry until crisp and golden brown. Serve while hot.

title: Turkey Dressing

ingredients.name: loaf bread
ingredients.raw: 2 loaves bread, broken into small pieces

steps: Mix together.
Add water until soupy.
Stuff turkey.
Put water in bottom of pan with turkey.
Bake 3 hours; 45 minutes at 400° and the balance at 325°.

title: Granny'S Kitchen
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Add buttermilk, then yeast mixture.
Stir until thoroughly moistened.
Turn out onto floured board and knead a minute or two.
Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter.
Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise for 30 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Brush tops with melted butter.
Yield:
60 (2-inch) biscuits.

title: Sausage And Salsa Skillet Dinner

ingredients.name: dark red kidney bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 can (8 oz.) dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained

steps: Cut sausage in half lengthwise, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.
In 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage, tomatoes, water, salsa and beans.
Mix well, breaking tomatoes with large spoon.
Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let stand, covered, about 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Roast Fresh Ham

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. salt or less to taste

ingredients.name: ham shank
ingredients.raw: 1/2 fresh 9 lb. ham, shank or butt

steps: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together except ham.
Remove rind from ham. Score fat with a knife.
Rub mixture over ham. Wrap ham in foil or plastic and refrigerate overnight.
Heat oven to 425°.
Unwrap ham.
Place in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Roast, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
Reduce heat to 325°.
Baste with drippings every 30 minutes for about 4 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160° internal temperature.

title: Snickers Bar Dessert
steps: Mix vanilla pudding according to directions on package.
Stir in Cool Whip.
Add 2 chopped Snickers.
Pour over crust.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
This makes 1 large 9-inch pie or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.

title: Somen Noodle Salad

ingredients.name: somen noodle
ingredients.raw: Somen noodle or Soba noodle (if you don't have, you can use thin spaghetti)

steps: Rinse lettuce.
Drain well.
Tear into small pieces.
Clean and slice mushrooms.
Rinse cucumber, green pepper, onion and tomatoes, sliced.
Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl. Garnish with green onions.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Brown pork chops on each side; drain.
Arrange potatoes in a 9 x 12-inch casserole, lightly coated with nonstick spray.
Mix water, soup and sour cream in small bowl; pour over potatoes. Arrange pork chops on top.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake, covered, at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Carrot Tuna Noodle Salad
steps: Mix carrots, celery and tuna together.
Add mayonnaise.
Just before serving, add noodles.
Serves about 6.

title: Cool Veggie Pizza Or Mexican Siesta Pizza

ingredients.name: dill weed
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. dill weed or 1 pkg. dry Ranch dressing*

ingredients.name: tomato cucumber broccoli carrot onion pepper mushroom cheese lettuce black olive zucchini
ingredients.raw: toppings (as many as desired): tomatoes, cucumbers, broccoli, carrots, onions, peppers, mushrooms, cheese, lettuce, black olives, zucchini

steps: *For Mexican Siesta, add 2 tablespoons of sour cream and 2 tablespoons of taco mix.
Omit mayo and dill.

title: Cinnamon Nuts
steps: Mix cinnamon into sugar; add cream and mix well.
Cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly; cook to 240°.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Stir until syrup coats nuts.
Spread on wax paper to cool.
Break into pieces.

title: Diet Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Put your sliced cucumbers or any cut up vegetables in mixture. Cover and store in refrigerator.
Eat whenever hungry.

title: Gloria'S Fried Pie Dough
steps: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in shortening.
Add liquid ingredients and refrigerate.
This can be stored several days and used as needed.
For fried pies, I roll out a thin saucer-sized circle of dough.
Fill with desired fruit and fold in half.
Press edges with fork and fry in skillet with a little bit of shortening.
This dough is very easy to work with and tastes great.

title: Papaya Seed Dressing
steps: Put vinegar and dry ingredients in blender with motor running. Add oil in steady stream.
Add onion, then papaya seed and blend until seed looks coarsely ground.
Chill for 1 hour.
Good on fruit or green salads.

title: Vegetable Quiche
steps: Saute onions, zucchini and garlic in margarine or oil. Prebake 1 pie crust until slightly cooked.
Mix together cheese, eggs, milk and dash of Tabasco sauce.
Add sauteed vegetables to egg mixture.
Pour into crust.
Bake at about 350° until set, about 45 to 60 minutes.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top after it is baked.

title: Leota'S Fudge

ingredients.name: sq. semi sweet baker s chocolate

steps: Mix syrup, sugar, milk and chocolate.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Increase heat until soft ball stage is reached. Add butter and put in cool water until mixture is lukewarm.
Add vanilla and beat until candy stands alone.
Add pecans and mix and turn into greased dish.

title: Old Fashion "Peach" Cake
steps: Mix together cake mix, pie filling, eggs, vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Mix together flour, sugar, butter and flavoring (will be crumbly).
Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Relish
steps: Combine
first	4 ingredients.	Mix sugar and remaining ingredients.
Bring
to a boil; cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes.
Pour
vinegar
mixture
over vegetables and toss. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
steps: Mix all together. Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken

ingredients.name: celery and parsley flake
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. celery and parsley flakes (or any seasoning desired)

steps: Before you go to church Sunday morning, cut up and remove the skin from fryer; salt and flour lightly.
Arrange in single layer in slow cooker.
Slice onion; spread over chicken.
Sprinkle over this the seasoning, thyme and celery
and parsley flakes.
Place lid on cooker; turn on.
Come home from church and eat!

title: Summer Punch
steps: In a large pitcher or punch bowl, combine all except sherbet. Stir until all juices are thawed and blended.
Top with scoop of sherbet, if desired.
Makes 18 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Tortoni Squares
steps: Combine almonds, oleo, crumbs and extract; mix well.
Sprinkle 1/3 of crumbs over bottom of 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan that is lined with foil.
Spoon half of ice cream over crumbs.
Drizzle with preserves.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Repeat layers.
Store in freezer.
Cut in squares and garnish with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Zucchini-Potato Pancakes
steps: Heat oil in large skillet.
In large bowl, combine zucchini, potatoes, eggs, cracker crumbs, salt, basil and pepper.
Stir until well mixed.
Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls into heated oil and cook until brown.
Add more oil, if needed.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.
Makes about 18 medium pancakes.

title: Crepes
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth.
Add flour and milk. Mix in slowly.
Put on a small frying pan with Crisco, 1/4 cup crepe batter.
Flip and fry both sides until golden brown.

title: Italian Cookie Anise Toast
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour cookie sheet.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat sugar and eggs for 5 minutes. Add anise and beat well.
Add dry ingredients and mix at low speed.
Make 3 separate long loaves on cookie sheet, 3-inches wide.
Bake 15 minutes, until lightly baked.
Remove from oven and cut into 1-inch cookies.
Put back on cookie sheet, cut side down, and bake 10 more minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lyn'S Dip
steps: Heat jello, cream cheese, tomato soup and water until melted and blended well.
Cool well.
Add Miracle Whip, pecans, bell pepper and onion; chill overnight.
Makes about 2-quarts of dip. Good for a large crowd and good with chips or vegetables.

title: Best Yet Banana Bread

ingredients.name: soda dissolved in tbsp. water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. water

steps: Mix in order given and pour in loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Corn Flake Chicken

ingredients.name: envelope zesty italian dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (0.6 oz.) envelope Zesty Italian dressing mix

ingredients.name: chicken breast half skinned and boned
ingredients.raw: 6 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish.
Dip each chicken breast in milk.
Roll in crumb mixture.
Place chicken in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 18 minutes or until done.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Rocky Mt. Apple Pie

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cream or half and half

steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Spread 1/2 mixture evenly in bottom of pie pan.
Line pan with quartered or halved apples, cut side up. Spread remaining sugar mixture on apples.
Drizzle cream over apples.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Yummy Strawberry Pie
steps: Crush crackers fine, then combine with sugar and butter.
Mix well.
Press firmly in unbuttered 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Place in refrigerator to cool.
Mix milk and lemon juice by hand until thick.
Add strawberries and part of the juice for color.
Arrange in pie shell.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fruit Tray And Dip

ingredients.name: strawberry pineapple grape banana and orange
ingredients.raw: strawberries, pineapple, grapes (red and white), bananas and oranges

steps: Mix together sour cream, jelly and coconut for dip mixture. Wash and cut fruit.
Arrange on tray.
Use decorative toothpicks to pick up fruit and dip in mixture.

title: Hot Tuna Melts
steps: Mix ingredients in order using 8 to 12 hamburger rolls.
Fill with mixture.
Cover with tops.
Seal each sandwich inside of foil and put on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: The Cake That Won'T Last

ingredients.name: pineapple and juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice (1 c.)

steps: Mash
bananas
in
mixing bowl.
Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended by hand.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Garden Pizza

ingredients.name: plu pkg. cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) plus 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese

ingredients.name: each variou vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. each various vegetables (examples: cucumbers, carrots, green olives, green peppers, radishes, broccoli, green onions, etc.)

steps: Spread crescent rolls on cookie sheet and press together. Bake as directed on can until brown.
Mix remaining ingredients except vegetables and spread over crust. Top with vegetables.

title: Country Pork Ribs

ingredients.name: pork chop all fat removed
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 lb. pork chops, all fat removed

steps: Rub ribs with crushed garlic and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in roasting pan, rib side down,in 350° oven.
While ribs are roasting, put dried fruit in saucepan, barely cover with water and simmer covered for 35 minutes.
After ribs have cooked for 1 hour, add the fruit and its cooking liquid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes.
Make glaze by combining unsweetened orange juice concentrate, onion flakes and mustard.
Spread over ribs and roast another 15 minutes, basting frequently.
If ribs don't appear nicely browned, bake a little longer until they have a pleasing color.
Cut the ribs into serving size pieces and arrange along with the fruit on a platter.
A green vegetable and salad will finish meal.

title: Lazy Macaroons
steps: Beat the egg whites with a dash of vanilla until stiff. Slowly add sugar and fold in the coconut. Drop by a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes at 325°.
Makes about 20.

title: White Chocolate Candy
steps: Melt, stirring constantly over low heat, the first three ingredients.
Add Rice Krispies and peanuts.
Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.

title: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Mix dry ingredients together, then add shortening. Mix until it's a cornmeal type texture.
Add egg and enough water to make it "a little wetter than pie crust dough." Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares.
Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour.
Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pinylata Or Sausage Rolls
steps: Mix flour with hot roll mix flour.
Use yeast from mix plus extra yeast, dissolved in the warm water.
Mix yeast water into flour and mix until dough comes away from side of bowl.
Add maybe 1/2 cup flour more and knead 1 minute.
Cover and let rise 1/2 hour.
Roll 1/3 of dough to size of 10-inch pie shell.
Spread 1/3 of cooked and drained sausage on top with some Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and bread crumbs sprinkled on.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Cut into 3-inch pieces or smaller.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Do 3 times.

title: Cheesy Baked Mostaccioli
steps: Brown meat good; cut up vegetables.
Add mushrooms, soup, onion, pepper and celery.
Cook 45 minutes, then add cheese.
Stir until melted.
Add cooked noodles to the mixture.
Put mixture in a large casserole dish and bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding mix as directed on box
ingredients.raw: 1 box vanilla instant pudding, mix as directed on box

steps: Mix strawberries with glaze; set aside.
Break cake into bite size pieces.
Fold together pudding, Cool Whip and condensed milk.
Layer cake, pudding mixture and strawberries in a punch bowl until reaches top.
You may garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Creamed Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and boned
ingredients.raw: 4 whole, large chicken breasts, skinned and boned

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. dry white wine or water

ingredients.name: herb seasoned stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 c. herb seasoned stuffing mix, crumbled

steps: Arrange chicken in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Place cheese slices over chicken.
Combine soup and wine.
Stir.
Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and cheese.
Sprinkle with stuffing. Drizzle butter over crumbs.
Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Mock Black Forest Cake For Microwave Oven
steps: Grease or spray with Pam, a microwave Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle nuts and put cherries in bottom of pan.
Put mixture in pan, only 1/2 full.
Bake on High for 13 minutes.

title: Healthy Supper

ingredients.name: ground turkey
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground turkey or super lean ground beef

steps: Cook meat in large pot.
Add rice, bouillon (dissolved in hot water) and seasoned salt and stir.
Add cabbage, onions and carrots.
Cover and cook slowly until cabbage cooks down and carrots are tender.
Can be simmered for an hour and left unattended.
Serve with soy sauce, if desired.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Corn And English Pea Salad
steps: Drain corn and peas.
Stir in other ingredients until mixed well.
Chill at least 12 hours.

title: Chilled Summer Soup
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add the lettuce, watercress and spring onions and fry for 8 minutes.
Stir in all but 3 tablespoons of the chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Blend the flour to a paste with the remaining stock and stir into the soup.
Add salt and pepper to taste and continue cooking until soup has thickened.
Puree in an electric blender. Cool, then stir in cream.
Sprinkle top with parsley.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tempting Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature; sift together flour, soda and salt.
Cream together margarine, shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add the egg; cream until mixture is fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth; blend in milk.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet; flatten the dough with the bottom of a glass which has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Cheesecake Pie
steps: Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip and some of the chopped fresh fruit.
Spoon into crust. Chill.
Arrange fresh fruit on top.

title: Pancake Mix
steps: Sift flour and baking powder into bowl.
Add milk, melted shortening and egg.
Beat well. Pour onto sprayed pan.
(For thinner pancakes, add more milk.)
Makes 12 to 15 (5-inch) pancakes.

title: Baked Beans With Ground Beef
steps: Saute onion, green pepper and celery.
Brown ground beef.
Mix beans, barbecue sauce, catsup and brown sugar.
Add beef and sauteed vegetables.
Mix everything together.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Meatballs

ingredients.name: heinz barbecue sauce with onion
ingredients.raw: 1 bottle Heinz barbecue sauce with onions

steps: Mix beef, bread crumbs, eggs, soup mix and Accent.
Roll into bite size pieces.
Arrange on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Rolls
steps: Arrange rolls in well-greased, fluted tube pan.
Sprinkle pudding (dry) over rolls.
Cook butter and remaining ingredients over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles.
Pour over rolls.
Cover tightly with foil.
Let stand overnight on counter.
Next morning, bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes, then invert carefully onto serving dish.

title: Fresh Mint Jelly

ingredients.name: mint leaf and stem firmly
ingredients.raw: 1 c. fresh mint leaves and stems, firmly packed

steps: Wash mint, leaving stems intact.
Crush or coarsely chop. Place in a large saucepan.
Add sugar, water and vinegar.
Over high heat, bring to a full rolling boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.

title: Blueberry Torte
steps: Combine graham cracker crumbs (save some for the top), sugar and melted margarine and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Soften cream cheese and beat until smooth.
Add eggs, remaining 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla and cream well.
Pour cream cheese mixture over crust and bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool.
Spread pie filling over cream cheese mixture.
Top with whipped cream and the rest of graham cracker crumbs.
Chill overnight.

title: Lolita'S Deep Dish Apple Pie
steps: Mix sugar and apples.
Arrange sliced apples into chilled shell 1/2-inch from edge; work toward center until shell is covered.
Add salt, cinnamon, grated rind of lemon and lemon juice to apple mixture in pie shell.
Pile remaining apples on top.
Dot with butter.
Cover with top crust and seal edges.
Bake in preheated 450° oven for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Frozen Strawberry Salad(Salad Or Dessert)
steps: Cream together Cool Whip, sugar and cream cheese.
Fold remaining ingredients into mixture.
Place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and freeze or you may put in individual foil muffin cups and freeze. Enjoy.
Serves 10.

title: Pintos And Sausage
steps: Cook beans as directed on bag (I use more water, to give some juice), around 2 1/2 hours.
Cut up sausage.
Add to beans.
Cook about 15 minutes more.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Great with cornbread and onions.

title: Colorful Vegetable Salad

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans, drained

ingredients.name: commercial italian salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) bottle commercial Italian salad dressing

steps: Layer half of vegetables in a salad bowl.
Repeat layers.
Add salad dressing.
Cover tightly and chill until ready to serve.

title: Oriental Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: or brussels sprouts
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh or frozen Brussels sprouts

steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Remove from pan and drain on paper towel.
Stir soy sauce into the bacon drippings.
Add chestnuts, garlic and broth.
Bring to a boil and add Brussels sprouts. Return to a boil; cover and reduce heat, cooking about 8 minutes or until sprouts are just tender.
Combine cornstarch and water and add to the pan liquid.
Cook, stirring, until thickened. Sprinkle reserved bacon over the top to serve.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Scotch-A-Roos
steps: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil.
Boil maybe 1 or 2 minutes, no longer or they will get too hard.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and stir together.
Add Rice Krispies.
Put in bar pan, greased with butter or margarine.

title: Hinder Wings
steps: Mix together.
Use only 2 larger sections of wings.
Put wings in a shallow pan; pour sauce over.
Baste and turn every 15 minutes so they get covered with sauce.
Last 10 minutes, sprinkle with sesame seed.
Drain on cake racks (spread newspaper underneath to catch drippings).
Can be eaten cold.

title: Wanda'S Lasagna
steps: Boil noodles until done.
Brown hamburger meat.
In a large bowl, combine hamburger meat, Ragu sauce, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and garlic powder.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
steps: Cut hot baked potatoes in half.
Scoop out insides; reserve shells.
In large bowl, with electric mixer, beat potatoes and spread until creamy.
Gradually beat in milk; stir in onion, salt and pepper.
Spoon mixture into reserved shells.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Arrange in baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Delicious Meatballs And Gravy
steps: Chop onion; add garlic to oil in a large pot.
Saute until soft (do not burn).
Strain tomatoes.
Add this to the onions and garlic, plus puree, salt, black pepper, water and sugar.
Cook this for 1 hour, low to medium heat.

title: Pasta

ingredients.name: penne
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. penne or other small tubular pasta

ingredients.name: basil leaf
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. packed fresh basil leaves, chopped

ingredients.name: bottled red pepper flake
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. bottled red pepper flakes or up to 1 tsp.

steps: For pasta, drop penne into kettle of boiling water; return to boil and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Drain; toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Return to pan and keep warm. For sauce, saute garlic slowly in 3 tablespoons olive oil in skillet until softened, but not browned.
Add olives, basil, red pepper and tomato sauce.
Heat.
Stir in cheeses and heat, stirring until chunks begin to melt.
Pour over pasta.
Pass additional grated Parmesan cheese to sprinkle over if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt(Diabetic)

ingredients.name: plu tsp. granulated fructose divided
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. plus 2 tsp. granulated fructose, divided

steps: In a large saucepan, soften gelatin in water for 2 minutes. Place over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved.
Add evaporated milk, 1/2 cup of the fructose and salt to gelatin.
Stir over medium heat until well blended, approximately 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in yogurt and vanilla.
Set aside.

title: Baked Eggs
steps: Layer in order in a small baking dish.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.
Serves one.

title: Orange Delight Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water.
Use the pineapple juice and enough cold water to make the 2 cups cold liquid.
Add to Jell-O and let set until it starts to congeal.
Add pineapple and marshmallows.
Fold in whipped cream.
Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Teriyaki Steak Strips

ingredients.name: flank steak in
ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. flank steak, cut in 1-inch strips

ingredients.name: green onion with top
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chopped scallions with tops (or use onion salt)

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic, minced or garlic salt

steps: Combine all ingredients
(except flank steak).	Marinate flank steak overnight.
Grill.

title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water.
Drain and mash with the rest of the ingredients except for the melted butter.
Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Collards And Cornbread

ingredients.name: ham hock
ingredients.raw: 2 ham hocks or 1 c. ham chunks

steps: Wash greens thoroughly (2 to 3 times) to remove sand.
Take out and discard tough stems.
Put ham hocks or ham chunks in pot.
Add greens and fill half full with water.
Let greens come to a boil, then turn fire down and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until seasoned and tender.
Add salt according to taste when serving.
Lift greens out of water into a flat bowl and cut into bite size pieces with a sharp knife.
We like to sprinkle pepper sauce or vinegar on our plates.

title: Cracker Pudding
steps: Mix together the milk, crackers, coconut, salt and sugar; scald.
Pour about a cup of this hot mixture over the egg yolks. Blend egg and hot milk together before returning to hot mixture. Cook until thick; add vanilla.
Pour into baking dish and cover with meringue.

title: *Sweet And Sour Carrots

ingredients.name: green pepper in
ingredients.raw: 1 medium green pepper, cut in 1-inch squares

steps: Cook carrots in slightly salted water for 15 minutes.
Add pepper and cook for 3 minutes more; drain.
Drain pineapple and save juice.
Add water to juice to make 1/3 cup.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt, liquid, vinegar and soy sauce.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
Add vegetables and pineapple.
Heat through. Serves 6.

title: Skillet Cabbage

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 c. drained tomatoes or 2 c. chopped fresh ones

steps: Combine ingredients in large skillet.
Cover and cook 3 minutes.
Stir and cook 3 more minutes.
Yields about 6 servings.

title: Paper Cup Salad
steps: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, sugar, salt, pineapple, bananas and coloring.
Fold in nuts.
Spoon into paper muffin cup liners in muffin tins and freeze.
When frozen remove from tins. Put in plastic bags or airtight container and return to freezer. Will keep for several months.
Take out of freezer for 15 minutes before serving.
Peel off liners and serve on lettuce.
Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: No Bake Orange Coconut Balls
steps: Melt butter and pour over vanilla wafer crumbs and add remaining ingredients.
Roll into balls and then roll in the coconut.
Place on cookie sheet to let harden.

title: Easy Combination In A Pastry Shell

ingredients.name: any of the following shrimp lump crabmeat crawfish tail scallop chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 c. any of the following: cooked shrimp, lump crabmeat, crawfish tails, scallops, chicken or 1 to 1 1/2 c. mushrooms, broccoli, etc.

steps: Make the white sauce by melting butter in a large skillet. Take off the heat and add flour to make a paste.
Add milk, return to heat and stir constantly until thick and smooth.

title: Amish Raisin Cream Pie
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch.
Add milk and 2 slightly beaten egg yolks.
Cook until thick.
Add salt, vanilla, oleo and cooled raisins.
Pour into baked crust.

title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Mix egg and Parmesan cheese together.
Cook spaghetti and drain.
Mix in 1 tablespoon butter, then mix into spaghetti with the egg and Parmesan cheese.
Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with a little oil.

title: No-Bake Peanut Nuggets
steps: Heat sugar and milk in saucepan to boiling.
Boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and add saltine crumbs, peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix well so that peanut butter is melted.
Add coconut and peanuts and stir until mixture is stiff.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper to form mounds.

title: Crisp Candy Bars

ingredients.name: peanut butter
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. peanut butter or butterscotch chips

steps: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In saucepan, mix syrup and sugar, stirring
frequently
to boil over medium heat.
Remove from heat. Stir
in peanut butter, then cereal and press into pan.
Melt your chips and spread while hot.

title: Plains, Georgia Cheese Ring
steps: Mix cheese, onion, pecans and mayonnaise together.
Mold mixture with a spoon or hands into a ring.
Fill the center with strawberry preserves. Serve with Ritz crackers.
Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Stuffed Eggs

ingredients.name: salt pepper nutmeg and red pepper
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper, nutmeg and red pepper

steps: Remove shells.
Cut eggs in half; remove yolks.
Mix yolks with ingredients; beat until smooth, adding a little cream if necessary.
Sprinkle red pepper for garnish.

title: Bread Stuffing For Turkey

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 3/4 c. butter or margarine, melted

steps: Cook onion in 2 tablespoons of butter until soft but not brown.
Combine with the bread, seasonings and stock.

title: Lemony Torte Squares
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour.
Batter will be stiff. Pack in 9 x9-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Benedict Spread

ingredients.name: cucumber and of juice
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4-inch cucumber, grated and drained of juice

steps: Mash cream cheese with grated cucumber pulp.
Add onion, salt and enough mayonnaise to make a smooth spread.
Add small amount of green food coloring to make filling a very pale green.
This is one of my favorites.

title: Berries 'N Bits Trifle

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand condensed milk

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding

ingredients.name: whipping cream whipped
ingredients.raw: 2 c. whipping cream, whipped (I often use Cool Whip for lower calories)

ingredients.name: nestle little bit semi sweet chocolate
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Nestle Little Bits semi-sweet chocolate

steps: In large bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and water.
Add pudding mix and beat well.
Chill for 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 2 cups pudding into 3-quart glass bowl.
Top with 1/2 of each of the vanilla wafers, berries, little chocolate bits and remaining pudding.
Repeat layers.
Garnish with additional little bits, wafers and berries.
Chill thoroughly.
Refrigerate any leftovers. Serves 8 to 10.
An elegant, delicious treat.

title: Plan Ahead Pinto Beans

ingredients.name: green chile roasted and
ingredients.raw: 3 large green chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded or canned green chiles

steps: Note:
Sprouting the beans helps to remove some of the gas and also brings in extra nutrients.

title: French Chocolate Pie
steps: Cream butter with sugar.
Stir in chocolate.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each addition at high speed.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into a cooled 9-inch pie shell.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

title: Hamburger With Baked Beans
steps: Cut bacon strips in small pieces.
Add onion and saute.
Brown ground beef with the onion and bacon.
Add remaining ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.

title: Millionaire Pie - No Bake
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and beat for 5 min.
Pour into shell, mix next three ingredients and spread over first layer. Chill and serve.

title: Okra Gumbo
steps: Saute meat and drain on paper towel.
Combine all ingredients in large stewpot.
Cook until okra turns color.

title: Chicken Pilaf

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 3 chicken breasts, halved or other chicken parts

steps: Mix rice, soup mix, soup, water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika.
