Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.

title: Apricot Almond Brie
steps: Remove top rind from cheese; place cheese on serving plate. In a small saucepan, combine preserves and liqueur.
Heat until mixture is hot, but not boiling.
Pour some of the sauce over cheese (save remainder for adding later, if desired).
Sprinkle almonds over top.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Tomato

ingredients.name: del monte italian style stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 2 (14 1/2 oz.) cans Del Monte Italian style stewed tomatoes

steps: Place chicken in baking dish.
Bake, covered, 15 minutes in oven preheated to 425°; drain.
Combine tomatoes, cornstarch, oregano and pepper sauce.
Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened.
Pour heated sauce over chicken; top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes, uncovered.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Briar Patch Bake

ingredients.name: macaroni and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 1/4 oz.) pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner

steps: Brown meat; stir in barbecue sauce and onion.
Heat.
Prepare macaroni dinner as directed on the package except use 1/2 cup milk. Layer half the dinner in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
Cover with meat mixture.
Top with remaining dinner.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Muenster Cheese
steps: Don't let new small potatoes go to waste.
Scrape them or if you want to do a basketful or more, fill your washing machine with cold water and let it run to clean them.
Pack them in jars; add water and 1 teaspoon salt to each quart.
Cold pack 3 hours.

title: Rigatoni And Cheese Sauce
steps: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Melt margarine.
Add flour and cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Do not brown.
Stir in milk, salt, pepper and cheese.
Cook until smooth and thickened.
Pour sauce over hot rigatoni and mix gently.
Sprinkle peas on top and place in oven at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Best-Ever Corn Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients and stir together.
Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch dish in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Egg Pudding
steps: Put cubed bread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt margarine and cheese in double boiler.
Pour over bread.
Beat eggs with fork and add milk and mix.
Pour over mixture.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
Bake one hour at 300°.

title: Quick Cole Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage in bowl.
Add pinch of celery seed or more, if desired.
Add cole slaw dressing and stir.
Chill and serve or serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in water; let stand while combining sour cream, sugar and baking soda in large bowl.
Add 2 cups biscuit mix, then yeast mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in 3 more cups biscuit mix.
Turn dough onto board dusted with 1/2 cup biscuit mix; knead to form smooth ball.
Shape dough into small rounds the size of a walnut. Place close together in buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake rolls 15 minutes, or until done.
Makes 72 bite size rolls.

title: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Bring margarine, sugar, cocoa and milk to a boil for about 3 minutes.
Add peanut butter and oats.
Then drop on waxed paper and allow to cool.

title: Butterscotch Balls
steps: Soften butter (don't melt).
Mix powdered sugar, peanut butter, graham crackers, vanilla, coconut and butter in large bowl.
Roll into 1-inch balls.

title: English Trifle
steps: Bake cake in oblong pan according to directions on box.
This only uses half the cake (you can find someone baking on the same day and share).
Break 1/4 of the cake into large pieces and place in a 2-quart serving bowl.
Pour half the thawed strawberries over the cake.
Spread with half of prepared pudding.
Repeat layers. Chill at least 8 hours.
Right before serving, spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle with almonds.
Spoon into dessert dishes to serve.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
steps: Mix well.
Pour into a graham cracker pie crust and top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp And Green Noodles
steps: Cook noodles as directed on package.
Line a casserole with noodles and make into a nest.
In a large frying pan, saute the shrimp in 1/2 cup clarified butter until pink and tender, about 5 minutes.
Cover noodles with shrimp.
Combine soup, sour cream, mayonnaise and chives; add mustard and sherry.
Pour sauce over shrimp and sprinkle Cheddar cheese over all.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until
cheese has melted and bubbly.
Serves 6.

title: Baby Ruth Cookies

ingredients.name: baby ruth candy bar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Baby Ruth candy bar, cut into small pieces

steps: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg.
Stir in Baby Ruth pieces and dry ingredients.
Add vanilla and blend well. Chill dough for 30 minutes.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake in oven at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.
Remove from baking sheet onto wire racks to cool.
To enhance flavoring, add caramel flavoring.

title: Erin'S Orange Salad

ingredients.name: tub cool whip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) tub Cool Whip (I use light)

steps: Mix Jell-O with cottage cheese until well blended.
Add fruit; be sure oranges and pineapple are drained well.
Mix well and fold in Cool Whip.
Makes a great low-cal, cool salad.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bonbons

ingredients.name: ready spread vanilla frosting
ingredients.raw: 1 can ready to spread vanilla frosting

ingredients.name: ready spread chocolate frosting
ingredients.raw: 1 can ready to spread chocolate frosting

steps: In large bowl, combine vanilla frosting, peanut butter and margarine until well blended.
Stir in crumbs; mix well.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Chill 1 hour.

title: Dried Beef Snax
steps: Spread
cream cheese on slice of dried beef.
Put slice of pickle
on
top
and roll up.
Chill, then slice into bite size pieces.

title: Ada'S Carrot-Pineapple Jello Salad
steps: Dilute lemon jello in boiling water.
Add cold water and pineapple juice.
Let cool.
Add the crushed pineapple and 1 cup shredded carrots.
Chill until set.

title: Tammy'S Chicken Fingers
steps: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add enough buttermilk to cover the chicken strips. Stir. Coat chicken strips and refrigerate overnight.
Remove chicken strips from mixture and shake off excess.
Dip in a mixture of flour, salt, pepper and the seasoned salt. Deep fry until chicken strips are golden brown and drain on a paper towel.

title: Scrambled Tots
steps: In a large frypan, put layer of Tater Tots to cover skillet. Cook Tater Tots until just about done.
Mash Tater Tots flat with a spatula.
Break open about 4 or 5 eggs over the top of Tater Tots.
Mix eggs in with Tater Tots. Season to taste.

title: Cheesy O'S
steps: Heat oven to 300°.
Melt butter in baking pan.
Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Add cereal; mix well.
Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

title: Baked Rice Dressing
steps: Mix all in large bowl.
Bake in covered 9 x 13-inch bowl at 350°
for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Broccoli Au Gratin
steps: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Cook onions in melted margarine until limp.
Add thawed broccoli, salt, pepper and savory.
Cook 5 minutes over low heat.
Put spaghetti into greased 3-quart casserole.
Cover with a layer of cheese slices.
Pour in milk. Add a layer of broccoli, then cover with cheese slices.
Bake 30 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: *No Crust Coconut Pie*
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Add vanilla, then add milk and coconut.
Grease two 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Squash Balls
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients and form into small balls.
Roll in cornflakes.
Drop in hot grease and fry.

title: Pizzarino Green Beans
steps: Combine drained beans with remaining ingredients.
Heat thoroughly, stirring gently.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Relish

ingredients.name: raspberry thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen raspberries, thawed and drained

steps: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
May be refrigerated, covered, for 1 month.
Makes 5 cups.

title: Berniece Thurn'S Pancake
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.
Mix together yolks and the rest of ingredients; fold in egg whites.
Cook on hot griddle or heavy frying pan until bubbly on top; turn once.
Cook until golden brown.
Serve with hot syrup and butter.

title: Noodles Warsaw
steps: Chop cabbage into pieces.
Brown sausage, season with chili powder.
Drain sausage.
Bring water to a boil and cook noodles for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tootie Fruitie Salad
steps: In large mixing bowl, place peaches, pineapple and fruit cocktail if used with all juices; slice strawberries and add
to other fruit, then add pudding mixes. Do not prepare pudding, just dump in bowl with fruit and mix. Add bananas, sliced or chunk-sizes. Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: June'S Kidney Beans(Abington Grange Supper)
steps: Soak beans overnight.
Place salt pork in the bottom of a bean pot, drain the beans and to pot with all other ingredients.
Cover with hot water and bake at 325° for 5 or 6 hours.
Add more water as needed and reduce temperature to 300° for last hour.
Add more molasses, if desired.
Fork test, done when beans are tender, but not mushy.
Serves 10 hungry people.

title: Melanie'S Simple Sorbet

ingredients.name: peach in heavy syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can peaches in heavy syrup

steps: Freeze unopened can of fruit for at
least 12 hours (longer is even better).
Dip frozen can in hot water a few seconds to loosen edges and make it easier to get out the contents.
Cut the frozen fruit up into chunks and put into food processor.
Add lemon juice, liqueur and cranberries. Pulse on/off for about 30 seconds.
Serve immediately or can be scooped into small balls and stored in freezer until ready to serve.
Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole

ingredients.name: pork sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pork sausage, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: bread in
ingredients.raw: 2 slices bread, broken in small pieces

steps: Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (or longer, if needed).

title: Holiday Eggnog
steps: Beat eggs and add all ingredients, cooking constantly.
Chill! Fold in egg whites and cream; fold in brandy and rum.
Chill, then add vanilla.

title: Honey Drop Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Add vanilla and honey.
Bake on greased cookie sheets at 350°.

title: French Salad Dressing
steps: Put all the ingredients in mixing bowl.
Mix on low for 15 minutes.

title: White Enchiladas
steps: Crush Doritos.
Mix together soup, sour cream, chilies, onion and chicken.
In a 3-quart casserole, layer Doritos, soup mixture and cheese in that order.
Make 2 layers.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Spudnuts
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water.
Mix potatoes and milk.
Add flour salt, shortening and sugar.
Add 3 more cups flour and knead.
If needed, add 1 more cup flour.
Let dough double itself, then roll out and cut with regular doughnut cutter.
Let rise until twice their regular size.
Cook in deep oil at 390°.
Makes 4 dozen plus holes.

title: "Momma'S Chili"

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes (whole; slice the tomatoes and add juice also)

ingredients.name: french s brand chili o mix with onion
ingredients.raw: 1 pack French's brand Chili-O mix with onion

ingredients.name: bush s brand light kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Bush's brand light kidney beans

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can water (use the tomato sauce can)

steps: Cook in at least a 4-quart Dutch oven.
Brown the ground chuck and chopped onion until the meat is thoroughly cooked.
Add the salt and pepper for seasoning.
Then add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil over low heat for 30 to 35 minutes.
Stir often to avoid burning.
No lid is necessary.
Serve hot.
Serves 4.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
steps: Mix sour cream, milk, Bisquick, eggs, pepper and salt together; stir in ham, cheese and chilies.
Pour into deep pie plate.
Cook until inserted knife comes out clean at 400° (40 minutes).
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Pizza Dough

ingredients.name: all purpose
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. all-purpose * or whole wheat flour

steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Stir in remaining ingredients; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Let rest about 5 minutes.

title: Southern Okra

ingredients.name: sized tomato and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium sized tomatoes, peeled and quartered

steps: Cook okra in boiling salted water 10 minutes; drain.
Brown onion and green pepper in salad oil.
Add tomatoes and cook slowly for 5 minutes.
Add okra and remaining ingredients.
Cook over low heat until vegetables are just tender, stirring as little as possible.
One cup canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh tomatoes.
Serves 4.

title: Simple Super Fudge

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can sweetened condensed milk (Borden's Eagle Brand)

steps: Use a double boiler; heat chocolate chips until melted.
Add can of condensed milk and vanilla.
(Also peanut butter if desired.)
Add nuts.
Pour into a lightly buttered 8-inch or 9-inch square pan.
Cool for 1 or more hours and then cut into squares.

title: Lime-Sweet Pickles
steps: Soak cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours.
Rinse in clear water several times.
Soak in clean water for 3 hours.
Drain. Mix the cloves, vinegar, celery seed, salt and mixed spices; pour over pickles.
Let stand overnight.
Heat to boiling and put into jars.

title: Forget-Me-Not Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs until foamy and white.
Add salt.
Continue to beat, gradually adding sugar until a stiff peak forms.
Fold in morsels and pecans.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet by the spoonful.
Place in oven and turn oven off.
Do not open door until the next morning.
Yields 40 to 60 cookies.

title: Salmonettes Heloise
steps: Pour salmon juice into measuring cup and set aside.
Put salmon in mixing bowl and 1 egg.
Break up salmon and mix the egg real good.
Fork in 1/2 cup flour.
Mixture is thick.
Add a little pepper, 1/4 salmon juice and add 1 teaspoon baking powder. Beat with a fork.
It must foam.
Pour into salmon mixture.
Mix with fork.
Scoop with small spoons into hot oil.
Makes brown tidbits.
Stick with toothpick and serve with dip or put a hot sauce over them.

title: German Cheese Soup
steps: Cook vegetables in one and one-half quarts of water until tender.
Add other ingredients and cook until cheese is melted.

title: Double Quick Rolls(Makes 1 Dozen Rolls)
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a large bowl.
Add water, shortening and egg.
Beat until smooth.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk, about 30 minutes.
Stir down batter by beating about 25 strokes.
Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins.
Let rise until batter rounds over tops of cups, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 400°.
Bake until golden brown (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Bisquick Butter Biscuits
steps: Cut cold butter into 1/4-inch pieces.
Toss baking mix and butter with fork until coated.
Add milk; stir just until milk is absorbed (do not overstir).

title: Microwave Sliced Baked Potatoes

ingredients.name: herb
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 Tbsp. chopped herbs (such as parsley, chives, thyme and sage) or 2 to 3 Tbsp. dried herbs of your choice

steps: Peel potatoes if skin is tough or just rinse and pat dry.
Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through.
Place potatoes in microwave dish.
Sprinkle with melted butter and herbs.
Microwave on High for 10 minutes; rearrange after 5 minutes.
Let rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Microwave for 4 to 6 minutes until potatoes are soft and cheese melted.
Sprinkle with salt.

title: Baked Pineapple(Side Dish For Ham)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Can be served with ham.

title: Mandarin Pork Chops With Wild Rice

ingredients.name: pork loin chop
ingredients.raw: 4 pork loin chops (3/4-inch thick; about 3/4 lb.)

ingredients.name: lipton grain and wild rice with sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Lipton long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe)

ingredients.name: mandarin orange segment in light syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can Mandarin orange segments in light syrup, drained (reserve 1/2 c. syrup)

steps: In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil and brown chops.
Add water, long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe), reserved syrup and green onions.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 13 minutes or until pork is done.
Stir in oranges; heat through.

title: Strombolis
steps: Brown meat, pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons oil with garlic. Add tomatoes.
Drain all liquid so mixture is very dry.
Flatten out crescent rolls into 1 sheet, mush seams together so there are no holes.
Place meat and vegetable mixture on one half and bring other side over.
Press edges together.
Cook 35 minutes at 350° until crust is golden brown.
Serves 2 adults and 1 to 2 children. Repeat recipe to make more Strombolis as needed.

title: Sauerkraut And Spareribs
steps: Rinse kraut and put in roaster.
Top kraut with onion slices and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Add water so it is almost to the top of the kraut in the pan.
Brown ribs in skillet and lay on top of kraut.
Mix in a large measuring cup ketchup and Worcestershire sauce, and then fill the cup with water so the mixture measures a total of 1 cup.
Mix and pour over ribs and kraut.
Put in oven for 2 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 6 oz.) can cherry pie filling or other prepared fruits

steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix with sugar.
Cut in butter; add beaten egg and mix to make crumbs.
Place 1/2 of crumbs in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Distribute cherries evenly and top with remaining crumbs.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes.
Serve with ice cream or other topping. Sprinkle crumbs lightly with cinnamon.

title: Garlic Buttered Green Beans

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh or frozen green beans

steps: Cook green beans in water, covered, until tender.
Meanwhile, in a skillet saute mushrooms in butter until tender.
Add onion powder and garlic powder.
Drain beans.
Add to skillet and toss. Season with salt and pepper.
Yield:
6 servings.

title: Mother'S Golden Potato Casserole
steps: Grate potatoes coarsely.
Add other ingredients, except last 2, mix thoroughly.
Press into casserole dish.
Top with mixture of bread crumbs and butter.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese And Apple Pancakes
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff. Combine all other ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Fold in egg whites.
Heat oil or melt butter in a skillet.
When it is hot enough to sizzle a drop of batter on contact, add spoonfuls of batter.
Fry on both sides until firm and lightly browned. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Easy Spaghetti
steps: Brown hamburger meat with onion and bell pepper.
Drain grease.
Add spaghetti and tomatoes.
Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Seafoam Salad
steps: Make jello with 1 cup of water; let cool.
Cream the cream cheese and add jello.
Add pineapple and nuts.
Fold in whipped cream.
Refrigerate.
(I use a ring mold.)
Serves 10 to 12.

title: White Greek Cookies
steps: Cream butter well, then add sugar gradually.
Add egg yolks and vanilla, continuing to mix.
Fold in almonds and whiskey.

Add flour and baking powder and mix by hand until dough is formed. Then make small shaped cookies (round balls, flat half moons). Bake at 350° for 20 minutes (almost light gold) on ungreased cookie sheet.
Cool cookies before sifting confectioners sugar on top and bottom.

title: Sandwich Spread
steps: Cut Spam and cheese in pieces.
Use food grinder with small attachments.
Grind all and add enough Miracle Whip to moisten well.
Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Cherry Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: green onion including top
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch green onions, including tops, chopped

steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain and crumble.
Combine bacon with tomatoes, cucumber and onions.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, sweet basil and pepper.
Mix well and chill.
Combine vinegar and salad oil; shake well.
Just before serving, pour over salad and toss.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Seedless Raisin Tarts
steps: Beat all ingredients together and fill unbaked tart shells. Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Makes about 15.
Bake at 350°.

title: Orange Blossom Cream
steps: Dissolve sugar in orange juice.
Whip evaporated milk until stiff.
Combine with juice; mix well.
Serve immediately.

title: Independent Dream Cake

ingredients.name: yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (2-layer) yellow or white cake mix

steps: Gradually add orange juice to confectioners sugar, blending well.
Makes 1/3 cup.

title: Peanut Logs
steps: Mix
well peanut butter, Rice Krispies, oleo and sugar. Melt chocolate chips and wax.
Roll by teaspoon size in hands. Keep your
fingers
wet
and
then
dip the logs in chocolate mixture. Put on wax paper.

title: Bread-N-Butter Pudding
steps: Butter glass baking dish.
Cut buttered bread into triangles; mix fruit with sugar.
Arrange buttered bread, fruit and sugar in layers in the dish.
Beat the eggs with the milk, then pour egg and milk mixture over the bread-butter-fruit and allow this to soak in for 15 to 20 minutes.
Then bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until custard is set and top is lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Bar Cookies
steps: Melt together corn syrup and white sugar.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Add 7 cups cereal (corn flakes, Rice Krispies, Cheerios, etc.).
Mix well.
Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cool and cut into squares.

title: Mexican White Corn

ingredients.name: white corn
ingredients.raw: 3 (12 oz.) cans white (Shoe Peg) corn or regular whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Melt the margarine and cream cheese over low heat.
Leave all liquid on chilies for spicier flavor.
Mix altogether.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Carrots A L'Orange

ingredients.name: carrot stick and
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. carrots, cut into sticks and cooked

steps: Mix cornstarch and sugar in small saucepan.
Pour in orange juice and mix well.
Heat, stirring until thickened.
Stir in butter and ginger.
Pour over cooked carrots.

title: Tomatoes With Mozzarella
steps: Layer slices of tomatoes and Mozzarella.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh basil, salt and freshly ground pepper.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Eggplant Supreme

ingredients.name: ricotta cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. Ricotta cheese (skim or whole milk)

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 2 boxes frozen spinach, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: or can tomato sauce with mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 jar or can tomato sauce with mushrooms

steps: Heat oven to 350°. Fry eggplant and drain on paper towels. Cook spinach according to directions and drain.
Mix Ricotta cheese and spincah, don't beat, just blend.
Spread evenly in pan. Layer eggplant on top.
Either slice or grate Mozzarella cheese and layer over eggplant.
Cover with sauce.
Sprinkle grated cheese. Give it a blessing and throw it in preheated oven for 45 minutes until bubbly.
Enjoy!

title: Mandarin And Pineapple Salad
steps: Drain juice and add to water to make 3 cups; boil.
Add Jell-O, fruit and cinnamon.
Let set, serves 8.

title: Cherries In Snow

ingredients.name: angel food cake in
ingredients.raw: 1 angel food cake, cut in cubes

steps: Soften cream cheese.
Mix in powdered sugar, vanilla and milk. Gently fold in Cool Whip.
In glass bowl, put some of the cake cubes.
Drizzle some of the Cool Whip mixture over cake.
Spoon pie filling over that.
Add another layer of cake, Cool Whip and cherries.
Keep making layers until all ingredients are used up, ending with cherries on top.
Store in refrigerator or make ahead of time and freeze.
This makes a lot!

title: Layered Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: refrigerated uncooked cheese tortellini
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. refrigerated uncooked cheese tortellini

steps: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water.
In large clear glass bowl with straight sides or 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer cabbage, spinach, tortellini, tomatoes and green onions.
Pour dressing evenly over top; sprinkle with bacon.
Cover; refrigerate until serving time. Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Lou'S Turkey Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in dish.
Cover with potato chips, crushed or uncrushed.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Great for after the holiday meals.

title: Chinese Country Ribs

ingredients.name: country style
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 lb. country style or spareribs

steps: Combine soy sauce, marmalade, catsup and garlic.
Brush both sides of ribs.
Place in crock-pot.
Pour in remaining sauce. Cover and cook on low, 8 to 10 hours.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pecan Crisp Treats
steps: Melt margarine for 1 minute in microwave.
Add sugar and microwave 2 more minutes.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Grease jelly roll cookie sheet.
Carefully break each cracker into 4 pieces and place side by side in a single layer on cookie sheet.
Drizzle pecan mixture over crackers.
(Do 1 pan at a time.)
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from pan while still warm.

title: Hamburger Pizza

ingredients.name: ground chuck brown and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained

steps: Prepare pizza dough according to package directions.
Mix together tomato paste and tomato sauce.
Add dash of oregano and dash of garlic salt. Spread sauce over unbaked pizza crust. Spread browned ground chuck over the sauce.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake on lowest rack for 10 minutes at 500° or
until golden brown.
Makes 1 pizza.

title: Mother'S Cornbread Dressing

ingredients.name: pan cornbread
ingredients.raw: large pan cornbread, crumbled (made with about 3 c. meal)

ingredients.name: white bread toasted and
ingredients.raw: 2 pieces white bread, toasted and crumbled

ingredients.name: broth from turkey
ingredients.raw: about 1 c. broth from small turkey

steps: Cook onion and celery in part of broth until tender, then puree.
Crumble cornbread and toasted bread.
Mix with rice, pureed onion mixture and enough broth to make a fairly soupy mixture.
Heat bacon grease in shallow baking pan and add dressing mixture and bake at 400° until brown on top and crusty on edges.

title: Persimmon Marmalade
steps: Cut, core and mash fruit.
Add other ingredients and cook until thick. Pour into jars and process 10 minutes in boiling water bath.
Makes 6 (1/2-pint) jars.

title: Crispy Chocolate Log
steps: Line a 15 x 10 x 2-inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper; grease the paper and set aside.
In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine marshmallows, butter and peanut butter.
Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes; stir until well blended.
Stir in cereal until well coated.
Spread into prepared pan.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate and butterscotch chips. Microwave, uncovered, on High for 2 minutes.
Stir; spread over cereal to within 1-inch of edges.
Roll up jelly roll style, starting with a short side, peeling away waxed paper while rolling.
Place, seam side down, on a serving plate.
Refrigerate for 1 hour or until set.
Cut into 1-inch slices.
Makes 10 servings.

title: Shakertown Corn Pudding
steps: In a large bowl, blend butter, sugar, flour and salt.
Add the eggs and beat well with a rotary beater or mixer on low.
Stir in the corn and milk.
(If using frozen corn, chop it up a little first to release the milky juices.)

title: Chicken Continental

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 boneless chicken breasts, cut in strips

ingredients.name: bird eye bavarian style bean and spaetzle
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Birds Eye Bavarian style beans and spaetzle

steps: Saute chicken in oil.
Sprinkle with salt; add vegetables and broth.
Bring to full boil over medium heat.
Separate vegetables with fork, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes.
Combine sour cream, flour, and paprika.
Stir into vegetables and heat gently.

title: Heath Bars
steps: Line crackers on bottom of cookie sheet.
Boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes.
Pour sugar and butter mixture over crackers.
Bake 4 minutes at 375°.
Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Let melt.
Spread with butter knife.
Put in refrigerator for about 10 minutes.
Remove and cut into squares.
Return to refrigerator.
Sprinkle nuts on top, if you desire.

title: Cucumber Pickle Relish

ingredients.name: coarsely cucumber with skin on
ingredients.raw: 7 c. coarsely grated cucumbers with skins on (any size except real large ones)

steps: Mix by hand and put in jars.
Makes 2 quarts.
Cover with lids (not sealed) and tighten and then loosen a little.
Pickles will work a little so it needs a little "working" space!
Refrigerate. Will keep up to a year.

title: Meat, Potato, Egg Scramble
steps: Cook hash browns according to directions.
Beat desired amount of eggs with 2 teaspoons water, then pour over potatoes.
Cook eggs, turning 1 to 3 times.
When eggs are done, put cheese on top.
Cover pan to melt cheese.
Cook in 12 x 14-inch skillet. Five eggs will serve 4 people, 4 to 6 ounce portions.

title: Cracked Wheat Cereal(Diabetic Approved)
steps: Toast cracked wheat and coconut by stirring constantly in a dry pan over medium heat for several minutes, until lightly browned.
Place in a saucepan andd remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped nut, if desired.

title: Brown Sugar Squares

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 large bag chocolate chips or 1 (7 oz.) pkg.

steps: Mix thoroughly and bake 16 to 20 minutes at 375° in a 10 x 14-inch pan.
When cool, cut into squares.

title: Tender Roast

ingredients.name: or lb. roast
ingredients.raw: 2 or 3 lb. roast or 6 pork chops

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of celery soup

steps: Spray pan with Pam.
Slice onion in bottom of pan.
Wash; salt and pepper the roast.
Lay roast on onion in pan.
Cover roast with the undiluted soup.
Cover pan with aluminum foil.
Cook in a 300° oven for 3 hours.
This will make its own gravy.

title: Pear Butter

ingredients.name: pear and cored
ingredients.raw: 10 large ripe pears (5 lb.), quartered and cored

steps: Combine pears and water in a large Dutch oven.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat 40 minutes or until pears are soft, stirring occasionally.
Drain.
Press pears through a sieve or food mill; measure 1 quart of puree.
Combine 1 quart puree with remaining ingredients in a Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, 15 minutes or until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat; skim off foam.
Quickly pour hot pear mixture into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims.
Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands.
Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes.
Yield:
2 pints.

title: Julienne Of Beets And Carrots Or Carrots And Parsnips

ingredients.name: beet and carrot
ingredients.raw: beets and carrots or carrots and parsnips

steps: Cook beets.
Slip off skins and julienne.
Julienne carrots or parsnips. Cook to desired tenderness.
Melt butter and add to it a little orange juice.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels

ingredients.name: mozzarella and cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 5 oz. shredded Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese (half and half)

ingredients.name: refrigerated pillsbury crescent roll
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. refrigerated Pillsbury crescent rolls

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small bowl, blend pepperoni, cheeses, oregano and egg.
Roll apart crescent rolls into 8 rectangles (press perforations to seal).
Spread mixture on each rectangle, making sure to cover to the edges.
Starting at shorter side, roll up and seal.
Cut each roll into 6 pieces.

title: Tank'S Taco Grande(Mom Or Dad Will Help With Hard Parts.)

ingredients.name: ground turkey
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground turkey or ground beef

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Spray Pam on bottom and sides of 9 x 13 baking dish. Cook turkey or beef until no longer pink, breaking up chunks to small crumbs. Add taco mix and water (see mix directions). Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of salsa.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
steps: Combine first 2 ingredients in a 2 x 8 x 12-inch dish, mixing well.
Layer with remaining ingredients in order listed.
Serve with Tostitos.

title: Columbus Cooler Punch
steps: Mix all juices except 7-Up or ginger ale.
Add just before serving.

title: Squash Carrot Casserole
steps: Cook squash according to directions on the package; drain. Sliver raw carrots on coarse side of grader.
Mix squash, carrots, pimentos, sour cream and undiluted soup in saucepan.
In separate bowl mix herb stuffing and margarine.
Line baking dish with half of herb stuffing mixture.
Pour in squash mixture and top with remaining half of herb stuffing mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Microwaved Bread Pudding
steps: In a 2-cup casserole, slightly beat eggs.
Add sugar and blend.
Pour in milk and blend with salt and cinnamon.
Add raisins and bread cubes.
Dot with butter.

title: 12-Hour Cole Slaw

ingredients.name: onion and separated
ingredients.raw: 2 large onions, sliced thin and separated

ingredients.name: green pepper and
ingredients.raw: 1 green pepper, quartered and sliced thin

steps: Layer half of cabbage, onions and green pepper.
Sprinkle half of sugar over vegetables.
Repeat.
Let stand while making dressing.

title: Cranberry Fluff
steps: Grind cranberries in blender.
Add marshmallows and sugar. Chill, covered, overnight.
Add grapes, apples, walnuts and salt. Fold in chilled, whipped cream.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Summer Succotash

ingredients.name: corn from cob
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. fresh corn, cut from cob

steps: Cook corn and lima beans in a small amount of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender; drain and set aside.
Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon and set aside.
Saute chopped onion in bacon drippings until onion is tender; remove onion and set aside. Add flour to bacon drippings, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add tomatoes and rest of ingredients.
Heat through.

title: Grasshopper Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine first 4 ingredients and beat until stiff.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on foil-covered cookie sheets.
Turn oven off and leave cookies in oven overnight.
Store in tins between wax paper.
May be frozen.

title: Nut Cups
steps: Mix flour, margarine and cream cheese and refrigerate.
Mix brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, salt and margarine.
Cook over low heat.
Watch closely as it burns easily.
Add walnuts.
Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick.
Cut with a scalloped cookie cutter.
Press into 1-inch muffin tin.
Drop 1 teaspoon of filling into each cup about 3/4 full.
They will swell.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Avoid overbrowning.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce For Pasta Or Pizza Crust, Etc.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add onion and garlic.
Saute 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients.
Stir well and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 10 minutes or until reduced to 4 cups.
Keep in freezer for quick pasta dishes.

title: Chicken Nest
steps: Arrange pasta in skillet.
Top with chicken (undrained), frozen peas, carrots and sliced onion.
Pour on broth.
Sprinkle with tarragon.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gail'S Quiche Lorraine
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust.
Cook in 375° oven for about 1 hour.

title: Mama'S Bread Pudding
steps: Scald milk with margarine.
Add with all remaining ingredients to bread and stir lightly.
Bake at 350° until firm.

title: Lemonade Stand Pie

ingredients.name: concentrated lemonade
ingredients.raw: 1 can (6 oz.) frozen concentrated lemonade or pink lemonade, partially thawed

ingredients.name: breyer vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (1 pt.) Breyers vanilla ice cream, softened

ingredients.name: thawed cool whip non dairy whipped
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 c. thawed Cool Whip non-dairy whipped topping

ingredients.name: prepared graham cracker crumb crust
ingredients.raw: 1 prepared graham cracker crumb crust (6 oz.)

steps: Beat lemonade concentrate in large bowl about 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in ice cream, blending well.
Gently stir whipped topping until smooth.
Freeze, if necessary, until mixture will mound.
Spoon into crust.
Freeze at least 4 hours or until firm. Let stand at room temperature or in refrigerator about 30 minutes or until pie can be easily cut.
Garnish with strawberries.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Hamburger Stuffed Bread
steps: Cut off top of loaf of bread and hollow out, forming a crust shell.
Tear enough bread for 2 cups; set aside.
Brown beef and oil; add green pepper, Worcestershire sauce and cheese soup. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in bread crumbs.
Fill in bread crust. Place American cheese slices diagonally on top.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Ruth'S Crab Pie
steps: Mix cream cheese with 1/2 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce and a little lemon juice.
Spread in bottom of pie plate.
Pick shells from large can of backfin crabmeat.
Spread over cream cheese. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Mix Heinz chili sauce, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire, horseradish and lemon juice and pour over crab. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Rolls With Gold Medal Flour
steps: Mix
all with flour.
May have to add a little more flour but make a soft dough.
Knead real good.
Put in a greased bowl.
Let rise until double in bulk, about
1 hour.
Work down and make into rolls.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Applesauce Jello Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. strawberry or raspberry jello

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries or raspberries

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sour cream or Cool Whip

steps: Add cup of boiling water to package of jello.
Mix until dissolved.
Add package of frozen berries; stir until thawed.
Add the applesauce and stir well.
Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Chill in refrigerator until set.
For the topping, fold in 1 cup of marshmallows into 1 cup of sour cream or Cool Whip and spread over the set jello.

title: Pasta Alfredo

ingredients.name: noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. noodles or fettuccini (cooked as directed on pkg.)

ingredients.name: parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. grated Parmesan cheese or more

steps: Heat butter and cream.
Do not boil.
Mound pasta in warm buttered bowl and pour on cream; sprinkle generously with cheese and toss thoroughly but lightly.
Season to taste.

title: Egg Dumplings
steps: Sift and measure the flour.
Cut the butter into the flour. Break the egg into a measuring cup, then add enough water to come up to the 3/4 cup line.
Add to the flour; mix lightly with a fork. Drop by tablespoonfuls over boiling meat and broth or into well-greased steamer placed over boiling water.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are tender.

title: Lime Salad Chiffon With Graham Crackers
steps: Make the crust with butter and cracker crumbs.
Put into an 8-inch square pan.
Chill.

title: Toffee Candy
steps: Cook butter and sugar on medium heat, stirring frequently, until temperature reaches 290° on candy thermometer.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet with sides.
Spread out.

title: Paintbrush Cookies
steps: Give each child 3 large marshmallows and toothpick.
Instruct to insert toothpick and to align marshmallows.
Decorate snowmen with raisins, fruit slices and cereal pieces.
Eat as snack.

title: Baked Beans With Green Pepper And Carrots
steps: Wash beans, cover with water and cook until soft.
Drain, not too dry.
Add salt and bacon drippings.
Mix in baking dish the beans, brown sugar, onions, green pepper and grated carrots.
Add catsup.
Bake in 325° oven for one hour or until as dry as desired.

title: Cabbage Goulash

ingredients.name: tomato with liquid reserved
ingredients.raw: 1 (28 oz.) can tomatoes, chopped with liquid reserved

steps: In a large kettle, brown sausage, beef and onion.
Drain off any fat.
Add remaining ingredients, except cabbage; mix well. Stir in cabbage and simmer, 15 to 20 minutes or until cabbage is tender.
Serves 8.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
steps: Add sugar and water to cherries.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over jello and stir until dissolved.
Place in refrigerator until cool. Remove and add Coke, pineapple and nuts.
Refrigerate until set.

title: Unleavened Communion Bread
steps: Mix flour, Crisco, salt and sugar until like coarse cornmeal. Add cold water.
Roll as for pie dough, approximately 1/8-inch thick onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Prick with a fork.
Cut into bite size pieces (1/4-inch squares) with a knife before baking.
Bake in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until very light brown.

title: Dipsy Devil Dip

ingredients.name: cream cheese with pimiento
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jar cream cheese with pimiento (or add pimientos)

steps: Combine all ingredients, except vegetables.
Beat until creamy.
Makes about 1 cup.
Use as a vegetable dip.

title: Chipped Chopped Ham Spread
steps: In a big bowl mix all ingredients together, except semi-hard rolls, and let stand overnight in refrigerator.
Next day cut the rolls in half, on one side smear a little amount of butter and put on spread.
Close the roll with the other half and mount in aluminum foil.
Heat oven to 350°F and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. If you do not use up all the rolls at once, the rest mounted in aluminum foil can be stored in refrigerator for 2 days.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients into balls.
Brown in butter at 250° in electric frypan or regular pan on medium high heat.
Melt catsup and currant jelly in frypan.
Simmer meat balls and sauce together for 30 minutes.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes With Apricots

ingredients.name: apricot reserve liquid
ingredients.raw: 1 can drained cooked apricots - reserve liquid

steps: Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Cut sweet potatoes into thick slices.
Arrange 1 layer in 10x6x2 greased baking dish.
Cover with layer of apricots sprinkled with some brown sugar.
Repeat layers.
Combine butter,
reserved apricot liquid and orange rind. Pour over layers.
Bake uncovered 45 minutes - basting once or twice with liquid from bottom of dish.
Top with nuts during last 5 minutes.

title: Bread Machine Buttermilk Wheat Bread
steps: In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order given. Select "white bread" setting.
Bake according to bread machine directions.
Makes 1 medium loaf (16 slices).

title: Sweet Sour Green Beans
steps: Cook beans until crisp and tender (6 to 8 minutes). Drain. Plunge into ice water; drain.
Set aside. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Keep 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.
Stir in flour. Cook until bubbly.
Stir in water, vinegar and sugar. Heat to boiling and slightly thickened.
Add beans and toss occasionally. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and bacon.

title: Green Chili Corn Bread
steps: Mix meal, eggs, oil and milk.
Add other ingredients and stir. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
Bread is done when inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Quick Mix Pepperoni Batter Bread

ingredients.name: sharp
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. grated sharp or Cheddar cheese

steps: Set aside 1 cup flour.
Mix together remaining ingredients, including yeast, in a large bowl.
Stir in margarine and water into dry mixture.
Mix in only enough flour to make very thick batter. Cover; let rest 10 minutes.
Turn batter into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover.
Let rise in warm draft-free place until double in size, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Check for doneness.
Remove and cool on wire rack.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce

ingredients.name: or ginger
ingredients.raw: 1 piece fresh or dried grated ginger (1 1/2-inches long)

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Good on spareribs or chicken.

title: Spiced Pecans
steps: In a bowl, beat egg white and water until frothy, not stiff. Add pecans and mix until nuts are covered.
Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in
a small bowl and pour over pecans. Stir well with wooden spoon until pecans are coated.

title: Escalloped Potatoes With Ham

ingredients.name: ham in
ingredients.raw: large ham pieces, cut in chunks

steps: Boil potatoes with skin on.
Peel and slice into baking dish. Add ham and mushroom soup.
Bake in oven at 325° for 30 minutes. Quick and good!

title: Roast & Gravy
steps: Cook roast and spices until tender.
Drain & slice.
Add gravy and onion soup mix.
Simmer 2 hours until done.

title: Dorito Casserole
steps: Cook hamburger, salt and onion.
Layer baking dish with Doritos.
Put meat mixture on top of Doritos.
Mix soups and Ro-Tel and pour mixture over meat.
Bake at 350° until it bubbles. Remove from oven and top with grated cheese.
Return to oven until cheese melts.
Sprinkle with crumbled Doritos.

title: Scrambled Egg Bake

ingredients.name: mild
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. mild or sharp Cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes

steps: In a large mixing bowl with a wire whisk or fork, beat eggs until frothy.
Stir in milk; mix well.
Add cheese.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves immediately.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift flour, soda and cocoa and add alternately with buttermilk and flavoring.
Bake in 4 nine-inch greased and floured cake pans at 325° for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Judy'S Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Sprinkle more nuts on top.
Bake at 350°
for 35 minutes.
Makes 2 pies.

title: Spiced Apple Cider

ingredients.name: clove
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. whole cloves or 1/2 tsp. ground

ingredients.name: allspice
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. whole allspice or 1/2 tsp. ground

steps: Pour brandy
and
cider into large coffee pot.	Combine remaining
ingredients
and
pour
into the percolator basket. Perk until done.
Makes 9 to 10 cups of cider.

title: Creamy Orange Glaze
steps: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Pour over hot cake.

title: Vodka Slushes

ingredients.name: tea bag in c. boiling water
ingredients.raw: 2 tea bags in 3 c. boiling water

steps: Combine all ingredients and mix.
Let set in freezer for at least 24 hours.
Stir occasionally.
Serve with 7-Up.

title: Soft Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.
Blend in flour, baking soda and baking powder.
Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost or sprinkle with sugar just before you put in oven.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups(Old Recipe)
steps: Mix chicken with 1 1/4 cups cheese.
Put mixture in center of each roll and "roll up".
Lay rolls in 9 x 13-inch pans.
Heat soup, milk and 3/4 cup cheese until cheese melts.
Pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.

title: Crab Cakes Canton
steps: Combine crab meat, bread crumbs, garlic and ginger in bowl. Mix well.
Add egg white and teriyaki sauce; mix well.
Shape into patties, about 1/2-inch thick and 2-inch in diameter.
Heat 1 teaspoon oil into large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot.
Add crab cakes to hot oil.
Cook 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Easy Bake Cheese Omelet
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside.
Slightly beat egg yolks.
Add 1/2 cup of the Cheddar cheese soup.
Mix well. Fold yolk mixture into white mixture.
Spread in an ungreased 8 1/2-inch round baking dish. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffy and golden brown.

title: Damson Pie

ingredients.name: fruit heat a little bit
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chopped fruit, heat a little bit

steps: Put all together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° about 45 minutes, until crust is pretty and brown and pie does not jiggle (firm).
Good with Cool Whip on top.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Cabbage

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cabbage, cut into small wedges

steps: Cook cabbage in small amount of water until tender; drain well.
Melt butter over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly.
Stir in spices.

title: Mississippi Pound Cake

ingredients.name: each almond coconut and rum extract
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each: almond, coconut and rum extract

steps: Cream butter and shortening.
Gradually add sugar.
Blend in about 1/2 of the flour and all baking powder.
Stir in milks and extracts.
Then blend in remaining flour.
Beat a short while until fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Grease and flour Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Let sit in Bundt pan 10 minutes, then turn over on cake plate.
When cool,
sprinkle powdered sugar lightly.
Then add fresh fruit to the plate.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
steps: Lightly spray 9 x 3-inch spring-form pan with vegetable cooking spray.
Line bottom of pan with ladyfinger halves, split sides up.
Cut 10 to 12 additional ladyfinger halves in half.
Use to line side of pan, allowing cut ends to rest on ladyfingers in bottom of pan.
Set aside on baking sheet.

title: Liver Pate
steps: Saute liver in butter.
Mash and simmer.
Add onion and spices.
Simmer 2 more minutes.
Whip until smooth.
Serve with crackers.

title: Baked Scallop Casserole
steps: Place rinsed scallops in a greased casserole dish. Pour milk over scallops and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes.
Add Ritz crumbs to melted butter and mix well.
When scallops are finished baking, remove from oven and spread crumb mixture evenly over scallops.
Place under broiler just until golden brown.

title: Pineapple Stuffing
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add bread, pineapple and oranges. In separate bowl, beat eggs and add to mixture.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Lentil Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and simmer 1 hour or until lentils are tender (1/2 hour in pressure cooker).
Take out ham bone.
Strip off bits of meat and return to soup.
Remove bay leaf.
Serve with 2 tablespoons vinegar on top.
Croutons may also be served with soup.
Serves 8.

title: Chiffon Pie
steps: Mix eggs, sugar and pineapple juice until smooth; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add Jell-O, then let cool completely. Whip milk which has been refrigerated overnight.
Add lemon juice. Fold cooled Jell-O mixture into whipped milk, blending well. Place mixture into 2 prepared crusts.
Refrigerate and then serve.

title: Castle Hamburgers

ingredients.name: strained beef
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) jar strained beef or veal baby food

steps: Mix and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Make into patties and fry. Put holes in burgers to cook evenly.

title: Black Bean And Rice Soup
steps: Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth.
Pour into large saucepan.
Stir in water, oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil.
Stir in rice.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Serve with chopped onions if desired.

title: Stewed Pears
steps: Pare and core pears.
Place in cold water until ready to use. Make syrup.
Add fruit, cored side down.
Boil gently until soft. Add lemon juice before done.

title: Cranberry Oatmeal Square
steps: Mix 2nd mixture well and put half into a 7 x 11-inch pan; press firmly.
Pour in cranberry mixture and cool with remaining dry mixture.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut into squares.

title: Snack Bars

ingredients.name: marshmallow
ingredients.raw: 2 bags (one 16 oz., one 10 oz.) large marshmallows

ingredients.name: chocolate chip mini m m s
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. chocolate chips, mini M&M's or raisins (optional)

steps: In a very large bowl, combine the first five ingredients.
In a saucepan over low heat, cook and stir marshmallows and butter until marshmallows are melted.
Add honey and mix well.
Pour over cereal mixture; mix well.
Add chips, M&M's or raisins if desired. Pat two-thirds into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan and the remaining third into a 9-inch square pan.
Cool.
Yield:
4 to 5 dozen.

title: Blueberry Streusel Cobbler

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. cold margarine
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp. cold margarine or butter

steps: In bowl, combine berries, sweetened condensed milk and rind. In large bowl, cut 3/4 cup margarine into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly.
Add berry mixture.
Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan.
In bowl, combine 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in 2 tablespoons margarine until crumbly.
Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden.
Serve warm with ice cream and Blueberry Sauce.

title: Rice And Chicken Almondine
steps: Saute almonds and onion in butter for 10 minutes.
Stir in flour.
Add bouillon and cream, stirring until thickened.
Add chicken and remaining ingredients.
Pour into casserole.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Cook Frosting
steps: Cook until thick the flour and milk.
Cream the butter, granulated sugar and vanilla.
Add both mixtures together and beat for 16 minutes.
Frost cake and refrigerate.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
steps: Combine all dry ingredients.
Make a well in center.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir until moist.
Spoon into greased muffin pan, filling 1/2 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie 3
steps: Cream the butter and sugar together thoroughly. Add the eggs, syrup and salt.
Mix well.
Add the vanilla and pecans.
Pour into the pie pan lined with pastry. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350° until firm.

title: Tapioca
steps: Soak tapioca overnight in water.
Stir in 2 cups whipped topping and some nut meats.
Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Cabbage Surprise
steps: Place all ingredients in large pot.
Cover with water and bring to boil.
Boil 10 minutes, then simmer until soft.
Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Apple Cinnamon Baked French Toast
steps: Slice bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with oil and arrange bread slices tightly together.
Mix eggs, milk, 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla.
Pour half of mixture over bread. Arrange sliced apples on top and pour balance of egg mixture over top.
Take remaining 1/2 cup of sugar and mix it with the cinnamon and nutmeg.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with hot syrup.

title: Quick Cabbage Casserole
steps: Slice cabbage, cook 10 minutes in salt water.
Drain.
Mix soup, milk, cabbage and cheese.
Pour into casserole.
Top with crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes in 350 degree oven.

title: Texas-Style Beans And Rice

ingredients.name: or can baked bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 to 18 oz.) jar or can baked beans

ingredients.name: or slivered red
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. diced or slivered red or sweet white onion

steps: Combine beans, tomatoes, picante sauce, beer and brown sugar in large saucepan.
Simmer uncovered 20 minutes.
Stir in rice and salt; heat through.
Sprinkle with onion and cilantro.

title: Amaretto
steps: Bring brown sugar and water to a boil.
Let syrup cool.
Mix almond extract and vodka to syrup.
Shake well.
Let stand for 3 days.

title: Christmas Candy

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: red and green cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. red and green cherries, finely chopped

steps: With hands thoroughly mix above ingredients.
Shape into small balls.
Place on wax paper and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Tamale Pie
steps: Brown ground meat; drain fat.
Stir in tomato sauce, beans and seasoning.
Prepare muffin mix according to the package directions.
Spread muffin mix batter over chili mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Bake 5 minutes more or until cheese melts.
Serves 6.

title: Grandma Stoddard'S Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Stir sugar, oleo and milk together in pan.
Boil to soft ball stage (about 5 minutes).
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter; stir well.
Add vanilla.
Pour into a greased pan.
Allow 30 minutes to cool.

title: Green Beans And Corn Casserole
steps: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish; combine butter and cracker crumbs and press one-half of mixture into the bottom of the casserole dish.
Layer remaining ingredients in dish twice; top with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until it bubbles.

title: Salted Pecans
steps: Coat pecans with melted margarine; sprinkle with salt.
Bake 20 minutes at 275°.
Cool on paper towels.

title: Party Fizz
steps: Pour the orange juice into a bowl, then the pineapple juice and club soda.
Add the sherbet and mix everything with an egg beater.
Pour the fizz into glasses.

title: Peanut Butter Health Bread
steps: In medium bowl, stir flour, oats, baking powder, and salt.
In large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat peanut butter and sugar until smooth.
Beat in egg.
Gradually add milk.
With mixer on low, beat in dry ingredients until smooth.
Stir in raisins.

title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: In an electric skillet, combine sugar, butter and milk.
Set the heat control at 280°.
Bring to full boil and boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly.
Turn off heat.
Add marshmallows, peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir until melted.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
Makes 2 pounds.

title: Gooey Buns
steps: Grind bologna and cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Butter 6 buns. Fill and wrap individually in tinfoil. Bake in a 325° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Wayne'S Hush Puppies(For Large Gatherings)

ingredients.name: aunt jemima self raisin white corn meal
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 lb. Aunt Jemima self-rising white corn meal

steps: Mix all ingredients well; drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Submerge, if possible, until brown.
Enjoy!

title: Beginner'S Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour and salt together in bowl.
Cut in shortening with fork until mixture looks like corn meal.
Add water a little at a time.
Let set a few minutes.
Knead on floured surface and shape into pie shell.

title: Spinach Polenta Casserole
steps: Saute garlic in oil until crisp.
Remove and add the spinach and salt and pepper to taste.
Steam until limp.
Remove from pan and squeeze dry when cool.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
steps: Cream butter and cream cheese together.
Slowly add sugar, beating until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolk.
Add flour and vanilla and mix well.
Chill dough at least 1 hour.
Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Gently press a cherry half or pecan half into each cookie.
Bake at 350° until bottom of cookies start to brown, 6 to 10 minutes.
Do not overbake.

title: Caramel Frosting
steps: Place all ingredients in cooker.
Bring to a boil; turn down. When it forms a soft ball in cold water, take off stove.
Let cool, then mix with a mixer.

title: Church Windows Candies

ingredients.name: nut
ingredients.raw: 1 can chopped nuts (1 c. or less; optional)

steps: Melt margarine and chocolate chips.
Let cool slightly.
Add nuts and marshmallows.
Spread coconut on wax paper.
Divide mixture into four rolls.
Roll in coconut.
Wrap in wax paper. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours before slicing.
Cut in 1/2-inch thick slices.

title: Corn Custard
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir in eggs.
Scald milk and 2 tablespoons butter; add to corn mixture.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Mix crumbs in 1 tablespoon butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake until browned.

title: Aunt Jo'S Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Mix and boil sugar, brown sugar, salt and milk for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients and beat thoroughly. Immediately place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate until cool.

title: Hungarian Rhapsody

ingredients.name: breast of turkey cutlet flattened
ingredients.raw: 8 breast of turkey cutlets (about 1 lb.), flattened

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic, minced finely or put through garlic press

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.
Over high heat, brown the cutlets briefly on both sides; do not overcook.
Reserve browned cutlets on a warmed platter.
In the same skillet over medium heat, saute chopped onion and garlic in the remaining olive oil until lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in paprika and cook 2 minutes longer.
Blend in sour cream until just heated through.
Do not allow the mixture to boil!
Season with salt and pepper.
Remove from
heat.
Spoon the sauce over the cutlets; serve with boiled rice.

title: Microwave Taco Chops
steps: Combine taco mix with cornflake crumbs.
Dip one side of each chop into egg and then into crumb mixture.
Reserve remaining egg and crumbs.
Place crumb side up into 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or large pie plate, placing meaty ends of chops toward outside of dish.
Microwave uncovered on High for 5 minutes, turning dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes.
Turn chops over; top with remaining egg and crumbs.
Dissolve bouillon cube in water on High for 30 seconds. Stir.
Pour around (not over) chops.
Cover with plastic wrap; microwave for 6 minutes on High, rotating dish once.
Let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Use pan drippings for gravy, if desired. Serves 4.
Simply delicious!

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
steps: Beat all together with mixer.
Makes one 9-inch pie.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Chili
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Fruit Pie

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: chopped fruit (apples, bananas or other fresh fruit)

steps: Roll out biscuits.
Fill with fruit and seal edges like fried pies.
Place in single layer in casserole dish.
Pour liquid mixture over pies.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 350° until done.

title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
steps: You will also need measuring cups and spoons, a bowl, an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan and an oven.
Preheat oven to 350°, then smear the inside of the pan with shortening.

title: Banana Burrito
steps: Lay tortilla on flat surface; spread evenly with peanut butter and raspberry spread.
Sprinkle with coconut, if desired.
Place banana on edge of tortilla; roll up to enclose.
Wrap loosely in paper towel.
Microwave on High for 35 seconds.

title: Football Popcorn
steps: Melt oleo in a saucepan.
Stir in brown sugar.
Simmer until syrup forms.
Immediately pour over already popped popcorn.
Stir well.

title: Breakfast Bake
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Combine all ingredients.
Pour into two 9-inch pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Ham can be substituted for sausage.

title: Plain Jane Cake

ingredients.name: your choice flavoring
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. your choice flavoring (may be 2 different flavors)

steps: Mix butter, Crisco and sugar together until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, until they are mixed in well.
Gradually add milk and flour.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Nadine Krall'S Pork Chops And Rice
steps: Brown chops in frypan.
Pour onion soup mix and enough water over chops to keep chops covered.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
Add Minute rice and simmer.
For two people, use 1/2 cup rice.

title: Creamy Reception Punch
steps: Spoon vanilla ice cream by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Add juices, stirring to muddle ice cream.
Slowly pour in 7-Up or Sprite. Stir to mix.

title: "Green Stuff" Salad

ingredients.name: pear juice
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. pear juice (use juice from can of pears)

steps: Heat pear juice to boiling.
Pour over jello and dissolve. While hot, pour jello over cream cheese.
Mix well with mixer until blended.
Place mixture in refrigerator or freezer until it starts to set.
Add whipped cream with mixer until well blended. Add nuts and pears; pour into serving bowl.
Chill until firm.

title: Hot Cranberry Cider

ingredients.name: apple cider
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. apple cider or apple juice

steps: In large saucepan combine ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Remove spices.
Serve warm.

title: Peppers 'N Potatoes

ingredients.name: each julienne red and green pepper and onion
ingredients.raw: 1 c. each julienne cut red and green peppers and diced onions

ingredients.name: instant chicken broth and seasoning mix
ingredients.raw: 2 packets instant chicken broth and seasoning mix

ingredients.name: scrubbed red potato
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. scrubbed red potatoes, thinly sliced

steps: In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine until bubbly; add bell peppers, onions and garlic.
Saute until vegetables are softened.
Stir in water, broth mix and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.
Add potatoes, cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender.
(Add more water if necessary to prevent sticking.)

title: Supreme Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: escort
ingredients.raw: 1 box Escort or 1 roll Ritz crackers

steps: Cook chicken until tender.
Chop in bite-size pieces.
Slice water chestnuts.
Crush crackers.
Sprinkle 1/2 crackers in bottom of baking dish.
Mix chicken soup, water chestnuts, sour cream and onions together.
Pour in baking dish.
Top with remaining crumbs and sprinkle butter over crackers.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Muffins
steps: Cook sausage and drain well.
Mix flour, corn meal, egg, milk and oil.
Add sausage.
Place in greased muffin pan and bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mustard Potato Salad

ingredients.name: red potato boiled and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. small red potatoes, boiled and thinly sliced

steps: Cool potatoes completely. To make mustard dressing, in a large serving bowl, combine white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard and salt. Whisk in olive oil until well blended.
Add sliced red potatoes, scallions and roasted red peppers.
Toss to coat well with mustard-oil dressing.

title: Caramel-Peanut Pie
steps: Place
cup
sugar in heavy skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts and forms a light brown syrup.
Reduce heat to low;
gradually add boiling water in
a slow
stream,
stirring
constantly
with a wire whisk. Remove from heat.

title: Christmas Wreath
steps: Melt butter and marshmallows.
Allow to melt gradually over low heat.
Stir until creamy.
Add food coloring; mix good.
Add corn flakes.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Press hole in middle to form a wreath shape.
Press cinnamon candy on to appear as berries.
Allow to harden.
Place layers of wax paper between layers of wreath.

title: Good Homemade Ice Cream
steps: Beat sugar, Pet milk and egg yolks until sugar is dissolved. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in with vanilla.
Pour in freezer.
If not enough to fill to line, fill with milk.
Any fruit you desire can be added to this.

title: Homemade White Bread
steps: Heat 4 cups water to 110°; use 3/4 cup of the water and dissolve yeast and 3/4 teaspoon regular sugar.
Stir in flour, Sweet 'N Low, salt, pepper and Crisco.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
steps: Combine ingredients.
Microwave until melted. Serve with corn chips.

title: Bacon-N-Eggs
steps: Cut hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks.
Mix with mayonnaise, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon.
Put mixture back into eggs and serve.
Kids love them.
Serve for breakfast with toast.

title: New England Blueberry Muffins

ingredients.name: blueberry
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 c. fresh or frozen drained blueberries

steps: Beat together the sugar and butter.
Add eggs and milk.
Add dry ingredients and beat for 1 minute.
Fold in blueberries.

title: Celery Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook celery in small amount of salt water until tender, but crisp.
Drain; add remaining ingredients except crumbs.
Put in shallow 2-quart dish; sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Sweet Potato Surprise
steps: Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
Drain and cool.
Peel the potatoes and mash. Combine mashed sweet potatoes, frosting, vanilla and cinnamon; mix well. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 18 minutes.
Sprinkle with marshmallows. Continue baking 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sauce For Ribs Or Burgers
steps: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
The sauce can then be sealed in a jar and stored in the refrigerator or used at once.
Yield:
Enough sauce for three chickens, halved, or for 5 to 6 pounds of ribs.

title: Chicken And Biscuit Dinner

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. chopped, cooked chicken or turkey

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) jar chicken or turkey gravy

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 c. frozen green beans or peas

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each biscuit into half.
In saucepan, put chicken or turkey, gravy, beans, seasoning and pepper.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups.
Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden.
This is a fun recipe for kids to do.

title: Scotch Shortbread
steps: Sift flour, measure, add salt and sift again.
Cream butter, gradually add confectioners sugar and beat until light.
Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture.
Blend thoroughly.
Put dough in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut in squares before completely cool.

title: Diabetic Maple Flavored Pancake Syrup

ingredients.name: equal
ingredients.raw: 6 pkg. Equal or 1 3/4 tsp. equal measure

steps: In small saucepan, combine apple juice and cornstarch.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, Equal, maple flavoring and vanilla.
Serve over pancakes, waffles or French toast.
Makes 1 cup.

title: Corinne'S Famous Pea Salad
steps: Place 1/2 head of lettuce on bottom of bowl.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and sugar.
Layer eggs atop lettuce in bowl.
Add more salt.
Layer as follows:
Peas, remaining lettuce, bacon and Swiss cheese.
Spread mayonnaise over top, sealing to edge of bowl.
Cover and chill 24 hours.
Toss before serving.

title: Strawberry Surprise
steps: Cook cake according to directions on package.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put glaze on top of cake (cooled).
Place cut strawberries on top and top with Cool Whip.
Chill.

title: Sausage-Peach Breakfast Bake

ingredients.name: brown and sausage link such as little sizzlers.
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. pkg. brown and serve sausage links such as Little Sizzlers.

steps: Drain peaches and reserve liquid.
Cut sausage links crosswise into bite-size pieces.
Prepare pancake mix as usual, except use up to 1 c. of peach liquid as part of the mixture.
Turn into a 9 x 13 baking dish and arrange peaches and sausage on top.
Bake 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with syrup.

title: Spiders

ingredients.name: nestle semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) bag Nestle semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: Melt chips and then add peanuts and chow mein noodles.
Spoon onto wax paper.
Chill.

title: Josette'S Lasagna Roll-Ups
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet and set aside.
Boil noodles until cooked and rinse with water.	Blend cheeses together and set aside.
Add browned ground meat with sauce and seasoning in a pan and simmer.
Spread cheeses onto noodle on one side.
Roll noodles, curly side out.
Cut in half.
Do so with remainder of noodles.
Pour sauce into baking dish and place noodles with non-curly side down into sauce.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Serve warm.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
steps: Crumble brown sugar, butter and flour together like pie dough. Reserve 1 cup for topping.
Mix together by hand the beaten eggs and sour cream.
Mix soda, salt and vanilla with flour mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Crumble on reserved topping. Bake at 350°
for 40 minutes.
Check at 35 minutes.

title: Pudding Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: grape and strawberry or
ingredients.raw: grapes and fresh strawberries, halved or quartered (optional)

steps: Drain juices from pineapple and mandarin oranges into large bowl.
Add instant pudding and Tang.
Stir until smooth.
Add bananas, kiwi fruit, pineapple, oranges, grapes and strawberries. Mix well and chill.
Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Tangy Meatballs
steps: Combine beef, salt, pepper, egg and cream.
Shape into 1/4-inch balls.
In skillet, brown meatballs in butter, turning carefully to avoid piercing.
Combine remaining ingredients; add to brown meatballs.
Cover; reduce temperature and simmer about 30 minutes.
Serve warm.
Makes about 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Pasta With Chicken
steps: In large skillet, melt butter.
Add chicken, onion and garlic; cook until chicken and onion are tender.

Stir in spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, stirring frequently, 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Serve sauce over hot pasta; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hamburg Noodle Casserole
steps: Brown
ground beef.
Cook noodles until not quite done; drain. Put
in
greased casserole.
Put 1 layer hamburg and 1 layer noodles.
Cover
with mushroom soup.
Repeat layers and cover with
celery
soup.
Bake in 350° oven until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

title: Grape Sunshine
steps: Using real ripe grapes, wash and remove stems.
Place in large kettle with enough water to cover bottom of pan only. Kettle can be pretty full of grapes.
Cook over medium heat until skins pop open.
Run grapes, skins and seeds through a sieve, crushing grapes and skins as much as possible.
Stir in 1 box of Sure-Jell with pulp in kettle.
Bring to a full boil over high heat.
Add sugar at once, bringing to a full boil again; stir constantly.
Boil 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Skim off foam. Put hot mixture in jars or glasses and top with melted paraffin.

title: Passover Rolls Or Muffins
steps: Boil water and oil together.
Add matzoh meal, sugar and salt. Mix off of the heat.
Beat very well.
Add eggs, 2 at a time, beating very well.
Bake in muffin tin at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pizzacato Pizza Casserole
steps: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Take sausage out of casing and crumble.
Brown and drain off grease.
Stir in tomato puree, sauce, water, mushrooms and seasonings.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add cooked macaroni and stir well.
Put 1/3 of meat and macaroni mixture into a greased 3-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/3 Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat with remaining 2/3.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Glazed Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Put butter or oleo in hot mashed potatoes; stir until butter is melted.
Add sugar, slightly beaten egg and flavoring.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch crust.
Sprinkle 1/4 sugar over top of pie.
Wait until sugar becomes moist, then put into oven.
Bake at 350° until done and glaze has formed.

title: Italian Cookies
steps: Beat eggs well.
Add sugar and beat.
Add melted shortening and juice.
Mix well.
Add salt, baking powder, flour and mix until smooth and easy to handle.
Make into different shapes. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Decorate with colored sugar or frosting.

title: Barbecue
steps: Place meat in heavy kettle or skillet and cook slowly until meat changes color.
Add onions and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add other ingredients, except soup.
Simmer for about 1 hour.
Add soup and cook a while longer.
Salt to taste.

title: Butterscotch Cream Cheese Bars
steps: In saucepan, melt morsels and margarine.
Stir in crumbs and nuts.
Press half of mixture firmly into the bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Melba Sauce
steps: Put frozen raspberries into a quart glass measuring pitcher. Heat, uncovered, in microwave oven 1 minute on High.
Stir to break berries apart. Cook, uncovered, 30 seconds on High or until berries are defrosted.
Stir a mixture of sugar and cornstarch into raspberries, then stir in currant jelly. Cook in microwave oven 6 minutes on High until sauce thickens.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
steps: Place chicken, skin side down, in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix honey, mustard, lemon juice and salt.
Spoon half of mixture over chicken.
Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: Dee'S Strawberry Pudding Cake
steps: Crumble cake in baking pan.
Put berries over cake.
Let set in freezer while you mix pudding and milk.
Pour mix over cake.
Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Pecan Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan.
In large bowl, combine brownie mix, water, oil and egg.
Beat 50 strokes by hand.
Add frosting and sour cream; mix well.
Spread batter in greased pan.
Sprinkle pecans and chocolate chips evenly over top.
Bake at 350° for 42 to 52 minutes.
Cool completely.

title: Hot Maple Toddy

ingredients.name: realemon lemon juice from concentrate
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate

steps: In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients (except optional). Over low heat, simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.
Serve hot with butter and cinnamon sticks, if desired.

title: Poppy Seed Bread Or Muffins
steps: Beat all ingredients together in large mixing bowl for 2 minutes.
Pour into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 15 slices per loaf.
(Also, can use for muffins.)
Contains less than 1 gram of fat per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Eggless Spice Cake
steps: Sift all
ingredients.
Place
in
bowl and add 1/2 cup melted shortening,
cups water and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Mix well and bake
in
layers in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Spicy Glazed Wieners
steps: Cut 3 thin gashes on each wiener.
In medium saucepan over medium heat, cook remaining ingredients, stirring, until cranberry sauce melts and becomes smooth.
Add wieners and heat through. Serve hot with cocktail picks.
Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream (Frosty)
steps: Mix Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip, then chocolate milk.
Put into electric freezer.
Makes 1 gallon.

title: Molded Lemon Dessert
steps: Make jello according to directions.
When fairly thick, whip the milk.
Add to jello (using large bowl).
Add sugar, lemon juice and vanilla.
Put 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add jello mixture.
Put remainder of crumbs on top.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pasta With Broccoli Di Rape And Sausage

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or vegetable oil

ingredients.name: pasta shell
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. medium pasta shells or any small size pasta of choice

steps: Remove the long stems and tough outer leaves from the Broccoli di Rape.
Keep florets and small leaves, cut up, place in colander and wash several times.
Pour oil into pan on medium heat.
Lightly crush garlic, place in heated oil and allow to turn golden, then remove garlic if you wish.
Remove casing from sausage, place meat in pan and cook thoroughly, breaking the pieces of meat apart as they continue to cook.
If you still have not removed the garlic, do so now.
Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil from pan; add Broccoli di Rape to pan and mix with cooked sausage.
Keep mixing together, add your broth, mix and cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Mix flour and butter together to form a roux and stir into your mixture.
Cook approximately 5 minutes more until sauce thickens. Serve over pasta and add the grated Italian cheese of choice.
