title: Three Layer Pie
steps: Combine ingredients and bake
in
a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

title: Healthy Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown sirloin with onion.
Add other ingredients.
Simmer 15 minutes or so.
Serve open-faced on bread of choice.

title: Virgin Island Soup

ingredients.name: oregano bay leaf and tabasco sauce
ingredients.raw: oregano, bay leaf and Tabasco sauce to taste

steps: Simmer first 5 ingredients together 20 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 30 more minutes.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels

ingredients.name: flour tortilla
ingredients.raw: 7 to 10 flour tortillas (will need less if large size used)

steps: Drain chilies and olives.
In mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except tortillas.
Spread mixture onto tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion.
Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap to prevent drying out.
Chill for several hours.
To serve, slice tortillas into 1-inch segments.
Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Great Pheasant Or Partridge
steps: Do not thicken!
Pour over meat and bake for 2 hours on low. Serve with rice.

title: Cinnamon Chip Muffins
steps: Combine just until moistened.
Spoon into muffin pan with liners.
Bake at 400 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until done. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Boil until soft ball stage the cocoa, sugar, butter and milk. Remove from heat.
Immediately stir in the vanilla, oats and nuts. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls; ready to eat when cool (about 15 minutes).

title: The Best Snickerdoodles
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix together thoroughly the shortening, sugar and eggs.
Sift together the next 4 ingredients and stir into creamed mixture.
Chill dough.

title: Roasted Pecans
steps: Melt butter in
large
skillet.
Add remaining ingredients, then pecans.
Stir well.
Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until they are golden
brown.
Remove
and drain on paper towels.

title: Teddy Bear Popcorn

ingredients.name: salt microwave popcorn
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 to 3.5 oz.) pkg. salt-free microwave popcorn

ingredients.name: bear shaped vanilla graham cracker
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. bear shaped vanilla graham crackers

steps: Prepare popcorn as package directs.
In large bowl, combine cinnamon-sugar, cocoa and salt.
Stir in popcorn, tossing to coat well.
Stir in graham snacks and M&M's.
Makes 11 cups.

title: Pudding Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls. Flatten with hand on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

title: Squash Casserole #2

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken

steps: Melt
butter
and mix in stuffing.
Line part of casserole dish
with part of stuffing.
Spoon in other ingredients (mixed together).	Cover with remainder of stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Alice'S No Bake Cookies
steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to rolling boil.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Pour boiled mixture over oatmeal mixture.
Stir and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let cool completely.

title: Chocolate Chip Pan Cookie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl mix margarine, sugars, vanilla and eggs with mixer.
Gradually add flour until well blended.
Stir in chips and nuts.
Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
(Check after 30 minutes.)
Cool, then cut into squares.

title: Banana Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients except flour. Gradually add flour, stirring lightly.
Pour into muffin cup inserts in muffin pans.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Yield: 2 dozen muffins.

title: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheddar Cheese

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: red potato in
ingredients.raw: 4 medium red potatoes, cut in 1/8-inch slices (peel on)

steps: Empty soup into 2-quart casserole.
Stir in milk gradually. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover tightly and microwave on High 20 to 35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until tender. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.

title: Scones(Recipe From Ireland, 100 Years Old)
steps: Mix all ingredients together with pastry blender.
Drop by big spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.
Makes 6 to 8 scones.
Serve warm with jam, jelly or honey.
Quick, easy and good.
They freeze well.
Heat in microwave a few seconds.

title: Bob'S Creamy Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Combine sugar,
condensed milk and water.
Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils.
Cook to 330° until soft ball forms in cold water.

title: Bourbon N' Steak Barbecue
steps: Mix bourbon and soy sauce in flat roasting pan, preferably steel.
Marinate steak for at least 5 hours, more if you have time.
Barbecue as usual, seasoning steak as desired while cooking.
Sauce may be stored in refrigerator and used again. Double ingredients if necessary as meat should almost be covered while marinating.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup

ingredients.name: cauliflower floweret
ingredients.raw: 1 small head cauliflower (1 lb.), broken into flowerets

ingredients.name: instant chicken bouillon in c. water
ingredients.raw: 3 tsp. instant chicken bouillon in 3 c. water or 3 c. chicken broth

steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer on reduce heat for 20 minutes or until tender.
Melt butter in small pan.
Add flour, salt and pepper; blend.
Add milk, stirring until mixture boils.
Add cheese and cook until cheese melts.
Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Rich Loaf Bread
steps: Sift flour before measuring.
Scald milk.
Add sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast and beaten eggs.
Add half of the flour and beat 3 minutes.
Add rest of flour, half a cup at a time, and stir after each addition.
Knead.
Shape.
Allow to rise until light and bake.

title: Seven Minute Icing

ingredients.name: marshmallow in
ingredients.raw: 6 large marshmallows, cut in small pieces

steps: Put all ingredients, except vanilla, in top of boiler.
Stir until well mixed.
Place over simmering, but not boiling, water. Cook, beating constantly with electric mixer at high speed, for about 7 minutes, or until icing becomes stiff and glossy.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Stir until blended.

title: Easy Orange Balls(Unbaked)

ingredients.name: concentrated orange juice thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can concentrated frozen orange juice, thawed (undiluted)

steps: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs.
Add powdered sugar, butter, orange juice and nuts.
Mix well with hands.
Form into balls.
Chill.
Store in refrigerator.
If desired, roll in coconut immediately after shaping.

title: Enchilada Pie

ingredients.name: enchilada sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 can enchilada sauce (mild or hot Ole El Paso)

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 small can green chilies, chopped (mild or hot)

steps: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain off fat. Mix together soups, enchilada sauce and chilies. Add drained meat to this mixture. Grate and mix together Velveeta and Cheddar. In a deep casserole (9 x 12), alternate layers of 4 to 6 corn tortillas, 1/2 meat
mixture and 1/2 grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves about 8.

title: Ham And Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: pasta bow and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. pasta bows (or other small pasta), cooked and drained

ingredients.name: fully smoked ham julienne
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fully cooked smoked ham, cut into julienne strips

ingredients.name: green bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small green bell pepper, chopped (about 1/2 c.)

steps: Gently	toss ingredients together.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Open-Face Apple Pie
steps: Mix well.
Place
into uncooked pie shell.
Cook for 15 minutes on 325°.
Turn oven to 350° and cook 30 minutes more.

title: Fluffy Banana Pudding

ingredients.name: jell o banana cream flavor instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (6 serving size) Jell-O banana cream flavor instant pudding and pie filling

ingredients.name: thawed cool whip cream whipped
ingredients.raw: 3 c. thawed Cool Whip extra creamy whipped topping

steps: Pour milk into blender.
Add pudding mix.
Blend in blender 1 to 2 minutes.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Gently stir in whipped topping. Place wafers in bottom and sides of Pyrex dish.
Put in pudding mixture.
Add bananas and more vanilla wafers.
Repeat in layers until reaches top.
Last layer is cream mixture.
Place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Quick And Easy Homemade Biscuits
steps: Combine all ingredients, form
a
ball	and knead until smooth.
Pat out dough and cut out biscuits.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until
golden brown.
Makes about 10 large biscuits or more smaller ones.

title: Hot Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut up

ingredients.name: french bread
ingredients.raw: French bread cubes or tortilla chips

steps: In a saucepan cook onion, garlic, and tarragon in margarine. Stir in cornstarch.
Add milk all at once.
Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Gradually add cheeses, stirring till melted.
Serve with bread or chips.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Pineapple Burgers
steps: Set oven at broil and/or 550°.
Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt.
Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal.
Place patties on rack in broiler pan.
Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, ketchup and mustard. Turn patties.
Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Curried Fruit
steps: The day before serving, drain and dry fruits on paper towels. Arrange fruit on shallow "bake and serve" dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Melt butter and add curry powder.
Pour over fruit. Bake 1 hour at 325°.
Refrigerate and reheat until bubbly hot when ready to serve.
Cooking the casserole one day early allows curry flavor to penetrate fruits for best flavor.
Serves 12.

title: Sip And Cheer

ingredients.name: lemonade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed

steps: In a 2-quart non-metal container, combine bourbon, lemonade, beer and lemon juice.
Refrigerate.
Serve over ice and garnish with mint leaves and lemon slices, if desired.
Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Cheesy Omelets
steps: Preheat skillet.
Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into skillet.
When eggs are done, turn burner to simmer. Break cheese into 4ths and place on eggs.
Serve after cheese melts.

title: Sloppy Tom
steps: In a large skillet that has been sprayed with Pam, cook turkey until brown.
Combine all other ingredients and add to turkey. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Hash Brown Bake

ingredients.name: hash brown slightly thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. frozen hash browns, slightly thawed

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. sour cream or half and half or light sour cream

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup

steps: Mix all together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Let stand overnight or a few hours to blend flavors.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until golden brown on top.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Golden Smoothies
steps: Place the first four ingredients in a blender; cover and process until smooth.
Pour into glasses; garnish with orange and cherries if desired.

title: Sausage Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Fully cook sausage and drain well.
Mix sausage, onions, cheese and flour.
Beat eggs and milk; pour over the sausage mixture.
Mix all well and pour into pie shell.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mallow Fudge Squares
steps: Boil sugar, milk, oleo and chocolate to soft ball stage.
Beat while cooling.
Mix together marshmallows, graham crackers, nuts and vanilla.
Add this to the chocolate mixture.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Check with toothpick.

title: Happiness Cookies(By:  Luerle Ruff)
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service.
Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith.
Blend well.
Fold into daily life.
Bake well in a warmth of human kindness, and serve with a smile anytime.
It will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Add water to unpeeled potatoes just to cover.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bring to boiling for 30 to 35 minutes.
Drain.
Peel and shred potatoes with a grater.
In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes, cheese and butter; stir until butter is melted.
Stir in sour cream, green onion, salt and the pepper.
Transfer to a greased pan.
Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together (except fried onions).
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake for 60 minutes, covered.
Uncover and sprinkle with fried onions.
Bake for additional 15 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Peach Crisp

ingredients.name: peach well
ingredients.raw: 1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches, well drained

steps: Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Quick Mexican Venison

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Brown venison; drain any grease.
In a large stew pot, add all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce temperature to a simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Season to taste with garlic salt and black pepper.

title: Cherry Nut Icing For Banana Nut Cake
steps: Cook
the
sugar,
milk and Karo until soft ball stage. Add dates, cherries, pecans, butter and vanilla.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
steps: Soak raisins in hot water for 10 minutes; drain.
Mix the flour with sugar.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Cream together and add cream and raisins.
Cook over low heat, stirring until thick. Cool and add vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Make meringue from egg whites and bake until nicely browned.

title: Rich Waffles
steps: Mix dry ingredients in mixer bowl.
Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs.
Mix well and beat at medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in heated waffle iron.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
steps: Mix Bisquick, 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended.
Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar.
Pour water on top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm.
Serve at once, topped with ice cream.

title: Cloud Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in Crisco like coarse crumbs.
Combine egg and milk.
Add to flour mixture.
Turn out on lightly floured board.
Knead gently with heel of hand 20 strokes. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness.
Cut and place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake in a 425° oven for 10 to 14 minutes or until light brown.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Mike'S Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Brown pork in oil and set aside.
Saute celery and onion in pork juices until limp.

title: Party Meatballs
steps: In a bowl, mix hamburger with onion soup mix.
Form into meatballs and fry until done.
While frying meatballs, put chili sauce and grape jelly in crock-pot with 1 onion and let cook. When meatballs are done, place in crock-pot and serve.
Great for parties!

title: Fortune Cookies
steps: In a bowl mix flour, sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add cooking oil and add white; stir until smooth.
Add water and mix well. Make one cookie at a time.
Pour 1 tablespoon of the batter on a greased skillet.
Spread into a circle.
Cook 4 minutes on one side and 1 minute on the other at low temperature.
Working quickly, put a message in the cookie.
Fold in half and in half again.

title: Vienna Torte
steps: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored.
Add sugar; beat well. Add flour, salt and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add cream of tartar and beat until very stiff.
Add egg yolk mixture to whites, folding carefully.
Pour into large ungreased angel food pan.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.

title: Kim'S Ham And Hash Brown Omelet

ingredients.name: ham in
ingredients.raw: 4 thin slices ham, cut in pieces

steps: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble.
Cook ham; crumble.
Add potatoes, onion and pepper to skillet and cook until brown and crisp.
Blend eggs and milk; pour over potatoes.
Top with cheese, bacon and ham.
Cover and cook at low temperature for 10 minutes. Serve in 4 wedges.

title: Jack Straws (Candy)
steps: Melt chocolate in double boiler.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix very well.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Allow to air dry.
Store in an airtight container.

title: Reese Cookies
steps: Mix all top 4 ingredients together real good. Make into small balls and press 1 Kiss in each.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 5 minutes in a 350° oven.
Yields 3 dozen.

title: Beef Burgundy

ingredients.name: stew beef
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. stew beef, cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: burgundy
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Burgundy or other red wine

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine first five ingredients in a Dutch oven or covered baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Grandma'S Individual Ham Loaves
steps: Mix ground beef, ham, eggs, milk, mustard and corn flakes. Grease muffin tins and sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of muffin cups.
Spread pineapple over brown sugar.
Shape meat mixture into balls and place in muffin cups.
This is great for entertaining. (This can be made in 10 x 15-inch pan.) Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 15 individual loaves.

title: Snicker Cake

ingredients.name: german chocolate cake mix with pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 German chocolate cake mix with pudding

steps: Mix cake mix according to directions on box.
Pour half of batter into greased pan (no flour).
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Louisiana Whiskey Balls
steps: Crush vanilla wafers.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Mix well and form into balls.
Roll in additional powdered sugar. Makes about 2 dozen small balls.

title: Hickory Nut Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light.
Add egg, mixing well.
Stir in flour until well combined.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Shape dough into 2 long rolls; wrap each roll in waxed paper.
Chill several hours.
Slice rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Frank'S Sausage And Peppers
steps: Remove stems and seeds from green peppers and cut into chunks. In ovenproof dish, saute green peppers in olive oil until soft (on top of stove).
Sprinkle with a little salt.
Remove green peppers from dish; brown sausage in same dish.
Add red wine and cover; bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
Uncover, add sauteed green pepper and bake 30 more minutes.
Serve in same dish.

title: Easy Pralines
steps: Mix the sugar, milk, butter and soda in saucepan.
Cook to soft ball stage. The soda turns the sugar to caramel taste and color as it cooks.
Remove from stove.
Cool a few minutes. Add vanilla, then beat.
Before mixture begins to stiffen, add nuts and spoon onto wax paper.

title: No Cook Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Melt margarine; add graham cracker crumbs, peanut butter and confectioners sugar.
Mix and spread on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top of mixture.
Set in refrigerator.
Cut into squares when set.

title: Low Cholesterol Zesty Sausage Casserole

ingredients.name: great northern bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) can Great Northern beans (not drained)

steps: Brown sausage and onion.
Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole at 350°.
Serves 4.
Sausage Casserole plus a salad makes a fine low cholesterol meal.

title: Baked Squash
steps: Wash and
slice
to	8
squash
and boil until done. Drain excess
water and add 1/2 stick margarine and mash.
Mix egg, sugar and Pet milk.
Pour into hot squash, stirring fast. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° until firm (20 to 30 minutes). Sprinkle with grated cheese and melt.

title: Chicken Ala Balsamic
steps: Fry breaded chicken in garlic and olive oil.
After frying all chicken, saute and cover pan until chicken is fully cooked.
Put aside sliced mushrooms, red peppers and sliced onion and simmer. Take a little olive oil and garlic; simmer mushrooms, red peppers and onions until cooked.
When cooked, pour over chicken and then pour balsamic vinegar over entire food.
Simmer until hot.

title: Oven Bag Chicken Supreme

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients except chicken. Dust inside of large oven bag with flour and lay bag inside oblong baking pan.
Arrange chicken, cavity side up, in a single layer in bag, spooning mixture evenly over top.
Tie bag; pierce top with 2 to 3 small slits.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Venison Stew
steps: Mix together all ingredients in large stew pot, adding enough water to achieve desired consistency between
soup or thick stew. Simmer on low to medium-low for 3 or 4 hours.
Makes a very mild, but tasty soup.

title: Butter Nut Balls
steps: Blend shortening, butter, salt, sugar and vanilla.
Add flour and nuts.
Place in refrigerator for about 1 hour.
Place balls of dough on slightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.
Sift on powdered sugar.

title: Cauliflower Casserole

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen cauliflower or 1 large head (fresh)

steps: Cook cauliflower and drain; drain peas.
Combine cauliflower, peas, cheese and sour cream.
Pour into buttered casserole dish. Cover with Ritz crackers.
Dot with butter.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Milk Chocolate Cake Icing
steps: Blend together.
Beat on high until smooth.

title: Butterscotch Graham Squares
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Break each graham cracker in half. Place close together on a 17 1/4 x 11 x 1-inch nonstick cookie pan with side on it.
Place butter and brown sugar in a glass measuring cup.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.
Microwave on High for 1 minute or until butter is melted.
Remove from microwave.
Stir.
Let cool at room temperature 2 minutes.
Add pecans; mix well.
Put a teaspoonful on each cracker.
Bake 7 minutes.
When cool, remove and store.

title: Taco Dip I
steps: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan, spread refried beans on bottom. Next spread cream cheese over beans.
Brown ground beef; drain and add taco seasoning mix.
Spread on cream cheese.
Next, spread salsa and top with cheese.
Bake 15 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Marengo

ingredients.name: chicken part skinned and boned
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. chicken parts, skinned and boned (if desired)

steps: Pierce sausages; simmer in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain.
Brown sausages in Pam sprayed pot.
Remove and brown chicken pieces in pot.
Spray again if needed.
Remove meat and cook onions until tender, stirring frequently.
Do not brown onions.

title: Chocolate Angel Food Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Follow directions on angel food mix package, stirring cocoa and coffee powder into dry mix.
Beat 1 1/2 minutes, scraping bowl often.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes in unoiled tube pan.
Invert and cool thoroughly.
Top with Berry Sauce. Makes 12 servings.

title: Dream Whip Salad

ingredients.name: instant lemon pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. instant lemon pie filling (stir in fruit)

steps: Combine all ingredients together and place in covered container in the refrigerator for 3 or 4 hours before serving. This salad keeps well for several days.
When mixing, if real thick, add some of the pineapple juice.

title: Fresh Salad Freeze

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple, well drained

steps: Mash bananas with fork; blend in remaining ingredients.
Stir well, pour into molds.
Freeze until firm.

title: Sausage And Apple Stuffing

ingredients.name: french
ingredients.raw: 8 c. cubed French or Italian bread (day old or oven dried)

ingredients.name: sage
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. dried sage (or 1 Tbsp. fresh, chopped)

steps: Place bread cubes in a large bowl and set aside.
In a medium size skillet over medium heat, saute sausage until well browned, about 10 minutes.
Transfer sausage to paper towels to drain and discard drippings.
In same skillet, melt butter.
Add onion; saute until soft but not brown.
Stir in stock, apples and raisins; bring to a boil.
Pour over bread cubes and mix in sausage, salt and sage.
(Makes approximately 10 cups).
Great for light or dark poultry dishes.

title: Forgotten Chicken And Rice

ingredients.name: rice mixed with pkg. dry onion soup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. raw rice, mixed with 1/2 pkg. dry onion soup

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Put rice mixed with onion soup and mushrooms in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut up chicken; salt and pepper the pieces and place on top of rice mixture.
Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup with 2 1/2 cans water.
Pour over chicken on rice.
Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Pink Lady Day Salad
steps: Drain pineapple; save juice.
Add enough liquid to dissolve Jell-O.
Mix Jell-O as directed.
Place over medium heat, stir until marshmallows melt and cool for 10 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into mold and chill.

title: Cookie Clusters
steps: Melt 2 squares of white bark in a 200° oven for 20 minutes in a 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Remove from the oven when completely melted and add peanut butter.
Mix.
Combine granola and noodles to the mixture and coat well. Drop by tablespoon onto aluminum foil. Will harden when cooled.
Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Shape into ball and roll into flour.
Cook in hot oil (360°) until brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Cake(No Mixing)
steps: Spread pineapple in large baking dish.
Sprinkle coconut over pineapple.
Sprinkle brown sugar over coconut, then sprinkle cake mix (dry from box).
Slice butter thin and place over cake mix, making sure to cover completely.
Bake at 300° for about 1 hour.

title: Ranch Crackers
steps: Coat oyster crackers with vegetable oil.
Mix dry ingredients and toss with crackers.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes in a 475° oven.

title: Frosted Blueberry Salad

ingredients.name: raspberry blueberry
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. raspberry, blueberry or blackberry jello

steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Drain blueberries and pineapple.
Measuring liquid, add enough water to make 1 cup and add to jello mixture. Chill until jello becomes jelly. Fold in blueberries and pineapple.
Pour into long dish and chill until firm.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Dressing
steps: Prepare wild rice according to directions on the box.
Cut chicken in cubes; brown sausage, chicken and onion together. Drain the fat; mix all ingredients together.
Bake 1 hour at 350° or until lightly browned.

title: Ranch Biscuits
steps: Mix yeast with warm water.
Mix all other ingredients.
Leave in refrigerator and use as needed.

title: Southern Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Whip cheese until light and fluffy.
Beat in sugar and peanut butter.
Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly.
Fold in topping. Pour into pie shell.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
Freeze and serve frozen.

title: Helen Green'S Green Chili Casserole

ingredients.name: old el paso picante
ingredients.raw: 1 large bottle Old El Paso picante

steps: Brown hamburger, onions and chilies.
Add mushroom soup. Layer with chips, hamburger mixture and cheese in two layers. Bake until cheese melts in 350° oven.

title: Walnut Caramels
steps: In large, heavy saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, butter and half of the cream.
Heat to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Stir in remaining cream, nuts and vanilla.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches a temperature of 244° on a candy thermometer (small amount dropped into very cold water will form a firm ball).
As mixture becomes thick, stir constantly.
Immediately pour mixture evenly into a well buttered 8-inch square pan.
Let stand until cool.
Cut into 1-inch squares.
Wrap individually in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Yields 64 candies (about 1 1/2 pounds).

title: Microwave Potatoes
steps: Slice potatoes medium thick.
Layer in deep dish glass pie pan.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Dot with butter. Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave 25 minutes on High.

title: Grandma Hanrahan'S Vanilla Icing
steps: In a small bowl, combine powdered sugar, milk, vanilla and a few drops of food coloring (if desired), stirring until smooth. The icing should be fluid but thick enough to form a line when drizzled from the tip of a spoon.
If necessary, add a few drops of milk to thin or a little more sugar to thicken.
Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Cup
steps: Drain pineapple.
Alternate layers of pineapple and strawberries; sprinkle each layer with sugar.
Sprinkle mint over top; chill thoroughly.
Serve in sherbet glass.
Serves 6.

title: Quick Potatoes Au Gratin

ingredients.name: southern style hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen Southern-style hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix potatoes, cheese, soup, salad dressing, onion and pepper.
Spoon into 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with combined crushed corn flakes and margarine.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Cookie Salad

ingredients.name: instant vanilla
ingredients.raw: 2 small instant vanilla or white chocolate pudding mix

steps: Crumble 3/4 package cookies into bite-size pieces; set aside. Combine pudding and buttermilk thoroughly. Fold in whipped topping and then add the mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
When ready to serve, mix in the crumbled cookie pieces and then place the remaining whole cookies on top for decoration.

title: Rosebud'S Biscuits

ingredients.name: bowl of self raisin flour sifted
ingredients.raw: medium to large bowl of self-rising flour, sifted

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.raw: extra oil (for pan and top of biscuits)

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Make a well in flour, patting flour down lightly.
Pour milk into the well.
Add oil to milk.
With hands, gradually add flour to make soft dough.
Flour hands.
Pinch off dough; roll between hands forming biscuits.
Place biscuits on pan greased with oil.
(I place biscuits touching.)
Dab oil onto top of each biscuit.
Bake at 450° for approximately 5 to 6 minutes or until done.
Place on broil to slightly brown tops.

title: Red And Green Christmas Salad

ingredients.name: size avocado and
ingredients.raw: 1 medium size avocado, pitted, peeled and thinly sliced

ingredients.name: warm champagne vinegar dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Warm Champagne Vinegar Dressing (recipe follows)

steps: Place the spinach leaves in a large salad bowl and arrange the avocado slices in a circle around the edge of the salad.
Place the pomegranate seeds in the center of the salad.
Make the warm dressing.
Pour 1 cup of the dressing over the salad at the table; toss and divide between salad plates.
Makes 8 portions.

title: Beginner'S Blueberry Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter and pour in baking dish. Mix flour, sugar and milk together.
Fold in berries and pour over butter.
Do not stir.
Bake until golden brown.

title: Rhubarb Crumb Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine rhubarb, egg, vanilla, 4 tablespoons flour and sugar together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Blend 3/4 cup flour, brown sugar and margarine together until crumbly.
Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Sauce
steps: Make paste of cornstarch and water.
Combine with rest of ingredients; bring to a boil.
Stir until thick.

title: Country Hash
steps: Combine meats in one boiler.
Cook until done.
Cool for 15 to 20 minutes, then chop.
Add vinegar, butter and onion.
Reheat for 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quick And Simple Meal
steps: Brown ground chuck and add chili powder, garlic powder and tomatoes.
Cook macaroni as directed on package.
Mix ground chuck and macaroni.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake in a covered casserole dish at 325° for 20 minutes.
Yields 4 to 6 servings. Can be frozen.

title: L-H Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix in blender.
Serve on greens and top with bacon.

title: Cornbread Muffins
steps: Mix all this together.
Put in greased muffin pans and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes approximately 12 muffins.

title: Ten-Minute Turkey Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Cover and let simmer about 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Dorothy'S Rhubarb Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add sugar and flour.
Mix together with wooden spoon and stir in soft butter and salt.
Pour this over rhubarb in unbaked shell.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes and then at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Kraft Macaroni And Hamburger

ingredients.name: macaroni and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 1/4 oz.) pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (no water)

steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on package.
Brown meat; drain.
Add onion and green pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add soup.
Add all together in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: pimento with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small jar whole pimentos with juice, chopped

steps: Mix with heavy-duty mixer until well blended.
Refrigerate.

title: Honey Apple Squares
steps: Step 1:
Spread peanut butter on a cracker.

title: Road Runner Cake
steps: Melt oleo and add to one beaten egg and cake mix.
Press into a pan.

title: Nipponese Eggplant
steps: Peel eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch to 3/4-inch cubes. Meanwhile, in a skillet, fry onions in butter.
Add eggplant, soy sauce, water and brown sugar to onions.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serves 3 to 4.

title: Creme Caramel
steps: Butter eight 6 ounce custard cups.
In small skillet over medium heat, melt 1/2 cup sugar, stirring, until it is a light brown syrup.
Pour syrup into buttered cups.
Place cups in shallow baking pan for easy handling.
Glass is best.
Preheat oven to 300°.
In large bowl with mixer at low speed, beat eggs, salt and 1/2 cup sugar until lemon colored.
Gradually beat in milk and vanilla extract.
Pour mixture into prepared cups; put hot water into pan to within 1-inch of top of cups; bake 1 hour until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool on wire racks.
Refrigerate.
When ready to serve, use knife to loosen custard from cups and invert onto dessert plates, letting syrup run down sides onto dish.

title: Spice Pork Chop Bake

ingredients.name: hot pepper sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. hot pepper sauce to taste

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Arrange pork chops in a single layer in a 3-quart baking dish.
Bake chops for 20 minutes or until they begin to brown; spoon off fat.
Combine remaining ingredients in bowl.
Spoon mixture over chops and bake 15 minutes or until they are no longer pink.
Stir sauce before serving.

title: Chicken Breast In Mushroom Sauce
steps: Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken; place in baking dish. Bake in a 400° oven until brown (if desired).
Combine soup, mushroom pieces and milk; pour over chicken.
Reduce temperature to 350°.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Blushing Bunny Sauce
steps: Put salt, pepper and flour with butter in double boiler.
When melted, add cheese (which has been broken into small pieces) and stir until cheese melts.
Then add tomato sauce and beaten egg; stir until smooth.
Serve on toast.

title: Cocoa Fudge Sauce
steps: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan.
Add corn syrup and milk and blend thoroughly; bring to a boil.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla.
Cool, without stirring, until pan feels warm to hand.
Serve.
Yields 1 1/2 cupfuls sauce. Very good!

title: Fluffy Frosting
steps: Mix egg whites, cream of tartar and sugar in small bowl with mixer at high speed, gradually until smooth and glossy.
Gradually beat in corn syrup, vanilla and salt until stiff peaks form.
If desired, beat in food coloring or 1 cup coconut.

title: Shawn'S Deer Steak
steps: Brown the venison in a skillet with 1/2 stick of margarine. When browned, add onion and green pepper.
Continue cooking on medium heat.
Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt.
When onion is tender, add Worcestershire sauce.
Top with one can of diced tomatoes.
Cover and simmer until meat is tender.

title: Finger Salad

ingredients.name: original recipe hidden valley ranch
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. original recipe Hidden Valley Ranch

steps: Press the rolls on a cookie sheet and bake according to the package directions.
Mix the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and Hidden Valley Ranch together.
Spread on cooled crescent rolls.
Top with the vegetables.
Top the vegetables with the Cheddar cheese and cut it into squares.

title: Microwave Hot Dogs
steps: Place hot dog in bun.
Carefully wrap single servings in separate paper towel.
Smooth wrinkles in paper towel with hand or appropriate utensils as individual taste dictates.
Place both items in microwave.
Cook on High setting for approximately 40 to 60 seconds.
See microwave for further details.
When food is cooked to taste, remove hot dogs from microwave, unwrap from paper towel and add condiments.

title: Tuna Melt Sandwiches

ingredients.name: tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked

steps: In a medium bowl, combine celery, cheese, tuna, onion, mayo and salt; set aside.
Spread butter over the cut side of buns. Spread tuna mixture on bun bottom; replace top.
Wrap in foil. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Lemon Bar
steps: Mix dry cake mix, margarine and egg together.
Press mixture into bottom of 12 x 9-inch cake pan, then mix powdered sugar, 2 eggs, cream cheese, vanilla and lemon juice together until smooth. Spread second mixture evenly over the cake mixture.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
You may want to sprinkle powdered sugar over top as it cools.

title: Artichokes And Cheese

ingredients.name: artichoke heart and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps: Mix all together.
Bake in glass dish at 350° until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips - El Grande Chips.

title: Roast Pheasant
steps: Cut off necks of birds close to bodies, leaving neck skin on to help hold the stuffing.
Remove pin feathers; singe if needed. Rinse inside and out in warm water; drain and pat dry.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies

ingredients.name: scant c. lard
ingredients.raw: 1 scant c. lard or other shortening

ingredients.name: baking soda dissolved in c. hot coffee
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 2/3 c. hot coffee (instant coffee is fine)

steps: Cream together in a large bowl the sugar, lard or other shortening, molasses and eggs.
Sift the flour, ginger and salt. Dissolve the baking soda in the coffee.
Stir dry ingredients into molasses mixture, adding coffee alternately.
Chill.
Roll out dough to a thick layer, 1/2-inch or so.
Cut with round cutter. Dip into sugar.
Place on greased baking sheet, leaving room to spread.
Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes but do not let brown as they will be too hard.
They are a good big soft cookie which keep well. Cool on rack and enjoy with a glass of milk.

title: Texas Golden Chicken Breasts
steps: In a large, heavy skillet, heat butter and olive oil over low heat.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, rosemary and cheese; mix well.
Dampen chicken breasts.
Roll in flour mixture, then eggs, then croutons.
Cook in butter, 4 minutes per side.
Serve with white sauce or milk gravy.

title: Red Beans
steps: Soak beans overnight. Brown salt pork in shortening. Brown onions. Add flour, browning to form a roux.
Add beans and enough water to cover well. Simmer 2 hours.
Serve with rice. Serves 8.

title: The "Day After" Punch
steps: In a large bowl, stir together the juices, the Curacao, the sugar and the cherries and let the mixture stand, covered and chilled, overnight.
Stir in the brandy and champagne; serve over ice.
Makes about 18 cups.

title: Sauce For Wieners

ingredients.name: hot dog
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. hot dogs, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Simmer first 4 ingredients 10 minutes.
Add hot dogs.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve.
Makes approximately 50.
Honey wieners work better.
You may add more wieners if you wish.

title: Chocolate Bonbons
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium saucepan, combine chocolate chips and margarine.
Cook and stir over low heat until chips are melted and smooth.
Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, nuts, chocolate mixture and vanilla. Mix well.
Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy kiss, covering completely.
Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.
Do not overcook. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool.

title: Nestle Quik Icing

ingredients.name: or more tbsp. milk
ingredients.raw: 1 or more Tbsp. milk (keep adding as needed)

steps: Cream margarine and shortening.
Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well, then add vanilla and milk.

title: Jeff'S New Potato Salad

ingredients.name: red new potato boiled and
ingredients.raw: 16 medium red new potatoes, boiled and cubed

steps: Combine all ingredients and adjust mayonnaise for desired creaminess.
Serves 8.

title: Grandma'S Hot Chili
steps: Cook hamburger and onions.
Drain grease.
Mix tomatoes, sauce and paste into mixture.
Drain beans and add and mix.
Add salt and pepper, hot sauce and chili powder to taste.
More will be hotter.

title: Noah'S Ark Clam Chowder

ingredients.name: clam drain and save juice
ingredients.raw: 2 cans minced clams, drain and save juice

steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot; cover and bake at 200° for four hours or simmer for four hours.
Stir every hour.
If mixture becomes too thick, add the extra clam juice.
This freezes well.

title: Orange Pineapple Dessert
steps: Stir graham cracker crumbs with sugar and melted oleo.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Mix cream cheese to soften, then add to Jell-O, a little at a time.
Fold in crushed pineapple; do not drain.
Add Cool Whip.
Pour on graham cracker crust and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Quick Minestrone Soup

ingredients.name: pea and carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots

steps: Combine ingredients in a large pan; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until pasta is done, stirring occasionally.
Yields 9 servings.
One cup per serving.
Top with Parmesan cheese, grated.

title: Raggedy Ann Salad
steps: Place peach in center of salad plate.
Position egg for head, celery sticks for arms and legs and lettuce for skirt.
Add cheese for hair, cherry for mouth and raisins for eyes, nose, buttons and shoes.
Yields 1 serving.

title: Cheesy Spicy Spinach

ingredients.name: spinach liquid reserved from cooking spinach
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. spinach liquid, reserved from cooking spinach

ingredients.name: roll hot pepper cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) roll hot pepper cheese, cubed

steps: Cook spinach according to directions on package; drain well, reserving 1/2 cup spinach liquid.
Set aside.
In pan coated with nonstick cooking spray, melt margarine and saute onion until tender.
Add flour; stir.
Gradually add milk and spinach liquid to make sauce.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Add cheese and seasonings; cook until cheese is melted.
Add spinach to pan, combining well.
Yields 10 servings.
A favorite of spinach lovers.

title: Pierogie Casserole

ingredients.name: lasagne noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. lasagne noodles or 1 bag wide egg noodles

ingredients.name: boiled potato
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 boiled potatoes (no seasoning or butter)

steps: Boil noodles and drain.
(If using lasagne, lay flat until ready to use.)

title: Yum Yum Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and add other ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Crab Mushrooms
steps: Mix mayonnaise, cream cheese, lemon juice, chili sauce and crabmeat
all together and fill mushroom caps with mixture. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on High in your microwave.
Watch carefully!

title: Hot Cheese Bubble
steps: Mix together and cook at 425° for 10 minutes, approximately. Serve with Wheat Thins.
Serve hot.

title: Corn Bread Squares
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan.
Combine dry ingredients.
Stir in milk, oil and egg, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm.
Makes 9 servings.

title: Coconut Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and shortening; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with cream of coconut.
(Begin and end with flour.) Stir in lemon rind and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Homemade Picante Sauce

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 6 fresh jalapeno peppers, chopped (or to taste)

steps: Combine all ingredients, except for the peppers, and simmer together until onion is nearly done.
Add peppers and continue simmering until all flavors are blended.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Caramel Turtles
steps: Melt caramels and cream in double boiler.
Combine oat mixture without chocolate chips. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: White Chocolate "Peanut Clusters"
steps: Melt white chocolate in double boiler.
Add vanilla and stir - add peanuts and mix well.
Drop on cookie sheet lined with wax paper.
Let cool until firm.
Store in cool place.
Yield 2 - 3 dozen.

title: Easy Lunch Treat

ingredients.name: hormel chili
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Hormel chili (or any no bean chili)

steps: Bake fries.
Pour heated chili over fries; top with cheese and bake until cheese melts.

title: French Onion Soup(Microwave)
steps: Melt the butter in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add onions and cook for ten minutes.
Stir in beef bouillon, salt, flour and pepper.
Cover and cook another 10 minutes.
Spoon into individual bowls.
Toast bread and add to soup.
Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Heat on High for 1 minute and 15 seconds.

title: Divinity
steps: Stir sugar, corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved.
Cook, without stirring, to 260° on candy thermometer (or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball).

title: Lemon Cookies

ingredients.name: duncan hine lemon supreme cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix

steps: Mix all ingredients well with a spoon.
Roll into quarter-size balls.
Roll into powdered sugar and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Milk Shakes
steps: Spin all ingredients together in the blender or food processor.
Serves 1.

title: Reese'S Candy(Club Member: Renee Evans)
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
Press out onto a 10 x 14-inch cookie pan.
Melt chips and wax together and spread over crust.
Refrigerate only 15 minutes.
Take out and cut into candy squares.
Return to refrigerator.

title: Reese'S Candy

ingredients.name: semi sweet
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet or milk chocolate chips

steps: Combine ingredients and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch glass dish.
Melt chips in microwave; pour on top of fudge mixture. Chill well several hours.
Cut pieces at room temperature.

title: Baked Spinach Cheese Squares
steps: Thaw spinach. Blend all ingredients and put in an 11 x 7-inch buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cut in squares to serve.

title: Pizza Hotdog
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Split buns and hotdogs lengthwise. Place layer of cheese on buns.
Add hotdog slices to buns.
Top with sauce.
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Place on broiler pan until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Punch Bar
steps: Beat first 3 ingredients on high.
Add next 4 ingredients and beat on medium.
Spread in a greased 13 x 10 x 2-inch pan.
Top with coconut and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Casserole

ingredients.name: sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. cooked sausage, drained and crumbled

steps: Grease an oblong pan.
Layer sausage, bread and cheese in pan. Mix all other ingredients.
Slowly pour mixture over layers.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
The next morning, bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Fall Vegetable Skillet

ingredients.name: butternut squash and
ingredients.raw: 2 c. butternut squash, sliced 1/4 inch and cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: sweet potato the same
ingredients.raw: 2 c. sweet potato, sliced the same

ingredients.name: carrot on diagonal
ingredients.raw: 2 c. carrots, cut 1/4 inch on diagonal

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh green beans, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

steps: Place ingredients in a large skillet and cook over low heat, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes to desired tenderness of vegetables. Serve.
Enjoy!
This reheats well for leftovers.

title: Garlic Roasting Chicken

ingredients.name: garlic smashed and
ingredients.raw: 4 cloves garlic, peeled, smashed and finely chopped

steps: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Stir butter (oleo) and garlic together in small bowl until well blended. Using your fingers, gently loosen skin on breast and smear about 2 teaspoons of oleo mixture under skin.
Spread remaining mixture over outside of chicken.
Add salt and pepper.
Bake on rack in pan at 375° for approximately 65 minutes.

title: Low-Calorie Preserves

ingredients.name: fruit strawberry blackberry peach etc.
ingredients.raw: 3/4 to 1 Cup Fruit - Strawberries, Blackberries, Peaches, etc.

ingredients.name: apple concentrate juice
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 Cup Frozen Apple Concentrate Juice

steps: Cook 3 to 4 minutes on high.
Sprinkle 1 tsp. unflavored gelatin in cooked fruit, dissolve and cool.

title: One Hour Italian Casserole
steps: Brown ground turkey in skillet.
Drain off excess fat.
Add meat into spaghetti sauce and simmer over stove while preparing the rest of the recipe.
Prepare pasta according to directions on box.
Spray with nonstick oil; add pasta and pour meat sauce over. Arrange pepperoni on top.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let sit 10 minutes and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Sunny Jim Peanut Butter Swirls
steps: Mix shortening, sugar, peanut butter, eggs and milk.
Add flour, salt and soda.
Melt chocolate chips.
Divide dough and roll each out into oblong.
Spread melted chocolate and roll. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Slice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Angel Sweets
steps: Melt chocolate and butter in small saucepan over low heat. Remove and blend in egg.
Stir in the rest except coconut.
Shape in balls.
Roll in coconut.
Refrigerate on waxed baking sheet.

title: Turkey Pie

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: water or mixture of water and broth to cook vegetables

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: *If making your own crust, add a dash of thyme or poultry seasoning to flour.
If using prepared crust, just cut strips to fit whatever pan you use.

title: Violet Jelly
steps: Fill any size glass jar with violet blossoms.
Cover with boiling water.
Put lid on jar and let blossoms infuse for 24 hours.
The next day, open the jar and strain the blue infusion, discarding the spent violets.
Measure out 2 cups of the infusion and add the juice of 1 lemon and 1 package of Sure-Jell.
Bring just to a boil and immediately add sugar.
Bring back to a boil and boil hard for 1 minute.
Pour into hot sterilized jars or glasses and seal.

title: Graham Cracker Cookie Bar
steps: Combine nuts, sugar and butter in saucepan and boil 2 minutes. In the meantime, break graham crackers where scored and place in bottom of a large jelly roll pan or cookie sheet that has been lined with aluminum foil.
Placing crackers close together; pour mixture over crackers.
Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Watch closely.
Cool and remove from pan with spatula.

title: Brandy Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: blue cheese and
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. Blue cheese, crumbled and softened

steps: Beat Blue cheese, cream cheese, garlic, parsley and brandy in a small bowl on low speed until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate about 6 hours or until firm.

title: Favorite Casserole

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. grated cheese (Colby, American or Mozzarella)

steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Cook macaroni as directed and drain.
Combine all ingredients in large casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pineapple Lime Ring
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cold water and juice. Gradually add jello to cream cheese, mixing well until blended. Chill until thickened but not set.
Fold in marshmallow, pineapple and nuts.
Pour in 6-cup ring mold.
Chill until firm.

title: Carrot Souffle
steps: Soak crumbs in milk for
10 minutes. Grease a 1-quart casserole.
Combine crumbs, egg yolks, carrots, onion, cheese, salt and pepper.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold into carrot mixture.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until set.

title: Almond Crescents

ingredients.name: nut
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. finely chopped nuts or 1/2 c. mini chocolate chips

steps: Blend together first 6 ingredients; add finely chopped nuts or mini chocolate chips.
Shape into crescents and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown.
Sift powdered sugar over crescents while still warm.
Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Lucille'S Mexican Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of celery
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Brown meat and onion.
Drain.
Add beans, soup and tomatoes. Simmer for 5 or 10 minutes.
Stir often.
Place tortilla chips in large casserole dish.
Pour meat mixture over chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Place cheese on top during last 5 minutes of baking.

title: No Bake Pretzel Dessert
steps: Mix pretzels and cracker crumbs with Sweet 'N Low and melted margarine.
Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Chill overnight.

title: Roasted Chicken And Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. potatoes or 8 to 10 medium potatoes

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. garlic powder or 2 cloves crushed garlic (crushed fresh garlic is preferred)

steps: Oven should be preheated 10 minutes before using it to a temperature of 350°.

Poke holes in chicken and season chicken in holes, inside cavity and outside with adobo, oregano and garlic. Soften butter stick in microwave and place half of it inside cavity and rub on all of the outside the other half of the softened butter.
Place chicken, breast down, in a pan big enough to also hold potatoes later on.
Place in oven and spread melted butter over chicken frequently.
As soon as chicken is placed in oven, start to prepare potatoes.
Chicken should cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours (set timer when chicken is placed in oven).

title: Butterscotch Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Make four small rolls and wrap in wax paper.
Place
in refrigerator.
When ready to bake, slice and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° about seven minutes.

title: Linguine Al Pesto

ingredients.name: basil cleaned and stem removed
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh basil, cleaned and stems removed

steps: Method 1:
Drain 1 can of pinto beans.
Mash.
Cook in bacon grease or lard.

title: Slime
steps: Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a small bowl.
Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of water.
If mixture is too dry, add more water.
If too runny, add more cornstarch.
Food coloring may be added, if desired.
Slime will feel dry and solid to the touch, but if picked up, will dribble through your fingers.
If hit, it will be solid, but if finger is placed in the bowl gently, it will be liquid.
Have fun!

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine the first 7 ingredients listed in a mixing bowl.
Pour the mixture into a pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes, or until done.

title: Get Together Punch
steps: Day before:
Pour 1 can punch into 1 1/2-quart ring mold, freeze.
Mix remaining punch, pineapple juice, lemonade and club soda in punch bowl.
Just before serving, unmold frozen punch ring carefully.
Place in bowl, garnish as desired.
Makes approximately 2 quarts, 16 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Cinnamon Twist

ingredients.name: dry yeast let rise in cup warm water minute
ingredients.raw: 1 dry yeast- let rise in 1/2 cup warm water for 15 minutes

steps: Mix and put on a board and roll to an oblong shape.
Melt butter and spread over dough.
Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over half of the dough.
Fold over other half and pat thin.
Cut into 1/2 inch strips and twist. Let rise 1 hour and bake in 375 degrees till light brown, This makes 24 twist.
May be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.

title: Noodles Romanoff
steps: Power Level:
High (100%) and Medium (50%).
Total Cooking Time: 23 to 29 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake

ingredients.name: strawberry jello dissolved in c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. strawberry jello, dissolved in 1/2 c. water (at room temperature)

steps: Empty cake mix in a large mixing bowl.
Add all other ingredients and beat 3 minutes.
Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 sheath cake pan. Bake at 350° until done (usually about 30 minutes).

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and margarine.
Press graham cracker mixture into cookie sheet or large cake pan.
Mix together powdered sugar and peanut butter.
Press peanut butter mixture on top of graham cracker layer evenly.
Melt chocolate chips and pour on top.
Let cool and cut into squares when firm.

title: Baked Fish Loaf

ingredients.name: tuna fish
ingredients.raw: 2 c. canned tuna fish or salmon or 1 lb. filleted fish, cooked

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Drain and flake fish.
Add onion and capers to fish.
In separate dish, combine mayonnaise, water, cream, salt, paprika and stir until smooth.
Add 1/2 of this cream sauce to fish and mix well.
Place fish mixture in buttered loaf pan or baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Use the remaining sauce, after the curry is mixed into it, to spread over the fish loaf slices.
It can be cut into six slices while it is still hot and the sauce spooned over the slices.
This is a good one for dieters.

title: Party Crunch Mix

ingredients.name: wheat
ingredients.raw: 4 c. square wheat or rice cereal

ingredients.name: la choy chow mein noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) can La Choy chow mein noodles

steps: Heat oven to 250°.
Combine both cereals and noodles in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Set aside.
Combine the remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over cereal mixture.
Stir to cool evenly. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.
Cool.

title: Marinated Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: brussels sprouts
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. Brussels sprouts (2 c.) or 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. thinly sliced celery (1 large rib)

ingredients.name: tomato well
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can sliced tomatoes, well drained*

steps: Cook sprouts in 2-inches boiling, salted water for 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender; drain.
Place in shallow bowl with celery and tomatoes.
Pour on dressing; cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Drain before serving.
Spoon into lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 4 servings.

title: Icy Punch
steps: Mix packages of jello with 3 cups hot water to dissolve and add 3 cups cold water.
Set aside.

title: Ritz Torte
steps: Beat egg whites stiff.
Add sugar and vanilla.
Beat well on high speed.
With rolling pin, roll crackers together with baking powder on waxed paper.
Stir into egg white mixture.
Fold in chopped nuts.
Spread into a 9-inch greased pie tin.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
When cool and before serving, top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.

title: Fabulous Beef Fajitas

ingredients.name: prepared italian salad dressing divided
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. prepared Italian salad dressing, divided

ingredients.name: sirloin steak
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless sirloin steak, cut into 1/4 inch strips

ingredients.name: onion and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 1 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings

steps: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak.
Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a skillet, saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender.
Remove and keep warm.	Drain steak, discarding marinade in skillet, saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink.
Return vegetables to pan.
Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides.
Yield:
4-6 servings.

title: Home Baked Beans
steps: Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight.
Next morning, cook slowly until skins burst or until just tender. Drain, reserving liquid.
Place half the beans in the bean pot or casserole.
Bury part of pork in the beans and half of combined remaining ingredients.
Add remaining beans and seasonings.
Place remaining salt pork over top.
Cover with bean liquid and bake in 250° to 300° oven between 6 to 8 hours.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Baked Indian Pudding

ingredients.name: molasses
ingredients.raw: 1 c. molasses or golden table syrup

steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Butter a deep 2-quart casserole.
Heat milk and sugar in a saucepan over low heat until tiny bubbles appear around edge of pan. Gradually stir in corn meal; cook, stirring constantly, until smooth and slightly thickened.
Remove from heat.
Stir in eggs, cinnamon, ginger, salt and molasses (syrup).
Stir together thoroughly.
Pour into prepared casserole. Bake, uncovered, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot as is, or with vanilla ice cream.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Cheesecake Pie

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. cream cheese, softened (8 oz. each)

steps: Beat cream cheese.
Add eggs, sugar, vanilla and lemon peel. Blend until fluffy.
Pour this into unbaked crust.
Bake until firm, 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
This is better after chilling for at least 8 hours.
Top with strawberries; it's great.

title: Basic Pasta(Noodle Dough)
steps: Put flour and salt in mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and in it put the eggs and oil.
Mix together with your fingers.
Knead the dough until smooth, adding more flour or a few drops of water as necessary.
Dough may also be made using a mixer with a dough hook or in a food processor.

title: Texan Pecan Pie
steps: Mix well.
Put in 9-inch pastry.
Cook for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Italian Artichoke Dip
steps: Drain artichokes and mix all ingredients; sprinkle with black pepper and bake in a quiche dish at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

title: Jonna'S Baked Quail
steps: Salt and pepper birds.
Brown quail in oil.
Place in Dutch oven.
Saute onion, parsley and celery.
Add broth and mushrooms and stir well.
Pour over quail.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres

ingredients.name: stouffer s spinach souffle thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen Stouffer's spinach souffle, thawed

steps: Marinate drained artichoke bottoms in dressing overnight. Drain and place artichoke bottoms in baking dish. Fill each with thawed souffl.
Dust with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Dumplings

ingredients.name: chicken flavored soup base
ingredients.raw: chicken flavored soup base to taste

steps: Boil chicken, onion, carrots and parsley until done.
Add soup base enough to taste.
Remove chicken to cool, then pick meat off bones.

title: Cheesy Ham Potato Casserole
steps: Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender.
Add flour and seasonings. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.
Add 1/2 cup cheese, stirring until cheese melts. Add ham and potatoes. Spoon into greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Triple Cheese Dip
steps: Blend all ingredients thoroughly.
Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Serve with corn diggers.

title: Pilaf

ingredients.name: fine egg noodle in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. fine egg noodles (uncooked), broken in pieces

steps: In saucepan, brown noodles in butter; stir often.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil; stir.
Cover; cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Makes about
2 cups.

title: Orange Muffins
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add yogurt.
Add dry ingredients and then raisins and nuts.
Spray a muffin pan with Pam and fill cups.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 large muffins.

title: Carbo Mexicana

ingredients.name: ranch style bean
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Ranch Style beans (or pinto, kidney, butter, lima, etc.)

ingredients.name: bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (1 large) red bell pepper, diced

ingredients.name: chili powder garlic onion parsley and pepper
ingredients.raw: chili powder, garlic, onion, parsley and pepper to taste

steps: Combine all ingredients except salsa.
Toss with salsa.

title: Baked Cranberry Sauce
steps: Wash and drain cranberries.
In large bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon.
Add cranberries and mix well.
Spoon into a 9-inch square pan and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add orange marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts to hot cranberry mixture, stirring well.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Krunchy Krazy Korn
steps: Heat oven to 250°.
Place popcorn in foil lined pan.
In large saucepan, combine sugar, margarine and corn syrup.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Simmer 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla.
Pour mixture evenly over popcorn; mix well.
Bake at 250° for 30 minutes, stirring twice during baking time.
Remove from pan immediately.
Cool completely.

title: Chicken Fanfare

ingredients.name: chicken flavored stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chicken flavored stuffing mix

ingredients.name: rind from orange
ingredients.raw: grated rind from 2 oranges or 2 Tbsp. dried orange peel

steps: Remove skin from chicken.
Pound between 2 pieces of waxed paper to 1/4-inch thick. Remove waxed paper.
In a large bowl, combine stuffing ingredients, the mix, water, butter and raisins. Mix thoroughly.
Place 1/3 cup stuffing mix on each chicken breast.
Fold ends of chicken over the stuffing. Wrap chicken bundle with 3 slices of bacon.
Combine topping ingredients of nuts, orange rind and sugar in pie plate. Roll chicken in nut mixture.
Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Chilled Potato Soup
steps: Stir potato flakes into hot water until smooth.
Blend in butter and milk until well mixed.
Add chicken stock base, Beau Monde and nutmeg, blending well.
Stir in scallions.
Turn into a 2-quart jar, cover tightly and chill overnight.
Spoon into small soup cups to serve.

title: Blueberry Pineapple Cream

ingredients.name: corn flake c.
ingredients.raw: 4 c. corn flakes, crushed to 1 c.

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve juice)

steps: You may use 2 cups fresh blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water.
Cook until thick and cool.

title: Taco Roll-Ups
steps: Mix and spread on tortillas.
Roll up tortilla and wrap in Saran Wrap overnight or at least 6 hours.
Cut off in 3/4-inch slices.
Serve with salsa sauce.

title: Grandma'S Cookies
steps: Cream together all but flour and nuts.
Mix in flour and nuts. Form into logs about 1 1/2-inches in diamater; wrap in wax paper and freeze.
Slice 1/4-inch thick.
Cook at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.
Watch color carefully, after 7 minutes they go from white to burned.
Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Magic Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
Sift flour, soda, salt, baking powder and sugar together.
Cut in shortening with blender or fork.
Add yeast and milk to dry mixture.
Mix to stiff dough. Knead; pinch off biscuits or roll out.
Allow to rise for 10 minutes.
Bake at 425°.

title: Grandma Lewis' Stuffing

ingredients.name: linguica each bread used
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. linguica for each bread used

steps: Fry linguica and onion in small amount of oil.
Add parsley.

title: Chewies
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients well.
Add remaining ingredients; mix until well blended.
Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325°.
Sprinkle top with powdered sugar while warm.
When center sinks and pulls away from sides of pan, Chewies are done.

title: Dean'S Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate bit
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate bits (Nestle; use 2/3 pkg.)

steps: Cream margarine, sugar and milk in a 6-quart pan.
Put on medium heat.
Stir to full boil (soft ball, 230°).
Add marshmallow, bits and nuts.
Stir.
Pour into buttered pan.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits(Like The Ones From Red Lobster)
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms; beat vigorously for about 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Barbecue Pecans
steps: Combine first four ingredients.
Stir in pecans and mix well. Spread pecans evenly in a shallow baking pan.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.
Drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt, if desired.
Yield: 4 cups.

title: Beef Noodle
steps: Spread noodles in well- greased casserole.
Top noodles with cottage cheese, sour cream, cream cheese and chives.
Cover with remaining ingredients.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
steps: Scald milk.
Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast into warm water.
Add cooled milk mixture, eggs and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough.

title: Bush'S Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Beat the egg yolks until creamy; set aside.
Heat the milk in a double boiler to boiling.
Combine the egg yolks, sugar, peanut butter, cornstarch and salt.
Stir gradually into the milk and cook in the double boiler, stirring constantly until thick.
Pour into the pie shell and refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hungarian Keiffels
steps: Crumble yeast in sour cream.
Beat the egg yolks.
Add cream, then mix with flour mixture.
Knead ingredients to form a ball. Roll out in circles; fill with a nut filling.
Bake 8 minutes in 350° oven.
Brush with egg yolk and return to oven to bake 10 minutes more.

title: Black Walnut Pie
steps: Cream butter, sugar and salt and mix well.
Stir in walnuts. Pour into pie crust.
Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes, then lower temperature to 355° and bake until firm.

title: Minty Mallows

ingredients.name: nestle toll house mint chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House mint chocolate morsels

steps: Combine over hot (not boiling) water, sweetened milk and mint chocolate morsels.
Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.
In large bowl, combine marshmallows and nuts.
Add chocolate mixture; mix well.
Spread into foil-lined 9-inch square pan.
Chill until firm, about 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Tarts
steps: Drain pineapple from juice.
Make a thick syrup of juice and 1 cup sugar.
Roll out tart crust and spread thin layer of pineapple; sprinkle with dry sugar.
Fold tart and fry slowly until golden brown.
Place on platter and cover with pineapple syrup.

title: Orzo Salad
steps: Drain fruit and boil juice with sugar and egg.
Pour over cooked orzo noodles.
Let stand overnight.
Next day, add fruit and Cool Whip.
Very good.

title: Basil Tomato Tart

ingredients.name: folded refrigerated unbaked pie crust
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (15 oz.) pkg. folded refrigerated unbaked pie crust (1 crust)

ingredients.name: loosely basil leaf
ingredients.raw: 1 c. loosely packed fresh basil leaves

steps: Unfold pie crust according to package directions.
Place in a 9-inch quiche dish or glass pie plate.
Flute edge; press with the tines of a fork, if desired.
Prebake according to package directions.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the Mozzarella cheese.
Cool on a wire rack.

title: Mint Julep
steps: Dissolve sugar in the bourbon.
Crush mint against the inside of 10 ounce glass.
Pack glass with crushed ice, add sweetened bourbon, stir, top with mint.
Relax and enjoy.

title: Marshmallow Waldorf Salad
steps: Place chopped apples in bowl; sprinkle with lemon juice.
Add marshmallows, celery, walnuts and enough mayonnaise to moisten; toss lightly.
Serve in lettuce cups; top with apple wedges.

title: Alice'S Butter Cake
steps: Cream sugar, oleo, and Crisco.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add flour, milk (3/4 cup milk and 1/4 cup water to make 1 cup) and flavoring; add nuts and cherries.
Grease and flour tube pan. Start in cold oven.
Turn temperature to 300°.
Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake(Put In Punch Bowl)

ingredients.name: yellow cake with no pudding in mix
ingredients.raw: 1 yellow cake with no pudding in mix

ingredients.name: or instant vanilla pudding mixed up
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small instant vanilla pudding, mixed up

steps: Mix up cake in sheet pan.
After cake cools, cut in half. Crumble half of cake in bottom of punch bowl.
Divide ingredients in half and layer over cake.
Add second half of cake, crumbled. Repeat second half of ingredients.
Top with last half of Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with nuts or coconut and whole cherries if desired.

title: My Mom'S Strawberry Pie
steps: Boil together until thick 7-Up, sugar and cornstarch.
Add Jell-O and boil 1 more minute.
Let cool.
Put sliced strawberries in crust and pour syrup mixture over strawberries.

title: Slush Punch
steps: Mix together.
Freeze for three days.
When ready to serve, thaw 3 hours then add 2 liters of 7-UP or Sprite.

title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix sugars, vegetable oil, and peanut butter.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift in flour, salt and baking soda.
Mix until well blended.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Press with thumb.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 15 minutes.
(All ovens are different)

title: Cabbage On The Grill
steps: Cut cabbage in 4 pieces.
Wrap 1 bacon strip around each quarter or a pat of butter.
Season and wrap in foil.
Place on grill about 10 minutes.
Turn over and cook about 10 minutes more.

title: Mom'S Double-Crispy Chicken

ingredients.name: corn flake cereal c.
ingredients.raw: 7 c. corn flakes cereal, crushed to 1 3/4 c.

ingredients.name: chicken and
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. frying chicken pieces, rinsed and drained

steps: Put crushed corn flakes cereal into shallow dish or pan.
Set aside.
In a small mixing bowl, beat egg and milk slightly.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Mix until smooth.

title: Apple Pudding
steps: Mix and sift dry ingredients; add apples, eggs and melted butter.
Stir until well blended.
Bake in an 8-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cottage Cheese Quiche
steps: In blender, combine cottage cheese, eggs, milk, paprika and salt.
Line 10-inch pie shell with caraway seed and your favorite shredded cheese.
Pour in cottage cheese mixture.
Bake in 450° oven on lowest rack for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer or until done when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Speedy Apple Crisp

ingredients.name: and cooking apple
ingredients.raw: 5 to 6 c. sliced and peeled cooking apples

steps: Spread apples in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan.
Cut butter into remaining ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden.
Serve warm.
Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer)
steps: Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir flour, salt and baking powder together.
Add to eggs and mix well.
Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies.
Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Can be served warm or cold.

title: Yellow Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice following package directions.
When done, stir in margarine and soup (do not add water to soup).
In casserole dish, layer rice, corn and cheese.
Repeat, ending with cheese on top. Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or in microwave on High for 7 minutes and allow to stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Holiday Punch

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate

steps: Combine juices and mix well.
Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale.
Garnish with maraschino cherries.
Makes 25 punch cup servings.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli With Mushrooms And Cashews

ingredients.name: broccoli in floret
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh broccoli, cut in florets

steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in wok or large skillet.
Add broccoli, sugar and salt.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes or until broccoli is tender/crisp.
Add remaining oil, mushrooms, onions and nutmeg; stir-fry until added vegetables are tender-crisp, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Sprinkle on cashews.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Honey Barbecued Chicken
steps: Salt and pepper chicken pieces on all sides.
Mix soy sauce, ketchup, mustard, wine and honey in an oblong dish.
Add chicken and turn to coat well.
Let stand at room temperature 2 hours, turning occasionally, or refrigerate overnight.
Reserve marinade. Preheat grill, then turn to low and cook for 50 to 60 minutes with lid closed.
Brush with marinade and turn chicken while it's cooking.

title: Tried And True Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugars.
Add oil, eggs and vanilla; mix. Mix dry ingredients and stir into sugar mixture.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Place 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with glass dipped in sugar.
(I color my sugar with food coloring.)
Bake at 350° for 9 to 12 minutes until bottom is golden brown.

title: Skillet Fish Italiano

ingredients.name: fish fillet
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fish fillets, fresh or frozen, thawed

steps: In large skillet, cook onion in margarine until tender.
Add fish, lemon juice, oregano, zucchini and mushrooms; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Top with tomato and cheese; cover and simmer 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

title: Cherries In The Snow
steps: Butter a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar, adding sugar a little at a time, until stiff peaks form. Add vanilla, nuts and crushed soda crackers. Mix well. Place into pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
