Cool. Add Cool Whip making high peaks, and then add the cherries. Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 8 large servings.

title: French-Style Green Beans
steps: Fry and drain bacon.
Mix the chopped onions, bacon and A.1. sauce into the green beans.
Heat 10 minutes.

title: Walnut Tassies
steps: Cream the cream cheese, flour and margarine together.
Shape into little balls.
Press in very small muffin tins.
Mix together brown sugar, egg, butter, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Fill the crust with this mixture.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cheddar Macaroni Salad
steps: Beat cheese together with
1/4	cup
of the mayonnaise, minced onion, mustard and pepper sauce until well mixed.
Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Drain.
Stir cheese mixture together with the
hot
macaroni.
Let
cool.
Combine all other ingredients.
Stir together with macaroni mixture.

title: Hamburger Pan Meal
steps: Layer hamburger patties, potatoes and onions in a rectangular pan.
Salt and pepper according to taste.
Pour can of tomatoes over layers.
Cover with foil.
Bake in a 450° oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Birds Nest Cookies
steps: Melt butterscotch pieces in microwave.
Remove and add other ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.
Do not store in refrigerator.

title: Hoppin Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Saute onions in butter.
Mix together with remaining ingredients and simmer until liquid is gone.
Stir occasionally.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Squares

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand condensed milk

steps: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).
In medium saucepan, melt morsels and margarine; stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half the mixture firmly onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Beat in Eagle Brand, egg and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour into prepared pan.
Top with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool to room temperature.
Chill before cutting into bars.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Kelly'S Taco Pie
steps: Brown meat and onion.
Add taco seasoning and cook according to directions.
Spray a large casserole dish with Pam.
Line dish with rolls and add about 1 cup crushed Doritos.
Top with meat mixture.
Spread sour cream and sprinkle cheese over all.
Garnish with chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: My Favorite Brownies
steps: Mix well the eggs, sugar and salt.
Blend in vanilla.
Add mixed flour and cocoa.
Stir in melted margarine and pecans.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool in pan.
Cut into squares.

title: Pretzel Jello
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine and pat into a 13 x 9 cake pan. Bake 7 to 8 minutes until toasted. Set aside to cool.

title: Creamy Fudge

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sweetened condensed milk (Borden Eagle Brand)

steps: Place chocolate in 1-quart casserole and melt 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High power.
Turn 1/4 turn halfway through.
Add rest of ingredients.
Pour into buttered container.
Chill until firm. Makes 1 pound.

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup (Creme Crecy)

ingredients.name: plu c. chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. plus 2 c. chicken or beef bouillon

steps: In a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add carrots and onion and cook slowly for 15 minutes.
Add rice and 1 quart bouillon.
Cook slowly for 45 minutes or until carrots are soft.
Puree the soup in a blender a half cup at a time.
Return to pan and add 2 cups more bouillon.
Bring to a boil and add milk and 1 tablespoon of butter.
Serves 4 to 5 big eaters.

title: Jellied Cranberry Relish

ingredients.name: cranberry orange relish
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can (1 1/4 c.) frozen cranberry orange relish

steps: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Break frozen relish in chunks. Add to gelatin and stir until thawed.
Add cold water and orange juice.
Chill until partially set.
Stir in celery and nuts.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold or individual molds and chill until firm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pasta Sauce(Large Pot)
steps: Saute onion in small amount of oil.
Add tomato paste.
Stir for a minute.
Add all other ingredients.
Then add 4 cans of water, using tomato paste can for measure.
Bring to boil.
Simmer 3 hours, stirring often.
Add 1/2 cup grated Italian cheese after cooking 1 hour.
(Meatballs can be made and cooked in sauce.)

title: Waldorf Whiz

ingredients.name: red deliciou apple unpeeled
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped Red Delicious apples, unpeeled

steps: Beat cream cheese until smooth.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Broccoli Rice Whiz
steps: Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain.
Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in margarine.
Add onion, bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot.
Fold in Cheez Whiz, chicken soup and milk.
Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended.
Fold in chopped broccoli.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Serves 12.

title: Ritzy-Chicken
steps: Melt butter.
Dip chicken in butter, then roll in crushed crackers.
Place in baking pan.
Bake at 350°.
Bake approximately 1 hour.
Turn chicken after 30 minutes.

title: Apricot Nectar Molded Salad
steps: Heat apricot nectar to boiling; remove from heat.
Add lemon gelatin, stirring to dissolve.
Stir in crushed pineapple. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture.
Divide remaining mixture in half.
Pour 1/2 into 2-quart mold or 8 x 12-inch pan.
Refrigerate until set.

title: Date Rolls
steps: Cook dates, butter, yolks, sugar and vanilla in heavy saucepan.
Stir continuously until boils.
Boil 5 minutes.
Watch closely, will scorch.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla wafers and nuts.
Shape in rolls.
Roll in coconut.
Keep in refrigerator. Slice when ready to serve.

title: Mary Pat'S Fudge
steps: Put butter, chocolate and vanilla in large mixing bowl.
Then put milk and sugar in a large pot.
Put the pot on the stove and turn the stove onto medium-high.
Bring the sugar and milk mixture to a boil for 6 minutes.
You must stir this constantly or else it will burn.
Next, take this off the stove and pour it into the chocolate, vanilla and butter bowl.
Blend this on low power until everything has melted.
Now pour this into a cake pan, cover and cool.
Refrigerate.

title: Canned Green Beans
steps: Boil for 40 minutes. The beans need to be placed in a large pan covered with water. After your 40 minutes are
up, place in quart jars and seal.

title: Dutch Carrots
steps: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan. Cook onion in drippings. Add carrots. Season with salt and pepper. Turn carrots into hot vegetable dish and garnish with bacon.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Etouffee

ingredients.name: chicken and skin and fat removed
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 lb.) frying chicken, cut into pieces and skin and fat removed

steps: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy pot and saute chicken until brown.
Remove chicken from pot.
Add 1 tablespoon oil.
Saute the onion, celery and sweet pepper; cook 15 minutes.
Add 1/4 cup water; cook for another 15 minutes.
Add chicken and 2 1/2 cups water; cook partially covered for about 1 hour.
Sprinkle parsley.
Turn off heat.
Let stand tightly covered for 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
Serves 6.

title: Eclair Cake

ingredients.name: instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small boxes instant pudding (French vanilla; lite or regular)

steps: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Line bottom with graham crackers.
Mix pudding with milk; blend 2 minutes, then blend in Cool Whip.
Put 1/2 of mixture over graham crackers.
Put second layer of graham crackers and then the remaining pudding mix over this.
Cover with graham crackers.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in a 1-quart glass measuring cup or serving pitcher.
Microwave on Medium about 4 minutes or until mixture just starts to boil, stirring once during cooking time. Stir to combine ingredients to a smooth sauce.
Serve warm over ice cream.
Refrigerate leftover sauce and reheat in microwave on Medium as needed.
Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Sausage-Noodle Bake

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

steps: Combine first 7 ingredients, stirring well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Combine margarine and stuffing mix.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Easy Orange Sherbet
steps: Combine soda, condensed milk and pineapple, mixing well.
Pour into electric ice cream freezer.
Ice and salt freezer.
Plug in and wait for a great treat.

title: Deep-Dish Brownie
steps: Blend melted butter or margarine, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl.
Add eggs and beat well with a spoon.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan.
Cool and cut into squares.

title: Never Fail Icing
steps: In a small bowl, beat margarine and cream cheese.
Add sugar till desired thickness.
Mix well.

title: Sunny Banana Pie

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 1/4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: Slice bananas into crust. Gradually add 1/2 cup milk to softened cream cheese, mixing until well blended.
Add pudding mix and rest of milk.
Beat slowly 1 minute.
Pour into crust and chill. Garnish with toasted coconut.

title: Omega Oyster Crackers

ingredients.name: flax seed oil
ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup Flax Seed Oil (source of Omega-3 essential fatty acids)

ingredients.name: grape seed oil
ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup Grape Seed Oil (source of Omega-6 essential fatty acids)

steps: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl.
In another bowl, place crackers.
Pour mixture over crackers.
Mix well & let sit for one hour.

title: No Eggs Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
steps: Into large mixing bowl, put 2 cups sugar and 2 cups flour.
In a saucepan put oleo, water and cocoa; bring to a boil.
Pour over dry ingredients and mix well.
Add eggs and buttermilk to which soda has been added.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in large pan (cookie sheet size).
Ice while cake is still hot.

title: Microwaveable Zesty Red Dip
steps: Place all ingredients in small microwavable bowl and mix well. Place same bowl in center of microwave oven.
Heat on High (100% power) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until warm, stirring dip halfway through heating time.
Or heat in small saucepan over low heat until warm.
Serve warm.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Herb Bread

ingredients.name: loaf sourdough
ingredients.raw: 1 loaf sourdough or French bread, sliced

steps: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl.
Spread on one side of each bread slice.
Wrap loaf in foil.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cucumber Cinnamon Rings

ingredients.name: cucumber and cored out
ingredients.raw: 2 gal. large cucumbers, sliced and cored out (hollow insides out) *

steps: *Note:
You can quarter these instead of making rings.

title: Pickles In A Blanket
steps: Lay out a piece of dried beef.
Coat with cream cheese.
Wrap around pickle slice widthwise and stick a toothpick in center of pickle.

title: Mango Salad
steps: Use mango juice and water to make 3 cups liquid.
Dissolve jello in heated liquid.
Blend mangos and softened cream cheese. Add jello.
Chill and serve.

title: Butter Pie
steps: Warm milk and eggs together on stove.
Add sugar, vanilla, butter and spices, mix well and pour in pie dish.

title: Browned Butter Frosting
steps: Heat margarine in saucepan over medium heat until delicate brown.
Remove from heat.
Stir in powdered sugar.
Stir in vanilla and milk.
Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
steps: Sprinkle yeast over warm water.
In separate bowl, combine sugar, salt, cinnamon and butter.
Stir in mixed yeast.
Beat in 1 1/2 cups flour.
Add raisins.
Stir in remaining flour; knead, sprinkling flour on hands, and work surface until dough no longer sticks.
Knead about 10 minutes.
Form into ball and place in a greased bowl, turning to grease.
Cover and place in warm spot for 1 hour, until double in size.
Punch down and shape into loaf. Place in greased bread pan.
Cover; let rise 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 1 loaf.

title: Grandma'S Icebox Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Form into 2 rolls; wrap in wax paper and chill overnight or until needed.
Slice to 1/4 to 1/2-inch each and place on pan.
Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Beef Porcupines
steps: Mix beef, rice, onion and seasonings.
Form into small balls. Cook in hot oil in skillet turning frequently until light brown on all sides, but not crusty.
Add tomato sauce and water.
Mix well. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Pie
steps: Drain Mandarin oranges.
Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shells.

title: Cucumber-Radish Salad
steps: In medium bowl, combine yogurt, corn oil, parsley, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Add cucumbers, radishes and green onions. Toss to coat.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Baba
steps: Clarify butter.
Flatten chicken breasts between waxed paper. Brown chicken on both sides in butter over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms; cook about 10 minutes on medium heat.
Add Marsala; cook about 5 minutes.
Place Mozzarella on top.
It will melt quickly and chicken is ready to serve.
Goes well with steamed rice.
Serves 4.

title: Fried Apple Pie Crusts
steps: Mix ingredients together and set aside.
Beat eggs and cream together.
Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Add eggs and cream mixture to the flour and shortening. Cover and place overnight in refrigerator.

title: Drop Rolls
steps: Mix sugar and melted butter.
Add beaten egg and dry yeast dissolved in the warm water.
Add flour.
Drop by spoonfuls in muffin tins.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Laura'S Turkey Casserole

ingredients.name: turkey stewed and
ingredients.raw: 1 turkey, stewed and cubed (4 to 5 c.)

steps: Mix together.
Place in casserole dish.
Top with 1 package herb seasoned stuffing.
Pour 1/2 cup broth over it.
(Laura uses 2/3 to 3/4 of packaged stuffing.)
Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Chicken can replace the turkey.

title: Cowboy Bean Soup
steps: Saute onions and bell peppers.
Brown hamburger meat, add all other ingredients.
Simmer 1 hour.

title: Low Calorie Pizza
steps: Brown burger and drain off grease.
Mix tomato paste, Italian seasoning, onion flakes and garlic salt to burger.
Spread over the pita bread and sprinkle cheese over the top.

title: Lemon Basil Pasta
steps: In a small bowl, combine butter, lemon juice and spices.
Toss with pasta.
Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Torte
steps: Mix and press crushed cookies and melted butter into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Freeze until frozen.
Spread softened ice cream over frozen crust and freeze again until frozen.

title: Best Ever Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mash bananas with potato masher; set aside.
Cream shortening and sugar well.
Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour with salt, baking powder and baking soda.
Add flour mixture alternately with bananas to sugar mixture.
Mix until well blended.
Stir in walnuts.
Pour batter into 1 large or 2 small well-greased loaf pans.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Garlic Rolls
steps: Thaw and soften dough.
Blend melted butter, egg, garlic powder, parsley and salt.
Cut off pieces of dough about the size of small walnuts.
Dip into butter mixture.
Place pieces of dough into greased pans until all dough is used.
Cover; let rise until doubled in size.
Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes.
Brush with melted butter or margarine.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped cauliflower or 1 c. chopped carrots (optional)

steps: Rinse peas in hot water and drain.
Combine vegetables, nuts and bacon with sour cream.
Mix dressing and mustard; pour over salad.
Toss gently and chill.
Can make the day ahead and refrigerate.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Baked Barbecue Steak
steps: Chop the steak into chunks about 1-inch.
Place in bottom of casserole.
Put in barbecue sauce, then carrots and onions.
Bake in 350° oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Baked Beans-Beef Style
steps: Saute onions in butter, add hamburg and brown.
Drain off fat. In 2-quart casserole dish, add hamburg, salt, ketchup, mustard, vinegar and beans.
Mix well and cover and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Mousse
steps: Soak gelatine in water.
Add to hot soup.
Put in cheese, salad dressing, shrimp, salt and pepper.
Beat until smooth.
Cool.
Add onion and celery.
Pour into oiled mold.
Serve with crackers.

title: Garlic Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes in skins.
Cool and shred coarsely.
In greased casserole dish, alternate layers of potatoes, butter, cheese, onion, sour cream, salt, pepper and parsley.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Geri'S Crunchy Sweet Dills

ingredients.name: vlasic polish crunchy dill
ingredients.raw: 1 (46 oz.) jar Vlasic Polish crunchy dills

ingredients.name: each mustard seed celery seed and dill seed
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: mustard seed, celery seed and dill seed

steps: Drain juice from pickles, saving 2/3 cup.
Put pickle juice, sugar, water, vinegar and spices in a large 3-quart saucepan and bring to a boil.
Slice pickles in 1-inch slices and put back into jar.
When vinegar mixture has cooled to lukewarm, pour over pickles.
Replace lid and shake well.
Put in refrigerator.
Each day for 10 days, shake pickles to distribute spices.
After the 10 day period you will have great pickles.
These make a nice gift, especially for the holidays.

title: Purple Cabbage Cole Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage.
Chop onion.
Mix.
Top with 3/4 cup sugar. Boil vinegar, oil, 2 teaspoons sugar, mustard and celery seed. Cool.
Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir.
Refrigerate 6 hours. Keeps a long time in Tupperware.

title: Ham N' Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. grated medium sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in greased casserole dish and cover.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Oatmeal Muffins

ingredients.name: envelope instant oatmeal with apple and cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope instant oatmeal with apples and cinnamon

steps: Beat egg slightly with fork.
Add rest of ingredients and mix until combined.
Put in greased muffin cups.
Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 6.

title: Filled Star Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla extract.
Beat in egg yolks and orange juice.
Combine flour and salt; mix in 2 cups at a time until dough is soft.
Add flour if needed.
Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.
Roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness.
Use a star cutter to cut out shapes.
Use thimble to cut out 5/8-inch centers (these are the top cookies). Gather dough scraps and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut out stars and put onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool and fill with jam.
Sift confectioners sugar on top.

title: Simple Salad
steps: Mix Cool Whip and jello.
Stir well.
Mix in cottage cheese and oranges.
Stir well.
Chill before serving.

title: Candy Apple Delight

ingredients.name: container whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (8 oz. each) crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Combine whipped topping and pineapple in bowl.
Peel, core and slice apples.
Cut apple slices into quarters.
Cut Snickers bars into small cubes.
Chop peanuts.
Fold in apples, candy bars and peanuts to whipped topping mixture.
Yield: approximately 7 cups.

title: Herbed Bread Sticks

ingredients.name: take heart ranch honey dijon dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Take Heart Ranch Honey Dijon dressing

steps: Chop herbs.
Add to dressing.
Spread on bread that has been cut into shapes desired.
Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yummie Bars
steps: Combine cake mix, eggs, oleo and peanut butter; stir until mix holds.
Press 2/3 into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread filling over dough.
Crumble reserved dough over filling.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut when cool.
Makes 36.
Test with toothpick for doneness.

title: Hot Cheddar Dip
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix grated cheese, grated onion and mayonnaise.
Put in a small ovenproof dish (like a soup crock). Bake for about 20 minutes in a 400° oven.
Serve with crackers while bubbly and hot.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Salad

ingredients.name: sauerkraut and
ingredients.raw: 1 (27 oz.) can sauerkraut, rinsed and drained

steps: In a large bowl, combine the first four ingredients.
Pour sugar over and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Serve chilled.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.

title: Chicken "N" Rice
steps: Grease bottom and sides of large baking dish with butter. Cover bottom of dish with 1 cup uncooked rice.
Place several dabs of butter on rice.
Salt and pepper fryer pieces and place on top of rice.
Spoon 1 can cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top.
Add water to almost cover chicken, approximately 2 cups.
Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake 3 hours at 250°.

title: Cherry Topped Icebox Cake

ingredients.name: jell o brand instant vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Jell-O brand instant vanilla or chocolate pudding

steps: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with some of the graham crackers (break, if necessary).
Pour cold milk into bowl.
Add pudding mix.
With electric mixer at low speed, beat until well blended (1 to 2 minutes).
Let stand 5 minutes.
Blend with Cool Whip.
Spread half of the pudding mixture over crackers in pan.
Add another layer of graham crackers.
Top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers.
Top with pie filling.
Chill 3 hours.

title: Pineapple-Lime Float

ingredients.name: pineapple juice chilled
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can pineapple juice, chilled (1 1/2 c.)

ingredients.name: limeade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (6 oz.) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed (1/3 c.)

steps: Combine pineapple juice, water and limeade concentrate. Divide pineapple mixture among 6 tall glasses.
Spoon half of the lime sherbet into the glasses; stir gently.
Carefully pour chilled ginger ale into each glass.
Top with scoops of remaining lime sherbet.
Garnish with mint leaves, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Apricot Nut Cake
steps: Preheat oven
to 325°.	Soak dried apricots in the baby food apricots while you assemble other ingredients and grease a 10-inch tube
pan,
lining the bottom with wax paper cut to fit.
Mix all
at once the sifted flour, sugar, eggs, oil and flavoring, beating
until
smooth.
Add
apricots and pecans, mixing well. Bake
about 1 hour or until light brown and firm to touch.	Cool in pan before removing.

title: Grandpa'S Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Sift remaining ingredients; add to creamed mixture.
Refrigerate dough and roll 1/8-inch thick.
Cut to desired shapes.
Bake on greased sheet at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yield: 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: Nana'S Pot Roast
steps: Brown meat with onion, a little butter, salt and pepper.
Pour water to top of meat and simmer all day on low.

title: Seven-Up Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add egg gradually.
Mix salt with flour and add Seven-Up with flour.
Use a large pan with hole in it. Bake 2 hours at 325°.

title: Cookies Cake
steps: Combine milk and egg.
Add cake mix and chopped pecans.
Pour into pan and top with chocolate chips and Bits 'O Brickle.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Tastes better if you let set for 1 day.

title: Easy Skillet Supper

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. raw beef or cubed cooked beef

steps: Melt butter in frypan at low heat.
Add macaroni; stir to coat thoroughly with butter.
Add tomato juice; bring to rapid boil. Stir in beef and onion, salt and pepper.
Cover; reduce heat to 250° and cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese.
Serve with tossed salad.

title: Strawberry Jello Pie
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch well.
Add water and salt until it thickens.
Remove from heat and add strawberry jello and cool mixture really good.
Add cut up strawberries and pour into 2 cooked pie shells.
Chill for 2 hours.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Gelatin Balls

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. lime or strawberry jello

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar.
Let stand until firm.

title: Great Fruit

ingredients.name: instant lemon pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 small box instant lemon pudding and pie filling

steps: Combine lemon pudding and orange juice (as liquid) and mix well.
Add all other ingredients.

title: Popcorn Salad
steps: In bowl, combine the ingredients.
Chill.
Top with grated cheese and crumbled bacon, reserved from mixture.
Rest should go into salad.
Use within three hours.

title: Jennies Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening.
Add sugar gradually.
Mix well.
Add beaten eggs and vanilla.
Stir in sifted flour, soda and oats.
Form into small balls.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Zesty Veggies

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.raw: 1 c. celery, cut into 2-inch strips (about 2 stalks)

steps: Drain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid.
Add enough water to liquid to make 1 cup.
In large skillet, combine all ingredients.
Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Simmer about 5 minutes.
Cool and refrigerate in a tightly covered bowl for at least 24 hours.

title: Hamburger And Bean Casserole
steps: Brown beef; drain.
Add other ingredients and cook until the mixture bubbles.
Put mixture into casserole dish.
Split biscuits, uncooked, in half and cover top of casserole.
Put cheese on top of casserole and on top of biscuits.
Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Toasted Deviled Hamburgers
steps: This wil cover 8 slices of bread.
Cut crust from bread. Toast on one side.
Spread with hamburger on side not toasted. Return to broiler and let broil for eight or ten minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Easy Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Microwave in safe microwave casserole dish:
sugar and syrup. Cook 4 1/2 minutes.
Add peanuts.
Cook 3 minutes.
Add butter and vanilla.
Cook 2 minutes and 15 seconds.
Add baking soda.
Stir lightly.
Pour onto buttered pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Do not spread.

title: Vegetable Couscous

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. olive oil or vegetable oil

steps: Heat all ingredients except couscous and cheese to boiling in a 2-quart saucepan.
Serve over couscous.
Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
steps: In large mixing bowl, cream butter, confectioners sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add flour, salt and pecans; mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Boston Brown Bread *
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Spoon into three greased coffee cans or loaf pans.
Let stand for one-half hour. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Molly'S Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in saucepan.
Beat egg yolks with milk.
Gradually add water to dry ingredients; stir to blend. Stir some of the hot mixture into eggs, then mix all together. Cook until thick.
Add vanilla and butter.
Top with meringue.

title: Red Molded Salad
steps: Combine cheese, celery, mayonnaise and nuts; let stand at room temperature.
Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add applesauce and cinnamon.
Pour half of mixture in pan; congeal.
Spread layer of cream mixture; top with remaining gelatin mixture and congeal.

title: Trail Mix
steps: Mix sugar and syrup; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter.
Mix.
Add corn flakes and drop by spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Zesta Cracker Candy
steps: Mix milk
and
sugar.
Put in small pot.
Come to rapid boil. Stir
constantly
for 3 minutes.
Take off burner.	Add crackers, peanut butter and vanilla flavoring; mix well.
Pour in small square pan or glass with margarine (grease it lightly).
Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Fudgies
steps: Boil first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes.
Combine peanut butter with hot ingredients.
Add oatmeal, stir well; add salt.
Drop by spoonfuls on foil and allow to set for at least 30 minutes.
(If it thickens too quickly, add small amounts of milk.)

title: Delicious Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Serve cold or heat slowly.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Pimiento
steps: Drain pimiento, reserving 1 teaspoon juice; set pimiento and reserved juice aside.
Break pasta into thirds; cook according to package directions, drain.
Place pasta in a serving bowl.
Add pimiento, reserved pimiento juice, cheese and remaining ingredients; toss well.
Serve warm.
Yield:
4 servings.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry with syrup thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. frozen strawberries with syrup, thawed

steps: Beat together cream cheese and sugar, then add Cool Whip.
Mix well and then spoon over crust.
Mix jello with boiling water. Add strawberries with syrup.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Pour over cheese mixture and refrigerate.
When set, garnish with nuts.

title: Vegetable-Lentil Chowder
steps: Combine lentils, water and salt in large saucepan.
Cook, covered, over medium heat for 30 minutes.
Cook onion and green pepper until tender.
Combine all ingredients.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 large servings.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients and form small meat balls.
Place in a pie plate and microwave on High until meat balls are almost fully cooked (about 6 to 7 minutes).
Rearrange once.
Give dish 1/2 turn during cooking.
Repeat procedure until all meat balls are cooked. Add to spaghetti sauce the last hour of simmering.

title: Old Fashion Jumbles
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter or Crisco with sugar, egg, milk and vanilla.
Mix all ingredients together. Roll thin.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Place on slightly oiled sheet. Bake at 375° approximately 10 minutes.

title: Turnip Casserole
steps: Combine turnips, butter, sugar, salt, eggs, pepper and 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs; mix well.
Pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with rest of bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon of melted butter.
Bake until brown, about 30 minutes, at 350°.

title: Cream Cheese Delight
steps: Melt oleo.
Add yellow cake mix and 2 eggs.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Batter is stiff.

title: Paper Mache
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl and allow to sit 24 hours.
Then add water and flour.
Mix thoroughly.
Can form over balloon or use in molds.	Allow to air dry.
Depending on the weather, sometimes takes 3 days.
Sometimes use clear acrylic spray depending on the project.
Enjoy!

title: Fried Cauliflower
steps: Wash cauliflower; cut in small pieces with stems.
Boil in small amount of water until about half done and still somewhat crisp.
Remove from heat; drain and cool just until it can be handled.
Dip cauliflower pieces, one at a time, into mixture made of the egg and milk.
Coat generously with flour to which desired amount of salt has been added.
Fry in hot oil.
(May use deep fryer or skillet with 1/2 inch of oil.)
Brown lightly on both sides for approximately 5 minutes.
Ready to eat as finger food!

title: Layered Ground Beef Casserole

ingredients.name: green pepper and divided
ingredients.raw: 1 large green pepper, seeded, sliced and divided

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 2 large potatoes, peeled and sliced thin

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (10 3/4 oz.) cream of celery soup

steps: In 2-quart casserole, layer half the onion, celery and green pepper; season with salt and pepper.
Top with beef; season with three-fourths teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
Pour on tomato sauce.
Top with remaining onion, celery and pepper. Arrange potatoes over top; spread with soup.
Bake uncovered in preheated 350° oven for 1 to 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until potatoes are tender and top is lightly browned.
Do not stir.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Fruit And Cabbage Salad

ingredients.name: cabbage about head
ingredients.raw: 2 c. shredded cabbage, about 1/4 medium head

steps: Place all ingredients, except lettuce leaves, in a bowl and toss.
Refrigerate until serving time.
On individual salad plates, place a lettuce leaf and then fill with a portion of the salad; or serve in large bowl (no lettuce leaves needed).
Cabbage adds a crispy texture to the fruits in this simply prepared salad.
Serves 6.

title: Cabbage And Tomato Skillet(Serves 4)
steps: Cook bacon in skillet (large) until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon; set aside.
Add remaining ingredients in skillet; cook over medium heat, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in bacon.

title: Nanny'S Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.
Wet bottom of glass and flatten cookies.
Bake at 350° for 10 or 15 minutes or less.

title: Egg Nog(Serves 6)
steps: Mix eggs with sugar and salt.
Add milk and vanilla. Serve cold in tall glasses with nutmeg sprinkled on top.

title: Curry Dip
steps: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients.
Cover.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Serve with vegetable dippers. Makes 2 cups.

title: Nanie'S Banana Bread
steps: Cream the shortening, eggs, flour, soda, sugar, salt, then mashed bananas and chopped nuts.
Grease loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 70 to 80 minutes.

title: Bonbons Mound Candy
steps: Roll the first 6 ingredients into small balls.
Combine the chocolate and paraffin together in a double boiler. Dip balls into the chocolate mixture and put chocolate balls on wax paper until hardened.

title: Whole-Wheat Irish Soda Bread
steps: Note:
Bake bread the same day you plan to serve it.

title: Heavenly Hash Candy

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips (1 c.)

ingredients.name: up pecan
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cut up pecans or another kind of nut

steps: Mix the sugar, milk and corn syrup in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to a boil (mixture will be bubbling all over top). Boil and stir another 2 minutes more. Take off heat. Stir in the chocolate chips until completely melted. Cool about 15 minutes.
Stir in the pecans and marshmallows. Drop by 2 teaspoons onto wax paper.
Chill until firm or put in a buttered pan and cut into pieces.

title: Caramel Delight Pie
steps: In a skillet, brown pecans and coconut in butter; set aside. Blend cream cheese and condensed milk together.
Add all of the Cool Whip.
Divide into pie crusts.
Top with the coconut-pecan mixture, then drizzle the caramel topping over the top.
Keep refrigerated.

title: Coconut Refrigerator Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine white
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines white or yellow cake mix

steps: Cake Mix:
Mix and bake according to directions.
Bake in 2 layers.
Let cool and split each layer, making 4 layers.

title: Microwave Fruit Salad
steps: Combine pudding mix and 1 cup fruit juice.
Microwave, uncovered, for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring every minute.
Add pineapple and oranges.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Add bananas when ready to serve.
Decorate with maraschino cherries.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole

ingredients.name: golden cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can golden cream of mushroom soup

steps: Arrange broccoli and cauliflower in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Saute onion and margarine.
Add cheese, soup and mushrooms. Simmer until cheese melts.
Pour sauce over vegetables.
Sprinkle with almonds and bread crumbs.
Bake covered at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: Cream the margarine and sugar in a mixing bowl.
Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Mix. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Beat until combined.
Pour half of the mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with half of the topping mix. Add remaining batter and topping. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Taco Layered Dip

ingredients.name: el paso refried bean
ingredients.raw: 1 large can El Paso refried beans

steps: Mix beans, seasoning mix and salsa together.
Put in a large pan.
This is the bottom layer. Top with sour cream, then avocado dip, then layer cheese and tomato on top.
Let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving.
Serve with chips.

title: Snowflake Square
steps: Cream shortening. Add sugar slowly while creaming mix.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Combine milk and almond extract. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold in. Pour into 10-inch square shallow cake pan. Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 30 minutes. Cool.
Frost as desired. Cut into squares.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender.
Drain off water, add ham, cheese, green pepper and cream of mushroom soup. Mix just enough to blend.
Put in greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Pastry
steps: Pour boiling water over shortening.
Stir well.
Sift in dry ingredients and stir until nothing sticks to bowl.
May be chilled in a large ball or divided into smaller ones.
Wrap in foil before chilling.
Keeps well in refrigerator.
Roll to desired size for pie.

title: Aunt Mollie'S Salmon Loaf

ingredients.name: salmon with juice skin and bone removed
ingredients.raw: 1 can salmon with juices, skin and bones removed

steps: Mix all ingredients together (except parsley flakes).
Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
Use parsley to garnish top of casserole.
Serves 2 "oink-oinks" or 3 normals.

title: Quick Meal
steps: Cook potatoes, onions and ground beef in skillet on medium heat until redness is gone from meat, stirring constantly, so potatoes and onions won't scorch.
Add small amount of water, 1/2 cup.
Season to taste.

title: Holiday Nuts
steps: Toast nuts at 325° for 15 minutes.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold in sugar and salt.
Slowly fold nuts into mixture and mix until coated.

title: Shrimp Mold
steps: Soften cream cheese to room temperature.
Mix all ingredients together.
Shape into round or square shape on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours.
Place on serving dish and remove waxed paper.
Serve with crackers.

title: Artichoke Quiche
steps: Drain oil from artichoke hearts.
Reserve hearts.
Put oil into frying pan.
Heat.
Chop scallions and fry in oil until limp. Drain oil, reserve scallions.

title: Johnnycakes
steps: In large bowl, put flour, corn meal, baking powder and salt in bowl; set aside.
Beat shortening, sugar and eggs; beat well.
Add the milk, then the flour mixture.
Drop a spoonful of batter onto the frying pan with a large spoon.
Brown the cakes on both sides by turning them with the spatula.

title: Oven Steamed Rice
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 2-quart ungreased casserole dish with a tight fitting lid, mix rice, salt and pepper.
Dot with butter.
Pour boiling water over rice.
Stir to melt butter. Bake, covered, 45 minutes (do not lift lid).
Add green onions. Mix lightly.
To serve, fluff up rice lightly with fork.
Serves 6.

title: Easy Soup

ingredients.name: any brand dry vegetable soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box any brand dry vegetable soup mix

steps: Brown beef, then add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer until done.
Serves 6.

title: Saucepan Cookies
steps: Pour melted shortening over brown sugar and add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch pan.
Let cool 10 minutes.
Cut into squares and remove from pan when cold.

title: English Pea Salad

ingredients.name: english pea
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 to 16 oz.) can English peas, drained

ingredients.name: or more tbsp. mayo
ingredients.raw: 2 or more Tbsp. mayo or salad dressing

steps: Toss all ingredients together in medium bowl.
Chill before serving.

title: French Cheeseburger
steps: Slice the bread lengthwise and hull out loaf (top and bottom). Brown hamburger and onions, then add catsup.
Spoon into bottom part of the bread.
Put a slice of cheese on top of meat.
Place top of bread on sandwich, then roll in plastic wrap.
Place in oven and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Slice and serve with salad.

title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce
steps: Blend ingredients; refrigerate if desired.
Heat over hot water before serving.
Yields about 1 cup sauce.

title: Prime Rib Roast Beef

ingredients.name: dry good season italian dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry Good Seasons Italian dressing mix

ingredients.name: roast
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 lb. roast (frozen and cut to fit in crock-pot)

steps: Mix first 3 ingredients with 3 cups water.
Put frozen roast in crock-pot.
Pour liquid mixture over it.
Put lid on and cook on low overnight.
Serve.
Cut in thin slices on Kaiser buns.
Use juice to dip sandwich in.

title: Mom'S Million Dollar Fudge
steps: Combine sugar and milk; bring to full rolling boil.
Boil and stir for 4 1/2 minutes.
Break up chocolate and mix with other ingredients.
Pour hot syrup over all ingredients and stir.
Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Mounds Bars

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: Mix coconut, milk, sugar and butter together.
Spread in a sheet cake or cookie pan.
Put in freezer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Remove; cut into bars.
Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler.
Dip bars into chocolate mixture (I dip them with a toothpick).
Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Banana Dream Pie

ingredients.name: jell o banana cream instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. Jell-O banana cream instant pudding

steps: Prepare Dream Whip with 1 cup of milk as directed on package, using a large mixer bowl.
Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Blend, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes, scraping bowl. Spoon into pie crust. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Frosted Graham Crackers
steps: Fill an 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with graham crackers.
Boil 1 cup butter and 1 cup brown sugar for a few minutes.
Add 1/2 cup ground nuts to mixture.
Pour over graham crackers and spread evenly.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.
Cut while warm.

title: Hawaiian Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained

steps: Beat cream cheese at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy; stir in remaining ingredients.
Serve on crackers or bread.
Yield:
3 1/4 cups.

title: Pink Stuff
steps: Mix ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill for 1 hour.

title: Special Potato Dish
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, mix all ingredients together.
Chill overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Soup
steps: Cook ground meat until browned.
Drain and add taco seasoning, stirring well. Add tomato sauce and chopped tomatoes.
Stir in corn and simmer over low heat 30 to 45 minutes.
Serve with crackers.
Serves 6.

title: Mozzarella Munchies
steps: Mix the cheese, onion and Miracle Whip together and spread on party rye.
Put under the boiler to slightly brown and bubbly. Serve.

title: Cherry Pie(Makes 10 Pies.)
steps: Combine sugar, tapioca, salt and almond flavor.
Mix thoroughly with fruit and fruit juices before pouring into shells. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Arkansas Beans

ingredients.name: van camp s pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (46 oz.) can Van Camp's pork and beans

ingredients.name: barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. barbecue sauce (tangy hot or mild)

steps: Fry hamburger meat in large skillet.
Drain off fat.
Pour pork and beans in with hamburger meat, then barbecue sauce.
Heat thoroughly.

title: Sauteed Zucchini
steps: Heat skillet.
Put in oil.
Heat and put in garlic, zucchini, salt and pepper. Cook few minutes until tender.
Great taste.

title: Barley With Ham
steps: Simmer ham in water until ham loosens from bone.
Discard bone and fat.
Add barley and onion.
Cook until barley is tender, about 1 hour.
Serves 2 as a main course.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Chip Bars
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cookie pan and preheat oven to 350°. Prepare Toll House cookie dough as directed on package of chocolate chips.
Place 3/4 of dough on bottom of pan.
Mix together cream cheese, sugar and beaten eggs.
Pour over top of dough in pan. Glob on the rest of the dough.
Bake for 30 minutes and touch to see if dough springs back.
May need to bake for 40 minutes.

title: Biscuits For Your Dog
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well, roll out and cut with "bone" shaped cookie cutter.
Bake at 300° until very hard.
Fido will love these!

title: Cowboy'S Delight(Pineapple Dessert)
steps: Mix together the vanilla wafers and 1/4 cup melted butter and pack into an 8 x 8-inch dessert dish.
Cream the powdered sugar and 1/2 cup butter.
Add eggs and beat 10 minutes.
Beat whipping cream until stiff (could use Cool Whip).
Add drained crushed pineapple and nuts (if desired).
Mix the sugar, butter and egg mixture.
Top with pineapple mixture.
Decorate with vanilla wafer crumbs, whipping cream, cherries and nuts.
Refrigerate for 8 hours.

title: Barbecued Hamburger-Bean Casserole
steps: Cook hamburger with onion until brown, then drain.
Stir in brown sugar, salt, barbecue sauce and pork and beans and heat through.
Place in casserole.
Separate biscuits and cut in half. Sprinkle with cheese, then arrange over hamburger mixture.
Bake in preheated 425° oven until biscuits are brown.

title: Sarah Matt'S Onion Soup

ingredients.name: stew meat in bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless stew meat, cut in bite size pieces

ingredients.name: oil sugar flour salt red pepper and mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: oil, sugar, flour, salt, crushed red pepper and Mozzarella cheese

steps: Place butter and one "plop" of oil in a large kettle.
Cut up onions and saute in kettle.
Add salt as desired and 1 spoon sugar for flavor and browning.
When onions are soft and brown, sprinkle 2 spoonfuls (1 at a time) of flour and mix into onions.
It will be pasty.
Add meat and brown, about 30 minutes.
Add 4 cans of broth and 4 cans of water.
Add 3 to 4 bay leaves and a few sprinkles of red pepper.
Bring mix to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat to simmer for as long as you would like.
Serve in bowls with torn pieces of bread and cheese, letting the cheese melt.
Enjoy!

title: Classic Potato Salad

ingredients.name: and potato
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cooked, peeled and cubed potatoes (5 to 6 medium)

steps: In a large bowl, stir together the first 5 ingredients until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients.
Toss to coat well.
Cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors.
Makes about 5 cups.

title: Irish Champ

ingredients.name: potato preferably yukon gold
ingredients.raw: 6-8 potatoes, preferably Yukon Gold or Yellow Fins

steps: Peel and slice potatoes.
Just cover with salted water and boil until tender.

title: Tapioca Pudding
steps: Boil tapioca, water and salt for 1/2 hour.
Two hours later, add jello and sugar.
When cool, top with whipped cream and fruit. Mix in marshmallows.

title: Crumb Cake
steps: Beat eggs until light and frothy. Add sugar and beat.
Mix baking powder and graham cracker crumbs. Then add to mixture.
Add vanilla and then the nuts.
Pour into 2 layer cake pans.
Bake at 325° for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sailboat Salad
steps: Wash lettuce leaves and stack on four salad plates.
Cut the cantaloupe in half and scoop out the seeds.
Cut each half into half.
Place each piece in the "green sea" of lettuce.
Cut the 2 slices of cheese in half diagonally (from corner to corner).
Use a toothpick and make a sail with the cheese and then "raise the sail" on each "boat".

title: Walt And Roberta'S Favorite Seven Layer Cookies Or Hello Dollys
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Sprinkle cracker crumbs over melted butter, then spread crumbs with chocolate chips, then butterscotch chips.
Sprinkle coconut over this, followed by the milk poured evenly over the coconut and add the chopped pecans on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool and cut in 1 1/2-inch squares.
Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Yields approximately 3 dozen.

title: Low-Fat Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Peel and slice potatoes; layer in baking dish with flour and salt and pepper.
Cover with canned milk.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: butter bread
ingredients.raw: 8 slices buttered bread, cut into cubes

ingredients.name: link sausage brown and bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. link sausage, browned and bite size cut

steps: Salt and pepper lightly.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Put bread, sausage and cheese into pan.
Pour egg mixture (beat eggs, 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard) into pan.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Self Crust Egg Custard
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Add to well-beaten eggs.
Add milk, evaporated milk, melted butter, salt and vanilla flavoring and mix well.
Grease a 9-inch pie pan with butter; pour mixture in pan and sprinkle with nutmeg if desired.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Appetizers

ingredients.name: apricot preserve
ingredients.raw: 1 small jar apricot preserves (peach or pineapple)

steps: Mix soup, dressing and preserves in bowl.
Put chicken in a 13 x 9-inch loaf pan.
Cover with mixture.
Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Main Dish Salad
steps: Make tossed salad.
Cut up egg and cheese in salad or add cottage cheese to salad.
Add dressing.
Serves 1.

title: Veggie Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill for 4 hours or overnight.
Serve with assorted raw veggies.

title: Washington Favorite Senate Bean Soup
steps: Put beans in a large pot.
Add the 2 or better quarts of water and soak overnight.
Next day, drain the beans and add more water, more than cover.
Add the ham bone to the beans and water, cover and simmer for 2 hours.
Remove the ham bone from pot and chop the meat and return it to the pot.
Then add onion, potato, celery and garlic.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Be sure there is enough water, cook for another hour.

title: Sassy Cinnamon Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Combine egg, milk and oil. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients.
Fill greased muffin pan 2/3 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Yields 12 muffins.

title: Cinnamon Rolls "Ready In The Morning"
steps: At 4 p.m., boil first 4 ingredients together.
Set in sink in water to cool.
In a big bowl, dissolve the yeast in water.
Stir in cooled mixture, 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to handle easily.
Put in a greased bowl and let rise.
At 9 to 10 p.m., punch down.
Roll out in rectangle; spread with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (3 tablespoons cinnamon, 1 cup sugar and 1 cup brown sugar).
Roll up and cut.
Makes about 40 if cut about 1-inch.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
steps: Prepare angel food cake according to directions.
Just before baking, add red food coloring and stir into cake.
Bake according to directions.
Combine egg whites, sugar and strawberries in top of double boiler; beat with mixer to mix.
Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with mixer.
Cook 7 minutes, or until mixture stands in peaks.
Remove from boiling water; beat until cool.
Fold in 2/3 cup strawberries.
Spread over cake.

title: Garlic Pork Roast

ingredients.name: pork loin roast backbone loosened
ingredients.raw: 1 pork loin roast, backbone loosened (about 5 lb.)

steps: With a sharp knife, cut deep pockets between each rib on meaty side of roast.
Combine green peppers, green onion, celery and garlic; stuff deeply into pockets.
Season roast with salt and cayenne pepper.
Insert meat thermometer.
Place roast, rib side down, in a shallow roasting pan.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 to 3 hours or until thermometer reads 170°.
Let stand 15 minutes before carving.

title: Hershey Easy Pie

ingredients.name: reese miniature peanut butter cup unwrapped
ingredients.raw: 20 reeses miniatures peanut butter cups, unwrapped

ingredients.name: tub non dairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 large tub (12 oz.) frozen non-dairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: Chop each peanut butter cup into 6 pieces, set aside. Microwave kisses in medium microwave safe bowl on high 1 minute or just until chocolate is melted when stirred, stir in 3 1/2 c. whipped topping until blended.
Spread half of chocolate mixture into crust, sprinkle with peanut better cup pieces.
Top with remaining chocolate mixture.
Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Snickers Cake
steps: Mix cake according to directions.
Pour half
of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk and butter over low heat.
Pour caramel mixture over baked cake.
Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts and all of chocolate chips over mixture.
Pour remaining batter over this. Sprinkle with rest of the nuts and bake 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge(Small Batch, Can Be Doubled)
steps: Remove from heat and add 1/2 stick butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Let cool to 135°.
Add peanut butter.
Mix well.
Pour into buttered dish.
It should be getting stiff as you mix it up. It does not take long to set up.

title: Chili Beans
steps: Put meat in shortening, then add chopped onion and garlic. Next, add the kidney beans, tomato soup and seasonings.
Heat thoroughly.
Just before serving, top with cheese and place under the broiler to melt cheese.

title: Macaroni Cheese Pie
steps: Cook macaroni until tender.
Grate block cheese in bowl.
Mix powdered cheese, milk and eggs together.
Layer macaroni, then cheese alternately in casserole dish.
Pour mixture on top.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook at 450° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
steps: Mix all together and cook over medium heat until tender.
If cabbage seems to be quite moist, cut water by 1/2 cup.

title: Jollof Rice
steps: Brown beef in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven.
Drain.
Add chicken, broth, mushrooms, rice, onion, green pepper, barbecue sauce and seasoning; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender.
Add tomatoes; mix lightly.

title: Spanish Rice(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
steps: Cook rice in boiling salted water until tender. Fry 1/2 cup bacon until crisp. Add onion and green pepper; simmer until onion is soft and yellow. Add tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper. Pour rice into strainer and rinse with hot running water. Add rice to onions, bacon and green pepper mixture. Mix well and pour into greased casserole dish.
Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Slush

ingredients.name: raspberry
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 c. fresh or frozen unsweetened raspberries

ingredients.name: raspberry ginger ale
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. raspberry ginger ale or additional ginger ale

steps: In a large saucepan, cook the cranberries and 1 1/2 cups water over medium heat until the berries pop, about 15 minutes. Stir in raspberries. Transfer to a blender or food processor; cover and process until smooth. Strain and discard seeds, reserving juice. Pour the juice into a 2-quart freezer-proof container; set aside. In a small
saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over remaining water. Let stand for 1 minute. Stir in sugar.
Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Add to berry juice. Stir in ginger ale; cover and freeze.

title: Chicken Noodle Dumplings
steps: Boil chicken.
Debone.
Add 2 cans cream of chicken soup to broth.
Add noodle dumplings.
Cook until tender.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Skillet Sausage And Sauerkraut
steps: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sliced meats.
Cook 2 to 4 minutes, stirring until brown.
Add broth and stir 30 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix.
Cover and simmer over moderately low heat 10 minutes, until hot and flavors blend.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.
Contains 311 calories.

title: Icebox Cake
steps: Save the vanilla wafer box.
Put all ingredients together and put in the box you saved; place in refrigerator.
Cool for 24 hours.
Tear box away and serve.

title: Stuffed French Bread
steps: Slice off top of loaf of bread and carve out center (keep). Brown and drain ground beef, sausage, onion and bell pepper. Combine egg, milk and bread (center).
Add to meat.
Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on bottom of bread.
Add meat mixture on top of cheese.
Add cubes of Velveeta on top of meat.
Put on top loaf. Brush with butter.
Wrap in foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Do not overbake.
Take out of foil and slice.

title: Creamy Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.name: cream of celery
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 1/2 oz.) cans cream of celery or cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: southern style hash brown
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 c. frozen Southern-style hash browns or potatoes O'Brien

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan, over medium heat, cook onion until tender.
Stir in soup and cream cheese cubes.
Cook, stirring constantly until smooth and hot.

title: Schnitzel
steps: Beat each chop with meat beater until about 1/4-inch thick. Add Season-All.
Beat eggs with fork on a flat plate.
Put breadcrumbs on another plate.
Put seasoned chops first in eggs to coat on both sides and then in breadcrumbs.
Put breaded chops in medium hot grease in frying pan and brown both sides for 5 to 7 minutes, turning each chop only once.
Enjoy.

title: Hot Dog And Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 5 c. raw potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick

steps: Place layer of half potatoes and onions and half of the hot dogs over bottom of 2-quart baking dish.
Drizzle half the margarine.
Season with salt and pepper.
Repeat, using remaining ingredients.
Pour warm milk over casserole.

title: Easy Oven Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown ground beef and strain and return to pan.
Add sauce and water, bring to a boil.
Remove from heat. In 9 x 13-inch pan add meat sauce, noodles and cottage cheese. Repeat in layers, ending in layer of cheese.
Bake 1 hour.
Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before cutting.
Makes 10 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies(Early 1900'S Recipe)
steps: Sift together all dry ingredients.
Add liquids and mix well. Roll out dough 1/8 inch thick and cut in desired shape.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450° for 7 minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Country Corn Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients, except Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° in casserole dish sprayed with Pam for approximately 45 minutes. Add the Cheddar cheese on top after half done.

title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
steps: Bake Angel Loaves.
Cool.
Cut cake crosswise into 1/2-inch slices.
Cut each slice in half and put together with matching slice of cherry-nut or vanilla ice cream.
If desired, top with chocolate sauce.
Makes 12 to 14 sandwiches.
Use remaining loaf for another dessert.

title: Hamburger Chop Suey

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. beef broth or 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 3/4 c. boiling water

ingredients.name: bird eye chinese style vegetable with seasoned sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye Chinese style vegetables with seasoned sauce

steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet; add broth, soy sauce and sugar.
Add vegetables; bring to a full boil, separating vegetables with fork, stirring frequently until sauce and cubes are blended.
Cover and simmer 2 minutes.
Bring to a boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
steps: Combine sugar, butter and evaporated milk in a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Microwave on High for 9 to 10 1/2 minutes.
Add chocolate bits and marshmallow cream.
Microwave on High for 30 seconds.
Add chopped nuts and vanilla.
Stir until chocolate pieces are melted.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Cool and cut into squares.

title: Bubble Recipe
steps: Combine, shake and let settle 4 hours.
Have fun with bubble wand.
Do not eat.

title: E-Z Pizza
steps: Chop bell pepper and green onion together, sprinkle over sauce. Add sausage, pepperoni or hamburger.
Top with cheese.
Cook about 10 minutes or until cheese begins to brown.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
steps: Grate together cucumber, carrots and onion.
Drain the juice and save.
Cream together the cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Heat juice till hot, but not boiling, let it cool in cold water, add pkg. of knox gelation and stir together, let cool again until room temperature.
Mix cucumber mix, and cream cheese mix into juice mixture.
Stir well, and then beat mixture until it is fluffy and creamy.
Refrigerate over night, salt to taste and spread onto frozen bread, trim off crust of bread and cut into finger sandwiches.

title: Currant Glazed Appetizer Franks

ingredients.name: cocktail frank
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. cocktail franks or sliced franks

steps: Heat jelly and mustard together; stir occasionally, until blended.
Add franks and heat.
Serve with toothpicks.
Use a fondue pan which keeps just the right heat but does not burn.

title: Cheese Potatoes
steps: Cook the potatoes and grate or mash with a wire potato masher. Combine cheese and butter.
Melt.
Add sour cream, onion, salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes.
Put into 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
Yummy.

title: Fruit Bread
steps: Blend together the butter and sugar and beat.
Mix flour, baking powder and soda and add to butter mixture.
Add beaten egg and gradually add buttermilk.
Fold in raisins.
Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Aunt Gin'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream together sugar, Crisco and butter and add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the creamed mixture to the flour mixture.
Add milk and vanilla.
Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, depending on oven.

title: Russian Tea(Old Recipe)

ingredients.name: lipton instant tea with lemon
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Lipton instant tea with lemon (sweetened)

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Put 4 to 5 teaspoons in cup of hot water.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert
steps: Mix together, cottage cheese and dry jello.
Beat.
Add cool whip and mandarin oranges, pour in dish.
Refrigerate for a couple of hours, then serve.

title: Dieter'S Fluff

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 medium can crushed unsweetened pineapple, drained

steps: Mix jello with cottage cheese.
Add drained pineapple.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Any flavor jello can be used.

title: Parslied Potatoes

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder

steps: Peel a strip of skin off of potatoes in the middle.
Place potatoes in cold water.
Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil.
Saut onion and garlic for approximately 5 minutes. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley; bring to a boil.
Place potatoes (one layer) in skillet.
Return to boil.
Reduce heat.
Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes with slotted spoon to a serving bowl.
Add pepper to skillet mixture; stir.
Pour over potatoes.
Sprinkle with remaining parsley.

title: Lettie'S Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Combine first five ingredients and cook until it forms a soft ball.
Add peanut butter.
Grease cookie sheet.
Pour.
Cut in squares.

title: Garlic Pasta
steps: Chop the garlic and saute in the olive oil.
Do not burn the garlic.
Add the pinch of red pepper flakes to the olive oil and garlic.
Pour the olive oil mixture over the cooked spaghetti. Add the cheese and parsley flakes and toss.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake

ingredients.name: gumdrop
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. gumdrops or orange slices, cut with scissors dipped in hot water

ingredients.name: raisin
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. raisins or dates (can use both)

steps: Heat milk and melt marshmallows in double boiler.
Mix crushed graham crackers, candy, raisins and nuts together.
Add milk and marshmallow mixture; mix well.
Put in a well buttered 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Rotini
steps: Brown and drain ground beef, onion, salt and pepper.
Add Prego, tomato juice, oregano and sweet basil; simmer 20 minutes. Cook macaroni until tender and drain.
Grate cheese.
Layer in 2-quart casserole dish the meat sauce, macaroni, cheese, macaroni and meat sauce.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Add remaining cheese on top and bake until melted.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Ham Balls
steps: Combine all together.
Shape into fairly large balls.
Place in shallow dish and bake after pouring sauce over them at 325° for 2 hours.

title: 24-Hour Cucumber Pickles
steps: Cut cucumbers in thin slices and soak in lime water for 12 to 14 hours.
Wash and soak in salt water for four hours.
Bring to a boil in strong alum water.
Pour off alum water and dip in hot boiling water.
Combine spices (in a bag), sugar, vinegar and cucumbers and simmer for 25 minutes.
Let cool.
Pack in jars and seal.
Makes 10 to 11 pints.

title: Easy Holiday Salad

ingredients.name: or pkg. raspberry jello
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small pkg. raspberry jello

steps: Make jello as usual, using 2 cups boiling water; stir until dissolved.
Add frozen raspberries; stir until mixed.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Pour half of mixture into dish.
Chill until firm.
Mix softened cream cheese with small amount of sour cream. Spread over jello mixture.
Top with rest of jello mixture. Chill.
Cut into squares.

title: Turkey Salad

ingredients.name: turkey breast
ingredients.raw: 1/2 turkey breasts or any part of meat equal to 1/2 breast

steps: Cook turkey until tender, debone as soon as cool enough.
Put in refrigerator to get cold.
Chop all ingredients in food processor individually, removing to mixing bowl.
Add all ingredients.
Mix well.
Refrigerate until ready to be served.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Drain.
Add stewed tomatoes and tomato juice.
Add spices to taste.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Fall Ratatouille Recipe

ingredients.name: each eggplant onion red pepper and zucchini
ingredients.raw: Cut 1 each, medium eggplant, onion, red pepper and zucchini into chunks

ingredients.name: kraft special collection sun tomato dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. Kraft Special Collections Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing

ingredients.name: low sodium tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 can (16 oz.) undrained low-sodium diced tomatoes

ingredients.name: reduced fat parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. reduced fat Parmesan cheese, shredded

ingredients.name: reduced fat mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. reduced fat Mozzarella cheese, shredded

steps: Saute vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, cook about 15 minutes, allowing some of the liquid to evaporate.
Top with cheeses and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Irish Potato Cakes

ingredients.name: potato very fine
ingredients.raw: 4 raw medium potatoes, grated very fine

steps: Mix all together and form into little cakes.
Fry in butter until brown.
Serve hot with syrup or butter.

title: Granny'S Lazy Daisy Cake
steps: Beat first 4 ingredients together.
Boil last 2 ingredients, add to egg mixture and mix well.
Bake in a 350° oven until done.

title: Prune Cake

ingredients.name: and prune
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cooked and drained prunes, chopped (save juice)

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix mix as directed
ingredients.raw: 1 box yellow cake mix, mix as directed

steps: Beat prunes, cake mix, cinnamon and nutmeg real hard.
Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
While cake is hot, poke holes in cake layer. Mix buttermilk, sugar and melted margarine together; pour over the cake.
Heat and stir until all sugar is melted.
Bake in pan that the cake can stay in until all is eaten.

title: Missy Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. pkg. frozen hash browns, thawed

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 10 3/4 oz. can cream of celery soup

steps: Combine first 7 ingredients.
Spoon into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until bubbly.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: Yeast Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening until fine.
Heat milk, lukewarm only.
Dissolve yeast in milk.
Mix with dry ingredients and knead well. Roll out 1/4-inch thick.
Cut in rounds or squares.
(I prefer squares.)
Brush with butter and top with another round or square and butter top.
Let rise a few minutes before baking at 350°.

title: Pilaf Rice
steps: Saute onion in butter in large skillet until tender, but not brown, about 5 minutes.
Add rice and saute for 3 minutes.
Add bouillon
and salt.
Bring to boil.
Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with a fork.

title: Bourbon Bread Pudding
steps: Cube bread; soak in milk.
Add sugar, eggs, vanilla, chopped apple, raisins and margarine.
Mix all together with hands.
Put in buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until firm.

title: Cheddar Baked Potatoes

ingredients.name: baking potato
ingredients.raw: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices

steps: In smal bowl, combine soup, paprika and pepper.
In a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with cheese.
Spoon soup mixture over cheese.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Uncover.
Bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
steps: Cream the sugar with the oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beating until well blended.
Add flour sifted with the baking powder. Pour 1/2 into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

Spread the cherry pie filling over the dough. Sprinkle lightly with sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining dough and sprinkle with more cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes. Drizzle with powdered sugar glaze when still slightly warm.

title: Pecan Balls
steps: Mix well.
Roll to size of walnut or smaller.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Super Hash Brown Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes, shredded (not diced)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup

steps: Mix hash brown potatoes, grated Cheddar cheese and chopped onion together.
Mix sour cream, soup and melted margarine together.
Combine potato mixture and soup mixture in large bowl. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over the top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Everyone loves it.

title: N.Y.  Cheesecake
steps: Mix all ingredients in order given, beating well after each. Pour in well-greased 10-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Shut off oven.
Leave in oven for 2 hours.
(Total:
3 hours; do not open oven door from start to end!!)

title: Southern Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: egg plu tbsp. milk
ingredients.raw: 1 egg plus 2 Tbsp. milk or water, beaten

steps: Wash chicken; drain on paper towel.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dip in egg mixture.
Add spices to flour; coat chicken.
Fry slowly in hot oil until browned on both sides (about 35 minutes), turning as needed.

title: Quick Tea Mix
steps: To use, add 1 teaspoon of spiced tea mixture per cup of boiling water.
Package tea in small jars.
Use a ribbon to tie a cinnamon stick (used to stir tea) to top of jar along with instructions on how to use mix.

title: King Casserole
steps: Place in baking dish layer of chicken and Doritos.
Mix in chopped onion, soup and tomatoes together.
Pour over chicken and Doritos.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Green Bean Supreme
steps: Drain green beans.
Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart casserole.
Bake 10 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: dry ranch style dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry Ranch style dressing mix

ingredients.name: roasted sunflower seed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. roasted, unsalted sunflower seeds or chopped pecans

steps: Combine all ingredients, except sunflower seeds or nuts. Refrigerate until firm enough to handle.
Form into ball and roll in sunflower seeds or nuts.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Eggplant Moussaka

ingredients.name: or eggplant and unpeeled
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 medium eggplants, cut into large chunks and unpeeled

steps: Steam eggplants for 2 to 3 minutes.
Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and celery in vegetable oil.
Add tomatoes and cook briefly (5 to 10 minutes).
Add to mixture the cracked wheat cereal and simmer 20 minutes or so until cereal is cooked.
(Add tomatoes or tomato sauce, if liquid evaporates).

title: Bloody Mary
steps: Shake with cracked ice.
Strain into 6 ounce glass.

title: Low-Fat Chicken In Mushroom Gravy

ingredients.name: healthy request mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can Healthy Request mushroom soup

steps: Remove all visible fat from chicken breasts.
Place in casserole which has been sprayed with Pam.
Top with condensed mushroom soup and add pepper to taste.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.
(No additional salt is needed.
Can substitute Healthy Request condensed chicken soup if desired.)

title: Na-Cho Ordinary Potatoes
steps: In square baking dish covered with plastic wrap, steam potatoes with 2 tablespoons water for 10 minutes on High in microwave, stirring halfway through.
Toss with oleo and seasonings.
Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cups cheese.
Microwave for 2 minutes on High.
Top with chips and remaining cheese.
Cook for 2 minutes and 30 seconds on 50% power.

title: Crabmeat Quiche

ingredients.name: crabmeat
ingredients.raw: 1 c. crabmeat or 1 (7 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, drained

steps: Combine mayonnaise, flour, milk and beaten eggs; stir until well blended.
Then add remaining ingredients.
Pour into the pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Spoon Bread
steps: Sift meal with salt and add boiling water.
Add butter and stir until smooth.
Add beaten eggs and milk.
Sprinkle baking powder over top and stir quickly into batter.
Pour into greased pan or pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour for large pan or 45 to 50 minutes for 2 pie pan or 1/2 recipe.

title: Meatball Appetizers
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Make into balls the size of meatballs.
Cook on a broiler pan at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes about 30 meatballs.

title: Yeast Dough For Sweet Buns And Cherry Bread

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.raw: 3 whole eggs or 1 whole egg and 4 yolks

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sugar (3/4 c. for less sweet dough)

steps: Mix together yeast, milk and flour.
Let stand until spongy (20 to 30 minutes).
In a large bowl, put eggs, salt and sugar. Mix well, then add 4 cups flour.

You'll have a very soft dough. Next, add your first mixture. Beat with a spoon. Add 1/2 cup melted butter. Work butter into the dough mixture until smooth. Knead on floured surface, adding 1 more cup flour until smooth and elastic. Dough is kneaded enough when it becomes shiny and has little air pockets or bubbles in the surface.
Put dough in greased bowl and turn, leaving greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and make cinnamon buns or Cherry Bread.

title: Golden Medley Orange Candied Yams

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: In saucepan, melt butter or margarine.
Add almonds, brown sugar and orange juice; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add yams; sprinkle with salt.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes, spooning sauce over frequently.
Garnish with orange sections. Makes about 8 to 10 servings.

title: Grandmothers Tea Cakes
steps: Sift dry ingredients then cut in shortening.
Add eggs, milk, and vanilla.
Roll out dough and cut as desired.
Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
steps: Place rhubarb in pastry shell.
Blend together egg, sugar, salt, tapioca and sour cream.
Pour over rhubarb and bake.

title: Coss Hot Cider
steps: Make in a 12-cup drip coffee maker glass pot or any 12-cup container.
Mix together apple cider, apple juice, lemon juice, cinnamon and cloves.
Serve hot.
This can be heated in a microwave or on top of the stove.
Keep hot on a drip coffee maker.

title: Butter Stickies(From Connie'S Biscuit Mix)
steps: Make the same way as biscuits, but roll the dough into an oblong shape.
Spread top with melted margarine.
Sprinkle with generous amounts of cinnamon, sugar and brown sugar.
Roll jelly roll fashion and cut into 1/2-inch slices.
Put in greased pan; adding 1 tablespoon water to bottom.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes; turn out onto plate.

title: Chicken Salad (For Two)

ingredients.name: swanson s premium chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) can Swanson's premium chunk chicken, drained

steps: In medium bowl, gently stir together chicken, apple, celery and raisins.
In cup, stir together dressing and brown sugar; pour over chicken mixture.
Toss gently to coat.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
Yields 1 1/2 cups or 2 servings.

title: Angel Hair Pasta And Tomato Vinaigrette
steps: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine tomatoes, garlic, basil, oil, vinegar and red pepper flakes in skillet.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until tomatoes are barely heated through and still firm, about 3 minutes.
Pour over drained pasta.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Mix together in a large bowl eggs and sugar.
Add salad oil, flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, pumpkin and vanilla.
Put mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased and floured pan and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Mamaw'S Yeast Rolls

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. shortening (add to hot water and let melt)

steps: Take sugar, salt and yeast, mix with flour; add the water. Mix until it gets like bread dough.
Keep adding flour until it is thick enough to knead.
Put in greased bowl and let rise until double.
Roll out and cut into biscuits.
Bake at 350° until golden brown; brush with butter.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles Or Peppers

ingredients.name: unpeeled cucumber
ingredients.raw: 25 sliced unpeeled cucumbers or 45 red and green peppers

ingredients.name: white onion
ingredients.raw: 15 small white onions or 3 large onions sliced

steps: In large pan, cover cucumbers or peppers and onions with salt. Fill pan with water.
Let stand for 2 hours.
Bring cider vinegar, celery seed, mustard seed, powdered ginger, turmeric and sugar to a rolling boil.
Add drained cucumbers and onions.
Heat just to boiling and pack in hot, sterilized jars.

title: Smicker Cake

ingredients.name: german chocolate cake mix mixed as on
ingredients.raw: 1 German chocolate cake mix, mixed as on box

steps: Mix cake, put half of cake batter in pan and bake.
While cake is baking, melt caramels with milk and butter.
When cake is done, pour caramel, chocolate chips and pecans on top then pour other half of batter on top and bake until done.

title: K F C   Biscuits
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Shape into biscuits.
Bake at 450° for 16 to 18 minutes.
Makes 6 biscuits.

title: Carrot Cake 2
steps: Sift together flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon, then add eggs, oil, carrots and nuts.
