Mix all together well.
Pour into angel food cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Quick Carrot Bars

ingredients.name: pillsbury carrot and spice cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Pillsbury carrot and spice cake mix

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan (jelly roll pan) or two 8 or 9-inch square pans.
In a large bowl, blend oil, eggs and applesauce 1 minute on low speed.
Add cake mix; blend until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in raisins. Pour into prepared pan; spread evenly. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool completely.
Frost with cream cheese frosting. Sprinkle with nuts.
Makes 36 bars.

title: Velvet Salad

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.raw: 1 small box lime or orange Jell-O

steps: Drain pineapple and save juice.
Boil Jell-O and pineapple juice for one minute.
Let cool and mix all ingredients together; refrigerate.

title: Chicken Potato And Cheddar Bake

ingredients.name: unpeeled potato
ingredients.raw: 13 oz pkg frozen unpeeled potato slices

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Spray a 13x9 baking dish.
Place chicken in baking dish, sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Spread broccoli and 1 1/2 c. cheese over chicken.
Place potatoes on top; bake 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1/2 c. of cheese; bake 5 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Steamed Cabbage
steps: Cut up cabbage, then rinse in cold water.
Drain and put in 5-quart pot.
Add chopped onion, salt and pepper.
Cover pot and let cook on medium-high until cabbage is tender.
Stir often.

title: Russian Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Use as a dressing for a salad.

title: Light Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water.
Put sugar, shortening and salt in container you are making rolls in.
Add 1 cup boiling water to mixture.
Stir until dissolved.
Add 1 cup cold water.
Stir in yeast mixture.
Beat egg and add to mixture. Add flour, 1 cup at a time, stirring.
Cover and refrigerate.

title: Toffee Bar Dip

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/4 - 1/2 c. brown sugar, packed (more or less depending on how sweet you like things)

steps: Crush Heath bars.
Combine all ingredients together and mix.
Graham crackers and apples are great to dip.

title: Cheese Cakes
steps: Blend together with electric beater.
Spoon on vanilla wafer about 2/3 full in a cup cake paper.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: 4 Layer Coconut Dessert

ingredients.name: coconut
ingredients.raw: 2 small boxes coconut or vanilla pudding

steps: 1st Layer:
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; dump in flour and coconut and spread mixture in bottom of pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool completely.

title: Teriyaki Marinade Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour over meat and let stand at least 2 hours.
Refrigerate.

title: Chicken A La King
steps: Melt butter in a heavy 2-quart saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Remove from heat; stir in chicken broth gradually. Add cream.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add chicken and pimento.
Heat to serving temperature.
Serve immediately over toast or in patty shells.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
steps: Melt butter in baking dish.
Add one ingredient on top of each other.
Bake 25 or 30 minutes at 325°.
Let cool; cut in squares.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
steps: Mix above ingredients and press in cookie sheet with sides. Melt 1 stick butter with 12 ounces chocolate chips.
Spread over mixture and chill for at least 4 hours, better if overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Candy
steps: Combine sugar, butter and milk; roll into a ball on waxed paper.
Put small amount of powdered sugar on paper to keep from sticking.
Roll out ball and spread with peanut butter.
Roll out with fingers into a long roll and wrap in waxed paper.
Put in refrigerator to harden.
Cut into small pieces.

title: Cheesies Potatoes
steps: Melt margarine in pan.
Quarter 6 potatoes.
In a bag, shake potatoes, cheese and flour until potatoes are coated.
Place in pan and bake until brown.
Bake at 450° for 30 minutes in 10 x 12-inch pan.

title: Baked Brie In Phyllo

ingredients.name: brie
ingredients.raw: 1 small round Brie (can use Camembert cheese)

ingredients.name: phyllo dough thawed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. frozen phyllo dough (10 to 12 sheets), thawed

ingredients.name: red and green grape apple pear
ingredients.raw: red and green grapes, apples, pears (optional)

steps: Wrap the Brie in thawed phyllo dough, brushing each sheet with butter and keeping unused phyllo covered with a damp cloth.
Turn the cheese over after applying each sheet of phyllo for even distribution.
Brush phyllo wrapped Brie with butter.
Cover and refrigerate.
Before serving, place the phyllo wrapped cheese in a shallow baking dish.
Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Garnish with fresh dill and fruit. Serves 20 to 30.

title: Fruit And Nut Pies(Christmas Pie)

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Combine cherries and pineapple in a saucepan.
Add sugar and flour.
Cook until thickened.
Sprinkle orange jello over mixture and stir until dissolved.
Cool mixture slightly.
Add bananas and pecans or walnuts.
Pour into the pie shells.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle #2
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° until firm.

title: Crullers

ingredients.name: philadelphia cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened

steps: Combine cream cheese and margarine, mixing until well greased. Add flour and salt; mix well.
Shape dough into ball; chill 1 hour.
On lightly floured surface, roll dough to 12 x 6-inch strips.
Fry in deep hot oil, 375° for 1 to 2 minutes or golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Roll in sugar.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Homemade Hot Cocoa
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients; blend well. Store in a tightly covered container.
Makes 3 3/4 cups mix (15 to 16 servings).

title: Creamy Ham And Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: velveeta shell and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Velveeta shells and cheese dinner

steps: Prepare dinner as directed on package.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Chill.
Add additional salad dressing before serving if desired.
Yields 4 servings (you can add tuna instead of ham).

title: Rutabaga Magic

ingredients.name: or lb. rutabaga and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. or 2 lb. rutabaga, peeled and chopped

steps: Combine all ingredients except butter with water to cover in saucepan.
Cook until tender; drain.
Mash with butter and serve immediately.

title: Ground Beef And Noodle Casserole
steps: Brown beef, garlic salt, salt and pepper.
Add tomato soup and then add sour cream and cream cheese.
Mix and add noodles.
Put in large casserole dish.
Top with grated sharp cheese.
Heat in moderate oven until bubbly.

title: Tangy Ham Dip
steps: Mix sour cream, deviled ham, chopped chives, horseradish and Worcestershire sauce in bowl.
Blend well.
Chill for 1 hour. Serve with potato or corn chips.

title: Lazy Housewife Pickles
steps: Mix well and refrigerate.
Ready to eat in a few hours.
Keeps well a long time, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Orange Slice Cookie
steps: Dice the pound of orange slices and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of flour.
Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Add brown sugar and flour and salt.
Mix well and add chopped nuts. Turn batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or 9 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 340° for 35 minutes.
Cut while still warm and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Tropical Fruit Sherbet

ingredients.name: kiwi fruit and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium kiwi fruit, peeled and quartered

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed (undiluted)

steps: Mix all ingredients in electric blender or food processor until smooth (make sure the
top is on the blender or food processor).
Pour into 1
gallon
ice cream freezer and freeze according to
manufacturer's
instructions.
Serve immediately when ready.
Makes 7 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Hot Corn Salad
steps: In saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat; stir in green onion and carrot.
Cook, stirring, 1 minute; stir in corn, vinegar, sugar and zucchini.
Cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring often, until hot.

title: Twinky Cake

ingredients.name: cake mix baked as directed on
ingredients.raw: 1 cake mix, baked as directed on box

steps: Bake cake.
Let cool.
Beat other ingredients for 10 minutes. Slice your cake in layers.
Spread filling on each layer and refrigerate.

title: Terry'S Chicken Tetrazzini
steps: Prepare Oodles of Noodles according to package.
Let cook until almost all liquid is cooked out of pot.
Add cream of mushroom soup to pot. Add can of chicken to pot.
Stir all ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.
Quick and delicious.

title: No Cook, No Can Cucumber Pickles
steps: Fill 1 gallon glass or plastic jug with sliced cucumbers. Dissolve salt in enough water to cover cucumbers.
Let set for 3 days.
Pour off water, rinse 3 times in cold water.
Soak 24 hours with alum in water to cover.
Pour off and rinse 3 times in cold water.
Cover with white vinegar, let set for 7 days.
Drain vinegar off and throw away.
Rinse 1 time.
Heat 1 cup vinegar and 3 cups sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Cool and pour over cucumbers (will not cover pickles), add pickling spice and turmeric (put spice and turmeric in soft cloth tied up).
Let set for 24 hours.

title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
steps: Cut squash in half, remove seeds and bake cut-side down at 350° for 50 minutes.
In skillet, cook pork, celery and onion until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender.
Drain fat.
Stir in salt, curry powder and cinnamon.
Cook 1 minute more.
Stir in applesauce and bread cubes.
Place stuffing in squash halves; bake uncovered 20 minutes more.
Makes 2 servings.

title: Mama'S Green Junk(Beulah Thomas)

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Refrigerate.
May garnish with cut up maraschino cherries for a festive look.

title: Polynesian Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken disjointed and up
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. chicken, disjointed and cut up

steps: Fry chicken pieces in oil until brown.
Saute onions in same pan; add sherry (or other liquid).
Stir, scraping brown bits loose and blending into liquid to combine with chicken in pan.
Add crushed pineapple and water or stock and braise 25 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and bamboo shoots.
Thicken with cornstarch.
Serves 20.

title: Hamburger Goulash
steps: In skillet, saute onion in oil until tender.
Add ground beef and sprinkle with garlic salt, salt and pepper.
Brown; drain grease.
Add pork and beans, tomato sauce and hot sauce.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
steps: Place bread in greased casserole.
Brown sausage and drain grease.
Sprinkle sausage over bread.
Top with shredded cheese. Combine eggs, milk, salt and mustard with whip.
Pour over cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Delight Sauce
steps: Cook sausage until light brown and drain fat.
Combine the rest of the ingredients and simmer on low for 30 minutes.

title: Valentine Cookies
steps: Cream butter or margarine and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla and beat well.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture with milk to form a dough.
Chill.
Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut with heart shaped cookie cutter.
Place half of the cookies on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush each with water.
Cut smaller heart shaped centers from remaining cookies and place the heart frames on top of cookies.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool; fill center heart space with cherry filling.

title: Cream Potato Casserole
steps: Cook, drain and mash potatoes just like cream potatoes.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour in buttered baking dish and top with more butter and Parmesan cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick And Easy No Bake Pineapple Sour Cream Pie(Very Lo-Cal And No Sugar Except In Crust)

ingredients.name: instant sugar vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small instant sugar free vanilla pudding

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well with spoon or fork (not electric mixer) until thick.
Pour into 1 Keebler ready crust (graham or cookie crust).
Top with lite Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

title: Cornbread Skillet Casserole

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 2 to 4 jalapeno peppers, chopped or use 1/4 c. bell pepper

steps: Combine eggs, corn meal, corn, milk and oil in a bowl; set aside.
Cook beef until browned; drain well and set aside.
Pour 1/2 of corn meal mixture into a greased 1 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet.
Spread evenly with beef.
Top with cheese, onion and peppers.
Pour on remaining batter.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Butter Balls
steps: Cream Crisco and 1/2 cup of the sugar.
Stir in flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Mix well.
Make into 1-inch balls.
Place on cookie sheet, which has been rubbed with Crisco.
Bake in oven, 375°, for 12 to 15 minutes.
Roll in sifted confectioners sugar immediately after baking.
Cookies may be re-rolled in sugar after cooling, if desired.

title: Poncho Dreg'S Dip
steps: Brown ground beef.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add chili to ground beef and heat.
Put beef and chili mixture into casserole dish.
Spread sour cream over mixture.
Place 6 slices of Velveeta cheese on top of sour cream.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Vanilla Sauce(For Baked Apples)
steps: Add all items, except vanilla.
Boil until thick (3 minutes). Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Poor Man'S Chow Mein
steps: Brown beef, onions and celery (I usually begin beef in a small amount of water and after awhile, pour away drippings).
To the beef, add onions and celery; continue browning.
Mix in casserole dish the soups, water, rice and soy sauce.
Add the browned beef mixture and stir.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Place topping of dry chow mein noodles on each serving.

title: Harriet'S Chicken Cantonese
steps: Heat oil in skillet or wok and saute chicken until brown. Blend rest of ingredients and add to skillet.
Mix; cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place chicken in platter and coat with sauce.

title: Brown Bread
steps: In a large bowl, sift together dry ingredients.
Add beaten egg and buttermilk and stir into a soft dough.
With floured hands, knead dough lightly and quickly into a ball.
Shape dough into approximately a 7-inch round and place in a 9-inch pie plate. Cut a deep cross into the dough.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for 25 minutes and then lower the oven temperature to 350° for an additional 25 minutes.
Test for doneness as above.
Let bread sit for one hour before serving.

title: Biscuit Casserole
steps: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Add soup and ketchup.
Pour into casserole dish.
Top with biscuits.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes, or until biscuits are done and lightly browned.

title: Creamy Lo-Cal Dressing
steps: Blend all ingredients with hand beater until very smooth. Store in covered jar in refrigerator.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Seven Layer Dinner

ingredients.name: ground beef brown
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef, browned or 1 1/2 lb. sausage patties

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 can tomatoes or 1 can condensed tomato soup

steps: Put one layer of each ingredient, in order, in a large casserole dish.
Bake, covered, in casserole at 375° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coca-Cola Cherry Jello Salad

ingredients.name: maraschino cherry in half
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. maraschino cherries, chopped in halves

steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
You may add Coca-Cola now or later.
Add cherries and pecans.
When at room temperature, place in refrigerator.
After jelling, cut and place on lettuce leaf.

title: Betty Roger'S Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 8 chicken breast halves or 12 thighs, boned and skinned

ingredients.name: mushroom and sauteed
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced and sauteed

steps: Saute stuffing in butter until golden.
Add 3/4 of buttered stuffing to bottom of greased 3 quart casserole dish.
Place chicken in dish.
Mix together soup, sour cream and mushrooms. Pour over chicken.
Add remaining crumbs on top.

title: 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
steps: In a casserole, stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla. (Mixture will be stiff.)
Cut butter over top.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir vigorously until smooth.
Blend in nuts. Pour into waxed paper-lined loaf pan.
Chill one hour.
Cut into squares.

title: Lemon Whip
steps: Mix together and press in 9 x 13-inch pan the crackers, sugar and margarine.
In bowl, mix 1 small can frozen lemonade, Cool Whip, lemon juice and milk.
Beat with mixer and spread over crust.
Store and serve from freezer.

title: Ham Crescents

ingredients.name: swiss
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded Swiss or Cheddar cheese

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Unroll dough into 4 rectangles.
Press seam smooth.
Place one slice of ham; spread with mustard and sprinkle with cheese.
Starting on short side, roll up; press to seal and roll in sesame seed.
Repeat with other rectangles.
Cut each roll into 5 slices (20 in all).
Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Place slices cut side down.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove from pan immediately.

title: Ambrosia Cream Cheese Mold
steps: Soften gelatin in water; let mixture stand 5 minutes.
Drain pineapple and reserve juice.
Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup.
Pour juice into saucepan; heat to boiling.
Add gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, lemon juice and cream cheese (a wire whisk helps to blend).
Chill until gelatin is partially set.
Fold in pineapple chunks, orange, pecans and coconut.
Spoon mixture into lightly greased 1-quart mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold.

title: Rock Road Fudge
steps: In double boiler, mix and melt milk, butter and chocolate morsels.
Remove from heat and add marshmallows and pecans.
Pour into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan lined with wax paper.
Chill 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: South Of Border Dip

ingredients.name: ground beef brown and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained

steps: Cook and stir on low heat the cheese, tomato soup, taco seasoning and Ro-Tel.
Add ground beef and rice.
Put over chips.

title: Cheese Snacks
steps: Add red pepper to sifted flour.
Work margarine and cheese together.
Work in flour and Rice Krispies.
Form into very small balls.
Place on a cookie sheet.
Press each ball flat with the tines of a fork that has been dipped in flour.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Cool just slightly before removing from pan.

title: Easy And Fast No Cook Italian Pudding Squares
steps: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cookies.
Mix pudding as directed on package, adding 1 teaspoon anise for each package.

title: Millionaires

ingredients.name: milk chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. milk chocolate chips (not semi-sweet)

steps: Melt caramels with water and butter.
Add pecans and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons onto buttered or Pam sprayed wax paper.
Chill.

title: Cherry Delectibles(May Be Prepared Ahead Of Time)
steps: Blend cheese and butter; work in flour until stiff dough is formed; chill overnight.
Drain cherries, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.
Combine cherries, reserved liquid and brandy; chill overnight.

title: Squash Casserole(Ernestine'S Favorite Recipe)
steps: Boil squash until tender; drain.
Let stand for 8 minutes. Saute bell peppers and onions.
Beat eggs separately in bowl. Save enough cheese to top casserole.
Combine all ingredients with squash, mixing well.
Pour into large casserole dish or large baking pan.
Bake at 350° until done or brown.

title: Chitterling Fritters(For Bill Colgan)
steps: Mix all ingredients with enough milk to give a pancake batter consistency.
Drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil.
Cook until browned.
Bon Appetit, Bill.

title: Homemade Cheese Dip
steps: At room temperature, cream onion, cheese and canned cream together.
Add more cream, if too thick.
Serve with chips.

title: Almond Cake
steps: Grease pans well, then	flour.	Cream butter, margarine and Crisco; add sugar, then eggs.
After
this	is well mixed, add baking powder, almond extract,
flour and then milk.
Bake at 325°.
Bake until golden
brown
(toothpick
inserted comes out clean).

title: Marinated Pork Chops
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small mixing bowl.
Place chops in glass baking dish.
Pour marinade over chops.
Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours.
Drain chops.
Reserve marinade.
Heat gas grill to medium setting.
Cook with cover down for 7 1/2 minutes on each side.
Baste with marinade.
Enjoy!!

title: Butternut Balls
steps: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Stir in flour and salt. Add nuts; mix well.
Form stiff dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Peanut Butter And Walnut Fudge

ingredients.name: smooth
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. jar smooth or crunchy peanut butter

steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, salt and 3/4 can of milk well.
Cook over medium heat to boiling.
Continue boiling until when by dropping in a small glass of cold water beads form in glass.
Remove from heat.
Stir in margarine, peanut butter and nuts.
Stir and beat until mixture starts to thicken.
Pour onto well buttered cookie sheet.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: The 8-Minute Light 'N Fruity Pie

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 c. fresh fruit (sliced strawberries, peaches, bananas, raspberries or blueberries).

ingredients.name: or you can use can of apricot peach fruit cocktail
ingredients.raw: OR you can use 1 (8 oz.) can of drained apricots, sliced peaches, fruit cocktail, or pineapple.

steps: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water; stirring about 3 minutes.
Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove any unmelted ice.
Using a wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit.
Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound up.
Spoon into prepared pie crust.
Chill 2 hours.
Garnish, if desired.

title: Crab Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with slightly moist bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sweet 'N' Sour Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cook the cabbage in 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt for 7 minutes.
Remove from heat, drain well and place in a 1-quart casserole.
Fry the chopped onion until crisp, remove from pan and set aside.
Blend the flour and brown sugar into the bacon drippings in the pan.
Stir in the beer and vinegar.
Add pepper, 1/4 teaspoon salt and the onion; cook lightly until onion is limp.
Return the chopped bacon to the mixture.
Pour this sweet-sour mixture over the cabbage and cook about 10 minutes in a 350° oven.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
steps: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.
Equally distribute Macadamia nuts over bottom of dish.
Set aside.

title: Cayenne Chicken
steps: Place chicken breasts in a large pan, sprinkle with seasonings of cayenne pepper and garlic powder.
Cover with onion slices; bake at 400° until chicken is done.
Spread picante sauce over chicken and over sauce the grated cheese.
Return to oven just until cheese melts.
Serve with nacho chips and salad.

title: Hamburger Junk

ingredients.name: garlic salt oregano salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: garlic salt, oregano, salt and pepper

steps: Brown hamburger and onion. Season with garlic salt, oregano, salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese to taste. Add tomatoes, tomato paste and water.
Let simmer.
Put half of the sauce in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish, then half of the macaroni. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and sharp cheese.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Waffles
steps: Sift together pumpkin, eggs, milk and butter.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg.
Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture.
Stir until thoroughly combined.
Bake in waffle iron.

title: Moravian Mints

ingredients.name: drop peppermint extract
ingredients.raw: 12 drops peppermint extract or 3 drops oil of peppermint

steps: Simmer granulated sugar and water together until syrup threads from spoon.
Take from stove; add confectioners sugar, cream of tartar and peppermint.
Beat until creamy and drop from spoon onto wax paper.
For wintergreen flavor, use wintergreen extract and pink coloring, peppermint extract with green coloring and lemon extract with yellow coloring.

title: Passover Muffins
steps: Dissolve sugar and salt in boiling water.
Add oil.
Add matzo meal.
Cool.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat thoroughly after adding each egg.
Place in greased muffin pans.
Bake at 450° until golden brown.
Makes approximately 12 large muffins.

title: Summer Chicken
steps: Mix all the wet* ingredients with ginger and mix well.
Cut vegetables and put them all in the marinating dish with the chicken and marinade.
Place dish in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Mix the marinade every once in a while.
Place vegetables and sauce in a tin pan or tin foil.
Place it on the top rack or on the side of grill.
Grill chicken until done.
Serve with white or wheat rice.
It's good.

title: Braised Cabbage, Kielbasa And Spuds
steps: Cut cabbage and potatoes in 1-inch chunks.
Mix broth with mustard in a large saucepan.
Add the cabbage and potatoes; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cover; simmer 15 minutes.
Add kielbasa; cover and cook 5 minutes or until hot.
Serve with mustard.
Serves 4.

title: Chicken Tortilla
steps: Boil 4 to 6 chicken breasts.
Oil a casserole dish.
Line with Doritos (regular flavor).
Put a layer of chicken that has been taken off the bone on top of the Doritos.
Mix together cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups with Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Pour on top of chicken.
Place a layer of Doritos on top and Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Tasty Potato Salad

ingredients.name: red onion in ring
ingredients.raw: 1 cup red onions, sliced in rings

ingredients.name: kraft low calorie thousand island salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup Kraft low calorie Thousand Island salad dressing

steps: Cook, peel and slice potatoes.
Combine with celery, onions, green peppers, pimentos and seasoning.
Add Dressing.
Mix well and chill.
Add additional dressing before serving.

title: Pat'S Chicken Enchiladas

ingredients.name: green chili pepper and
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, drained and seeded

steps: Place tomatoes, chili peppers, coriander and salt in blender; blend until smooth.
Add sour cream and blend.
Set aside.
Mix chicken, cream cheese and onion, also salt to taste, if desired.

title: Chicken And Wine(Makes 4 To 6 Servings)
steps: Place chicken skin side up in baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch. Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle generously with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Forgotten Short Ribs

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 can tomato sauce or 1 bottle tomato catsup

steps: Salt and pepper ribs.
Put in Dutch oven.
In small pan combine remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour over short ribs.
Cover and bake at 275° for 4 hours or until tender.
Spoon off excess fat prior to serving.

title: Dutch Cookies
steps: Cream butter/margarine. Add sugar and cinnamon; beat well. Add egg yolk; beat well. Sift and add flour. Mix well. Press dough evenly unto greased cookie sheets or 12
x 15-inch pan. Brush with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and pecans. Bake 30-35 minutes at 300°. Cut into squares while warm.

title: No Salt Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add shortening, sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Gradually add, by hand, rest of flour.
Makes a soft batter.
Let rise about 30 minutes.
Punch down.
Beat 25 strokes.
Knead lightly.
Spread in greased pan; let rise again.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Makes 1 loaf.

title: Zucchini Slaw
steps: In large bowl, toss zuchini with carrot and green onions.
In a small screw-top jar, combine remaining ingredients; cover and shake well.
Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Onion Pretzel Snacks
steps: Break pretzels into bite size pieces.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt butter and add onion soup mix.
Stir well.
Pour over pretzels and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Let cool completely.
Store in tightly closed container.

title: Mock Lemon Pie
steps: Mix and cook together the first 5 ingredients.
Add eggs and lemon extract; cook a little bit more.
Cool and pour into baked pie crust.
Beat egg whites; add 2 tablespoons sugar.
Put on top and brown in hot oven.

title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
steps: Butter 8 x 8-inch pan.
Slice peaches and put in the bottom of the pan.
Cut bread into 5 finger slices and put on top of the peaches.
Mix butter, flour, sugar and egg.
Pour over bread. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Six Week Muffins
steps: Mix together all dry ingredients.
Add other ingredients, mix thoroughly and store in covered bowl in refrigerator.
Do not mix second time.
Fill muffin cups and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. May add any fruit variation.
Will keep well in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
steps: Break cauliflower into sections.
Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water, which has been salted.
Drain well.
Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons margarine, onion, cheese, sour cream and salt.
Spoon into a 1 1/2 quart casserole.
Melt remaining margarine and toss with bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over the cauliflower mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
Yield:
10 to 12 servings.

title: Oven-Buttered Corn Chunks
steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
Add milk and corn.
Stir until soft dough is formed.
Turn out on a well floured board or pastry cloth. Knead about 15 times.
Roll out in a rectangle 1/2-inch thick.
Cut into 1-inch strips and then into 24 pieces.
Roll in the melted butter and arrange in the pan.
Bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: County Kitchen Chicken Pie

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook chicken until tender.
Remove meat from bones.
Reserve broth; cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In a saucepan, mix and bring to a boil the reserved broth and soup.
In another bowl, combine margarine, pepper, salt, flour and buttermilk.
Mix thoroughly to form batter.
Pour broth mixture over chicken.
Spoon batter over top.
Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cordon Bleau

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and split
ingredients.raw: 3 chicken breasts, skinned, boned and split

ingredients.name: swiss cheese stick
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. Swiss cheese, cut into 6 sticks

steps: Pound chicken.
Season with salt.
Place ham and cheese on each.
Tuck in sides and roll, pressing to seal.
Coat with flour. Lightly brown in butter; place in a baking dish.
Stir mushrooms, water, wine and Heinz 57 sauce in butter in skillet.
Heat and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender. Thicken sauce and serve with rice.

title: Tuna-Zucchini Frittata

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.raw: 2 c. shredded zucchini (about 2 medium; do not pare)

ingredients.name: tuna in oil
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 1/2 or 7 oz.) can tuna in oil

steps: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in 8 or 9-inch skillet.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
In large bowl, beat eggs with milk.
Add mushrooms zucchini, tuna, salt, lemon juice and tarragon.
Mix well.
Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter in skillet.
Pour in tuna mixture.
Cook over low heat to medium heat, without stirring, until frittata is set on bottom.
Place under broiler and cook just until top is set, about 3 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Sunflower Dirt Cake
steps: Crush cookies, place half crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth.
Mix in powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Honey Salad Dressing
steps: Place ingredients in a jar and shake.
Refrigerate.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Hungarian  Paprikas
steps: Saut onions in 2 Tbsp. shortening, drain.
Add to the onions the red pepper and paprika, salt and water.
Add cut up chicken and cook until tender about 2 hours.

title: Mint Salad
steps: Melt jelly over low heat.
Add salad dressing.
Blend well. Stir in marshmallows, pears and pineapple.
Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 8-inch square pan.
Freeze until firm.

title: Canjica(Corn Pudding)
steps: Cook the corn as you would dried beans or peas until tender (20 minutes in the pressure cooker is one way).
Don't use a lot of water.
After the corn is done, add other ingredients.
(You may need more milk, coconut and sugar, depending on how the corn comes out.)
Before serving, sprinkle with cinnamon.
The texture should be creamy, but lumpy and not too thick.
Serve warm.

title: Good Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients except oats and chips. Stir in oats and chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 100 cookies.

title: Baked Ham Slice-Sauterne

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. sliced ham (left from baked ham)

steps: Place ham in a shallow baking pan.
Mix sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan.
Stir in water and margarine.
Cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes.

title: Oranged Barbecued Wings
steps: Split chicken wings at each joint and discard tips; pat dry. Season wings with salt and pepper.
Place wings on broiler pan. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.
Combine barbecue sauce, orange juice, Worcestershire sauce, rind, cloves and garlic in saucepan. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Brush sauce over wings.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Mixed-Up Hamburger
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine soups, water, onions and cheese.
Cover with Tater Tots.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Italian Cream Cake

ingredients.name: white cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. white cake mix (not the pudding in mix type)

steps: Mix all together.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
Cool.

title: White Punch
steps: Mix all together in large punch bowl.
Serves about 75 people.

title: Red And White Strawberry Salad
steps: Drain pineapple.
Mix jello with water.
Add partially thawed strawberries, stir well.
Add bananas and pineapple.
Place 1/2 of mixture in 9 x 12-inch pan.
Put in refrigerator until firm. Put sour cream on top.
Put the rest of the strawberries mixture and refrigerate until firm.
Cut into square to serve.
Dessert of salad.

title: Sherry Cake

ingredients.name: yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb. 2 1/2 oz.) pkg. yellow cake mix

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (about 3 3/4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

ingredients.name: the christian broth cream cherry
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. The Christian Brothers cream sherry

steps: Combine cake mix, pudding mix and nutmeg in large bowl.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Mix at low speed until moistened, then beat at medium speed 3 minutes, or beat by hand 150 strokes per minute!
Turn batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake, below oven center, in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until cake tests done.
Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Turn onto wire rack and glass, if desired.

title: Cheese Logs
steps: Grate and mix all cheese together.
Add chili powder and garlic salt to taste.
Roll in crushed nuts.

title: Garlic Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: envelope cheese garlic salad dressing mix

steps: Combine
sour
cream,
salad
dressing	mix and parsley flakes in a small bowl;
chill several hours to blend flavors. Serve with crackers or crisp vegetable sticks.

title: Fruit Wake-Up
steps: Combine banana, pineapple and orange juice in bowl.
Chill in refrigerator.
Spoon into serving dishes.
Top with toasted coconut.

title: Cappuccino Shake
steps: In a blender, combine milk, coffee crystals, sugar and extract.
Blend until coffee is dissolved.
Serve with a dash of cinnamon.
For a hot drink, pour into a mug and heat in a microwave.
Yield:
1 serving.

title: Banana Nut Loaf

ingredients.name: sifted martha white self raisin flour
ingredients.raw: 2 c. sifted Martha White self-rising flour

steps: Hat oven to 350°.
Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Mix together thoroughly sugar, shortening and eggs.
Stir in buttermilk, mashed bananas and flour, then soda and fold in chopped nuts.
Turn batter into prepared pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool in pans for 10 minutes.
Remove and cool completely.

title: Wendy'S Cheesy Potatoes

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken soup (10 3/4 oz.)

steps: Fully cook potatoes in skin in microwave.
After cool, peel skins off and cut in pinwheels.
In casserole dish, make a layer of potatoes.
Put cheese strips on top of potatoes.
Continue to make layers until you have used up the potatoes.
Empty cream of chicken soup into separate bowl.
Mix well with one soup can of milk, then pour over potatoes.
Top with cheese strips.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Place in oven uncovered at 400° for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is completely melted throughout the casserole dish.

title: Special Mashed Potatoes
steps: Make mashed potatoes.
Add cream cheese, eggs, flour and minced onion.
Put in baking dish.
Top with French fried onion rings. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Fourth Of July Dip
steps: Spread beans in bottom of Pyrex dish.
Top with sour cream and then pour melted cheese over sour cream.
Top with sliced jalapenos.
Serve with chips.

title: Chicory(Cooked Greens)
steps: Clean and wash one head of chicory.
Cut into manageable eating size.
In a proper size pot, place 2 cups water, pinch of sugar, pepper, tomato sauce (for taste and color) and the press of 2 large cloves garlic.
Add the cut greens to the pot containing the listed ingredients and cook, covered, at medium heat, until done (about 10 to 15 minutes).
Enjoy with toasted French or Italian bread.

title: Sauerkraut And Noodle Dough
steps: Place sauerkraut and water in 4-quart size saucepan.
Begin heating.

title: Basic Crepes
steps: In mixer bowl, beat eggs lightly.
Add melted margarine or butter and mix.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. (Batter will be thin.)
Pour scant 1/4 cup butter into lightly greased and heated 8-inch crepe pan or skillet.
Tilt pan to coat bottom evenly with batter.
Cook over medium heat until brown; turn crepe to brown second side.
Cool pan slightly between crepes.
Spoon filling onto center of crepe and roll.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Potato Soup

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Peel and cube potatoes; add chopped onions.
Cover with water. Cook together for 20 to 25 minutes.
Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, cheese, broccoli, salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer over low heat until cheese melts.
Serve with Broccoli Cornbread.

title: Pineapple Almond Slaw
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside. Combine cabbage and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add sour cream mixture.
Toss well, cover and chill.

title: Parmesan Cheese Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Place butter into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and melt in oven.
Mix Parmesan cheese, flour, salt and pepper in a bowl with a cover.
Place potatoes into the mixture.
Shake until well coated.
Place in pan and sprinkle leftover mixture over the top.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
steps: Combine together 1 cup sugar, flour, butter, baking powder and milk; pour into 9-inch square pan.
Over this batter put rhubarb, 1 cup sugar and boiling water.
Bake at 350° until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Croque Monsieur

ingredients.name: reduced fat deli ham
ingredients.raw: 6 oz reduced-fat deli ham, thinly sliced

steps: Cut a slit in each bread slice to form a pocket.
Spread 1 tsp honey mustard into each bread pocket.
Divide ham and cheese evenly among bread pockets.
Combine milk and egg whites in a shallow bowl, stirring with a whisk.
Dip sandwiches, 1 at a time, in milk mixture, turning to coat.
Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat.
Add 2 sandwiches; cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Repeat procedure with remaining sandwiches.
Yield:
4 servings.

title: Sunday Morning Brunch
steps: Mix eggs, salt, 1 cup of milk, mustard and soup with remaining 2/3 cup milk.
Layer bread, sausage, cheese, mushrooms and egg mixture in a rectangular cake pan.
Leave in refrigerator overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8 to 12.

title: Yulonda'S Homemade Sweet Spaghetti
steps: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Brown hamburger and drain grease from meat.
Stir in barbecue sauce and add water and sugar.
Stir all together.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch rectangular cake pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Scala
steps: Flour chicken breasts and brown in oil. Drain fat from pan and add consomme to chicken; simmer 25 to 30 minutes.
Add 1/2 to 1 cup sour cream to make a creamy sauce. Add several shakes of black pepper.
Put chicken and sauce in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Fried Pies

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: sugar or Sweet 'N Low to taste

steps: Roll out biscuits real thin and put fruit in side.
Cut around edges.
Fry in oil.
Drain on paper towels.

title: Raspberry Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate.
Cream margarine, eggs and sugar, then add chocolate.
Stir in flour and walnuts.
Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Drop jam by teaspoonfuls over surface of batter. Swirl with fork to mix into batter.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Alabama Apples(Roll Tide!)
steps: Put butter in bottom of casserole; add sliced apples and sugar.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Consomme Rice
steps: Mix all ingredients together and cover.
Cook in oven at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese-Macaroni Salad
steps: Chill macaroni.
Combine with celery, peas, carrots and green pepper.
Season to taste.
Moisten with mayonnaise.
Mix lightly with two forks.
Serve on any crisp salad greens.
Garnish with cheese balls or diced stuffed olives.
Yield: 6 servings.

title: Beef Goulash(Microwave)

ingredients.name: stew beef in
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. stew beef, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: Place beef in a 3-quart microwave casserole.
Peel tomatoes and remove cores.
Cut tomatoes in chunks.
Place in casserole with beef.
Add onion, salt and pepper; stir.
Cover and cook on Roast for 40 to 50 minutes or until beef is tender.
Stir twice during cooking time.
Stir sour cream into mixture and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.

title: Sausage Bake

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (16 oz.) tomatoes, diced or squeezed

steps: Braise sausage and drain grease off.
Add flour to sausage and add all ingredients.
Place in casserole dish.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
steps: Cream the oleo, Crisco and sugar until smooth.
Beat in eggs. Sift together the flour and soda; add to creamed mixture.
Form into a ball.
Roll out on floured board to the thickness you desire and cut out.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen, according to thickness.

title: Wild Rose Jelly
steps: Measure rose petals.
Cover with water and bring to a boil. Boil 15 minutes.
Strain through a jelly bag.
Add strawberry juice and measure the liquid.
If you do not have a quart, add enough water to make up the difference.
Return to kettle.
Stir in sugar and bring to a boil.
Still, stirring, pour in pectin and boil 1 minute more.
Pour into jelly glasses and seal with paraffin.

title: French Eggs
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Lay bread in 2 layers in pan. Cover each layer with grated cheese; sprinkle with bacon.
Mix eggs, milk and salt together; pour over top.
Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Williamsburg Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole.
Top with crushed potato chips and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Baskets
steps: Crush shredded wheat biscuits until fine.
Melt chocolate in double boiler until soft.
Stir in peanut butter and add mixture to shredded wheat.
Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper.
Shape into birds nest and place jelly beans in each one.
Chill.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Gelatin Mold
steps: Cook sugar and pineapple 5 minutes.
Let cool.
Dissolve gelatin in cold water.
Add gelatin to sugar and pineapple and chill.
Beat in separate bowls the cream cheese and Dream Whip. When pineapple is cold, beat in the cream cheese and the Dream Whip until well mixed.
Add nuts.
Place in mold and refrigerate.

title: Green Beans And Ground Beef

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. green beans or 1 qt. can

steps: Brown onion and garlic lightly in fat. Add beef and cook stirring with fork 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and 3 cups of water. Heat to boiling.
Add beans and cook 10 minutes.
Thicken with cornstarch blended with a little water.
Cook slowly 10 minutes longer, stirring often.
Serve on
hot rice.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Molly'S Pork Chops
steps: Mix soup and water and set aside.
Place pork chops in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Slice onion and green pepper on top of each chop. Pour tomato soup over the top.
Cover with tinfoil, vent foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix at medium speed for 3 minutes.
Stir in next 2 ingredients.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes.
When cool, spread with cream cheese frosting.

title: Macaroni Pizza
steps: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet.
Add tomato soup and cook 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir frequently.
Cook macaroni until tender.
Add egg and milk to the macaroni.
Spread macaroni mixture in greased jelly roll or cookie pan.
Spread tomato beef mixture on top of macaroni.
Place thin slices of cheese on top and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Golden Lamb'S Sauerkraut Balls
steps: Grind ham and pork together and saute until brown.
Add flour, milk and dry mustard and cook until thick.
Cook sauerkraut separately.
Grind the sauerkraut and meat mixture together. Return to stove and cook until thick.
Cool.
Shape.
Roll in flour.
Dip in milk.
Roll in cracker or bread crumbs.
Fry in deep fat at 350° until brown.

title: Alexandra'S Favorite Drumsticks

ingredients.name: margarine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. margarine or butter, melted and cooled

steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in bowl.
Dip drumsticks
in margarine.
Roll in flour mixture to coat.
Arrange in ungreased square pan and bake, uncovered, until done, about 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Bake

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 green pepper, cut into small pieces

steps: In a large skillet, put in a couple of tablespoons olive oil and saute garlic, onions, tomatoes and green pepper.
Saute until pepper is tender and tomatoes are mushy.
Set aside.
Saute zucchini in some more olive oil.
Cook until zucchini is 1/2 done, just tender.
Heat oven to 350°.
Mix vegetables together with zucchini and put in a large glass or Corning pie or quiche dish. Cover with 2 cups of cheese.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Easy Cream Pie
steps: Mix together dry ingredients. Gradually add milk and Milnot. Cook on very low heat until thick. Add butter.
Pour in baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Makes 1 pie.

title: Tasty Grilled Potatoes
steps: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in large bowl until well blended.
Stir in potatoes and onions to coat.
Divide potato mixture evenly among 3 large pieces of heavy-duty foil.
Seal each and place on grill approximately 30 to 45 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Makes 3 large servings.

title: White Mountain Frosting
steps: Mix in saucepan and keep covered first 3 minutes, then cook to 242° on thermometer.
Beat 1/3 cup or 3 egg whites until stiff, while syrup is cooking.
Pour syrup slowly over whites and add 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge
steps: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and nuts until well-blended.

title: Lettuce Salad Dressing
steps: Mix ingredients (not lettuce); mix well.
Spread over lettuce.

title: Sure-Jell Strawberry Jam
steps: Mix strawberries and sugar thoroughly; set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in pan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy. Pour into plastic containers.
Cover.
Let stand at room temperature 24 hours.
Store in freezer.

title: Royal Chocolate Sauce
steps: Combine cornstarch, cocoa, margarine, honey and water in a heavy saucepan, bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; add marshmallow creme and vanilla.
Stir until blended. Serve warm over ice cream or as a dip for fresh fruit and cake cubes. Makes 2 cups.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
steps: Pour juice into percolator.
Put rest of ingredients into the basket of percolator.
Perk as if making coffee.
Recipe can be halved or doubled.

title: Juanita'S Cocktail Chicken Balls
steps: Combine ingredients in order listed except 3/4 cup pecans. Mix well.
Shape into small balls and roll in chopped pecans. Keep refrigerated until serving time.
These can also be frozen for later use.
Try spearing a chicken ball and a pineapple chunk on an hors d'oeuvre pick.

title: Cream Cheese Peach Pie
steps: Beat crust ingredients 2 minutes.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.

title: Strawberry Or Peach Pizza

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 Package Strawberry or Peach Pie Glaze

steps: Grease a pizza pan.
Press the cookie dough in the pan, put pecans on top and press them down into the dough.
Bake 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes.
Cool.

title: Norma'S Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: green chile split and
ingredients.raw: 2 cans whole green chiles, split and seeded

steps: In a well-buttered, 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, beginning and ending with cheese, layer cheese and chiles.
Mix eggs with salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste.
Pour egg mixture over layered cheese and chiles.

title: Squirrel With Rice
steps: Dice salt pork; saute until brown.
Add squirrel pieces; brown lightly.
Add water.
Simmer until tender.
Add rice, catsup, onion and seasonings.
Cook over low heat.
Cook until rice is tender.

title: Lemon Chess Pie(A Dessert Of Early Virginia)

ingredients.name: juice and rind of lemon
ingredients.raw: juice and grated rind of 1 lemon

steps: Beat the eggs with a fork or wire whisk and gradually add the sugar.
Add the lemon juice and rind; mix well.
Slowly add all ingredients until completely blended.
Pour into an 8-inch pie shell and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown or until a knife inserted into the filling comes out clean.

title: Apricot-Filled Pear Cake
steps: Drain pears.
Save 1/2 cup juice.
Blend pears in blender until smooth.
In large bowl, combine cake mix, pureed pears, 1/2 cup pear juice and eggs at slow speed until smooth and moistened. Beat 2 minutes on high.
Pour batter in a lightly greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Grease a piece of wax paper and fit in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes, remove from pan and cool completely. Slice cake in half, spread apricot jam over cut half.
Replace top cake layer.
Spread with topping.
Chill well.

title: Chicken Fillet Casserole
steps: Beat eggs well and dip chicken in them, then dip chicken in bread crumbs.
Fry in oil and brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towel.
Put the chicken in a casserole dish.
Dissolve bouillon in a cup of hot water and add reserved mushroom liquid; stir well. Pour over the layered chicken and add the mushrooms.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
At end of baking time, remove from oven and add enough slices of cheese to cover chicken.
Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

title: Spider Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Melt shortening in frypan placed in oven.
Beat egg; add 1 cup milk.
Stir in cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.
Turn into frypan with melted shortening. Pour over remaining milk.
Do not stir.
Bake 25 minutes at 425°.

title: Chicken Paprikas

ingredients.name: chicken part skin removed
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 lb. chicken parts, skin removed

steps: In a Dutch oven over low heat, cook onions in butter until soft but not brown.
Add paprika and rub into onions with wooden spoon. Add chicken, meaty side down, and stock.
Bring to a boil, then cover and gently simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Chicken should be very tender and onions mushy.
Remove chicken to a platter and debone.
Cut larger pieces into serving chunks, if you wish.
Add 2 tablespoons of cooking liquid to cornstarch and mix well.
Add this mixture to liquid in pot.
Bring to a boil and stir until thickened.
Reduce heat and stir in sour cream, heating just to simmer point.
Add chicken, cover and simmer a few minutes until heated through.
Holds well at low heat.

title: Peach Tart
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Mix eggs, sugar, flour and cream.
Pour the mixture over peach slices which have been arranged in the bottom of the pie shell.
Dot the top of the tart with butter. Bake for 10 minutes at 425°; reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Wondrous Brownie Pie

ingredients.name: bar sweet chocolate and cooled
ingredients.raw: 1 bar (4 oz.) sweet chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: Beat until smooth or blend in blender until smooth. Pour into greased pie plate then pour nuts over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: 14 Day Pickles

ingredients.name: coarse salt gal. water
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. coarse salt to 1 gal. water

ingredients.name: powdered alum each gal. hot water
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. powdered alum to each gal. hot water

ingredients.name: cinnamon bark
ingredients.raw: 2 pieces cinnamon bark (break in small pieces)

steps: Stir salt in water until salt is dissolved; pour over cucumbers.
Let stand for one week; drain well.
Add alum; soak 24 hours in the alum water; drain well.
Split cucumbers; let them drain.
Wash churn; dry it.

title: Chicken N' Rice
steps: Spread
rice on bottom of small roasting pan.
Sprinkle mushrooms and pepper over rice.
Lay chicken pieces over this. Dilute
mushroom
soup
and
onion soup with water.
Pour over chicken.
Bake covered at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Apple Glazed Carrots

ingredients.name: baby carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 16 oz. pkg. peeled trimmed baby carrots

steps: Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add carrots and saute until carrots begin to brown slightly, about 8 minutes.
Add apple juice and honey and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender and liquid is reduced to glaze, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Transfer to bowl.
Sprinkle with green onion tops and serve.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Rum Duff

ingredients.name: rum
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. rum or 1 tsp. rum extract

steps: Combine applesauce, sugar, rum, grated orange rind and gingersnaps.
Stir until well mixed.
Chill.
Just before serving, fold in whipped cream and pile into sherbet dishes.
If desired, top with additional cream and nuts.

title: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh broccoli or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's cream of broccoli soup

steps: If using fresh broccoli, cut into spears.
In a 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole dish, arrange broccoli and top with chicken.
Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.

Combine butter and bread crumbs; sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, or microwave by covering with wax paper and cooking on High for 6 minutes, or until hot, rotating dish halfway through heating.

title: Strawberry Punch
steps: Mix sugar and Jell-O together.
Add boiling water; mix well. Add pineapple and orange juice.
Freeze in plastic 1 gallon container or 1 gallon Ziploc bag.
When ready to serve, add ginger ale.

title: French Ice Coffee

ingredients.name: strong coffee
ingredients.raw: 3 c. strong coffee (instant, perked or decaf)

steps: Mix coffee and sugar together and cool.
Add half and half, milk and vanilla. Pour into Ziploc bags or milk cartons and freeze.
Two hours before serving, remove from freezer.
Serve with spoons at a slushy consistency.

title: Pinto Beans(German Style)
steps: Wash beans.
Cover beans with plenty of water and bring to boil.
Boil 2 minutes, set off burner, cover beans and let set for 1 hour.
Drain off water and rinse beans.
Cover with water and cook beans until tender.
Add onion and all other ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Crazy Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: The Best And Easiest Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients well.
Roll into 1-inch balls and place on slightly greased cookie sheet.
Press each ball with fork.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or just until cookies start to turn brown.

title: Graham Cracker Shells
steps: Grind graham crackers and empty into plastic bowl.
Add sugar and melted butter.
Mix with both hands until well mixed and all the mixture is moist.
Measure out 1 1/3 cups of mixture into each pie pan.
Use fork to line side of pan with mixture.
Spread remainder of mixture around bottom of pan and press down with bottom of flat glass.
Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole (Or Chicken)

ingredients.name: pork chop
ingredients.raw: 4 pork chops (3/4-inch thick) or 6 pieces chicken

steps: Dredge meat in flour.
Cook in a little shortening until brown. Put in 2-quart or larger baking dish.
Brown pepper, celery and onion.
Put in dish with meat.
Add rice on top, then tomatoes. Bake in 350° oven until tender, about 45 minutes.
Might have to add 1/2 cup water when gets dry.

title: Golden Coconut Balls

ingredients.name: maraschino cherry sixth
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 maraschino cherries, cut into sixths (optional)

steps: Spread coconut in a large shallow pan.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes, until golden brown.
Turn into a small pie pan. Cool.

title: Parmesan Baked Tomatoes
steps: Cube tomatoes into bite size pieces.
Spread tomatoes evenly in a casserole dish.
Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Sprinkle bread crumbs over tomatoes.
Sprinkle cheese next.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Rice And Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix chicken soup and milk; reserve half of the mixture.
Mix remaining soup, rice and 1/4 of the onion soup mix.
Pour into ungreased baking dish.
Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts.
Sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Favorite Peach Pie
steps: Peel and halve peaches.
Lay face down in unbaked pie shell.
Mix coffee cream, sugar, cinnamon and flour together.
Pour over peaches.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Cinnamon Christmas Ornaments
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Will be a dense dough.
Knead well and roll out to 1/8-inch dough.
Cut with cookie cutters.
Use a straw to cut out hole for ribbon.
Lay on a flat surface to dry for up to 7 days, flipping to allow for even drying.
Decorate with acrylic paints and glitter.
String ribbon through straw hole.

title: Famous Pretzels
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk or water.
Add sugar, salt, margarine and flour.
Mix all ingredients with a wooden spoon.
Cover and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes.
Form pretzels; brush with slightly beaten egg or a little egg white with a few drops of water.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 425° for 15 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Mexican Cheese Dish(Great! Xxx)

ingredients.name: monterey jack cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 oz. Monterey Jack cheese, grated

steps: Grate 10 ounces sharp Cheddar cheese into a 9 x 13-inch buttered Pyrex dish.
Sprinkle 5 tablespoons of finely chopped jalapeno peppers on top.
Grate 8 to 10 ounces Monterey Jack cheese on top of peppers.
Press down.
Pour 6 to 7 beaten eggs onto cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 325° or until set and golden. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Mexican Cheese Crackers
steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
Place crackers in large shallow baking pan.
In a small bowl, combine butter, taco seasoning mix, Worcestershire and salt.
Pour butter mixture over crackers; stir well.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Pour onto waxed paper to cool.
Store in airtight container.
Yields 6 cups snack mix.

title: Peanut Butter Parfait
steps: Mix Oreo cookies and margarine.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread ice cream on top of cookies.
Sprinkle on peanuts and freeze for several hours.
Melt chips and stir in sugar, margarine and evaporated milk.
Bring to a boil.
Boil for 10 minutes.
Cool completely.
Spread cooled fudge on peanuts and freeze.

title: Blender Banana Bread
steps: Put egg, butter, bananas, sugar and granola into blender. Whirl on low until smooth.
Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add blender mixture and stir until moistened.
Turn into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 60 minutes.
Yields one loaf.

title: Colwell'S Special Squash

ingredients.name: yellow
ingredients.raw: 3 medium yellow or zucchini squash, cut in bite-size chunks

steps: Cover squash and onion with water and butter and bring to boil.
Cook approximately 5 minutes, until tender.
Drain.
Melt Velveeta cheese.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour over squash. Makes 4 servings.

title: Crispy Crunchy Brittle
steps: Place walnuts in 9-inch glass pie plate.
Microwave at High 5 minutes, stirring halfway through until toasted; set aside.
In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle, combine sugar, corn syrup, water, butter and salt.
Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes, stirring well at least once until sugar dissolves.
Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 minutes, stirring once after 2 minutes until mixture reaches 300°.
Stir in baking soda; add toasted walnuts. Turn at once into buttered 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.
Spread thin.
Let stand until cooled.
Break into pieces.
Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies

ingredients.name: hershey s kiss with almond
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) bag Hershey's Kisses with almonds

steps: Remove foil from Kisses.
In a large bowl, combine butter, sugars and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour; blend until smooth. Stir in chips. Mold scant tablespoon of dough around each Kiss, covering completely.
Shape into ball and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set.
Cool.
Remove from cookie sheet.
Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.
Drizzle topping over each cookie (optional).

title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
steps: Mix all together.
Do not overmix.
Drop in greased muffin tins.
Bake at 450° until brown, approximately 20 minutes.
An especially good recipe for weight watchers.

title: Lemon Jello Salad

ingredients.name: carrot in
ingredients.raw: 1 c. carrots, cut in small pieces

steps: In blender, mix Jell-O and water.
Add juice, vinegar and milk.
Add cream cheese, one piece at a time.
Add carrots and pineapple.
Pour in 2-quart mold and chill.

title: White Monkey

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1-inch cube Cheddar cheese or 2 Tbsp. Cheez Whiz

steps: Melt margarine over low heat; stir in flour and cook for one minute.
Slowly add milk; cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until melted.
Salt and pepper to taste. Serve over toast.

title: Diabetic Persimmon Pudding
steps: Mix pulp, sweetener and egg.
Add dry ingredients and a little of the milk.
Blend well.
Add rest of milk and butter.
Bake 55 minutes at 325°.

title: Zucchini Cake Squares
steps: Blend together.
Cut like pie dough.
Press 1/2 on bottom of lightly greased pan (cookie sheet).
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes (on bottom rack).

title: Polish Noodles And Cabbage
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet.
Add onion and saute until soft.
Add cabbage to skillet.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in caraway seed, salt and pepper.

title: Zesty Grilled Pork Chops
steps: Combine the first five ingredients.
Place chops in a glass baking dish and pour marinade over.
Cover and refrigerate 3 to 6 hours or overnight.
To cook, remove chops from marinade and grill or broil 4-inches from the heat to desired doneness. Brush occasionally with the marinade.
Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 450 degrees.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon and baking soda.
Using pastry blender or fork, cut in shortening until mixture resembles course crumbs; stir in raisins.
Stirring with fork, add buttermilk until mixture leaves sides of bowl and soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead lightly until no longer sticky.
Roll out 1/2
inch thick and cut with floured 2 1/2 inch cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet with sides touching.
Bake at 450 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes on wire rack and frost. Serve immediately.

title: Savory Italian Rice Bake
steps: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs.
Remove sausage from casing and crumble.
In 12-inch skillet, brown sausage and onion; drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet.
Set aside.
Add zucchini and garlic; saute over medium-high heat 1 minute.
Cover, continue cooking over low heat about 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Combine prepared Rice-A-Roni, sausage mixture, 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce and basil; spread into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until heated through.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef Vegetable Stew

ingredients.name: chuck roast in
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. chuck roast, cut in 1/2-inch squares

steps: Add meat, onion, celery and salt to 6 to 7 quarts boiling water.
Boil on medium about one hour.
Add potatoes, carrots, bouillon and hot pepper to taste.
When beef is well done, add tomatoes. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Pecan Cookies
steps: Cream together margarine, sugar, egg and molasses until mixture is smooth.
Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; mix well.
Stir in chopped pecans.

title: Scalloped Cabbage

ingredients.name: cabbage in bite size
ingredients.raw: 6 c. cabbage, cut in bite size pieces

steps: Cover the cabbage with 1-quart boiling water.
Add the salt; boil 5 minutes, drain dry.
In the melted oleo, add flour and stir well.
Add milk and cook until thickens a little.
Put cabbage in baking dish.
Add cheese to sauce and stir until melted.
Pour over the cabbage and cover with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Almond Joy Cake
steps: Mix chocolate cake mix as directed on box.
Bake in two 13 x 9-inch pans for 20 minutes at 350°.
While cake is baking, mix in large bowl 1 cup Pet milk and 1 cup sugar.
Bring to rapid boil and remove from heat.
Add marshmallows; stir until melted.
Add coconut.
Pour over hot cakes; cover completely.
In a saucepan heat to a rapid boil 1 1/2 cups sugar, 1/2 cup Pet milk and margarine.
Remove from heat; add chocolate chips and stir until melted.
Pour over cakes to completely cover.
Sprinkle with toasted coconut if desired.

title: Noodles And Cabbage
steps: Cook cabbage and onion together until cabbage is almost done. Cook noodles; drain.
Mix noodles with cabbage, onion and sour cream.
Mix half of the cheese into mixture.
Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and then with bread crumbs.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken-N-Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and boned
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chicken breasts, skinned and boned

steps: Dip chicken breasts in yogurt.
Roll in mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Place in baking dish.
Place tinfoil lightly over dish.
Bake at 350° for approximately 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Pudding Mix
steps: Store dry ingredients in airtight container.
For pudding, combine 1 cup mix with milk in pan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Stir in butter and vanilla.
Yields 9 batches (4 servings per batch).

title: Margaritas
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients
in
a large pitcher.
Fill pitcher with ice and
water.
Serve immediately in salt-rimmed glasses.

title: Dillicious Pot Roast
steps: In heavy saucepan, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings from pan.
Crumble bacon; set aside. Sprinkle both sides of beef with lemon pepper marinade.
Brown beef in bacon drippings.
Combine mushroom soup, dill pickle and Worcestershire sauce; pour over browned meat.
Cover; simmer for about 2 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender.
Remove to warm platter.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
Skim fat from gravy; serve with roast.

title: Popcorn Surprise Squares
steps: Melt oleo and marshmallows; add gumdrops, popcorn, M&M's and nutmeats.
Press into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan.
Cut into squares.

title: Easy Brunch Casserole

ingredients.name: breakfast sausage brown and well
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. breakfast sausage, browned and well drained

steps: Place croutons in greased 9 x 13-inch metal pan.
Put grated cheese over croutons.
Brown sausage and place on top of cheese. Beat eggs and mix with soup, mustard, milk and mushrooms.
Pour over sausage.
Bake, covered, with foil in 300°
oven for 1 1/2 hours.
This recipe may be prepared the night before and refrigerated.
Serves 10.

title: Green Pea Salad

ingredients.name: lesueur pea
ingredients.raw: 2 cans LeSueur peas (or any good quality small peas)

ingredients.name: bread and butter pickle
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. bread and butter pickles, chopped

ingredients.name: american cheese in
ingredients.raw: 6 slices American cheese, cut in small squares

steps: Gently add all ingredients to peas.
Refrigerate before serving.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Melt butter and peanut butter.
Add vanilla.
Stir in powdered sugar.
Place in pan; let cool.

title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Slice cucumbers, onions and peppers very thin.
Salt overnight, covered with water.
Drain, then cook with remaining ingredients.
Let stand in hot vinegar for a few hours, then reheat and can.

title: Holiday Dessert

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 oz cream cheese, broken into small pieces

steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water, turn heat to simmer, add marshmallows and dissolve.
Add drained pineapple.
Cool.
Whip milk and cream cheese in large bowl, add cold jello mixture.
mix well.
Pour into greased mold and refrigerate.
Top with whipped cream in mold pattern if desired.

title: "Bev'S Cocoa"
steps: Mix together cocoa and sugar.
Add dash of salt and the water. Bring to boil.
Stir in milk and vanilla.
Remove from heat. Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Chews

ingredients.name: red hot cinnamon candy
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. red hot cinnamon candies

steps: Combine all ingredients but cereal and melt in top of double boiler.
Add cereal, mixing quickly.
Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan.
Chill; cut in 1/2-inch squares.
Dust with powdered sugar.
Wrap individually in waxed paper.

title: Western Hash
steps: Brown onions, bell pepper and beef in large skillet.
Add tomatoes, basil, rice, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Pour into casserole dish and cover with slices of American cheese.
Heat in oven at 350° until cheese melts.
Serve hot.

title: Spiced Peaches
steps: Combine the vinegar, the juice from the peaches, sugar, cinnamon and cloves.
Boil until reduced by about half.
Remove the spices.
Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches.
Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Frosting

ingredients.name: whipped margarine
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. whipped margarine (Blue Bonnet or Parkay)

steps: Cook water and cornstarch (stirring constantly until thick). Remove from heat and let stand until cold.
Add sugar, vanilla and margarine.
Beat with electric mixer until smooth.
Spread on cool cake.

title: Toffee Refrigerator Dessert
steps: Mix crackers and margarine.
Press 2/3 cup of cracker mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Prepare pudding with 2 cups milk; add softened ice cream and blend until smooth.
Pour over crust. Put in the freezer until set.
Remove and spread Cool Whip on the top.
Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and crushed Butterfinger bars.

title: Tuna Crunch Casserole

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked

ingredients.name: slightly potato chip
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. slightly crumbled potato chips or one of the following: goldfish crackers, chow mein noodles, can French fried onions

steps: In 1-quart casserole, blend soup and milk.
Stir in tuna, egg and peas.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with potato chips, etc. and bake 5 minutes longer.
Makes 3 to 5 servings.

title: Sunrise Cherry Pie
steps: Drain pineapple well, reserving two tablespoons syrup. Combine softened cream cheese, vanilla and reserved syrup, mixing until well blended.
Stir in 1/4 cup pineapple and 1/2 cup pie filling.
Gradually add sugar to cream, beating until soft peaks form.
Fold into creamed cheese mixture.
Pour into crust.
Top with remaining pineapple and pie filling.
Chill until firm.

title: Pork In A Crock-Pot
steps: Place in crock-pot.
Add dash of seasonings.
Pour mixed soup and water over chops.
Cover; let cook all day on low.

title: Tuna 'N Noodle Casserole
steps: Boil noodles according to package directions.
Drain.
Add drained tuna, soup, a little butter and some milk.
Peas may be added if desired.
Mix well.
Bake in greased casserole at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge For Cake
steps: Melt butter and chocolate chips together.
Add powdered sugar. Pour a little milk at a time.
Heat on stove.
Will not get real thick until after it cools.

title: Turkey Bacon Club Sandwich
steps: Cut each roll lengthwise into 2 halves.
Spread mayonnaise on 1/2 of each roll.
Place 3 slices of cooked turkey bacon over the mayonnaise.
Place tomato slices and lettuce over the turkey bacon. Serve open-faced or as a closed sandwich.
Enjoy!!

title: Best Ham Sandwiches
steps: Melt butter.
Add rest of ingredients; stir.
Brush top and bottom of bun.
Stack with ham and cheese.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Batter Rolls

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. melted butter or salad oil

steps: Dissolve yeast in water.
Melt butter.
Mix all ingredients together.
Leave in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Fill muffin pan 1/2 full.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Microwaved Streuseled Apples
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and place in 8-inch glass dish.
Then mix last of ingredients until crumbly.
Sprinkle crumb mixture over top of apples.
Microwave on High for 12 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Can serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Banana Freeze

ingredients.name: orange juice prepared with c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, prepared with 3 c. water

steps: Combine sugar and water. Boil 3 minutes. Cool.
Mash bananas. Add to fruit juices and stir in sugar syrup.
Pour into containers and freeze. When ready to serve, thaw slightly.
Pour carbonated beverage over mixture.

title: Cough Syrup
steps: Boil all ingredients, except honey, for about 3 minutes. Strain through cloth to remove all seeds and lemon rind.
Mix well with honey.
Take one warm tablespoon at a time at 1/2 hour intervals.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole

ingredients.name: jimmy dean sausage fried and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Jimmy Dean sausage, fried and crumbled

steps: Beat eggs until lemon colored.
Add bread, sausage, etc. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Uncle Joe Allen'S Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients together in large bowl.
This is a great salad and easy to make.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Meatballs
steps: Cook onion, celery and pepper.
Add ketchup, sugar and vinegar.
Warm, then add to meatballs.

title: Heavenly Banana Pudding
steps: Beat cream cheese and milk together.
Fix pudding by directions.
Mix milk mixture to pudding.
Make layer of bananas, wafers and pudding mixture or put pudding mixture on the bottom of 9 x 10-inch pan.
Put bananas and wafers in, then to finish, put a layer of Cool Whip on top.
Cool for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chili Rice
steps: Saute onion in oil in 2-quart boiler.
Add rice, salt and chili powder.
Pour in broth plus enough water to make 16 ounces liquid.
Bring to
boil and then cover and simmer until rice is done.

title: Aunt Janet'S Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and celery in skillet; drain fat.
Pour hamburger into baking dish, 2 1/2-quart dish.
Add 3 cups boiling water, rice and dry vegetable soup.
Cook 1 hour at 350°.

title: Happy Life Recipe
steps: Take Love and Loyalty, mix it thoroughly with Faith.
Blend it with Tenderness, Kindness and Understanding.
Add Friendship and Hope, sprinkle abundantly with Laughter.
Bake it with sunshine.

title: Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
steps: Blend cheese with margarine.
Stir flour with salt and paprika and mix well.
Wrap 1 tablespoon of mix around each olive. Completely cover the olive.
Freeze in a plastic bag.
To serve, place frozen puffs on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in 400° oven for 10 to 15 minutes until golden.
Olives will be quite hot. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Mixed Fruit Pies

ingredients.name: regular size can pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 regular size can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Mix
milk and lemon juice; add other ingredients.
Pour in crusts.
Chill for 4 hours.

title: Brownies #2
steps: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add chocolate syrup, nuts and flour.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Polk Salad
steps: Gather polk greens in spring of year.
Look and wash well. Parboil greens; rinse.
Boil again.
Put 2 tablespoons of soda in water, rinse well.
Squeeze out all the water you can.
Put greens and cut up onion in skillet with fair amount of Crisco.
Cook until onion is translucent.
I like to scramble 3 or 4 eggs, then mix with cooked greens.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche

ingredients.name: baked and cooled pie shell
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 inch) baked and cooled pie shell

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch milk recipe mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe mix (original)

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sprinkle cheese in pie crust.
