Whisk eggs until frothy.
Add other ingredients and mix.
Pour over cheese.
Bake at 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.

title: Onion Mushroom Rice
steps: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, bring to boiling soup mix, rice and water.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in green onions, if used.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Instant Spice Tea
steps: Crush red hots to powder.
Mix to all other ingredients.
Keep in a closed container.
Add 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Fried Zucchini

ingredients.name: old bay seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 tsp. Old Bay seasoning (more or less to taste)

steps: Slice zucchini.
Roll in flour, then roll in milk/egg mixture. Roll in bread crumb/Bay seasoning mixture.
Let set 1 hour before frying in canola oil.

title: Mini Morsel Cookies
steps: In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
In a large bowl, combine 1 cup sugar and vegetable oil.

Mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in mini morsels (do not use whole bag, it will be more than you need). Shape into balls. Roll in remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Beef Stew - Oven Baked

ingredients.name: beef stew meat
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut small

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery soup (I use 2)

steps: Put meat in roaster.
Add onion soup mix; sprinkle on.
Add potatoes, onions and carrots.
Mix together cream of celery soup, water and catsup.
Pour over stew.
Bake, covered, for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Cheese Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in water.
Put in blender or food processor. Add cheese in 1-inch cubes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in berries and nuts.
Pour into mold.
As jello begins to thicken, stir to distribute fruit and nuts evenly.

title: Fried Catfish
steps: Mix together flour, salt, pepper and other seasonings with corn meal.
Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Orange Sour Cream Cookie Frosting
steps: Combine all ingredients, beating well until spreading consistency.
Place 1/4 teaspoon frosting on each warm cookie.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Pie
steps: Cook macaroni as directed.
Meanwhile, grate the cheese, set aside.
Combine milk, eggs, salt and pepper, swish lightly until smooth.

title: Milk Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: milk chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (11 1/2 oz. pkg.) milk chocolate morsels

steps: Combine butter, evaporated milk, sugar and salt in medium, heavy saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.

title: Quick Trick Fudge
steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to a full boil.
Boil 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add vanilla and beat until thick.

title: Fresh Vegetable Casserole
steps: Saute onions in butter until golden.
Separate into rings, if desired.
Add pepper rings and cook until tender.
Combine ingredients in a 2-quart shallow casserole and toss lightly. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender, stirring once.

title: Potato Patties
steps: Add chopped onion to mashed potatoes.
Form into patties. Brush with butter.
Fry in butter greased frying pan until golden on each side.

title: Honey Butter Chicken
steps: Toss chicken in your favorite coating.
Melt 1/2 cup butter in roasting pan.
Roll chicken in butter.
Arrange in pan skin side down.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Melt 1/4 cup butter with honey and lemon juice.
Turn chicken skin side up and drizzle with honey mixture.
Bake another 30 to 40 minutes, basting occasionally.
Serve with steamed rice.

title: Biscotti Di Prato

ingredients.name: almond extract
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. almond extract or 2 tsp. anise extract

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place almonds in shallow pan and bake until golden brown (8 to 10 minutes).
Let cool.
Reduce oven to 300°.
In small bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla and extract. In mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Add egg mixture and mix until blended, about 1 minute.
Cut almonds in half and mix in.
Divide dough in half.
On greased and floured baking sheet, pat out dough into 2 logs, about 1/2-inch high, 1 1/2-inches wide and 12-inches long, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to wire rack.
Cool 5 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Ragout(With Pate Grand-Pere - Dumplings)
steps: Cook beef in margarine.
Add onion, salt and pepper.
Brown, stirring often.
Add other ingredients, mix, cover, and let simmer.
Prepare dumplings (pate grand-pere).

title: Apple Pork Chops
steps: Brown pork chops on both sides in hot fat.
Place apple slices in greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with butter or margarine. Top with browned chops, Cover. Bake in 400° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Serves 3 to 4.

title: Queso Napolitano(Cream Cheese Flan)
steps: Heat sugar in skillet over medium-high heat until melted, clear and light brown, stirring occasionally.
Spoon syrup over bottom and around sides of 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Set aside.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
steps: Brown ground beef; cook macaroni.
Mix all but pizza sauce and mozzarella cheese together.
Place in a 9 x 13 pan, pour pizza sauce over the top, then sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the pizza sauce.
Bake 350° for 30 minutes.
Cover with foil until the last 10 minutes.
A can of mushrooms can be added to the meat mixture if desired.

title: Rosy Glow Punch

ingredients.name: cranberry juice cocktail chilled
ingredients.raw: 3 (1 qt.) bottles cranberry juice cocktail, chilled

ingredients.name: lemonade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed

steps: Combine cranberry juice cocktail and concentrate.
Stir well; chill.
Just before serving, pour into a 4 quart punch bowl.
Add scoops of sherbet.
Slowly add ginger ale.
Makes about 50 (1/2 cup or 4 ounce) servings.

title: Shells, Cheese And Tomato Macaroni
steps: Cook shells for 14 minutes; drain.
Mix everything else together and add to drained shells.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Coconut Eggnog
steps: Simmer first 4 ingredients.
Mix 1 cup into eggs.
Mix back into pan.
Stir over low heat 5 minutes to thicken.
Strain and chill.
Add nutmeg, if desired.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme
steps: In greased baking dish or 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of potatoes, peppers and onion.
Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over.
Cover; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender.
Serves 8.

title: Slow Cooker Barbecue Pot Roast

ingredients.name: green pepper in ring
ingredients.raw: 1 large green pepper, cut in rings

steps: Brown meat in hot oil in skillet then transfer to slow cooker.
Add sauce, green pepper, and onion. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 to 5 hours or until tender. Slice and serve with sauce.

title: Mixed Cut Green Bean Casserole
steps: Cook cauliflower in salted water according to package.
Drain. Arrange in a buttered 1-quart casserole.
Drain beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.
Add drained beans to casserole.
Melt butter in small saucepan.
Stir in flour.
Add reserved 1/2 cup liquid, milk, onion, salt and hot sauce.
Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sauce thickens.
Pour over vegetables in casserole. Garnish with pimento.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Fat Free T'S Easy Lasagna

ingredients.name: ground turkey
ingredients.raw: ground turkey or extra lean ground beef

steps: Brown and drain meat.
Add spaghetti sauce, onions and green pepper.
Add enough spaghetti sauce to make thinner than usual. Cook slowly until well blended.
Combine grated Mozzarella cheese with cottage cheese and Egg Beaters.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan spread a thin layer of the meat mixture, then the uncooked lasagna noodles.
Top with meat mixture and a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Continue layering and end with Parmesan cheese topping.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Wontons(Appetizers)
steps: Brown meat and onion; drain fat.
Add rest of ingredients, except wonton skins.
Put mixture each skin.
Fold in triangle. Wet edges with cold water to seal.
Fry in 1-inch hot oil until golden brown, 30 to 60 seconds.
Drain on paper towel.
Freeze if you wish.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Brown meat and onion.
Drain fat and run hot tap water over meat.
Using a colander makes this easy.
Combine meat mixture, soups and corn; heat thoroughly.
Add noodles and it's ready to serve.

title: Friendship Salad

ingredients.name: loyalty and never a thrust
ingredients.raw: 2 c. loyalty and never a thrust

steps: Blend in understanding and good measure.
Mix faith and sportsmanship in all pleasure.
Add for seasoning a pinch of humor and wit.
A few grains of kindness won't hurt a bit.
Use confidence and courage, let none go to waste.
Mix in a bowl with oil of love to taste.
Serve as many as you can handle, but remember to serve yourself as well.

title: Apple Cinnamon Rice
steps: Combine juice and water in medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice and cinnamon stick.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Yields 3 cups.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
steps: In top of double boiler, blend together sugar, flour, salt and milk.
Beat eggs and vanilla.
Place over boiling water and stir until thick.
Set aside until cold.
Cover crust with a layer of sliced strawberries.
Top with filling and refrigerate to chill. Spoon whipped cream around edge of filling.
In center, put whole berries.

title: Tassies
steps: Blend first four ingredients thoroughly.
Divide into 24 equal parts and form into balls.
Place a ball into each of 24 miniature muffin pans.
Press thumb into each ball to make a shell.
Beat with a fork the next 4 ingredients until blended.
Place a few ground nuts in each shell and pour filling over each.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Party Spinach Dip(Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: land o lake fat sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Land O Lakes fat-free sour cream

ingredients.name: water chestnut and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped

steps: Process cottage cheese in a blender until smooth.
Press spinach between paper towels until almost dry.
Put cottage cheese, spinach and remaining ingredients into a bowl.
Blend well, folding ingredients together.
Cover and refrigerate 3 hours.
Yields 3 cups.
Has 14 calories and a trace of fat per tablespoon.

title: Candy Store Cake

ingredients.name: hershey bar over hot water
ingredients.raw: 6 Hershey bars, melted over hot water

steps: Cream together sugar and butter. Blend in remaining ingredients.
Pour batter into a buttered and floured angel food tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Daiquiri Pie
steps: Place gelatine, pudding and sugar in saucepan; stir in 1/2 cup water and the eggs.
Blend well. Add remaining water; stir over medium heat until mixture comes to full boil.
Remove from heat and stir in rum.
Chill thoroughly.
Fold Cool Whip into chilled mixture and spoon into graham cracker or chocolate crust.

title: Pineapple Layered Salad
steps: Beat
egg
yolks; add 1 cup syrup from pineapple, sugar and flour.
Cook until thick.
Arrange in layers in bowl with a
layer of pineapple, a layer of marshmallows, grated cheese, then sauce. Repeat.
Serve at room temperature.
Serves 6.

title: Pimento Loaf
steps: Soak bread in milk; mix with other ingredients and cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Serve hot.

title: Cry Babies (Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add molasses and egg.
Beat until smooth.
Stir together flour, baking soda and ginger.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk.
Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake until lightly browned, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Bean Dish
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well in casserole dish.
Put grated cheese on top or you can use canned onions.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Slices

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (12 oz. pkg.)

steps: In medium saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter, stirring constantly, until blended.
Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes.
Stir in marshmallows and 1 cup nuts; do not melt marshmallows.

title: German Pfannkuchen
steps: Beat eggs.
Add 1 cup milk and continue beating.
Then add flour sifted with the salt, sugar and then rest of the milk.
This will be a thin batter.
Heat iron frying pan fairly hot with a tablespoon of melted butter in the bottom.
Pour 2 or 3 tablespoons of the batter into the pan and roll it from side to side until bottom is covered.
When top is set, dot with a teaspoon of butter and flip it over with a pancake turner to finish cooking.
It is good served with butter and sugar rolled up and eaten with a fork. Applesauce, thick, is also good on these pancakes.

title: Lemon Chicken On Escarole
steps: Wash escarole thoroughly and boil down.
Saute minced garlic in olive oil in frypan.
Cut up cooked escarole some before simmering with garlic.
(This can be done ahead of time.)
Salt while cooking.

title: Wesley'S Biscuits
steps: Melt shortening in pan which biscuits will be baked.
Leave enough melted shortening in the pan to turn the biscuits.
Add remaining melted shortening with other ingredients and mix well.

title: Low-Fat Fusilli Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple chunks, undrained

steps: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.
Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again.
Drain pineapple, reserving 2 tablespoons juice.
Combine pasta, pineapple chunks, cantaloupe and grapes in a medium bowl.
Cover and chill.
Combine yogurt and reserved 2 tablespoons pineapple juice in a small bowl, stirring well.
Cover yogurt mixture and chill.

title: Crab Au Gratin Dip

ingredients.name: b. special crab meat
ingredients.raw: 1 b. special crab meat (fresh, no shells)

steps: Pick carefully through the crab for pieces of shell. Blend the cream cheese, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and mayo until smooth. Fold in the crab.
Spread in a 9-inch Pyrex pie plate.
Sprinkle lightly with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until browned and bubbly.
Serve over crackers.

title: New Potatoes And Peas

ingredients.name: new potato
ingredients.raw: 9 small new potatoes (about 1 1/2 lb.), quartered (about 4 c.)

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: dill weed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. dried dill weed or thyme leaves, crushed

ingredients.name: pea with pear onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas with pearl onions or peas, thawed and drained

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan, place potatoes.
Add water to cover potatoes.
Over high heat, heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to medium.
Cook 8 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.
Drain in colander.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
steps: Place chicken breasts in oblong pan.
Mix together soups and water.
Heat.
Pour over chicken.
Top with cheese and stuffing mix.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Pat topping down into soup mixture.
Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Grammie'S Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix well by hand, you don't have to be afraid of overmixing.
Pour into loaf pan and let set 1 minute. Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

title: Swiss Mocha

ingredients.name: nonfat dry milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. nonfat dry milk or mix 1/2 c. dry milk with 1/2 c. coffee creamer

steps: Stir ingredients together and place in blender until mixture is powdered.
Place in an airtight container or a pretty jar. Yields 1 cup.
Use 2 rounded teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Cocktail Sauce For Shrimp
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Serve with boiled shrimp.

title: Pronto Hominy

ingredients.name: each salt onion salt pepper and dry mustard
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each: salt, onion salt, pepper and dry mustard

steps: Make cream sauce with the first 8 ingredients; when thick add cheese.
Mix in well-drained hominy and undrained chilies.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Double Peanut Cookie Bars

ingredients.name: peanut butter flavored
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. peanut butter flavored pieces

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In hot oven, melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Remove from oven.
Stir in crumbs; spread evenly in bottom of pan.
Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Sprinkle with a layer of peanut butter flavored pieces, layer of chocolate pieces and then peanuts.
Press peanuts gently into mixture.
Bake 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Chill at least 1 hour before cutting bars.
Makes 36 bars.

title: Mom'S Peach Pie

ingredients.name: peach and
ingredients.raw: 6 large fresh peaches, peeled and sliced

ingredients.name: chilled butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chilled butter, cut into 6 pieces

steps: Beat egg white until foamy; brush over bottom and side of pastry.
In small bowl, combine flour and sugars; cut butter into mixture until it resembles fine crumbs.
Sprinkle 2/3 of mixture in bottom of crust; top with peaches.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Black Chocolate Cake
steps: Sift sugar, cocoa, flour and salt together.
Add eggs, vanilla and margarine.
Boil 2 cups water; remove from heat.
Add 2 teaspoons baking soda.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix flour, baking soda and salt and set aside.
Cream butter until fluffy and beat in sugar, egg and vanilla.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Shape into 2-inch balls.
Place 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Let cookies remain on sheet until they are firm.
Makes 21 (4-inch) cookies.
(For softer cookies, add an additional 1/2 cup flour.)

title: Low-Fat Cranberry-Apple Cobbler

ingredients.name: coarsely rome apple
ingredients.raw: 3 c. peeled, coarsely chopped Rome apples

ingredients.name: jellied berry cranberry sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can jellied whole-berry cranberry sauce

steps: Place chopped apple in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray.
Combine cranberry sauce and orange juice, stirring well.
Spoon cranberry sauce mixture evenly over apple.
Combine oats, flour and brown sugar; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Sprinkle oat mixture evenly over cranberry mixture.
Coat oat mixture with cooking spray.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until apple is tender.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mile High Biscuits
steps: Sift all ingredients together.
Blend in shortening.
Add milk and egg (one at a time).
Stir to mix.
Turn out on floured board and knead.
Roll out and cut biscuits.
Bake at 375° until light brown.

title: Preserved Children
steps: Mix the children and dogs together.
Sprinkle the field with flowers.
Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in sun.
When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: Vegetable Kabobs

ingredients.name: zucchini diagonal
ingredients.raw: 2 small zucchini cut into 1-inch diagonal slices

steps: Pour boiling water over mushrooms and let stand 2 minutes; drain.
On 4 skewers alternately thread mushrooms and zucchini. Combine Italian dressing and Worcestershire sauce.
Grill kabobs over medium coals about 12 minutes turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture.
Thread cherry tomatoes on end of skewers and grill 5 to 10 minutes more until heated through, turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture.
Yield: 4 servings.

title: Mexican Hominy Casserole
steps: Drain hominy.
Place in 2-quart casserole dish.
Heat soup (undiluted).
Add Cheez Whiz and let melt.
Pour over hominy. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: German-Style Red Cabbage
steps: Cut cabbage into 6 wedges, removing core; place in large saucepan.
Add onion, sugar, salt, bay leaf and water.
Bring to boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Add vinegar and apple; cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until apple is tender.

title: Canadian Doughnuts

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: shortening or vegetable oil for frying

steps: In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine and sugar together until light. Add egg and milk. Stir until well blended. Sift flour a second time with baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Add enough of the flour mixture to the butter-sugar mixture to make a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll into 1/3-inch thick and cut with doughnut cutter.
In a deep skillet or deep fryer, heat vegetable oil or Crisco to 365°.
Fry doughnuts until golden brown on both sides, do not crowd.
Drain on absorbent paper and dust with powdered sugar or granulated sugar.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: Onion Puffs On French Rounds
steps: Cut small French rolls into slices and mound mixture of remaining ingredients onto each slice.
Place under broiler until puffy and slightly browned.

title: Pepperoni Puffs
steps: Combine cheese, mushrooms, onions and mayonnaise.
Spread about 2 teaspoons of the mixture on each toast round.
Place pepperoni slice on top.
Place on baking sheet.
Broil 3 to 5 minutes until cheese melts.
Serve immediately, or keep warm in 250° oven.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Stir in milk. Sift together and stir in dry ingredients. Chill at least one hour. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake in preheated 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until set.
Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Oven Spareribs
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Sprinkle ribs with lemon juice.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
While cooking, combine rest of ingredients.
Bring to boil, then remove.
Pour over ribs and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour (until tender).

title: Frankfurter Puffs
steps: Pour boiling water over 6 frankfurters.
Cover; let stand 8 minutes.
Slit each frank lengthwise.
Spread with mustard. Combine 2 cups well-seasoned mashed potatoes, minced onion, chopped pimento and chopped parsley.
Spread over split frank. Brown in broiler or oven.
Makes 6 servings.

title: 1900 Great-Grandmother Sarah Bright'S Laundry Soap

ingredients.name: good clean grease
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. good, clean grease (free from water)

steps: Dissolve the lye well in 5 cups cold water.
Melt the grease and strain through an old stocking into the lye, stirring all the time.
Mix the kerosene, amonnia and Borax together and then add the oil of sassafras.
Add the grease and mix well.

title: Low Calorie Salad
steps: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese.
Sprinkle orange jello over it and mix well.
Mix pineapple with oranges and add 1/2 box of pudding.
Mix with the mixture of Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Potato Souffle
steps: Brown onion in butter.
Add flour and then milk.
Add egg yolks and sauce to potatoes; mix well, then fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake in a greased dish in oven about 25 or 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Apple And Cheese Casserole
steps: Place apples in shallow casserole dish.
Cream butter with sugar.
Gradually work in cheese and flour.
Spread over apples and bake at 350° about 30 minutes until top begins to brown.

title: Beef Cheese Ball
steps: Grate dried beef.
Mix all ingredients together.
Roll cheese ball in extra grated dried beef.

title: Mock Pound Cake
steps: Blend margarine and cream cheese.
Add sugar, beat well until mixed.
Add eggs 1 at a time, blending until smooth; add vanilla. Sift flour, salt and baking powder 3 times.
Add flour alternately with milk.
Mix smooth after each addition.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 4-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° about 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Big Mac Sauce
steps: Mix well and keep refrigerated in a covered container.
Makes about 2 cups sauce.
Spoon over piping hot hamburgers.

title: Excellent Cheese Biscuits
steps: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese together and drop by tablespoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°.
Melt butter and add garlic powder.
Brush over warm biscuits.

title: Quick And Easy Dessert

ingredients.name: angel food cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 Angel Food cake mix or store bought

ingredients.name: blueberry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can blueberry pie filling (or any filling you like)

steps: Bake angel food cake as directed.
When cool, break cake in pieces and place in baking dish.
Cream sugar, cream cheese, and condensed milk together.
Fold in cool whip with electric mixer. Pour this mixture over cake pieces then add pie filling.

title: King'S Ranch Chicken

ingredients.name: nacho cheese dorito
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. nacho cheese Doritos, crushed

ingredients.name: garlic salt and red pepper
ingredients.raw: garlic salt and red pepper to taste

steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces.
Grease 9 x 13-inch dish with margarine.
Sprinkle crushed chips in dish.
Add other ingredients in order listed. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more.

title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup
steps: Cook asparagus in water until tender.
Whip asparagus in blender until smooth.
Saute onions in margarine.
Stir in flour and cook until bubbly.
Add milk gradually, stirring until thickened.
Stir in asparagus puree.
Add chopped parsley and salt to taste.
Do not boil.

title: Angel Rolls
steps: Let rise for 30 minutes and knead; cut out with biscuit cutter.
Dip in melted butter; let rise.
Bake at 450° until brown.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Cook first three ingredients for 5 minutes until sugar has dissolved.
Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter.
Mix well. Place in buttered platter to cool.

title: Ham, Potato And Cheese Chowder
steps: Put potatoes, onion, water and oleo in covered dish and microwave 10 to 12 minutes, stir occasionally.
In large bowl, combine milk, flour and pepper (shake flour and little milk to dissolve).
Microwave 6 to 7 minutes, stir often.
Pour over potatoes.
Add ham and cheese, microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Pineapple Pudding
steps: Drain pineapple and set juice side.
Mix flour and sugar.
Add reserved juice, stirring well.
Beat egg and add to mixture.
Stir in pineapple.
Pour into casserole dish.
Top with bread cube. Pour melted oleo over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Animals
steps: Place peanut butter, cream cheese and honey in mixing bowl. Stir until well blended.
Trim crust from bread.
Cut into animal shapes using cookie cutters.
Spread peanut butter on half the bread animals.
Top with a matching bread animal.
May be covered and refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
steps: Mix all together and store in an airtight container.
To make tea, use 2 teaspoons to cup of boiling water.

title: Strawberry Frozen Pie
steps: Blend yogurt, sour cream and strawberries together.
Pour into pie crust; freeze until solid.

title: Camper Stew
steps: Do not drain any of the ingredients.
Just pour in crock-pot. Mix all of the ingredients together and cook on low for about 6 hours or let simmer on low on top of stove for 2 hours.
Pepper, salt and add hot sauce to taste.

title: Apricot Spread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill.
Serve on little pieces of bread.

title: Cucumber Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients, except cucumber, mixing until well blended.
Stir in cucumber.
Chill several hours or overnight. Serve with chips or as a vegetable dip.
Yields 1 2/3 cups.

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
steps: Drain beans and bean sprouts; mix with onion and garlic.
Mix salad oil, sugar and vinegar together and pour over beans.
Let marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: 20 Minute Chicken Parmesan

ingredients.name: and chicken breast half
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless and skinless chicken breast halves

steps: Using palm of hand, flatten chicken to even thickness.
Dip chicken into egg, then into crumbs to coat.
In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, brown chicken on both sides.
Add sauce.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheeses.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Eggplant

ingredients.name: shrimp cleaned and coarsely
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. shrimp, cleaned and coarsely chopped

steps: Parboil the eggplant whole.
Let cool and cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop inside out, leaving about 1/2-inch around side and bottom.
Chop the pulp.
Saute onion, butter, parsley flakes and garlic powder until wilted.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes more.
Add eggplant pulp and 3/4 cup bread crumbs and shrimp and ingredients.
Cook on low heat until done, 5 to 10 minutes.
Fill hull and sprinkle rest of bread crumbs on top.
Add a strip of bacon on each one.
Bake in oven until bacon is done and bread crumbs are toasted.

title: Pineapple Carrot Bread

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 c. grated carrots (or I use canned carrots)

steps: Combine flour, salt, soda and cinnamon; set aside.
Combine eggs, sugar and oil in mixing bowl.
Mix well.
Stir in carrots and pineapple.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.
Yields 2 loaves or makes 5 miniature loaves.

title: Sandy'S Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: spinach and well
ingredients.raw: 1 bag spinach, washed and drained well

steps: Trim spinach; tear in small pieces and refrigerate.
Sprinkle strawberries with 1 teaspoon of sugar or artificial sweetener and refrigerate.

title: Tomato Beef Stew
steps: Shake meat with seasoned flour in plastic bag.
Brown meat in shortening in Dutch oven or stew pot.
Add soup and water; cover. Simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Cook 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Stir occasionally to thicken.
Uncover and cook to desired consistency.
Serves 5.

title: Peachy-Cream Shake
steps: Put 1/4 cup milk and sliced peaches in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Add ice cream.
Blend.
Add 3/4 cup milk.
Blend until mixture is combined.
Sweeten with sugar, if desired.
Pour into tall glasses.
Garnish with peach slices, if desired.
Serves 3 to 4.

title: Sweet-Potato Puff
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into pieces. Cover with water.
Bring to a boil and boil 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and mash. Beat egg, cream, salt, sugar and spices together, then beat into mashed potatoes. Whip until fluffy.
Heat oven to 350°. Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Pile whipped potatoes in baking dish.
Press marshmallows lightly into potato mixture. Bake, uncovered, about 30 minutes or until marshmallows are melted and browned.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Southern Fried Corn
steps: Cut kernels of corn off cobs with sharp knife.
Scrape each ear with knife to remove all of corn and milk from each ear.
Melt butter in heavy saucepan or heavy skillet.
Add corn and 1 tablespoon of milk per ear (about 1 cup for 12 ears).
Simmer until tender.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
(I use white pepper.)

title: Gold Coast Pork Chops

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small green pepper, cut into strips

steps: In skillet, brown chips (use shortening, if necessary).
Pour off fat.
Stir in soup, water, carrots, onion and sage. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes. Add green pepper and celery. Cook 15 minutes more until done. Stir occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Squash-Potato-Onion Casserole

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. shortening (bacon drippings may be used)

steps: Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Stir about 3 times.

title: Chocolate Vinegar Cake
steps: Mix in order.
Grease and flour a 13 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch cake pan.
Pour mixture in and bake at 300° for about 1 hour until top springs back at touch.

title: Walnut Cake
steps: Cream together Crisco, sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Mix well.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add vanilla. Mix all ingredients well.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 300°.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms

ingredients.name: or more mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. or more large fresh mushrooms

steps: Remove stems from mushrooms and wash carefully.
Save stems for another dish.
Combine drained crab meat and grated sharp cheese.
Add mayonnaise and mix well with a fork.
Stuff this mixture into each mushroom cap.
Sprinkle each with crushed crackers.
Bake for 10 minutes in 350° oven.
Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and run under the broiler until they bubble. Serves 8.

title: Garlic Grits
steps: Cook grits.
Add shredded cheese, margarine and Worcestershire sauce.
Add beaten eggs; mix.
Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Judy'S Fudge Candy
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Cook and boil for 10 minutes. Combine next 5 ingredients with cooked ingredients.
Add a pinch of salt and vanilla and mix.
Pour into pan lined with wax paper and chill for 4 hours.

title: Strudel
steps: Put fruit, sugar and salt in greased baking dish; dot with butter.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and egg.
Spread over top of fruit; cover with foil and bake at 375° for 20 minutes, or until fruit bubbles.
Uncover; bake 25 minutes longer.
Serve warm with topping, custard or ice cream.

title: Biscuit Pizza'S

ingredients.name: american cheese in fourth
ingredients.raw: 5 slices American cheese, cut in fourths

ingredients.name: pizza sauce
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. pizza sauce or barbecue sauce

steps: Leave biscuits out at room temperature while you are browning meat.
Drain grease after browning hamburger meat.
Add barbecue sauce or pizza sauce.

title: Hawaiian Sweet-Sour Ribs
steps: Fry ribs until brown and add soy sauce, sugar, vinegar and pineapple juice.
Cover and simmer about 30 minutes on low heat. Add pineapple chunks and continue to cook on low heat for another 30 minutes or until meat is tender.
If desired, thicken juice with cornstarch and serve.

title: Chicken Drummettes Teriyaki
steps: Cut large drummette sections from chicken wings and reserve rest for another use.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large, glass dish or plastic bag.
Add the drummettes and marinate. Refrigerate overnight.

title: My Mother'S Apricot-Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: apricot and fine
ingredients.raw: 1 large can apricots, drained and cut fine

steps: Drain and chill fruit.
Reserve juices.
Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Add 1 cup combined juices.
Chill until slightly congealed.
Fold in fruits and marshmallows.
Pour in long baking dish and chill until firm.
Spread with Cheese Topping.

title: Gingernut Cookies
steps: Melt butter in a pan and remove from heat; add sugar, syrup and beaten egg.
Mix until well combined.
Sift flour and ginger into bowl and pour in butter mixture.
Mix until combined.
Allow to cool a little.
Roll teaspoons of mixture into balls.
Place well apart on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake in moderate oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 45.

title: Macadamia Nut Fudge
steps: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil.
In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine sugar, salt, evaporated milk and butter, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a firm rolling boil. Boil 6 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat.
Stir in chips, unsweetened chocolate, marshmallows and vanilla.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into pan.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Remove from pan and peel off foil.
Makes 2 pounds, 10 1/2 ounces candy.
Contains a total of 5,950 calories; sorry!

title: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People)

ingredients.name: instant lemon pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. instant lemon pudding (approximately 3.5 oz. size)

steps: Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm.
One-half hour before serving, spread whipped cream over the top.

title: Breakfast Tacos(Eggs With Chile)
steps: Scramble the eggs with 1/4 cup of milk.
Saute onions in bacon grease.
Pour mixture into bacon grease in skillet.
Add chopped bacon.
In blender, mix jalapeno peppers with tomato sauce.
Add 1 cup of water to this mixture; dump into scrambled eggs.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with tortillas.
Serves at least 4 persons.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Top with Cheddar cheese, if desired.
Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Special Cheese Cake
steps: Soften
margarine
and blend with graham cracker crumbs. Spread evenly
on
bottom
and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Blend remaining
ingredients, one at a time and mix well.
Pour into spring pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Leave oven door closed for 1
hour to let set and cool.
Next open and cool, 30 minutes more.

title: Cukes
steps: Slice cucumbers and onions and cover with water; add salt. Let stand for 3 hours or more.
Drain and rinse.
Mix vinegar, sugar, water and celery.
Pour over cukes and let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
Can be frozen.

title: Punch For A Crowd
steps: Put Tang and sugar in a small container with lid and some of the water.
Shake until Tang and sugar are completely dissolved, then combine with all other ingredients in a very large container. Slice orange very thin and float on top.
Sugar can be omitted.

title: Light And Creamy Pumpkin Pie

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (6 serving size) instant vanilla pudding

steps: Combine pumpkin, milk, pudding mix and pie spice in a small bowl.
Beat at low speed until blended, about 1 minute.
Fold in 2 1/2 cups of Cool Whip.
Spoon into crust.
Refrigerate until firm, about 4 hours.
Use remaining Cool Whip on top, if desired.

title: Shoestring Potato Salad

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced, cooked chicken or tuna

steps: Mix salad dressing and mustard well.
Add to other ingredients (except potatoes) and mix well.
Chill.
Just before serving, add potatoes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
steps: Mix ingredients and sprinkle stuffing on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Deluxe Refrigerator Rolls
steps: In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water.
Stir in butter, shortening, sugar and potatoes.
Add cold water and salt; stir in flour.
Use immediately, or store in refrigerator.
Pat on table; cut into squares.
Makes about 3 dozen.
Place in pan, not touching.
Let rise 1 hour, until double in size.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Cake
steps: Light oil 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spread pineapple in pan.
Pour in cherry pie filling.
Sprinkle cake mix; slice oleo and place on top.
Top with nuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Favorite

ingredients.name: or c. prepared pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 or 2 c. prepared pie filling (cherry or other fruit)

steps: Whip cream cheese in milk.
Whip package of Dream Whip and add to cream cheese.
Place in crust.
Top with pie filling.
Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
steps: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and melted butter; spread half on bottom of pan and chill.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar and Dream Whip.
Beat until very stiff.
Spread half of this mixture on crust.
Next, spread cherry pie mix.
Top with remaining cream cheese mixture and then sprinkle with remaining graham cracker crumbs.

title: Italian Slaw
steps: Chop cabbage and leave in bowl.
Dice green peppers and onions.
Add to chopped cabbage.
Stir in sugar, salt, oil and vinegar.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Refrigerate for crispness.
May keep in closed glass container up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Tequila Slush

ingredients.name: wink
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. bottle Wink or similar drink

steps: Mix ingredients and freeze.
Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving and stir until slushy with a spoon.
Can be refrozen and kept indefinitely.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken

ingredients.name: or ground chicken
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cooked cubed or ground chicken

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend softened cream cheese and 4 tablespoons margarine.
Add chicken and spices; mix well.
Separate crescent rolls into triangles.
Place chicken filling on a triangle and top with another crescent triangle.
Twist.
Brush with margarine and top with crushed croutons.
Bake on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. olive oil or vegetable oil

steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft in a large saucepan; stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, salt, sugar and water. Heat to bubbling; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, stirring frequently, 45 minutes or until sauce has thickened.
Yield:
5 cups.

title: Pecan Buns
steps: In a large bowl, blend egg, sugar and warm water.
Stir in yeast until dissolved.
Add roll mix gradually.
Add extra flour and knead until dough is not sticky.
Put in a warm place and let rise about one hour.

title: Tom'S Navy Bean Soup
steps: Wash and look through beans.
Combine beans and water in large dutch oven, bring to boil, cover and remove from heat.
Let stand for one hour.
Add ham hocks, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 hours.
Remove meat from bone, chop into pieces and add back to soup.
Stir in salt and pepper.
Saute onion in butter and add to soup, stirring in well.
Serve while hot with cornbread or crackers.
Yields about 5 quarts.

title: "Date Ball" Cookies
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until it boils hard.
Cool slightly; add 1 teaspoon vanilla and Rice Krispies.
You may substitute 1 cup nuts for 1 cup Rice Krispies.
Cool.
Form into balls (1 teaspoon each) and roll in coconut.
(Good frozen.)

title: Beignets From Togo
steps: Grind dry black-eyed peas into a flour.
Mix this with chili pepper, minced onion and salt.
Add small amount of water to make small rolls.
Fry in hot oil.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Salad

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Cheddar cheese, cubed or strips

steps: Cook macaroni, drain and rinse with cold water.
Combine macaroni, cheese, tuna, onion and celery in a large bowl.
Stir together (use ziti macaroni).
Pour salad dressing, salt and pepper over macaroni mixture and mix thoroughly.
Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Serves 5 to 8.

title: Magic Potion(Halloween)
steps: Prepare Creepy Crawler Ice Ring.
Pour boiling water over gelatin in heatproof bowl.
Stir until gelatin dissolves.
Stir in cold water.
Add lemon-lime beverage and sugar; stir well (mixture will foam for several minutes).
Unmold ice ring by dipping bottom of mold briefly into hot water.
Float ice ring in punch.
Serve cups of punch garnished with gummy worms, if desired.

title: Nan'S Hershey Chocolate Cake
steps: Soften butter.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour, syrup and vanilla.
Bake in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Six-Layer Casserole
steps: In a greased casserole, make a layer of each ingredient in the order listed.
Season each layer.
Bake for 2 hours at 350°. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Coconut Chews
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and cream in saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved.
Continue cooking without stirring to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat; fold in corn flakes, coconut and nuts.
Press into buttered pan.

title: Braised Cabbage
steps: In a large pot saut onions and bacon until tender.
Add cabbage, water, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer until done.
Mix cornstarch with water and add to cabbage.
Cook until liquid is slightly thick.

title: Loaf Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Grease and flour a loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 10 or 12 minutes or until done.

title: Mississippi Mud
steps: Combine walnuts, flour and butter until crumbly, Sprinkle into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees.
Cool.
Mix 2 instant chocolate puddings with 2 c. milk.
Spread over cream cheese layer.
Mix 2 instant vanilla puddings with 2 c. milk.
Spread over chocolate layer.
Top with 1-12 oz.
Cool whip, Sprinkle with chocolate jimmies.

title: Shrimply Delicious

ingredients.name: shrimp cocktail and sauce
ingredients.raw: 3 jars Fresh shrimp cocktail and sauce (found in meat or seafood dept.)

ingredients.name: salad shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1/2 bag cooked salad shrimp (frozen food section)

steps: Thaw shrimp, rinse and drain.
Let cream cheese stand at room temperature for 1 hour or until softened.
Put all three packages into a bowl.
Add 3 jars of Fresh.
Mix together until well blended.
The cream cheese will be pink in color.
Fold in shrimp. Serve with vegetables and grain crackers.
Great for all occasions.

title: Dog Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine wheat flour, powdered milk, salt and garlic powder.
Cut in shortening or meat drippings until mixture resembles corn meal.
Mix in egg and add enough ice water until mixture forms a dough.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick and cut. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until done.

title: Fried Chicken
steps: Mix flour, meal, salt and pepper in a dish.
Melt shortening in an electric skillet.
Roll chicken in batter and fry in electric skillet for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: North Carolina Bishops Bread

ingredients.name: maraschino cherry and up
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, drained and cut up (1 c.)

steps: Combine eggs and sugar.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to egg mixture.
Stir in dates, cherries, chocolate pieces and nuts.
Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/4 hours.
Let stand overnight before slicing.

title: Louise'S Cornbread
steps: Mix cornmeal, sugar, and oil.
Add 3/4 boiling water.
Mix well.
Beat egg yolk and add to mixture along with the buttermilk. Whip egg white and fold in.
Pour into muffin tins sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 400° for 12-15 minutes.

title: Fried Alligator Fingers
steps: Soak the fingers in buttermilk for several hours; drain and salt and pepper to taste.
Heat about 1-inch of oil in frying pan. Shake the fingers in flour.
Place in frypan in hot oil on medium heat for several minutes, turning until all sides are brown.

title: Nut Muffins
steps: In a medium bowl combine brown sugar, pecans, flour and salt. Stir in eggs and vanilla just until blended.
Batter will be lumpy.
Spray the muffin cups with cooking spray or line them with paper cups.
Fill cups about 2/3 full.
Place muffin cups in cold oven.
Set oven on 300° and bake for 25 minutes.
Cool on a wire rack, run a knife round the edge of each muffin cup to loosen muffins.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Smoked Sausage And Apple-Kraut
steps: Mix sauerkraut, apples and thyme in a Dutch oven.
Put the smoked sausage on top.
Poke the sausage several times with a fork.
Pour the apple juice in the Dutch oven. Simmer in covered pan for 1/2 hour.
If there is too much liquid, continue to simmer, uncovered, until the liquid is reduced.

title: Hard Cinnamon Candy
steps: Mix sugar, corn syrup and water in a large saucepan and stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves.
Boil without stirring, until the temperature reaches 310° or until drops of mixture form brittle threads in cold water.
Remove from heat and allow to stand until all bubbles have simmered down.
Stir in flavoring and coloring.
Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. When cool enough to touch, break in pieces and coat with powdered sugar.
Store in airtight container.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices

ingredients.name: baking potato
ingredients.raw: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices (about 4 c.)

steps: In a small bowl, combine soup, pepper and paprika.
In 2-quart oblong baking dish, greased, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Pour soup mixture over potatoes.
Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Turn over and bake 10 minutes longer until potatoes are tender.
Serves 6.

title: Cranapple Crunch
steps: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, which has been buttered, with the apples.
Spread with cranberries.
Mix oatmeal, flour, brown sugar and butter.
Crumble over apples and cranberries.
Bake at 300° until done.

title: Navy Bean Soup(Crock-Pot)

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ham or smoked pork butt

steps: Soak beans in water overnight.
Combine all ingredients in cooker. Add water to cover. Cook on low 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours. Remove ham or pork from soup; cut into pieces and return to pot.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cherry Pie Delight
steps: Cream together the cream cheese, sugar and milk.
Spread mixture over crust.
Spread Cool Whip over top.
Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Cottage Cheese Croquettes
steps: Saute onion until soft.
Combine all other ingredients.
Chill for 1 hour or overnight.
Make croquettes.
Place on oiled cookie sheet and bake at 350° until brown.
Serve with gravy.

title: Upper Crust Chicken

ingredients.name: kraft sharp natural cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded Kraft sharp natural Cheddar cheese

steps: Trim crust from bread, reserving crust.
Cut bread slices diagonally into quarters.
Cut reserved crust into cubes.
Combine bread cubes, chicken, celery and 1 3/4 cups cheese; mix well. Spoon into 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.
Arrange bread quarters over chicken mixture.
Combine mayonnaise, egg and seasonings, mix well.
Gradually add milk, mixing until blended. Pour over bread.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes.
Garnish with celery leaves, if desired.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Pan-Fried Potatoes And Zucchini
steps: Cut vegetables into chunks.
Cook potatoes in oil over medium-high until some have browned.
Add zucchini, salt and pepper.
Cover; cook over medium-low until zucchini is done.

title: Sweet Potato-Pecan Puffs

ingredients.name: baked
ingredients.raw: 4 baked or boiled sweet potatoes or yams

steps: Whip sweet potatoes with margarine.
Season to taste with spices.
Form mixture into small balls.
Cover each ball with pecans.
Arrange on lightly greased baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Serve piping hot.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dessert Cake
steps: Place the egg in a bowl and beat.
Add the fruit cocktail, then add dry ingredients (except brown sugar).
Mix well.
Put in ungreased pan.
Sprinkle with the brown sugar.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
Broken pecans can be added on top of brown sugar before baking.

title: Mock Chopped Liver
steps: Saute the onion until brown.
Blend all ingredients in food processor.
Serve chilled with crackers.

title: Frito Dressing
steps: Mix together.
Put into baking dish.
Bake in oven 25 minutes at 325° until brown.

title: Krispy Cheese Crackers
steps: Mix cheese and margarine; add flour, salt and pepper, mix well.
Shape into small balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork.
Bake at 375° about 10 minutes.

title: Ham Potato Patties
steps: Combine potatoes, onion and ham.
Chill 1 hour.
Shape mixture into patties.
Combine milk and eggs. Dip patties into this mixture and then in crumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Potato & Sausage Chowder
steps: Melt butter and cook onion until soft.
Stir in flour.
Add potatoes, milk, salt & pepper.
Cook 25-30 minutes.
Add cheese and kielbasa and cook another 2-3 minutes.

title: Cheese Meat Roll
steps: Combine beef, egg, crumbs, onion, 1/3 cup sauce, salt, oregano and pepper.
Mix well and shape into flat rectangle, about 10 x 12 inches, on waxed paper.
Sprinkle cheese over.
Roll as for jelly roll; press ends to seal.
Bake in shallow baking dish at 350° for 1 hour.
Drain off excess fat.
Pour remaining sauce over roll; bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Husband'S Delight
steps: In a large skillet, brown beef with onion, then drain grease. Stir in soup, cream cheese and catsup.
Transfer to a large casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Top with biscuits and bake for an additional 10 to 20 minutes, until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Strawberries On A Cloud
steps: Mix sour cream, evaporated milk and 10x sugar together.
Add thawed whipped topping.
Tear angel food cake into small pieces and put into a large bowl.
Add first mixture, stir together.
Mix strawberries (sliced) and glaze.
Put on top of cake mixture. Keep refrigerated.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 c. diced chicken, cooked or 2 cans Hormel chicken

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal.
Slit top.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Cool 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni And Cheese With Tomatoes
steps: Cook macaroni.
Peel and chop onion.
Preheat oven to 350°. Open can of stewed tomatoes.
In mixing bowl, combine milk, cheese, stewed tomatoes and onion.
Pour cooked macaroni into baking dish.
Pour tomato cheese mixture over macaroni and stir. Bake in oven for 40 minutes.

title: Helen'S Macaroni And Cheese

ingredients.name: and mild cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: medium and mild Cheddar cheese (use 2/3 to 3/4 lb. per each c. macaroni)

steps: Grate cheese in flat dish.
Beat egg and pour over cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add milk to cover cheese.
Pour cooked macaroni into dish; stir.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Frosty Dessert
steps: Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip; stir until smooth.
Spread on cooled crust.
Mix pudding with milk. Spread on top of cream cheese.
Spread Cool Whip on top of cream cheese.
Sprinkle with whatever you have.

title: Cake Frosting
steps: Cream shortening.
Add confectioners sugar; add egg whites and beat well.
Add vanilla or other desired flavoring.
Beat until smooth; spread on cake.

title: Red Cabbage(A Sweet And Sour Dish With Great Color)
steps: In a small saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar and cloves.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes.
Remove cloves.
Add onion and water; simmer 5 more minutes.
Place shredded cabbage in a large saucepan and pour hot vinegar solution over cabbage.
Cook until cabbage is hot and crisp-tender (5 to 6 minutes).

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Fritters
steps: Combine egg and milk.
Stir in sugar and salt.
Sift and mix together the flour and baking powder.

title: Corn To Can
steps: Cut raw corn off of cob and measure.
Add water, sugar and salt.
Stir well.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Cool.
Put into freezer containers and freeze.

title: Easy Baked Beans

ingredients.name: pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans pork and beans (any brand)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Ym Ym Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil and debone chicken breasts.
Place in casserole dish. Undercook broccoli and layer on top of chicken.
Melt together both soups, mushrooms, margarine and cheese.
Pour over broccoli and chicken.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: New Year'S Omelet
steps: Scramble eggs in a bowl.
Add ham and cheese.
Mix.
Add a dash of wine and spice to taste.
Pour in a heated skillet.
Flip when lightly golden brown.

title: Guey Cake
steps: Mix.
Pour mixture on top of cake in pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Slush Cake
steps: Mix together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Fried Rabbit

ingredients.name: rabbit dressed cleaned and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. rabbit, dressed, cleaned and cut into serving pieces

steps: Roll rabbit in mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Heat fat or oil, about 1/4 inch deep, in heavy frypan, large enough to hold the pieces without crowding.
Use moderate temperature.

title: Western Stew
steps: Marinate meat in dressing for several hours or overnight in fridge.
Remove from marinade and brown meat.
Combine meat, marinade and water in a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Add vegetables and continue baking for 45 minutes.
Place biscuits around edge of casserole; brush with margarine.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 475° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Fettuccine

ingredients.name: loui kemp crab delight flake or
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Louis Kemp Crab Delights flakes or chunks

steps: Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain.
Heat butter and garlic in skillet on medium heat until garlic is lightly browned.
Add Crab Delights, half and half and pepper.
Heat about 3 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble, stirring occasionally.
Add Parmesan cheese; stir for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Toss Crab Delight sauce with fettuccine.
Serve immediately with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Makes four 1-cup servings.

title: Yankee Doodle Soup
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.
Makes about 6 cups.

title: Dean'S Squash Casserole

ingredients.name: squash up and boiled until tender
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. squash, cut up and boiled until tender

steps: After cooking squash, beat in bowl with Mixmaster.
Add other ingredients, including bread crumbs.
Place in shallow casserole; cover with more bread crumbs.
Dot with butter; bake for about 45 minutes at 350°, until brown on top.

title: Roasted Pecan Clusters
steps: Melt butter in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan.
Spread pecans evenly in pan.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Christmas Cookies
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Mix well. Add shortening and cut into flour mixture with a pastry blender. Break eggs in a cup and fill with milk to make 1 cup; add vanilla. Add to flour mixture and mix well.
Chill if desired for easier handling.
Roll out on pastry cloth and cut out cookies.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool and decorate as desired.

title: Fruit Ice Cream

ingredients.name: whipping cream
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 pt. whipping cream or half and half

steps: Mix and pour into ice cream freezer.
Freeze per instructions for freezer.

title: Doughnuts
steps: Beat the one egg; add sugar and beat until very light and white.
Add the milk without stirring.
Then sift 1 pint flour to which has been added the baking powder and salt and nutmeg.
Beat this thoroughly; then add quickly enough flour to make a firm but soft dough.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into rings.

title: Christmas Gelatin Layered Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple juice
ingredients.raw: 1 1/3 c. pineapple juice (add water to get desired amount)

steps: Layer 1:
Dissolve lime gelatin in hot water.
Add pineapple and juice-water mixture to gelatin; stir well.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and place in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Cream Caramel Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt together.
Alternating, add flour and sour cream to butter mixture.
Add vanilla.

title: Stroganoff Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain.
Combine ground beef, onion and seasonings.
Shape into 16 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in oil, turning to brown all sides.
Stir in soup.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sour cream, macaroni and sweet peas.
Put in greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bunker Hills
steps: Combine
Spam,	cheese, mayonnaise, relish and mustard. Pile on open-face buns.	Broil until cheese is bubbly.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Sauce

ingredients.name: or rhubarb
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. fresh or frozen chopped rhubarb

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan combine rhubarb, sugar, 2 tablespoons water and cardamon or cinnamon.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes or until fruit is tender.
Stir together the 1 tablespoon water and cornstarch.
Add to rhubarb mixture.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for 2 minutes more.
Stir in strawberries. Serve warm over ice cream.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: broccoli according pkg. direction and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked according to pkg. directions and drained

ingredients.name: ham in
ingredients.raw: 2 c. ham, cut in small pieces

steps: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli, ham and rice.
Mix well. In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole.
Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

title: B J'S Baked Ham Omelette

ingredients.name: muenster
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Muenster or Jack cheese, shredded

steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Sift flour with baking powder; beat eggs and season lightly.
Add 5 to 6 drops Tabasco sauce.
Stir in flour, ham, cheese, cottage cheese and most of the melted margarine.
Swirl rest of margarine around in dish to coat evenly.
Pour in egg mixture.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until puffed and golden brown.
Cut into squares and serve.

title: Two-Flavor Fudge

ingredients.name: each butterscotch and chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. each: butterscotch and chocolate chips

steps: In saucepan, combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, evaporated milk and butter or margarine.
Bring to full boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently.
Boil for 15 minutes over moderate heat, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat.
Add marshmallow cream, butterscotch chips and chocolate chips.
Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth.
Blend in nuts and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.
Freezes well.

title: Chutney Chicken Spread

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. grated onion or sliced scallion

steps: Process chicken in food processor for 5 seconds, using steel blade.
Add cream cheese, chutney, curry, onion, mayonnaise and pepper.
Process 5 to 10 seconds, until well blended.
Place in an au gratin dish; spread with almonds.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Serve with large corn chips.

title: Pot Roast

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. beef round or chuck roast

steps: In a 6-quart saucepan, put oil and heat.
Brown roast on both sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; cook 2 hours.
Add vegetables.
Cook 45 minutes.
Remove roast and vegetables.
Stir in flour and 1/2 cup water.
Gradually stir into pot.
Cook until it boils and thickens.

title: Mum'S Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: white rice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. white rice (old fashioned or 5 minute)

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cook rice and raisins together.
Beat egg yolks and add sugar, pinch of salt, milk, nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Caramel Coconut Pie

ingredients.name: dish pie crust baked and cooled
ingredients.raw: 2 deep dish pie crusts, baked and cooled

steps: Brown coconut and pecans lightly in 1/4 cup margarine.
Mix cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip. Put 1/4 cream cheese mixture in each pie crust.
Drizzle 1/4 jar caramel and 1/4 coconut mixture.
Repeat layers.
Freeze (better results if frozen overnight).
Thaw 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cran-Apple Bake
steps: Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for one hour or until brown and bubbly.

title: Caramel Apple Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: apple cored and
ingredients.raw: 2 small apples, peeled, cored and sliced

ingredients.name: old fashioned
ingredients.raw: 1/3 to 1/2 c. old-fashioned or reduced-fat caramel apple dip

steps: Beat cream cheese and sugar in mixing bowl until fluffy and well-blended.
Spread on bottom of pie crust.
In skillet, over medium heat, melt butter and add apples.
Cook, stirring, until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes.
Drain well on paper towels.

title: Maxine'S 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
steps: In a 1 1/2-quart bowl, stir sugar, cocoa, milk and vanilla together until partially blended.
Place butter over top in center of bowl.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir vigorously until smooth.
(Don't worry if all the butter does not melt; it will as mixture is stirred.)
Pour mixture into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.
Cut into squares.
Makes about 36 squares.

title: Baked Spareribs Aloha
steps: Cut ribs into serving pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in shallow pan. Bake at 450° for 1/2 hour.
Pour off excess fat.
Reduce oven heat to 350°.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Pour over ribs. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tangy Tea Mix

ingredients.name: tang powdered orange drink
ingredients.raw: 14 oz. Tang (1 3/4 c.) powdered orange drink

steps: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl.
Store in glass jars.

title: E-Z Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Use can from cream of mushroom soup to add the hot water and half and half to all ingredients.
Stir together and put in casserole dish and bake at 400° for one hour.

title: Pepsi Barbecue Chicken
steps: Put chicken in pan.
Put salt over chicken, then put Pepsi up to the top of chicken.
Then cook 1 hour at 350°.
Then cover with barbecue sauce.

title: Vanilla Wafer Pudding

ingredients.name: maraschino cherry and
ingredients.raw: 1 bottle maraschino cherries, drained and chopped

steps: Pour half of the vanilla wafers into about a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Whip cream until stiff and fold in drained maraschino cherries (chopped) and drained crushed pineapple.
Add chopped nuts.
Layer the creamed mixture over the wafers; add the remaining vanilla wafers.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pineapple Glazed Apple Pie

ingredients.name: tart apple cored and in
ingredients.raw: 7 tart medium apples, peeled, cored and cut in wedges (7 c.)

steps: In large saucepan, combine 1 1/4 cups of pineapple juice and sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Add apple wedges.
Simmer, covered, 3 to 4 minutes or until apples are tender, but not soft.
With slotted spoon, lift apples from liquid.
Set apples aside to drain.
Blend the remaining 1/4 cup pineapple juice slowly into cornstarch.
Add to hot pineapple liquid in saucepan.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles.
Cook 1 minute more.
Remove from heat; stir in butter or margarine, vanilla and salt.
Cover and cool 30 minutes, without stirring.

title: Chocolate Thing
steps: Melt butter in a 6 x 9-inch glass baking dish.
Mix in flour and pecans.
Press into pan to form crust.

title: Key Lime Pie (Or Lemon)

ingredients.name: key lime juice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Key lime juice or lemon

steps: Fold together milk and juice.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into crust and cool for a few hours.

title: Angel Food Pie
steps: Put water, sugar and pineapple in top of double boiler and bring just to boiling point.
Mix flour and cornstarch and add to pineapple mixture.
Cook until it thickens.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
When cool, fold in egg whites.
Pour into 2 baked pie shells.
Top with 1/2 pint whipped topping for each pie. Sprinkle with coconut.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Gelatin Easter Baskets

ingredients.name: jell o brand gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor)

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water.
Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

title: Midwestern Scalloped Corn And Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown sausage; drain off all fat except about 2 tablespoons. Add flour and stir until blended, then add milk and stir until mixture boils and thickens.
Add corn, salt and pepper to mixture. Place into shallow casserole.
Arrange thick slices of tomato over the top of sausage and corn mixture.
Top with grated cheese. Place under broiler for 4 to 5 minutes, until tomatoes are cooked and cheese is melted.
Yields 4 servings.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake

ingredients.name: ready crust graham cracker pie crust

steps: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar.
Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip, blending well.
Spoon onto crust.
Chill until set, at least 4 hours.
Garnish with fresh strawberries, if desired.

title: Apricot Cookies
steps: Cream the butter with sugar.
Mix in egg yolks, then flour, then nuts.
Use hands.
Grease an 8-inch square pan.
Put half of the dough in pan.
Top with 2 tablespoons of apricot preserves. Put the rest of the dough on top of the apricot preserves.
Spread remaining preserves on top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Party Potato Salad

ingredients.name: wyler s chicken flavor instant bouillon
new potato and
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. new potatoes, cooked and sliced

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. small cooked shrimp or cubed cooked ham (optional)

steps: In large bowl, mix buttermilk, mayonnaise, horseradish, sugar, bouillon and dill.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill.
Garnish.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: A-B-C Salad

ingredients.name: lime gelatin dissolved in c. boiling water
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. lime gelatin, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water

ingredients.name: fruit juice
ingredients.raw: 1 c. fruit juice or cold water

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add fruit juice or cold water.
Add fruit cocktail.
Pour in a 9 x 13-inch dish and let set.

title: Breakfast Ham Ring(Yields 8 Servings)
steps: In a large bowl lightly beat 2 eggs.
Add ham, sausage, bread crumbs, milk, parsley and horseradish and mix well.
Press into a greased 6 cup ring mold.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Toward end of baking time, prepare scrambled eggs with remaining eggs. Remove ring from oven and drain juices.
Unmold onto serving platter.
Fill center with scrambled eggs.
Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Spinach Shells

ingredients.name: cream spinach cooled
ingredients.raw: 2 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen creamed spinach, cooled

ingredients.name: container ricotta cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese

steps: Prepare shells and drain.
Cool spinach and pour into large bowl.
Add salt, pepper and cheese (Ricotta or cottage cheese). Mix fried beef and spaghetti sauce.
Stuff cheese mixture into shells.
Pour spaghetti sauce over shells.
Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and
ingredients.raw: 2 whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into strips

steps: Drain oranges, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup.
Blend syrup with stir-fry sauce.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or skillet (high heat).
Add chicken, cashews and garlic; stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Heat remaining oil in same pan.
Add onion and snow peas.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes and then add chicken, cashews and stir-fry sauce mixture.
Cook and stir to coat all ingredients.
Remove from heat and stir in oranges.
Serve on rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Sugar-Free)
steps: Mix all ingredients until well blended.
Pour into unbaked 8-inch pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Then 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Lemon Pie(No Bake)
steps: In medium mixing bowl, blend cream cheese, lemonade and condensed milk until smooth.
Add a few drops of food coloring. Blend well.
Squeeze 1/2 lemon into mixture.
Add Cool Whip and blend for a few minutes.
Pour into pie crust.
Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Shredded Carrot And Egg Salad
steps: In a medium bowl, combine carrot, onion, eggs and salt.
Add salad dressing.
Toss to combine.
Refrigerate about 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese And Apple Spread

ingredients.name: red deliciou and golden apple
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. finely chopped red Delicious and golden apples

steps: Combine softened cream cheese and salad dressing, mixing well. Add cheese and apples; mix well.
Chill.
Serve with apple wedges, crackers and bread.
Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Easy Rotini Salad
steps: Mix vinegar and sugar; slowly add oil.
Add cooked rotini and green pepper.

title: Edna'S Cornbread
steps: Mix corn, eggs and sour cream together.
Add meal.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Makes 16.

title: Potato Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Using a large bowl, beat eggs well. Add flour, salt, baking powder and butter to eggs and beat well until all is dissolved.
Add potatoes and onions and mix well. Don't be afraid to use your hands!
Pour into brownie pan and bake for 1 hour.
Enjoy!

title: Cicoria Fina Agliata(Dandelion Sauteed With Garlic)
steps: Clean and wash greens, cut in half.
Place in saucepan.
Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender.
Remove and drain.
Heat oil and garlic in frying pan.
Place greens in pan.
Stir with wooden spoon until slightly dry.
Serve hot.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Buttermilk Chicken
steps: Melt 1 stick of butter in a flat casserole dish.
Salt, pepper and flour chicken pieces.
Place in dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Turn over and bake for 15 minutes more.
Mix cream of chicken soup with buttermilk and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake for 15 minutes longer.
Serve with rice.

title: Jello Pie
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients well; let come to boil.
Add jello. Mix and let cool.
Chill milk.
Beat until stiff and add all together.
Pour in crust.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Mix together and shape into balls.
Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Play Clay
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Work the mixture with your hands until it feels well mixed.
Shape the dough into decorations like stars or snowmen or cut with cookie cutters.
Be sure to make small hole in the top or push a paper clip into the dough.

title: Easy 1 Hour Rolls
steps: Heat milk to lukewarm.
Add oil.
Mix yeast and sugar into a small amount of warm water to dissolve yeast.
Add to milk mixture and then dry ingredients. Roll out on floured board and knead well. Cut out biscuits and place in oiled pan.
Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a covered pan and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add cheese, stirring over low heat until cheese is melted.
Whisk in beer and stir until well blended.

title: Pizza Bread
steps: Thaw frozen bread dough.
Roll dough into 2 (14 x 8-inch) rectangles.
Beat together eggs, Parmesan cheese and oregano. Spread egg mixture on dough, reserving 3 tablespoons.
Top with cheese and melt.
Roll up from long edge and pinch seams to seal. Place seam side down in greased pan.
Brush top of loaves with remaining egg mixture.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Escallop Corn
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in a greased, uncovered container, 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Oh-So Easy Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Reserve 1/4 cup of the M&M's.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Spread in pan.
Sprinkle with reserved candies.
Bake about 30 minutes, until light golden brown; cool. Cut into bars.
Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Chiffon Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
In egg whites, add 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar and beat well until very stiff.
In yolks, add flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, oil, extract, rind and water.
Beat well until creamy.
Fold into egg whites, do not beat.
Pour into 10 inch tube pan.
Do not grease.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes and 375° for 10 minutes more.

title: One Pan Dinner
steps: In electric frypan, brown pork chops and onion.
Wash sweet potatoes and microwave 10 minutes on High.

title: Frankfurters And Sauerkraut
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients
and cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours, the longer the better.
Add frankfurters and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Manicotti(Jean Stapleton'S Recipe)
steps: Grease griddle lightly.
Wipe away excess grease with paper towel.
Put one teaspoonful batter on griddle.
These do not need to brown.
Do not turn.
They are done when top appears dry.

title: Angel Food Cake And Strawberries

ingredients.name: angel food cake bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 angel food cake torn into bite size pieces

steps: Mix jello according to directions minus 1 cup of cold water. Refrigerate until partly set.
Mix in Cool Whip and strawberries. Mix well.
Add angel food cake and stir just until mixed. Refrigerate until set.
This is better is it is made a day ahead of time.

title: Before Breakfast
steps: Fry sausage and
drain
off fat.
Beat eggs.
Add milk, salt and mustard.
Layer in 9
x 13-inch baking dish or pan:
bread, sausage and cheese.
Pour egg mixture over all.
Put in cold oven. Set temperature at 350°.
Bake 45 minutes.

title: Spanish Cabbage
steps: Fry bacon; break in pieces.
Saute onion and green pepper. Chop cabbage.
Add tomatoes, salt and pepper and vinegar.
Put all in one pot and boil until cabbage is done.

title: Herbed Toast

ingredients.name: italian
ingredients.raw: 2 (1 1/2 oz.) slices Italian or French bread

ingredients.name: each basil and parsley
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. each: chopped fresh basil and parsley

steps: Preheat broiler.
In small mixing bowl, combine margarine, basil and parsley; mix thoroughly.
Onto each slice of bread, spread half of the margarine mixture; sprinkle half of the cheese on each slice of bread.
On nonstick baking sheet, arrange bread slices, herb-side up, and broil until cheese is golden, about 1 minute.

title: 8 Layer Salad

ingredients.name: lettuce sprinkled with salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 head shredded lettuce, sprinkled with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: bacon fried crisp and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled

ingredients.name: hellmann s mayonnaise and c. miracle whip mixed together
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Hellmann's mayonnaise and 1 c. Miracle Whip, mixed together

steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer as follows:
1/2 head shredded lettuce, bacon, eggs, peas, onion, mixed dressing, ham and Swiss cheese.
Press down after each layer.
The dressings will spread thickly over entire surface and top with ham and cheese.
Cover with Glad Wrap and refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Cole Slaw Without Mayonnaise
steps: Grate or shred cabbage and soak in water for an hour Drain and rinse well and pat off water.
Mix sour cream, sugar and cider vinegar well and pour over cabbage and mix well.
If using caraway seeds, spin then in the blender long enough to release the oils and mix in the slaw.

title: Chocolate Pie (No Cook)

ingredients.name: sq. semi sweet chocolate and cooled
ingredients.raw: 2 sq. semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: Combine sugar and butter.
Beat in electric mixer at medium speed five minutes.
Add chocolate and one egg; beat five minutes. Add other egg, vanilla and salt; beat five minutes.
Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon in baked pie shell and chill.

title: Smothered Deer Tips
steps: Cut stew meat into small pieces and brown in cooking oil. Remove meat and saute onion and garlic in the oil.
When onion is tender, put the meat back into oil with onion and garlic.
Add flour and toss until blended.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Lower heat and slowly add water until sauce is not too thick.
