Add Kitchen Bouquet to darken and simmer on low flame until meat is tender, about 1 hour.

title: Banana Cream Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: graham cracker crumb crust
ingredients.raw: 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

ingredients.name: realemon lemon juice from concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate

steps: In a large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla.
Slice 2 bananas; dip in lemon juice.
Drain and line crust.
Pour over bananas; cover.
Chill 3 hours or until set. Before serving, slice remaining bananas; dip in lemon juice, drain and garnish top of pie.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Coconut Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
steps: Mix eggs, sugar, flour, oleo, milk, coconut and vanilla.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Chicken
steps: Place chicken parts in a single layer in large baking pan. Cover with soup, onion and Chablis wine.
Cover dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with rice and vegetable.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: John'S Favorite Buffalo Wings

ingredients.name: chicken wing up
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. chicken wings, cut up or wingettes

ingredients.name: durkee red hot sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 large bottle Durkee red hot sauce

steps: Melt butter and mix with red hot sauce.
Cook wings in oven at 325° for 1 hour.
After hour is up, pour sauce mixture over wings. Turn oven up to 425° and cook for 1 more hour.
Serve hot with Blue cheese salad dressing for dipping.

title: President Clinton'S Lemon Chess Pie
steps: In a large bowl, toss sugar, flour and cornmeal with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

title: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (or 2 1/2 - 3 pounds chicken pieces with skin removed)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray.
Roll chicken pieces in flour to evenly cover all sides.
Dip chicken in egg white and roll in cornflake crumbs. Place on prepared cookie sheet.
Bake 20 - 30 minutes for boneless breast halves or 45 - 55 minutes for chicken pieces.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed on package.
Chop onion, pepper and celery.
Brown sausage and drain, then add vegetables.
Cook until vegetables are limp.
Add rice and soup and pour into greased 3-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Quail Our Favorite Way

ingredients.name: enough flour in a sack coat quail
ingredients.raw: enough flour in a large sack to coat quail

ingredients.name: cooking oil in heavy cooking utensil
ingredients.raw: cooking oil 2 1/2 inches deep in heavy cooking utensil (should be enough oil to cover quail)

steps: Shake salt over each quail, covering all parts.
Put quail in sack with flour and shake well.
Oil should be hot enough that it bubbles when quail are placed in it.
Put quail in oil with breast side down.
Turn when browned with total cooking time not over 10 minutes.
Remove quail to drain on paper towel.
Pour off oil into container, reserving enough oil and drippings to make gravy.

title: Peach Almond Cream Tart

ingredients.name: peach filling and
ingredients.raw: 1 (21 oz.) can peach filling and topping

steps: Bake pie shell at 375° for 15 minutes.
In bowl, combine condensed milk, sour cream, lemon and extract; mix well. Reserving 6 peach slices, spread remaining filling on bottom of pie shell.
Top with sour cream mixture.
Top with reserved peach slices and almonds.
Bake 30 minutes at 375°.
Cool.
Refrigerate.

title: Hungry Jack'S Pancakes
steps: Break eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork.
Add buttermilk and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix just long enough to blend well.
Pour onto hot griddle and brown lightly on both sides.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Beat eggs and add milk.
Add salt and mustard.
Cube bread; stir into eggs.
Add cheese and sausage. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Crabmeat Dip
steps: Heat all ingredients in a double boiler.
Serve warm with crackers.

title: Punch For A Bunch
steps: Mix and chill.
Freeze some of the punch in a mold to keep cold.
Do not add ice.
The ice will melt and water down the punch.

title: Fat-Free Fudge Brownies
steps: Combine flour, cocoa, sugar and salt.
Stir to mix well.
Stir in applesauce, egg whites and vanilla.
Fold in nuts, if desired. Coat an 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Spread batter evenly in pan and bake at 325° for 23 to 25 minutes or until the edges are firm and the center is almost set.
Cool to room temperature.
Cut into squares and serve.
Yields 16 servings. Contains 80 calories and 4 grams fat.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
steps: In large saucepan, boil/steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water. Remove about 1/4 of the broccoli and set aside.
Put remaining broccoli in blender and puree until smooth.
In large saucepan over medium heat, combine flour, butter and 1 cup of water until creamy.
Pour mixture from blender into flour mixture.
Rinse blender with 1/2 water and cream or evaporated milk and pour in flour-broccoli.
Stir and season with spices.
Microwave Cheez Whiz and stir into soup.
Chop broccoli that was set aside and add to soup.
Heat thoroughly.

title: Super Potato Casserole
steps: Mix together first 3 ingredients; add onions, salt, pepper and sour cream.
Place in casserole.
Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Steak House-Style Grilled Steak
steps: Mix seasonings and brown sugar.
Brush steaks with oil. Sprinkle seasoning mixture over both sides; press into steaks. Place steaks on medium-hot grill.
Grill 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until cooked to desired doneness.

title: Chocolate Peppermint Pie
steps: Combine cocoa and sugar.
Add to pudding mix and prepare as directed on package.
Cool; add vanilla.
Whip cream and fold into chocolate mixture.
Pour into peppermint stick ice cream shells. Freeze.

title: Crystal'S Crab Mold
steps: In large bowl, dissolve the gelatine in water.
Heat soup and add to gelatine.
Add rest of ingredients; mix and mold (i.e., Tupperware jello mold container).
Chill 6 hours.
Unmold.
Serve with crackers.

title: Peg'S Shrimp Yummies

ingredients.name: or more green onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. or more chopped green onions

steps: Place cheese on dish.
Pour 3/4 sauce over cheese.
Place shrimp on top and add rest of sauce.
Sprinkle with green onions. Place crackers around dish.

title: Zucchini-Stuffing Casserole

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook squash until tender, drain, mash lightly and drain again. Make stuffing according to directions.
Layer 1/2 of stuffing on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Mix rest of ingredients together, layer and then top with remaining stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Lemon Pineapple Salad

ingredients.name: oz. can pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. 4 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Melt marshmallows in milk over low heat; pour jello in, stirring until dissolved.
Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise, mixing until well blended.
Gradually add jello mixture, mixing until well blended.
Stir in pineapple.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into 2-quart mold; chill until firm.
Unmold if you like.
Makes 12 servings.

title: French Pastries
steps: Press 1 can of crescent rolls into a 13 x 9-inch pan, sealing perforations.
Cream 1 cup sugar with cream cheese and vanilla. Spread this over dough.
Top with remaining can of dough.
Brush with egg yolk.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar and pecans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Best when served same day at room temperature.

title: Golden Ruhl Broccoli
steps: Cut off tips of broccoli only and steam or boil until almost done.
Meanwhile, mix soup, eggs, onions, mayonnaise and cheese and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Saucy Apple Swirl
steps: Grease and flour tube pan. Put 1/2 batter in pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle most over batter.
Also, sprinkle most of nuts.
Add rest of batter and sprinkle rest of nuts and sugar-cinnamon.
Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes, sometimes longer.

title: Pumpkin Rolls
steps: Combine 2 cups flour and yeast.
In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt until warm.
Add to dry mixture.
Add egg and pumpkin.
Beat at low speed 1/2 minute.
Beat 3 minutes on high.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie

ingredients.name: light cream
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. light cream or half and half

steps: Mix sugar and flour; add cream, egg, vanilla and nutmeg.
Mix well with eggbeater or wire whisk.
Put rhubarb in pie shell; pour cream mixture over rhubarb.
Push the rhubarb pieces down so they will be well coated with the cream mixture.
Flute edge of pie crust.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Communion Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, sifting 3 times.
Add cream and milk to make a medium dough ball.
Divide into 4 equal parts and knead 25 to 30 minutes.

When dough is smooth and free from bubbles, roll out with rolling pin onto metal baking sheets. Measure with ruler 1-inch (prick with fork) the width of cooking sheet, all the way across (1-inch prick, 1-inch prick).
Bake in slow oven 12 to 15 minutes at 375° until light brown.
Cut apart lengthwise with sharp knife.

title: Chocolate Fried Pies

ingredients.name: cooking oil fat
ingredients.raw: cooking oil (Crisco preferred) for deep fat frying

steps: In a saucepan, combine granulated sugar, flour and cocoa powder.
Stir in the 1/2 cup milk and butter.
Stir until blended thoroughly.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until it thickens. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Let cool.

title: Yummy Casserole
steps: Fry mushrooms in butter pan about 10 minutes; do not brown. Fry medium onion in butter.
Combine ham, cheese and mushroom mixture.
Place cooked noodles in greased oblong casserole.
Place ham and cheese mixture over noodles.
Pour half and half over top. Cover and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

title: Tropical Pork Chops
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Place chops in shallow baking dish. Top with pineapple and orange juice.
Bake for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Spinach-Cheese Bake
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir until blended.
Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes.

title: Ham & Cheese Omelet Rolls

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. green onions (with tops) thinly sliced

steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a bowl combine cream cheese and milk, whisk until smooth.
Add flour and salt, mix well.
In a separate bowl gently whisk eggs then add cream cheese mixture, mix well.
Pour in a long cookie sheet (parchment paper may be used). Bake for 30 to 33 minutes or until eggs are puffy and golden. Meanwhile, finely chop ham.
Remove omelet from oven, immediately spread dijon mustard, and sprinkle 1/2 of cheese, ham and green onions.
Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and roll up, (like a jelly roll).
Let stand 5 minutes allowing cheese to melt.
Slice and serve.

title: Jessie'S Potato Salad

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced

steps: Mix all ingredients except salt.
Add salt last to taste. Store in sealed container in refrigerator for at least 1 hour prior to serving.
Serves 10.

title: Germany Gurting Cucumber Salad
steps: Chill cream.
Wash and slice cucumbers.
Sprinkle with salt and sugar; add vinegar.
Allow to stand 10 minutes.
Add sweet cream and mix.
Chill 15 minutes before serving.

title: Watergate Salad(Pistachio)

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple with juice

ingredients.name: container cool whip or
ingredients.raw: 1 large container Cool Whip or topping

steps: Mix dry pudding and pineapple.
Fold in Cool Whip, nuts and marshmallows.
Fill 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Rib Ticklin' Barbecue Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Brush sauce on meat the last 20 minutes of grilling.

title: Ratatouille

ingredients.name: yellow summer squash
ingredients.raw: 2 large yellow summer squash, sliced 1/8-inch thick

ingredients.name: romano
ingredients.raw: freshly grated Romano or Mozzarella cheese

steps: Pour stewed tomatoes, water and spice in a large pot with garlic, pepper and crushed red pepper.
When mixture comes to a boil, stir in onions, zucchini and yellow squash.
Stew (boil) for 2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes.
Serve in individual bowls; garnish with freshly grated cheese.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight Dessert
steps: Mix together the first 3 ingredients in
9 x 13 baking dish; spread out for crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: light cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. light cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded (40% less fat) Cheddar cheese

steps: Press shredded carrots between paper towels to remove excess moisture; set aside.
In large bowl, combine cheeses and minced onion.
Stir in shredded carrots and broccoli.
Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Shape mixture into a ball; wrap with plastic wrap.
Makes one cheese ball.

title: Shrimp And Rice
steps: Cook shrimp in boiling water with a little salt about 10 minutes and peel.
Cook the rice in shrimp water.
Saute onions and bell pepper (chopped) in margarine.
Add rice and stir.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to taste, then shrimp. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Herb Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in saucepan; remove from heat.
Stir in lemon peel, flour, dill weed and salt.
Blend in half and half; cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat.
Blend a small amount of hot mixture with egg yolk; blend back into hot mixture.
Stir well; cook for 1 minute longer.
Serve over cooked vegetables.

title: Peach Dump Cake

ingredients.name: butter brickle
ingredients.raw: 1 butter brickle or vanilla cake mix (dry)

ingredients.name: peach in juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can peaches in juice, sliced

steps: Pour sliced peaches into ungreased cake pan.
Pour dry cake mix onto that.
Cover with melted butter.
Bake at 400° until cake does not jiggle when moved.
To serve, top with Cool Whip.

title: Light Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix all ingredients together; as you do for biscuit dough.
Put wax paper and then a towel over bowl.
Let stand and rise for 1 1/2 hours.
Knead dough until stiff, using 1/2 cup flour.
Place in a greased loaf pan.
Brush with melted butter and let rise for 2 hours.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: David'S Favorite Spiced Tea
steps: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container until ready to use.
Then add 3 to 4 heaping teaspoonfuls to a cup of hot water or 2 to 3 tablespoons to a glass of ice water and enjoy.

title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
steps: Mix together well and freeze.
Will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

title: Fruity Mermaid Kabobs
steps: For each kabob, thread a watermelon wedge, large at the bottom, onto a 6-inch narrow cocktail straw to make the tail of the mermaid.
Next, thread a prune onto the straw, push gently next to the watermelon to tighten and look like a waist.
Next, thread a cantaloupe ball for the face.
Pull in a mound of alfalfa sprouts from the container and stretch the mound just enough to keep the sprouts bunched together.
Shape the hair and insert onto straw letting hair drape around face.

title: Holiday Fruit Cookies

ingredients.name: red and green cherry
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chopped red and green cherries

steps: Mix well shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Add buttermilk and stir in flour.
It will be easier to work with if you chill dough overnight.
Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until done.
Yields 7 dozen.

title: Mushrooms With Garlic Butter
steps: Mince the garlic.
Wash the mushrooms quickly, then trim and slice them.
Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat.
When the foam subsides, add the mushrooms, the minced garlic, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are browned and tender, about 5 minutes.
Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper if needed.
Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

title: Salad(Christmas Or Valentine'S Day)

ingredients.name: red raspberry
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. red raspberry or strawberry jello

ingredients.name: red raspberry
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen red raspberries or strawberries

steps: Bring water to a boil; add jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Add frozen berries; continue to stir until berries are thawed apart. Add applesauce.
Stir until well mixed.
Set in refrigerator until set.

title: Lisa'S Famous Breakfast Eggs Florentine

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen chopped spinach

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Cover the bottom of shallow baking dish (10 x 6 x 2-inch) with spinach.
Break eggs around outside edge of dish.
Pierce egg yolks twice and egg whites several times with a toothpick.
Mix soup, pepper and onion flakes.
Pour around eggs.
Cover spinach completely.
Cover and cook on High for 7 to 8 minutes or until eggs are almost set.
Sprinkle cheese.
Let stand covered 5 minutes.
Serves 6 people.

title: Chicken Broccoli Vegetable Saute!

ingredients.name: campbell s cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Campbell's cream of broccoli soup

steps: In skillet over medium heat, in 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.
Remove chicken; keep warm.
In same skillet, in remaining margarine, cook broccoli, carrots and mushrooms 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in soup, milk and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Return chicken to skillet.
Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Basil Chicken With Rice
steps: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat, heat broth, tomatoes, garlic and basil to boiling.
Add chicken, rice, peas and hot pepper sauce.
Return to boiling; remove from heat.
Cover.
Let stand 5 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice with fork before serving.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven-Barbecued Beef Brisket
steps: Trim brisket well.
Place in large deep roasting pan.
Heat Worcestershire sauce, liquid smoke and margarine. Pour over brisket.
Cover tightly with heavy-duty aluminum foil.
Cook in oven at 250° for 1 hour per pound. (Or cook at 425° for 1/2 hour, then reduce heat and cook at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes per pound.) Meat is done when fork inserts easily.
Cool for 30 minutes and cut with electric knife into thin slices.

title: Percolator Punch
steps: Place sugar and spices in basket of percolator.
Place juice and water in lower part of coffee pot and allow to perk just like coffee.

title: Wild West Corn
steps: Melt cream cheese and milk, stirring constantly.
Add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: Spiced Nuts
steps: Mix sugar, cream of tartar and cinnamon.
Pour in boiling water.
Boil until soft ball stage.
Remove from fire.
Add vanilla and pecans.
Stir until mixture sugars.
Turn out on waxed paper and separate pecans.

title: Delicious Pecan Pie
steps: Combine oleo, sugar and syrup.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (do not boil).
Let cool slightly.
Add to beaten eggs, vanilla, salt and pecans.
Pour in unbaked pie crust.
Bake in 325° oven for about 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Graham Cracker Crumb Crust
steps: Blend ingredients together; spread out in a 9-inch pan.
If desired, bake at 375° for 8 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Chewy Brownies
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl.
Mix at low speed until smooth.
Combine baking soda and flour in sifter.
Sift in dry ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9 baking dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Friendly Fungus-Marinated
steps: Gently boil the mushrooms for 1 minute, drain.
The heat will help the marinade to absorb into the mushrooms.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Beer Batter Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients in bowl.
Add beer and beat 60 strokes with spoon.
Fill a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and drizzle top with melted butter.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or golden and tests clean.
Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Batter Dip For Frying
steps: "How many ways can you eat peanut butter.
Let me count the ways."

title: Truthahn Brust In Zwiebelrahm Sosse(Turkey Breast In Onion Sauce)

ingredients.name: turkey breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 slices raw turkey breast (1/4 to 3/8-inch thick) or chicken breast

steps: Set oven at 350°.
Lay turkey slices in shallow baking dish (spray with nonstick coating).
Mix together whipping cream and soup mix; pour over turkey.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: German Potato Pancakes
steps: Grate potatoes, add salt and egg and mix well.
Drop by tablespoons in well-greased frying pan, spreading real thin.
Fry slowly until browned on each side.

title: White Cake
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together three times. Cream sugar and shortening; add milk, stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Oriental Skewers
steps: Wash and cut chicken into 1-inch chunks.
Also cut sirloin into chunks.
Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce for 1 hour.
Marinate steak in Worcestershire sauce for 1 hour.
Cut and wash peppers and onion into large chunks.
Put peppers and meat on skewer alternating.
Cook on grill until done.
Serve over rice with extra sauces, sauteed mushrooms and pineapple chunks.
Do not use the sauce that the meat marinated in.
Use fresh sauces.

title: Christmas Crunch
steps: Boil syrup, butter, sugar and salt together for 5 minutes at medium-high.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and soda; return to heat and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour over Rice Chex, almonds and coconut; mix well.
Pour out onto greased cookie sheet (large). Cool, cut and eat.

title: Broccoli And Walnut Stir-Fry
steps: In a large skillet or wok, heat the oil until quite hot.

Add the walnuts and saute for 1 minute. Add the broccoli and cook over medium heat, tossing frequently, until tender and crisp, about 4 minutes. Add the soy sauce and cook 1 minute more. Serve immediately, garnished with red bell pepper.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake(Yields 6 Servings)

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (9 or 10 oz. each) pkg. frozen green beans, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: french fried onion ring
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can French fried onion rings

steps: In a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole, combine soup, milk, soya sauce and pepper.
Add beans and 1/2 of the onion rings.
Stir. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes until hot and bubbly.
Stir. Top with remaining onion rings.
Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Zelma'S Never Fail Dumplings
steps: Beat eggs and shortening.
Add dry ingredients and enough milk to make a stiff dough.
Knead dough on floured surface.
Roll out very thin, cut in strips and drop into boiling broth with a teaspoon of Accent seasoning. When dumplings are almost done, add a few drops yellow food coloring and 1 cup of cream.

title: Easy Grilled Chicken

ingredients.name: your favorite barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: your favorite barbecue sauce (we like Heinz 57)

steps: Layer chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder to your taste.
Place in microwave oven and cook chicken until done (around 30 to 40 minutes depending on your oven).
Remove chicken and place on heated outdoor grill.
Baste barbecue sauce over it and put lid down.
It only has to stay on the grill for a few minutes to get the smoked flavor without all of the time and trouble of regular grilled chicken.

title: Rhubarb Sauce For Ice Cream
steps: Barely cover the ingredients in a saucepan.
Cook over low heat until tender.
Sauce will be kind of thick.

title: New England Baked Beans
steps: Cook dry beans in water until softened (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Drain and put into crock-pot.
Add all remaining ingredients; mix well.
Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or high 4 to 6 hours.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a buttered Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture reaches soft ball stage or candy thermometer registers 243°; remove from heat. Cool to 180°.
Stir in vanilla.
Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until mixture thickens and begins to lose its gloss.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan or baking dish; cool.
Yield:
1 1/4 pounds.

title: Sandwich Or Cracker Spread

ingredients.name: good season italian salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix

steps: Blend until consistency wanted.
Make sandwiches or serve on crackers.

title: Turkish Delight
steps: Bring
orange juice to a boil.	Stir boiling juice into gelatin.
Dissolve	completely.
Pour
into
an 8 x 8-inch pan lightly sprayed
with
oil.
Chill 3 hours or more. Slice into squares and coat with confectioners sugar, then serve.

title: Easy Cobbler Pie Topping
steps: Prepare fruit or berries and sugar to taste (can use fresh or canned).
Mix flour and sugar.
Add beaten egg and mix until mixture is like coarse cornmeal.
(I do this with my fingers; if preferred you can use a fork.)
Sprinkle mixture over fruit or berry cobbler filling in a pie plate or glass long dish.

title: Great Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: hot sausage and of all fat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. hot sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained of all fat

steps: Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a buttered baking dish. Combine eggs, milk, salt and dry mustard; pour over the ingredients in the baking dish.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake the next morning in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quickie Frozen Dessert

ingredients.name: ice cream sandwich
ingredients.raw: 12 ice cream sandwiches or number to fit dish

ingredients.name: butter brickle bit
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Butter Brickle bits (6 oz.; crushed Heath bars may be substituted)

steps: Layer large oblong Pyrex dish (10 x 14-inch) with ice cream sandwiches.
Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle candy bits on top. Cover and place in freezer.
When ready to serve, remove from freezer.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Cut into squares.
Makes 12 to 15 generous servings.

title: Corn And Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all together.
Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mission Artichoke And Spinach Frittata

ingredients.name: seasoned salt
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. seasoned salt or onion powder

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke in
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. jar marinated artichokes, cut in small pieces

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.raw: 4 c. fresh spinach or chard, chopped into small pieces

steps: Melt 1/4 cup or less margarine in 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
Beat the eggs, then gradually mix in the remaining ingredients one at a time in order.
Pour in the 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Pete'S Sauerkraut
steps: Mix all ingredients in saucepan.
Cook on high heat for 2 minutes,
stirring	constantly.
Cook
on medium heat for 7 minutes,
stirring often to keep from burning.
Delicious over hot dogs.

title: Chambord Brownies
steps: Mix together above ingredients and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Allow to cool.

title: Corn And Sausage Bake
steps: Brown breakfast sausage.
Drain off grease.
Mix all ingredients in casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until bubbling and brown.

title: Peanut Butter S'Mores(Microwave)
steps: For each s'more, spread 1 graham cracker square with peanut butter.
Top with semi-sweet chocolate pieces and marshmallows. Cover with another graham cracker square.

title: Namak Paaray
steps: Mix together all ingredients and add small amounts of water, enough to make a smooth, binding dough.
Divide dough into 3 parts.
Set aside for 10-15 minutes.

title: Deviled Ham And Chive Balls
steps: Blend ham, pretzels, Worcestershire and pepper thoroughly and form 25 balls, using a rounded 1/2 teaspoon for each.
Freeze on cookie sheet for 30 minutes.

title: Creme De Menthe Brownies
steps: Cream butter and sugar, then add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: quaker oats
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and mix lightly, but thoroughly.
Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until meat is no longer pink.
Drain and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Dodgers(Hush Puppies)
steps: Mix all ingredients together, drop by rounded teaspoon into hot grease.
Fry until golden, turning once.

title: Continental Frosting
steps: Cook milk and flour until thick; take off heat (cool).
Cream sugar and butter with mixer until fluffy, 4 to 5 minutes.
Add flour and milk mixture.
Beat another 4 to 5 minutes.
Add vanilla. Keep cake cool after frosting (refrigerate).
Add crushed pieces of pineapple and flavoring if you want it (just a little).
Very good over chiffon cake, angel cake or any other kind of cake.

title: Sparkling Catawba Punch

ingredients.name: sparkling catawba white grape juice
ingredients.raw: 3 qt. bottles sparkling Catawba white grape juice

steps: Mix pineapple juice and lemonade.
Add ginger ale and sparkling grape juice just before serving.
Makes 125 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Creamy Pimento Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: pimento
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) jar diced pimento (do not drain)

steps: Position knife blade in food processor bowl.
Add first five ingredients.
Process until smooth.
Add pimento.
Pulse 4 or 5 times.

title: Pineapple Scallopini
steps: Melt butter and break toast into pieces.
Pour butter over toast.
Drain pineapple (partially).
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over toast.
Bake, covered, for 30 minutes.
Great with ham.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
steps: Brown and drain hamburger and onion.
Mix all other ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Dip In Rye Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients (except bread).
Cut top off bread (keep for lid).
Dig out center of bread (keep bread for dipping).
Fill bread with mixture.
Replace top of bread.
Triple wrap bread with foil and place in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours (or until cheese is melted and mixture is hot all through).
Mix pieces of bread with 2 tablespoons of butter and place in oven for 10 minutes.
Serve dip warm with raw vegetables, crackers, bread sticks, etc.

title: Ranch-Style Baked Lentils
steps: Rinse the lentils.

In a heavy saucepan, bring lentils, salt and 4 cups water to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Meanwhile, brown beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Stir in soup mix, catsup, mustard, vinegar and remaining water. Gently stir in lentils. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Bake, covered, at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield: 4 to
6 servings.

title: Parker'S Favorite Pecan Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs slightly, just until whites and yolks are mixed.
Stir in sugar, then add corn syrup, melted butter, milk and vanilla.
Stir the pecans into the egg/sugar mixture.
Pour mixture into an unbaked pie crust.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
steps: In 2-quart saucepan, melt oleo.
Do not get too hot.
Add cocoa and milk; mix well.
Stir in powdered sugar; bring to a bubbling boil stirring constantly.
Cook 2 or 3 minutes more. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and peanut butter.
Stir until cooled slightly and begins to firm.
Pour into greased (oleo) 8 x 8-inch dish.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Logs
steps: Mix the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl, then roll small logs and dip in the chocolate.
(Melt the chocolate chips and wax in top of double boiler and keep stirring the chocolate while you are dipping the logs.
Use toothpicks to dip with.)

title: Cucumbers And Sour Cream
steps: Peel cucumbers; slice thin and chill.
Mix other ingredients together.
Toss all lightly.
May be served on greens.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Blender Bearnaise
steps: Reduce vinegar together with tarragon until liquid is almost gone.
In a blender, beat eggs and lemon juice until lemon colored. In the same pan as the vinegar and tarragon, melt the butter while hot.
Slowly pour into the egg mixture while the blender is running.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Enjoy.

title: On The Grill
steps: Remove silk from corn, but not the husks.
Tie the husks closed.
Wrap potatoes in foil.
Some fresh herbs and margarine can be added to the foil package, if desired.
Dip summer squash and eggplant slices in olive oil.
Soak husks of corn in cold water for 10 minutes.
Drain and cook for 30 minutes, turning. Cook potatoes 45 minutes and squash and eggplant for 20 minutes on coals that have burned 45 minutes.

title: Apricot-Pineapple Molded Salad
steps: Mix Jell-O and let set until slightly thickened.
Add crushed pineapple.
Beat together cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Fold Cool Whip mixture into the Jell-O.
Pour into a shallow baking dish (8 or 9-inch square pan).
Let set in refrigerator until firm.

title: Great Gerts
steps: Cream margarine and cheese.
Add seasonings, flour and Rice Krispies.
Pinch off small bits with your fingers and press flat with a fork dipped in cold water.
The smaller these are the better they are.
Bake on a cookie sheet for about 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Glorified (Heavenly) Rice
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Chill very thoroughly before serving. Serves 6 to 8.
If you choose to use Cool Whip, add just before serving instead of whipping cream.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
steps: Put the sugar, milk and butter in boiler; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Add the cocoa, quick oats and nuts.
Stir and mix in the vanilla and pinch of salt.
Spoon out by drops on dish sprayed with Pam or greased with butter.

title: Oven Stew

ingredients.name: size potato in
ingredients.raw: 4 medium size potatoes, cut in pieces

steps: Cut stew meat into small pieces.
Salt, pepper and roll in flour.
Brown in skillet.
Put stew meat, carrots, tomato sauce and cabbage in a long pan or Dutch oven.
Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours or until tender-done at 300° to 350°.

title: Frozen Coleslaw
steps: Combine vegetables.
Sprinkle with salt and let stand 1 hour. Drain, if water accumulates.
Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute.
Cool.
Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir well. Freeze in plastic bags or container. To serve, thaw in refrigerator.

title: Frozen Strawberry Yummy

ingredients.name: strawberry partially thawed
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed

steps: Cut first 3 ingredients as for a crust.
Add nuts.
Spread out crumbs onto cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Spread a little more than half of the crumbs into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: German Chocolate Cake Mix Cookies

ingredients.name: pillsbury plu german chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Plus German chocolate cake mix

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Blend well.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until set.
Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets.
Makes 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Fried Sweet Potatoes
steps: Slice sweet potatoes.
Cover an iron frying pan with just enough oil to cover bottom.
Fry 1 layer of sweet potatoes at a time, turning to brown both sides, lightly.
Lift onto platter and, if desired, sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar, or eat plain.

title: 4 To 6 Pound Brisket(Freezes Well)

ingredients.name: colgin hickory liquid smoke
ingredients.raw: 3 oz. bottle Colgins hickory liquid smoke

steps: Trim all fat from brisket.
Generously cover both sides of brisket with garlic salt, celery salt and onion salt. Pour all of hickory liquid smoke; place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil and put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Lipton Pepper Steak

ingredients.name: chuck steak off all fat
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chuck steak, cut off all fat

ingredients.name: green pepper in
ingredients.raw: 2 medium green peppers, cut in strips

ingredients.name: water can tomato sauce and c. water
ingredients.raw: water (optional), 2 small cans tomato sauce and 2 c. water *

steps: Cut meat into thin strips, 2-inches long.
In a large skillet, heat shortening and brown meat trimmings.
Stir in onion soup mix and *2 cups water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes (until meat is tender).
Stir in peppers and simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water.
Stir into skillet mixture. Cook until thickened.

title: Goop
steps: Mix and shake.
Put in covered container.

title: Cranberry Grape Ice Cream Soda

ingredients.name: ocean spray cran grape grape cranberry drink
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Ocean Spray Cran-Grape grape cranberry drink

steps: In a blender container, process grape cranberry drink and 1 scoop ice cream until smooth.
Pour into glass with remaining ice cream.
Top with soda.
Makes 1 serving.

title: Cherry Pound Cake
steps: Grease tube pan and dust with flour.
Combine margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour, vanilla and salt; mix well.
Fold in walnuts and halved maraschino cherries.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove from pan after 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Macaroni Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. chicken or turkey, cooked and diced

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and with liquid
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. can mushroom stems and pieces with liquid

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 10 3/4 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Mix all ingredients in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.
Cover and cook at 350° until macaroni is tender, 55 to 60 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Strawberry Square Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry thawed and
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained

steps: Dissolve gelatin and water together.
Add pineapple juice. Place in the refrigerator until partially congealed.
Fold in fruit and marshmallows.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place in refrigerator overnight to congeal.
Serves 24.

title: Loaf Pound Cake
steps: In one bowl combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend in butter, vanilla, egg yolks and milk.
Beat vigorously for 3 minutes.
Pour batter into a greased 9-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.
Yields one 9-inch cake.

title: Candied Or Stewed Apples
steps: Dissolve sugar in water in large saucepan.
Prepare apples by cutting in half and removing cores.
Place in saucepan and sprinkle with spices and butter.
Cover and cook slowly and turn apples when about half done.
Cook until juice begins to get syrupy.

title: Salisbury Meatballs
steps: Combine the ingredients.
Cover with sauce.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Fresh Salsa
steps: In a large frying pan, cook all the chiles until black on each side, then cut chiles down the middle and remove all the seeds. Dice chiles real small.
Put into a large saucepan.
Chop onions and tomatoes real small.
Put into pan with chiles.
Add the Pace salsa to other ingredients in pan.
Also, add tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes and 1 cup of water.
Let simmer for about 1 hour.
Make sure to add about 1 tablespoon of garlic salt.
Make sure to mix all ingredients well before simmering.
Makes about 6 pounds of salsa.

title: Easy Crust Chicken Pie
steps: Cook and debone fryer.
Cut up chicken and place in a large baking dish.
Mix soup and broth; heat until creamy.
Add salt and pepper; pour over chicken.
Mix flour, milk and melted margarine. Spoon over chicken.
Bake at 450° until brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Curried Baked Fruit(Prepare The Day Before)

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) can pineapple chunks or spears

steps: Drain all fruit.
Add sugar and curry to melted butter. Arrange fruit and nuts in layers in casserole; pour butter mixture over all and bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Refrigerate overnight. Reheat at 350° before serving.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Possum Stew
steps: Paw 'n the chillun' allus worked so hard a' catchin' little fish outta the creek that they just had to be cooked! ... but they iz sweet 'n gud eatin'.
Scales, take insides out'n the haid off ... clean in cold watah ... salt 'n roll in 1/2 meal 'n 1/2 flour ... drop in hot fat 'n brown on both sides.

To eat small bream ... furst pull fins off ... then start at the tail 'n ease meat up with a fork along backbone all the way up to whair the haid wuz ... hit'll cum off in one piece widout bones iffn you're careful.

title: Imperial Crab
steps: Combine ingredients. Toss lightly.
Put in crab shells.
Bake in a 350° oven until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Lasagne

ingredients.name: lasagne noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 or 10 oz.) pkg. lasagne noodles, cooked

ingredients.name: cracker barrel sharp cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. Cracker Barrel (Kraft) sharp cheese, grated

steps: Lightly brown beef and remove excess fat.
Add tomato sauce, onions, salts and sugar.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Cream together sour cream and cream cheese.
Line lightly oiled 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with layer of cooked noodles.
Add 1/2 of tomato mixture.
Put cream cheese mixture on top and spread evenly into layer.
Put another layer of noodles and top these with other half of tomato mixture.
Put grated cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Coffee-Toffee Torte
steps: Freeze, then crush Heath bars.
Prepare angel food cake as directed on box.
Bake in a 10-inch tube pan.
Invert and cool. In saucepan, mix pudding and instant coffee, but using only 1 1/3 cups of milk for each package of pudding for a total of 2 2/3 cups of milk.
Cook according to directions on box.
Cool.
When cool, beat until mixture is smooth.
Fold in half of the whipped cream. Split cake into 3 layers.
Spread half of the pudding-cream mixture between layers.
Fold remaining whipped cream into pudding mixture and frost tops and sides of cake.
Sprinkle top and sides of cake with crushed Heath bars.
Chill until ready to serve.

title: *Baklava("Pita Dulci")
steps: Butter a 12 x 17 x 1-inch baking pan. Butter 8 to 10 sheets of phyllo for bottom crust.
Sprinkle nuts (combined with sugar and cinnamon).
Sprinkle nuts on every sheet or every two sheets. Top with 8 sheets. Refrigerate.
Cut into diamonds. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes. (After 40 minutes, lower oven to 325° for remaining 20 minutes.)
Pour cooled syrup over hot Baklava.

title: Phillip'S Dump Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple in syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in syrup (undrained)

ingredients.name: margarine in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. (1 stick) margarine, cut in thin slices

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Dump pineapple into pan; spread evenly.
Dump cherry filling.
Spread evenly.
(Layer) dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer; spread evenly.
Sprinkle nuts on top of dry cake mix.
Put margarine over top.
Bake at 350° for 48 to 53 minutes.
Serve warm or cold. Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Apple Pie Delight(Diabetic)

ingredients.name: equal measure
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. Equal Measure or 20 pkg. Equal

ingredients.name: pared tart apple
ingredients.raw: 6 c. thinly sliced pared tart apples (4 to 6 Granny Smith)

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In a mixing bowl combine Equal Measure, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.	Add dry mixture to apples; toss gently to coat fruit.	Fill a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate with apple mixture.
Dot with margarine.
Cover with top crust, that has slits in it.
Seal and flute edge.	Bake 15 minutes at 425° and turn oven down to 350° and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Pecan Halves
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Spread pecans on large baking sheet. Melt butter and pour over pecan halves.
Sprinkle with salt and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Fancy Green Beans
steps: Chop bacon in pieces,
fry in skillet.	Saute onion and pimiento in bacon grease;
add
the green beans, juice and all to mixture.
Add garlic
salt	and
Nature's
Season to taste. Simmer.

title: Mustard And Vinegar Pickles
steps: Mix all ingredients; make sure cucumbers are covered.
Use a large container.
Let set for 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Never Fail Caramel Icing
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add brown sugar.
Boil over low heat, stirring constantly.
Stir in milk and bring to a boil again, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm.
Gradually add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.

title: Wild Turkey Salsa And Rice

ingredients.name: wild turkey breast
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. wild turkey breast or chicken

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped red or green peppers

ingredients.name: garlic salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: garlic salt and pepper to taste

steps: Cut up turkey in chunks and cook in a crock-pot with water on low for 4 hours or until tender.
Saute oleo, garlic, onion and green peppers in a Dutch oven.
Add all vegetables in a Dutch oven on top of stove and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add cooked turkey and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Pink Flamingo
steps: Soften cream cheese; beat until fluffy.
Add milk, lemon juice, vanilla and red food coloring.
Mix well.
Pour into a vanilla wafer crust in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Slice bananas over the top.
Spread whipped cream over the top.
Chill and serve.

title: Curry-Glazed Chicken
steps: Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat in a 375° oven until melted.
Stir in honey, mustard and curry powder. Add chicken, turning to coat.
Bake, turning chicken over after 20 minutes.
Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 4 servings. Contains 255 calories per serving.

title: Cherry Flip

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 can cherry or blueberry pie filling

steps: Mix together crackers and oleo and pat into a small oblong dish.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar and milk.
Spread on top of cooled crust.
Sprinkle nuts on cream cheese mixture.
Spread Cool Whip atop nuts.
Then spread pie filling atop the Cool Whip.
Very good!

title: Orchard Pops
steps: In blender, combine all ingredients; blend until smooth.
Pour about 1/3 cup into each of six 3-ounce paper cups.
Cover with foil.
Insert wooden stick through foil.
Freeze
for 5 hours or until firm.
Before serving, let pops stand 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove foil and peel off paper cups.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole

ingredients.name: wide noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. wide noodles, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: cream of tomato soup
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (10 3/4 oz. each) cream of tomato soup (undiluted)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup

steps: In a large skillet, brown beef.
Remove beef and drain fat. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Saute onion and pepper until tender.
Add beef, Worcestershire sauce, noodles and soups; mix well.
Spoon into a greased 3-quart casserole; top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Lena'S 5 Pound Fudge
steps: Cook together until a firm ball.
Beat until you can't beat anymore.

title: Campfire Bean Dinner
steps: In large skillet, brown meat well.
Stir in soup mix, beans, chili sauce and water.
Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
steps: Cook, drain and mash potatoes.
Add cheese, sour cream, salt, pepper and butter.
Beat until smooth and fluffy.
Refrigerate or bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 8 cups.

title: Old Fashioned Light Bread
steps: In a large mixer bowl, combine 3 cups flour and yeast.

In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt just until warm and shortening is almost melted; stir constantly. Add to flour mixture. Beat at low speed 1/2 minute, scraping sides of bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Gradually stir in as much flour as you can mix with a spoon.
Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic. Shape into a ball.
Place in a lightly greased bowl at least twice as
large as the ball of dough.
Turn dough over once to grease surface. Cover with slightly damp cloth. Allow to rise in warm place until double in size (about 1 hour).

title: Texas Meatballs And Rice

ingredients.name: onion and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 1 large onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings

steps: Mix ground beef, egg, chili powder, salt and pepper; shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls.
Place in 2-quart casserole.
Microwave at High (100%) until meatballs are set and lose pink color, 4 to 7 minutes, rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time.
Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover.
Microwave at High (100%) until mixture is bubbly and onion is tender, 4 to 7 minutes.
If using an oven without a carousel, stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Paul Newman Chicken
steps: Clean chicken and marinate several hours in dressing.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Put bread crumbs in plastic bag and shake chicken generously in crumbs.
Spray a 13 x 9 pan with Pam.
Place chicken in pan.
Cook for 1 hour, uncovered, turning once.
If chicken appears to be cooking too fast, turn oven down to 350° for the last 15 or 20 minutes.
This dish is great hot or cold.

title: Skyline Dip
steps: Microwave Skyline until completely defrosted.
Spread cream cheese in the bottom of a medium size baking dish until covered. Pour defrosted Skyline over cream cheese.
Sprinkle cheese and onions (optional) and serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: "Newfie" Corn Soup
steps: In a 2-quart pot, melt butter.
Add onion and cook until soft, but not brown.
Add potatoes, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water. Cook until potatoes are soft and water is evaporated.
(Add more water, if necessary.)
Add creamed corn and evaporated milk to desired consistency.
Simmer 5 minutes over low heat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with hot Italian bread or rolls and a salad.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix sugar and flour.
Add 3/4 of mixture to fruits.
Put remaining and sugar mixture in unbaked pie shell.
Add fruit.
Dot with butter.
Add top crust.
Bake in 420° oven for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 35 minutes more.

title: Haystack Cookies

ingredients.name: butterscotch
ingredients.raw: 2 (12 oz.) pkg. butterscotch or chocolate morsels

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pecans, chopped or parched peanuts

steps: Melt peanut butter and morsels and fold in potatoes and pecans.
Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Green Bean Side Dish

ingredients.name: dill weed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. dill weed (more if you wish)

steps: Steam beans with oil and dill weed to warm.
Add margarine to taste.
Serve piping hot.
This vegetable is especially good with Italian foods.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Indian Corn
steps: Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until crisp, drain, reserving 2 tablespoons fat.
In reserved fat, saute green pepper and onion until tender.
Add corn, salt and pepper; heat thoroughly over medium heat.
Add cream; cook 1 minute, stirring.
Stir in bacon. Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

title: Mexican Meat Casserole
steps: Fry hamburger and onion together; pour off grease.
Mix in enchilada sauce and mushroom soup; mix well.
In casserole dish, layer Doritos, sprinkle with grated cheese. Place layer of meat mixture and layer of Doritos, and layer of meat mixture, sprinkle with cheese.
Cook in hot oven for 10 minutes.

title: June'S Jiffy Peach Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in large pan.
Mix batter of flour, sugar and juice.
Pour over butter.
Lay peaches over batter.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Waffle Cookie
steps: Cream margarine.
Add eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Add flour, then chocolate chips.
Heat up waffle iron.
Put 2 to 4 small teaspoons of batter,
separately, in waffle iron, making 2 to 4 cookies.
Close iron, then take out with fork.
"Great!"

title: Grandmother'S Gingerbread
steps: Blend sugar, shortening and eggs.
Stir in molasses.
Combine dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.
Beat well.
Pour into greased and floured pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until done.

title: Frozen Pea Salad - Layered

ingredients.name: lettuce bit
ingredients.raw: 1/2 head of lettuce, broken into bits

steps: Put all ingredients in large bowl in layers as listed.
Spread over this 2 cups mayonnaise mixed with 3 tablespoons sugar (seal edges as you spread).
Cover with airtight seal (I use Tupperware).

title: Pineapple And Coconut Pie
steps: Pour into two 9-inch pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Anisette Sponges Cake

ingredients.name: anisette sponge by stella d oro
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Anisette Sponges by Stella D'Oro (not toast)

steps: Mix together rum and water.
Layer one package of Sponges in a 10-inch spring-form pan.
Pour half the water and rum mixture over sponges.
Cook pudding according to directions.
While hot, pour half over sponges.

title: Debbie'S Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix Jell-O and hot water in large container; set aside.
In food processor, grind cranberries and orange.
Chop celery; mix together.
Add lemon juice and sugar.
Add nuts.
Refrigerate until firm.

title: Bean And Vegetable Salad

ingredients.name: or oz. pkg. mixed vegetable
ingredients.raw: 16 or 20 oz. pkg. frozen mixed vegetables

steps: Cook frozen vegetables as directed; drain and cool.
Add drained red beans.
Add diced vegetables and mix.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and mix.
Mix sugar, vinegar, flour and mustard in a small saucepan.
Cook, stirring until clear.
Cool and pour over vegetables.

title: Zucchini Stew
steps: Thaw sausage meat the night before.
Brown in frying pan and drain any excess fat.
Set meat aside.
Peel zucchini and slice into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Peel and slice onions and garlic.

title: Teresa'S Cabbage Salad
steps: Saute almonds in butter; add poppy seed.
Cool.
Mix cabbage and noodles and almond mixture.
Add dressing of oil, vinegar and sugar.
Refrigerate an hour if possible.

title: Mary Bradshaw'S Bourbon Hot Dogs
steps: Cut hog dogs in bite size pieces.
Put on cookie sheet in 350° oven just until cuts are sealed.
Mix catsup, sugar, rosemary, oregano, basil and bourbon and bring to a boil.
Add hot dogs. Best to do day before so flavor can set in.

title: Brandy'S Chicken

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Open Rice-A-Roni and sprinkle in baking dish.
Put chicken breasts on top of rice.
Mix seasoning packet in 3 cups of water in which you have dissolved the 2 chicken bouillon cubes.
Add soup to water with seasoning and mix well.
Pour over chicken and rice.
Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Cover when bake at 350°.

title: Diet Apple Pie

ingredients.name: apple juice as it is
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen apple juice as it is

steps: Mix cornstarch and apple juice and bring to a boil.
Mix cinnamon, nutmeg, oleo and apples and add to juice.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Place top crust over and make several slits in top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Arabic Chicken Fajitas(Very Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch slices

ingredients.name: white mushroom in half
ingredients.raw: 2 c. white mushrooms, cut in half

ingredients.name: salt and black pepper as
ingredients.raw: salt and black pepper as needed

steps: Spray large wok with nonstick cooking spray; heat until very hot.
Add chicken and cook it for 4 minutes.
Remove from wok and keep it warm.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
steps: Saute onions in butter.
Cook broccoli cuts as per directions. Drain.
Add cream of mushroom soup, 1 can evaporated milk, 2 cans regular milk and Cheez Whiz.
Heat over medium-low flame, stirring regularly.

title: Fruit  Dip
steps: Gradually beat orange juice into Cool Whip until the mixture is creamy, but not thin.
Add sugar to taste.
Serve with fresh or canned fruits.

title: *Mary E'S French Dressing
steps: Blend all ingredients well.
Shake well before using.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
steps: Saute celery and onion in margarine until onion is transparent. Add the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: Skillet Chicken And Rice
steps: Saute celery, onion and green pepper in small amount of oil or butter until tender. Add chicken, salt and poultry seasoning. Continue stirring until chicken is heated.
Cook rice according to package using chicken broth instead of water. Add to sauteed ingredients and cook until dry and beginning to stick to skillet.

title: Fiesta Salad
steps: Separate onion slices into rings.
Place in salad bowl with green pepper and tomato.
Fry bacon until crisp; remove and drain. Pour off bacon drippings.
Reserve 2 tablespoons in skillet. Stir vinegar, chili powder, salt and red pepper sauce into drippings; heat to boiling.
Pour over vegetables and toss lightly.
Crumble bacon; sprinkle on top.
Serve with a slotted spoon.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Delicious Drumsticks
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in a bowl.
Dip chicken into butter.
Roll in flour mixture to coat. Arrange in an ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch.
Bake uncovered until done, about 50 minutes.

title: Annie'S Old Fashioned Fudge
steps: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa, milk and syrup over low heat until mixture forms a soft ball.
Stir only until sugar is thoroughly dissolved.
Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
Let stand.
Beat until thick and creamy.

title: Greens With Hot Dressing

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.raw: 6 slices bacon, cut into small pieces

steps: Wash, drain and dry lettuce and greens.
Add chopped green onions; set aside.
Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp; drain.
Set aside skillet with the hot bacon fat still in it. Combine the vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper in a bowl. From the reserved skillet, pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of hot fat.
Pour the vinegar mixture into the skillet.
Place skillet over the hot coals; bring mixture to a boil.
Remove from heat and pour over the lettuce and spinach greens.

title: Lemon Freeze Pie
steps: Cream the cream cheese.
Add lemonade and evaporated milk. Blend in Cool Whip.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Chill in refrigerator until firm.
This is for 1 pie only; double ingredients for 2 pies.

title: Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: red pepper in half ring
ingredients.raw: 1 red pepper, cut in half rings

steps: Put oil in pot, add garlic, onion, mushrooms and red peppers. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add florets and stir-fry 5 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Add salt and lemon rind.
Toss and serve.
Serves 6.

title: Blender Pear Salad
steps: Drain juice from pears and boil 1 cup of juice to dissolve gelatin.
Put remaining ingredients in blender, including gelatin. Blend; add nuts.
Pour into serving dish and garnish with shredded cheese, chopped peanuts, sliced canned pears, etc. Chill.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
steps: Blend well the cake mix, jello and flour.
Add salad oil and eggs, one at a time, also well drained strawberries.
Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Creamy Joes
steps: Brown ground beef, drain off fat.
Mix in a bowl canned milk and canned mushroom soup.
Add to ground beef and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve on roll like Sloppy Joes.

title: Mexican Layer Dip
steps: Layer first four items.
Decorate with green onions, chopped tomato and black olives.
Finish with teaspoon of sour cream and avocado.
Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Sal'S Pizza Burgers
steps: Brown beef, onion and spices together.
Add tomato sauce and mushrooms.
Let cool.
Put on hamburger bun halves.
Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes about 12 to 16 halves.

title: Easy Microwaved Baked Apple
steps: Core a firm, flavorful apple, such as Jonagold, Empire, Cortland or Redfree, but don't cut through the bottom of the apple.
Peel a little of the skin from around the top of the apple.
Put some butter and brown sugar in the hole, and microwave on High for 2 minutes.

title: Eggnog Kringla
steps: Sift powdered sugar and nutmeg.
Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
In another large bowl, beat butter until softened. Add flour mixture and egg nog alternately; mix well.
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350° when ready.
Roll golf ball-size balls of dough into long ropes on floured surface, then shape in figure 8's on a cookie sheet, pinching edges together. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown around edges.
Cool on wire racks and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Oregano Rice

ingredients.name: green onion with stock and bulb used
ingredients.raw: 8 green onions, sliced with stock and bulb used

steps: Saute rice in margarine until light brown (rice).
Place in 3-quart casserole.
Add remaining ingredients; cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or a little longer.

title: Butterscotch Dip For Apples
steps: Mix all of the ingredients in a very heavy boiler until smooth and well blended.
This is a great dip and would be an excellent addition to any party.

title: Caramel Chews(Unbaked)
steps: Melt caramels in the water in double boiler.
Remove from heat and stir in coconut, oats and nuts.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Shape into 2 (12-inch) rolls.
Frosted with melted chips.
Refrigerate. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.

title: Seafood Cornbread Dressing

ingredients.name: jiffy cornbread mix
ingredients.raw: 3 boxes Jiffy cornbread mix (bake per instructions)

ingredients.name: onion and bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. frozen onion and bell pepper

ingredients.name: salt black pepper and tony chachere s seasoning
ingredients.raw: salt, black pepper and Tony Chachere's seasoning to taste

steps: Mix soup and chicken broth into a large pan.
Add onion and green pepper.
Mix and simmer until tender.
Add butter, shrimp, crabmeat and all seasonings.
Pour this mixture over crumbled cornbread and mix well.
Bake at 350° until done.
Makes 2 average size casseroles or 1 large.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Balls

ingredients.name: hot lean uncooked pork sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. hot, lean, uncooked pork sausage

ingredients.name: drop hot red pepper sauce
ingredients.raw: several drops hot red pepper sauce or red pepper if desired hotter

steps: Mix sausage and cheese well with biscuit mix.
Shape into balls about the size of a quarter.
Pat partially flat.
Place on cookie sheet and bake for approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Makes approximately 7 to 8 dozen.

title: Apple Bean Bake
steps: Melt butter.
Add cubed apples and cook until tender.
Add brown and white sugar.
Stir until melted.
Stir in cinnamon, catsup and molasses.
Add beans and mix well.
Pour mixture into 2-quart casserole.
Bake in 400° oven for about 1 hour.

title: Pear And Jello Salad
steps: Use only half of juice from pears.
Mix Jell-Os in hot water; use half of pear juice.
Put all ingredients in the blender, mix completely.
Pour in mold and chill until it gels.

title: Cajun 15 Bean Soup

ingredients.name: regular
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 lb. regular or mild Italian sausage (Polish sausage may also be used)

steps: In a large pan or kettle, cover beans with water and add 2 tablespoons salt.
Soak overnight.
In the morning, bring to boil and then drain.
Add 2-quarts water.
Bring to boil.
Simmer slowly 2 1/2 hours to 3 hours.
May be cooked in crock-pot.
In a skillet, saute onion, garlic and sausage until sausage is brown. Drain off excess grease; add contents to bean pot with stewed tomatoes, lemon juice and flavor package.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Serves 12 to 14.
Great as a leftover next day.
Also freezes very well.

title: Peanut Patty
steps: Cook ingredients in a heavy skillet or pan over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes.
Add red food coloring.
Turn off heat and add oleo and powdered sugar.
Pour on a greased cookie sheet. When set, break into pieces.

title: Pico De Gallo (Fresh Salsa)
steps: Do not peel tomatoes.
Chop/dice all ingredients.
Start with one serrano pepper and taste.
If your desire for the fire is greater, then add more peppers.
Enjoy with chips, vegetables, etc.

title: Creamy Carrot Nut Mold(Salad)

ingredients.name: pineapple do not drain
ingredients.raw: 1 (13 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple, do not drain

steps: Lightly oil a 2-quart mold with cooking oil.
Pour boiling water over gelatin in bowl and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.
Gradually add gelatin mixture to sour cream, stirring until well blended.
Stir until mixture begins to jell.
Stir in pineapple, carrots and nuts.
Turn into mold and chill until firm, about 4 hours.
Unmold onto salad greens.

title: Powdered Sugar Angel Food Cake
steps: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.
Fold in 1 tablespoon at a time the granulated sugar.
Sift together the powdered sugar, flour and salt.
Fold into egg mixture.
Add vanilla.
Bake in tube pan at 375° for 45 minutes.
Invert the cake while cooling.

title: Oven Caramel Popcorn
steps: Boil sugar, margarine, syrup and salt for 5 minutes (stir). Remove from heat and add soda and vanilla.
Stir well over popped corn (add nuts if desired).
Spread on deep cookie sheet or shallow roaster.
Place in 200° oven for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals.
Remove from oven, cool and store in tightly covered containers.

title: Marshmallow Creme
steps: Soften gelatine in water over top of double boiler.
Place over boiling water and stir gelatine until dissolved.
Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Put corn syrup in large mixing bowl; pour hot gelatine mixture over the syrup and beat until thick (about 15 minutes).
Stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla.
Store in 1-quart wide-mouth jars in refrigerator.
Spoon out as needed.

title: Quebec Tourtiere
steps: Mix meat, onion and spices in a saucepan. Add boiling water. Simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Skim off any fat. Preheat oven to 375°. Roll out half of the pastry and line 9-inch pie plate. Place filling in pie plate and cover with the remaining pastry. Prick with a fork. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden. Serve piping hot topped with homemade ketchup or chili sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Layered Potato Salad

ingredients.name: new potato well
ingredients.raw: 4 cans sliced new potatoes, drained well

steps: Layer 1/2 potatoes in a large bowl.
Sprinkle with 1/2 onion and 1/2 eggs.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon oil if desired.
Blend cottage cheese and mayonnaise together and spread 1/2 over above layers; sprinkle with 1/2 the dry dressing mix and lemon pepper to taste.
(Be generous with the lemon pepper.)
Repeat layers.
Let set overnight to develop flavors.

title: Sauteed Shrimp
steps: Melt butter in large baking pan.
Add shrimp and lemon and herb seasoning sprinkled on top of shrimp.
Bake at 450° about 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Country Breakfast Pie

ingredients.name: pie shell premade
ingredients.raw: 9-inch pie shell, premade or from scratch

steps: Cook sausage until done; crumble, then drain.
Mix cheese and sausage; sprinkle in pie shell.
Lightly beat eggs.
Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture.
Pour in shell and bake at 375° about 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fruit Salad(Sugar-Free)

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 can unsweetened crushed pineapple (16 to 20 oz.)

steps: Mix together.
Drain and rinse mandarin oranges before putting in bowl.

title: Lemon-Poppy Seed Muffins

ingredients.name: lemon instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. lemon instant pudding mix (4-serving size)

ingredients.name: poppy seed
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. poppy seed (I use 1/8 c. or 2 Tbsp.)

steps: Grease bottoms of or use paper baking
cups in regular muffin pan.
Mix oil, milk, eggs and pudding mix with fork until blended. Stir in the poppy seeds.
Divide evenly into 12 prepared muffin pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 375°.
Cool 10 minutes and drizzle with glaze.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients.
Pour into an 11 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over top.
Slice butter over top of cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Biscuits

ingredients.name: ham fit on biscuit
ingredients.raw: ham slices, cut to fit on biscuits

ingredients.name: swiss cheese fit on biscuit
ingredients.raw: Swiss cheese slices, cut to fit on biscuits

steps: Bake biscuits until light browning starts. Split biscuits and place ham and Swiss cheese in the middle. Replace tops.
Place biscuits in a 13 x 9-inch glass (greased) dish.
Melt margarine in saucepan.
Combine remaining ingredients with the margarine. Spoon mixture over the biscuits.
Cover and place in refrigerator overnight.
Uncover and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Potatoes In Apple Cups
steps: Boil sweet potatoes until tender.
Peel and mash.
Add butter, salt and sugar to potatoes and blend thoroughly.
Scoop out inside of apples, leaving a margin of about 1/4-inch all around.
Fill apples with mashed sweet potatoes.
Place in a baking dish and bake in a moderate oven at 325° for about 15 minutes, until apples are cooked.
Place marshmallows on top of potato mixture and return to oven to allow marshmallows to brown.
Serves 4.

title: Chicken In Tarragon Sauce
steps: On hard surface, with meat mallet, flatten each chicken breast.
In large frypan, place butter over medium high temperature.
Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned and fork can easily be inserted.
Remove chicken and keep warm.
In same frypan, add mushrooms and saute about 2 minutes.
Add cognac and carefully ignite by touching edge of pan with match flame.
(Always use caution when flaming!) Allow flame to completely die out after several minutes.
Add cream and cook over high heat until mixture reduces and thickens, coating back of spoon.
Stir in cayenne, tarragon, dash of salt and lemon juice.
Arrange chicken on a platter and pour sauce over to serve.
Serves 4.

title: Cajun Chicken Casserole With Cornbread Crust
steps: Combine chicken, soup, celery, green pepper, onion and pimentos in a large bowl.
Stir well.
Pour into a 9 x 14-inch pan or individual casserole dishes.
Combine cornbread mix, chicken stock and melted butter in a large bowl.
Stir well.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake in a 350° oven until crust is golden and casserole is bubbly, for about 15 to 20 minutes.
Yields 10 servings.

title: Fresh Tofu Loaf
steps: Beat eggs slightly.
Add mushroom soup; beat and blend with milk and soy sauce.
Mash tofu coarsely, and combine all ingredients; mix well.
Bake in oiled loaf pan, set in a pan of hot water, at 350° about 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding.

title: Battle Bread
steps: Mix all together and put in a covered bowl in icebox.
Let set for 1 hour.
Grease bread pan.
Put dough in pan.
Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Double Batch Easy Baked Beans

ingredients.name: ranch style bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans Ranch Style beans or barbecue style beans

steps: Brown meat and onion together.
In crock-pot, add all ingredients.
Bake at 300° for about 2 hours (low setting on crock-pot).
Can be baked in a large Corning Ware dish in oven.

title: Barb'S Pasta Salad
steps: To the cooked pasta add the Italian dressing and salad season mix.
Mix well and refrigerator overnight.
Just before serving add the green peppers and tomato.

title: Cajun-Style Chicken Nuggets

ingredients.name: envelope lipton onion
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton onion or onion-mushroom soup mix

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: In large bowl mix onion soup mix, bread crumbs, chili powder, cumin, thyme and pepper.
Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture; coating well.
In large skillet heat 1/2-inch oil and cook chicken over medium heat turning once until tender.
Drain on paper towel. Serve warm and could be served with assorted mustards.
Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Ants On A Log
steps: Wash celery and cut into small pieces.
Fill celery with cream cheese and add raisins.
Children can assist with this activity.

title: Saturday Night Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: In a 2-quart casserole, combine onion and ground meat. Microwave 4 minutes on High (100%).
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Add to meat and onion, stirring to blend.
Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High (100%) or simmer on stove.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cranberry Smoothie
steps: Combine half of all the ingredients in electric blender; process until smooth.
Repeat with all the remaining ingredients. Combine mixtures.
Pour into individual glasses.
Makes about
4 cups.

title: Zucchini Dish

ingredients.name: nice size zucchini or
ingredients.raw: 1 nice size zucchini or 3 small, chopped

steps: Spread rolls on 9 x 13-inch pan.
Saute onion and zucchini in oleo until soft.
Pour over rolls.
Pour eggs over zucchini and onions.
Sprinkle cheese over all.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.
Cut in squares.

title: Company Rice

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1 cube butter or margarine, cut up

ingredients.name: cooking cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 to 3 Tbsp. cooking sherry or other wine (this is optional)

steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Bake in covered 2-quart casserole dish 1 hour or until done.
Serves 6.

title: Rice Puffs

ingredients.name: brown
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cooked brown or white rice

steps: Beat egg.
Stir in poultry seasoning, salt and cheese; mix with rice.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Shape by rounded teaspoonfuls into 1-inch balls.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil.
Fry rice balls until golden brown; drain.
Makes about 15 rice balls.

title: Pepperoni Quiche Appetizer
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour in a greased pie plate (use a bigger pan and make thinner for an appetizer).
Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

title: Salted Peanut Crisps
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix shortening, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting.
Blend together flour, soda and salt; stir in.
Mix in peanuts.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart on lightly greased sheet.
Flatten with tumbler dipped in sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen (2-inch) cookies.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Nut Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a medium bowl, stir flour, baking soda and salt.
Set aside.

title: Crock-Pot Camp Stew

ingredients.name: lean ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. lean ground beef or turkey

ingredients.name: tabasco sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. Tabasco sauce (may be adjusted to taste)

steps: Brown ground beef and drain well.
Add to other ingredients in crock-pot.
Stir well, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (high for 2 to 3 hours).
Serve with tossed salad and crusty French bread for a quick and easy meal.

title: Bacon And Chive Potato Salad

ingredients.name: unpeeled red potato
ingredients.raw: 6 c. quartered, unpeeled small red potatoes

ingredients.name: bacon crisply and
ingredients.raw: 8 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled

ingredients.name: chives
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chopped chives or sliced green onions

steps: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 14 minutes or until tender. Drain.
Mix mayonnaise and mustard in a large bowl.
Add potatoes, bacon and chives.
Mix lightly.
Refrigerate until serving (at least 1 to 2 hours).
Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Pimiento Cheese
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients with mayonnaise.
Add pimiento, salt and sugar.

title: 100% Frosting
steps: Boil the first 5 ingredients until clear.
Pour over slightly beaten egg white; continue to beat until spreading consistency. Add vanilla.

title: Grits And Cheese Souffle

ingredients.name: quick
ingredients.raw: 1 c. quick or regular cooking grits

steps: Grease a 2-quart souffle dish.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Cook grits in milk and water according to package directions.
Add salt.
When grits are cooked, add pepper, nutmeg, Tabasco and all but 1/2 cup of cheese.
Mix well and then allow to cool slightly. Add egg yolks.
Beat egg whites stiff and add half of them to the grit mixture; beat well.
Fold in remaining egg whites with a rubber spatula.
Spoon into the souffle dish and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.
Bake 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Ladyfinger Dessert
steps: Melt chocolate in a double boiler pan.
Stir in instant coffee.
Cool.
Beat egg yolks and fold in chocolate mixture. Beat egg whites, fold in chocolate mixture. Beat whipping cream with salt and fold in mixture.

title: Carrot Cheese Log

ingredients.name: container reduced calorie soft style cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (8 oz.) container reduced calorie, soft-style cream cheese

ingredients.name: wheat and barley nugget cereal
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. wheat and barley nugget cereal, crushed

steps: Mix together carrots, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and fines herbes.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Microwave Potatoes For 2

ingredients.name: following seasoning seasoning salt garlic powder pepper and salt
ingredients.raw: any of following seasonings: seasoning salt, garlic powder, pepper and salt

steps: Peel and chunk potatoes.
You can also add chopped onion to taste.
Put in small casserole with tight fitting lid.
Don't add any water.
Cook on high for 3 minutes.
Add small pat of oleo.
Stir well to coat the potatoes.
Then add any of the seasonings and cook, covered, for 1 more minute or until tender.

title: Lemon Chiffon Jello

ingredients.name: lemon jell o or
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) lemon Jell-O or 1 (6 oz.) box

steps: Pour the liquid from the pears into a saucepan with the 2 packages Jell-O.
Heat just before it boils.
