Blend pears, cream cheese and Cool Whip in blender.
Fold in Jell-O.
Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish sprayed with Pam.
Let set in refrigerator until firm.
Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Mushroom Pie

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: pie crust mix
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pkg. pie crust mix or homemade crust

steps: Combine chicken, celery soup, mushrooms and liquid, celery, green pepper and steak sauce in a large skillet.
Heat slowly, until bubbly hot, about 10 minutes.

title: Family Reunion Rolls(Makes 2 Dozen)
steps: Scald milk.
Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast into warm water; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture.
Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour.
Beat until smooth.
Add and stir in remaining flour.

title: Green Chilli
steps: Saute pork steak; salt and pepper to taste.
Brown hamburger; salt and pepper to taste.
Put Ro-Tel and tomatoes in blender and blend about 30 seconds.
Cut jalapenos into small pieces.
Put all ingredients into large soup pot, add 1/2 jar of minced garlic and cook (simmer) for about 1 hour or so.

title: Baked Pork Chops(Makes 1 To 2 Servings)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash chops and season on both sides. Beat together egg and milk.
Dip chops in mixture, then coat on both sides with crushed cornflakes.
Place in baking dish and bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the juices run clear.
It is not necessary to turn chops during cooking.
Serve in sandwich or with baked potato or other vegetable.

title: Lemon Oat Lacies(Cookies)

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (4 sticks) butter or margarine, softened

ingredients.name: quaker oats uncooked
ingredients.raw: 3 c. Quaker oats (Quick or old fashioned), uncooked

steps: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy.
Add remaining ingredients, except powdered sugar; mix well.
Cover.
Chill 30 minutes.

title: Roast Beef Po Boy
steps: Put roast in baking pan.
Add onion, garlic and soup.
Add bouillon cubes to water; pour over.
Cover with foil; bake at 350°.
May need to add more water.
Slice roast; serve on French bread with gravy.

title: Chocolate Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
steps: Mix
sugar,
salt
and	cocoa.	Add
eggs and mix well. Stir in vanilla and milk.
Add melted oleo, then coconut.
One cup of nuts may be added, if desired.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at
350° for 40 minutes or until firm.
Cool and serve.

title: Mexican Fiesta

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Brown meat; drain.
Add seasoning and water.
Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Prepare rice.
Melt cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes; mix well.
Combine meat, rice and cheese dip.
Top with chips.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Applesauce

ingredients.name: cooking apple cored and
ingredients.raw: 4 medium cooking apples, peeled, cored and quartered

steps: Place apples and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Cover and microwave on High until apples are tender.
Stir in sugar and cinnamon.
Cool.

title: Brown Sugar Macaroons
steps: Combine sugar, nuts and egg and mix.
Using 1 rounded teaspoonful per cookie, shape into balls.
Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in a preheated 300° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Stuff(Stuff:  An Unspecified Material Substance Or Aggregate Of Matter.)
steps: Brown sausage and drain well.
Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs. Spread mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Combine sour cream, poppy seed, salt and eggs.
Spread this mix over the sausage.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Nugget Salad

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cubed, cooked ham or chicken

ingredients.name: bottled low fat italian salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. bottled low-fat Italian salad dressing

steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain.
In large bowl, combine pasta and remaining ingredients; toss to mix. Serve immediately or cover and chill.
Stir gently before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Congealed Waldorf Salad

ingredients.name: apple unpeeled and
ingredients.raw: 1 large apple, unpeeled and finely chopped

steps: Bring 1 cup cider to a boil; add gelatin and stir until dissolved.
Stir in remaining cider.
Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white.
Fold in apple, celery and pecans.
Pour into a 4-cup mold.
Chill until set.
Unmold on a lettuce lined plate and top with a dollop of mayonnaise.

title: Ground Meat & Rice
steps: Brown meat in butter.
Add: soup, rice and water.
Cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Irene'S Cake

ingredients.name: sugar vanilla instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. sugar-free vanilla instant pudding mix

steps: In a casserole dish, place crumbled angel food cake in bottom and cover with crushed pineapple with juice.
Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and pour over pineapple.
Place sliced bananas over pudding; cover with Cool Whip.
Let chill before serving.

title: Homecoming Banana Pudding
steps: Mix pudding, milk, sour cream and half of Cool Whip.
Layer crackers, bananas and pudding.
Top with other half of Cool Whip.

title: "Kay Huddleston'S Broccoli Casserole"

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or 1 can cream of chicken soup or 1 can cream of celery soup

steps: Saute onion in margarine.
Mix soup and Cheez Whiz.
Add cooked and well drained broccoli.
Top with onion rings or cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Corn Noodle Soup
steps: Cut up the chicken and cover with 3 quarts water.
Add the salt and saffron and stew until tender.
Remove chicken from stock and set aside the legs and breast for chicken salad.
Take the rest of the meat from the bones and return meat to broth.
Add the corn and noodles to soup.
Season with pepper.
Cook 15 minutes longer.
Before serving, add parsley and chopped eggs.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
steps: Boil a whole chicken in a Dutch oven pot with water.
(Cover chicken over half way with water) after chicken is done, take out of broth to cool.
Mix flour and shortening in together first. Then add all other ingredients.
(I beat my egg in with the 5 tablespoons of chicken broth.) After mixing all ingredients, mixture should be a soft dough.
Roll out dough very thin and let stand for about 10 minutes.
Then cut into strips and drop into boiling broth.
Simmer about 15 minutes, then add deboned chicken to dumplings.

title: Crunch Cake
steps: Mix sugar and shortening until light and creamy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Stir in flavorings.
Start baking in cold oven at 275° in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Copy Cat Cheese Biscuits(Similar To Those Served By A Popular Seafood Restaurant)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Mix baking mix, cheese and water.
Drop by large spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
After baking, while hot, brush with melted butter, mixed with the parsley, garlic and Italian seasoning.
Serve hot.
Makes about 12 biscuits.

title: J.D.'S Texas Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: campbell s chicken gumbo soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (12 oz.) cans Campbell's chicken gumbo soup

steps: Heat soup to boiling.
Reduce heat and melt in cheese.
Add green chiles.
Pour into bowl and let cool for one hour.
Great for dipping fresh vegetables or tortilla chips.
For hotter dip, use Velveeta jalapeno cheese.

title: English Cheese Melts

ingredients.name: or olive
ingredients.raw: 2 cans (2.25 oz. each) sliced or chopped olives

steps: Cut English muffins in half.
Set aside.
In large bowl mix together olives, cheese, onions, mayonnaise and salt.
Spread mixture evenly over 12 muffin halves.
Place on baking sheet. Broil 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted.
Cut in half before serving.
Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes & Apples

ingredients.name: cooking apple cored and ring
ingredients.raw: 3 large cooking apples, cored and cut into 1/2 inch rings

steps: Cut sweet potatoes in half crosswise.
Cook in boiling water to cover, for 10 minutes.
Drain and cool.
Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Zucchini Brownies
steps: Mix together flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and baking soda. Combine shredded zucchini, vanilla and oil.
Mix with dry ingredients.
Add nuts.
Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
May frost or serve as is.
Very good!

title: Crispix Squares
steps: Pack first four ingredients in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add vanilla ice cream.
Keep frozen until ready to serve.

title: Italian Fish Fillets

ingredients.name: fish fillet skin and bone removed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. fish fillets, skin and bones removed (about 1/2-inch thick)

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley (1 Tbsp. if dry)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut fish into serving size pieces. Arrange in greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with parsley, basil, oregano and pepper.
Top with spaghetti sauce, then sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily at the thickest part.

title: "Vinegar For Sushi"

ingredients.name: vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. vinegar (Heinz white vinegar in glass is best)

steps: Combine
vinegar,
sugar and salt in saucepan, stirring until sugar
dissolves.
Bring to a boil.
(If you desire, add ajinomoto when
liquid
becomes clear.) You can make a larger "batch" at a time and keep it on hand, making it handy to make sushi,
inari, maze-gohan, California roll, etc., frequently. The "su"
is
also very
good to make "sunomono" or for other salads.

title: My Favorite Meat Ball Appetizer

ingredients.name: italian bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Italian bread crumbs (may take more)

steps: Mix ingredients together; roll into walnut size balls.
Bake on cookie sheet at 350° until done (approximately 30 to 45 minutes).
Prepare the sauce while meat balls are baking.

title: Brennan Potatoes
steps: Bake potato.
Grill bacon until crisp.
Drain, leaving 3 tablespoons grease.
Add onion and saute slowly.
Remove from heat.
Cut shallow lengthwise strip from potatoes and scoop out inside and add to skillet.
Add cheese, crumbled bacon, sour cream and seasonings.
Mix and mash with spoon to blend.
Return to low heat and heat through.
Stuff into potatoes.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Grilled Fajitas

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. chicken or steak, cut into small strips

ingredients.name: onion ring
ingredients.raw: 2 medium onions, sliced into rings (keep intact)

ingredients.name: red green
ingredients.raw: 1 large, red, green or yellow pepper, cut into strips

ingredients.name: fajita marinade mixed according pkg. direction
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. fajita marinade, mixed according to pkg. directions

ingredients.name: sour cream and salsa
ingredients.raw: sour cream and salsa to taste

steps: Marinate the meat according to directions. Grill the vegetables until tender-crisp.
Remove and keep warm.
Grill meat until preferred doneness.

title: Cabbage Casserole In A Rice Cooker
steps: Brown ground meat and sausage together.
Drain oil when cooked.
Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; then transfer into rice cooker.
When cooked, leave in cooker for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dutch Baked Beans

ingredients.name: great northern bean
ingredients.raw: 1 large (40 oz.) can Great Northern beans

steps: Saute peppers and onions in small amount of oil.
Blend all ingredients together.
Pour into casserole.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothy

ingredients.name: strawberry in light syrup partially thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries in light syrup, partially thawed

steps: In blender, process strawberries, yogurt, banana and juice until smooth.
Immediately
pour into chilled, insulated drink container or make into popsicles.
Refrigerate any remaining drink in covered container and serve later.
Instruct your child to give the container several vigorous shakes before opening it.

title: Cheese And Chilies Roll

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. cream cheese (not light or fat-free)

steps: Bring cheeses to room temperature.
On a sheet of wax paper, roll out Velveeta.
Divide the cream cheese into small portions and put on top of Velveeta.
Roll again.
Spread the green chilies over cheeses.
Roll up as for a jelly roll.
Divide into 2 rolls. Serve with crackers.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
steps: Roll pork chops in flour and onion mixture.
Brown pork chops in oiled skillet.
Add whole tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Cover with tomato sauce and simmer until tender.

title: Sizzlers
steps: Cook hamburger meat and onion until done; drain.
Add chili powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper and red pepper.
Cook for a few minutes.
Add Cheez Whiz and cook until melted.
Spread meat on flat tostada shells.
Shred cabbage on top of meat (may want to sprinkle red pepper on if you like hot stuff).
Place another tostada shell on top of cabbage.

title: Caramel-Peach Crunch Dessert

ingredients.name: cling peach
ingredients.raw: 1 (29 oz.) can cling peach slices, drained

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a bowl, combine flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Add butter.
Mix well.

title: Fruit Pops
steps: Put in all ingredients and blend until smooth.
Put in Dixie cups or popsicle molds.
Put plastic spoon or popsicle stick in middle and freeze until frozen.

title: Chili Cheese Puff
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Kentucky Chess Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until solid.

title: Bean Relish Bowl

ingredients.name: onion and in ring
ingredients.raw: 1 small onion, peeled, sliced and in rings

steps: Combine all but lettuce and egg.
Toss lightly, cover.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Just before serving, add lettuce and egg.
Toss.

title: Fried Eggplant Or Summer Squash
steps: Wash eggplant; pare and cut in 1/2-inch slices.
Or wash squash and cut crosswise in slices.
Dip slices in well seasoned flour.
Saute slowly in butter for 10 to 15 minutes, or until crisp and browned, turning occasionally.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Whitney'S Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Boil potatoes in jacket until done.
Peel and mash.
Add butter, sugar, vanilla, sprinkle of nutmeg & cinnamon.
Combine the beaten eggs and milk.
Mix with potatoes until well blended. Pour into pie shells.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake(This Cake Is So Tasty It Doesn'T Need Frosting)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together and beat well.
Bake in tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour.
May sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.

title: Miniature Cheese Cakes

ingredients.name: thank you peach blueberry
ingredients.raw: 20 to 21 oz. can Thank You peach, blueberry or cherry pie filling

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Line cupcake pans with paper liners. Place vanilla wafer in bottom of each liner.
In small bowl beat next 5 items until light and fluffy.
Fill liners 3/4 full with mixture.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set.
Top each with spoonful of filling and 1 teaspoon nuts.
Chill.
Serves 24.

title: Christian Cake
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy for others.
Flavor with little gifts of love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of faith and prayer to lighten other ingredients and raise texture of great heights of Christian living.
Bake well at a high degree of human kindness and serve with a warm smile.

title: Old-Fashioned Fudge
steps: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add corn syrup and milk.
Stir.
Cook on medium heat, stirring often, until it reaches a soft ball stage (235° on a candy thermometer).
Add butter and vanilla.
Let cool. Beat until it thickens and loses its shine.
Pour into greased pan to harden.
(Nuts may be added just before pouring into pan.)

title: Beet Top Greens
steps: Beet greens may be prepared in the same ways that you prepare spinach or Swiss chard, but they must be young and small to be tasty.
Try cooking the greens in boiling salted water for 5 to 8 minutes.
Drain, chop and add the butter or margarine.
Toss with a fork until butter is melted.
Add the horseradish and lemon juice; mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serves 4.

title: Glad'S Own Custard Pie(Ed'S Very Favorite)
steps: Beat eggs; add sugar.
Scald milk and add to mixture.
Add nutmeg; pour into unbaked crust.
Bake at 350° until filling is firm.
Top with meringue.
Brown slightly.

title: Orange-Nut Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Stir in orange rind and nuts. Beat eggs in small bowl. Add orange juice and oil.
Mix well. Add to flour mixture.
Mix until moistened.
Fill greased tins 2/3 full. Bake at 425° for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Caramel Apple Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: sugar mixed with tbsp. cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. sugar, mixed with 2 Tbsp. cinnamon

steps: Melt butter.
Add brown sugar and corn syrup and blend.
Pour mixture into bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 10-inch round pan.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
Peel and slice apple.
Spread apple slices on top of nuts.
Dip each refrigerated roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture (one side only).
Place sugar side down in the pan.
After placing all rolls in pan, sprinkle remaining mixture over all.
Bake in 375° oven and turn out onto a large plate or tray.
Let sit for 30 seconds, then lift off and serve warm.

title: Ginger'S Chocolate Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease cookie sheets.
Combine first four ingredients and mix well with spoon.
(Dough will be thick.)
Add vanilla chips and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Let stand on cookie sheet 1 minute before removing to wire rack.
Yields 2 dozen large or 4 dozen small cookies.

title: Chocolate Crunch Truffles

ingredients.name: butter and in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. (1 stick) butter, softened and cut in chunks

steps: In a medium saucepan over very low heat, melt chocolate, stirring constantly; remove from heat.
Add butter, stirring until melted; stir in liqueur and orange peel, if desired.
Transfer to a medium bowl; cover and refrigerate until mixture is fudge-like, about 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter And Oat Cookies
steps: Bring first three ingredients to a boil. Take off heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

title: Southern Peanut Pie
steps: Beat eggs until foamy.
Add sugar, syrup, butter, salt and vanilla.
Continue to beat until thoroughly blended.
Stir in peanuts.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.
May be topped with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Corny Cornbread

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: Blend eggs, margarine, sour cream and corn.
Add salt and muffin mix.
Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
This is best when served hot.

title: Mock Coconut Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together in order given.
Beat well. Chill dough 1 hour.
Shape into small balls.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
Do not overbake.
Let cool on cookie sheet before removing.

title: Never Know It'S Low-Fat Cake
steps: Prepare German chocolate cake mix as directed on package, substituting Egg Beaters and applesauce for eggs and oil.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan, sprayed with low-fat cooking spray, as directed.
Pour condensed milk over hot cake (in pan).
Let cool. Spread caramel topping.
Sprinkle Grape-Nuts.
Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Delicious and guilt-free!

title: Sopaipillas
steps: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl.
Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mealy.
Add water, a tablespoon at a time, and toss with a fork to blend.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth.
Roll out as thin as possible. Cut into 2 or 3-inch squares and fry in hot oil, 370°, until puffed and browned.
Makes 20 to 30, depending on size.
Serve warm with cinnamon sugar or syrup, if desired.

title: Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chopped red or green bell pepper

steps: Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot.
Add cabbage, onion, pepper, garlic powder, sugar, salt and pepper.
Stir-fry until cabbage is just tender and light green, about 3 minutes. Add water and cover; remove from heat.
Let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Dutch Rusk

ingredients.name: dry yeast prepared in water sugar mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. dry yeast, prepared in water-sugar mix

steps: Mix first 4 ingredients, then add flour to thicken slightly. Add the next 3 ingredients and mix.
Add flour until right for punching.
Lard sides of pan.
Knead a few minutes more.
Let rise 2 times.
Make into large 3-inch buns.
Let raise.
Bake at 350° and let cool.
Slice each bun in 2 or 3 slices.
Dry in low oven until crisp.

title: Easy Vanilla Pudding
steps: Mix together sugar, flour, salt and milk; cook over medium heat to a boil.
Separate eggs; beat yolks.
Mix with small amount of pudding mix.
Then add to entire mixture.
Put back on fire and cook for one minute.
Remove from heat.
Add 1 stick of oleo and vanilla.

title: Date Roll
steps: Melt margarine and marshmallows in pan over low heat.
Chop dates and nuts.
Add to margarine-marshmallow mixture.
Spread about 1 cup graham cracker crumbs on wax paper.
Shape mixture into long roll.
Lay on graham crackers and roll up.
Chill; slice thin.

title: Yummy Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Heat milk and sugar to rolling boil in 2-quart saucepan, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Add chocolate and salt.
Stir until chocolate melts, then beat with rotary beater until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla. Keeps well in jar in refrigerator (if the family doesn't find it).

title: Rita'S Banana Crush(Punch)
steps: Dissolve sugar in water.
Add juice and bananas (mashed or put in blender).
Put in 7-Up that's been chilled.

title: Baked Apple And Carrot Casserole(Low-Fat!)
steps: Place half of the sliced apples in a buttered casserole dish. Cover with half of the carrot slices.
Combine dry ingredients; sprinkle half of the mix over carrots.
Repeat the layers; pour orange juice over the top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Favorite Christmas Candy
steps: Combine all ingredients in bowl.
Mix well.
Shape into 2 logs; wrap in foil.
Store in refrigerator.
Cut into slices. Yields 4 dozen.

title: No Sugar Apricot Cookies(Diabetic)
steps: Sift flour and salt.
Put cream cheese and butter in a bowl and blend.
Add sifted ingredients; blend and cover.
Chill.
Heat oven to 350°.
Divide dough into small portions.
Roll on floured board about 1/8 inch thick and 3 inches square.
Place a scant tablespoonful of preserves in center of dough and fold 2 opposite corners to center.
Pinch and seal.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake 20 minutes until edges are lightly browned.

title: Sarah Circle Christmas Shrimp Casserole

ingredients.name: slightly dry bread crust and
ingredients.raw: 8 slices slightly dry bread, crusts trimmed and cubed

ingredients.name: sharp american cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. sharp American cheese (2 c. shredded)

steps: Put 1/2 crumbs in casserole.
Add shrimp, mushrooms and 1/2 cheese.
Top with remainder of bread and cheese.
Beat eggs slightly.
Add seasonings and milk; mix.
Pour over the casserole. Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.
(May be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated.)

title: Hawaiian-Style Chicken

ingredients.name: bird eye hawaiian style vegetable with pineapple and a seasoned sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye Hawaiian-style vegetable with pineapple and a seasoned sauce

steps: Combine flour, salt and pepper; dredge chicken pieces.
Heat oil in large skillet; add chicken and brown well on both sides. Turn chicken skin side up and add water.
Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Place chicken on platter and keep warm. Add vegetables to skillet.
Bring to a full boil over medium heat, separating vegetables with fork.
Stir until sauce cubes are blended.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in catsup and serve over chicken.
Makes 3 servings.

title: Cowboy Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes.
Let cool.
Peel and cube.
In large skillet, fry bacon.
Remove bacon and allow to cool, then crumble.
Saute onions and peppers in bacon drippings.
Add potatoes and stir, heating thoroughly.
Add bacon last.
Serve while hot.

title: Peanut Velvet Frosting
steps: Heat butter over low heat until golden brown.
Remove from heat.
Beat in sugar, milk, vanilla and salt.
Blend in Jif. Frosts one 9 x 13-inch cake.

title: Scandinavian Cucumbers

ingredients.name: cucumber with skin on
ingredients.raw: 3 thinly sliced small cucumbers with skin on

steps: Stir together sour cream, sugar, parsley, vinegar, onion and dill.
Fold in cucumbers; cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Coconut Bananas
steps: Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces.
Place lemon juice, sour cream and coconut in separate bowls.
Dip bananas in lemon juice.
Roll in sour cream and then in coconut, making sure all sides are coated.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Makes about 24 pieces.

title: Quick Butter Cookies
steps: Mix oleo and other ingredients with a fork or fingers.
Roll into balls about 1-inch.
Place on cookie sheet and press with fork crisscross.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Posh Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash until tender.
Drain well; beat eggs and add all ingredients to eggs.
Pour into buttered baking dish and dot with butter or top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: New Version Apple Crisp
steps: Place apples in bottom of a 11 x 7-inch baking dish or pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg over apples.
Cover with slices of white loaf bread with crust removed.
Mix sugar, margarine and egg.
Pour over bread.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Salad
steps: Cook rhubarb in water for 8 to 10 minutes.
Remove and add Jell-O, sugar and juice.
Chill slightly.
Fold in apple and nuts.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Pudding

ingredients.name: container strawberry flavor soft cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container strawberry flavor soft cream cheese

steps: Slice all but 4 berries.
Mix cream cheese, milk and confectioners sugar until smooth.
In 4 goblets, layer half of sliced berries, then half of cheese mixture.
Repeat.
Garnish with whole berries.
Shave the chocolate bar.
Top each goblet with 1 ounce shaved chocolate.

title: Oreo Cookie Delight
steps: Layer in a 9 x13 inch pan.
1st layer, put crushed cookies in dish and pour melted butter on top.
2nd layer, mix cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread on top of cookies.
3rd layer, sliced strawberries.
4th layer, pineapple. 5th layer sliced bananas. Top with Cool whip.

title: Christmas Morning Breakfast Casserole
steps: Scramble eggs and set
aside.
Fry bacon and set aside. Fry hash browns and set aside.

title: Barbecue Buns

ingredients.name: instant nonfat dry milk solid
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. instant nonfat dry milk solids

ingredients.name: very warm tap water
ingredients.raw: 2 c. very warm tap water (120~ to 130~)

steps: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and yeast.
Add oleo.
Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add 3/4 cup flour.
Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.
Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough.
Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes).
Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Meatballs
steps: Cook meatballs as directed (see recipe).
Mix brown sugar and cornstarch in skillet.
Add meatballs; stir in pineapple (with syrup), vinegar and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat.
Add meatballs.
Cover; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Stir in green pepper. Cover; simmer until crisp-tender, 5 minutes.

title: Methodist Baked Beans
steps: Brown
ground
beef and onion;	drain good.
Mix ground beef, onion,
sugar
and pork and beans.	Put in a long Pyrex dish.
Put bacon
on top of beans and top with ketchup.
Cook until bacon is cooked.
Bake in oven at 400°.

title: Stir-Fry Lemon-Honey Pork
steps: Cut pork into thin strips.
Dredge in the flour.
Cook quickly but thoroughly in the hot oil.
Remove meat from skillet.
Add remaining ingredients to drippings and cook 2 minutes until crisp but tender.
Stir pork strips in and serve.

title: Spoon Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine corn meal, shortening and 2 cups of milk in a pan over medium heat.
Bring mixture just to a boil, stirring constantly.
Blend beaten eggs, salt and remaining milk.
Add to corn meal mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in baking powder.
Pour into greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve hot with butter.

title: Murlean'S Pretzel Salad
steps: Mix crushed pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill.

title: Summer Cake

ingredients.name: whipping cream
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. whipping cream or 8 oz. carton Cool Whip

steps: Bake cake as per directed in a large oblong pan.
While hot, cover with crushed pineapple.

title: Fruit Rolls
steps: Crush wafers to fine crumbs.
Add to nuts and chopped cherries.
Mix well in milk.
Pour coconut on waxed paper.
Form rolls by rolling and shaping on coconut.
Wrap in foil. Refrigerate.

title: Easy Spareribs
steps: Place all ingredients in a heavy pan and cook 45 minutes (high heat).
Stir
every 10 minutes until all sauce is gone. Turn to low heat; fat becomes oil.

title: Zucchini, Carrot And Tomato Casserole

ingredients.name: zucchini diagonally in
ingredients.raw: 3 small zucchini, cut diagonally in 1/4-inch strips

steps: Cook carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Combine carrots, zucchini and tomatoes in rectangular dish.
In saucepan, stir cornstarch, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and butter until smooth and thick.
Pour sauce over vegetables.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and almonds.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Beef Casserole(Chinese Style)

ingredients.name: potato chip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. crushed potato chips or corn flakes

steps: Cook beef until brown and crumbly.
Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Arrange thawed peas over meat, then cover with celery. Mix together soup, cream, seasonings and onion.
Pour over celery. Sprinkle with chips or flakes.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
steps: Mix in order given and our into unbaked pie crust. Bake in moderate oven 25 minutes.
You may use an orange instead of lemon; it's very good.

title: Mary'S Cheese Grits
steps: Cook grits.
Add cheese, butter and garlic.
Stir until blended.
Beat 3 eggs in measuring cup.
Add half and half to eggs to measure 1 3/4 cups total.
Add to grits.
Put in casserole. Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 10.

title: Homemade Custard

ingredients.name: cornstarch dissolved in water
ingredients.raw: 5 to 7 Tbsp. cornstarch, dissolved in water

steps: Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat until it comes to a full boil.
Pour into a 9x13 pan lined with vanilla wafers or crackers.

title: Chinese Icicles(Cookies)
steps: Using high speed of the electric mixer, cream butter, sugar and vanilla until soft and creamy.
Sift together salt and flour; add gradually to butter mixture.
Blend well on low speed.
Add noodles, stirring in by hand.
Chill until firm.
Pinch off small pieces of dough and shape into fingers.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool; dust with powdered sugar.
Yield:
5 to 6 dozen icicles.

title: Zucchini Parmesan(Can Substitute Eggplant For Zucchini)
steps: On wax paper, combine bread crumbs with oregano.
Cut zucchini lengthwise.
Brush with mayo; coat with crumb mixture.
In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, arrange zucchini, crumb side up.
Cook, covered with wax paper on High for 12 to 15 minutes, until tender, rotating halfway through cooking time.
In small bowl, cook spaghetti sauce on High for 1 to 3 minutes, until hot.
Meanwhile sprinkle 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese over zucchini.
Spoon sauce over cheese; top with remaining Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
steps: Season meat with salt, brown in hot fat.
Arrange alternate layers, onions, potatoes and meat in a 2-quart casserole.
Pour soup over layers.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over casserole about 10 minutes before it's done, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Two-In-One Bake

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: Cook cauliflower in 1-inch boiling salt water until tender-crisp; drain.
Separate into flowerets.
Start heating oven to 350°.
Combine soup and milk in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
Add cauliflowerets, ham, savory and 1/2 cup cheese. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Fresh Key Lime Pie
steps: Pie Shell:
Mix cracker crumbs, butter and sugar in bowl. Press into pie pan to form crust.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°; cool.

title: Sensational Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips.
In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon margarine, cook 1/2 of beef and 1/2 of onion until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender.
Set aside and repeat with remaining margarine, beef and onion.
Return meat mixture to skillet.
Stir in soup and paprika.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to very low.
Stir in sour cream.
Gently heat through.
Serve on hot noodles.

title: Spaghetti Pizza Style
steps: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Mix with egg and milk.
Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with spaghetti sauce, grated cheese and pepperoni or other toppings.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese And Sausage Biscuits

ingredients.name: biscuit in half
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. can biscuit, cut in half

steps: Grease muffin pan and press biscuit half in pan cups up the side as far as you can.
Divide sausage and place on dough.
Mix cheese cottage cheese eggs and pepper; pour over sausage and dough.
Bake 375° 15 to 20 minutes.
Wipe muffin pan, grease and make the rest of the muffins.

title: Corn And Tomatoes
steps: Cook all ingredients together.
On the farm, we used fresh corn and tomatoes.
This was one of Claude's favorites.

title: New Potato Dish
steps: Boil new potatoes until partly cooked.
Remove from pan and cut potatoes into halves.
Pour melted butter over potatoes in a baking dish and sprinkle with dry Italian dressing.
Finish baking until done.
Do not cover.

title: Mill Road Acres Beer Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Best when just baked.

title: Pizza Sandwich

ingredients.name: or tbsp. catsup with tsp. oregano mixed in
ingredients.raw: 2 or 3 Tbsp. catsup with 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. oregano mixed in

steps: In a frypan with a small amount of melted margarine, grill 2 slices of sandwich bread on one side only of each slice.
Then remove one slice from pan and set aside.

title: Beef Nachos

ingredients.name: colby/monterey jack cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 2 c. shredded Colby/Monterey Jack cheese, divided

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown ground beef; drain.
Put into mixing bowl.
Add salsa, chili powder, Miracle Whip and corn.
Layer 1/2 meat in dish.
Add 1/2 chips and cheese on top.
Layer rest of ingredients.

title: Pork Sausage Spread
steps: Brown and drain the sausage.
Add remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Daffodil Dip
steps: Cut the white of the egg up into the cream cheese and salad dressing.
Keep the egg yolk separate and mix all the rest together.
After that's done, smash the egg yolk and sprinkle on top.
If you want a big dish, use 8 ounces cream cheese and 2 hard-boiled eggs.

title: Sour-Creamed Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato cream with milk and butter
ingredients.raw: 3 c. potatoes, creamed with milk and butter (may use leftover potatoes)

steps: Mix ingredients together.
Pour into casserole dish.
Bake at 350° until hot.

title: Creamy Raspberry Ring
steps: Combine gelatin and water and cook over medium heat until dissolved.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add milk and softened gelatin; beat until mixed.
Refrigerate until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes.
Stir in cream cheese mixture until smooth; fold in whipped cream.
Pour into ungreased mold.

title: German Schnitzel
steps: First, flatten meat to tenderize and make larger.
(This can be done by pounding meat with the flat side of meat cleaver or plate edge.)
Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder and spread with mustard.
Dip meat in egg on both sides and then dip in bread crumbs.
Melt margarine in skillet at medium-high heat.
When margarine is hot, add meat and fry until brown on both sides.
If egg is left over, scramble and place on top of meat.

title: Cookie Bars

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: hershey s semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 2 c. (12 oz. pkg.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips

ingredients.name: hershey s butterscotch chip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Hershey's butterscotch chips or peanut butter chips

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine.
Press firmly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour Eagle Brand evenly over crust.
Top evenly with remaining ingredients in order listed.
Press down firmly.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool; chill thoroughly, if desired.
Cut into bars.
Store, loosely covered, at room temperature.

title: Buttermilk Jello

ingredients.name: jello
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. jello (any flavor; do not mix flavors)

steps: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan and heat until jello is dissolved.
Set off and cool.
Beat in Cool Whip and pour in dish.

title: Oven-Fried "Chicken" Chimichangas

ingredients.name: chicken like
ingredients.raw: frozen chicken-like slices (amount depends on how much you wish to make)

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained

steps: Grind or chop "chicken"; add cheese and green chilies, set aside.
Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave at High 15 seconds or until hot.
Brush both sides of tortillas, one at a time, with vegetable oil (keep remaining tortillas warm).
Place a scant 1/2 cup of "chicken" mixture just below center of each tortilla.
Fold in left and right sides of tortilla to partially enclose filling.
Fold up bottom edge of tortilla; fold into a rectangle and secure with a wooden pick.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and "chicken" mixture.
Place on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned.
Serve with shredded lettuce, salsa and sour cream. Yields 4 servings.

title: Kool-Aid Modeling Dough
steps: Mix flour, salt, cream of tartar, Kool-Aid and water in medium saucepan.
Stir in oil.
Adult should stir the mixture over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes until mixture forms a ball in the center of the pan.
Remove to a floured surface and knead for 1 minute. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

title: Snow Flakes
steps: Melt chips in microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until melted. Pour into dry ingredients; mix together.
Pour onto wax paper and let cool.
Chocolate chips may be used also.

title: Wintertime Corn Pudding
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle paprika on top.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack Mix
steps: Mix and blend first 4 ingredients and blend well.
Pour over the two packages of oyster crackers.
Mix well and place in air-tight container for storage.

title: Three Fruit Jam
steps: Combine fruit and lemon juice in 4-quart saucepan.
Cook, stirring until it is almost tender.
Stir in sugar, powdered pectin, butter and food coloring.
Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Boil for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from heat and skim off foam.
Ladle into sterilized jars, leaving 1/2-inch space at top.
Seal with paraffin.
Makes 8 (6 ounce) glasses.

title: Bacon Cheddar Grilled Sourdough Bread

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (1 1/2 c.)

ingredients.name: bacon crisply and
ingredients.raw: 4 slices bacon, crisply cooked, drained and crumbled (bacon bits may be substituted)

steps: Heat grill.
Cut loaf into 1-inch slices.
Lightly spread one side of each slice of bread with margarine.
Place, margarine side down, on ungreased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle cheese, bacon and parsley evenly on bread slices.
When ready to barbecue, place slices, margarine side down, directly on gas grill over medium-high heat or on charcoal grill 4 to 6-inches from coals.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until bottom of bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Cucumber Spread
steps: Press shredded cucumber between paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Stir in cucumber and other ingredients.
Spread between party rye or wheat bread, or as a spread for open-faced sandwiches.

title: Peach Alexander

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 medium fresh peach (canned or frozen may be used)

steps: Mix in blender and serve.
This will make 4 to 6 servings.

title: Veggie Surprise
steps: Put eggs, milk, corn bread mix and onion soup (one package) into blender container.
Mix until blended.

title: Smashed Potatoes
steps: first smash the potatoes.
Mix the potatoes and the flower and the water.
cook it for 40 menets.
Put the potatoes on a plat and then put butter on it.

title: Almond Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate; set aside.
Cream margarine and sugar.
Beat in eggs and blend in chocolate, vanilla and flour.
Add 1/2 almonds and spread in 8-inch pan.
Sprinkle remaining almonds and bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Baked Plum Tomatoes With Linguini
steps: In a 13 x 9-inch glass Pyrex dish, pour a layer of olive oil. Cut up about 10 plum ripe tomatoes in halves.
Sprinkle on top lots of fresh garlic, salt and pepper, basil or spice and oregano (optional).
Bake in 350° oven until the tomatoes get a little soft or to the consistency you like (approximately 35 minutes). It doesn't look like tomato sauce.
Cook up linguini and add to the Pyrex dish that the tomatoes are in.
Toss and serve.

title: Chicken In Sour Cream

ingredients.name: enough milk rinse out soup
ingredients.raw: enough milk to rinse out soup can

steps: Put chicken in a baking dish.
Mix other three ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Earthquake Dessert
steps: Cover a 9 x 13 x 3-inch cake pan with coconut.
Next, sprinkle on nuts.
Prepare cake mix according to box directions; spread over nuts and coconut, but don't mix together.
Blend until smooth the cream cheese, oleo and powdered sugar.
Carefully spread over cake batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Will rise and fall and have craters like an earthquake!

title: Mickey Mouse Rice Pilaf

ingredients.name: margarine
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. margarine or butter (chicken fat can also be used)

steps: Melt margarine in a large skillet and saute garlic, onion, celery and mushrooms until tender, not browned.
Add rice and stir until each grain is coated.
Add chicken broth, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Transfer to buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid absorbed.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Southwestern Salad

ingredients.name: ranch style bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can Ranch Style beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Wash and drain lettuce.
Break into small pieces in a large salad bowl.
Add tomatoes which have been cut into small pieces. Add Ranch Style beans.
Just before serving, add corn chips and Catalina dressing.
Toss well and serve.
For small servings, this recipe can be halved.

title: San Antonio Skillet Supper

ingredients.name: and chunky salsa
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. thick and chunky salsa or picante sauce

ingredients.name: dark red kidney bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: avocado sour cream and cilantro
ingredients.raw: avocado slices, sour cream and chopped cilantro (optional toppings)

steps: Cook sausage in half lengthwise.
Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.
In a 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage and remaining ingredients except optional toppings.
Mix well, breaking up tomatoes with large spoon.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Remove from heat; let stand covered 5 minutes.
Top as desired and serve with additional salsa or picante sauce.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Amanda'S Punch
steps: Chill all juices first.
In punch bowl with ice ring, add already mixed cranberry, pineapple and sugar.
To this add ginger ale and serve.

title: Homemade Ice Cream(1 Hour And 30 Minutes)
steps: In 3-quart saucepan, combine milk and whipping cream.
Cook over low heat until warm (6 to 8 minutes).
In large mixer bowl, combine all remaining ingredients.
Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until smooth (2 to 3 minutes).
Gradually stir into milk mixture.
Cool to room temperature.
Pour into ice cream canister.
Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions.
Yield:
3 quarts.

title: Boursin Cheese Spread
steps: Mix all ingredients together until fluffy.
Refrigerate at least 24 hours for flavors to blend.
Soften at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Dreamy Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple and save juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained and save juice

steps: Heat milk and marshmallows in a double boiler until marshmallows are melted.
Add lemon jello; stir until dissolved. Mix crushed pineapple with cream cheese with mixer.
Add to jello mix.
Add nuts.
Cool.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Form in flat shallow dish and let set in refrigerator.
Make red jello using drained pineapple juice for part of liquid.
When beginning to set, pour over cold bottom layer.

title: Super Easy, Super Quick Supper

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 box frozen chopped chicken or 1 lb. chicken, chopped and cooked

steps: Heat 1 tablespoon cooking oil (any variety) in large frying pan.
Add onion and cook until clear.
Add chicken and cook until thawed.
Add broccoli and mushrooms and cook about 5 minutes until heated through.
Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts.
Mix stir-fry seasoning according to package directions and pour over stir-fry.
Add soy sauce to taste.
Be careful not to cook too long, bean sprouts will become soggy.
Serve immediately over hot cooked rice.

title: Orange Gelatin Salad

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1 small can frozen orange juice concentrate

ingredients.name: size can pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 medium size can crushed pineapple, drained

steps: Mix together gelatin and hot water.
Add orange juice concentrate; cool.
Add orange slices and crushed pineapple.
Let congeal.

title: Fiesta Chicken Bake

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cooked chicken or turkey, cubed

steps: Place chips on the bottom of a glass casserole dish.
Scatter the chicken pieces on top of chips.
Mix soups and chiles together and pour over all.
Top with tomatoes; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Garnish with sour cream and guacamole before serving.

title: Mini-Reuben Hors D'Oeuvres
steps: Layer bread slices on cookie sheet.
Put a teaspoon of dressing, then a piece of corned beef, sauerkraut and top with a small piece of Swiss cheese.
Put under broiler for 3 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (32 oz) pkg frozen shredded hash brown potatoes, (thawed)

steps: Combine all ingredients, stirring well; spoon into a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish.
Bake at 350 for 40 minutes.
Yield:
12 to 15 servings.

title: Harvest Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix lightly with a fork.
Shape into a loaf and bake in a greased 8-inch square pan for one hour.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add lemon juice and beaten egg yolks; mix.
Stir in flour and milk.
Fold in egg whites that have been beaten stiff.
Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 450° for first 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 325° and bake until set as custard, about 45 minutes.

title: Pecan Dreams
steps: Cream sugar and oleo.
Add vanilla.
Mix in flour and pecans, then roll in small balls and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes, then roll in powdered sugar twice.

title: Biscuit And Beef Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown beef and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly.
Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles.
Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Spoon Hot Rolls
steps: Mix warm water and yeast. Melt margarine.
Add margarine, sugar, egg and flour to yeast.
Mix well.

title: Sauteed Calf'S Liver With Onions

ingredients.name: calf liver crosswise
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. calf liver, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch strips

steps: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy skillet.
Add onions and cook, stirring frequently, for 7 to 8 minutes.
Stir in sage and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer or until onions are limp and slightly colored. Set skillet off heat.

title: Zesty Squash

ingredients.name: squash or
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 squash (yellow or zucchini or mixed), sliced or cubed

steps: Mix cut squash, Ro-Tel tomatoes (do not drain) and 1 1/2 to 2 cups water in a large pot. Stew on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until squash is tender.
Preheat oven to 350°.

In a baking dish, spoon in layer of squash mixture, dob with butter, sprinkle with handful of bread crumbs and layer of cheese. Continue layering until all mixture is used. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Dessert
steps: Combine crackers, sugar and oleo.
Spread 3/4 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix Eagle Brand milk and orange juice.
Fold in Cool Whip and oranges.
Fold in Cool Whip and oranges.
Spread in crust. Top with remaining cracker mixture.
Refrigerate.

title: The Original Berlin Fair Clam Chowder

ingredients.name: clam steamed and ground
ingredients.raw: 6 clams, steamed and ground (save the juice from the steaming process)

ingredients.name: or size potato and ground
ingredients.raw: 4 or 5 medium size potatoes, peeled and ground

steps: Use a coarse grinder for all ingredients.
Cook salt pork and onions just a little.
Add about 2 or 3 cups or more water, then the potatoes.
Cook until nearly done.
Add clams and the juice, salt, pepper and a little sugar (about 1 teaspoon).
Simmer about 1 hour uncovered.
This recipe can to me from my sister-in-law, Marion France.

title: Chicken Chip Bake
steps: Use 1/2 bag of chips mixed in with all the ingredients.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put rest of chips over all.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. (Put in cake pan or casserole.)
You can use canned chicken or cook a whole one and use it.

title: Corn Dogs
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together to form batter.
Roll or dip frankfurters in mixture and fry in deep fat.

title: Meat Ball Stew

ingredients.name: ground meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground meat (beef, elk, deer, etc.)

steps: Chop onion fine.
Combine ground meat, chopped onion and rice in a large bowl.
Form into medium size meat balls and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Casserole
steps: Parboil kielbasa for a few minutes before slicing to remove some of the fat.
Melt grape jelly in pan then add can of chili and slices of kielbasa.
Simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Simple Salmon Cakes
steps: Drain salmon and flake into bowl; stir in onion, egg and bread crumbs.
Mix.
Form into 1/2 inch thick patties; fry in a little oil until crisp and golden on both sides.
Turn only once while frying.
Serve with lemon.

title: Walnut Pie
steps: In a medium bowl, beat together eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter, vanilla and salt.
Arrange walnuts on bottom of pie shell. Carefully pour egg mixture over walnuts.
Bake on bottom rack of preheated 400° oven until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, about 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool on wire rack. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cardinal Punch
steps: Pour all juices into a large goblet half filled with ice cubes.
Top with ginger ale.
Decorate with slices or oranges and lemons.

title: Jerky
steps: Cut meat into strips 1/8-inch thick.
Soak meat in mixture of ingredients for 6 hours. Dry in oven or on stovetop until crisp.

title: French Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, undrained

steps: Combine soup and margarine; stir well.
Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts, reserving liquid.
Add enough water to reserved liquid to equal 1 1/3 cups.
Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Crab Topping For Crackers
steps: Mix all together.
Let set for awhile to blend.
Spread on crackers.

title: Easy Strawberry Jam
steps: Combine berries and 2 cups sugar in pan.
Boil 5 minutes. Add remaining sugar and lemon juice.
Boil 12 to 15 minutes longer.
Remove from heat and stir until foam disappears.
Let set overnight.
Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Shrimp Toast
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread on bread.
Cut diagonally.
Put about 1 inch oil in frying pan and heat.
Place bread with filled side down and fry 15 seconds.
Turn and fry other side until golden brown.
Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Southern Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar well.
Break the eggs, one at a time, in a small bowl.
Combine all ingredients and beat for about 5 minutes. Grease a large pound cake pan and bake for 2 hours at 275°.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
steps: Cream together egg, sugar, shortening and molasses.
Add rest of ingredients.
Roll in small balls, then roll in sugar.
Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes.

title: Honey Coconut Divinity
steps: Boil together sugar, honey and water until syrup spins a thread.
Slowly pour syrup over stiffly beaten egg whites, beating continuously.
Beat until mixture holds in shape.
Blend in extract and coconut.
Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper or spread in a buttered 9-inch square pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Toasted Cheese Rounds

ingredients.name: loaf pepperidge farm party rye bread
ingredients.raw: 1 loaf Pepperidge Farm party rye bread

steps: Mix all ingredients together well, except bread.
Spread over entire slice of bread.
Broil on cookie sheet until bubbly.
Serve warm.

title: Buttery Toasted Rye Loaf

ingredients.name: or oblong loaf rye bread
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) round or oblong loaf rye bread (unsliced)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients, except bread; mix well.
Slice loaf into 1/2-inch slices, cutting but not through bottom of loaf.
Spread one side of each slice with margarine mixture.
Wrap in foil; bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nutty Pie
steps: Beat the egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
Add the sugar gradually.
Mix baking powder with graham cracker crumbs and fold into meringue mixture.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Bake for 25 minutes in a 350° oven in a greased Pyrex pie pan.
Don't overbake.
Cool. Pour small carton of Cool Whip over pie; refrigerate overnight.

title: Yogurt Pies
steps: Fold ingredients together and put in graham cracker crust.
If your family doesn't like yogurt, they will like these.
(These are great for diabetics or heart patients.)

title: Diet Cookies

ingredients.name: instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. instant pudding mix (any flavor; I use sugar-free pudding and the small box)

steps: Mix well.
Shape into small balls.
Place on greased cookie sheets 2-inches apart.
Flatten with fork and sprinkle lightly with sugar.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Only 7 calories each! Makes 15 cookies.

title: Colo Spaghetti Salad
steps: Night Before:
Cook spaghetti and rinse under cold water. Refrigerate.
Peel, deseed and chop cucumber.
Chop green pepper and green onions.
Deseed and chop tomatoes.
Add spaghetti.
Add salad dressing (all of it).
Add salad dressing now or just before.

title: Gerry'S Chicken With Lime Butter

ingredients.name: chicken breast half boned and skinned
ingredients.raw: 6 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned

steps: Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper.
In a large frypan, place oil and heat to medium temperature.
Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Turn chicken, cover and reduce heat to low.
Cook 10 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease.
Remove chicken and keep warm; drain off oil and discard.

title: Quick-N-Easy Cherry Cobbler
steps: Combine fruit and 3/4 cup sugar.
Let stand for 20 minutes. Melt margarine to pour over cobbler at the end.
Sift together flour and sugar.
Add milk.
Stir briskly (lumps will remain). Pour butter over top.
Top with fruit.
Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Fillet Of Flounder
steps: Combine egg, milk, salt and pepper.
Soak the fish in this mixture for 15 minutes.
Dip each fillet in the bread crumbs. Melt butter in skillet.
Add fillets and saute on both sides until brown.

title: Fettucini

ingredients.name: bacon and up
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. bacon, cooked and cut up

steps: Let butter or margarine, eggs and cream stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.
Cook bacon in skillet until browned.
Remove and drain on paper toweling.
Beat together eggs and cream just until blended.
Cook pasta until al dente (tender), about 15 minutes.
Drain thoroughly; do not rinse.
Toss pasta with butter.
Pour egg mixture over and toss until pasta is well coated.
Add bacon, cheese, pepper and parsley; toss to mix. Serves 6.

title: Salt Dough
steps: Mix with your hands, adding more flour if dough is sticky and more water if crumbly.
Wet the surface to add bits of decorative dough to cut-outs.
After shaping, bake at 200° until thoroughly dry (about 1 hour).
You may glaze with egg yolk/water for brown color.
Varnish cooled ornament.

title: Jessica'S Famous Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients all together.
Form into a loaf.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball Or Log
steps: Have cream cheese at room temperature.
Combine with all ingredients except nuts.
Form into ball or log.
Place in refrigerator and chill.
Take out and roll ball or log in nuts. Wrap in waxed paper or foil and place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Pastel Cookies
steps: Mix together the shortening, margarine and sugar.
Add gelatin, eggs and vanilla.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Roll into small balls; place on cookie sheet.
Flatten with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Make sure glass has a bottom design on it that goes on cookie when pressed.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Cobbler Pie
steps: Line an 8-inch square pan with cherry pie filling.
Mix margarine, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, flour, salt and milk. Pour 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water over the batter.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 400°.

title: Baked Pineapple Dessert
steps: Beat eggs.
Add flour and sugar.
Mix well.
Add pineapple. Pour into greased casserole and cover with white bread (cubed). Pour melted butter or margarine over all.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Delicious!

title: Fluff (Weight Watchers)

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

ingredients.name: mandarin orange and up
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges, drained and cut up

ingredients.name: fat vanilla yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) fat-free vanilla yogurt or banana crme

ingredients.name: fat sugar white chocolate pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small box fat-free, sugar-free white chocolate pudding

ingredients.name: fat sugar banana cream pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small box fat-free, sugar-free banana cream pudding

steps: Mix together yogurt, Cool Whip and puddings.
Fold in pineapple and oranges.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crunch Top Potatoes
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2-inch crosswise slices.
Cook in boiling water until almost tender.
Melt butter in shallow 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add single layer of potatoes, turning once in butter.
Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake 1/2 hour or until done and tops are crisp.
Serve hot.

title: Spicy Creamy Grits

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. (3 oz.) sharp cheddar cheese, shredded

steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil in a large sauce pan. Gradually stir in grits.
Return to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally for 5 to 7 minutes until thickened. Add cheeses and hot sauce or red pepper, stirring until cheeses melt.
Serve immediately.

title: Texas Pie

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix

steps: Spread each ingredient in a large pan in the order that it's written.
Bake about one hour at 350°.

title: Movie-Time Nachos

ingredients.name: white corn restaurant style tortilla chip
ingredients.raw: 1 bag white corn restaurant-style tortilla chips

steps: Empty chips into large serving bowl; set aside.
Over low heat in small saucepan, mix remaining ingredients.
Add a little more milk or salsa to achieve desired consistency.
Stir constantly until thoroughly heated.
Allow to cool a few minutes before serving.
Dip and enjoy!
Serves 2 to 4.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
steps: Steam broccoli and drain.
Put half of it into a casserole dish.
Beat 1 egg until light, add undiluted mushroom soup and mayonnaise; mix well.
Pour 1/2 of this mixture over broccoli in the casserole and also half of the grated cheese.
Repeat with layers of broccoli mixture and cheese.
Melt 1/4 cup butter.
Mix with crumbled crackers and sprinkle over entire casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Recipe can be doubled.

title: Chocolate Pudding
steps: Mix dry ingredients together.
Slowly add milk, while stirring.
Cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil.
Boil 1 minute and add oleo and vanilla.

title: Cream Of Broccoli

ingredients.name: envelope lipton chicken noodle soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton chicken noodle soup mix

steps: In medium saucepan, bring 3 cups milk and broccoli to the boiling point, then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir in Lipton chicken noodle soup mix and flour blended with remaining milk.
Bring to the boiling point, then simmer 10 minutes or until soup is lightly thickened and broccoli is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Pinwheels
steps: Blend together cream cheese, green onions, black olives, pimentos and jalapenos.
Spread on 10 flour tortillas.
Roll jelly roll.
Sash wrap and chill.
Slice.
Serve with salsa.

title: Italian Cheese Sticks
steps: Bring butter and cheese to room temperature.
Beat together the butter and cheese until well blended.
Combine flour, oregano, salt and cayenne; add to cheese mixture, gradually.
Add water; mix until well blended.
Form dough into a ball.
Roll out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut into 3 x 3/4-inch strips or cut into shapes with small cookie cutters.
Bake on ungreased baking sheet in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Serve warm or cold.
Makes about 40.

title: Vichysquash

ingredients.name: light cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. light cream or half and half

steps: Saute onion in butter until clear.
Add broth and cut up squash; cook until tender.
Puree squash when cool; season and add cream when cold.
Sprinkle top with chives.
Can be served hot or cold.

title: Horseradish Sauce Variation-2
steps: Blend the ingredients and run through food processor.
Once combined-refrigerate.

title: Low Cholesterol Pie Dough
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Roll between wax paper.
Makes enough for a double crust pie or two pie shells.

title: Sour Green Beans
steps: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Saute onion in bacon fat until transparent.
Drain beans, reserving liquid. Combine vinegar, sugar and bean liquid and pour over beans and onion in baking dish.
Microwave or heat in medium oven, covered.
Sprinkle bacon over beans prior to serving.

title: Diabetic Pie

ingredients.name: family size pkg. sugar instant vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 family-size pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding

steps: Mix; add ingredients and pour into crust.
Top with Cool Whip (optional).

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: herb flavored stuffing mix divided use
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb-flavored stuffing mix, divided use

steps: Combine 1 cup stuffing mix with the tomatoes, ground chuck, and egg, mixing well with your hands.
Prepare remaining stuffing mix as directed on package, following directions as if you were using all the bread.
Divide the meat mixture in half.
Drop chunks of half of the meat into 8 x 8-inch pan.
Top with the prepared stuffing and press down gently.
Layer the rest of the meat mixture on top.
Again in chunks.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending upon the amount of meat used.
Makes 9 servings.

title: Candied Walnuts
steps: Combine brown sugar, sugar and sour cream in a small saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until it boils.
Cook
to the soft-ball stage (240° on candy thermometer).
Stir in salt and vanilla.
Pour hot candy over walnuts in a mixing bowl.
Mix until walnuts are evenly coated.
Spoon out onto waxed paper.
Separate nuts.
Allow to cool and set.

title: Roseanne'S Shipboard Stroganoff
steps: Heat the gravy.
Add the canned roast beef.
Just before serving, add the yogurt and mix.
Serve immediately over cooked egg noodles.

title: Watermelon Rind Preserves
steps: Clean rind by removing red meat and green outer part of rind. Cut rind and lemon into small pieces.
Mix fruit and sugar; let set overnight.
Cook mixture for about 1 hour, until thickened. Remove mixture from heat.
Add 1/2 cup pectin and enough food coloring to give an attractive color.
Seal preserves in jars.

title: Teriyaki Beef Jerky
steps: Mix sauce well and pour over thin sliced beef.
Let marinate at least 4 hours.
Place strips on wire rack over cookie sheet. Bake at 150° for 11 to 12 hours.
Blot excess grease.
Store in container with a lid at room temperature.

title: Potato Cheese Fritters
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients well.
Shape into balls.
Dip in well beaten egg; roll in crumbs.
Fry in deep fat until crispy.

title: Stir-Fry Fajitas

ingredients.name: stir fry beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless, stir-fry beef or chicken

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 large green pepper or 2 Ortega peppers

steps: In a large skillet, fry meat in salad oil until tender.
Add garlic, onion and rest of ingredients.
Cook until desired tenderness.
Serve mixture on warm tortillas topped with salsa and sour cream to your taste.

title: New Waldorf Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple cored and up
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. fresh pineapple, peeled, cored and cut up or 2 (15 1/4 oz.) cans pineapple chunks, drained

ingredients.name: kiwi fruit lengthwise and
ingredients.raw: 2 kiwi fruits, peeled, halved lengthwise and sliced

ingredients.name: reduced calorie mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. reduced calorie mayonnaise or salad dressing

steps: In a large bowl, gently toss together pineapple, apple, celery, grapes, walnuts and kiwi.
In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, yogurt and honey.
Fold gently into fruit mixture. Cover and chill for 2 hours.
Makes 6 to 8 servings, each containing 210 calories and 2 grams saturated fat.

title: Mud Pie
steps: Mix crushed wafers and butter.
Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with softened ice cream.
Top with hot fudge.
Freeze for 10 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip and almonds.
Freeze any leftovers.

title: Good Lite Cake
steps: Put pears in mixer.
Add 1/4 cup Crisco oil and cake mix. Beat, then add eggs, one at a time.
Beat well.
Bake in tube pan at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: All-In-One Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash potatoes, but do not peel them. Cut them into quarters.
Wash the carrots and cut them into 2-inch chunks.
Peel onions and cut into wedges.

title: Hot Crab Meat Spread
steps: Blend well.
Put in Pyrex casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers or French bread.

title: Oven French Fries
steps: Wash, peel and cut potatoes lengthwise into "French fries." Toss with oil in a large bowl.
Spread in a single layer on baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once. Salt before serving, if desired.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
steps: Combine chicken, celery, pineapple, salt, lemon juice and mayonnaise.
Stir in salted almonds.
Chill in refrigerator. Serve on lettuce or endive.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Tea
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Serve hot or cold.
Contains 160 calories per serving.

title: Granny Eudell'S Chewy Brownies
steps: Mix and pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cut while still warm.

title: Dave'S Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes in skins and cool.
Peel potatoes and chop in large 1/2-inch chunks.
Add 1/2 mayo and mix carefully or with clean hands, if desired.
Add veggies and salt and pepper to taste.
Add remaining mayo and mix carefully.
Chill and serve.

title: Strawberry Ice
steps: Place strawberries in blender.

Cover and blend until smooth. Microwave marshmallows and milk in large mixing bowl on High for 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth when stirred, stirring after 1 minute. Gradually add strawberries to marshmallow mixture, beating until well blended.
Blend in juice and peels.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttercream Frosting
steps: In small saucepan, stir flour and milk smooth.
Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; let cool.
In bowl, cream butter, Crisco, sugar and vanilla.
Add milk/flour mixture to butter mixture and beat with electric mixer until smooth.

title: Salted Nut Roll
steps: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle 1/2 of the jar of peanuts
on
bottom.
Melt	margarine and peanut butter chips. Add Eagle
Brand milk and stir, then add marshmallows and stir until coated.
Pour marshmallow mixture over peanuts and press down. Sprinkle
rest of nuts on top and press down.
Cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Scallop

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 3 small sweet potatoes, cooked and sliced thin

ingredients.name: tart apple and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. tart apples, peeled and sliced thin

steps: Place in a buttered baking dish by layers, half of the sweet potatoes, cover with half of the apples, sprinkle with half the sugar, dot with half of the butter and sprinkle with half of the salt.
Repeat the layers.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until apples are tender.

title: Skillet Casserole
steps: Put oil in skillet.
Add hamburger, onions and green pepper. Brown.
Pour off excess grease. Add tomatoes.
Simmer 1 hour. Add macaroni and cook another 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Grami Hurd'S Larded Grouse
steps: Grouse are rather dry birds and need to be larded to be palatable.
Clean and wash quickly under running water.
Cover bird entirely with thin slices of bacon, tying them in place with a crossing of soft string or toothpicks.
Place the birds in a roasting pan and baste them with enough boiling water to use again and again.
Roast in an oven (350°) for 45 minutes, basting frequently.

title: Danish Cucumbers
steps: Peel and slice cucumbers thin.
Sprinkle with the salt.
Let stand at least an hour or overnight.
A plate should be placed on top of cucumbers and weighted down.
Drain and rinse well.
While they are draining, mix the vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Pour over the cucumbers and let them stand at least 2 hours.
Serves 6.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
steps: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, salt and pepper well.
Form into good size balls and wrap in cabbage leaves.
Fasten with toothpicks.
Place in large pot; cover with canned tomato soup. Simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.
Shredded cabbage may be placed between layers of rolls to give more flavor to the sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake(Needs No Frosting)
steps: Mix all.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream on top.

title: Easy Chicken Divan

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or peas

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 1/2 oz.) cans condensed cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: or sharp cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. medium or sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded (1/2 c.)

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 c. sliced cooked chicken or 3 chicken breasts, cooked and boned

steps: Cook broccoli or peas according to package directions in salted water until tender.
Drain.
Arrange peas or broccoli in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
Layer chicken on top. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over all.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until heated.
Trim with pimento strips, if desired.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sausage Brunch(Serves 8)

ingredients.name: bulk sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. bulk sausage, cooked and drained

steps: Put croutons in bottom of 8 x 12-inch Pyrex pan, then put 2 cups cheese on top, then loose sausage.
Beat eggs, mustard and milk.
Pour over top and let sit overnight in refrigerator.
In the morning, pour over top 1 can cream of mushroom soup, mixed with 1/2 cup milk.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of cheese over this.
Bake 1 1/4 hours at 300°.

title: Bear Claws

ingredients.name: captain crunch peanut butter cereal
ingredients.raw: 3 c. Captain Crunch peanut butter cereal

steps: Melt candy wafers and Crisco together.
Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl.
Pour melted candy over cereal and cool well.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
When firm, store in airtight container.

title: Homemade Summer Sausage

ingredients.name: morton tender quick meat cure
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. Morton Tender Quick meat cure

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Roll into 2 rolls, then wrap meat in foil.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Punch holes in the bottom of the rolls with a fork.
Place the rolls on a rack in a baking pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Yum Yum!!!!

title: Cherry-Pineapple Strudel
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease a 13 x 9-inch cake pan with butter.
Spread can of pineapple (do not drain) in greased cake pan.
Spread cherry pie filling over pineapple.
Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pineapple and cherries.
Sprinkle pecans over cake mix.
Cut butter in small pieces and put on top of cake mix and nuts.
Bake for 1 hour.
Be careful not to burn pecans.
Serve hot or cool.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine the first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until blended.
Add egg and beat until blended.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Add to creamed mixture at low speed.
Drop by heaping teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until brown.
Cool 2 minutes before removing from sheet.

title: Cheaters Jam Cake
steps: Mix cake by directions on the box and add flour.
Fold in jam, raisins and nuts.
Do not beat or mix with mixer.
Flour and grease three 9-inch cake pans.
Spoon batter equally into pans. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes, depending on your oven.

title: Chicken Lasagna

ingredients.name: broccoli precooked until almost done
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. broccoli, precooked until almost done

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, cooked and diced

steps: Heat soup and cream cheese together.
Layer all ingredients and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Homemade Noodles

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. cream or half and half

steps: Place chicken (without skin) in large kettle of water, along with celery and celery salt.
Cook for approximately 1 hour. Remove chicken and strip meat from bone.
Return meat to water and add noodles.
Cook for half an hour.

title: Beefy Rice
steps: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter.
Mix rice, soup, salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender.
Serves 4.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Cook onion in margarine until tender.
Add remaining ingredients; heat until boiling.
Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Best Ever Baked Beans
steps: Brown hamburger and onions until done and drain.
Mix all ingredients and put into a casserole dish.
Place in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Suncoast Ham
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients; bring to boil.
Brush sauce liberally on ham.
Grill about 20 minutes on each side.

title: Nutty Bars

ingredients.name: nuts.
ingredients.raw: 1 cup chopped nuts. (I use slivered almonds)

steps: Melt margarine and mix with crackers.
Press into 9x13 baking pan.
Layer coconut, chocolate and butterscotch chips, and nuts in order.
Spread milk evenly over mixture.

title: Roast Lamb

ingredients.name: each marjoram thyme and rosemary
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: marjoram, thyme and rosemary

steps: Crush garlic with salt and pepper.
Mix with oil; spread on lamb.
Sprinkle with marjoram, thyme, rosemary and flour.
Pour wine and 1 cup water into pan.
Roast in a 325° oven for 2 1/2 hours, basting frequently.
Serves 6.

title: Cheese Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in a pan.
Mix in flour and salt. Add milk slowly, stirring until smooth. Cook and stir until sauce thickens. Add mustard and cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Makes 2 2/3 cups sauce.

title: Tacos

ingredients.name: shaped taco shell
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. shaped taco shells or 1 pkg. soft tortillas

steps: Brown chopped meat, stirring often.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Drain off fat.
Put ground meat in a bowl.
Everyone puts their favorite things on their own tacos.
Eat and enjoy.

title: Summertime Salad
steps: Break cauliflower and broccoli in small pieces; dice onion. Crumble bacon.
Mix together rest of ingredients, then add all together and stir well.
Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting
steps: Combine sugar, cocoa, oleo and milk.
Stir until sugar dissolves over medium heat.
When mixture comes to a rapid boil, boil one minute.
Remove form heat.
Add vanilla.
Cool and beat. Spread on thin cake layers.

title: A Love Cake For Mother

ingredients.name: holiday birthday and everyday surprise
ingredients.raw: some holiday, birthday and everyday surprises
