ingredients.name: powdered get up when i should
ingredients.raw: 1 box powdered get up when I should

steps: Mix well and bake in hearty warm oven and serve to mother everyday.
She ought to have it in big slices.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch glass dish, pour pie filling on bottom. Spread evenly.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling.
Melt butter and pour over cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Milk Punch
steps: Place strawberries and sugar in mixer bowl.
Beat with electric mixer until well blended.
Combine with milk and ice cream in punch bowl.
Serves about 25.

title: Honey Poppy Seed Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together in order given.
Blend in blender or mixer until oil disappears.
Yield: 2 cups.

title: Russian Borscht

ingredients.name: mckay s chicken seasoning
ingredients.raw: McKay's chicken seasoning or G. Washington broth or beef flavored seasoning

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: tomatoes (canned or stewed or tomato juice)

steps: Make vegetable soup with first five ingredients, including beets (if using raw ones).
Add canned beets (if using canned) when soup is almost done.
Add tomatoes and generous amount of dill weed (to your own taste of course).
Serve with dollop of sour cream or cottage cheese.

title: English Scones
steps: Rub the butter and flour until they resemble fine bread crumbs. Stir in the baking powder, sugar and sultanas.
Add the milk to make a sticky dough and turn onto a floured surface.
Knead gently, then roll flat (about 1-inch thick) and cut out circles.
Place on floured baking tray.
Brush with milk.
Bake at 220°C for 10 to 20 minutes.
Spread with butter and jam to taste.

title: Double Good Blueberry Pie
steps: Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.
Add water and 2 cups of blueberries.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and clear (mixture will be quite thick).
Remove from heat.
Stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool.
Place remaining 2 cups raw blueberries in pie shell.
Top with cooked berry mixture.
Chill.
Serve garnished with whipped cream.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast
steps: Cook sausage until brown or done; drain well.
Spread bread cubes in 12 x 8 x 2-inch buttered baking dish.
Top with sausage, then cheese.
Combine eggs, milk, salt and mustard; beat well. Pour over cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.

title: Old Fashioned Vinegar Candy
steps: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sugar and vinegar.
Stir until sugar dissolves; wash down sides of pan with pastry brush dipped in cold water.
Boil mixture to brittle stage (256°); pull and cut into small pieces with scissors or knife.
Arrange on buttered plate to cool.

title: Carolyn'S Ice Cream
steps: Add sugar to beaten eggs; beat until stiff.
Add remaining ingredients.
Use a Number 2 can crushed pineapple (drained). This was a recipe of Carolyn T. High.
Freeze in ice cream churn.

title: Spaghetti Bake Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger, butter, onion and green pepper.
Cook spaghetti as directed; drain.
Mix hamburger mixture, spaghetti, tomato soup and corn.
Put in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Cover liberally with cheese.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Toll House Kookie Brittle

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate morsels

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine butter, vanilla and salt in bowl and blend well.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Add flour, chocolate morsels and 3/4 cup walnuts.
Mix well.
Press evenly into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup walnuts
over top and press in lightly.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool.
Break into irregular pieces. Can cut into bars when warm, if desired.
Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Double Lime Chiffon Salad
steps: Drain pineapple reserving juice.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add reserved juice.
Cool until slightly thickened; beat until frothy.
Fold in pineapple, cottage cheese, mayonnaise and nuts.
Place in 13 x 9-inch pan or mold.
Refrigerate until firm. Yield:
12 servings.

title: Deep-Fried Turkey

ingredients.name: vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 gal. vegetable or peanut oil

steps: Fill the injector needle of a bulb baster with salad dressing and squirt under skin.
Tie legs together with one end of a 30-inch string.
Pour oil to depth of 5 to 6 inches into a deep pot of a propane cooker; heat to 325°.
Carefully lower turkey into hot oil using string; fry 30 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in turkey registers 185°.
(Temperature of oil drops immediately after turkey is placed in it; oil may not reach 325° again.)
Remove turkey from oil and cool slightly before slicing.

title: Vidalia Onion Classic Casserole
steps: Saut sweet onions in butter until transparent. Add chicken broth, sherry and flour. Cook and stir. When slightly thickened, transfer to medium casserole. Top with bread crumbs and both cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Cranberry Crunch
steps: Grease 10-inch quiche or pie plate.
Spread cranberries over bottom of dish.
Sprinkle with 1 cup sugar and pecans.
In small bowl at high speed, beat eggs until frothy.
Add 1 cup sugar; beat well at low speed.
Add flour, shortening and margarine.
Pour batter over berries and nuts.
Bake 1 hour or until golden at 325°.

title: Fruit Cocktail Bars

ingredients.name: lg. can fruit cocktail with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 lg. can fruit cocktail, with juice

steps: Mix together fruit cocktail, vanilla, eggs and sugar.
Add flour, soda, salt and brown sugar.
Mix and pour into greased and floured cookie sheet.
Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Macaroni Cheese Twist
steps: Cut up green
pepper
and
garlic;
fry
in
pan with 4 tablespoons oil until tender.
Stir in tomato sauce and water. Simmer 10 minutes.	Add
cheese (cut in 1/2-inch cubes).
Stir into mixture.
Serve over hot macaroni.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
steps: Put eggs in pan.
Drain pineapple and add to eggs. Beat together. Add sugar and flour to juice and cook until thick. Pour over pineapple, marshmallows and cheese in a bowl. Stir and chill.

title: Pull Apart Cheese Loaf
steps: Mix melted margarine/butter and garlic powder.
Dip biscuits in this and put in a greased loaf pan so they are standing vertically (4 rows of 5 biscuits).
Mix green onion and grated cheese.
Put about 1 teaspoon of mixture between each biscuit until it is gone. Pour any leftover melted butter/garlic mixture over the top.
Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until golden brown in a 375° oven.

title: Angel Food Cherry Dessert
steps: Crumble angel food cake into bite size pieces.
Prepare pudding according to directions, then mix whipped topping with pudding.
Put cake pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan and top with the pudding mixture.
Chill.
Top with cherry pie filling and chill again.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Boil sugar, milk and butter at a hard boil for one minute.
Put into a bowl and add cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla.
Last, add your oats and mix well.
Spoon onto foil or wax paper until firm.

title: Mystery Artichoke Appetizer

ingredients.name: water artichoke and
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 1/2 oz.) cans water packed artichokes, drained and finely chopped

steps: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly and pour into greased baking dish.
Note:
Onion and artichoke may be chopped separately in food processor, pulsing carefully.
Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Pickled Onions
steps: Drop onions in boiling water.
Boil 3 minutes.
Drain.
Place in cold water.
Cut root end; squeeze stem end to remove onion skin.
Combine 2 cups water and pickling salt; pour over onions. Let stand 12 hours.
Drain; rinse thoroughly.
Combine vinegar, sugar and pickling spices; bring to boiling.
Pack onions into hot jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Cover with pickling liquid, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Adjust lids and process in boiling water bath (half-pints) for 10 minutes.

title: Golden Puffs
steps: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon into hot oil.
Fry until golden brown on each side.
Drain and shake in brown bag containing cinnamon and sugar or powdered sugar.
Makes a great after school snack.

title: Chocolate Peanuts Candy
steps: Melt chocolate chips on stove at low heat until completely melted.
Add peanuts and Chinese noodles.
Mix well.
Drop by tablespoon into cupcake wrappers.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Let chill in refrigerator until you're ready to serve.

title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy; beat in condensed milk until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.

title: Onion Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: pouch campbell s dry onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pouch Campbell's dry onion soup mix

ingredients.name: tomato and up
ingredients.raw: 1 c. tomatoes, undrained and cut up

ingredients.name: cheese with jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cubed cheese with jalapeno peppers

steps: In 2-quart saucepan, combine soup mix, tomatoes and cheese over medium heat.
Heat to boiling, stirring often.
Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream.
Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables for dipping.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.
Preparation time:
5 minutes.

title: Cheese Wedges
steps: In a bowl, mix flour, corn meal and chili powder.
Add butter, milk and egg.
Stir until just moistened.
Press mixture into nine-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° until mixture is lightly browned and begins to pull away from sides of pan (about 25 minutes).
Mix cheese, chilies and green onions; spread over hot mixture.
Return to oven and bake until cheese melts (about 15 to 20 minutes).
Serve either hot or cold.
Makes 12 pieces.

title: Hobo Beans
steps: Brown ground beef and onions.
Drain.
Drain juice from butter beans and kidney beans.
Add the 4 beans and salt and pepper to taste.
Add a pinch or two of chili powder and bring to boil. Then turn to low and let simmer.

title: Baked Round Steak

ingredients.name: or can cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 2 or 4 cans cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: lipton onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 pkg. Lipton onion soup mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°; place round steak in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread cream of chicken soup over steak.
Shake Lipton onion soup mix over other soup.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Corn Bake
steps: Combine all ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish, sprayed with Pam.
Mix well.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until golden brown ontop.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
steps: In a bowl, mix together 1 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons flour and diced rhubarb.
Pour into an 8 or 9-inch baking dish and dot with butter.

title: Dilled Shrimp Dip

ingredients.name: shrimp and
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 1/2 oz.) can shrimp, rinsed, drained and chopped

steps: Blend milk gradually into cream cheese.
Stir in lemon juice, shrimp, Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt and dill.
Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
Serve with crackers.

title: Flank Steak
steps: Place steak flat in shallow baking dish.
Mix all ingredients and pour over steak.
Let stand all day, turning occasionally or refrigerate overnight.
Barbecue 5 minutes on each side or broil 2 minutes on each side.
Cut diagonally into thin strips.

title: Banana Quick Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat shortening until creamy and glossy.
Gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy after each addition.
Add eggs and beat until thick and pale lemon color.
Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with bananas.
Blend thoroughly after each addition.

title: Cereal Mix
steps: Provide each child with covered margarine tub.
Have available various measuring cups and spoons.
Instruct children to make a snack mixture by using various measuring tools.
Encourage them to compare amounts measured.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
steps: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil; let cool.
Whip Pet milk; add sugar, celery, apple and nuts.
Add Jell-O mixture and refrigerate.

title: Japanese Cookies
steps: Cream the sugar with the butter.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Shape into two rolls; chill until firm.
Cut 1/4-inch thick and bake 30 minutes at 300°.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Lorraine Priest'S Peanut Butter Bonbon
steps: Mix powdered sugar and cracker crumbs.
Heat margarine and peanut butter over low heat until melted.
Stir into crumb mixture. Press in ungreased baking pan 8 x 8 x 12-inch.
Heat chocolate chips in small saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until melted.
Spread over crumb mixture.
Refrigerate until firm, about 30 minutes.
Cut into one inch squares (3 dozen candies) or shape into one inch balls and dip in mixture of chocolate chips and one tablespoon of shortening.

title: Corny Squares
steps: Mix sugar and syrup in boiler; boil for 1 minute.
Add peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir without heat until smooth.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cornflakes and peanut butter mix in pan.
Cut squares when cool.

title: Fresh And Frosty Lemonade
steps: Combine lemon juice and sugar.
Add water, stirring.
Serve over ice in glasses and garnish with lemon slices.

title: Layered Macaroni Shrimp Salad

ingredients.name: elbow macaroni and
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: or can shrimp and
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 (4 1/2 oz.) cans shrimp, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: green pea thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen green peas (about 10 oz.), thawed

ingredients.name: red
ingredients.raw: 4 c. shredded red or green cabbage

steps: In large salad bowl, layer greens, macaroni, 1 1/2 cups cheese, tomatoes, shrimp, peas and cabbage.
Combine mayonnaise and Italian dressing.
Pour over salad.
Top with remaining cheese.
Cover and refrigerate several hours.

title: Thanksgiving Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: whipping cream
ingredients.raw: 2 c. whipping cream or 8 oz. Cool Whip

steps: Grind cranberries fine.
Add pineapple and sugar.
Stir well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight (covered).
Two hours before serving, whip cream.
Add nuts.
Place in a serving bowl and chill.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease 10-inch skillet.
Brown sausage and onion; drain well.
Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk and oil.
Pour half of mixture into skillet.
Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese.
Pour remaining batter over top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chew Bread
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Pour in light brown sugar.
Mix together.
Add eggs, flour and flavoring.
Add as many pecans as you like.
Pour in a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
When middle of bread falls, take out of oven.
If you don't take out of oven when it falls, it won't be as moist.

title: Southern Gizzards
steps: Heat oil in iron skillet on medium-high heat.
Dip gizzards in whipped eggs and roll in flour or pancake mix.
Put as many as you can get in the skillet.
Turn every 5 minutes for about 20 minutes or dark brown.

title: Cream Sticks
steps: Put yeast in warm water; scald milk, then add your oleo in hot milk to melt.
Put together when cool, then add yeast, well beaten eggs, vanilla and sugar.
Add flour.
Put in warm place until double in bulk.
Roll out and cut in pieces, about 1/2 x 3 1/2-inches long.
Let rise again.
Fry in deep vegetable oil. Cut top of stick open and fill with filling.
Ice with brown sugar frosting.

title: Chocolate Walnut Pie
steps: Melt together chocolate chips, evaporated milk and butter or margarine.
Remove from heat and add flour, salt, sugar, eggs (mixed well) and walnuts.

title: Winona'S Mocha Torte
steps: Blend dry cake mix, cinnamon and clove in large mixing bowl. Prepare cake according to package directions.
Divide batter into three 8-inch glass baking dishes.
One at a time, microwave 4 minutes and 30 seconds to 5 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes, then turn out immediately onto a cake rack.

title: Baked Chili Cheesy Dip
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients.
Spoon into a 1-quart casserole dish.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir before serving.
Serve hot with toasted bread slices or tortilla chips.
Makes 4 cups.

title: All-Season Salad
steps: Combine cranberry sauce and lemon juice in bowl; mix well. Spoon in lightly oiled mold.
Freeze until firm.

title: Martha Odom'S Cookies
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and Crisco.
Add egg and beat well.
Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.

title: Polenta With Cheese

ingredients.name: fontina
ingredients.raw: 7 oz. Fontina or Gruyere cheese, thinly sliced

steps: Bring water to boil, add salt and sprinkle in cornmeal, stirring constantly.
Cook over low heat for 40 minutes.
Polenta is cooked when it begins to leave the sides of the saucepan.
Add cheese and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes.

title: Pink Snowstorm

ingredients.name: red fruit juicy punch
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen red fruit juicy punch

steps: Combine punch, milk and ice cream in an electric blender. Blend until smooth and frothy.
Pour into tall glasses.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Javanese Pork Sate
steps: Cut tenderloin(s) in half.
Blend remaining ingredients together.
Marinate pork in mixture for 10 minutes.
Grill or broil for 10 to 12 minutes, turning when needed.
Serve with hot cooked rice, if desired.
Serves 4.

title: Oreo Spider Cookies
steps: Scrape filling out of Oreo cookies.
Cut red licorice into thin strips (to look like spider legs).
Put frosting on an Oreo piece; drape red licorice over frosting so that the licorice hangs out both sides.
(Use however many red strips you want for however many legs you want.)
Put an Oreo piece on top to form cookie. Put little dots of frosting on top for eyes.
Enjoy this fun treat!

title: Bar-B-Q Sauce
steps: Pour water, vinegar, syrup and mustard into a large pan. Beat with a portable mixer until smooth. Add butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until butter melts.
Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Makes enough sauce for 5
- 3 1/2 to 4 lb. whole fryers split down the breast and cooked over a charcoal fire.
Makes 1 gal. sauce.

title: Bacon And Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.name: white meat chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) can cooked white meat chicken, drained

ingredients.name: armour lower salt bacon crisp and
ingredients.raw: 3 slices Armour lower salt bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled

steps: Combine chicken, celery, onion, yogurt and pepper in small bowl.
If desired, place lettuce leaf on bottom of each bun; place pineapple ring on lettuce.
Top each with one third of the chicken mixture and bacon.
Makes 3 servings.

title: Cherry 'N Apple Dump Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine pie filling, apples and lemon juice.
Pour into an 8 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch glass baking dish or a size larger.
In medium bowl, cut margarine into cake mix until crumbly.
Add pecans and sprinkle evenly over pie filling.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with ice cream or plain anytime.

title: Sausage Hors D'Oeuvres
steps: Crumble ground beef and sausage, fry and drain well.
Add spices and Worcestershire sauce.
Melt cheese with meat over low heat.
Serve on party rye.
(Place on cookie sheets and freeze. Reheat 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.)
Serves 24.

title: Holiday Ham Balls

ingredients.name: bisquick original
ingredients.raw: 3 c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix

ingredients.name: fully smoked ham
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. finely chopped, fully cooked smoked ham

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place about 2 inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
Serve warm.
Yields about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Cheese Rounds
steps: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika; stir well.
Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse meal.
Add cheese; stir well.
Roll dough to 1/3-inch thick on floured surface.
Cut with a 1 3/4-inch biscuit cutter.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Savory Turkey Casserole

ingredients.name: scalloped potato mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. scalloped potato mix (with onion flavor)

ingredients.name: condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 10 3/4 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup

ingredients.name: turkey
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cubed, cooked turkey or chicken

steps: Heat oven to 375°. In large bowl, combine contents of seasoning packet, poultry seasoning and water; mix well.

Add soup; blend well. Add potato slices, turkey, carrots, celery and onion, stirring until thoroughly combined. Spoon mixture into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Oyster Cracker Munchies
steps: Mix and pour over crackers.
Let sit several hours.

title: Asparagus Spears With Garlic Mustard
steps: In 10-inch skillet, place asparagus spears; add enough water to cover.
Bring to a full boil.
Cook over medium heat until asparagus is crisply tender (5 to 7 minutes).
Drain; return to skillet.
Add remaining ingredients, pushing asparagus to side just until butter is melted.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through (5 to 7 minutes).
Makes 4 servings.

title: Corn Flake Candy
steps: Cook sugar and syrup until boils, then remove from heat.
Add peanut butter.
Stir peanut butter in sugar and syrup.
Pour mixture over corn flakes.
Press corn flakes and mixture into a sugar pan.
Let cool, cut in squares and eat.

title: Grilled Lemon Dill Fish

ingredients.name: firm textured fish filet
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. firm-textured fish filets (such as cod, catfish or salmon)

steps: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, dill and lemon peel.
Place fish on greased grill over medium coals.
Brush with 1/2 of the mayonnaise mixture.
Grill 5 minutes, turn.
Brush with remaining mayonnaise mixture.
Grill an additional 5 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Pam'S Stuffed Peppers(Serves 3)
steps: Cut stem ends from peppers; remove seeds and cut peppers in half.
Cook peppers in a small amount of water; cover.
Cook in microwave oven on High power for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from microwave and water.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture.
Place in baking dish.
Pour tomato sauce over mixture in peppers.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Miracle Cake
steps: Mix flour, soda, cocoa and sugar.
Add Miracle Whip, warm water and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Pour batter into greased and lightly floured 8-inch layer or 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.
Frost with icing when cool.
Also makes 18 cupcakes.
Buttercream frosting is very good on this cake or use your favorite icing, also.

title: Grilled Tomatoes With Oregano

ingredients.name: plu tsp. peanut
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. plus 10 tsp. peanut or vegetable oil

ingredients.name: oregano
ingredients.raw: 5 tsp. chopped fresh oregano or 2 1/2 tsp. dried oregano

steps: Preheat the broiler.
Core the tomatoes and slice them in half.
Grease a baking dish (large enough to hold the tomatoes) with 1 tablespoon of oil.
Arrange the tomato halves in it, cut side up.
Sprinkle each with about 1/2 teaspoon oregano and salt and pepper.
Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon oil over each half.
Broil for about 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple Mint Freeze
steps: Stir together first two ingredients, and let stand several hours or overnight.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Pour in container and freeze (8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch dish works well).
Serve frozen; if not all used, it refreezes well for next meal.

title: Pineapple Layer Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine moist deluxe pineapple supreme cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg Duncan Hines Moist Deluxe Pineapple Supreme cake mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 9 inch round cake pans.
Prepare, bake and cool cake mix according to directions on box.
Place one cake layer on serving plate.
Spread with 1/2 of pineapple preserves.
Spread about 4 oz. of Cool Whip on top. Place second cake layer on top.
Frost top and sides of cake with remaining Cool Whip.
Coat top of cake with remaining pineapple preserves.
Garnish sides with shredded coconut.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mango Fruit Parfait
steps: Put the mango and orange juice in a blender and puree until smooth.
Slice 20 of the strawberries, leaving 4 whole.
Line the bottom of 4 balloon wine glasses with the sliced strawberries. Pour a thin layer of the mango puree over each to cover.

title: Easy Taco Pie

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained

steps: Crumble corn chips in bottom of pan and add refried beans, ground beef, salsa, black olives and last Monterey Jack cheese. Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes.
After baked, top with sour cream.

title: Fruited Pistachio Pudding
steps: In large bowl, combine pudding mix, whipped topping and salad dressing.
Mix well.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Leave in bowl or put in individual dishes.
Chill.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Favorite Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: In
bowl mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar.
In another bowl, beat eggs about 1 minute on high speed until light and fluffy.
Pour eggs over flour mixture.
Pour in buttermilk.
Add
butter.
Fold
together
entire mixture until flour is just moistened.
Bake pancakes on greased, hot griddle using about 1/4 cup of mixture to make a 4 to 5-inch pancake.

title: Cherry Slush
steps: Bring first 2 ingredients to a boil; add jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Add almond extract and pineapple juice.
Add 1 1/2 juice cans of water.
Put this mixture into freezer and let freeze solid, 6 to 8 hours.
Set out of freezer before serving.
Put in large container or punch bowl, then add your choice of clear beverage.
Serve partially thawed or slushy.

title: Stuffed Baked Orange With Yams
steps: Cook yam until tender, peel and beat smooth.
Add margarine. Mix other dry ingredients together and set aside.
Squeeze the juice from oranges.
Cut oranges in half and set aside.
Add dry ingredients to yams.
Add milk and vanilla.
Mix well.
In each orange half stuff yam mix to top.
Bake at 350° until light brown on top of yams.

title: Fried Spaghetti
steps: Boil 5-quart pan of water.
Put in spaghetti and cook to desired consistency.
While spaghetti is cooking, put in large skillet the hamburger meat and chopped onion.
Brown and drain. Add Ragu spaghetti sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain spaghetti and add to skillet.
Fold over until sauce and spaghetti are mixed.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Spinach Dip

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch milk original ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk original ranch salad dressing mix

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained

steps: Combine ingredients.
Stir to blend.
Chill for at least 1 hour.
Serve in hollowed out round loaf of French bread; use hollowed out section to make bread cubes for dipping.

title: Broccoli Quiche

ingredients.name: broccoli prepared according pkg. direction then well
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, prepared according to pkg. directions, then drained well

ingredients.name: bacon ham
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cooked bacon, ham or turkey (optional)

steps: Beat eggs well, then add broccoli.
Add milk, then fold in mayonnaise.
Add minced onion.
Fold in the cheeses; mix all ingredients well.
(If any of the optional ingredients are used, this recipe will make at least 2 quiches.)
Pour ingredients into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes, or until set and beginning to brown on top.
Make sure that the pie shell does not burn.

title: German Chocolate Cake
steps: Make up cake mix using the water and egg whites called for on the box.
Melt chocolate and butter on low heat and add salt.
Add chocolate mixture to cake batter.
Gently fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake in two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Chilli And Beans
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Combine all ingredients, including ground beef in crock-pot.
Stir well.
Cook on high for 4 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve with cornbread or crackers.

title: Old-Time German Potato Salad
steps: Cook potatoes; cool, peel and slice.
Fry bacon until golden brown.
Take bacon out of pan; add butter to bacon grease.
Stir in flour until smooth.
Mix vinegar and water together in a bowl, then slowly add to flour mixture.
Add sugar, stirring all the time.
Pour over potatoes with chopped onions and crumbled bacon. Stir gently until all mixed together.
Serve.

title: Grandma Lucy'S Pecan Pie
steps: Combine. Put in unbaked shell. Top with whole pecans.
Bake at 375° or until done.

title: Authentic Wassail
steps: Mix together and let simmer.
The taste is delicious and the aroma is to die for!

title: Quick Bisque Tortoni(Kids' Recipe)

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream slightly
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. vanilla ice cream, slightly softened

steps: Place 6 fluted paper baking cups into cupcake pan.
Mix ice cream, whipped topping and 1/4 teaspoon almond extract.
Spoon into paper cups.

title: Angel Strawberry Delight
steps: Mix strawberries and gel together.
Cut cake into serving pieces and spread strawberry mixture on top.

title: Hearty Sausage And Rice
steps: Crumble sausage into 2-quart casserole.
Add onion and green pepper.
Cover.
Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 1/2 minutes or until sausage is set and vegetables are tender, stirring once.
Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Microwave at High 6 1/2 to 9 minutes or until heated through (140° to 150°), stirring once. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Speedy After School Pizza
steps: Place one tortilla on a microwave-safe plate.
Spread spaghetti sauce evenly over tortilla.
Add pepperoni.
Cover with cheese.
Put the pizza in the microwave.
Cook until cheese is melted, approximately 1 minute on medium heat.
Remove and cut into fourths. Serves one.

title: Speedy Yellowtail Sauce
steps: Just mix in blender or shaker and serve over your favorite fish.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Diet Cake
steps: Place all in bowl except flour and wheat germ.
Pour 1 c boiling water over all and stir well.
Add the flour and wheat germ and mix well.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cabbage And Sausage
steps: Fry sausage and set aside.
Steam cabbage with small amount of water for about 5 minutes.
Add sausage and small amount of sausage grease (1 tablespoon).
Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until cabbage is tender.

title: Squash Pickles
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and let stand for 1 1/2 hours.
Mix together vinegar, sugar, mustard seed and celery seed.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over squash mixture and bring to boil again.
Pack in sterilized jars.

title: Homemade Hot Fudge
steps: Bring to a boil and cook
for 8 minutes.
Cool and store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Cherry 'O Cream Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: chilled cherry comstock pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can chilled cherry Comstock pie filling

steps: In medium bowl, beat cheese until light and fluffy.
Gradually add condensed milk and stir until well blended.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Turn into crust.
Refrigerate 2 or 3 hours. Garnish with chilled pie filling before serving.

title: Curried Baked Fish
steps: Combine dressing, wine, dill weed and curry.
Spread on fish. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Working Person'S Roast
steps: Put roast in a large piece of heavy aluminum foil.
Cut slits in meat and insert slivers of garlic.
Cover roast with soup. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over meat.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over meat.
Add desired seasoning.
Cover tightly with foil, leaving room around meat.
Place in pan.
Cook at 250° from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (meat is tender and juicy and gravy is made). Delicious!

title: Bubble Bread
steps: Cut dough into squares 1-inch size.
Layer nuts, raisins, dough and dry mixture.
Then pour 1/4 cup melted butter on, then repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Banana Pudding

ingredients.name: sugar instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 small box sugar-free instant pudding mix

steps: Beat first 2 ingredients for 2 to 3 minutes on low and set in refrigerator.
Place graham crackers in a gallon size plastic Ziploc bag.
Crush with rolling pin.
Place about half of crumbs in bottom of container.
Cover with 1 sliced banana.
Then cover with pudding.
Slice 1 more small banana over pudding.
Sprinkle with about 1/2 to 3/4 cup of cracker crumbs.
Very good and low calorie. Makes 6 servings.

title: Crustless Fudge Pie
steps: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat.
Beat other ingredients into eggs and then add chocolate mixture.
Blend thoroughly.
Pour into a greased pie plate (9-inch) and bake 40 to 45 minutes in a preheated oven (350°).
Cool.
Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Truffle Brownies

ingredients.name: instant coffee dissolved in tbsp. water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. instant coffee dissolved in 2 Tbsp. water (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt chocolate chips with butter, cool slightly.
In a large mixing bowl at medium speed, beat brown sugar and eggs until blended.
Add chocolate mixture and dissolved coffee; beat well.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Spread evenly in baking pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean; cool on a wire rack.

title: White Fudge
steps: Cook the first 5 ingredients to a soft ball stage.
Let cool to lukewarm.
Add the remaining ingredients; beat until smooth.

title: Grandma'S Rolls
steps: Combine sugar, salt and oil.
Add hot water and beat. Sprinkle yeast over and set.
Mix in and add egg (use wire whip). Gradually add 3 cups flour (use wooden spoon).
Knead.
Pour 1 tablespoon oil in bowl and cover dough.
Set for 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Dressing
steps: Cook onion and green pepper until tender in soup.
Mix all ingredients except chops, salt and pepper.
Put in baking dish. Place pork chops on top.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover; bake 45 minutes in 400° oven.
Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Quick 'N Easy Casserole(My Favorite)

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Place vegetables in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 7 minutes to partially thaw.
Stir in rice, soup, chicken, milk, half the cheese and the onion.
Then sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 5 cups or 3 servings.
Can be prepared in skillet.

title: Can'T Get Enough Buffalo Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret herb with garlic soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets herb with garlic soup mix

steps: Split wings and discard tips.
Cut chicken wings in half at joint.
Broil or grill wings 30 to 45 minutes, turning often until cooked or bake in 425° oven for 1 hour, turning halfway.
In bowl combine cayenne pepper sauce, butter and herb with garlic soup mix to coat.
If you can't take it hot, eliminate the pepper sauce. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Mock Ambrosia

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice

steps: Peel and coarsely grate apples.
Add orange juice that has been thawed a little.
Let apples start absorbing juice.
Sprinkle in orange jello and stir.
Add pineapple and stir.
Add flavorings and cherries.
Store in refrigerator.

title: * Easy Potatoes And Ham *
steps: Make potatoes according to directions.
Add other ingredients and bake 30 to 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Serves 4.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding
steps: Scald milk.
Combine flour, brown sugar and salt.
Add 2 cups of scalded milk to dry ingredients; mix well.
Return to pan of scalded milk.
Cook and stir until thick.
Remove from stove.
Add the beaten eggs, vanilla and chunk of butter.
Mix until smooth. When cool, stir in graham cracker crumbs and whipped topping.

title: Hearty Baked Macaroni
steps: In small bowl, combine water, tomato puree, Italian seasoning and 1/2 of garlic powder.
In another bowl, combine cottage cheese, onion powder and rest of garlic powder.
Spray a 9 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish with cooking spray.
Spread 1/3 of tomato mix in dish.
Layer 1/2 of macaroni, all of cheese mixture, and 1/3 of the tomato mix.
Add rest of macaroni and cover with tomato mix.
Cover and bake at 350° for an hour.
Uncover and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, until cheese melts.

title: Tuna Bean Salad

ingredients.name: red kidney bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Lightly mix all ingredients except nuts.
Line serving bowl with salad greens.
Fill with mixture.
Top with chopped nuts. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Potato-Leek Soup
steps: Cook vegetables in enough water to keep from sticking until tender.
Add Accent while cooking.
Serve hot with saltine or other crackers.

title: No Bake Cherry Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: In a medium bowl beat cheese until light and fluffy.
Add the sweetened condensed milk and blend thoroughly.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour into crust.
Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with the amount of desired topping of pie filling before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Spiced Tea Mix

ingredients.name: ice tea mix with lemon and sugar
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. ice tea mix with lemon and sugar

steps: Mic the ingredients.
Make 2 cups.
Use 2 teaspoons per 1 cup hot water.

title: Peach-Berry Smoothie

ingredients.name: or peach
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sliced fresh or frozen peaches

steps: Combine all ingredients in blender container.
Cover and blend 30 to 60 seconds or until smooth.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: Super Bowl Casserole

ingredients.name: ranch style bean with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ranch Style beans with juice

ingredients.name: kernel corn with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 can whole kernel corn with juice

steps: In Dutch oven, brown ground beef or sausage with onion.
Drain grease.
Pour in beans, corn, stewed tomatoes and one can Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Take 20 flour tortillas, broken up, put half in 14 x 10-inch pan.
Layer meat, cheeses, tortillas, meat and cheeses. Pour 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes over top.
Let sit for two hours, covered with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Serves 10 to 12.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Boil chicken breasts until done.
Debone and cut in cubes. In a 9 x 13-inch dish, layer chicken on bottom.
Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken.

title: Steak And Potato Casserole
steps: Brown steak on both sides.
Cut in chunks.
Put in casserole dish.
Add rest of ingredients.
Stir up.
Cook at 350° to 400° for 1 hour or until steak is tender.

title: Granny Deturck'S Corn Fritters
steps: Combine first three ingredients.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs and milk.
Add oil.
Combine with dry ingredients and stir just until all ingredients are mixed.
Fold in corn.

title: Favorite Chocolate Brownies(Microwave)

ingredients.name: chocolate flavored ice cream syrup
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chocolate flavored ice cream syrup

steps: Microwave (High) butter in uncovered 1-quart dish 15 to 20 seconds or until softened.
Blend in sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Blend in vanilla.
Add flour, ice cream syrup and salt; mix well.
Grease bottom only of 8-inch square dish.
Spread batter in dish.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.

title: Black Olive Soup
steps: Blend all ingredients, except eggs and cream in blender on high speed for 1 minute.
Transfer to saucepan, heat and add beaten eggs;
cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Add cream.
Serve hot or cold. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Granny'S Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt.
Add egg yolks and butter. Gradually add milk.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until brown.
Add strawberries on top and top with meringue and brown about 8 minutes.

title: 5 Pound Fudge
steps: Place first 5 ingredients in large bowl and set aside.
Cook milk and sugar until rolling boil.
Lower heat and cook for 12 minutes, stirring continuously.
Pour over first mixture and stir until all ingredients are well blended.
Pour into greased pan (large or two smaller).
Spread to thickness desired.

title: Microwave Praline Fudge

ingredients.name: fat condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can fat free sweetened condensed milk

steps: Mix first three ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on low, stirring constantly, until ingredients are smooth.
Add in pecan halves and pour into a well greased 9 by 9-inch serving dish.
Cut into bite sized squares and serve when cool.

title: Keith'S Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
Mix all other ingredients.
Pour into a casserole dish and cover with tinfoil.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Garlic Broiled Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 lb. chicken (whole frying, cut in half or separate pieces)

steps: In small bowl stir together butter, pepper, garlic and soy sauce.
Heat broiler.
Place chicken on greased broiler pan.
Broil chicken 6 to 8 inches from heat, turning every 10 minutes and brushing with butter mixture during last 10 minutes, for 30 to 35 minutes or until fork-tender.
Just before serving, brush with butter mixture and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with cooked rice.

title: Martha'S Chinese Cookies
steps: Mash some dough together with your hands.
Then you smash it. Cook it in a pan on the stove 5 minutes.
Then you smash them to decorate them.
Then you eat them.

title: Chocolate Mint Dessert
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In large bowl, beat flour, sugar, butter, eggs and syrup until smooth. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.
Cool completely.

title: White Barbecue Sauce
steps: Mix all in blender.
Dip chicken breasts in sauce as you grill and baste.

title: Corn Casserole Supreme

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. shredded Cheddar cheese (one 8 oz. pkg.)

steps: Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Place crushed potato chips or crushed cornflakes on top.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake 1 hour.
Casserole will serve 10 people.

title: Holiday Bake

ingredients.name: american mixture heartland style vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. pkg. American mixtures, Heartland style vegetables (frozen)

ingredients.name: cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of broccoli soup

ingredients.name: french fried onion ring
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can French fried onion rings

steps: Microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes (or bake in 375° oven for 30 to 35 minutes) until vegetables are crisp and tender, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle with remaining onion rings. Serves 5.

title: Swedish Nut Wafers
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly butter a cookie sheet or jellyroll pan.
Cream butter, then gradually beat in the sugar until well blended.
Add egg, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Mix together flour, baking powder and salt; mix into first mixture. Spread dough onto the cookie sheet as thin as possible, just enough to cover pan.
Sprinkle with nuts and press them into dough gently.
Mark with sharp knife into rectangle (cookie size), bake about 12 minutes.

title: Chili Verde

ingredients.name: pork steak
ingredients.raw: 3 pork steaks (lean meat), cut into 1/2-inch strips

ingredients.name: green chily or
ingredients.raw: 2 small cans whole green chilies, chopped or sliced

steps: Fry meat until golden brown.
Pour unwanted grease out.
Saute onions and garlic with the meat. Add chilies, jalapeno, cumin, salt, water and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer until pork is done.
It's delicious with beans, rice and tortillas.

title: Ronnie'S Chili
steps: Cook hamburg, onions and peppers until done.
Drain off fat and add the rest of the ingredients.
Simmer for a couple of hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained (juice reserved)

ingredients.name: green bell pepper in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 green bell pepper, cut in chunks

ingredients.name: loin
ingredients.raw: 4 (1-inch thick) loin or rib pork chops

steps: Cook pineapple juice, catsup, brown sugar and vinegar in medium size saucepan for 5 minutes until hot and flavors have blended.
Add carrots, pineapple and green pepper.
Remove from heat.
Brown pork chops in oil in large skillet.
Arrange in single layer in shallow baking dish.
Spread pineapple-vegetable mixture over top.
Cover with foil and bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until chops are done and vegetables are crisp-tender.

title: Macaroni Fruit Salad
steps: Drain fruit real well; save juices and set aside.
Cook and cool macaroni.
Cook fruit juices, sugar, eggs, flour and vanilla. Cool cooked sauce mixture.
When cool, mix with fruits and macaroni.
Refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, mix Cool Whip with salad.

title: Swiss Steaks Picante

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce (no salt added)

steps: Heat oil in skillet; working in batches, add steaks and brown 2 minutes, turning once.
Remove to plate.
Add green onion, garlic and cumin; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato sauce and salsa. Bring to simmering; add meat to skillet and cook 1 to 3 minutes or just until heated.

title: Sausage Gravy
steps: Brown sausage until it crumbles.
Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of drippings.
Add oleo to drippings.
Add flour and cook 1 minute.
Add milk and cook until thickened.
Stir in sausage and seasonings.

title: Rosemary Chicken With Vegetables
steps: Rinse chicken with water and pat dry.
Salt and pepper entire chicken, then rub garlic onto chicken, then pat rosemary on chicken.
Sprinkle juice of 1 lemon over chicken and stick the used lemon in chicken cavity.
Put chicken in clay roasting oven or roasting bag.
Surround chicken with chunks of potatoes, carrots and onion around chicken.
Place in 375° oven and cook between 1 to 1 1/2 hours (check for doneness).
Serves 4.

title: Zesty Sausage Appetizers
steps: Cut sausage links into bite size pieces.
Combine preserves and mustard over low heat for 5 minutes.
Add sausage and heat for 15 minutes.
Serve hot in chafing dish, fondue pot or crock-pot. Serve with picks to eat.

title: Baked Salmon
steps: Lay fillet of salmon in baking pan; put onion slices over fish and layer bacon strip over onions.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Last 10 minutes, pour whole tomatoes over fish.

title: Frosted Brownies
steps: Combine first three ingredients in bowl and set aside.
Bring butter, cocoa and water to boil and pour over flour mixture.
Add remaining ingredients; add to cocoa and flour mixture, beating until smooth.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Rice Jambalaya

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small green pepper, cut into strips

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. pork, cut into thin strips or canned tuna or any meat desired, cooked

steps: Heat oil in skillet.
Add onion, green pepper and garlic; cook until tender-crisp.
Add tomatoes, okra and cooked meat.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Cover.
Serve hot.

title: Quick Green Pea Casserole *

ingredients.name: green pea not
ingredients.raw: 2 (1 lb.) cans green peas, not drained (LeSueur)

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 2 cans cream of celery soup, undiluted

steps: Cook celery and green pepper in saucepan in small amount of margarine, butter or oil until soft.
Add green peas with their liquid, undiluted soup and sweet basil.
Add herb stuffing until liquid is absorbed and mixture reaches desired consistency for a casserole.
Heat.
Pour into casserole.
Decorate with pimento and serve.
(If you like something crunchy in the casserole and to save time, stir in the celery and green pepper raw.
For an extra quick casserole, omit them entirely.)

title: Unbaked Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix together margarine, milk and sugar in a heavy 2-quart pan. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat, add peanut butter and mix thoroughly.
Stir in oats.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Pizza Potatoes
steps: Spray casserole with Pam.
Slice potatoes; add salt and pepper.
Heat and bring to boiling; boil 3 to 4 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, water and oregano; dot with oleo.
Sprinkle shredded Mozzarella cheese on top.
Place sliced pepperoni over cheese and bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Bundles
steps: Combine chicken, pineapple, almonds, ginger, garlic powder and mayonnaise.
Separate dough into 4 rectangles.
On ungreased baking sheet, press each piece of dough into 8 x 5-inch rectangle. Firmly press perforations to seal.
Cut each rectangle in half to make squares.
Place about 1/4 cup chicken mixture in center of each piece of dough.
Pull 4 corners of dough to top center of chicken mixture.
Twist ends and seal edges.
Brush with melted margarine and sprinkle with sesame seed.
Makes 8 sandwiches.

title: Refried Beans

ingredients.name: pinto
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. dried pinto or pink beans

ingredients.name: hot bacon dripping
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. hot bacon drippings or butter or lard

steps: Combine beans in a pan with water and onions.
Bring to a boil, cover and remove from heat for 2 hours (or soak beans in cold water overnight).
Return to heat, bring to boil and simmer slowly until beans are very tender, about 3 hours.
Mash beans with a potato masher and add bacon drippings, butter or lard.
Mix well and continue cooking, stirring frequently until beans are thickened and fat is absorbed.
Salt to taste.
Serve or reheat.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Microwave Ranch Eggs

ingredients.name: marzetti garden ranch dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. Marzetti Garden Ranch dressing (or other Ranch dressing)

steps: Melt one pat butter or margarine in small bowl in microwave, on High for 30 seconds.
Add eggs and Ranch dressing (Marzetti Garden Ranch works the best).
Beat thoroughly.
Cook on High for one minute.
Fold in outer edges.
If desired, place cheese slice over top of eggs.
Cook again for 45 seconds on High with cheese, or 30 seconds without, until cheese is melted and eggs are not runny in center.
Serves one.

title: French Fried Chicken Bites

ingredients.name: chicken breast bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt and set aside.
Combine egg, flour and milk, stirring until smooth.
Dip chicken in egg mixture. Roll in cracker crumbs.
Fry chicken in 1-inch hot oil until brown. Drain on paper towel.
Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Hot Tomato Hamburger

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato with green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies

steps: Layer chips in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix Ro-Tel tomatoes, cream of chicken and hamburger together.
Layer this on the chips.
Layer Cheddar cheese on the soup mixture.
Layer chips and then another layer of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Cherry Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: eagle brand milk chilled
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand milk, chilled

steps: In medium bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Add Eagle Brand milk; blend thoroughly.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour into crust.
Chill 2 hours or until set.
Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving.

title: Future Turnover
steps: Pour grape and orange juice into the container, then take the measuring cup and fill it with sugar.
Take the spoon and stir it for about 1 to 2 minutes.
And then you put it in the refrigerator for about 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Chicken Doritos
steps: Boil and debone chicken.
Mix the soups together on the stove with the broth.
Line a 12x13 pan with Doritos, put the chicken on top of the chips, pour soups on chicken and sprinkle with the onions.
Top with grated cheese.
Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies (No-Bake)
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, margarine, milk and salt.
Bring to a quick boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add oats, peanut butter and flavoring.
Mix well and spoon onto wax paper to cool.

title: Bushel O' Cookies
steps: Mix together until you have mixture stiff enough to use as a rolled dough.
Chill dough for 2 hours or overnight.
Excellent!! Have for Christmas cut-outs.

title: Chocolate Chews

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. self raisin flour sifted
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. plus 1 Tbsp. self-rising flour, sifted

steps: Melt margarine.
Combine eggs, sugar and vanilla flavoring with margarine. Gradually add flour and cocoa. Add 1/2 cup pecans to mixture. Pour mixture into 9 x 11-inch greased pan.
Add remaining pecans, sprinkling on top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
They are done when it rises and falls back down.

title: Barbecued Pork
steps: Cook pork in lightly salted water over low heat 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Drain, reserving 1 cup broth.
Cut pork into thin slices and place in a large shallow baking pan.
Combine salt, reserved broth and remaining ingredients.
Mix well and pour over pork slices.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cheddar-Dill Popovers
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Generously grease 6-ounce custard cups or 8 medium muffin cups (2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch).
Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl; stir in remaining ingredients with fork or wire whisk just until smooth (do not overbeat).
Fill custard cups half full or muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake 25 minutes.
Decrease oven temperature to 325°.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until deep golden brown.
Immediately remove from cups.
Serve hot.
Yields 6 to 8 popovers.

title: Easy Pumpkin Swirl

ingredients.name: pioneer
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Pioneer or Bisquick buttermilk baking mix

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan.
Line top and sides with waxed paper.
Grease waxed paper.
Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in pumpkin, stir in dry ingredients. Pour into pan, spread evenly, sprinkle with nuts.
Bake for 13-15 minutes.
Invert onto towel dusted with powdered sugar.
Peel off waxed paper, roll up cake and towel together from short side. Place seam side down on wire rack.
Cool completely, unroll cake.

title: Orange Beach Shrimp Salad

ingredients.name: vidalia onion in ring
ingredients.raw: 1 Vidalia (or Peru Sweet) onion, cut in rings

ingredients.name: hass avocado in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 Hass avocado, cut in small pieces

ingredients.name: steamed shrimp cooled and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. medium steamed shrimp, cooled and peeled

steps: Using a clear 3-quart salad bowl, layer lettuce, onion, tomatoes, avocado and olives.
Top with shrimp and cheese.

title: Baked Pork Chops
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove excess fat from chops and place in baking pan.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Then on each chop, spread catsup about 1/8-inch thick.
Sprinkle 1 1/2 to 2 teaspoons brown sugar on each chop, then place a slice of lemon on each chop.
Sprinkle a little more brown sugar.
Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, depending on the thickness of the chops, basting occasionally.

title: Slim Salmon Loaf

ingredients.name: mashed potato made with skim milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. mashed potatoes, made with skim milk

steps: Blend all ingredients until well blended. Spread in nonstick loaf pan, baking dish or individual molds.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes in loaf pan, 20 minutes if use individual molds.

title: Pinecone Cheese Balls
steps: Spread almonds in single layer in shallow pan.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes, stirring often until almonds are toasted. Split each nut in half when cool.
Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Mix well.
Add bacon, onion, dill and pepper.
Mix well.
Cover and chill overnight.
Form cheese mixture into shapes of two pinecones on serving platter. Beginning at narrow end, press almonds at slight angle into cheese mixture in rows.
Continue overlapping rows until all cheese is covered.
Garnish with clean, washed pine sprigs.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Bisquick Quiche
steps: Grease a 9-inch pie pan.
Sprinkle in veggies, onion and cheese. Beat remaining ingredients and pour into pan over veggies. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

title: Custard Pie Filling
steps: Beat eggs.
Stir in sugar, salt, vanilla, nutmeg and scalded milk then pour into egg mixture.
Pour into pastry shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake at 425° for 22 minutes or until firm. Cool and serve.

title: Yankee Pot Roast
steps: About 4 hours before serving, in Dutch oven over medium heat, in hot salad oil, brown the meat well on all sides.
Add remaining ingredients with 1 1/2 cups water and heat until boiling.
Reduce heat; cook until fork-tender.
Serve meat with pan liquid.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: English Popovers
steps: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Fill 8 well-greased muffin tins or custard cups.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then lower oven temperature to 350° for 20 minutes longer.
Serve warm with butter and jam.

title: Grayce'S Krazy Cake
steps: Sift dry above ingredients into an ungreased 9 x 14-inch cake pan.
Make 2 holes or depressions in flour mixture in pan.
In one hole, put 2 tablespoons vinegar, in one put 3/4 cup oil.
Mix with a fork until well blended.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 50 minutes.
A toothpick may be inserted to test doneness or the cake should raise from small pressure from fingertips.
The mixture will stick to the toothpick if not done.

title: Potato Pie
steps: Put the cottage cheese through a food mill to make it smooth. Beat the mashed potatoes into the cottage cheese.
Beat in sour cream, eggs, salt and cayenne.
Stir in scallions.
Spoon into pastry shell.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake at 425° for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: All In One Quiche

ingredients.name: ham turkey shrimp chicken bacon
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced ham, turkey, shrimp, chicken, bacon or vegetables

steps: Combine first
5 ingredients in blender and mix well.
Turn into ungreased deep dish 9-inch or regular 10-inch pan.
Add meat, shellfish or vegetables, poking into batter.
Top with onions, mushrooms and cheese.
Bake until top is golden brown, about 45 minutes at 350°.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexitalian Lasagne
steps: Combine chili, salsa, mushrooms, Parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Mix cottage cheese and parsley flakes.
Layer noodles, cottage cheese, chili and Mozzarella.
Repeat to make 3 layers. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Summer Potato Salad(Serves 8)
steps: Peel the potatoes and slice about 1/4 inch thick.
Bring to a boil for 10 minutes in salted water.
Drain.

title: Low-Fat Candy
steps: Cook butter, sugar and milk on low heat for 10 minutes.
Add chocolate chips, marshmallow, prunes, nuts and vanilla.
Cook on low for 10 minutes.
Put in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
When it gets cool, cut.

title: Zucchini Tomato Bake
steps: Combine zucchini and seasonings in casserole.
Cover.
Place in oven and cook 15 minutes.
Add tomatoes and continue cooking for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Skillet Dinner
steps: Brown chicken in oil until lightly browned; remove from pan. Add vegetables and stir for 2 or 3 minutes.
Add chicken broth mixed with cornstarch to pan.
Return chicken to pan.
Cover and cook slowly for 20 minutes.
Serves 2.

title: Pudding Cones
steps: Stir milk into pudding; beat 1 minute.
Set cones in a small glass to keep them from falling over.
Spoon pudding into cones and they're ready to eat.

title: Refrigerator Yeast Rolls
steps: Combine 1st 5 ingredients in small mixing bowl and beat 3 minutes with heavy duty mixer at medium speed.
In large mixing bowl, combine flour, shortening, sugar and water and mix thoroughly.
Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Cover and let dough rise in warm place, 85° free from drafts for 3 hours or until doubled in bulk.
Punch dough down; cover; refrigerate overnight.
With lightly floured hands, shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls; place in 3 greased 9-inch cake pans.
Let rise in warm, draft free (85°) place approximately 2 hours or until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 2 1/2 dozen large rolls.
Dough can be stored in refrigerator in greased and covered bowl 5 to 6 days.

title: Clam-Crab Dip
steps: Melt the first three ingredients.
Then add the minced clams, crabmeat, garlic salt to taste and a pinch of "accent."
Serve warm on crackers.

title: Creamy Vegetable Medley

ingredients.name: condensed golden corn soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed golden corn soup

ingredients.name: bird eye farm mixture
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) bag Birds Eye frozen Farm Fresh mixtures (broccoli, cauliflower and carrots)

steps: In a saucepan mix soup, milk and vegetables over medium heat. Heat to a boil.
Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheese.
Heat until cheese is melted.
Serves 6.
Prep. Time:
10 minutes.
Cook Time:
25 minutes.

title: Rice Krispy Treats
steps: Mix together the sugar and Karo syrup.
Bring to a boil. Stir in the peanut butter and cereal.
Press into 9 x 13 inch pan. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Charoses(A Passover Seder Symbol)
steps: Have children mix all ingredients after chopping. Add enough grape juice to bind mixture.
Serve on matzoh.

title: Dreamy Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. peeled potatoes or 20 servings instant potatoes

steps: Cook and mash potatoes.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until light and fluffy.
Put in greased casserole dish; dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Carrots
steps: Scrape carrots with vegetable parer.
Cut into penny slices. Place carrots in saucepan; cover with cold water.
Add salt. Cover saucepan and cook over medium-high heat until water starts to boil.
Turn heat down to low; cook 15 minutes longer.
When carrots are tender, pour contents of saucepan into colander in sink.
Shake to drain water.
Put carrots back in saucepan.
Stir butter and brown sugar; cook over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring a few times.
Carrots should be shiny and glazed.

title: Hamburger-Cheese Dip
steps: Thicken the flour and milk.
Add cheese and melt.
Add the rest of the ingredients; simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Pilgrim Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a large bowl, mix turkey, peas, corn, gravy, 2 tablespoons of the chives and the thyme.
Turn into shallow 2 1/2 to 3-quart baking dish; set aside.
Warm potatoes and mix in remaining chives.
Cover turkey mixture with potatoes. Bake at 400° for about 25 minutes, until turkey mixture is bubbly and potatoes begin to brown.
Makes about 6 servings.

title: Spam Dish
steps: Cook macaroni as directed and drain.
In large skillet, cook and stir onion, green pepper and butter, until onion is tender. Stir in macaroni and remaining ingredients.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole and cover.
Bake at 400° fo 30 minutes.

title: Butter Rings
steps: Combine first four ingredients.
Scald milk.
Cool to lukewarm. Crumble yeast into milk.
Add sugar.
When bubbling, add to cream in which the egg yolks have been beaten.
Mix well.
Add to flour mixture.
Mix thoroughly and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, divide into 6 equal parts.
Roll each into a thin roll and twist two together (makes 3 rings).
Place each in greased pie pan and let rise for about 2 hours.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Winter Guacamole

ingredients.name: jalapeno chile and
ingredients.raw: 2 small jalapeno chiles, stemmed, seeded and minced

ingredients.name: sun tomato and
ingredients.raw: 4 sun dried tomatoes (packed in oil), drained and minced

ingredients.name: bacon crisp and coarsely
ingredients.raw: 5 slices bacon, cooked crisp and coarsely crumbled

steps: Pit and peel avocados; mash pulp in medium bowl to chunky consistency.
Add lime juice, scallions, jalapeno chiles and tomatoes, then fold in cheese, bacon and coriander.
Season to taste with salt.
Serve as soon as possible to keep bacon crisp. Use your favorite chips for dipping.

title: Delicious Sweet Potatoes
steps: Mash the sweet potatoes.
Add sugar, spices, butter or margarine and salt.
Beat until light, then stir in raisins and nuts.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
steps: Mix well.
Store in sealed jar.
Use 1 to 2 tablespoons for 1 cup hot water.
May also serve iced.

title: Crock It Meatballs
steps: Combine grape jelly and chili sauce in crock-pot.
From ground meat into balls and drop in.
Stir well to coat the meatballs. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: One Dish Meal
steps: Slice a layer of raw potatoes in bottom of greased casserole dish, then put a layer of raw onion with layer of hamburger.
Pour in cooked tomatoes, then season each layer to your liking with your favorite seasonings; season each layer.
Bake 1 hour in oven at 350° or until tender.

title: Pupu Korean

ingredients.name: drummette
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 lb. drummettes or chicken wings

ingredients.name: chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 skin chili pepper, minced or 6 to 8 drops Tabasco sauce

steps: Salt chicken; dredge in flour or add salt and pepper to about half a bag of
a plastic bag (the kind that you get from the supermarket
with your vegetables).
Shake your drummettes in the bag (no
mess).
Deep
fry chicken.
Dip, while hot, in sauce made with remaining ingredients.

title: Microwave S'Mores
steps: On paper plate,
place graham cracker square.
Top with chocolate square and
marshmallow.
Microwave on High 15 to 20 seconds.
Makes one serving.

title: Fancy Flounder Roll-Ups(A Great Dish For Those Whose Favorite Meal Is Fish.)

ingredients.name: broccoli pear and
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: good size fillet of flounder
ingredients.raw: 8 good size fillets of flounder (about 2 lb.)

steps: Divide broccoli among fillets, placing across and wrapping/rolling fillet around; secure with toothpick.
Arrange in 2-quart shallow baking dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch).
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Nut Brownies
steps: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler or barely simmering water or microwave.
Stir.

title: Michael'S Danish Chocolate Chip Tart A' L'Orange

ingredients.name: graham cracker
ingredients.raw: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. graham crackers (mini tart crusts)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine Ricotta, eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in chocolate chips. Spoon 1/4 cup into each crust (mini).
Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (center will be soft).
Cool completely.

title: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak

ingredients.name: steak in
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. steak (i.e. London broil), thinly sliced in strips

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic, crushed or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder

steps: Brown steak in frypan with 1 teaspoon butter (margarine or Pam), garlic and ginger.
Put into crock-pot with all other ingredients except green peppers.
Cover and cook on high 3 to 4 hours or low 6 to 8 hours.
Add peppers and cook for 1 more hour.

title: Roasted Mixed Vegetables

ingredients.name: red skin potato wedged
ingredients.raw: 4 large red skin potatoes, wedged (about 2 lb.)

ingredients.name: carrot and
ingredients.raw: 3 large carrots, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces (about 2 c.)

ingredients.name: parsnip and
ingredients.raw: 3 large parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces (about 2 c.)

steps: In a large bowl, toss potatoes, carrots, parsnips and onions with rosemary and garlic.
Drizzle with margarine.
Arrange in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 450° for 40 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender, stirring constantly.

title: Beet Pickles
steps: Cook beets until tender; pour off hot water.
Put on cold and peel.

title: Chocolate Squares
steps: Melt caramels in 1/3 cup evaporated milk and set aside.
Mix all other ingredients, except chocolate chips, together and press half the batter in greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.
Take from oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Then cover with caramel mixture.
Put remaining batter over caramel mixture by spoonfuls.
Bake for 18 minutes.

title: New England Dinner
steps: Use all of this in amounts to serve 6 people.
Steam on stove top on low heat 1 1/2 hours.

title: Caramel Clusters
steps: Heat margarine in a heavy 3-quart saucepan over medium-high heat until melted.
Stir in sugar (mixture will be very granular). Stir frequently with wooden spoon 4 to 5 minutes while mixture melts and begins to turn golden (sugar and margarine may separate).
Continue cooking 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture is light golden and no longer granular.
(Mixture may still be separated; do not overcook.)
Remove from heat. Quickly add cereal.
Mix until cereal is completely coated. Immediately spread on ungreased cookie sheet.
Cool completely; break into bite size pieces.
Store in airtight container.
Makes about 6 cups candy.

title: Biscuit Flat Bread

ingredients.name: hungry jack biscuit pressed circle
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. Hungry Jack biscuits, pressed into 4-inch circles

ingredients.name: garlic clove
ingredients.raw: 1 garlic clove, minced or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder

steps: Press Hungry Jack biscuits into circles.
Mix well mayo, Parmesan cheese, tarragon, basil, green onions and garlic clove. Spread onto biscuit circles to 1/4-inch of edge.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 13 minutes.

title: Grandmother Fleming'S Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Cook sugar, peanut butter, milk and Karo in pan until it forms soft ball when dropped in cool water.
Then remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
Pour into buttered dish and chill.

title: Almond Bars
steps: Melt over low heat.
Spread on cooled crust.

title: Fruit Dip(Diabetic Recipe)
steps: Mix yogurt and cinnamon together.
Add enough pancake syrup to dipping consistency and taste.
Dip fruit into mixture.

title: Miracle Whip Dip
steps: Grate cheese and onion very fine.
Mix with Miracle Whip.
Add finely chopped jalapeno peppers to taste.
Make a day ahead so flavors can blend.
Serve with any type chips.

title: Aunt Pat'S Easy Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in 10 inch baking dish.
Combine flour and sugar. Add milk.
Pour into the middle of melted butter.
Do not stir. Pour fruit into middle of dish.
Do not stir.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 min. to 1 hour, depending on depth of dish and oven.

title: Tomato Slaw
steps: Cut lettuce into small pieces.
Cut tomato into cube.
Add mayonnaise, mix well.
Chill until ready to eat.

title: Deviled Crab
steps: Cook eggs.
While they are hot, mash them up in casserole dish with butter.
Put crab meat in.
Add salt and pepper, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and milk.
Stir.
Sprinkle top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Cook at about 375° for approximately 30 minutes.
Be sure to pull crab meat apart.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.raw: 1 c. boiling salted water (1 1/2 tsp. salt)

ingredients.name: dry bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. dry bread crumbs or cracker crumbs

steps: Combine the ground beef, salt, pepper and onion together.
Add the tomato sauce and bread crumbs to the ground beef.
After cooking the meat until brown, put the meat into the green peppers. Boil the green peppers for about 2 minutes before you put the meat into them.

title: Biondi'S Bruschetta

ingredients.name: tomato chop in fine little
ingredients.raw: 2 large tomatoes, chop in fine little cubes

steps: Mix tomatoes, onion, parsley, basil and garlic.
Cut bread in oval slices.
Pour olive oil on bread slices and spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of mixture on top.
Put in oven at 375° to 400° for 10 minutes to toast.
Watch it!
Enjoy as a wonderful pupu!

title: Aunt Bertha'S Sweet Dill Pickles
steps: Wash pickles of brine.
Slice or split lengthwise and put into pint jars.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil, stirring.
Let cool.
Pour over pickles.
Let stand 30 days.

title: Lazyman Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in bottom of pan.
Mix flour, sugar and milk.
Add syrup and peach pieces.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chewy Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Combine chocolate and shortening in saucepan over low heat until melted.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Mix in remaining ingredients. Spread in pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until brownies begin to pull away from the side.
Do not overbake. Cool slightly. Frost with favorite chocolate frosting.

title: Beef Marinade
steps: Boil for 5 minutes. Pour over beef. Put in fridge at least 2 hours. Best if left overnight.
Shake to mix occasionally. Fix beef as desired.

title: Super Cheese Straws

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 c. finely chopped grated sharp Cheddar cheese or New York extra sharp

steps: With electric mixer at medium to high speed, cream butter and shortening until soft.
Add cheese; mix well.
Sift flour, salt, mustard and cayenne pepper together.
Add in 3 additions.
Mix well after each addition.
Pipe cheese mixture on a cookie sheet; bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350° or until just starting to turn golden brown at edges.
Carefully transfer cheese straws to a wire rack for cooling as they are very crisp and break easily. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.
Makes 8 to 9 dozen.

title: Meaty Baked Beans
steps: Fry bacon. Saute hamburger and onion. Crumble 10 slices of bacon into hamburger. Add the remaining ingredients.
Put into a baking dish. Crumble the last 2 slices of bacon on top of dish. Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Breast Boned
steps: Melt margarine or butter and dip chicken breasts.
Mix flour and salt and dip chicken in this.
Beat egg with water and dip chicken.
Mix bread crumbs and cheese and roll chicken in this. Place chicken in baking dish and bake 45 minutes in a preheated 350° oven.

title: The Barn Doors Garlic Dressing

ingredients.name: lemon juice and vinegar mixed
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. lemon juice and vinegar, mixed

steps: Place raw eggs in the mixer.
While beating, add salt and mustard.
Slowly add the oil, then remaining ingredients.
Store dressing in covered jar.

title: Peach Whip Pie
steps: Bake pie crust.
Cut peaches into small pieces.
Prepare pudding according to package directions.
Beat in whipped topping. Fold in peaches.
Turn into pie shell.
Chill several hours or until firm.

title: Old Fashioned Peach Cobbler
steps: Combine the peaches and 3/4 cup sugar.
Let stand 20 minutes. Melt the margarine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish in oven. Sift together flour, 1 cup sugar and baking powder.
Add milk and stir briskly.
Lumps will remain. Pour into baking dish or melted butter. Top with peaches.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Rice Salad
steps: Prepare rice as directed on package.
Mix in mayonnaise.
Mix apple with lemon juice.
Stir into rice mixture with remaining ingredients.
Chill.

title: Cherry Salad(Ambrosia)
steps: Drain juice from the pineapple and put in a large bowl.
Add the milk, cherries and nuts; mix well with a spoon.
Fold in the unfrozen Cool Whip.
Cover and refrigerate.
The salad sets well when refrigerated the night before or 4 hours before serving.

title: Lisa'S Beef Soup

ingredients.name: uncooked orzo
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. uncooked orzo (pasta which looks like rice)

steps: Cook beef, onion and garlic; drain fat.
Add tomatoes, water and bouillon.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered 20 minutes.
Add orzo and mixed vegetables.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Enjoy.

title: Hash Brown Casserole 3

ingredients.name: hash brown
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. bag of frozen hash browns

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup

steps: Mix all above ingredients together.
Put into a 9 x 13 baking dish.
Sprinkle crushed corn flakes on top of the mixture (about 1 1/2 to 2 cups).
Pour melted butter on top (1/2 stick).
Bake at 350 for about 1 hour.

title: Do Nothing Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix by hand (do not use electric mixer).
Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Spread topping over cake while warm.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Salt Map
steps: Add more water if necessary.
Knead 7 to 10 minutes until dough has a firm consistency.
To air dry, allow 48 hours.
To bake, put in 325° to 350° oven for 30 minutes or until light brown.
Poke air bubbles with toothpick during baking process. Reduce temperature 50° to 75° if necessary.
Great for school projects.

title: Shrimp Or Crab Spread
steps: Drain and rinse crab or shrimp.
Spread cream cheese over platter or dish, top with sauce and then with shrimp or crab.
(If desired, sprinkle lemon juice on top.)
Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Rice Consomme Casserole
steps: Cook chopped onion in melted margarine.
Add other ingredients; mix well.
Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Easy Caramel Rolls
steps: Grease Bundt pan. Cut loaf into 7 sections.
Put in pan.
Mix sugars and cream together.
Pour over rolls. Cover and put in refrigerator overnight.
Next morning, preheat oven to 350°.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove and let stand until caramel sets, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Mud Pies
steps: Melt chocolate chips and margarine in double boiler, stirring until smooth. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoons onto wax paper.
Cool.

title: My Peanut Butter Pie

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling

steps: In a medium bowl, combine the confectioners sugar and peanut butter.
Mix to a crumbly consistency (like a streusel) and remove about 1/2 cup of the mixture; set aside.
Pour the remaining mixture evenly over the pie crust.
Make pudding according to package directions; pour pudding over the crumb layer, then cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mama'S Rolls
steps: In a large bowl, combine 2 1/4 cups flour, salt, sugar, yeast and Crisco.
On low speed of the mixer, add 2 cups of hot water (120° to 130°) and add the egg.
Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes.
With mixer, beat in 1 or 2 cups of additional flour.
If using dough hooks, change to them to add the remainder of the flour to make a smooth dough.
If mixing by hand, add the remainder of the flour with a wooden spoon.
Turn onto a floured surface and knead into a smooth and elastic dough.
Shape into a ball and turn into a large greased bowl.
Cover and set in a warm place to rise for about two hours.
Punch down the dough.
Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.

title: Snow Crunch
steps: Combine cereal, raisins and peanuts in large container; mix well.
Combine margarine, chocolate morsels and peanut butter in saucepan.
Heat until melted, stirring constantly.
Do not boil. Add vanilla and let cool.
