ingredients.raw: chopped celery, green pepper, onion, canned shrimp and hard-boiled eggs

steps: Thin cream cheese with mayonnaise and curry, enough so it will spread thin on a plate.
Layer the chopped food on top of cream cheese. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Skins
steps: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and rub skins with oil.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until done.
Cool potatoes.
Cut in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out pulp, leaving 1/4 to 1/8-inch shell.
Pulp may be reserved for mashed potatoes.
Deep fry shells in oil for 2 minutes until light brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Place skins on baking sheet; sprinkle with cheese and bacon.
Place under broiler until cheese melts.
Serve with sour cream.

title: Orange Blossom Punch
steps: Combine sugar and water; heat and stir until sugar is dissolved.
Bring to a boil for 5 minutes without stirring. Chill.
Add juices and ginger ale; pour over ice.
A large jar of maraschino cherries could also be added.
(Makes 50 servings.)

title: Ham And Cheese Sandwich
steps: Put Miracle Whip on bread.
Then put ham, cheese, tomato slice and lettuce on slice of bread.
Put the other slice of bread on the lettuce.

title: Zucchini And Cheese

ingredients.name: other cheese
ingredients.raw: other cheese to taste (Provolone, Parmesan, etc.)

steps: Arrange bacon slices in single layer in a 2-quart glass baking dish.
Microwave for 5 to 6 minutes on High or until crisp.
Remove bacon.
Crumble and set aside.
Add onions and green peppers to bacon fat.
Microwave for about 3 minutes on High.
Layer all in dish and cover with glass lid on.
Microwave for about 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Karo Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
steps: In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients.
Mix well.
In medium bowl, whisk egg whites, water and syrup.
Stir this into dry ingredients until smooth.
Pour into 9-inch square pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray (Pam).
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 16 servings; 130 calories, 0 grams of fat.

title: Pear Preserves
steps: Cook sugar, Karo and water to a rolling boil.
Drop pears into mixture.
Cook over medium heat until thick.
Makes 4 pints.

title: Ground Chuck Rice Hot Dish

ingredients.name: or more ground beef brown
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. or more ground beef, browned

steps: Mix and bake in covered dish 1 1/2 hours at 375°.
Add water to keep moist while baking.

title: Pineapple Icing
steps: Combine all ingredients except pineapple.
Cook over medium heat for 12 minutes or until thick.
Stir constantly.
Remove from heat and add pineapple.
Spread on cooled cake.

title: Worthy Bars
steps: Mix oatmeal, brown sugar and oleo like pastry.
Add syrup, vanilla extract and almond extract.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan (works best with wet hands).
Bake at 350° for only 10 minutes.
Cool.

title: Foil Dinner

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef or cube steak

steps: Take aluminum foil (about 18 to 24-inches) and spread flat (4 of these).
Make patties from ground beef or use 1 cube steak. Put patty in center of foil.
Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce and seasoned salt.
Place onion on top of pattie.
Cut potatoes, carrots and squash in slices and lay on top of onion.
Add one pat of butter on top and close foil.
Cook at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Pizza
steps: Thaw out in bread wrapper 3 loaves of frozen dough (Dakato Brand is best).
Let rise until double in size, about 8 hours. Grease 2 pizza pans (13 x 18-inch) with Crisco.
Cut dough in half.
Press 1/2 dough into each pan.
(Make sure dough doesn't shrink.)
Cover with towel and let rise for 1 hour.

title: Golden Fried Chicken
steps: Combine egg and milk.
Roll chicken in flour, then dip in egg batter.
Roll in flour again.
Fry in oil in skillet.

title: Easy Cherry-Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: supermoist devil s food cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. SuperMoist devil's food cake mix

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Beat eggs in large bowl.
Stir in cake mix (dry), cherry pie filling and oil until blended.
Spread in pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Surface of cake will be bumpy.
Cool completely.
Prepare pudding as directed for pie.
Let stand about 5 minutes or until thick. Spread over cake.
Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Chicken And Asparagus Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Place asparagus on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Put chicken on top of the asparagus.
Combine soups, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.
Pour over the chicken and sprinkle the cheese on next.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch fresh broccoli, cut up or 20 oz. frozen broccoli cuts, cooked and drained

steps: In 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in broccoli and half of the onions.

title: Indiana Chili
steps: Fry ground beef and onion.
Drain grease and set aside.
Boil water. Add macaroni until tender. Drain water from macaroni and then add tomato juice, ground beef mixture and spices.
Bring to a boil again, then remove from heat.
Serve in soup bowl along with crackers and peanut butter for a cozy, warm-up meal.

title: Southwestern Bean Salad

ingredients.name: pink bean and
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 1/2 to 16 oz.) can pink beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: black bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: black eyed pea and
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained

steps: In large bowl with wire whisk or fork, mix olive oil, vinegar, cumin and salt.
Add celery, scallions, pink beans, black beans and black-eyed peas.
Gently toss to coat well.
To serve, stir in celery leaves.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
steps: Drain spaghetti.
Add chicken, onion, mushroom soup and chicken broth; mix well.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and place in 350° oven.
Cook for 1 hour.
When cheese melts, stir into mixture.

title: Sue Made These Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix shortening in boiling water.
Let cool somewhat before adding together.
Then add other ingredients.
Let rise until double.
Roll and cut out.
Put in pan.
Let rise again.
Bake at 400° until done.

title: Chicken
steps: Combine ingredients and placed in covered pan.
Cook at 350° for about 2 hours or until tender.

title: White Buttermilk Cake
steps: Cream sugar and Crisco.
Add buttermilk, egg whites and vanilla.
Mix dry ingredients and add to mixture. Pour in greased cake pans and bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Appetizer Ham Ball
steps: Blend deviled ham, olives, mustard and Tabasco.
Form in ball on serving dish; chill.
Combine cream cheese and milk; frost ball with mixture.
Trim with parsley flakes and sliced olives.
Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.
Pass assorted crackers.

title: Taco Twist
steps: Brown beef and add taco seasoning (saving 1 tablespoon), peppers and tomato sauce.
Let simmer for a few minutes.
Cook and drain macaroni and add cheese, sour cream and remaining taco seasoning to macaroni.
Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish.
Top with hamburger mixture and sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Dr. Pepper In A Gel
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add Dr. Pepper; mix well. Pour into individual cups.
Chill about 2 hours or until firm.

title: Quick Sticky Buns
steps: Cut biscuits in quarters with scissors.
Mix sugars and cinnamon. Add biscuits and toss to coat well.
Put in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Pour melted butter over. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
steps: Brown coconut and pecans in oleo.
Mix cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Put 1/4 cream cheese in each pie crust.
Drizzle 1/4 jar caramel, then 1/4 coconut mixture.
Repeat layer.
Freeze.
Thaw 5 to 10 minutes. This is better if frozen overnight.

title: Soda Cracker Cookies
steps: Spray a large jelly roll pan with Pam.
Line with aluminum foil and spray that with Pam.
Put in 1 layer of soda crackers with sides touching but not overlapping.
Melt brown sugar and butter.
Boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, then pour over crackers.
Bake at 400° for 7 minutes.
Remove pan from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over the top and spread as they melt. Sprinkle with at least 1/2 cup of nuts.
When cool, break into pieces.

title: Half-Moon Cookies

ingredients.name: sq. chocolate
ingredients.raw: 4 sq. melted unsweetened chocolate or 6 Tbsp. cocoa

steps: Cream butter, sugar, eggs and chocolate in large bowl.
Add flour and mix well.
Add remaining three ingredients.
Mix until batter is smooth.
Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet by heaping tablespoonfuls.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 20 minutes (depending on size of cookies).
Cool and frost with Buttercream frosting.
Kids love these and so do adults!

title: Captain Bear'S Tanuki Chicken

ingredients.name: young fryer less than
ingredients.raw: 1 whole young fryer less than 4 lb.

steps: Preheat grill (if no grill, preheat oven to 375°). Rinse chicken, pat dry.
Drizzle with sesame oil and message in gently, sprinkle with garlic salt (including cavity).
Massage into skin. Place chicken in pie pan, add about 1 inch water to pan - very important.	This keeps the chicken moist inside by steaming as it cooks.
Place pan on grill.
Grill for about 1 hour on low heat or bake in oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until skin is crispy and juices run clear.

title: Carrot And Sweet Onion Relish
steps: Season this mixture with spices of your choice.
Combine all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl.
Stir well and cover, then refrigerate overnight.

title: Cracker Jacks
steps: Cook the brown sugar, butter, syrup and cream of tartar to 260° until a hard ball.
Pour over popcorn.
Put in oven for 1 hour.
Stir 3 times.

title: Beet Salad

ingredients.name: beet well and liquid reserved
ingredients.raw: 1 can beets, drained well and liquid reserved

steps: Mash beets.
Combine reserved liquid with enough water to make 3 cups.
Heat and add sugar.
Add Jell-O and gelatin; dissolve.
Let mixture cool.
Pour vinegar over beets.
Fold beets, onion, and mustard seed into jello mixture.
Allow to cool and gel.

title: Bite Size Mini Blinis
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove crusts from bread and roll flat with rolling pin.
Combine cream cheese with egg yolk and sugar. Spread on bread.
Roll up jelly roll fashion and cut in half.
Dip each roll into melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake on cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sundae Pie
steps: Mix together the flour and butter.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until light brown.
Cool.

title: Honey Balls
steps: Combine all, except corn flakes.
Roll into balls.
Roll in corn flakes to coat.
This is a great snack for children.

title: Lemon Pineapple Pie

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple, well drained

steps: Stir lemon juice into condensed milk.
Stir until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add drained pineapple.
Fold in Cool Whip and pour into crusts.
Cover with plastic lids that come with crusts. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Can be frozen ahead.
Thaw 2 to 3 hours before serving.
"The easiest pie you will ever make!"

title: Rusty'S Dump Cake
steps: Dump applesauce into greased pan (9 x 13-inch).
Dump pineapple on top.
Spread yellow cake mix on top.
Melt butter and pour on top of cake mix.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over batter.
Do not stir. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with Cool Whip, whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Glorified Rice
steps: Combine cooked rice, sugar, pineapple, cherries and marshmallows in bowl.
Fold whipped cream into rice mixture.
Add chopped nuts, if desired.
Chill in sherbet glasses.

title: Eggs Goldenrod
steps: Boil eggs; cool quickly.
Shell.
Cut in half lengthwise. Separate white and yolk in separate containers.
Dice whites. Crumble yolk with fork.
Prepare medium white sauce in saucepan. Add dash of rosemary and parsley.
Simmer a few minutes.
Add diced whites, stirring constantly.
Prepare toast in meantime.
Pour egg mixture on toast; crumble yolk generously on top.
Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Fiesta Bean Dip
steps: Combine beans and enough liquid to make of dipping consistency in saucepan.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Cook over low heat until cheese is melted.
Serve hot with tortillas or chill and serve with chips.

title: Oatmeal Candy
steps: Boil sugar, milk, butter and cocoa for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal.
Drop mixture by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Cooked Squash
steps: Melt butter in skillet, add onion and cook until soft.
Stir in bell pepper and cook until soft.
Add squash and seasonings; cover and simmer until tender.
Drain tomatoes, save the liquid and add them to the skillet.
Cook 5 to 8 minutes more, adding some of the tomato liquid if needed.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Trout Kottwitz

ingredients.name: very coarsely artichoke bottom
ingredients.raw: 1 can very coarsely chopped artichoke bottoms (1 to 2 c.)

steps: Melt 5 tablespoons butter in a large heavy skillet; add trout, artichokes and mushrooms and cook 7 to 8 minutes over medium heat or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper while cooking.
Remove fish and vegetables to heated plates or keep warm in low oven.
Combine Brown Sauce, lemon juice and the 2 cups butter; mix with a wire whisk and cook over low heat until heated through.
To serve, ladle about 1/4 cup sauce over each fillet.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Margarita
steps: Mix all ingredients except strawberries in blender with cracked ice and pour into a wire goblet
rimmed with salt. Garnish with strawberries, or mix all ingredients including the strawberries in blender with ice.

title: White Chocolate Cheesecake

ingredients.name: white chocolate instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. white chocolate instant pudding mix

steps: Beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup of the milk in a large bowl with a wire whisk until smooth.
Add remaining 1 1/2 cups milk and pudding mixes.
Beat with wire whisk 1 minute.
Stir in whipped topping until smooth and well blended. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.
Store leftover pie in refrigerator.
Yield: 8 servings.

title: Bertha'S Potato Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes until almost done. Take off unit and cool.
Add sour cream, chicken soup, grated cheese and the margarine.
Pour into greased baking dish and bake in a 350° oven until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Freezer Cole Slaw
steps: In a large bowl, combine vegetables with salt; let stand 1 hour.
Place remaining ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute.
Cool.

title: Chocolate Dream Layer Cake
steps: First Layer:
Mix margarine, flour and pecans.
Then press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes, then cool.

title: Plantation Coconut Pies
steps: Beat eggs well with sugar.
Add coconut.
Pour into uncooked pie shells and bake at 350° until done.
This makes 2 pies.

title: Butter Baked Chicken And Gravy

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup

steps: Dip chicken in 1/2 cup evaporated milk.
Roll in mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Melt butter or margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Put chicken into pan, skin side down.
Bake in 425° oven 30 minutes.
Turn chicken.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
steps: Cut corned beef in 6 portions.
Wash cabbage and cut into 6 wedges.

title: Chocolate Coconut Balls

ingredients.name: angel flake
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Angel Flake or 16 oz. bag coconut

steps: Mix coconut, sugar, oleo, milk and nuts.
Form into balls. Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler and dip.

title: Baked Chicken Dinner In One Pan

ingredients.name: broiler in half
ingredients.raw: 2 broilers, cut in half (2 lb. each)

steps: Place vegetables in a roasting pan which has a tight-fitting cover and that will be large enough to accomodate the chicken (cut in half lengthwise).
Place chicken halves over the vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and pepper; pour half and half over this; dot with butter.
Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until you can pierce the thickest part of the chicken with a sharp fork. Uncover and place under broiler for 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Jam(Sugar-Free)

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 3 qt. fresh or frozen whole strawberries

ingredients.name: strawberry flavored sugar gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 (.3 oz.) pkg. strawberry flavored sugar-free gelatin

steps: Crush berries until a small amount of juice forms.
Place in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Boil 2 minutes.
Stir in gelatin until dissolved.
Remove from heat.
Add the sweetener and mix well.
Adjust sweetener to taste.
Pour into jars or plastic containers.
Store in refrigerator up to 3 weeks.
Yields 2 3/4 cups.

title: Roll Kuchen
steps: Make a soft dough.
Roll out very thin.
Cut into desired size or shape.
Fry in deep fat until brown.

title: Squash Au Gratin
steps: Cook squash in 350° oven until tender.
Allow to cool, then peel and mash.
Add rosemary, salt and pepper to taste.
Spread squash into a buttered 13 x 9 pan.
Shred Asiago cheese and completely cover top of squash.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly.
Serves 8.

title: Date Ball Candy
steps: Cook first 3 ingredients over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add vanilla, Rice Krispies and nuts.
Roll into balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Goulash
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet, drain off grease.
Put in large kettle and add all other ingredients, except macaroni.
Cook about 30 minutes.
Add macaroni and boil for 10 minutes on medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Sour Cream Limas

ingredients.name: or can butter bean lima half liquid off
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 large cans butter bean limas, half liquid drained off

steps: Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish.
Bake 1 hour or until done in 350° oven.

title: Autumn Apple Cakes(Pancakes)
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Put a little cooking oil in the frypan and make just like pancakes.
Fry and enjoy.

title: Frozen Cucumber And Onion Pickles
steps: Mix cucumbers, onions and salt.
Let stand 2 to 3 hours. Drain and rinse well.
Mix vinegar and sugar, stirring well until sugar is dissolved and syrup is thin.

title: Antipasto On A Stick

ingredients.name: heart of palm and
ingredients.raw: 1 can hearts of palm, drained and cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke heart and
ingredients.raw: 9 oz. jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and halved

steps: Make dressing as directed.
Marinate all in dressing for at least 4 hours.
Alternate all on 20 to 25 wooden skewers to serve.

title: Grilled Pork Chops
steps: Clean chops; then sprinkle on powdered ingredients.
Add liquids.
Let set as long as possible, at least 30 minutes. Grill on grill and enjoy!!
Serves 6.

title: Sleigh Ride
steps: Whip the cream with vanilla.
Mix coffee with sugar and chocolate syrup.
Pour into stemmed glasses or Irish coffee mugs. Place a generous dollop of whipped cream in each mug.
Garnish with a candy cane and/or a sprinkle of crushed candy.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ham And Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: chicken flavor ramen noodle
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. chicken flavor Ramen noodles

steps: In a large saucepan, combine water, noodles, contents of seasoning packet and frozen vegetables.
Bring to a boil.
In a small jar, with a tight fitting lid, combine milk and flour; shake well to blend.
Gradually add to soup, stirring constantly.
Cook until soup is thickened.
Stir in ham.
Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Honey-Poached Apples
steps: Core and pare apples.
Cut into thin wedges and place in bowl with water to cover.
Add 1 teaspoon lemon juice and set aside.

title: Maple Nut Cookies

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 cups flour (no baking powder or soda used)

steps: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate. Roll into ball dip in sugar and place on cookie sheet. Flatten
with fork. Bake approx. 12 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Mexican Sauce Dip

ingredients.name: mild and c. hot mexican sauce mixed together
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. mild and 1/2 c. hot Mexican sauce, mixed together

ingredients.name: cheddar and mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: shredded Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese (desired amount)

steps: Spread cream cheese in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Pour sauce over top.
Spread lettuce on top of that, then onion, tomatoes and green peppers.
Spread cheese on top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Serve warm.

title: "Low-Fat Biscuits"

ingredients.name: cold low fat
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. cold low-fat or skim milk

steps: Heat oven at 450°.
Cut butter into flour until particles are fine like crumbs.
Add milk and stir with fork only until dough leaves side of bowl.
Turn dough out onto lightly floured board; knead just until smooth.
Roll dough out about 1/2 inch thick and cut with floured cutter.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 12 to 14 biscuits.

title: Cheesey Ham Grill
steps: Top 4 bread slices with slices of Velveeta, Oscar Mayer ham and second slice of bread.
Spread outsides of sandwiches with softened butter.
Cook in skillet on medium heat until golden brown on both sides.
Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Spanish Cream Loaf
steps: Boil sugars, cream and butter until it will form soft ball in cold water.
Let stand until cool.
Beat until firm and creamy; knead well.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Shape into loaves and roll in damp cloth.
Leave about 30 minutes in cool place.
Remove cloth and wrap in wax paper.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drop Cookies
steps: In a large saucepan, melt first 4 ingredients over medium-high; bring to a boil.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Stir in next 3 ingredients.
When well blended, add oatmeal.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.
Let cool.
Eat and enjoy.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen, depending on size.

title: Barbecued Meatballs

ingredients.name: each salt pepper garlic powder chili powder and worcestershire sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. each: salt, pepper, garlic powder, chili powder and Worcestershire sauce

steps: Mix all together.
Form into meatballs and place in a baking dish.
Pour Barbecue Sauce over meatballs and bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Waldorf Salad For A Crowd
steps: Blend mayonnaise and whipped cream.
Core and chop apples, adding to dressing immediately.
Add other ingredients except walnuts; mix lightly.
Salad can be chilled before serving.
Add walnuts just before serving.
Makes 50 (1/3-cup) servings (5 quarts).

title: Meat Loaf In Minutes
steps: In microwave, mix all but catsup in microwave-safe 12 x 8-inch dish.
Shape firmly into 8 x 4-inch loaf.
Cover with waxed paper. Cook on High 15 minutes, or until center is 170°.
Rotate during cooking time.
Cool.
Pour 2 tablespoons liquid into cup from drippings.
Add catsup, blend.
Spread on loaf and bake on High 1 minute.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Cocoa Fudge
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add milk.
Heat to boiling.
Boil 8 minutes (don't stir) or until soft ball stage.
Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla.
Beat until glossy.
Pour into pan.

title: Easy Jello Surprise
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Measure 1 1/2 cups gelatin; add applesauce and cinnamon to gelatin in a bowl.
Chill until set, but not firm.
Chill remaining gelatin until slightly thickened.
Blend in yogurt and spoon over gelatin in bowl.
Chill until set, about 3 hours.
Garnish with additional yogurt, if desired.
Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.

title: Italian Potatoes
steps: Dice and brown onion in canola oil, then add remaining ingredients to the pan.
Cook over low flame, stirring occasionally, until carrots and potatoes are tender, adding more liquid if necessary to keep from sticking.

title: Onion Soup

ingredients.name: beef stock
ingredients.raw: 6 c. beef stock or canned beef broth

steps: Save onions in butter until golden brown.
Add the salt and water and cook over medium heat until the water is reduced to 1/2 cup.
Add the beef stock and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve garnished with chopped parsley.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Banana Split Pie
steps: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
Add drained pineapple and bananas.
Pour into pie crust.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and cherries.

title: Jelly Roll
steps: Take egg yolks and whip them thick and yellow.
Beat into them the sugar.
Stir in flour sifted with baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites until firm.
Add to the mixture.

title: 8-Layer Dip

ingredients.name: sour cream mixed with tbsp. taco seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pt. sour cream mixed with 3 Tbsp. taco seasoning

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 small can chopped green chilies or may use 3 bunches green onions, chopped

steps: Layer in order:
jalapeno
bean
dip,
sour cream mixed with taco seasoning, chopped
green
chilies
or chopped green onions, Monterey Jack cheese,
Swiss cheese, tomato and olives on 10 1/2-inch plate or platter.	Dip with nachos.

title: Sauerkraut Sausage Balls
steps: Pat excess moisture from sauerkraut.
Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Shape to form 1-inch balls.
Bake in ungreased shallow pan in 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Cabbage Unstuffed
steps: Saute meat, onions and garlic; drain.
Add tomato sauce, salt, thyme and pepper to meat; mix well.
Place half of cabbage in greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with half of meat sauce. Repeat layers.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Top with grated cheese.
Serves 6.

title: Yogurt And Fruit Salad
steps: Layer beginning with the granola, then add the yogurt.
Add grapes, sliced banana and sliced strawberries.
Repeat until your bowl is full, ending with the fruit.

title: Broiled Swordfish With Apricot-Mustard Glaze

ingredients.name: swordfish steak
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 lb. swordfish steaks (also good with tuna, shark, salmon, chicken or flank steak)

steps: Preheat broiler.
Combine jam and mustard in a small bowl. Spread half of glaze evenly over one side of steaks.
Broil about 4-inches from heat for 4 to 6 minutes per side, depending on thickness of steaks or fillets, or until fish is opaque in center and begins to flake when touched with fork.
Spread steaks with remaining glaze after turning over.
Cut into 4 equal portions if necessary.
To serve, garnish steaks with shredded radish.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Candied Fruit Slices

ingredients.name: candied cherry in half
ingredients.raw: 2 c. candied cherries, cut in half

steps: Cream butter.
Gradually add powdered sugar.
Blend in egg and vanilla.
Add flour; mix well.
Stir in pecan halves and candied cherries.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Divide dough into thirds. Shape into rolls 12-inches long (3).
Wrap in waxed paper.
Chill at least 3 hours.
Cut into 1/4-inch slices and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Grandma Janie'S Fruit Salad
steps: Clean, cut, cube and seed all fruits.
Place in a large bowl and toss carefully to avoid mashing the fruits.

title: Low Calorie Cheeseburger Pie

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. cooked beef or ground turkey

steps: Brown meat, onion and pepper.
Add spices and tomato sauce. Mix well.
Add rice.
Mix well.
Add 1/2 of cheese and stir until cheese melts.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Then add rest of cheese and bake 15 minutes more.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chad'S Tasty Skinny Pancakes
steps: Mix milk, egg whites and maple flavoring.
Add wheat flour and white flour.
(Possible to have all white flour.) Grill and enjoy.

title: Tropical Cherry Dump Cake
steps: Pour pie filling and crushed pineapple into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Mix together and spread evenly over the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over fruit mixture.
Pat down lightly.
Pour melted butter over cake mix; sprinkle on layer of chopped pecans, as thick as you like and top with layer of coconut, as thick as you like.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
steps: Prepare mashed potatoes with butter and milk as usual to taste.
Add remaining ingredients and blend together with mixture. Fold into buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Tomato Pudding

ingredients.name: bread in
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh bread, cut in 2-inch squares

steps: Mix tomato puree, 1/2 cup boiling water, brown sugar and salt and boil 10 minutes.
Put bread in buttered casserole.
Pour 1/2 cup melted butter over bread.
Add tomato mix.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes, covered, in 300° oven.
Only tomato puree works.

title: Salsa Cheese Dip
steps: In skillet, fry sausage until done and crumbly.
In medium-size bowl, microwave Velveeta cheese until creamy.
Remove from microwave.
Add salsa, onions and sausage.
Stir well.
This will keep in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Butter Mints
steps: Combine all ingredients and beat at low speed until well blended.
Add small amount of food color and knead until blended. Press mixture into mint molds or roll into small balls and flatten slightly.

title: English Meat Pie
steps: Cut stew meat into small to medium squares.
Put into an oven-safe casserole dish or pot.
Chop up onion and put in with meat.
Add salt, pepper and bouillon cube and completely cover with water.
Cook in oven for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours on about 250° to 300°.
The slower you cook it the more tender the meat will be. Let cool, then put all the meat into a pie shell, covering the meat with the broth.
Put on top pie shell and place on a cookie sheet.
Cook at 425° until pie crust is brown.

title: Bonnie'S Scotch Shortbread

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: about 7 c. flour (depending upon how much the butter will take up)

steps: Mix the ingredients.
Pat into a pie plate or rectangular pan to depth of 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch.
Prick entire surface with a fork. Bake at 250° for 1 hour or until pale brown.
If baked in pie pan, cut into wedges to serve.
One-half the recipe fits into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
If baked in rectangular pan, cut into small rectangular pieces.
Very rich!

title: Bad Bars
steps: Combine ingredients in a large mixing bowl in order listed. Blend, using mixer.
Pour in greased baking pan.
Cover with chocolate chips.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

title: Hearty Hodgepodge

ingredients.name: bean and pork in tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (31 oz.) can beans and pork in tomato sauce

steps: In large saucepan, cook beef, onion and garlic until beef is browned and onion is tender.
Stir in minestone soup, beans and pork, 3 1/2 cups of water, the celery, Worcestershire sauce and oregano.
Simmer, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Turnips And Onion
steps: Wash and peel turnips and onion.
In a large skillet, put 2 tablespoons of margarine or oil.
Add grated turnips and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Saute for about 10 minutes or until turnips and onion are tender.

title: Penne Gold

ingredients.name: pancetta
ingredients.raw: 4 slice pancetta (Italian bacon) or Prosciutto (Italian ham)

ingredients.name: italian plum tomato with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (35 oz.) can Italian peeled plum tomatoes with juice

steps: Brown pancetta and garlic in olive oil over medium heat in a large frying pan (7 minutes).
Add tomatoes with liquid, salt and pepper flakes and boil, breaking up tomatoes for 30 minutes or until thick, stirring frequently.
Cook penne in large pot of boiling water until al dente.
Drain pasta.
Put back in pot.
Add sauce and mix to coat.
Add cheese; mix well.
Serve.
Enjoy!

title: Easy Salad

ingredients.name: tall can pineapple and juice
ingredients.raw: 1 tall can crushed pineapple and juice

steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Cool and blend cream cheese in jello.
Chill.
While soft add crushed pineapple and juice.
Add nuts and Cool Whip.
Chill thoroughly in Pyrex dish or molds.

title: Simple Jello Dessert

ingredients.name: fruit cocktail
ingredients.raw: 1 large can fruit cocktail, or other fruit

steps: Make jello as directed on box, add fruit and let gel completely.
Spread whipped topping over and serve.

title: Bohemian Peach Slices
steps: Drain peaches well.
Beat egg whites (set aside).
Cream margarine and sugar; beat well.
Add egg yolks, beat; add flour and vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour batter in 9 x 13-inch pan, lightly greased and spread evenly.
Lay sliced peaches on batter, putting them close together.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until nicely browned.
Let stand 5 minutes, then sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Never cover, as it will get soggy.
You may use any canned fruit.

title: Freezer Sweet Dill Pickles

ingredients.name: unwaxed cucumber
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. (3-inch long) unwaxed cucumbers, cut into 1/8 inch slices (equals 4 c., sliced)

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 3/4 lb. onion, cut into 1/8 inch slices

ingredients.name: dill
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. dried dill or more to taste

steps: In a large bowl layer cucumbers and onion.
Sprinkle with salt and water and toss gently.
Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours. Drain very well.
In small saucepan combine sugar, vinegar and dried dill.
Heat gently (do not boil) until sugar is melted, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and allow to cool.
Pack drained vegetables in freezer containers and pour liquid over to cover.
Freeze; will be ready to eat as soon as they are defrosted.

title: Cooked Cole Slaw Dressing
steps: Beat the eggs with sugar.
Add vinegar, butter, dry mustard, salt and pepper to taste.
Cook in double boiler until thick. Thin with cream to use.
Keeps real good in refrigerator.

title: Trace Creek Stag Night Potatoes(Aka Hash Brown Potato Casserole)

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

ingredients.name: american cheese
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. grated American cheese or 8 oz. shredded Cheddar cheese

steps: Place potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix 1/2 cup melted butter, cream of chicken soup, grated cheese, sour cream, salt, pepper and onion.
Pour over potatoes.
Top with cornflakes and drizzle 1/2 cup melted butter over all.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken Blue Ola Cord(Ham And Cheese Rolls)

ingredients.name: half chicken breast and pounded very
ingredients.raw: 4 halves chicken breast, boneless and pounded very thin

steps: Cut ham slices in half; cut a piece of chicken to fit ham and top with a slice of cheese.
Roll up all items; hold together with toothpicks.
Dip in milk, then flour, then egg.
Roll in corn flake crumbs.
Brown in oil.
Place in glass dish.
Top each roll with a pat of butter.
Add a little water to dish.
Cover with foil.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Zucchini Scallop
steps: Layer zucchini, crackers, onion and cheese in a 2 quart casserole.
Combine milk and egg.
Pour over zucchini mixture. Pour melted margarine over all.
Sprinkle with pepper.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Crumbles
steps: Spread pie filling in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix dry cake mix with melted butter and stir until crumbly.
Sprinkle crumbs over pie filling and do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is golden.

title: Sugar Free Hot Chocolate
steps: After mixed, use 1/4 c. more of mix to 1 c. hot water.
Makes 1 cup.

title: Matrimonial Squares
steps: Measure dry ingredients into large bowl and cut butter into it until crumbly.
Press half of crumbs into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. (Make this a large half.)

title: Four Fruit Salad
steps: Combine reserved juices and measure 3/4 cup.
Set aside.
Mix cornstarch, sugar and orange juice and the reserved fruit juices. Stir on stove in pan until thick.
Cool.
Add all the fruit and mix well.
Pour into covered dish and refrigerate several hours. Best left overnight.

title: Flavorful Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 8 x 4-inch loaf pan, combine ground beef, milk and soup mix, mixing with fork.
When thoroughly blended, pat loaf evenly in pan.
Mixture will be very moist. Combine brown sugar, mustard and ketchup.
Spoon over unbaked loaf.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until done.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Southern Okra And Tomato

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 3 tomatoes, peeled and quartered or canned tomatoes

steps: Cook okra in boiling salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain some. Brown onion and green pepper in oil.
Add tomatoes and cook slowly 5 minutes.
Add okra and remaining ingredients.
Cook over low heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Beets In Orange Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients except beets.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Pour over cooked beets and serve.

title: Haselnuss-Stangen(Austrian)
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks, flour and hazelnuts.
Roll dough into bars about the size of a finger and cut into 3-inch pieces.
Brush with a beaten egg and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Eggs Delight
steps: Beat eggs.
Add flour, baking powder and butter; mix well. Add cheese and chilies.
Bake in well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 375° for 15 minutes or 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Quick Vichyssoise

ingredients.name: packaged instant mashed potato
ingredients.raw: packaged instant mashed potatoes (enough for 4 servings)

ingredients.name: whipped cream cheese with onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. whipped cream cheese with onion

steps: Combine water, snipped parsley and the chicken bouillon cubes in a saucepan.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring until the bouillon cubes dissolve.
Remove from heat; add light cream.
Stir in instant mashed potatoes.
Cool at room temperature for 15 minutes.

title: Hunter'S Chicken
steps: Cut chicken in serving pieces.
Saute in oil until well browned and tender, about 25 minutes.
Remove from pan and keep warm.
In the same pan, saute mushrooms and onion.
Add tomato paste and herbs.
Cook about 4 minutes, then pour over the chicken.
Serve with boiled noodles with poppy seed and a green salad.

title: Baked Cornish Hen With Honey Sauce
steps: Wash hens and remove giblets to use for gravy or stuffing. Season hens inside and out with salt and pepper.
Place in roasting pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Mix honey and Worcestershire sauce together.
After the first 30 minutes, baste hens every 10 minutes with mixture.

title: Sawdust Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together and stir by hand.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in preheated 325° oven until glossy and set (about 25 to 30 minutes).
Do not overbake.
Serve warm with sliced bananas and whipped cream.
Serves 8.

title: Favorite Brownies
steps: Melt butter.
Remove from heat and add sugar and cocoa.
Add eggs, beating well after each.
Add flour, salt, vanilla and nuts. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad With Lemon Sauce
steps: Mix pudding and pineapple together and allow to sit for 5 minutes.
Add fruit cocktail and strawberries.
Mix gently and chill before serving.

title: Luau Spread
steps: Beat eggs with sugar and vinegar.
Melt butter in frying pan and scramble eggs until dry and mealy, about 10 minutes.
Add egg mixture to softened cream cheese.
Add onion and olives.
Chill. Serve on crackers.

title: Bakers Frosting
steps: Cook and stir cornstarch and milk until thick.
Cool. Combine butter, Crisco, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Beat well until sugar is well dissolved.
Add to cooked and cooled mixture and beat together.

title: Delicious Corn Bread
steps: Pour meal mix, flour, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl.
Beat eggs slightly, add to meal mixture with enough milk to make a fairly thin batter.
Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan or whatever size you have.
Use grease from sides and dribble over top, bake in hot oven at 450° until done, test with knife blade or toothpick to be sure it is baked inside.

title: Peppermint Ice Cream
steps: Place milk in top of a large double boiler.
Bring water to a boil. Cook until milk is thoroughly heated. Remove from heat. Set aside.

title: Partridge In A Pear Tree Pie

ingredients.name: pineapple reserve syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained, reserve syrup

ingredients.name: pear half and in half
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can pear halves, drained and cut in halves

steps: Cook cranberries, 1 1/2 cups sugar, the pineapple and 1/4 cup of the reserved syrup, stirring constantly, until cranberries are tender about 5 minutes.
Cool; prepare pastry.
Mix flour, salt and cinnamon.
Stir into cranberry mixture.
Pour into pastry lined pie plate.
Gently press pear halves spoke fashion onto cranberry mixture.
Heat oven to 400°.
After rolling pastry for top crust put partridge leaf and pear shapes.
Sprinkle with sugar if desired.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake until pastry cut outs and pie crust are golden brown 7 to 10 minutes for cut outs and about 40 for pie.
Arrange cut outs on pie.

title: Mom'S Harvard Beets
steps: Melt butter in low heated skillet.
Make a paste of sugar, salt, vinegar, water and cornstarch.
Mix together.
Add canned beets.
Stir and let simmer until heated through.

title: Seashell Salad
steps: Combine ingredients in a large bowl.
Add pepper and Season-All to taste.

title: Old Fashioned Buttermilk Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Beat butter and sugar in large mixing bowl.
Stir in eggs, flour, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake until the tip of a knife inserted in the center comes out clean, about 45 minutes.
Cool slightly before serving.

title: Country Cornbread

ingredients.name: shedd s spread country crock
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. (1 1/2 sticks) Shedd's Spread Country Crock

steps: Combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl, mixing well.
Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Add to dry mixture and stir with a wooden spoon until just moistened.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches

ingredients.name: beef roast
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. beef roast, cooked or 2 cans beef, cooked and drained (two 28 oz. cans or 2 1/2 size can)

steps: Slice beef roast; mix with sauce.
Heat thoroughly.
Make several hours ahead so the sauce can flavor the meat.
Reheat and serve.

title: A No Bake Cheese Cake
steps: Cream together until smooth.
Then fold in 8 ounce carton of Cool Whip.
Add 2 teaspoons of vanilla (optional).
Put in graham cracker crust and chill for 4 to 5 hours.
(May top with fruit filling.)

title: Egg Dick
steps: Do it!!
Toast bread and cut into cubes; saute onions and set aside.
Then use the same skillet for sausage.
Cook sausage and crumble like meat for spaghetti.
Drain grease.
Mix together eggs, mustard and 2 cups of milk.
Layer slices of broken pieced bread along baking dish, 13 x 9-inch.
On top of bread, layer onions, cheese and sausage.
Before baking, take 1/2 cup of milk and thin out the cream of mushroom soup.
Pour that over the rest. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours, then enjoy!!

title: Poor Man'S Dinner
steps: Brown ground beef.
Slice potatoes and onions, thinly.
Layer in a baking dish or pan, starting with ground beef, then potatoes and onion.
Pour soup over the mixture and bake at 400° for 1 hour or until onions and potatoes are tender.

title: Pepperminties
steps: Two hours before serving or early in the day:
Into large bowl, measure flour, sugar, margarine, baking powder, salt, egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until well blended.
Shape into ball.
Preheat oven to 325°.
On lightly floured surface, roll half of dough in 12 x 6-inch rectangle.
Cut lengthwise into 4 strips, then cut each strip crosswise into 6 pieces.
Place rectangles about 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until lightly browned.
Remove to wire racks to cool.
Repeat with remaining dough.

title: Potatoes Boulangere
steps: Cook onions in butter for 5 minutes, or until soft and golden. Add potatoes, consomme, salt, pepper and marjoram.
Cook, covered, over lowest possible heat, for 25 to 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Corned Beef Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients, except parsley, together in a large bowl.
Form into small balls and roll in parsley.
Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Casserole

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.raw: 1 c. tuna or 1 lb. hamburger, cooked

steps: Combine in a bowl the noodles, tuna or hamburger and cream of mushroom soup.
Add milk and seasonings to taste.
Place in cake pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and cook until melted.

title: Oven Barbecued Spareribs
steps: Cut ribs into serving size (3 to 4 per person).
Place in single layer, meaty side up, in a shallow baking pan.
Add 1 slice of lemon and 1 slice onion on each piece.
Bake at 450° for 30 minutes.

title: Wicked Punch
steps: Mix
all together and pour over ice ring in punch bowl. Great for weddings.

title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
steps: Beat together cake mix, melted oleo and 1/3 cup evaporated milk.
Stir peanuts into mixture and press 1/2 of it in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.
Melt caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in double boiler.
After cake comes out of oven, sprinkle chocolate chips on top and pour caramel mix on top.
Crumble remaining 1/2 cake mix on top.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Nebraska Pie Crust(3 Double Crusts)
steps: Cut Crisco into flour, salt and sugar. Mix well the water, egg and vinegar. Add to dry and mix. Cover tightly and refrigerate until chilled. (May be frozen.)
Roll each crust on floured board.

title: Louisiana Yam Pie
steps: Mash sweet potatoes until free of lumps.
Add sugar, cinnamon, allspice and salt.
Beat eggs; add to mixture and cream well. Blend milk and butter.
Mix well.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Buttermilk Dinner Rolls

ingredients.name: soft butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. soft butter or part shortening

steps: Add crumbled yeast and sugar to lukewarm buttermilk.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Add melted butter, salt and soda.
Beat well and add half the flour and unbeaten eggs.
Beat well.
Add remaining flour to make a stiff dough.
Let rise until double in bulk.
Shape in rolls.
Let rise again.
Grease muffin pans good. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Barbecue Muffins
steps: Separate dough into 10 biscuits.
Flatten into 5-inch circles. Place each one in the bottom and sides of a greased muffin pan. Set pan aside.
Brown ground meat and drain well.
Mix brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar and chili powder.
Stir until smooth.
Add to meat and mix well.
Divide meat mixture among biscuit lined pan (about 1/4-cup) for each.
Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Dieter'S Delite Angel Food Cake
steps: Pour egg whites into a large bowl; warm to room temperature, about 1 hour.
Measure sifted flour with 3/4 cup sugar; re-sift. Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat (at medium speed) egg whites with salt and tartar until stiff peaks form.
At high speed, beat in 1 cup sugar (1/4 cup at a time), beating well after each addition. Sprinkle 1/4 cup flour mixture over whites.
Fold in 15 strokes with a wire whisk until all flour disappears.
Continue until all flour mixture is gone.
Gently push in ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Remove all air bubbles with a knife through batter.
Smooth top of cake.

title: Basic Marinade
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Works best for London Broil steak.
Let marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours.
Barbecue grill to your liking.

title: Sugar Cookies(Easy, Old-Fashioned)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°. Mix oleo and sugar.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Add flour and all dry ingredients.
Bake in ungreased pan for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Cakes(Good And Quick For Lent)

ingredients.name: salmon
ingredients.raw: 1 can salmon (red or pink; deboned, optional)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Form into patties about the size of your hand.
Fry in oil until golden brown on both sides. Serve with cheesy noodles and a green veggie or salad.
Serves 2 to 3.
Doubles nicely.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate-Peanut Butter Balls

ingredients.name: chunky peanut butter
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chunky peanut butter (18 oz. jar)

steps: Blend well the margarine and chunky peanut butter.
Add confectioners sugar and Rice Krispies.
Mix well.
Refrigerate a couple of hours.

title: B~B~Q Potatoes
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes.
Cook until tender.
Drain off water and add 1/2 stick butter.
Mix together the other 1/2 of butter (melted), vinegar, paprika, sugar, catsup and BBQ sauce.
Heat and pour over potatoes.

title: Mrs. Field'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl and set aside. Cream the sugars and the softened butter.
Add the eggs and the vanilla.
Add the flour mixture and beat thoroughly.
Stir in the chocolate chips by hand.
Bake at 300° for 20 to 24 minutes.

title: Skillet Burgers
steps: Brown beef, onions and peppers.
Add rest of ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover and simmer about 1/2 hour.

title: Fluffy Apple Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients in order listed.
Makes a great salad or dessert.

title: Easy Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use oblong baking dish.
Melt butter in baking dish.
While still hot, pour fruit for cobbler into hot butter.
Mix flour, sugar and milk; mix well and pour over fruit. Bake until golden brown.

title: Baked Cream Cheese Appetizer

ingredients.name: refrigerated crescent dinner roll
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls

ingredients.name: dill weed
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tsp. minced, fresh dill weed or 1/2 tsp. dried whole dill weed

ingredients.name: dill weed sprig
ingredients.raw: fresh dill weed sprig for garnish

steps: Unroll dough on a lightly floured surface; press seams together to form a 12 x 4-inch rectangle.
Sprinkle and gently press minced dill weed onto top of cream cheese.
Place cream cheese, dill weed side down, in center of dough.
Bring up sides of dough snugly around cheese, pinching to seal.
Place seam side down on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Brush with egg yolk.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 22 minutes.
Garnish, if desired.
Serve warm with crackers.
Yields 16 appetizer servings.

title: Tuna Pot Pie(Serves 6)

ingredients.name: pea and carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots

ingredients.name: cream of potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of potato or cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: poultry seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning or dried thyme

steps: Line 9-inch pie pan with one crust.
Set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients; salt and pepper to taste.
Pour filling into pie pan.
Top with second crust.
Seal and crimp edges.
Slit top of crust to vent.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sizzling Sausage Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: hillshire farm smoked sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hillshire Farm smoked sausage or Polska kielbasa

ingredients.name: or vegetable
ingredients.raw: 3 1/4 c. fresh or frozen chopped vegetables (like broccoli, carrots, onion, mushrooms)

steps: Cook rice and keep warm.
Saute vegetables in oil until crisp-tender.
Add sausage and season to taste.
Heat thoroughly. Mix in 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and serve immediately over warm rice, sprinkling with remaining Parmesan cheese.

title: Hot Fudge Topping
steps: Bring to a boil over medium heat the milk, sugar, cocoa and salt.
Boil for 5 minutes; don't beat.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Mix well but do not beat.
Pour into bowl and serve warm.
Can be reheated or served cold by adding milk and mixing well.

title: Crab And Pepper Hash

ingredients.name: red potato and fourth
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. small red potatoes, cooked and cut into fourths

ingredients.name: crabmeat thawed and cartilage removed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. frozen crabmeat, thawed, drained and cartilage removed or salad style imitation crabmeat, thawed

steps: Heat margarine in a 10-inch skillet until melted.
Cook onion, bell pepper and garlic in margarine over medium heat, stirring in remaining ingredients.
Cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until hot.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Spiced Shrimp
steps: Bring water and seasoning to boil.
Add shrimp.
When the water returns to boil, remove from heat and drain.
Chill until ready to serve.

title: Red Pepper Vegetable Dip

ingredients.name: hidden valley original ranch mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley original Ranch mix

ingredients.name: bottled pimento
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. diced, bottled pimentos or red peppers, drained

steps: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Best if chilled overnight. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Miracle Whip Pound Cake
steps: Cream together the Crisco, margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time. Alternate flour and milk until used up. Add vanilla. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Cream Sauce
steps: Melt butter and remove from heat.
Stir in flour.
Put back on heat and stir.
When smooth, add milk and salt.
Stir constantly. Serve with vegetables.

title: Holiday Fruit Salad
steps: Whip the cream in a large glass bowl; add sugar and vanilla. Mix well.
Drain fruit cocktail, pineapple and mandarin oranges until all liquid is completely drained off.
Add fruit to whipped cream and mix.
Add marshmallows and pecans and mix.
Chill in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Christmas Pickles

ingredients.name: prepared horseradish
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. prepared horseradish or 1 tsp. powdered horseradish

steps: Drain pickles and discard liquid.
Slice each pickle lengthwise into quarters.
As you repack the pickle strips into the jar, add remaining ingredients, alternating with pickles.

title: Pistachio Loaf
steps: Mix cake mix and pudding together dry.
Pour oil, water, eggs and sour cream.
Beat; set aside.
Mix in small bowl sugar and cinnamon.
Grease 2 large loaf pans.
Layer cake mixture, then sugar/cinnamon mixture, making 3 layers, cinnamon/sugar last. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Excellent!!!!

title: Stuffed Buns
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread on buns; wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: New Potato Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes until done.
In 8 x 12-inch casserole, layer sliced potatoes; sprinkle with
salt.
Add cheese, onions and butter, then bacon.
Repeat layers, ending with bacon.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni and drain well.
Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, egg, salt and pepper.
Add Cheddar cheese and mix well. Stir in cooked macaroni.
Pour into a greased 4-quart baking dish; sprinkle with paprika.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Relish Recital

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Cover; refrigerate. Yields 6 servings.

title: Banana Butter
steps: First, prepare the fruit.
Mash thoroughly about 10 ripe bananas.
Measure 3 cups into a very large saucepan.
Squeeze the juice from 1 medium lemon; measure 2 tablespoons into the pan. Add maraschino cherries.

title: Fancy Freeze
steps: Let ice cream soften.
Swirl in syrup and chips.
Re-freeze.

title: Strawberry Mousse Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
When dissolved, add cold water. Blend mayonnaise, lemon juice and salt and add to gelatin mixture, beating thoroughly.
Chill until partially set, then whip fluffy. Fold in strawberries.
Pour into a mold and chill several hours.

title: Bean And Beef Bake(Origin: American)
steps: Brown beef in butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put in casserole and put bacon on top. Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

title: Kid'S Size Mini Pizzas
steps: Remove biscuits from can.
Separate the biscuits between the flakes.
(One can should make 20 small pizzas.)
Grease pan and flatten biscuit out.
Spray with butter.
Spoon sauce onto biscuits; add toppings.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Crispy Parmesan Potatoes

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. (1/2 stick) butter or margarine, melted

steps: In medium-sized saucepan, cover potatoes with water.
Place over high heat.
Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Slice potatoes and layer in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with almonds and green onions.
Drizzle with butter or margarine and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Skimpy Shrimp
steps: Butter a small casserole dish.
Add first four ingredients. Beat mushroom pieces, mustard, eggs, milk and onion; pour over first mixture.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Serves 2.
Double shrimp, bread dressing, eggs and milk for four.

title: Cauliflower Carrot Salad
steps: Clean cauliflower.
Cut into flowerets.
Peel and slice carrots.
Mix Miracle Whip, sugar, vinegar, salt and pepper to taste.
Add cauliflower and carrots.
Mix until well coated.
Add a couple shakes of Parmesan cheese.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
steps: Mix well and chill.
Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Thai Noodle Salad

ingredients.name: green onion hollow green top discarded
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch scallions, hollow green tops discarded

steps: Mix together in large serving bowl first 5 ingredients to make dressing.
While cooking linguine according to package directions, wash scallions and slice thinly on the diagonal. Trim and wash snow peas.
Drain cooked linguine, add to dressing in bowl and toss well.
Toss in scallions and snow peas.
Toast sesame seed to golden brown in heavy skillet over moderate heat, stirring often.
Toss into salad.
Serve warm or chilled.

title: Buttermilk Bread
steps: Grease two 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
In large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt, baking soda and yeast; blend well.
In small saucepan, heat buttermilk, water and 1/2 cup margarine until very warm (120° to 130°).
(Mixture will look curdled).
Add warm liquid to flour mixture.
Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed.
Stir in an additional 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl.
On floured surface, knead in 1/2 to 1 cup flour until dough is smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Place dough in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel.
Let rise in warm place (80° to 85°) until light and doubled in size, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mama'S Shortcake
steps: Cream the margarine and sugar.
Blend in egg.
Mix flour and baking powder together and blend with creamed mixture.
Add milk a little at a time, blend well after each addition.
Grease or Pam spray two 9 x 13-inch cookie sheets, then flour dust them.
Divide dough in half and place half of dough on each cookie sheet. Sprinkle all over with flour because dough is very sticky.
Pat dough out flat and as thin as possible, about 1/4 inch thick. Poke holes in dough with a fork and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Watch carefully as this will overcook easily.
Cool. Cut in half and layer with strawberries and top with whipped topping.
The best!

title: Orange Rolls
steps: Prepare dough.
When ready to shape, combine sugar, grated rind and raisins.
Divide dough in half.
Roll out each half to an 18 x 9-inch rectangle.
Brush with melted margarine.
Sprinkle with sugar mixture.
Roll up from long sides.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch slices and place in 2 greased 9-inch cake pans.
Cover and let rise in warm place free from draft until double in bulk, about 1 hour.
Bake at 375° for about 20 to 25 minutes (check time, lightly brown).
Remove from pans and frost immediately with Orange Icing.

title: Bark Candy

ingredients.name: cap n crunch peanut butter cereal
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Cap'n Crunch peanut butter cereal

steps: Melt bark in double boiler or microwave.
Pour over all other ingredients and stir until coated.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
Work quickly, as bark will begin to set.
If this occurs, set the bowl in warm water for a few minutes and stir again.
(It is easier to make this in 2 batches by halving the ingredients.) Allow to cool and set, then store in airtight container.

title: Round Steak Above Average
steps: Trim and cut round steak into serving size pieces; salt and pepper.
Turn in flour and brown in frying pan (I like to use Corning Ware so I can serve in it, too).
Sprinkle on onion soup mix.
Add tomato sauce and one tomato sauce can of water.
Scrub and cut sideways (slices about 1/4-inch thick) 4 or 5 potatoes and layer on top.
Salt and pepper potatoes and bake at 350° about 45 minutes.
Serves 4.

title: Beef Wellington

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 1 large fillet of beef, trimmed (feeds 10 adults)

steps: Sprinkle beef with garlic powder.
At oven temperature of 325°, cook beef approximately 15 minutes per pound (approximately 1 1/2 hours).
When beef is cooked, wrap in aluminum foil and let sit for 1/2 hour.
Right before serving, drape Virginia baked ham over beef.
Drape Pillsbury crescent rolls on top of ham.
Whip egg and milk together and spread a little on top of crescent rolls.
Cook in 350° oven for approximately 15 minutes.
Slice and serve.

title: Chop Suey

ingredients.name: lean beef and pork
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. lean beef and pork (1/2 each)

steps: Cube meat, flour and brown.
Add small amount of water and simmer until done.
Cook onions and celery in salted water until done.
Add celery, onions, vegetables and bean sprouts to meat. Add soy sauce and brown gravy sauce; thicken with cornstarch.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Pixies
steps: Melt chocolate in the top of a double boiler over simmering water or in a small saucepan over very low heat.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Combine oil, chocolate and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each addition.
Add vanilla; add sifted ingredients to chocolate mixture and blend thoroughly.
Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Cashew-Parmesan Fish Fillets
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In jelly roll pan or large, shallow, rimmed baking pan, melt butter in oven.
Meanwhile, in pie plate, beat egg slightly.
On waxed paper, combine cheese and flour.
Dip each fillet in egg; coat both sides with cheese mixture.
Remove pan from oven; add 3 tablespoons salad oil to butter.
Swirl to blend.
Arrange fillets in pan, turning to coat with butter mixture.
Sprinkle fillets with chopped cashews.
Bake on top rack 10 minutes.
Garnish fillets with lemon wedges.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Cavatina

ingredients.name: mixed pasta
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. mixed pastas (at least 4 different types, such as small shells, small corkscrews, small elbow macaroni, thin egg noodles, etc.)

steps: Mix the different pasta together and cook in boiling water until tender.
While pasta is cooking, brown ground beef in skillet.
Remove beef from skillet and use drippings to saute bell pepper and onion slices until tender.
Add mushroom slices and heat thoroughly.
Drain off excess drippings from vegetables.
In large casserole dish, layer the following:
Pasta mixture, vegetables, beef, pepperoni, cheese and sauce.
Repeat layers, ending with cheese on top.
Bake at 350° until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted.
Serve with French bread and a green salad.
Serves 8.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: pasteurized process american cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 c. (1 lb.) cubed pasteurized process American cheese

ingredients.name: natural cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded natural Cheddar cheese

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. ground beef, cooked, crumbled and drained

steps: In 3-quart saucepan, combine all ingredients except tortilla chips.
Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until melted (12 to 15 minutes).
Serve with tortilla chips.
Yields 3 cups.

title: Fluffy Pink Salad
steps: In large bowl mix all ingredients together.
Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and refrigerate.

title: Magic-Quick Chocolate Frosting
steps: In heavy saucepan, combine chocolate and Eagle Brand.
Over low heat, cook and stir until chocolate melts and mixture thickens (about 10 minutes).
Remove from heat.
Stir in water and cool. Stir in vanilla.
Use to frost 1 (8 or 9-inch) 2-layer cake. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Rhubarb Pudding
steps: Mix above ingredients together.
Spread 1/2 mixture into 1 quart baking dish.
Put in rhubarb and 1 1/2 cups sugar.
Spread remaining batter on top.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Cheeseburger Loaves

ingredients.name: american cheese in half diagonally
ingredients.raw: 3 slices American cheese, cut in half diagonally

steps: Measure corn flakes cereal.
Crush to 1 cup and place in large mixing bowl.
Add egg, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Beat well.
Add ground beef.
Mix only until combined.

title: Summer Tea
steps: Brew tea bags in boiling water for 5 minutes, then add remaining ingredients.
Chill before serving.

title: Bernie Shay'S Impossible Pie
steps: Melt oleo.
Add sugar, eggs, Bisquick, vanilla and coconut. Add milk.
Bake at 350° until firm in regular pie pan.

title: Albondigas
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Shape into 1-inch balls and place in ungreased shallow baking dish.
Broil 20 minutes.

title: Asparagus-Pea Casserole
steps: Layer asparagus, peas, egg, soup and cheese.
Top with onion rings.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Style Croquettes
steps: Grind slices of soyameat and hard-cooked eggs.
Saute onion in margarine and add to egg mixture.
Add Mocha Mix and seasonings. Shape into croquettes and roll in crumbs.
Bake in 350° oven until lightly browned, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes And Pasta
steps: Saute shallots and garlic in olive oil until soft (not brown). Add wine and tomatoes.
Bring to boil over medium-high heat and reduce heat.
Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Powdered Sugar Pound Cake
steps: Sift sugar and set aside. Sift unmeasured flour, then measure 2 1/2 cups and sift again. Set aside. Cream margarine, add sugar gradually. Beat this until it is light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time. Reduce mixer speed and begin adding flour gradually. before adding all the flour, mix in lemon extract. Gently put in tube pan.

Bake one hour to one hour and ten minutes. Remove from oven when cake pulls from side of pan. Tilt pan from side to side to loosen cake. Place cake rack on top of cake and flip. Gently lift off pan. Pour glaze on hot cake.

title: Hot Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 6 Tbsp. (1/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp.) butter or margarine, melted

steps: Cook chicken, without salt, until done. Shred into small pieces.
Make roux out of butter, flour, salt and pepper (blend together over low heat until bubbly).
Remove from heat and stir in chicken broth.
Bring to boil; boil 1 minute.
Stir in 2 cups shredded chicken and celery.
The celery will stay rather crisp. Makes enough to fill 15 sandwiches, depending on the size of buns.

title: Blackburn'S Pecan Pie
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat eggs and remaining ingredients for filling. Stir in pecans.
Pour into pastry lined pan.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes until filling is set.

title: Bavarian Torte
steps: Mix butter and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients and press into bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°, cool.

title: Sugarless Cake
steps: Heat milk and melt marshmallows.
Then add all other ingredients.
Pack in pan.
First cover pan with wax paper.
Put in refrigerator.

title: Spicy Catfish
steps: Pour mustard into a large mixing bowl.
Add fish; turn to coat.
Remove fish from mustard and place on a pan.
Sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and paprika.
Spray grill with nonstick vegetable spray.
Place fish directly on grill or use fish basket.
Turn once.
Cook until fish flakes easily with a fork, approximately 12 minutes.
Cook over medium coals.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
steps: Wash cucumbers and cut in sticks.
Cover with boiling water and let stand 4 to 5 hours.
Drain and pack solidly into pint jars.
Mix remaining ingredients in pan, bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.
Pour over cukes, filling within 1/2-inch of top.
Put on lids and rings.
Process 5 minutes.

title: Bacon Layered Salad
steps: Layer lettuce in the bottom of a large salad bowl (glass makes very pretty salad).
Sprinkle sugar, salt and pepper over lettuce. Slice or chop eggs on top of lettuce.
Layer lettuce again. Sprinkle with salt, sugar and pepper.
Add bacon (crumbled) layer. On top of bacon, add layer of Swiss cheese.
Spread 1 cup mayonnaise on top of cheese.
Can sit overnight for more flavor.

title: Crunch Top Pound Cake
steps: Beat sugar and butter.
Add 1 egg at a time.
Add a little flour and whipping cream, alternately.
Add vanilla.
Bake 1 hour and 40 minutes in a cold oven at 300°.

title: Pioneer Potato Candy

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. grated lemon or orange rind

steps: Combine potatoes and margarine.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat thoroughly.
Add remainings.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.
Let set until firm.

title: Vegetable Ball

ingredients.name: pineapple squeezed and
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple, squeezed and drained

steps: Mix all above ingredients, except nuts.
Chill until you can form into a ball.
Roll in chopped nuts.
Serve with crackers.

title: Congealed Strawberry-Pineapple Salad
steps: Dissolve 2 pkg. strawberry gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Mix half of dissolved gelatin with crushed pineapple (undrained) and bananas.
Put in refrigerator to thicken.
When thickened, spread sour cream on top.
Mix reserved gelatin with package of strawberries and put on top of sour cream.
Return to refrigerator to thicken.

title: Fish Roll
steps: Roll biscuit dough to 1/4-inch thick on floured board. Combine fish and onion and moisten slightly with mayonnaise.
Mix and spread on dough.
Roll this dough and mixture into a jelly roll and cut into 1 1/2-inch slices.
Bake on greased baking sheet at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mexican Beef Dip
steps: Brown ground beef; drain and add taco seasoning mix.
Set aside.
Warm refried beans in bottom of a medium size rectangular pan.
Cover beans with sour cream, then spoon ground beef mixture over the sour cream.
Melt Velveeta cheese with Ro-Tel tomatoes; pour over the entire pan.
Serve with taco chips and watch it disappear.
(This can be prepared ahead of time, just simple heat in microwave until good and hot.)

title: Easy Baked Chicken Breast
steps: Note:
As many as you wish boneless chicken breasts.

title: Easy Goulash Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown hamburger and onion.
Drain off fat and add to the other ingredients.
Put mixture in greased casserole and bake, covered, for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter "Tastycake"

ingredients.name: milk chocolate
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. milk chocolate or 3 oz. semi-sweet chocolate bits

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine milk and butter in a saucepan and heat to the boiling point.
Remove from heat and set aside to cool.

title: Our Favorite Red Cabbage
steps: Put drippings into skillet.
Melt.
Add cabbage, sugar, water, salt, pepper and vinegar.
Stir to blend.
Cover pan and simmer 30 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Almond Punch
steps: Combine in large bowl and serve.
Or pour in pitcher and pour over crushed or shaved ice.

title: Poppy Seed Lemon Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 small loaves.

title: Gameburger Casserole

ingredients.name: or can cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of celery soup

steps: Take ground meat from any game animal and brown a little in pan.
Then put in casserole.
Slice onion on this and fill casserole with potatoes.
Salt and pepper.
Over this, pour soup. Bake until potatoes are tender.

title: Barbecue Beer Chicken
steps: Put chicken in baking dish.
Place onion and pepper on top. Mix rest of ingredients; pour over chicken.
Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Orange Cake
steps: Cream eggs, sugar and butter.
Add alternately dry ingredients and milk.
Bake at 350° until it tests done (approximately 1/2 hour).
Makes 3 layers.

title: Penne With Tomatoes And Balsamic Vinegar

ingredients.name: garlic clove very
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 garlic cloves, sliced very thin

ingredients.name: italian plum tomato and
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Italian plum tomatoes, peeled and drained

ingredients.name: penne
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. penne or other short, tubular pasta

steps: Put olive oil and garlic into skillet over medium heat.
When garlic sizzles, add tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Add rosemary and cook 10 to 12 minutes, then turn off heat.
Cook pasta al dente; drain and transfer to pot with the sauce.
Turn on the heat to very low and toss the pasta and sauce for about 1 minute.
Turn off the heat and make a well in the middle of pasta.
Pour the vinegar into the well and toss thoroughly for a few seconds. Serve at once.

title: Fluffy French Toast
steps: Place 1 cup milk in shallow dish.
Combine beaten eggs, flour, salt, and baking powder in another shallow dish; add 1/3 cup milk and blend.	Melt shortening in skillet.
Dip bread, one slice at a time, into milk, then into egg mixture.
Turn to coat both sides of bread.
Place bread in skillet; cover and cook over low heat until bread is golden brown on one side.	Turn, cover, and cook until other side is golden brown.
Serve immediately.

title: Currant-Glazed Ham

ingredients.name: smoked fully bone in ham half
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 lb.) smoked, fully cooked, bone-in ham half

steps: Combine currant jelly and sherry in a small saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until jelly melts.
Remove from heat; set aside.

title: Quick And Easy Pasta Salad(Lo-Cal Or Not)

ingredients.name: italian salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 16 oz. Italian salad dressing (regular or lo-cal)

steps: In colander, place veggie mix, sliced onion and mushrooms. Cook pasta until done and pour into colander over veggies.
Drain well.
Mix together with crushed garlic, salad dressing and sliced olives.
Chill well and serve.

title: Macaroni And Beef Casserole

ingredients.name: each ground beef and bulk pork sausage
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. each: ground beef and bulk pork sausage

steps: In skillet, brown beef, sausage and onion.
Drain fat.
Add tomato paste, water, oregano and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. In a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, layer half of the macaroni, half of the meat sauce and half of the cheese.
Repeat.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: 5 Single Pie Crusts
steps: Beat eggs, water and vinegar.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Chill 1 hour.
Divide into 5 crusts.

title: Texas Pasta
steps: Cook pasta until tender.
Drain all cans of vegetables.
Dice bell pepper (use only the amount for your taste).
Mix all together.
This recipe should be made up the day before you want to serve it.
Keep refrigerated until served.

title: Old Fashioned Cream Pie
steps: Beat together and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 400 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes.
Makes 1 pie.

title: Fish Casserole

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 2 medium green peppers, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: Layer the ingredients in a buttered casserole dish.
Dot each layer of fish with butter.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich

ingredients.name: cold brie
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. cold Brie, cut into 1/8-inch thick slices

ingredients.name: firm textured white bread crust removed
ingredients.raw: 8 slices firm textured white bread, crusts removed

steps: In a heavy medium skillet, melt the butter over high heat. When the butter begins to brown, add the mushrooms and toss to coat.
Saute, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms have browned around the edges, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the green onions and cook for 1 minute longer. Transfer the mushrooms to a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the cheese among 4 slices of bread.
Top each with the mushrooms, leaving about 1/4-inch from the edge of the bread. Add a tarragon sprig and cover with the remaining 4 slices of bread.
Preheat a cast-iron ridged griddle or skillet for 10 minutes over moderate heat. Grill the sandwiches for 4 minutes per side or until the bread is lightly browned and the cheese has melted.
Serve halved as a first course or quartered as an hors d'oeuvre.

title: Austrian Barley Soup
steps: Saute butter, barley, celery and onion for 4 minutes.
Add consomme and simmer 30 to 40 minutes.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sugar Coated Peanuts
steps: Put in saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring until all moisture is used up.
Place in a large baking pan so nuts won't be crowded.
Put in 300° oven for 10 minutes; stir well and bake another 10 minutes.
Turn oven off and leave in oven for another 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Almost Heaven Cake
steps: Prepare cake according to directions and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
When done, punch holes in the cake with a fork.
Pour pineapple with juice over cake.
Beat cream cheese, pudding mix and milk together until thick.
Spread over pineapple.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Garnish with coconut.

title: Peanut Butter Pie 2
steps: Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy.
Add peanut butter and honey.
Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crust. Chill and serve.

title: Puff Pastry
steps: Bring water to a boil.
Add butter, stirring, until all butter is melted.
Add all at once flour and salt.
Cook, stirring vigorously, until mixture is smooth and forms soft ball that does not separate.
Cool slightly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each egg until mixture is smooth.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Size depends on use (small for appetizers or large for cream puffs).
Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.
Yields 50 small puffs.

title: Apple Pie Without The Guilt

ingredients.name: fat yogurt
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fat-free yogurt or ice milk

steps: Cook taco shells until crunchy.
I use butter spray in a nonstick skillet and put in microwave.
Pour canned apples into a microwave dish and heat until hot.
Lay out taco shells and use 1/4 can of apples on top of each shell.
Top with 1/2 cup of fat-free ice milk or frozen yogurt.

title: S'Mores
steps: For each serving, place 4 squares of a milk chocolate candy bar on a graham cracker.
Toast a marshmallow over campfire.
Slip the marshmallow onto the chocolate and top with a second graham cracker.
Eat like a sandwich.

title: Carbonnara
steps: Bake bacon until crisp, brown and crumble.
Set aside.
Cook linguine according to package.
Drain and saute in butter.
Remove to serving platter and keep warm.
Mix cream and yolks well and pour into pan used to saute pasta.
Stir until thick over medium heat.
Add cheese and blend well.
Pour over pasta and sprinkle with bacon.
Toss and serve.

title: Christmas Casserole Cookies
steps: Beat Eggs well; add Sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add Vanilla, Dates, Nuts and Coconut.
Put in a greased 2-1/2 quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350.
Stir well and let cool.
Roll into balls and roll in the colored Sugars.

title: Fleecy Cloud Dessert

ingredients.name: french vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
