steps: Crush crackers and mix with melted oleo.
Press into 9 x 13-inch dish (save some crumbs for top).
Soften ice cream and mix with dry pudding, then stir in milk.
Pour over crumbs.
Top with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle crumbs on top.

title: Congealed Lime Salad
steps: Cream dry jello and cream cheese.
Gradually add 1 cup boiling water.
Add juice from crushed pineapple and enough cold water to make one full cup.
Add crushed pineapple and pecans.
Two cups of marshmallows may be added if desired.
Chill until firm. Different flavors of jello may be substituted, also different fruits.

title: Speedy Barbecue Sauce
steps: Combine cold water and gravy mix.
Add catsup, mustard and worcestershire sauce.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture bubbles.
Yield 2 cups.

title: Red Torte Cake
steps: Cook flour and milk until thick, stirring constantly.
Cool. Cream sugar, vanilla and butter.
Add the flour and milk mixture. Ice cake.

title: Spicy Potatoes
steps: Peel and slice potatoes.
In a large gallon bag, empty Lipton soup mix and oil.
Place a few potatoes at a time and shake to coat well.
Place in baking dish, cover and bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Hopscotch Cookies
steps: Melt butterscotch morsels over hot water; stir in peanut butter.
Mix in large bowl the marshmallows and noodles.
Add hot mixture and mix thoroughly; drop on wax paper and let cool.

title: Icebox Lemon Pie
steps: Blend until thick; pour into pie crust.
Chill thoroughly.

title: Beer Glaze For Ham
steps: Cook slow.
Stir over medium low heat.
Cook ham 1/2 hour before glazing.
Glaze ham while baking until mixture is all used.

title: Cinnamon Monkey Bread
steps: Grease and flour a Bundt pan.
Quarter cut biscuits and roll each quarter in 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon mixture.
In a saucepan, melt butter.
Add 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.
Heat until sugar melts.
Pour over biscuits.
Sprinkle chopped pecans over biscuits.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool 10 minutes.
Remove onto cake plate.
Enjoy!

title: Snowcapped Broccoli Spears
steps: Cook frozen broccoli spears according to package directions; drain well.
Meanwhile in a small bowl beat egg whites and salt with a rotary beater until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold in mayonnaise or salad dressing; set aside.
Arrange cooked broccoli spears with stem ends toward center on oven-proof platter or 9-inch pie plate.
Drizzle the melted butter over broccoli spears. Spoon the mayonnaise mixture into the center of the platter over broccoli stems; sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until topping is golden.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Prepare Tuna Helper as directed except use canned chicken. Immediately place into ungreased deep skillet and place uncooked biscuits on top.
Put into a 350° oven.
Bake until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar in bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Add enough flour gradually to make soft dough.
Shape into 5 balls.
Roll 1/8-inch thick on floured surface.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes.
Remove to wire rack to cool completely.
Store in airtight container.
Yield:
144 servings.

title: Chocolate Nog
steps: Combine eggnog, chocolate syrup and creme de cacao; cover and chill.
Before serving, beat whipping cream to soft peaks. Reserve 1/2 cup of the whipping cream for garnish.
Fold the remaining whipped cream into the eggnog mixture.
Pour into serving glasses.
Dollop with reserved whipped cream.
Garnish with chocolate curls.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Cup O' Trifle
steps: Place cake cubes in large bowl.
Sprinkle with orange juice. Stir preserves into cake cubes.
Divide into 6 dessert glasses. Pour milk into medium bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Beat with wire whisk 1 or 2 minutes.
Gently stir in Cool Whip.
Spoon over cake cubes in glasses.
Garnish with Cool Whip, nuts, maraschino cherries, etc.
Refrigerate.

title: Mom'S Toffee Ice Cream Pie

ingredients.name: heath english toffee bar
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. chopped Heath English toffee bars

steps: Line a 9-inch buttered pie pan with vanilla wafers on the side and bottom.
Spoon half the ice cream in the shell.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup chopped candy over this.
Top with remaining ice cream. Garnish with 1/4 cup candy bits.
Freeze until serving time.

title: Tasty Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients; pack firmly in a greased loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Pour catsup on top before serving.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Combine chicken and soy sauce; let stand 15 minutes.
Heat oil over medium heat; add rice and cook until golden brown, stirring frequently.
Add chicken and broth; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until rice is tender.
Remove cover; stir in onion, green pepper, celery and broccoli.
Cook until liquid is absorbed.
Serve immediately with extra soy sauce.

title: Quick Lasagna

ingredients.name: ricotta
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Ricotta or dry curd cottage cheese

ingredients.name: romano
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. grated Romano or Parmesan cheese

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced or grated

ingredients.name: lasagna noodle as directed on package
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. lasagna noodles, cooked as directed on package

steps: Baking Temperature: 350°.
Baking Time: 30 minutes.

title: Slaw Cabbage
steps: Mix together the sugar, mustard seed and celery seed with the Wesson oil, vinegar and salt.
Bring to a boil; pour over vegetables.
Will last for days in the fridge.

title: Marinated Flank Steak
steps: Combine all ingredients, except steak, in a large, shallow dish, stirring well.
Place steak in dish.
Score steak on each side.
Marinate overnight, turning at least twice.
Grill or broil about 8 minutes on each side.

title: Great-Great Granny Delia'S Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Season chicken and brown in shortening.
Cover with water and cook until tender.
While the hen is cooking, prepare the dumplings.
Mix dry ingredients together.
Add eggs and stock. Make into dough stiff enough to roll out thin and cut in narrow strips.
Drop dumplings into boiling pan of chicken and stock. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Pie
steps: Cook potatoes and onion in water to cover on top of stove. Stir in mushroom soup.
Add corned beef.
When hot, drop biscuits on and bake at 350° until biscuits are done (about 12 minutes). Lift biscuit to check underneath to see if it is baked.

title: Butterscotch Bar Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add the beaten eggs.
Add flour and baking powder.
Add pecans and vanilla.
Bake in long pan at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Mama'S Eggplant Dressing

ingredients.name: roll mild jimmy dean sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. roll mild Jimmy Dean sausage

steps: First follow directions on stuffing and set aside.
Cook all other ingredients, except for cheese, together until done; add Stove Top dressing into eggplant mixture.
Mix well.
Put into buttered casserole pan; add grated cheese on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Light Alfredo Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender.
Process until smooth. Pour into a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated.

title: Cookies Surprise
steps: Mix all ingredients except Kisses and refrigerate for 2 hours. Wrap 1 tablespoon of dough around Hug or Kiss, wrapping into a ball.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Shake in Baggie with confectioners sugar.
Shake when ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Brownies With Ice Cream
steps: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish or pan.
Let cool.
Spread ice cream over the brownies and freeze until hard.

title: Seven-Up Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 small can crushed pineapple (add juice to)

steps: Mix jello in boiling water and juice; blend in blender jello, cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Stir in nuts, pineapple and 7-Up and chill.

title: Easy Rhubarb Dessert
steps: Mix cake as directed on package.
Pour batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Spread rhubarb over batter.
Sprinkle with sugar; pour cream over top.
Do not mix.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Karo Pecan Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add sugar and flour.
Add syrup, butter and vanilla, then add pecans. Pour into unbaked pie crusts and bake one hour at 325°.

title: Elegant Steak And Rice

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 11 oz. can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Cut steak into thin strips.
In a large skillet, brown meat in oil using high heat.
Add onions and saute until crisp.
Blend soup, liquid from mushrooms and garlic salt together.
Pour over steak, add mushrooms.
Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve over a bed of rice.

title: Tuna Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: pie shell baked
ingredients.raw: 1 (9-inch) pie shell, baked or crumble saltines in bottom of pie plate

ingredients.name: swiss
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss or American cheese

steps: In large bowl, toss tuna, cheese and onion; spoon into pie shell.
In bowl, stir together eggs, mayonnaise and milk.
Slowly pour over tuna mixture.
Bake at 375° for 50 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Pickled Cucumber Relish

ingredients.name: garlic and clove the flavor
ingredients.raw: garlic and cloves to taste the flavor

steps: Chop cucumbers fine; add salt; cover cucumbers with ice and let stand for 3
hours.
Chop onions and pepper very fine; set aside.
In large pot heat vinegar, sugar, turmeric, celery seed and cloves;
bring
to a boil; add chopped vegetables and simmer 15 minutes.
Can and seal.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream butter or margarine with sugar.
Then add eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
Stir in flour, sifted with baking powder and salt.
Chill dough if time permits.
Working with a handful of dough at a time, add extra flour until dough becomes pliable. Roll to 1/4-inch thickness on a well floured board, then cut into desired shapes.
Small cookie cutters work best.
Arrange on a large cookie sheet, lightly greased.
Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Pork Loin
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Rub pork loin with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake on rack, 30 minutes per pound.
Remove from oven 30 minutes before done and punch holes in meat.
Pour glaze over loin and return to oven for another 30 to 40 minutes. Slice and serve with remaining glaze.

title: No Cook Boiled Custard

ingredients.name: jell o instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 large pkg. Jell-O instant pudding mix (vanilla)

steps: Mix Dream Whip and add other ingredients.
Stir.
Chill and serve.

title: Miniature Pizza Cups
steps: Cook and drain ground beef.
Stir in tomato paste, onion and seasonings.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes.
Place biscuits in a greased muffin tin, pressing to make sure bottom and sides are covered.
Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture into each biscuit-lined cup and then top with cheese.
Bake at 400° for 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Canapes

ingredients.name: orlean shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1 can Orleans shrimp, drained (small or medium)

steps: Toast bread triangles on one side.
Mix mayonnaise, cheese and mustard.
Spread mayonnaise, cheese and mustard mixture on untoasted side of bread triangle.
Place shrimp on top and spread a small amount of additional mayonnaise, cheese and mustard on top.
Place under broiler until lightly browned.

title: Kolaches
steps: Cream the cream cheese and butter together; add flour and knead.
Cover and put in refrigerator for at least 3 hours.
Cut dough into quarters. Roll out on powdered sugar 1/8-inch thick. Cut into 2-inch squares.
Fill.
Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Brownie Pie
steps: Melt margarine in pan.
In a separate bowl, mix sugar, flour and cocoa.
Pour into melted margarine and stir thoroughly.
Add eggs, one at a time, heating well after each egg.
Add milk, vanilla and nuts, stirring all to blend.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Blast
steps: In blender container, add first 4 ingredients; cover.
Blend just until smooth.
If desired, serve with scoop of ice cream. Makes 2 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves

ingredients.name: tender leaf from the grapevine
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. tender leaves from the grapevine (fresh or preserved)

steps: Remove stems from leaves and wash the leaves.
Dip in boiling water for 1 minute to soften if using fresh leaves.
(Prepare preserved leaves according to directions.)
Wash rice and combine with meat and seasonings.
Place leaf under side up and put a spoonful of filling across the stem end.
Turn up the stem end, fold over sides and roll tightly to form a cigar.
Place extra leaves or lamb bones on the bottom of cooking pot to prevent scorching.
Arrange rolls tightly together in layers.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
steps: Stir constantly sugar, milk and oleo.
Bring to boil and boil for 6 to 7 minutes.
Remove from heat and add chocolate chips and Marshmallow Creme, pinch of salt, vanilla and nuts (if desired). Stir until all is dissolved and well mixed.
Pour onto a greased plate, cool, then cut.

title: Tuna Vegetable Dip
steps: Combine carrots, celery, onions and tuna.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Serve cold with raw vegetables or crackers.

title: Grilled Sweet Potatoes With Applesauce

ingredients.name: applesauce
ingredients.raw: 2 c. applesauce (sweetened to taste with honey or maple syrup)

steps: Cut hot peeled potatoes in half lengthwise; arrange in shallow baking dish and brush with 2 tablespoons water.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter to the applesauce.
Pour over sweet potatoes.
Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: 7-Layer Jello

ingredients.name: jello
ingredients.raw: 4 small pkg. jello (green, red, yellow, orange)

steps: Oil a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Using 4 separate bowls, mix each box of jello with 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water; set aside.
Dissolve 2 packages Knox gelatine with 1/2 cup cold water; set aside for 5 minutes.
Boil 2 cups milk in a pan, then add 1 cup sugar until dissolved.
Add 2 cups sour cream and 2 teaspoons vanilla.
Wait about 5 minutes, then add Knox gelatine mixture to sour cream mix.

title: Crisp Pickle Slices

ingredients.name: amount of green food coloring
ingredients.raw: a small amount of green food coloring

steps: Do not pare cucumbers; slice 1/8-inch thick.
Add onions and salt.
Cover with cracked ice and mix thoroughly.
Let stand 3 hours; drain thoroughly.
Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Drop cucumber slices into mixture.
Cook until they become transparent.
Seal in hot, sterilized jars.
Makes 4 pints.

title: Cranberry Chicken
steps: Mix soup mix, sauce, and dressing together.
Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking pan.
Pour marinade over chicken and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Queen Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple well
ingredients.raw: 1 medium can crushed pineapple, well drained

steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in order, mixing well with each addition.
Stir in Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.
Can be frozen.

title: Barbecue Pork

ingredients.name: bull eye barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 bottles Bulls Eye barbecue sauce

steps: Cook roast in crock-pot.
Drain, pull apart and discard fat. Mix all ingredients and heat in skillet about 15 minutes.
Serve or freeze.
If frozen, heat in oven.

title: Deviled Seafood Casserole

ingredients.name: crabmeat
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can crabmeat or 1/2 lb. fresh crab

ingredients.name: butter cracker
ingredients.raw: 1 c. buttered cracker or bread crumbs

steps: Mix all ingredients, except crumbs, and place in buttered casserole dish.
Top with crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Serves four to six.

title: Delicate White Cake
steps: Measure flour, salt, baking powder and sugar into sifter. Measure shortening and egg whites into Mixmaster bowl.
Measure milk and vanilla into cup.
Have the shortening at room temperature.
Line bottoms of 2 (8-inch) layer pans with paper or grease.

title: Swiss-Jack Cheese Ball
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl; mix thoroughly.
Spread mixture thinly in sheet cake pan.
Bake for 8 minutes.
Stir/turn mixture.
Bake another 8 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.
Turn onto plastic wrap and form into a ball.
Refrigerate.
Cover with sliced almonds before serving.

title: Canned Fish

ingredients.name: fish skinned and approximately
ingredients.raw: fish, skinned and cut into approximately 2-inch long pieces

steps: Mix together and pour salt, vinegar, tomato cocktail and brown sugar over fish in jars.
Seal.
Process in pressure cooker at 10 pounds for 90 minutes.
This resembles canned salmon and is very good for fish loaf.

title: Angel Food Cookies

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 bag chocolate chips or coconut is also good in them

steps: Mix together the above ingredients.
Spray cookie sheet, drop by spoonful onto cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Kock Kaase
steps: Melt margarine.
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Add evaporated milk.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Beat well.
Add a few caraway seeds; mix thoroughly.

title: Boiled Green Peanuts
steps: Take Highway 231 south out of Dothan to Highway 109.
Turn right.
Go to Florida state line, first farm on right past state line.
Owned by Mark Nolin.
Get about 1 1/2 gallons of green peanuts, about 3/4 matured (not fully mature).
Bring home.
Put in cast-iron pot with 3 or 4 gallons of water.
Add salt to taste. Boil slowly 1 1/2 to 2 hours until peanuts are tender.

title: My Husband'S Apple Crisp
steps: Toast the breadcrumbs.
Cut butter into small pieces.
Peel and core apples.
Slice thinly.

title: Cheese Dip For Doritos
steps: In a glass baking dish, layer each of the ingredients.
Grate the Cheddar cheese, Monterey Jack and Mozzarella.

title: Graham Cracker Cookie
steps: Spread crackers to fill cookie sheet completely. Boil oleo and sugar 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in nuts.
Pour over the crackers and spread. Bake at 325° for 11 minutes. Cool and break into pieces.
Let stay in oven until it cools.

title: Cranberry Cake
steps: Beat 2 minutes the cake mix, cream cheese and milk.
Mix in the eggs.
Combine.
Fold into batter the cranberries, walnuts, sugar and mace.
Pour into greased 10 x 4-inch tube or 12-cup Bundt pan. Bake in 350° oven for 60 to 65 minutes.
Cool 20 minutes; remove from pan.
Dust with confectioners sugar.
Yield:
one 10-inch cake.

title: Good And Easy Salad
steps: Mix Cool Whip, cottage cheese and dry jello.
Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Biscottis
steps: Mix sugar and margarine together.
Add eggs one at a time. Add anisette extract and beat until smooth, then add baking powder and flour one cup at a time.
Beat and scrape bowl until all is combined smoothly, then roll out into 3 loaves of equal size. Bake in 375° oven until golden color.
Remove and slice 1 inch diagonally and put back into 350° oven for a few moments until toasted.

title: Fruity Eggnog Muffins(Microwave)
steps: Combine flour, eggnog mix, sugar and baking soda.
Stir in cherries coated with dry mixture.
Blend in milk, oil and egg. Line each compartment of a foam insulated large or jumbo egg carton with paper mini baking cups.
Spoon batter into each cup filling 2/3 full.
Place a cherry quarter in center of each muffin.
Close lid of carton and microwave on 50% for 3 minutes, rotating carton midway through cooking.
Do not peek.
Leave lid closed and set carton flat for 3 minutes.
Remove muffins.
Repeat procedure twice for 36 mini muffins.

title: Drizzle Cake

ingredients.name: or oz. jar caramel ice cream
ingredients.raw: 9 or 12 oz. jar caramel ice cream topping

steps: Bake cake according to box directions.
While still hot, poke holes all over cake.
Slowly pour Eagle Brand milk over cake.
Cool cake 5 minutes.
Pour slowly the caramel topping on.
The topping may need to be heated some to help pouring.
Cool cake completely, then add Cool Whip on top.
Put the crumbled Heath bars over the Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

title: Fig Preserves
steps: Combine the figs, lemon and sugar in a large pot.
Cook on medium heat until thick, stirring just enough to prevent sticking, for about 1 hour.
Spoon into hot sterilized jars; seal.
Makes 6 - 7 half pints.

title: Pudding Puzzle Cake

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed

steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease six 6-ounce custard cups.
In saucepan, melt butter and chocolate, stirring until blended and smooth.
Remove from heat.
In bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar and baking powder; stir in milk, vanilla and chocolate mixture. Blend thoroughly.
Spoon batter into custard cups.

title: Stetson Salad
steps: In airtight container, make layers as follows:
lettuce, cauliflower, bacon, cheese and mayonnaise.
Chill 24 to 48 hours. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Toss before serving.

title: Ione'S Tomato Aspic
steps: Heat tomatoes, soften gelatin in vinegar.
Add to warm tomatoes stir until dissolved.
Then add chili peppers. Refrigerate until firm.
Present servings on lettuce leaf with daub of mayo.

title: White Pizza

ingredients.name: loaf bread dough
ingredients.raw: 1 loaf frozen bread dough or your favorite bread dough

steps: Place dough in pan and stretch to pan size; let rise.
Mix ingredients together and spread on pizza shell.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
Cut and serve.

title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
steps: Bake cake as directed on box in 9 x 13-inch pan.
When warm from oven, put holes in it with large meat fork.
Spread pineapple and juice over cake.
Prepare pudding as directed and pour over pineapple.
Spread Cool Whip on top of pudding.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sue Crouch'S Punch
steps: Combine apple juice, pineapple juice and lemonade.
Sweeten to taste.
Add chilled ginger ale just before serving.

title: Marshmallow Torte
steps: Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler.
Cool.
Whip the cream and fold together with other mixture.
Put in graham cracker crust.
Put in refrigerator until firm.

title: Swiss-Broccoli Soup
steps: In saucepan, heat bouillon in 1 1/2 cups water until dissolved.
Add broccoli, cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Add milk, cheese, nutmeg and a dash of pepper. Cook and stir until cheese melts.
Combine flour and 1/2 cold water; stir into broccoli mixture.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Shortbread Cookies
steps: In large bowl, combine flour, margarine, sugar and vanilla; mix until well blended.
Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips; mix well. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Shape into 2-inch logs.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool completely.

title: Sweet Dills

ingredients.name: dill pickle well
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. sliced dill pickles, well drained

steps: Mix sugar and water; bring to a boil.
Add a few drops green food coloring, if desired.
Pour liquid over pickles and chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Southern California Layered Dip
steps: You will need a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
In a bowl, peel and mash avocados.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add 1 tablespoon lemon juice to preserve green color.
Spread this mixture into the 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Nell'S Brownies
steps: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift cocoa and flour together and add to sugar mixture.
Add nuts and stir.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan and cook at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sausage, Cheese And Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup combined with can evaporated milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup, combined with 1 (13 oz.) can evaporated milk

ingredients.name: smoked sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices

steps: Mix mushroom soup and milk together with half of the onion rings.
Layer hash brown potatoes, sausage, soup mixture and shredded cheese alternately.
Bake at 350° until heated through, about 40 minutes.
Add more cheese and the rest of the onion on top.
Bake long enough to melt cheese.
(So easy, so goooood!)

title: Chopstick Chicken

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Wash, dry and cut chicken into serving pieces.
Combine in baking dish the cream of mushroom soup, onion soup mix, uncooked rice and water.
Arrange chicken over rice mixture.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 30 minutes, or until chicken and rice are tender.

title: Water Chestnut Hors D'Oeuvre
steps: Cut chestnuts in half; wrap each with 1/2 strip bacon and secure with toothpick.
Put in pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Pour off fat.
Mix peaches, sugar and ketchup and carefully pour over chestnuts.
Be careful not to cover picks or they become sticky.
Bake 1/2 hour more.
Eat or freeze.

title: Tangy Fruit America'S Cut

ingredients.name: center pork loin chop
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 to 1 1/2-inch thick boneless center pork loin chops

ingredients.name: cranberry sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. cranberry sauce or your favorite fruit jam

steps: Brown four America's Cut in a large skillet with vegetable oil, turn chops.
Stir in cranberry sauce or your favorite fruit jam, mustard and vinegar.
Cover and simmer gently for 12 to 15 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.
Preparation time:
5 minutes. Cooking time:
25 minutes.

title: Tell A Neighbor Cake

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. white or yellow cake mix

steps: Mix all together.
Beat 4 minutes.
Bake in 350° oven 40 to 45 minutes.
Frost with Brown Butter Icing.

title: Dutch Butter Squares
steps: Cream butter in a large mixing bowl; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add egg and beat well.
Gradually stir in flour, blending well (dough will be sticky).
Divide dough in half.
Place each portion of dough in a well-greased 8-inch square pan.
With floured hands, press dough evenly into pans. Place pans in cold oven.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until light brown.
Cut into 2-inch squares while warm.
Remove from pans, cool on wire racks.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Polly'S Pan Apples
steps: Cut apples in half, do not peel.
Cut out core and seeds.
Lay in large frying pan with margarine, with cut side up.
Mix sugar, cornstarch, water and cinnamon.
Pour over apples.
Put lid on and cook until tender.

title: Calico Casserole

ingredients.name: cornbread stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. cornbread stuffing mix (such as Stove Top)

steps: Mix together vegetables, mayonnaise, celery, onion and cheese. Place in baking dish.
Mix stuffing (bread crumbs only) and butter.
Spread on top of vegetable mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Casserole will "crackie" when done.

title: Chicken Delicious
steps: Mix all dry ingredients.
Melt butter; dip chicken in it, then roll in dry ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Oyster Cracker Bits

ingredients.name: ranch style salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Ranch style salad dressing mix

steps: Mix oil and seasonings in large bowl.
Toss crackers in mixture.
Pour in large Ziploc bag.
Leave out on counter and turn bag every 40 to 50 minutes (3 or 4 times).
Ready to eat in 24 hours.
Keeps for weeks.

title: Islander Cheese Ball
steps: Mix cheese and pineapple with mixer.
Stir in onion, green pepper, salt and 1/2 cup pecans. Roll into 1 large ball, 2 logs or fill a scooped out fresh pineapple half.
Roll or top with remaining pecans.

title: Chocolate Topping(Diabetic)
steps: Combine milk, chocolate, cornstarch, sugar replacement and salt in saucepan.
Bring to a full boil and boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.

title: Sauerkraut And Kielbasa

ingredients.name: kielbasa
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 lb. kielbasa, cut into 1/2 to 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: maple flavored pancake syrup
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. maple flavored pancake syrup (may substitute 1/4 c. brown sugar)

steps: Drain and rinse kraut.
Mix all ingredients together.
Place in slow cooker, medium temperature.
Cook 3 to 4 hours.
May need to drain off juice, depends on kielbasa brand (Eckrich is the best!).

title: Pecan Rolls

ingredients.name: loaf bread
ingredients.raw: 1 loaf frozen bread (Rhodes brand works well or frozen sweet bread)

steps: Thaw loaf of bread.
In 9 x 13 pan, melt 2 tablespoons oleo, 1/4 cup brown sugar and syrup.
Roll out dough to 12 x 16-inches. Spread with 2 tablespoons oleo.
Sprinkle the other 1/4 cup brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts.
Roll up from long side like a jelly roll; slice into 12 pieces and put in prepared pan.
Bake at 360° for 15 to 20 minutes or according to recipe on bread package.

title: Never Fail Peanut Brittle
steps: Boil sugar, Karo and water until thread spins or 250°.
Add peanuts and cook until a few drops dropped in a cup of cold water cracks.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, vanilla and soda.
Pour onto buttered cookie sheet, spreading as thin as possible with spoon.

title: Russian Salad

ingredients.name: banana mashed with tsp. lemon juice over banana
ingredients.raw: 1 banana, mashed with 1 tsp. lemon juice over banana

steps: Mix marshmallows, Jell-O and cream cheese with hot water; dissolve over low heat.
Remove from heat.
Add other ingredients. Chill in molds until set.

title: Sesame Brown Rice
steps: Place 1 1/2 cups water in saucepan and bring to boil; add pinch of salt and rice.
Bring to boil again, cover.
Turn heat down to cook rice approximately 50 minutes.
When rice is done, combine tahini, tamari sauce and water in small saucepan.
Bring to boil and cook five minutes.
Add water to create creamy consistency. Combine rice and sesame sauce and serve while hot.

title: Peach-Pear Jelly
steps: Peel and cut up pears.
Cook until soft. Blend pears in blender, then follow directions for jelly on Sure-Jell package. Pour in sterile jars and seal.

title: Coconut Cream Cake

ingredients.name: regular white cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. regular white cake mix (no pudding)

steps: Combine cake mix, 1 cup coconut, water and egg whites.
Beat 2 minutes at highest speed of mixer.
Reduce speed to low; beat for 1 minute.
Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool cake in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Large Potato Casserole
steps: Thaw potatoes.
Combine in a large bowl with 1/2 cup melted butter, salt, pepper, onion, soup, sour cream and shredded cheese. Blend well and pour into a 3-quart casserole dish, which has been greased with butter.
Mix remaining melted butter with crushed corn flakes; sprinkle on top of potato mixture.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Poppy Bread
steps: Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Makes 3 small loaves or 2 large loaves.

title: School Rolls
steps: In large bowl, pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Blend and cool.
Sprinkle yeast into lukewarm water and stir until dissolved.
Combine with beaten eggs; add to sugar, salt and shortening.
Add flour all at once and blend well.
(Stir until you cannot stir any longer.) Cover and place in refrigerator.

title: Orange Delight
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water.
Cook sugar and pineapple until boiling.
Add to jello and chill until syrupy.
Add cheese, pecans and marshmallows.
Fold in Dream Whip.

title: Betsy'S Italian Potato Souffle
steps: Mash potatoes.
Add 2 beaten eggs, Parmesan cheese and seasonings.
Layer with Mozzarella cheese.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Top with seasoned, buttered bread crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Can be frozen.
Serves 6.

title: Cheese Cookies(Appetizer)
steps: Knead together.
Roll into hands into round balls.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press down with fork dipped in flour to make flat cookies.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Rhubarb Slush

ingredients.name: or rhubarb
ingredients.raw: 3 c. chopped fresh or frozen rhubarb

ingredients.name: pink lemonade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed

steps: In a saucepan, combine rhubarb, water and sugar; bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until rhubarb is tender.
Cool for about 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Balls
steps: Melt oleo and work peanut butter and confectioners sugar in oleo.
Make into balls.
Put on waxed paper on cookie sheet and refrigerate until firm.
Melt large package of chocolate chips and wax.
Dip balls in chocolate and place on wax papered cookie sheet.

title: No-Bake Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix milk, cocoa, sugar and oleo in pan. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop on waxed paper.

title: Pepper Pork Chop Dijon
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Layer sliced potatoes and onions. Sprinkle with salt and pepper in baking dish.
Spread Dijon mustard on pork chops.
Place pork chops on top of potatoes.
Now, pour ginger ale in baking dish, being careful not to get ginger ale on pork chops.
Bake for 1 hour or until done.
Chow down 3rd section.
This goes well with garden salad.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients together, except the powdered sugar.
Roll in 1/2-inch balls.
Roll balls in powdered sugar.
Chill.

title: Rice With Black Beans
steps: Mix tomatoes, beans, oregano, garlic and onion powder.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Meatballs In Sour Cream Gravy
steps: Combine ground chuck, 3/4 teaspoon salt, pepper, egg and onion in bowl; mix well.
Shape into balls around olives.
Brown in shortening in skillet.
Remove from skillet.
Keep hot.
Add flour to 3 tablespoons pan drippings; mix well.
Add 1/2 cup water.
Cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Add sour cream and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Simmer for several minutes.
Pour sauce over meatballs. Yields 4 servings.

title: Fettucine With Bacon And Peas

ingredients.name: pea thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained

steps: Crumble bacon. Cook fettucine as package directs.
Drain and return to cooking pan over medium heat. Add bacon, peas, tomato, butter, cream, salt and white pepper.
Heat to warm through, stirring constantly. Serve immediately.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Make-Ahead S'Mores

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)

steps: In a heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate.
Add sweetened condensed milk and vanilla; cook and stir until smooth, making 1 sandwich at a time.
Spread 1 tablespoon chocolate mixture on each of 2 whole graham crackers; sprinkle 1 with marshmallows and gently press second graham cracker, chocolate side down, on top.
Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Carefully break each sandwich in half before serving.
Wrap in plastic wrap; store at room temperature.
Makes 64 servings.

title: Yeast Bread
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast.
Heat water, milk and 3 tablespoons margarine until warm (butter does not need to melt).
With electric mixer at medium speed, add liquid ingredients with the dry ingredients.
Beat for 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add 1 cup flour and beat 2 minutes at high speed.
With spoon, stir in about 3 cups of flour to make soft dough.

title: Old Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Mash potatoes to smooth paste.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add sugar, molasses and milk.
Mix thoroughly.
Add cloves and vanilla; blend well.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool and serve.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake

ingredients.name: red and green gumdrop in bit
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. red and green gumdrops, cut in bits

steps: Crush crackers into crumbs.
Mix fruits, nuts, marshmallows and gumdrops, all finely chopped together.
Add sugar and whipped cream, blending well.
Pack in loaf pans or Christmas tins.
Pack until well pressed together.
Let stand for 2 weeks.
Remove from pans.
Put in plastic bag.

title: Apricot Milk Shake

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream up
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. vanilla ice cream, cut up

steps: Blend 1 cup milk, ice cream and apricot halves until smooth. Add remaining 1 cup milk, lemon juice and almond extract, if desired.
Serve immediately.
Yield: 4 1/2 cups.

title: Honey Spice Fruit Cup

ingredients.name: lime lemon
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tsp. lime, lemon or orange juice

steps: In medium bowl, stir honey, juice and cinnamon.
Toss with all the fruit.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Honey Mustard Mixed Vegetables(Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: carrot in stick
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. carrots, cut in thin 2-inch sticks

steps: Steam carrots for 10 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broccoli and steam until barely tender, approximately 8 additional minutes. Combine mustard with honey and dill to make a smooth sauce.
Mix sauce with hot cooked vegetables and stir gently until sauce is evenly distributed.

title: Magic Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Pour batter on top of butter.
Put 2 cups fresh or canned fruit on top.
Cook until crust forms on top and is brown.

title: Icebox Pie
steps: Mix oleo, flour, brown sugar and nuts to make a crust.
Pat into large pie pan or rectangle baking pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: No-Cook Spicy Barbecue Sauce
steps: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients; stir well.
Use to baste chicken, spareribs or hamburgers.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Pot Roast In Foil

ingredients.name: envelope dry onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope (about 1 1/2 oz.) dry onion soup mix

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Place 30 x 18-inch piece heavy-duty aluminum foil in baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Place meat on foil.
Sprinkle soup mix over top of meat and spread with cream of mushroom soup.
Fold foil over meat and seal securely.
Cook in 300° oven for 4 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Spicy Sugared Nuts
steps: Pour nuts into egg white and stir until coated and sticky. Blend together sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over nuts.
Stir until nuts are evenly coated.
Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes at 300 degrees.
Cool, break apart and store in Tupperware container.

title: Canyon Ranch Jet Fuel Dressing *
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Yields 2 cups.
Each serving, 2 tablespoons, contains 5 calories, 1 calorie from fat.

title: Walnut Muffins
steps: Whisk all wet ingredients together.
Mix all dry ingredients together.
Add wet mixture to dry mixture.
Next, add fruit and nuts.
Grease muffin tins.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy-Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: turkey ham
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can turkey, ham or chicken, flaked

steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Add all other ingredients except bread cubes.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Top with buttered bread cubes.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Regina'S Strawberry Supreme Cake
steps: Bake cake by directions on box.
Let cool.
Poke holes in cake with fork.
Mix Jell-O by box directions and pour over cake.
Let chill for 30 minutes.
Mix 2 boxes pudding with 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cake and chill.
Add pie glaze on top of pudding.
Wash and trim strawberries.
Slice and put on top of glaze.
Keep refrigerated at all times.

title: Deidre Hall'S Shrimp Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler over simmering water.
Stir to melt.
Serve with Triscuits or crackers.

title: Hot Cheese

ingredients.name: velveeta mild mexican cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Velveeta mild Mexican cheese

steps: Cook and drain sausage.
Put cheese and tomatoes in a crock-pot; cook on low until cheese is completely melted.
Then add sausage.
Stir occasionally.

title: Norman'S Chopped Liver

ingredients.name: chicken liver
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh chicken livers, cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: chicken fat
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. fresh chicken fat (found in frozen food area)

steps: Saute chicken livers and 1/2 onions in heavy frying pan until onions are golden brown and livers have turned light brown.
Put them into a chopping bowl.
Add salt, pepper and the rest of raw onion.
Chop together until coarse and blended (or put through a food grinder).
Do not puree.
Add chopped eggs.
Refrigerate and serve with crackers or rye bread.

title: Quick And Easy Cheese Ball
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Form into a ball and chill.

title: Mock Apple Pie

ingredients.name: zucchini slightly and cooled
ingredients.raw: 4 zucchini, slightly cooked, drained and cooled *

steps: *Use large zucchini that have lost their sheen.
Peel, remove seeds and membrane.
Slice as you would apples.

title: Chruscik
steps: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick and lemon colored.
Add sugar, butter and rum and continue to beat.
Fold in flour and knead until dough blisters.
Fry in deep fat (Crisco).

title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Meat
steps: Wash and drain mushrooms.
Remove stems and chop fine.
Heat oven to 350°.
Mix stems, beef, onion, salt, pepper, basil and catsup.
Fill mushrooms full.
Place in buttered baking pan and bake 25 minutes.

title: Baby Formula
steps: Mix together.
Divide and pour into 8 bottles, 2 1/2 ounces in each bottle.

title: Cheese Date Pastries
steps: Cook dates, sugar and water over low heat, stirring constantly until soft.
Cream margarine and cheese together; blend in flour. Chill at least 1 hour (work with a small amount of dough at a time).
Roll 1/2-inch thick on lightly floured board; cut into rounds.
On half rounds, place 1 heaping teaspoon date filling. Cover each with another round of pastry.
Press edges together with fork.
Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Spread

ingredients.name: crabmeat and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, drained and flaked or 1 pkg. frozen crabmeat, thawed and flaked

steps: Combine cream cheese, milk, Worcestershire sauce, crabmeat and green onion.
Place in small casserole dish and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with toasted almonds.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Instant Boiled Custard

ingredients.name: half and half
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. half and half or 1 pkg. Dream Whip, prepared

steps: Blend all ingredients well with electric mixer.
Store in glass container.
Three recipes yields 2 gallons.

title: Mom'S Red Velvet Cake
steps: Mix everything together, then bake at 300° until sides pull away from pan, approximately 25 minutes.
Layers vary depending on size of pan.

title: English Muffin Bread
steps: Stir flour, sugar, yeast and baking soda together.
Heat 2 cups of milk and 1/4 cup water.
Add to dry mixture; beat well. Stir in enough flour to make stiff batter (about 2 1/4 cups).
May substitute wheat flour here, if preferred.
Spoon into 2 greased pans dusted with cornmeal.
Let rise for 45 minutes.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes, until well brown.

title: Juicy Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a loaf pan.
Bake in a moderate 350° oven for 1 hour.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with Heinz 57 sauce.

title: Fudgsicles

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.raw: milk (amount called for on pudding pkg.)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Mix well and pour into molds; freeze.

title: Stir-Fried Pork With Mushrooms

ingredients.name: cornstarch blended in tbsp. broth
ingredients.raw: 1/2 Tbsp. cornstarch blended in 4 Tbsp. broth

steps: Cut pork into 1 1/2 x 1-inch very thin slices.
Add 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce to it to soak for a few minutes.
Soak dried mushrooms in 1/4 cup warm water for 20 minutes (retain water) and remove stems.
Remove stems from fresh mushrooms and wash thoroughly.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large frying pan.
Add pork and stir-fry over high heat for 2 1/2 minutes and push to one side of the pan.
Stir-fry together both types of mushrooms for 1 minute.
Add the remaining soy sauce, sugar and sherry.
Mix and scramble the sliced pork together with the mushrooms for 1 minute. Pour in half the mushroom water and the cornstarch mixture. Stir and scramble together.
Soon after the contents reboil and thicken, dish out and serve.

title: Shery'S Homemade Chicken And Noodles
steps: Mix all ingredients well; roll out thin and allow to dry all day.
Boil chicken; set aside until noodles are dry.
When ready to cook, bring chicken to a rapid boil; add dry noodles.
Boil about 10 minutes or until done.
(Can be mixed using 1 egg to every 1/2 cup flour to fit your family's size.)

title: Trix Micro Bars
steps: Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Combine margarine and marshmallows.
Melt in microwave 1 minute and 30 seconds to 3 minutes, stirring after 1 minute.
Stir in cereal until coated.
Press in pan and cool.

title: No Bake Fruit Nibbles

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. dried fruit, finely chopped

steps: In a small bowl, stir fruit bits, nuts and brandy.
Let stand for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: cherry chip cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Cherry Chip Cake Mix (Betty Crocker)

steps: Mix all ingredients together with a wooden spoon.
Add M&M's last.
Don't grease the cookie sheets.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in a 350° oven.
Leave cookies on sheet after baking for a few minutes before placing on a rack to cool.

title: Quick Blueberry Crisp
steps: In bowl, stir white sugar and lemon juice over blueberries. Place in buttered glass baking dish.
Mix flour, brown sugar and butter.
Cover blueberries with mixture.
Bake 30 minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Lamb Roast
steps: Flour lamb roast and place in baking pan with 3/4 cup of water.
Cover pan and place in oven at 500° for 30 minutes. Remove roast from oven.
Add the white wine, lemon juice, garlic powder and bay leaf.
Cover pan again; cook for 3 hours at 350°. Lastly, remove pan from oven and debone roast.
Pour favorite barbecue sauce over meat in pan to suit individual taste.
Broil meat in oven for 5 minutes or less.

title: Red Beet Relish
steps: Cook beets and dice.
Mix all other ingredients and boil for 20 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Raspberry Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add raspberries and applesauce. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan to set.
Put marshmallows and sour cream in a bowl.
Let stand overnight.
Next day, beat with mixer and spread on top of Jell-O mixture.

title: Fudgie Scotch Ring
steps: Melt morsels with sweetened condensed milk in top of double boiler.
Stir occasionally until morsels melt and mixture begins to thicken.
Remove from heat.
Add chopped walnuts and vanilla. Blend well.
Chill 1 hour.
Line bottom of 9-inch pie pan with 12-inch square of aluminum foil.
Place 3/4 cup walnut halves in bottom of pan forming a 2-inch wide ring.
Spoon chocolate mixture in small amounts on top of nuts to form ring.
Decorate with remaining nuts.
Chill in refrigerator until firm enough to slice. Makes 36 slices.

title: Recipe For A Happy Home
steps: Take love and loyalty and mix thoroughly with faith.
Blend in tenderness, kindness and understanding.
Add friendship and hope. Sprinkle abundantly with laughter.
Bake with sunshine and serve daily with generous helpings of love.

title: Maple Butterscotch Brownies
steps: In a bowl, combine brown sugar, butter and maple flavoring. Beat in the eggs, one at a time. Combine flour and baking powder; add to egg mixture. Stir in walnuts.
Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brownies test done. Cool. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Sorghum Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cream shortening until light. Add unbeaten eggs and beat until light and fluffy.
Add molasses and dry ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Add hot water, stirring briskly.
Turn into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baby Food Cake

ingredients.name: or jar strained baby food
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small jars strained baby food (applesauce or plums)

steps: Mix all ingredients well in a large bowl.
Pour mixture in a greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Blue Ribbon Buttermilk Pie
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients; beat slightly.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add flaked or shredded coconut; beat slightly.
Add vanilla and salt.
Pour in 2 unbaked pie shells.
Cook 45 minutes or until done at 325°.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Rice Krispies Cake

ingredients.name: rice krispy
ingredients.raw: 6 c. Rice Krispies (regular, Cocoa Krispies or seasonal Rice Krispies cereal)

steps: Spray a Bundt pan or any kind of mold with cooking spray. Microwave margarine and marshmallows on High for 2 minutes in a large microwave-safe mixing bowl.
Stir to combine.
Microwave 1 minute longer.
Stir until smooth.
Add cereal; stir until well coated.
Press firmly into into Bundt pan (I spray the back of a large spoon or spatula with cooking spray).
You may need more than one recipe.
I alternate recipes, using Cocoa Krispies.
Turn out onto serving plate.
Decorate with M&M's, gumdrops, or as desired!

title: Heavenly Coconut Cake
steps: Mix cake as directed.
After cake cools, poke holes in cake. Pour Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut over cake.
Spread cake with Cool Whip and top with coconut.
Let cake set several hours or overnight in refrigerator.

title: Easy To Cook Baked Beans

ingredients.name: campbell s pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 2 (1 lb.) cans Campbell's pork and beans

ingredients.name: kraft barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (18 oz.) Kraft barbecue sauce or 1/2 plain and 1/2 bottle hot barbecue sauce

steps: In skillet, brown together hamburger and onion.
Wash lightly all bean juice from canned beans.
Mix beans, meat mixture and barbecue sauce.
Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
May seem to have too much liquid at first, but will absorb it after setting awhile.

title: Barbecue Beans
steps: Brown ground beef and onion.
Mix all ingredients and bake at 450° for 1 hour.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
steps: Cook macaroni in boiling water for 10 minutes.
Add broccoli and carrots; cook until macaroni is tender, 2 minutes longer. Rinse under cold water to cool; drain.

title: No Mess Barbecue Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Shake flour in Reynolds oven bag. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Add barbecue sauce and orange juice to bag.
Squeeze bag to blend ingredients.
Add chicken to bag.
Turn bag to coat chicken with sauce.
Arrange chicken in an even layer.
Close bag with nylon tie.
Cut 6 (1/2-inch) slits in top.
Bake until chicken is tender, 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie(Makes Own Crust)
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease pie plate.
Beat ingredients together until smooth, 1 minute in blender on high or 2 minutes with hand beater.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until knife inserted into center comes out clean (approximately 50 to 55 minutes).

title: Lime Chicken Breast
steps: Rub chicken with garlic salt.
Place chicken in buttered baking dish and sprinkle with lime juice, tarragon, salt, pepper and onions.
Then pour white wine over chicken and bake at 400° for 40 minutes or until done.
Turn chicken after 20 minutes.

title: Pucker Pie
steps: Mix milk and lemon juice; add pecans, cherries and bananas. Pour into pie shell and chill.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Nevermiss Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and beat.
Add dry ingredients with milk.
Batter will not be real thick.
Add raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls and bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes or until set.

title: Low-Fat Chili Topped Potatoes
steps: Bake 4 large potatoes until tender.
Cut open and divide chili between the 4 potatoes.
Top with low-fat cheese.

title: Ginger'S Baked Beans
steps: Fry bacon and crumble.
Cook ground meat and drain.
Mix all ingredients together and bake for 1 hour at 350° or slow cook 6 to 8 hours.

title: Cranberry Meat Balls
steps: Mix together and make into 1-inch meat balls.
Do not fry meat balls.

title: Rice And Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown sausage, celery, onion and bell pepper in skillet; drain.
You can heat the soups and cheese, if you wish.
Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well.
Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until whole dish is heated.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Pie

ingredients.name: boiled up chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 c. boiled cut up chicken or turkey

steps: Mix ingredients together except cheese and butter.
Pour in pie shell.
Put cheese and butter over mixture.
Top with pie shell and brush with egg whites.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Danish Pastry Apple Bars

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 6 c. apples (sugar, cinnamon and almond flavoring as for pie)

steps: Combine flour and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Beat egg yolk in measuring cup.
Add enough milk to make 2/3 cup of liquid.
Mix well and stir into flour.

title: Sugar Cookies(Very Good!!!)
steps: Cream butter and oleo with sugar.
Add eggs and beat.
Add vanilla.
Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Chill the dough.

title: Coconut Bars

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: Cut each slice of bread into 4 strips (without crust).
Dip in condensed milk and roll in coconut.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 minutes.

title: Asparagus With Cream

ingredients.name: or asparagus
ingredients.raw: 2 c. drained cooked or canned asparagus

steps: Set the oven at 325°.
Arrange the asparagus in a shallow pan (preferably a buttered baking dish).
Cover with the sour cream. Add just a sprinkling of salt and pepper, then top with the bread crumbs and dot generously with butter.
Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the crumbs are nicely browned.
Serves 4.

title: Fluffy Persimmon Pie
steps: Cream the sugar and cheese together.
Add pulp.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into crust.
Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Vinese Cookies
steps: Mix all together well.
Form into a ball about the size of a pecan.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake 35 minutes at 300°.
While warm, roll each cookie 2 times in powdered sugar.

title: Rice Custard Pudding
steps: Cook rice until tender in salted water.
Scald 3 cups of milk and add drained rice.
Mix cornstarch and sugar.
Blend with 1 cup cold milk.
Add to hot milk, stirring until thick.
Cook over low heat, stirring often (in double boiler) 10 minutes or more.
Add slightly beaten egg yolks; cook 2 or 3 minutes until eggs are set. Add vanilla.
Turn into baking dish.
Make meringue of egg whites, adding 8 tablespoons sugar, while beating mix half of the meringue into the custard.
Mix the remainder on top.
Bake until brown (325°).

title: Tuna Fish Burgers
steps: Mix all the ingredients and fill buns.
Wrap in foil and heat in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Southern Pecan Pie(Delicious)
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and melted butter.
Beat eggs.
Add with flour and salt.
Blend.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Top with whipped cream.

title: Frosty Lime Punch

ingredients.name: limeade thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 (6 oz. each) cans frozen limeade, thawed

ingredients.name: lemon lime carbonated beverage chilled
ingredients.raw: 2 (12 oz. each) bottles lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled

steps: Mix limeade concentrate, cold water and carbonated beverage in a large punch bowl.
Spoon scoops of sherbet into bowl.
Serve immediately.
Yields 15 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Cold Pizza(Appetizer)

ingredients.name: chili sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/2 bottle chili sauce (Bennett brand other brands change the taste)

ingredients.name: each of white and yellow cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. each of white and yellow cheese, shredded

steps: Mix cream cheese, onion, green pepper and spread evenly over bottom of a square dish or small oblong pan (8 x 4 inch).
Spread chili sauce as second layer.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Serve with large size Fritos.
Since this recipe makes only a small amount, I usually double the recipe.

title: Creamed Rice
steps: Cook rice and empty Cheez Whiz into hot rice.
Saute celery and onion in oleo.
Boil broccoli until tender and drain.
Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Red Fruit Compote
steps: Use equal quantities of first 6 ingredients.
Frozen fruit may be used.
Mix fruit together and bring to a boil.
Simmer just until all the fruit is tender.
Add sugar to taste and thicken with cornstarch mixed with water.
Serve cool with sweet cream.

title: Holiday Slush
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Freeze well.
Spoon into a glass.
Pour ginger ale or desired mix to fill glass.

title: Soft A & P Cookies
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients, then add rest of ingredients.
Mix well; chill for a couple of hours or over.
Roll out on floured board 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Put on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 12 to 15 minutes or less.
Yields about 60 cookies.

title: Jenny'S Eggs Florentine(American Meatless Breakfast)
steps: Blend last 6 ingredients in a blender or processor.
Gently heat resultant sauce in saucepan.
Place cheese slices on toast. Broil them until cheese melts.

title: Green Salad
steps: Melt Jell-O in boiling water; add chopped marshmallows.
Stir in softened cream cheese.
Add pineapple and nuts.
Pour into dish and chill until firm.

title: Strawberry Cake-Pie
steps: Beat yolks. Add sugar and beat for 1 minute. Add juices, rind, berries, whites and salt.
Pour into baked shell and bake for 30 minutes in slow oven at 350°.
Cool and serve plain or topped with whipped or ice cream.

title: Cool Jello Pie

ingredients.name: fruit or
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced, fresh fruit or canned, drained

steps: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water, stirring about 3 minutes.
Add ice cubes and stir completely until gelatin is thickened (2 to 3 minutes).
Remove any unmelted ice.

title: Chicken Vallejo

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 whole chicken, cut up OR equivalent in chicken pieces

steps: Mix canned soups, rice and water together.
Put in 9 X 13 baking dish.
Place chicken pieces on top.
Sprinkle whole thing with onion soup mix.
Bake at 375 degrees for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is done and liquid is absorbed.

title: Strawberry Dessert(Excellent Dessert For Diabetics)

ingredients.name: jell o sugar vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 large pkg. Jell-O sugar-free vanilla instant pudding

steps: Place a single layer of graham crackers in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix pudding according to directions; add container of Cool Whip.
Pour 1/3 of pudding mixture over graham crackers and cover all graham crackers with pudding.
Add another layer of graham crackers.
Pour next 1/3 of pudding.
Add another layer of graham crackers.
Pour remaining pudding on graham crackers. Clean and slice strawberries, reserving large ones to decorate top of dessert.

title: Strawberry Layer Cake

ingredients.name: jell o cheese cake
ingredients.raw: 1 Jell-O (no bake) cheese cake (do not use crust)

steps: Make cake according to instructions on box in layers.
After cake is cooled, mix the filling portion only of the Jell-O cream cheese cake (no crust).
After mixed, spoon out filling between layers of cake.
Top each layer with fresh strawberries; also on top of cake.
Cover entire cake with Cool Whip.
Keep chilled. Makes approximately 8 to 10 small slices.

title: Cornmeal Waffles
steps: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; stir in cornmeal and set aside.
Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored. Beat in buttermilk and melted butter.
Add to dry ingredients and stir just until blended.

title: Spice Cookies
steps: Cook raisins in water for 5 minutes.
Drain raisins and save 1 cup liquid.
Add soda and shortening to liquid.
Sift together all dry ingredients.
Add raisins and liquid and stir.
Spread thin in 2 oblong greased pans.
Bake at 350° for approximately 12 minutes. Ice with thin powdered sugar icing while hot.
Cut in bars while warm.

title: Lemon Mousse
steps: Prepare Ahead:
Combine lemon rind, juice, extract, egg yolks, egg, 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch in double boiler.
Cook over hot water; stir constantly until thickened (6 to 8 minutes).
Remove from heat; put in bowl to cool.
Mixture must be totally cold before going onto next step.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Chews
steps: Combine corn syrup and sugar in a large saucepan.
Heat to boiling and remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in cereal and pecans.
Drop from a tablespoon onto wax paper.

title: The New Banana Pudding

ingredients.name: instant french vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) box instant French vanilla pudding

steps: Split Twinkies lengthwise.
Place cream side up in 15 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Slice bananas over Twinkies.
Prepare pudding according to directions and pour over top of bananas.
Spread Cool Whip on top.
Chill.
Allow time to set before serving.

title: Quick Golden Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown round steak and cut into bite-size pieces.
Mix mushroom soup and sour cream.
Pour over meat; warm through.
Serve over warm noodles.

title: Orange-Flavored Carrots
steps: Add carrots, onion and salt to boiling water.
Cover and simmer gently until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain, but save 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid.
Add orange juice concentrate, lemon juice and the cooking liquid you saved to the vegetables.
Stir gently.
Heat again until vegetables are hot.

title: Thin Corn Fritters
steps: Cut down the rows of corn.
Press out the pulp and milk.
Into the corn, stir the seasonings.
Slightly beat egg yolks and add to the mixture.
Beat egg whites to a thick foam and blend into the corn mixture.

title: Panoche Squares
steps: Melt butter and while hot, add brown sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
Sift together the dry ingredients and stir into mixture.
Mix in chocolate chips and nuts.
Spread evenly in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Wayside Bars(For The Young Cook)
steps: Melt first two ingredients over hot (not boiling) water.
Stir until smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add the saltines.

title: Best Ever Pound Cake
steps: Cream sugar
and butter.
Add eggs one at a time.
Beat after each addition.
Add flour and cream alternately.
Grease tube pan. Pour in batter.
Cook in preheated oven at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Lin'S Grapenut-Custard Pudding
steps: Use ovenproof bowl.
Beat eggs, then add sugar, vanilla and half and half.
Once mixed, add 1/2 cup of Grape-Nuts.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Place bowl on cookie sheet with water.
Bake at 325° for 45 to 55 minutes.
Check; if knife stuck in middle comes out clean, it is done.

title: Petite Frozen Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: or can orange juice concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. or 1/2 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

ingredients.name: cranberry sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. can whole cranberry sauce (2 c.)

steps: Mix mayonnaise and Cool Whip.
Fold in cranberry sauce and orange juice.
Line muffin pan with paper baking cups.
Fill with mixture and freeze until firm.
Remove and refrigerate 10 to 20 minutes before serving.
Makes 12.

title: Cherry Nut Pie
steps: Add lemon juice to Eagle Brand and mix.
Add drained cherries and pecans to this mixture.
Add whipped cream, coloring and sugar; mix gently until thoroughly mixed.
Place in a cool baked pie shell.
Let stand in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Lamb Loin Chops With Walnut Glaze
steps: Place lamb chops on an unheated rack in a broiler pan.
Broil 3 inches from heat for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Turn; broil 5 to 6 minutes more.

title: Brownie Pies
steps: Melt chocolate chips and margarine in saucepan over low heat. Combine flour and sugar in bowl.
Beat eggs, vanilla and milk in bowl.
Add flour mixture and chocolate mixture; mix well.
Add pecans; mix well.

title: Mom'S Hot Sauce
steps: Put all ingredients together on High and count to 6.
Let sit in refrigerator for 6 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Garlic Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. butter or margarine, at room temperature

ingredients.name: garlic crumb
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. dried crushed garlic crumbs (a packaged seasoning)

steps: Mix together and spread on any kind of bread.
Bake on baking sheet at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Biscuits
steps: Cook the potatoes, onion, salt and pepper in water until tender.
Drain.
Mix in the corned beef that has been broken apart with a fork.
Put into a baking dish.
Mix a double batch Bisquick rolled biscuits and place them on top of potato mixture.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes until biscuits are golden.

title: Crispy Caramel Corn
steps: Measure into saucepan brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt.
Bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and soda.
Pour over popped corn and peanuts, then mix well.
Spread it onto two large pans.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Nachos
steps: On a large platter, spread the chips. Put the chili over the chips.
Warm the cheese and pour over the chips and chili. Garnish with the onions, tomatoes and sour cream on top in the center.

title: Tossed Romaine Salad

ingredients.name: romaine lettuce in bite size
ingredients.raw: 8 c. romaine lettuce, torn in bite size pieces

steps: Rub large wooden salad bowl with cut cloves of garlic.
Stir in oil, cheese, lime juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Add romaine and croutons.
Toss until leaves glisten.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Lasagna
steps: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Layer these ingredients. Start with apple pie filling, then noodles, apple filling and so on. Top with nuts.
Bake at 350° approximately 1/2 hour.

title: Ma'S Meat Loaf
steps: In blender, place eggs, V-8, Worcestershire sauce and onion soup mix. Blend, then add mixture to meat.
Mix well.
Add oatmeal and mix again.
Place 3 to 4 strips of bacon in the bottom of the pan. Form loaf. Cover with remainder of the bacon.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Longer, if bacon is not brown. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Basic Papaya Smoothie(Serves 6)

ingredients.name: papaya seed and
ingredients.raw: 2 large papaya, peeled, seed and slice

ingredients.name: banana peel and
ingredients.raw: 1 large banana, peel and cut into chunks

steps: Add papaya, coconut milk and fruit juice to blender bowl. Process.
Add chunks of banana to blender, a few at a time.
Add strawberries.
Blend until smooth. Add crushed ice and whip until mixture is slushy.
Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole(Good!)

ingredients.name: chicken breast and up
ingredients.raw: 2 chicken breasts, cooked and broken up

steps: Put thawed broccoli in bottom of buttered dish.
Add cooked and cut up chicken as next layer.
Heat soup, mayonnaise, Velveeta and lemon juice until cheese is melted and pour over top of broccoli and chicken.
Top with crushed crackers and add melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and hot and top browned.

title: Angler'S Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: button garlic across but not clear through
ingredients.raw: 7 buttons garlic, cut across but not clear through

steps: Mix thoroughly.
Let stand in fridge for at least 1 week.

title: Whipped Margarine
steps: Let margarine set at room temperature for a while.
Cream until soft.
Add Mazola and whip more.
Add buttermilk and continue beating.
Fill 4 (1-cup) margarine containers or 2 large containers.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
steps: Mix ingredients into dough.
Roll to 1/4 inch thick.
Cut into cookie size.
Bake at 350° for approximately 8 minutes or until light brown.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
steps: Mix flour and milk in saucepan.
Cook over low flame until thick like a paste.
Put in a saucer to cool.
Cream butter and shortening with electric mixer for four minutes.
Add sugar to creamed mixture and beat for four minutes.
Add flour paste and beat 4 minutes.
Add vanilla and blend.

title: Sausage Cheese Grits Casserole

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese, divided

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 3-quart baking dish. Bring water and salt to a boil in a large saucepan.
Slowly pour in grits.
Cover, reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup cheese and butter until melted.
Add eggs, milk and sausage; blend well.
Pour mixture into prepared dish.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 1 hour or until cheese is golden brown. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Hoffa
steps: Combine thawed, well drained spinach, mushrooms, diced scallions and cream cheese.
Stuff mixture under the skin of the chicken breast.
Paint skin with mustard; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Best Ever Lemon Meringue Pie
steps: Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan; set aside. Combine egg yolks, water and lemon juice.
Stir in sugar mixture; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in butter and lemon rind.
Put in baked shell.

title: Green Bean Stir-Fry
steps: Steam green beans briefly just to soften a little.
Drain. In a bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic, sesame seeds, brown sugar and peanut butter.
While pan is still warm, add sauce and warm thoroughly.
Add green beans and toss to coat.
Yields 2 servings.

title: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix all together.
Add enough milk to make a thin custard. Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.
Turn oven temperature down to 350° and bake until done.

title: Fried  Eggplant
steps: Peel eggplant and slice.
Dip slices in egg; coat with flour and salt and pepper to taste.
Fry in vegetable oil until tender.

title: New And Safe Eggnog
steps: Heat milk in saucepan.
Do not boil.
Beat eggs in, boil.
Add salt, gradually beat in sugar. Beat 1 cup of hot milk in egg mixture.
Then add egg mixture to remaining hot milk mixture in saucepan. Beat constantly.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickens and 160° on candy thermometer.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg and vanilla.
Place saucepan in large bowl of ice for 12 minutes.
Cover and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Quick Brown Sugar Icing
steps: Melt oleo; add brown sugar and melt again.
Add cream or milk and allow to boil vigorously 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Immediately start adding powdered sugar, beating well and add vanilla.
Continue adding powdered sugar until frosting is a consistency to spread.

title: Norwegian Fattigman
steps: Mix all of the ingredients using enough flour to make a soft dough.
Roll out thin and cut in strips in the shape of diamonds. Make a one inch slit in the middle of each diamond.
Loop one tip of the diamond through slit to make the cookie look like a diamond with a knot in the middle.
Fry in hot lard turning once.
Drain well on paper towels.
Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sour Cream Pie
steps: Mix together sugar, sour cream, egg yolks and cornstarch. Cook 12 minutes, then add raisins and nuts.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Be sure to rinse raisins well before putting into pie filling.

title: Texas King Ranch Casserole
steps: Boil chicken with seasonings (pepper, salt, poultry seasoning, etc.).
Keep the chicken stock.
Remove chicken from bones.

title: Pigs In A Pen
steps: Partially cook bacon slices.
Cut franks into thirds and wrap with bacon.
Place in crock-pot or slow cooker and cover with brown sugar.
Cook until done.

title: Chewy Bread
steps: Combine butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Blend in flour and vanilla.
Add nuts and mix well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Cinnamon Cake
steps: Mix together.
Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Before you sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top, mix the cinnamon and sugar together, then sprinkle on top.

title: German Style Poke Chops
steps: Using an electric frypan or black pan, brown pork chops.
Then add soup, salt, pepper and garlic.
Bring to a boil, then turn down to simmer.
Add onion on top of pork chops.
Cook for 45 minutes. Serve with rice.
Your gravy is already made.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake

ingredients.name: cloverleaf roll dough
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen cloverleaf roll dough (about 25 balls)

ingredients.name: vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. vanilla pudding mix (not instant)

steps: Separate roll dough into pieces.
(Each will make 3 pieces.) Other roll dough will work too.
With larger ones, use only about 20.

title: Creamy Potato Bake

ingredients.name: packaged instant mashed potato
ingredients.raw: packaged instant mashed potatoes (enough for 6 servings)

steps: Prepare potatoes using package directions, omitting butter. Add cheese; beat well.
Stir in egg, onion and parsley; blend well.
Turn into well-greased 1-quart baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Dash with paprika.
Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Ruth'S Whole Wheat Rolls
steps: Add yeast to warm water to dissolve.
Add beaten egg and Master Mix.
Mix with wooden spoon until combined.
Stir vigorously 30 to 40 strokes.
Place bowl in warm place until doubled in bulk.
Stir down and spoon into greased muffin tins. Let rise again until doubled.
Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes, until lightly browned.
Makes 12 large rolls.

title: Cream Of Celery Soup
steps: Add the celery to the beef stock and boil about 1 hour. Season to taste with pepper, celery salt and salt. Thicken with batter made of the fat and flour and just before serving add the milk.
Add enough beef stock 10 minutes before serving to make 5 gallons.

title: Bleu Cheese Dressing #1

ingredients.name: tarragon vinegar
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. tarragon vinegar or regular vinegar

ingredients.name: veined cheese
ingredients.raw: 6 oz. veined cheese (Blue, Roquefort or Stilton)

steps: Coddle eggs in simmering (not boiling) water for exactly 60 seconds.
Put eggs in blender and blend for a few seconds, then slowly add half of the olive oil while blending.
Add the remaining ingredients, except for the rest of the oil, and blend until the cheese is chunked to the size desired.
Slowly add the rest of the oil while blending.
If the dressing starts getting too thick, stop adding the oil before the full cup is in.

title: Filled Cookies

ingredients.name: ground and raisin in c. water
ingredients.raw: 1 c. ground and cooked raisins in 1/4 c. water

steps: Cream shortening; add sugars and cream well.
Add soda mixed with sour milk and flour to make a soft dough.
Roll out and cut with round cookie cutter.
Place on a cookie sheet and fill with raisin mixture.
Top with another cookie that has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 375° until light brown.

title: Santa'S Kisses
steps: Combine sugar, flour, salt and coconut.
Stir in egg whites, almond extract and almonds.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove from baking sheet immediately.
While still warm, push chocolate kiss or cherry into center of each cookie.

title: Quick Gourmet Fish

ingredients.name: firm fish
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. firm fish (cod, halibut, perch, orange roughy, etc.)

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic or dash of garlic powder

ingredients.name: italian style stewed tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Italian style stewed tomatoes

steps: Place onion, oil and garlic in dish.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes on high.
Add tomatoes and cinnamon. Top with fish. Cover and cook for 3 more minutes on High.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli And Mushroom Salad
steps: Mix vegetables together and let set for 1 hour.
Mix sugar, oil and etc. together and pour over vegetables.
Let stand 1 hour before serving.

title: Sunburst Salad
steps: In large bowl, combine gelatin in dry form with cottage cheese.
Blend well.
Blend in drained pineapple.
Fold in Cool Whip and oranges.
Place in serving bowl.
Chill before serving.

title: Seafood Celebration
steps: Blend in food processor or blender.
Sprinkle 1 package unflavored gelatin over 1 cup heavy cream.
Bring to a slow boil, stirring continuously.

title: Hot Barbecued Chicken Wings
steps: Remove wing tips and cut wings in half.
Dust in mixture of flour and chili powder and fry in hot oil 8 to 10 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Heat together the Lea & Perrins sauce and hot pepper sauce.
Add the cooked chicken wings and simmer for a few minutes.

title: Surprise Snowballs

ingredients.name: chocolate covered peanut gumdrop jelly bean and/or m m s
ingredients.raw: chocolate covered peanuts, gumdrops, jelly beans and/or M&M's

steps: In a large mixing bowl, beat butter on medium until softened. Add sugar and salt; beat until fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
On low, gradually add flour.
Shape the dough into 1-inch balls.
Press a piece of candy in center of each and shape the dough around it.
Place balls about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until edges are golden.
Place powdered sugar in a plastic bag.
With a spatula, transfer 2 to 3 cookies at a time into the bag.
Gently shake sugar onto the cookies.
Cool on a cooling rack.
When cool, gently shake cookies again.

title: Mother'S "Secret Recipe" Baked Beans
steps: In a medium saucepan, saute onion and bell pepper.
Add mustard, brown sugar and liquid smoke, mixing well.
Drain liquid from top of beans and add mixture, simmering until heated through.

title: Instant Pizza
steps: Place piece of bread on a small pan.
Put on 1 sliced tomato first and then a slice of cheese.
Place in oven for 2 minutes. Great for afterschool snack.

title: Green Goddess Dressing(Low-Fat)
steps: In a blender or food processor, combine the first 4 ingredients with 1 tablespoon of the milk and 1/2 of the lemon juice and blend or process until smooth.
Taste for seasoning and add salt, pepper and additional lemon juice as needed.
For a thinner dressing, add the remaining milk and blend until smooth.

title: Egg Noodles
steps: Mix altogether.
Divide into 2 balls.
Roll out on good floured board very thin.
Cut into about 4-inch wide strips. Flour each strip and stack.
Cut very thin.
Let dry.
Drop in salted chicken broth.

title: Cheese Snack Rounds

ingredients.name: sharp process cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jar sharp process cheese spread

steps: Mix cheese spread and baking mix.
Shape into roll about 1-inch diameter on lightly floured cloth-covered board.
Roll in sesame seed, pressing lightly if necessary.
Wrap and refrigerate until firm, at least 2 hours.
Heat oven to 375°.
Cut into 1/4 inch slices.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Yankee Noodle Dandies

ingredients.name: la choy chow mein noodle
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) cans La Choy chow mein noodles

steps: Melt chocolate and butterscotch morsels in top of double boiler over hot water.
