Remove from heat; quickly stir in noodles and peanuts until evenly coated.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Chill.
Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Makes 36 cookies.

title: People "Puppy Chow"(Snack)
steps: Melt chocolate chips and oleo in microwave.
Stir in peanut butter and mix well.
Pour over Crispix cereal; mix well until coated.
Put powdered sugar in plastic trash bag.
Add cereal mix. Shake until coated.
Refrigerate until serving.

title: Corned Beef Spread

ingredients.name: corned beef by hand
ingredients.raw: 1 can corned beef, shredded by hand

steps: Mix together and leave in refrigerator overnight.
Next day, add 1 cup mayonnaise and mix well.
Serve as a sandwich or with crackers.

title: Double Chocolate Caramel Squares
steps: Mix the cake mix, butter and 1/3 cup milk.
Divide in half. Spread half the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 6 or 7 minutes.

title: Hot Spinach Dip

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and reserving juice
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) boxes frozen chopped spinach, thawed, cooked and drained, reserving juice

steps: Melt butter in large skillet.
Saute onion until soft.
Add flour, milk and spinach juice.
Continue to cook until thick.
Add cheese and spinach.
Add Worcestershire sauce and salt.
Serve hot in chafing dish with toast points or corn chips.

title: Classic Heroes
steps: Layer salami, cheese and ham on bottom halves of rolls.
Top with tomato slices, onion and lettuce.
Sprinkle dressing over lettuce.
Replace tops of rolls.
Serve.

title: Texas Caviar *
steps: Combine; mix lightly.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours.
May be used as a salad or as a dip with tortilla chips.

title: Easy Baked Ravioli

ingredients.name: ground chuck and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Ground Chuck, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: four cheese ravioli and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Four-Cheese Ravioli, cooked and drained

steps: Mix cooked meat and sauce together.
Gently stir in pasta and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese.
Pour into a 2qt. casserole dish.
Top with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Bake at 375 degrees, uncovered, for 20 min.

title: Horseradish Mousse
steps: Sprinkle gelatin over cream to dissolve.
Warm gently and stir.
Let cool.
Add salt and lemon juice.
Beat evaporated milk until firm.
Beat in mayonnaise, then beat in softened cream cheese.
Beat in horseradish.
Continue beating while drizzling gelatin mixture in.
Spray ring mold with Pam; pour in mousse and refrigerate until set.
Serve with roast beef.

title: Deviled Swiss Steak
steps: Combine mustard and flour; pound into steak.
Season with salt and pepper.
Brown on both sides in a little fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover; simmer 2 hours.
Yield:
6 servings. Carbohydrate 11 grams, protein 24 g, fat 14 g, calories 268.

title: Ham And Sweet Potatoes(Microwave)

ingredients.name: sweet n low
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 pkg. Sweet 'N Low to taste

steps: Place ham in a baking dish; add potatoes and pineapple.
Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup water to reserved juice, liquid and Sweet 'N Low; thicken with cornstarch.
Pour over meat and cover with plastic paper.
Cook on Medium-high for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Miracle Seafoam Icing
steps: Mix brown sugar, water and vinegar.
Bring to a boil, then cook 3 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine egg whites, cream of tartar and salt.
Beat into peaks.
Slowly add syrup, beating all the while.
Beat 5 minutes more.
Add vanilla and blend.
Sprinkle with coconut after frosting cake (if you wish).

title: Chicken Crunch

ingredients.name: herb seasoned stuffing
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. herb seasoned stuffing, finely crushed

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. chopped fresh parsley or dried parsley flakes (optional)

steps: In shallow dish, combine 1/3 cup soup
and 1/4 cup milk.
Set aside.
On waxed paper, lightly coat chicken with flour. Dip into soup mixture.
On another piece of waxed paper, coat chicken with stuffing.
On baking sheet, arrange chicken. Drizzle with margarine. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Extra Special Buttercream Frosting
steps: Cream shortening until fluffy; add sugar and continue creaming, until well blended.
Add salt, flavoring and whipping cream.
Blend on low speed until moistened.
Beat on high speed until icing is fluffy.

title: Steak With Rice

ingredients.name: steak run through cuber
ingredients.raw: 1 round steak, run through cuber or pounded

steps: Place rice in baking pan.
Mix soup and water; pour over rice. Place steak on top of rice mixture. Salt and pepper may be sprinkled over steak.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brown Sugar Pie
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Pour blended ingredients into 9-inch pie crusts.
Bake in 350° oven until done.
Makes 2 or more pies.

title: Chocolate Pie Or Coconut Pie
steps: Heat milks.
Mix sugar, cocoa, flour and salt.
Beat real good.
Beat egg yolks good and add 1/2 hot mixture into yolks.
Pur egg yolks into hot milk.
Cook until thickens.
Add vanilla and butter.

title: Brisket Of Beef And Potatoes

ingredients.name: first brisket of beef
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. first cut brisket of beef

ingredients.name: all purpose potato and
ingredients.raw: 4 large all-purpose potatoes, peeled and quartered

steps: Generously season meat with garlic powder and salt.
Place in open roasting pan and bake 1/2 hour in 500° oven.
Remove from oven. Lower oven temperature to 350°.
Add onions and water to cover bottom of pan.
Cover and return to oven for 1/2 hour.
Add potatoes to pan and pour tomato sauce and 1/2 can of water over meat and potatoes.
Cover and cook 2 hours.
Turn potatoes once and spoon gravy over all.
Meat should be tender.
Allow to cool before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Balls (No Bake)
steps: Mix all ingredients by hand.
Shape into small balls.
Melt 1 large package of chocolate chips (double boiler) plus 1/2 piece of paraffin wax.
Dip balls into hot chocolate mix and put them on wax paper to cool.
Let them harden (or put them into the refrigerator).
After they have hardened, place them in a freezer bag and freeze.

title: Yawning Yellow Yahoo Cake
steps: Mix together all dry ingredients.
Add shortening, then milk, vanilla and eggs.
Mix until smooth.
Bake at 350° in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Frost and eat!

title: Apple Nut Muffins
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well.
Pour into muffin pans that have been sprayed with Pam at 350° for approximately 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Cake(No Eggs)
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl and make 3 wells in it.
Place vanilla, oil and vinegar, each in a well. Pour cold coffee over all and stir.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan.
Makes 24 great cupcakes.

title: Kisses
steps: Beat egg whites until very dry.
Add white sugar, beating all the time, then add brown sugar and vanilla.
Beat until stiff. Add nuts.

title: Mama Susie'S Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil fryer until done.
Cook noodles in chicken broth until done.
Add other ingredients, except bread crumbs and margarine. Pour into baking dish.
Top with melted margarine.
Sprinkle crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
This will make a large casserole or 2 medium casseroles.

title: Pony'S Chocolate Pudding
steps: In heavy boiler, combine flour, cocoa, sugar, egg yolks, milk and water.
Cook on medium heat until thickened; stir constantly. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring.
Put vanilla wafers in 2 to 2 1/2-quart ovenproof bowl.
Pour cooked mixture over vanilla wafers. Beat egg whites stiff.
Add 1/2 teaspoon flavoring and 1/2 cup sugar.
Spread on top of pudding.
Top brown in oven.
Watch carefully to keep from burning.

title: Low-Fat Pineapple Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in a square cake dish.
Bake at 350° until center springs back.

title: Buttermilk Waffles

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. melted butter or vegetable oil

steps: Mix together flour, oats, cornmeal and baking powder in a large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and blend well.
Let batter stand 15 minutes before baking.

title: Strawberry Butter(This Is Good On Many Breads, But Is Real Yummy On Hot Biscuits.)

ingredients.name: strawberry completely thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, completely thawed

steps: Soften butter in mixing bowl.
Add thawed strawberries.
Add powdered sugar and stir until real smooth.	Refrigerate but allow to soften slightly before serving.

title: Cream Of Pimiento Soup

ingredients.name: salt and ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: Saute the onion and pimientos in the butter until the onion is tender but not brown.
Blend in the flour; gradually add the broth and milk.
Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Add the cheese and stir until melted.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Lime Gelatin Salad
steps: Let cheese soften and mix with gelatin.
Add hot water; mix and add remaining ingredients.
Chill.

title: Cherry-O-Cream Cheese Pie
steps: In medium sized bowl, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and stir until well mixed.
Blend in lemon juice and vanilla.
Turn into crust. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Garnish with chilled cherry pie filling.

title: Tuna Fish Salad
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper in bowl.
Place lettuce on plate.
Scoop tuna salad onto bed of lettuce.
Serve.

title: Cowboy Beans

ingredients.name: salt pork
ingredients.raw: salt pork or ham butt to season

steps: In a large Dutch oven, place pinto beans, onion and salt pork or ham.
Cover with water and cook slow for about 3 hours, adding water as needed.

title: Jules Salmon Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brush salmon with olive oil. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and dill.
Squeeze lemon on top
of salmon and sprinkle with brown sugar.	Top salmon with the lemon slices. Bake 20 to 30 minutes.
This bakes really well in stoneware.

title: Fried Tomato Slices
steps: Slice tomatoes into 3/4 inch slices.
Combine eggs and milk. Dip each tomato slice in egg mixture and then into cracker crumbs. Melt shortening and fry coated tomato slices.
Brown on both sides,
turning once.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Oriental Cabbage
steps: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, add cabbage.

title: Poultry Quiche
steps: Bake pie shell in a 350° oven until brown, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle turkey or chicken into pie shell, along with cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until blended.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Deer Chili

ingredients.name: ground deer meat
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. ground deer meat (amount according to your taste)

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Brown ground deer and drain.
In stew pot, add all of the ingredients together.
Simmer on low about 1 hour.
(You may also use ground beef, ground chuck or ground turkey.)

title: Creamy Lime Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Cool slightly, then add milk.
Chill until thick, but not set.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate.
Serves 16.

title: Blintz Casserole
steps: Grease a casserole with 1 to 1 1/2-inch sides with margarine. Place blintzes, folded side in dish.
Top each blintz with 1/2 teaspoon margarine.
Beat remaining ingredients until well mixed and pour over blintzes.
Bake in preheated 350° oven until set and beginning to brown.
Serves 3 to 4.

title: Tropical Cake

ingredients.name: or more pecan coarsely
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. or more pecans, coarsely broken

steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Preheat oven to 325°.
Spread pie filling over bottom of pan. Sprinkle coconut over pie filling. Add crushed pineapple with juice. Spread evenly.
Add dry cake mix from box.
Spread on and smooth top. Spoon melted margarine over dry cake mixture. Sprinkle top with pecans.
Bake 30 minutes or until brown.
Serve warm or cool by spooning from dish.
May serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Houston Shrimp Kabobs

ingredients.name: shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: garlic clove and in three
ingredients.raw: 3 garlic cloves, peeled and cut in three

steps: Place all ingredients in a bowl.
Marinate 12 hours in refrigerator.

title: Overnight Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 c chicken breasts, cooked and chopped

ingredients.name: shell macaroni and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg small shell macaroni, cooked and drained

steps: Combine cooked chicken and macaroni, mix well.
Add cucumber, celery, mayonnaise, sour cream and salt and pepper.
Mix well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Aunt Sylvia'S Chocolate Sauce
steps: Bring to a boil and boil one minute.
Stir continuously.
Beat it off the stove one more minute.
Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Broccoli-Lima Bean Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and lima beans as package calls for.
Cool.
Mix all together.

title: Taco Fantastico

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Hidden Valley Ranch (milk or buttermilk)

steps: Brown ground beef with chili powder; drain.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef with cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, taco chips, olives and prepared dressing.
Garnish with taco chips.

title: Mustard Greens With Straw Mushrooms

ingredients.name: peanut vegetable
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. peanut, vegetable or corn oil

steps: Discard tough outer leaves and cut off tough base end of each set of mustard greens.
Also remove the soft leafy portion, leaving the firm center portions.
Cut these pieces into 1 1/2-inch lengths.
Wash and drain well.
Boil a small amount of water (enough to later cover greens).
Add the greens.
Let the water return to a boil; drain greens and drop immediately into cold water, then drain well (this blanching tenderizes the tougher mustard greens).

title: Twice Baked Sweet Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers, leaving 1/8-inch shell.
Mix potatoes, 2 tablespoons margarine, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg with an electric mixer until smooth.
Stir in 2 cups marshmallows, pineapple and 1/2 cup marshmallows and walnuts; spoon into shells.
Toss remaining margarine, marshmallows and walnuts; sprinkle on top of potatoes. Bake 20 minutes.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cucumbers(Polish)

ingredients.name: dill leaf
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. finely chopped fresh dill leaves

steps: Sprinkle the cucumber slices with salt and leave to drain for 30 minutes.
Drain off excess water.
Put the cucumbers into a serving bowl.
Mix together the ingredients with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour over the cucumbers and fold together gently. Leave in a cool place for 15 minutes before serving.
Serves 4.

title: Soft Pretzels(Easy Enough For Children To Make)

ingredients.name: kosher salt sesame seed
ingredients.raw: kosher salt, sesame seed or poppy seed

steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes.
Combine next three ingredients; add to yeast mixture, mixing well.
Turn dough out onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 minutes).
Divide into 16 portions; roll each into an 8 to 10-inch rope.
Twist each into pretzel shapes, letters or curlicues; place on ungreased baking sheets.
Combine egg with water; stir well.
Brush pretzels with egg mixture; sprinkle with kosher salt or seed.
Bake at 425° for 12 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.
Yields 16 pretzels.

title: Easy Make Ahead Dessert
steps: Beat first five ingredients until light and fluffy.
Line muffin tins with paper liners.
Place vanilla wafers in bottom of each cupcake paper liner.
Fill with mixture 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 20 minutes.
Top with 1 tablespoon cherry pie filling.
Chill.

title: Almond Joys
steps: Heat Karo syrup and mix with coconut.
Chill and roll into Almond Joy shape.
Top with an almond.
Dip into melted chocolate and put on wax paper to harden.

title: Champagne Chicken
steps: Salt and pepper chicken breasts, place in a baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients well in a separate mixing bowl using a mixer on low speed to blend in the margarine.
Pour mixture over chicken and bake uncovered at 350° for 50 minutes to an hour. Serve with rice.

title: Trillionaire Candy
steps: In a pan, combine topping and pecans over medium heat.
Stir constantly. Bring to a boil and cook 3 to 5 minutes longer or until thick.
Cool 5 minutes. Spoon 1/2 teaspoon caramel mixture on each cracker.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until firm.
Melt chips and dip bottom of each cracker in chocolate.

title: Cream Cheese Rounds
steps: Mix ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for twelve minutes (until soft).

title: Panic Button Casserole

ingredients.name: beef bite sized
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. dried beef, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: Stir soup to creamy consistency; add remaining ingredients except cheese.
Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top.
Cover; refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.
Uncover.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Marinated Pork Tenderloin
steps: Drain pineapple; reserve juice.
Combine reserved juice and next 3 ingredients; set aside.
In a small dish, pour marinade over tenderloins.
Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Cook on grill about 20 to 30 minutes on each side.
Grill pineapple slices for about 5 minutes and place on top of the tenderloins.

title: Creole Tomatoes
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain, chop and set aside.
In the skillet, leave just enough bacon grease to saute onions until transparent.
Add to this the pulp, scooped carefully with teaspoon, from the tomatoes (do not scrape shells too thin).
Add the mashed eggs and enough bread crumbs to make a firm mixture. Season with butter, salt, pepper and parsley (if necessary, add a little canned tomato juice).
Add bacon last and stuff tomatoes with mixture.
Sprinkle tops with buttered bread crumbs.
Place stuffed tomatoes in a baking dish and bake at 350° until thoroughly heated and buttered bread crumbs are browned.
Do not cook long enough for tomatoes to lose shape.
Serve hot.

title: Heirloom Butter Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cream together butter, powdered sugar and salt.
Add vanilla and flour.
Mix thoroughly.
Shape into balls, using about 1 teaspoon for each cookie.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes.
These will not brown, so be careful and leave in for specified time.
Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Linguine With Clam Sauce
steps: Saute minced garlic in olive oil in skillet.
Then add chopped onion to mixture and saute.
Add diced bell pepper to mixture and saute.
Take juice from 2 cans of clams and pour into mixture. Drain juice from the rest of the clams and pour out.
Saute mixture while cooking linguini.
Add 2 drops olive oil to water when cooking linguini.
When cooked, drain and put in large bowl. Pour sauteed mixture over and mix.

title: Kraut Relish
steps: Mix together kraut, onion, celery and green pepper.
Combine vinegar, oil and sugar.
Blend and let stand for 1 hour or longer. Serves 6.

title: Korean Seaweed And Rice
steps: Buy seaweed in an Asian grocery store.
Cut sheets into quarters.
Brush both sides very lightly with sesame oil and sprinkle lightly with salt.
Broil on a cookie sheet for about 5 seconds.
(This is somewhat similar to potato and is delicious all by itself.)
Put a small amount of rice in the middle of each sheet and roll up like a log.
Serve as a side dish or hors d'oeuvres.

title: Rise'S Lemon Pudding Cake
steps: In a large bowl, mix sugar, salt and lemon juice.
Add 6 egg yolks (save egg whites in separate bowl) and beat well.
Add flour and melted butter (or margarine) and mix well.
Add milk (one cup at a time).
Beat egg whites until peaked and fold into mixture.
Pour into well-greased 9 x 11-inch baking dish.
Set baking dish into pan of cold water (approximately 1/2-inch deep)* and bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
Cool and serve. Refrigerate when cool.

title: Almond Roca Or Butter Crunch
steps: Boil all ingredients (except chocolate bar) slowly to hard crack when dropped in cold water.
Will be pretty dry.
Spread into 2 pizza pans (medium size).
Break chocolate bar into pieces and drop onto hot candy.
Spread after it melts and then sprinkle with more chopped nuts (or save a few).

title: Never Fail Frosting
steps: Place sugar, unbeaten egg whites, cream of tartar and water in top of double boiler.
With eggbeater, whip briskly while cooking mixture over vigorously boiling water, but do not touch top of upper pan.
Whip until stiffly beaten.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Special Strawberry Bread
steps: Sift
dry
ingredients	together
in bowl. Make a well. Add strawberries, juice and all*.
Add oil and eggs.
Mix well by hand.
Stir
in food coloring.
Spoon into two greased and floured loaf
pans.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
Cool on rack before removing from pans.

title: Beer Cheese Dip

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz. each) pkg. cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch milk recipe original ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe original Ranch salad dressing mix

steps: In medium bowl, combine Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and salad dressing mix.
Gradually stir in beer until mixture is to desired consistency.
Garnish with green onion and additional Cheddar cheese.
Serve with pretzels or assorted fresh vegetables, if desired.
Makes about 3 cups.

title: Chocolate Oreo Dessert(Pampered Chef)

ingredients.name: reese s peanut butter cup
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Reese's peanut butter cups (1.6 oz.)

steps: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Remove from oven and cool completely.
Chop Oreo cookies (2 cups) and mix with 1 1/2 bowls of whipped topping. Spread Oreo mixture on top of brownie.
Chop Reese's cups and sprinkle on top of Oreo mixture.
Drizzle ice cream topping over top.
Use remaining whipped cream to garnish.

title: Carnation 5-Minute Fudge(Heritage Recipe)
steps: In saucepan mix evaporated milk, sugar and salt and cook over low heat to boiling.
Cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Add marshmallows, chocolate pieces, vanilla and nuts.

title: Cream Cheese Cake Puffs
steps: Beat together the first 4 ingredients until smooth.
Line cupcake tins with paper liners.
Place 1 vanilla wafer at the bottom of each.
Fill 3/4 full with cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.
Top with pie filling.
Makes 12 cupcakes.

title: Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; drain.
Combine sugar, flour, salt and eggs. Cook until thick and cool.
Let stand overnight.
Add mandarin oranges, pineapple and Cool Whip.

title: Southern Yeast Biscuit Dough

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. (1/4 oz. each) active dry yeast

steps: Combine the water and sugar in a small bowl.
Stir in the yeast. Set aside until the mixture becomes bubbly. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and baking soda.
Stir to mix. Cut in the shortening using a pastry blender, a fork or your fingertips until the mixture resembles cornmeal.
Add the yeast mixture and buttermilk. Stir with a large wooden spoon until well mixed.
This will not be a smooth dough.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the dough until needed; it will keep about 1 week. Makes about 8 cups of dough.

title: Quick Pound Cake
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients; alternate with the flour, sifted 3 times, baking powder, soda and salt.
Bake 1 hour at 325° or 350° using tube pan or 2 loaf pans.

title: One Egg Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add unbeaten egg and vanilla. Beat well.
Sift flour.
Sift with baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk to creamed shortening.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
steps: Mix brown sugar and flour.
Mix first four ingredients and shape into 2-inch balls.
Roll in brown sugar and flour mixture. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired, and dip in melted butter.
Put in greased casserole and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Crawfish Jambalaya In Rice Cooker
steps: Mix all ingredients, except butter, and place in rice cooker. Pour melted butter over all.
Do not add water.
Cook as you would rice.
Do not open and stir.
After chime sounds on cooker, continue steaming 30 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Cinnamon Salad
steps: Stir candies in water until dissolved.
Remove from heat; add jello and stir.
Start to set in refrigerator, then add celery, apple and pineapple.
Pour in mold and return to refrigerator until set.

title: Sugar Cookies For Cookie Cutters
steps: Cream first 5 ingredients.
Add dry items.
Chill for 2 hours. Then roll with flour.
Use cookie cutter in desired shapes.
Bake in 350° oven about 10 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple And Rice

ingredients.name: uncooked golden acre instant rice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. uncooked Golden Acres instant rice

steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
I use crushed pineapple instead of pineapple slices.
Put 1/3 of rice in bottom of a buttered casserole.
Cover with 1/2 of pineapple and dot with 1 1/2 tablespoons butter and 1/4 cup brown sugar.
Repeat with another 1/3 of rice and rest of pineapple.
Dot with butter and brown sugar.
Cover with remaining rice.
Dot with remaining brown sugar and butter.
Pour pineapple juice over top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
I bake this in 2 baking dishes and freeze one and it warms in oven good.
This serves about 6 people.

title: Delicious Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 small chicken or 6 to 8 chicken breasts, cooked and chopped up

steps: Mix chicken with the 2 cans of soup and broth and place in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Crush crackers and brown in margarine.
Place on top of chicken mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Butter Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, 1 at a time and beat well after each addition.
Add flour and cream alternately to mixture. Flour and grease tube pan.
Bake on highest rack in oven at 300° for 1 hour and 50 minutes.

title: Pecan Lemon Fruit Cake
steps: Cream butter; add sugar and cream. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Mix baking powder with flour one cup at a time. Mix the other cup of flour with nuts and fruit.
Fold the mixture in and add the lemon extract.
Mix well; pour in tube pan and let set overnight in refrigerator.
Cook in slow oven at 250° for 3 hours.

title: Grilled Mushroom And Cheese Sandwich
steps: Saute bacon until crisp.
Remove, drain and crumble.
Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings; add mushrooms for 2 minutes. Spread toast with mayonnaise; top with sauteed mushrooms, crumbled bacon, onion rings and cheese.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 8 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.
Serves 3 as entree or cut into quarters and serve as hors d'oeuvres.

title: Carolyn'S Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: family size vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. family size vanilla pudding mix (not Instant)

steps: Mix Cool Whip and buttermilk.
Sprinkle pudding mix over top. Stir.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Chill at least one hour before serving.
This recipe came from a very dear friend who we were stationed with at Eglin AFB Florida.

title: Ribs And Kraut
steps: Combine in covered pan.
Bake at 375° for 2 hours.

title: World'S Best Brownies
steps: Melt butter and chocolate.
Let cool.
Meanwhile, cream eggs and sugar well.
Add all other ingredients including butter and chocolate.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 30 to 32 minutes at 350°.
You may want to put foil around the edges of the brownies before you bake them to avoid overbaked edges.

title: Meat Loaf Pizza
steps: Blend first 6 ingredients together.
Shape and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Divan

ingredients.name: broccoli pear
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into spears or 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. cooked, cubed chicken or turkey

steps: In 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole, arrange broccoli and top with chicken.
Combine soup and milk; pour over top.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine butter and bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over cheese.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Buttermilk Custard
steps: Melt butter.
Add sugar, milk and flour.
Beat in eggs.
Put in unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350°.

title: Easiest Fruit Salad
steps: Mix and refrigerate.
Should be eaten soon after mixing so the fruit doesn't discolor.

title: Fresh Salsa - Quickly

ingredients.name: jalapeno
ingredients.raw: 1 jalapeno (1/3 for mild, 2/3 for medium and all for hot and spicy)

steps: Put all of the ingredients in your food processor and mix to a consistency desired.
Medium thickness is best.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Becca'S Best Punch

ingredients.name: container raspberry sherbet
ingredients.raw: 1 container raspberry sherbet or vanilla ice cream (optional)

steps: Freeze a ring of cranberry juice in a Bundt cake pan. Chill all others overnight.
Mix all ingredients together.
Add more or less of one to taste.
May add ice.
Serves 40 plus.

title: Mexican Chili Dip

ingredients.name: velveeta mexican cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta Mexican cheese or regular processed cheese

steps: Over low heat, melt processed cheese.
Add cream cheese and melt together.
Mix in chili.
Pour into dish and serve with nacho chips.

title: Venison Sausage
steps: Remove all fat from the venison.
Venison fat is strong and musky and not good eating.
Use the same amount of lean fresh pork as you have of venison.
Your mixture should be half and half to be really good.
Grind up the meats and mix them together thoroughly.
Then add water, mixing well.
Mix in the seasonings. At this point, it is a good idea to cook a little of the sausage mixture and adjust seasonings to your taste.
Stuff the meat in casings, keeping the links about 6 to 8-inches long.
The sausage may also be molded into patties and wrapped in aluminum foil.

title: Hearty Bean Soup

ingredients.name: ham hock
ingredients.raw: 1 ham hock or 1 1/2 c. diced cooked ham

steps: Combine all ingredients and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender.
Add more chicken broth and water if needed.

title: No-Knead Bran Bread
steps: Stir together flour, dry milk and salt.
Combine yeast, sugar, warm water and cereal in large mixing bowl; let stand 2 minutes. Add egg, oleo and 1 cup flour.
Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes. Gradually add flour to remaining mixture by hand to stiffen sticky dough.
Let rise until double in size, about 1 hour.
Stir down; spoon into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan and bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Apache Cheese Bread(Party Dip)
steps: Scoop out bread.
Mix all ingredients.
Place in scooped out bread.
Bake at 350° on sprayed cookie sheet for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Or you may serve with crackers.

title: Tia Maria
steps: Boil until sugar is dissolved; remove scum.
Cool to room temperature.
Add 26 ounces straight alcohol.

title: Mother'S Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix dry ingredients and add beaten eggs, milk and vanilla. Cook in top of double boiler until thick.
Put into uncooked pie shell and bake at 400°.

title: Sausage And Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: hillshire farm smoked sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hillshire Farm smoked sausage or Polish kielbasa (any variety), sliced in bite size pieces

ingredients.name: or vegetable
ingredients.raw: 3 1/4 c. fresh or frozen chopped vegetables (broccoli, carrots, onion, mushrooms)

ingredients.name: salt pepper garlic and oregano seasoning
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper, garlic and oregano for seasoning

steps: Cook rice and keep warm. Saute vegetables in oil until crisp and tender. Add sausage and season to taste.
Heat thoroughly. Mix in 1/2 cup cheese and serve immediately over warm rice. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Crisp Chicken
steps: Salt and pepper chicken; mix eggs with milk and beat well. Put chicken pieces in egg mixture and then coat with crushed chips until well coated.
Place on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam; bake at 325° for about 35 minutes.

title: Caroline'S Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix flour, salt and baking soda; set aside.
Mix shortening and peanut butter; add both kinds of sugar.
Mix well.
Add eggs and beat well.
Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture.
Drop dough from a teaspoon on a baking sheet.
Flatten with a watered fork.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Chow Mein Clusters
steps: Melt butterscotch bits, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in noodles, coating carefully.
Add peanuts and mix quickly.
Drop onto wax paper with teaspoon.

title: Favorite Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken soup or mushroom

ingredients.name: dry lipton onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry Lipton onion soup mix

steps: Put chicken in casserole dish.
Mix sour cream, soup and onion mix.
Spread on chicken.
Add chow mein noodles, if desired.
Cook 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Marguerite'S Brown Sugar Pie
steps: Stir eggs, sugar and syrup.
Add flour and mix well.
Add vanilla and melted butter.
Blend and pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. can cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: cheddar
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. Cheddar or American cheese, shredded

steps: Slice peeled potatoes.
Mix all ingredients together and bake in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Can also bake in microwave for 45 minutes on Medium setting.

title: Biscotti(Italian Anise Toast)
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream oleo and sugar; add flavoring.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add flour and almonds.
Dough will be sticky; divide in half.
Spread with floured fingers in log shape on greased cookie sheet, side by side.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cut diagonally into slices.
Turn onto one side.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes; turn over and bake until lightly toasted.
Store in tight container.
Makes 3 to 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Hoecakes

ingredients.name: bacon fat butter
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. bacon fat, butter or vegetable oil

steps: Combine the cornmeal and salt in medium bowl.
Stirring cornmeal constantly with spoon, pour in boiling water in a slow stream and beat until smooth.
Let stand a few minutes.
Heat a large heavy skillet with bacon fat, butter or oil until hot.

title: Kartoffel Kloesse

ingredients.name: bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. bread crumbs or cracker meal

steps: Boil potatoes in jackets, skin and mash.
Spread to dry out moisture.
Put them in large bowl and add 2 level teaspoonfuls salt.
Make hollow and break into this two eggs.
Sift in flour, add cracker meal and nutmeg.
Mix and form into dry balls (if too wet, add more cracker meal).
Drop small balls into boiling, salted water.
When these potato balls come to surface of water, allow to boil 3 minutes.
Center on platter and add dressing made as follows:
Melt butter in frying pan; add bread crumbs.
Brown and spread on potato balls.
Makes 18.

title: Chocolate Bread 'N Butter Pudding

ingredients.name: day old bread
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 c. small cubes day old bread

ingredients.name: semi
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. semi or bitter-sweet chocolate, grated

steps: Place bread cubes in a shallow, 2-quart baking dish (12 x 3 x 2 1/2-inch high oven dish works well).
Pour butter over bread and toss to mix well.
Gently stir in chocolate.
Heat eggs with sugar, vanilla and salt, then beat in warmed cream and milk.
Pour custard over bread crumbs.
Place baking dish in a larger pan.
Add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake in 375° oven until custard is set, about 45 minutes.
(One of Narsai David's KCBS kitchen goodies!)

title: Smoked Brisket
steps: Place brisket in roaster.
Pour liquid smoke over brisket. Sprinkle with garlic and celery salt; cover with onion.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Prune Pudding
steps: Put prunes, raisins and water in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Keep just at boiling point and mash with a potato masher. Add sugar. Stir with masher. Add tapioca, one tablespoonful at a time.
Keep cooking and stirring for 2 or 3 minutes.
Pudding will thicken as it cools.
Serve with cream or half and half.

title: Gina'S Ranch Crackers
steps: Throw all ingredients in covered bowl and shake to mix well. Then shake again.
Let marinate in fridge overnight.

title: Zucchini Crab Cakes

ingredients.name: zucchini and squeezed dry
ingredients.raw: 2 c. zucchini, peeled, grated and squeezed dry

steps: Mix and form into cakes.
Lightly flour and fry until brown. Can be served with tartar sauce.

title: Black Olive Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: kraft roka blue cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 jar (8 oz.) Kraft Roka Blue cheese

steps: Blend together first three ingredients.
Add olives and chives.
Mold into ball and refrigerate.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Beef Burger Barbecue(A Teen-Age Party Food)

ingredients.name: red star special active dry yeast
ingredients.raw: 1 packet Red Star special active dry yeast or 1 cake Red Star compressed yeast

ingredients.name: condensed onion soup
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. condensed onion soup (reserve remainder of 10 1/2 oz. can)

ingredients.name: pillsbury s best all purpose flour
ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/4 c. Pillsbury's Best all-purpose flour*

steps: Soften yeast in warm water in mixing bowl.
Strain soup.
Add sugar, shortening, salt, egg and strained soup to softened yeast. Gradually add flour to form a soft dough, beating well.
(For first additions of flour, use mixer).
Cover.
Let rise in warm place (85° to 90°F) until light and doubled in size, 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut And Ribs
steps: Put all ingredients in pot. Cover and cook until meat falls off bones. Remove about 1 cup juice.
Thicken with 2 tablespoons flour.
Add to meat and sauerkraut. Add cooked kielbasi.

title: Hamburger-Cornbread Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and onion.
Add Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, salt and tomato juice; cook for 15 minutes, then add kidney beans.
Pour into greased casserole dish and top with cornbread mixture.
Bake at 425° for about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hearty Bacon Potato Chowder
steps: Cook bacon in saucepan over medium heat until bacon is crisp. Add potatoes and onions.
Continue cooking for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender.
Add remaining ingredients and continue cooking until heated thoroughly, 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Jean Nickel'S Peanut Brittle
steps: Put 1/2 cup water in large, heavy pan and bring to boil.
Add sugar and syrup; stir until dissolved and then boil until it spins a thread. Add peanuts and cook slowly over a low fire until it turns a golden brown.
Turn off fire and leave pan on burner. Then add butter and flavoring and stir good.
Add baking soda. Mixture will foam up and change color and texture.
Stir thoroughly and then spread quickly in large, buttered jelly roll pan.

title: Shrimp Fettucini
steps: Cook fettucini; follow directions on package.
Warm alfredo sauce.
Cook the Knorr creamy pesto mix.
Follow the directions on package.
Add cooked shrimp to the alfredo sauce.
Drain the fettucini.
Add the alfredo sauce and shrimp to fettucini.
Add the pesto mix to the fettucini and alfredo sauce.
Serve on plates topped with Parmesan cheese and black pepper.
Enjoy!

title: Almond Shortbread Bars

ingredients.name: land o lake sweet cream butter
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Land O' Lakes sweet cream butter, softened

steps: Heat oven to 350°.

In a large mixer bowl, combine flour. sugar, butter, egg yolk and almond extract. Beat at low speed, scraping bowl often, until particles are fine (2 to 3 minutes). Press in bottom of greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.

title: Nana Mccann'S Chocolate Sauce
steps: Simmer together butter, milk and sugar for 10 minutes.
Add chocolate, vanilla and salt to milk mixture.
Simmer half hour three or more times (raising and lowering temperature to keep from boiling but bringing to boil 3 times).
Test consistency by dropping a little in cold water.

title: Appetizer Shrimp Dip
steps: Thin softened cheese and shrimp with half and half.
Add enough catsup for color.
Add spices.
Let stand in refrigerator 2 to 6 hours.
Do not use blender.
Enjoy!

title: Party Rye Loaf

ingredients.name: or pkg. chipped beef
ingredients.raw: 1 small jar or pkg. chipped beef, shredded

steps: Mix all ingredients except bread.
Hollow out loaf of bread so that loaf resembles a bowl.
Fill with dip.
Cut up bread that was scooped into bite size pieces.

title: Pork Chops With Lima Beans
steps: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper.
Coat chops with flour, brown on both sides in hot shortening.
Place lima beans in casserole dish; sprinkle with onion.
Place chops on beans; top with tomatoes.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake, covered at 325° for 1 1/2 hours, until chops are tender.
Liquid from tomatoes can be used during baking, if necessary.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Classic Rum Cake

ingredients.name: jell o vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 3/4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding and pie filling

steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan.
Mix all cake ingredients together.
Pour batter over nuts.
Bake 1 hour.
Cool.
Invert on serving plate.
When completely cooled, sprinkle top of cake with powdered sugar.
Enjoy!

title: Ground Turkey Breast Basic Mix

ingredients.name: plain
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. plain or seasoned dry bread crumbs

ingredients.name: ground pepper or
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. ground pepper or to taste

steps: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients.
Add other seasonings as desired.
You can use this mixture for burgers, meat balls or meat loaf.
Makes 6 servings (140 calories, 2 g fat per serving).

title: Corned Beef Dinner For St. Patrick'S Day(Serves 6)

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cabbage, cut in wedges

ingredients.name: butter and parsley
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. melted butter and minced parsley

steps: Wipe brisket with a damp paper towel.
Put in pot and cover with water.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat, cover pan tightly and cook 3 1/2 to 4 hours.
In the meantime, prepare vegetables.

title: Mom'S Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Place paper cupcake liners into muffin pan which holds 12 muffins.

title: Honey Ham
steps: Cut meat off bone.
Use 12 ounces.
Steam 30 minutes.
Cool. Remove skin; cut off fat.
Slice into small pieces (2 or 3 inches round).
Steam again, 30 minutes.
Remove juices. Boil water.
Add sugar and ham.
Stir 1 to 2 minutes until sugar dissolves and bubbles appear.
Add honey until mixture is complete, about 30 seconds.

title: Texas Ranger Beans
steps: Mix ketchup, sugar, vinegar, chili powder, Worcestershire, salt and pepper to a paste.
Add to beans and onion.
Bring to a boil.
Bake in oven at 325° for 1 hour or until sauce is thick.

title: Sausage Cheese Muffins
steps: Brown sausage and onion; drain.
Pour in Bisquick, pepper and sugar.
Add cheese and milk.
Bake in muffin tins at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 20 muffins.

title: Ambrosia Congealed Salad

ingredients.name: or pkg. orange flavored jello
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small pkg. orange flavored jello

steps: Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Add cold water to juice to measure 1 cup. Stir boiling water into jello in
a large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Stir in measured liquid. Refrigerate 1 1/4 hours or until slightly thickened. Stir in Cool Whip with wire whip until smooth.
Refrigerate 10 minutes or until mixture will mound.
Stir in oranges, pineapple, marshmallows and coconut.
Refrigerate until firm. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Heavenly Hash Pie
steps: Mix
all
ingredients, except Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shells and top with Cool Whip.

title: Baked Chicken And Broccoli
steps: Boil broccoli in salty water.
Bake chicken until tender. Slice and arrange the broccoli and chicken in a buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.
Pour over chicken and broccoli.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Jo Sims' Rolls
steps: Combine water, salt, lard and sugar.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add to yeast dissolved in water.
Add egg and half of flour.
Beat well. Stir in rest of flour.
(I use 1/2 cup of flour to knead the dough.)
Cover and let rise until double in bulk; punch down and put in refrigerator and let rise again.

title: Potato Deluxe Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: or more sharp cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. or more sharp Cheddar cheese, grated

steps: Thaw hash browns 30 minutes before using.
Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Put into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle crushed potato chips over top.
Dab with butter, if desired.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Stew

ingredients.name: carrot and
ingredients.raw: 4 carrots, peeled and cut into chunks

ingredients.name: salt pepper and paprika
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and paprika to taste

steps: Dredge stew meat in onion soup mix.
Put into baking casserole.
Put potatoes and carrots on top of meat.
Combine cream of mushroom soup and cooking sherry and mix until smooth. Add mushrooms to soup mixture.
Pour over top of meat, potatoes and carrots.
Cover and bake at 250° for 5 hours.

title: Apple Bread
steps: Grease loaf pans.
Mix flour and cinnamon.
Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Add apples.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Diabetes Apple Cake

ingredients.name: apple cored and in
ingredients.raw: 3 apples, cored and cut in pieces

steps: Use tart, crisp apples, not sweet varieties such as Delicious. Mix together the eggs, flour, cinnamon, vanilla and oil.
Beat for 5 minutes until everything is well mixed.
Add the cut apples and mix well.
Add the walnuts.
Pour batter into a greased pie pan. Bake in 450° oven for at least 30 minutes or until light brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Congealed Salad Or Dessert
steps: Sprinkle Jell-O over pineapple.
Add cottage cheese, Cool Whip and nuts; mix well.
Refrigerate.
Serve on lettuce leaves or as a dessert.

title: Skillet Scramble

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 1 can (8 oz.) tomatoes, drained and chopped

steps: In large skillet (preferably nonstick), melt butter or margarine with oil.
Saute pepper and onion over medium-low heat 10 minutes or until very tender.
Stir in ham and tomatoes; cook over medium heat until liquid evaporates, about 6 to 7 minutes.

title: Eggplant Italian
steps: Wash and cut ends from eggplant.
Slice eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds.
Boil until slightly tender.
Pour tomatoes into saucepan. Add spices; boil for 15 minutes.
Place tender eggplant into 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour cooked tomatoes over eggplant.
Add grated cheese to top.
Cover cheese with bread crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Slush Punch

ingredients.name: oz can cranberry apple juice concentrate

steps: In a bowl, combine the cranberry sauce, concentrates, water, cinnamon and allspice.
Cover and freeze for 8 hours or overnight. Remove from freezer 45 minutes before serving.
For each serving, combine 1/2 c. slush mixture with 1/2 c. lemon-lime soda.

title: Fruit Mix
steps: Drain all fruits very well.
Mix Jell-O into Cool Whip until well blended.
Fold in fruits. Chill 4 hours or overnight.

title: Baby Ruth Bars
steps: Mix all together and bake at 400° for 12 minutes.
Use a 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch pan.

title: Orange Yogurt Shake

ingredients.name: orange juice thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed

ingredients.name: nonfat vanilla
ingredients.raw: 2 c. nonfat vanilla or plain yogurt

steps: In blender container, combine all ingredients.
Cover and blend 30 seconds or until smooth.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: 7 Vegetable Mushroom Rice

ingredients.name: wild
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cooked wild or regular rice

steps: In a saucepan mix vegetables, rice, mushrooms and onions. Over medium heat, heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serves 8.

title: Raspberry Jello

ingredients.name: raspberry thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen raspberries, thawed and drained

steps: Dissolve gelatin in cold water.
Heat milk and pour in gelatin, stirring well.
Stir in salt and sugar until dissolved. Chill until partially set.
Whip Dream Whip following package directions.
Fold Dream Whip and raspberries into first mixture. Stir in food coloring if more color is desired.
Serves 10.

title: Ricotta Pie
steps: Combine together the first 6 ingredients; set aside.
Beat the eggs until foamy; add the 1 cup sugar.
Stir into the Ricotta mixture until well blended and smooth.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until mixture is firm and pastry is golden brown.
Remove from oven and place on cooling rack until cool.
Keep refrigerated.
Eat and enjoy.

title: Ricotti Bake

ingredients.name: spaghetti sauce from scratch
ingredients.raw: spaghetti sauce from scratch or Ragu

steps: Make spaghetti sauce; simmer.
Boil noodles.
Mix together in casserole.
Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese or layer.
Bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Ogede Paranta(Baked Banana; African)
steps: Peel banana and cut in half lengthwise.
Lay banana halves in baking dish and squeeze lemon or lime juice over them.
Make a syrup with the sugar and warm water.
Boil for 5 to 10 minutes. Pour over banana.
Bake at 325° until soft and slightly brown on top.

title: Punky'S Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Boil sugar, cocoa, corn syrup, salt and milk until forms soft ball in water.
After it tests done, add oleo, peanut butter, vanilla and walnuts.
Beat in until well mixed, then quickly spread on 2 buttered plates.

title: Mama'S Fruit Cake
steps: Add flour to fruit and nuts, making sure all is well coated. Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Add melted butter.
Mix in with hands the fruit and nut mixture.
Line tube pan with greased brown paper.
Bake in 275° oven for approximately 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Microwave Chicken Casserole
steps: Microwave broccoli in 1 1/2-quart dish for 2 minutes. Stir in rice, chicken, soup, milk, 1/4 cup cheese and onion.
Cook on High 6 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup shredded cheese and cook 5 minutes.
You may need to adjust cooking time depending on the microwave.

title: Herbed Radishes

ingredients.name: or pkg. radish
ingredients.raw: 2 large bunches or 2 (6 oz.) pkg. radishes

steps: In a medium size saucepan, place radishes in a single layer. Add just enough water to cover.
Boil gently, uncovered, 10 to 12 minutes or until tender; drain well.
Add margarine, thyme and basil.
Toss to coat.
Serves 4.

title: Pecan Fingers
steps: Cream butter and 9 tablespoons powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Blend in vanilla; add flour and nutmeg, mixing until well blended.
Stir in pecans.
Shape dough into finger shapes about 2 inches long.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 300° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Cook and roll each in powdered sugar. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Roasted Onions And Potatoes(Serves 8)

ingredients.name: russet potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. Russet potatoes, cut into wedges

steps: Combine all ingredients in large roasting pan.
Toss well. Bake at 450° until potatoes are crisp and golden brown, stirring occasionally, about 1 1/4 hours.
Season potatoes to taste with salt and pepper.

title: J. Burgers
steps: Mix onion soup mix and spaghetti mix with 1/2 cup hot water. Stir into a soup mixture.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Make into patties.
Cook like regular hamburgers.
You can add extra spices.

title: Sausage And Lentil Stew

ingredients.name: seasoning basil thyme bay leaf garlic hot pepper flake salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: seasonings to taste: basil, thyme, bay leaf, garlic, hot pepper flakes, salt and pepper

steps: Cook lentils according to package directions in water.
Simmer approximately 20 minutes until almost soft.

title: Capered Cherries
steps: Place cherries in a bowl and cover with white vinegar; let stand 24 hours.
Pour vinegar off.
Add sugar to cherries, cup for cup.
Stir every few hours for 5 or 6 days until sugar is dissolved.
Put in small jars and seal.
Serve as a condiment (like pickles).
Very good with poultry and meats.

title: John'S Potatoes And Smoked Sausage
steps: Cook onion, green pepper and garlic in small amount of oil until partly done.
Add potatoes, sausage, some chopped cilantro and several dashes of hot sauce on top.
Cook slowly for a good amount of time.
Add a small amount of water if it gets too dry. Add salt, if desired.

title: Caramel Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Rice-A-Roni
steps: Brown beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain and remove from skillet. Melt margarine in skillet and brown spaghetti.
Add beef, onion, rice and broth. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice and spaghetti are fully cooked. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Carrot Cake(Self-Rising Flour)
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients.
Add Wesson oil, eggs and carrots; beat well.
Pour into two 9-inch pans or three 8-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool.

title: Bulgarian Stew
steps: Grease an oblong casserole dish, large size.
Cut in the vegetables and sprinkle with salt, pepper and a little sugar. Season the meat and mix into the vegetables.
Pour over the juice; stir and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° until done, about 2 1/2 hours.
The meat should be very tender.
This can also be baked at 300° for a longer time.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: A+ Pound Cake
steps: Place all into a large mixing bowl and beat until very, very smooth.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
You don't have to cream any of the ingredients. Just dump everything into bowl.
This turns out well everytime.

title: Sid'S Easy Rice Dressing

ingredients.name: ground meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground meat or chicken livers

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.raw: 1 medium to large yellow onion, chopped

ingredients.name: red pepper black pepper and salt
ingredients.raw: pinch of red pepper, black pepper and salt

steps: Cook all ingredients together, stirring to keep from sticking in a Dutch oven about 1 hour.
Mix in cooked rice (4 cups).
Serves 10 to 12.
Or you can use a package of ground chicken livers.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread No. 2
steps: Mix well.
Pour into well-greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 450°.

title: Tuna Balls(16 Calorie Appetizer)

ingredients.name: water pack tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can water pack tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Blend tuna and cheese.
Add celery, lemon juice, Worcestershire and salt.
Mix well.
Allowing 2 teaspoons for each, form mixture into small balls.
Roll in chopped parsley and chill well.
Serve with cocktail picks.
Makes 30 balls.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet.
In a large mixing bowl add cornbread mix, milk, egg, oil and creamed corn.
Mix well. Pour half of mixture in a deep cast-iron skillet.
Layer hamburger and onion, layer cheese and then pepper.
Cover with remaining mix.
Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Freezer Pickles
steps: Mix together the cucumbers, onion, pepper and salt in big mixing bowl.
Set aside 2 hours, then drain.
Mix together vinegar, sugar, celery seed and mustard seed in cooking pan; bring to boil. Set aside.
Let cool.
Pour over cucumbers.
Put in refrigerator 2 or 3 days, then freeze in small amounts.

title: Bacon Cabbage Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of celery soup

steps: Fry bacon until crisp.
Cut up cabbage and layer it in 8 x 11-inch casserole dish with celery soup, crumbled bacon and grated cheese.
Add a small amount of water.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Slowly add liquids, beating constantly.

title: Delicious Strawberry Pie
steps: Take enough frozen berries from freezer to fill a pie tin. Drain off liquid after berries are thawed.
Make a strawberry sauce by adding about 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch to liquid and boiling until it is thickened.
Take an unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle the bottom with flour thinly.
Put in strawberries. Cover with 1 cup sugar, then pour over the cooled strawberry sauce, enough to fill pan.
Cover with top crust and prick with a fork.
Sprinkle a little sugar on top before baking.
Bake in 375° to 400° oven for about 1 hour.

title: Biscuit Sausage Quiche

ingredients.name: pillsbury grand refrigerated buttermilk biscuit
ingredients.raw: 1 can Pillsbury Grands refrigerated buttermilk biscuits

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In large skillet, brown sausage, onion and green pepper; drain well.
Combine eggs, cheese and sausage mixture.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: bacon in
ingredients.raw: 4 strips bacon, cut in small pieces

ingredients.name: american cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. American cheese, cut in strips

steps: Cook cauliflower in boiling salted water.
Drain; cool and break into flowerets.
Arrange alternate layers of cauliflower, bacon and cheese in well greased casserole.
Beat eggs with milk and seasonings.
Pour over all.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp With Garlic Butter
steps: Slit each shrimp down the back without removing the shell. Flatten and place cut side up in a shallow broiler pan.
Sprinkle with the garlic and olive oil and put under a preheated broiler. Broil 3 minutes, then turn the shrimp.
Broil an additional 4 minutes, or until the flesh is opaque and the shrimp are cooked through.
Transfer to a warmed platter.
Pour the cooking liquid over the shrimp and sprinkle with the parsley and lemon juice. Garnish with lemon wedges.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Dip For Tortilla Chips
steps: Cook ground beef; drain excess fat.
Add cheese and soup and simmer on low heat until cheese is melted.
Add salsa and blend well.
Serve dip with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Wild Rice
steps: Put all ingredients, except broth, in frying pan and cook until long grain rice appears a little yellow.
Add bouillon and put everything in a greased 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Sour Cream Duck
steps: Coat duck with flour; fry in melted butter.
Add onion, tomato juice and mushrooms.
Cook until onion is tender.
Cook duck until tender.
Remove duck; stir sour cream in juice.
Pour over duck before serving.

title: Manasta
steps: Cut and clean escarole.
Boil for 10 minutes.
Drain and set aside.
Cut spareribs discarding excess fat.
Put in pan with water to cover.
Boil 1/2 hour.
Skim off foam.
Add escarole, garlic, salt, pepper and red pepper.
Simmer 30 to 45 minutes more.

title: Black Forest Trifle

ingredients.name: chocolate fudge pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 2 small pkg. chocolate fudge pudding mix (not instant)

ingredients.name: cookie crumb
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. cookie crumbs (made from chocolate chip cookies)

steps: In a saucepan, prepare pudding according to package directions, using 3 3/4 cups milk.
Remove from heat and cover surface of pudding with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming.
Let cool 30 minutes.

title: Bratwurst-Apple Skillet

ingredients.name: cooking apple cored and
ingredients.raw: 1 large cooking apple, cored and thinly sliced

steps: Brown bratwurst in medium skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally.
In medium bowl, combine all remaining ingredients.
Add to skillet.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 8 to 12 minutes or until apples are tender, stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Classic Alfredo Pasta
steps: Cook fettuccine according to your taste of doneness; drain. Meanwhile, in small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; gradually stir in cheese, then cream until well blended.
Continue heating sauce, stirring constantly, just to boiling point.
Remove from heat; stir in parsley.
Add sauce to hot fettuccine; toss lightly.
Serves 6.

title: Oven Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: salt and pepper on top
ingredients.raw: salt and pepper on top to taste

steps: Boil potatoes and mash with sour cream, cream cheese, butter, salt and pepper.
Add milk to right consistency.
Put in greased casserole (2-quart) and dot with butter.
Sprinkle with paprika. When ready to serve, bake at 350°, uncovered, for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Surprise

ingredients.name: pistachio instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 3/8 oz.) box pistachio instant pudding mix

steps: Mix all ingredients and chill for four hours.
Serve cold.

title: Double Cheese Hamburger Pie
steps: Cook potatoes and butter in oven at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes until brown.
Brown ground beef.
Salt and pepper ground beef and potatoes.
Sprinkle half the cheese (shredded) over the potatoes. Sprinkle ground beef over cheese.
Add remainder of the cheese and stretch crescent rolls over the top.
Bake according to crescent roll directions until brown.

title: Nutmeg Bread Pudding
steps: Melt margarine in oblong dish.
Toast buns and break into bite size pieces.
Soak in melted margarine.
Sprinkle with nutmeg and stir well.
Beat eggs; add sugar and scalded milk to eggs.
Pour over bread pieces.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Macaroni Skillet Dinner
steps: Brown beef, onion and pepper in large skillet; drain off the fat.
Add the tomatoes, cooked macaroni and diced cheese.
Stir gently; add tomato soup.
Cook on low until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Alabama Biscuits

ingredients.name: cake yeast
ingredients.raw: 1/2 cake yeast or 1 pkg. dry yeast

steps: Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar.
Cut in Crisco.
Dissolve yeast in buttermilk.
Combine dry ingredients in liquid and roll out on floured board.
Cut with floured cutter.
Let rise 1 1/2 hours.
Bake on greased baking sheet 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Pie
steps: In a bowl, with electric mixer, combine cream cheese, peanut butter, sugar and milk.
Beat until smooth.
Gently fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into crust. Freeze for 4 to 6 hours.
Thaw for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Coconut Joys

ingredients.name: sq.
ingredients.raw: 2 sq. or 2 oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted

steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Remove from heat (or microwave). Add powdered sugar, coconut and food tint, if desired.
Mix well. Shape rounded teaspoonful of mixture into balls.
Make indent in center of each and place on cookie sheet.
Fill centers with melted chocolate.
Chill until firm.
Store in refrigerator. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Harriet Sherrard'S Banana Bread

ingredients.name: scant tsp. soda dissolved in the water
ingredients.raw: 1 scant tsp. soda, dissolved in the water

steps: Mash bananas well with fork.
Combine ingredients, except bananas.
Add bananas.
Bake in a deep narrow loaf pan for about 1 1/4 hours.
Bake in a slow oven at 350°.

title: Savory Sunday Eggs
steps: Brown sausage, drain.
Add onions; cook until tender.
Add combined eggs, milk and pepper.
Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until eggs begin to set.
Add cream cheese; continue cooking; stirring occasionally until cream cheese is melted and eggs are set.
Sprinkle with chives.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Golden Yellow Punch
steps: Add water to frozen concentrates as directed on cans and mix all together.
Add the pineapple and apple juice, mixing well. This is best to let stand several hours before serving, or freeze until about 3 hours before serving and set out to thaw until mushy.
Add ginger ale before serving.
Yields 25 servings.

title: Belgian Baked Potatoes(One Of My Favorites)
steps: Cut potatoes as for French frying.
Pour melted butter in baking dish.
Swish potatoes until all pieces are coated.
Season with salt and paprika.
Cover, then place in 350° oven for about 55 minutes.
(Real, real good.)

title: Quick Shrimp And Rice

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked shrimp or other seafood

ingredients.name: condensed cream of shrimp soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of shrimp soup

steps: Toss bread crumbs with 1 tablespoon margarine.
Cook and stir shrimp in 1/4 cup margarine until hot.
Stir in soup, milk and lemon juice.
Heat, stirring frequently, until hot.
Serve over hot rice.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Broccoli And Cheddar Dip

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret vegetable recipe soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets vegetable recipe soup mix

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, thawed (or spinach, thawed and squeezed dry)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a 1-quart casserole, combine vegetable soup mix, sour cream, broccoli and 3/4 cup cheese until smooth.
Top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese.
Bake 30 minutes or until heated through.
Serve with fresh vegetables, breadsticks or crackers.
Makes about 3 cups dip.

title: Mexican Turkey Casserole

ingredients.name: turkey drain and reserve broth
ingredients.raw: 2 pt. cooked turkey, drain and reserve broth

ingredients.name: each onion and bell pepper saute and set aside
ingredients.raw: 2 c. each diced onion and bell pepper, saute and set aside

ingredients.name: each fat cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can each 99% fat free cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce (no salt added)

ingredients.name: mild green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can mild chopped green chilies (undrained)

ingredients.name: no fat cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 oz. no fat grated Cheddar cheese

steps: Place tortilla chips in 12 x 15 x 2-inch Pam sprayed pan. Crush chips slightly.
Add cut up turkey.
Blend 1 cup broth and remaining ingredients (except cheese) and pour over turkey.
Top with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake in 350° oven about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Delicious Cake
steps: Mix together cake mix, mandarin oranges, eggs and oil.
Beat exceedingly well.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
When cool, top with the pineapple and instant pudding mixed together until thick, then add whipped topping.
Spread on cake.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
steps: Beat egg.
Put egg and butter in saucepan.
Add salt, sugar and fruit juice.
Cook over water until thick, about 5 minutes. Add lemon juice.
If too thick, thin with cream.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Cook onions and mushrooms in butter in large skillet until tender.
Stir in rice, chicken, broccoli and condensed soup.
Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish, top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Coconut Filling
steps: Mix flour and pineapple.
Cook until it thickens. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Mint Pies

ingredients.name: chocolate wafer
ingredients.raw: 1 box chocolate wafers (without icing in the middle)

ingredients.name: nut and maraschino cherry
ingredients.raw: chopped nuts and halved maraschino cherries

steps: Cream together butter and sugar.
Blend in melted chocolate and add eggs.
Beat well.
Blend in peppermint and almond extracts.
Use foil cupcake liners.
Fill each cup 3/4 full. Place whipped cream on top of each.
Sprinkle with nuts and top with cherry half.
Freeze for 2 hours.
Defrost 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
Serves 12 to 14.

title: Too Easy Cobbler

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 5 to 6 peaches, sliced (I use any kind of fruit)

steps: Place peaches in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan.
Remove crust from bread and cut in 5 fingers.
Place bread over peaches.
Mix sugar, flour and butter.
Pour over bread.
Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Baked Rice
steps: Saute all vegetables in butter. Bring the water to a boil. Add chicken bouillon and 1 cup uncooked rice.
Add vegetables and pour into casserole dish.
Cook, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Easter Eggs
steps: Cream first 3 ingredients; crush M&M's and add cereal.
Shape into balls and chill.

title: Wheat Salad
steps: Wash and clean wheat.
Boil in 3 cups water for 1 hour, or until done.
Drain and cool.
Add other ingredients.
Let set for 2 hours or overnight.
(Colored marshmallows are very colorful, but do not taste very good if it sets overnight.)
This will keep several days, if it lasts that long.

title: Golfers' Special Pot Roast

ingredients.name: chuck roast
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 to 6 lb.) chuck roast or 1 thick round steak

steps: Place roast on a
large sheet of heavy-duty foil; cover with dry soup mix
and
mushroom
soup.	Add potatoes and carrots. Bring foil up and cover;
roll and secure edges tightly about 6 inches above
roast
so
no moisture escapes.
Bake at 350° for 3 to 4 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Chicken Wings Pacifica
steps: Arrange wings in shallow pan.
Heat butter, soy sauce, sugar, water and mustard until butter and sugar melt; cool.
Pour over wings and marinate at least 2 hours, turning once or twice.
Bake in same pan in a 375° oven for about 1 1/2 hours, turning often. Drain on paper towels.

title: Swedish Pineapple Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Mix by hand and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Coffee Cake
steps: Unroll dough. Separate into triangles. Spread each triangle with part of the butter or margarine. Combine brown sugar, cinnamon and walnuts in a small bowl. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of the mixture over each dough triangle.
Roll up as label directs.
Place rolls, point side down, in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan in two layers.
Brush top of loaf with remaining butter or margarine. Sprinkle with remaining topping. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Turn out onto wire rack. Cool.

title: Tropical Ambrosia
steps: Drain pineapple and oranges, reserving liquid.
Add enough water to liquid to make 2 cups.
Bring liquid to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Add gelatin; stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat. Add sherbet, oranges and half the pineapple, stirring until sherbet is melted.
Pour into a 6-cup ring mold and chill until firm. Unmold onto serving platter.
Combine sour cream, coconut, marshmallows and remaining pineapple.
Spoon mixture into center of gelatin ring.
Enjoy!
Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 9-inch square baking pan with a nonstick spray.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all dry ingredients until well mixed.
In a separate small bowl, whisk egg whites, water and corn syrup.
Add to dry ingredients and stir until smooth.
Pour into prepared baking pan; bake 30 minutes. Cake is done when it springs back when lightly touched.

title: Dynamite Corn Bread

ingredients.name: self raisin cornmeal
ingredients.raw: 1 c. self-rising cornmeal or 1 c. regular corn meal and 2 tsp. baking powder

steps: Place butter in pan in hot oven (400°) until melted.
Sift corn meal, salt and sugar together in bowl.
Put creamed corn, eggs, sour cream and onion into bowl and mix well (always mix wet ingredients into dry).
Pour the melted butter very slowly into the mixture and stir.
Pour into hot pan.
Bake at 375° to 400° for about 45 minutes or until golden brown across the top.

title: Hot Butter Rum Batter
steps: Mix together the butter and sugars.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Freeze in containers (one pint containers are a good size).
Thaw slightly before using.
Add 2 to 3 tablespoons (to your taste) of batter to a cup and add boiling water.

title: Beef And Potato Bake
steps: In a large nonstick skillet with ovenproof handle, brown meat and onion.
Drain off any accumulated fat.
Add potatoes, tomato sauce, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.
Spread evenly in bottom of skillet.
In medium bowl, with fork, lightly beat eggs.
Blend in yogurt; spread over meat mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until topping is set.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Stephanie'S Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Blend first 7 ingredients together.
Add flour and chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° until very lightly browned on edges.
Recipe may be cut in half. Freezes well.

title: Sourdough Bread Appetizer
steps: Cut bread in 1/2 inch slices (do not cut all the way through the bottom).
Turn 90° and cut again.
Melt butter, add basil, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle over and into bread. Wrap together in foil.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Potato And Egg Salad

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 5 lbs. potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks

steps: In 5 quart sauce pan, place potatoes and enough water to cover; heat to boiling over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer 10-12 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender. Drain potatoes; cool slightly.

title: Chili Salad(Main Dish Salad)

ingredients.name: chili con carne with bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can chili con carne with beans

steps: In salad bowl combine chunks of lettuce, corn chips, chopped tomato, pepperoni, olives and cheese.
Meanwhile, in saucepan heat canned chili con carne with beans until bubbly. Immediately pour atop salad, tossing lightly to coat.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Lemon Bisque
steps: Mix jello, sugar and water; cool.
Grate lemon.
Whip milk. Add jello, sugar and water mixture.
Beat, then add lemon.
Pour in dish lined with vanilla wafers and chill.

title: Mom'S Italian Chicken Soup
steps: Slowly boil chicken until it is ready to fall off the bone. Remove chicken and set aside to cool.
Add water and 3 to 4 bouillon cubes to make approximately 6 cups of broth.
Stir into broth, 3 tablespoons of soup greens, tomato sauce and 1/2 pound spaghetti noodles (broken into thirds).
Cook until noodles are tender.
Break apart chicken and add to soup to warm.

title: Krazy Krunch
steps: Combine popped corn/nuts in a large container.
Mix sugar, butter and Karo.
Boil 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and pour over corn and nuts.
Mix thoroughly.
Spread over cookie sheet to dry.
Break apart and store in tightly covered container.
Keeps for a long time.

title: Quick Rice And Meat Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: meat
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 c. cooked meat, cubed (leftover pork, beef, chicken)

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cooked broccoli or 1 pkg. frozen broccoli

steps: Cook onion in large skillet with oil.
Add mushrooms and meat. If using frozen broccoli, cook in microwave first and the add to meat, mushrooms and onion mixture.
Add cooked rice.
Then add soy sauce and heat through.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Fried Corn Flake Chicken

ingredients.name: cornflake crumb but not pulverized
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. cornflake crumbs, crushed but not pulverized

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash chicken and pat dry.
Mix together eggs and milk.
Separately mix cornflake crumbs, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in milk and egg mixture; then in crumbs, evenly coating each piece.
Set in well-greased baking pan.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake, uncovered, 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Garlic Chicken
steps: Place chicken in crock-pot.
Spoon soup over chicken. Sprinkle garlic on top. Cook on low setting.
Serve over rice. Great for working people!

title: Butterfinger Ice Cream

ingredients.name: fun size butterfinger bar
ingredients.raw: 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger bars or 6 large bars

steps: Crush candy bars.
Mix all of above ingredients and freeze in an ice cream freezer.

title: Red Hot Jello
steps: Put red hots and 1 cup of water in saucepan and heat until candy dissolves.
Add Jell-O, stir until dissolved.
Add 1 cup cold water.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Add apples, celery and nuts.

title: Rose Petal Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in water, then dissolve sugar.
Put in rest of ingredients at same time and stir until lumps of Crisco are gone. Spoon into greased muffin cups and bake at 400° for 10 minutes. (Rest of batter keeps in fridge for several days.)

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread

ingredients.name: mashed banana
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. mashed ripe bananas (2 large or 3 small)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar together until light and creamy.
Beat in egg.
Sift together flour, baking soda and salt.
Combine the bananas and yogurt stirring just enough to mix.
Add dry ingredients alternately with banana mixture to butter mixture stirring just enough to combine well.
Turn into 9 x 5-inch oiled loaf pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Remove from pan and finish cooling on a rack.
Yields 1 loaf.

title: Ham Dip

ingredients.name: salt and ground pepper
ingredients.raw: dash of salt and freshly ground pepper

steps: Gradually add mayonnaise to cream cheese, blending until smooth.
Add ham, onion juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Mix well.

title: 2 Minute Fudge(Microwave)
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients in 1 1/2-quart dish.
Top with butter. Microwave at High 1 minute.
Stir until smooth; microwave 1 more minute.
Blend in nuts.

title: Five-Cup Salad
steps: Fold all ingredients together thoroughly.
You may chill it before serving or serve at once.

title: Italian Dream Cake
steps: Cream well the sugar, Crisco and oleo.
Add 5 egg yolks, one at a time, and beat well after each addition.
Add vanilla.
Mix flour and soda and add alternately with the buttermilk to the creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites and fold into the batter.
Pour batter into 3 greased and floured pans (approximately 8-inch).
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Chocolate Pieces
steps: Place foil to cover a cookie sheet.
Place enough crackers to cover the cookie sheet.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bring to
a boil the margarine and sugar. Boil 3 minutes.
Pour mixture over the top of the crackers. Place in a 350° oven for 5 minutes.
Remove and put on the chocolate chips.
Return to oven for about 1 minute.
Take out and spread the softened chips.
Put in refrigerator until cool. Break into pieces.

title: Raisin Bread Pudding
steps: Place milk in a large saucepan; heat until warm (do not boil). Remove form heat.
Add bread and next 6 ingredients; stir well. Spoon mixture evenly into 6 (4 ounce) ramekins or custard cups coated with cooking spray.
Place ramekins in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; add hot water to a depth of 1 inch.

Bake at 350° for 20 minutes; shield with aluminum foil and bake an additional 10 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Remove ramekins from water. Serve pudding warm or chilled.

title: Italian Cheese Balls
steps: Combine ingredients and mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into 375° olive oil in fryer.
Fry only until balls are set.
Place in baking dish and cover with sauce.
Sprinkle additional cheese on top.
Bake 1/2 hour at 375°.

title: Quick Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat broiler.
Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil.
Melt butter in microwave.
Slice bread into 3/4-inch slices.
Dip slices in butter and sprinkle both sides with garlic.
Arrange slices on cookie sheet and spread cheese on top of each slice. Sprinkle oregano lightly on cheese.
Put in broiler until cheese melts.
Serve at once.

title: Instant Ambrosia
