steps: Mix both cans of pineapple together.
Sprinkle instant pudding over pineapple; let stand 10 minutes.
Add nuts and marshmallows. Fold mixture into Cool Whip.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
steps: Mix pretzels, granulated sugar and margarine.
Press in 13 x 9-inch baking dish and bake 6 to 8 minutes at 400°.
Cool.

title: Do-Ahead Egg Casserole

ingredients.name: bacon up very
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bacon, cut up very small

steps: Butter slices of bread and decrust.
Lay butter side down in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
With mixer or blender, beat eggs, milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard.
Pour over bread.
Sprinkle cheese over egg mixture.
Place bacon (uncooked) on top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Layered Strawberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water (sugar-free jello can also be used).
Add thawed strawberries and entire can of crushed pineapple (undrained).
Cool awhile and then add 2 mashed bananas.

title: Sour Cream Pancakes
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff, add yolks and beat.
Add sour cream with soda, then the flour and salt.
All this is easily done in your electric mixer.

title: Petey'S Birthday Cupcakes
steps: Melt butter and cool to room temperature.
Cream butter and sugars.
Add eggs, 1 at a time (beat each one before adding) and vanilla.
In a separate bowl mix flour and salt and add to batter. Add chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° in a muffin tin lined with paper liners for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mrs. Tathum'S Topped Cake
steps: Make yellow cake according to directions.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
(Can also use 15 x 10-inch pan).
While cake is baking, mix cream cheese until smooth.
Add vanilla pudding and milk.
Beat at medium speed until thickened.
Spread on cooled cake.
Next, spread on well drained crushed pineapple. Refrigerate.

title: Aunt Tot Warner'S Egg Custard
steps: Dump all ingredients in blender and blend 3 minutes.
Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Cook 40 minutes at 350°. Add coconut for different taste.

title: Skillet Steak

ingredients.name: new potato quarter
ingredients.raw: 10 small new potatoes, cut into quarters (about 1 lb.)

ingredients.name: green and red pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. green and red pepper chunks

ingredients.name: sirloin steak in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. trimmed boneless sirloin steak, cut in chunks

steps: In 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, peppers and water. Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 12 minutes, or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice.
Drain; set aside.
Spray 12-inch nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
Heat skillet over medium heat.
Add beef chunks.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes until meat is pink; stir frequently.
Add potato mixture and remaining ingredients.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until potatoes brown and mixture is hot.
Stir frequently.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: swanson chicken and
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Swanson chicken, drained and shredded

steps: Mix all ingredients; add just enough mayonnaise to mix well. Shape into balls.
Roll in chopped pecans until coated.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Moma'S Fudge
steps: Combine all ingredients, except peanut butter and vanilla in heavy skillet on medium heat.
Bring to rolling boil for 1 minute. Turn off heat, add remaining ingredients and beat until thick. Put in greased dish and let stand until firm.

title: Beau Monde Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Chill for 24 hours.

title: Vinegar Candy Or White Taffy
steps: Put sugar, water and butter in a heavy saucepan.
Place over low heat.
Stir carefully until sugar is dissolved.
Then cook, without stirring, until mixture forms a hard ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add vanilla; stir.
Pour into a shallow, buttered pan.
When cool enough to handle, pull with fingertips into rope-like lengths.
Then cut into chewable size pieces with buttered kitchen scissors.

title: English Taffy Cookies
steps: Cream together butter or margarine and sugar.
Add egg yolk and vanilla.
Add flour; mix well.
Usually I wash hands very well, then mix dough with your hands; it is easier.
Grease a cookie sheet (large) and pat dough very thin.
Whip the egg white with a fork until frothy.
Spread on top of dough with your hand. Sprinkle with 1 cup chopped pecans.
Pat slightly to press pecans down a little.
Bake at 300° for approximately 40 to 45 minutes. Cut at once in squares or rectangles.
This recipe is great at Christmas!

title: Pumpkin Roll(Diabetic)
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients.
Beat the eggs and pumpkin and add to first mixture.
Line sheet
pan with white paper.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Roll in towel.

title: Ho Ho Cake
steps: Cream margarine, white shortening and sugar.
Cream well for 15 minutes until smooth consistency, then add milk.
Beat until smooth and blended.
Spread over cooled cake.
Chill before frosting with chocolate topping.

title: 6 Week Muffin Mix
steps: Mix cereal, flour, sugar, salt, soda and cinnamon.
Add and mix well the eggs, vegetable oil and buttermilk.
Never stir again.
Batter wil be thick and get thicker.
Keeps 6 weeks.
Fill muffin cups 1/2 cup full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: George'S Favorite Banana Pudding
steps: Mix first four ingredients and put into microwave.
Rub margarine around top of bowl so mixture won't boil over.
Cook until thickened; add egg yolks and return to microwave for a minute.
Take out and add vanilla and margarine.
Do not overcook.
Mixture needs to be able to pour so it will soak into the layers of bananas and wafers.
Layer bananas and wafers in a bowl, then pour pudding mixture over the layers.

title: Rich Chocolate Frosting
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add egg yolks, beating after each. Stir in cooled melted chocolate.
Blend in vanilla and add water until it is at spreading consistency.

title: Cheese Strata
steps: Trim crusts from bread and make 6 cheese sandwiches.
Place in baking dish.
Mix eggs and milk together; season to taste.
Pour over sandwiches, slowly and carefully.
Let stand for 1 hour. Bake in moderate 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Steak With Lobster Tail

ingredients.name: beef top loin steak
ingredients.raw: 4 beef top loin steaks, cut 1-inch thick

steps: Slash fat edge of steaks at 1-inch intervals.
In skillet, cook steaks over medium-high heat to desired doneness; turn occasionally.
Allow 9 to 10 minutes total time for rare or 11 to 12 minutes for medium. Season with salt and pepper.
Drop lobster tails in boiling salted water to cover.
Return to boiling; reduce heat.
Simmer 8 minutes; drain.

title: Beef Burritos
steps: Add onion to hamburger while browning.
Add other seasonings and green chili sauce.
Take large spoonfuls of meat mixture and place in center of warm tortillas.
Sprinkle with grated cheese. Fold sides of each tortilla over and the end up; place on cookie sheet, folded side down.
Cover with aluminum foil and heat in 325° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Caps

ingredients.name: part skim mozzarella
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/3 c. shredded part skim Mozzarella

steps: Wash and stem mushrooms.
Arrange them on a cookie sheet.
Mix remaining ingredients and stuff into mushroom caps.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Never-Fail Chocolate Icing
steps: Mix all
together
and
after it starts boiling, boil 2 minutes and
add
1 teaspoon vanilla.
Beat until you think it will stay on the cake.

title: Crescent Cookies
steps: Combine all
ingredients and mix well.
Make into small balls. Roll
slightly by hand and shape into crescents.
Bake on a lightly
greased cookie tin in a 325° oven for about 8 to 10 minutes.
When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

title: My Mother'S Eggnog
steps: Separate eggs.
Place in 2 large mixing bowls.
Add 6 tablespoons of sugar to each bowl.
Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and deep yellow in color.
Add brandy, rum or bourbon; stir well.

title: Baked Ham And Eggs
steps: Mix bread and ham in a 9 x 12-inch greased pan.
Cover with cheese.
Mix other ingredients except chives.
Pour over cheese and bread mixture.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with chives; serve.

title: Sour Milk Cookies

ingredients.name: soda in c. sour milk
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. soda in 1 c. sour milk

steps: Blend sugar and oleo, then add eggs, 1 cup flour and soda in sour milk.
Add rest of flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla. Drop by tablespoon; flatten with wet fork.
Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes.
Sprinkle several times when baking.

title: Frank'S French Toast
steps: Combine all ingredients in a shallow bowl until blended.
Dip slices of bread into mixture to coat both sides.
Brown both sides on hot griddle.
Makes 8 to 10 slices.

title: Cheese-Bean Dip
steps: Mash avocados, stir in lemon juice, chopped tomatoes and onion.
Set aside.
Spread bean dip in a shallow, round 9-inch dish.
Spread avocado mixture over bean dip.
Alternate cheeses over the top in pie wedge sections (resembling a wheel-spoke). Sprinkle top with ripe olives.
Sprinkle edges with chopped tomatoes and green onion tops, if desired.
Serve with king size corn chips.
Yield: 4 cups.

title: Pink Velvet Salad
steps: Beat cream cheese until smooth.
Add juice from cherries and beat.
Add cherries, drained pineapple, marshmallows, bananas and Cool Whip.
Let set in refrigerator until time for serving.

title: Cottage Berry Salad
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients well; fold in cottage cheese.
Chill and serve.

title: Candy
steps: Boil sugar, milk, butter and salt to soft-ball stage.
Add vanilla.
Remove from heat.
Beat vigorously until mixture loses gloss.
Stir in pecans.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Microwave Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Wash sweet potatoes thoroughly.
Pierce skins all around with a knife or fork.
Wrap individually in a paper towel and microwave on High.
Count the total number of potatoes to be cooked and add 8 minutes per potato to total the necessary cooking time.
When cooking time elapses, allow potatoes to remain wrapped in paper towel (2 minutes per potato).
Unwrap potatoes and allow to cool enough to handle and peel.

title: Talleriva
steps: Fry meat, onion and pepper; drain.
Cook noodles; drain.
Add tomatoes, meat and corn.
Pour in a baking dish.
Cover with cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

title: English Strawberry Trifle

ingredients.name: vanilla sugar instant pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. vanilla sugar-free instant pudding mix

ingredients.name: angel food cake bite size
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (10-inch) angel food cake, torn into bite-size pieces

steps: Place light sour cream in a large bowl.
Gradually whisk in milk and orange juice until smooth.
While whisking gradually, add pudding and orange peel until well mixed and thickened.
In a large serving bowl, layer half cake pieces, one-third strawberries and half pudding mixture.
Repeat layers.
Arrange remaining strawberries on top.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Makes 10 servings.

title: Chicken Medallions

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. melted butter (this can be omitted for less fattening dish)

steps: Cut chicken into 1-inch nuggets.
Combine other ingredients, except butter.
Dip chicken in butter, then into cheese/crumb mixture.
Spread on foil covered baking sheet and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Manhattan Potatoes(Different)

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup

steps: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water.
Drain.
Dilute celery soup with milk and fold in potatoes and other ingredients, except bread crumbs.
Place in greased casserole and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Apple-Cinnamon Rolls

ingredients.name: apple and
ingredients.raw: 2 large apples, peeled and cut into 8 wedges

steps: Cut roll dough triangles into halves lengthwise to form 16 triangles.
Place 1 apple wedge at wide end of each triangle; roll to enclose apple.

title: Cousin Carol'S Seafood Sauce

ingredients.name: clam shrimp crab meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. clams, shrimp, crab meat or squid

steps: In a saucepan, add oil and minced garlic.
Chop parsley leaves and add to saucepan.
Stir until parsley is limp.
Add seafood (cleaned and de-shelled).
Add tomato sauce, wine and basil.
The sauce should be a light red-pink color.
Reduce liquid until meat is just showing through the liquid.
If you are using all fresh seafood, add a can of clam juice to add flavor to the sauce. Reduce as noted before.
Cook spaghetti until it is al dente.
Add sauce; toss and serve.

title: Fruit And Cream Pie

ingredients.name: thawed cool whip whipped
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. thawed Cool Whip whipped topping

ingredients.name: keebler ready crust graham cracker pie crust
ingredients.raw: 1 Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust (6 oz.)

ingredients.name: jell o brand gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor, use flavor of fruit selected)

ingredients.name: jell o vanilla flavor cook and pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor cook and serve pudding and pie filling

steps: Mix cream cheese and sugar in large bowl until well blended. Stir in Cool Whip.
Spread in crust.
Refrigerate.
Mix gelatin, pudding mix and water in medium saucepan until smooth.
Stirring constantly, cook on medium heat until mixture just comes to boil. Remove from heat.
Cool 5 minutes.
Stir in fruit.
Spoon over cream cheese layer.
Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.
Garnish as desired.
Store leftover pie in refrigerator.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Mushroom Steak And Gravy
steps: Cut steak in bite size pieces.
Beat eggs and milk together. Dip steak into egg and milk mixture.
Roll in cracker crumbs. Brown on stove in hot oil about 5 minutes until brown.
Remove from skillet; place in baking dish.
Pour mushroom soup over steaks.
Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Onion Topped Green Beans
steps: Place ingredients in 2-quart glass dish (12 x 7-inch).
Drain the beans.
Cover and microwave on High 5 minutes.
Let stand 3 minutes.

title: Quick Microwave Potatoes(Serves 4 To 6)
steps: Thick slice (1/3-inch) potatoes into shallow baking dish (9-inch square).
Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
Cover. Microwave on High 10 minutes, rotating baking dish as necessary, until potatoes test fork-tender.

title: Best Ever Fudge Frosting
steps: Mix all except vanilla and cook 5 minutes after it starts boiling.
Add vanilla.
Beat.

title: Italian Wine Cookies
steps: Bring all of the ingredients, except for the flour, to a boil and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes.
Cool.
Add enough flour until liquid is absorbed and easy to handle.
Blend/knead until thoroughly smooth.
Cut pieces and roll out like strufoli.
Should be as thick as your thumb.
Shape like a shell by curling on the side of a grater.
Place on a lightly greased cooking sheet and bake at 400° until lightly browned.
When cooled, place in a bowl and mix with honey.
Place on a platter.
Can be decorated with colored confetti and finely chopped nuts.

title: Old-Fashioned Strawberry Preserves

ingredients.name: strawberry and hulled
ingredients.raw: 2 qt. small ripe strawberries, washed and hulled

ingredients.name: drop red food coloring
ingredients.raw: a few drops red food coloring

steps: Place strawberries in a large saucepot with sugar, salt, corn syrup and lemon juice.
Gently mix until berries are coated with sugar.
Let stand 5 to 6 hours.
Prepare jars.
Slowly heat strawberries in mixture until sugar is dissolved.
Shake pan occasionally, but do not stir.
Boil rapidly for 12 to 15 minutes or until strawberries are translucent and syrup is thick.
Add red food coloring, if desired.
Skim foam, carefully ladle berries into hot jars, 1/4-inch from top.
Adjust caps and process 15 minutes in a boiling water bath canner.
Yield: 4 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Caramel Turtle Brownies
steps: Unwrap caramels and put in saucepan with 2 tablespoons evaporated milk.
Melt and set aside.
Mix milk, cake mix, melted butter and nuts; stir until blended.
Spread 1/2 this mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Take out and sprinkle chocolate chips on top; drizzle with caramels.
Drop remaining cake mixture by teaspoonfuls on top.
Mix.
Bake 20 minutes longer.
Do not overbake.
Cut while warm; cool in pan. Eat, enjoy and then go work out.
Totally dangerous and fattening!

title: Mildred Booe'S Corn Bread
steps: Heat oven to 375° to 400°.
Put shortening in a large cake pan and melt it.
(Put in oven to melt.)
In a mixing bowl, mix all the remaining ingredients by hand.
Beat about a minute, then pour into pan and bake in hot oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Bump Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: potatoes (1 per person plus 1 to 2 extra)

steps: Peel potatoes and cut in 1/2-inch cubes.
Add just enough water to cover.
Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the water evaporates and the potatoes are soft.
Add butter.

title: Pound Cake Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar. Add beaten egg, then flour and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Good crisp cookie, like the crust on a pound cake.

title: Courthouse Crock-Pot Spaghetti Sauce
steps: In a crock-pot, combine all ingredients.
Stir thoroughly and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Serves 6.

title: Hominy Ole

ingredients.name: liquid from hominy and milk measure
ingredients.raw: liquid from drained hominy and milk to measure 1 c.

steps: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.
Blend in flour and salt.
(Drain liquid from hominy and add enough milk to make a cup).
Add to previous ingredients.
Cook until thick, then blend in shredded cheese and chili.
Pour over hominy in casserole bowl and heat in microwave 6 minutes.

title: Girl Scout Goulash
steps: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer over low heat 20 minutes.
Good with cornbread.

title: Easy Chile Cheese
steps: Spread and open chiles into small rectangular baking dish (greased).
Pour cheese over chiles and then pour beaten eggs over this.
Cook at 375° until knife comes out clean (about 20 minutes). Serve hot!

title: Pecan Pie For A Crowd
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine first seven ingredients; mix well.
Add the pecans.
Pour 2 1/4 cups filling into each pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes.
This makes 64 servings.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chicken breast, skinned, boned and sliced thin

steps: In small bowl, combine chicken, cornstarch and soy sauce; mix well.
In large skillet or wok heat 1 tablespoon oil.
Stir-fry chicken until it loses color and starts to brown.
Remove chicken and set aside.

title: Hot Bean Dish
steps: Brown hamburger and onion, drain.
Add brown sugar, catsup, mustard, vinegar and salt.
Mix.
Then add all of the beans.

title: Midwestern Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: smoked sausage and
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices and halved

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. green or red pepper strips

steps: Mix together salad dressing, mustard and milk until well blended; set aside.
Combine sausage, peppers and onions in a medium bowl.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir in squash. Continue microwaving on High for 2 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add salad dressing mixture; mix lightly.
Microwave on Medium (50%) for 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring after 2 minutes (do not overcook).
Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Delight Salad

ingredients.name: bacon fried crisp and
ingredients.raw: 10 bacon slices, fried crisp and crumbled

steps: Combine broccoli, raisins, onion and pecans in large salad bowl.
Mix well.
In small bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over broccoli mixture until coated.
Chill until ready to serve.
Just before serving, sprinkle crumbled bacon on top of broccoli salad.
If preferred, bacon may be mixed in salad.

title: Miniature Brownies
steps: Line 72 mini muffin tins with baking cups or arrange baking cups on cookie sheets.
Melt butter in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add chocolate chips; stir until melted.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs; stir briskly. Gradually stir in flour, then nuts.
Fill baking cups 3/4 full. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes at 350°.

title: English Nut Toffee
steps: Put all ingredients except butter and vanilla into saucepan and boil until it forms a firm ball in water.
Add vanilla and butter.
Pour into buttered pan and mark into squares while warm.

title: Punch With Sherbet
steps: Mix punch and ginger ale.
Be sure the mixture is cold and add sherbet when ready to serve.

title: Hamburger Macaroni Casserole
steps: Fry ground beef, onions, and peppers.
Cook macaroni.
Mix together, add pizza sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake until heated through.

title: Homemade Mustard(Very Good)

ingredients.name: dry mustard
ingredients.raw: 1 c. dry mustard or three (1.12 oz.) cans

steps: Soak mustard and vinegar overnight.
Add sugar and eggs; mix well with mixer or blender.
Cook in double boiler until thick.

title: Southwest Macaroni And Beef

ingredients.name: campbell s condensed cheddar cheese soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's condensed Cheddar cheese soup

ingredients.name: mexican
ingredients.raw: 1 can Mexican or regular style stewed tomatoes

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz. size) can chopped green chilies (only use 1/2 of this can)

steps: In a skillet, cook beef, onion and chili powder; drain.
Put all of this in a large kettle.
Add soup; stir until smooth.
Stir in broth, water, tomatoes and chilies.
Heat to boiling.
Add macaroni.
Reduce heat to low.
Cook 12 minutes or until macaroni is very tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Lillian'S Pecan Pie
steps: Boil syrup and sugar together for about 2 minutes.
Pour fine stream over eggs, slowly stirring well.
Add vanilla and nuts. Turn into unbaked pie shell and bake about 50 minutes at 275° or until done.

title: Hot Herb Bread
steps: Cut bread diagonally into 1-inch slices. Blend butter and other ingredients.
Butter bread slices and wrap in aluminum foil. Heat in hot oven at 400° for 10 minutes.
Also in a 250° oven for 1/2 hour or on coals.

title: Zelma'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream fat; blend in sugar, eggs and flavoring.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add to chilled dough; roll and cut to desired shapes.

title: Butter Nut Cookies
steps: Cream
the
butter;
add
sugar
and mix.
Add nuts and flour. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Goat Cheese And Broccoli
steps: Saute broccoli in 1 tablespoon of butter for about 5 minutes. Set aside.
Boil chicken broth until reduced to 1/2 cup.
Add thyme, goat cheese, remaining butter and broccoli.
Keep warm.

title: Chicken And Broccoli

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or fresh, cooked

steps: Place cooked broccoli in a 3-quart casserole or a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Peel chicken into pieces and place on top of broccoli. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Onion And Potato Bake

ingredients.name: onion and separated ring
ingredients.raw: 2 medium onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings

steps: Scrub potatoes and slice 1/8 inch thick.
Coat.
Put in shallow 2-quart casserole with Pam.
Combine potatoes and salad dressing in casserole; toss gently.
Cover and microwave it on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minute intervals.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and microwave at High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minutes intervals.
Yields 6 servings (88 calories each).

title: Chocolate Nut Chews
steps: Crush honey graham crackers.
Mix everything together.
Spread mixture in a buttered brownie size pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Relish
steps: Cut up cucumbers, peppers and onions; soak in salt water for 1 hour, then rinse and drain.
Mix sugar and vinegar; drop first 3 ingredients in and bring to a boil.
Pack in jars and seal.

title: Chicken Saute With Vinegar

ingredients.name: shallot
ingredients.raw: 4 shallots, chopped or 1 small to medium onion (depending on how fond you are of onions)

steps: Heat 7 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet big enough to hold the pieces of chicken.
Season the pieces with salt and pepper; brown them lightly.
The butter should remain light in color.
Cover the skillet and continue cooking the chicken for about 10 minutes or until tender.
When tender, place the pieces of chicken on a platter.
Cover and keep warm.

title: Italian Squash
steps: Cook onion and garlic in butter for 5 minutes.
Add squash. Salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Sara'S Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all together and shape in loaf.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes or microwave on High for 15 to 20 minutes.
Put catsup all over top.

title: Chocolate Pistachio Cannolis(Makes 12 Cannolis)

ingredients.name: nestle toll house milk chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (11 1/2 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) Nestle Toll House milk chocolate morsels

steps: Melt over hot (not boiling) water, Nestle Toll House milk chocolate morsels; stir until smooth.
Remove from heat; cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, beat Ricotta cheese until smooth.
Add cream cheese, confectioners sugar, citron and vanilla extract.
Beat well.
Blend in melted morsels.
Spoon into cannoli shells.
Dip ends in nuts.
Chill until ready to serve.

title: Peanut Butter Delight

ingredients.name: sweet thing
ingredients.raw: 4 pkg. Sweet Thing or 1/3 c. sugar

ingredients.name: sweet thing
ingredients.raw: 10 pkg. Sweet Thing or 1 c. 10x sugar

steps: Mix cracker crumbs, oleo and Sweet Thing.
Press into bottom of 9 x 14-inch baking pan.
Bake 6 to 7 minutes at 350°.
Set aside to cool.
Mix cream cheese, sweetener and milk until light and fluffy.
Add peanut butter and beat until smooth.
Fold Cool Whip into peanut butter mixture.
Pour onto the cold crust.
Chill 5 to 6 hours.
Garnish with chopped dry peanuts.

title: Baked Country Ham
steps: Soak ham for 24 hours in cold water.
Take out of water and place in roaster pan.
Mix 2 quarts of water and 1 cup of molasses together and pour over ham.
Place 2 layers of heavy duty aluminum foil over ham and place lid on roaster.
Preheat oven to 500°. Put ham in oven and time for 30 minutes.
Turn oven off after 30 minutes and wait 3 hours and turn oven back on and let it reach 500° again and time for 30 minutes.
Then turn oven off and leave ham in overnight, 2:00 PM is a good time to start this recipe.
Do not open oven after you start!

title: Fried Dill Pickles
steps: Mix egg, milk, Lea & Perrins, Tabasco and 1 tablespoon of flour.
Mix 2 cups of flour, salt and pepper in separate bowl.
Dip pickles in egg mixture, then flour mixture, then back in egg mixture and back in the flour.
Fry to a golden brown.

title: Crunchy Caramel Chocolate Chews

ingredients.name: bite size crispy rice cereal
ingredients.raw: 2 c. crushed bite size crispy rice squares cereal

ingredients.name: nestle toll house semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate morsels (1 c.)

steps: Melt margarine with molasses over low heat. Stir in rice squares.
Press into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Melt caramels with milk in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently, until smooth.
Pour over crust. Sprinkle with chocolate morsels and nuts.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
Makes 16 squares.

title: Sunflour Biscuits
steps: Cut shortening into flour.
Add milk gradually to make a soft dough.
Turn out on floured board and knead lightly, about 30 seconds.
Roll 1/3-inch thick.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake on greased biscuit pan at 450° for about 10 minutes.

title: Cracklin' Bread
steps: Scald corn meal with boiling water.
Add shortening and cool slightly.
Beat eggs thoroughly.
Add milk and salt.
Combine the two mixtures.
Add baking powder and cracklings and blend thoroughly.
Turn into well-greased pan and bake in a moderately hot oven at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Clara'S Fried Corned Beef Pies

ingredients.name: crisco shortening
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. Crisco shortening or cooking oil

steps: *This is a special cut pork chop.
Sometimes you can find the center-cut pork chops for stuffing at the supermarket, but most times you have to ask your butcher to cut the pocket slits.
And note, they are expensive, but well worth it.

title: Artichoke Egg Casserole(Serves 6)
steps: Chop artichoke hearts and use oil to saute onions.
Combine and put in greased Pyrex dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Plant Fertilizer
steps: Dissolve gelatine in warm water.
Add cool water.
Water plants with this about every six weeks.

title: Carrot And Pea Salad
steps: Scrape well, wash and grate raw carrots.
Mix with 1/2 cup of sour cream and peas.
Shape into cone and place in a salad dish. Pour over cone 1/2 cup sour cream mixed with salt and sugar.
Top cone with sliced fresh tomatoes and lettuce leaves.

title: Fillets Elegante

ingredients.name: pollack fish fillet
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. frozen pollack fish fillets (boneless and skinless)

steps: Thaw fillets enough to separate.
Arrange in 9 x 13-inch pan. Dash with pepper.
Dot with butter.
Drain shrimp.
Mix shrimp and soup together and spread over fillets.
Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Southern Style Matzo Ball Soup

ingredients.name: potato in
ingredients.raw: 2 large potatoes, cut in large pieces

steps: In large pot, boil 2 quarts water.
Add in order the broth, potatoes, carrots and onions.
Let cook at boiling.
Combine eggs and oil; beat well.
Add matzo meal and stir well.

Refrigerate matzo mixture for at least 15 minutes, then take teaspoon size portions of matzo meal, roll into balls and drop into broth. Reduce to simmer for 30 minutes or until balls are fluffy and veggies are tender.
Add peas and butter.
Serve hot with rolls or cornbread.

title: Aunt Judy'S Salad
steps: Combine Jell-O and hot water.
Stir until dissolved.
Add all other ingredients.
Stir well.
Refrigerate until set.
Better if prepared 24 hours before serving.

title: Vegetable Bake
steps: Mix the last 4 ingredients.
Pour mixture over vegetables. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes or more.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms Parmesan
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash mushrooms and select 12 of the largest.
Remove stems and set aside.
Chop stems and remaining mushrooms.
Place chopped mushrooms in a skillet.
Add butter and cook over low heat for 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients, except melted butter.
Mix well.
Fill mushrooms with stuffing. Place in greased baking pan.
Drizzle with melted butter. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger-Country Style Steak
steps: Mix meat, 3 to 4 tablespoons flour and salt; shape into patties.
Roll each patty with rolling pin on floured board (about 1/4-inch thick).
Brown on both sides in shortening.
Remove meat and pour off all but 2 to 3 tablespoons fat in pan.
Add 1/4 cup flour and allow to brown.
Stir occasionally.
Add water and cook until thickened.
Layer meat and gravy in casserole dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 5 or 6.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Vegetable Dish

ingredients.name: very onion
ingredients.raw: 1 very large onion (or more or less)

steps: Cut up and dice onion.
Using some butter or margarine or water using a large frying pan, fry onions until soft.
Add stewed tomatoes and bring to a boil.
Peel zucchini and slice.
Add cut up zucchini to stewed tomato mixture.
Add to taste salt, garlic salt and/or garlic powder.
Bring to boil, then turn down to low and cover with lid until zucchini has cooked and has turned yellowish in color.
Add Muenster completely over the top of mixture and cover until melted.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
steps: Brown meat in hot oil; add mushrooms, rice, onion and soy sauce.
Fry over low heat 10 minutes.
Stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add more soy sauce if desired.

title: Maye'S Venison And Gravy
steps: Slice venison and
pork into pieces about the size of the palm of your hand.
Remove all fat and sinew.

Wash meat well. Salt and pepper each slice and roll in flour. Fry in skillet in very hot oil until golden brown. Remove from skillet and put in large roasting pan with lid. Spread chopped onion on top of meat.
Pour excess oil out of skillet and use remaining drippings to make brown gravy.
Add a jar of gravy, if needed. Bake in a 300° oven for 6 to 8 hours. Serve with rice.

title: Codfish In Layers(Portuguese)
steps: In a pan, you put the oil.
Slice the onions.
You put a layer of sliced potatoes, 1 can chickpeas, then one layer of codfish (it should already be cooked), then the tomatoes and olive oil.
You repeat this.
You wait until everything is cooked and then you serve it.

title: Broiled Tomato Wedges
steps: Melt butter in shallow baking pan.
Add tomatoes; turn to coat on all sides.
Broil 4 inches from heat 5 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Golden Lemon Chicken

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret golden herb lemon soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets golden herb lemon soup mix

steps: Dip chicken in egg, then in bread crumbs.
In skillet melt butter; brown chicken 10 minutes and turn.
Stir in soup mix blended with water.
Bring to boil.
Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Poppin' Fresh Barbecups(Club Member: Terah)
steps: Brown ground beef; add barbecue sauce, sugar and onion.
Grease muffin tins and place a biscuit in each one.
Mold biscuit around tins, leaving a hollowed out place in middle.
Put beef mixture in each one and top with cheese.
Bake until biscuits are brown at 400°.

title: Italian Delight

ingredients.name: american
ingredients.raw: 1/4 lb. American sliced or Velveeta cheese

steps: Cook hamburger, stirring, but not browned.
Add salt, pepper and garlic.
Add tomato sauce; simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook noodles; drain.
Put a layer of meat sauce in baking dish.
Top with noodles and corn (which has been drained) and cheese.
Repeat same layer of each, then add cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

title: Light As A Feather Muffins
steps: Mix together sugar and shortening.
Blend in egg.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir in alternately with 1/2 cup milk.
Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Afternoon Soda
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Blend until ice cubes are crushed.
Makes a blender full.
For low calories, use Sweet 'N Low and diet cream soda.

title: Aunt Frances'S White Brownies
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Put in greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
(Double recipe to use 9 x 13-inch pan.)
Sprinkle sugar and pecan pieces on top.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Date Loaf Candy
steps: Cook sugar and milk until it boils.
Add dates and salt. Cook to soft ball stage.
Add oleo, nuts and vanilla.
Beat until firm and holds shape on spoon.
Pour candy in row on wet cup towel.
Roll.
When cold, slice.

title: Gail'S Artichokes(Appetizer)
steps: Place artichoke hearts (with marinade) in shallow casserole or glass pie plate.
Combine corn flake crumbs and Mrs. Dash and sprinkle over artichokes.
Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake in a 350° oven until hot, about 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Orange Pepper Steaks
steps: Press pepper into both sides of steaks.
Place steaks on rack in broiler pan so surface of meat is 2 to 3 inches from heat. Combine marmalade, vinegar and ginger.
Brush top of steaks with half of marmalade mixture.
Broil steaks 10 to 15 minutes, turning once and brushing with remaining marmalade mixture.

title: Scallop Saute
steps: Melt butter in large skillet.
Saute mushrooms, green peppers, onions and garlic over medium-high heat until soft.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Add scallops to skillet and saute over high heat. As scallops begin to shrink, return vegetables to skillet; salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in wine.
Serve immediately over hot rice. Serve with your best white wine.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Candy Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put into a well-greased cookie sheet.
Press into pan with wooden spoon.
Top with melted chocolate chips.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Remove and slice into 2 x 2-inch squares.
Leave in pan and put back in refrigerator.
Serve cold.

title: Traditional Southern Fried Okra
steps: Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Add okra and shake well to blend and coat 1 cup of okra at at time to cornmeal mix.
Put 1/4 cup oil into a cast iron frying pan and heat until hot.
Add coated okra a little at a time until brown.
Yield about 10 servings.
(Add additional oil as needed.)

title: Chicken Mozzarella
steps: Brush bottom of rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch, with oil. Mix Parmesan cheese, Bisquick, seasoning, paprika and pepper; coat chicken.
Place, skin side down, in pan.
Bake 45 minutes; turn chicken.

title: Crab Spread
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Add salad dressing or mayonnaise, grated cheese, garlic and Worcestershire sauce.
Add salt and pepper. Rinse the crab meat several times, then squeeze out excess water and shred before adding to cheese mixture.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Snickers Salad
steps: Cut apples into chunks (peel or not as you wish).
Stir apples into Cool Whip.
Using blender, chop fine Snickers bars (do only 3 to 4 at a time; empty blender and do again).
Stir Snickers into the salad.
Refrigerate and serve the same day.

title: Baked Meatballs
steps: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, onion, salt and pepper.
Shape into balls.
Brown slightly.
Combine catsup, mustard, vinegar and sugar.
Pour over browned meatballs and bake in a covered dish at 350° for 1 hour.
Check and add water, if necessary.

title: Oatburgers
steps: Bring water, soy sauce and seasoning to a boil.
Turn down heat.
Add onion and oats.
Form into patties.
Bake until nicely browned at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Turn after 20 minutes.

title: Never-Fail Pie Crust
steps: Add sugar and salt to flour.
Then blend in butter flavored Crisco until crumbly.
Mix together vinegar, water and egg and blend with a fork.
Add to crumbly flour and mix together until it holds together.
Divide into four equal parts.
This dough refrigerates and freezes well.

title: Skillet Meal
steps: Brown hamburger in skillet; drain off fat.
Add mixed vegetables, water and onions.
Simmer until vegetables are tender. Add soup.
Stir and heat to boiling.
Turn off heat.
Let set for 5 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.

title: Magic Fruit Cake
steps: Break up mincemeat; add water.
Boil 1 minute.
Butter 9-inch tube pan.
Bake 2 hours at 350°.

title: Coeur A La Creme
steps: Soften cream cheese; beat with electric mixer.
Add vanilla; continue beating, gradually adding sugar.
Whip cream until stiff; fold into cheese mixture.
Line mold form with cheesecloth; spoon mixture into mold.
Overlap cheesecloth over top.
Chill at least 24 hours (put plate under mold to catch liquid).
Serve with berries, berry sauce or fresh fruit.

title: Neiman-Marcus Dip

ingredients.name: green onion with top
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch chopped green onions with tops

steps: Must be made at least 48 hours ahead.
Mix and serve with crackers.

title: Buttermilk Pie(Great Grandmother Sanderson'S)
steps: Mix
all
ingredients
together.
Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° until set, about 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Asparagus Risotto

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: In large saucepan, melt butter; add onion and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
In medium saucepan, boil chicken broth. Reduce heat; simmer.
When onion is tender, add rice.
Stirring, ladle in 1 cup broth.
Cook, stirring; add another cup.
When rice is near done, add asparagus; 5 to 7 minutes later add shrimp.
When almost done, add 1/2 cup wine.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Waikiki Meatballs

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can beef or mushroom gravy

steps: Combine beef, onion and salt; shape into 20 meatballs.
In skillet, brown meatballs and cook celery in shortening until tender; pour off fat.
Add gravy, pineapple and juice.
Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes.
Stir now and then.
Uncover; cook 5 more minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Hot Garlic Onion Dip

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. garlic powder or 1 to 2 cloves garlic, pressed

steps: Mix sour cream and onion mix.
Add garlic and mix.
Add more garlic, if needed, to taste.
Add cumin powder to taste and mix. Add Tabasco sauce and mix.
Add cayenne.
(The sour cream can absorb the cayenne, so add more, if desired.)
Let stand in refrigerator at least 1 hour to meld.

title: Grilled Swordfish Steaks
steps: Sprinkle steaks with salt, pepper and paprika; rub seasonings in lightly.
Place fish on preheated grill.
Brush top with 2 tablespoons butter.
Turn after about 3 to 5 minutes.
Brush second side with remaining butter and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes more.
Serve with lemon.

title: Dilled Green Bean Bundles
steps: Place dill in water for 1 hour.
Cut lemons in half and juice. Slice the rind into rings.
Combine dill water, 1/4 cup lemon juice, vinegar and salt in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Drain beans and place in a glass or crockery bowl.
Place lemon rings over the beans and pour the dill dressing over all.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Drain beans and arrange them on lettuce leaves with a lemon ring surrounding them, forming bundles.
Serves 8.

title: Salad Or Dessert

ingredients.name: apricot
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. apricot or peach jello

steps: Bring to boil the crushed pineapple.
Add apricot or peach jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Let cool.
Add Cool Whip and buttermilk.
Refrigerate.
A taste sensation.

title: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Cook instant rice; set aside.
Cut green onions and saute in skillet with small amount of shortening.
Scramble eggs in same skillet with sauteed green onions; mix together.
In large bowl, mix and add as follows:
layer of rice, sprinkle pepper and salt lightly, sprinkle La Choy soy sauce evenly.
Pour lightly
the La Choy gravy darkener.
Add scrambled eggs with onion (part of it). Repeat steps until all ingredients are in bowl.
Mix together; ready to serve.

title: Chili Cheese Casserole
steps: Layer the
cheeses in a greased quiche dish.
In quiche shaker mix
together
the
remaining
ingredients.
Pour over cheese and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken In Crescent Rolls With Cheese Sauce
steps: Cook chicken until done.
Roll pieces of chicken in crescent rolls.
Mix together cream of chicken soup and milk.
Bring just to boiling.
Put half of chicken soup in bottom of 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Place chicken and crescent rolls on top of 1/2 of soup. Pour the rest of soup on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with Cheddar cheese and bake for 5 more minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Non Alcoholic Fruit Punch

ingredients.name: fruit juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen fruit juice (choose color)

ingredients.name: ice mold
ingredients.raw: ice mold (in shape of heart or star)

steps: Mix the 7-Up or Sprite and the frozen fruit juice.
Make one mold of ice in star or heart shape.
Decorate with strawberries or cherries, if available.

title: Vegetable-Ravioli Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli cauliflower and carrot
ingredients.raw: 16 oz. frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrots

steps: Saute onion in 1 stick of oleo.
In saucepan, mix together soups and milk to blend well.
Then in 9 x 13-inch baking dish, place vegetables.
Top with cooked ravioli, then sauteed onions. Pour soup mixture over casserole.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 1/2 hour.

title: Chocolate Pudding Desert

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 oz) pkg walnut or pecan pieces

steps: Mix together and put into 9 x 13 baking dish.
Pat down to cover bottom of pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: New Year'S Bean Soup
steps: Soak beans overnight with 2 tablespoons salt.
Drain next day, add 2 quarts water and ham bone.
Simmer slowly for 3 hours and then add rest of ingredients and simmer another 30 minutes or more until beans are tender.
Thicken if desired.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
steps: Sprinkle berries with 3/4 cup sugar.
Mix dry ingredients in 8x8 baking pan.
Add milk and stir well.
Spread dough in pan. Pour melted butter over dough.
Place sweetened berries on top. Bake at 350 degrees until dough rises on top and
brown about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Hot Spiced Nectar
steps: In large crock-pot, add apricot nectar, orange juice, water and lime juice.
Stir in brown sugar.
Tie up the spices in cheesecloth or suitable material to let seep.
Add to juice mixture.
Cover with lid.
Turn on high until it reaches desirable serving temperature.
Turn to low and let simmer.
Serve hot throughout the day or party.
Discard spice bag.

title: Mother'S Tea Cakes
steps: Mix shortening, sugar and salt together.
Alternately mix flour, eggs, vanilla and milk together.
Add baking powder and beat very well.
Roll thin and cut out with biscuit cutter or cookie cutter.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

title: Summer "Apple" Pie

ingredients.name: zucchini and
ingredients.raw: 5 c. zucchini, peeled, seeded and sliced thin

steps: Mix together in a saucepan zucchini, sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, water and cinnamon; bring to a boil.
Cook until zucchini is tender.
Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Butterfinger Candy Pie

ingredients.name: butterfinger candy bar coarsely
ingredients.raw: 6 Butterfinger candy bars (2.1 oz. each), coarsely chopped

steps: Beat eggs lightly in large bowl.
Stir in water, sugar, flour and salt until well combined.
Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat.
Stir hot butter into batter.
Stir in chopped candy bars.
Cool completely.

title: Lemon Freeze Cheesecake
steps: Mix lemon jello with hot water; cool until just about ready to jell.
Mix and blend well cream cheese and sugar.
In a large bowl, beat chilled Pet milk until fluffy.
Add jello mixture and cream cheese mixture to Pet milk mixture and mix well by hand.
If you want real lemon taste, add 1 teaspoon lemon flavoring.

title: No Sugar Added Lemon Icebox Pie

ingredients.name: low fat cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. low fat cream cheese - softened

ingredients.name: tub lite cool whip thawed
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. tub lite cool whip - thawed

steps: Beat cream cheese with mixer until smooth.
Add in the lemon juice, sweetener, and cool whip and beat until
smooth.
Pour into the graham crust, top with the lemon zest and refrigerate until firm (approximately 3 hours). Also good to substitute lime juice and lime zest instead of the lemon. Freezes well.

title: Tamale Bites
steps: Combine cornbread, 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce and salt.
Add ground beef.
Mix well.
Shape into balls.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat remaining enchilada sauce and tomato sauce.
Place meatballs in serving dish.
Pour sauce over and top with cheese.

title: Chocolate Corn Flake Cookies
steps: Beat egg whites stiff.
Add salt and beat.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat very stiff.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Spread Or Ball
steps: Mix all together well.
Form into a ball or leave in a dish. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Add nuts on top.

title: Strawberry Wine-Freeze
steps: Blend all ingredients at high speed.
Prepare 1/2 hour before serving.
The lemonade can may be used for measurement tool.

title: Orange Sherbet Gelatin Salad

ingredients.name: heavy cream whipped
ingredients.raw: 1 c. heavy cream, whipped, or 1 pkg. Dream Whip (prepared)

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add sherbet; mix well. Chill until partially set.
Add oranges; fold in whipped cream. Pour into oiled 1 1/2-quart mold.
Chill until set.

title: Plantation Squash
steps: Cook squash with salt and pepper until tender; drain and place in casserole.
Pour celery soup over squash and top with French fried onions.
Cover with foil.
Place in oven.
Bake about 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Sweet And Sour Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken, cut in serving pieces (skin removed)

ingredients.name: dark red russian dressing
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (8 oz.) bottle dark red Russian dressing (can also use Catalina)

steps: Place chicken in a single layer in pan or ovenproof casserole. Mix remaining ingredients with a little water.
Pour mixture over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Orange Pound Cake
steps: Combine shortening and sugar well; add 1 egg at a time, beating well after each egg.
Sift flour and salt; add alternately with the orange juice and flavoring.
Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Taylor Hash
steps: Let rice and water simmer slowly until rice is well done. There will be no water left.
Add ground beef, tomatoes and seasonings.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour.
Serves 8.

title: Honey-Baked Chicken And Sweet Potatoes
steps: Set oven to 375°.
Brush chicken with sauce mix (dressing, honey, salt and pepper) and bake, skin side down, for 30 minutes. Turn chicken and rebrush with sauce.
Add sweet potatoes.
Bake 15 minutes more.

title: "Fresh" Peach Pie

ingredients.name: pie crust thawed and baked
ingredients.raw: 1 frozen pie crust, thawed and baked

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. sugar (1/2 c. NutraSweet for diabetics)

steps: Peel peaches and slice in bowl.
Put sugar, water and cornstarch in plastic pan (microwave bowl).
Cook 1 minute at a time in microwave until thick and clear.
Add jello.
Put peaches and jello mixture in crust alternately.
Use whipped cream or Cool Whip for topping, if desired.

title: Easy Barbecue Hash

ingredients.name: hickory flavored barbecue sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 jar (16 to 18 oz.) hickory flavored barbecue sauce

steps: Cook pork roast in slow cooker until done (either all day or overnight).
Remove roast and set aside to cool.
Roast should be falling apart.
Pour broth in another bowl and save.
In the slow cooker, add the beef, making sure you break up the chunks.
Add onion and barbecue sauce.
Shred the pork roast with your fingers and add to the slow cooker.
Add a splash of lemon juice and 2 cups of the broth.
Mix well.
Add about 1/4 cup each of ketchup and mustard (more or less to your taste).
Add salt and pepper and simmer at least 30 to 45 minutes.
More broth may be needed to reach desired consistency.

title: Jelly Center Cookies
steps: Roll dough in balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Make impression in center and fill with jelly.
Bake at 350° until done.

title: Southwestern Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Prepare cornmeal pastry.
Combine flour, cornmeal and salt in medium-size bowl.

With pastry blender or 2 knives cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle cold water, 1 tablespoon at a time, over mixture, tossing lightly with fork after each addition until pastry is moist enough to hold together. Shape pastry into ball.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until needed.

title: Date Loaf
steps: Boil sugar, milk and dates until they form a soft-ball. Remove from heat.
Add nuts and butter.
Beat as long as possible. Pour into a thin cloth wet with cold water.
Roll and place in refrigerator.
When cold, slice.

title: Rich Banana Pudding

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding

ingredients.name: carton whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 to 16 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Line the bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with vanilla wafers. Cover completely with sliced bananas, overlapping a bit.
Prepare pudding according to package directions, using 3 cups milk.
Add sweetened condensed milk. Fold in whipped topping. Pour over bananas. Chill before serving.
Texture is soft. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Chocolate Dream Cake
steps: Mix cake according to directions on box.
Add dry instant pudding and smashed bananas and mix well.
Pour into 3 greased/floured cake pans.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Test with toothpick.
Cool 7 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Lefse

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. cream or condensed milk, heated

steps: Put potatoes through ricer and add all the ingredients, except flour.
Cool before adding the flour.
Use extra flour for rolling out.
Bake in sheets on hot lefse grill or griddle.

title: Precious Pink Punch

ingredients.name: or lemon juice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. fresh or frozen lemon juice

steps: Chill all ingredients just before serving.
Combine ingredients and pour over crushed ice.
Garnish with lemon slices and mint.
Makes 14 (8-ounce) servings.

title: Cheese And Frank Roll-Ups
steps: For filling, in a bowl, combine cottage cheese, pickle relish and mustard.
Slice franks lengthwise, cutting to, but not through, the opposite side.
Fill each frank with half of the filling.
Place each frank, filling side down, in the center of a tortilla.
Fold tortillas so opposite edge overlaps.
Place the tortillas, seam side down, in shallow baking dish.
Bake, covered, in a 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake, uncovered, for 5 more minutes.
Top with green onion.
Serves 1.

title: Lime Broiled Catfish
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Stir in lime juice, salt, pepper and garlic; mix well.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Place fillets in a shallow baking dish.
Brush each fillet generously with lime-butter sauce.
Broil for 5 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Remove to a warm serving dish.
Spoon pan juice over each fillet.
Garnish with lime and parsley, if desired.

title: Hawk'S Nest Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Beat until smooth; pour into pie crust (graham cracker, chocolate cookie, crumb, nut or regular).
Chill.
Serve plain or garnish with chopped peanuts or chocolate sauce.

title: Cherry Cool Whip Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and set in refrigerator.
Let chill for 1 hour.

title: Lotus Ice Cream
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl, stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Freeze in a hand-turned or electric ice cream freezer.
Makes 1 quart.

title: Gooey Butter Bars
steps: Mix cake mix, 1 stick melted margarine, 1 egg and 1 cup nuts. Pat in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cream together powdered sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs.
Pour over crust mixture.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool and cut into squares.

title: Dessert Squares
steps: Barely mix together oleo, cake mix and egg.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Then mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and eggs until creamy and smooth.
Pour over first mixture.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Cut into squares.

title: Crunch & Creamy Hash Brown Bake

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. chopped onion (can substitute dried onion, but lessen quantity to 1/8 cup)

ingredients.name: chex
ingredients.raw: 2 c. crushed chex or rice krispies

steps: In a large bowl, combine half of margarine (melted), hash browns, sour cream, chicken soup, onions, and a chicken soup can full of milk.
Put in a 9x13 pan, salt and pepper to taste.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Pour other half of melted margarine over crushed cereal and mix; sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Laura Dawn'S Herbed Corn
steps: In a small bowl, combine first 6 ingredients.
Spread 1 tablespoon over each ear of corn.
Wrap corn individually in heavy-duty foil.
Grill, covered, over medium coals for 10 to 15 minutes, turning frequently or until corn is tender.
Yield:
8 servings.

title: Bavarian Mint Coffee
steps: Blend all ingredients on high until blended.
Yield: 4 cups. Place 1-2 Tbsp. in coffee cup; add 6 oz. boiling water.
For extra flavor serve with peppermint or cinnamon stick.
If desired add brandy or rum to taste.

title: Yummy Chocolate Mint Fudge

ingredients.name: nestle toll house mint flavored semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House mint-flavored semi-sweet chocolate morsels

steps: In medium saucepan, combine marshmallow cream, sugar, evaporated milk, butter and salt; bring to boil, stirring constantly, over medium heat.
Boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly, over medium heat.
Remove from heat.
Add mint-flavored chocolate morsels; stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. Store in nuts and vanilla extract.
Pour into foil-lined 8-inch square pan.
Chill in refrigerator until firm, about 2 hours.
Cut into 1-inch squares.
Makes 1 3/4 pounds of delicious fudge candy. Great for the Christmas holidays or for anytime of the year!

title: Venetian Pasta Rolls
steps: Remove casing from sausage, crumble sausage into skillet, brown and drain.
Add onions; cook until tender.
Stir in 1/2 cup sauce and 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese.
Cover each noodle with 1/3 cup sausage mixture.
Roll up starting at the narrow end.
Place, seam side down, in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Spoon remaining spaghetti sauce over noodles.
Top with Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Oreo Dessert
steps: Combine cream cheese, margarine and sugar together.
Add Cool Whip.
In another bowl whip pudding with milk until thick and fold into cream cheese mixture.
Spread bottom of pan evenly with Oreos and spread batter over crumbs.
Top with another layer of crumbs. Let set overnight.

title: "Killer" Brownies
steps: Combine first 2 ingredients on low heat, stirring constantly. Keep warm while you combine the remaining ingredients except the chocolate chips in a bowl.
Press 1/2 of the mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over baked layer.
Spread or drop by teaspoonful the caramel mixture on top of the chips and then cover with pieces of the remaining cake mixture.
Bake 20 minutes more.
Serve warm or cooled. Delicious!!

title: Overnight Egg Casserole
steps: Put bread on bottom of a rectangular casserole dish.
Beat eggs and add next 4 ingredients to egg mixture.
Pour over bread slices.
Top with Cheddar cheese.
Put in refrigerator overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Shortcake
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with fresh fruit and whipped topping.

title: Uris' Easy Biscuits

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. water (for hard crust; for soft crust, use milk)

steps: Mix dry ingredients with wire whisk.
Add salad oil and liquid.
Mix dough well until soft ball.
Knead until elastic on floured surface.
Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut into 2-inch rounds.
We use a glass.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350° or until light golden brown.

title: Apple Enchiladas
steps: Spoon fruit filling evenly down the center of each tortilla. Sprinkle evenly with cinnamon.
Roll up and place seam side down in a lightly greased pan.
Bring butter, sugar, brown sugar and water to a boil, in a medium saucepan.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring constantly for three minutes.
Pour over enchiladas.
Let stand for 30 minutes.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Young At Heart Chili(Chili Cook Off Entry - 1994)

ingredients.name: brook s chili hot bean or
ingredients.raw: 1 (53 oz.) can Brook's chili hot beans or to taste

steps: Saute onion and green pepper for about 3 minutes; add ground chuck and brown.
Add tomato juice, tomato sauce, sugar and salt. Simmer for 2 hours (more or less).
Add chili beans and simmer 1 hour (more or less).
Add chili powder, if desired.
Enjoy!

title: Blueberry Glace Pie

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: vanilla ice cream or whipped cream

steps: Combine 1 cup blueberries and water in medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil; simmer 3 to 4 minutes.
Combine sugar and cornstarch in small bowl.
Add sugar mixture to blueberries in saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until syrup is clear and thickened.
Stir in 1 tablespoon orange juice.

title: Biscake (Loaf)

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. sugar or 6 pkg. Sweet 'N Low

steps: Mix sugar into flour in a small mixing bowl.
Add the milk and vanilla.
Beat with a spoon until creamy and smooth or with a beater for 4 minutes.
Add the egg and mix thoroughly.
Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cheezy Potatoes
steps: Peel and boil small potatoes until almost done; drain and set aside to cool.
Melt cheese and mushroom soup (rinse can with water) until melted.
Chop onion; pour in cheese mix.
Slice potatoes; put into casserole dish.
Pour over cheese mix. Sprinkle with bacon bits and bake until hot through and through.

title: Basic Pie Crust
steps: Sift flour and salt together.
Cut in Crisco (using pastry blender or two knives) until mixture resembles cornmeal.
Beat egg, vinegar and water together and add to first mixture.
Mix well until a ball is formed. Divide in half.
Roll between two sheets of wax paper.

title: Ebbie'S Corn Relish
steps: Cook corn, vinegar and sugar 20 minutes.
Add other ingredients except mustard and cook 20 minutes.
Put mustard in after mixture is removed from stove and stir.
Put in jars while hot.
Makes 16 to 18 pints.

title: Cavatelli

ingredients.name: wagon wheel
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. wagon wheel or corkscrew macaroni

ingredients.name: italian sausage link
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. Italian sausage links, sliced to 1/2-inch thick

steps: Prepare pasta according to package; drain and set aside.
In large skillet, cook sausage until no pink remains; remove from skillet.
Drain off fat, reserving 1 tablespoon.
Cook green onion and garlic in reserved drippings until tender.
In 2-quart casserole, combine cooked pasta, sausage, onion mixture, tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce, half of cheese, Italian seasoning and pepper.
Toss gently to combine.
Bake in a 375° oven for 25 minutes.
Uncover; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes more or until heated through.

title: Baked Broccoli-Corn
steps: Cook chopped broccoli; drain well.
Whisk egg slightly; add mayo and soup, then whisk to blend.
Stir in cooked broccoli, onion, corn and cheese.
Turn into oblong 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with stuffing.
Pour margarine over stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Crusty Bread With Lemon Pepper Butter
steps: Combine butter and lemon pepper.
Pack into small serving bowl.
Serve with bread.

title: Ranch Style Baked Beans
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In large skillet, melt butter and brown meat.
Stir in soup mix, beans, catsup, water, mustard and vinegar.
Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole or bean pot.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Aunt Marg'S "Fudge"
steps: Mix all ingredients together well.
Cook for 5 minutes in saucepan over medium heat.
Beat 1 minute hard with mixer.
Pour out into a buttered pan.
Chill.

title: Vegetable Salad(Marinated Vegetables)

ingredients.name: carrot and
ingredients.raw: 2 carrots, quartered and cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: pimento
ingredients.raw: 1 jar (4 oz.) pimento, cut into strips

steps: Combine last four ingredients with 1/4 cup water.
Bring to boil.
Add vegetables and simmer for 10 minutes, then cool. Vegetables should be crisp.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Serve in glass bowl.

title: Super Easy Tamale Pie
steps: Remove wrappers from tamales, place in ovenproof dish.
Mix water and chili together, then pour over tamales.
Melt Velveeta cheese and pour over tamales and chili mixture.
Bake in oven for 30 minutes on 350°.
If you're in a hurry, bake on High in microwave for 10 minutes.

title: Rice Surprise Salad
steps: Drain pineapple juice into a 2-quart bowl.
Peel bananas and dip into pineapple juice, then slice into bite-size rounds. Combine bananas into bowl with crushed pineapple, rice, marshmallows and Cool Whip.
Mix well and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Grape-Nuts Ice Cream
steps: Add sugar gradually to beaten eggs.
Beat well after each addition.
When stiff, add remaining ingredients (except Grape-Nuts) and mix thoroughly.
Pour into ice cream maker.
Add Grape-Nuts and crank until firm or frozen.

title: Festive Cherry Dessert(Aka: Dump Cake)

ingredients.name: regular size can cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 regular size can cherry pie filling

steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan put cherry pie filling and pineapple pieces.
Sprinkle cake mix on top (dry) then coconut and nuts. Put melted margarine on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Rita'S Brownies

ingredients.name: sq. chocolate
ingredients.raw: 2 sq. unsweetened chocolate or 3 Tbsp. cocoa and 1 Tbsp. oil

steps: Beat the eggs and sugar in bowl.
Melt shortening and chocolate in pan.
In another large bowl, add flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla.
Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour small square pan.
Mix all ingredients above and beat 2 minutes. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool.
Put on icing.

title: Steak Bake
steps: Cook minute steaks in a small amount of oil in a large skillet until brown.
Add drained green beans, tomatoes, mushrooms and onion.
To thicken the sauce add flour in a small amount of water and pour into the mixture.
Cook for 15 or 20 minutes or until the sauce is thick, then put 4 or 5 biscuits on top of the mixture after you pour everything into a round baking dish.
Then cook until the biscuits are brown, then serve.

title: Potato-Cheese Casserole
steps: Mix ingredients.
Save part of bacon to sprinkle on top after casserole is cooked.
Bake casserole at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Low-Calorie Chocolate Soda
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar and Sweet 'N Low.
Add two tablespoons of milk.
Stir until smooth.
Add the rest of the milk.
Stir.
Add ice cubes.

title: Baked Chicken And Wild Rice

ingredients.name: uncle ben s original wild rice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 box Uncle Ben's original wild rice

steps: Mix soup, water and rice in a flat 2 x 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Wrap each chicken breast with a thin slice of ham.
Add the bacon.
Place on top of rice mixture.
Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 30 minutes longer or until bacon is brown.

title: Cool Whip Salad
steps: Mix Cool Whip and jello together until jello is dissolved. Add fruit cocktail.
Fix ahead of time; keeps well.

title: Chicken Chalupas

ingredients.name: chicken and in bite size
ingredients.raw: chicken, cooked and cut in bite-size pieces

steps: Mix soups, chilies and chicken.
Layer tortillas, soup, chicken mixture, tortillas, soup and chicken mixture.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 250°.
Add shredded cheese during the last 15 minutes.

title: Skillet Tetrazzini
steps: Brown mushrooms and onion in butter until tender.
Stir in gravy and cheese.
Heat until cheese melts.
Add chicken and spaghetti.
Heat and stir now and then.
Garnish with parsley. Serves 4.

title: Fruited Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: whipped dessert thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. frozen whipped dessert topping, thawed

ingredients.name: mandarin orange section
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained

steps: In mixer bowl, blend together cottage cheese and thawed topping.
Beat until blended.
Stir in dry gelatin.
Fold in pineapple and mandarin oranges.
Press into 7 or 8-cup mold. Chill several hours or overnight.
Unmold onto serving plate; garnish with endive.
Serves 12.

title: Weight Watcher Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. sliced strawberries, fresh or frozen

steps: Do not drain any fruit.
Mix and chill.

title: White Sugar Cookies
steps: Beat softened butter until creamy.
Add sugar and continue beating until light and fluffy.
Beat in vanilla.
Stir in flour until it is almost incorporated and then sprinkle milk over dough and finish mixing.
Remove dough from bowl and gather in ball. Knead briefly.
Roll 1/2 at a time 1/8-inch thick and cut into shapes.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.
Edges will be lightly brown.

title: Chile Beans

ingredients.name: kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Brown beef and onion.
Add remaining ingredients; simmer for 30 to 60 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers, cornbread or French bread slices.
Good with tossed salad.
Can be prepared in crock-pot and can be frozen.

title: Cheese Roll Or Ball

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. cheese (Longhorn, Cheddar or sharp), grated

steps: Mix all ingredients together, except chili powder, until well blended.
Form into a roll or ball.
Roll in chili powder sprinkled on wax paper.
Chill.

title: "Never Failing" Fudge

ingredients.name: hershey bar
ingredients.raw: 2 large Hershey bars or Mr. Goodbars (1/2 lb.)

steps: Bring to a
rolling
boil in a large pan and boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from stove and add:

title: Jello Rice Salad
steps: Bring rice and water to a boil.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Drain and save rice water.
Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in rice water.
Add pineapple and Cool Whip.
Let set.

title: Grated Potato Dumplings
steps: Grate potatoes.
Add salt and beaten eggs.
Add enough flour to make a soft dough.
Drop by spoonfuls into boiling water; cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain and rinse in hot water.
Cook onion until golden brown in butter.
Pour onions and butter over dumplings.
Serve hot.

title: Oil-Free Granola

ingredients.name: raisin
ingredients.raw: 1 c. raisins (or less or more as desired; add after cooking)

steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
In a large bowl, combine oats, wheat flakes, nuts and salt.
Warm the honey and vanilla; mix with oats. Spread thin on cookie sheet.
Cook 20 to 25 minutes.
Stir every 5 minutes to prevent burning.
Yields 6 cups.

title: Maple Sugared Popcorn
steps: Combine unpopped corn and water.
Set aside.
Heat oil in 1 1/2-quart pan.
Add sugar to heated oil.
Add popcorn and water. Cover.
Pop the corn quickly and shake the pan constantly.
After peak popping, remove from heat.
Enjoy!

title: Bits O Brickle Cake

ingredients.name: pillsbury plu yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Pillsbury plus yellow cake mix

ingredients.name: heath bit o brickle baking chip
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Heath Bits O' Brickle baking chips

steps: Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg until crumbly.
Press in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add sweetened condensed milk, egg and vanilla; beat until blended.
Add pecans and brickle baking chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Juice Drink
steps: Stir juices, water and sugar in pitcher until sugar is dissolved.
Just before serving, add ginger ale.
Put ice cubes in glasses.
Add drink and serve.
Makes 1 quart or 32 ounces.

title: Chocolate Pecan Fudge
steps: Mix chocolate, milk, sugar and syrup.
Cook until a drop in cold water forms a soft ball.
Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter.
Beat mixture until it becomes thick.
Add pecans and pour into greased pans.
Cut into squares when cool.

title: Fresh Peach Sauce

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. vanilla (or use half almond extract)

steps: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan, mix crushed peaches, sugar and orange juice.
Place over high heat and stir until boiling.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 15 minutes or until thick without covering.
Remove from heat; stir in lemon juice and extract. Makes 2 cups.
Serve warm on pound cake or chill the sauce to make up parfaits to place in freezer for future use.

title: Paula'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly.
Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Irresistible Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt cake pan.
Bake 55 minutes.
Serves 12.

title: Italian Soup

ingredients.name: chunky italian tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 4 (15 oz.) cans chunky Italian tomato sauce

steps: Combine all ingredients except macaroni and cheese.
Cook until zucchini is slightly tender, then add precooked macaroni (should be cooked 7 to 8 minutes).
Cook with macaroni 4 to 5 minutes.
Top with Mozzarella cheese when served.

title: Cucumber Salad Dressing
steps: Grind cucumbers and onions; drain well.
Add sugar, lemon juice, seasonings, coloring and mayonnaise, stir until smooth. Refrigerate.

title: Caramel Delight
steps: Put cookie dough in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with crushed Oreos.
Pour melted caramel on top and bake until crust is done.
Pour melted chips on top and chill.
Add sprinkles too, if you wish.
Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Pumpkin Dessert

ingredients.name: solid pack pumpkin
ingredients.raw: 1 can solid pack pumpkin (and ingredients listed on label to make pie)

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. white or yellow cake mix

steps: Prepare the pumpkin the same as for pie (recipe is on the label).
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle cake mix over top. Melt butter and drizzle butter over cake mix.
Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Banana Corn Bread

ingredients.name: or pkg. yeast in tbsp. warm water
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. or pkg. yeast, softened in 2 Tbsp. warm water

steps: Place cornmeal, wheat germ, potato flour, soy flour and softened
yeast in a bowl.	In another bowl, beat the eggs and all other
ingredients.
Add the dry ingredients to the moist mixture and mix well.
Place in prepared 9 x 5 x 2-inch bread pan and let rise about 1 hour.
Bake in a 325° oven for 40 to 50 minutes. Yield:
1 loaf.

title: Cheese Beans
steps: Drain beans.
Toss beans, mayo and 1/4 cup cheese.
Cook in microwave for 5 minutes; stir.
Add 1/4 cup cheese and stir again. Cook 5 minutes; stir.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and cook 5 more minutes.
Serve piping hot.

title: Apple Custard
steps: Scald
milk with margarine.
Beat together eggs, sugar, cornstarch	and vanilla and add to milk and margarine mixture. To this, add apples.
Pour into 2 pie shells.	Bake for 1 hour or until firm at 350°.

title: Stuffed Shells

ingredients.name: spinach defrosted
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 or 10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, defrosted

steps: Parboil shells.
Combine cheeses, eggs, spinach and cooked sausage.
Stuff shells.
Put extra cheese and sauce over the top. Place in oven at 350° for 1 hour (covered with foil).
Uncover at least 10 minutes.

title: Bologna Salad Sandwich Spread
steps: Process in food processor until coarsely ground.
Add enough Miracle Whip to spread easily.

title: Brisket
steps: Line a roasting pan with onions.
Lay brisket on top, then season with garlic powder and seasoned salt.
Brown for 20 minutes at 450°.
Reduce heat to 350°; cover and cook for about 1 1/2 hours.
Add the sauce; rinse the sauce can with the white wine and pour over the meat.
Add potatoes and cook for about 1/2 hour longer.

title: Heavenly Gold Salad
steps: Heat 1/2 cup apricot nectar and use it to dissolve a small package orange jello.
Add remaining nectar.
Add 1 small can crushed pineapple, 2 bananas, 1 cup marshmallows and 1/2 cup nuts. Chill and serve.

title: Orange-Pineapple Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow or pineapple cake mix

steps: Mix together all ingredients, except mandarin oranges.
Beat with mixer.
Add mandarin oranges and mix into batter with spoon. Pour into 4 greased cake pans.
Bake at 300° until done.
This batter takes about 30 minutes.

title: Alice Lis' Pierogies
steps: Mix together flour, eggs, milk, salt and butter.
Roll like pie dough and cut with 2-inch cookie cutter.
For filling cook and mash potatoes; mix with onion, fried in butter and drained, and dry cottage cheese as you like.
Put filling on half of round, fold, pinch sides together with fork.
Drop into boiling water, a few at a time.
They are done when they come to the surface (about 3 minutes).
Remove from water.
Serve with sour cream or fry.
If you plan to freeze them, don't cook.

title: Cheese-Rich Casserole
steps: Saute green pepper and onion in a small amount of Crisco in a small baking dish.
Add uncooked Minute rice and 1 can cream of mushroom soup plus 1/2 can of water.
Salt and pepper to taste. Put shredded Cheddar cheese to cover on top.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Peach Bavarian

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz. each) pkg. peach or apricot flavored gelatin

ingredients.name: carton whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Drain peaches, reserving 2/3 cup juice.
Chop peaches into small pieces and set aside.
In a bowl, dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water.
Stir in reserved syrup.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Stir extract into whipped topping.
Gently fold into gelatin mixture.
Fold in peaches.

title: Pheasant Flamed With Apples

ingredients.name: heavy white bread with crust removed
ingredients.raw: 6 slices heavy white bread with crusts removed

steps: Salt and pepper pheasants inside and out, then put 1 tablespoon butter inside each cavity.
Place in roasting pan with 3/4 cup water.
Roast in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni and drain; put in crock-pot with all other items.
Add extra cheese on top.
Cook 2 1/2 hours on low.
(Spray crock-pot with Pam and it won't stick.)

title: Veggie Bars

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning

steps: Chop peppers, mushrooms and broccoli; set aside.
Line a lightly greased 15 x 10-inch pan with rolls.
Pinch seams together.
Bake at 350°
for 7 to 8 minutes.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and seasoning together and blend until smooth. Spread on rolls. Mix all veggies and cheese and sprinkle on cream cheese.
Cover and chill.
Cut in squares.

title: Chocolate Brownie Cake
steps: Mix everything in a mixing bowl, except syrup.
After mixing well, stir in chocolate syrup by hand.
Spread in a greased and floured pan (13 x 17-inches).
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Cheese Bread(Makes 3 Loaves)
steps: Combine first four ingredients in a large bowl.
Stir to dissolve.
Add eggs, cheese and flour, enough to make an easily handled dough.
Knead dough quickly and lightly until smooth and elastic.

title: Can Opener Casserole

ingredients.name: red pimento
ingredients.raw: 1 can red pimento, cut into strips (optional)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in greased or Pam sprayed casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lazy Doughnuts
steps: In a mixing bowl, cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Combine flour, baking powder, nutmeg and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk.
Fill greased muffin cups two-thirds full.
Bake at 350° for 18 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack.
Dip doughnuts in melted butter, then roll in cinnamon-sugar.
Serve warm. Yield: about 10 servings.

title: Broccoli, Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli as directed on package.
Drain.
Mix with other ingredients but use 1/2 can cheese soup.
Pour into 1 to 2-quart casserole.
Top with rest of the Cheddar cheese soup.
Cook at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly.

title: Bacon, Lettuce And Tomato Salad
steps: Prepare Dressing:
In small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, water, vinegar and salt.
Set aside.
Cut red onions crosswise in half.
To make onion cups, cut and scoop out each onion half, leaving bottom intact and about 1/4-inch thick shell. Finely chop enough scooped-out onion to make 1/4 cup.
