Add chopped onion to mayonnaise mixture.
Fill red onion cups with dressing.
Garnish with chives, if desired, and refrigerate while preparing salad.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
steps: Drain all vegetables and mix with dressing.
Let stand overnight.

title: Ozark Pie
steps: Combine egg, sugar, salt, baking powder and flour; beat well. Stir apples and nuts into beaten mixture.
Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Spoon on the ice cream. Spread the crushed candy bars over the top and freeze.

title: Holupki (Cabbage Rolls)
steps: Steam the cabbage until soft enough to roll.
Add rest of ingredients.
Roll mixture in cabbage leaves.
Place in pan. Cover with 1 can of tomatoes.
Simmer until done, about 2 hours.

title: Hominy Jalapeno Casserole

ingredients.name: hominy
ingredients.raw: 2 (16 oz.) cans hominy, drained (reserve 1/2 c. liquid)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Combine hominy liquid, soup and butter.
Heat until butter is melted.
Remove from heat; add hominy, jalapeno pepper and seasoning.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pork-Kraut-N-Apple Skillet
steps: In heavy skillet or Dutch oven, brown chops in drippings.
Add onions; cook several minutes.
Mix sauerkraut and apples; spoon over meat.
In another skillet, heat sugar, stirring constantly until it is a rich caramel color.
Pour over sauerkraut mixture. Cover tightly; cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together in order given.
Form 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with a fork.
Bake for 7 to 8 minutes at 375°.

title: Pop Up Bread
steps: Stir dry yeast into 1 1/2 cups of flour; set aside.
Heat water until just warm, not hot.
Mix water with the milk, cooking oil, salt and sugar.
Stir until dissolved, then add flour and yeast and stir until smooth.
Add eggs (well beaten) and slowly pour in 1 3/4 cups of flour, stirring constantly, until fairly smooth.
Dough may be a little tough.
Grease two 1-pound coffee cans well with shortening, then fill each can with half of the batter.
Let rise to 1 inch from top of cans.
Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown at 375°.
Remove bread from cans and allow to cool.

title: Omelette Aux Fines Herbes
steps: Whisk together first three ingredients.
Heat an omelet pan over medium heat.
Add butter, coating bottom of pan.
Pour egg mixture into pan.
As it cooks, gently lift the edges of the omelet with a spatula, tilting pan to allow the uncooked portion to flow underneath the cooked portion.
Sprinkle herbs over omelet.
Fold in half, transfer to plate.
Use parsley for garnish, if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cinnamon-Nut Toast
steps: Heat frying pan.
Melt butter.
Place the bread in the melted butter; turn both sides, then take it out.
Sprinkle some cinnamon on both sides.
Sprinkle the nuts on the side that is facing up. Place the bread in the frying pan just as is.
Wait 3 minutes; turn over and sprinkle some nuts on that side.
Cook until done or brown.

title: Fanciful Fruit Pizza

ingredients.name: pillsbury refrigerated sugar cooky
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. Pillsbury refrigerated sugar cookies

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Slice cookie dough as directed on package. Arrange slices in bottom of ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Using floured fingers, press dough evenly into pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool completely. In small bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Spread mixture over cooled cookie crust.
Arrange fruit over cream cheese.
In small bowl, combine orange marmalade and water; blend well.
Spoon marmalade mixture over fruit.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
Cut into squares.
Store in refrigerator.
Serves 12.

title: West Virginia Salad
steps: Bring pineapple to boil and add jello.
Stir well to dissolve jello.
Cool and add buttermilk.
Stir Cool Whip in and add pecans.
Refrigerate to set well.

title: Candy Bar Pie

ingredients.name: container whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: In a double boiler or microwave oven, melt chocolate bars. Quickly fold into the whipped topping. Stir in vanilla.
Spoon into pie crust. Garnish with shaved chocolate. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Ham Delights

ingredients.name: swiss cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1/3 lb. Swiss cheese, cut in squares

steps: Blend together the first 5 ingredients.
Split the rolls; spread top and bottom with mixture.
Place on rolls the shredded ham and cheese squares.
Wrap in foil.
Bake for 10 minutes at 400°.
These may be wrapped individually or placed in pan and covered with foil.
They freeze well.
Yields about 40.

title: Peach Jam
steps: In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine peeled peaches, sugar, cornstarch, ginger, allspice and salt.
Microwave on high, uncovered, 3 minutes.

title: Nana'S Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: soda dissolved in c. sour milk
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. sour milk

steps: Beat together sugar, flour, baking powder and soda/milk.
Add egg and cocoa which have been mixed with butter.
Flavor with vanilla.
Bake in slow oven (about 350°) until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Mom'S Chicken Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Place chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Mix both soups together with tarragon; pour over chicken.
Place vegetables over top.
Mix flour and baking powder in a bowl; add buttermilk and margarine.
Stir to form a thin dough; pour evenly over chicken mixture.
Bake, uncovered, about 1 hour until crust rises to top and browns lightly.
Serves 6.

title: Easy Red Beans And Rice

ingredients.name: chorizo sausage bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. chorizo sausage, cut into bite size pieces

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, undrained and chopped

steps: Cook sausage in large skillet over low heat until done.
Drain and reserve.
Add to skillet onion, green pepper and garlic; saute until tender.
Add beans, tomatoes, sausage and seasonings; simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes or add to crock-pot and cook on low as long as desired.
Great for football parties.
Serve over rice. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Raspberry Ripple Pie

ingredients.name: cream whipped
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cream, whipped or 1 envelope Dream Whip, whipped

steps: Soften cream cheese.
Mix in confectioners sugar.
Add whipped cream.
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add partially thawed raspberries.
Layer in pie shell, cream cheese mixture on bottom. Save a little for top for contrast.

title: Red Tomato Preserves

ingredients.name: red tomato
ingredients.raw: 5 lb. (11 c., quartered) ripe red tomatoes

steps: Scald, peel and quarter tomatoes.
Add sugar and let stand overnight.
Drain off juice and boil it rapidly until it spins a thread when dropped from spoon.
Add tomatoes and lemons and boil until thick and clear.
Add a few drops of red food coloring. Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Pork Roast

ingredients.name: pork roast boned rolled and tied
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) pork roast, boned, rolled and tied

steps: Place roast, fat side up, on rack in roasting pan.
Bake at 325° for 2 to 3 hours.
Combine garlic, marmalade and ginger root in saucepan.
Cook over low heat until bubbly, stirring constantly.
Remove garlic and ginger root.
Brush glaze over roast 2 to 3 times during the final 30 minutes of roasting.
Serve on platter.
Garnish with orange slices.

title: Fruit Turnovers
steps: Sift flour in large bowl or pan.
Add shortening and milk; knead dough to a stiff texture.
Roll out thin; cut into at least 7-inch circles.
(I use a 3-pound Shedd's Spread bowl for a cutter.)
Spoon in about 2 tablespoons of fruit, already drained and sweetened to taste.
Fold over to make half-moon shape.
Bake at 350° until golden brown; rub with butter while they are hot.

title: Crab Burger
steps: Mix all ingredients above together.
Butter 6 halves and toast in broiler.
Put 1 large spoonful of crab mixture onto toasted half and top with slice of cheese.

title: Lemon Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast boned split and skinned
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, boned, split and skinned

steps: Melt butter in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Add garlic. Flatten chicken breasts, then fold envelope fashion and roll in seasoned bread crumbs.
Place chicken in baking dish; bake at 350° for 30 minutes, basting occasionally.
Add lemon juice; bake for an additional 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Potato Salad For A Crowd

ingredients.name: salt and celery seed
ingredients.raw: salt and celery seed to taste

steps: Cook, cool and peel potatoes.
Slice and chop while warm. Cover chopped warm potatoes with sugar and vinegar.
Add onion, celery and Miracle Whip and toss.
Add salt and celery seed while tossing; chill.
Makes 5 to 6 pounds which will yield 20 to 25 servings.

title: Creamy Cucumbers

ingredients.name: cucumber and
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 large cucumbers, peeled and sliced thin

steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Pour over cukes and onions. Stir, cover and chill.

title: Petite Caramel Pecan Rolls

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. finely chopped pecans or other kind of nut

steps: In small bowl, combine brown sugar, oleo and corn syrup; mix well.
Spread into the bottom of an ungreased 8-inch or 9-inch round cake pan.
Set aside.

title: Simple Cheesecake

ingredients.name: graham cracker pie crust
ingredients.raw: graham cracker pie crust (prepared or homemade)

steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Mix thoroughly until smooth.
Pour mixture into graham cracker crust and bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour.
Top with a can of your favorite prepared pie filling.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
steps: Melt chocolate in microwave on Medium-high.
Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg yolks.
Stir in vanilla and chocolate.
Add flour, soda and salt.
Beat in flour mixture, alternately with buttermilk.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter.
Pour batter into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with wax paper.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center; cool.
Spread frosting between layers and over top of cake.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Pie
steps: Mix well; pat firmly into bottom of deep dish pie pan.
(If you want, you can use a Pet-Ritz deep dish pie shell.)

title: Vinegar Cake
steps: Sift together the first 5 ingredients.
Then add the next 4 ingredients.
Beat together well.
Bake in a greased, floured sheet pan at 350° for 30 minutes, until cake springs back when touched.

title: Carrots Winemaster Inn

ingredients.name: carrot scraped and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, scraped and sliced thin

ingredients.name: cooking cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/3 c. cooking sherry or dry white wine

ingredients.name: onion fine
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. onion, cut fine (green onions are attractive)

steps: Simmer carrots and celery, separately, until tender.
Drain. Melt margarine.
Add wine, sugar and carrots; simmer until carrots are coated with sauce.
Add celery and other ingredients, adding enough dill weed to give attractive appearance.
Hold on warm until served.

title: Mushroom Fingers
steps: Over low flame, saute mushrooms and onion in butter until soft; drain, if necessary.
Add salt to taste.
Combine parsley and sour cream; add mushrooms and onion.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Trim crust from bread; cut into 3 strips or into quarters.
Spread with mushroom mixture; dust with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen appetizers.

title: Monkey Bread(Serves 8 Plus)

ingredients.name: roll bisquick biscuit in quarter
ingredients.raw: 4 rolls Bisquick biscuits, cut in quarters

ingredients.name: sugar and cinnamon mixture
ingredients.raw: sugar and cinnamon mixture (3/4 c. sugar and 1 tsp. cinnamon)

steps: Mix in a small saucepan.
Pour over biscuits in Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool for 30 minutes.
Turn out onto plate.
Cut in slices or pick out pieces as you wish.

title: Chess Pie Cake
steps: Mix first three ingredients.
Pour into buttered pan (9 x 13-inch).
Press down firm.
Then mix next three ingredients and pour over top of cake mix mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Mustard-Grilled Chicken
steps: In a small bowl, stir together 1/3 c. of the mustard, 1 Tbsp. of the cayenne, the vegetable oil, and the vinegar.
Place the chicken in a large lock-top plastic bag and pour in the mustard mixture.
Press out the air and seal the bag tightly.
Massage gently to distribute the marinade.
Set in a large bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, turning and rubbing the bag occasionally.
Prepare a fire for indirect-heat cooking in a covered grill.
Combine the remaining 1/3 c. mustard with the remaining 1 Tbsp. cayenne.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, allowing as much marinade as possible to cling to the surface. Place the chicken, skin side down, in the center of the grill rack.
Grill, turning frequently, for about 25 minutes; do not worry if some of the marinade sticks to the grill.
Turn the chicken skin side up and brush it with the mustard-cayenne mixture.
Cover the grill, open the vents halfway, and cook until opaque throughout and the juices run clear, about 10 minutes longer.
If necessary, cut the chicken into smaller portions, then transfer to warmed individual plates and serve.

title: Date-Nut Bread
steps: Mix margarine, sugar, egg yolk and nuts.
Put baking soda over the dates; add boiling water.
Add this to first mixture.
Add flour, vanilla and beaten egg white.
Bake in loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: James' Favorite Chicken And Rice
steps: Wash chicken and dip in Italian dressing.
Sprinkle generously with lemon pepper, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Cook as desired.
For best results, I let the chicken sit overnight in the Italian dressing and cook on the grill.
Cook rice until tender and add sliced garlic cheese and soup.
Spread into a lightly greased baking dish and bake at 400° until cheese is bubbly. Serve with chicken and a garden salad.

title: Stew Beef Casserole

ingredients.name: stew beef in bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 lb. stew beef, in bite size pieces

steps: Mix well together the soup, A.1. sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
Add to stew beef which has been salted and peppered to taste.
Put in casserole dish.
Bake, covered, for 3 hours at 300°.
Serve over rice.

title: Zucchini Bake
steps: Slice zucchini in bottom of dish.
Brown hamburger and onion together; drain.
Mix in tomatoes.
Place on top of zucchini.
Top with pizza sauce.
Layer Mozzarella cheese on next, then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layers.
Place crushed cracker crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for one hour or until tender.

title: Scalloped Oysters(Microwave)
steps: Add flour to cream and stir until well dissolved.
Generously grease microwave-safe casserole dish (button and sides) with butter.
Cover bottom of casserole with a third of the crackers which have been crumbled by hand.
Add one layer of oysters.
Pour half of the cream mixture over oysters.
Add salt, pepper, garlic powder and sliced butter.
Repeat process by making another layer as listed.
Cover well with a layer of crumbled crackers, sliced butter, salt and pepper.
(You should judge the amount of salt by the saltiness of the oysters.)
Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese.
Microwave (Medium-high) for 15 minutes, rotating at 5 minute intervals.

title: Quick Mexican Dish
steps: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Season.
In oblong dish, put layer of quartered tortillas.
Spread meat into dish, then beans, cheese and tortillas.
Spread Ro-Tel tomatoes on top of tortillas. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Raisin Sauce
steps: Mix flour and sugar with water.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Lower heat and continue cooking until thickened.
Add raisins and remove from heat.
Let cool; stir in grated rind, lemon juice and orange juice.
Add orange slices just before serving, if you wish.

title: Chocolate Bavarian

ingredients.name: or pkg. pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 large or 2 small pkg. pudding (6 oz. total)

steps: Mix flour, margarine and pecans. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes and cool.
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Pour over cooled crust.
Fix pudding as directed on box.
Cool completely and put over cream cheese mixture.
Cover with small carton Cool Whip.
Sprinkle some chopped nuts on top (optional).

title: Heidi'S Favorite Cookies

ingredients.name: english toffee bit
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. (10 oz. pkg.) English toffee bits

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Stir together flour, baking soda and salt in a large mixer bowl. Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until well blended.

Add eggs; blend thoroughly. Gradually add flour mixture, beating well. Stir in toffee bits. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely.
Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Busy Day Hot Dish
steps: Fry hamburger.
Add soup, water, sliced potatoes and onion, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Place in casserole dish; bake for 1 hour at 325°.
Add more water, if necessary.

title: Squash Green Pepper Casserole
steps: Combine milk, butter and bread crumbs.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° approximately 25 minutes or until set.

title: Date Nut Chews(Golf Balls)
steps: Beat eggs, salt and almond extract or brandy until light. Gradually add sugar and syrup.
Add flour, dates and nuts.
Pour into 2 greased 8-inch pans.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While still hot, shape into small balls with 2 teaspoons and roll in hands, then in powdered sugar.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
Add rest and mix with mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Brown Jug Soup
steps: Combine potatoes, onions, bouillon cubes, mixed vegetables and water in a big pot.
Bring all to a boil and reduce heat.
Simmer for one-half hour.
Then add celery soup and Velveeta cheese.
Stir until well blended and hot.
Serves 6.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Cheese Casserole
steps: Cook rice according to directions; drain.
Place in a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish.
Add broccoli, cheese and soup; mix well. Crush crackers and place on top of mixture.
Place pats of butter on crackers.
Bake in oven at 350° until bubbly.

title: Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms

ingredients.name: soft bread crumb lightly toasted
ingredients.raw: 1 c. soft bread crumbs, lightly toasted

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake souffle, uncovered, for 15 to 18 minutes, or until slightly warmed.
Combine souffle, bread crumbs, onion and lemon juice in bowl; mix well.
Remove and discard mushroom stems.
Place mushroom caps in shallow baking pan.
Brush with butter; sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Baba'S Pumpkin Cake Pie

ingredients.name: libby s pumpkin
ingredients.raw: 1 large can Libby's pumpkin (make recipe as directed on can)

ingredients.name: white
ingredients.raw: 1 box white or yellow cake mix

steps: Crumble dry cake mix and margarine together as for pie dough in bowl.
Spray 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish with Pam.
Pour pumpkin filling into dish; sprinkle all crumbs on top of filling. Bake cake as you would pumpkin pie recipe on can, except bake 10 minutes longer.
Test by inserting butter knife in cake.
If clean, cake is done.
May be served with Cool Whip.

title: Cranberry-Banana Mold
steps: Dissolve jello in water.
Add cranberry sauce and stir until blended.
Chill until partially thickened.
Add sliced bananas and pecans.
Spoon into mold; chill until firm.
Serve on greens. Yields 6 to 9 servings.

title: Plum Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl (except nuts).
Beat at medium speed for 10 minutes.
Add pecans.
Pour in a greased tube pan.
Bake for 60 minutes at 300°.
Serve plain or with glaze.

title: Smothered Potatoes With Squash
steps: Cut potatoes into strips.
Coat skillet with oil over medium heat.
Saute lightly the onions and bell pepper.
Add potatoes and stir to coat with oil.
Cook, stirring for 2 minutes.
Add squash and seasonings; gently mix.
Cover and heat on low.
Cook until potatoes are tender, checking and turning often.

title: Black Beans

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 1/2 Tbsp. garlic powder or 3 large garlic cloves, crushed

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 tsp. olive oil or cooking oil

steps: Rinse beans with water and pick out bad beans and dirt.
Soak beans in water 2 to 3 hours or overnight.
Saute onions and green pepper in oil.
Add garlic and oregano.
Set aside while cooking beans.
Put beans and cup of water in pressure cooker.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook 1 hour at medium heat.
When beans are soft, add sauteed mixture.

title: Comanche Dip(Salsa)
steps: Roll each pepper in hand 8 or 9 times hard, then dice.
Put all ingredients in blender and blend.
Serve with chips, veggies, etc.

title: Lite Dessert
steps: Put pineapple and juice in bowl.
Sprinkle jello in pineapple and stir well.
Fold in Cool Whip until set.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream the shortening and sugar thoroughly.
Sift together the flour, salt and soda.
Combine with oatmeal.
Add to the creamed mixture, alternately with the milk.
Stir in the vanilla.
Roll out to 1/8-inch thickness on floured board.
Cut into 2 1/2-inch circles with floured cookie cutter.
Bake on greased cookie sheet in 375° oven for about 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

title: Green And Yellow Rice

ingredients.name: spinach and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: each thyme marjoram rosemary and salt
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each thyme, marjoram, rosemary and salt

steps: Beat egg and grate cheese.
Add milk to egg, add cheese, then spinach and mix well, but gently.
Add onion, Worcestershire sauce and seasonings.
Cook rice.
Add butter.
Add rice mixture to spinach mixture.
Turn into a 2 quart casserole.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Triple Orange Ambrosia

ingredients.name: mandarin orange section
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in sherbet until melted.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Mix in half the oranges and pineapple chunks.
Pour into ring mold sprayed with no-stick cooking spray.
Chill until firm.
Unmold.
Stir marshmallows, coconut and remaining fruit into whipped topping.
Scoop mixture into center of ring mold.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Creamy Chocolate Frosting
steps: Combine melted butter and cocoa; then add milk and vanilla. Stir in sugar (sifted if lumpy) and salt in 3 parts.
Beat until smooth.
If frosting is too thick, beat in 1/2 teaspoon milk at a time.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
steps: Bring the 5 ingredients to a boil, stirring constantly, until very thick.
Stir in 2 tablespoons butter and 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice.
Cool.
Fold in 2 cups fresh blueberries.
Chill. Whipped cream for topping is good.

title: Tynes Family Oyster Casserole
steps: In buttered casserole dish, put 1 layer oysters, then 1 layer crushed crackers. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Repeat.
Pour Pet milk over all this.
Finish by pouring regular milk until all ingredients are covered. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Burst Cookies

ingredients.name: nestle peanut butter morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. Nestle peanut butter morsels

steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
In a small bowl combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
In a large bowl mix butter, brown sugar, white sugar and vanilla extract.
Beat at medium speed until creamy (3 to 5 minutes).
Add egg; beat well.
Turn mixture on low.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in peanut butter chips.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 7 to 9 minutes.
Cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes.

title: Corn Scallop

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can whole kernel corn (do not drain)

ingredients.name: cream corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can creamed corn (do not drain)

steps: Mix cans of corn in bowl.
Add eggs (beaten), butter, sour cream and cornbread mix.
Lightly grease a casserole dish and pour in baking dish and bake for 40 to 50 minutes at 350° or until golden brown.

title: Cranberry Pudding Bread

ingredients.name: regular sized jell o instant pudding lemon flavor
ingredients.raw: 1 regular sized Jell-O instant pudding lemon flavor

steps: Mix first 6 ingredients with spoon.
Then mix 4 minutes with beater at medium speed.
Fold in cranberry sauce (cubed).
Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for about 55 minutes.

title: Low - Cholesterol Pancakes
steps: In a bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients.
In another bowl, combine buttermilk, oil and vanilla; add to dry ingredients.
In a mixing bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Fold into batter.
Pour batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto a hot griddle coated with non-stick cooking spray.
Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes.
Cook until second side is lightly browned.

title: Pudding Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Pour into pie shell and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Limas In Pepper Boats
steps: Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seeds.
Parboil 5 minutes and drain. Brown onion in fat. Add tomatoes, seasonings and limas. Simmer 20 minutes. Remove from fire.
Add cheese. Fill peppers with mixture. Sprinkle with crumbs.
Place in shallow pan in 1/2-inch of hot water.
Bake in moderate oven 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Church Window Cookies

ingredients.name: or walnut
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped or finely chopped walnuts

steps: Melt chocolate chips and butter in double boiler.
While melting, prepare other ingredients.

title: Baked Broccoli

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained (or 2 bunches of fresh broccoli

ingredients.name: cheddar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded cheddar or colby cheese

steps: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs.
Pour mixture into an oven proof baking dish which has been either well greased or sprayed with non-stick cooking oil.

title: Chicken Divan Supreme

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and
ingredients.raw: 1 chicken breast, skinned, boned and sliced

steps: Cook broccoli until crisp-tender.
Combine salad dressing, flour and salt.
Gradually add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened.
Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted.
Layer broccoli, chicken and sauce in 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 2 servings.
Recipe may be doubled.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dream Cake

ingredients.name: strawberry thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) box frozen sliced strawberries, thawed

steps: Mix together cake mix, flour, gelatin, eggs, and water.
Beat 2 minutes.
Add half the box of strawberries, including the syrup, to the batter; beat 1 minute.
Add oil and beat again.
Pour into greased and floured 11 X 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes.
Cool.

title: Perfect Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix flour, baking soda, and salt; set aside.
Cream butter, shortening, sugar and vanilla; add egg and beat until fluffy. Stir in flour mixture; blend in milk to form a dough.
Roll dough into balls and flatten with glass dipped in water and sugar.
Bake at 400 degrees for 9 minutes or less.
Don't over cook.

title: Broccoli Divine

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 1 large bunch broccoli or 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (10 1/2 oz.) condensed cream of celery soup

steps: Place broccoli in shallow baking pan (10 x 6 x 2-inch).
Blend soup, cheese and milk.
Pour over broccoli.
Top with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Frozen Lemon Dessert
steps: In a saucepan, melt butter.
Stir in crumbs.
Reserve 1 tablespoon for garnish.
Press remaining mixture on bottom of a buttered 8 x 8-inch baking pan; set aside.

title: Brownies For A Crowd
steps: Use My-T-Fine lemon pudding.
Cook as directed.
Beat egg whites, adding 2 tablespoons sugar for each egg used in pudding. Fold beaten egg whites into pudding.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Sprinkle a few crumbs on top.

title: Elskaffee
steps: Make one pot of coffee; add sugar and milk to taste.
Let cool.
Add two scoops of ice cream per glass of coffee.
Top with whipped topping and add chocolate shavings.
This makes a good after dinner dessert in the summer.
Serve with drinking straw and a long teaspoon.
Can also be dressed up with liquor like Southern Comfort, mint liquor or Amaretto.

title: Roulade
steps: Note:
Amounts will vary depending on number made.

title: Creamed Peas
steps: In large saucepan, cook peas according to package directions. In another medium saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender but not brown.
Blend in flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Add cream and lemon peel.
Add Swiss cheese, cooking until melted.
Put peas in serving bowl.
Pour sauce over peas and serve.

title: Ice Box Cookies
steps: Mix, divide into 4 rolls (sprinkle small amount of flour on wax paper and roll dough into approximately 1 1/2 inch diameter rolls).
Place rolls in refrigerator until chilled.
Slice and bake in 350° oven 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Saucy Cocktail Franks
steps: Melt jelly over medium heat; blend in mustard.
Add franks; stir gently until franks are heated through and covered in jelly mixture.
Place in server over candle warmer.
Serve with toothpicks.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Ann'S Honey Mustard Dressing

ingredients.name: kraft fat mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 c. Kraft fat-free mayonnaise or Miracle Whip

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove minced garlic or 1 tsp. minced garlic from a jar

steps: Place all ingredients in a bowl and blend together.
Yield:
2 1/2 cups or 10 servings allowing 1/4 cup per serving.
Contains 40 calories per 1/4 cup.
Keeps at least 1 week in the refrigerator. Use on sandwiches as well as salads.

title: Cheese Dreams

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.raw: dash of cayenne pepper to taste

steps: Mix together cheese and butter; add flour and Rice Krispies. Mix well.
Add cayenne pepper.
Roll into quarter sized balls. Place on the greased cookie sheet; flatten with fork.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Doritos Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil and debone chicken.
Layer chicken, Doritos, cheese, onion and corn in casserole dish.
Mix chicken soup, mushroom soup, milk and tomatoes.
Pour over casserole.
Top with cheese. Bake at 375° until done, about 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes (Au Gratin)

ingredients.name: cheez whiz
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz or 1 lb. sliced cheese

steps: Put sliced potatoes in boiling water and precook for 5 to 8 minutes, until slightly cooked but not soft.
Drain and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray.
Melt the margarine in saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cornstarch and salt until blended.
Add the milk and slowly stir until a thick white sauce forms.
Turn off the heat and add the cheese to sauce. Stir until the cheese melts, then pour over the potatoes.
Place a layer of cheese slices on top or sprinkle with grated cheese, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and the potatoes are soft.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Spaghetti With Fresh Tomato Sauce
steps: In a large skillet, cook onions in olive oil until onions are lightly browned.
Stir in tomatoes, broth and seasonings.
Cover. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Drain.
Serve with tomato sauce and cheese.
Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Nut Crunch
steps: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish and spread the undrained crushed pineapple over the bottom of the pan; add the layer of blueberries and 3/4 cup of sugar.
Sprinkle the box of cake mix on top of the fruit mixture.
Then pour the melted margarine evenly over the layer of cake mix; top with a generous amount of pecans.
Finally, for a crunch glaze, sprinkle the 1/4 cup of sugar on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
After cake has cooked 25 minutes, cut down through the cake with a spoon to permit juices to come up.

title: Date Torte
steps: Cream eggs and sugar.
Add fruit and nuts, then white of eggs gradually.
Add flour and vanilla.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll into small balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet, well apart, flatten with glass bottom or fork dipped in sugar.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Mousse
steps: Heat cranberry juice to boiling, then add jello and stir until dissolved.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Chill until thick but still syrupy, then fold in Cool Whip.
Pour in mold and chill until firm.

title: Hamburger Zucchini Casserole
steps: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water until tender (drain). In large bowl, mix all ingredients (using Stove Top dressing mix, any flavor; dry and seasoning packet).
Bake in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Texas Caviar
steps: Drain peas.
Add celery, green onions, peppers and drained pimientos.
Add dressing.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chinese Beef Casserole
steps: Saute celery, pepper and onion.
Add ground beef and brown. Add noodles and mushroom soup and bake at 350°.

title: Grams Baked Corn
steps: Cream butter with sugar, flour and pepper.
Add beaten eggs and milk; add corn and salt.
Bake in a buttered baking dish at 350° for 1/2 hour or until set.

title: Grand Marnier Smoothies

ingredients.name: grand marnier or
ingredients.raw: 1 oz. (2 Tbsp.) Grand Marnier or to taste

ingredients.name: orange zest plu orange
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. freshly grated orange zest plus orange slices for garnish

steps: In a blender, blend ice cream, orange juice, Grand Mariner and zest until smooth, but still thick.
Pour mixture into 2 chilled stemmed glasses and garnish with orange slices.
Makes 2 drinks.

title: Mother'S Broccoli Casserole(Pearl Bassett)

ingredients.name: broccoli according direction on pkg.
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked according to directions on pkg.

ingredients.name: celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can celery soup (note: do not dilute)

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 small grated onion or onion flakes

steps: Mix well.
Add salt and pepper (to your liking).
Pour mixture over broccoli.
Put crushed Ritz crackers on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 325° in oven.

title: Berkeley Guacamole
steps: Peel and seed the avocados.
Mash the avocados in a nonmetallic bowl with a fork.
Don't overdo it.
Add the lime juice, garlic and Tabasco.
Add a dash or two of salt.
Taste and see if you need to add any more lime juice or salt.
Add the remaining ingredients, and stir judiciously (the guacamole's texture should be chunky, not pureed).
Refrigerate until you're ready to serve it.

title: Steak Or Chicken Fajitas

ingredients.name: sirloin
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. round, sirloin or skinned, boneless chicken, cut into strips

ingredients.name: salsa sour cream and guacamole
ingredients.raw: fresh salsa, sour cream and guacamole (to serve)

steps: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil. Saute the onion and bell pepper (cut into thin strips) until tender. Remove from skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, brown your meat, then add Lawry's fajitas mix and 1/4 cup water.
Blend well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Return vegetables to skillet to heat. Add the tomato (cut into thin wedges).
Ready to serve.

title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Add flour, soda, salt and vanilla. Mix well.
Add oatmeal.
Shape 1 teaspoon of mixture into a ball. Press or flatten lightly on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Beef Roll-Ups
steps: Make stuffing according to directions on box.
Cut steak into thin pieces, about 4 1/2 x 2-inches; score.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Spread some dressing on each piece of meat.
Roll up and fasten with skewer or toothpicks.
Roll in flour and brown in butter.
Add 2 cups water (meat stock is better) and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until tender.
Remove toothpicks.
Pour gravy over meat. Garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Puppy Chow Snack - For People
steps: Melt butter, chips and margarine in pan over low heat.
Pour over cereal and stir until well coated.
Put powdered sugar in a paper bag.
Add cereal and shake to coat well.

title: Easy Cheese Strudel
steps: Pat 1 package of crescent rolls in an ungreased jelly roll pan (15 x 17-inch).
Seal the cracks in the dough.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth and spread over crescent dough in pan. Roll other package of crescent rolls to fit pan and use it to cover the cream cheese mixture.
(If dough sticks, use a little flour as you would when rolling pie dough.)

title: Daddy Johnny'S Broccoli Bread

ingredients.name: broccoli and thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 box frozen broccoli, chopped and thawed

steps: Mix cornmeal mix, eggs, cheese, onion, broccoli, peppers and half of the melted butter.
Coat skillet with the rest of the melted butter.
Pour in mixture.
Bake at 400° for about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Butternut Squash Souffle

ingredients.name: orange rind
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. grated orange rind (cut up orange in squash)

steps: Mix and pour in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Donut Muffins
steps: Cream together shortening and sugar.
Add egg; beat well.
Mix and sift dry ingredients together.
Add alternately with milk.

title: Hot Percolator Punch
steps: Mix juices, water and sugar.
Put in 30-cup percolator. Place cloves, cinnamon and salt in basket.
Perk as you would coffee.

title: Never Fail Cold Fudge
steps: Melt margarine; put in all ingredients in a bowl.
Pour in melted margarine and stir until smooth; put mixture in pan and chill until firm.
Add nuts (optional).
Cut in squares.

title: Frosty Mandarin Orange Dessert
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in orange sections with syrup.
Add sherbet by spoon and stir until melted.
Pour into 5-cup serving bowl.
Yields 9 servings.

title: Pizzaburgers
steps: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender, but not brown.
Add tomato paste and seasonings.
Simmer, uncovered, about 15 minutes.
Spoon hot meat mixture between or over bun halves. If you like, slip onion rings and/or Mozzarella cheese into each bun.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Cathedral Window Cookies
steps: Sprinkle 3 pieces wax paper with powdered sugar.
Put on, roll and chill, then slice.

title: Favorite Vegetable Soup
steps: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan, combine onion, garlic and 1/4 cup of broth; cook until onion is translucent.
Add remaining ingredients and rest of the broth.
Cover and cook over a high heat, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer or until vegetables are soft, about 20 minutes.
Makes 2 servings.

title: Wild Duck With Apples
steps: Mix apples, raisins and breadcrumbs; add apple juice until moist.
Fill the ducks with this stuffing.
Rub the ducks with onion, salt and pepper.
Roast at 325°, breast down, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Baste frequently with remaining apple juice.

title: Lasagne Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and squeezed dry
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

ingredients.name: prepared spaghetti sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (26 to 32 oz.) jar prepared spaghetti sauce

steps: Cook lasagne acccording to package directions; drain and set aside.
In medium bowl, blend Ricotta cheese, eggs, spinach, Mozzarella cheese, basil and marjoram.
Spread evenly on lasagne strips cut in half.

title: Great Gramma'S Salmon Loaf
steps: Mix all together.
Press into a deep greased dish.
Grate cheese over top, if desired.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Real comfort food!
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fried Eggplant
steps: Cook
peeled and cut up eggplant in water until tender. Drain all water.
Mash eggplant; mix in egg, salt and pepper. Add enough
flour
to
make slightly thick.
Drop by teaspoon into hot
grease.
Cook until brown and drain on paper towels or in colander.

title: Clay Dough
steps: Thicken on stove, stirring constantly, then knead.
Color as you wish.
Store in a covered container when not in use.
Hours of fun for children!

title: Ole Timey Tea Cakes
steps: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl as listed.
Mix with a wooden spoon.
Roll out on floured board thin.
Cut with any size cutter.
Place on a flat cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°.
Bake only until tops are light brown.
Best stored in a flour
sack or pillow case if you can keep the kids out.

title: Rice Krispies Snow Balls
steps: In bowl, mix butters and sugar well.
Add nuts and Rice Krispies.
Mix well and roll into balls.
Dip balls into sugar water and roll in shredded coconut.
Fun for the kids.

title: Bunch Punch

ingredients.name: pineapple juice chilled
ingredients.raw: 1 (46 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled

steps: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl.
Makes 5 1/2 quarts.

title: Pea-Goulash

ingredients.name: hamburger
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. hamburger (best to use ground chuck)

ingredients.name: american cheese
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 American cheese slices (may substitute other cheese)

steps: Brown hamburger.
Remove from pan; set aside.
Add oil to hamburger grease.
Fry potatoes and onion in grease.
Add hamburger when potatoes are tender.
Pour 1 can peas with juice over hamburger mixture.
Top with cheese.
Cook on low until cheese is melted.
Kids love this when cold outside.

title: Terrific Freezer Biscuits
steps: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl; mix until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add milk and egg together.
Mix well and turn out on a floured surface; knead several times.
Roll out to 3/4-inch thickness.
Cut out in 2 1/2-inch biscuits.
Put on a greased cookie sheet and freeze.
When biscuits have frozen, place in a plastic bag in the freezer and take out when needed.
Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Glazed Baked Ham

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple slices (juice pack), drained (reserve juice)

steps: Place ham on roasting rack in 10-inch square casserole.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.
Microwave at Medium-high (70%) for 15 minutes; set aside.
Mix 3 tablespoons of reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar and mustard in small bowl; microwave at Medium-high (70%) until hot, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after half of the cooking time.
Place 4 cloves in each pineapple slice; arrange on top of ham.
Pour half of the glaze over ham.
Cover. Microwave at Medium-high (70%) until internal temperature reaches 130°, 20 to 30 minutes, brushing with glaze 2 or 3 times.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Banana Butterscotch Pie
steps: Cover the can of Eagle Brand with water and boil 3 hours. This will caramelize.
Slice bananas in pie shell.
Spread Eagle Brand over.
Top with whipped cream.

title: Pickled Peaches Or Pears
steps: Clingstone peaches are the best for making pickles.
If clingstone's are unavailable, use regular peaches, quartered.
Dip in boiling water and remove skins.
Stick each peach with 4 to 6 cloves and drop immediately into a boiling hot syrup made of vinegar, sugar and stick cinnamon.
Boil slowly until peaches are tender (8 to 10 minutes).
Pack into jars.
Add hot syrup and seal.
Makes 2 quarts.

title: Schumann'S Frozen Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: or pkg. pie crust mix
ingredients.raw: 1 stick or 1/2 pkg. pie crust mix

ingredients.name: sq. semi sweet chocolate and cooled
ingredients.raw: 6 (1 oz.) sq. semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: Prepare 9-inch baked pie shell as directed on package.
In small mixer bowl, blend 1 cup confectioners sugar and butter on low speed until fluffy.
Blend chocolate and vanilla.
On high speed, beat in eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each time.
Pour into baked pie shell, cover with plastic wrap.
Freeze several hours or until firm.
For easier cutting, remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving, remove plastic wrap.
In chilled bowl, beat cream, add 2 tablespoons confectioners sugar until stiff.
Pile onto pie, garnish with chocolate curls.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Mushroom Casserole

ingredients.name: crab meat
ingredients.raw: 4 oz. crab meat, drained (or cooked shrimp)

steps: In saucepan, melt margarine.
Add flour; stir.
Add milk and soup.
Lower to simmer.
Add egg, mushrooms, cheese and crab; stir well.
Simmer until cheese melts.
Add sherry and stir.
Pour into lightly buttered ramekins.
Bake at 375° until bubbly and brown on top (approximately 30 minutes).
Excellent side dish with steak.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Special
steps: Fry bacon in a large covered pan.
Remove the bacon and add onion, bell pepper, bay leaf and celery.
Saute until tender.
Add peas, tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce.
Cover the pan and simmer for 3 hours.

title: Candied Pork Chops
steps: Place pork chops in a 13 x 9-inch dish.
Salt and pepper. Sprinkle onion, spices and sugar over the chops.
Cook in a 425° oven until nicely done and glazed (about 30 minutes).

title: Salmon Soup
steps: Combine in pot.
Bring to boil.
Serve warm with crackers.

title: Turkey Roll-Ups

ingredients.name: chive and onion cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chive and onion cream cheese

steps: Spread cream cheese on tortillas, followed by a thick layer of turkey and a cucumber.
Roll up jelly roll style and cut into bite sized pieces.
Dip in salsa for an appetizer.

title: Cranberry Apple Punch
steps: Place all ingredients in large punch bowl.
Add garnish of orange slices, fresh cranberries and ice.

title: Steamed Stew
steps: In a 10-inch skillet, place a layer of hamburger patties, a layer of onion rings, a layer of potatoes and carrots.
Continue until pan is full.
Add 1/4 cup water.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes

ingredients.name: cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cottage cheese (small curd dry), drained

steps: Beat eggs lightly.
After you have melted the butter and it has cooled slightly, add it to the eggs.
Then add flour and salt to the mixture.
Over a pancake griddle heated to 375°, pour 1/2 cup or 1/4 cup of pancake mixture, depending on your desired pancake size.
When the pancake begins to brown slightly around edges, flip to brown other side.
Add syrup and eat.

title: Chocolate Morsel Pound Cake
steps: Mix all together except morsels.
After all is mixed, stir in morsels.
Pour into tube pan and place in cold oven and bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Mixed Vegetable Pickles

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. green or yellow beans, or mixed

steps: Cook peas, beans, carrots and corn with salt as for table use, and drain.
Soak diced cukes, onion and cauliflower in salt water for 2 hours or more; drain well.

title: Speidi Sauce Marinade
steps: Mix ingredients.
Let come to room temperature before covering and then refrigerate.
Serve only on rainy summer days, preferably holidays and vacations.

title: Sue'S Icebox Lemon Pie
steps: Melt butter and brush onto crust; bake at 350° for 3 to 4 minutes.
Blend milk, yolks and lemon juice.
Beat well.
Pour into pie shell.

title: Egg Boats
steps: Peel hard-boiled eggs.
Cut in half.
Remove yolk.
Mix with mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper.
Cut two paper triangles. Tape them to toothpicks.
Put yolk mixture and sails into egg halves.
Sail it into your mouth.
Makes 12 boats.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Green Beans

ingredients.name: green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh green beans, cut and cooked

steps: Fry bacon until crisp; drain.
Saute onion in bacon fat until golden.
In small bowl, mix cornstarch, salt, mustard, sugar and vinegar.
Add liquid from beans and beat until smooth.
Add the mixture to bacon fat in pan and boil until thickened slightly. Add beans and stir well.
Crush bacon on top.
Heat until hot and bubbly.

title: Kim'S Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: water chestnut and
ingredients.raw: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained

steps: Combine bite size pieces of chicken and next 5 ingredients. Pour into 9 x 12-inch glass baking dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top, then bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Stuffing For Turkey
steps: Chop liver and heart together on cutting board.
Add cinnamon, nutmeg and garlic powder.
Sprinkle parsley to cover meat.
Chop in all ingredients until mixed.
Using frying pan, coat bottom with olive oil and saute chopped onion and fry until lightly browned. Add ingredients that are now chopped to the frying pan and let cook until done.
Peel potatoes and boil.
Mash cooked potatoes with fork.
Add all ingredients and use beater to mix.
Salt to taste. Turkey is now ready to be stuffed.

title: All-In-One-Pot-Dinner
steps: Peel and slice potatoes.
Place in casserole.
Slice onions over potatoes.
Scrape and slice carrots, then place slices over onions.
Cover with corn, then spread ground beef evenly over top. Add seasoning.
Spread undiluted soup over ground beef, then cover casserole.
Bake in preheated 250° oven for 3 hours or until done.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Jimmy Carter Dessert
steps: Blend flour and butter; add peanuts.
Press into an 8 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.

title: Eye-Of-The-Round

ingredients.name: or more eye of the
ingredients.raw: 3 lb. or more eye of the round

steps: Cover real heavy with Season-All and garlic pepper.
Wrap good with foil.
Cook at 350° minutes per pound.
Slice real thin. Serve with Parker House rolls and hot mustard.
Great for cocktail parties.

title: Mom'S Chili

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. chili powder (or hot spice to taste)

steps: Brown hamburger; drain.
Put all ingredients into large pot; simmer for about 2 hours.

title: Play Dough You Can Eat

ingredients.name: powdered milk
ingredients.raw: 1 c. powdered milk (or more if needed)

steps: Wash your hands!
Mix the pudding and milk.
Add the peanut butter.
Mix in powdered milk until the texture is like play dough. Break off a portion about the size of a golf ball.
Mold it like play dough.
Make a batch of play dough "cookies" to be shared by family and friends.
After working with the play dough, enjoy eating it!

title: Supreme Fudge(Microwave)
steps: In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle, combine sugar, cocoa, milk, butter and corn syrup.
Microwave at High for 5 minutes.
Stir well until sugar dissolves.
Microwave at High for 9 to 11 minutes or just until mixture reaches 234°.
Let stand until edges are 130°, about 30 minutes.
Add vanilla and beat until candy loses its gloss.
Quickly stir in walnuts and turn into buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Set aside at room temperature to cool completely.
Cut into squares when set.
Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
steps: Mix ingredients together; put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1 cup crushed corn flakes mixed with 1/4 cup melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Angel Food Cake Topping

ingredients.name: dream whip whipped according direction
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Dream Whip, whipped according to directions

steps: Mix pudding and milk.
Make Dream Whip according to directions. Put both in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Then mix the two together. Cut you cake into pieces and put some topping on each piece as it is being served.

title: Bacon Big Boys
steps: Split rolls lengthwise; if tops are rounded, trim slightly. Spread inside of tops with prepared mustard.
Arrange 2 cheese slices and 2 frankfurters on bottom half of each.
Replace tops.

title: Pecan Sandies Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add water and vanilla.
Mix well. Blend in flour and nuts.
Chill 4 hours.
Shape into balls or fingers.
Bake on cookie sheet at 325° for 20 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Cool slightly.
Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Coopers Famous Pound Cake

ingredients.name: butter room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. butter, softened to room temperature

steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Mix dry ingredients except sugar together.
Sift 3 times.
Cream butter and sugar mixture.
Beat eggs and then add to butter and sugar mixture.
Using electric mixer, add flour and milk intermittently to butter, eggs and sugar mixture.
Flour should be added as the very last ingredient.
Then add vanilla to the mixture.
Flour and grease round tube pan.
Bake cake to golden brown, about 2 hours.
One cup floured nuts and 1 cup floured raisins may be added to mixture as last ingredients if desired.

title: Beef Hash
steps: Brown beef and onion in large skillet over medium heat (8 to 10 minutes).
Pour off drippings.
Stir in potatoes, salt and pepper.
Increase heat to medium-high and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in salsa.
Continue cooking 8 to 10 minutes or until potatoes are lightly browned.
Stir occasionally.
Garnish with green onions and olive slices.
Serves 4.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms With Pasta

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.raw: pinch of chopped parsley or scallions

steps: Rinse, drain and slice mushrooms thickly.
Heat large pan and then add olive oil.
Add pressed or chopped garlic to hot oil and (before garlic starts to brown) add mushrooms and stir.
Let cook for 5 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Splash with sherry and stir for another minute or so.
Spoon onto cooked pasta (fettucini works well) and garnish with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley or scallions.

title: Fruit Cole Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage, peel and section orange, slice celery, core and chop apple and cut grapes in half.
Combine above (except apple and yogurt) in large bowl.
Cover; chill in fridge.

title: Mawmaw'S Pineapple Upside-Down Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple ring or
ingredients.raw: 1 can pineapple, crushed, rings or chunks

steps: Melt butter in iron skillet on stove.
Add sugar and pineapple into skillet.
Add cake mix on top and pat down.
Bake until done.

title: Microwave Ruby Red Strawberry Pie

ingredients.name: strawberry thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, sliced strawberries, thawed

ingredients.name: strawberry and hulled
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. fresh strawberries, washed and hulled

steps: Combine sugar, cornstarch and water in a large glass mixing bowl until smooth. Stir in frozen strawberries and juice. Microwave for 2 minutes on High. Stir and continue cooking for 2 to 5 minutes on High or until thickened.
Cool.
Fold whole strawberries into glaze mixture.
Pour into baked pastry shell. Chill. Serve with whipped cream.
Makes a 9-inch pie.

title: Cabbage Beef(Low-Fat)

ingredients.name: chili bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can chili beans or kidney beans

steps: Cook ground beef and drain well in colander.
Spray hot water over beef to get all fat off.
Combine cabbage, beans and tomato juice and add salt, pepper and chili powder to taste.
Simmer until cabbage is well done.

title: Graham Muffins
steps: Mix altogether by hand.
Bake in a 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: No-Bake Cracker Bars
steps: Grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Layer the bottom of the pan with Club crackers.

title: Ham And Cheese Casserole
steps: Saute onions and celery in butter in large skillet until soft. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients.
Line baking dish with heavy-duty foil.
Grease foil generously.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown and firm in center.

title: Spaghetti Pizza
steps: Cook the spaghetti noodles, drain and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together the egg, milk and Parmesan cheese (amount as desired).
Add to spaghetti noodles.
Brown the hamburger meat. Drain grease and add celery and onion, if desired.
Put on top of spaghetti noodles.
Pour a jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce on top of hamburger.
Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake long enough to melt cheese.

title: Indian Style Chai
steps: Bring water and ginger to a boil.
Warm milk, but don't scald.
Add tea and vanilla and boil 1 minute.
Add brown sugar and cinnamon; boil 3 more minutes.
Drain tea and add warm
milk.

title: Orange-Graham Pie
steps: Prepare the 2 graham cracker crusts.
Combine in saucepan and bring to a boil while stirring:
egg, sugar and pineapple juice. Add and stir in until dissolved orange jello.
Chill until syrupy (quicker to use freezer).
Whip until stiff and thick the evaporated milk (best to chill milk, bowl and beaters).
Fold in jello mixture.
Pour into graham crusts.
Chill until firm.
Slice and serve.

title: Batter Bread Recipe
steps: Mix together 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a large bowl.
Add butter.
Gradually add water to dry ingredients; beat for 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer.
Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour; beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Stir enough remaining flour in to make soft dough.
Cover; let rise until doubled, about 35 minutes.
Stir down.
Turn into 2 well-greased 1 1/2-quart casseroles.

title: Squash Relish
steps: Combine
all
ingredients
and	mix
well.
Let stand 1 hour. Bring to a boil and boil for 15 minutes.
Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Trilby(Greek)
steps: Mix
together
and roll out thin.
Cut out with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 375° for 5 minutes.

title: Great Grandmother'S Pound Cake

ingredients.name: pet milk add water make c.
ingredients.raw: 1 small can Pet milk, add water to make 1 c.

steps: Cream the butter, oil, sugar and salt.
Beat in the eggs, one at a time.
Add flour and milk in small quanities (alternate, flour, milk, flour, milk, etc.; end with flour).
Fold flavoring in by hand.
Grease the baking pan, then dust it with flour. Place cake in a cold oven, then bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Do not open oven door while cake is baking!
Remove from pan at once.

title: Bonanza Chicken
steps: Brown chicken.
Combine soup, sour cream, mushrooms and sherry.
Pour over chicken in baking pan.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake covered at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sonrise Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch original dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original dressing mix (the one that requires milk)

ingredients.name: processed beef from the dairy section
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. processed beef from the dairy section

steps: Mix cream cheese and chopped olives together with electric mixer or food processor.
Sprinkle dry dressing mix to taste, 1/2 package to entire package.
Chop beef into tiny squares, saving a few slices for garnish.
Mix the chopped beef with other ingredients.
Form into a ball.
Cut saved beef into 1-inch squares and cover the cheese ball like a patchwork quilt to keep moist.

title: Blueberry Glaze
steps: Mix together; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Cook until thick and clear.
Cool and serve on cheese cake.

title: Autumn Fruit Salad
steps: In a saucepan, combine sugar and flour.
Stir in water; bring to a boil.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla.
Cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine apples, grapes, celery and walnuts.
Add the dressing and toss lightly.
Refrigerate until serving.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Polish Kolaches

ingredients.name: or c. flour mix dough
ingredients.raw: 6 or 7 c. flour to mix dough

steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Let rise.
Fill with cooked prunes or peaches.
Bake in 350° to 400° oven for 15 minutes or until light brown and done.

title: Blueberry Jello
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water.
Add 1 1/4 cups liquid including berry juice.
Let chill until partially set.
Mix together sour cream and berries.
Add to chilled Jell-O.
Return to refrigerator.
Before serving, top with whipped cream or not.

title: Chocolate Mound Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine
ingredients.raw: Duncan Hines or Pillsbury chocolate cake mix

steps: Mix together sugar, milk, marshmallows, coconut and vanilla. Bake cake as directed in 9 x 13 cake pan.
While cake is warm, pour mixture over the cake after melting and boiling it for 1 minute at a full boil.

title: Quick Salmon Pate
steps: Drain salmon and reserve juice.
Whirl salmon, cream cheese, green onions and pepper in a food processor fitted with metal blade.
Add liquid smoke and about 1 teaspoon of reserved juice. Keep refrigerated.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 1 cup.

title: Aunt Carole'S Meringue Dessert

ingredients.name: lemon pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. lemon pudding and pie filling

steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add cream of tartar.
Gradually add 1 cup sugar.
Spread meringue in pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Coconut Balls
steps: In large bowl combine coconut, sweetened condensed milk and melted butter.
Set aside in a cool dry area for 2 to 3 hours. Then add confectioners sugar and knead mixture to well mixed. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on baking sheets lined with wax paper.
Freeze until firm.
Once frozen these can be dropped into Ziploc storage bags to dip at a later time.
When ready to dip, melt together chocolate pieces and Crisco in top of double boiler. Dip tops of frozen balls in warm chocolate mixture (chocolate will set immediately.)
Store in cool place.
Makes 8 dozen pieces.

title: Jan Hagel(Swedish Cookie)
steps: Cream together the margarine, sugar and egg yolk.
Add flour and cinnamon.
Pat into jelly roll pan.
Beat the egg white with 1 teaspoon water until fluffy; brush on dough.
Sprinkle with nuts. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Microwave Cherry Crisp

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c butter or margarine, cold and cut into small pieces

steps: Spoon pie filling into greased 9 inch microwave-safe pie plate. Combine brown sugar, oats and flour in a bowl; cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Sprinkle over filling.
Microwave on high for 12-14 minutes.
Serve warm with ice cream if desired.
Serves 4.

title: Nut Snacker Spread
steps: Toast almonds in oven at 200° for 30 minutes.
Combine softened cream cheese and mayo.
Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients. Chill overnight.
Form spread into desired shapes.
Cover with almonds.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Pecan Cracker Short Cake
steps: Beat eggs stiffly.
Beat in sugar and add remaining ingredients.
Spread into two greased pie pans.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Lillian'S Salmon Soup
steps: Saute onion in butter until transparent, not brown. Add all flour and enough milk to blend. Add salmon and mix.
Add the rest of the milk.
Allow to thicken.
Do not allow to boil. Add oyster crackers.
Serve immediately.

title: Chewy Chocolate Nut Cookies

ingredients.name: macadamia nut coarse
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) jar Macadamia nuts, chopped coarse

steps: Beat butter, egg, sugars and vanilla at medium-high speed until fluffy.
Add flour, beating on low speed until just mixed. Add nuts and chips.
Chill 1 hour.
Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 325° for 13 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Smoked Salmon Spread(Low-Fat)
steps: Place all ingredients in food processor and blend to smooth spreading consistency.
Smoke your own salmon to reduce the cost of this recipe.
Makes 8 ounces of spread.

title: Creamy Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage very fine.
Slice onion very fine and separate rings.
Toss these two together.
Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle sugar over mixture.
Combine mayonnaise and vinegar. Pour over cabbage and onion.
Toss.
Chill.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Squash Cheese Souffle

ingredients.name: yellow squash and
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 yellow squash, cooked and sliced

steps: Heat milk; pour over bread crumbs.
Add next 4 ingredients; mix well.
Stir in squash and cheese.
Bake until firm in greased 2-quart casserole at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti And Cheese

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese regular
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese, regular or hot

ingredients.name: spaghetti and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (12 or 16 oz.) spaghetti, cooked and drained

steps: Boil spaghetti until cheese is cooked.
Melt Velveeta cheese in 1 cup milk.
Blend mixture of cheese and milk and well drained spaghetti together.
Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle American cheese on top and bake at 350° until the cheese becomes brown.
Serve hot.

title: Stuffed Jalapeno Peppers

ingredients.name: pickled jalapeno pepper and
ingredients.raw: pickled jalapeno peppers, halved and seeded

steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise and Cheddar cheese in a bowl.
Fill jalapeno pepper halves with mixture. Keep refrigerated until served.

title: Camper'S Pancake Mix
steps: If thinner pancakes are wanted, add a little more water.
This is great to take when camping.

title: Snappy Turtles
steps: Grease
cookie
sheet.
Arrange
pecan halves on cookie sheet, flat side down, in groups of four to resemble the shape of a turtle.
Place 1 caramel candy in center of pecan group. Bake at 325° until caramel melts (5 to 8 minutes).
They need to be just soft.
Flatten with buttered spatula.
Cool.
Frost with melted chocolate.
Makes 24 turtles.

title: Tuna Burritos
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, water, butter and salt to make the dough.
Knead the dough into a soft mass.
Form the mass like a Mexican tortilla.
For each made-up tortilla, add some tuna; fold them in half and, with a fork, pinch the edges to tighten.
Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Creamy Garlic Clam Sauce
steps: Melt butter in saucepan; add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in broth and milk, stirring until sauce boils and thickens.
Add parsley, salt and pepper to taste and Parmesan cheese.
Drain 1 can chopped clams; add to mixture and cook 1 more minute.

title: White Sauce(Salsa Balsamella)
steps: In saucepan, melt
butter.
When
butter foams, stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Cook and stir 2 minutes until mixture bubbles. Add milk all at once.
Stir constantly while mixture thickens. Makes 2 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Lebanese Rice
steps: Boil chicken until tender with some onion and celery.
Take chicken off bone; strain broth (keep broth boiling).
Soak rice in enough water to cover while deboning chicken.

title: Cheese Ring With Strawberry Jam
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in food processor until smooth. Press into 6 cup mold lined with plastic wrap that overhangs sides (to lift out).
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Unmold onto serving tray.
Fill center with strawberry jam.
Arrange Triscuits around ring.
Makes approximately 50 servings.

title: German Apples And Cabbage
steps: Core and slice apples and cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Lower heat, cover and simmer until cabbage is tender, a little more than half an hour.

title: Peanut Patties
steps: Combine ingredients in large saucepan.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Bring to boil.
Cook over medium heat to firm ball stage.
Remove from heat and add 2 tablespoons butter or margarine and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Cool slightly and then beat until thickens.
Drop on wax paper.

title: Miniature Ham Loaves

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. plus 2 Tbsp. brown sugar, packed

steps: In a bowl, combine eggs, milk and cracker crumbs.
Mix well. Add ham and sausage.
Shape 1/3 cupfuls into individual loaves. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish.	Combine the tomato soup, brown sugar, vinegar and mustard.
Mix well and pour over loaves.
Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes, basting every 30 minutes. You can use 1/2 cup mixture instead of 1/3, but I like the smaller loaves.

title: Blueberry-Banana Pie
steps: Cook juice with sugar, flour and lemon.
Cool, then carefully add blueberries.
Pour in a baked, cooled pie crust.
Slice bananas over the top.
Serve with whipped cream and a red cherry.

title: Half Pound Cake

ingredients.name: shortening
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shortening or butter or margarine

steps: Option:
Omit lemon flavoring and add 1 cup nuts.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
steps: Cut tomatoes and onions (tomatoes in quarters and slice onions).
Sprinkle 1 cup salt over this and let stand 1/2 day. Heat mixture of vinegar, sugar and bag of spices.
Drain onions and tomatoes.
Add onions, tomatoes and peppers to hot mixture and cook until tomatoes change color, about 10 minutes.
Do not cook until tomatoes are soggy.
Pack in jars and seal.
Use hot pepper according to how hot you like.

title: Potatoes Royale

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 10 oz. can cream of chicken soup

steps: Mix together the soup, sour cream, onions, cheese, salt, pepper and
bacon.
Add the hash browns.
Place in a 13x9 baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350°for 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
steps: Mix all ingredients well and make meatballs.
Put in large casserole dish.
Pour Sauce Mix over meatballs and cook for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Butterscotch Nut Bars
steps: Mix as for pie crust.
Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Pizza

ingredients.name: envelope lipton vegetable recipe soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton vegetable recipe soup mix

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Onto lightly oiled pizza pan, press dough to form crust.
In a small bowl, blend soup mix, oil, basil, garlic and pepper.
Spread evenly on dough. Top with remaining ingredients. Bake 20 minutes until crust is golden brown. Cut into wedges.

title: Fried Salmon Cakes
steps: Mix ingredients (leave liquid on salmon).
Make patties.
Fry in oil until golden brown over medium-low heat.

title: Oven Baked Stroganoff
steps: In 2-quart covered casserole, stir soups. Add beef. Cover and bake at 325° for 3 hours.
Cook noodles according to package. Before serving, add sour cream.
Serve over noodles.

title: Cabbage Dressing
steps: Put all ingredients into a blender and mix well or whip until sugar is all dissolved.
Pour into a jar.
Keeps in refrigerator for weeks.
Use on cole slaw, or may be used on a tossed (lettuce) salad.

title: Pig Eating Cake
steps: Mix and bake in 3 layers at 350°.
Cool completely.

title: Tuna Fish Casserole
steps: Cook cream of mushroom soup as directed.
Cook egg noodles until done.
Spread tuna fish over bottom of medium casserole dish; add noodles, then cream of mushroom soup.
Mix all together. Bake in oven for 15 minutes at 325°.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese and cook an additional 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Doyle'S Delight
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
In Bundt pan, layer 12 frozen rolls, half of dry mix, then 12 frozen rolls and then remaining dry mix.
Pour oleo (melted) over all.
Cover with moist cloth overnight.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn Dish

ingredients.name: cracker crumb
ingredients.raw: crackers crumbs (1 1/2 rolls; save some for top)

steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Pour into a buttered baking dish.
Sprinkle some cracker crumbs on top.
Dot with butter.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Broccoli Cheese Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients and pour into greased pan.
Bake in 350° oven until brown.
This will be approximately 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Peanut Crunch
steps: Melt chocolate and peanut butter chips in a double boiler over hot water.
Remove from heat.
Stir in noodles and peanuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let stand 20 minutes.
(Makes about 36.)

title: Beef And Pepper Rice Skillet

ingredients.name: steak in
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut in thin strips or 1 to 1 1/2 lb. ground beef

steps: Brown meat in oil; add onion, rice, beef broth, water and soy sauce.
Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Cover and cook low, until liquid is absorbed (about 25 minutes).
Add green pepper and pimento.
Heat through.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Carrot Sandwiches(Appetizer)
steps: In mixer, cream the cheese and add grated carrots, onion juice, salt, pepper and enough mayonnaise to moisten.
Add pecans. Trim bread.
Spread filling and roll like jelly roll.
(We rolled our bread prior to spreading filling.) Chill or freeze before slicing into 1/2-inch slices.
Freezes well.

title: Broiled Fish A La Acapulco
steps: Prepare fish, marinate in remaining ingredients for 30 minutes.
Place on a greased sizzle platter.
Brush with melted butter.
Broil until done (do not turn).
Remove to plate, keep warm.
Place platter on burner.
Add marinade and reduce juices by 1/2.
Return fish to hot platter and baste with juices.
Serve.

title: Vegetable Salad
steps: Cut up cauliflower and broccoli.
Slice onions and celery. Add frozen peas.
Mix together mayo, sour cream and Ranch dressing.
Pour over veggies and stir well.
Refrigerate for 4 hours.

title: Beef With Red Wine Marinade

ingredients.name: top steak
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 1/2 lb.) top round steak or London broil

steps: Place steak in a shallow dish or zip top heavy-duty plastic bag.
Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Stir well. Pour marinade over steak. Cover or seal and chill 8 hours, turning occasionally. Remove steak from marinade.
Grill over medium (300° to 400°) coals for 7 to 9 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness.
To serve, slice grilled steak across the grain into thin slices.
Yields about 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry(Time:  About 45 Minutes Before Serving)
steps: Cut carrots and celery into 3 inch long matchstick thin strips.
Slice onion thin.
Cut broccoli into 2 x 1/2-inch pieces. Cut mushrooms into quarters or cut in half if small.
In 5-quart Dutch oven or 12-inch skillet over high heat, in hot salad oil, cook carrots, celery, onion and broccoli, stirring quickly and frequently, about 3 or 4 minutes.
Add mushrooms, water, salt and sugar; cover and cook 5 or 6 minutes longer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Contains 95 calories per serving.
Yield: 8 servings.

title: 1-2-3-3-4 Mayonnaise Biscuits
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Mix milk and mayonnaise.
Mix both together until just blended.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly floured cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Don't overbake!
Can be made larger, but the smaller the better, I think.

title: Mousse Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Put remaining ingredients in blender, then mold.

title: Little Red Hen'S Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in the warm water.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased bowl; let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Punch dough down and put into greased 9-inch pie dish.
Let rise 1 hour.
Melt butter and pour over dough.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Hamburger
steps: Mix ground beef, eggs, salt, nutmeg, onion, cinnamon, bread crumbs, garlic salt and water.
Mix well, then form into round ball.
Roll ball in cracker meat into a shape like a hot dog. Brown in a little oil, then put into tomato juice and simmer for 1 hour.
(I use Ragu sauce.)
To serve, put into hot roll.

title: Chocolate Gravy(For Kids 2 To 92)
steps: Mix dry ingredients in skillet.
Add milk slowly and stir until gravy is thick.
Serve over fresh bread.

title: Ann'S Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 chicken breasts (without the bone or you can use the frozen chicken, honey mustard from Sams)

steps: If you use the fresh chicken, cook it for about 45 minutes in the oven or grill.
Place chicken breasts in a deep baking dish, then add the cream of chicken soup mixed with the water.
Cook peppers and onions in a small amount of butter until tender, then spread over the chicken. Add the mushrooms.
Sprinkle with the Mozzarella cheese. Bake, covered with foil, for about 1 hour at 375° to 400°.

title: Macaroni-Ham Salad

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced cucumber or 1 bell pepper, chopped

steps: Combine ingredients; toss together until blended.
Serve with sliced tomatoes and crackers.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hash Brown Breakfast Casserole
steps: Mix together soups, sour cream, onions and cheese.
Melt butter and pour on top.
Bake for 1 hour and take out and sprinkle corn flakes over top slow and bake for 15 minutes longer.
(Corn flakes, optional.)

title: Feather Bed Rolls

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: 5 c. flour or enough to make a moderately stiff dough

steps: Melt shortening into milk while milk is hot.
Dissolve yeast into water and add to cooled milk.
Add sugar, salt and eggs; mix well.
Add flour one cup at a time and knead until dough is stiff and elastic.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Roll out and cut into desired shape.
Cover and let rise until double in size.
Bake at 400° until golden brown.

title: Tequila Berry Salad

ingredients.name: low calorie hidden valley ranch dressing made with mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. low-calorie Hidden Valley Ranch dressing, made with mayonnaise

steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Just before serving, add remaining ingredients.

title: Crispy French Fried Mushrooms

ingredients.name: corn chex cereal
ingredients.raw: 5 c. Corn Chex cereal, crushed or bread crumbs or corn flakes, crushed

steps: Thoroughly mix flour, salt, baking powder and pepper.
Beat egg yolk and mix together.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Beat egg white until foamy.
Add sugar.
Beat until stiff but not dry. Fold into milk mixture.
Dip mushrooms in batter.
Drain.
Roll in Chex crumbs.
Drop a few at a time into deep hot (385°) fat.
Fry until golden brown (1 or 2 minutes), turning once.
Makes 18 to 20 appetizers.

title: Katie'S Biscuits
steps: Mix together in bowl and knead.
Mix well.
Turn out on well floured board.
Roll out to about 1/2-inch thick.
Cut with 3 1/2-inch cutter.
Brush on melted butter.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Gregg'S Barbecue Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in pan and heat over low heat for about 1 hour.
Add Cajun spices if not hot enough.
Dip meat in sauce after cooking a few minutes.
Baste after cooking with more sauce.

title: Russian Dressing(Salad Dressing)
steps: Chop parsley and pickle very fine.
Add ketchup; stir and add mayonnaise.
Blend thoroughly.
Keep covered in refrigerator. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Turkey And Dressing

ingredients.name: smoked turkey
ingredients.raw: 1 box smoked turkey slices (2 boxes for bigger casserole)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup dilute with amount of water
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom soup, dilute with small amount of water

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. butter or margarine (may use more or less depending on preference)

steps: Saute onion and celery in butter. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Cut turkey slices in half. Lightly grease 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, arrange in dish alternating stuffing/turkey slices.
May use double 1/2 slices if desired, stands up better.
Dilute mushroom soup with 1/4 to 1/2 cup milk and pour over top of casserole.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Enchilada Casserole
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch dish, mix together.
Crush a bag of Doritos in bottom of a pan.
Pour mixture over Doritos.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake in 325° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Pie

ingredients.name: angel flake coconut
ingredients.raw: 1 can Angel Flake coconut or 1 c. frozen coconut

steps: Mix lemon juice and condensed milk and stir until very thick. Add Cool Whip and mix well.
Then add remaining ingredients.
Pour into pie crusts and chill thoroughly.
This makes 2 large pies, each serving about 6.
Freezes well also.
Serves 12.
