title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Quickie

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of mushroom soup (10 1/2 oz.)

ingredients.name: cheez whiz
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. Cheez Whiz or grated cheese

ingredients.name: french fried onion ring
ingredients.raw: 1 can French fried onion rings (2.8 oz.)

steps: Layer vegetables that have been thawed and drained.
Mix soup and cheese.
Pour mixture over vegetables.
Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for approximately 10 to 15 minutes on High. Add onion rings and microwave an additional 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Crab-Filled Phyllo Bites

ingredients.name: crabmeat flaked and cartilage removed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can crabmeat, drained, flaked and cartilage removed

ingredients.name: wheat wafer
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. crushed shredded wheat wafers (6 crackers)

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and and
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: sheet phyllo dough thawed
ingredients.raw: 6 sheets frozen phyllo dough (16 x 13-inch), thawed

steps: For filling:
In a medium mixing bowl, combine crab, cheese, mushrooms, crushed wafers, parsley, onion powder and pepper. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the butter.
Toss to mix.
Set aside. Unfold phyllo; spread one of the sheets flat.
Brush with butter. Top with another sheet.
(Cover remaining phyllo sheets with a damp towel or Saran Wrap while working.)
Cut stack of buttered phyllo lengthwise into fourths and crosswise into fifths.
You will have 20 (3 1/4-inch) squares.

title: Mango Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into large pastry-lined pie pan. Cover with top crust.
Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Butter Crisp Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix together sugars, shortening, eggs (one at a time) and vanilla.
Add rest of ingredients.
Spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Corn
steps: Put in 2 (9 x 13-inch) cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour; stir often.
Cool, package and freeze.
I quarter this and use immediately for eating.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
steps: Beat eggs until light.
Gradually add sugar.
Blend thoroughly.
Fold in sifted dry ingredients.
Heat milk and butter.
Fold in the hot milk, butter and flavoring.
Bake in greased and floured 9-inch layer cake pans in a 400° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Also bakes well in a tube pan.

title: Baker'S Dough Clay
steps: Mix 1 cup of flour with 1 cup of salt in a large mixing bowl. Add water, a little at a time, until it feels like clay.
You can also add food coloring to the dough.
After you have formed the clay, bake it in the oven at 200°.
Check it every 5 minutes until it is hard.
You can paint it if you have not colored it.
Enjoy!

title: Harvest Cake
steps: Blend together with wooden spoon the eggs, sugar and oil until oil is blended.
Sift flour, soda, cinnamon and salt.
Stir with spoon into egg mixture.
Do not overbeat.
Fold in diced apples and nuts.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan lightly.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until cake leaves side of pan.
When cold, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Lincoln'S Mother'S Stew

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. chili powder or to taste

steps: Brown the beef, then add onions, cabbage and celery; cook for 1/2 hour.
Add remaining ingredients and cook for 20 minutes. (May also be put in crock-pot.)

title: Golden Beef Casserole

ingredients.name: niblet kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 can Niblets whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Brown beef, onion and green pepper in small amount of shortening in heavy skillet.
Mix in remaining ingredients. Spoon into a 1 3/4-quart greased casserole dish.
Bake in oven at 350° for about 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: French Pancakes
steps: Heat together in saucepan the milk and butter.
When slightly cooled, beat in the eggs, flour, baking powder and salt; beat until smooth.
Melt a little butter in skillet; do not burn.
Pour in batter; tilt skillet slightly to cover bottom evenly.
Cook for 1 minute.
Loosen with spatula; flip and cook other side.
Makes 6 good size French Pancakes.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding(Yields 32 Four-Ounce Portions)
steps: In a heavy-gauge pot, over moderate heat, combine rice, sugar and milk.
Cook until rice is tender, approximately 45 minutes. When rice is cooked, remove pot from stove and gradually incorporate eggs.
Return to heat and cook thoroughly.
Add vanilla and pour into Bain Marie.
Chill overnight.

title: Strawberry-Pineapple Jello
steps: Cook jello, strawberries and pineapple with water in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Pour 1/2 of this mixture into glass dish or bowl.
Chill until firm.
Spread sour cream on top of set jello.
Carefully spoon remaining 1/2 of mixture on top of the sour cream.
Chill until set.

title: Shrimp And Tomato Salad
steps: In a large creamer, mix olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice and parsley, set aside for flavors to blend.
Remove shrimp from freezer.
Place in colander and rinse.
Rinse tomatoes and lettuce.
Tear off bottom of lettuce leaves and discard.
Place two whole lettuce leaves per salad plate.
Cut off tops and bottoms of slicer tomatoes, cut into three flat rounds.
Place three tomato rounds per plate on top of lettuce.
Next, divide shrimp into sixths.
Place on top of tomatoes.
Stir dressing and pour equal amounts onto each salad.
Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Cabbage
steps: Slice very fine the red cabbage into saucepan.
Add the sugar, bacon fat, vinegar, salt, pepper and ground cloves.
Simmer for at least 1 hour.
You'll find that it improves with longer cooking.

title: Greek Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: envelope good season lemon and herb
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Good Seasons lemon and herbs or Italian salad dressing mix

steps: Combine lemon juice, water and salad dressing mix in cruet or jar.
Shake well.
Add olive oil, Feta cheese and oregano.
Shake well.
Makes 1 cup.

title: Sausage-Hamburg Casserole

ingredients.name: any type egg noodle
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. any type egg noodles

steps: Cook ground beef and sausage with oregano until done; drain. Add Cheddar cheese soup and tomato soup; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook package of egg noodles.
Pour all into large casserole dish and mix thoroughly.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese over top.
Bake 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Butter Herb Baked Fish(Shared By Larry Sherman)
steps: Combine crackers, cheese and spices.
Dip fish in butter, then cracker mixture.
Bake in Pyrex dish for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Orange Buttermilk Molded Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple in syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple in syrup

ingredients.name: carton whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: In large saucepan, bring pineapple and syrup to boil.
Remove from heat and stir in gelatin.
Cool to room temperature.
Stir in buttermilk; fold in whipped topping and pecans.
Pour into 8-cup molds.
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Deluxe Macaroni Cheese

ingredients.name: elbow macaroni and
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained

steps: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well.
Stir in cheese.
Add cooked macaroni.
Mix well.
Pour into greased 9-inch square baking dish.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Italian Butter Nut Balls
steps: Mix butter, sugar and egg yolks.
Add flour, baking powder and lemon.
When done, form small balls.
Dip in egg whites which have been slightly beaten.
Then roll in ground nuts.
Press cherry on top.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Beans And Sprouts(5 Servings)

ingredients.name: green bean trim and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. green beans (fresh), trim and cut into long strips

ingredients.name: white vinegar and soy sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. white vinegar and soy sauce

steps: Steam or boil green beans and bean sprouts until just tender. Saute onions in oil until golden; add remaining ingredients and bean sprouts cooking liquid.
Heat, then add beans and sprouts. Stir to mix and heat through.
Serve.
Save liquid.

title: Chili Dog Pie

ingredients.name: chili
ingredients.raw: 2 cans chili or 4 c. homemade chili

steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Press biscuits in buttered pan.
Blend all other ingredients well.
Pour into pan.
Pour on top cheese. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Five Crust Pie Crust
steps: In a small bowl mix until smooth the flour, water and salt. Set aside.
In a larger bowl, mix until fine the flour and shortening.
Add paste.
Mix until smooth.
Make into a ball. Cover completely with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate.

title: Lemon Basil Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 375°. Mix salad dressing, juice, honey and basil. Place chicken in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread with dressing mixture. Bake 45 minutes or until done.
Serves 4.

title: Chicken Jewel

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke heart
ingredients.raw: 2 jars chopped marinated artichoke hearts (reserve liquid)

steps: Arrange chicken in a well greased casserole dish.
Top with mushrooms and artichokes evenly.
Pour artichoke marinade over all ingredients.
Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Potato Latkes(Pancakes)
steps: Mix potatoes, onions, eggs, flour, salt and pepper.
Heat oil until it sizzles.
Drop in heaping tablespoonfuls of batter and flatten each latke a little.
Turn and fry both sides until brown. Drain on paper towels.
Serve with applesauce or sour cream.

title: Veggie Potato Melt
steps: Pierce potatoes; place on a paper towel.
Microwave until tender.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Combine other ingredients and microwave on High until tender (2 to 3 minutes).
Split potatoes and fill with vegetable mixture.
You may top with cheese or butter.
Microwave another 30 seconds to melt the topping.

title: Barbara Simon'S Chicken With Cranberries

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 to 3 1/2 lb.) chicken or boneless breasts

ingredients.name: and yellow onion
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. peeled and chopped yellow onions

steps: Cut up chicken; pat dry with paper towels.
Mix flour with salt and pepper and dredge each piece of chicken.
Pan-fry in peanut oil just until brown, turning once.
In the meantime, mix remaining ingredients in a stainless steel saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour this over the chicken and cover.
Cook slowly for 35 to 40 minutes or until chicken is very tender.

title: Surprise Middle Cupcakes
steps: Mix cake as directed on package.
Beat together above ingredients except chocolate chips.
Stir in chips.
Drop heaping tablespoonful of cake mix into cupcake paper holders, then add 1 teaspoon filling.
Top with 1 tablespoon cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Recipe For Baby Wipes(Saves $$$)
steps: Combine water, oil and shampoo.
Cut one roll of Bounty paper towels in half (with electric knife of very sharp knife).
Put cut side down in old baby wipe container.
Pull out tube from middle, then start first towel.
Pour liquid over evenly and let set 24 hours before using.

title: New Orleans Green Rice
steps: Cook rice
according to package directions, but add bay leaf to the
cooking
water.
When
done
remove the bay leaf. Saute green onion, white	onion, parsley and celery in butter, in a large frying
pan;	cook
slightly so celery stays crisp. Add cooked rice and blend together.
Serves 6.

title: Cheese Wafers

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened (1/2 stick)

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. extra sharp Cheddar cheese, grated (about 4 oz.)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a mixing bowl, combine the butter and cheese with a fork, then blend in the flour and cayenne pepper.
Roll the mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place on a buttered baking pan and flatten until about 1/4-inch thick.
Bake, uncovered, for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Makes 12 wafers.

title: Chicken Lush
steps: Mix with fork.
Put in casserole.
Place in a 325° oven for 35 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oven Popcorn
steps: Don't forget the soda.
Stir.
Pour over popped corn gradually and stir and stir.
Put in 250° oven for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Apple Smile Snacks
steps: Cut apple into eighths.
Remove seeds.
Place one eighth flat on its side on a plate.
This is the bottom "lip." Have your child spread peanut butter on the apple for the tongue.
Place 2 or 3 marshmallows on for "teeth."
Then place another eighth on top for the top "lip."
The red peeling side is the lips.

title: Scandinavian Fish Dinner

ingredients.name: sole fillet thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen sole fillets, thawed

steps: About 1 hour before serving, in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat in 1-inch of boiling water, heat potatoes to boiling.
Cover and cook 20 minutes or until tender; drain.

title: Chicken Breasts And Chipped Beef
steps: Now, this is my very favorite and it can cook slowly while you entertain your company.
Great for Sunday night supper served with salad, whole string beans, rolls and butter and spiced peaches. So rich that no starch is needed.
Add Irish coffee for dessert and you've got something!
Can be made day ahead.

title: Chocolate Coconut Dream

ingredients.name: equal
ingredients.raw: 5 pkg. Equal (do not use the spoonable kind)

steps: Heat butter and chocolate until the chocolate is just melted; do not cook too long (double boiler is best).
Pour in small bowl; mix well.
Add in heavy cream, vanilla and Equal; stir until mixture looks creamy and smooth.
Add in coconut, once again; mix well.
Place almonds on a plate with space between them.
Put a spoonful of the chocolate mixture on top of each almond.
Chill until able to pick up with your fingers.
Store in the refrigerator.

title: Beer Batter(Fish, Poultry, Etc.)

ingredients.name: dry mustard
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. dry mustard or regular mustard

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper or red pepper

ingredients.name: beer
ingredients.raw: 1 c. beer (flat and at room temperature)

steps: Stir together dry ingredients.
Carefully combine egg and beer. Slowly stir into dry ingredients.
Dip pieces of meat or onion rings into batter and fry in deep shortening.

title: Herb Chicken
steps: In roaster pan, bake breast 15 minutes.
Cover chicken with thyme, rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper.
Add potatoes, carrots and onions.
Cover with water.
Bake at 350° until vegetables are cooked.

title: Tuna Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: seasoned fine dry bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. seasoned fine dry bread crumbs

steps: Preheat oven at 350°.
Cut precooked potatoes in 1/4-inch slices.
Arrange half of the potatoes in a greased shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.
Cover with tuna, then with remaining potato slices.
Beat eggs, milk and cheese together, then pour over potatoes, sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake for 45 minutes or until custard is set and potatoes are golden brown.
Makes 6 servings.

title: 20-Minute Apple Butter
steps: Combine all ingredients and cook for 20 minutes.
Put into jars and seal.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits(Just Like Red Lobster'S)

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. garlic powder (depending on taste)

steps: Mix ingredients until a soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Brush hot biscuits with mixture of 3 tablespoons butter, melted, with 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder.
Serve warm.
Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Chicken Breasts Italiano(Microwave)
steps: In 9 x 13-inch glass, combine margarine and onion.
Cook on High for 4 minutes.
Add chicken and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.

title: Apple Pecan Muffins

ingredients.name: pecan
ingredients.raw: 1 c. chopped pecans (walnuts may be substituted)

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: water (enough to make a soft dough)

steps: To standard muffin mix, add apple pie filling (chop up the apple slices, but use all of the can contents, including the thickening, which makes the muffins moist), cinnamon and pecans. Mix with enough water to make a soft dough.
Divide into muffin tins.
Will make 12 extra-large muffins or 24 medium.
Bake at 375° until done.

title: Ripe Tomato Relish

ingredients.name: tomato skinned and fine
ingredients.raw: 6 to 7 lb. ripe tomatoes, skinned and chopped fine

steps: Put tomatoes, onions and peppers in a pan.
Pour salt over them and let set overnight.
Next day put in hot sterilized jars. Mix sugar, vinegar, mustard seed and red pepper.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes to an hour until it thickens.
Pour over vegetables in jars and seal with lids.
Makes 6 pints.

title: Super Salisbury Steaks

ingredients.name: mushroom stem and
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, chopped

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Shape into thick patties and broil.

title: Reuben Supper

ingredients.name: dark rye bread
ingredients.raw: 4 to 5 c. diced dark rye bread

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and layer each ingredient in order given, mixing salad dressing and mayonnaise together before spreading over sauerkraut.
Cover with foil.
Bake 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 15 minutes until cheese is melted and bread is toasty.

title: Cookie Fruit Cobbler

ingredients.name: refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough
ingredients.raw: 18 oz pkg refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease 9 x 13 pan.
Spoon filling into pan. Set aside.
Crumble cookie dough into med bowl.
Add oats, mix well.
Sprinkle over filling.
Bake 24 - 28 minutes or until top is golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spice Nuts
steps: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly; then add the water.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and nuts until mixture is coated.
Add sugar; pour on wax paper.
Then separate the nuts.

title: Corned Beef Hash(Great Easy Recipe)
steps: Fry potatoes (that have been salted and peppered) until cooked down.
Add onions and garlic.
Add corned beef; stir together.
Add 1 quart of water and simmer 1/2 hour or until potatoes are cooked. Add water, as needed.
Good with cornbread.

title: Pavlova(Australian Meringue Dessert)

ingredients.name: assorted fruit
ingredients.raw: assorted sliced fruits (kiwi, strawberries, raspberries, blueberries)

steps: Whip egg whites to soft peaks.
Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, whipping 5 to 10 minutes until firm peaks form.
Lower speed and fold in vinegar and cornstarch for 1 minute.
Grease pizza pan.
Cut brown paper to fit and grease that, also.
Mound and round edges with spatula, not coming near the edges.

title: Tuna Bunsteads
steps: Mix ingredients.
Fill 8 hamburger bun halves (a little of the bread in the center of the bun may be removed).
Place in deep pan; cover with foil.
Heat at 250° for 30 minutes.
Great for teenagers or all tuna lovers.

title: The Original Mexican Cornbread
steps: Combine all ingredients, except cheese.
Make sure sides and bottom of iron skillet are well-oiled.
Pour 1/2 mixture in hot skillet.
Add shredded cheese.
Pour other 1/2 on top of cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Vegy Snack
steps: Cut ham into squares.
Cut carotes in stripes.
Place with brokley on collieflower on micwave dish.
Shred cheese over ham and vegys.
Heat until cheese melts.

title: Eva'S Broccoli Bread
steps: Cook and drain broccoli well.
Add remaining ingredients with cornbread mix added last.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Dinner
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add green chilies, beans, tomato sauce and water.
Simmer 30 to 40 minutes.
Line bowl with tostados.
Add half of meat mixture, then layer of cheese, more meat and another layer of cheese.
Top with tostados.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Tart Sweet Potato Apple Bake
steps: Slice potatoes in 1/2-inch rounds.
Cook in a small amount of water until almost tender.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a shallow baking dish and make alternate layers of sweet potatoes and apple slices.
Sprinkle apple layers with lemon juice, sugar and cinnamon.
Dot with butter and pour water over all.
Bake 1 hour, or until potatoes are very tender.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chocolate Caramel Cake
steps: Mix cake mix according to package directions.
Pour half of mix into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes.
While cake is baking, in saucepan on low heat, melt caramels, butter and milk together.
Pour this mixture over cooked cake.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour remaining cake mix over top and bake for 20 minutes.
All baking is done at 350°.

title: Sawdust Modeling

ingredients.name: wheat paste
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. wheat paste or wallpaper paste

steps: Mix ingredients; add water gradually until a modeling consistency is reached.
Excellent for puppet heads, fruits, vegetables, masks, figures or animals.

title: Garlic Sticks

ingredients.name: corn chex cereal c.
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Corn Chex cereal, crushed to 3/4 c.

ingredients.name: plu tsp. butter
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. butter or margarine, melted

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine Chex, garlic powder and salt. Add 2 tablespoons butter; mix thoroughly.
Cut each biscuit in half.
Roll between palms of hands into sticks, 8 inches long. Brush with remaining butter.
Coat with Chex crumbs.
Place on baking sheet.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot.
Makes 20 sticks.

title: Pineapple Cake Filling
steps: Drain pineapple.
Save syrup.
Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan and boil.
Pour over egg whites.
Mix pineapple and spread on favorite cake layers.

title: *Screwball Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Mix together oil, vanilla, vinegar and cold water.
Add all at once to dry ingredients and blend together well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in an 8 x 8-inch cake pan or make 1 1/2 dozen cupcakes.
Serves 9.

title: Onion-Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: envelope onion
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope onion or onion-mushroom recipe soup mix

ingredients.name: all purpose potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. all-purpose potatoes, cut into large chunks

steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In a large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients.
Close bag and shake or toss in bowl, until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking pan. Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.

title: Indian Cookies
steps: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl, then mix together.
Make a well in middle of bowl.
Place eggs and water/milk gradually into well.
When mixing, include dry ingredients from sides.
Place flour on flat surface to roll out and cut-out round cookies.
Bake in 325° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 2 dozen.

title: German Red Cabbage Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients except cabbage and onions; pour over cabbage and onions; toss well.
Chill about 4 hours.

title: Rolled Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.raw: 1 jar dried beef (2 pieces per chicken breast)

steps: Roll each chicken breast.
Place 2 pieces of dried beef around each rolled chicken breast.
Wrap 1/2 piece uncooked bacon around each rolled chicken breast.
Place chicken rolls in baking dish. Mix mushroom soup with sour cream and pour over chicken rolls.
No salt or seasoning needed.
Bake, uncovered, for 3 hours at 250°.

title: Overnight Salad

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. shredded Parmesan or mild Cheddar cheese

steps: Layer the first 4 ingredients in a bowl; do not stir. Refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, top with the tomato, eggs and the mayonnaise, mixed with Parmesan or mild Cheddar cheese (spread over top).
When serving, reach spoon to bottom of bowl to get all layers.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Frosted Coffee Punch
steps: Dissolve instant coffee in hot water. Pour over ice cream in large punch bowl.
Add ice and rum flavoring.
Combine heavy cream, 1 tablespoon instant coffee and honey. Whip to soft peaks. Fold 1/2 whipped cream mixture into punch.
Top with remaining half.

title: Dinner In A Skillet
steps: Brown
beef,
onion and green pepper in margarine.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Clusters

ingredients.name: toasted pecan walnut
ingredients.raw: 2 c. toasted pecans, walnuts or peanuts

steps: Melt chocolate and peanut butter in microwave or double boiler, stir often to mix well.
Add remaining ingredients; stir with wooden spoon to coat evenly.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Yields 11 dozen.

title: Sweet And Sour Red Cabbage Salad
steps: Slice cabbage and onion thin, sprinkle with sugar.
Boil together vinegar, oil and spices.
Pour over cabbage and onion. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Mix and serve.

title: Texas Hot Dog Sauce
steps: Brown hamburg and onion in oil. Work hamburg with fork until fine. Add remaining ingredients. Salt and pepper.
Simmer no less than 2 hours.

title: Rice Pudding(Khees)
steps: Boil the whole milk; add the rice and let it cook on low fire until rice is soft.
Keep stirring in between.
When the rice is cooked, add cream, sugar, nuts and raisins.

title: Beef Roast With Cola
steps: Place roast in pan and add soup mix and cola.
Cover and seal tightly with foil over pan.
Roast at 300° until tender.

title: Old-Fashioned Bread Pudding
steps: Soak bread in milk in greased baking dish.
Combine eggs, sugar, salt and cinnamon and stir it into the bread mixture.
Add the raisins and set into a pan of water.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until the knife comes out clean.
Approximate yield:
6 portions.

title: Bar Cheese
steps: Melt cheese.
Add rest of ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into crock or dish with cover.
Serve with crackers.
Will keep in refrigerator up to 3 months.

title: Turkey And Stuffing Bake

ingredients.name: durkee french fried onion
ingredients.raw: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions

ingredients.name: condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: turkey and
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (7 oz.) turkey, cubed and cooked

steps: Combine butter and water; stir until butter melts.
Pour over seasoned stuffing crumbs; toss lightly.
Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions.
Spoon stuffing mixture into 9-inch shallow baking dish (1 1/2-quart).
Press stuffing across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell.
Combine soup, milk, turkey and peas; pour into stuffing shell.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: "Skordalia" Garlic Sauce
steps: Pound the garlic with the salt and walnuts until well blended and creamy.
If you like the taste of chopped nuts, just mix the chopped nuts with the salt and garlic, which you put through a garlic press.
Add the bread crumbs with oil, a little at a time, then the vinegar and finally the cold water.
Put enough water to make the mixture soft like a paste.

title: Cucumber Sandwich Spread
steps: Grind cucumber pulp.
Place on cheesecloth and squeeze out the juice.
Combine pulp with cream cheese, onion and seasonings, mixing thoroughly.
Add just enough food coloring to make spread pale green.

title: Cheesy Eggplant Grill

ingredients.name: salt pepper and oregano
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and oregano to taste

steps: Layer all ingredients, starting with eggplant and ending with Mozzarella.
Place in foil.
Make a ball of foil and close loosely on top, so it does not stick to cheese.
Bake on barbecue, lid down for 10 minutes.

title: Leftover Turkey Teaser
steps: Place turkey, soups, peas, carrots and chicken broth in large casserole dish.
Mix together oleo, broth and stuffing mix. Crumble on top of mixture in casserole dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes or bubbly.
Serves 6.

title: Nachos El Grande
steps: Spread each chip used with 1 teaspoon of refried beans. Sprinkle grated cheese over them evenly and top with jalapeno ring.
Bake in oven at 350° until cheese has completely melted. Serve and enjoy.

title: Vanilla Sauce

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.raw: nutmeg to taste (my family likes lots)

steps: Combine cornstarch and brown sugar well.
Add milk gradually, blending smooth.
Cook over medium-high heat until thick, stirring to prevent lumps.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, vanilla and nutmeg.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
steps: Mix butter, sugar and flour.
Make small balls; press with thumb.
Fill thumbprint with jam.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until light brown on edge.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Balls
steps: Rinse and chop sauerkraut.
Combine all ingredients.
Form into walnut size balls.
Roll in 1/2 cup bread crumbs.
Place on cookie sheet (ungreased or sprayed with Pam).
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Makes 3 to 5 dozen, depending upon size.

title: Swedish Deep-Dish Apple Pie
steps: Peel, core and slice apples.
Put apples into deep 2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon. In separate bowl, crumble together flour, sugar and butter. Sprinkle crumbled mixture onto apples.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Serve with ice cream or cheese.

title: Venison Steaks
steps: Mix flour, salt, pepper and Creole seasoning in one bowl. Break eggs into a bowl and add a small amount of milk.
Beat.
Cut the venison into serving sizes; flour them and then dip into the egg mixture.
Then flour again.
Fry in a pan with vegetable oil. After frying, place in a covered dish in the oven at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mom'S Candied Sweet Potatoes
steps: Peel and cut potatoes as for thick French fries.
Place in an 8 x 12 x 2-inch dish.
Cover potatoes with sugar and salt. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Add pieces of butter.
Pour lemon juice over mixture.
Sift flour evenly over the potatoes; stir so flour is barely seen.
Bake for 1 hour at 400°.
Baste frequently with the thick syrup.

title: Grandma Armstrong'S Banana Pudding
steps: Scald milk.
Mix cornstarch and sugar.
Add egg yolks.
Add this mix to scalded milk.
Cook until thick, then add vanilla. Layer cookies and bananas in a bowl, repeating until all gone. Top with a meringue, if desired.

title: Crackerjacks
steps: Bake nuts at 350° until brown, about 15 minutes.
Put in popped corn.
Melt butter and sugar together.
Drizzle over mixture.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Dark Chocolate Turtles
steps: Combine the caramels with milk
in
the top of a double boiler and heat until caramels are melted.
You can do this in the microwave too, at High for about 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often. Beat
with
a
wooden
spoon
until
creamy.
Stir
in pecans. Drop by spoonfuls onto a sheet of buttered wax paper. Let set for 15 minutes.

title: Nutty Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: mayonnaise sour cream
ingredients.raw: mayonnaise, sour cream or Ranch dressing

steps: Combine first 7 ingredients.
Add enough mayonnaise, sour cream or Ranch dressing to moisten.

title: Chocolate Or Vanilla Popcorn Pieces
steps: Spray cookie sheet or wax paper.
Microwave bark and peanut butter 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir.
In large bowl, mix popcorn, Rice Krispies and peanuts (optional).
Stir mix into this and put in spoonfuls on wax paper or tray.
Let harden for at least 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Sweet Rolls
steps: Add shortening mixture to flour and yeast, plus 2 eggs.
Beat 1/2 minute on low and 3 more minutes on high.
Add 5 more cups flour and stir in.
Put in refrigerator to rise.
This can keep several days in refrigerator.
Can make cinnamon rolls or dinner rolls.
Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cheese Twice-Baked Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes at 425° for 45 to 60 minutes or until soft.
Cut a lengthwise slice from the top of the potatoes.
Scoop out pulp and place in bowl.
Mash potatoes; add sour cream, butter, salt, pepper, onions, broccoli and 3/4 cup cheese.
Refill potato shells; top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.

title: Blueberry (Or Cherry) Pizza

ingredients.name: pie filling
ingredients.raw: 2 cans pie filling (can use 1 qt. fresh or frozen blueberries)

steps: Butter 13 x 9-inch glass dish.
Put fruit in bottom. Sprinkle dry cake mix over.
Sprinkle nuts over.
Pour melted margarine over.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes, needs to brown.

title: Lowell Inn Crescent Rolls
steps: In a bowl, dissolve yeast in water (plus 1 teaspoon sugar). Mix ingredients.
Add rest of flour until smooth.
Cover.
Let rise in a warm place until double, 1 1/2 hours.
Divide.
Shape. Let rise until double, 1 hour.
Brush with butter.
Bake in oven at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes, until rich golden brown.
Makes 32 rolls.

title: One Crust Pie
steps: Mix together the flour and salt.
Cut in with pastry blend the shortening.
Sprinkle with ice water.
Gather dough together and press firmly into a ball.
Roll out into a circle larger than the pan all around.

title: Raisin Bran 6 Week Muffins
steps: Mix bran, flour, soda, salt and sugar.
Beat eggs; add oil and milk.
Add dry ingredients.
Place in covered dish in refrigerator.
When you bake, spoon them in greased muffin tins (or use paper baking cups).
Bake at 350° for about 18 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Potato Casserole
steps: Stir together all ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Sprinkle with bacon, if desired.

title: D C H Chicken Salad A La Sandy Toerpe

ingredients.name: and market day chicken steak
ingredients.raw: 8 cooked and cubed Market Day chicken steaks

steps: Mix together.
Put on a plate with a small bunch of grapes or other fresh fruit.
I also put a croissant or fresh roll on each plate.

title: Corned Beef Stew

ingredients.name: condensed split pea and ham soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (11 1/2 oz.) cans condensed split pea and ham soup

steps: Combine soup, water, undrained vegetables and the corned beef. Bring to boiling over low heat.
Stir biscuit mix and 1/3 cup water.
Spoon dough onto boiling stew.
Cook uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Cover and cook 10 minutes more.
Serve.

title: Ice Box Fruit Cake
steps: Roll graham crackers with rolling pin until very fine.
Melt marshmallows and add milk in double boiler.
Mix all the other ingredients toegther.
Pour melted marshmallows and milk over them.
Mix well and pack in cracker box or roll.
Put in refrigerator 24 hours before cutting.

title: Turtle Bars

ingredients.name: caramel ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 1/4 oz.) jar caramel ice cream topping

steps: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour, oatmeal, brown sugar and salt.
Add butter, mixing until crumbly.
Reserve 3/4 cup of mixture for topping.
Press remaining mixture into bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Toss Salad
steps: Wash and break lettuce into bite-size pieces.
Dice celery. Chop onion fine.
Peel cucumbers (if needed); dice.
Mix together just before serving.
Add dressing.
Toss to coat.
Then add diced tomatoes and toss lightly again.
Serves 50 to 60.

title: Chicken Bake
steps: Mix macaroni, chicken, eggs, cheese and cream of mushroom soup.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Pour cream of chicken soup over the top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Simply Sensational Ambrosia

ingredients.name: banana in
ingredients.raw: 3 large ripe bananas, cut in chunks

ingredients.name: light rum
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. light rum or orange juice

steps: In a medium bowl, gently toss bananas, oranges and orange juice (rum).
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

title: Holiday Cheese Appetizers
steps: Mix mayonnaise and cheese together until soft, like butter. Place in center of round of the breads, about 1/8 teaspoon each of chopped onion.
Cover bread round completely with mayonnaise and cheese mixture.
Refrigerate, if desired.
To serve:
Broil 5 to 8 minutes, until puffed and brown.
Serve immediately.

title: Spice Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add eggs; beat well.
Sift flour and spices together.
Add milk and the rest of the ingredients; mix well.
Pour into 2 greased and floured pans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until done.

title: Perfect Cornbread
steps: Sift flour with sugar, baking powder and salt.	Stir in cornmeal; add
eggs,
milk	and
shortening.
Beat	with mixer until just smooth,	about
minute.
Do
not overbeat.
Pour into greased 9-inch pan and bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Candy
steps: Melt margarine; stir in peanut butter.
While hot, stir in confectioners sugar.
Mix well.
Roll into balls.

title: Chicken-Almond Puffs
steps: Combine broth and margarine in medium saucepan; bring to a boil.
Combine flour and salt; add all at once to broth mixture, stirring vigorously over low heat until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms smooth ball.
Remove from heat; let cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time; beat with wooden spoon after each.
Beat until batter is smooth.
Stir in chicken, almonds and paprika. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes; reduce to 350° and bake 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve immediately.

title: Slivered Beef Liver
steps: Cut liver into 1/4-inch slices.
Melt margarine in 10-inch skillet.
Saute onion slices in margarine until tender.
(Do not brown.)
Add liver; season with salt, chili powder and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Cheese And Sausage Dip

ingredients.name: good season garlic salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons garlic salad dressing mix

steps: Brown sausage slowly on range top.
Melt cheese on low burner. Crumble cooked sausage and mix with cheese and the rest of the ingredients.
Serve with Doritos, Tostados or fresh vegetables.

title: Hot Tom(Tomato Catsup)
steps: Chop all together.
As it cooks, keep the foam dipped off. Let mixture cook until it gets thick.
Put in jars and seal.
This is good on most anything.

title: Lemon Bites
steps: Mix ingredients.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Playdough #2
steps: Put all ingredients in a pan.
Cook on low flame, stirring constantly.
Ingredients begin to congeal.
Remove from heat when you can no longer stir it!
Place dough on wax paper until it's cool enough to knead.
Add food coloring.
Knead like bread dough. Store in covered plastic container.
No need to refrigerate.

title: Southern Key Lime Pie

ingredients.name: key lime peel
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 3/4 tsp. finely shredded key lime peel or 1 1/2 tsp. finely shredded Persian lime peel

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. lime juice (8 to 10 key limes or 2 to 3 Persian limes)

steps: Separate egg yolks from whites; set whites aside for meringue.
Place the egg yolks in a medium mixing bowl; with a fork or whisk beat egg yolks till combined.
Gradually stir in the condensed milk and lime peel.
Add lime juice and water, stirring well (the mixture will thicken).
Pour into the baked pastry shell.
Bake in a 325° oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and transfer to a wire rack.
Increase oven temperature to 350°.

title: Chicken Adobo
steps: Marinate chicken in vinegar, soy sauce, peppercorn and 1/2 garlic.
Add water and simmer, uncovered, until tender.
Strain sauce; separate the sauce from meat.
Allow to cool.
To reduce sauce, cook in open saucepan; simmer until sauce thickens with bay leaf.
Heat cooking oil; brown meat and half garlic.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Serve with rice.

title: Wild Rice Hot Dish
steps: Cook rice.
Brown meat and vegetables.
Combine browned mixture with rice, chicken soup and 1 can mushroom soup.
Put in 3-quart casserole and pour mushroom soup over top.
Bake for 2 hours at 300°.

title: Cabbage Salad Dressing
steps: Combine onion and vinegar in blender.
Add sugar.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Add oil, salt and celery seed.
Keeps weeks in refrigerator.

title: Pesto Ala Genovese

ingredients.name: ground black pepper
ingredients.raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: In a blender or food processor, put basil leaves, nuts and garlic.
Blend until smooth. Add olive oil, a little at a time, pushing down mixture with plastic spatula, as needed.
Add grated cheese and pepper.
Blend to smooth paste.
Heat sauce in double boiler.
Cook pasta al dente, according to package.
Drain and transfer to heated serving dish.
Toss with pesto.

title: Quick Fix Salmon Cakes

ingredients.name: old bay salmon classic seasoning mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1.34 oz.) pkg. Old Bay salmon classic seasoning mix

steps: Mix as directed on back of package of Old Bay salmon classic seasoning mix.
Form into medium-size patties.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie

ingredients.name: jiffy baking mix
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Jiffy Baking Mix or Bisquick

steps: Preheat oven to 400.
Grease a 10 x 1-1/2 inch pie plate.
Cook and stir Beef and Onion until browned.
Drain.
Spread in plate. Top with half of the Cheese.
Beat Milk, Baking Mix, Eggs, Salt and Pepper until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater).
Pour over Hamburg and Cheese.
Bake 25 minutes.
Top with Tomatoes.
Sprinkle with rest of Cheese.
Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean (5 - 8 minutes).
Cool 5 minutes. 6- 8 servings.

title: Just For Fun "Creative Clay"
steps: Put ingredients in saucepan and cook slowly on low heat until you have the consistency of mashed potatoes.
Cool.
This clay can be rolled, cut with cookie cutters or shaped by hand for ornaments, beads, decorations, etc.
After "sculpting" let dry overnight. Once dry can be painted with acrylic paints.

title: Crab Cake
steps: Saute onions and parsley until soft in margarine; drain.
Mix well with rest of ingredients. Form in cakes and dust with flour. Fry in small amount of hot oil.

title: Chow Mein Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients well, except noodles.
Add chow mein noodles just before serving.

title: Tex Mex
steps: Cook hamburger; drain grease off.
Mix all other ingredients. Add hamburger.
Cook about 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Pitas

ingredients.name: hillshire farm smoked sausage
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Hillshire Farm smoked sausage, sliced

steps: Saute onion and pepper in butter.
Add sliced sausage and drained sauerkraut.
Heat through.
Mix in sour cream and mustard. Heat but do not boil.
Serve in pita breads.

title: Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar, salt and butter or margarine thoroughly.
Beat egg and extract into creamed mixture until light and fluffy.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
Gradually stir into creamed ingredients.
Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on floured board.
Cut into fancy shapes.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes or until light brown around edges.
Remove to cool.
Store in airtight container. Yield: about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Meringue Shells(Elegant Dessert)
steps: Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until frothy, using electric mixer.
Start adding sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, as whites continue to beat.
Continue to beat until all sugar is used and meringue is stiff.

title: Peachy Glazed Pork Chops

ingredients.name: envelope lipton recipe secret onion soup
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets onion soup

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) jar peach or apricot preserves

ingredients.name: green
ingredients.raw: 2 medium green or red bell peppers, sliced

steps: In a small bowl combine onion soup mix, preserves and water. In a 13 x 9-inch pan, arrange chops and peppers.
Top with soup mixture.
Broil, turning once, until chops are done.

title: Oats Cereal
steps: Mix and roast until light brown.
Serve with milk.
Roast at 350°.

title: Light Side Summer Fruit Pie
steps: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water.
Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove any unmelted ice.
Using wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit, if desired.
Spoon into crust. Chill 2 hours.
(Strawberry jello and strawberries are great.)

title: Breakfast Made Beautiful(Make This The Night Before)

ingredients.name: sausage brown and
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. sausage, browned, drained and crumbled

steps: Grease with oleo a large oblong casserole dish. Trim crust from slices of bread.
Butter bread on one side only.
Arrange slices, buttered side up, to completely cover bottom of dish. Cover the bread slices with half of the sausage.
Lay slices of cheese over sausage.
Repeat bread, sausage and cheese.
Combine eggs and milk. Pour over casserole.
Cover and refrigerator overnight.
Next morning, let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle bacon bits over the top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, depending on your oven.

title: Christmas Pea Salad
steps: Combine peas, pimentos and cheese in a bowl; mix lightly.
Add salad dressing, salt and pepper; mix lightly.
Chill for 1 hour or longer.

title: Easy Cheesy Corn
steps: Melt butter in skillet.
Add corn and cook until tender.
Add pepper to taste Cut up cream cheese.
Add to corn.
Cook until melted.

title: Oriental Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: water chestnut and
ingredients.raw: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained

ingredients.name: bacon fried crisp and
ingredients.raw: 8 slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled

steps: Combine spinach, bean sprouts and water chestnuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Just before serving, toss with eggs and dressing.

title: Olvera Street Chili Quiche(Microwave)

ingredients.name: half and half
ingredients.raw: 1 c. half and half or milk

ingredients.name: green chily
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can diced green chilies, drained

steps: Microwave pastry in a micro-safe pie plate quiche dish for 4 to 5 minutes at High power until crust is almost dry.
Turn pie plate once, if oven is not a rotating one.

title: Mamie'S Million Dollar Fudge
steps: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl.
Boil the next 4 ingredients in a large kettle for 6 minutes, stirring often.
Pour at once over the first mixture.
Stir vigorously. Pour into buttered pan.
Let stand a few hours, then cut and store in tins.

title: Seaside Salad

ingredients.name: pea and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: tuna and flaked
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Prepare dinner as directed.
Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly and chill.
Serves 6 to 8.
I use more relish and onion. Serve on lettuce leaf.
Makes lots.

title: Almond Bark Goodies
steps: Melt almond bark in a double boiler; add peanut butter and mix well.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Drop by teaspoon or 1/2 teaspoon on wax paper; let set until firm.
Store in a cookie jar or tin.

title: Cooked Fruit Dip
steps: Melt butter.
Add sugar over low heat until sugar melts.
Add sour cream and vanilla.
Chill.
Great with combination of fruits. Arrange fruit on a large platter with dip in center.

title: Colcannon With Kale Or Spinach

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cut kale or 1 pkg. spinach

steps: Preheat oven to hot (400°).
Peel potatoes; cut into quarters. Place in saucepan with water and salt.
Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Drain and mash.

title: Appetizer Franks

ingredients.name: frankfurter bite sie
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. frankfurters, cut into bite-sie pieces

steps: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir in franks.
Cook for 30 minutes; serve in chafing dish.

title: Peach Cobbler #1(Microwave)
steps: Alternate ingredients in a microwave safe dish by making layers.
Cook on high in microwave for 20 minutes, uncovered.

title: Turkey Burger Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: lipton beef onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Lipton beefy onion soup mix (dry)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients, reserving 1/2 can of tomato sauce for later.
Form into loaf and bake 40 to 45 minutes.
When 1/2 done, pour remaining sauce on top.

title: Cool Whip Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate until time to serve.

title: Raw Cranberry Salad
steps: One day ahead:
Put cranberries and both oranges (use peeling from one) through meat grinder or blender.
Add sugar and let stand overnight.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup

ingredients.name: white pepper
ingredients.raw: dash of white pepper or cayenne

ingredients.name: cherry
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. sherry (Taylor New York State dry sherry is good)

steps: Pick through crab.
In a large pot, melt butter. Add flour and pepper.
Stir and simmer for 2 minutes. Add milk and crushed bouillon cubes. Simmer and stir until bouillon dissolves and mixture thickens. Salt to taste. Add crab, parsley and sherry.
Do not bring to a boil.

title: Corn Pudding Delight(Vegetable Casserole)
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Cornbread Fritters
steps: Mix ingredients.
Mix with water to a thin consistency.
Pour small amounts
into frypan with cooking oil.
Brown on both sides.

title: Iced Brownies
steps: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add eggs.
Sift flour with cocoa.
Add vanilla, water and nuts.
Add this mixture to the butter mixture.
Bake at 350° in greased and floured pan (10 x 15-inch) for about 30 minutes.
Let brownies remain in pan.

title: Great Grandmother'S Apple Stack Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar together, then molasses.
Add eggs, beating well.
Add milk alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Mix well.
Pour mixture about 1/2-inch deep in 6 greased layer pans or you can use 3 layer pans and they can be split.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes or until tested one (if using 3 pans, cooking time may take up to 30 minutes).
Cook apples, season to taste, then cool; mash apples good or run through a colander.
Use dried apples.
When cake layers are cool, spread apples on top and stack up.
Use no icing on top.
This cake is better if made ahead and let it set for several days before serving.

title: Cinnamon-Raisin Bars
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Sift together dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture.
Add oats and 1 tablespoon water.
Mix until crumbly.
Firmly pat half the mixture in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Spread with Raisin Filling.
Mix remaining crumbs and 1 tablespoon water.
Spoon over filling; pat smooth.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) about 35 minutes.
Cool. Drizzle with Cinnamon Icing.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Cherry Tarts
steps: Grease outside of muffin tin.
Using favorite pie crust recipe, put crust on outside of tin.
Prick and bake at 400° for approximately 8 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Crunch
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine cooked, mashed sweet potatoes with all ingredients.
Cook in a 9-inch baking dish.

title: Butterscotch Brownies(Makes 9 Servings)

ingredients.name: instant butterscotch pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 3/8 oz.) pkg. instant butterscotch pudding and pie filling

steps: In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, combine pudding mix, flour, sugar, eggs, margarine, vanilla, baking powder and salt.
Beat 2 minutes.
Stir in pecans.
Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool in pan.
Cut into squares.

title: Venison Pepper Steak(Serves 4 To 6)
steps: Cut venison steak into 1/2-inch pieces.
Press the flour, salt and pepper into the meat.
Melt butter in skillet, add steak slices.
Brown on all sides.
Simmer onions and green peppers in small amount of butter or oil, until tender.
Add meat to onions and peppers, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Texas Panhandle Yum Yum
steps: Mix and pat into 9 x 13-inch glass loaf dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.

title: Congo Bar
steps: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.
Add other ingredients.
(Batter will be very thick.)
Pour into greased 9 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 300° or 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm.

title: Honey Popcorn Balls
steps: In saucepan, combine sugar, honey and margarine.
Cook over low heat until mixture bubbles around edges.
Pour over popcorn.

title: Mrs. Addie'S Banana Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in a greased loaf pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Rolled Bananas
steps: Peel bananas; cut in half (not lengthwise).
Spread with mayonnaise; roll in crushed peanuts.

title: Olde English Tea Cakes
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter and sugar, then add eggs; cream until light and creamy.
Add vanilla after creaming butter, sugar and eggs.
Add dry ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon.
Touch top of cake lightly with cloth covered glass dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 9 minutes.

title: Granny'S Cake And Topping
steps: Mix all the ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups nuts. Sprinkle on top of cake batter and bake 40 minutes at 325°.

title: Cucumber Dip Or Spread
steps: Grind cucumber and onion together, very fine.
Put in a strainer or cheesecloth and press out juice.
Soften cream cheese. Add enough of the juice to make it a dippable consistency.
Add salt to taste and a shake of Accent also enhances the flavor.
If the vegetables did not render enough juice to make the cheese spreadable, add mayonnaise.
A drop of green vegetable coloring makes this very pretty.
If a strong flavor is desired, add a tiny bit of the finely ground pulp.

title: Haddock Au Gratin
steps: Heat the oven to 400°.
In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except the fish.
Place the fish on individual squares of greased aluminum foil.
Spoon the crumb mixture over the fish. Seal the foil securely and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish flakes easily.
Makes six servings.

title: Dave'S Turtles
steps: Melt chips, stirring constantly.
Add cashews and noodles; stir until completely covered with chocolate.
Scoop mixture out with a tablespoon and put on wax paper to cool and harden.
You may also use any cereal.
Cheerios and Kix work well.

title: Country Style Raisin Pie
steps: Empty box of raisins in pan.
Cover with water and boil raisins until tender.
Place sugar, flour, vanilla and salt in bowl.
Add enough water to make paste.
Add the paste mixture to the tender raisins and bring mixture to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Pour mixture into two uncooked pie shells; add a top crust and place in oven.
Cook until top crust is golden brown.

title: Toll House Layer Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan.
Line with waxed paper.
In a bowl, cream butter, sugars, vanilla and salt.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat well. Gradually add flour.
Stir in 1 cup chocolate pieces.
Spread in pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool.

title: Mag'S Homemade Ice Cream
steps: Mix sugar, flour, salt and milk.
Cook in top of double boiler over simmering water, stirring until slightly thickened.
Cover and cook 10 minutes more on low heat.
Add hot milk mixture slowly to eggs, beating constantly.
Return mixture to top of double boiler and cook over boiling water for 5 minutes, or until custard coats spoon.
Cool; add vanilla, condensed milk and cream.
Freeze in ice cream freezer.
Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Salmon Delight

ingredients.name: butter toast
ingredients.raw: 4 slices buttered toast or patty shells

steps: Place top chafing pan in water jacket.
When heated, put in cream, eggs, butter, cayenne and parsley.
While it's steaming, add drained salmon.
Heat through well.
Do not let it boil. Serve on toast or patties.
A dash of sherry is optional.
Serves 4.

title: Corned Beef Party Rolls
steps: Mix poppy seed, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, onion and margarine.
Spread mixture on both insides of rolls.
Add slice of corned beef and slice of Swiss cheese.
Wrap in foil.
Bake about 10 minutes at 400°.
Freezes well.
Yields 90.

title: Easy Garlic Pasta
steps: Blend parsley and basil into butter.
Blend this with cream cheese.
Add Parmesan, olive oil, garlic and pepper.
When pasta is ready, drain.
Add 2/3 cup boiling water to cheese mixture. Stir and toss with pasta.

title: Boxti(Irish Potato Pancakes)
steps: Shred enough potatoes to make 4 cups.
Drain.
Mix in all ingredients except butter.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter on a 12-inch skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Pour 1/2 cup of batter for each Boxti.
Flatten out with spatula.
Grill on each side for 2 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat for rest of batter.
Makes 8 Boxti.
Batch can be doubled, but must be cooked.

title: Memphis Corn Pudding

ingredients.name: jiffy corn muffin mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) box Jiffy corn muffin mix

ingredients.name: kernel corn with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can whole kernel corn with juice

steps: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl until blended. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned and set.

title: Jello Bread

ingredients.name: yellow
ingredients.raw: 1 box yellow or white cake mix

steps: Mix all ingredients; beat well.
Pour into well-greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool before removing from pans.
Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients together, shape into loaf or use a loaf pan.
Bake in a 325° oven for 45 minutes.
Preheat the oven.

title: Reuben Sandwiches
steps: Butter one side of rye bread and put in skillet.
Top with slice of cheese, layer of corned beef and layer of sauerkraut. Put on other slice of bread, buttered side up.
Toast until cheese starts to melt.
Turn over and toast other side.

title: Wild Rice With Sausage
steps: Cook rice, water, bouillon according to directions on box. Saute sausage, celery, onion and mushrooms.
Drain grease.	Add butter and seasoning.
Fold in wild rice and serve.

title: Corn  Pudding
steps: Mix corn and eggs together.
Slowly add butter.
Add Jiffy cornbread mix and sugar.
Mix together.
Salt and pepper to taste. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until center is firm.

title: Bishop Asbury Pound Cake

ingredients.name: sifted cake flour
ingredients.raw: 4 c. sifted cake flour (may use 3 1/2 c. all-purpose flour)

steps: Preheat oven to 325°.

Grease and flour a 12-cup tube pan. Cream together butter and sugar using a heavy-duty electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time and with the mixer running continuously at medium speed, add lemon juice and vanilla.
Finally, add the flour a little bit at a time.
Pour thoroughly mixed batter into prepared pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until a straw test shows that it is done.
Remove to a rack to cool about 15 minutes, then turn out onto the rack.

title: Carrots And Pineapple
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Add remaining ingredients; heat through.

title: Apple-Cherry Turnovers

ingredients.name: sour red cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 (40 oz.) can pitted sour red cherries, drained

steps: Pare, core and slice apples.
Add cherries.
Mix dry ingredients.
Cut puff pastry sheet into 4 squares.
Arrange apple-cherry mixture on pastry.
Sprinkle with dry ingredients; top with dots of butter.
Fold pastry to form triangle.
Seal edges.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with vanilla ice cream.
Yield:
4 turnovers.

title: Homemade Ink(This Recipe Is Dedicated To All Teachers Everywhere.)
steps: Crush several empty walnut shells into very small pieces.
In a saucepan, cover the shells with boiling water.
Simmer until the liquid is very dark brown.
Add some salt and vinegar (this will "set" the color).
Strain the ink through a piece of cheesecloth into a jar.
You can use this ink in any pen that dips or fills with ink.

title: Granny Disspayne'S Chocolate Candy

ingredients.name: peanut butter
ingredients.raw: 3 large Tbsp. peanut butter or chopped nuts

steps: Combine sugar, cocoa, Karo syrup and milk in saucepan.
Cook until gets hard and add butter, beat until starts getting thick. Add peanut butter or chopped nuts.
Pour into a greased dish.

title: Cin-Soy Burgers
steps: Mix hamburger meat and soy sauce in large bowl.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar and mix through meat thoroughly.
Form into patties and grill.

title: Santa'S Whiskers(Christmas Cookies)

ingredients.name: red candied cherry
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. finely chopped red candied cherries

steps: In mixing bowl, cream together butter or margarine and sugar. Blend in milk and vanilla or rum flavoring. Stir in flour, chopped cherries and pecans. Form dough into two 8-inch rolls. Roll in flaked coconut to coat outside.
Wrap in plastic wrap and chill thoroughly. Cut into 1/4-inch slices and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° until edges are golden, about 12 minutes. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Waldorf Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients and beat at medium speed. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill at least 1 hour.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Crescents
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Mix sugar, vanilla, egg and cream cheese in medium mixing bowl.
Place 1 roll of crescents in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press in firmly.
Spread cream cheese mixture over crescents.
Spread cherry pie filling over cream cheese mixture. Place last roll of crescents over top.
No need to pat down. Bake at 350° until top is golden brown.
Cool, chill and serve.

title: Cuban Pork

ingredients.name: pork pork roast
ingredients.raw: 6 lb. fresh pork, pork roast or shoulder

ingredients.name: salt pepper garlic powder and oregano
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano

steps: *Variation:
If barbecue sauce cannot be found, you may use fresh squeezed sour orange for the marinade.
Remove seeds before squeezing.
Approximately 4 to 6 sour oranges will be needed.

title: Late Nite Noodle Special
steps: Cook macaroni until tender.
Rinse, heat margarine and tomato juice until margarine is melted.
Add to noodles.
Nice for a late night snack.

title: Microwave Meatloaf
steps: Mix together all ingredients. Shape into loaf.
Microwave on medium high (70%) for 22 to 24 minutes or until no longer pink. Allow to stand covered 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Chicken Broccoli Bake

ingredients.name: skinned chicken breast half
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless, skinned chicken breast halves, cubed

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen broccoli, thawed and drained

steps: Mix all ingredients.
Spoon into 12 X 8 baking dish.
Bake so minutes
at 375 or until chicken is cooked through.

title: Karen'S Strawberry Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add frozen berries and stir until thawed and melted.
Add drained pineapple and chopped bananas.
Pour half of mixture in large glass or plastic bowl and congeal.
Spread sour cream over congealed jello.
Pour remainder of jello mixture over sour cream and congeal.

title: Casserole Mexicana

ingredients.name: kidney bean
ingredients.raw: 1 can (1 lb. 4 oz. size) kidney beans

ingredients.name: black olive
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 1/2 oz. size can) black olives chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Heat cooking oil in large skillet.
Add ground chuck and cook until browned.
Stir in taco seasoning mix, then the kidney beans, black olives and tomato sauce.
Cook until the mixture boils.
Pour into a 2 quart casserole dish.
Cover with cheese and crushed chips.
Bake until cheese melts.
Serves 6.
Tasty and quick!

title: Irish Potatoes
steps: Grease a 2-quart baking dish.
Thaw spinach and drain thoroughly.
Cook potatoes and mash.
Add margarine, sour cream and seasonings.
Stir in spinach.
Turn into baking dish, sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Oatmeal Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
Mix oats, flour, brown sugar and baking soda.
Stir in melted margarine. Reserve 3/4 cup of oatmeal mixture; press remaining oatmeal into pan.
Bake 10 minutes; cool 5 minutes.

title: Apple-Nut Squares
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Spread evenly in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 325°
for 1 hour; remove. Spread prepared topping evenly over top of baked cake.
Cool; cut into squares.
Makes 36 pieces.

title: Mcmullan Rice Beef Bake
steps: Brown beef in a little fat.
Add all other ingredients and put in a large, well-greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir once about halfway through cooking period.
Serves 8 to 10.
Very, very good.

title: No-Bake Chocolate Cheesecake

ingredients.name: hershey s semi sweet chocolate chip
nondairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 c. frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed

ingredients.name: packaged graham cracker crumb crust
ingredients.raw: 8-inch (6 oz.) packaged graham cracker crumb crust

steps: In small micro-proof bowl, melt chocolate chips on High (full power) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred.
Set aside to cool.
In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and butter until smooth.
On low speed, blend in melted chocolate.
Fold in whipped topping until blended.
Spoon into crust.
Cover; chill until firm.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add pumpkin and eggs.
Mix well. Mix dry ingredients:
flour, cinnamon, soda and salt.
Add to first mixture.
Mix. Add nuts.
Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes from 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Tuna Yums
steps: Mix cream cheese, tuna and onions together well.
Let chill overnight or at least 4 hours.
Serve on Ritz crackers or celery sticks.

title: Rice With Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 to 4 lb.) chicken, cut in serving pieces

steps: Cook rice in salted water for 5 minutes.
Set aside.
Flour and season chicken.
Fry chicken in oil until brown.
Pour rice over chicken.
Cover and cook until chicken is tender.
Add water as needed.

title: Tandy Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs until thick and lemony. Slowly add sugar, milk and vanilla, mixing slowly.
Blend dry ingredients together and fold into egg mixture by hand.
Blend well and pour into greased 13 x 15-inch jellyroll pan.
Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Sunset Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add cranberry sauce while still hot.
Stir or whip until dissolved.
(If you prefer a smoother salad, put cranberry sauce through food processor.) Chill until syrupy. Dice bananas and fold into gelatin with nuts. Pour into mold(s).
Chill well.
Serves 8.

title: Kidney Bean Salad

ingredients.name: onion the size of egg
ingredients.raw: 1 small onion the size of egg

steps: Boil eggs and dice.
Dice pickles and onion and then mix with kidney beans.
Add mayonnaise to desired consistency.

title: Microwave Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 large cooked sweet potatoes or 1 large can

steps: Put all ingredients except sweet potatoes or yams in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish.
Microwave, uncovered, on High for 2 to 3 minutes until thickened.
Stir once.
Add sweet potatoes, coating all sides.
Microwave on High, uncovered, for 5 minutes, rotating dish once and spooning syrup over potatoes.

title: Spanish Potato Omelet
steps: Slice potatoes, onions and ham with thinnest slicing disk of food processor.
(If you don't have food processor, slice as thinly as possible by hand.)
Saute potatoes and onions in oil until soft, but not brown.
Butter an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch glass baking dish. Layer potatoes, onions and ham in dish.
Scramble eggs with salt and pepper to taste and pour over all.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until eggs are set.
Cut into squares.
Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Crunch Dessert #2
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well.
Spread in bottom of pan.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over top. Sprinkle on pecans.
Drizzle margarine over top.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Spanish Corn Bread

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded cheese (keep half of cheese back)

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Have pan greased and hot.
Pour half of batter in a pan.
Sprinkle with half of cheese.
Pour rest of batter in pan and bake to almost done.
Then sprinkle rest of cheese over all and finish baking.

title: Butterscotch Bliss
steps: Melt butter; stir in flour.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° until lightly brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy.
After crust is cool, drop mixture onto crust by spoonfuls, then spread.
Combine pudding and milk.
Beat until thick.
Spread over cream cheese layer.
Top with Cool Whip and nuts.
Refrigerate.

title: Baked Potatoes
steps: Wash and bake potatoes until done.
Cut open and spoon out potatoes from hulls.
Mix with salt, pepper, Parmesan cheese and margarine.
Pack back into hulls.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over all 8 halves.
Place in warm oven until ready to serve.

title: Gold Shipment Broiled Chicken
steps: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with foil.
Melt the butter in the pan. Place chicken, skin side down, in the pan and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Blend the remaining salt, honey, mustard and lemon juice.
Brush half of the honey mixture on the chicken. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Turn the chicken and brush with the remaining honey mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes more, or until the chicken is tender.
Serves 4.

title: Company Chicken Pie
steps: Boil and debone chicken.
Place bite size pieces in bottom of baking dish; salt and pepper to taste.
Mix sour cream and chicken soup with 1 can broth from boiling chicken.
Pour over chicken. Crush Ritz crackers in small pieces; put over top of mixture.
Cut margarine up and place around on top of crackers.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until nice and bubbly.

title: Cottage Cheese Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Shaum Torte(Meringue Shells)
steps: Heat oven to 275°.
Cover baking sheet with heavy brown paper. Beat egg whites.
Add cream of tartar and beat until foamy.
Beat in sugar, one teaspoon at a time until stiff and glossy.
Do not underbeat.
On brown paper, shape meringue into 9-inch circle, building up sides.
Bake 1 1/2 hours.
Turn off oven.
Leave in oven with door closed for 1 hour.
Finish cooling out of oven away from draft.
Put on plate and fill with strawberries and ice cream.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Stuffed Semi-Hard Rolls

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 3/4 lb. cheese (grated American or Cheddar)

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. grated onion or a little onion salt

ingredients.name: tabasco sauce and worcestershire sauce
ingredients.raw: dash of Tabasco sauce and Worcestershire sauce

steps: Split and remove part of the center of the rolls.
Stuff the rolls with the mixture.
Wrap in wax paper or aluminum foil and heat in a 350° oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Corned Beef A La Jardinera
steps: Mix corned beef and vegetables in a frying pan.
Add water and tomato paste.
Cook for 5 to 10 minutes and serve over rice.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes(Serves 4)

ingredients.name: herb such as parsley chives thyme and sage
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 tsp. chopped fresh herbs such as: parsley, chives, thyme and sage OR 2 to 3 tsp. dried herbs of choice

steps: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough, or otherwise just scrub and rinse them. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through.
Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way through. Put potatoes in a baking dish.

Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425° for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned and cheeses are melted and potatoes look soft inside. Check for doneness with a fork. Serve with any meat, fish or poultry dishes or as a main dish with your favorite salad.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Turkey Legs
steps: Sprinkle turkey with salt and pepper.
Place in slow cooking pot.
Combine remaining ingredients; pour over turkey.
Cover and cook on low for 5 to 7 minutes.
If turkey legs are small, serve 1 thigh or drumstick per person.
If large, slice off cooked meat and serve with sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheesy Chops

ingredients.name: pork chop and bone removed
ingredients.raw: pork chops (as many as your family will eat), trimmed and bone removed

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: potatoes (as many as your family will eat), peeled and sliced thin

steps: Place chops in single layer in a greased pan.
Next, layer onions on top of chops, then raw potatoes.
Pour on undiluted soup.
Spread as evenly as possible.
Lay single layer of cheese slices on top.
Cover well.
Bake in 400° oven for 1 1/2 hours or until chops are done.
If using a glass baking dish, bake at 350°.

title: Meat Loaf Casserole

ingredients.name: catsup chili sauce
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. catsup, chili sauce or tomato soup

steps: Mix beef, milk, oatmeal, catsup and onions.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Butter a large casserole and place sliced potatoes in the dish.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and parsley. Spread meat mixture over potatoes.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove cover and bake 30 minutes more.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dorice'S Brownies
steps: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.
Add flour and cocoa.
Add vanilla and chopped nuts.
Spread in Pam sprayed pan (9 x 12-inch does fine).
Cook at 325° for about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Lickin' Casserole

ingredients.name: herb seasoned stuffing
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned cube stuffing

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. skinless and boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: green bean thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen cut green beans, thawed

steps: In a bowl, mix stuffing, butter and broth.
Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Spread evenly.
In a bowl, mix chicken, soup and green beans.
Spread mixture evenly over stuffing.
Cover and bake in a preheated, moderate oven at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Remove from oven, uncover and sprinkle with cheese.
Place in oven and bake 10 minutes.

title: Squash Dressing Casserole

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup undiluted
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted

steps: Melt margarine and blend with stuffing.
Mix together remaining ingredients.
Spread 1/2 stuffing mix on bottom of oblong dish, spread squash mix on top.
Sprinkle remainder of stuffing over squash mix.
Bake at 350° until brown on top.
Cut into squares and serve.

title: Wedding Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes

ingredients.name: pepperidge farm herb flavored bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Pepperidge Farm herb-flavored bread crumbs

steps: Spread potatoes in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Mix sour cream, soup, cheese, onion and 1/2 stick melted butter together.
Spread over potatoes.
Mix 1/2 stick melted butter and bread crumbs and spread over potatoes.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Cookies
steps: Heat chocolate chips, margarine, marshmallows and vanilla. Remove from heat once melted and add oatmeal and coconut.
Spoon on wax paper and put in refrigerator for 3 hours.

title: Anisette Knots

ingredients.name: warm water
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. warm water (I find that 1/4 c. is sometimes too much, start with 1/2 the amount and add, if needed)

steps: In bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Toss lightly. Add eggs and sugar, mix well.
Mixture will be crumbly.
Add melted butter, anise extract and warm water.
Stir until mixture forms ball.
Knead 5 minutes until smooth.
Cook in fridge 1 hour.
Pinch off pieces of dough size of walnuts and roll into logs.
Tie into knots, shape and place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes until slightly brown.

title: Saturday Nite Spread
steps: Cook onion on medium heat.
Add hamburger and slightly brown. Add 1 can chicken gumbo soup (undiluted), ketchup and mustard. Simmer for at least 30 minutes.
Serve on buns.

title: Dehaven'S Magic Bars
steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13 pan.
Spread graham cracker crumbs over butter.
Pour milk over crumbs.
Add chocolate and butterscotch morsels.
Put coconut and nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes till golden brown.

title: Quick And Easy Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. chicken breast, cut in strips

steps: Put meat in wok or frypan with about 1 tablespoon oil.
Cook until done.
Push aside and add 1/2 bag of mixed vegetables. Stir-fry until crispy.
Add mushrooms.
Mix water, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch and garlic salt.
Pour over all ingredients and cook until thickened.
Serve over rice.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken With Dressing

ingredients.name: corn bread stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. corn bread stuffing mix

steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in pan.
Add chicken.
Cover and cook until done.
Pour drippings into 2 cups measuring glass.
Add water to reach 1 1/2 cups mark.
Tear chicken meat into strips.
Put remaining butter (2 tablespoons), onion and celery into saucepan and stir, cooking on low heat.
Add stuffing mix, egg, salt, seasonings and 1 1/2 cups drippings mixture.
Stir until moist. Add chicken pieces and toss.
Cover and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Fudgil Scotch Ring

ingredients.name: nestle s semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) (1 c.) Nestle's semi-sweet chocolate morsels

ingredients.name: nestle s butterscotch morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) Nestle's butterscotch morsels

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

steps: Melt chocolate and butterscotch morsels with sweetened milk in top of double boiler over hot (not boiling) water.
Stir occasionally until morsels and mixture begin to thicken.
Remove from heat.
Add chopped walnuts and vanilla.
Blend well.
Chill 1 hour until mixture thickens.
Line bottom of 9-inch pie pan with 12-inch square of foil.
Place 3/4 cup walnut halves in bottom of pan, forming 2-inch wide flat ring.

title: Creamy Strawberry Daiquiris

ingredients.name: pink lemonade concentrate thawed
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed

steps: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until mixture is smooth.
Yield:
1 quart.

title: Icebox Dessert
steps: Cream sugar, butter and egg yolks.
Add nuts, pineapple, marshmallows and vanilla.
Mix well.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in.
Line a 9 x 12-inch dish with graham crackers. Carefully pour in mixture.
Sprinkle with crushed graham cracker crumbs.
Let set in icebox (refrigerator) overnight.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
steps: Prepare onions; cut into 1/4-inch slices and separate into rings.
Heat oil (1 inch) in 3-quart saucepan to 375°.
Beat remaining ingredients with hand beater until smooth.
Dip each ring into batter, letting excess drip into bowl.
Fry a few onion rings at a time in hot oil, turning once until golden brown; about 2 minutes.
Drain.

title: Salmon Party Log
steps: Mix salmon and cream cheese in a bowl by hand.
Dice 1 small onion and mix.
Add salt, horseradish and lemon juice.
Mix until all is blended.

title: Cheeseless Cheesecake

ingredients.name: pineapple in its own juice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. crushed pineapple in its own juice

ingredients.name: artificial sweetener equal tsp. sugar
ingredients.raw: artificial sweetener to equal 8 tsp. sugar

steps: Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup of the water over low heat.
Put into blender.
Add rest of the ingredients and blend well.
Pour into an 8-inch pan.
