Sprinkle cinnamon on top and refrigerate until sets.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Fruit Squares
steps: Crust:
In saucepan, mix 1/4 cup sugar and butter; heat until butter melts.
Stir in cracker crumbs; press in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Neapolitan Pudding

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

steps: In a large bowl, combine condensed milk and water.
Add pudding mix; beat well.
Chill 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 2 cups pudding into a 3-quart serving bowl; top with half each of the wafers, strawberries, mini chips and remaining pudding.
Repeat layering, ending with pudding.
Garnish with additional mini chips, wafers and strawberries, if desired.
Chill thoroughly.

title: 6 Eggs Pound Cake

ingredients.name: cake flour
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cake flour or Pillsbury flour

steps: Beat sugar and eggs until fluffy.
Add evaporated milk.
Using an electric mixer gradually add flour, beating constantly and scraping down sides of bowl.
Beat in flavors.
Put batter in a loaf pan.
Bake at 450° for 1 hour or until cake is golden brown.

title: Diet Lemon Cheese Cake

ingredients.name: light n lively low fat cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Light 'n Lively low-fat cottage cheese

ingredients.name: light philadelphia cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. light Philadelphia cream cheese

steps: Spray an 8 or 9-inch pie plate with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle crumbs on bottom and sides.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; cool.
Into blender put gelatin, cottage cheese and softened cream cheese; blend until smooth.
Pour into large bowl. Gently stir in Cool Whip.
Pour into crumbs.
Chill 4 hours, until set.
Top with cherry filling, if wanted.

title: Fluffy Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Combine cream cheese, sugar, butter and vanilla.
Mix on high speed until smooth and fluffy.
Add about 1 tablespoon of buttermilk (or more) to make frosting of spreading consistency.

title: Mushroom Steak

ingredients.name: any meat suitable stir fry
ingredients.raw: 1-1 1/2 lb. of any meat suitable for stir fry (thin strips)

steps: Brown and saute meat in 2-3 T. oil, cut pepper into strips and add to meat, stir in soup and milk.
Simmer 10 -15 min. additional milk can be added if mixture becomes too thick.
Serve over a bed of rice.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Dip
steps: Beat above ingredients with electric mixer.
Mix well.
Chill and serve with your favorite chips or crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Roll
steps: Boil water, syrup, 3 cups of sugar and salt until mixture will form ball that will crack on side of cup in cold water or cook to 250° or hard ball stage.
Pour syrup slowly over beaten egg whites. Beat until it becomes stiff and dough like (7 to 10 minutes).
Cool so you can handle with hands.
Add enough powdered sugar to make pliable dough to roll out.
Divide dough into 3 parts.
Roll out each round on wax paper sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Spread peanut butter on top.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Cut into slices.

title: Pineapple And Shrimp Salad
steps: Clean shrimp and let stand in French dressing for 1 hour; drain.
Arrange lettuce on platter.
Cut slices of pineapple in half; put on lettuce, then add shrimp.
Add celery (cut in thin slices) and eggs (cut in quarters lengthwise).
Serve with cooked salad dressing.
Serves 6.

title: Frozen Peach Pie
steps: Scald, peel and slice peaches.
Measure 4 quarts.
Dissolve Fruit-Fresh in water.
Add peaches; drain.
Combine peaches with other ingredients.
Line four 8-inch pie pans with heavy-duty foil, letting it extend about 5 inches beyond the pan.
Divide the filling among foil lined pans.
Fold foil over loosely.
Freeze until firm, then cover tightly.
Remove from pan; return to freezer.
May be stored 6 months.

title: Best Ever Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: pouch campbell s onion soup and recipe mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pouch Campbell's onion soup and recipe mix

steps: In
a large bowl, mix well the soup mix, ground beef, bread crumbs, celery, ketchup, milk and egg.
Press meat mixture into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Dutch Apple Pie In A Sack
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Shake sugar, spices, flour and apples in a sack. Arrange in a pie crust. Combine butter, brown sugar, flour and a pinch of salt to make crumb topping.
Sprinkle on apple mixture. Bake in a sealed oven roasting bag for 1 hour.

title: Mock Hollandaise(Low Cholesterol)
steps: In a small saucepan, beat all ingredients with a wire whisk until smooth.
Stirring constantly, cook over medium-low heat until thick.
Serve over vegetables.

title: Plantation Poppy Seed Cake

ingredients.name: regular yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (18.5 oz.) box regular yellow cake mix

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 3/4 oz.) box instant vanilla pudding and pie filling

steps: Combine all ingredients, stirring until just blended.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer exactly 2 minutes.
Pour batter into a well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan or tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until cake is done.
Serve warm or cool.
If desired serve with fruit preserves, applesauce or ice cream.

title: Baptist Pound Cake
steps: Cream shortening and butter with sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Sift flour; add baking powder and sift again.
Add milk and flour alternately to mixture.
Add vanilla.
Pour into a greased and floured tube pan; put in cold oven.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Turkey Ala King
steps: Melt butter or margarine in saucepan.
Blend in flour, onion, salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly.
Stir in milk; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
Stir in turkey and mushrooms, with liquid. Heat thoroughly.
Serve over rice or hot biscuits.

title: Christmas Cheese

ingredients.name: olive
ingredients.raw: 1 small can ripe olives, chopped (1/2 c.)

steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Sprinkle with paprika and roll. Wrap in foil and chill.
Slice as needed and serve with Ritz crackers.
Keeps 3 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Popcorn Jelly Bean Cake
steps: Have a large 10-inch tube pan ready.
Place margarine in large, heavy pot over low heat until melted.
Add marshmallows and stir until melted.
Add popcorn, nuts and jelly beans; stir until thoroughly coated.
Using a large spoon, pack the mixture into greased pan and smooth out.
Place in refrigerator for 1 hour. Unfold onto plate.
Use butter on hands to help smooth.

title: Black Bean Relish
steps: Mix ingredients.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Zucchini Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch or 10 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Milk Punch
steps: In a large bowl mix milk and apple juice concentrate.
Scoop in vanilla ice cream to keep cold.
Add cinnamon and nutmeg to taste.
Serves 25 people.

title: Lemon Cream Chicken
steps: Pound chicken until flat.
Brown on both sides in butter.
Put chicken into flat baking dish (9 x 9-inch).
Combine half and half and fresh squeezed lemon juice.
Add salt, pepper and lemon rind. Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and broil for 10 minutes or until cheese bubbles.

title: Pecan Pie(Elvis Presley'S Favorite)
steps: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, Karo and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Add broken pecans on top of filling mixture in the pie.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 325°, then bake until a knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean.

title: "No Peek" Chicken

ingredients.name: dry onion soup mix
ingredients.raw: dry onion soup mix or other seasoning

steps: Mix together rice, milk and soups.
Place in baking dish or casserole.
Place chicken pieces on top and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix or other seasoning of choice.
Cover tightly and bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Small Cheesecakes
steps: Place a cupcake liner in cupcake pan.
Mix in blender cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Put 2 tablespoons on top of each cupcake, and bake in oven.
Take liner from pan, cover each with 1 tablespoon of fruit glaze.
Cool and refrigerate.

title: Out-Of-This-World Pie
steps: In saucepan, combine pie filling, undrained pineapple, sugar and cornstarch.
Cook over medium heat until thick.
Add gelatin and food coloring, stirring until gelatin dissolves.
Remove from heat; stir in bananas and nuts.
Spoon into pie shells. Refrigerate until firm.
Garnish with whipped cream.
Makes 2 pies.

title: German Steamed Slaw
steps: Fry bacon and reserve the grease.
Chop cabbage and onions. In a large, heavy pot, mix cabbage, onions, salt, pepper, celery seed and tomatoes.
Add sugar and vinegar to warm bacon grease and then add to the cabbage mixture.
Cook slow until cabbage is very soft and translucent.
Stir occasionally.

title: Cheese Carrots
steps: Cook carrots until tender; drain.
Place in baking dish, sprayed with Pam.
Melt cheese and butter.
Stir constantly or it will scorch.
Pour over carrots.
Top with corn flakes crumbs. Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

title: Crisp Sugar Cookies
steps: In a mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with the milk.
Cover and refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes.
On a floured surface, roll out dough to 1/8-inch thickness.
Cut out cookies into desired shapes and place 2 inches apart on a greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until edges are slightly browned.
Yields 8 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Anadawa Bread
steps: In a large bowl, slowly pour boiling water over corn meal; stir.
Let cool 1 hour.
Dissolve yeast in warm water, then add to corn meal along with other ingredients.
Mix thoroughly, cover and let rise until doubled.

title: Peaches And Cream

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 large box instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: Drain peaches and reserve juice.
Melt oleo in dish.
Mix milk, flour and pudding.
Beat egg in peach juice.
Add mixture to milk mixture.
Pour into dish.
Place peaches on top.

title: Kansas Dirt Cake

ingredients.name: instant vanilla
ingredients.raw: 2 (3 oz.) boxes instant vanilla or French vanilla pudding

steps: Crush cookies and put half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix softened cream cheese and butter until smooth with mixer.
Mix in powdered sugar.
Fold in whipped topping.
In a separate bowl, mix pudding, milk and vanilla.
Fold cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture together.
Pour in a pan over cookie crumbs. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Chill.
This can also be frozen and served either frozen or chilled.

title: Carrie'S Devilish Eggs
steps: Slice hard-boiled eggs in half; remove yolks.
Set halves aside.
Mash yolks with a fork in a bowl.
Add sugar, cayenne pepper, mustard, mayonnaise, salt and pepper to taste.
Mash yolks.
Blend well.
Spoon yolk mixture into halves.
Refrigerate. Keep covered.
May omit cayenne pepper and add 1 or 2 tablespoons relish or minced onion.

title: Cheesy Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.name: loaf velveeta cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 loaf (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese (chopped in 1/2-inch cubes)

steps: In a saucepan, bring vegetables to a boil.
Shut off once at boil and add cream of chicken soup and canned chicken.
Pour in 9 x 11-inch baking dish.
Add cubes of cheese.
Roll out biscuits on counter until 1/4-inch thick.
Place canned biscuits on top. Place in oven at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Cookies

ingredients.name: baking powder tsp. baking powder
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. baking powder + 1 tsp. baking powder

steps: Mix butter and sugar in mixing bowl.
Add eggs and beat well. Mix flour, cornmeal, baking powder, salt and vanilla together. Add ingredients to mixture.
Put raisins in dough last.
Use No. 40 scoop and put dough on a greased 18 x 26-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes in conventional oven or 325° for about 12 minutes in convection oven, until lightly browned.
Makes about 100 cookies.

title: Quick Banana Nut Bread

ingredients.name: snackin cake banana walnut cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Snackin' Cake banana walnut cake mix

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom only of loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inches.
Mix all ingredients in bowl.
Stir with fork until batter is uniform color, about 1 1/2 minutes.
Pour into pan. Bake until toothpick inserted comes out clean, 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Grapefruit Pie
steps: Cut grapefruits in half.
Put sections with membrane removed into a drainer set over a measuring cup.
Add water to make 1 1/2 cups of liquid.
Add all ingredients (except pie shell) together and cook until thickened.
Cool.
Add grapefruit sections.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Chill.
Serve with whipped topping.

title: Creamy Jigglers

ingredients.name: or pkg. jell o brand gelatin
ingredients.raw: 4 (4 serving size) pkg. or 2 (8 serving size) pkg. Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor)

ingredients.name: jell o vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling

steps: Stir boiling water into gelatin.
Dissolve completely.
Cool to room temperature.
Pour milk into small mixing bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Beat with wire whisk until well blended.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill until firm, about 3 hours.

title: Best Ever Rice Pudding
steps: Pour milk into deep pot, warm milk, then add salt and butter. Bring to a boil.
Lower flame and add rice.
Cook until rice is soft and milk becomes thick.
In a separate pot, mix the eggs, sugar and vanilla, mixing well.
When the rice is soft and the milk is thick, turn off flame and mix with rice and milk, a little at a time until mixture becomes thoroughly mixed.
Allow to cool and enjoy.
Those who enjoy raisins may add raisins to this mixture when combining the mixtures.

title: Microwave Oven-Fried Fish

ingredients.name: cereal flake cracker
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 3/4 c. crushed cereal flakes, crackers or bread crumbs

steps: In shallow dish (microwave-safe), melt butter on High for 60 seconds.
In bowl, combine egg, water and lemon juice.
In another pan, combine flour, onion salt, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon paprika (optional).

title: Lemon Grape Punch

ingredients.name: scoop kool aid lemonade flavor sugar mix
ingredients.raw: 2 scoops Kool-Aid lemonade flavor sugar sweetened mix

steps: Combine grape juice and soft drink mix.
Chill.
Just before serving, add lemon-lime.
Serve over ice cubes.

title: Hawaiian Fudge
steps: Combine sugar, milk or cream and well drained pineapple. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until mixture reaches the soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add pecans and coloring. Let cool slightly and then beat until creamy.
Pour into a greased loaf pan.
Cool and cut into squares.
Yields 18 squares.

title: Congealed Peach Salad

ingredients.name: or size pkg. peach flavored gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 large or small size pkg. peach flavored gelatin

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple (do not drain)

steps: Mix dry gelatin and undrained pineapple in saucepan.
Heat until gelatin melts.
Cool slightly.
Add buttermilk and fold in whipped topping.
Pour into prepared mold and refrigerate.

title: "Busy Day" Fruit Or Berry Cobbler
steps: Mix dry ingredients and add milk, forming a batter.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a baking dish or casserole dish.
Pour batter on top of butter.
Heat berries or fruit, adding 1/2 cup of sugar if they are not sweetened.
Pour the berries or fruit over the batter and bake for 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Gullivers Corn
steps: Mix butter and flour.
Add to corn, cook for several minutes until thickens.

title: Cream Of Peanut Soup
steps: Chop 4 stalks celery and 1 onion.
Braise in 1/4 pound butter.
Add flour and cook until well blended.
Add 1 gallon chicken stock and bring to boil.
Add 1 pound peanut butter and stir until well blended.
Add 1 quart cream and serve.

title: Mother'S Hamburger Soup

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.raw: 1 c. diced potatoes or cooked rice

steps: Saute onions in 1 tablespoon oleo.
Brown ground beef.
Pour off fat.
Add the remainder of ingredients, cover and cook until tender (about 30 minutes).

title: Fried Jalapenos

ingredients.name: pancake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 c. pancake mix or 3/4 c. self-rising flour

steps: Halve jalapenos; take out seeds.
Stuff with cream cheese. Dip in thick batter and deep fry.
Drain on napkin.

title: Easy No-Bake Pie

ingredients.name: lime lemonade orange juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small can frozen lime, lemonade, orange juice or pink lemonade

ingredients.name: drop
ingredients.raw: drop or two of food coloring

steps: To the citrus juice, add appropriate food coloring.
Add condensed milk and stir.
Add Cool Whip and blend.
Evenly divide mixture into two pie shells.
Chill.
Ready in 5 minutes.
Holds up well in refrigerator.

title: Wilderness Refrigerator Cake
steps: Put marshmallows and milk in double boiler until melted.
Make Dream Whip according to recipe.
Mix crackers and butter and line a greased pan.
When marshmallows are cool, fold in Dream Whip and pour over cracker crust.
Then top with cherry filling. Refrigerate until time to serve.

title: Oatmeal Pancakes
steps: Combine syrup, milk and egg.
Add pancake mix, oatmeal, shortening and pecans.
Beat lightly until well blended.
Cook on hot greased griddle or skillet.

title: Easy Cheesy Bean Squares

ingredients.name: great northern
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can Great Northern or pinto beans

steps: Combine all ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup grated cheese for topping.
Pour into well-greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set.
Sprinkle with reserved cheese and bake another 5 to 10 minutes until cheese melts.
Allow to set 10 minutes.
Cut into squares.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In a 10-inch cast-iron or heavy ovenproof skillet over medium heat, fry bacon until crisp.
Drain on paper towels and crumble; set aside.
Remove all but 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings from skillet.
Place skillet in oven to keep skillet hot.

title: Hannah'S Cheese Puffs
steps: Arrange 4 bread slices in the bottom of a large greased baking dish.
Cover with a slice of cheese.
Beat the eggs until they are frothy.
Add the milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard, mixing them well.
Pour over the sandwiches.
Heat the oven to 350°.
Place the baking dish in the refrigerator and let it stand until the milk mixture is absorbed by the bread.
Bake for 30 minutes.
The sandwiches will be puffed and lightly brown when done.
Serves 4.

title: Scrumptious Caramel Squares
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt caramels and milk over low heat.
Mix Bisquick, oats and brown sugar.
Stir in melted margarine until crumbly.
Press half of the mixture in ungreased rectangular pan. Bake 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Sprinkle remaining crumbly mixture over chips, nuts and caramel mixture.
Press lightly.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until light golden brown.
Cut in squares.

title: Pookie Cookies

ingredients.name: pillsbury chocolate chip cookie mix
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. Pillsbury chocolate chip cookie mix

steps: Cream together the cream cheese, eggs and sugar.
Cut 24 cookies from first package and lay on a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour cream cheese mixture over cookies.
Cut 24 cookies from second package of cookie mix.
Place on top of mixture.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Cool and top with powdered sugar.

title: No Fail Peanut Butter Fudge

ingredients.name: crunchy
ingredients.raw: 1 c. crunchy or smooth peanut butter

steps: Melt butter Crisco.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix well until peanut butter is melted.
Add confectioners sugar and mix well.
Pour into 8 x 8-inch ungreased baking pan.
Refrigerate until cool.
Melt chocolate chips.
Let cool, then spread on top of fudge.

title: Buttermilk-Coconut Pie

ingredients.name: unbaked dish pastry shell
ingredients.raw: 1 unbaked (9-inch) deep dish frozen pastry shell

steps: Combine first 7 ingredients; pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, shielding with aluminum foil after 25 minutes.

title: Tortellini Alfredo Soup

ingredients.name: stouffer s fettucini alfredo sauce thawed
ingredients.raw: 76 oz. Stouffer's fettucini alfredo sauce, thawed

ingredients.name: stouffer s cheese tortellini in egg pasta
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Stouffer's cheese tortellini in egg pasta

ingredients.name: stouffer s cheese tortellini in spinach pasta
ingredients.raw: 2 c. Stouffer's cheese tortellini in spinach pasta

steps: Place fettucini sauce in a heavy stockpot; add milk, onions, red peppers, carrots, broccoli and black pepper; stir well to combine.
Heat to 160° or until the vegetables are tender; stir frequently.
Stir in the tortellini.
Hold at 160° for service. Garnish with Parmesan cheese.
Yield:
20 to 22 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Quick Milk Soup
steps: Heat milk to boiling in a large pot.
Add dumplings made of Bisquick mix and milk.
Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes and covered, 10 minutes.
Serve with butter and salt to taste.

title: Super Rib Sauce

ingredients.name: firmly light brown sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: Whisk all ingredients together.
Barbecue spareribs, brushing sauce on during last 20 minutes of cooking time.
Use sauce liberally!

title: Lo-Cal Meat Loaf(Crock-Pot)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Shape into round loaf.
Put rack in crock-pot.
Place meat loaf on rack.
Cover and cook on high for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Chicken Livers Smothered In Onions

ingredients.name: chicken fat margarine
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. chicken fat, margarine or butter

ingredients.name: sweet onion about
ingredients.raw: 2 c. sweet onions, sliced about 1/8 inch thick

steps: Cut the chicken livers into bite-size pieces.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and allow to stand a few minutes.
Melt the chicken fat in a large skillet with a tight-fitting lid.
Add chicken livers and saute them until they begin to brown and can be cut with a fork.
Add the onions and mushrooms; cover.
Cook over low heat 10 minutes.
Remove cover and turn up heat slightly. Turn the livers and onions over with a spatula and saute 5 minutes longer or until onions turn golden brown.
Serve at once.
Serves 4.

title: Garlic Parmesan Bread
steps: Mix, knead and let rise.
Bake at 400° for thirty minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Kiwi Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Combine kiwi fruit, banana, yogurt and ice cubes in a blender container.
Process until pureed.
Pour into 2 glasses.
Garnish with strawberries.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Beat shortening and sugars together until creamy.
Add eggs and peanut butter; beat well.
Sift together flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture, mixing well.
Stir in oats.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Press with tines of fork and crisscross.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

title: *Broccoli Cheese Bake

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Press rolls flat in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle cashews over dough.
Put broccoli over the nuts.
Mix remaining ingredients and spread over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Scalloped Potatoes #1
steps: Slice potatoes fairly thin into greased casserole.
Pour mushroom soup over potatoes and mix well.
Pour milk over potatoes. Dot with butter.
Bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°.
Double for company.

title: Richmond Refresher

ingredients.name: strawberry daiquiri mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) cans frozen strawberry daiquiri mix

steps: Combine daiquiri mix and orange juice in blender.
Add enough ice to bring mixture up to 5 cups.
Blend until slushy.

title: Hot Roll Bagels

ingredients.name: poppy
ingredients.raw: 1 to 2 tsp. poppy or sesame seed

steps: In large bowl combine yeast from foil packet with the flour mixture.
Stir in 1 cup hot tap water, egg and margarine, until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface.
With greased or floured hands, shape dough into a ball.
Knead dough for 10 minutes, until smooth. Cover with inverted bowl, let rest for 5 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Yams

ingredients.name: yam
ingredients.raw: 4 (1 lb.) cans yams, drained or use fresh baked or boiled yams

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine sugar, salt and cinnamon in small bowl.
Slice yams 1/4-inch thick; lay in greased ovenproof dish or pan.
Sprinkle melted butter on yams, then the sugar mixture.
Arrange another layer of yams and repeat the sprinkling procedure.
Continue until yams are gone.
Bake 25 minutes or until yams are hot and sugar is bubbly.
Great for the holidays.

title: Cajun Chicken
steps: Crush Doritos and mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Connie'S Shrimp Chowder

ingredients.name: corn
ingredients.raw: 2 cans drained corn or 1 bag frozen corn

steps: Cover potatoes with water and boil with onion flakes, salt, and pepper until tender.
Do not drain. Mash with potato masher. Add corn and shrimp. Cook until shrimp is done. Add half-and-half and sour cream. Simmer to blend flavors. Add chives if desired.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Cover chicken with water and simmer until tender, with the onion and bay leaf.
Remove chicken.
Cut meat from bones, return to kettle.
Add parsley, season and add noodles.

title: Two-Tone Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

steps: In a saucepan, over low heat, melt semi-sweet chocolate chips with 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk, 1 tablespoon cream and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Remove from heat; stir in 1/2 cup walnuts. Spread into aluminum foil-lined 9-inch square pan.
In another saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips with remaining sweetened condensed milk, 1 tablespoon cream and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Remove from heat; stir in remaining 1/2 cup walnuts. Spread over fudge in pan.
Chill 2 hours or until firm.
Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off foil and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Coconut Dreams
steps: Blend salt with flour.
Cream together all ingredients, except honey and cherries or nuts.
Form into 2 rolls and refrigerate. Slice 1/4 inch thick on ungreased cookie sheet.
Brush top with honey and decorate with cherries or nuts.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes, until slightly browned.

title: Easy Bake Chocolate Chewy Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar in mixer bowl.
Add eggs and vanilla; blend well.
Combine with flour and cocoa; stir in nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Strawberry Icebox Cake
steps: Bake cake.
Scratch top of cake with fork so Jell-O can dribble in cake.
Mix Jell-O with 1 cup hot water and then add strawberries. Dribble over cake.
Mix pudding with 3 cups milk as directions on package.
Pour over cake.
Put Cool Whip on top of pudding.
Let set overnight or for a few hours before serving.

title: 7 Layer Cookies(Or Hello Dolly)
steps: Melt margarine in 9 by 13-inch pan.
Add the graham crackers, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and nuts in layers. Do not stir.
Pour 1 can Eagle Brand Milk over other ingredients. Bake at 325 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut in bars.

title: Stripe It Rich Cake

ingredients.name: jell o instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 2 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O instant pudding

steps: Prepare cake mix as directed.
Bake in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Remove from oven and poke holes down through the cake with the round handle of a wooden spoon.
Holes should be at 1-inch intervals.

title: Grandpa Witzel'S Potato Pancakes
steps: Peel and grate potato, then stir in egg and salt.
Fry in a large skillet as one large pancake in a small amount of oil over medium heat, turning once.
The pancake should be rather dark or it won't be cooked through.

title: Yellow Angel Food Cake
steps: Add 1/2 cup sugar to beaten egg whites.
Add 1/3 cup sugar, vanilla, salt, baking powder and flour to egg yolks.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake in ungreased tube pan at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: *Curabie 2

ingredients.name: almond brown in a little butter and fine
ingredients.raw: almonds, browned in a little butter and chopped fine

steps: Beat butter 10 minutes.
Add orange juice, vanilla, egg yolk, whiskey and sugar.
Continue beating.
Add flour and baking powder on low speed and mix until the dough doesn't stick to your hands. Add almonds.
Pat piece of dough to desired thickness and cut with cookie cutter.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Bake until golden on bottom.
Do not brown top.
When cool, sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Makes 45 to 50 cookies.

title: Bean Recipe
steps: Soak beans overnight.
Then cook until tender.
Add rest of ingredients.

title: Barbecued Beefies

ingredients.name: each pepper celery salt and garlic salt
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. each pepper, celery salt and garlic salt

steps: Shape mixture
into
balls.
Place in greased shallow pan. Pour Texas Barbecue Sauce over all.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Delicious Sour Cream Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar thoroughly. Add beaten egg yolks. Add sour cream alternately with flour, salt and baking powder. (Add stiffly beaten egg whites after flour.)
Bake at 375° approximately 45 minutes or 1 hour or until done when tested with a straw. Bake in angel food pan.
(Not necessary to ice, just a little sifted powdered sugar on top.)
Delicious.

title: Frozen Oreo Dessert
steps: Combine crumbs and butter in bowl, mixing well.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread ice cream over crust.
Top with fudge topping.
Spread whipped topping over all.
Freeze until firm. Yields 24 servings.

title: Blackberry Syrup
steps: Bring to boil, boil 6 to 8 minutes.
Seal.

title: Chicken Simon And Garfunkel(From Recipe Box Of Judy Thompson, Houston, Texas)

ingredients.name: salt pepper and paprika
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and paprika (as you like)

ingredients.name: each sage rosemary and thyme
ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. each: sage, rosemary and thyme

steps: Add salt, pepper and paprika as you like to bread crumbs. Make spice mixture of parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme; set aside.
Wrap chicken breasts in cheese slices.
Roll in bread crumb mixture.
Place in greased baking dish.
Pour butter and spice mixture over chicken pieces.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Add wine and bake another 30 minutes.
Time may be shortened for small pieces, such as tenders.

title: Cajun Fried Chicken

ingredients.name: cajun seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. Cajun seasoning or mix 1 tsp. paprika, 1/2 tsp. each: garlic and onion powders, 1/4 tsp. salt and dried thyme leaves and 1/8 tsp. pepper

ingredients.name: chicken breast half fillet all crosswise
ingredients.raw: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves fillets, all pieces halved crosswise

steps: In large skillet, heat 1/2-inch oil to 400°.
In large bowl, mix flour, seasoning and 1 teaspoon salt.
In another bowl, mix egg, milk and pepper sauce.
Sprinkle chicken with remaining salt. Coat with egg mixture; drain off excess.
Coat with flour; shake off excess.
In hot oil, fry chicken 6 minutes or until browned and cooked.
Drain.

title: Oriental Cole Slaw

ingredients.name: cabbage mixed with green onion and any other veggy you normally use
ingredients.raw: 1 head cabbage, mixed with green onions and any other veggies you normally use

steps: Cook dressing until blended and smooth.
Toss with cabbage mixture at any time, but mix in 1 package Top Ramen noodles just before serving.

title: Caramel-Pineapple Whip Cream
steps: In a saucepan, place the two cans of condensed milk.
Cover with cold water.
Place lid on saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Turn heat down to simmer (you will hear the water rumble).
Boil for 2 hours and 15 minutes.
Place cans in refrigerator overnight.
Next day open cans on both ends.
The caramel will slide out.
Cut caramel into slices.
Place a slice of caramel on a pineapple ring; top with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Surprise Cake
steps: Bake strawberry cake mix as directed on package.
When cake is finished baking, poke holes all over top of cake with a fork.
Mix together remaining ingredients.
Pour strawberry mixture over top of cake.
Let cool and add topping.

title: Cheesy Beef Corn Bread
steps: Mix corn meal, salt, soda, corn, eggs, oil and onion (if desired) well.
Pour 1/2 of mixture in greased pan (I use an iron skillet).
Mixture will be a thick consistency.
Sprinkle seasoned (salt and pepper) ground beef on top.
Add cheese and top with remaining batter mixture.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Potato Cakes
steps: Peel and boil potatoes.
Mash well. Add salt, pepper and egg yolks.
Mix.
Fold in the beaten egg whites.
Place mixture in a well-greased pan and bake for 35 to 40 minutes in a preheated oven at 400°.
Cut in squares and serve hot with meat and other vegetables.

title: Killer Chocolate Cake
steps: Sprinkle nuts and coconut over bottom of floured and greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cake mix per package directions.
Pour over nuts and coconut.
Melt margarine; add cream cheese and sugar; mix together.
Pour this over top of cake mix and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Rotten Coconut Cake
steps: Cook cake mix for 3-layer cake according to directions.
Mix together sour cream, Cool Whip, sugar and coconut.
Chill in refrigerator, then spread on cake.
Refrigerate cake until served. Gets better as it sets.

title: Shrimp Boil

ingredients.name: or unpeeled potato in half
ingredients.raw: 4 or 5 unpeeled potatoes, cut in half

ingredients.name: hillshire farm sausage up
ingredients.raw: 2 large Hillshire Farm sausages, cut up

ingredients.name: shrimp well and left in shell
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. shrimp, rinsed well and left in shell

steps: Bring water and bag to a boil.
Add potatoes and boil for 20 minutes.
Remove shrimp bag and add corn and boil for 20 more minutes.
Add sausages and boil for 8 minutes more, then add shrimp and boil 4 more minutes after this; drain off all water and spread onto table that has been covered with paper sacks.
Serve with cocktail sauce and tartar sauce.
Use paper plates and there is no clean up except one pot.

title: Two-Tomato Salad
steps: In large bowl with wire whisk or fork, beat chopped basil, oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and sugar until blended; set aside. In 5-quart saucepan over high heat, heat 3 quarts of water to boiling.
Fill a large bowl with ice water.
Meanwhile, cut small "x" in stem end of each cherry tomato.
Add 1 pint cherry tomatoes to boiling water.
After 5 seconds, with slotted spoon, remove tomatoes to ice water to cool them.
Repeat with remaining cherry tomatoes, heating water in saucepot to boiling before adding each pint of cherry tomatoes and adding more ice to water in large bowl as needed.

title: Cheese Puff Surprises
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a medium mixing bowl, blend cheese with margarine.
Stir in flour, salt and paprika; mix well.
Wrap a teaspoon of mixture around each olive.
Bake on cookie sheet for 15 minutes.
Yield: 48 pastries.

title: Plain Cucumber Pickles
steps: Heat vinegar
and
water.
Add cucumbers and heat until cucumbers turn
their
color (do not boil).
Pack cucumbers in pint jars and add 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon sugar.
Cover with hot mixture and seal.

title: Pineapple-Orange Cooler
steps: Mix all but ginger ale and soda water.
Add ginger ale and soda water (chilled) just before serving.
Garnish with orange slices.
Add crushed ice.
The best I have ever served.

title: Breakfast In A Glass
steps: Slice banana into blender jar.
Add all remaining ingredients and blend at high speed 1 minute.

title: Magic French Fudge

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. (6 oz. each) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: In top of double boiler, melt chocolate chips over hot water. Remove from heat; add condensed milk, vanilla, salt and nuts. Stir until smooth.
Turn into wax paper lined 8-inch square pan. Chill.
Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken And Bows

ingredients.name: chicken cutlet up
ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. chicken cutlets, cut up

steps: In large skillet, heat oil and brown chicken.
Add onion, mushrooms and garlic and cook until vegetables are tender.
Add tomatoes, wine, salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer, covered, 45 minutes on low.

title: Shaggy Dogs
steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil.
Then pour over the Rice Krispies and nuts.
Make into balls and roll in 1 can coconut. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Tuna Casserole Sandwiches(Microwave)

ingredients.name: tuna fish
ingredients.raw: 1 small can tuna fish (in water), drained

steps: Mix tuna fish with soup.
Spread on toasted bread.
Add onion powder and grated cheese.
Cook on High for 15 seconds.

title: Turnovers
steps: Mix until it makes a firm dough. Roll out into 6 in.

circles. Put your favorite filling (example; cooked meat, fruit, vegetables, etc.) in the middle. Brush water halfway around the edge of each. Draw both sides to the center over the filling to seal. Crimp the edges and brush all over with beaten egg. Bake on cookie sheet at 400° 25-30 min. until well browned. Serve hot or cold. If you wish to fry them do not brush with egg. Deep fry 5-6 min.

title: Vegetable Bars

ingredients.name: each green onion broccoli carrot tomato cauliflower and cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. each: green onions, broccoli, carrots, tomatoes, cauliflower and Cheddar cheese

steps: Take the crescent dinner rolls and press on a greased 13 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Mix cream cheese, sour cream and Hidden Valley Ranch party dip in a small bowl.
Chop fine and pat dry with paper towels:
onions, broccoli, carrots, tomatoes (cut and drained), cauliflower and Cheddar cheese.
Spread cheese mixture on rolls.
Sprinkle chopped vegetables on top and chill for 3 hours.
Cut into finger size squares and serve.

title: Tasty Punch
steps: Boil sugar in hot water for 1 minute.
Cool.
Add fruit juices and pineapple.
Chill.

title: Easy Fantasy Fudge

ingredients.name: semi sweet real chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet real chocolate chips

steps: Mix margarine, sugar and milk in a heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan; bring to a full boil, stirring constantly.
Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234°, stirring constantly to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat.
Gradually stir in chips until melted.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into greased 9-inch square or 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Cool at room temperature; cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Texas Pecan Cake

ingredients.name: baking soda dissolved in tbsp. warm water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 4 Tbsp. warm water

steps: Cream butter and sugar well.
Beat egg yolks well and add to butter and sugar mixture.
Add a little flour, the soda dissolved in water and lemon extract.
Add a little more flour.

title: Green Bean And Yogurt Casserole
steps: Place beans in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and drain.
Put beans in a one-quart casserole dish coated with cooking spray.
Set aside and keep warm.

title: Sugarless Health Cookies

ingredients.name: seedless raisin in hot water
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. seedless raisins, softened in hot water

steps: Cream butter or margarine.
Chop dates and walnuts.
Sift soda and flour.
Beat egg and sweetener.
Combine all ingredients and drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Be sure to get 18 cookies.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Garden Variety Dip

ingredients.name: dry roasted peanut
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. finely chopped dry roasted unsalted peanuts

steps: Combine ingredients, adding salt as an option.
Chill 2 to 3 hours.
Makes about 2 cups.

title: Linguini Carbonara
steps: Start cooking pasta.
Meanwhile, cube bacon and cook until transparent.
Add onion and cook until slightly brown and crisp. Drain fat; add wine and simmer 5 minutes.
Set aside.

title: Fruit And Cream Cheese Salad
steps: Drain fruit cocktail, reserving juice.
Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup.
Dissolve gelatin in the 2 cups boiling water.
Add the juice mixture.
Take 2 1/4 cups of this mixture and chill until thickened.
Blend remaining gelatin slowly into softened cream cheese and cinnamon, beating until smooth.
Set aside.
Add fruit cocktail to thickened gelatin and pour into 6 cup mold or 10 individual molds.
Chill until set but not firm, about 15 minutes.
Top with cream cheese and gelatin mixture. Chill until firm, about 3 hours.
Unmold.
Makes about 10 servings.

title: Fastest Cake In The West
steps: Mix all ingredients in an ungreased baking dish (9 x 13-inch). If apple pie filling is used, add 1 teaspoon allspice.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Honey Walleye
steps: In shallow bowl, beat egg; add honey.
In plastic bag, combine crackers and salt.
Smash crackers until fine.
Coat fillets in egg.
Place in bag and shake.
Cook fillets in oil, 3 to 5 minutes a side.
Serve with lemon wedge.

title: Sue Lee'S Stir-Fried Cabbage

ingredients.name: green bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 large green bell pepper, cut into strips

steps: Stir-fry vegetables over 350° in wok or large skillet.
Cook for 7 to 8 minutes.
Cover; reduce heat and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, depending on how crispy you want your cabbage.
This is a real good diet day dish with baked chicken or anything else for that matter.

title: German Baked Beans(Serves 6)

ingredients.name: bacon brown and
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. bacon, chopped, browned and drained

steps: Wash and drain sauerkraut.
Add all other ingredients; mix well.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours, covered.

title: Chocolate Peanut Bars
steps: Combine sugar and syrup until it comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla.
Add cereal and press into buttered 9-inch square pan.
Melt chocolate bars and butterscotch pieces and spread on top.

title: Five Fruit Salad
steps: Drain pineapple chunks, reserve 1 tablespoon syrup.
Combine pineapple chunks, reserve syrup, mandarin oranges, coconut, marshmallows and sour cream.
Chill for 2 hours to 24 hours. Before serving sprinkle with pecans.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Mr. M'S Munchy Mouth Snack
steps: Spread apple slices lightly with a layer of peanut butter. Sprinkle marshmallows on top of the peanut butter.
These can be sandwiched together.
Finish off this snack with a big glass of milk because they tend to stick to the roof of your mouth.

title: Stuffed Hog Maw
steps: Clean the stomach and remove membranes.
Mix potatoes, onion, celery, cabbage, sausage and seasonings.
Stuff the stomach as tightly as you can and sew up.
Bake in large roaster with cover on at 325° for 3 hours.
Brown, uncovered, for last 10 minutes.
Gravy may be made and served with it.

title: Blueberry Angel Dessert
steps: Beat egg whites and tartar until frothy.
Add sugar and beat on high until it stiffens.
Add or stir in crackers, nuts and flavoring.
Spread in cookie sheets and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Let cool completely.
Spread with large Cool Whip.
Make a cradle inside and spread with 1 can blueberry pie filling. Chill 4 hours or overnight.

title: Company Strata

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Cut doughnut shapes out of bread.
Fit scraps (crust removed) in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer cheese, broccoli and diced ham over bread.
Arrange doughnuts and holes on top.
Combine eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard.
Pour over bread.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake uncovered at 325° for 55 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: No Peek Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350° for 30 minutes.
Beat egg whites stiff with cream of tartar.
Slowly add sugar and vanilla.
When stiff, fold in chocolate chips.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto foil-lined cookie sheet.
Put all cookies in oven at the same time.
Close the door and turn off the oven.
Leave cookies in oven 8 hours or overnight.

title: Southwestern Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: ro tel tomato and green chily
ingredients.raw: 2 cans Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Put all together in a large pot and cook for a couple of hours on low.
Serve over Tostitos chips, crumbled up.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top.

title: Broccoli Rice Bake
steps: Cook celery and onion in margarine until golden.
Combine soup, water and cheese spread.
Thaw broccoli over hot water in top of double boiler.
Combine all ingredients.
Place in a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn Casserole

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. can whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Melt margarine; add to beaten eggs and remaining ingredients and mix well.
Place in a greased pan (7 x 11-inch) and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
The casserole is ready to eat when brown on top and not soggy in the center.
Serves 10.

title: Cheesy Sausage Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brown sausage and crumble; drain well. Mix soup and water.
Stir sausage into soup mixture.
Add Bisquick and stir just until all ingredients are moistened.
Spray small muffin tins with nonstick spray.
Fill muffin tins with batter.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Beef Skillet Supreme

ingredients.name: italian green bean
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen Italian cut green beans

steps: Cube beef and brown in salad oil.
Add chopped onion, celery and bell pepper; brown.
Mix together the water, cornstarch and soy sauce; add to mixture.
Add the mushrooms and green beans and cook for 10 or 12 minutes or until beans are done, stirring occasionally.
Serve over cooked Minute rice.

title: Polish Soup
steps: Cook roast, cabbage, carrots and onions together for about 2 hours; add potatoes and cook on low heat another hour.
Add chicken and broth; cook low for 1 more hour.
Serve over noodles. Sprinkle with parsley flakes.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: each broccoli floweret red pepper and carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 c. each broccoli flowerets, red pepper strips and carrot slices

steps: Heat oil in skillet over high heat.
Cut chicken into strips. Add to skillet with garlic.
Stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add vegetables. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 1 minute.
Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake And Icing

ingredients.name: soda dissolved in c. boiling water
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time.
Beat well after each is added.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Add chocolate and vanilla.
Add water and soda last.
Bake at 350° in a greased and floured 1 x 12 x 15-inch pan.

title: Milk Shake
steps: Beat eggs with a beater until foamy.
Add vanilla, salt and sugar.
Add milk and mix in a blender.
Serve cold with cinnamon or nutmeg.
Makes enough for four people.

title: Mary'S Turkey
steps: Boil chicken in water until tender, but does not fall off the bone.
Remove from water and cover with your choice of barbecue sauce.
Let stand in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours or overnight. Place on grill and finish cooking, turning several times.

title: Out Of This World Cherry Pie

ingredients.name: pie crust baked
ingredients.raw: 2 large pie crusts, baked or graham cracker

steps: In saucepan, combine pie filling, sugar, pineapple and cornstarch.
Cook until thick.
Remove from heat; add Jell-O. Stir to blend and cool.
Add bananas and nuts.
Pour into crusts and top with whipped cream.

title: Mini Muffin Tins
steps: Blend cream cheese and margarine together.
Cut in flour as with pie crust.
Form into a ball and chill.
Roll out, cut and press into mini muffin tins.

title: Chicken And Biscuits Pot Pie

ingredients.name: pea and carrot
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can peas and carrots, drained

steps: Rinse chicken.
Cook in water to cover in saucepan until tender.
Bone and chop chicken; reserve broth.
Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bring soup, 1 soup can reserved broth and tarragon to a boil in saucepan, stirring to mix well.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle peas and carrots over soup mixture.
Spread Biscuit Topping evenly over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.
Yield:
6 servings.

title: Baked Chicken Breast
steps: Mix thyme or parsley with pepper and corn flake crumbs.
Dip chicken in milk and then in crumb mixture.
Place chicken in baking dish that has been lightly oiled with olive oil.
Bake, covered, 50 to 55 minutes at 400°.
Serves 6.
Is low in sodium and fat.

title: Best Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cream butter and sugar until well blended.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
Add flour, beating well (at least 10 minutes).
Bake for 1 hour or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Baked Spinach Casserole
steps: Drain spinach.
Cook celery and onion in a little margarine. Mix with remaining ingredients, saving cheese crumbs for topping. Bake at 275° until it smells good, about 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie Filling
steps: Fill pumpkin can with evaporated milk plus fill it with regular milk.
Bake at 400° for 5 minutes, then at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Watermelon Slush Punch
steps: Boil sugar and water until clear and sugar is dissolved; set aside.
In blender, blend watermelon, salt, lemon juice, food coloring and lime juice.
Add sugar syrup.
Freeze at least 24 hours.
Break into chunks and place in glasses.
Pour 7-Up over chunks, blending in slush.

title: Brown Raisin Cake (Dutch)(Like A Quick Bread.)

ingredients.name: raisin
ingredients.raw: 1 c. raisins, or mix currants, chopped dates and raisins

steps: Bake at 350° for 1 hour for regular loaf pan.
I use half-size loaf pans and make 2 small loaves and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fresh Gooseberry Pie
steps: Mix together sugar, flour and whipping cream.
Combine with gooseberries.
Pour into prepared crust and bake until crust is brown and filling set.
Delicious.

title: Quick Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large can unsweetened, crushed pineapple, drained

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding (put in dry)

steps: Put vanilla pudding in Cool Whip.
Mix until pudding is not grainy.
Add fruit and it's ready to serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake With Caramel Glaze
steps: Combine cooking oil and sugar.
Add well beaten eggs and vanilla (or cinnamon).
Measure and sift together the flour, salt and soda.
Add dry ingredients to first mixture.
Stir in apples and nuts; combine thoroughly.
Pour into tube or loaf pan; bake at 350°.

title: Granny Deavers Spoon Bread
steps: Slowly add cornmeal to boiling water, stirring constantly until thick and smooth.
Add butter and salt; cool to lukewarm. Then add eggs and milk.
Beat for 2 minutes.
Pour into greased casserole and bake in preheated 375° oven for 35 minutes or until golden brown.
Spoon out while piping hot and pass more butter.

title: Frozen Pops
steps: Dissolve Jell-O, Kool-Aid and sugar in boiling water.
Add cold water; stir well.
Pour into ice cube trays, small paper cups or frozen pop molds.

title: Beef Barley Soup
steps: Brown beef in oil in a Dutch oven.
Add water.
Bring to a boil and skim off foam.
Simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour or until beef and barley are tender.

title: Potato Hot Dish

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup

steps: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot Pasta Salad
steps: Cook twist pasta according to box directions.
Drain and rinse both kinds of beans and add to the pasta.
Cook broccoli just until tender and drain before adding to the pasta.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer to heat through before serving.

title: Hot Apple Wassail
steps: Wash orange well.
Do not peel.
Cover thickly with whole cloves stuck through the skin and bake the orange in a small pan for 45 minutes at 350 F.
Place the orange, two cinnamon sticks, and about 1/2 c of the candies in a large crock pot with the apple juice.
Turn on high and let it sit until very hot, and candies have melted.
Serve in small cups.

title: Lemon Caper Chicken
steps: Combine flour, paprika and pepper on a plate.
Press chicken into mixture, coating evenly and then shake off excess.
In a heavy 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes on each side.
Do not overcook.
Place on heated platter.
Add chicken broth to skillet, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom. Stir in the lemon juice and capers and heat through.
Pour sauce over chicken breasts and serve.
Serves 4.

title: Saucepan Brownies
steps: In a large saucepan, melt chocolate chips and butter over low heat.
Stir until well blended.
Remove from heat and add biscuit mix, milk and egg.
Stir well until all lumps are gone.
Add nuts. Put in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Icing(Good)
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Boil 1 minute; remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Cool.
Beat until creamy; spread on cake.

title: Cocktail Mushrooms

ingredients.name: good season italian salad dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian salad dressing

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 jars whole mushrooms (4 1/2 oz. size jar), drained

steps: Mix ingredients together and add mushrooms.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Pour off sauce and serve mushrooms with toothpicks.

title: Potatoes And Onions
steps: Slice potatoes thin and onions.
Layer alternately.
Add butter, salt and pepper.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.
May be cooked on gas grill.

title: Herbed French Bread

ingredients.name: salt garlic and herb seasoning
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. salt-free garlic and herb seasoning

ingredients.name: loaf unsliced french bread
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) loaf unsliced French bread, cut into 1-inch slices

steps: Combine butter and seasonings; spread between bread slices and place loaf on a baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: French Onion Soup(Serves 4)

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. beef broth (1 qt. boiling water and 1 bouillon cube)

steps: Thinly slice onions and brown in butter.
Add broth, Worcestershire sauce, brandy and a dash of salt and pepper. Simmer until onions are tender. Serve into oven-safe bowls. Sprinkle croutons on top of soup and cover with cheese.
Place in oven at 550° until cheese is fully melted and slightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Sour Cream 'N' Chicken(Yields 8 Servings)

ingredients.name: dill
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. fresh dill or 1 tsp. dill weed

steps: Place chicken in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle with pepper.
Combine soup, soup mix, sour cream, lemon juice, dill and mushrooms; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hole-In-One Peppers
steps: Precook the green pepper shells in boiling salted water 5 minutes. Drain and cool.
Mix pork and beans, wieners, onion, brown sugar, catsup and mustard.
Fill shells and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Skillet Beans
steps: In a nonstick skillet, melt margarine.
Add onion and pepper. Cook until tender.
Add ground beef.
Continue to cook until done, not brown.
Drain.
Add beans, sauces, corn and ketchup and cook about 15 minutes.
If it becomes too dry, add a little water.

title: Larkin'S Shrimp Dip

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1 can shrimp, drained or 1 c. salad shrimp

steps: Use food processor.
Mix all ingredients except shrimp.
Mix shrimp in last.
Mix lightly, leaving shrimp in small pieces.
Dip is excellent on crackers, as a chip dip or on bread or toast.

title: Chicken Devon

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and slightly seasoned
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, skinned and slightly seasoned

steps: Bake chicken 1 1/2 hours at 350°, covered.
Remove from oven. Arrange broccoli under chicken breasts in baking pan.

title: Spotted Dick
steps: Mix flour, salt and baking powder.
Add the margarine, sugar and currants.
Mix with sufficient milk to make a soft dough. Place dough in a greased basin, filling it 2/3 full and cover with wax paper and foil.
Steam in a covered saucepan for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with a custard sauce or sprinkled with brown sugar.

title: Cranberry And Ginger Ale Punch

ingredients.name: lemon and
ingredients.raw: 1 lemon, washed and cut into 8 slices

steps: Put cranberry juice and ginger ale into a large punch bowl. Add ice.
Decorate with lemon slices with a cherry placed in the center of each slice.

title: Energy Recipe
steps: Peel the apples.
Take out the core and the seeds.
Cut into small pieces.
Put apples into a blender or food processor.
Add the orange juice.
Add the cinnamon to the apples and the orange juice.
Blend until the mixture is creamy.
Spoon into cups or bowls.
Makes four servings.

title: Chicken Marsala With Cream Sauce(Serves 4)
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large saucepan; add chicken, salt and pepper.
Cook on both sides.
Remove from pan.
Melt remaining butter; add shallots and mushrooms.
Cook until mushrooms are soft. Add wine; bring to a boil, stirring up bottom of pan.
Add cream and lemon juice; return to a boil.
Pour over cooked chicken.

title: Noodle Pudding *
steps: Cook noodles 5 minutes and drain.
Combine all other ingredients with hand mixer.
Grease 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Mix noodles with ingredients.
Sprinkle top with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
If this is to be frozen, bake 40 minutes, then, when ready to eat, bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Bars
steps: In a large bowl, combine the first four ingredients; set aside.
In a saucepan, bring the corn syrup and sugar to a boil, stirring frequently.
Remove from the heat; stir in peanut butter and vanilla.
Pour over cereal mixture and toss to coat evenly. Spread into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Cool.
Cut into 3 x 3-inch bars.

title: Ripley Tomatoes
steps: In a buttered 2-quart casserole mix tomatoes and 2 cups stuffing together.
Stir in onion, sugar and seasonings.
Dot with oleo.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Drambuie Pecan Rounds(Makes 4 Dozen)
steps: In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg and 3 tablespoons Drambuie.
Slowly add flour and mix well.
Shape dough into a 12-inch log.
Wrap dough in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour or until firm.
Cut dough into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack.

title: Spicy Drop Cookies
steps: In a bowl, cream together sugar and shortening.
Add egg and stir.
In small bowl, dissolve baking soda in molasses.
Stir into creamed mixture. Add the dry ingredients. Stir well. Form into balls.
Place onto cookie sheet. Flatten.
Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 12 minutes.

title: Colorado Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle a lot of grated Parmesan cheese on top.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Lemon Haddock
steps: Cut fish into serving size pieces.
Place in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients; sprinkle over fish.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry And Cream Squares
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add berries, stirring occasionally until thawed.
Add pineapple; pour half the mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
Spoon sour cream over chilled gelatin, spreading in an even layer.
Pour remaining gelatin over; chill until firm.

title: Quick Cranberry Relish
steps: In small mixing bowl, stir together cranberry sauce, 1/2 of walnuts, raisins, cinnamon and cloves.
Cover and chill cranberry mixture thoroughly in refrigerator.
Stir mixture before serving. Sprinkle remaining walnuts over top before serving.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Rhubarb Marmalade
steps: Combine juices and water with rhubarb.
Bring to a boil and add pectin.
Stir until pectin is dissolved and add the sugar. Boil gently for 5 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Medley
steps: Heat electric wok or skillet at 325° for 2 to 3 minutes; add oil and heat 1 minute.
Add celery, onion and broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add cabbages and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Cover and cook vegetables over low heat 3 minutes.
Stir in salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.

title: Buttermint Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple with juice
ingredients.raw: 20 oz. can crushed pineapple with juice

ingredients.name: buttermint coarsely or
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. buttermints (about 1 c.), coarsely crushed or chopped

steps: Mix together the dry jello, pineapple with juice and marshmallows.
Refrigerate overnight.
Two to three hours before serving, fold in buttermints and Cool Whip.
Refrigerate until serving.
Very sweet, but delicious!

title: Aunt Almeda'S Caramel Corn
steps: In a saucepan place sugar, oleo, salt and syrup; bring to a boil.
Boil 5 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon baking soda.
Pour over popcorn on a large baking sheet.
Stir well.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir well every 15 minutes.

title: Mom'S 24 Hour Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen unsweetened strawberries or 1 pt. fresh medium strawberries, washed

steps: Combine peach pie filling, pineapple, mandarin oranges, strawberries and apples.
Cover and place in refrigerator overnight.
One hour before serving, add kiwi and banana.
Serves 15.

title: Pink Poodle Pie
steps: Mix lemonade with milk.
Fold in other remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shells.
Chill and serve.

title: Peanut Butter And Crackers(Men Only)
steps: Place 4 crackers on a tablecloth.
Smooth peanut butter over them; add jam, jelly or honey.
Top with remaining crackers.
Lay a knife on tablecloth.
Leave top off honey, jam or jelly, whichever you use.
Stay out of house until wife "cools-off"!

title: Frozen Banana Smoothy
steps: Place all ingredients into a blender.
Blend until smooth. Experiment with different amounts of fruit, yogurt and juice--to your taste and texture.

title: Pork Stir-Fry
steps: Slice pork into 1/8-inch strips.
Marinate in soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in skillet until hot.
Add pork and stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes. Add vegetables
(unthawed) and the chicken broth or water.
Stir all together.
Cover and steam for 3 minutes until vegetables are heated through, yet still crisp and tender.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Edward'S Mansion Orange Muffins
steps: Mix together all dry ingredients.
Add butter, shortening, milk, eggs and orange juice.
Mix thoroughly.
Spoon batter into greased muffin pans until 2/3 full.
Top each muffin with an orange section.
Bake in 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen muffins.

title: Kirsten Potatoes
steps: Peel, quarter and slice potatoes.
Cook in boiling salted water (boil water, then add potatoes) for 5 minutes (no longer or potatoes will become mushy).
Drain.
Spread out in greased casserole.
Pour butter mixture (last 4 ingredients) over all and stir to coat.
Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ritz Delights
steps: Cook dates, pecans and milk on low heat, stirring constantly. Cook approximately 3 minutes.
Spread on Ritz crackers (approximately 60 to 70).
Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

title: Creamy Onion And Potato Soup
steps: Melt butter in Dutch oven over low heat. Add flour, stirring until smoothy. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook 1 minute.
Gradually add the chicken broth, stirring constantly. Add potatoes and salt.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Add milk and heat.

title: Norwegian Betasuppe

ingredients.name: ham hock
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ham hocks or 1/2 c. finely chopped ham

ingredients.name: each potato rutabaga and celery root
ingredients.raw: 2 c. each: potatoes, diced, rutabaga and celery root

steps: Combine peas, ham hocks or ham, onion, thyme and water.
Add potatoes, rutabaga, celery root, leek and salt.
Combine ingredients in a large Dutch oven and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add vegies and salt and cook for another 30 to 45 minutes.
If using ham hocks, remove, trim, cut finely and return to the soup!

title: Bill'S Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel, cook and dice potatoes.
Cook chopped onion in milk. Do not let boil.
Melt stick of butter in hot onion milk mixture. Mash potatoes with the hot onion milk butter mixture.
Beat until creamy.
Put cool potatoes in individual packages and store in freezer.
When ready to use, thaw out,
place in Corning Ware dish and reheat in a steamer.
Will taste like fresh mashed potatoes.

title: Beet Relish
steps: Grind the beets, onions and green peppers.
Tie the cloves in a cheesecloth bag.
In a large kettle, combine the vegetables, clove bag, sugar, vinegar, 1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove clove bag.
Ladle into hot jars and adjust lids.
Put in boiling water bath for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage: One Dish Meal
steps: Boil rice and onions together for 12 to 15 minutes in water. In bottom of casserole, put rice and onions.
Add corn for next layer.
Mix tomatoes with tomato paste; pour over top.
Punch with a fork to distribute evenly.
Put sausage* on top.
Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Cherry-Apple Drink
steps: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Add lemonade, apple juice and ice water and stir.
Makes about 1 gallon.

title: Artichoke Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Place hearts in casserole; sprinkle with next 5 ingredients. Add soup; stir to coat.
Mix together oil and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over top.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Elva Sorenson'S Almond Drink(Russian Tea)
steps: Put sugar and 3 cups of water in gallon size pan.
Stir until dissolved over medium heat.
Add orange juice, lemonade and enough water to make 1 gallon.
When dissolved, add vanilla and almond extract.
Can be served hot or cold.

title: Grilled Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Cut thin slice from stem end of each tomato; remove pulp to form shallow cups.
Remove seeds and chop tomato pulp.
Combine with 2 tablespoons cheese, 1 tablespoons parsley and pepper.
Fill tomato cups with mixture.
Combine bread crumbs, remaining cheese and parsley.
Spoon mixture evenly over filling.
Place in disposable foil pan.
Cover loosely with foil.
Cook over medium coals 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Pecan Praline Bars

ingredients.name: graham cracker x section
ingredients.raw: 24 graham crackers, broken into 1 1/2 x 3-inch sections

ingredients.name: light brown sugar firmly
ingredients.raw: 1 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed

steps: Line 12 x 18-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with aluminum foil.
Place graham crackers on foil bringing foil up to form edges for crackers.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Boil brown sugar and margarine cubes together for 3 or 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Add pecans and spread evenly over crackers.
Bake 10 minutes in preheated oven.
When cool, cut along indentations of graham crackers.
Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: No-Cook Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix all above ingredients and marinate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Cook your favorite pasta (ziti) and toss with tomato sauce while still hot.

title: Scotch Scones
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Blend in butter.
Add sour milk.
Turn out onto floured board.
Pat or roll gently to 1/2 to 1-inch thick in a rectangle about 4 x 8 inches.
Cut in 16 triangles.
Place on baking sheet.
Brush with egg wash.
Bake in hot oven (400°) about 15 minutes.
Makes 16 scones.

title: Sally Lunn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350° 10 minutes before baking.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Heat milk, shortening and water to very warm.
Blend 1 1/3 cups flour with sugar, salt and dry yeast in large bowl.
Blend warm liquids into flour at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add 2/3 cup remaining flour and eggs and beat at high speed for 2 minutes.
Add rest of flour and mix well.
Cover and let rise until double, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Punch down and turn into prepared pan.
Cover and let rise about 30 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Grasshopper Dessert

ingredients.name: vanilla yogurt
ingredients.raw: 3 pt. softened vanilla yogurt or ice cream

steps: Mix cracker crumbs and melted butter together for crust.
Pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Mix all other ingredients, except Cool Whip and nuts.
Pour over cracker crumbs.
Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts.
Freeze for at least 3 hours.

title: Dill Weed Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Must be Hellmann's (do not substitute).
This dip tastes better if you make it the night before and refrigerate.

title: Brown Jug Cheese Soup

ingredients.name: broccoli and cauliflower
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) bag frozen broccoli and cauliflower

steps: Cook first 4 ingredients in a large pot for 20 minutes.
Add potatoes and frozen vegetables.
Cook another 20 minutes. Add soup and cheese.
Stir often until cheese melts, cooking on low heat. Delicious!

title: Hoppin John Soup
steps: Fry sausage and drain. Add peas and juice, onion, salt, pepper, water and sausage.
Bring to a boil and cook on medium heat 30 to 45 minutes.
Add cooked rice and let simmer 10 minutes.

title: Meringue Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 200°.
Put egg whites and salt in bowl of mixer.
Beat until foamy.
Gradually add sugar until 1 1/4 cups have been added.
Beat until not grainy.
Fold in remaining 1/4 cup sugar and the vanilla into meringue.
Fill a pastry bag with mixture and pipe onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 1 hour until completely dry.
Remove from pan and put on rack to cool. Fill each cup with Lemon Curd and top with fresh strawberries.

title: Super Supper Casserole

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable and seasoned then
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked and seasoned, then drained

steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Place cooked, drained mixed vegetables, ground beef and tomato soup in greased casserole dish.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Citrus Chicken
steps: Place chicken breasts in a well greased casserole dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Hot Potato Salad
steps: Mix mayonnaise and bacon and add to potatoes, onion and Cheddar cheese.
Place olives on top.
Bake at 425°
for 45 minutes (uncovered).

title: Baked Apple Slices For Diabetics And Dieters

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 6 to 7 c. sliced apples (choose ripe sweet apples)

steps: Combine apples, spices and tapioca in baking dish.
Dot with butter and bake in 350° oven until bubbly and tender.

title: Mushroom Cream Cheese Hors D'Oeuvres
steps: Mince mushrooms.
Combine with cream cheese and seasoned salt. Divide crescent rolls into 4 rectangles.
Spread cream cheese mixture.
Roll up lengthwise and cut each in 4 pieces.
Brush lightly with beaten egg and sprinkle with poppy seed.
Bake until light golden brown at 375° (12 to 15 minutes).

title: Light, Hot 'N' Sassy Buffalo Wings

ingredients.name: chicken breast split boned skinned and up
ingredients.raw: 3 chicken breasts, split, boned, skinned and cut up into strips

steps: Blend dry ingredients.
Place in shallow bowl.
Beat egg whites with pepper sauce.
Coat chicken strips with oats.
Dip in egg mixture and then in oats.
Place in broiler rack, sprayed with Pam to coat.
Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes.
Remove from oven; turn over.
Spray with Pam.
Return to oven; cook 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Serve with light Ranch dressing as dip.

title: Corton
steps: Place ground pork in a large pan and cover 1/2-inch above meat with water. Boil for 1 hour, keeping water to meat level. Add garlic and onion salt. After boiling for 1 hour, add allspice and cloves.
Continue to boil and simmer for another hour.
When done simmering, pour into bowl and let cool completely before refrigerating.

title: Raisin Cream Pie
steps: Boil raisins and water slowly until most of the water is taken up.
Add the 1 1/2 cup milk; mix remaining ingredients with the 1/2 cup of half and half and add to the raisins and cook until thick.
Top with meringue from egg whites.

title: Quick And Easy Meat Loaf

ingredients.name: green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small green pepper, cut into 8 pieces

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Tear each bread slice into 6 pieces. Put it into food processor and crumb bread.
Transfer to large bowl.
Chop green pepper and quartered onion fine and add to chopped bread pieces.
Add with ground beef, salt and pepper. Combine egg and milk.
Mix all meat mixture and blend ingredients thoroughly by hand.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Glazed Graham Crackers
steps: Combine sugar, oleo, pecans and vanilla
in a saucepan. Boil for 3 minutes. Split graham crackers about 40 small pieces. Put on cookie sheet and pour glaze over graham crackers. Bake at 300 degrees for 12 minutes. Put on wax paper.

title: Porcupines

ingredients.name: tomato sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. tomato sauce or tomatoes or tomato juice

steps: Mix all ingredients, except tomatoes, and form into balls. Brown in skillet.
Add tomato sauce.
Cover and cook at low temperature until rice is done (about 1 1/2 hours).

title: Charoset, Mid-East Style *
steps: Cook dates with honey in water for about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently until smooth.
Stir and combine with rest of ingredients. Makes 1 cup.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: In saucepan, blend together butter, flour, salt and cheese. Add milk all at once.
Cook and stir until mixture boils.
Stir in broccoli.
Turn into 1-quart casserole, top with crumbs.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 people.

title: Chocolate Orange Sauce

ingredients.name: hershey s premium semi sweet chocolate
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. Hershey's premium semi-sweet chocolate chunks

steps: In medium microwave-safe bowl, place all ingredients. Microwave on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until smooth when stirred. Serve warm sauce over hot poached pears.
Makes about 1/2 cup sauce.

title: Chesapeake Bay Fried Hard Crabs
steps: Chill
the crab in ice water, then wash crab and remove the top
hull,	cleaning
out
the entrails.
Also remove the apron and lungs.	While removing entrails, take yellow fat out of the top hull and put in separate bowl.

title: Crab Newburg

ingredients.name: crab meat
ingredients.raw: 4 lb. of crab meat (flaked) or 2 lb. of crab meat and 2 lb. of shrimp

ingredients.name: half and half
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pint of half and half (1/2 cup)

ingredients.name: rounded tbsp. old bay seasoning
ingredients.raw: 1 rounded Tbsp. Old bay seasoning or 1/2 Tbsp. of Tony Chacheres (or more to taste)

steps: Mix all the ingredients except crab.
Then add crab meat and cook on stovetop until hot. Serve over rice.

title: Autumn Skillet Dinner

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.raw: 1 medium red onion, sliced thin (or chopped)

steps: Trim fat from chops, then brown both sides.
Remove from skillet.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until tender.
Add cabbage, apple, apple juice, vinegar, bay leaf and pepper.
Toss well.
Add the browned chops, arranging over the top.
Cover skillet and cook 20 to 30 minutes on low heat.

title: Chex Party Mix
steps: Melt butter.
Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce. Gradually add cereal, nuts and pretzels; stir.
Heat in 200° oven for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Filled Thumbprints
steps: In food processor, combine all ingredients except egg whites, pecans and preserves.
Shape rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into 1-inch balls.
In small bowl, beat egg whites until foamy.
Dip balls into egg whites; roll in finely chopped pecans.
Place 1-inch apart on greased cookie sheet.
Make depression in each cookie with back of teaspoon.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Fill centers with preserves.
Continue baking for 6 to 10 minutes or until light brown.
Yield:
3 dozen.

title: Nan Marshall'S Baked Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb. chicken pieces or 2 lb. chicken

steps: Preheat oven
to
Heat
shortening
in
x 9 x 2-inch or 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.
Mix all dry ingredients in bag. Add 2 or 3 pieces of chicken and shake until coated.

title: Crescent Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup water (105° to 115°).
Add sugar, salt and 1 1/2 cups flour, stirring well.
Add eggs, butter and remaining flour.
Knead until smooth and elastic, approximately 10 minutes.
Place dough in greased bowl, turning to coat.
Cover and let rise in warm place about 1 hour until double in size.
Punch down; divide into 4 equal parts.
Roll each part into 1/4-inch thick circle; cut into 8 wedges.
Roll up for crescent, starting at wide end.
Place on baking sheet; cover and let rise 45 minutes, until double in size.
Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.
Makes 32 rolls.

title: Donuts

ingredients.name: baking powder in c. flour
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. baking powder in 5 c. flour

steps: Mix in this order:
sugar, salt, shortening, eggs, buttermilk, soda, flour and baking powder.
Roll to thickness desired.
Cut with donut cutter and save center for "donut holes."
All donuts may be served plain or sugared or powdered sugared.

title: Small Hungarian Nut Rolls
steps: Mix together butter, milk and eggs.
Crumble yeast into mixture.
Stir well until yeast disappears.
Mix in remaining salt and flour.
No kneading is needed.
Put into greased bowl and refrigerate overnight.
Cover with wax paper or damp towel.

title: Marshmallow Crispy Treats
steps: Melt margarine over low heat. Add marshmallows. Stir until melted. Remove from oven. Stir in cereal.
Press into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Spanish Burgers
steps: Brown onion and hamburger; drain.
Add rest of ingredients together in skillet; cook 5 minutes.
Bake in a shallow pan at 375° for 30 minutes.
Place in buns and serve.

title: Bacon Chestnuts
steps: Mix chili sauce, brown sugar and mayonnaise together.
Wrap chestnut with 1 strip bacon.
Spear with toothpick.
Wrap 2 cans chestnuts.
Place in single layer on baking dish.
Add sauce. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Serve warm.

title: Herb Omelet
steps: Beat egg and milk together.
Pour into warm nonstick pan.
As egg mixture sets, lift gently with spatula so uncooked mixture flows beneath.
Cover egg mixture with mushrooms, pimento, basil, parsley, salt and pepper.
Fold in half.
Serve on heated plate.

title: Sweet And Sour Vegetables

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.raw: 4 medium cucumbers or zucchini, cut long and sliced thin

steps: Cook vegetables in salted water for 3 minutes.
Drain.
Run cold water over and drain.
In a large bowl combine vegetables, cucumbers and onion.
