Combine vinegar, sugar, oil and soy sauce. Stir until well blended and sugar is dissolved.
Pour vegetables and toss lightly.

title: Plain Flour Dumplings
steps: Beat egg and water together.
Gradually beat in enough flour so mixture is smooth and holds together.
Drop by teaspoon into boiling soup or stew and boil about 5 minutes.

title: Best Ever Lemon Pie
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch together in top of double boiler. Add water.
Combine egg yolks with juice and beat.
Add to sugar mixture and cook over boiling water for 25 minutes or until thick. Add lemon extract, butter and vinegar and stir thoroughly.
Pour into pie shell and let cool.
Cover with meringue and brown in oven.

title: Confetti Snowball Freeze

ingredients.name: waffle creme fine
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. waffle cremes, crushed fine (4 c.)

steps: Chill bread loaf pans.
Using small ice cream dipper, scoop ice cream and sherbet onto cooled cookie sheets.
Refreeze until ready to use.
Crush sugar wafers into fine crumbs.
Line 1 cup wafers in bottom of pans, reserving some for topping.
Put Cool Whip into pastry bags and squirt on wafer crumbs.
Line 4 chocolate balls on one side and 4 lime balls on other side.
Cover with a layer of Cool Whip and in between balls.
Line 4 orange balls and 4 raspberry balls the same way; cover again with Cool Whip.
Top with remaining crumbs.
Cover with plastic wrap; freeze overnight.

title: Cranberry Ade

ingredients.name: block of ice
ingredients.raw: block of ice or ice cubes

steps: Mix cranberry juice, orange, lemon and pineapple juices and water.
Chill thoroughly.
Pour into punch bowl or pitchers over ice or ice cubes.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake

ingredients.name: graham cracker crumb
ingredients.raw: 2 c. graham cracker crumbs or 1 pkg. grahams

steps: Dissolve gelatin in water and add lemon juice.
Cool.
Cream the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla; add gelatin.
Mix well.
Fold whipped Milnot into gelatin mixture.

title: Jan Hagel Cookies
steps: Cream together butter and sugar.
Beat in egg yolk.
Gradually stir in flour and cinnamon. Add almond extract.
Press dough thinly into a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet until sheet is completely covered.
(Dough will fill 2 cookie sheets.)
Beat egg white slightly with a small amount of water (enough to thin egg white and make it watery).
Brush egg white mixture thinly over dough to serve as a glaze.
Sprinkle almond slices over dough. Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.
Cut cookies into desired size and remove from baking sheet immediately. An alternative method is to make cookies with a cookie press.

title: Pecan Shortbread Cookies

ingredients.name: light brown sugar loosely
ingredients.raw: 1 c. light brown sugar, loosely packed

steps: In a mixing bowl, beat together the butter, light brown sugar, vanilla and salt until light and fluffy.
Stir in the flour and nuts, just enough to combine.
Do not overmix or cookies will be tough.
Form the dough into a ball and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

title: Old English Cheese Crock

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (2 c., lightly packed)

steps: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, Port wine, mustard and basil until thoroughly blended.
Mix in Cheddar cheese and chopped almonds.
Beat to blend thoroughly; pack in crock or small bowls. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Eggs(The Taste And Texture Of Peanut Butter Cups.)

ingredients.name: chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. chocolate chips or candy coating

steps: In 1 1/2-quart bowl or casserole, microwave margarine at High for 1 to 2 minutes, until melted.
Add crumbs, sugar and peanut butter; mix well.
Chill until firm.
Shape into eggs and refrigerate.

title: Pan Pierogi(This Is A Lazy Way To Make Pierogi!)
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water; mash with butter, milk and Velveeta cheese.
(This can be done the night before.) Cook lasagna noodles.
While noodles are cooking, fry onions in butter. Set aside.
Butter a large casserole dish (9 x 13-inch).
Layer four noodles on bottom of pan and spread half of the potato mixture on them.
Top with 4 more noodles.
Put half the onions on top of noodles and spread the rest of the potato mixture.
Place the last 4 noodles on top and cover with onions.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Let stand about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Michigan Sauce

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 tsp. chili powder to taste

steps: Boil hamburg and drain.
Mash hamburg after drained until fine.
Return to pot and add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 1 to 2 hours.

title: Blueberry-Bran Muffins
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Set aside.
Mix milk and cereal together and let stand a few minutes.
Add egg and oil; mix well.
Add flour mixture only until moistened.
Carefully add berries.
Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12.

title: Hallelujah Ham Loaves
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cream first 4 ingredients.
Add onion, ham and cheese.
Mix well. Halve rolls lengthwise.
Place, cut side up, in pan. Spoon ham mixture on top.
Cover with remaining halves.
(Can be sealed and frozen at this point, if desired.)

title: Cheese Vegetable Dish

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Cheddar cheese, cut into chunks

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed and
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. frozen broccoli, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: cauliflower thawed and
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. frozen cauliflower, thawed and drained

steps: Melt cheese and margarine.
Add vegetables; stir in crackers. Sprinkle some crackers over top.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Easy Buttermilk Bread
steps: Dissolve first 2 ingredients in a large bowl.
Sift the following 3 dry ingredients and add to yeast mixture.
Heat the following 2 ingredients; add to dry ingredients.

title: Delicious Pork Roast

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 or 5 lb.) pork shoulder or loin

steps: Place all ingredients in a large covered casserole dish and bake for 3 1/2 hours at 350°.
Or you can put this in a slow cooker before work and have it ready when you get home.
This is great served with vegetables as a meal or makes a great sandwich, cold or hot.

title: Fix-Ahead Mashed Potatoes
steps: Place potatoes in saucepan.
Add water to cover and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Simmer 25 minutes, or until tender; drain and peel. Place in large mixing bowl and mash.
Add 2 tablespoons butter and next 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Brush top with melted butter; sprinkle with paprika.
Bake immediately or cover and put in refrigerator.
If refrigerated, let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, or until hot.

title: Cranberry Waldorf
steps: Cook cranberries, sugar and water until berries quit popping. Dissolve jello in hot mixture and let set.
Add other ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Carol'S Peppered Steak

ingredients.name: campbell s french onion soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's French onion soup (in beef broth)

steps: Flour and brown steak.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Homemade Egg Noodles
steps: Mix ingredients until well blended.
Mixture will be extremely firm dough.
Turn onto large floured surface.
Sprinkle with flour and roll until extremely thin.
Move dough around as rolling to make sure underside of dough is floured well to keep from sticking. Cover thin dough with thin layer of flour.
Roll dough, beginning at one edge.
Slice dough into 1/2 or 1/4-inch strips.
Unroll and coat each noodle evenly with flour.
Dry on surface for 1 hour or dry completely and store until needed.

title: Peanut Butter Crisscross
steps: Mix sugar, shortening, eggs, brown sugar and vanilla.
Add baking soda and peanut butter, then the flour.
Use small scoop or spoon.
Drop on ungreased cookie sheet.
With fork, flatten out and make crisscross on top of cookie and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 10 dozen.

title: Grilled Tomatoes

ingredients.name: or tomato
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 ripe tomatoes (cut in 1/2 inch slices)

steps: Season tomato slices with salt, pepper, and sugar.
Dip in butter, then in cracker crumbs.

title: Mama'S Yeast Rolls
steps: Heat milk, Crisco and sugar; let cool completely.
Add yeast and flour to milk mixture.
Let this rise for 2 hours.

title: Fruit Pudding Cake
steps: Drain Number 2 can fruit cocktail.
Fold into mixture.
Put in 6 x 10 or 9 x 9 Pyrex pan, ungreased.
Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Nell'S Baked Beans

ingredients.name: van camp s pork and bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can Van Camp's pork and beans

steps: Combine all ingredients except bacon.
Fry bacon and let drain.*

title: Chicken Casserole Supreme

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. mixed vegetables, cooked and drained

steps: Combine hot rice and cheese spread in a large bowl.
Add chicken, cooked vegetables and undiluted soup.
Mix well and pour into buttered 2-quart casserole.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake, covered, in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Remove cover and bake until bread crumbs are brown.

title: Microwave Swiss Steak

ingredients.name: steak in
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. boneless round steak, cut in serving pieces

steps: Place butter in 2-quart baking dish (12 x 7-inch).
Microwave on Roast 1 minute or until melted.
Combine flour, salt, pepper and mustard in plate.
Coat meat in seasoned flour.
Arrange in melted butter.
Cover with glass lid or plastic wrap.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes or until no longer pink.
Turn meat over, place onion rings on top.
Combine ketchup and brown sugar.
Cover and microwave for 20 minutes on Simmer.
Then rearrange meat, cover and continue cooking on Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until fork tender.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Seafoam
steps: Cook sugar, water and vinegar until it forms a thread or a ball in a glass of cold water.
Add mixture to beaten stiff egg white (add slowly so you don't cook the egg whites).
Beat real well by hand or electric mixer.
When the mixture starts to get stiff add vanilla.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on waxed paper, Saran Wrap or large plate greased with oleo.

title: Festive Frozen Salad

ingredients.name: bing cherry
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can pitted Bing cherries, drained

steps: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, sugar, salt, pineapple, diced bananas and food coloring.
Lightly fold in nuts and cherries. Spoon into paper cups which have been placed in muffin tins. Freeze.

title: Bread Sticks(Makes 4 Servings)
steps: Spread slices of bread with margarine.
Sprinkle with garlic salt (if used) and pepper.
Stack bread and slice into sticks about 1/2-inch thick; spread in a baking pan.
Bake at 300° (slow oven) about 25 minutes until crisp and lightly browned.

title: Aunt Yvonne'S Chicken Crabmeat Salad

ingredients.name: chicken breast deboned and coarsely
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, cooked, deboned and chopped coarsely

ingredients.name: seedless green grape in half
ingredients.raw: 1 c. seedless green grapes, cut in half

steps: Toss chicken pieces, crabmeat, grapes, walnuts and celery together.
Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken mixture.
Toss again.
Chill.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Doves In Foil
steps: Place doves, breast up, on 6 pieces of aluminum foil, 12-inches square.
Place 1/2 strip thick bacon over breast of each dove.
Place vegetables around doves on foil; salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over doves.
Fold foil to seal.
Bake in 325° oven for 90 minutes.
When done, place foil containers on dinner plate and unfold.

title: Roasted Potatoes With Sour Cream
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brush jelly roll pan lightly with butter.
Slice potatoes 1/2-inch thick, discarding ends and arrange on prepared pan.
Brush with butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake 15 minutes.
Turn potatoes; brush with remaining butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake 10 minutes more or until tender and golden.
Transfer potatoes to serving platter and keep warm.
To serve, spread 1/2 teaspoon sour cream on each slice.

title: Peaches Delight

ingredients.name: raggedy ann peach in
ingredients.raw: 1 can Raggedy Ann peaches, cut in small pieces

steps: Drain peaches; add sherry, partially thawed orange juice and sugar.
Stir until dissolved.
Freeze in tray.
After freezing, it can be put in a plastic container; keeps well.
One quarter cup of Triple Sec or Cointreau can be added.

title: Knox Gelatin Salad
steps: Mix gelatin and water. Set aside. Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil.
Mix gelatin into pineapple and sugar.
Let stand and cool to room temp.
Mix cream cheese and marshmallow cream together.
Add pineapple mix.
Let stand in refrigerator 1 1/2 hr. Prepare Dream Whip according to directions.
Fold into pineapple mixture and set in 9x13 pan.
Garnish with pineapple slices and cherries.

title: Frosty Jello

ingredients.name: heaping tsp. flavored gelatin
ingredients.raw: 1 heaping tsp. flavored gelatin (not lemon or lime)

steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in refrigerator until thickened.
Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Cajun Grilled Pork Chops

ingredients.name: center pork loin chop
ingredients.raw: 4 boneless center cut pork loin chops (1 1/2-inches thick)

steps: Combine spices; mix well.
Coat chops with spice mixture. Grill over medium-high heat 7 to 8 minutes each side, turning once.

title: Coconut Crunch Pie
steps: Mix together and put into pie dish.
Bake for 30 minutes at 300°.
Cool.
Slice bananas on top, then cover with Cool Whip.

title: Holiday Egg Nog

ingredients.name: golden rum
ingredients.raw: 1 c. golden rum or 1 to 2 Tbsp. rum flavoring

steps: In a large bowl beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add sugar and salt, beating until thick and lemon colored.
Stir in rum and cream.
Chill 3 hours.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Syrup
steps: Beat eggs.
Mix with sugar and oleo.
Boil syrup a few minutes; cool a little, then pour over sugar, eggs and butter mixture.
Add vanilla flavoring.
Pour in crust.
Bake at 300° until done.

title: Sauerkraut Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine deluxe devil s food cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines Deluxe devil's food cake mix

ingredients.name: and sauerkraut
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. rinsed, drained and chopped canned sauerkraut

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 8 or 9-inch round layer cake pans.

title: Chocolate-Coconut Drops
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt chocolate in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sweetened condensed milk, coconut and walnuts.

title: Pasta Frola (Guava Torte)

ingredients.name: guava jelly
ingredients.raw: 2 c. guava jelly (Weis has it the name is Goya)

steps: Sift together the dry ingredients.
Add the margarine to the dry ingredients with a pastry blender.
Add the eggs and the milk. Roll out 3/4 of the dough into a circle.
Save the other part for the top.

title: Spaghetti Salad 2(Delicious!)
steps: Break spaghetti into 3 to 4-inch pieces; cook, drain and rinse.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients and toss.
Combine dressing ingredients and pour a portion over spaghetti mixture and chill.
Add additional dressing just before serving.

title: Sauerkraut Meatballs
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; make into meatballs (do not brown).
Place meatballs in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Tea Ring
steps: Sift all dry ingredients together.
Add beaten egg.
Add lard and as much water as needed.
Put on board and stretch long. Spread with butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Roll up and bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Macaroni Tuna Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni.
Drain.
Blend soup, milk and mayonnaise.
Stir in cheese and tuna.
Fold in macaroni.
Combine crumbs and melted butter.
Sprinkle on top of casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° until heated, 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Kathry'S Carrots
steps: Boil carrots and salt for 5 to 10 minutes; drain and place in a large casserole dish.
Cover with syrup, sugar and butter.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Bacon And Swiss Cheese Pie

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.raw: 3 pieces cooked bacon, broken into small pieces

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. heavy cream or evaporated milk

steps: Line a 9-inch pie pan with rich pastry.
Brush with slightly beaten egg white.
Bake in preheated hot oven at 450° until crust sets, but is not brown.

title: Bar-B-Burgers
steps: Spread the rolls on ungreased baking sheet.
Press seams together.
Bake at 400° about 8 minutes.
Brown meat over medium heat, drain off grease.
Add barbecue sauce, onion and 1/4 cup cheese.
Spoon over rolls.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup of cheese over meat mixture.
Bake until cheese bubbles.

title: Corn Souffle Casserole
steps: Mix; bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
Don't open oven. Do not use lid.

title: Sausage-Apple Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Betty'S Doughnuts
steps: Mix sugar and lard; add beaten eggs.
Sift flour, salt, baking powder, soda and nutmeg.
Add to first mixture with buttermilk.
More flour may be added so that the dough can be handled nicely.
Turn the doughnuts as soon as they come up so they won't crack.

title: Venison Delight Stew

ingredients.name: deer roast
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 lb. deer roast (cut off fat)

steps: Peel and wash carrots and potatoes.
Cut up into small chunks. Place in the bottom of a crock-pot.
Put deer roast on top. Sprinkle Adolph's seasoning on meat.
Pour onion soup mix over roast.
Pour water over top and cover with lid.
Cook on low heat for approximately 6 to 8 hours, if able, or cook on high heat for approximately 4 hours and then lower setting to medium heat.
Use judgement, depending on size of meat.
Periodically, as juices develop, baste meat and vegetables.
It will melt in your mouth!

title: Ranch Salad Dressing Mix
steps: Combine onion flakes, garlic flakes and parsley flakes into bowl; mix well.
Store in airtight container.

title: Quick Beef Hash
steps: Melt fat in skillet.
Add onion, potato and carrots.
Stir and cook until potatoes are brown.
Add meat, salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook for 30 minutes, stirring and chopping mixture frequently.
Serve with catsup.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken deboned and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. chicken (breasts are better), cooked, deboned and diced (3 breasts)

ingredients.name: salsa
ingredients.raw: 1 c. salsa or 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and chilies, diced

steps: Cook, debone and dice chicken.
Dump chicken with onion and cook until onion is tender.
Pour broth and salsa or Ro-Tel into chicken mixture.
Bring to a boil and stir in Minute rice.
Turn heat off.
Cover for 5 minutes (rice will cook in the 5 minutes). Top with shredded cheese.
The cheese will melt without returning to heat.

title: Dad'S Barbecue Mop
steps: Mix together ingredients.
Mop on meat while it is in the pit. Will serve 4 large sirloins.

title: Pineapple Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Use on Wheatsworth crackers.

title: Glazed Fruit Dessert

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained (save juice)

steps: Combine pudding and pineapple juice, folding in pineapple, oranges and bananas.
Refrigerate.
May top with Cool Whip.

title: Quick Oyster Soup
steps: Put margarine in saucepan.
Add celery, oysters and seasonings and cook until tender.
Add celery soup, milk and water.
Cook until soup boils up well.

title: Broccoli Au Gratin(Makes 6 Servings)

ingredients.name: envelope lipton onion mushroom recipe soup mix
ingredients.raw: 1 envelope Lipton onion mushroom recipe soup mix

ingredients.name: light cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (1/2 pt.) light cream or half and half

ingredients.name: cauliflower separated floret and
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cauliflower, separated into large florets and cooked

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.

In saucepan bring water to boil; stir in onion-mushroom recipe soup mix and simmer, covered, 5 minutes. Stir in flour blended with cream and Worcestershire sauce. Bring just to the boiling point, then simmer, stirring constantly until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cheese until melted.

title: Special Pound Cake

ingredients.name: each vanilla lemon and orange flavoring
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each vanilla, lemon and orange flavoring

steps: Cream oleo
and
sugar well.
Add one egg and about 1/2 cup flour
alternately.
Mix
well.
Add
flavorings.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes in a tube pan.

title: Roast Turkey With Cornbread Dressing
steps: Remove giblets and neck from turkey; reserve for giblet gravy. Cover giblets and neck with water; cook slowly until tender. Wash turkey thoroughly with cold water; pat dry.
Pour salt in palm of hand and rub over turkey and in cavity of turkey.
Combine chopped celery, onion and bell pepper in large boiler; cover with water.
Cook until onions are clear, celery very tender and most of water absorbed.
Cool.

title: French Poultry Dressing
steps: Peel and dice onions.
Fry in butter until golden brown.
Pour off and mash boiled potatoes.
Add ground giblets and dried bread which has been soaked in potato water and if needed, broth from giblets.
Mix all together and add enough salt, pepper and sage to taste.
Melt 1/4 pound of butter and while it is hot, mix this in well.
After it has cooled, stuff fowl with it.
It has a different flavor than any dressing one can get.
Put dressing left over in dish and bake the last hour that bird is cooking and mix the two together.
Makes a moist dressing.

title: Fruit-Yogurt Delight

ingredients.name: pineapple and chilled
ingredients.raw: 1/2 canned unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained and chilled

ingredients.name: peach and chilled
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. canned unsweetened peaches, drained and chilled

ingredients.name: banana and
ingredients.raw: 1 banana, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces (frozen)

steps: In food processor or blender, combine all ingredients.
Cover and blend on high speed about 1 minute or until smooth.
Yields 3 servings.
Per serving about 155 calories, 0.3 g fat.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Baked Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.
Set aside 4 halves.
Place each remaining half on 14 x 14-inch piece of foil.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Top each half with 2 slices each of green pepper and onions.
Dot with 1/2 tablespoon margarine.
Top with remaining halves and crisscross two strips of bacon around each. Wrap individually and bake 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Corn Casserole

ingredients.name: saltine cracker and divided
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. saltine crackers, crushed and divided

steps: Cook broccoli until about half tender.
Drain and add 1/4 cup bread crumbs and remaining ingredients.
Pour in casserole dish. Mix 1/4 cup bread crumbs with melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Beef And Broccoli

ingredients.name: cream of broccoli soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of broccoli soup

steps: Slice beef across grain into thin strips.
In skillet, in 1 tablespoon hot oil, cook beef until brown, stirring often. Remove.

title: Chicken Pie Mexican-Style

ingredients.name: tomato and
ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 small tomatoes, peeled and chopped

ingredients.name: or more green chili pepper and
ingredients.raw: 2 or more green chili peppers, peeled and chopped

steps: Cook onion in butter until tender.
Add tomatoes, salt and pepper; cook over medium heat until thick.
Stir in rest of ingredients.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes until browned.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Nana Cassie'S Diet Banana Bread
steps: Melt butter and mix with sugar.
Beat egg and add with butter and sugar mixture.
Mash bananas and add to mixture.
Mix well. Add flour and soda.
Pour in pan.
Bake for 35 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Sausage Appetizer

ingredients.name: smoky link bite size
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. smoky-links, cut into bite size pieces

steps: In medium saucepan, combine apricot preserves and mustard. Stir and cook over low heat 5 minutes.
Add smoky-links and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
steps: Beat oleo and sugar.
Add vanilla and water.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Dough will be stiff.
Form into candy cane shapes with hands.
Bake at 325° on ungreased cookie sheet until set. Frost with powdered sugar frosting.
Stripe with pink frosting.

title: Strawberry Weight Watchers Dessert

ingredients.name: sugar cook and vanilla pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 box sugar-free cook and serve vanilla pudding

steps: Cook pudding and jello with water. Put strawberries in a 9 x 9-inch dish and pour cooled mixture over.
Top with Cool Whip if desired.
Double for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pineapple Torte

ingredients.name: wheat
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. whole wheat or white flour

steps: Cook pineapple, sugar and cornstarch.
Stir until thick. Cool.
Mix remaining ingredients and pack in a 9 x 13-inch pan up 1/2-inch on sides.
Save small amount for topping.
Pour in pineapple mixture.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Raspberry Limeade
steps: In a blender or food processor, puree 1 cup of the raspberries with 1 cup of water and force the puree through a fine sieve set over a pitcher, pressing hard on the solids.
Add remaining 1 cup of raspberries and remaining 2 1/2 cups of water, the sugar and the lime juice.
Stir mixture until sugar is dissolved.
Divide the limeade among tall glasses; fill with ice cubes and garnish each drink with mint sprigs.
Makes 4.

title: Macaroni Cheese Deluxe
steps: Cook macaroni, drain well.
Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, egg, salt and pepper.
Add shredded cheese and mix well. Stir in macaroni.
Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Lime Party Salad
steps: Melt marshmallows and milk in microwave until melted, about 5 minutes.
Pour hot mix over Jell-O and stir until dissolved.
Stir in cream cheese until dissolved, using low speed beater.
Add undrained pineapple.
Cool.
Blend in Cool Whip and chill in bowl or mold.

title: Unbaked Cheese Cake
steps: Mix jello with boiling water; set aside in refrigerator. Chill until thick syrup.
Mix sugar, cheese and vanilla with fork. Add real lemon.
Whip milk stiff.
Add cheese mixture to jello and pour slowly into milk.
Turn as you pour.
Melt oleo and mix with crumbs.
Put 1/2 crumbs in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Save rest of crumbs for top.
Place in freezer for 2 hours.
Remove. Ready to serve.

title: Barbecue Salmon

ingredients.name: parmesan cheese
ingredients.raw: fresh grated Parmesan cheese or in the box

steps: If whole, split salmon in two down the back; place salmon on hot barbecue skin side down on foil.
Cook until you can turn it over onto heavy foil, approximately 5 to 10 minutes (depending on the size of your fish).
Peel the skin and any brown color and fat off; discard.
Drizzle garlic butter and spread Parmesan cheese over until you get a thick crust.
Cover with barbecue lid or foil and cook until done and crust is brown.
If company is coming, make a lot, as they inhale this as fast as you can cook it.

title: "No Weep" Meringue
steps: Combine all ingredients and boil until it spins a thread. Remove from heat immediately.
While beating constantly, pour syrup slowly into 2 stiffly beaten egg whites.
Beat until it holds shape well.
This meringue keeps exceptionally well.

title: Dinner Mints
steps: Work with hands.
Knead into play dough consistency. Refrigerate overnight.
Mold into any shape on waxed paper. Store in refrigerator or freezer.
Serves 300.

title: Party Asparagus
steps: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1/2 cup water, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper to boiling.
Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Add asparagus and cook, covered, until fork-tender.
Top with onion mixture.

title: Oven White Rice
steps: Saute onion in butter until transparent.
Combine onion, rice and broth and bring to a boil on top of stove.
Put in covered casserole and cook in 325° oven for 25 minutes.
Fluff with fork before serving.
Cold leftovers of this can be used for your favorite fried rice recipe.

title: Cheesecake Bars
steps: Mix ingredients.
Save 3/4 cup of mixture for topping.
Pat remainder in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 350°. Cool.

title: Nuts And Bolts
steps: Melt oleo and stir in remaining ingredients.
Cook in oven pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hot Pineapple Side Dish

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese divided
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided

steps: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup of the juice; set aside. In medium bowl, combine sugar and flour.
Add the butter and 1 cup cheese; mix well.
Gently stir in pineapple.
Pour into a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle crushed crackers on top; drizzle with reserved pineapple juice.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
This is great with ham.
Serves six.

title: Cheese Pie
steps: Place crescent rolls in greased square pan.
Whip eggs, add cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Apricot Crescents(Each Ball Makes 1 Dozen Crescents)
steps: Cut margarine in flour until it resembles coarse meal.
Combine yolk and sour cream.
Stir into flour mixture.
Divide and shape dough into 4 balls.
Wrap each portion in waxed paper and chill for 4 hours.
Roll out one portion of dough on floured surface into a 10-inch circle.
Spread 2 tablespoons apricot preserves on circle and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons coconut and 1 tablespoon chopped pecans.
Cut circle into 12 wedges.
Roll up edges, beginning with the wide end and place point side down on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Sweet Dinner Rolls
steps: Combine warm water and yeast; let rise 10 minutes.
Stir good, then add the rest of flour.
Put in bowl.
Let rise until double. Punch down.
Let rise again.

title: "South Of The Border" Steak

ingredients.name: taco sauce
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) jar taco sauce (hot or mild)

steps: Brown steak in butter while adding seasonings to meat until light brown.
Drain off any grease.
Remove steak; put in an oven-safe dish.
Pour taco sauce on top of steak, then sprinkle top of steak with chopped green chiles.
Bake, covered, for 35 minutes at 350°.
Remove cover.
Add shredded cheese to the top of each piece of steak.
Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and melted well.
Serve with Spanish rice.

title: Overnight Yeast Waffles
steps: Scald milk.
Cool to lukewarm.
Put water in large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast.
Stir until dissolved.
Add milk, butter, salt, sugar and flour.
Mix thoroughly with rotary beater until batter is smooth.
Cover and let stand at room temperature overnight. When ready to bake, add eggs and baking soda.
Beat well.
Cook on waffle iron.

title: Bacon Cream Cheese Spread
steps: Combine softened cream cheese, bacon, mayonnaise, onion powder and wine to spreading consistency.
Serve with assorted crackers and/or party bread.

title: Party Oyster Crackers

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch buttermilk original mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk original mix

steps: Combine Hidden Valley mix and oil; add dill, garlic and lemon pepper.
Pour over crackers and stir to coat.
Bake on cookie sheets for 15 to 20 minutes at 250°.
Store covered.

title: Snap Rolls
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Bake in muffin tins at 400° until brown.

title: Easy Cream Peach Pie

ingredients.name: baked and cooled pie crust
ingredients.raw: 1 (9 inch) baked and cooled pie crust

steps: Combine cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla, mixing until well blended.
Spread onto bottom of pie crust; chill at least 4 hours. Top with peaches just before serving.

title: Quick Cabbage Rolls
steps: Combine hash and onion in bowl; mix well.
Form into eight 3-inch rolls.
Pour boiling water over cabbage leaves; cook for 2 minutes, then drain.
Add salt and pepper.
Place roll on each leaf; roll up.
Secure with toothpicks.
Place in baking dish; dot with butter.
Dissolve bouillon cube in 3/4 cup hot water; pour over cabbage rolls.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Grandma Truckenmiller'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° approximately 11 minutes.

title: Chewy Cake
steps: Melt butter and mix in brown sugar.
Add flour, eggs, vanilla and nuts.
Stir until mixed well.
Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm.
Yield:
2 dozen.

title: Mint Dazzler
steps: Mix and press into 12 x 9 x 2-inch dish the first two ingredients.
Cream together 1/2 cup margarine and powdered sugar; add the eggs and chocolate, which has been beaten until fluffy and light.
Pour this over the crust.
Set this in the freezer while you fold the marshmallows into the Cool Whip.
Spread this over the chocolate mixture.
Sprinkle with crushed peppermint candy. Keep in freezer until ready to use.
Keeps well.

title: Citron Preserves
steps: Peel citron; cut into strips.
Rinse in water, pick up and put in preserving pan (leave the water in preserving pan that drains from rind).
Mix sugar with rind.
When sugar dissolves on low heat, you will have just about a pan full.
Add pineapple.
Cook until mixture is of preserving consistency.

title: Cranberry Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: old fashioned
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. old fashioned or quick oats (uncooked)

ingredients.name: or c. cranberry
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 c. fresh cranberries to taste

steps: Combine flour, brown sugar, oats and cinnamon and cut in margarine until the mixture resembles coarse crumb mixture.
Toss 1 cup of crumb mixture with sweet potatoes (drained) and the cranberries.
Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Sprinkle marshmallows over top and broil until lightly brown.
Serves 6.

title: Sweet And Sour Glazed Ham

ingredients.name: ground clove
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. ground cloves or less to taste

ingredients.name: smoked fully ham
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 to 7 lb.) smoked, fully cooked ham

steps: Combine jelly, mustard, lemon juice, ground cloves plus the juice from the pineapple and cherries in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Set aside.

title: Hot Garlic Bread
steps: Cut bread
in 3/4-inch slices, not quite through bottom crust. Combine margarine, garlic, parsley flakes, oregano and dried dill.
Spread
generously between slices.
Wrap loosely in foil and
heat
at
about
15 minutes.
Open foil and brown.

title: Corn Creole

ingredients.name: kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained

ingredients.name: tomato up with liquid
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. canned tomatoes, cut up, with liquid

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. chili powder (more or less to taste)

steps: Melt margarine in a 1 1/2-quart pot.
Add onion and green pepper.
Stir over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients, mix well and stir over medium heat for 5 more minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Poor Man'S Casserole
steps: Press raw beef in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread soups evenly.
Top with Tater Tots.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Ice Cream "Cake"

ingredients.name: fudge ice cream in microwave easier pouring
ingredients.raw: 1 jar fudge ice cream topping, softened in microwave for easier pouring

steps: Mix first two ingredients and press firmly in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
then layer ice cream, fudge and Cool Whip.
It works best if you freeze each layer.
Decorate top with whatever!

title: Will'S Punch
steps: Pour pineapple juice, kool-aid and sugar in a gallon pitcher. Mix together well.
Fill the rest with water.
Put punch in freezer a few hours before serving, so the mixture will be slushy.

title: Sweet Popcorn
steps: Combine sugar, butter, and water in large heavy pot.
Bring to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly; continue to cook until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture becomes syrupy, 4 to 5 minutes,
Remove pot from heat.

title: Best Ever Rolls
steps: Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Let cool to lukewarm.
Add eggs.
Sprinkle yeast in warm water and let dissolve.
Add.
To first mixture, add flour, one cup at a time. Put in large bowl and place in refrigerator.
Cover with damp cloth.
Let rise until doubled.

title: "Our" Mayonnaise
steps: Place all ingredients in a food processor fitted with the metal blade.
Process 4 to 5 minutes until double in volume and very smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass container.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Lime Jello Fluff

ingredients.name: pineapple in heavy syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 can (medium) crushed pineapple in heavy syrup

steps: Put pineapple in a saucepan.
Add vinegar and bring to a boil for 1 minute.
Remove from the heat and add the box of jello. Stir in and blend.
Cool until it is cold to the touch.
Whip the topping according to directions and add cream cheese in small pieces and whip.
Add to cold pineapple and mix well.
Put in loaf pan and set for 2 to 3 hours or overnight.
Slice in squares.

title: Homemade Stuffing
steps: Mix all the ingredients together in a large container.
Can be stuffed in the turkey or baked in a pan in the oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Bread
steps: Mix ingredients well.
Pour into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Easy Noodle Suey

ingredients.name: lrg. onion fine fried with meat
ingredients.raw: 1 lrg. onion cut fine & fried with meat

steps: Boil noodles in salt water.
Mix with other ingredients. Pour tomato juice over all.
Dot a little butter on top.
Mix and bake until top is nicely browned.

title: Canine Delight

ingredients.name: soy pedigree with chunky beef bacon and cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 can soy-free Pedigree with chunky beef, bacon and cheese

steps: Put chunky beef, bacon and cheese into dog's dinner dish.
Add warm gravy.
Top with string beans and cooked carrots.

title: Cheese Crisp
steps: Mix cheese, butter, flour and pepper (if desired) with hands until very soft.
Then add Rice Krispies and mix again.
Form into small balls.
Put on cookie sheet and flatten slightly with fork. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Crab And Broccoli Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. broccoli, cut in 2-inch pieces

steps: Cook broccoli in salted water until it's slightly soft. Drain.
Place broccoli in a greased medium-sized casserole dish. Cook and stir cream of mushroom soup until smooth.
Add crab meat and mushrooms.
Stir.
Pour sauce over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven; sprinkle cheese and bake for another five minutes.
Serves 4 to 5.

title: Chicken Escort Casserole

ingredients.name: boiled chicken breast in bite size
ingredients.raw: 4 boiled chicken breasts, cut in bite size pieces

ingredients.name: each chicken and mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can each: chicken and mushroom soup

ingredients.name: escort cracker
ingredients.raw: 1 box Escort crackers, crushed (must be Escort)

steps: Stir crushed crackers into melted oleo.
Put half on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chicken on crackers.
Mix soups and sour cream; spoon over chicken.
Put rest of crackers on top.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Chowder

ingredients.name: betty crocker scalloped potato
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pkg. Betty Crocker scalloped potatoes or 1 pkg. Betty Crocker au gratin potatoes

steps: Mix all ingredients except chicken and cheese in 3-quart saucepan.
Heat to boiling, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer.
Stir occasionally until potatoes are tender (20 to 25 minutes).
Stir in cheese and chicken.
Cover and cook until hot about 5 minutes longer.

title: Easy Fettuccine

ingredients.name: velveeta italiana pasteurized process cheese spread
ingredients.raw: 3/4 lb. Velveeta Italiana pasteurized process cheese spread, cubed

ingredients.name: fettuccine and
ingredients.raw: 8 to 9 oz. fettuccine, cooked and drained

steps: Cook and stir garlic in oil in skillet on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add cubed Velveeta cheese spread and milk, stirring until cheese is melted.
Add cooked fettuccine.
Mix lightly.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge Sauce
steps: In medium saucepan, bring evaporated milk just to a boil.
Add chocolate morsels.
Return to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted, slightly thickened and smooth.
Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and salt.
Serve warm as a dipping sauce for fresh fruit or spoon over cake or ice cream.
Yields 2 1/3 cups.

title: Syrup For Pancakes
steps: Mix, boil for 3 minutes;
stir.
Optional:
Add flavorings such as black walnut, maple or something.

title: Pickle Roll-Ups
steps: Warm cream cheese in the microwave.
Add garlic salt to taste. Spread on medium to thin sliced deli ham.
Roll dill pickle up in it.
Cool in fridge for 10 minutes.
Slice in 1/2-inch sections.

title: Slush
steps: Bring water and sugar to a boil.
Then cool mixture.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Freeze and serve with ginger ale or 7-Up.

title: Low Fat Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: fine egg noodle and
ingredients.raw: 12 oz. bag fine egg noodles, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: chicken breast boned and skinned
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, cooked, boned and skinned

steps: In large bowl combine chicken and spaghetti sauce.
In separate bowl combine ricotta cheese, egg whites, and parmesan cheese.
Spray 9 x 13 inch pan with nonfat cooking spray.
Spread 1/2 of chicken/sauce mixture in pans.
Top 1/2 mixture of ricotta cheese.
Place 1/2 the noodles on top of this and repeat layers. Top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30-40 minutes.

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf Squares

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and squeezed
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed

steps: Mix beef, bread crumbs, 1/2 cup ketchup, milk and egg in a large bowl until blended.
Pat 1/2 of meat mix into bottom of an 8-inch square pan.
Layer with spinach, then cheese.
Top with remaining meat mix.
Spread 1/3 cup of ketchup on top.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Norwegian Coffee Cake
steps: Mix like pie crust.
Spread and press on cookie sheet until thin.

title: Jordan Marsh Blueberry Muffins

ingredients.name: berry
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 c. berries (flour all berries in lunch bag)

steps: Melt butter and mix with sugar until fluffy.
Add rest of ingredients, except berries.
Mix well by hand.
Fold in berries. Fill lightly greased muffin tins to the top and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen.

title: Homemade Irish Cream Liqueur

ingredients.name: eagle brand condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk

ingredients.name: whipping
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whipping or light cream (1/2 pt.)

steps: In blender container, combine all ingredients; blend until smooth.
Store tightly covered in refrigerator up to 1 month. Stir before serving.
Return remainder to refrigerator.

title: Asparagus With Cheese(78 Calories Per Serving)

ingredients.name: asparagus pear
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh asparagus spears or 10 oz. pkg. frozen or 1 can Green Giant spears

steps: After asparagus is cooked until tender (if fresh) or cooked according to package directions (if frozen), drain.
Put asparagus in flat baking dish.
Toss sesame seed over asparagus.
Also distribute pimientos.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Heat at 350° until cheese melts.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Berry Cobbler

ingredients.name: cherry pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 can cherry pie filling or any flavor pie filling

steps: Mix flour, sugar, vanilla and milk.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour flour mixture over melted margarine.
Spoon on pie filling.
Bake 30 minutes at 350° or until knife comes out clean.

title: Hot Pecan Dip

ingredients.name: el paso chile pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 small can El Paso chile peppers (optional)

steps: Cut up dried beef.
Let cream cheese soften.
Mix together ingredients (except pecans).
Bake at 350° until hot (15 to 20 minutes).
Take pecan halves, butter them and bake for 3 minutes (until hot).
Put pecan halves on top.
Serve with Frito chips or breadsticks.

title: Glazed Gingered Carrots
steps: Cook carrots unseasoned until tender; drain well.
Place carrots in skillet.
Add butter, brown sugar and ginger.
Ccook over medium heat until mixture begins to bubble.
Turn heat down to low and baste often.
Continue cooking for 30 minutes and basting until they are well glazed.

title: Peach Almond Cobbler

ingredients.name: peach
ingredients.raw: 5 c. sliced peaches (freshly cooked or canned)

steps: Mix together.
Pour peaches into an 11 x 6 x 8-inch pan.

title: Wilted Cucumbers
steps: Peel cucumbers, leaving some green on.
Score lengthwise with tines of fork.
Slice as thinly as possible and sprinkle with salt.
Let stand at room temperature 1-2 hours.
Drain thoroughly, pressing out as much liquid as possible.

title: Sausage Stuffing For Squash
steps: Saute sausage; push aside.
Add onion and celery; saute until golden.
Remove from heat.
Stir in stuffing and thyme.
Mix well. Sprinkle water over mixture.
Toss until evenly moist.
Stuff centers of cleaned and halved squash.
Bake until done.

title: Creamsicle Cake
steps: Bake cake to package directions in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dissolve jello in 3/4 cup boiling water.
Add cold water.
Cool to room temperature.
Cool cake 20 to 25 minutes after baking.
Poke holes in top of cake approximately 1 inch apart.
Pour jello slowly over top of the cake.
Refrigerate while preparing topping.

title: Cranberry-Orange Relish

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. fresh or canned drained pineapple (optional)

steps: Wash cranberries; drain in colander and coarsely chop 1/2 cup at a time in blender or food processor.
Wash and remove seeds from apple and orange (do not peel).
Chop other fruits.
Add to cranberries.
Add spices; mix well.
Flavor improves on standing in refrigerator.
May also be frozen.

title: Broccoli Salad Supreme
steps: Rinse broccoli.
Cut off large stalks and separate.
Break large pieces into very small flowerets of broccoli.
Slice red onion very thin and separate into rings.
Combine raisins and peanuts and mix with broccoli.
Place onion slices and rings on top of broccoli mix.
One hour before serving, pour salad dressing over all and chill thoroughly.
Serve in large decorative bowl as accompaniment for any type of entree.
Crisp and delicious!

title: Anisette Cookies
steps: Beat eggs until smooth.
Add rest of ingredients.
Work batter until firm.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Get out a large mixing bowl.
In it pour sugar, milk, cocoa and butter.
Boil these for 3 minutes or until melted.
When done, pour into another bowl.
Quickly add peanut butter, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla.
Quickly pour into small, square pan and cool until hard.

title: Cooked Icing
steps: Cook milk and flour until thick.
Cool.
Beat butter, shortening, sugar and vanilla until sugar is dissolved.
Add milk mixture to sugar mixture until fluffy.
Add peanut butter to taste.
Mix until blended and fluffy.

title: Meltaway Pecan Balls

ingredients.name: butter up
ingredients.raw: 1 c. butter (2 sticks), cut up (no substitutions)

steps: Preheat oven to 325°. In food processor with knife blade attached, pulse pecans with 1/4 cup confectioners sugar until nuts are very finely ground. Add butter and vanilla and process until smooth, occasionally stopping processor and scraping side with rubber spatula. Add flour; process until evenly mixed and dough forms. With floured hands, shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into 3/4-inch balls. Place balls 1-inch apart on ungreased large cookie sheet. Bake 16 to 18
minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned and cookies are light golden. Transfer cookies to wire rack; cool slightly, about 3 minutes.

title: Date Nut Torte Bars
steps: Combine crumbs, baking powder and salt.
Beat eggs until light.
Beat in sugar gradually (3 to 4 minutes).
Add crumbs mixture, vanilla, dates and walnuts, mixing well.
Grease a 9-inch square pan.
Pour in mixture and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool.
Cut into squares.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Apricot Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients and roll into a ball.
Refrigerate 24 hours.
Roll in chopped pecans.
Serve with gingersnaps.

title: Clam Appetizers
steps: Mix all ingredients and spread on halved English muffins. Freeze if desired.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

title: Gourmet Fillet Of Sole
steps: Arrange sole in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Thaw soup; pour over sole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serve immediately.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Pavlovia

ingredients.name: egg white well stirring in gradually
ingredients.raw: 4 egg whites, beaten well, stirring in gradually

ingredients.name: sugar until peak form
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. sugar, beaten until peaks form

steps: Spread out or put spoonfuls on greased tray; cook slowly for one hour at 200°.
Bon appetit!!!!

title: Zucchini With Dill Sauce
steps: Sprinkle slices with salt.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Spread slices on paper towels; pat dry.
Melt butter in a saucepan; add zucchini.
Toss until well coated with butter.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes until barely tender.
Meantime, beat flour into sour cream.
Pour over zucchini.
Stirring gently, simmer 2 or 3 minutes until thick and smooth.
Stir in sugar, vinegar and dill.

title: White Frosting
steps: Boil flour and milk until thick.
Let cool.
Cream sugar, Crisco and butter.
Add boiled mixture to cream and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.

title: Twentieth Century Pound Cake

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. vanilla or lemon flavoring (your choice)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar very well.
Add eggs, one at a time, blending mixture well between adding the eggs.
Add the flour, stirring well.
Add the milk, stirring constantly.

title: Stuffed Apples(Diabetic Recipe))
steps: Cut apples in half and hollow out core.
Place in baking pan. Combine nuts, raisins and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Stuff into apple hollows.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.
Makes 4 servings.
One apple equals 1 fruit and 1 fat.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream(No Cooking)
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs, cream, sugar, salt and vanilla; mix well with a mixer.
Pour into can.
Add condensed milk; stir well.
Add dairy milk to fill line on can and stir. Churn in freezer per instructions.
Makes approximately 4 quarts.

title: Green Chili Grits Casserole

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese (light Velveeta may be used)

steps: Use a large, thick boiler.
Bring water and salt to a boil. Add grits; cook slowly until thick.
Add cheese (cubed), green chilies and margarine.
Stir until the cheese melts.
Stir in the beaten eggs.
Pour into a casserole dish sprayed with nonstick spray.
Cook for 1 hour in a 275° to 300° oven.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Recipe may be cut in half.

title: Grilled Potatoes
steps: Wash potatoes and slice (do not peel).
Lay out a sheet of aluminum foil (1 1/2 feet long).
Spread 1/4 stick of butter on the aluminum foil.
Lay a layer of potatoes on top of the butter, a layer of chopped onion, then sprinkle with the seasoning salt. Repeat until all potatoes, onion and seasoning salt is gone.
Put the rest of the butter on top of the potatoes (evenly).
Fold the edges of the aluminum foil together and seal.
Twist the end of the foil to prevent butter from leaking out.
Take second piece of foil and cover the bundle for the second time.
Grill for about 45 minutes.

title: Aunt Georgia'S Burritos
steps: Brown ground beef.
Drain well.
Add salsa.
Divide evenly among the tortillas.
Top with cheese.
Roll.
Bake on a cookie sheet covered with foil for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Creamed Cheese Chocolate Fudge
steps: Place the cream cheese in a bowl and cream it until soft and smooth.
Slowly blend the sugar into it.
Add the melted chocolate.
Mix well.
Add vanilla, salt and chopped pecans and mix until well blended.
Press into a well-greased shallow pan. Place in refrigerator until firm (about 15 minutes).
Cut into squares.

title: Cheese Cake(No Bake)
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into a graham cracker crust. Refrigerate until set, several hours or overnight.
Serve plain or top with fruit topping (canned pie filling is good).

title: Four Sheet Dinner

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup

steps: Brown ground beef; drain.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole.
Layer onion, carrot and potato over meat.
Combine soup, milk, salt and pepper; pour over vegetables.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pork Chop Rice Casserole
steps: Fry pork
chops; set aside.
Place rice in baking dish. Add soups and
stir
to
mix.
Lay pork chops on top and cover baking dish.
Bake
at
for
35 minutes or until rice is flaky and tender.

title: Cherokee Casserole

ingredients.name: mixed vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 can mixed vegetables (or vegetable of your choice; can omit entirely)

ingredients.name: cheese type and quantity of your choice
ingredients.raw: Cheese, type and quantity of your choice

steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Add remainder of ingredients except cheese.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Pour into casserole dish and top with cheese.
Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly.

title: Cheesy Lima Beans

ingredients.name: all green lima bean
ingredients.raw: 1 (No. 303) can small all green lima beans

steps: Drain beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid from can.
Put beans, reserved liquid, chopped celery, onion powder, pepper, mayonnaise and 1/2 cup of the cheese into greased casserole dish.
Stir to mix well.
Dot with butter.
Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup cheese on top.
Then spread crushed crackers over all.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 300° oven.

title: Crawfish Pie

ingredients.name: tony s creole seasoning
ingredients.raw: Tony's Creole seasoning to taste (sage and curry)

steps: Saute crawfish tails in margarine, about 5 minutes.
Remove crawfish tails, add onions, celery, bell pepper and garlic to margarine and saute for 10 minutes.
Season crawfish and add to mixture, along with the soup.
Cook at least 20 minutes.
If too thick, add a little water.
Place in pie shell and cover with top. Bake in 300° oven until brown.
Serves 4.

title: A.C.'S Venison Chili
steps: Mix all ingredients together and simmer on low.
Cook 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: No-Fuss Baked Beans
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Top with bacon slices.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Cooley'S Creamy Peaches
steps: Cook peaches in water until tender.
Add brown sugar, salt and flour mixed with the cream into a smooth paste.
Cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

title: Kettle Deer
steps: When you are cutting up your deer, cut into small 1-inch squares, bite-size.
You can freeze this until ready to cook down. Heat a black kettle with a small amount of water in it to boiling.
Add the cubed deer and stir constantly.
You will need to add water as needed to keep a liquid on the deer.
Add salt and pepper to your taste.
Depending on the age and toughness of the deer, cook this until tender, approximately 2 hours.
When the deer is tender, add the onions.
Onions really add the flavor and take away the wild game taste.
The more onions, the better the flavor.

title: Cube Steaks Au Poivre
steps: Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, over medium heat, melt margarine. Cook steaks until browned on both sides.
Arrange steaks on platter.
Keep warm. Into pan drippings, over medium heat, stir water, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.
Heat through and pour over steaks.

title: Brownie Mix
steps: In large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and cocoa; with a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed.
Store in large container.
It doesn't have to be refrigerated.
Keeps 10 to 12 weeks and yields 17 cups mix.

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Gravy

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 boneless and skinless chicken breasts (may also use turkey breasts)

ingredients.name: campbell s healthy request cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: campbell s healthy request cream of chicken soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request cream of chicken soup

steps: Place chicken or turkey in ovensafe dish.
Pour soup and broth over meat.
Season with salt, pepper and poultry seasoning to taste.
Bake, covered, in 350° oven about 1 hour or until meat is tender and no longer pink.

title: Rice (Low In Fat)
steps: Put 6 cups of water in a 2-quart pot on high.
Add margarine (optional), garlic and onion.
Cut the potatoes in squares and add to the boiling mixture.
Add vegetables (optional) and rice. Cover with a lid.
Place on medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Chipped Beef Ball

ingredients.name: chipped beef chop up in blender
ingredients.raw: 3 pkg. chipped beef, chop up in blender

steps: Mix 2/3 of beef into mix.
Save the other 1/3 beef for outside of ball.
Chill.

title: Dressing Casserole
steps: Saute onion and celery in melted margarine.
Sprinkle poultry seasoning on top to cover.
Run each slice of bread under water. Squeeze out excess and place in large bowl.
Add onion mixture and all other ingredients.
Spread in greased pan and bake at 375° for 1 hour or until golden.

title: Spanish Rice Steaks
steps: Coat steaks with flour.
In skillet, brown steaks in oil. Transfer to lightly greased 9-inch square baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper; set aside.
Saute onion slices; add Spanish rice and sugar and mix well.
Spoon rice mixture over steaks; sprinkle with parsley flakes.

title: Mountain Bean Pot
steps: Cut bacon in pieces and brown bacon, hamburger and onion. Drain fat.
Add beans, sugar and catsup.
Slow cook in crock-pot. Salt and pepper to taste.
Kids love this.
Great for cookouts!

title: German Apple Pancakes
steps: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Make small center in flour mixture and add eggs.
Beat eggs with spoon, adding small amount of flour from sides until mixed.
Add vanilla and mix.
Add milk and beat into eggs with flour until a good batter texture is formed.
Add sliced apples.
Pour by ladlefuls onto hot griddle until brown and risen on both sides.
Serve with butter and syrup.

title: Classic Pot Pie

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: 3 c. shredded cooked chicken (I use already cooked, Louis Rich brand)

steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Prepare pie crusts as directed.
Use 9 x 10-inch glass pie pan.
Heat soup and milk until creamy.
Add salt and pepper.
Add chicken and thawed mixed vegetables.
Mix well. Remove from heat and spoon into crust.
Top with second crust. Seal edges; flute.
Cut slits in several places in top crust. Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes or until crust is brown.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Churros

ingredients.name: sugar plu a little
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. sugar plus a little extra

steps: In small saucepan, combine Bisquick and cinnamon.
In a 1-quart saucepan, heat water and 1 tablespoon sugar to boiling. Add boiling mixture to Bisquick mixture.
Reduce heat and stir vigorously until dough forms a ball.
Remove from heat; beat in egg until smooth.
Transfer dough into a pastry bag fitted with a star tip.
Pipe 5-inch strips into a hot skillet with 1-inch of oil.
Cook until golden brown on all sides, turning to coat evenly.
While still hot, roll in extra sugar.
Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Whipped Cream Salad

ingredients.name: whipping cream dream whip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. whipping cream, Dream Whip or Cool Whip

steps: Drain pineapple, reserving syrup.
Add enough boiling water to syrup to make 1 cup.
Dissolve jello in hot liquid.
Stir in cranberry sauce and orange peel.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in oranges and pineapple.
Whip the cream and fold into fruit mixture.
Pour into a 6 cup mold and chill until set.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Toasted Almond Truffles

ingredients.name: nestle s milk chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 1/2 oz.) pkg. Nestle's milk chocolate morsels

steps: Combine evaporated milk and sugar in small heavy-gauge saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a full rolling boil.
Boil 3 minutes.
Stir constantly.
Remove from heat. Stir in morsels and almond extract until morsels melt and mixture is smooth.
Chill 45 minutes.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in almonds.
Chill until ready to serve.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen truffles.

title: Campfire Potatoes
steps: Cook unpeeled potatoes in boiling, salted water, about 20 minutes.
Slice about 1/8 inch thick.

title: Strawberry Supreme

ingredients.name: bird eye quick thaw strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) Birds Eye quick thaw strawberries

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. softened vanilla ice cream or sour cream

steps: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water.
Add cold water. Measure 2 cups into a separate bowl.
Add the frozen fruit.
Stir carefully until fruit thins and separates.
Chill until mixture is almost set, about 15 minutes.
Spoon into sherbet glasses, filling each about 2/3 full.
Chill set but not firm.
Chill remaining and blend in others, then chill for 3 hours.

title: Amaretto Fruit Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
Serve with bite size fruit.

title: Caramel Bundt Rolls

ingredients.name: loaf rhode bread
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 loaves Rhodes frozen bread, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: butterscotch pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) butterscotch pudding mix (not instant)

steps: Lightly grease a Bundt pan.
Sprinkle pecans in bottom of pan. Place frozen rolls in pan and sprinkle with package of dry pudding mix.
Melt margarine, remove from heat and add brown sugar and cinnamon.
Pour this mixture over rolls.
Let rise overnight, uncovered, at room temperature.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Immediately invert onto serving plate.

title: Bisquick Cornbread
steps: Melt butter and set aside to cool.
In a bowl, beat eggs; add milk and cooled butter.
In a separate bowl, combine the Bisquick, sugar, baking soda and cornmeal.
Mix together the wet and dry ingredients.
Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

title: Stuffed Onions

ingredients.name: stove top stuffing
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Stove Top stuffing or similar

steps: Peel and slice in half.
Place in dish and cover.
Microwave on High 10 minutes or until soft.
Prepare stuffing according to package directions.
Add mushrooms and crabmeat and mix well. Mound stuffing onto onion halves and microwave for 2 more minutes or until hot through.
Can be served as a vegetable or with salad as entree.

title: Chicken And Shrimp Saute

ingredients.name: boned and skinned chicken
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. boned and skinned chicken, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: shrimp and deveined
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. large shrimp, shelled and deveined

ingredients.name: sweet yellow bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 c. thinly sliced sweet yellow bell pepper

ingredients.name: sweet green bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 c. thinly sliced sweet green bell pepper

ingredients.name: fettuccine according pkg. direction
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. fettuccine, cooked according to pkg. directions

steps: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons butter.
Add chicken and shrimp.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is light golden and shrimp are pink, about 4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken and shrimp; set aside.
To skillet, add yellow and green peppers; cook, stirring occasionally until crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Using a knife, break up tomatoes in can.
Add to skillet, stirring to loosen brown bits on bottom of pan.
Heat until bubbling, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add reserved chicken and shrimp. Stir in 2 tablespoons butter.
Arrange pasta on serving platter. Top with chicken-shrimp mixture.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Creamed Turkey
steps: Melt butter, add flour and stir over low heat until blended. Add cold broth and milk at once.
Cook, stirring constantly, until uniformly thickened.
Set over hot water.
Add the seasoning and turkey and heat thoroughly.
Add more seasoning, if desired. Serve over biscuits, toast or rice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Fantastic French Bread
steps: Soften yeast in warm water.
Mix first 6 ingredients.
Knead for about 10 minutes, every 10 minutes for an hour.
Press down dough.
Divide dough into 4 balls.
Let rest 10 minutes.
Make into rolls or loaves.
Let rise until double.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Lori'S Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
steps: Mix together all ingredients but the chicken in a saucepan over a low heat.
Pour mixture over chicken pieces.
Spread out in a baking pan (oblong).
Allow chicken to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: 7 Layer Bars
steps: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
Press lightly and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni With Ricotta
steps: Combine, in bowl, cheeses, water, oil, salt and pepper.
Beat until smooth.
Set aside.
Cook macaroni and drain.
Place in casserole, pour mixture over and toss with forks.
Keep warm.

title: Monster Cookies (160)
steps: Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla, corn syrup, baking soda, oleo and peanut
butter until smooth.
Blend in oatmeal. Add chips and M&M's.
Drop
by tablespoons and flatten on cookie sheet. Bake about
12 minutes at 350°.	Plan to make a day of it with the family.

title: Angels Delight
steps: Mix together pineapple, nuts and marshmallows.
Cover and place in refrigerator overnight to chill.
Next morning, whip the cream until thick (being careful not to overbeat).
Fold cream into the chilled mixture.
Top with cherries.

title: Merkts Cheddar Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: merkt sharp cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. Merkts sharp Cheddar cheese or any kind you like

ingredients.name: garlic salt
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. garlic salt (eliminate if garlic in cheese already)

steps: Let set until all ingredients reach room temperature.
Beat together.
May freeze part of this recipe, but don't re-freeze. Great with pretzels, vegetables or crackers.

title: Best Ever Corn Dogs
steps: Boil hot dogs; dry on a paper towel.
Mix dry ingredients together.
Add egg and milk; beat until smooth.
Dip franks in batter and fry until brown.
Drain on paper towel.
Serve warm.

title: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps: In a medium bowl, mix yogurt, mayonnaise, dill weed, sugar and salt.
Add cucumbers, carrots and onion. Stir to coat with yogurt mixture.
Serve immediately.
Yields 4 portions (3 cups).

title: Blueberry Delight #1
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Soften margarine and cut into dry cake mix until thoroughly blended.
Pat into 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Spread pie filling over cake mix.

title: Easy Swiss Steak

ingredients.name: beef mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can beefy mushroom soup or cream of mushroom soup

steps: Heat oil from garlic.
Dredge serving size pieces of steak in seasoned salt, pepper, etc.
Brown steak in hot oil.
Drain fat. Cover with soup.
Add water.
Turn heat to medium-low.
Cover pan. Check fairly often.
Cook until done.

title: Sangria Punch #2

ingredients.name: burgundy
ingredients.raw: 1 (25.4 oz.) bottle Burgundy or other dry red wine

steps: In large bowl, combine Burgundy, mixed fruit, lemon concentrate and grenadine syrup.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Stir into club soda.
Pour into glasses and top with orange slices.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Bake
steps: Brown pork chops.
Sprinkle with seasoned
salt and pepper; set aside.

title: Mike'S Gourmet Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Clean mushrooms and take out the stem.
Using a spoon, scoop out center, forming a small bowl.
Fill each mushroom with shrimp; season each mushroom with Johnny's seasoned salt, lemon pepper and garlic powder to taste.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 13 minutes, then sprinkle cheese over each mushroom and broil until cheese is melted.

title: Christmas Jello Salad
steps: Mix 2 envelopes jello with milk.
Add 1 1/4 cups of boiling water and mix well.
Set aside.
Mix red jello and 1 cup of hot water; set aside.
Mix green jello and 1 cup hot water; set aside. Add 1 package of gelatin with first and second jellos.
Place both colors of jello in icebox until firm.
Add milk mixture, then add other color on top.
Chill!

title: Risotto

ingredients.name: flavorful olive oil
ingredients.raw: 6 Tbsp. extra virgin flavorful olive oil

steps: In a medium pan, heat chicken broth to a simmer over medium heat.
While broth is heating, saute onion in oil for 3 or 5 minutes until soft.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil.
Add 1/2 cup broth and stir with a wooden spoon until the broth has been absorbed.
Continue this pattern with rest of broth, adding it 1/2 cup at a time and stirring until it is absorbed by the rice.
When you have used all the broth, test the rice to see if it is still too chewy.
If so, add more hot broth or hot water until it reaches the desired consistency.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese and black pepper.

title: Buried Treasures(Children'S Recipe)

ingredients.name: treasure such as cooky miniature marshmallow peanut butter fruit chocolate chip nut etc.
ingredients.raw: treasures such as broken cookies, miniature marshmallows, peanut butter, fruit, chocolate chips, nuts, etc.

ingredients.name: jell o instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O instant pudding (any flavor)

steps: Choose 4 different treasures.
Put 2 tablespoon of each treasure in the bottom of each dessert dish.
You may put more than one ingredient in each dish, if you wish.
Pour 2 cups cold milk into bowl with pudding mix.
Mix until thick.
Gently spoon the pudding over the "treasures".
Pudding will thicken quickly and will be ready to eat in 5 minutes, or refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serves 4.

title: Apple Crisp(Microwave)
steps: Spread apples in microwavable dish (8 x 8 x 2-inch).
Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly.
Sprinkle over apples. Microwave on High for 6 minutes.
Rotate dish 1/2 turn.
Microwave 6 to 8 minutes longer or until apples are tender.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Mandarin Salad
steps: Bake chicken breasts at 450° for 25 minutes.
Cut into chunks; put in freezer to cool.
On bed of lettuce, add orange segments, green pepper, chilled chicken and walnuts.
Top with Italian dressing; sprinkle with chow mein noodles.
Serves 2 to 3 as a main dish.

title: Salmon Puff

ingredients.name: soft bread
ingredients.raw: 2 c. soft bread cubes (2 1/2 slices of bread)

steps: In a large bowl, combine eggs, milk and soup.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until mixture appears set.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Orange Supreme Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven as directed on back of cake mix; prepare cake as directed (substitute water with apricot juice).
Add 1/2 package orange Jell-O mix and orange flavoring.
Pour into Bundt pan and cook as directed.
After cooked, cool cake on plate.

title: Chicken Baked In Mustard

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: 2 whole skinless boneless chicken breasts (1 to 1 1/2 lb.)

ingredients.name: soft homemade bread crumb
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. soft homemade bread crumbs (make in food processor)

steps: Cut chicken into 4 equal pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Brush mustard onto both sides of the chicken.
Roll each piece in bread crumbs, coating thoroughly.
Shake off excess.
Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Old Fashion Cottage Cheese Cake

ingredients.name: dry cottage cheese put through sieve
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. dry cottage cheese, put through sieve or processor

steps: Mix cheese, sugar, eggs, salt, vanilla and flour.
Add cream. Mix thoroughly.
Pour in pan lined with graham cracker crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Rosie Potatoes

ingredients.name: hash brown potato thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed

steps: Combine all ingredients but Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 12 to 16.

title: Bea'S Chocolate Macaroons
steps: Beat egg whites until just foamy.
Add sugar, coconut and vanilla.
Melt chocolate chips until slightly softened, not soupy. Fold into egg mixture; blend well.
Place by tablespoonful onto lightly greased cookie sheet or on parchment baking paper.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes or until edge of cookie can be lifted.
Will be soft, but will harden later.
They refrigerate or freeze well.

title: Mud Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and cocoa.
Beat in eggs, vanilla and flour.
Mix well and fold in nuts and coconut.
Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 40 minutes in 350° oven.
Spread marshmallow cream on top of cake and return to oven. Bake for 5 minutes.
Cool and frost with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Healthful Banana Bread
steps: Sift dry ingredients together; add bananas, oil and honey and mix thoroughly.
Bake in loaf pan for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Water Whipped Pie Crust
steps: Put shortening in bowl.
Add boiling water and milk.
Whip with a fork until all water is absorbed and is thick and smooth mixture is formed.
Sift the flour and salt into mixture and stir quickly into a dough.
Work until smooth.
It's easier to roll between 2 sheets of wax paper.
Very easy to handle.

title: Apple Refresher

ingredients.name: chilled apple cider
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. chilled apple cider or juice

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. cinnamon or to suit your taste

steps: Mix ingredients together in blender until frothy.
Serve immediately.
Serves 2 to 3.

title: Ham Delight
steps: Mix all except ham and cheese.
Split Pepperidge Farm party rolls and spread mix on both halves.
Add small slice of ham and piece of Swiss cheese.
Put rolls back in aluminum pan.
Wrap with aluminum foil and heat in a 400° oven for 10 minutes.
Serve warm.
Can be made ahead of time and frozen.

title: Italian Casserole
steps: Boil noodles until tender.
Drain.
Brown beef until done. Rinse with hot water.
Mix together noodles and beef; add spaghetti sauce and pepperoni.
Mix well.
Add 1/2 package of cheese.
Mix. Put into casserole dish.
Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Sangria

ingredients.name: dry red wine
ingredients.raw: 1 (4/5 qt.) bottle dry red wine (3 1/4 c.)

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.raw: 1 c. fruit (sliced orange, lemons, apple, peach and banana)

steps: Into large pitcher, pour lemon juice and sugar; stir until the sugar dissolves.
Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Secret Kiss Candy
steps: Combine margarine and sugar; add vanilla and flour.
Blend until light and fluffy; add nuts.
Chill dough 2 hours.
Roll Kiss in tablespoon of dough.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Do not brown.
When cool, roll in confectioners sugar.
Great for Christmas candy bags.

title: Pineapple Shrimp Appetizers

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 chopped green onions (some of the greens also)

ingredients.name: or tsp. horseradish
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 tsp. horseradish or Dijon mustard

steps: Combine everything together except the cukes.
Thick slice cukes and spoon heaping teaspoonful of filling on top of each slice.
Garnish with thin slices of green onion tops, if desired. No grams of fat in recipe.

title: "Rink Tum Diddi"
steps: In double boiler, melt grated cheese; add and stir in can of tomato soup, then egg.
Beat all of this well.
Serve hot on saltine crackers!!
Makes a delightfully light Sunday night "supper"!!

title: Dorothy Sherman'S Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine yellow cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.raw: 2 tsp. lemon juice or lemon extract

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Beat 2 minutes on medium speed.
Then 4 minutes on high speed.
Bake in a well-greased tube pan at 325° for 55 minutes or until done.
Let cool for a few minutes and then turn upside-down on plate.
With large cooking fork tines, punch holes in cooled cake.

title: Rhubarb Conserve
steps: Wash rhubarb; cut into 1/2-inch pieces.
Combine in heavy kettle with remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat and simmer on low heat for about 1 1/2 hours, or until like conserve in consistency.
Remove from heat. Pour into clean, sterilized jars.
Makes 12 half pints.

title: Zucchini Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown meat, onion, garlic and green pepper. Add zucchini and mushrooms. Cook a little more.
Pour in greased casserole.
Pour beaten eggs over and spread with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until eggs are set.

title: 30 Minute Creamy Macaroni

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. cubed cooked ham or turkey

steps: Prepare macaroni according to package and drain.
Combine milk and mushroom soup, mustard, pepper and vegetables.
Boil for 10 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.
Turn heat off. Put in ham and cheese; stir.
Then put all ingredients with macaroni and stir.

title: Cottage Potatoes

ingredients.name: each salt pepper and parsley flake
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. each: salt, pepper and parsley flakes

steps: Mix all together in large baking pan.
Sprinkle with crushed corn flakes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are soft.

title: Scotch Toffee Bars(Microwave)
steps: Combine butter, oats, brown sugar, corn syrup, vanilla and salt in 2-quart dish.
Press firmly in bottom.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes on Full power or until bubbling all over.
Top with chips and heat 1 minute or until melted.
Spread evenly over crust and chill.
Cut into squares.
Store in airtight containers.

title: Stuffed Squash
steps: Cut necks off squash and core inside out and save.
Mix all ingredients except 1 can tomato paste and squash hulls.
Stuff squash loosely; put neck in top and secure with toothpick.
Cover with water and add 1 can tomato paste.
Bring to a boil and simmer 1 hour.

title: Praline Grahams
steps: Arrange crackers side by side as close as you can on cookie sheet covered with foil.
Cookie sheet must have sides.
Put butter and sugar in pan and cook 1 1/2 minutes.
When it comes to a boil, take off heat and add nuts and vanilla, then spread evenly over crackers. Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
When cool, break apart. Can be frozen.
Will not get soggy.

title: E-Z Chicken Dinner
steps: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place celery in bottom of pan.
Place chicken breasts on top of celery. Season chicken with seasoned salt. Drain 1 can of potatoes.
Place around chicken. Drain half the juice from the second can of potatoes and place around chicken.
