Add green pepper, mushrooms and onion. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cover pan with aluminum foil to keep in moisture.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Batter For Zucchini
steps: Mix
together
and put in icebox for 2 to 3 hours before using.
Dip zucchini in the batter and deep fry.

title: Easy Breakfast Pie

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. shredded cheese (may use Cheddar, Jack or Swiss)

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle sausage, cheese and onion into bottom of dish. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.
Pour over mixture in casserole dish.
Bake until knife inserted halfway between center comes out clean, about 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Makes 6 large servings.

title: Pizza Fritte(Fried Bits Of Dough)
steps: Peel, boil and mash the potatoes.
Save the liquid and add it to the flour.
Mix all ingredients together well and set in warm place to rise until double in bulk.
When dough has raised sufficiently, pinch off small pieces and fry
in oil in deep fryer. Drain and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Turkey Impossible Pie

ingredients.name: up turkey
ingredients.raw: 2 c. cut-up cooked turkey or chicken

steps: Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle turkey, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.
Pour into plate.
Bake until golden brown for 30 to 35 minutes in 400° oven.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
steps: Mix in order given.
Bake at 300° or 325° for 1/2 hour or longer.

title: Irish Potato Bake

ingredients.name: corn chex c.
ingredients.raw: 4 c. Corn Chex, crushed to 2 c.

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained

ingredients.name: mashed potato seasoned
ingredients.raw: 3 c. mashed potatoes, seasoned to taste

ingredients.name: american cheese or
ingredients.raw: 1 c. American cheese, shredded or sliced

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Butter sides and bottom of casserole dish. Combine Corn Chex and butter; set aside.
Combine broccoli, mashed potatoes, sour cream, garlic powder and seasoned salt. Pour 1/2 of this mixture into casserole dish.
Top with 1/2 cup of American cheese, then 1/2 cup of Corn Chex mixture.
Layer remaining broccoli, cheese, Corn Chex, in that order.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Enjoy!

title: Instant Cocoa
steps: Mix well.
Add 1/3 to 1/2 cup per cup of hot water.

title: Saute Carrots
steps: Place carrots, salt, pepper and water in a 2-quart saucepan. Cook on high until steam rises from the lid.
Then reduce to low for 10 to 15 minutes.
Drain well and roll carrots in bread crumbs and saute in skillet with butter until lightly browned.

title: Cashew Chicken Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken bouillon
ingredients.raw: 3 c. chicken bouillon (2 cubes per c., more if needed)

ingredients.name: a.1. sauce
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. A.1. sauce or 1/2 tsp. sugar

steps: Bring bouillon to boil, making sure cubes are dissolved.
Add cornstarch paste; cook until thickened.

title: Easy Pepper Steak

ingredients.name: steak
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into strips

steps: Brown meat; drain grease.
Add broth to meat; simmer until tender.
Add all other ingredients, except cornstarch, and simmer for 10 to 15 more minutes.

title: Broiled Cake
steps: Beat eggs until fluffy.
Add sugar and dry ingredients.
Melt butter and pour into warm milk.
(Do not boil.)
Add vanilla and mix with other ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Deep Fried Cheese Balls
steps: Mix all together; form into balls.
Deep-fry until brown. Place on plate with paper towel until grease is gone.

title: Popsicles

ingredients.name: kool aid
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. Kool-Aid (same flavor as jello)

steps: Mix well and add 1 cup cold water.
Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for several hours before serving.
Run water over molds to loosen popsicles.

title: Fillet Of Flounder Mediterranean
steps: Butter shallow baking dish.
Arrange fish in dish.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add remaining ingredients and pour over fish. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned
ingredients.raw: 4 to 6 chicken breasts, skinned (may be boneless)

steps: Place chicken on individual aluminum foil squares.
Generously sprinkle each breast with some of the onion soup mix and 3 to 4 pats of butter.
Add a few dashes of Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper as desired.
Wrap in foil and bake about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Zucchini Dressing
steps: Fry zucchini and add minced onion in a small amount of fat for a few minutes.
Melt oleo in a casserole dish.
Put zucchini on top.
Mix dressing according to directions on box (except omit oleo).
Put on top of zucchini.
Add sour cream and chicken soup (undiluted).
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Royal Rice

ingredients.name: green onion with top
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. finely chopped green onions with tops

ingredients.name: rice
ingredients.raw: 3 c. cooked rice (cook in beef broth)

steps: Saute onions and oleo until soft.
Add rice, salt and mushrooms.
Heat thoroughly.
Fluff lightly with a fork.

title: Dinosaur Chow

ingredients.name: c. swamp water
ingredients.raw: 1\2 C. Swamp Water (Milk with Green Food Coloring)

steps: Mix Dirt and Swamp Water. Add Crushed Bones and Fat. Boil 3 min. Add Squashed Bugs and Dead Grass, Stir until melted.
Remove from heat. Stir until mixture begins to thicken.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Cool, eat and Enjoy YUM! YUM!

title: Break Away Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.
In large bowl, pour boiling warm water over Crisco and dissolve.
Add sugar, salt, eggs, yeast and flour; mix well and let double in size.
Knead. Divide dough into 2 parts.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter.
Dip each biscuit in melted butter.
Stick on end in Bundt pan.
Let rise 2 to 3 hours.
Bake at 350° until golden brown, about 30 minutes.
This makes 2 pans.
Do not cut, just pull apart.

title: Quick And Easy Quiche
steps: Mix together milk, Bisquick, eggs, salt and pepper until smooth.
Add onions, cheese and bacon to mixture.
Mix well.
Pour mixture into a lightly greased 10-inch pie pan.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cream Coconut Icing

ingredients.name: lemon rind
ingredients.raw: grated rind of 1/4 lemon or orange

steps: Cream the butter until soft.
Add sugar alternately with lemon juice.
Add a dash of salt.
Beat until smooth and light.
Add grated rind of lemon.
Spread and sprinkle coconut on top and sides of cake.

title: Italian White Clam Sauce
steps: Brown lightly garlic in olive oil.
Drain clams, add clam meat, onion and sherry to pan.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over linguine noodles.

title: Eggplant Patties
steps: Peel the eggplant and slice them up.
Then place them in large bowl, fill bowl with water and put 1/2 teaspoon salt in water to keep the eggplant from turning dark.
Let stand for 3 minutes, then drain off.
Place the eggplant in pot, boil on medium heat until tender.
Mash them up.
Add the ingredients in, mix well with spoon.
Make small patties, place in skillet in hot fat at 275°.
Fry until golden brown.
Serve while warm.

title: Chicken Cacciatore With Fettuccine

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned and
ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 chicken breasts, skinned and cut into strips

ingredients.name: spiral rotelle
ingredients.raw: cooked spiral rotelle or fettuccine, drained

steps: Sprinkle flour on strips of chicken.
Saute with onion and oil; add carrots, tomatoes and seasoning.
Cook, covered, for 20 minutes on low heat.
Serve over the cooked pasta.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Dip

ingredients.name: reduced fat cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 3 oz. reduced fat cream cheese, softened

steps: Cut red peppers lengthwise into halves.
Place on broiler pan with cut sides down.
Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat source until skin on peppers is blistered and black.
Wrap peppers in towel or place in a Ziploc bag; let stand 5 minutes. Remove skin, seeds and stems from peppers.
Cut peppers into 1-inch pieces and process in blender until smooth.
In a small bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Beat in red pepper puree and remaining ingredients. Refrigerate in a covered dish for several hours, allowing flavors to blend.
Serve with vegetables for dipping.

title: Fruit Fluff
steps: Drain fruit and mix with Cool Whip, cottage cheese and dry jello.
This can be eaten immediately, but is best when chilled for a while.

title: Hot Chicken Wings
steps: Wash wings; add salt, pepper and tenderizer.
Place in baking pan.
Bake at 425° until one side is done (about 30 minutes). Turn wings.
Pour Texas Pete sauce over wings.
Cook for awhile longer.
Let sit 5 minutes before eating.

title: Cranberry Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: ocean spray raisin cranberry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup Ocean Spray Craisins Sweetened Dried Cranberries

steps: Wash and clean spinach.
Divide evenly among 4 salad plates. Top each with 2 Tbsp. of sweetened dried cranberries and onions.

title: Oriental Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: oriental vegetable
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. Oriental vegetables or 10 oz. pkg.

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet until hot.
Add Crab Delights and vegetables.
Cook and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add seasoning; stir well.
Cook 1 minute more.
Serve immediately.

title: Orange Frost

ingredients.name: orange juice diluted
ingredients.raw: 3 (12 oz.) cans frozen orange juice, diluted

steps: Combine orange juice and ginger ale and pour over orange sherbet.
Float slices of orange and sprigs of mint in punch bowl for garnishes.
Yield:
50 (8-ounce) servings.

title: Hot Crab And Artichoke Dip
steps: Drain crab meat and chop artichokes.
Combine with cheese and mayonnaise.
Heat in a small casserole at 350° for 20 minutes. Serve with small slices of garlic toast.

title: Favorite Drop Biscuits
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Blend in oil with a fork until mixture resembles coarse sand.
Mix in buttermilk.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls onto oiled baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for about 15 minutes.
Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Short Cake
steps: Beat yolks, sugar, water and dry ingredients.
Beat whites stiff.
Fold into mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes using a 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Hog Dogs In Crock-Pot
steps: Combine 1 cup water with the Kitchen Bouquet sauce.
Bring all ingredients to boil and thicken.
Put in crock-pot with previously warmed hot dogs.
Add 1 to 2 cans drained pineapple chunks.
Warm all through entirely and keep hot dogs and pineapple under sauce to keep moist.

title: Low-Fat Honey-Mustard Chicken
steps: Spray a large pan with Pam.
Place chicken breasts in pan. Cook on medium heat until done.
Reduce heat and add onions, mushrooms, rice, peas and carrots.
Fold all ingredients together and cover.
Cook on low heat for 7 to 10 minutes.
Serves four.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well. Mix in pineapple and juice.
Cube bread and add to pineapple mixture.
Bake in a greased casserole at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6.

title: Chicken And Egg Noodles
steps: Debone cooked chicken.
Cook noodles.
Combine all ingredients. Serve while hot.

title: Lazy Lasagna
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
In large bowl, toss noodles with 1 cup cottage cheese, 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Add sauce to browned ground beef.

title: Chicken Dumplins
steps: Stew chicken and debone.
Add milk and bring to boil.
Add salt and pepper.
Mix water, flour, oil and egg.
Roll out thin and cut in strips.
Drop in hot chicken and simmer until done, about 30 minutes.

title: Grandma Pandolfi'S Famous Spaghetti And Eggplant(Serves 8 To 10 People)

ingredients.name: very eggplant
ingredients.raw: 1 very large eggplant or 2 medium ones

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.raw: 4 large cans crushed tomatoes or puree

steps: Peel and slice eggplant into circles.
Fry in olive oil until browned.
Place on paper towels or paper bags to blot oil out. Set aside.
Begin your marinara sauce.
Saute garlic in oil until brown in the bottom of a pot.
Add tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper (dash of sugar optional).
Let sauce simmer about 1/2 hour or 45 minutes.

title: Raisin Nut Pie(Yields 11-Inch Pie)
steps: Coat raisins and nuts with flour.
Beat egg yolks; add other ingredients.
Beat egg whites, then fold in.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Green Snap Beans
steps: Clean and snap green beans.
Put bacon drippings in a large pot; add the snap beans and about 2 cups water.
Cook at medium temperature.
Add water as needed.
Just before they are done, add the salt and sugar.
Serve with fresh onions and cornbread. Yield:
6 servings.

title: Spinach-Cheese Squares

ingredients.name: spinach thawed
ingredients.raw: 20 oz. frozen spinach, thawed (squeeze out water)

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in large greased rectangular pan at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool 45 minutes.
Cut into small squares.
Reheat at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes when serving as hors d'oeuvre.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
steps: Mix soda, water and sugar.
Add cocoa and stir well.
Add flour and vanilla.
Mix well and add mayonnaise.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Pancakes(Eighteen 4-Inch)
steps: Beat eggs, butter and milk until well blended.
Add flour and baking powder, sugar and salt to ingredients.
Add mix just enough to make creamy batter with some lumps.

title: Butterscotch Candy
steps: Melt chips in double boiler.
Mix in remaining ingredients. Stir well.
Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper.
Let set until hard.
Makes about 6 dozen candies.

title: Colcannon(Irish)
steps: Chop 6 scallions very fine.
Soak in cup milk with 1 teaspoon of salt for 1/2 hour.
Put in a saucepan and simmer for 1/2 hour. Boil 6 medium potatoes, peeled in salt water.
Cover until tender. Drain, dry and begin to mash.
When smooth, beat in the scallions and milk.
Add 3 tablespoons butter and continue beating over low heat.

title: Vicki'S Spinach Salad
steps: Cook bacon.
Reserve drippings.
Wash spinach and tear into bite size pieces.
In a large bowl, combine spinach, onion, avocado, tomato and crumbled bacon.
Set aside.

title: Breakfast Casserole #2
steps: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Cube bread and scatter the bread cubes in the pan.
Brown and drain the meat.
Cover the bread cubes with meat.
Mix eggs, milk, mustard and pepper together.
Pour over meat and bread.
Cover with cheese.

title: Mrs. O'Hurley'S Potatoes
steps: Let potatoes thaw slightly; break apart.
Spread in about an 8 x 12-inch cake pan.
Mix the onion, garlic salt, soup and sour cream.
Spread on top of potatoes.
Sprinkle on cheese and corn flakes (crushed).
Drizzle butter on top.
Bake for about 45 minutes at 350°.
Onions may be cooked ahead.

title: Congealed Fruit Salad
steps: Cream jello and cream cheese together.
Add boiling water; mix well and cool.
Add remaining ingredients and congeal.

title: Chicken In The Basket
steps: Allow 3 pieces of chicken per person.
Brown chicken well in skillet on top of stove.
For each serving, cut one 12-inch square of foil.
Place 3 pieces of chicken in center of foil square.
On each serving, place a few mushrooms and chopped onions.
Add to each serving 3 tablespoons of milk.
Gather foil together around chicken and seal edges, forming basket.
Bake in 250° to 300° oven for about 1 hour before ready to serve.

title: Grandma'S Ice Creamwoodland Park, Colorado
steps: Warm milk to luke warm.
Combine all other ingredients.
Put into freezer.
Add milk and stir.
Freeze according to your freezer directions.

title: Cheese Bread
steps: In a large bowl combine 4 cups of the flour and the yeast. Heat milk, sugar and salt until warm (115° to 120°), stirring to dissolve sugar.
Add to flour mixture, along with eggs and cheese. With electric mixer on low, beat until well blended.
By hand, stir in remaining flour to make a stiff dough.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth.
Place in large greased bowl; cover with clean towel and let rise until double in bulk. Divide dough; knead and place in greased bread pans.
Will make 3 large loaves.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, until golden brown on top.
Remove from pan and butter top of loaves.
Let cool.
This makes great toast!

title: Ibo Stew(Nigerian)

ingredients.name: beef stew mix
ingredients.raw: Beef stew mix or Onion soup mix

ingredients.name: your choice of spice
ingredients.raw: your choice of spices or the items below

steps: *Tomato Puree:
Vegetable oil and tomato paste.
Heat oil in pan. Add tomato paste and stir.
Allow to heat thoroughly while continuously stirring.

title: Ruby Flip
steps: In a pitcher, dissolve cherry Jell-O in boiling water.
Stir in lemonade concentrate.
Add cold water and cranberry juice; chill thoroughly.
Just before serving, add ginger ale.
Mix gently.
Makes 16 (6-ounce) servings.

title: Quick And Easy Cajun Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken breast and in bite size
ingredients.raw: 3 small chicken breasts, cooked and cut in bite size pieces

steps: Make rice according to package directions.
Add tomatoes to rice, then add chicken and heat thoroughly.

title: My Swiss Steak

ingredients.name: sirloin
ingredients.raw: 3/4 to 1 lb. sirloin or round steak

steps: Slice beef in strips.
Dredge in flour.
Brown beef in heated oil; add onions and saute until soft.
Chop tomatoes and add to beef, including juice.
Stir in tomato soup.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Daisy'S Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine sugar and flour. Boil the margarine, water and cocoa. Pour over sugar and flour mixture. Add eggs, soda, buttermilk and salt.
Grease pan and cook 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pickled Carrots
steps: Remove skins; boil in water until slightly tender.
Slice or leave whole.
Pour syrup made of vinegar, sugar and spices (in bag), boiling, over carrots.
Let stand overnight, then bring to boil and boil 5 minutes.
Remove spices; pack carrots into clean jars.
Fill to within 1/2 top of jars with hot spiced syrup.
Put on cap; seal.
Process in water bath for 10 minutes.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
steps: Mix first 2 ingredients with mixer, adding remaining ingredients and beating in vegetable oil slowly.
Refrigerate. Shake and pour over cabbage just before serving.
Will keep in refrigerator for a week or more, covered, then just shake or mix well.
Pour on cabbage as much as you like, to moisten the cabbage.

title: The Proverbial Black-Eyed Pea

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp salt, or more to taste

ingredients.name: salt pork ham hock
ingredients.raw: Salt pork, ham hock or bacon ends

steps: Shell the peas, using some of the tender snaps.
In a 3 quart pot, cover the peas with water and add salt.
Add your choice of meat.
(In an emergency when you're out of meat, peas may be seasoned with Lawry's seasoning salt.)
Bring to a boil and simmer about 2 or 2 1/2 hours.
Taste and correct seasonings.
This same method works for cream peas, crowder peas or purple-hulled peas. Serves 4 - 6.

title: Quick Lasagne
steps: Brown beef and drain well.
Cook noodles as directed on box. Place small amount of sauce in baking dish.
Next, place layer of noodles.
Cover noodles with beef.
Pour the remaining sauce over the beef.
Spread cottage cheese over sauce.
Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Muffin Rolls
steps: Mix flour, sugar and yeast together.
Beat in water, Wesson oil and egg.
Put in bowl in refrigerator until ready to use.
Put in greased muffin pans and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.
Makes about 2 dozen.
(Will keep about 3 days in refrigerator.)

title: Hot Artichoke Spread

ingredients.name: artichoke and
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can artichokes (hearts), chopped and drained

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well. Spoon into lightly greased pie pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

title: Cookie Delights
steps: In saucepan, combine margarine, pineapple, sugar and cornstarch.
Bring to a boil and cook until thick.
Put between Dixie cookies; top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Pina Colada Fruit Dip

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. can crushed pineapple (in its own juice; undrained)

ingredients.name: instant coconut pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 oz. pkg. instant coconut pudding mix

steps: In food processor bowl with metal blade or blender container, combine all ingredients. Cover.
Blend 30 seconds.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors.
Serve with fresh fruit.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Eulla'S Oven Cooked Beef

ingredients.name: golden cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can golden cream of mushroom soup

steps: Cut all fat off meat; mix with soup.
Put in pan and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.
Serve over rice.

title: German Slaw
steps: Chop cabbage and onion and pour 1 cup sugar over it.
Combine 1 tablespoon sugar, salt, dry mustard, celery seed, vinegar and oil in small pan and bring to boil.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage immediately.
Cover and refrigerate until next day.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
steps: Roll out each biscuit into about a 6 inch circle.
Place cheese and hotdog on it and roll up.
Follow baking instructions on the can.

title: Quick Eggnog
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender container.
Cover; blend at high speed just until thoroughly combined.
Serve immediately. One recipe makes approximately 4 1/2 cups or 8 to 10 half-cup servings.
Repeat as necessary for additional servings.

title: Vegetarian Lunch

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1 Tbsp. creamy or chunky peanut butter

steps: With knife or spoon, apply peanut butter to one side of one bread slice.
Repeat procedure with jam or jelly on the other bread slice.
Place slice with peanut butter on top of slice with jelly, making sure ingredients face each other.
Cut into triangles if desired.

title: Platanos Maduros En Leche(Plantains In Milk)
steps: Peel the plantains.
Wash, then cut lengthwise deep, but not enough to cut in half.
The idea is to fill the plantain.
Melt butter (low heat) in frying pan large enough to hold the plantains.
Fry the plantains in butter with medium heat.
Brown on both sides.
When browned, remove from the pan.
Fill each plantain with a slice of American or Mozzarella cheese.
Roll them in the sugar and return to the heat.
Pour the milk over them and break the stick of cinnamon into the milk.
Cover and simmer them for 1 hour over low heat.

title: Toll House Cookie Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla until well blended.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Beat into creamed mixture until smooth.
Add chips and nuts.
Spoon into crust.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until puffed. Serve with ice cream.

title: Nut And Raisin Cake
steps: Mix all together.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Low-Fat Baked Chicken
steps: Dip chicken in beaten egg, then in crumbs.
Put in Pyrex dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Mix Parmesan and red pepper and sprinkle over top of chicken.
Bake in 400° oven 30 minutes.
Do not turn.

title: Sue'S Monkey Bread
steps: Grease a Bundt pan.
Cut biscuits in half.
Shake in bag with sugar and cinnamon.
Melt margarine and brown sugar until dissolved.
Place biscuits in pan.
Pour melted mixture over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Garlic Feta Cheese Spread

ingredients.name: garlic mashed with tsp. salt
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic, mashed with 1/4 tsp. salt

steps: Place everything in the food processor to blend, then convert to crock and cover tightly.
Will keep up to 2 weeks.

title: Party Meatballs In Sauce
steps: Combine above mixture well.
Shape into 1 to 2-inch balls and place on 2 greased brownie sheets.

title: Chocolate Caramel Brownies

ingredients.name: german
ingredients.raw: 1 box (18.25 oz.) German or other chocolate cake mix

ingredients.name: package chocolate covered caramel
ingredients.raw: 2 packages (7 oz. each) chocolate covered caramels (If you prefer, you can use plain caramels)

steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Coat a 9 x 13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Eggplant Au Gratin
steps: Peel and boil eggplants in salted water until soft; strain off water and mash.
Fry sliced onions in butter.
Beat eggs.
Grate cheese.
Combine ingredients; salt and pepper to taste.
Place in greased casserole.
Cover with crumbs; dot with butter.
Bake in moderate oven for 45 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Czechoslovakia Cookies
steps: Mix together and bake in greased square cake pan at 325° until light brown.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Peanut Fudge
steps: In a heavy saucepan, combine the chocolate pieces and peanut butter.
Stir over low heat until chocolate is melted and mixture is blended.
Blend in the peanuts.
Mix in the marshmallows.
Heat just until marshmallows begin to swell and melt, but do not melt completely.
Put butter in a 9-inch square pan.
Pour mixture into the pan, smoothing the top.
Chill until firm.
Cut into squares or triangles.
Makes about 60 squares or triangles.

title: Cranberry Salad Supreme

ingredients.name: red grape and
ingredients.raw: 2 c. red grapes, halved and seeded

ingredients.name: whipped cream
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. whipped cream or Cool Whip

steps: Combine cranberries and sugar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Drain off liquid the next day.
Combine all but marshmallows.
Add them and stir.
Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Spiced Blueberries

ingredients.name: each ground cinnamon clove and allspice
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. each: ground cinnamon cloves and allspice

steps: Mix all ingredients except pectin in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add fruit pectin.
Stir well.
Pack into sterilized jars.
Seal.

title: "Frying Pan" Fudge
steps: Chop nuts; set aside.
Mix sugar, margarine and milk together in a heavy skillet.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cook 6 more minutes, stirring often.
Remove from heat.
Add chocolate chips and nuts.
Stir until fudge begins to form.
Quickly add vanilla flavoring.
Drop fudge on wax paper with teaspoon.
Let cool.
Store in airtight container.

title: Chinese Chewies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour mixture into pan. Mixture will be thick. Bake at 325 for 20-30 minutes. DO NOT OVERCOOK.

title: Macaroni And Olive Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; rinse thoroughly and drain for 10 minutes. Place 1/3 macaroni in bottom of large bowl. Over this macaroni, slice 1 of the eggs and 10 olives and dice 4 mushrooms. Add mayonnaise for desired consistency with 1/4 teaspoon of the mustard.
Add salt and pepper and mix thoroughly. Repeat this procedure 2 more times.

title: Country Pie
steps: Mix beef, bread crumbs, onion, green pepper, seasonings and 1/2 can tomato sauce.
Spread in greased 9 to 10-inch pan, forming a shell.
Mix rice, cheese and remaining sauce. Place in meat shell.
Sprinkle top with a little additional cheese.
Bake in a moderate 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes until meat is done.
Cut into pie shaped pieces.
Serves 6.

title: Country Style Homemade Ice Cream
steps: In a large mixing bowl beat eggs until foamy.
Gradually add sugar; beat until thickened.
Add whipping cream, vanilla and salt; mix thoroughly.
Pour into the can of a 4-quart ice cream churn. Add milk to the fill line and stir.
Freeze as manufacturer of the churn suggests.
Makes 4 quarts.

title: Farmers Potatoes

ingredients.name: potato boiled in jacket
ingredients.raw: 8 to 10 medium potatoes, boiled in jackets

steps: Let potatoes cool, peel and shred.
Layer potatoes and butter; season with salt.
Repeat for 3 layers.
Pour whipping cream over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cream will bubble up.
Recipe may be halved.

title: Scrapple
steps: In a small bowl, blend together corn meal and 1 cup water. In a large saucepan, combine pork sausage, sage, salt, parsley and chicken broth.
Gradually stir in 2 cups water, being careful to separate sausage into fine pieces; bring to a boil.
Slowly add corn meal to the boiling mixture, stirring constantly with a wire whisk.
Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon Dip
steps: Drain and flake salmon, removing skin and bones.
Combine all ingredients.
Blend thoroughly.
Chill.
Serve with crackers as a spread or thin with milk and serve with chips as dip.

title: Crunchy Chicken
steps: Mix Ritz crumbs, cheese and parsley.
Mix garlic, salt, pepper and margarine in a pot and melt.
Dip chicken in melted margarine and then in crumb mix and coat
all
over.	Put in a pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour uncovered.
A crowd pleaser!

title: Broccoli Noodle Kugel *

ingredients.name: broccoli thawed but do not cook
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed but do not cook

steps: Cook noodles and drain.
Add all ingredients together.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes, uncovered, in a large 9 x 13-inch pan.
It can serve 10 to 12 people, depending on appetites.

title: Chocolate Eclair Pudding Cake
steps: Measure cold milk in large mixing bowl.
Add pudding mix with mixer until thick.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put a layer of graham crackers in bottom of pan. Cover crackers with 1/2 of pudding mix.
Cover pudding with second layer of graham crackers.
Add remaining pudding and cover with a third layer of graham crackers.
Ice with chocolate frosting and chill overnight.

title: Linguini With Salmon Sauce

ingredients.name: salt white pepper and nutmeg
ingredients.raw: salt, white pepper and nutmeg to taste

steps: Cook linguini in boiling water; drain.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in heavy saucepan.
Add peas and saute for 1 minute.
Add remaining butter and cream; reduce heat to low and cook until butter melts.
Add salmon, 1/2 cup cheese and spices.
Simmer until cheese melts and salmon is heated through.
Toss with cooked pasta and garnish with remaining cheese and parsley.
Serves 4.

title: Oven Baked Beef Stew
steps: Place 1/2 sliced potatoes in bottom of large baking dish. Brown meat, a few pieces at a time, with onion in oil in a large skillet.
Place meat and onion over potatoes in baking dish.
Top with remaining sliced potatoes. Combine gravy, onion soup mix and water in a small bowl.
Pour over meat and potatoes. Cover. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Stir in frozen peas. Continue baking for 15 minutes longer or until meat is tender.

title: Spinach Hors D'Oeuvres

ingredients.name: dry chicken stove top stuffing
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry chicken Stove Top stuffing

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Shape into balls and freeze on cookie sheet which has been lined with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Dilly Dip
steps: In large bowl, mix together all ingredients except red cabbage.
Let set in refrigerator for a few hours or overnight. Add extra dill, parsley or onions if desired.
Hollow out the red cabbage and fill with dip.
Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Orange-Grapefruit Salad

ingredients.name: orange juice thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed

ingredients.name: grapefruit section and in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. can grapefruit sections, drained and cut in pieces

steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add orange juice concentrate and cold water.
Drain oranges, reserving syrup.
Add syrup to gelatin mixture.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in oranges and grapefruit.
Pour into 6 1/2-cup ring mold.
Chill until set.
Unmold.
Serve with mayonnaise.

title: Broccoli Continental

ingredients.name: broccoli pear thawed and
ingredients.raw: 10 oz. broccoli spears, thawed and chopped

steps: Combine milk, margarine and cheese in saucepan over low heat until cheese melts.
Cool and stir in egg.
Place broccoli in greased 1-quart baking dish; sprinkle with salt.
Pour cheese mixture over broccoli.
Cook and stir garlic in margarine for 2 minutes.
Add toast cubes and stir until butter is absorbed. Sprinkle over broccoli; top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cocoa Oatmeal Treats
steps: In a medium saucepan, stir together the sugar and cocoa.
Stir in the milk and butter.
Cook over medium heat until boiling. Stir constantly.
Boil for one minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter.
Add oats and peanuts.
Stir to mix well.
Quickly drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto wax paper or foil.
Cool completely.
Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Irish Stew
steps: Bring meat to a boil in large pan.
When meat is about half cooked, add the carrots (sliced) and the onions and turnips (quartered).
Cook until vegetables are about half done.
Then add the potatoes (cut in quarters).
Season with salt and pepper. Cook until the stew begins to thicken.

title: Custard Corn Pudding
steps: Beat eggs and add corn, salt, pepper and cracker crumbs. Heat evaporated milk, water and butter
and
add
to first mixture, add
sugar.
Pour into greased
quart
dish
and sprinkle with nutmeg.
Set in pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Beans And Macaroni (Pasta Con Fagoli)(Hearty Italian Peasant Dish)

ingredients.name: besan
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can beans (pinto or white beans)*

steps: *If
desired,
use
fresh shelled butter beans to which you add slight amount of water.

title: Magic Apple Cobbler
steps: Melt butter and spoon a little into a large, glass baking dish (to grease it).
Arrange the apple slices in the bottom of the dish.
Combine remaining butter and other ingredients and pour over apples.

title: Kentucky Corn Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, combine sugar, flour, salt and eggs.
Beat well.
Add milk and corn.
Pour into shallow baking dish.
Add butter.
Place dish in a larger dish with water. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
The first 1/2 hour of baking, stir mixture every 10 minutes.
Must set like custard.
Remove from oven immediately when done.

title: Golden Carrots
steps: Combine carrots and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and vent.
Microwave on High 5 to 10 minutes or until carrots are done, stirring once.

Combine onion, butter and nutmeg in a small bowl; microwave on High 30 seconds to 1 minute or until onion is tender and transparent. Add next 4 ingredients and stir well; microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add onion mixture to carrots, tossing gently to coat.
Yields 4 servings.

title: Granny'S  Bread Pudding
steps: Add the margarine, sugar, salt and raisins to the milk.
Mix flour with a small amount of the milk.
Add to the milk mixture. Heat almost to a boil.
Pour over the bread crumbs and let stand about 5 minutes.
Add the nutmeg.
Mix well. Pour into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Heavenly Chocolate Berry Pie

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. semi sweet chocolate morsel
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. semi-sweet chocolate morsels

ingredients.name: baked pie shell
ingredients.raw: baked pie shell or graham cracker crust shell

steps: Place 1/2 cup chocolate morsels in double boiler; bring water to boil.
Reduce to low and cook until morsels melt.
Set aside.

title: Dreamy Banana Salad
steps: Whip cream.
Put layer of vanilla wafers in bottom of large shallow dish.
Add layer of crushed pineapple with juice, layer of sliced banana and layer of whipped cream.
Start again with layer of vanilla wafers, pineapple, bananas and cream.
Make about 3 layers.
Refrigerate and serve.

title: Peach "N" Cream Congealed Salad
steps: Mix jello in 2 cups boiling water until dissolved.
Add peach pie filling and pineapple.
Mix well.
Pour in container and chill until firm.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Jam
steps: Prepare fruit; add sugar and pineapple.
Boil for 20 minutes; remove from heat and add Jell-O.
Mix well.
Pour into jars and seal.

title: Low-Fat And Sugar Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: fat kraft philadelphia cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) fat-free Kraft Philadelphia cream cheese

ingredients.name: sugar chocolate pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box sugar free chocolate pudding mix

steps: Put sour cream, cream cheese and dry pudding mix into bowl and mix with electric mixer.
Add creme de menthe flavoring to your taste and mix.
Fold in 6 ounces of light Cool Whip and put into pie crust and spread rest of Cool Whip on top.
Refrigerate.

title: Irish Holiday Cake

ingredients.name: devil s food cake mix with pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. devil's food cake mix with pudding

ingredients.name: best food mayonnaise
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Best Foods mayonnaise (must be Best Foods)

ingredients.name: bailey s irish cream
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Bailey's Irish cream (must be Bailey's)

steps: Preheat your oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, place the cake mix and add eggs, mayonnaise and Irish cream; mix thoroughly.
Fold in nuts, marshmallows and chocolate bits.
Pour into greased 12-cup fluted tube or Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Seafood Cakes - Tuna Or Salmon

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 1/2 oz.) can tuna or salmon, drained

ingredients.name: each celery green onion and green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/4 c. each finely chopped celery, green onions and green peppers

steps: Mix tuna or salmon, dressing, mustard, vegetables, seasonings and 1/2 cup bread crumbs.
Form balls, roll in bread crumbs and refrigerate 30 minutes or longer.
Heat skillet; add 2 tablespoons oil.
When hot, flatten balls and cook on each side on medium to low heat until brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Rolls
steps: Grease pan.
Sprinkle nuts on bottom.
Arrange frozen rolls evenly over nuts.
Sprinkle dry pudding over rolls.
Melt butter; add brown sugar and cinnamon.
Cover rolls with mixture.
Place in cold oven overnight.

title: R S V P Cookies
steps: Caramelize the sugar and margarine.
Add coconut, ground walnuts, sugar and flour.
Mix.
Add baking soda, vanilla and salt. Mix. Lastly add egg whites. Mix lightly.
Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Will spread.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350° (watch carefully after 10 minutes).
When cool, dip half of each cookie in melted sheet dark chocolate.

title: Hershey'S Syrup Brownies
steps: In large mixing bowl, beat together all ingredients, except nuts.
Eggs should be added one at a time.
Stir in the chopped nuts.
Pour into a greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes; remove from oven.
Prick top with fork many times; pour frosting over it while cake is warm.

title: Apple Cider
steps: Simmer all ingredients together and serve hot.
Remove spices. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Onion Snack Squares
steps: Stretch pie shells to cover bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Crush onions with rolling pin.
Sprinkle over shell (save some for top).
Sprinkle cheese over onions.
Beat eggs, milk, salt, seasoned salt and pepper together.
Pour over onions and cheese.
Sprinkle with reserved onions and cheese.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
May be baked at 350° for 25 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cut into squares.
Makes 36 to 40 squares.

title: Bing Cherry Jello
steps: Drain cherries; save juice.
Cut cherries in half.
Mix water with jello.
When jello is dissolved, add enough water to cherry juice to make 1 cup.
With mixer, soften cream cheese; add juice mixture to cheese and mix until smooth.
Refrigerate jello to get syrupy.
Add slowly to cheese mixture.
Mix until smooth.
Add cherries.
Pour into mold.
Refrigerate until set.

title: Layered Hot Dish

ingredients.name: or can kernel corn
ingredients.raw: 1 c. or can whole kernel corn, drained

ingredients.name: each onion and green pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. each: finely chopped onion and green pepper

steps: Put rice and corn in layers.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour over this 1 can of tomato sauce and 1/2 can water.
Put on top the onion and green pepper, then ground beef.
Sprinkle with more salt and pepper.
Pour over a second can of tomato sauce and 1/4 can water.
Cover with bacon.
Cover and bake about 1 hour at 350°.
Remove cover and bake about 30 minutes or until bacon is crisp.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Angel Food Cake With Pineapple

ingredients.name: angel food cake
ingredients.raw: 1 angel food cake (made from a cake mix or store bought)

ingredients.name: vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. vanilla instant pudding

steps: Slice cake twice to make 3 layers.
Mix together the crushed pineapple with juice, instant pudding and 2 cups of Cool Whip. Spread this mixture between cake layers and also frost the outside of the cake with Cool Whip.
Store cake in the refrigerator.

title: Easy Vegetable Linguine
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain bacon, reserving 2 tablespoons fat.
Saute broccoli and onions in reserved fat.
Crumble bacon. Add vegetables and bacon to combined remaining ingredients; mix lightly.
Serve with additional cheese.
Yield: 2 servings.

title: Happy Day Cake(Layers, Loaf Or Cupcakes)
steps: Sift into bowl the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Add shortening, 3/4 cup milk and vanilla. Mix 2 minutes. Add eggs and remaining milk; beat
1 minute longer. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or according to pan size.

title: Franks Oriental Style

ingredients.name: hot dog in diagonal
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. hot dogs, cut in 1/4-inch diagonal slices

steps: Mix the first 6 ingredients together.
Add mixture to the hot dogs, sliced and browned in the vegetable oil until curled.
Stir constantly until mixture thickens and hot dogs are coated.
To serve, add the sliced green onion.

title: Jazzy Potato Casserole

ingredients.name: salt and white pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Boil potatoes in jackets until almost done; chill until very cold.
Peel and shred with a grater.
Melt margarine in double boiler; add cheese, a small amount at a time.
Mix together the sour cream and milk; add to cheese mixture.
Add onions and stir. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add the shredded potatoes.
Put in casserole; bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Serves 6.

title: Fresh Vegetable Pita
steps: Put all vegetables, except tomatoes, in food processor. Process
until
fairly
fine. Drain well on paper towels.
Mix with cream cheese and lemon.
Add some mayo for proper consistency. Take
1/2 pita and put in a couple of tomato slices and fill with
some
of the vegetable spread. A slice of cheese is also good in this pita sandwich.

title: Homemade Kraut
steps: Mix the first
four ingredients together and bring to a boil. Using quart jars, place a teaspoon of salt in each jar. Pack chopped cabbage in	jars.
Pour
in
hot
mixture.	Run a knife around inside of
jars
to	be sure liquid comes to top. Seal jars and set in cool place.

title: Meadowbrook Farm Traditional New Year'S Day Dinner

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. fresh pork, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Season pork cubes with salt and pepper.
Brown in fat in large heavy saucepan.
Combine water, sauerkraut, apple and onion; add to pork.
Simmer 40 minutes.
Place dumplings on top of sauerkraut.
Cover pan; steam until done.
Lift dumplings onto plate.
Place sauerkraut in deep dish or platter.
Cover with pork cubes; top with dumplings.

title: Carbonara Spaghetti

ingredients.name: or tbsp. butter milk yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1 or 2 Tbsp. butter, milk, yogurt (or cream)

steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Cook spaghetti; drain.
Mix all ingredients with spaghetti immediately.
Serve with more grated cheese, if desired.

title: Hillbilly Meal
steps: Brown hamburger; cook celery and onions until tender.
Mix all together mushroom soup, water and mixed vegetables in the bottom of baking dish.
Mix cornbread mix according to directions.
Pour on top and bake until the bread is done at 350°.
Also good in an iron skillet.

title: Meat Loaf With Rice

ingredients.name: season with salt pepper and dash of garlic
ingredients.raw: season to taste with salt, pepper and dash of garlic

steps: Cook rice in beef broth according to package directions. Combine bread crumbs, milk, egg and seasoning.
Add 1/4 cup onion and 1/4 cup cheese.
Mix well.
Spread mixture evenly on waxed paper to approximately 12 x 10-inch.
Combine cooked rice, 1/4 cup cheese and remaining onion.
Spread on top of beef.
Roll up jelly roll style and seal ends.

title: Beef And Cabbage Casserole
steps: Brown meat; drain off fat.
Add onion, tomato sauce and juice.
Put half of cabbage in a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with meat mixture and repeat layer of cabbage and meat again.
Insert 1 whole clove in center, cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Oriental Pork Chops
steps: Brown pork chops and place in baking pan (one layer).
Place a pineapple ring on each with a mushroom cap in center.
In saucepan, combine pineapple juice (add water to make 2 1/2 cups), soy sauce and sugar; bring to a boil.
Stir in 1/2 cup of water in which the cornstarch has been dissolved.
Bring to a boil again. Pour over chops.
Bake at 325° for 2 hours, covered.

title: Dole Golden Layer Cake

ingredients.name: dole pineapple in juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can Dole crushed pineapple in juice

ingredients.name: carton whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

ingredients.name: pound cake thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen pound cake, thawed

ingredients.name: almond flavored liqueur
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. almond flavored liqueur or 1/3 c. pineapple juice and 1/2 tsp. almond extract

steps: Combine undrained pineapple, whipped topping and pudding mix; let stand 5 minutes.
Cut cake lengthwise in thirds.
Drizzle with liqueur.
Spread one-third pudding mixture over bottom layer of cake.
Top with second layer.
Repeat layering, ending with pudding.
Chill 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with toasted sliced almonds; garnish with pineapple slices, if desired.
Serves 12.

title: Milk And Egg Free Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease either a 9-inch round or a 8-inch square cake pan.
Sift flour, sugar and soda together.
Mix applesauce, oil and vanilla in a bowl; add the dry ingredients and stir just until flour is moistened.
Spread batter into prepared pan.
Bake 30 minutes.
For a 2-layer cake, double the recipe.

title: 7 Week Bran Muffins
steps: Mix and store up to 7 weeks in refrigerator.
Bake in greased muffin tins at 375° for 12 to 17 minutes.

title: Brownies With Marshmallows

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 2 sticks butter, softened (do not use oleo)

steps: Mix all ingredients but marshmallows in a large pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle marshmallows on top and return to oven for 3 minutes.
Remove and let cool.

title: Yams And Cherries
steps: Slice sweet potatoes 1/2-inch thick.
Arrange layer in buttered casserole dish.
Mix all dry ingredients; sprinkle over potatoes.
Dot with 1 tablespoon butter.
Add 1/2 of the cherries. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Pour potato liquid over layers until visible.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Berry Freeze
steps: Place all the ingredients in the jar of a blender and process until smooth, about 1 minute.
Pour into 2 tall glasses and garnish with strawberries.
Makes 2 servings.

title: Broccoli Or Spinach Cornbread

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chopped spinach or chopped broccoli, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1/2 onion, finely chopped (more if you like)

steps: Combine Jiffy mix and vegetable.
Saute onion and salt in 3/4 stick butter.
Mix all together.
Pour mixture in a greased 9 inch pie plate.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or bake at 350° even longer.

title: Apple Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease bottom of muffin cup.
Beat egg with fork.
Stir in milk, oil and apple.
Add dry ingredients; stir just until flour is moistened.
Batter should be lumpy.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Artichoke Dip
steps: Drain artichokes; mix mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and artichokes.
Pour in small casserole dish and bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes or until brown and bubbly.
Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: 14-Day Pickles
steps: Fill
churn
or
other glass or crockery container with whole cucumbers.	Cover
with 2 cups salt to a gallon of cold water. Set one week.

title: Lemon Whip Jello Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple drain and save juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple, drain and save juice

steps: To jello, add 1 cup hot water and juice from pineapple.
Place in refrigerator until it congeals.
Beat cream cheese into jello until smooth.
Fold in pineapple and diced celery.
Whip cream and fold into other mixture.
Spoon into molds.
Decorate with olives.

title: Hot Mexican Dip

ingredients.name: chili powder and garlic
ingredients.raw: dash of chili powder and garlic

steps: Heat slowly soup and cheese, stirring constantly.
When cheese is melted, add sour cream, onion and flavoring.
Heat thoroughly. Sprinkle on chili powder.
Serve hot.
Nice to serve in crock-pot.

title: Cheesy Chili Franks
steps: Cook noodles according to package; drain.
In saucepan, combine first 5 ingredients.
Simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.
Pour noodles in baking dish; top with mixture, then the shredded cheese.
Broil in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped or fresh

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cook broccoli as directed; drain and spread in ungreased rectangular baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Layer ham and cheese over broccoli.
Beat remaining ingredients with hand beater until smooth; slowly pour over cheese.
Bake uncovered for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quaker Stew(Casserole)
steps: Brown hamburger in a large pan.
Take out enough to line the bottom of the casserole.
Cover remaining meat with water.
Add celery salt to taste.
Simmer meat mixture while preparing vegetables.
Place potatoes (peeled and sliced) and onion (peeled and chopped) alternately in layers in casserole.
Mix peas and tomatoes and spoon over potatoes and onion.
Cover casserole with hamburger mix.
Bake at 375° until vegetables are cooked.

title: Wineburgers
steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Combine remaining ingredients (except flour) and heat thoroughly until bubbly.
Stir in flour to thicken.
Serve on buns.

title: Mom'S Cornbread
steps: Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and soda in large mixing bowl. Add egg and buttermilk.
Mix until smooth.
Stir in hot bacon grease.
Return to hot skillet.
Bake in pre-heated oven at 425° 18-20 minutes.

title: Old-Fashion Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, add 1 1/2 cups sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and flavorings; beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture; mix.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 3 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets. Press cookies with a fork to flatten.
Sprinkle cookies with remaining sugar.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove to wire racks to cool.
Yield: 8 dozen.

title: Coconut Pie (Without A Crust)
steps: Grease a pan well with butter.
Mix ingredients together and pour batter in pan and cook 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Macaroni Ala Creole
steps: Cook macaroni in plenty of water with salt.
Drain water off. Cook hamburger and onions in bacon drippings until nicely browned. Add chopped mushrooms.
Add macaroni and cook 5 minutes longer. Add seasoning and green pepper (chopped) to the tomatoes (chopped).
Simmer 10 minutes; then add to the macaroni mixture in the frying pan or baking dish.
Set in oven to brown for 20 minutes at 375°.
Serve hot.
Serves 8.

title: Layered Ice Cream Dessert
steps: Sprinkle 1/2 cup chocolate crumbs evenly in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Set aside.
Combine butter and chocolate in a heavy saucepan; cook over low heat until melted.
Remove from heat; add powdered sugar and beat 2 minutes at medium speed in electric mixture.
Add yolks, beating until smooth.
Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until stiff peaks form.
Fold into chocolate mixture.
Carefully spoon mixture over crumbs and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Jiffy Barbecue Sauce
steps: Heat all ingredients in a one quart sauce pan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.
Simmer about 5 minutes.
Makes 1 3/4 cup.

title: Rugalach
steps: Mix together flour and salt.
Cream together margarine and cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Blend in flour mixture. Chill several hours in wax paper (important).

title: Rye Toppers
steps: Combine beef, sausage and onion in a large skillet.
Cook over medium heat until browned, then drain.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Spread about 1 tablespoon of mixture on slices of bread. Place on a cookie sheet and put in freezer for about 10 minutes. Place in baggies to store in freezer until needed.
Bake at 350° until hot.

title: Carlie'S Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Measure flour, granulated sugar and 2 tablespoons cocoa into bowl.
Blend in milk and shortening; stir in nuts.
Pour into ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Stir together brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa; sprinkle over batter. Pour "hot" water over batter.
Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat yolk; brush over crust.
Bake 5 minutes.
Beat cheese, sugar and eggs until smooth.
Add pumpkin and spices.
Pour in crust; bake until set 40 to 45 minutes. Cool.
Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Spud Burgers
steps: Combine meat, onion and potatoes and form into patties.
Fry or broil until potatoes are done.
Add seasoning.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Rice Krispies Squares
steps: Melt butter in large pan.
Add honey and peanut butter.
Stir until mixed and leave on heat until mixture bubbles and boils a bit.
Stir in 2 1/2 cups Rice Krispies.
Remove from heat and mix thoroughly.
Turn off burner.

title: Salmon Patties 2

ingredients.name: tall can pink salmon remove bone
ingredients.raw: 1 tall can pink salmon, remove bones

steps: Mix all ingredients (except oil) thoroughly.
Heat shortening or oil until hot.
Add mixture to hot oil.
Cook until brown on each side.
Should yield 12 to 15 patties.

title: Ham And Cheese Quesadillas
steps: Combine cheeses; divide equally between two tortillas.
Place ham and green chiles over cheese.
Top with another tortilla.

title: Dream Delight Pie
steps: Combine jello, water, sugar and cornstarch.
Stir until it coats spoon.
Remove from heat and add coloring.
Let cool a little and add lemon juice.
Let cool completely, but not congealed.
Place sliced strawberries in shells.
Refrigerate until congealed.
The jello mixture should be placed on top of the strawberries before placing in refrigerator.

title: Casserole Surprise

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 1 large potato, peeled and sliced thin

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup or cream of celery

steps: Pat 3/4 of ground beef in bottom of cold electric skillet. Layer vegetables over meat as listed, then crumble remaining meat over vegetables.
Pour soup over meat and vegetables and spread to the edges of skillet.
Top with cheese.
Cook over medium-low heat (in electric skillet at 300°) for 30 to 40 minutes, or until vegetables are tender and mixture is bubbly.

title: Almond Tea
steps: Mix in gallon container the tea and 2 cups water.
Boil sugar and 2 cups water for 5 minutes.
Cool and add to tea mixture.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Add additional water to make 1 gallon.

title: Japanese Jello
steps: Dissolve together the first 3 ingredients.
Boil together sugar and water.
Add sugar and water mixture to dissolved jello mixture.
Stir well.
Pour into pan; refrigerate until set.
Cut into shapes.
Easy to eat with fingers.
Great for children!!

title: Hearts Of Romaine Salad
steps: Remove dark green outer leaves and discard.
Tear remaining leaves into quarter pieces; rinse and dry.
Add into food processor the basil, shallots, vinegar and mustard and process briefly (three or four short bursts).
Add oil and cheese and process in two short bursts, just to combine.
Divide romaine hearts among four chilled plates and drizzle dressing over. Garnish with basil sprigs and toasted pine nuts.

title: Fruity Cream Dessert
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Measure 1 cup gelatin mixture and add cold water until thickened.
Add fruit and put into 1 1/2-quart serving bowl.
Blend ice cream into remaining gelatin and spoon over clear gelatin.
Chill until set.
Serves 12.

title: Betty'S Dump Cake
steps: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump in cherry pie filling.
Dump in pineapple.
Sprinkle cake mix to cover. Do not stir.
Sprinkle nuts on top.
Cut butter into small pieces and dot top of cake. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve plain or with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Fruit
steps: In a saucepan over low heat, melt chips and shortening, stirring constantly until smooth.
Spear fruit with toothpicks and dip into chocolate.
Place on waxed paper.

title: Iowa'S Assemblyman Berk'S Barbecue Chicken
steps: Place chicken in single layer in baking dish.
Mix catsup and Coca-Cola well.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Homemade Turkey Chili

ingredients.name: tomato with juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) can tomatoes, chopped with juice

steps: Brown turkey in wok.
Stir to break up. Add onions and garlic. Saute until soft. Add chili mix.
Stir to blend.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes.
Add water, if chili becomes too thick.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
steps: In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook beef until browned, stirring to separate meat.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in soups, water, mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce.
Spoon into a 3-quart baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbling.
Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven; stir.
Arrange biscuits on hot beef mixture.
Top with cheese.
Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.
Serves 6.

title: Featherlight Rolls
steps: Add Crisco to milk while milk is still warm.
When milk has cooled, dissolve yeast in water and add to milk.
Add sugar, salt, eggs and flour.
Beat well.
Let rest in bowl about 20 minutes. Knead dough for a minute or two.
Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full or make out rolls and let rise until double in bulk.
Bake in hot oven at 425° for 20 minutes.
Brush with butter after removing from oven.
Makes about 36 rolls.
Only one rising is necessary for this recipe.

title: Bear Steak
steps: Pound flour into steak to tenderize.
Brown meat in fat.
Cook with onions and green pepper.
Put steak in Dutch oven with more green pepper, tomato sauce, beer and mushrooms.
Cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.
Add a little water if too thick.
Serves 4.

title: Blueberry Pineapple Dump Cake
steps: In a long butter dish, spread blueberry filling evenly across bottom.
Spread pineapple even for next layer.
Slice the margarine thinly and place evenly on top.
Bake at 325° or 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine cake mix, eggs, pumpkin, water, oil, pudding mix and cinnamon.
Beat at medium speed for 5 minutes. Stir in pecans.
Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done.
Let cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack.
Frost with cream cheese frosting or serve with whipped cream.

title: Italian Chicken And Rice

ingredients.name: chicken up and skinned
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) chicken, cut up and skinned

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.

Stir together water, rice, tomatoes, Velveeta cheese, onion and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning into greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with chicken; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and remaining Italian seasoning. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until chicken is tender. Let stand 5 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Our Favorite Pound Cake
steps: Blend sugar, salt and mace in large mixing bowl. Cream the sugar mixture and butter until light and fluffy.
Add extracts. Beat eggs into mixture, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add parts of flour and milk to creamed mixture alternately, blending well after each addition.
When smooth, turn batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean and cake is golden brown.
Allow cake to cool 5 minutes in pan. Turn out on cooling rack.
Cool thoroughly.

title: Vegetable Chinese Pie
steps: Cut meat into cubes.
Layer meat in casserole dish.
Pour vegetable soup on top of meat.
Spread mashed potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Good Hush Puppies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Mixture will be thick.
Let rise about 30-40 minutes.
Do not stir.
Then just drop by spoonful into hot grease and fry.

title: Nourishment In Minutes
steps: Get into car and proceed to nearest fast food restaurant drive through window.
Glance over a menu and order.
Get amount of purchase out and wait your turn.
Pay and either go home to eat or find a park or eat in car.
Enjoy.

title: Asparagus Chinese Style
steps: Snap off the tough stems of asparagus spears.
Cut the stalks into 1/2-inch slices.
Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet, add garlic, salt, and asparagus.
Saute over moderate heat for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch, water, and soy sauce.
Add to asparagus, stir and bring to a boil again.
Stir for 1 minute, add pepper and serve at once.
Serves 4.

title: Charlie'S Cornbread

ingredients.name: salad oil
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. salad oil or bacon drippings

steps: Mix all together.
Bake in a 400° to 450° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes (or until done).

title: Fabulous Fruit Dip
steps: Mix ingredients until creamed.
There may be a few lumps of cream cheese but that's okay.
With an assortment of fruits, dip in!
(Best if refrigerated overnight.)

title: Summertime Picnic Relish

ingredients.name: firm tomato and
ingredients.raw: 4 firm medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped

steps: In large skillet, cook and stir onion and green pepper in oil over medium heat until onion is tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling.
Cool.
Cover; refrigerate several days.
Makes about 3 cups.

title: Slimey Goop For Kids(Also Called Gak)
steps: Mix together the glue and water.
Mix together the water, Borax and food coloring.
Stir mixtures together and watch Gak appear!
Great for Halloween parties.
For age 5 and up.

title: Perfect Brownies
steps: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Blend in vanilla, flour and chocolate.
Mix nuts into batter or sprinkle over top and pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan.
Bake in 325° oven for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Oven Baked Potatoes
steps: Alternate layers of onions and potatoes in a casserole dish. Mix together margarine and seasonings; pour over potatoes and onions.
Cover and bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
Uncover; sprinkle paprika over and bake uncovered for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Cabbage
steps: Stir-fry cabbage in oil and salt.
Add carrot and onions.
Add broth.
Cook, tossing a minute or so.
Stir in soy sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Brutzel Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Line a standard size cookie sheet with built up sides with aluminum foil.
Lightly spray with Pam. Arrange the saltine crackers in single layer over the foil.
Set aside.

title: Smoked Salmon Log
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together and chill.
Then form into log shape.
Roll/coat "log" in pecan/parsley mixture.
Chill several hours.
Serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: breast of chicken and
ingredients.raw: 1 breast of chicken, cooked and cubed

steps: Place all ingredients in chicken broth and cook until vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with crackers or bread.

title: Sauce For Chicken Or Veal Cutlets
steps: Saute garlic.
Add preserves, soy sauce and water and cook until combined and hot.
Serve over cutlets.

title: Cherry Delight Pie
steps: Mix softened cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk, then slowly add lemon juice. Pour into pie crust.
Bake on 350° for 30 or 35 minutes or until set.

title: Baked Yams
steps: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup syrup.
Line sides of an 8 x 10-inch baking dish with pineapple, slightly overlapping. Arrange yams in center.
Pour pineapple syrup over yams.
Combine flour, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in nuts. Sprinkle over yams.
Top with marshmallows.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Pinwheels

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. (8 oz. each) cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: hidden valley ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (1 oz.) Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix

steps: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Spread on tortillas.
Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towel.
Sprinkle equal amounts of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese.
Roll tortillas tightly.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Cut rolls into 1 inch pieces. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Peaches And Cream Cake

ingredients.name: butter flavor cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. butter flavor cake mix (make 2 layers)

ingredients.name: whipping cream
ingredients.raw: 2 c. whipping cream or Cool Whip

steps: Mix and bake 2 cake layers as directed on box.
Cool layers; split each layer.
Combine sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Add peaches and water; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.
Cool mixture completely.

title: Batter For Shrimp
steps: Mix in large bowl.
Add water to soften batter up.
Drop shrimp in.
Lift out and put in hot oil.

title: Champignons Au Vin Blanc

ingredients.name: garlic clove
ingredients.raw: 2 garlic cloves, finely minced, or 1/4 tsp. garlic powder

steps: Drain mushrooms and set aside.
Melt butter and combine olive oil.
Add remaining ingredients and saute for about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and continue to saute, turning occasionally, for 5 to 8 minutes (until thoroughly heated, but not browned).
Serve promptly with lightly spooned sauce.

title: Parker House Rolls
steps: In large bowl place water, yeast and sugar; place aside for yeast to grow.
In a small pot, heat to melt Crisco and add milk. Add sugar and salt, cool and add to yeast mixture.
Add flour, a little at a time, mixing well after each addition until you have a firm dough.
Cover and set aside to rise to double in size. Remove from bowl, knead and roll out on floured wax paper.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Fold each roll in middle with pat of butter inside each one.
Place in a greased pan to rise again.
Bake at 350° about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Baked Flounder With Mushrooms
steps: Saute onion and mushrooms in margarine.
Add bread crumbs and parsley.
Place mixture on floured pieces and roll.
Use a toothpick to hold together.
Place in a shallow baking pan, seam side down and brush with butter and paprika.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Paprikash
steps: In a large heavy skillet, heat the oil. Add onion and cook until soft.
Add chicken pieces and brown. Sprinkle with paprika to taste and cover chicken with broth.
Cook, covered, until tender (about 45 minutes).
Remove chicken to heated platter and keep warm. Thicken remaining broth with milk, sour cream and flour, stirring constantly.
Arrange Spoon Dumplings around chicken on platter and serve with prepared gravy. Serves 4.

title: Baked Chicken With Rice
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Mix rice, soup mix, water and salt in baking dish.
Put chicken over rice; dot with margarine.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves about 5.

title: Rainbow Butter Cake

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. sifted granulated sugar
ingredients.raw: 1 c. plus 2 Tbsp. sifted granulated sugar

steps: Note:
Have all ingredients at room temperature.

title: Shrimp-Mushroom Casserole
steps: Melt butter.
Add flour; cook gently 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add milk while stirring.
Return to heat and cook until thick, stirring occasionally.
Stir in sherry.
In a small greased casserole, layer half the shrimp, mushrooms, almonds and sauce.
Repeat layers.
Top with Parmesan and crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Julie'S Iowa Corn Casserole

ingredients.name: jiffy corn muffin mix
ingredients.raw: 1 small box Jiffy corn muffin mix (add dry)

steps: Mix all ingredients together, bake 350 for 40 to 50 minutes. Use a large casserole dish.
This recipe increases in size.
It's done when knife comes out clean.

title: Boot Hill Salad
steps: Mix jello and 2 cups boiling water.
Add blueberries and pineapple.
Let set in 10 x 10 x 2-inch oblong dish.
Soften cream cheese; fold in sour cream.
Add vanilla and sugar; mix well.
Fold in pecans; spread over blueberry mixture.

title: Best Fudge
steps: Put chocolate chips, margarine and vanilla in large bowl. Combine sugar and milk in large saucepan.
Bring to a rolling boil; boil for 6 minutes.
Stir constantly.
Remove from heat. Pour ingredients in bowl; stir until butter and chips are melted and mixture thickens.
Pour into a greased dish.
Makes 5 pounds. Let stand for 5 to 6 hours before cutting.

title: No Knead Hot Rolls
steps: Cream shortening, sugar, salt and eggs.
Add boiling water and let cool.
Add yeast dissolved in cold water.
Add flour.
Let rise and then make into rolls.
Let rise again and bake until brown in a 400° oven.

title: Frozen Peanut Butter Ice Cream Cake

ingredients.name: chocolate cooky
ingredients.raw: 2 c. chocolate cookies or Oreo cookies

steps: Make 9-inch crust with chocolate or Oreo cookies (made into crumbs) and melted butter.
Chill.

title: Dixie Fried Chicken
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Combine flour and red pepper; set aside.
Combine egg and milk.
Dip chicken in egg mixture and dredge in flour mixture, coating well.
Heat 1-inch of vegetable oil in a skillet (350°).
Place chicken in skillet. Cover and cook chicken over medium heat 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Turn occasionally.
Drain chicken on paper towels. Yields 4 servings.

title: Hamburger Vegetable Casserole
steps: Brown
beef
and
onion
in skillet with one tablespoon oil. Pour all ingredients in baking dish. Mix well.
Sprinkle cheese and cracker crumbs on top and bake in a 350° oven until cheese is melted and slightly brown.

title: Delicious Soup
steps: Place sausage on bottom of baking dish, then add the vegetables on top and water last.
Bake 3 hours at 350°.

title: Fancy Chicken Log
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients.
Chill for 1 hour.
Roll in nuts and shape into a log.
Return to refrigerator, wrapped in plastic wrap.

title: Armenian Rice
steps: Fry bacon pieces.
Add butter; saute onion pieces until golden brown.
Add rice; saute 3 minutes.
Put in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add consomme and water.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Indian Fry Bread
steps: Mix flour, salt and baking powder.
Add water and knead thoroughly; cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
Make 10 or 12 balls, about 2 inches in diameter and then roll them flat and thin with a rolling pin.
Make two slashes in the center.
Fry on both sides in hot oil until golden brown.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Diabetic Baked Chicken

ingredients.name: saltine cracker
ingredients.raw: 1/2 pkg. saltine crackers or salt free

steps: Put in large glass pan in oven; cook until tender.
Turn as needed at least once during cooking.
Put cracker crumbs on chicken and add enough water to cover chicken, it makes its own gravy.
Put back in oven until done.
Cook on 425°.

title: French Fried Eggplant
steps: Slice eggplant 1/2-inch thick and slice again to make 1/2 x 3-inch sticks.
Place eggplant on paper towels; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt and let sit for 20 minutes.
Combine flour, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper in paper bag.
Add eggplant and shake to coat slices with flour.
Heat 1 1/2-inches oil in skillet until very hot.
Fry eggplant until golden brown (do not crowd them; fry in batches if necessary).
Drain on paper towels; sprinkle with salt.
Serve immediately.

title: Meat Noodle Casserole
steps: Brown meat and onion in fat.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add soup and milk; bring to a boil.
Cook noodles in boiling water as directed.
Combine meat mixture with noodles.
Put in casserole.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6.

title: Generic Eagle Brand Milk
steps: Blend for 3 minutes.
Let set for a while in refrigerator to thicken before using.
Can be stored for 2 weeks in refrigerator. Use in place of canned milk (Eagle Brand).

title: Olive-Cheese Puffs

ingredients.name: olive
ingredients.raw: 24 pitted ripe olives or 24 stuffed green olives

steps: Blend ingredients (except olives).
Mix well.
Mold 1 teaspoon dough around each olive.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Refrigerate.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Cinnamon Peaches

ingredients.name: peach half in natural juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (28 oz.) can peach halves in natural juice

steps: Pour can of peaches into small, square dish, pitted side up. Onto each half, put one teaspoon of brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of margarine.
Cover each peach half with cinnamon.
Cover juice around peaches with cinnamon.
Microwave until margarine is melted and peaches are hot.

title: Fresh Fruit Compote

ingredients.name: sparkling catawba grape juice chilled
ingredients.raw: 25 oz. bottle sparkling Catawba grape juice, chilled

steps: Peel peaches and slice into bowl.
Top peaches with strawberries, blueberries and melon balls.
Cover tightly and chill.
Just before serving, slice bananas into bowl and pour grape juice over fruit.

title: Old-Time Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Mix peanut butter, sugar, milk and salt in pan and begin to cook over medium heat.
Cook until the mixture forms hard, round ball when dropped into a cup of cold water.
Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter.
With a large wooden spoon, begin to beat the fudge until it cools and starts to thicken, approximately 300 strokes.
Pour into a greased (butter) platter or pan.
When it starts to set up, cut into 1 x 1-inch squares.

title: Chicken-Flavored Rice
steps: Melt margarine in large frying pan and add rice.
Brown slightly and add chopped onion, salt and pepper.
Add 1 can chicken rice soup and water.
Bring to boiling point and simmer (covered) without stirring for 30 minutes.

title: French Potato Gratin
steps: Peel and slice potatoes thinly.
Lightly grease an ovenproof casserole.
Layer potato slices in casserole, sprinkling each layer with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Press garlic over mixture. Add cream and milk.
(This all can be done ahead of time and chilled.)

title: Chinese Noodle Oodles
steps: Melt butterscotch morsels over low heat or microwave oven. Stir in unsalted peanuts and noodles.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper until firm.
Enjoy!!

title: No Bake Brown Sugar Cookies
steps: Drop on wax paper lined pan.
Let set until cooled.

title: Easy Barbecue
steps: Place roast (washed, salted and peppered) in crock-pot.
Pour other ingredients over roast.
Let cook on low all day (8 hours). Take roast out and tear into pieces.
Serve with buns and add extra barbecue sauce to your liking.

title: Secret Chocolate Sensation

ingredients.name: chocolate cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chocolate cake mix (with pudding in the mix)

steps: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer cake pans.
In a large bowl with mixer at low speed, blend all ingredients 30 seconds.
Beat at medium speed 2 minutes.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake in
a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pans and springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove and cool on wire racks.
Fill and frost as desired.

title: Turtle Shells
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each shell into 8 pie-shaped wedges.
Bake on ungreased baking sheets for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove shells and place on waxed paper.
Place caramels and milk in microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave on Medium power for 3 minutes.
Stir and repeat for 3 minutes, stirring often.
Spread caramel onto cooled shells.
Top with pecans. Microwave chocolate on Medium for 3 minutes; stir and repeat for 2 minutes, stirring often.
Drizzle chocolate over caramel and pecans.
Makes 32 candies.

title: Venison Roast - Stew

ingredients.name: venison roast
ingredients.raw: 4 lb. venison roast or venison, cut into stew

steps: Fry bacon and saute onion in drippings.
Dredge venison in flour and brown in bacon drippings.
Put venison, bacon and Worcestershire in
crock-pot.
Add	onion and soup.
Add water to make a gravy consistency.
Cook 10 hours.
Add potatoes and carrots and cook until tender.

title: Almond Brittle
steps: Line a cookie sheet with foil; coat with cooking spray.
Cook sugar and corn syrup in a 3-quart pan over medium-high heat to a soft crack stage, stirring constantly.
Add almonds, butter and almond extract, stirring constantly.
Cook 5 minutes longer, until mixture is golden.
Stir in soda; mixture will become foamy.
Pour onto cookie sheet; let stand 1 hour.
Peel off candy and break into chunks.

title: Tea Syrup
steps: Bring water to a boil.
Remove from heat and add loose tea. Cover and let stand 20 minutes.
Strain tea.
Pour over sugar and mix well.

title: Vanilla Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt and gradually blend into creamed mixture.
Stir in chips and drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 or 9 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Remove from cookie sheet.
Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Old Fashion Cream Pie
steps: Mix together.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cookies
steps: Mix all together.
Shape like a strawberry and roll in red sugar.
Dip top in green sugar.
Use slivered almonds for stem dipped in green coloring.

title: Baked Chicken With Rice Dressing
steps: Mix onion, celery and rice.
Mix mushroom soup with 1 1/2 cans water.
Add onion mixture to soup and put in casserole dish with chicken (whole or cut into pieces).
Bake in a 350° oven until chicken is done.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Salmon Burgers
steps: About 45 minutes before serving, in a bowl, mix egg, salmon, crumbs, green onion and celery; mix well.
Shape mixture firmly into 6 patties.
In 12-inch skillet over medium heat in hot salad oil, fry patties 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, prepare Hollandaise sauce mix as label directs.
Top each muffin half with salmon patty; spoon on sauce.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Ali'S Favorite Rigatoni
steps: Brown ground beef with onion and seasonings (garlic powder and pepper).
Stir in spaghetti sauce and let stew.

title: Tenderloin Deluxe
steps: Spread tenderloin with 2 tablespoons butter.
Place on rack in shallow, uncovered, pan at 400° for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile in small pan, cook onion in second 2 tablespoons butter.
Add soy sauce, mustard and pepper.
Stir in sherry.
Heat to boiling, then pour over tenderloin and bake another 20 minutes.
Pass remaining wine sauce while serving.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Cheese Ball
steps: Blend cream cheese and dip in a blender.
Shape into a ball. Roll in crushed pecans.
Make a day or 2 before serving and store in refrigerator.
Serve with lightly salted crackers.

title: Olive Souffle Casserole

ingredients.name: italian sausage parboiled and
