ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. Italian sausage, parboiled and sliced

ingredients.name: potato and
ingredients.raw: 4 medium potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced

ingredients.name: pimento stuffed green olive
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. sliced pimento stuffed green olives

steps: Saute sausage and onion in 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet until lightly browned.
Remove to shallow 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Heat remaining oil in skillet.
Add potatoes.
Saute for 3 minutes.
Add olives and tomatoes; mix well.
Pour over sausage mixture.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Fold egg yolks into whites.
Stir potato mixture and pour eggs over top.
Bake 17 minutes longer or until eggs test done, when toothpick is inserted in center and comes out clean.

title: Chunks Of Liver And Onions
steps: Saute mushrooms and onion.
Chop liver into chunks and add to mushrooms and onion.
Cook until done in middle.
Sprinkle flour over liver and stir with spoon until well mixed.
Add water until thickness as desired.
Simmer on low for 15 minutes, stirring repeatedly.

title: Chocolate Cookie Crumble(Diabetic)

ingredients.name: sugar instant pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) sugar-free instant pudding and pie filling

steps: Pour 1/2 cup of milk into blender.
Add cream cheese.
Process cream cheese.
Blend until smooth.
Add the remaining milk.
Add the pudding mix; cover and blend until smooth.
Spoon half of pudding into 6 individual dishes.
Cover with chocolate wafers, crumbled.
Refrigerate until set.
Serve.

title: Cheesy Chili Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Simple Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger.
Cook noodles.
Layer noodles, peas and hamburger in small casserole bowl. Mix soup and 3/4 can water. Pour over top of casserole.
Brown in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Mock Cream Icing
steps: Make paste with flour and milk and cook until thick.
Cool. Beat butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla.
Add to cooled paste mixture and beat until smooth.
If chocolate icing is preferred, use 1 square of melted chocolate.

title: Cauliflower With Shrimp Sauce

ingredients.name: condensed cream of shrimp soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can condensed cream of shrimp soup

steps: Separate cauliflower into flowerets.
Cook in boiling salted water until tender; drain.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
steps: Put onion and vinegar in blender.
Grate for a few seconds, then add rest of ingredients and blend until well mixed.
Makes 1 pint.

title: Hollywood'S Whooper Pie

ingredients.name: cool whip
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Cool Whip (1/2 eight oz. size)

ingredients.name: blue bell vanilla ice cream
ingredients.raw: 1 pt. Blue Bell vanilla ice cream

steps: Let ice cream set out at room temperature until creamy.
Put in mixing bowl, add cup of Cool Whip and 1 cup of crushed whopper's; mix together.
Pour into pie crust.
Sprinkle 1 cup of crushed whooper's on top of pie.
Put in freezer and let set for 3 hours before serving.
Keep in freezer.
Great for light cool dessert.

title: Banana Walnut Loaf
steps: Beat together sugar, shortening, eggs and banana.

Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and soda. Stir into creamed mixture. Beat until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes or until it tests done.
Cool on rack.

title: Easy Broccoli Soup
steps: Saute onion in margarine or butter until tender.
Add flour, stirring well.
Gradually stir in broth and broccoli; reduce heat. Stir in milk, cheese and pepper.
Heat until cheese melts.
Serve immediately.
Yields 4 cups.

title: Chocolate Plunge(Dip)

ingredients.name: karo light
ingredients.raw: 2/3 c. Karo light or dark corn syrup

steps: In medium saucepan, stir corn syrup and cream.
Bring to boil over medium heat.
Remove from heat.
Add chocolate; stir until completely melted.
Serve warm as a dip for fruit.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Lite Fettucine Alfredo
steps: Combine garlic and 1 cup skim milk in medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer on reduced heat.
Stir in flour and remaining milk.
Continue stirring for about 2 minutes, until thickened.
Add fat-free cream cheese.
Whisk vigorously for about 2 minutes, until smooth.
Add in butter until smooth.
Remove from heat, pour the sauce over hot fettucine.
Garnish with fresh parsley and ground pepper and serve.
Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: Jalapeno Fudge(Appetizer)
steps: Arrange grated cheeses in a 9 1/2 x 11-inch baking dish.
Mix flour, Egg Beaters and skim milk; pour mixture over cheese. Arrange jalapeno peppers on top as you like.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spicy Holiday Pecans
steps: Melt butter and add seasoning.
Mix thoroughly.
Add pecans and toss gently until nuts are coated.
Place in a shallow baking pan.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
Turn at least once.

title: Sweet And Sour Party Wings
steps: Clean and cut wings (if not already cut).
I recommend using pre-cut wings.
Foil line roasting pan. Roast at 400° for 1/2 hour. Turn, roast about 1/2 hour longer until brown.

title: Caramel Apple Dumplings

ingredients.name: baking apple pared and cored
ingredients.raw: 3 medium baking apples, washed, pared and cored

steps: Prepare pie crust as directed on box.
Roll 1/8-inch thick. With pastry wheel, cut out 3 (7-inch) squares, 6 strips (6-inches long and 3/4-inch wide) and 3 (1-inch) circles, rolling dough if needed.

title: The Best Cheesecake
steps: In small bowl with mixer at low speed, beat butter, 1/4 cup flour, 1/4 cup sugar, 1 egg yolk and 1/2 of grated lemon peel until well mixed; shape into ball.
Wrap and chill 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400°.
Press 1/3 of dough into bottom of 10 x 2 1/2-inch spring-form pan; bake 8 minutes.
Cool.
Turn oven to 475°.

title: Caramel Apples
steps: Mix brown sugar in cream cheese until well blended.
Slice apples.
Dip apple slice into caramel mixture, then into the peanuts.
Eat and enjoy.

title: Frozen Fruit Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients and freeze.
Thaw approximately 3 hours before serving or only freeze until mushy.
Makes about one gallon or 20 servings.

title: Tahiti Pear Salad
steps: Drain pear halves; dry on paper towel.
Blend the cream cheese, cottage cheese and maraschino juice.
Fill hollows of pears with cheese mixture.
Arrange on lettuce.

title: Carrot Creme Mold
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add undrained pineapple and carrots.
Fold in sour cream.
Pour into pan and refrigerate.

title: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls Or Sausages

ingredients.name: prepared meat ball
ingredients.raw: 1 large pkg. prepared meat balls or little sausage links

steps: Fill slow cooker with the meat balls or sausages.
Mix the other ingredients in a separate bowl and then pour over the meat. Cook for at least 4 hours.

title: No-Bake Blueberry Cheese-Pie
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch in saucepan.
Stir in water until blended.
Add 1 cup of the blueberries; stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until berries release their juices.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining berries.
Cool to room temperature.
Beat the cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla in a bowl until blended.
Spread over bottom of pie crust. Cover with berry mixture.
Refrigerate 2 hours or until chilled.

title: Orange Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.name: ginger root
ingredients.raw: 1 ginger root, sliced (size of small golf ball)

steps: Slice pork tenderloin in slices 1/2-inch thick and bake 30 minutes on rack.
Most of fat will be cooked out.
Saute garlic and ginger in undiluted orange juice for 15 minutes.
As sauce thickens, correct with small amount of water.
Place warm tenderloin slices in saute pan.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Serve in center of rice ring; cover with sauce.
Serves 4.

title: Mom'S Potato Salad
steps: Peel, dice and boil potatoes; drain.
Dice sweet pickles, onion and eggs; add to potato mixture.
Mix mayonnaise, mustard, sweet pickle vinegar and sugar and add to potato mixture.

title: Frozen Sour Cream Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: cherry and
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 c. cherries, pitted and chopped

ingredients.name: walnut
ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 c. chopped walnuts or pecans

steps: Mix together sour cream, lemon juice, sugar and salt.
Add cherries, nuts, banana and drained pineapple.
Pour into 24 cupcake paper liners that have been placed in muffin tins. Freeze.

title: Smoked Oyster Dip
steps: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Add olives and oysters. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Nut Crunch
steps: Combine crumbs and nuts.
Line bottom of 9-inch square pan with half of the crumb mixture.
Thoroughly cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks.
Add chocolate and vanilla.
Mix well.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Spread over the crumb mixture.
Top with remaining crumb mixture, patting down.
Chill in refrigerator overnight.
Cut in squares.
Serves 9.

title: Senate Navy Bean Soup

ingredients.name: navy
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. dried navy or pea beans (about 2 1/3 c.)

steps: Wash beans; discard any stones or shriveled beans.
Drain and place in large saucepot.
Soak.
(For quick soak method, combine beans and 6 cups water.
Heat to boiling; boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Cover; let stand 1 hour.
Or cover beans with water and soak overnight.)

title: Reese'S Cups
steps: Melt margarine.
Mix sugar, margarine and peanut butter together well.
Press into 9 x 12-inch dish. Melt Hershey bars and pour over mixture.
Cool and cut in squares.

title: Bar-Ba-Zee Pork Barbecue
steps: Make tea of pickling spice and 1/2 cup water or more.
Combine tea and other ingredients, shredding the pork into rest after it has simmered an hour or so.
Serve on buns.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pizzelles(Cookies)
steps: Beat eggs, gradually adding sugar.
Add margarine and flavoring.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Drop by tablespoons onto a hot waffle iron.
Done when golden brown.

title: Mother Mesquites Mexican Salsa

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. finely chopped canned jalapeno pepper, seeded

steps: Pour tomatoes into colander and drain, reserving juice.
Press tomatoes through the colander mesh.
(Also works to blend in processor quickly.)

title: Cheddary Pasta And Vegetables

ingredients.name: sweet
ingredients.raw: 1 large sweet or green pepper, chopped (optional)

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of celery soup

steps: In 4 quart saucepan, prepare macaroni according to package directions.
Add carrots, broccoli and peppers for last 5 minutes of cooking time.
Drain.
In saucepan, combine remaining ingredients over low heat, heat until cheese melts, stirring often.
Add macaroni and vegetables.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
Yields 5 servings.

title: Hanky Panky
steps: Saute sausage and ground beef and drain.
Slice Velveeta cheese and place on top of meats in pan to melt.
Mix together. Spread on breads and place under broiler until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: String Bean Casserole
steps: Drain string beans and corn; mix together with celery soup, sour cream, onions and almonds. Melt butter and pour over crushed crackers. Place Ritz crust on top of mixture.
Cook 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cucumber And Chicken Salad
steps: Combine the chicken, celery and cucumber and toss lightly. Mix in the French dressing and chill thoroughly.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Serve on lettuce with a cooked dressing.

title: Oatal Cookies
steps: Combine margarine and sugars and beat well.
Add eggs, vanilla, oatmeal and Total, beating after each addition.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°. Yields 6 dozen.
Store in airtight container or plastic bag.

title: Danish Meat Loaf
steps: Cook brown sugar, vinegar, water and dry mustard for 10 minutes.
Combine the remaining ingredients and 1/2 the syrup mixture.
Put in pan and cover with the remaining syrup.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp(Serves 4)
steps: Melt butter in medium saucepan.
Add minced garlic and saute until soft.
Add chopped scallops and cook for 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients and stir until mixed.
Mixture should be moist enough to mold when pinched.
Stuff each shrimp and bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until shrimp becomes white.

title: Fudge Cake
steps: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and nuts.
Blend well.
Pour into a greased Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes.
Cool well before cutting.

title: Chicken Kiev(Yields 4 Servings)

ingredients.name: chicken boned breast and
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken boned breasts, halved and skinless

steps: Mix together yogurt, chives, garlic, red pepper, black pepper and salt in bowl.
Cut a pocket under the breast alongside the bone and fill with mixture.
Fill all 4 breasts with mix and leftover put on top of chicken.
Put in baking dish and bake at 450° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Matt'S Macaroni Salad

ingredients.name: macaroni
ingredients.raw: 4 c. cooked macaroni or twist noodles

ingredients.name: onion and bell pepper may be added if desired
ingredients.raw: onion and bell pepper may be added if desired

steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate a few hours before serving.
Will keep several days in the refrigerator.

title: Southern Pecan Chicken
steps: Cover cooking dish with Reynolds Wrap.
Spread deboned chicken breast(s) across bottom of pan.
Pour Honey Mustard Dressing over all chicken breast(s).
Make sure all are coated.
Then sprinkle chopped pecans across top of chicken breast(s).
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 325°.
Tastes delicious with steamed fresh asparagus covered with cheese sauce.

title: Crisp Cucumber Pickles
steps: Put cucumbers, onions and peppers in a large pan or bowl. Then add salt and cover with ice.
Mix throughly.
Let stand for 3 hours.
Drain.

title: Chicken And Shrimp

ingredients.name: shrimp cleaned and deveined
ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. raw shrimp, cleaned and deveined

steps: In large frying pan, brown chicken and onion in olive oil. When browned, add rest of ingredients except shrimp.
Cover and simmer about 45 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add shrimp and simmer about ten minutes longer.
Serve over rice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Microwave Butterscotch Fudge
steps: In a 2-quart glass measure, combine sugar, butter or margarine and milk.
Microwave on High 8 1/2 to 10 1/2 minutes or until sugar is dissolved, stirring twice.
Add remaining ingredients and stir until butterscotch is melted and cream is well blended.
Turn into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Chill until firm. Yields sixty 1 1/4-inch pieces.

title: Impossible Garden Pie
steps: Sprinkle zucchini, tomato, onion and cheese in lightly greased 9-inch pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake about 30 minutes in 400° oven.
Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Congo Squares
steps: Melt the shortening in a large saucepan.
Add brown sugar and mix well; cool slightly.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the flour mixture to the mixture in the saucepan; mix well.
Add broken nuts and chocolate morsels.
Pour into 2 greased pans (7 1/2 x 11 x 1 1/2).
Bake at 325° to 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
When almost cool, cut into squares.

title: Rocky Road
steps: Prepare brownies according to package.
Allow brownies to cool completely.
Over medium heat, melt margarine, cream cheese and chocolate, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and sugar; mix well.
Add marshmallows and nuts; mix well.
Pour over brownies.

title: Tomato Pie(Not A Dessert)
steps: Peel and slice tomatoes; place on paper towel to drain.
Spread small amount of mayonnaise in bottom of baked pie shell.
Layer tomatoes, salt and pepper and light layer of mayonnaise until shell is filled.
Cover with sour cream.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Put under broiler for a minute if melted cheese is preferred.

title: Chocolate Almond Macaroon
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
In medium bowl stir together coconut, sugar, cocoa, flour and salt.
Add egg white and almond extract; stir until well blended.
Drop by teaspoonful on lightly greased cookie sheet; press almond on top, if desired.
Bake 18 minutes or until set.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely, about 1 1/2 dozen macaroons.

title: Easy Quiche Lorraine
steps: Toss cheese with flour.
Add half and half, eggs, bacon and seasonings.
Mix well.
Pour into shell and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bacon Quiche

ingredients.name: broccoli and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked and drained

steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brush pie crust with some of the beaten eggs and prick crust with fork. Bake 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Chip Dip

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.raw: 1 (4-1/2 oz.) can of shrimp (drained well on paper towel)

steps: Chop up drained shrimp into small pieces. Set aside.
In a medium size bowl, blend together all remaining ingredients and fold in sour cream.
Add the shrimp, cover and chill.
Serve with your favorite chips.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks

ingredients.name: dry ranch salad dressing mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. dry Ranch salad dressing mix

steps: Pour oil over oyster crackers in large bowl; mix well. Scatter dry salad dressing mix, dill weed, garlic powder and lemon pepper over crackers and mix well.
Mixture will look very oily. Let set.
Crackers will absorb all the oil.
Do not bake.
Store covered.
Keeps well.

title: Pickled Beet Salad
steps: Drain juice from beets and add to vinegar. Add enough water to make 2 cups liquid.
Add sugar and cloves and simmer 10 minutes. Remove cloves and pour liquid over Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Add beets and mold.
Serve on shredded lettuce with mayonnaise.

title: Semi-Sweet Italian Biscotti
steps: *Enough to make a
pliable dough, bread type flour high gluten is best.

title: Manicotti(Low-Fat)
steps: Cook shells as directed on box.
Mix together cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese.
Mix chopped tomatoes into Ragu sauce. Pour 1 cup of tomato sauce into a baking dish.
Stuff shells with cheese mixture and lay shells in dish.
Pour remaining sauce over shells.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Creamed Hamburger On Toast
steps: Brown beef; add salt, pepper and flour.
Mix well and add milk.
Cook until thickened.
If too thick, add more milk.
I use powdered milk and water.
This makes dish lower in calories. Serve over toast.

title: Uncooked Chocolate Chews
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa and milk in saucepan.
Add stick of margarine; heat mixture until margarine melts and begins boiling. Boil for 1 minute and remove from heat immediately.
Add vanilla and peanut butter; stir until melted, then add oatmeal.
Drop immediately by teaspoon or tablespoon on waxed paper.
Remove from waxed paper after hardened.

title: Cocoa Mounds
steps: Bring first 4 ingredients to a hard boil and then cook 1 minute.
Stir constantly.
Set off stove and add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal.
Drop on waxed paper.

title: Cranberry Torte
steps: Grind wafers to fine crumbs.
Spread half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg and beat until creamy.
Spread creamed mixture over crumbs to edge of pan. Combine fruits and granulated sugar.
Let stand 20 minutes. Spread over creamed mixture.
Cover fruit with whipped cream.
Top with rest of vanilla wafer crumbs.
Chill 12 to 24 hours.
Serves 24.

title: Curry Sausage Couscous
steps: Prepare couscous as directed on package.
Cook sausage, onion, nuts, curry powder, salt and garlic in 10-inch skillet until pork is no longer pink.
Drain.
Stir in couscous and parsley.
Cook about 2 minutes, or until mixture is hot.

title: Baked Butternut Squash
steps: Skin and seed squash.
Cut into 1-inch cubes.
Sprinkle cinnamon, nutmeg and sugar over squash.
Combine butter and lemon juice and drizzle over all. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Cakes
steps: Beat egg well; add and beat all other ingredients.
Bake on lightly greased griddle.

title: Short-Cut Spinach Lasagna

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps: In a big bowl, mix Ricotta, 1 cup Mozzarella, egg, spinach, salt and oregano.
Place 1/2 cup sauce in bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Top with one-third of the noodles.
Cover noodles with half the cheese mixture.
Repeat.
Top with remaining noodles.
Pour remaining sauce over top.
Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella.
Pour water around edges of pan.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove foil and bake 15 minutes more. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.
Serves 8 or more.

title: Rhubarb Butter Crunch
steps: Mix rhubarb with sugar and 3 tablespoons flour.
Stir and set aside.
Combine brown sugar, oatmeal and 1 1/2 cups flour.
Cut in the margarine until crumbly.
Sprinkle half of the mixture into the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour the rhubarb over the crust and top with the rest of the crumbly mixture.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Chapel Windows
steps: Melt butter and chips together.
Add well beaten eggs, nuts, powdered sugar and marshmallows.
Divide batter into two parts. Put on wax paper while still warm.
Roll using the paper and not hands.
Chill and slice.
Nice for church or Christmas get-togethers.

title: Zucchini Preserves
steps: Peel and seed 1 large, tender zucchini.
Cut on cole slaw cutter and measure 6 cups.
Stir all together, except jello.
Boil for 6 minutes.
Add jello.
Stir well and pour into jars.

title: Roasted Bell Pepper-And-Olive Crostini

ingredients.name: red bell pepper roasted and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. red bell peppers, roasted and peeled (about 2 large)

ingredients.name: yellow bell pepper roasted and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. yellow bell peppers, roasted and peeled

ingredients.name: diagonally french bread baguette toasted
ingredients.raw: 32 (1/2-inch thick) diagonally cut slices French bread baguette, toasted

steps: Cut bell peppers into 1x1/4-inch julienne strips.
Combine pepper strips and next 5 ingredients in a bowl.
Stir well.
Cover and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours.
Spoon about 1 tablespoon of mixture onto each bread slice.

title: Sad Sacks
steps: Mix until moist in a large bowl.
Spread into greased pan. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.
Cut while warm.

title: Nacho Beef Casserole

ingredients.name: tortilla chip nacho cheese flavored
ingredients.raw: 2 c. tortilla chips nacho cheese flavored, broken into pieces (not crushed)

steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown ground meat in a small amount of butter or margarine.
Drain grease.
Stir into ground meat the picante sauce, hominy, chili powder and water.
In an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch Pyrex dish, layer 1/2 of meat mixture, chips and cheese; repeat layer.
Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven or until bubbly and thoroughly heated.
Makes about 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Lemon-Poppy Seed Muffins
steps: Mix together dry ingredients.
Add milk, lemonade, oil and egg whites; stir together until just moist.
Fill paper filled muffin pans.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Pork Chops Nicoise(Serves 6)
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and fry pork chops until lightly browned.
Add the tomatoes, garlic, pepper, basil and wine.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, turning chops once.
Add olives and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Best-Ever Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients into a bowl.
Make well in center. Combine egg, milk and oil.
Add all at once to dry ingredients. Stir quickly until dry ingredients are just moistened.
Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.
Bake in 400° oven for 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Raw Sweet Potatoes Casserole
steps: Beat eggs; add milk.
Add to grated sweet potatoes.
Then add melted butter, sugar, syrup, spices and salt.
Pour mixture into buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
If you like, just sprinkle on some brown sugar and nuts.

title: Pineapple-Jello-Marshmallow Salad
steps: Boil first three ingredients together for 3 minutes.
Let cool. Add marshmallows and cottage cheese.
Whip cream and add to the ingredients.
Let set.

title: Judy'S Tortilla Soup
steps: In crock-pot, melt cheese. Put in chicken, chicken broth, chicken soup, celery soup and Ro-Tel.
Slice tortillas in small pieces and add to soup.
Heat in crock-pot until hot!

title: Cauliflower Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: bacon fried and
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. bacon, fried and crumbled or substitute Bac*Os

steps: Combine cauliflower, cheese, green pepper, onion and bacon. Mix Miracle Whip, sour cream and sugar.
Pour over ingredients and toss lightly.

title: Layered Bean Dip
steps: Mix beans and taco seasoning mix.
Spread in bottom of casserole dish.
Top with olives, salsa, cheese and sour cream. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Southern-Style Chicken Gravy

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained (reserve liquid)

ingredients.name: fully fried chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 (2 lb.) box frozen fully cooked fried chicken

steps: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter until golden.
Stir in soup, broth, mushroom liquid and seasonings.
Add chicken; cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve over Pilaf.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad Mold
steps: Mix gelatin and cranberry sauce with boiling water until well dissolved.
Chill until partially thickened (to the consistency of unbeaten egg whites).
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold or dish and chill until firm.

title: Quick And Easy Salmon Patties
steps: Drain salmon; set aside 2 tablespoons of juice.
In a medium mixing bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion until sticky.
Stir in flour.
Add baking powder to salmon juice; stir into salmon mixture.
Form into small patties and fry in a small amount of oil until golden brown.
Serve with tartar sauce, lemon juice or Caesar salad dressing.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Aunt Dora'S Jello Salad

ingredients.name: carton yogurt cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 small carton small curd cottage cheese

steps: Use no liquid.
Mix Jell-O with cottage cheese.
Add Cool Whip and fruit cocktail.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Honey-Pecan Pork Cutlets

ingredients.name: pork loin cutlet pounded thickness
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. boneless pork loin cutlets, pounded to 1/4-inch thickness

steps: Dredge cutlets in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a heavy skillet over medium heat.
Add cutlets and brown on both sides about 5 or 6 minutes.
Stir together remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, honey and pecans.
Add to skillet and stir gently.
Cover and simmer gently for 7 to 8 minutes.
Remove cutlets to serving platter; cover with remaining sauce from pan. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Sponge Pie
steps: In mixer bowl beat butter, sugar and egg yolks.
Blend in pumpkin, flour and spices.
Gradually add milk, blending well.

title: Quick Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a large skillet.
Add cream and 1/4 cup cheese.

Simmer over very low heat 4 to 5 minutes until sauce starts to thicken. Drain pasta well and add to skillet. Lift and stir to combine all ingredients and coat the pasta. Add remaining cheese, nutmeg, salt and a generous grinding of black pepper.

title: Orange Coconut Cake
steps: Separate eggs and beat the whites with 1/2 cup sugar.
Sift together the flour, 1 cup sugar, salt and baking powder.
Add the Wesson oil and 1/2 the orange juice to the flour mixture and beat well.
Add the egg yolks and the rest of the orange juice.
Fold in egg whites.
Add a little orange food coloring and coconut if desired.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.
Blend together oil, sugar and egg.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Add to mixture alternately with orange juice.
Wash cranberries, chop them and fold into batter.
Pour into greased pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, cream cheese and eggs together.
Slowly add the dry ingredients (flour and sugar) to it.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Fudgy Bonbons

ingredients.name: or c. semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. or 2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips

ingredients.name: hershey s kiss
ingredients.raw: 60 Hershey's Kisses or white and chocolate striped candy kisses

ingredients.name: white baking bar
ingredients.raw: 2 oz. white baking bar or vanilla flavored candy coating

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine chips and margarine.
Cook and stir over low heat until melted.
Add milk and mix well.
Mix flour, nuts, chocolate mixture and vanilla; mix well.
Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each Kiss, covering completely.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny, but will become firm as cool.
Do not overbake.
Remove and cool.

title: Sweet Pickle Beets
steps: Wash and cook beets until they are tender and dice them.
Put sugar, vinegar, spice and water in pot and beets.
Cook about 10 minutes and then put in jars and seal.

title: Hawaiian Pineapple Cake
steps: Bake cake by box directions.
Punch holes over top of cake with end of wooden spoon.
Spread pineapple over cake (you can drain juice).
Combine cream cheese, pudding mix and milk.
Beat until thick enough to spread over pineapple.
Top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle with coconut and pecans.
Refrigerate.

title: Gram'S Sugar Cookies

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.raw: 4 c. flour (need to add more for good consistency)

steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Mix in vanilla, eggs and sour cream. Add all dry ingredients.
Refrigerate overnight.
Roll out and cut out cookies (use enough flour so dough isn't sticky).
Bake at 350° until light brown, 5 to 10 minutes.
This is a large recipe and is great for holidays.

title: Lemon Supreme Cake
steps: Blend all ingredients in large bowl, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly.
Mix 1/2 cup of lemon juice and 1 1/2 cups confectioners sugar and pour over cake while still in pan.
Let cake cool thoroughly before taking from pan.

title: Chicken And Dumpling Soup

ingredients.name: lasagna noodle and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. lasagna noodles, broken into small pieces and cooked

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom
ingredients.raw: 1 can (your choice) cream of mushroom or cream of celery soup

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.raw: water (as much as necessary for desired thickness of soup)

steps: Combine ingredients into large pot.
Heat together for at least 15 to 20 minutes or until sufficiently hot to eat.

title: Skillet Cookies
steps: Melt butter in iron frying pan.
Beat eggs and add sugar and salt; add to butter.
Cook slowly until melted.
Add chopped dates. Cook about 20 minutes.
Pour over Rice Krispies and stir to mix.
Cool.
Roll into small balls and roll in fine coconut.

title: Party Dip
steps: Mix well and chill.
Serve with chips.

title: Spanish Hominy

ingredients.name: mild jalapeno pepper or
ingredients.raw: 2 mild jalapeno peppers or to taste (can use canned peppers)

steps: In large saucepan, saute onion in margarine until slightly browned.
Blend in flour and milk; stir.
Add hominy, cheese and peppers.
Cook over low heat until cheese has melted and is thick. Serve with Mexican food or great at a fish fry.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: Bernice Conn'S Unbaked Golden Cookies

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) jar creamy or crunchy peanut butter

steps: In a large, heavy pan boil sugar and syrup until it foams up all over the surface.
Turn heat off at once.
Add margarine, vanilla and corn flakes.
Mix well.
Add peanut butter and mix well.
Drop on waxed paper with a teaspoon.
Let cool before eating.
Makes 30 to 35 cookies.

title: Turkey Cups
steps: Mix 1/4 cup soup, meat, bread crumbs, onion, egg and pepper. Divide into 4 mounds.
Shape into circles, shape into cups.
Mix remaining ingredients and fill cups.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cajun "Barbecued" Shrimp

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: butter or margarine (squeeze margarine is best)

ingredients.name: tony chachere s creole seasoning mix

steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Lay shrimp in greased baking dish. Generously coat with margarine.
Sprinkle with Tony Chachere Creole seasoning heavily.
Cayenne is to taste, the more you use, the hotter it is, so start with a little.
Turn shrimp with spoon to coat.
Add a little garlic to enhance flavor.
Check every 10 to 15 minutes, turning shrimp each time.
Add more margarine and spices if necessary to coat all.
Shrimp will turn pink when done. Enjoy!

title: Yellow Jacket Cake Icing
steps: Cook
syrup,
sugar and water to 242°.	Whip egg whites very stiff.
In	another
bowl beat egg yolks stiff.
Combine the 2 and whip in syrup in thin stream.
When stiff and ready to spread add butter. Keep vessel covered for first cooking of sugar to prevent crystallization on sides of pan.

title: Yellow Cake With Coconut

ingredients.name: coconut juice
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. coconut juice or 1/4 tsp. coconut extract

steps: Bake cake mix as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool 15 minutes.
Bring milk, sugar, coconut juice and 1/2 cup coconut to a boil.
Put holes in cake with utility fork.
Pour hot mixture over cake.
Cool. Top with Cool Whip topping and 1/2 cup coconut.
Refrigerate.

title: Granny Flemmons Pineapple Pie
steps: Mix sugar, eggs and pineapple together.
Melt the butter and add to the other ingredients.
Mix all together and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: The Ranch Beans
steps: Fry ground chuck and drain.

Saute onions, bell pepper and celery. Add to ground chuck. Add picante sauce; bring to a boil. Add all remaining ingredients in large bean pot and cook low for 30 minutes. Serve hot and with cornbread or crackers.

title: Puffed Wheat Squares
steps: Boil first 4 ingredients 3 to 4 minutes.
Add puffed wheat. Mix and press into buttered pan.

title: Mom'S Best Brownies
steps: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour into mixing bowl; add remaining ingredients and mix together.
Pour batter into same 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mock Hamburger Patties
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Form into patties.
Brown in skillet.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and pour 1 can of mushroom soup over; bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Dessert

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. strawberry or raspberries (with juice)

steps: Mix all together.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch cake pan and freeze. Let unthaw slightly before serving.

title: Superb Chicken Breasts
steps: Debone chicken breasts and grease casserole dish.
Place breasts in casserole; over each breast place 1 slice of Swiss cheese.
Combine cream of chicken soup and broth.
Spoon this mixture over chicken and cheese.
Crush dressing, mix with melted butter.
Put over top of casserole.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8.

title: "Quick" Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.name: potato soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can potato soup or cream of chicken soup

steps: Combine soup, vegetables and chicken together and pour into one of the pie crusts (uncooked).
Dot with butter and sprinkle on a little black pepper.
Take second pie crust and press out flat; place on top of pie for the cover.
Slit a few places to let air out as it cooks.
Cook until golden brown in a 350° oven.
When done, brush with butter on top crust.

title: Steamed Rice
steps: Wash rice in water by rubbing together with hands.
Pour off wash water.
Combine with remaining ingredients in a heavy pot. Bring to a boil.
Stir.
Lower heat, then cover with a lid and simmer for about 25 minutes.

title: Cheese, Rice, Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed on package.
Cook broccoli as directed; saute onion in a small amount of margarine.
Mix all ingredients together; put in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until it is slightly browned.

title: Soda Cracker Chocolate Candy
steps: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with foil and coat with nonstick cooking spray.
Place crackers in rows on foil.
In a saucepan, melt butter.
Add the brown sugar and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes.
Pour over crackers and spread until completely covered. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes (crackers will float). Remove from the oven.
Turn oven off. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over crackers.
Return to oven until chocolate is melted, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Using a greased spatula, press nuts into chocolate. Cut into 1-inch squares while warm.
Cool completely; remove from foil.
Yields approximately 5 dozen.

title: "Aunt Elsie'S Lefse"
steps: Boil potatoes and mash very fine and fluffy.
Add cream, butter, salt and sugar.
Beat until light and let cool.
Add flour.
Roll as for pie crust, as thin as possible.
Bake on lefse grill, turning once, until light brown.

title: Snack Mix
steps: In a large bowl, mix together.
Store tightly covered.

title: Sizzling Cheese Squares
steps: In a medium bowl, combine cheese, bacon bits, mayonnaise, black olives, chives, cayenne pepper and bell pepper.
Spread on slices of rye bread.
Melt under broiler about 5 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Slaw
steps: Boil mixture; cool.
Pour over cabbage, onions and sweet pepper.
Let stand.
Store in refrigerator.
Keeps for weeks.

title: Oven Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Melt margarine in baking dish.
Cool slightly.
Pour rice (uncooked) over margarine.
Arrange salted pieces of chicken over rice.
Sprinkle with onion mix.
Combine mushroom soup with water; pour over chicken.
Cover tightly.
Bake at 350°
for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Uncover last 15 minutes so chicken can brown.

title: Tomato Rice
steps: Combine all ingredients in double boiler; cover and cook for 2 hours.
Do not stir.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Healthy Choice Crab Dip

ingredients.name: nonfat yogurt
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. nonfat yogurt or sour cream

ingredients.name: healthy choice fat cream cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Healthy Choice fat free cream cheese, softened

ingredients.name: healthy choice fat cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 c. (4 oz.) Healthy Choice fat free shredded Cheddar cheese

steps: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasonings.
Mix well. Stir in Cheddar cheese and crab.
Cover and chill 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with crackers, breadsticks or vegetables.

title: Gladys Starr'S Butterscotch Torte
steps: Combine until crumbly.
Pat into 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.

title: Serbian Eggs(Serves 8 To 10)
steps: Beat eggs lightly.
Mix all ingredients; refrigerate overnight in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve mild taco sauce if desired.

title: Larry'S Pan-Fried Gumbo
steps: Slice all squash, peel potatoes and onion.
Mix thoroughly in a bowl and cover with water.
In a Ziploc bag combine cornmeal and flour.
Add one handful of vegetable mixture to Ziploc bag at a time.
Shake to coat.
Pan fry until golden brown and potatoes are cooked.

title: Six Week Bran Muffins

ingredients.name: regular shortening
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. regular shortening or unsalted butter, melted

steps: In large bowl, mix cereal, flour, sugar, soda and salt.
Beat in the buttermilk, shortening and eggs until just mixed.
Pour in storage container.
Cover and refrigerate several hours or up to 6 weeks.

title: Drop Fudge
steps: Grease sides and bottom of large saucepan with 1 tablespoon margarine.
Add 1/3 cup margarine, sugar and milk.
Bring to boil over medium heat.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Takes about 7 minutes from first bubbles.
Add chocolate bits, marshmallow cream and chopped pecans.
Stir until chocolate is dissolved.
Beat until smooth and creamy.
Drop onto waxed paper.
Makes about 5 pounds.

title: Hot And Tasty Dip
steps: Microwave at Medium the cream cheese, in 1-quart casserole, 30 to 45 seconds until soft.
Blend in remaining ingredients. Microwave 5 to 6 minutes until hot, stirring after 3 minutes. Serve with cut vegetables, crackers or potato chips.

title: Coconut Cookies
steps: Mix together.
Make a roll.
Chill.
Slice.
Bake 35 minutes in 275° oven on ungreased pan.

title: Hot Cider Punch
steps: Combine water and spices in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes. Add apple cider and sugars. Simmer over low heat 10 minutes.
Makes 5 quarts.

title: Chocolate Peanut Buddy Bars

ingredients.name: milk chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 11 1/2 oz. pkg. (2 c.) milk chocolate chips

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large mixing bowl, beat peanut butter and butter until smooth, about 1 minute.
Add sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Blend in flour and salt.
Stir in 1 cup milk chocolate morsels.

title: Bean Jars And Soup
steps: Carefully place in layers in a clean quart jar.
Place a canning lid on the jar.
Give for gift.
Add the following information for Good Luck Soup for New Year's Day.
The contents of this jar will make 2 pots of soup.

title: Dill Weed Potatoes
steps: Wash potatoes and wrap individually in plastic wrap.
Cook in microwave for 8 minutes on High on each side.
Cool while still wrapped for easier peeling.
Cut in bite sizes.
Melt butter and dill weed.
Pour over potatoes and salt to taste.
Serve hot!

title: Jelly Filled Muffins
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Cut in shortening.
Add milk and egg.
Put batter in 12 muffin papers or pan.
Place 1 teaspoon jelly on top of each muffin and press down.
Bake at 350° until done, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Soup!

ingredients.name: herb seasoning tomato etc. as
ingredients.raw: herbs: seasonings, tomatoes, etc. as needed

steps: Note:
Use whatever in whatever amounts in order to delight your palate!

title: 7-Layer Avocado Dip
steps: Use medium ovenproof ceramic dish.
Begin layers with beans on the bottom of the pan.
Add avocado.
Add a little lemon juice to avocado to prevent avocado from turning black.
Mix sour cream and taco mix together, adding on top of avocado.
Sprinkle grated cheese, tomatoes, green onions and olives.
May be refrigerated if prepared ahead of time.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Parmesan Pasta And Spinach
steps: Place milk, broth and spinach in food processor. Blend until well mixed and smooth.
Saute garlic and onion in butter in skillet 2 to 3 minutes. Add spinach mixture. Cook over low heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cheese and pepper, stirring until thickened.
Pour spinach mixture over linguine and mix. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fresh Strawberry Jam
steps: In large 3-quart casserole, place berries and pectin.
Stir well.
Cover.
Microwave at High (10) for 8 to 10 minutes.
Add sugar and 1 small box strawberry Jell-O.
Microwave at High (10) for 8 to 10 minutes, uncovered, stirring after 5 minutes, until mixture reaches a full rolling boil.
Time 1 minute of boiling. Skim off foam with metal spoon.
Stir jam about 5 minutes.
Ladel in containers and freeze.

title: Red Peanut Patty
steps: Cook first 4 ingredients to soft ball.
Remove from heat and add butter and food coloring.
Stir until consistency of fudge. Drop by spoonfuls on buttered cookie sheets.

title: Mock Cordon Blu
steps: Roll together in this order:
turkey, ham, cheese (the kind you buy or deli sliced slightly thicker).
Spread biscuit crumbs on top; drizzle with margarine and bake until just heated.
Bake about 10 to 12 minutes at 350° to 400°.
Serve over seasoned rice or can put gravy over, if desired.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
steps: Marinate chicken at least 2 hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° or on a grill.

title: Orange And Crabmeat Salad
steps: Toss ingredients together lightly with a fork; salt to taste. Serve on crisp lettuce.
Keep refrigerated and serve well chilled.

title: Norwegian Slaw
steps: Shred first 3 ingredients.
Bring to boil next 4 ingredients. Remove from heat.
Add celery seed.
Pour over other ingredients. Place in tightly covered container.
Refrigerate overnight.
Will keep 2 weeks.

title: Two Squash Saute

ingredients.name: zucchini julienne
ingredients.raw: 2 medium zucchini, cut into julienne strips

steps: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine.
Place over medium-high heat until margarine melts.
Add zucchini and remaining ingredients; saute 5 minutes or until squash is crisp-tender.
Yields 6 servings (19 calories and 33% fat per 1/2 cup serving).

title: John'S Favorite Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix Crisco, peanut butter, sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended.
Add egg, beat until just blended.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Add to creamed mixture and mix at low speed until just blended.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Flatten slightly with crisscross pattern with fork. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.

title: May'S Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Do not peel cucumbers; slice thin.
Add onions and garlic cloves.
Add salt.
Cover with cracked ice; mix thoroughly.
Let stand 3 hours or overnight; drain well.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumber mixture.
Heat just until boiling.
Seal in hot jars.
Makes 8 pints.

title: Veggie Mix
steps: Cut vegetables into small, bite size pieces in large bowl. Pour Italian dressing over vegetables and mix well.
Seal bowl and let stand overnight.
Open and serve.

title: Creamy Shrimp Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese at room temperature; place in bowl.
Add salad dressing, onion, Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder; mix well.
Chop shrimp; add to cream cheese mixture.
Chill slightly. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Lime Supreme
steps: Combine Jell-O and boiling water.
Add while Jell-O is still hot the pineapple and bananas.
Cover top with small marshmallows while hot and let set in refrigerator.
Before serving, cover with salad dressing and grated Longhorn cheese.
Fix in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Honey Roasted Pretzels
steps: Place the pretzels in a large bowl, set aside.	In a microwave safe bowl mix the rest of the ingredients except the baking soda. Microwave for 2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute. Remove from microwave and add the baking soda.
Pour over pretzels, stir to coat well.
Spread pretzels out on sprayed wax paper to cool.
Store in an airtight container.
Easy and delicious snack!

title: Gold Corn Chowder
steps: Melt butter in a 3-quart saucepan.
Saute onion and celery until tender, about 3 minutes.
Stir in potatoes, milk, corn and pepper.
Heat to serving temperature.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted.
(If necessary, return to fire to finish melting cheese, but don't boil.) Serve immediately.
Yields 8 cups.

title: Mountain Dew Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water and cool.
Add Mountain Dew and pineapple juice.
Chill mixture until it begins to jell.
Fold in fruit and marshmallows.

title: Olive Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese. Drain olives and reserve juice. Chop the olives and mix with cream cheese.
Add about 2 tablespoons olive juice. Mix in sour cream and enough mayonnaise to a good consistency. Sprinkle with garlic salt.
Add about 6 to 12 drops Tabasco sauce (to suit taste).

title: Chocolate Crunchy Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Combine the first three ingredients in a pot.
Bring to a boil and boil 6 minutes.
Then add chocolate morsels.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter.
Pour in a long greased pan and refrigerate until firm.
Cut into small pieces.

title: Skillet Biscuit Cheese Bread
steps: Mix and pour in large skillet to which 2 layers of wax papers have been placed.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes; remove wax paper immediately.

title: Orange Sherbet
steps: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water, add lemon juice and cool to room temperature; stir in milk.
Freeze to a hard slush.
Beat with electric mixer until smooth.
Return to freezer; stir several times as sherbet freezes.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cauliflower Bake
steps: Make flowerets and cook 10 minutes.
Place in shallow baking dish.
Combine Swiss cheese and mayonnaise.
Beat egg whites and fold into cheese mixture.
Add lemon juice.
Spread over cauliflower and sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake about 10 minutes and then broil about 5 minutes until golden or puffs up.

title: Bacon Hot Slaw
steps: Dice bacon and cook slowly until crisp.
Pour off half the drippings.
Add other ingredients to remaining drippings and heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until cabbage is hot and well coated with sauce.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Cabbage should be crisp.
Drain off liquid before serving.
Serves 6.

title: Orange Special
steps: Pour juice into glass.
Pour cola into glass.
Stir and add ice.

title: Jiffy Corn
steps: Combine all ingredients and put in casserole dish sprayed with Pam.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Leparin Good
steps: Brown onion and hamburger.
Add other ingredients.
Cube buttered bread and place over top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Spinach Dip Ii

ingredients.name: spinach thawed and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps: Mix and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Good with Club crackers (Keebler Club or Captain crackers).

title: Broccoli-Spinach Casserole
steps: Cook spinach and broccoli half as long as directions call for. Drain.
Add a little salt and pepper.
Combine soup and cheese. Cook until cheese melts.
Combine vegetables and soup mixture. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Mix croutons with melted margarine. Sprinkle on top.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Hello Dollys
steps: Layer ingredients in order given in 8 x 8-inch ungreased square pan.
Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Let cool before cutting.

title: Frog Frosting
steps: Mix well by hopping.
Tint green.
Use on anything appropriate.

title: Hot Peppers And Green Tomatoes
steps: Get vinegar and water to boil.
Cut tomatoes to desired size. Put 1 teaspoon salt and sugar to quart jar.
Pack tomatoes and about 12 peppers to a quart.
Fill jars with boiling vinegar and water.
In about 30 days hot peppers and tomatoes will be ready to eat.

title: Chicken Victoria

ingredients.name: green red
ingredients.raw: 1 green, red or yellow bell pepper, chopped

steps: Brown chicken pieces in hot oil for 5 minutes; drain off fat. Add desired La Victoria salsa and water.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Uncover; add corn and bell pepper (add more water if necessary).
Cover and cook 10 minutes more.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Red Potato Casserole
steps: Boil the red potatoes until tender.
Mix together other ingredients. Slice 1 layer of potatoes thinly in buttered casserole. Top mixture, then repeat. Top with bacon bits.
Bake at 350° until bubbling.

title: Pfefferneusse
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Roll into long, thin rolls in wax paper.
Refrigerate overnight.
Slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices. Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cool and store in airtight container.
Will keep indefinitely.
Yield: about 800 peppernuts.
"A must for Christmas."

title: Chinese Chews
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add beaten eggs, then the flour that has been sifted with the cream of tartar and the soda.
Mix well. Add dates, nuts and flavoring.
Spread in 8-inch pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Tea House Pound Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour to creamed mixture, alternating with milk, beating well after each addition.
Stir in flavoring.
Pour into a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Spinach Salad Dip
steps: Thaw spinach and drain well.
Combine remaining ingredients and chill.
Cut hole in top of bread, big enough for dip to fit in.
Put dip in center of bread.
Cut pieces of bread and use for dipping. Can also be used as a vegetable dip.

title: Boudin Or Cajun Sausage
steps: Cut fresh pork butts into 1 1/2 pound pieces.
Boil all of the ingredients in 8 gallons of water.
When meat separates from bone, strain meat from stock.
Reserve stock.
Grind meat mixture in a meat grinder or food processor.
Cook 36 cups of rice.
Combine mixture with cooled rice and add enough stock to make it moist.

title: Cottage Cheese Patties
steps: Mix all ingredients except soup.
Form into patties.
Brown in small amount of oil.
Heat undiluted soup and pour over patties. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Georgia Peanut Butter Potatoes

ingredients.name: pineapple including juice
ingredients.raw: 1 small (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple including juice

steps: Combine first 6 ingredients and beat until fluffy.
Put 3/4 of potato mixture in a 13 x 9-inch casserole.
Cover with peanut butter, then top with remaining potatoes.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until center is firm.

title: Sugar 'N Spice Nuts
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In a large bowl, place nuts; set aside. In a small bowl, beat egg white and orange juice or water until frothy.
Add sugar, spices and salt; mix well.
Pour over nuts, stirring to coat well.
On a greased jelly roll pan or large shallow roasting pan, spread nuts so they do not touch.
Bake, stirring every 15 minutes, until light brown and crisp, 45 to 55 minutes.
Cool.
Store in an airtight container in a cool place up to 1 month.
Makes about 5 cups.
When placed in decorative container, they make a great gift.

title: Caramel Almond Cracker

ingredients.name: margarine
ingredients.raw: 2 sticks margarine (I Can't Believe It's Not Butter)

steps: Line jelly roll pan with separated Club crackers.
Melt margarine and sugar.
Bring mixture to boil.
Pour mixture over crackers and sprinkle with almonds.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.
Remove crackers immediately and place on wax paper.

title: Little Nut Rolls
steps: Mix thoroughly butter, flour, egg yolks, milk, vanilla and salt.
Form in 4 balls and cool for 2 hours.
Roll out dough then cut into 2 1/2-inch squares.
Fill each square with filling.
Roll and bake at 350°.
When cool, dust with 10x sugar.

title: Hearty Oatmeal Muffins

ingredients.name: any aunt jemima pancake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 c. any Aunt Jemima pancake mix

steps: Heat oven to 425°. Grease bottom only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Combine pancake mix, oats, brown sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining ingredients;
mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake in 425° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. This makes 1 dozen muffins.

title: Special "K" Unbaked Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix Karo and sugar.
Bring to a hard boil over moderate heat. When mixture boils, remove from heat immediately.
Stir in peanut butter and blend well, then fold in cereal until well coated. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper while still warm.

title: Vegetable Fritters

ingredients.name: soft tofu and
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. soft tofu, drained and rinsed

steps: Mix ingredients; form into patties (flat).
Cook in frypan with small amount of oil.
Serve warm.

title: No Bake Banana Pudding

ingredients.name: condensed milk
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)

ingredients.name: container nondairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: Prepare pudding following package directions. Let stand until slightly
thickened (3 minutes).
Mix in condensed milk and nondairy topping.
Slice bananas in 1/2 inch rounds. Layer wafers, bananas and
filling
in
clear glass bowl or 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish.
Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Jimmy Dean Appetizers

ingredients.name: velveeta cheese in
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in small cubes

steps: Brown together the sausage and ground beef.
Add rest of ingredients and mix until cheese is melted.
Put on party rye and freeze.
Makes about 25.
When you want to serve, take from freezer and place on cookie sheet; bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Mounds Bars Balls
steps: Cream butter and confectioners sugar.
Add coconut, sweetened condensed milk, chopped nuts and vanilla.
Stir until well blended.
Chill.
Roll into small balls.
Insert toothpick in each ball and freeze.
Melt chocolate chips, chocolate squares and wax. Dip balls into melted chocolate.
Place on waxed paper.
Chill.

title: Georgia Prune Cake
steps: Mix oil, sugar, eggs, prunes, milk, salt, spices and most of flour. Stir well. Add nuts; stir and add soda last with flour last. Pour into well greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake 35 minutes at 325°.

title: 3 Hole Devil'S Food Cake
steps: Sift all dry ingredients together into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Make 3 holes in dry mixture.
In first hole, put vanilla.
In second hole, put vinegar.
In third hole, put oil. Pour 2 cups lukewarm water over all and mix well with a fork.
Do not beat.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Ice when cool.

title: No Cook Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Put first 3 ingredients in large container and cover with salt; mix sugar and vinegar and dissolve.
Cool; pour over pickles and salt.
Cover tightly; put in refrigerator.
Ready to eat in 2 to 6 weeks.

title: Carrots Lyonnaise

ingredients.name: carrot in julienne
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. carrots, cut in julienne strips

steps: Cook together carrots, bouillon and water.
Simmer sliced onions in butter.
Add flour to thicken and water (drained from carrots).
Add to carrots and cook together 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Isabelle'S Delicious Cake
steps: Cover raisins well with water, boil 20 minutes.
Drain and save the water.
Mix remaining ingredients.

title: Mushroom Rice(Serves 4 To 5)
steps: Saute onion in small bowl in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes at High.
Heat water about 4 minutes in microwave.
Dissolve bouillon in hot water.
Add rice and onion and mushrooms to water. Microwave at 30% for 20 to 25 minutes.
Times may vary with different microwaves.

title: Vegetable Barley Soup
steps: Cover beef with water in large pot and cook about 20 minutes after water starts to boil.
Skim top.
Remove beef, cut into pieces and put back in stock.
Add V-8 juice, tomatoes and all other veggies.
Cook about 1 hour or until veggies are soft.
Add barley to pot of soup and cook according to package or cook barley in separate pot.

title: Cinnamon Applesauce Swirl Salad
steps: Dissolve candies and gelatin in water; stir in applesauce. Chill until partially set.
Pour into 8-inch square pan.
Mix cheese, cream and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir gently into jelled applesauce for swirled effect.
Chill until firm.
Serve squares on greens.
Serves 9 to 12.

title: Lemon Cut Out Cookies
steps: In
large mixing bowl, cream together butter and sugar. Beat in
egg.
Stir dry ingredients together; add alternately with ReaLemon
to creamed mixture.
Mix well.
(Dough will be soft.) Chill overnight.

title: Tuna And Rice Casserole

ingredients.name: uncooked rice
ingredients.raw: 2 c. uncooked rice (cook according to directions)

ingredients.name: cream of celery
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of celery or chicken mushroom

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 to 1 c. shredded Cheddar cheese (according to your taste)

steps: Mix all ingredients, except cheese in 9 x 11-inch casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted (about 20 to 25 minutes).

title: Date Nut Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar, egg yolks and vanilla.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Roll nuts and dates in flour mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and add to other ingredients.
Put in greased loaf pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.

title: Oven Potatoes
steps: The day ahead, cook the potatoes with skins on. Cool.
Peel and grate (with a cabbage grater).
Put in Pam sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat together the margarine and half and half.
Pour over potatoes.
Cover with Cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika. The next day, bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: My Favorite Jello Salad
steps: Drain pineapple; reserve juice for topping.
Combine apricot nectar and water in saucepan, bring to boil.
Add Jell-O and stir to dissolve.
Stir in pineapple, marshmallows and bananas.
Pour into shallow 2-quart dish and chill until firm.
Cover with topping; refrigerate.

title: Coffee Punch
steps: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil.
Let cool and add to ice cream and milk mixture.

title: Sweet Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients; add milk and drippings.
Mix well.
Bake in a loaf pan for 1 1/2 hours or until brown.
Bake in a preheated slow 300° oven until brown.
Cool in pan.
May be sliced thin with an electric knife or frozen.
Reheats well.

title: Fat-Free White Sauce
steps: In saucepan, combine water and cornstarch. Stir in milk. Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Makes 2 cups.

title: Easy Carrot Bars
steps: Combine ingredients in order given.
Pour into greased pan (11 x 16-inch or larger).
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Prize Gingerbread
steps: Mix together all ingredients, except egg, then add unbeaten egg and beat all lightly.
Bake in a shallow pan in a moderate oven for 20 minutes at 350°.
This is delicious warm or served cold topped with whipped cream.

title: Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
steps: Bring the water to a boil.
Add margarine and rice.
Bring to a boil; then reduce heat and cook for 20 minutes on low until water is all absorbed.
Cook broccoli 2 to 3 minutes.
Drain. When rice is finished, add cheese and broccoli.
Stir well.

title: Strawberry Preserves
steps: Combine strawberries and 2 cups sugar.
Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Add remaining sugar and lemon juice.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Pour into bowl and gently stir every few minutes until cool.
Jar and seal the next morning.
Strawberries will not separate into layers if completely cold when put into jars.

title: Chicken Bog For 100 People
steps: Boil chickens until done and debone.
Mix broth, pepper and salt. Cut sausage into one-inch pieces and add to broth.
Bring to a boil.
Add rice and stir constantly until broth begins to thicken.
Add chicken and stir.
Cover and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Granny'S Walnut Cake
steps: Chop the walnuts into small pieces.
Prepare cake mix as directed; fold in walnut pieces.
Bake according to directions in 8-inch round pans.
Allow cake to cool completely before frosting. Generously spread Cool Whip on cake.

title: Cube Steak And Sauce
steps: For Sauce:
Combine ingredients listed.
Bring just to a boiling point, stirring occasionally.

title: 2 Minute Hawaiian Pie

ingredients.name: pineapple in heavy syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup, undrained

steps: In large bowl, combine vanilla pudding mix, undrained pineapple and sour cream; stir until blended.
Pour mixture into pie crust.
Cover and chill 2 hours.

title: Pineapple Picnic Salad

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.raw: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix

ingredients.name: carton non dairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen non-dairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: In large bowl, gradually stir the undrained crushed pineapple into the cream cheese.
Stir in the pudding mix.
Fold in pineapple chunks and whipped topping.
Cover and chill until serving time.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fried Love Knots
steps: Mix all together into a dough.
Do not overmix.
Roll out dough.
Cut into triangles.
Make a slit in the middle of a triangle and invert to make a knot.
Fry in deep fat.
Fries very quickly.

title: Barbecue Green Beans
steps: Saute onion and bacon together.
Drain.
Add sugar, catsup and vinegar.
Mix well into a sauce.
Pour over green beans.
Heat to serve.
Serves 6.

title: Campfire Dump Cake
steps: Put pie filling in Dutch oven lined with foil if you want easy cleanup.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over filling.
Dot with butter chunks.
Bake for approximately 30 minutes in coals, below and above Dutch oven.

title: Chi Chi
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread thin on flour tortilla. Roll and chill.
Slice into bite size pieces.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Microwave)
steps: In 4-cup measure combine all ingredients.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Cook on High for 5 minutes, stirring once.
Let stand several minutes.
Serve with ribs, chicken, chops and hamburger. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Seven Layer Cake
steps: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer ingredients in the order listed.
Do not mix together.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: No Cook Noodle Lasagna
steps: Brown beef; add spaghetti sauce; stir well.
In another bowl, mix eggs, add cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese.
In 9 x 13-inch pan, place 3 uncooked noodles, alternate meat mixture, cheese mixture and noodles.
Repeat, ending with meat on top.
Pour hot water around edge of pan.
Cover with foil. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Remove from oven, sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Golfer'S Sandwich Spread
steps: In double boiler, cook the first 4 ingredients, stirring constantly until thick.
In mixing bowl, add to first mixture the last 3 ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Keep refrigerated.

title: Grandma'S Red Devil'S Food
steps: Mix the egg, flour, salt, sugar and sour milk with soda added to it.
Add lard, food coloring and melted unsweetened chocolate. Batter is quite thin.
Place in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
(Double recipe makes 9 x 13-inch pan, plus 6 cupcakes.)
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Crab And Spinach Casserole
steps: Thaw spinach.
Grate cheese.
Start with layer of spinach, then onions, then crab.
Repeat once again.
Refrigerate.

title: Reba Kelly'S Creamed Spinach
steps: Saute onion in bacon drippings.
Add flour to onion.
Cook approximately 1 minute.
Add liquid from the can of spinach and cook another minute, stirring to make smooth sauce.
Add spinach and season with salt and pepper.
Cook for about 5 minutes. Garnish with bacon bits.

title: Snow White Frosting
steps: Dissolve sugar and hot water in pan.
Boil 1 minute.
Add to egg, cream of tartar and flavoring in a bowl.
Beat at high speed until stiff.

title: Glazed Chicken
steps: Wash chicken pieces.
In a dish, mix together Russian dressing, onion soup mix and apricot preserves.
Dip each piece of chicken into mixture and place in pan.
Bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken over.
Brush with left over mixture and bake until done.

title: Chocolate Treat
steps: Mix together and press into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Let cool.

title: Chicken Dip
steps: Drain the can of chicken.
Saute the onion in butter, then add to chicken.
Stir in the soup and chilies.
Melt the Velveeta in a saucepan.
Add 1 cup of the Doritos.
Stir in the chicken mixture.
Place in a 9-inch pie pan.
Cover with the Cheddar cheese and put under broiler to melt.
Enjoy!

title: Easy Ham And Noodle Casserole

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: broccoli cauliflower and carrot thawed
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrots, thawed

steps: Cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain.
Keep warm.
Heat
oven to 350°.
Grease 2 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Strawberry Shortcake Squares
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Combine half and half and egg, stirring well.
Add to flour mixture, stirring just until moistened.

title: Pickled Daikon "Japanese Radish"
steps: Boil vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper until sugar melts.
Cool mixture and pour over sliced Daikon and let sit 1 hour and refrigerate.

title: Apricot Ice Cream
steps: Blend apricots plus juice in blender.
Squeeze oranges and lemon.
Add juice to apricot mixture.
Add remaining ingredients. Makes one gallon.

title: Creamy Cucumber Dill Sauce

ingredients.name: cucumber and
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. chopped cucumber, peeled and seeded

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Galliano Cake
steps: Mix together and beat 4 minutes.
Pour into tube pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Homemade Laundry Soap
steps: Dissolve lye in cold water, being careful not to let it splash.
Let it stand until cool, then add warm fat, slowly, stirring constantly.
Add all other ingredients.
Stir until thick, about one hour!

title: Chicken Crescent Rolls

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned deboned and
ingredients.raw: 1 3/4 c. chicken breasts, cooked, skinned, deboned and cubed

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. Cheddar cheese or sliced Velveeta cheese

steps: Mix chicken with 1/4 cup cheese.
Cook soup, milk and 1/4 cup cheese on stove until cheese is melted.
Place 1 tablespoon chicken mixture on wide end of each roll. Roll it up.
Place soup mixture in the bottom of a glass pan and place rolled crescents on top. Bake in a 375° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
During last 5 minutes, sprinkle extra cheese on top of rolls. Done when rolls are golden brown and cheese is melted.

title: Chocolate Nut Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar and salt.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Stir in 1 beaten egg. Press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Rae'S Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening.
Add sugar and beat in egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients over creamed mixture.
Mix well.
Form into small balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Do not flatten.
Bake at 350° for about 8 to 10 minutes (longer for crispier).

title: Boiled Cookies (No Bake)
steps: Mix the sugar and margarine in a saucepan; add milk.
Let it come to a full rolling boil.
Cook 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add oatmeal, vanilla and peanut butter.
Mix and drop by spoonfuls (use teaspoon) on wax paper.
Use cookie sheet; let cool.

title: Pork Chops With Apricot Sauce
steps: Cut the apricot halves into thin strips and combine with the stock.
Set aside.
In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium heat.
Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper and saute until browned, 6 to 8 minutes per side.
Remove chops from pan and cover to keep warm.
Add stock and apricots to pan.
Bring to boil, scraping up browned bits, and boil until stock is reduced to about 1/2 cup.
Remove from heat.
Add the mustard and stir until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the pork chops to serve.

title: Plain Yellow Cake
steps: Cream
shortening
and 3/4 cup sugar.
Beat egg whites. Add 1/4
cup
sugar.
Add
egg yolks and vanilla.
Beat until fluffy. Then
fold	in
other ingredients;	blend thoroughly. Pour	in two (8-inch) layer cake pans.
Grease bottom of pans and line with wax paper.	Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.

title: Traditional Cheese Cake
steps: Let cream cheese, sour cream and eggs stand at room temperature.
Blend all ingredients together for at least 15 minutes until mixture is smooth.
Pour into 9-inch greased spring-form pan.
Place pan in larger square pan which is half filled with hot water.
Bake in 375° oven for at least 1 hour until top is golden.
Remove from oven and let cool 1 to 2 hours. Refrigerate overnight.

title: France'S Chicken
steps: Cook chicken (boil) until it falls off the bone.
Cook noodles until half done.
Add soup and vegetables to cooked chicken along with noodles.
Simmer for about 1/2 hour.
Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Serves 4)
steps: Cook broccoli; drain.
Heat 1 stick of butter.
Crumble 1 roll of crackers; spread over cooked broccoli.
Spread butter over crackers and shredded Cheddar cheese.
Heat in oven until cheese melts.

title: "Rush-In" Chicken
steps: Combine preserves, dressing and soup mix.
Coat chicken with sauce and place in a baking dish in a single layer.
Cover chicken with remaining sauce.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Meltaway
steps: Cream all ingredients except oatmeal and mix.
Then add oatmeal and chill for 1 hour.
Form into walnut size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheets and flatten with fork.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Apple Dump Cake
steps: In ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan, pour pie filling and pineapple. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top.
Add nuts.
Melt margarine; drizzle over nuts.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Yummy Punch
steps: Take one large field, half dozen children, two or three dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles.
Mix the children and dogs together.
Put them in a field, stirring constantly.
Pour the brook over pebbles.
Sprinkle with flowers.
Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun.
When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: 3-Day Cole Slaw

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.raw: 1 medium head cabbage, chopped or shredded

steps: Chop cabbage, onion, pepper and pimiento; set aside.
Combine other ingredients and bring to a boil.
Pour hot sauce over chopped vegetables; mix well.
Pack into jars and cover.
Let sit for 3 days without removing cover.
Keep refrigerated.

title: Lemon-Lime Congealed Salad
steps: Heat 2 cups of water.
Add jello and stir.
Add pineapple, cottage cheese and milk.
Blend in mayonnaise and nuts.
Put in dish rinsed with cold water and cover with plastic wrap to make airtight.

title: My Own Squash Casserole

ingredients.name: herb seasoned stuffing mix
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. of herb seasoned stuffing mix

steps: Cook squash and onions in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.
Combine soup and sour cream.
Fold in drained squash and onion.
Combine stuffing mix and butter.
Spread one half of the stuffing mixture in bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Layer vegetable mixture on top.
Spoon rest of stuffing mixture as the final layer.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes(Method:  One Pot Or Skillet)
steps: Finely chop onions.
Brown onions and hamburger in a large pot or skillet; drain fat into heat resistant can.
Stir in tomato paste, water and barbecue sauce.
Cover; simmer until sauce is thick (approximately 10 to 15 minutes).
Serve on hamburger or kaiser buns.

title: Southern Pie
steps: Cream together the butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks, vinegar, nuts and raisins.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in an unbaked crust for 45 minutes in a moderate 350° oven.

title: Best Chocolate Pie In The World
steps: Cook pie crust first.
Roll out on floured board.
Bake at 425° for about 15 to 20 minutes.
I bake my crusts on the top shelf of oven; seems to brown more evenly.

title: Freezer Dinner Rolls
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 c. flour, sugar, salt and yeast.
Stir mixture and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine water, milk and butter.
Heat until butter melts.
Cool to 120° to 130°. Stir in flour mixture and beat with an electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add 1/2 c. flour and eggs.
Beat at high speed for 2 minutes.
Gradually stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough.

title: Baker'S Clay
steps: Mix and knead.
Form into desired shape and bake at 300°.

title: Cheesy Charlies
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, pickles and onion.
Spread on bread and cover with a cheese slice.
Bake open faced in oven until cheese melts.

title: Cake "Icing"
steps: Blend pudding, milk and powdered sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Bread
steps: Bring milk to a boil.
Dissolve cocoa in 1/3 cup hot water. Add to milk.
Add vanilla, oleo and sugar.
Cook on medium heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring constantly, until thick.
Pour over favorite bread.

title: Fresh Fruit And Cheese Sundaes

ingredients.name: low fat
ingredients.raw: 1 c. low-fat or regular cottage cheese

ingredients.name: seedless orange and
ingredients.raw: 2 seedless oranges, peeled and diced (grate 1 tsp. peel and set aside)

ingredients.name: strawberry
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. sliced strawberries or whole blueberries or raspberries

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. finely chopped, fresh or crushed, drained pineapple

steps: In a medium bowl, stir together the cottage cheese, orange pieces and berries.
Gently fold in pineapple, brown sugar and orange peel until mixed.
Spoon mixture into 4 serving dishes. Sprinkle almonds over each serving.
Makes 4 sundaes.

title: Hot And Spicy Noodles And Beans

ingredients.name: ranch style jalapeno pinto bean
ingredients.raw: 1 c. Ranch Style jalapeno pinto beans

steps: Start cooking macaroni in saucepan.
When tender, drain, rinse with cold water and set aside.
Brown hamburger meat in skillet. Add to taste, garlic salt, salt and pepper.
When brown, drain grease and add to pan of macaroni, along with beans and tomato sauce.
Simmer for approximately 20 minutes.
Depending on your taste, you may want to add a little more tomato sauce and/or another can of jalapeno beans.
Great for winter; it warms the body from inside out!

title: Icebox Pie Crust

ingredients.name: oleo in pie plate
ingredients.raw: 1 stick oleo, melted in pie plate

steps: Melt oleo in pie plate; add sugar.
Dump in flour.
Mix well with fork and pat with fingers.
Press in pie plate and push up on sides.
Prick with fork.
Bake until light brown at 350°.
Don't worry if it cracks!
Let cool and fill with your favorite pie mixture.

title: Orange Corn Muffins
steps: Blend all ingredients; fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 425° for 17 to 19 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

title: Hot Squash
steps: Cook squash and onion in butter and a little water until tender; drain.
Add pepper and cheese and stir until cheese melts. Put in dish and top with bread crumbs.
Heat in oven at 350° for about 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Quick Chicken Pie

ingredients.name: undiluted cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can undiluted cream of celery soup

steps: Put cut up chicken in casserole dish.
Pour chicken stock over chicken.
Layer the eggs over chicken.
Spoon celery soup over eggs.
Mix last three ingredients together and pour over other ingredients.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Canned Peppers And Wieners

ingredients.name: sweet and hot pepper up
ingredients.raw: 3 gal. sweet and hot peppers, cut up

steps: Combine and cook ketchup, juice, vinegar, sugar and garlic together for 30 minutes.
Add peppers and wieners and cook for 20 minutes longer.
Put in clean canning jars and cold pack for 10 minutes.

title: Southern Apple Cake
steps: Cream butter, eggs and sugar.
Add oil; add dry ingredients, then apples and nuts.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Mixed Up Dinner

ingredients.name: kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner

steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions. Add beans and sausage.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Kids love this.

title: Never-Fail Divinity
steps: Boil 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water until it forms a soft ball in cold water.

In another pan, boil 3 cups sugar, 1 cup syrup and 1 cup water until it forms a hard ball. Beat egg whites to a stiff froth. Add slowly first syrup, then second, beating all the time. Add nuts and vanilla just before dropping.
When begins to cool, drop on waxed paper.

title: 40 Cloves Garlic Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.raw: chicken pieces (legs, thighs, split breasts and wings)

steps: Put chicken parts in roasting pan.
Break heads of garlic apart; do not peel.
Put in pan with chicken.
Pour wine and lemon juice over chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika.
