Cover pan with foil. Bake at 350° to 375° for 1 hour.
Remove foil and brown under broiler.
Serve with French bread to spread roasted garlic on top.

title: Tender Baked Parsnips
steps: Drain parsnips when tender.
Mix with remaining ingredients, except butter and parsley.
Transfer to an oiled 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Dot with the butter.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish (if desired) and sprinkle with the parsley.

title: Italian Meat Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients; roll into balls.
Some cooks like to brown meat balls before cooking them in the sauce.
I prefer cooking them in the sauce without browning.
Either way is very good.

title: Onion Dip
steps: Place sour cream and green onion in a blender; blend one minute.
Pour into small bowl.
Stir in yogurt, dill, chives and garlic powder.
Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Basic Cookie Mix(About 16 Cups)
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt and baking soda until well blended.
With a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed.
Put in a large airtight container.
Label.
Store in a cool, dry place.
Use within 10 to 12 weeks.
Makes about 16 cups of Basic Cookie Mix.

title: Granola-Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Cream first 4 ingredients.
Add vanilla, baking soda, salt and flour.
Mix thoroughly and blend in cereal.
Drop mixture by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Preheat oven at 350°.
Chopped walnuts may be added.

title: Just Like Fresh Corn

ingredients.name: sweet corn kernel
ingredients.raw: 20 c. fresh cut sweet corn kernels

steps: Place butter in a roasting pan and place in a 325° oven until melted.
Stir in corn and cream.
Bake uncovered for 75 minutes or until the corn is tender, stirring occasionally.
Immediately place roaster in ice water to cool quickly, stirring frequently. Transfer corn to heavy duty plastic freezer bags and freeze.
May be frozen for up to 1 month.
To serve, just reheat.
Yield: 16 cups.

title: Pecans
steps: Bake in a 225° oven for 3 to 4 hours.
Turn every 30 minutes. Delicious.

title: Graveyard Stew
steps: Heat milk; butter toast.
Put toast in hot milk and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Three Bean Chili

ingredients.name: tomato bite size
ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, cut into bite-size pieces

ingredients.name: pinto
ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz.) can pinto or kidney beans, drained

ingredients.name: yogurt
ingredients.raw: yogurt or sour cream, sliced green onions, shredded cheese

steps: Combine gravy, tomatoes and chili powder in 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil, then stir in beans and chilies.
Cover; simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with desired toppings. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beef Corn Casserole
steps: While cooking package of noodles, brown ground beef with salt and onion.
Drain noodles and ground beef, then combine.
To these, add soups, pimento, corn and sour cream.
Pour into casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs.
May divide into 2 servings and freeze one.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Place 1 teaspoon margarine in each of 12 medium muffin cups.
Heat in oven until melted.
Divide the 2 tablespoons brown sugar among cups (1/2 teaspoon each).
Divide pineapple among cups (about 1 tablespoon each).
Place 1 cherry half, cut side up, in center of each cup.
Mix remaining ingredients; beat vigorously 30 seconds.
Fill muffin cups about 3/4 full.
Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes.
Immediately invert pan on heatproof serving plate; let pan remain a few minutes.
Serve warm.
Makes 12 muffins.

title: Spinach Spread

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, sliced thin

ingredients.name: uncut loaf rye
ingredients.raw: 1 uncut loaf rye or pumpernickel bread

steps: Mix first first 4 ingredients together.
Cut top off loaf of bread; scoop out the center.
Put spread in the "bowl."
Cut up center into pieces to spread spinach mix on.
When spread is all gone, cut up loaf and enjoy.

title: Whitefish Almondine
steps: Cut fillets into serving size pieces.
Sprinkle all sides with lemon juice.
Combine flour, salt and pepper.
Use to coat fish.
In large skillet over medium heat, in hot butter or margarine, fry fish pieces until brown, about 10 minutes, turning once.
Place fish on warm platter; keep warm.

title: Microwave Devil Dog Sandwiches
steps: Place bacon between layers of paper towels and microwave 3 1/2 to 4 minutes.
Split hot dogs lengthwise, not cutting all the way through.
Mix together ham, cheese, olives and mustard.
Spread on the inside of hot dogs and press together.
Wrap 1 slice of bacon around each hot dog and place in bun.
Wrap sandwiches loosely in paper towels.
Place 3 sandwiches 1 inch apart in microwave and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.

title: Dream Ice Cream
steps: Add milk to finish filling the freezer.
Mix well and freeze.

title: Mini Strombolis
steps: Combine cheeses in a small bowl.
Halve each biscuit horizontally, making 20 thin biscuits.
Gently shape each piece into a 2 1/4 x 4-inch oval.
Place a slice of pepperoni slightly off center on dough.
Top with level tablespoon of cheese mixture. Moisten edges.
Fold over and pinch to seal.
Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until golden.
Makes 20 servings.

title: Pecan Clusters
steps: Beat egg whites until forms a soft peak, add 1/2 sugar, beat. Then add other half until sugar is completely dissolved.
Grease pans, dip pecans in egg whites.
Place flat on baking sheet.
Bake in 350° oven until light brown.

title: Sister'S Chocolate Layer Dessert
steps: Melt margarine; add flour and nuts.
Put into bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 325°.
Cool thoroughly.
Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 1/3 cups whipped topping. Spread mixture over cooled baked crust.
When set, proceed with next layer.

title: Burritos
steps: Cook hamburger meat and onion until browned; drain well.
Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water; mix well.
Add refried beans; mix well.
Put filling into each flour tortilla.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with the seam side down.
Cover with the chili mixed with the 1/2 cup water.
Add cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Pig'S Delight

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. grated onion or 2 tsp. chives

ingredients.name: loaf bread
ingredients.raw: 1 round loaf bread (pumpernickel or whatever you prefer)

steps: Scoop out center of bread to form a bowl.
Serve chunks of bread
for dipping.
Combine all ingredients and mix well. Put dip in bread bowl and serve the chunks for dipping.
This works equally well as a dip with chips or vegetables.

title: All-Purpose Punch
steps: Mix Kool-Aid with 1 gallon water.
Mix orange juice and lemonade with water as directed on cans.
Pour juice mixture and sugar into Kool-Aid.
Makes 1 3/4 gallons.

title: Diet Ambrosia

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.raw: 1 large can crushed pineapple (packed in its own juice)

ingredients.name: diet fruit cocktail
ingredients.raw: 1 large can drained diet fruit cocktail

steps: Mix Ricotta cheese with mixer at high speed.
Beat in with mixer crushed pineapple including juice.
Remove beater and add drained fruit cocktail, diced apple, orange and sliced banana. Chill and serve.

title: Meat Balls Hawaiian
steps: Combine the first 5 ingredients; mix lightly but thoroughly. Shape meat mixture into 30 balls.
Roll in flour; brown meat balls in shortening.
Drain.
Prepare sauce; pour over meat balls and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

title: Jalapeno Rice
steps: Mix rice with sour cream and green chilies.
In a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish, layer 1/2 of the rice mixture and 1/2 of the cheese.
Repeat, ending with cheese. Bake 30 minutes, covered, then remove lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Oven Roast
steps: Place roast in covered casserole dish.
Mix soups together. Pour over roast.
Cover.
Bake at 250° for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Easy Company Stew

ingredients.name: beef in
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. boneless beef, cut in 2-inch cubes

ingredients.name: stuffed olive in half
ingredients.raw: 1 (4 oz.) bottle stuffed olives, cut in half

steps: Put all ingredients in saucepan.
Cover; simmer for 2 hours, or until beef is very tender.
Do not season until ready to serve, as olive juice may make it salty enough.
Serve on rice.
Serves 4 or 5.

title: Grilled Fish
steps: Place fish on tin foil.
Splash with wine.
Place lemon slices and dill on top of fish.
Wrap fish in foil tightly.
Grill on medium coals for 20 minutes or until fish flakes.
This is very low cal and a great way to do any kind of fish.

title: Edible Play Dough
steps: When cutting cheese cake, use a dental floss instead of a knife.
Works real well!

title: Fruit Basket Upset

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.raw: 1 small apple, cut into small pieces

steps: Mix fruit and marshmallows with whipped topping.
Chill and serve.

title: How To Cook A Christmas Turkey
steps: Cook 18 minutes in oven.
Serve with pretzel salad.
Put pretzel salad in oven for 19 minutes, then take out.

title: Balloon Wine
steps: Mix yeast well with warm water.
Pour juices into a gallon jug.
Add yeast and sugar.
Place a large balloon over jug. Secure with a rubber band.
Balloon will get large.
Wine will be ready in 21 days.

title: Becky'S Squash Casserole
steps: Melt together cheese, chilies, onion, soup and eggs.
Pour over squash.
Cover with cracker crumbs and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Lunar Frosting
steps: Mix together and add a few drops of milk if needed for consistency.
May double the recipe if you want more frosting. Cool cake for about 1 hour before frosting.

title: Cherry-Blossom Bread
steps: Drain and chop cherries, reserving juices. Add enough water to reserved juice to measure 1 cup. Combine butter, sugar and egg in bowl.
Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with cherry liquid, mixing well after each addition. Stir in nuts and cherries.
Spoon into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° until loaf tests done.

title: Crabmeat Pizza Spread
steps: Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, onion, lemon juice and garlic salt.
Spread on shallow platter.
Cover with chili sauce and then a layer of crabmeat.
Top with parsley flakes.
Chill for several hours or overnight.
Serve with crackers.

title: Vi'S Holiday Punch
steps: Add ginger ale when ready to use.
Makes 30 cups.

title: Butternut Squash Soup

ingredients.name: butternut squash and up
ingredients.raw: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled and cut up

steps: Combine all ingredients (except milk) and bring to a good boil.
Lower to medium heat.
When squash is tender, put any remaining chunks through blender.
Stir in milk.
Cooking time is about 1 hour.

title: Potato Sausage Soup

ingredients.name: tube sage sausage quarter
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) tube sage sausage, cut into quarters

ingredients.name: tube smoked sausage quarter
ingredients.raw: 1 (1 lb.) tube smoked sausage, cut into quarters

ingredients.name: potato in
ingredients.raw: 4 potatoes, diced in 1/2-inch squares (do not peel)

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. cream (enough to cover all ingredients)

steps: Fry sausage; drain.
Pat dry.
Boil potatoes and drain. Combine sausage, potatoes, cream and butter in pot with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to slow boil.
About 3 minutes before serving, add celery and carrots, finely diced.
(If you prefer your vegetables soft, cook ahead and add.)

title: Strawberry Soda
steps: First wash the strawberries and slice them into small pieces. Then put in blender with milk at high speed for 15 seconds.
Next, pour it into a cup, then add ice cream and soda.
Finally, drink!

title: Cherry-Pineapple Salad
steps: Mix together with spoon.
Refrigerate.
Can be served on lettuce.

title: "Not At Home Stew"
steps: Into a very large casserole, put layers of boneless stew meat, cut up potatoes, onions, celery, seasonings and 1/3 cup of instant tapioca.
Add enough tomato sauce to cover.
Put on lid.
Bake at 300° for 4 to 6 hours.
Makes a rich, thick and brown gravy!

title: Cheese Sausage Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350°. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Mashed Tatoes
steps: Put the tatoes in the stove, put 'em in a bowl.
Smash the milk and water and butter with the tatoes.

title: Bran-Flake Chicken
steps: In paper or plastic bag, combine bran flakes, sunflower seeds and seasoned salt.
Blend melted butter, lemon juice and salt. Brush chicken breasts with mixture, then shake, one at a time; coat lightly.
(Reserve remaining lemon-butter.)
Place chicken, skin side up, in ungreased, large shallow baking pan.
Bake in 375° oven for 40 minutes.
Do not turn.

title: Chili-Mac

ingredients.name: mexican style chili bean
ingredients.raw: 1 large can Mexican style chili beans (I use 2 medium size cans)

ingredients.name: chili pepper
ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. chili pepper (I use only 1 Tbsp. or less)

ingredients.name: chili sauce
ingredients.raw: chili sauce to taste (1/3 to 1/2 bottle)

ingredients.name: salt pepper and garlic powder
ingredients.raw: salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste

steps: Brown meat and onion in skillet.
Drain off grease.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and chili pepper.
Add tomato soup, beans and tomatoes.
Simmer.
Cook macaroni and add to meat mixture.
Simmer a while longer to heat through.
This makes quite a large amount.

title: Shrimp And Artichoke Dip

ingredients.name: artichoke heart in water
ingredients.raw: 3 (8 oz.) cans quartered artichoke hearts in water

steps: Mix all ingredients until well-blended.
Place into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes until dip begins to brown around edges.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Grape Cobbler
steps: Place grape juice in an 8 x 8-inch Corning Ware bowl and stir in 3/4 cup sugar.
In separate bowl, cut margarine into other cup of sugar and the flour until smooth.
Then spread evenly over grape juice.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown crust is formed.

title: Christmas Eve Pecans
steps: Beat egg white until foamy.
Add pecans and stir until coated, set aside.
Combine sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Stir gently onto pecans until coated.
Spread pecans in lightly greased pan.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
Stir every 10 minutes.

title: Fried Peppers In Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: bell pepper
ingredients.raw: 12 to 15 large, sweet peppers (some red, if available)

steps: Wash and dry peppers; cut in halves lengthwise and remove seeds.
Cut each half into 3 or 4 strips.
Spray heavy pan with Pam.
Add cooking oil and heat until very hot.
Drop in pepper strips.
Reduce heat to medium.
Stir constantly to prevent burning.
Cook until peppers are tender, not mushy.
Add tomato sauce and other ingredients.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with beans or other vegetables.
This can be canned to use throughout the year.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Slice up the apples into one-inch sections. Take a pie crust and layer in ingredients like so: layer of apples to line the bottom of the crust, sprinkle cinnamon, brown sugar and pudding mix on apples. Place pats of butter on top of the entire mixture. Follow this procedure until the pie crust is full (it should be like a sandpile, a mound).

title: Ras-Lem Swizzle

ingredients.name: raspberry
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. fresh raspberries or 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen raspberries

steps: Wash and drain fresh raspberries; put them in a saucepan with the 1 cup water.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
(If using frozen berries, no cooking is necessary, just thaw before using.)
Puree berries in electric blender and press through sieve to remove seeds.
Dissolve honey in warm water; add lemon juice, carbonated water and ice to chill.
Serve in individual glasses with ice and generous slice of lemon.
Yield: Serves 12.

title: Orange Smoothie
steps: Combine ingredients in blender.
Cover and run on high until smooth and well blended.
Makes 2 (12 ounce) servings.

title: Best Quick Salad
steps: Cook peas; drain and cool.
Chop tomatoes, onion and celery. Add together.
In shaker, mix oil, vinegar and sugar; shake.
Pour over and mix.
Cool.
Pretty, colorful and kids love it.

title: Mock Turkey Casserole
steps: Brown meat in a little butter.
Mix with remaining ingredients and blend thoroughly.
Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Serves 15 to 20.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
steps: Sift all ingredients together.
Store in tightly covered container(s).
Makes a large amount.
Use 1/4 to 1/2 cup of chocolate mixture with boiling water to make a big cup of hot chocolate.

title: Jalapeno Jelly

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 jalapeno pepper (more if you like it hotter)

steps: Seed peppers and chop fine.
Mix peppers, sugar and vinegar. Boil 1 minute.
Cool 5 minutes.
Add Certo and stir.
Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Bean Onion Salad
steps: Drain beans; add celery and onion.
Combine rest of ingredients and mix with beans.
Let stand for several hours before serving.
Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Zucchini Souffle
steps: Beat eggs, add Bisquick, cheese, oil, garlic powder, salt & pepper.
Add zucchini.
Bake 325° for 30-40 mins. in greased 8 inch square pan.

title: Molasses Popcorn Balls
steps: "I have come to Thee to take Thy touch before I begin my day. Let Thy eyes rest upon my eyes for awhile.
Let me take to my work the assurance of Thy friendship.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish

ingredients.name: potato tot
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. Tater Tots (or you can use frozen corn)

steps: Fry ground beef; drain.
Season and put in casserole with the green beans and mushroom soup and cover with Tater Tots.
Bake at 350°.
Serves 8.

title: Brandy'S Favorite Icebox Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, which have been beaten. Blend thoroughly.
Add pecans to flour and mix well.
Mix flour and butter.
Knead dough until smooth.
Form dough into rolls. Wrap in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight.
Slice thin and bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350° until done.

title: Quick Lemon Sherbet
steps: Combine water and sugar; bring to a full boil.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in lemonade; cool to lukewarm.
Pour into refrigerator tray to freeze.
During the first hour of freezing, stir vigorously 2 or 3 times to ensure smooth and fine grain.

title: Cherry Cheesecakes
steps: Beat mixture until fluffy.
Place a vanilla wafer in the bottom of a cupcake liner.
Fill 2/3 full of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 375° for about 15 to 20 minutes until mixture is set. Let cool.
Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Juicy Spaghetti Goulash
steps: Saut onions in butter; add beef. Cook until brown. Drain. Add tomato soup and 1/3 cup
water. Add sugar. Cook until hot. Add cooked noodles. Serve with bread and butter.

title: Mushroom-Stuffed Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: chicken breast skinned boned and
ingredients.raw: 4 chicken breasts, skinned, boned and halved

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°.
Melt 1/4 pound of the butter in a skillet.
Add the mushrooms, salt and pepper and cook, stirring often, until the mushrooms turn very
dark and absorb all the butter.
Remove from the heat and stir in 3/4 cup of the breadcrumbs and the nutmeg.
Divide the mushroom stuffing into 8 portions and place a portion in the center of each piece of chicken.
Fold the chicken around the stuffing and place, seam side down, in a shallow casserole.
Melt the remaining 4 tablespoons butter and brush over the chicken.
Sprinkle with the remaining 3/4 cup of breadcrumbs.
Pour on the cream and bake for 30 minutes until lightly browned.
Serves four to six.

title: Stuffed Wieners
steps: Split wieners in half lengthwise and put in a pan or on a cookie sheet.
Pile mashed potatoes on top.
Sprinkle grated cheese and paprika on top of potatoes.
Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Atlanta Baked Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken mushroom
ingredients.raw: 2 cans chicken, mushroom or celery soup

steps: Mix together soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken.
Put crushed Ritz crackers on top.
Pour melted butter over.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Caramel Puffed Crispies
steps: Place puffed rice into a very large bowl and set aside.
Boil brown sugar, butter and syrup for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir in condensed milk.
Boil an additional 3 minutes, stirring. Pour over puffed rice.
Stir well.
Pour into greased molds, greased pans or form into balls.
Let cool 1 hour.

title: Berry Pie

ingredients.name: berry
ingredients.raw: 5 to 5 1/2 c. fresh berries (more if needed)

steps: Bake pie shell.
Mash enough berries to measure 1 cup.
Stir together sugar and cornstarch.
Gradually stir in water and crushed berries.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Cool.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream Pie

ingredients.name: jell o chocolate instant pudding
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 serving size) pkg. Jell-O chocolate instant pudding

steps: Thoroughly mix milk and ice cream in bowl.
Add pie filling mix.
Beat slowly with hand beater or at low speed of mixer until blended.
Top with Cool Whip.

title: Flowerpot Dessert(Also Called Dirt)

ingredients.name: cream cheese room temperature
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, room temperature

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.raw: 3 Tbsp. butter or margarine, room temperature (optional)

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding and pie filling
ingredients.raw: 2 (3.4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling

ingredients.name: container non dairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz.) containers non-dairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: In a food processor or blender process cookies.
Do batches until they resemble fine crumbs (or dirt).
Set aside.

title: Cornbread Stuffing
steps: In skillet, cook the bacon until crisp. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Crumble bacon, reserving the onion and water. Cover. Cook until barely tender, about 7 minutes.
Combine reserved bacon drippings, vegetable mixture, cornbread crumbs, fine cornbread crumbs, ground sage and broth. Toss well. Bake, covered, in a 1 1/2-quart casserole at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 8 servings or enough stuffing for an 8 pound turkey.

title: Baked Corn Pudding
steps: Butter a casserole dish.
Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, then pour into baking dish and smooth over on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until crusty on top and a knife will come out clean.
Let cool a little before serving.

title: Herb Sauce For Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients except chicken.
Simmer for a few minutes. Arrange cut up pieces of skinned chicken in baking dish.
Spoon sauce over chicken.
Broil until golden brown.

title: French Fried Potato Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients in order given.
Drop from tablespoon into 375° deep fat.
When brown, drain on brown paper.
Serve hot.

title: Easy Peanut Butter And Chocolate Squares

ingredients.name: butter plu tbsp. butter
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. butter, melted plus 3 Tbsp. butter

ingredients.name: semi sweet chocolate chip
ingredients.raw: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. (2 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps: In large bowl, combine powdered sugar, peanut butter, graham cracker crumbs and 3/4 cup melted butter.
Stir until well blended.
Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips and peanuts.
Press into foil lined 9-inch square pan.
Set aside.

title: Frozen Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
steps: Mix pumpkin, sugar and spices.
Stir in sherry and stir in Cool Whip.
Spread 1/4-inch thick layer of ice cream on pie crust.
Add pumpkin mixture.
Freeze.

title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford #1
steps: Mix butter, flour and pecans until combined; pat in oblong baking dish (9 x 13-inch or close).
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Let cool.
Mix with beater the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust.
Whip together the milk and pudding; spread on cream cheese mixture.
Spread small container of chocolate Cool Whip over pudding mixture.
Refrigerate 2 hours, then serve.

title: Veggie Pizza(Vegetable Bars)

ingredients.name: dry hidden valley ranch dressing
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing

ingredients.name: each green pepper broccoli cauliflower and tomato fine
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. each green pepper, broccoli, cauliflower and tomato, chopped fine

steps: Roll or pat rolls to fit an 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.
Bake according to package directions. Cool.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing.
Spread on top of cooled, baked rolls. Sprinkle veggies on top, one at a time. Press gently into cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top. Chill before serving.

title: Ham And Cabbage
steps: Cut ham in small pieces and put in a large pot 1/4 to 1/2 full of water.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Boil about 1/2 hour. Cut cabbage heads into quarters and put into the pot.
Cover pot and boil with potatoes until potatoes are done.
Serve hot.

title: Marshmallow Krispie Wreaths

ingredients.name: marshmallow
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. marshmallows (32 count) or 3 c. miniature marshmallows

steps: Melt butter in 3 quart saucepan; add marshmallows and cook over low heat until melted, stirring constantly.
Add food coloring until green.
Remove from heat and stir in Rice Krispies, nuts and cherries.
Shape into two wreaths while still warm on greased wax paper.
Decorate with cherries (sliced in quarters like flower pedals) or colored jimmies.
Slice when serving.

title: Cheese Biscuits(Serving Size: 36)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon into greased muffin pan or on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Wacky Lenten Cake
steps: To the flour, add the sugar, baking soda, salt and cocoa.
Sift together 3 times, then place mixture in a small, greased 8-inch square pan.
Make 3 dents in the top of the mixture.
In the first dent, place 1 teaspoon vinegar; in the second dent, place 1 teaspoon vanilla; in the third dent, place 5 tablespoons melted shortening.
Put 1 cup of cold water over this and mix well.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 35 minutes.
Recipe may be doubled and baked in tube pan.
Bake longer than before.
A good moist cake. Delicious with sprinkled powdered sugar or topped with Cool Whip.

title: Rosa'S Beef Shoulder Roast
steps: Place roast in roaster or heavy Dutch oven.
Add tenderizer to both sides of meat.
Dice onion and sprinkle on top.
Place several small pats of margarine around top of meat.
Tenderize meat with a fork and add lemon juice and vinegar slowly over meat. Cook in preheated oven at 375° for 2 hours.

title: Mom'S Pie Dough
steps: Blend together flour, salt and shortening until well blended. Add vinegar to beaten egg and ice water.
Add to dough.
Blend together well.

title: Perfect Dressing
steps: Mix all together.
Good for any salad, especially slaw.

title: Peanut Butter Balls(Fun For Kids To Make And Eat)
steps: Stir together peanut butter and margarine.
Gradually add sugar, stirring until combined.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place on waxed paper.
Let stand until dry (about 20 minutes).
Melt confectioners coating.
Cool slightly.
Dip balls into melted coating; let excess drip off.
Place on waxed paper.
Let stand until coating is dry.
Makes about 30 pieces.
(Before dipping candy, chop the coating and melt it in a heavy saucepan over low heat.)

title: Texas Eggs

ingredients.name: cream of chicken
ingredients.raw: 1 can cream of chicken or shrimp soup (undiluted)

steps: Blend and heat the soup, cheese and sherry.
Soft scramble 1 dozen eggs; combine with other ingredients.
Put in an ovenproof casserole.
Refrigerate overnight.
To reheat, put in 300° oven for 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.

title: Glazed Fruit Centerpiece
steps: Can use any other fruit in season.
The amount of fruit depends on size of dish.

title: Hot Fudge Pie
steps: Melt butter and combine with cocoa.
Combine eggs, sugar, vanilla and add cocoa mixture.
Add flour and pecans.
Pour in 9-inch greased pie pan and bake in preheated 325° oven for 25 minutes.
Serve hot with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Fluffy Orange Salad

ingredients.name: neufchatel cheese spread with pimiento
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) jar Neufchatel cheese spread with pimiento

ingredients.name: mandarin orange section
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained

steps: Beat together cream cheese and cheese spread.
Drain and cut up peaches, reserving 1/4 cup syrup.
Beat reserved syrup into cheese.
Fold in fruits, marshmallows and whipped cream.
Fold into fruit mixture.
Chill 5 to 6 hours or overnight.

title: Great Pickles

ingredients.name: dill pickle
ingredients.raw: 1 qt. dill pickles (pour off juice, do not use)

steps: Slice pickles (or use hamburger slices).
Drain well.
Put other ingredients over sliced pickles.
Shake well.
Let set for 24 hours.
Very good!

title: Italian Slush
steps: Mix all ingredients in bowl and freeze.
Scoop out into glasses as wanted and add any kind of soda.

title: Sweet Potato Bonbons
steps: Beat sweet potatoes and add 1/4 cup butter, brown sugar, salt and grated orange rind.
Let cool if using fresh potatoes.
Divide into individual servings.
Press potato mixture around 1/2 marshmallow.
Shape into ovals.
Coat each with melted butter. Roll in crushed corn flakes.
Top with pecan half and place on greased cookie sheet.
Nice to freeze ahead.
Bake at 450° for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Harvest Popcorn
steps: Pop the corn.
Mix seasonings and oleo.
Pour mixture over popcorn, shoestrings and nuts.
Put in large pan.
Bake at 250°, stirring every few minutes.
I think about 15 to 20 minutes.
Just watch closely.

title: Quick Butterscotch Frosting
steps: Combine brown sugar, shortening, oleo and salt in saucepan and bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Add milk and cook over low heat 3 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Add powdered sugar and beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Crab Au Gratin
steps: Mix flour, salt and pepper with part of the milk.
Beat all the lumps out.
Add remaining milk and 1 cup cheese (reserve 1/3 cup for topping).
Cook in double boiler until smooth.
Add Tabasco and crab meat.
Pour into casserole.
Top with remaining cheese and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Butterfinger Cookies

ingredients.name: butterfinger chip coarsely
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Butterfinger chips, coarsely chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, beat sugar and margarine until creamy.
Beat in egg.
Blend in flour.
Stir in chopped Butterfinger chips.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 11 to 13 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned.
Remove from cookie sheet after 2 minutes.
Makes about 30 cookies.

title: Pig Licking Cake

ingredients.name: duncan hine cake mix
ingredients.raw: 1 box Duncan Hines cake mix (butter golden)

steps: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Use 2 round cake pans.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Broiler Halves
steps: Beat the eggs, then add the oil and beat again.
Add the other ingredients and stir.

title: Craft Family Trifle
steps: Make jello according to directions on box and allow to cool until not quite firm.
Place layer of ladyfingers on bottom of deep glass bowl and slightly up the side.
Layer strawberries on top of ladyfingers.
Pour cooled jello over strawberries and refrigerate until firm.
Make pudding according to directions on box and cool completely (stir occasionally while cooling).
Pour pudding on top of jello.
Refrigerate at least two hours before topping with whipped cream.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Decorate with colored sprinkles, if desired.

title: Ham Tortillas With Picante Mayonnaise
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a cup, combine mayonnaise and picante sauce.
Spread 1/2 mixture evenly over each tortilla.
Top each with two slices of ham.
Spread remaining sauce evenly over the ham.
Pile the lettuce and tomato evenly on the sauce.
Fold and bake for 5 minutes or until sauce bubbles.
Cool for 1 minute. Serves 2.

title: Cheesy Oven Fried Potatoes
steps: Wash potatoes; leave skins on.
Cut each potato into 8 wedges; set aside.
Combine cheese, salt, garlic powder and paprika; stir well.
Dip potato wedges into melted butter and arrange in a single layer in lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle cheese mixture over potatoes.
Bake in 375° oven, uncovered, until potatoes are tender and brown, about 40 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Icebox Rolls(Yields 12 Rolls)
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/8 cup lukewarm water with 1 teaspoon sugar.
To scalded milk, add 1/4 cup sugar and shortening.
Let stand until warm.
Stir in yeast.
Add egg and salt; beat well. Stir in enough flour to make a fairly stiff dough, about 2 3/4 cups.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
(May be refrigerated overnight.)
Spoon into greased muffin tins and let rise in warm place until double in size.
Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Scotch Fudge(Easy And Tasty)
steps: Combine butterscotch bits and peanut butter in top of double boiler.
Place over hot, not boiling, water; stir till butterscotch melts.
Add milk, stir until well blended.
Pour into foil lined 8 x 8 square pan. Chill till firm, cut in 1 inch squares.
Store in covered container.

title: Apple Delight(Serves 1)
steps: Combine apple, cinnamon and diet sweetener.
Bake at 325° until tender.
Serve over toasted bread.

title: Candles
steps: Place one pineapple ring on a lettuce leaf.
Stand in hole 1/2 of a banana.
Place piece of red cherry on top for flame.

title: Excellent Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: celery seed
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. celery seed (you can substitute 1/2 tsp. celery salt or poppy seed)

steps: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
You can add or reduce sugar to your liking.

title: Blue Carrot Salad
steps: Combine Blue cheese, cream and salt to taste.
Add the oil until creamy.

title: Kitty'S Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Mix all ingredients well.
Roll into ball.
Roll in chopped pecans.
Wrap in plastic wrap or foil and refrigerate.
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Roll-Ups
steps: Dice up corned beef and beat into cream cheese.
Add diced pickles and spread on small rye bread.
Roll up and cut into half.

title: Chicken With Wild Rice

ingredients.name: uncle ben s original wild rice
ingredients.raw: 2 boxes Uncle Ben's original wild rice (reserving seasoning packets)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put bacon in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with rice from both boxes, reserving seasoning packets.
Place chicken breasts on rice. Mix soup and water.
Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with reserved seasoning packets.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 8.

title: Grandma'S Dumplings
steps: Mix with fork.
Drop by tablespoon in boiling liquid.
Cook until done.

title: Chateau Potatoes
steps: Combine potatoes, cottage cheese, sour cream, onions, salt and pepper in mixer until smooth.
Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole. Cover top with melted butter and almonds, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

title: Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.name: ground ginger
ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 tsp. ground ginger or 1 Tbsp. freshly ground ginger

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. garlic powder or 2-3 cloves garlic, crushed

steps: In a disposable plastic bag, combine soy sauce, sugar, vegetable oil, ginger, garlic powder, black pepper.
Mix until sugar is dissolved.
Wash and cut chicken wings and add to the soy sauce marinade.
Marinate for at least 1 hour or longer.
Place chicken wings on cookie sheet.
Discard marinade.
Bake at 400° for 35-40 minutes.

title: Pudding Tortoni

ingredients.name: vanilla
ingredients.raw: 1 small pkg. vanilla or coconut pudding (not instant)

ingredients.name: toasted coconut and/or ground nut
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. toasted coconut and/or ground nuts

steps: Combine pudding mix, milk and sugar in saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil.
Remove from heat, cover with waxed paper and chill.
Then beat pudding; add extract. Whip cream and fold into pudding.
Pour into paper cups or muffin tins.
Sprinkle with toasted coconut and top with maraschino cherries.
Freeze until firm and eat directly from freezer. Serves 12.

title: Tomato And Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: tomato in
ingredients.raw: 4 large ripe tomatoes, cut in wedges

ingredients.name: basil leaf in
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. basil leaves, cut in strips

steps: Cook pasta.
Add remaining ingredients and stir.

title: Quick Vegetable And Beef

ingredients.name: campbell s chunky old fashioned vegetable beef soup
ingredients.raw: 1 can (19 oz.) Campbell's chunky old fashioned vegetable beef soup

steps: In saucepan over medium heat, heat oil.
Add broccoli and cook until tender-crisp.
Add soup, Worcestershire sauce and rice. Heat through.

title: Oven Omelet

ingredients.name: or egg
ingredients.raw: 6 or 8 eggs (even more can be used)

steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered 9 or 12-inch pan, depending on how many eggs are being used.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Luke'S Fruit Salad(Shoney'S)

ingredients.name: clean red grape
ingredients.raw: 32 oz. clean red grapes (Use two 16 oz. to go cups)

steps: Step 1:
Drain the grapefruit segments through the colander. Discard the liquid and place the fruit in a large Lexan pan.

title: Fudge Ball Cookies

ingredients.name: plu tbsp. margarine
ingredients.raw: 1/2 c. plus 1 Tbsp. margarine or butter

steps: Melt margarine and cocoa in pan over low heat.
Remove from heat and cool.
Add sugar, egg, salt and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in flour.
Dough will be stiff.
Shape into balls (use 1 teaspoon dough for each ball).
Bake at 375° for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Pink Salad(Dessert)

ingredients.name: container yogurt cottage cheese
ingredients.raw: 1 large container large curd cottage cheese

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and chill for 3 to 4 hours or until set.

title: Tangy Green Coleslaw
steps: Grate cabbage, cut into thin strips or chop finely.
In a large bowl, combine cabbage, dill and parsley. Blend together the sour cream and lemon juice.
Pour over cabbage.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Mix well. Serves 3.
Preparation time:
15 minutes.

title: Homemade Chocolate Pie
steps: In a saucepan, mix sugar, flour, cocoa (sift flour and cocoa first) and egg yolks and mix thoroughly.
Add milk.
Cook over medium heat until thick.
Stir constantly.
Take mixture off heat and add vanilla and butter.
Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Fried Eggplant Or Zucchini
steps: Slice eggplant or zucchini into 1/4-inch slices.
Dip in egg mixture and then in bread crumbs.
Fry in oil in skillet until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.
Serve immediately.

title: Mock Enchilada
steps: Brown beef in hot fat.	Add
onion and cook until soft. Mix in salt, pepper and chili.
Place alternate layers of corn chips, chili mixture and cheese in a greased casserole, ending with corn chips.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Dutch Red Cabbage
steps: Saute the cabbage in the margarine 5 minutes.
Add brown sugar, onion and apples.
Cook another 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients; cover and simmer slowly for about 20 minutes.

title: Hopping John
steps: Dice bacon.
Add onion and fry until bacon is crisp.
Add peas and rice, then water.
Cover and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes or until rice is tender.
(I always add a good sized shake or two of Louisiana hot sauce, not Tabasco sauce; there is a difference.)
Yields 10 servings.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow out tomatoes and place in a greased baking dish.
Next, saute peppers and onion along with the insides of one of the tomatoes until soft.
Add paprika, garlic, cocktail sauce and whole or diced shrimp.
Continue cooking until shrimp are done. Stuff tomatoes with mixture and top with cheese.
Preheat oven to 400° and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie(Makes 2)
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and syrup.
Break eggs one at a time. Beat; pour in pecans.
Put in uncooked pie crust.
Bake at 300° until done, about 20 minutes.

title: Surprise Salmon Cakes
steps: Drain liquid from salmon.
Into mixing bowl, add flaked salmon, slightly beaten eggs and remaining ingredients except cheese.
Mix. Shape into cakes around 1/4-inch cube of cheese.
Brown cakes in small amount of shortening.

title: Simply Pizza

ingredients.name: loaf french bread
ingredients.raw: 2 loaves French bread or 1 loaf regular white bread

ingredients.name: each favorite onion bell pepper ham mushroom and olive etc.
ingredients.raw: 1 c. each favorite toppings: sliced onions, sliced bell pepper, sliced ham, mushrooms and olives, etc.

steps: Cut French loaves into thirds lengthwise, making bread in approximately 1-inch to 1/2-inch thick.
Cut bread into desired slice size (thirds).
Preheat oven to 450°.
Put 1 to 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce on each slice, or as desired.
Place on toppings and pepperoni.
Put cheese on top of toppings.
Place on a cookie sheet.
Cook for 8 to 12 minutes, depending on desired doneness.

title: Sweet And Sour Asparagus
steps: Drain asparagus.
Combine rest of ingredients, except asparagus, and cook over medium heat for about 45 minutes. Remove cinnamon stick and cloves.
Pour the liquid over asparagus.
Cover and refrigerate immediately. Let marinate at least overnight.

title: Chunky Applesauce
steps: Melt marshmallows (I use up old marshmallows this way).
Peel and core 3 to 4 apples (any kind).
Cut into small chunks and add to melted marshmallow mixture.
Cook, stirring frequently until apple pieces soften and begin to get mushy.
Finished product will be very chunky.
If you have any cinnamon red hots or hearts, throw a handful and cook until candy melts.
Gives a pretty pink color and spicy taste.

title: Spanish Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes.
Cool and peel.
Cut into 1/2-inch thick round slices.
Combine remaining ingredients in a separate bowl.
Coat the bottom and sides of a shallow 2-inch baking dish with butter. Arrange a layer of sliced potatoes on the bottom and spread with mayonnaise combination.
Repeat and top with another layer of spread.
Bake in a 375° oven for about 15 minutes or until all cheese topping melts.
Cut into squares.
Serves 6.

title: Chipped Beef On Toast
steps: Rinse and cut dried, sliced beef into bite size pieces.
Set aside.
Prepare white sauce, as follows:
Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in flour; cook, stirring constantly, until paste cooks and bubbles a bit, but don't let it brown (about 2 minutes).
Add hot milk, continuing to stir as sauce thickens.
Bring to a boil.
May salt and pepper to taste.
Lower heat and stir in beef pieces. Pour over toast points.
Makes 4 servings.

title: Eggplant Deluxe
steps: Saute onion and green pepper in oil, then place all ingredients in layers in well-oiled (Pam) shallow baking dish (9-inch square or 9 x 13-inch), starting with eggplant.
Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Monkey Drop Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add molasses and hot water.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Drop by teaspoons and bake at 375° for approximately 8 minutes.

title: Millionaire Fruit Delight
steps: Mix sugar and sour cream together.
Add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.
Makes 10 servings.

title: Easy Southwestern Corn Chowder

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.raw: 1/2 lb. cooked ham, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

ingredients.name: kernel corn with green and red pepper
ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz.) can whole kernel corn with green and red pepper, drained

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan, combine ham, 2 cans corn and green chilies.
Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture just comes to a boil, 2 to 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream and milk.
Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3 to 4 minutes.
Serves 6. Easy and good.

title: Sweet Sour Chicken
steps: In a medium dish, put chicken, veggies and fruit all together. Pour honey and ginger on top.
Put lid on dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve over rice.

title: Onions Au Gratin
steps: Slice onions into 1/2-inch thick rings.
Saut in butter until tender.
Place in greased 8-inch square baking dish.
In a bowl, stir the broth, cream, flour and pepper until smooth.
Pour over onions.
Sprinkle with the cheeses.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown and mixture is bubbly.
Makes approximately 8 servings.

title: Spicy Potato Soup
steps: In kettle, brown beef. Drain.
Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Oven Fries(From Weight Watchers)
steps: Cut potatoes lengthwise into slices.
Mix with olive oil; sprinkle with seasonings.
Shake in large storage bag.
Place on nonstick baking pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 450° or until done.

title: Orange Coconut (Or Pecan) Balls

ingredients.name: orange juice concentrate
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate

steps: Crush vanilla wafers very fine and set aside. Using mixer, cream orange juice, sugar and butter. Add crushed vanilla wafers and pecans.
Shape mixture into bite-size balls and roll in coconut or pecans.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Yield: 5 to 7 dozen.

title: Robbie'S Vanilla Nut Roll
steps: Mix together well.
Divide into sections and roll out logs or press into square pan.
Roll logs in powdered sugar.
Chill and slice.

title: Ultimate Salad Dressing
steps: Puree onion and white wine vinegar in blender.
Mix in honey and Tabasco.
Add oil very slowly.
Serve over salad greens.

title: Authentic Swedish Meat Balls(Great For Parties)

ingredients.name: stale bread soaked in milk
ingredients.raw: 2 slices stale bread, soaked in milk

steps: Mix ingredients thoroughly together.
Keeping fingers moist by dipping fingers in bowl of cold water, roll mixture in tiny round balls.
Fry in butter over a low flame for 15 to 20 minutes.
Keep turning meat balls while cooking.
Yields 6 servings.

title: Gratin Of Potatoes With Boursin

ingredients.name: boursin cheese with herb
ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz.) bag Boursin cheese with herbs

ingredients.name: baking potato and
ingredients.raw: 4 lb. baking potatoes, peeled and cut 1/8-inch thick

steps: Combine cream and Boursin in a large heavy saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth.
Remove from heat. Arrange potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish, overlapping edges. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour cheese mixture over potatoes, covering them completely.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
steps: Add all ingredients; mix well.
Stir in zucchini and pineapple.
Spoon batter into loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
Cool 10 minutes in pan.
Turn out onto rack and cool.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Squares
steps: Melt margarine, then add 1 3/4 cups graham cracker crumbs, then powdered sugar and the peanut butter.
Mix well.
Pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place in refrigerator to cool while preparing chocolate.

title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients with beater.
Top with almonds and paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Boneless Chicken Casserole

ingredients.name: chicken breast deboned and
ingredients.raw: 2 chicken breasts, deboned and cut into pieces

steps: In a 13 x 9-inch pan, line with chicken pieces.
Place 1 layer of Swiss cheese.
Spoon cream of chicken soup over cheese. Sprinkle stuffing mix over soup layer.
Melt margarine and pour over bread crumbs.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Family favorite and quick.

title: B~B~Q Beans
steps: Brown sausage; pour off grease.
Set sausage aside in a bowl. Brown bacon lightly.
Add sausage, bell pepper, onion and brown sugar.
Let cook about 8 minutes.
Add beans and barbecue sauce. Let cook until it starts to thicken.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Penuche(Microwave)
steps: Blend together sugar, milk, butter, corn syrup and salt in a 3-quart casserole.
Microwave 5 minutes on High; stir well. Microwave 6 minutes on High.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Spread in buttered pan and cool until firm.

title: Amaretto Trifle

ingredients.name: nondairy whipped thawed
ingredients.raw: 8 oz. frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed

steps: Mix water and Amaretto and set aside.
Place 1 package sponge cookies on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.
Cover with 1/2 Amaretto mixture.
Make vanilla pudding; let cool.
Pour over sponge cookies.
Repeat sponge and Amaretto mixture; press down firmly.
Make chocolate pudding.
Cool 5 minutes.
Pour over sponge.

title: Cheese Fudge
steps: In large saucepan, melt cheese, butter and vanilla on low heat.
Sift dry ingredients.
Blend cocoa and powdered sugar; add nuts.
Put in large pan.

title: Broiled Salmon In Herb Sauce
steps: Combine butter, spices and chopped garlic and heat slowly until butter is melted.
Let stand for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle fillets with salt and place on greased broiler pan.
Brush with butter sauce.
Broil 3 inches from heat source 4 to 6 minutes on each side, basting several times.

title: Company For Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: ortega green chile
ingredients.raw: 1 (7 oz.) can Ortega whole green chiles

steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan, lay out chiles that have been split open. Sprinkle grated cheese over chiles.
Combine the remaining ingredients in a separate bowl and blend well.
Pour over cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Kahlua Cake
steps: Mix together all above ingredients except chocolate chips on medium for a couple minutes.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Bake in greased and floured Bundt or angel food pan for 45 to 55 minutes. Let cool 20 minutes, then remove from pan.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Yum!

title: Unfried Catfish
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°.
Spray vegetable oil over baking sheet 3 times to coat.
Put the cornmeal, thyme and basil on a large plate and mix well.
Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon of garlic powder, 1/8 teaspoon lemon pepper and 1 teaspoon of blackening seasoning on each of the catfish fillets.
Coat the fillets thoroughly with the cornmeal mixture and transfer them to the prepared baking sheet.
Dust each fillet with 1/8 teaspoon of the paprika.
Coat the catfish lightly with the cooking spray.

title: Brownies(Fudgy)

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.raw: 3/4 c. all-purpose flour (use cake flour if you want chewy)

steps: Melt butter and chocolate over very low heat.
Remove from heat; stir in sugar.
Blend in eggs one at a time.
Add vanilla. Stir in flour, baking powder and nuts.
Mix well.
Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yield:
16 squares.
(Do not overbake.)

title: Turkey Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour combined ingredients into 2 (9-inch) pie shells.
Sprinkle real bacon bits over pies and bake 35 minutes.
Allow to cool 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Clam Sauce And Pasta

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.raw: 1 clove garlic or 1/4 tsp. minced garlic

steps: Mix together; bring to boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over Creamettes vermicelli.
Low sodium, low fat and low cholesterol; 5 ounces sauce contains 125 calories, 2 ounces pasta contains 210 calories.

title: Low-Fat Freezer Slaw
steps: Sprinkle cabbage with salt; let stand an hour.
Boil sugar, vinegar and water for a minute; let cool.
Mix ingredients. Freeze if you don't wish to use until later.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Wings(Angelica'S Favorite)

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. chopped, fresh ginger or 1/2 tsp. ground

steps: Mix all ingredients except chicken wings.
Pour over wings. Bake 20 to 30 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Cinnamon Snowballs
steps: Stir together flour, cinnamon and corn flakes.
In large bowl, beat margarine and sugar until well combined.
Stir in vanilla. Add crumb mixture and nuts.
Mix well.
Shape dough in 3/4-inch balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from pan and while still warm, roll in powdered sugar.
Cool.
Roll again in powdered sugar.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad

ingredients.name: salt and black pepper
ingredients.raw: salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Crumble broccoli and cauliflower into very small pieces.
Chop bell pepper very small.
Mix all vegetables and cheese in salad bowl.

title: Company French Toast
steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add brown sugar and cinnamon.
Spread evenly on bottom of pan.
Cover with 2 layers of bread slices (could use 6 slices of thick cut bread, French or homemade).

title: Ruth'S Cheese Biscuits
steps: Cream the cheese, butter and Tabasco sauce together. Add flour and chill.
Roll out and cut in shapes, placing pecan dipped in egg white on each shape. Bake in hot oven at 400° for 10 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar when cold. Makes 60 plus (medium size shapes).

title: Fried Cornbread Cakes
steps: Mix above ingredients.
Stir in enough water to make dough thick.
Roll into ball with wet hands; flatten.
Fry in grease until golden brown; turn over and fry other side.

title: Austrian Stuffed Pancakes
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Beat egg yolks with sugar until creamy.
Blend flour and salt with cream.
Add to egg yolks.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake pancakes 4 to 5 inches in diameter. Immediately spread filling on and roll with asparagus or other vegetables.
Top with grated cheese and put in oven until cheese melts.
Serve.
Delicious!

title: Hot And Sweet Mustard
steps: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler.
Cook over low heat, whisking constantly until thickened, about 10 minutes.
Cool and pour into container.
Store in refrigerator.
Yields approximately 2 cups.

title: Sour Cream Potato Salad

ingredients.name: green onion with little of green top
ingredients.raw: 1/3 c. green onions, chopped with little of green tops

ingredients.name: salt and celery seed
ingredients.raw: salt and celery seed, to taste

steps: Peel and slice potatoes while warm.
Add dressing and chill. After chilling, add remaining ingredients.
Store in refrigerator until serving.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken Casserole
steps: Place in crock-pot in the order given, mixing seasonings with vegetables and putting chicken on top.
Chop the tomatoes and pour over all.
Sprinkle additional salt, garlic powder and oregano on top.
Cook on low for at least 5 hours.
Good meal for a busy day. Serves 6.

title: Mystery Pie
steps: Mix crackers, sugar and pecans together.
Beat egg whites and add to cracker mixture.
Add vanilla and pour in a greased pie shell.
Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Biscochitoes
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar.
Beat the eggs and add to Crisco and sugar.
Add anise seed, baking powder and water, stirring well. Add flour slowly, mixing real good.
Roll out on floured surface and cut with cookie cutters, about 1/4-inch thick.
You can sprinkle with candy crystals (optional).
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Let cool for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Crescent Nuggets
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly brown sausage and drain.
While sausage is still hot, add cream cheese. Stir until cheese is melted and mixture is creamy.
Separate crescent dough into 2 rectangles.
Form log of sausage mixture lengthwise down center of each rectangle.
Fold over the long sides of pastry to cover sausage log.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet, seam side down. Brush with egg whites.
Sprinkle with poppy seed.
Bake 20 minutes until crust is golden. When completely cooled, slice into 1 1/2-inch rounds.

title: Breakfast Omelet
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place bread in pan.
Fry bacon crisp and break in small pieces.
Mix bacon and rest of ingredients. Pour over bread and cover with foil.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake next day in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Supreme
steps: Cake can
be
made
and frozen up to two weeks ahead of time. Remove from
x
13-inch pan before freezing.
Put in garbage bag.

title: Bauernfruhstuck(Farmer'S Breakfast)

ingredients.name: ham in
ingredients.raw: 1 c. cooked ham, in small cubes

steps: Boil unpeeled potatoes 30 minutes.
Rinse under cold water. Peel and set aside to cool.
Slice potatoes.
In a large frypan cook bacon until transparent.
Add the potato slices.
Cook until lightly browned.

title: Quick Fudge Frosting
steps: In large bowl of mixer, stir together sugar, cocoa and salt. Add boiling water, vanilla and soft butter.
Stir together, then beat until smooth and light.
This frosting will seem thin at first but thickens while beating.
Makes about 3 cups.
Can be stored, covered in refrigerator.
When wanted, let soften at room temperature before spreading.

title: Blueberry Mumbles

ingredients.name: or c.
ingredients.raw: 3 or 4 c. fresh or frozen blueberries

steps: Mix flour and sugar together for top of berries.
Mix all other ingredients together until crumbly.
Press 3/4 of crumb mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put berries on top.
Mix the 3/4 cup sugar, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/3 cup flour and sprinkle over berries.
Sprinkle remaining reserved crumble mix over top of berry and sugar mix.
Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes until berries bubble through crumbs and they look golden brown.

title: Cheese Cupcakes
steps: Place 1 vanilla wafer in each foil liner (bake cups).
Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until well blended.
Add eggs; mix well.
Pour into foil liners.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: So Simple Baked Beans
steps: Wash and pick over beans.
Place in crock-pot.
Mix seasonings with part of water.
Pour over beans.
Bury bacon and onion in beans.
Add rest of water.
Cover and cook on low heat 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.raw: chicken breasts, boned (1/2 breast per person)

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup

steps: Arrange dried beef on bottom of casserole dish.
Wrap a strip around rolled up chicken breasts.
Place over dried beef.
Spread undiluted soup over all and cover.
Bake 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.
Baste several times.
Bake at 325°.

title: Ground Beef And Cabbage Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet.
Drain.
Shred cabbage.
(May use more or less.)
Layer the meat and shredded cabbage in casserole dish.
Pour tomato soup on top (undiluted).
You may stir slightly.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Nacho Dip(Creighton Favorite)
steps: Spread cream cheese in flat, round baking dish.
Add chili on top of cheese.
Top with shredded cheese and bake at 325° until hot.
Do not cover.
Serve warm with white nacho chips.
Yum, yum!

title: Ranch House Steak
steps: Trim excess fat from meat and slash edges of meat.
Combine flour, mustard, salt and pepper and coat meat.
Brown meat in oil; remove the meat and add flour mixture that remains.
Add a little water and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook until thick.
Replace meat in gravy and simmer 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mary'S Candied Fruit Cake
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in large bowl. Add pineapple, cherries and dates. Mix with hands until well incorporated. Beat 4 eggs until frothy; gradually beat in 1 cup sugar. Add to fruit mixture; mix well. Add pecans and mix well. Grease loaf pans and pack mixture in very firmly.
Bake at 275° for 1 hour. Don't overbake. Turn out on rack and cool.

title: Breakfast Cake
steps: Combine first four ingredients and keep out 1/2 cup for the top of cake.
Add liquid to crumb mixture.
Beat well and top with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Taco Bake

ingredients.name: ground beef turkey
ingredients.raw: 1 lb. ground beef, turkey or venison

steps: In skillet, over medium heat, cook meat until brown. Drain. Add soup, salsa, milk, tortillas and half of the cheese.
Spoon into 2 quart shallow baking dish.
Cover.
Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Serves 4.

title: Super Easy Rolls
steps: Dissolve oleo in boiling water with sugar and salt.
Set aside and cool to lukewarm.
Put yeast in 1/2 cup warm water (better too cool than too hot).
Add liquids and egg to flour.
Mix well and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Make 4 balls of dough.
Roll out in shape of pie crust.
Cut into 8 wedges.
Rol big side toward small point.
Let rise 2 hours in warm place.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Apple Burritos Casserole
steps: Mix together the pie filling, 2 teaspoons of cinnamon and nutmeg.
Place a spoonful in a flour tortilla and roll, closing both ends.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

title: Golden Hominy Casserole
steps: Saute oleo, and onions.
Add hominy and Cheese Whiz.
Dilute mushroom soup with 1 can milk.
Combine with other ingredients. Pour into a baking dish and layer with crushed Fritos.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Crabmeat Party Dip
steps: Pour cocktail sauce over square cream cheese.
Put crabmeat on top (sprinkled generously).
Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Sour Cream Sugar Cookie
steps: Cream together oleo, sugar and eggs.
Mix all ingredients well; roll and bake.

title: Butter Horns
steps: Heat milk to scalding; add margarine, sugar and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast and stir until dissolved.
Add eggs and then flour.
Mix to a smooth, soft dough.
Knead lightly on floured surface.
Place dough in a greased bowl; cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.
Divide dough into thirds.
Roll each third on floured surface to the size of a 9-inch pie pan. Cut each round in 12 wedges.
Roll each triangle, starting with wide end, and rolling to center.

title: Sugar Peanuts
steps: Put in frying pan (large).
Stir until all water is gone, then pour out in flat pan and put in oven at 300° for 25 minutes. Stir every 5 minutes.
When they look dry, they are ready.
Cool and serve.

title: Chutney
steps: Boil all ingredients together until thickened to jam consistency.
Cool and serve over cream cheese on crackers.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
steps: Combine eggs and pumpkin.
Blend in sugar, spice and flour; mix well.
Add milk; mix well.
Pour into pie crusts.
Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool, serve with whipped cream, if desired.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Kettle Roast
steps: Melt drippings in heavy iron skillet.
Season the meat with the ginger, salt and pepper and sear well on all sides.
Add bay leaves, cloves, onion and water.
Cover tightly and let simmer about 4 1/2 hours or until tender.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Hot Punch
steps: Combine ingredients in crock-pot to heat.
No need to add sugar.

title: Soup Up Hamburger
steps: Cook hamburger and drain.
Stir in gumbo soup, chicken soup, and mushroom soup.
Add a little mustard.
Serve over toast.

title: Magic Meat Loaf
steps: Mix water and 1 tablespoon ketchup; add crumbs.
Allow to soak.
Add chopped onion.
Blend with mayonnaise and mix well. Add remaining ketchup.
Mix well with chopped meat.
Form into a loaf.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Reese'S Squares
steps: Melt margarine on stove, blend with peanut butter and powdered sugar until mixture becomes smooth and creamy.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Then melt chocolate chips and pour over peanut butter mixture.
Refrigerate and cut into squares.

title: Cream Filled Chocolate Cookie Ice Cream Pie
steps: Mix crushed cookies and margarine to form crust.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread ice cream over cookies, then spread fudge topping over ice cream.
Spread Cool Whip on top.
Freeze for 2 hours.
Ready to serve.

title: Judy'S Crab Dip
steps: Cut the drained crabmeat into the cream cheese and salsa. Don't mix.
Serve with crackers.

title: Beef Chowder

ingredients.name: cream of celery soup
ingredients.raw: 2 (10.5 oz.) cans cream of celery soup

steps: Cook beef and vegetables until beef is browned; drain.
Add remaining ingredients and 1/2 teaspoon salt (optional).
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Leftovers may be frozen. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Rosemary Potato Soup
steps: Cube and boil potatoes until tender.
Drain water.
Mash potatoes and add onion and butter.
Add rosemary and gradually pour in milk until desired thickness.
Stir together well and place on low heat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tuna Chow Mein
steps: Butter a casserole dish and line with half of chow mein noodles.
Mix all of the ingredients, except remaining half of noodles, which you place on top of mixture.
Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.

title: Good-Good Roast
steps: Place
roast
on heavy-duty aluminum foil.
Spread half soup and onion soup mix over roast.
Salt and pepper roast and add steak
sauce.
Turn
roast
over
and spread other half of soup on the top side with dry soup mix and sauce.
Wrap roast and seal. Bake at 350° until desired doneness.

title: Green Chili Casserole

ingredients.name: corn tortilla in fourth
ingredients.raw: 1 pkg. corn tortillas, cut in fourths

steps: Brown ground beef and onion.
Add green chilies, soups and milk.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
In greased casserole, alternate layers of tortillas, meat mixture and cheese.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Let stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Cauliflower

ingredients.name: onion cook and drain well
ingredients.raw: 2 c. onions, cook and drain well

ingredients.name: cucumber let stand in salt water hour.
ingredients.raw: 8 c. cucumbers, let stand in salt water for 1 hour.

steps: Boil
for
20 minutes.
Cook cauliflower before you add to the rest of ingredients.

title: Carrot Hash Browns

ingredients.name: carrot and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium carrots, peeled and finely grated

ingredients.name: all purpose potato and
ingredients.raw: 3 medium all-purpose potatoes, peeled and finely grated

steps: Cube potatoes. Salt and pepper them, then cut margarine into small pieces and place on top.
Place in preheated 400° oven. Cook for about 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Amount of margarine used depends on amount of potatoes used.

title: Three-Week Slaw
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let stand.
Mix the remaining ingredients and boil, stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over cabbage mixture. Store, covered, in refrigerator for 3 weeks.

title: Shrimp Salad Petites

ingredients.name: black olive
ingredients.raw: 1 small can sliced black olives, drained

steps: In a small bowl, combine shrimp, celery, green onions, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Put 1 teaspoonful shrimp salad on crackers or bread slices. Sprinkle with paprika and top with olive slices.
Makes about 1 dozen.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix

ingredients.name: amount of salt and pepper
ingredients.raw: small amount of salt and pepper

steps: Mix all together.
It makes the equivalent of one package of taco seasoning.

title: Artichoke Salad

ingredients.name: green onion
ingredients.raw: 1 bunch green onions, chopped (use green tops)

steps: Cook Rice-A-Roni according to directions on package.
Cool, then add all other ingredients.
Pour juice from artichokes over all and mix gently.
May be served hot or cold.
Serves 8.

title: Mashed Potato Salad
steps: Peel potatoes; cook in salted water.
Mash well.
Add all ingredients to potatoes.
Mix well.
Sprinkle celery seed on top. May add sliced boiled egg on top.

title: Hungarian Goulash

ingredients.name: beef stew
ingredients.raw: 2 lb. beef stew, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: In Dutch oven over medium-high heat in hot butter, cook onions, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Add stew meat, paprika, salt and bay leaf.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 3 hours or until meat is fork-tender, stirring occasionally.
Discard bay leaf.
Stir in sour cream.
Serve over noodles.
Makes 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Salad

ingredients.name: pineapple in juice
ingredients.raw: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks in juice

steps: Drain pineapple and oranges.
Combine all ingredients.
Fold in yogurt and chill.
Serves 4 to 6.
Very good.

title: Chicken Breasts In Sour Cream
steps: Wrap chicken breasts with bacon; arrange in casserole.
Mix soup and sour cream and put on top of breasts.
Bake at 275° for 3 hours.

title: Mock Steak
steps: Mix hamburger, cracker crumbs and milk together.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Let set overnight in refrigerator.
Cut into squares.
Roll squares in flour and brown.
Cover with 2 cans soup and water.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes in jackets in salt water until tender.
May be stored in refrigerator for several days.
Shred potatoes; put in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix together soup, sour cream, margarine, onion, salt and pepper.
Pour over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle grated cheese and some bread crumbs over top.
Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Sour Cream Apple Dip
steps: Core and slice apples.
Soak in pineapple juice to prevent browning when exposed to air.
Combine sour cream, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Add sugar and cinnamon to taste.
Serve with sliced apples.

title: Nippy Oyster Crackers
steps: Mix well together and stir into 36 ounces of oyster crackers (3 bags).
Stir every 10 minutes for 2 hours.
Store in Tupperware container.

title: "Installation Punch"
steps: Mix water and add sugar until sugar dissolves.
Add remaining ingredients.
Use 1 1/2-quarts of ginger ale to one gallon. Yields 100 people.

title: Eggplant Fritters
steps: Combine all ingredients, mixing well, and drop by teaspoons into hot oil.
Brown and drain.

title: Indian Fire Dip

ingredients.name: or jar hot salsa dip
ingredients.raw: 1 (10 oz.) can or jar hot salsa dip

ingredients.name: corn chip tortilla chip
ingredients.raw: corn chips, tortilla chips or vegetable dippers

steps: In saucepan, combine all ingredients.
Heat until hot, 5 to 10 minutes.
Put in fondue pot or pot of your choice.
Serve warm with chips or vegetable dippers.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Crock-Pot Green Beans
steps: Chop bacon, fry with onion and green pepper.
Cook until tender.
Drain grease.
Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Season to taste with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat through for 2 hours.
Recipe may be reduced proportionally.

title: White Wine Punch
steps: Pre-chill all ingredients.
Combine and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Zucchini And Sausage Casserole
steps: Wash and trim ends of zucchini (don't peel).

Drop into boiling water and cook for 4 minutes. Drain and cut coarsely. Brown sausage meat (if using links, remove from casing) and onion. Mix all ingredients together, reserving 1/4 cup of the Parmesan cheese.
Put into baking dish; sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 40 to 45 minutes at 350°. Serves 8 as a side dish or 4 if served over rice.

title: Lemon Luscious Pie
steps: Prepare and bake pastry shell.
In medium saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch; mix well.
Stir in milk, lemon juice and egg yolks; cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Stir in butter and lemon peel.
Cool.
Fold in sour cream.
Spoon into cooled, baked pie shell.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until set.
Store in refrigerator.

title: Hershey'S Frosting
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients at low speed until blended well. Add syrup slowly as you continue to mix.
Add only enough syrup to obtain the color you desire.

title: Bevy'S Baked Beans
steps: In large pan, heat oil and fry ham and onions until tender. Add the cans of beans.
Bring to boil with brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce to taste.
I use about 1/2 cup brown sugar and about 3 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce.
It's easy to increase recipe, just boil down to remove excess liquid, if you like them thick.
The longer they simmer the better they taste, but it can be done in 30 minutes and you never turned on the oven.

title: Portuguese Breakfast
steps: Cook bacon in a 10-inch skillet.
Remove bacon and pour off grease.
Chop up tomatoes into small pieces.
Put tomatoes into skillet and simmer until tomatoes are stewed (lots of liquid). Add cooked bacon to tomatoes (mix together).
Poach eggs in tomatoes and bacon.
As eggs cook, let some of the liquid cook off.
When eggs are firm, cut through all sections and place on toast.

title: Impossible Bacon Pie

ingredients.name: bacon crisply fried and
ingredients.raw: 12 slices bacon, crisply fried and crumbled

steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 10-inch quiche dish or pie plate, 10 x 1 1/2-inches.
Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in dish. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater.
Pour into dish.
Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes and then serve.

title: Trevin'S Play Dough
steps: Coloring:
Place 1 1/3 cups of coconut in a jar with 1 to 2 tablespoons of any flavor jello and shake well.

title: It'S A Snap Apple Pie
steps: Line medium size pan with graham crackers.
Add spices and sugar to taste to the applesauce.
Pour thin layer of applesauce mixture over graham crackers, then put another layer of graham crackers and then another layer of sauce.
Put a layer of graham crackers on top and top with Cool Whip.
Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours before serving.

title: Asparagus Bites
steps: Mix cream cheese with Blue cheese and egg until well blended. Trim crusts from bread, allowing one slice of bread per spear of asparagus.
Flatten bread with rolling pin.
Spread each slice with the cream cheese mixture.
Place an asparagus spear on each slice and roll up.
Cut each roll into thirds.
Dip in the melted butter.
(May be frozen at this stage.)
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Bake 30 minutes or until browned, if frozen.

title: Susan'S Stuffed Pork Chops
steps: Cut pocket into pork chop.
Fill with mixture of all other ingredients.
Fasten closed with toothpicks.
Sprinkle with flour, salt and pepper, and paprika.
Brown.
Add 1/4 cup water, cover, and cook on low heat 1 1/2 hours.
Turn chops once.

title: Peach Cobbler E-Z
steps: Combine egg, flour and sugar.
Stir until mixed well.
Pour peaches into pie pan.
Sprinkle entire contents of flour-sugar mixture over peaches.
In a saucepan, melt the butter and pour it over pie.
Bake until golden brown and crispy at an oven temperature of 350°; average cooking time is 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad

ingredients.name: orange bite size
ingredients.raw: 2 c. fresh sliced oranges, cut bite size

steps: Drain juice from oranges and strawberries.
Heat juice and melt marshmallows slowly in juice.
Soften cream cheese with a small amount of mayonnaise and add to hot marshmallow mixture. Cool.
Add fruits and remaining mayonnaise.
Fold in whipped cream.
Freeze in shallow pan.
Serves 12.

title: Bread Or Rolls

ingredients.name: rapidrise yeast
ingredients.raw: 2 pkg. RapidRise yeast (I have used the other and it does fine, also)

steps: As you mix, add additional flour, stirring the bowl often. Add up to 5 1/2 cups of flour for rolls.
Add about 6 cups for bread.
If you have a strong mixer with a dough hook, you won't need to knead it.
Then pour your rather firm mixture onto a pastry cloth that has been floured.
Knead only to be able to make a ball.
Cover with plastic wrap and let it sit 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Crock-Pot Pork Chops
steps: Soak chops in salt water (1 tablespoon salt to enough water to cover chops) for 15 minutes.
This removes blood from the meat. Remove chops from water; pat dry with paper towels.
Brown chops in frying pan.
Place potatoes (washed and sliced lengthwise, with skins on) in bottom of crock-pot.
Mix soup with water; stir in the garlic and pepper seasoning.
Pour soup mixture over potatoes in crock-pot.
After chops are browned, place chops in soup mixture in crock-pot.
Cover; let cook on high for 4 hours or on low heat for 8 hours.

title: Shrimp Butter
steps: Blend all ingredients with mixer.
Add shrimp.
Chill and serve.

title: Orange Biscuits
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients then margarine; mix until crumbly. Make a hole in center.
Add peel.
Add orange juice and milk. Stir until dough clings.
Knead dough to 10 to 12 strokes on flour surface, then roll out dough.
Cut out biscuits.
Place in greased pan.
Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Divine
steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Place butter in an 8 x 12-inch baking pan and let melt in oven (or microwave).
Put broccoli in dish.
Top with layer of chicken.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.
Pour over meat.
Top with shredded cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and reheated.
Serves about 6.

title: Cocktail Franks
steps: Cut franks bite size.
Heat sauce; add franks.
Cook about 30 minutes.
Keep hot.

title: Chicken-Noodle Casserole
steps: Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo.
First cook chicken (save broth).
Bone and skin chicken.
Cut in bite size pieces.
Cook noodles in broth.
Mix all together until cheese is slightly melted.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Vegetables

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.raw: soy sauce or Tabasco to taste

ingredients.name: use your favorite veggy turnip broccoli cauliflower garlic pepper zucchini summer squash mushroom
ingredients.raw: use your favorite veggies: turnips, broccoli, cauliflower, garlic, peppers, zucchini, summer squash, mushrooms)

steps: Preheat oven to 475°.
Melt oil and butter in roasting pan large enough so that vegetables rest on bottom of pan.
Adjust oil and butter to amount of vegetables.
Using tongs, turn cut sides of longest cooking vegetables down to seal in juices (potatoes, onions, turnips).
Roast 15 minutes.
Toss once or twice.
Add medium cooking vegetables (broccoli, summer squash) and pour soy sauce (or other favorite sauce) to coat.
Roast 15 minutes.
Add mushrooms and any seasonings.
Toss lightly.
Roast 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve with cornbread.

title: Coca Cola Punch
steps: Combine lemons, water and sugar.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.
Serves 25 children.

title: Layered Mint Chocolate Fudge

ingredients.name: drop green
ingredients.raw: 1 drop green or red food coloring

steps: In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips with 1 cup sweetened condensed milk; add vanilla.
Spread half the mixture into wax paper lined 8 or 9-inch square pan.
Chill 10 minutes or until firm.
Hold remaining chocolate mixture at room temperature. In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt white baking pieces with remaining sweetened condensed milk (mixture will be thick).
Add peppermint extract and food coloring.
Spread on chilled chocolate layer.
Chill 10 minutes or until firm.
Spread reserved chocolate mixture on mint layer.
Chill 2 hours.

title: Mammaw'S Paint Remover
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Brush on wood with paintbrush.
Let stand 2 hours.
Wash off with water hose.
Keep in shade until dry. Mix only 1 making at a time.
Be sure not to get this on your skin. It burns.

title: Ginger And Peach Chicken

ingredients.name: boned chicken breast half
ingredients.raw: 4 medium (12 oz. total) boned, skinless chicken breast halves

ingredients.name: peach in light syrup
ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz.) can peach slices in light syrup

ingredients.name: ginger root
ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp. grated ginger root or 1/8 tsp. ground ginger

ingredients.name: water chestnut
ingredients.raw: 1/2 (8 oz.) can (1/2 c.) sliced water chestnuts, drained

ingredients.name: pea pod and
ingredients.raw: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen pea pods, cooked and drained

steps: Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray coating.
Preheat skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken.
Cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender and no longer pink; turn to brown evenly.
Remove from skillet and keep warm.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls

ingredients.name: hi ho cracker
